One moment she's there, and the next there's just a cascade of glimmering blue flame sizzling on the sheets, cool heat caressing your skin as embers spill out in great gouts onto the both of you. As Hotaru and you sit there awhile, gasping, the last embers of what used to be her simulacrum wink out with a sensual caress upon your skin. "[pc.ra kitsune |Forgive me, your Eminence |Sorry about that ]," Hotaru says, looking up at you with a sheepish grin and the sweat off her brow. Another moment of silence, the tboth of you staring at each other as her bosom rises and falls. "I guess I couldn't keep focus under... well..." Oh, there's no need to apologize at all. If anything, you consider it a compliment that you were able to fluster such a talented vixen to this degree. But yes, she looked like she was enjoying herself even while you were fisting not-her from behind — you don't suppose she did one of those things where she feels what her creation does? Hotaru gives you a sheepish smile. "[pc.ra kitsune |If I had, I would not have been able to maintain the duplicate for as long as I had, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. That would have been upsetting for the both of us, would it not? Certainly, it would have been nice to be in her place, but I can get that from my benefactors. A chance to be with someone as esteemed as you should be better spent on more private and perverse fantasies, should it not? |Nope. As fun as getting my brains fucked out would've been, I'm sure I wouldn't have lasted long under such a performance, and it wouldn't have been well for either of us. Not that I mind getting pushed into the ground like some kind of animal, but I can do things with you that I can't with my other benefactors, and that's a chance I'm not about to pass up. ]. Besides, you dealt with the poor creature so thoroughly that I could feel it anyway without the need for any mystical link or shared senses, so..." Well, that makes sense. So, this is her deepest, most perverse desire, then? Coaching others to get fingered and fisted while getting off to it? "Not just take get fucked,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ] but to do it well in the bargain," Hotaru purrs, swishing her tails. "There is a certain satisfaction to introducing another to pleasures you've personally had, and in passing on the art of serving others better. [pc.ra kitsune |If it pleases you, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, then I would be more than happy to perform for you sometime |If seeing me do this excites you... well, you just have to ask again next time, since I'll always be up ]." ] "

rows.original: You approach Hotaru's home, curious to see what the mischief maker is up to between her usual work and storytelling. You've dismissed your companions to wander as they see fit[party.has Kiyoko |, though Kiyoko stands beside you, quietly supportive and stubborn, as is her way while walking amongst her people ]. Stepping up to the sliding door, you [pc.ra kitsune |clap your hands outside |rap a knuckle on the wood ] — not that she ever answers or comes to greet you, but at least you make yourself known. With that courtesy out of the way, you step into her home with practiced ease, deftly avoiding the many scattered objects that make up the seamstress' messy existence. Hotaru herself sits at the low table in the main room, the space uncharacteristically clear of clutter as the vixen has set aside her pins and needles. The black-furred seamstress is deep in thought, her head in her hand as she bends over a letter. Her tails writhe in agitation as she mumbles under her breath. It takes a few seconds before she notices you[party.has Kiyoko | and Kiyoko ], her previously sour expression lighting up as she sees you[party.has Kiyoko | both ]. "Ah, [pc.isKitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ][party.has Kiyoko |, Myobu-sama ]." [pc.ra kitsune |Hotaru stands and gives a practiced bow, four poofy tails folding behind her as they counterbalance the weight of her clothing |[party.has kiyoko |Hotaru stands and gives a practiced bow, four poofy tails folding behind her as they counterbalance the weight of her clothing |An uncertain smile tars Hotaru's usual good humor as she waves you over ] ]. "Your dropping by is unexpected, but as it turns out, I was just thinking of you. Care to join me?" She's uncharacteristically serious today. What's the matter? Hotaru settles in her cushion, her ears flattening and mouth pinching in a grimace as she ponders how to answer your question. Mumbling to herself, she rocks in her seat and rests her head back in her hands, [pc.ra kitsune |unable to muster any more formalities past her greeting |then heaves a huge sigh ]. "I've received a letter from my father and mother..." They're out exploring and looking for %"The Motherlode" with Kohaku's parents and others, aren't they? "Ha. Yes, that's right. They've recently sent me yet another a letter recounting their travels, which aren't going to plan; carelessness and unfortunate events have made their recent adventures more dangerous than usual. They thrive off of environments like that, but they aren't as quick or spry as they used to be. Both have expressed wanting to come back to the colonies: 'our adventuring days are coming to a close,' they write." Hotaru looks down at the letter once again, her normally vivid red eyes dulled by pity and sadness. She picks up the thin paper between delicate fingers. "Mother hasn't been very direct about it, but more often in her letters she writes about their close calls. Both of them have written to me that they love me more times in the past two years than in the first ten they set out. They ask about how I'm getting along with others and if I've met someone nice. They ask about the possibility of grandchildren..." Hotaru sighs and rubs her cheeks. "I can imagine their faces, scrunched up in worry when I tell them that I've been doing quite well by myself and that my last suitor has been avoiding me ever since I lit one of his tails on fire." The black-furred vixen shoots you a sharp glare for less than a second, the meaning of %"don't ask" very swiftly communicated.[party.has Kiyoko | You hear Kiyoko give a slight chuckle behind you. ] Clicking her tongue, the normally energetic vixen tosses the letter back onto the table. It's not hard to see by the twitching of her ears or the swirling of her tails that this topic agitates her. "They're aware that at some point, their luck's going to run out, and then they won't be coming back. I've heard and read this before, but they've never been this heavy handed about it. I'm... worried. Not only for them to come back home safely, but for them to have something to come back to, other than their wayward daughter. I just... I don't know if I'm ready to take that leap yet." Hotaru looks at you with unsure eyes. So... you get the feeling Hotaru's trying to be subtle, and it doesn't suit her. Why doesn't she tell you what she really wants? "We've been together for a while, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ], and against all my expectations I've yet to set fire to you intentionally or accidentally. If there's anyone I'd want to [pc.mf |father |sire ] a kit on me, it would be you." You have to admit, it's very Hotaru-like for her to ask for something like this so plainly, abrupt as it may be even by her standards. One has to wonder why she'd think there's a chance you'd be amenable to the idea, though. A small, worried smile plays on Hotaru's lips. "Word gets around in a small place like this, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |you know ]. Doubly so when you're speaking with one of the people who ensures said word has legs. Although few will say it to your face, rest assured that everyone's aware of your recent dalliances with the den's women and the fruits thereof[kohaku.anyKids |, especially when the little golden gremlin's been showing off that miniature copy of herself to anyone who'll give her the time of day ]." Well... when she puts it that way, one has to admit it's not that big a leap for her to ask the same favor of you. "Since you've done it before, I know you aren't categorically against the idea[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]," Hotaru sighs. "The only question is... would you, please?"
rows.translation: 你走向萤火虫的家，好奇地想看看这个爱捣蛋的孩子在平时工作和讲故事之外又在搞什么名堂。你让同伴自己去随意活动，自己则独自走了过来。[party.has Kiyoko |尽管清子始终站在你身边，默默地给予支持，同时也坚持着自己的立场——这正是她在自己的族人中行事时的一贯方式。 ]走到滑动门前，你[pc.ra kitsune |到外面去拍手吧。 |用指关节敲击木头 ] — 虽然她从来不会回应你，也不会出来迎接你，但至少你会主动表明自己的存在。有了这种礼貌的举动，你就能轻松地走进她的家，巧妙地避开那些散落在各处的物品，这些物品正是这位裁缝杂乱生活环境的象征。 萤本人正坐在主房间里的那张矮桌前，这个平时总是杂乱无章的地方此刻出奇地整洁——因为那个狡黠的女子把所有针线活都收了起来。这位皮肤黝黑、身着黑色工作服的缝纫师正陷入沉思，她双手托着头，低头看着那封信。她的尾巴焦躁地扭动着，同时低声嘟囔着什么。过了几秒钟，她才注意到你的存在。[party.has Kiyoko | 还有清子 ]看到你时，她原本阴沉的表情立刻变得明亮起来。[party.has Kiyoko | 两者都 ]啊， [pc.isKitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ][party.has Kiyoko |宫部大人 ]。" [pc.ra kitsune |萤站起身来，熟练地行了一个礼，她身后飘动着四根蓬松的尾巴，这些尾巴巧妙地平衡了她衣物的重量。 |[party.has kiyoko |萤站起身来，熟练地行了一个礼，她身后飘动着四根蓬松的尾巴，这些尾巴平衡了她衣物的重量。 |萤原本总是面带笑容，充满活力，但此刻，她露出一个不确定的微笑，然后招手让你过去。 ] ]你突然来访真是让我有些意外，不过说实话，我刚才确实在想着你。愿意陪我一起吗？” 她今天的态度异常认真，到底发生了什么事呢？ 热灯笼坐在垫子上，耳朵贴在身上，嘴巴紧抿着，似乎在认真思考该如何回答你的问题。她自言自语地坐在那里，把头靠在双手上。 [pc.ra kitsune |在她打完招呼之后，便再也无法维持任何正式的态度了。 |然后他深深地叹了口气。 ]我收到了父母寄来的信……” 他们现在应该和琥珀的父母以及其他人一起出去探险，寻找‘宝藏’吧？ “哈，没错。他们最近又给我寄来了一封信，讲述了他们的冒险经历。他们的行程原本安排得很周密，但由于疏忽和一些意外事件，这次冒险变得比平时更加危险了。它们在这样的环境中得以生存，但已经不再像过去那样敏捷灵活了。它们都表示希望能够回到殖民地：“我们的冒险时光即将结束，”它们这样写道。 热灯再次低头看着那封信，她那原本充满生机的红色眼睛此刻因怜悯与悲伤而变得黯淡无光。她用纤细的手指拾起了那张薄纸。 “母亲并没有直截了当地表达这一点，但在她的信中，经常会提到他们那些险些发生危险的时刻。他们在过去两年里写信给我的次数，比他们相识的最初十年还要多。他们问我和其他人的相处情况，问我是否遇到了某个不错的人，还问我有没有可能会有孙子或孙女……" 萤叹了口气，揉了揉自己的脸颊。 “我可以想象到，当我告诉他们我独自一人过得还不错，而且自从我把那个追求我的人的尾巴点着之后，他就再也不敢靠近我时，他们该是什么表情——肯定都会忧心忡忡的。” 那只黑毛狐妖用锐利的目光瞥了你一眼，那一瞬间就传达出了“别问”的意思。[party.has Kiyoko | 你听到身后有纪代子轻轻笑了起来。 ]她吐了吐舌头，这个平时充满活力的狐妖把那封信又扔回了桌上。从她耳朵的抽动以及尾巴的摆动来看，这个话题显然让她非常不安。 “他们心里明白，总有一天，他们的运气会耗尽，到那时，他们就再也不会回来了。我之前也听说过这类事情，但从来没见过他们采取如此严厉的措施。我真的很担心……不仅担心他们能否安全回家，更担心他们回家后还能有什么可以依靠的，毕竟他们的女儿并不听话。我只是……还不确定自己是否已经准备好迈出那一步。 萤用充满犹豫的眼神看着你。 所以……你能感觉到萤其实是在试图委婉表达自己的意思，但这种表达方式并不适合她。为什么她不直接告诉你她到底想说什么呢？真的我们在一起已经有一段时间了， [pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] |[pc.name] ]出乎我的所有预料，我至今既没有故意也没有无意中点燃你。如果说有谁我真正想要[pc.mf |父亲 |陛下 ]如果我身上带着某个东西，那肯定就是你。” 你得承认，以她的性格，这么直截了当地提出这样的要求，确实很符合她的风格。不过，让人不禁疑惑的是，她为什么会认为你可能会同意这个想法呢？ 萤的嘴角浮现出一丝担忧的微笑：“在这种小地方，消息传播得可快了[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |你知道的 ]尤其是当你与那些负责让这些传言传播开来的人交谈时，这种感觉会更加明显。虽然很少有人会当面跟你说这些，但可以肯定的是，每个人都知道你最近与那些女性发生了些什么，以及由此产生的一些后果。[kohaku.anyKids |尤其是当那个小金色的小精灵总是向任何愿意搭理她的人展示她那个微型版本的自己时…… ]嗯……既然她这么说了，也得承认，她请你帮这个忙其实也没什么不合理的。 “既然你之前已经做过这种事，我就知道你并不是完全反对这个想法。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]萤叹了口气，说道：‘唯一的问题是……你愿意吗？

rows.translation: 这至少是一次发自内心的恳求。

rows.original: Hotaru shouldn't rush into something this drastic, but on the other hand you don't want to leave her out to dry, either. Maybe you could try to set them up together?
rows.translation: 萤本来不应该这么草率地做出这样的决定，但另一方面，你也不想让她陷入困境。或许你可以试着为他们牵线搭桥呢？
rows.raw: "Hotaru shouldn't rush into something this drastic, but on the other hand you don't want to leave her out to dry, either. Maybe you could try to set them up together?"

rows.original: Hotaru shouldn't rush into things for her parents' sake.
rows.translation: 为了她的父母，萤不应该贸然行事。
rows.raw: "Hotaru shouldn't rush into things for her parents' sake."

rows.original: You will. If she wants it that badly, then you absolutely will. Hotaru freezes, her ears flicking upwards, then blinks slowly. "E-eh? I — you —" Come now, she's clearly planned this out way in advance. Surely she's not the type to imagine that she wouldn't get this far? "I did, so many times, but..." the black-furred vixen exhales in a low gasp, still woozy from the sudden shock. "I... I didn't think you'd agree this easily[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence. The divine champion is supposed to have standards, after all, and I'm just a shut-in ]." Several dozen ways she schemed your answer and how she'd react to it, and not once did something like this ever cross her mind? Well, Hotaru is a storyteller, after all, and straight answers like the one you just gave aren't melodramatic enough to make a good story. But... they are quite charming in and of themselves, aren't they? "...You...!" Maybe, just maybe, she doesn't have to talk you into it. Kitsune tales are full of cleverness and outsmarting the proud, but never do they imagine that one would untie a knot by simply cutting through it. You reach out for Hotaru, glad for the ample leverage the seamstress' body provides as you hook your fingers under her arms and pull her forward around the table. Still not quite believing that she's gotten what she wanted, she stumbles and collapses into your arms, faceplanting right into your [pc.chest] until she gets a grip on herself and pushes herself up. Your eyes meet, and in that moment Hotaru doesn't know whether to sigh in relief or scowl. Well? You're sure she had so much fun dreaming up the ways she'd cajole you, [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |a feckless [pc.race] ], into giving her a kit against your better judgement, didn't she? Not when this is far more deliberate and thought-through than... well, the other times it's happened, right? "I couldn't sleep at night," she mumbles. Hotaru watches you closely, looking for any inkling of a sigh, a lecture, or perhaps horrified amusement — any reaction from you she can exploit to return to the script she's so meticulously written in her mind. "My gift wouldn't let me." Too bad, you'll have to take this small pleasure from her. Hotaru's too busy scrutinizing you, she doesn't notice your hand coming up under her chin — and when you finally lift it to force her gaze on you, the seamstress squirms, her body growing palpably warmer with the cool heat of foxfire. Eyeing you is one thing, being made to so do is another, and as Hotaru instinctively tries in vain to break eye contact, you take advantage of her mid-falter to pull her lips to yours. Hotaru's gift spins, half a dozen inane thoughts and schemes colliding against each other in a mind that produces half the den's gossip. And when you finally pull back, thumb stroking her rosy cheek, there's just the tiniest flicker of contrition in her expression. "It really is that simple, is it...?" You let the mischief maker sink down, and pat her firmly between her ears; her tails swish to and fro, seeking — and finding — purchase [pc.ra kitsune |as they wind about your own |on your legs ]. Tightness mounts in Hotaru's body as she tries to come up with a clever deflection, a way to regain control of the scheme that's gone awry, but her mind's blank as a desperate aching flares up in her lower belly. This is exactly what she wanted, but... "It's not supposed to happen this way," she moans. Does it matter? "Y-you can't just agree when I'm supposed to be seducing you! That's cheating! Can't you just put up even a little token resistance?" [pc.ra kitsune |Well, you are the divine champion, after all. Isn't being outsmarted by you almost as good as doing the outsmarting to begin with? Sometimes the best winning move is not to play |Oh no. You have no idea about this miserably complex web of social etiquette, so you're just going to plow straight through without regard for this poor creature in your arms and the consequences ]. And to be frank, you've never quite seen Hotaru like this before — it's quite amusing, one has to admit. And this is all it took? Hotaru moans again, thighs trembling; by the heat in her belly and cheeks, it's easy to tell that the overplanned thrill of her intended mischief's gone, replaced by a dizzying, insistent warmth pouring out from her gift. She hasn't burst into flames yet, but it wouldn't surprise you if she did. You have a great time turning the tables on this mischief maker, getting dangerously close to the point of being sexual, yet not quite there — pinching her cheeks, patting her head, grabbing her tail and then letting go — seeing how far Hotaru can go before she explodes is dangerous, to make an understatement, but if not now, then when?

rows.raw: " You will. If she wants it that badly, then you absolutely will. Hotaru freezes, her ears flicking upwards, then blinks slowly. "E-eh? I — you —" Come now, she's clearly planned this out way in advance. Surely she's not the type to imagine that she wouldn't get this far? "I did, so many times, but..." the black-furred vixen exhales in a low gasp, still woozy from the sudden shock. "I... I didn't think you'd agree this easily[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence. The divine champion is supposed to have standards, after all, and I'm just a shut-in ]." Several dozen ways she schemed your answer and how she'd react to it, and not once did something like this ever cross her mind? Well, Hotaru is a storyteller, after all, and straight answers like the one you just gave aren't melodramatic enough to make a good story. But... they are quite charming in and of themselves, aren't they? "...You...!" Maybe, just maybe, she doesn't have to talk you into it. Kitsune tales are full of cleverness and outsmarting the proud, but never do they imagine that one would untie a knot by simply cutting through it. You reach out for Hotaru, glad for the ample leverage the seamstress' body provides as you hook your fingers under her arms and pull her forward around the table. Still not quite believing that she's gotten what she wanted, she stumbles and collapses into your arms, faceplanting right into your [pc.chest] until she gets a grip on herself and pushes herself up. Your eyes meet, and in that moment Hotaru doesn't know whether to sigh in relief or scowl. Well? You're sure she had so much fun dreaming up the ways she'd cajole you, [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |a feckless [pc.race] ], into giving her a kit against your better judgement, didn't she? Not when this is far more deliberate and thought-through than... well, the other times it's happened, right? "I couldn't sleep at night," she mumbles. Hotaru watches you closely, looking for any inkling of a sigh, a lecture, or perhaps horrified amusement — any reaction from you she can exploit to return to the script she's so meticulously written in her mind. "My gift wouldn't let me." Too bad, you'll have to take this small pleasure from her. Hotaru's too busy scrutinizing you, she doesn't notice your hand coming up under her chin — and when you finally lift it to force her gaze on you, the seamstress squirms, her body growing palpably warmer with the cool heat of foxfire. Eyeing you is one thing, being made to so do is another, and as Hotaru instinctively tries in vain to break eye contact, you take advantage of her mid-falter to pull her lips to yours. Hotaru's gift spins, half a dozen inane thoughts and schemes colliding against each other in a mind that produces half the den's gossip. And when you finally pull back, thumb stroking her rosy cheek, there's just the tiniest flicker of contrition in her expression. "It really is that simple, is it...?" You let the mischief maker sink down, and pat her firmly between her ears; her tails swish to and fro, seeking — and finding — purchase [pc.ra kitsune |as they wind about your own |on your legs ]. Tightness mounts in Hotaru's body as she tries to come up with a clever deflection, a way to regain control of the scheme that's gone awry, but her mind's blank as a desperate aching flares up in her lower belly. This is exactly what she wanted, but... "It's not supposed to happen this way," she moans. Does it matter? "Y-you can't just agree when I'm supposed to be seducing you! That's cheating! Can't you just put up even a little token resistance?" [pc.ra kitsune |Well, you are the divine champion, after all. Isn't being outsmarted by you almost as good as doing the outsmarting to begin with? Sometimes the best winning move is not to play |Oh no. You have no idea about this miserably complex web of social etiquette, so you're just going to plow straight through without regard for this poor creature in your arms and the consequences ]. And to be frank, you've never quite seen Hotaru like this before — it's quite amusing, one has to admit. And this is all it took? Hotaru moans again, thighs trembling; by the heat in her belly and cheeks, it's easy to tell that the overplanned thrill of her intended mischief's gone, replaced by a dizzying, insistent warmth pouring out from her gift. She hasn't burst into flames yet, but it wouldn't surprise you if she did. You have a great time turning the tables on this mischief maker, getting dangerously close to the point of being sexual, yet not quite there — pinching her cheeks, patting her head, grabbing her tail and then letting go — seeing how far Hotaru can go before she explodes is dangerous, to make an understatement, but if not now, then when? "

rows.original: So, what was she expecting? Long, drawn-out melodrama? Tearful begging? You finally, reluctantly giving in despite knowing better, and her being all smug at having wrapped you around her little finger despite the odds? "Mmmmh." What a delightfully non-committal answer. The sight of Hotaru's four tails swishing to and fro as you continue to pet her ears and smooch her forehead sparks an impish desire in your heart — as one reasons, it's no worse than what she intended to cajole you into doing, right? Pressing the advantage before she can right herself, you grab as much of the lush, silken fluff as you can when it next draws close, and pull. Of course, no kitsune in good standing with polite society would ever do such a thing, but happily [pc.ra kitsune |you're the Trickster's divine champion |you have no part of such contrivances ] and do as you please. The effect is instantaneous as the jolt of pleasure shoots into the base of Hotaru's spine, takes a detour about her womb, and finally reaches her mind. Hotaru blinks once, twice, then every muscle in the mischief-maker's goes slack as she melts into your embrace, stupefied bliss written all over her rosy cheeks. This wouldn't be so bad if she didn't also burst into flames in the bargain. It's quite the lightshow: one moment the air shimmers as if just above a stove, the next Hotaru's ablaze as she abandons all pretense of leashing her gift, even if unintentionally. Flames leap from her bare skin and seep up through her clothes, singing the heavy fabric, while wisps and embers dance and spin around her head with dizzying speed like ghostly lights. Hotaru being able to truly let go — it's not something she gets to go every day, and as seething flame pours from her skin all around her, the seamstress looses a sighing moan and wraps her arms around you. [pc.ra kitsune |You've foxfire of your own, so you're protected somewhat, but even so having Hotaru light up like her namesake while she mumbles incoherent regrets into your chest is concerning, to say the least |Unlike everything else, you don't start to smolder and char despite Hotaru's self-immolation, but leaving yourself at the mercy of Hotaru's mercurial gift isn't something you intend ]. Although she's a mess, Hotaru's instincts guide her through the steps; she's more than happy to obey the dull, insistent ache emanating from her lower belly and relinquish her clothes to you, squirming like one of her silk moths emerging from its cocoon and letting you gather her cast-offs. Five generations of colonial living have made her bare skin sumptuous and springy to the touch, but you need to focus on the task at hand. If Hotaru can deal with your [pc.armor] while having her unstable nature dominate her thoughts and riddle them with primal lusts, you have no excuse for handling her poorly. This clearly isn't the first time she's self-immolated — Hotaru's clothes are barely singed despite the sheer intensity of the cool heat rising from her body. Finally, an answer for why the fabric's so heavy: while Hotaru isn't in control of her gift, it falls to you to keep her under control. So be it. The black-furred vixen's so absorbed in her melancholy desire that you've already bound her wrists behind her back by the time she's realized what 's going on. Yet she doesn't resist, instead squirming excitedly as you do the knots, testing their strength — gently at first, then with increasingly rabid desire as the bindings hold. Tying Hotaru up with her own clothes is delightfully perverse, in a way — the heavy, fire-resistant fabric still forms her restraints, just in a different manner. It's no string or rope... but it feels so much more authentic to improvise from materials at hand, doesn't it? First her wrists and ankles, then a gag — don't want those sharp teeth of hers biting down on you, or worse, her own tongue in her excitement. Then there's the matter of her tails — [pc.ra kitsune |you could just tie them up, but occupying them with your own feels so much more intimate — and gives you no end of opportunities to tease Hotaru while at it |tying them together and then that to her back is a chore with how slippery she is, and you get the feeling you wouldn't have been able to do it if Hotaru didn't want to be trussed up like a farm animal ]. A blindfold? At this point, why not? When the eyes are blinded, the heart clearly sees; that's [pc.isDK |the kind of dramatic crap Hotaru loves, isn't it |something Hotaru would enjoy, wouldn't she ]? But at last, it's done. Blindfolded, gagged, tied up from head to tails [pc.ra kitsune |and that last constantly receiving a stream of low-key pleasure from your own |in a position that can only be described as animalistic ], Hotaru's just about ready. She's constantly testing her bonds, trying to pull or even outright burn through them, but while they won't last too long, it'll be long enough to get the job done. It really isn't that often that one as gifted as Hotaru gets to really let loose — trussed up as she is, that hasn't discouraged her self-immolation any — and perhaps being bound is paradoxically, when she feels the most free.
rows.translation: 那么，她究竟期待什么呢？冗长拖沓的闹剧吗？泪流满面的恳求吗？还是希望你最终尽管明知道不该如此，却还是勉强屈服，而她则能得意洋洋地认为自己尽管面临种种困难，却还是成功把你玩弄于股掌之间呢？ 嗯……” 多么含糊其辞、却让人感到愉悦的回答啊。当你继续抚摸她的耳朵、亲吻她的额头时，看到萤的四条尾巴来回摆动，你心中不禁涌起一股调皮的想法——仔细想想，这也不比她原本想用这些举动来诱使你做的事情更过分吧？在她还没来得及调整自己的姿势之前，你迅速抓住那片柔软、丝滑的绒毛，在它再次靠近时尽可能多地抓取它们。拉动当然，任何在良善社会中享有良好声誉的狐妖都不会做出这种事，但幸运的是[pc.ra kitsune |你是诡计之神的神圣使者 |你与这些阴谋诡计毫无关系。 ]随你便吧。那种愉悦感瞬间袭来，从萤的脊椎底部开始，绕过她的腹部，最终传达到她的大脑。萤眨了眨眼，又眨了眨眼，然后她身上每一个肌肉都变得松弛下来，整个人融进了你的怀抱中，她那红润的脸颊上写满了极致的幸福与陶醉。如果她不会因此在同一时刻也燃烧起来，这种情况也不会这么糟糕。 这一幕简直就像一场精彩的灯光秀：前一刻，空气还仿佛在炉子上方微微闪烁；下一刻，萤就全身着火了，她彻底放弃了控制自己这种能力的尝试，哪怕这种尝试是无意的。火焰从她裸露的皮肤上喷射而出，渗入她的衣物之中，使得那些厚重的布料仿佛也随之“歌唱”起来；而那些细小的火焰与余烬，则以令人眼花缭乱的速度在她头顶周围旋转、飞舞，宛如幽灵般的灯光。 萤，真的做到了放手吧 — 这可不是她每天都能经历的事情。当灼热的火焰从她的皮肤上蔓延开来时，那位缝纫师发出一声叹息，然后将双臂紧紧地搂住了你。 [pc.ra kitsune |你自身也拥有“狐火”，因此某种程度上是受到保护的，但即便如此，当萤像她名字所象征的那样亮起光芒，同时在你耳边喃喃自语着那些混乱而充满悔意的话语时，至少可以说，这确实让人感到担忧。 |与众不同，你尽管萤选择了自焚，但这些火焰并不会开始闷烧或炭化；然而，将自己置于萤这种变幻莫测的能力之下，显然并不是你所愿意接受的。 ]虽然她显得有些凌乱，但萤的本能引导她完成了这些步骤；她非常乐意听从从下腹部传来的那种持续不断的、隐约的疼痛感，脱掉自己的衣服交给你，就像一只正在破茧而出的丝蛾一样扭动身体，让你把她的旧衣服收好。五代人的殖民生活让她的裸露皮肤变得柔软而富有弹性，但你现在必须专注于手头的任务。如果萤能够配合你的话[pc.armor]尽管她那不稳定的性格始终主导着她的思想，让她的思绪中充满了原始的欲望，但你没有任何理由因此而对她不好。 显然，这已经不是她第一次自焚了——尽管她身上散发出的冷热能量极其强烈，但萤的衣服却几乎没有被烧焦。终于，我们明白了为什么那些布料会这么重：虽然萤无法控制自己的这种能力，但保护她的责任却落在了你的身上。她已经控制住了。 就这样吧。那只黑毛狐妖完全沉浸在她的忧郁与渴望之中，等到她意识到发生了什么时，你的手已经将她的手腕绑在了背后。然而，她并没有反抗，反而兴奋地扭动身体，让你一边系紧绳结，一边测试它们的牢固程度——起初还很轻柔，但随着绳结越来越紧，她的渴望也变得越来越强烈。用她自己的衣服将萤束缚起来，从某种意义上说，这种做法实在是一种令人愉悦的变态行为——那些厚实且防火的布料依然在起着束缚她的作用，只不过方式有所不同而已。这既不是绳子，也不是缆绳……但带来的束缚感却要强烈得多。真实的就是利用手头现有的材料即兴制作，对吧？ 首先是要固定她的手腕和脚踝，然后还要用东西堵住她的嘴——可不想让她那锋利的牙齿咬到人，更糟糕的是，她在兴奋的时候可能会咬到自己的舌头。至于她的尾巴……那也是需要处理的。 [pc.ra kitsune |你可以把它们绑起来就行了，但用自己的东西来装饰它们会让人感觉更加亲密——而且这样还能让你有无数机会逗弄萤呢。 |把它们联系起来，然后那个由于她的身手实在太灵活了，因此在背后抓住她实在是一件相当困难的事情。你会觉得，如果没有萤的帮助，自己根本不可能完成这个任务。想要被像家畜一样捆得严严实实 ]蒙上眼睛？在这个时候，为什么不呢？当双眼被遮住时，心灵反而能看得更清晰；就是这个道理。 [pc.isDK |就是那种萤喜欢的夸张戏剧性情节，对吧？ |应该是萤会喜欢的东西吧，对吧？ ]但最终，它还是完成了。被蒙住眼睛，被堵住嘴巴，从头部到脚部都被绑得严严实实。 [pc.ra kitsune |而最后那一点，就是能够持续从自己身上获得那种潜移默化的愉悦感。 |处于一种只能用“动物般的行为”来形容的状态 ]萤已经差不多准备好了。她一直在不断地测试那些束缚，试图拉扯它们，甚至试图彻底破坏它们，虽然这些束缚不会持续太久，但足够让她完成任务了。像萤这样天赋异禀的人，其实并没有太多机会能够真正释放自己——尽管被束缚着，但这并没有阻止她进行自我“燃烧”；或许，恰恰是在被束缚的时候，她才会感到最为自由。

And amidst the ashes of the aftermath, embers still burn, Hotaru murmuring endlessly to herself as she massages her lower belly...

rows.original: It's hard to tell how long it's been when you next stir — by how much your muscles complain, you could've been there for hours, if not most of the day. You must've pulled out of Hotaru sometime without either of you noticing; the seamstress remains curled up in your arms, and now that things have calmed down it's hard to avoid noticing the angry red marks on her body where she really struggled against her bindings. "Do they look that good[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]?" Hotaru murmurs. She tries to chuckle, but her breath isn't up to the task even now. "They'll fade, but until then I get to enjoy them." Did she get what she wanted out of all this? "Now, how am I supposed to know that?" Hotaru flops over to face you, her nose an inch or two from yours, her breath warm on your lips. Groaning softly, she arches her back and pushes her tummy against you, rubbing its gentle warmth up and down your side. "I... allowed it to happen, should it come to that, but whether it actually will take is another matter. Come back in a few weeks, and I may have an answer. If it didn't... maybe I'll need to convince you a second time." She sounds as if she's hoping for another go just so she can have the pleasure of convincing you to agree. "You really did surprise me with how you just went along with it[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. I didn't even need to resort to any of the measures I thought I'd have to." Hotaru may be well-versed in narrative structures, but having that knowledge doesn't mean she's exempt from them. And you note that despite being as intense as she can sometimes be... her gift was a lot less mean-spirited than it could have been. "I..." her breath warms, and she dips her head to nuzzle her nose against yours. "It's pretty hard to stay mad when you're getting what you want, even if it's not quite in the way you imagined.[silly | That's how you tame an unstable if redeemable villainness, one supposes — mating, impregnation and marriage. Don't try this at home, kids. ]" Tsk. So, she got the validation [pc.ra kitsune |from someone in authority ]she was seeking, and that grudge is satisfied? Merely a few hours in, and she's already starting to get soft and mellow out. By the time she's through, her gift will be solely relegated to cooking and heating baths. "Well, that..." the mirth drains from Hotaru's face. "That wouldn't be so bad. I've lived with myself for a decent while now, and it's starting to get tiring. But we'll cross that bridge when it comes — for now, I'll wait and hope to conceive." She just has to put it that way, doesn't she? "[pc.ra kitsune |Our |My ] mother tongue is quite straightforward when it comes to some things. But... stay with me a little while longer, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |please ]? I'm going to have to clean all of this up, and I want to make the price as worth it as I can..."
rows.translation: 下次你动弹的时候，很难判断已经过去了多久——从肌肉的酸痛程度来看，你可能已经在那里待了好几个小时，甚至几乎一整天。你一定是在两人都没察觉的时候从萤体内退了出来；那位裁缝仍然蜷在你怀里，而如今事情平息下来，实在很难不注意到她身上那些拼命挣扎时留下的红肿痕迹。 “这些痕迹看起来真的那么好看吗[pc.ra kitsune |，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]？”萤轻声说道。她试图笑出来，但此刻她的呼吸依然无法支持这样的动作。“它们会慢慢淡去，但在那之前，我可以好好享受它们。” 那么，她是否从这一切中得到了自己想要的东西呢？ “现在，我怎么可能知道呢？”萤翻过身来面对你，她的鼻子离你的只有一两英寸，她的呼吸温热地拂过你的嘴唇。她轻轻呻吟着，弓起背，把肚子贴在你身上，用那温柔的暖意在你的侧身上来回摩擦。“我……我是允许了这件事发生，如果事情真到了那一步的话，但它究竟会不会成，那又是另一回事了。过几周再来，我或许就能给你一个答案。如果没成……也许我就得再说服你一次了。” 她的语气听起来好像还在期待再有一次机会，好让她享受说服你同意的那种乐趣。 “你竟然就这样顺水推舟地答应了，真是让我吃惊[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]。我甚至都不需要动用我原本以为非用不可的那些手段。” 萤或许精通叙事结构，但拥有这种知识并不意味着她就能免受其支配。而且你也注意到，尽管她有时会表现得非常激烈……她这份礼物其实远没有本来可能的那样充满恶意。 “我……”她的呼吸变得温热，她低下头，把鼻子贴上你的鼻子。“当你得到自己想要的东西时，其实很难继续生气吧，即使它并不完全是你想象中的那种方式。[silly | 大概这就是驯服一个不稳定但尚可救赎的女反派的方法吧——交配、受孕，然后结婚。孩子们，可别在家里尝试这个。 ]” 啧。这么说，她得到了她一直寻求的、[pc.ra kitsune |来自权威人士的 ]认可，那份怨恨也就此满足了？才过了几个小时，她就已经开始变得柔软温和起来。等这一遭结束，她的天赋怕是要彻底沦落到做饭和烧洗澡水上了。 “嗯，那样的话……”萤脸上的笑意消失了。“那倒也未必是坏事。我和自己相处了相当长一段时间，也渐渐觉得累了。不过等真到那一步再说吧——现在，我只能等待，并盼着能怀上。” 她非得那样说不可，是吧？ “[pc.ra kitsune |我们的 |我的 ]母语在某些事情上确实相当直白。不过……请再陪我待一会儿，[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |拜托了 ]？我得把这一切都收拾干净，而我想让这个代价尽可能物有所值……”

rows.original:
You're sorry, but you'll have to decline. Unlike what happened in the other circumstances, Hotaru is actually doing this with a somewhat clear mind — as much as she may want to do right by her parents, you don't think she should rush into motherhood out of a misplaced sense of familial duty.
    
    Hotaru sighs. "I'm aware the other times were... accidents[pc.ra kitsune
        |, your Eminence
    ]. Or were they? But still..."
    
    She should stop and think about how it felt to have her parents go on an adventure for all of her youth and leave her to be raised with Kohaku and by Komari. One is more than what she had, but wouldn't it be better with two? The demands of [pc.ra kitsune
        |your station
        |what's going on in the Marches
    ] means you can be hardly with her at all, and as you understand it fox kits need a lot more careful care than even children of other races require.
    
    If it's that much of a concern and she genuinely wants to do right by her parents for once... maybe she should let them do right by her as well and heed them when they finally do return, as opposed to action this drastic.
    
    Hotaru looks away and bites her lip. "[kohaku.anyKids
        |I will confess... part of the reason I tried so hard to fatten Kohaku up while she was pregnant was because I was jealous. It's true, there were times when she was miserable, but on the whole she seemed to enjoy herself, and has only gotten moreso after the fact. I... she's taken all the added weight in stride, even looks better because of it now that she's no longer able to fit into that horrible getup. It's that —"
        |It's just that... well, if I presented Mom with a grandchild, maybe she'd be more inclined to stay instead of going off again for just one last adventure, right? Tip the scales in my favor? She may have put her dream ahead of her own daughter, but a theoretical daughter's daughter?"
    ]
    
    See, this is what you mean by rushing into things.
    
    Hotaru sighs and leans forward, planting her elbows on the low table most unceremoniously. "Well, at least I asked. From what I hear, it's more than what others would have done. Shall we put this awkwardness behind us, then, and perhaps discuss something else?"

rows.original: "Eeeh?" If Hotaru's troubled expression was uncharacteristic, shock suits her even less as she raises her hands to her mouth and stares at you wide-eyed[pc.ra kitsune | regardless of how disrespectful it might be ]. "I — uh — that is[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ] —" Is something the matter? Hotaru takes a deep breath, flattens her ears, then tries to affect a sheepish smile. [tetsuya.isLover |"Aren't the both of you an item[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]? Would that make me a concubine or something?" Nothing so formal or crass, depending on how she views concubinage. But as she says, the Tetsuya and you are an item, and if you've learned anything about how colonial kitsune handle themselves and their relationships, it's that [pc.isFemale |the female, being head of household, is perfectly within her rights to pass out her husband for stud |it's all one big mess and far more relaxed than things would be in their homeland, given the far lower stakes involved ]. Horatu's smile widens. "I suppose that's one way of putting it[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. I'd always been worried, but if you're fine with sharing him..." Tetsuya has a big enough heart for more than just you, and you're not able to be here with him all the time; you'd welcome someone else tending to those needs of his while you're away. If Hotaru's been holding back all this while because she thinks that Tetsuya's been claimed, well, she has your permission to take care of him in your absence. She does have genuine feelings for him, doesn't she? Tetsuya doesn't like his relationships being arranged for him, but there's a difference between an arranged relationship and simply undamming a river and letting the water flow where it may. "I won't lie[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. After I thought you'd claimed him for yourself, I... regretted not making a move earlier. Told myself that I didn't have a chance compared to someone [pc.ra kitsune |as illustrious as |like ] you. But since you're giving me permission, I shan't hold back!" [party.has kiyoko |"You have learned well, Beloved," Kiyoko remarks dryly from your side. "But then, you were taught by the best. I suppose it is only fitting — and a little flattering for me — that you pass it down." ] |"You're suggesting... [pc.ra kitsune |I shouldn't be so impertinent as to question you |look, I wouldn't expect you to know ], but he's out of my reach." Why would Tetsuya be? She does have genuine attraction for him, doesn't she? Her daydreaming and fantasizing is pretty obvious when he's so much as remotely nearby. Hotaru turns her eyes from you. "It's that obvious[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]?" Extremely so. For someone as big of a gossip and mischief-maker as she is to needle out weaknesses in others, Hotaru's self-awareness can be quite lacking at times. "Ehe. I just... well. I don't have an excuse — only thing is that he must be more oblivious than me, then." Sadly, that's true. Look, what's been holding her up from making a move on him, then? The current state of affairs isn't going to last forever — eventually, either Tetsuya's going to find someone or go home. Every day Hotaru spends treading on her own feet is one less that anything might happen. "[pc.ra kitsune |"He's a prince, your Eminence. Someone with your status would be more than a match for him, but me? I'm a colonial no-name with a troublemaker's reputation — not that I care about the latter, but he will. I eat bugs and am far too willing to set fires. I just... it's reaching for the stars, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |Look, [pc.name], you've been with us for a while and probably understand our ways better than any other outsider in the entirety of this region. And yet... this isn't even a kitsune thing. He's a prince, for the gods' sakes. I'm just someone who can't even keep a lid on her own so-called talents ]." It doesn't stop the whole affair from being any less unseemly. Either make a move, or stop sighing and fantasizing — and honestly? She was willing to take so drastic a step as to make this kind of request of you, trying to win the heart of a prince isn't any more monumental a task. She wanted to have something to show her parents by the time they returned, right? Maybe a royal grandchild is rushing things, but a relationship? Tetsuya doesn't like others trying to push him into things, so you won't put in a good word for her with him or anything. But if Hotaru's serious about her feelings for him, then you're sure that her genuinity will be responded to in kind. Horatu folds her arms. She clearly doesn't like it, but can't argue with your reasoning right now. "Hmph..." ] You understand that their difference in station might conventionally pose a problem, but these are the colonies, where people who wouldn't fit in the Old Country are placed out of sight and mind. How did the saying go again? %"Heaven is high and the emperor is far away?" If there's any place a prince might hook up with a seamstress in a fairy-tale pairing outside of all kitsune social norms, it's here. "Oh. Oh. I..." Hotaru wrings her hands a moment, then her eyes brighten and ears perk. "When you put it that way[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ], I'm already thinking of a few situations our dear prince might find himself in." [pc.isDK |Normally, you'd be worried about Hotaru's mischief, but you think you know Tetsuya well enough that he'd appreciate the enthusiastic novelty |For a moment — just a moment — you pity Tetsuya, having a good guess at what kind of machinations you've just got him caught up into. On the other hand, Hotaru's enthusiastic spontaneity means he'll never have any reason to suspect your hand in this ]. This isn't any less drastic than Hotaru's original intentions, but Tetsuya's tendency to take things slow will mean Hotaru won't be rushing headlong into anything she might regret later. Now, with no doubt half a dozen devious plans taking shape in her mind, does Hotaru need a little time alone to make the necessary preparations? "[pc.ra kitsune |The mindfulness is most appreciated, your Eminence," Hotaru chuckles. "And your implicit permission, of course. It's not everyday that my actions are endorsed by anyone with authority |Oh. Right. Of course. There are so many things I have in mind, I don't know where to start." "Really, [pc.name] — you locals can have an impulsiveness that's absolutely enchanting. All right, I'll do it ]. But if you'd like to take your leave to avoid us being seen scheming together, I understand perfectly. Until next time, then?"

rows.original:
Hotaru's eyes widen, and a brief flicker of fiery excitement passes through her figure. Gathering as many of her tails in her arms as she can and wringing them in her hands, she's clearly not the most stoic of kitsune, especially not with a kit in her belly messing with her emotions.
    
    [hotaru.isMILF
        |"Oh, more sap, is it?"
        
        Quite so.
        
        The wringing intensifies, and Hotaru pinches herself; she knows full well how much the combination of concentrated nutrients intended for healing and pregnancy hormones has caused her to curves fill out, and yet the temptation of a reprieve from her moods when they happen is too much.
        
        Then, something clicks in her, and her objections fall away like petals in the breeze.
        
        "Well, the damage's been done, if you can call it damage to begin with." Hotaru braces herself, as if seeking to stand and bow, then considers her heavy, swollen middle and thinks better of it. "All the attention is welcome, if nothing else; it makes for good gossip. I'll be sure to use such an extravagant gift well."
        
        Hotaru's body has handled childbearing well — it's mostly been her gift that's been causing her trouble these last few months. And yes, you agree that you wouldn't call what's happened to her damage — quite the opposite, in fact.
        |"Oh! For me[pc.ra kitsune
            |, my [pc.mf
                |lord
                |lady
            ]
        ]? That's quite hard to come by, as a near-panacea should be."
        
        And a cure-all is what Hotaru needs to help tame her gift when she's under strain.
        
        "Which is true, but still. I know I don't warrant such extravagance, so you have my gratitude." Hotaru braces herself, as if seeking to stand and bow, then considers her heavy, swollen middle and thinks better of it. "[pc.ra kitsune
            |Truly, I'm getting better treatment than how some concubines have historically been. All these new perspectives you bring are quite interesting, your Eminence
            |Even the wealthy and connected don't get to taste the sap of divine trees, and yet you come and present me with a full flask. Congratulations, you've made a storyteller and talesinger lost for words — no small feat, that
        ]."
        
        It's your kit growing in her belly — no expense is too great.
    ]
    
    Hotaru giggles, her mood lurching violently from somber gratitude to giddy delight in the blink of an eye even as the air gets perceptibly warmer. "Be that as it may, thank you[pc.ra kitsune
        |, your Eminence
    ]. Let's see, now..."
    
    Foxfire wreathes Hotaru's index finger for a moment, then she pops open the flask and dips it in the sap. Slowly, she brings it to her lips and sucks, then nods in satisfaction as a dreamy smile spreads on her lips.
    
    "Everything I expected," she says after a moment's pause. "I'll save it for when my gift's acting on my nerves again, as Mai would put it."
    
    ...
    
    "What's with that look, [pc.ra kitsune
        |your [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]ship
        |[pc.name]
    ]? Did you expect that I'd drink everything here and now? With how potent the sap of divine trees is, I'll be sure to treasure your gift, stretch it out for only when I need it. There aren't that many things that can help with my nerves, and only one that tastes decent, so... ahaha, [pc.ra kitsune
        |such favor from one so high. Truly, I'm beside myself
        |forget it
    ].
    
    "Now, is there anything else you'd like to bring up?"

萤的眼睛瞪得大大的，身上闪过一丝炽热的兴奋。她把尽可能多的尾巴聚在怀里，紧紧地握在手中——显然，她并不是那种能够保持冷静的狐妖，尤其是当肚子里的那只小狐妖在扰乱她的情绪时，就更不可能了。
    
    [hotaru.isMILF
        |哦，又是这种液体吗？”

“没错。”

挤压的动作变得更加用力，萤紧紧捏住自己的身体；她非常清楚，这种富含营养、专为促进康复和怀孕而设计的成分，以及其中的孕激素，究竟是如何让她的身体线条变得更加丰满的。然而，每当情绪低落的时刻，这种能够暂时缓解不适的感觉，实在让人难以抗拒。
        
        然后，她突然明白了什么，之前的反对意见就像被风吹落的花瓣一样，全都烟消云散了。

“好吧，既然你已经做出了那个决定，那么伤害也就已经造成了……至少你可以这么认为吧。”萤做好了心理准备，仿佛想要站起身来鞠躬致意，但看到自己那隆起的腹部后，她又放弃了这个念头。至少，所有的这些关注都是值得的；至少可以用来编些好故事呢。我一定会好好利用这份如此奢华的礼物的。”

萤的身体非常适合生育——在过去几个月里，真正给她带来麻烦的，其实是这份礼物本身。没错，你也会认同，她所遭遇的这些根本不能被称为“伤害”——事实上，恰恰相反。
        |哦！对我来说[pc.ra kitsune
            |我的[pc.mf
                |领主
                |女士
            ]
        ]这样的东西确实很难找到，毕竟它应该被视作一种近乎万能的解药。”

而对于萤来说，当她处于压力之下时，正是这种‘万能药’能够帮助她控制自己的能力。

“确实是这样，但即便如此……我知道自己并不值得这样的慷慨，所以真的很感激你。”萤做好了站起身来鞠躬的准备，但看到自己那隆起的腹部后，又放弃了这个想法。[pc.ra kitsune
            |说实话，我得到的待遇比历史上一些妃子们所受到的还要好。您带来的这些新观点确实很有趣，阁下。
            |就连那些富有且有关系的人也尝不到那些神圣树木的汁液，而你却送了我一整壶。恭喜你，你让一个讲故事的人无话可说——这可真是了不起的成就啊。
        ]是你的小家伙在她的肚子里成长着——因此，再大的花费也是值得的。
    ]
    
    热灯笼轻声笑了起来，她的情绪在短短一瞬间就从沉郁的感激转变为兴奋的喜悦，与此同时，空气也明显变得温暖起来。“不管怎样，还是谢谢你。[pc.ra kitsune
        |，阁下
    ]让我想想，现在……”

Foxfire将萤的食指缠住了一会儿，然后打开小瓶子，将手指浸入树液中。她缓缓将手指送到唇边吸了几口，满意地点了点头，嘴角浮现出一丝梦幻般的微笑。

“正是我期待的效果，”她停顿片刻后说道，“等我的礼物再次让我感到烦躁不安的时候，我就会用这个了——就像舞会说的那样。”

……

“你那副表情是什么意思？ [pc.ra kitsune
        |你的[pc.mf
            |领主
            |女士
        ]运输
        |[pc.name]
    ]你难道以为我会立刻把这里的所有东西都喝光吗？鉴于神树汁液的效力如此强大，我一定会珍惜你的礼物，只在真正需要的时候才使用它。其实并没有多少东西能够帮助我缓解神经紧张，而其中只有这种汁液的味道还算不错，所以……哈哈， [pc.ra kitsune
        |得到如此高位之人的青睐，实在让我欣喜若狂。
        |算了
    ]现在，还有其他什么你想讨论的事情吗？

Carefully, Hotaru puts down the tray and sets out what ought to be a simple meal: one large serving bowl heaped high with cooked rice and broad beans, complete with a wooden serving spoon and individual bowls for the both of you. While a slight edge of some savory seasoning rises along with the steam coming off the meal, the fragrance has that homely, natural body to it.
    
    Not exactly gourmet food, but even when it comes to the kitsune and Hotaru in particular, even a simple staple can be dressed up finely and gain an allure of its own.
    
    "Eat up,[pc.ra kitsune
        | my [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ],
    ]" Hotaru purrs, still in a good mood from being in her element. "It's simple, but it gives you all the basics to keep going and maintain health, so long as you add a little garnish. It's what my parents eat when they're out in the wild and need to pack tight, or so they write back."
    
    That's very nice and all, but Hotaru seems to have forgotten that this is about her and her eating properly. [hotaru.anyKids
        |Neither she nor Kaori may have much of an appetite, but that only highlights the importance of keeping a schedule instead of waiting to be reminded to take care of oneself.
        |[hotaru.isPregnant
            |It's still odd that she's lost much of her appetite as her belly's grown, but that just means she has to consciously take care of herself and her unborn kit as opposed to needing her body to remind her to do so.
            |Her work may be of the sort that never has any off-days, but there's a difference between that and not taking care of herself.
        ]
    ]

    Come now, she's supposed to be a storyteller, gossip, and general never-do-well. Such transparent flattery isn't up to her standards.
    
    "Or maybe I'm just putting on the mask of a rural girl's incompetent attempts at flattery just for you[pc.ra kitsune
        |, my [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]
    ]." A giggle. "Come on, less talking, more eating. It's already starting to get cold."

rows.translation:
\n\n萤小心翼翼地将托盘放下，然后摆出了这顿看似简单的饭菜：一个装满煮熟的米饭和蚕豆的大碗，还配有一把木制勺子，以及为你们两人准备的单独小碗。当饭菜散发出的蒸汽中带着一丝浓郁的调味香气时，这种味道确实带有一种朴实而自然的美感。
    
    虽然算不上什么高级美食，但对于狐妖、尤其是萤而言，哪怕是最简单的家常菜，也能通过精心的搭配而变得美味可口，从而散发出独特的魅力。
    
    “快吃吧，[pc.ra kitsune
        | 我的[pc.mf
            |领主
            |女士
        ]，
    ]”萤发出满足的呼噜声，显然因为处于自己最擅长的环境中而心情愉悦。“这道菜很简单，但只要稍加点缀，就能提供维持健康所需的所有基本营养。我的父母在野外生活时，如果需要携带简单的食物，就会吃这个；至少他们写信回来是这么说的。”
    
    虽然这些话听起来很不错，但萤似乎忘记了一点：这一切其实都是为了她自己，为了让她能够吃得健康。 [hotaru.anyKids
        |她和香织可能都没有太大的食欲，但这恰恰说明了按时安排生活作息的重要性——而不是等到别人提醒自己才去照顾好自己的身体。
        |[hotaru.isPregnant
            |她的肚子越来越大，食欲却大大减退，这确实有点奇怪。不过，这也意味着她必须自觉地照顾好自己和未出生的宝宝，而不是让身体来提醒她该这么做。
            |她的工作或许永远没有休息日，但这与不照顾自己其实是两回事。
        ]
    ]
    
    “呵呵，我想是这样吧。只是当我们在一起的时候，我的思绪总是不由自主地回到你身上。”
    
    得了吧，她本来应该是个喜欢讲故事、爱闲聊、整天无所事事的人才对。这种如此直白的奉承可达不到她的水准。
    
    “或者，也许我只是为了你，才装出一副农村女孩那种笨拙的、不熟练的奉承姿态罢了。[pc.ra kitsune
        |我的[pc.mf
            |领主
            |女士
        ]
    ]。”嘻嘻，她说，“快点，少说点，多吃点吧。天已经开始变冷了。”
rows.raw:
"
    \n\nCarefully, Hotaru puts down the tray and sets out what ought to be a simple meal: one large serving bowl heaped high with cooked rice and broad beans, complete with a wooden serving spoon and individual bowls for the both of you. While a slight edge of some savory seasoning rises along with the steam coming off the meal, the fragrance has that homely, natural body to it.
    
    Not exactly gourmet food, but even when it comes to the kitsune and Hotaru in particular, even a simple staple can be dressed up finely and gain an allure of its own.
    
    "Eat up,[pc.ra kitsune
        | my [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ],
    ]" Hotaru purrs, still in a good mood from being in her element. "It's simple, but it gives you all the basics to keep going and maintain health, so long as you add a little garnish. It's what my parents eat when they're out in the wild and need to pack tight, or so they write back."
    
    That's very nice and all, but Hotaru seems to have forgotten that this is about her and her eating properly. [hotaru.anyKids
        |Neither she nor Kaori may have much of an appetite, but that only highlights the importance of keeping a schedule instead of waiting to be reminded to take care of oneself.
        |[hotaru.isPregnant
            |It's still odd that she's lost much of her appetite as her belly's grown, but that just means she has to consciously take care of herself and her unborn kit as opposed to needing her body to remind her to do so.
            |Her work may be of the sort that never has any off-days, but there's a difference between that and not taking care of herself.
        ]
    ]
    
    "Ehe. I guess. It's just that when we're together, my mind keeps on drifting back to you."
    
    Come now, she's supposed to be a storyteller, gossip, and general never-do-well. Such transparent flattery isn't up to her standards.
    
    "Or maybe I'm just putting on the mask of a rural girl's incompetent attempts at flattery just for you[pc.ra kitsune
        |, my [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]
    ]." A giggle. "Come on, less talking, more eating. It's already starting to get cold."
    "

rows.original: Rice and beans, steamed together — despite the meal's humble origins, one wouldn't call it crude, at least by Marches standards. Artist that she is, Hotaru's done all she can to bring out what a peasant meal that prioritizes volume over flavor has to offer, and she's done a surprisingly good job given what she has to work with. The rice is somewhere between fluffy and chewy, the beans flaky and slightly sweet, and the combined fragrance that rises from the steaming mountain fills the lungs and warms one's heart. There's also the matter of the light garnish — shredded greens and root vegetables that you're not familiar with, which add a light crunch to every other bite. Hotaru watches you carefully as you eat, but you're well aware of her pretexts to not apply herself and remind her to finish her own portions with several reproachful looks. Ha. Only at a dinner table can so much be said with no words at all. "Mmph. Maybe I made too much." [hotaru.isPregnant |A pregnant vixen saying that — now there's a first. You'd have expected any other vixen to have finished everything, then come after your portion, but Hotaru... well, she's hardly normal. A laugh. "Kohaku's been telling me that all my life, so I know it well." |She does really get into the mood of anything that gives her an excuse to light and tend fires, doesn't she? "Too bad there's not much call for such around these parts. Cooking really is the closest thing... but everyone makes their own meals at home around here and that's how things ought to be, it's better for everyone." Would she have preferred it, though? "Ha, yes. Making a living from tending a fire all day — I could do that for the rest of my days.[hotaru.anyKids | Although one could say that I've a little flame who needs tending these days. ]" ] At the end of the day, it's rice and beans — food meant to weigh down the stomach and keep the cold out. But in Hotaru[hotaru.anyKids | and Kaori ]'s company, it tastes far better than it has any right to be, and you steadily lose track of time... with the both of you applying yourselves, the small mountain starts to vanish. [hotaru.anyKids |While you apply yourselves, Kaori perks up at her mother's side and sniffs the air, but curls back up on her cushion at the foot of the table with a disinterested demeanor. How cute. She's learned to feign disinterest at such a young age. "I'm not entirely sure about the 'feign' part,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Hotaru says in between bites. "But either way, Kaori is still too young to be weaned, even if it's just rice and beans. Still, there's not that much that gets a rise out of her, even if briefly — maybe it's less the food itself and more the fact that you're here for the meal. Isn't that adorable?" |[hotaru.isPregnant |"Are you happy now[pc.ra kitsune |, oh divine champion ]?" Hotaru says as she reclines in her cushion and pats her tight, round belly. "I'm taking care of myself." You wouldn't need to worry about her and her unborn kit so much if she'd mind herself better. It's only a matter of months now before she has to live for others than just herself. "I'm aware. Although," Hotaru raises a finger to her lips and smiles. "I wonder what it'd be like if our daughter turned out to be just as relaxed as I am. Then we can exasperate you together." |"We're in the colonies; like the people, the food is often looked down upon by one's so-called cultural betters," Hotaru says, an odd sing-song lilt creeping into her voice. "But while one eventually tires of the capital's rich dishes and needs ever more ridiculous extravagance to maintain that initial richness... ] ]
rows.translation: 米和豆子一起蒸着吃——尽管这种食物的起源很普通，但按照马奇的标准来看，人们绝不会认为它粗糙或难吃。作为一位艺术家，萤竭尽全力去发掘这种以份量为主而非味道为重的农家饭菜所拥有的魅力，而考虑到她所拥有的条件，她做得其实相当不错。米饭的口感介于松软与有嚼劲之间，豆子则呈片状且略带甜味，当这些食材一起在热气腾腾的锅中蒸煮时，散发出的香气会充满整个空间，让人感到身心舒畅。 此外，还有那些装饰性的配料——一些你可能不熟悉的切碎的绿叶蔬菜和根茎类食材，它们为每一口食物增添了清新的脆口感。萤在你吃饭时仔细地观察着你，而你也清楚地知道她只是找借口不想帮忙，于是你用几道责备的眼神提醒她把自己的饭菜吃完。 哈，只有在餐桌上，才能用如此多的眼神交流来代替言语呢。 哼，也许我做得太多了。 [hotaru.isPregnant |一只怀孕的母狐狸说出这种话——真是前所未闻。你本以为其他母狐狸会先把自己的那份吃掉，然后再来抢你的，但萤……嗯，她确实不太正常。 “琥珀这一辈子都在跟我说这些，所以我非常清楚。”她笑着说。 |她一有机会生火做饭，确实就会立刻进入这种状态，不是吗？ “可惜在这附近，并没有太多需要生火做饭的情况。其实，烹饪才是最接近这种状态的活动了。不过在这里，每个人都是在家自己做饭的，事情本来就应该这样，这样对大家都更好。” 不过，她自己会不会更喜欢这样呢？ “哈，当然会。整天围着火堆做饭来维持生计——这样的生活我愿意一直过下去。[hotaru.anyKids | 虽然可以说，这些天我内心有一团需要被呵护的火焰。 ]" ] 归根结底，这些食物不过就是米饭和豆类而已——用来填饱肚子、抵御寒冷的普通食物罢了。但在萤的世界里[hotaru.anyKids | 还有香织 ]这家公司的产品，其味道其实远比它应有的水平要好得多，而当你全身心地投入其中时，时间也会不知不觉地流逝……在你们两人的共同努力下，那座小山开始逐渐消失。 [hotaru.anyKids |当你们都在认真做事的时候，香织却凑到妈妈身边，嗅了嗅空气，然后又若无其事地蜷缩在桌子脚边的垫子上。 真可爱，她这么小就学会了装作毫不在意的样子。 “不过，我不太确定她是不是真的在装作毫不在意[pc.ra kitsune | 阁下， ]萤边吃边说道，‘不过无论如何，香织现在还太小，还不能断奶，哪怕只是吃些米饭和豆子也好。不过，似乎并没有什么食物能真正让她兴奋起来，哪怕只是短暂的一瞬间——也许并不是食物本身，而是因为你陪在她身边一起吃饭这个事实吧。真是太可爱了，不是吗？ |[hotaru.isPregnant |你现在开心了吗？[pc.ra kitsune |哦，神圣的勇士啊 ]嗯，”萤一边靠在靠垫上，一边轻拍着自己圆鼓鼓的肚子说道，“我自己在照顾自己呢。” 如果她能更好地照顾自己，你就不会那么担心她和她还未出生的孩子了。再过几个月，她就不得不为别人而活，而不再只是为自己而活了。 “我知道这一点。不过，”萤把手指放在嘴唇上，微笑着说道，“我很好奇，如果我们的女儿也能像我一样随性自在，那会是什么样子呢。那么我们就一起惹你生气吧。 |我们在殖民地生活；和那里的人们一样，那些所谓的‘文化优越者’也常常看不起当地的食物，”萤说道，她的声音里带着一种奇怪的、略带吟唱般的腔调。“但是，当人们最终对首都那些精美的菜肴感到厌倦，需要越来越夸张的享受方式才能维持那种最初的奢华感时…… ] ]

rows.original: Now that she's closer, you note that the lacquered bowls Hotaru sets out are square — a somewhat unorthodox shape for a bowl, but what's more interesting are the noodles within. Steeped in dark broth, there's something about the scent, about the color of the dough that carries with it a hint of exoticness... This isn't wheat, is it? Hotaru shakes her head. "It's close, but not exactly. Like how cucumbers are actually fruits, but we use them as vegetables? Buckwheat's the same way, it's not really a cereal, but it's close enough that it's used as if it were a grain. "Kohaku has mountain fox ancestry — and every time she goes through the torii on business she always brings back a lot of buckwheat noodles from her relatives on the other side, enough that even what she shares with me is too much. Buckwheat flour's a staple, because neither rice nor wheat grow well in the mountains." Mm. You give some of the noodles an experimental bite, and find the texture somewhat grainy and nutty, as if the flour hadn't been very finely milled.[pc.bg soldier | There's some resemblance to acorn and other nut flours that were staples in some heartland regions while you were campaigning down there... ] "Soba can be a bit of an acquired taste, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]especially for those who aren't used to it. Some consider it a festival food, especially around the time of the new year. But..." But your visit is good enough cause for celebration that she's breaking these out? "Not exactly." Hotaru giggles and claps. "But it's a pretty enough sentiment that I think I'll go along with it. Please don't be shy[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ] — Kohaku keeps foisting buckwheat flour upon me." That's very nice and all, but Hotaru seems to have forgotten that this is about her and her eating properly. [hotaru.anyKids |Neither she nor Kaori may have much of an appetite, but that only highlights the importance of keeping a schedule instead of waiting to be reminded to take care of oneself. |[hotaru.isPregnant |It's still odd that she's lost much of her appetite as her belly's grown, but that just means she has to consciously take care of herself and her unborn kit as opposed to needing her body to remind her to do so. |Her work may be of the sort that never has any off-days, but there's a difference between that and not taking care of herself. ] ] "Ehe. I guess. It's just that when we're together, my mind keeps on drifting back to you." Come now, she's supposed to be a storyteller, gossip, and general never-do-well. Such transparent flattery isn't up to her standards. "Or you've hit that sweet spot in spacing your visits such that it's enough absence for the heart to grow fond, but not cold." A giggle. "And speaking of getting cold, less talking, more eating. We have plenty to go through... and enough time to do it in."

rows.original: \n\nNow that she's closer, you note that the lacquered bowls Hotaru sets out are square — a somewhat unorthodox shape for a bowl, but what's more interesting are the noodles within. Steeped in dark broth, there's something about the scent, about the color of the dough that carries with it a hint of exoticness... This isn't wheat, is it? Hotaru shakes her head. "It's close, but not exactly. Like how cucumbers are actually fruits, but we use them as vegetables? Buckwheat's the same way, it's not really a cereal, but it's close enough that it's used as if it were a grain. "Kohaku has mountain fox ancestry — and every time she goes through the torii on business she always brings back a lot of buckwheat noodles from her relatives on the other side, enough that even what she shares with me is too much. Buckwheat flour's a staple, because neither rice nor wheat grow well in the mountains." Mm. You give some of the noodles an experimental bite, and find the texture somewhat grainy and nutty, as if the flour hadn't been very finely milled.[pc.bg soldier | There's some resemblance to acorn and other nut flours that were staples in some heartland regions while you were campaigning down there... ] "Soba can be a bit of an acquired taste, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]especially for those who aren't used to it. Some consider it a festival food, especially around the time of the new year. But..." But your visit is good enough cause for celebration that she's breaking these out? "Not exactly." Hotaru giggles and claps. "But it's a pretty enough sentiment that I think I'll go along with it. Please don't be shy[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ] — Kohaku keeps foisting buckwheat flour upon me." That's very nice and all, but Hotaru seems to have forgotten that this is about her and her eating properly. [hotaru.anyKids |Neither she nor Kaori may have much of an appetite, but that only highlights the importance of keeping a schedule instead of waiting to be reminded to take care of oneself. |[hotaru.isPregnant |It's still odd that she's lost much of her appetite as her belly's grown, but that just means she has to consciously take care of herself and her unborn kit as opposed to needing her body to remind her to do so. |Her work may be of the sort that never has any off-days, but there's a difference between that and not taking care of herself. ] ] "Ehe. I guess. It's just that when we're together, my mind keeps on drifting back to you." Come now, she's supposed to be a storyteller, gossip, and general never-do-well. Such transparent flattery isn't up to her standards. "Or you've hit that sweet spot in spacing your visits such that it's enough absence for the heart to grow fond, but not cold." A giggle. "And speaking of getting cold, less talking, more eating. We have plenty to go through... and enough time to do it in."

rows.original: The noodles are as heavy as their flavor, wrung out in strands far longer than would be reasonable. It's no accident and while you have the suspicion there's some meaning to this, Hotaru makes a game out of sucking as much into her cheeks without biting off any of the strands. [hotaru.fucked |One can only wonder if she's advertising what she can do with her mouth and tongue — her motions are very definitely teasing, but not enough to be outright lewd. ]And the garnish... onions and a few local vegetables you don't recognize, completing an ensemble that's simple but rich. Mountain fare, indeed. Does Hotaru ever think of where her ancestors came from the same way Kohaku does? The black-furred vixen pauses and swallows deeply. "Oh. Hm. I — well, not very much, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |to be honest ]. Kohaku's parents came over, so she's only one generation removed. But me, whose line came over with the den matron at the outset? I do have clan relations back in the provinces, but... let's face it, even provincials don't want anything to do with the likes of me. I don't have money and favors to throw around like that little golden creature does. "I guess that's why I don't know how to make any of the traditional specialties from where my roots supposedly lie, as opposed to Kohaku bringing back soba and buckwheat flour every chance she gets. Even what I've just prepared for the both of us, I've had to make some substitutions — and honestly, I think it's better than the original recipe." And one can apply that to people as well. "As you say[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." Ordinarily, it would just be noodles, if a bit long; however, in Hotaru[hotaru.anyKids | and Kaori ]'s company, it tastes far better than it has any right to be, and Hotaru constantly teases you throughout[hotaru.anyKids | while your daughter only looks exasperated at her mother's antics ]. It's all in good fun, and you steadily lose track of time... with the both of you applying yourselves, the bowls slowly empty with no small satisfaction. [hotaru.anyKids |While you apply yourselves, Kaori perks up at her mother's side and sniffs the air, then raises her head to gaze longingly at the both of you, tails swishing. It's rare that one gets to see such unabashed interest from your infant daughter, and Hotaru nods, confirming your thoughts. "Ha. It only stands to reason that she'd care for old people food. Well, not literally food for old people, but more... well, you know what I mean. Dishes with history and meaning; even if her own mother doesn't really care for it, it looks like she instinctively does." That's a pretty long leap for a kit who isn't even weaned. Isn't Hotaru making all of this up as she goes along?[pc.isDK | One of the things that makes her a good storyteller is her ability to lie as easily as she breathes, after all. ] "Perhaps, but it does make for a good narrative, doesn't it? That, and we both know Kaori was born old." |[hotaru.isPregnant |"Are you happy now[pc.ra kitsune |, oh divine champion ]?" Hotaru says as she reclines in her cushion and pats her tight, round belly. "I'm taking care of myself." You wouldn't need to worry about her and her unborn kit so much if she'd mind herself better. It's only a matter of months now before she has to live for others than just herself. "I'm aware. Although," Hotaru raises a finger to her lips and smiles. "I wonder what it'd be like if our daughter turned out to be just as relaxed as I am. Then we can exasperate you together." |"Buckwheat noodles are usually served around the new year — the tradition is stronger on the other side of the ocean, I'm told, but there are some sticklers who keep to it. Me, I'm more of the opinion that if something is worth doing, you don't need to wait for some special occasion to do it if at all possible." Hotaru sighs. "They're fun to cook, and fun to eat, so... let's just say that Kohaku has a great friend in me who's willing to take all her extras." [kohaku.wellFed |Extras that were merrily returned to their sender in order to fatten her up. A giggle. "That was the best. Making a little creature like her pack away so much — the sight was worth it, and I regret absolutely nothing. How many times her own weight in my delicious meals did she eat over those months?" |By the looks of her, though, she doesn't eat it all herself. "Gods forbid! But hot dishes make for good gifts to friends, like right now. I don't have very many of them... but the people I do consider close, I stick with through thick and thin." ] ] ]
rows.translation: 这些面条的味道确实非常浓郁，被拉成的一根根面条长度也远超正常范围。这绝非偶然，当你怀疑其中一定隐藏着某种意义时，萤却将这个过程变成了一种游戏——她努力把面条吸进脸颊里，却从不咬断任何一根面条。 [hotaru.fucked |人们不禁会想，她是不是在展示自己用嘴巴和舌头能做出什么……她的动作确实带有挑逗意味，但还不至于显得过于淫荡。 ]而那些配菜……洋葱还有一些你不认识的地方蔬菜，共同构成了这道简单却丰富的菜肴。 确实，这是山区的美食。 萤有没有像琥珀那样，思考过自己的祖先来自哪里？ 那只黑毛狐妖停了下来，深深地吸了一口口水，然后说道：“哦……嗯，我……其实不太考虑这些。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |说实话 ]琥珀的父母是后来迁过来的，所以她只隔了一代。而我呢，我的家族是从一开始就跟着族长一起迁来的。虽然我在家乡还有家族成员，但是……说实话，就连家乡的人也不想和我这种人有任何瓜葛。我没有那么多钱，也没有像那个小金色的生物那样可以随意赠送的东西。 “我想，这就是为什么我无法制作那些源于我家乡的传统美食，而琥珀却一有机会就会带回荞麦面和荞麦粉的原因吧。就连我为我们两个人准备的食物，我也不得不做一些调整——但说实话，我觉得这样反而比原来的食谱更好。” 这个道理同样也适用于人与人之间的关系。 “正如你所说[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]通常情况下，它也就只是普通的面条，只不过会稍微长一些而已；不过，在萤里[hotaru.anyKids | 还有香织 ]这家公司的产品，其味道其实远超人们的预期，而萤也会一直拿这一点来逗你玩。[hotaru.anyKids | 而你的女儿，对母亲这些古怪的行为，只是显得有些无奈罢了。 ]这一切都只是为了开心而已，不知不觉中，时间就一点点过去了……由于你们俩都全力以赴，那些碗也慢慢地被清空了，这其中也蕴含着不少乐趣呢。 [hotaru.anyKids |当你们全神贯注地做着自己的事情时，香织在妈妈身边欢快地跑来跑去，嗅了嗅空气，然后抬起头，充满向往地望着你们两个，尾巴还不停地摇动着。能够看到自己的幼女表现出如此毫不掩饰的兴趣，实在是件难得的事。萤也点了点头，证实了你们的想法。 哈，她喜欢这类有历史意义和内涵的菜肴，这也是情理之中的事。当然，不是真正意义上的老年人专用食物，而是那种……你懂我的意思吧。这些菜肴承载着历史与故事，即使她自己的母亲并不喜欢这类食物，但她似乎天生就对此情有独钟。对于一个甚至还没有“断奶”的新手来说，这样的成长速度未免太快了。难道萤是在边做边编故事吗？[pc.isDK | 她之所以能成为一个出色的故事讲述者，原因之一就在于她能够像呼吸一样自然地撒谎。 ] 也许吧，但这确实为故事增色不少，不是吗？而且我们都知道，香织出生时就已经年纪不小了。 |[hotaru.isPregnant |你现在开心了吗？[pc.ra kitsune |哦，神圣的勇士啊 ]嗯，”萤一边靠在靠垫上，一边轻拍着自己圆滚滚的肚子说道，“我自己在照顾自己呢。” 如果她能更好地注意自己的身体状况，你就不会那么担心她和她还未出生的孩子了。再过几个月，她就不得不为别人而活，而不再只是为自己而活了。 “我知道这一点。不过，”萤把手指放在嘴唇上，微笑着说道，“我很好奇，如果我们的女儿也能像我一样随性自在，那会是什么样子呢。那么我们就一起惹你生气吧。 |荞麦面通常在新年期间食用——据说在海洋对岸，这一传统更为盛行，但也有一些人坚持遵循这一习俗。而我个人认为，如果某件事值得去做，那么如果可能的话，完全没有必要等到某个特殊的场合才去行动。”萤叹了口气，“制作荞麦面既有趣又美味，所以……可以说，琥珀有一个非常愿意帮她处理这些额外任务的好朋友。 [kohaku.wellFed |那些多出来的食物又被兴高采烈地送回原主，好把她喂胖。 她咯咯一笑：“那真是最棒的。让她那么个小个子吞下那么多食物——光看那场面就值了，我一点也不后悔。那几个月里，她吃下了多少倍于自己体重的、我做的美餐呀？” |不过，从她的外表来看，她并不会把那些食物都自己吃掉。 “天哪，那可不行！不过热菜确实是送给朋友的好礼物，就像现在这样。我并没有很多这样的礼物……但对我来说真正重要的人，无论发生什么，我都会一直陪伴在他们身边。 ] ] ]

rows.original: [party.has kiyoko |Seated at your side, [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] has long since smelled what's coming and perked up, pushing herself as close to the table as [kiyoko.pregStage 2 |her big pregnant belly will allow |is polite ]. Even if you're not as enthusiastic about it as she is, you can smell it too: heated oil, vinegar, and some kind of foreign seasoning. "It's inarizushi!" "So it is, Myobu-sama. I believe it is the appropriate dish for receiving those of such high station such as you and [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |your consort ], isn't it?" "Children these days have learned well, but I'd expect no less from one who was fostered by Komari. You've done well, girl." Kiyoko's words aren't surprising: in each and every one of the bowls sits an enormous pile of golden-brown pouches stuffed to bursting. Through the pouches' open front, you can see their contents: rice, grated carrots, small black seeds and diced vegetables, topped with small portions of scrambled eggs. Hotaru bows. "I've had to make some substitutions because of the inability to source some of the traditional ingredients, but I think the both of you will enjoy them. Please begin, and I'll join you shortly." "You heard her, Beloved. Let's begin. Thank you for the food, girl." Kiyoko inhales deeply, and she lets it out in a long, trembling sigh. [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3 |"Local flavor, she says? I see Komari has tried to keep something alive all this while. Ha, it may be that time passes slower than at home, thanks to her." It does look good, and smells just as heavenly. Just exotic enough to be interesting, but familiar enough to be what you know you like. That's how it is for Kiyoko, isn't it? Kiyoko blushes a little, and the kitsune folds her ears forward. I believe it is the appropriate dish for receiving those of such high station such as you and [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |your consort ], isn't it?" "Children these days have learned well, but I'd expect no less from one who was fostered by Komari. You've done well, girl." Kiyoko's words aren't surprising: in each and every one of the bowls sits an enormous pile of golden-brown pouches stuffed to bursting. Through the pouches' open front, you can see their contents: rice, grated carrots, small black seeds and diced vegetables, topped with small portions of scrambled eggs. Hotaru bows. "You heard her, Beloved. Let's begin. Thank you for the food, girl." Kiyoko inhales deeply, and she lets it out in a long, trembling sigh. [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3 |"Local flavor, she says? Just exotic enough to be interesting, but familiar enough to be what you know you like. That's how it is for Kiyoko, isn't it? Kiyoko blushes a little, and the kitsune folds her ears forward. "They... they just bring back good memories, you know? It's, hmm, akin to what I felt when I met you for the first time, Beloved." Like a morsel to be devoured? "Oh, don't demean yourself that way. But... you're not completely wrong, either." There's a moment of awkward silence as Kiyoko's expression falls, and then she perks up again as if nothing had ever happened. "Enough of that, there's no reason to ruin the flavour of food this good with such talk. Please, girl, do join us!" Now that's something you can agree with! |"What are you waiting for? Let's eat!" “是鱼生寿司！” “果然如此，宫部大人。我想，对于像您这样地位崇高的人来说，这确实是一道非常适合的菜肴。 [pc.ra kitsune |神圣冠军 |你的伴侣 ]不是吗？” “现在的孩子们都学得很好，不过对于一个被麻里抚养长大的人来说，我本来也没什么特别的期待。你做得很好，姑娘。” 清子的这番话并不令人意外：每个碗里都堆满了金黄色的小袋子，那些小袋子已经被塞得满满的。通过这些袋子敞开的开口，你可以看到里面的食材：大米、胡萝卜丝、小黑籽以及切块的蔬菜，上面还撒了一些炒鸡蛋。 热田鞠了一躬：“由于有些传统食材无法采购到，所以我不得不做一些替换，但我觉得你们俩一定会喜欢这些食物的。请开始吧，我马上就会加入你们。” “你听到了她的话，亲爱的。我们开始吧。谢谢你准备的食物，姑娘。” 清子深吸一口气，然后长长地、颤抖着吐了出来。 [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3 |地方风味，是吗？看来麻里一直都在努力保留一些传统的东西啊。哈，或许正是因为她的存在，时间在这里流逝得比在家里要慢一些吧。” 看起来确实很美味，香味也令人陶醉。足够奇特，因此引人入胜；同时又足够熟悉，让你能立刻感受到自己喜欢的风格。清子就是这样的，不是吗？ 清子微微脸红，而那只狐狸则把耳朵向前折叠。“它们…………它们只会唤起美好的回忆，你懂的吧？这种感觉，嗯，就如同我第一次遇见你时所感受到的那样，亲爱的。 就像一块让人垂涎欲滴的美味佳肴？ “哦，不要这样贬低自己。但是……你说的也不完全错。” 一阵尴尬的沉默出现了，清子的表情也变得黯淡下来，但很快她又振作起来，仿佛什么都没发生过一样。 “够了，没必要因为这种话而破坏这么美味的饭菜带来的享受。拜托了，姑娘，快来加入我们吧！” 这个要求，你总该同意吧！ |你还等什么？我们开始吃吧！” 你刚拿起餐具，清子就迫不及待地开始吃那些炸饭团，她的进食速度快得惊人，几乎像一只饿极了的狼或牛头怪一样，这种狂热的进食速度连最贪婪的野兽也会感到羞愧。在你们认识基约子的这段时间里，她展现出了许多不同的面貌，但这种纯粹而高效的工作状态，确实是一种完全不同的形象。就连萤也不例外，每当看到她那种高贵而专注的神情完全卸下伪装，全身心投入到工作中时，也会忍不住会心一笑。 小心点，宫部大人。这里还是挺热的。” 啊，她怀孕了。怀孕确实会给她带来一些变化。你可能会感到不满，但到现在你也已经习惯了。其实还挺可爱的，不是吗？ 热田将目光在你和清子之间来回移动，然后露出了淡淡的微笑。嗯， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |说实话 ]我本来也没指望自己能得到什么。所以如果美保能高兴的话……希望她能记住这件事，然后帮我在女主人面前说几句好话，对吧？ 清子咽了咽口水，然后赶紧又吃了一个炒饭袋子，随后才反应过来，又用力地咽了下去——看到她嘴里塞满食物的样子，还真是有点滑稽。“干得不错，姑娘。如今要想找到一个能达到你要求的人确实很难，但你已经超出了所有人的期望。下次我需要一个可靠的人选时，一定会想起你的。 [hotaru.isPregnant |现在你自己也怀孕了，肯定饿坏了吧。 ]为什么不加入我们呢？” rows.original: Hotaru's such a homebody, spending all day cooped up inside with her dyes, silks and moths. Does she ever step foot outside, or does she let the world come to her doorstep? "Such a silly question to ask[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Of course I have to go out — I can't spread gossip cooped up in these four walls, can I? And I have to get a proper bath from time to time. Like... the little gremlin lives in the storehouse where she works, but that doesn't mean she doesn't go out either. [hotaru.anyKids |"But at the same time..." A small smile spreads on Hotaru's lips, and the seamstress gathers Kaori up into her arms. "I will admit that in recent days, I'm feeling that more and more of what I've ever needed can be found at home. Before Kaori was born, I thought I'd be out there showing her off to anyone who cared, but just like the kits coming to my doorstep to hear stories, anyone who cares about her comes to visit. Like you do[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." And one can only imagine that daughter is as much of a homebody as her mother. "It's a little too early to tell, she does manage to look tired even when she's just napped. We'll know for sure once Kaori can get around on her own, won't we?" |[hotaru.isMILF |"On the other hand, I have to admit that I've settled down more than I usually do." A weak smile of resignation spreads over Hotaru's lips. "For anyone other than you, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]I just get so self-conscious." What's there to be self-conscious about? She looks perfectly fine to you. "You don't mind because it's your kit growing in here," Hotaru replies, patting her large, rounded tummy. "And to be honest, I'm quite proud of it and want to show it off. But the rest of me just feels... awkward. Ungainly. Even under all that I'm wearing, my hips and legs feel so heavy when I walk, and it's embarrassing knowing that they expanded as much as they did..." |[hotaru.isPregnant |"It's just... well, sometimes I get tired or moody, and it's really inconvenient to have it happen when outside, right? At home, I can just curl up under the covers and have a good cry, but I can't do that in public. If it were just myself, I wouldn't care, but there are other people around, and they don't need to put up with me." ... Hotaru wrings her fingers. "I know, I know. Our daughter's very calm; I'm the one who's been getting all inexplicably emotional of late. If anything, it would be even worse without her reminding me of her presence, but... well, I can't help but be gifted. I just don't want to make a scene in public..." |"It's just that going out takes time and effort to make oneself look presentable, and if it were just for me there really isn't much motivation to gussy up, right? But if I had [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion [pc.himHer]self |someone ] accompanying me, that'd be more than sufficient cause..." Just for you, she says? Hotaru gathers up one of her tails in her arms and idly toys with its tip. "Just for you indeed[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Passing along gossip is fun enough, but creating it? Well worth the effort." ] ] ] Well! If Hotaru's going to be that way, she won't mind if you decide how you're going to go out on the town? "You paint the broad strokes, and I'll fill in the details. What did you have in mind[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]?"
rows.translation: 萤火虫真是太喜欢待在家里了，整天都把自己关在房间里，摆弄那些染料、丝绸和飞蛾。她有没有走出过家门呢，还是说她让整个世界来到她的家门口呢？ “这个问题也太傻了吧[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]当然我得出去走走——总不能整天关在这四堵墙里传播流言蜚语吧？而且我也需要偶尔好好洗个澡。比如说……那个小淘气虽然住在她工作的仓库里，但那并不意味着她也不出门啊。 [hotaru.anyKids |但是同时……”萤的嘴角浮现出一丝微笑，然后将香织抱进怀里。“我必须承认，这些天我越来越觉得，我所需要的东西，其实都在家里就能找到。在香织出生之前，我以为自己会把她带到外面，让所有感兴趣的人都能看到她；但就像那些来到我家门口听故事的人们一样，任何关心她的人，都会主动来看她——就像你今天这样。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]可以想象，那个女儿和她母亲一样，也很喜欢待在家里。 “现在还很难说，即使她刚睡了一会儿，看起来也确实很疲惫。等薰能够自己独立行动了，我们就能确定答案了，不是吗？ |[hotaru.isMILF |另一方面，我必须承认，这次我确实比平时更加安于现状了。”萤的嘴角浮现出一丝无奈的微笑，“对于除了你之外的任何人来说， [pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]， ]我就是会感到很不好意思。” “有什么好觉得不好意思的？在你看来，她看起来完全没什么问题啊。”你别担心，因为这是你的小宝宝在肚子里成长呢，”萤一边说，一边轻拍着自己圆滚滚的大肚子。“说实话，我为此感到非常自豪。想要就是想炫耀一下。但我的其他部分却感觉……很尴尬，很不协调。即使穿了这么多衣服，走路的时候我的臀部和腿部还是感觉很重型，想到自己的身材变化这么大，真的让人觉得很尴尬…… |[hotaru.isPregnant |就是……有时候我会感到疲惫或者情绪低落，而在这种时候如果在外面的话，确实会很不方便，对吧？在家里，我可以躲在被子下面好好大哭一场，但在公共场合就做不到这一点。如果只有我一个人的话，我也不会在意，但周围还有其他人，他们并没有必要忍受我的情绪。…… 烈火紧握着自己的手指。“我知道，我知道。我们的女儿非常冷静；最近情绪波动大的反而是我。如果她没有不断提醒我她的存在，情况可能会更糟……但是。…嗯，我实在忍不住要送礼物了。我只是不想在公共场合闹出动静来…… |只是出门之前，需要花时间和精力来打扮自己，让自己看起来得体一些。如果只是为了我自己，其实并没有太大的动力去精心打扮，对吧？但是如果还有[pc.ra kitsune |神圣冠军[pc.himHer]自己 |有人 ]陪在我身边，这就已经足够成为理由了……” “只是为了你吗？” 萤把其中一条尾巴揽在怀里，闲闲地摆弄着它的尖端。“确实，只是为了你。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]传播流言蜚语已经很有趣了，但自己编造流言呢？那可真是值得花功夫去做的事情。 ] ] ] 嗯！如果萤是这种态度的话，她应该不会介意由你来决定怎么去城里玩吧？ “你负责制定大致的计划，我来负责细节的处理。你到底有什么想法呢？[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]？"
