It'll be fun." |It's such a fine evening, and there won't be that many people around to spoil the mood; with Hotaru growing increasingly round and heavy with each passing day, you don't want her getting into the habit of being too sedentary. After all, she won't be pregnant forever, and even if she doesn't mind a bit of baby fat you don't want her joints going to seed. "Oh, don't worry[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ] — I get plenty of exercise working at home. But you're not wrong in that we should take a walk, the stars are quite the sight through the tree roots at this time of year. And I do want Kaori to be exposed to all kinds of inspiration, even if she's still in my belly." Typical kitsune, isn't she? Her daughter's not even out of her belly and she's already thinking of the kit's future? A small, dreamy smile plays on Hotaru's lips. "Well, going so far as to suggest it's prenatal education's a bit of a stretch — part of it's just me finding a pretext to go stargazing with you while you're still around. But... you're not wrong in that I'm absolutely certain Kaori is far more aware of her surroundings than one might expect. Call it a mother's intuition. "But enough talk — shall we be off already?" ] |[hotaru.isPregnant |Now that she's with child, some fresh air and a calming atmosphere should help ease any discomforts she may have. "Discomforts[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]? I haven't had any. Mai says that this is supposed to be a difficult time, but... I'm fine, in body at least. Call it a hunch, especially this early on, but I feel like our daughter isn't the demanding sort." Unlike her mother? "Oh, you tease. If I'm demanding, then..." Hotaru leans forward, elbows on the table and chin cupped in her palms as her eyes meet yours. "Well, I said I was fine in body, but I've been missing you quite intensely these last few days. If I'm to be demanding, then I hereby demand that you take me out for a walk. [dayNight |Somewhere quiet, where it can be just us |The stillness of night is best for appreciating the beauty of light, after all ]." Seeing Hotaru's annoyance melt away in the blink of an eye, the vixen's inclination to being a homebody replaced with eager enthusiasm to be with you — if this is a side effect of her having your kit in her belly, you're all for it. |"A walk, you say? I prefer to let others come to me, but [pc.ra kitsune |since someone of your station asked, I have no choice but to be honored you'd choose me, hmm?" Hey, when she puts it like that, it drains all the fun out of it. "Oh, I was just teasing you, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]. It's true that I might be the only fox around who'll tell you no to your face instead of some silliness like 'it's difficult' or 'it's complicated' |with someone as exotic as you, I'd be silly to let this opportunity slip by, wouldn't I?" You? Exotic? Now that's a new one. "To me? You absolutely are." A small smile plays on Hotaru's lips as she folds her ears forward. "As I undoubtedly am to you, too ]. Coming from most people, I'd consider it a waste of time... but you'd make for good enough gossip that I wouldn't begrudge the time spent prying it out of you. Shall we be off, then? [dayNight |I know a few places where we won't be bothered |The skies can be quite romantic at this time of evening ]." ] ] ] ] With that, you take Hotaru's hand in yours and help her to her feet — [hotaru.pregStage 2 |with how round the vixen's gotten, she needs it, even if she'd never admit as much to your face |she makes a little melodramatic show of it, feigning needy helplessness all the while ]. Hotaru's fingers grip yours with surprisingly fierce strength, and she doesn't let go even when she's on her feet[hotaru.anyKids | and scooping up Kaori |[hotaru.pregStage 2 | and finding her balance with her big belly ] ]. "Shall we be off, then? I'm not the kind to spend forever getting ready to go out." "

rows.original: For someone who needs a good sense of fashion to do her job, Hotaru is good to her word and remarkably laid back when it comes to going out on the town. Hand in hand, the seamstress all but drags you out of her home; while you didn't have an exact destination in mind, Hotaru does. The black-furred vixen is keenly adept at leading from behind, tugging at your wrist and nipping at your heels with her steps to have you take her where she wants to be. She could just tell you, but where'd be the fun in that? [hotaru.isMILF |And as for you? [hotaru.isPregnant |Watching Hotaru waddle around massively pregnant with the kind of robust body needed to tote that belly of hers around is a treat in and of itself. Despite how heavy her pregnancy is, and not just in her middle, Hotaru seems to have a limitless well of energy when she's in a good mood. A spring in her step as she sashays at your side, the vixen gives off a slight sense of possessiveness which fits perfectly with how maternal she's become. |Even after having popped, Hotaru's hips have widened enough from the experience that her gait's changed even without the weight of a big belly attached to her. Of course, the fact that she's got Kaori slung in her other arm counts for something, but... It's just that she's settled into motherhood nicely, and it shows even in the spring in her step, let alone how starkly she's filled out despite her heavy clothes. ] It would be more gratifying if you had a view from behind, but the way Hotaru flows and bumps against you, her tails swishing from side to side with every step — her gift is much less troublesome when it swings towards mania, fetching in its enthusiasm. With Hotaru having mellowed out somewhat [hotaru.isPregnant |with your daughter in her belly |after having popped ], it might even be fetching under the right circumstances... |[hotaru.pregStage 2 |And besides, having Hotaru waddle around with an increasingly heavy middle is a treat in and of itself, especially when the prospect of spending time with you had clearly put her in a good mood and given the seamstress plenty of energy despite being this heavily weighed down. Fueled by her condition, Hotaru's gift is acting up again, but at least her mania's working for instead of against you, a big dreamy smile on her face as she hurries to keep in step with you. ] ] How does it feel to get some fresh air? "Come now[pc.ra kitsune | my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. You're acting as if I never go past my doorstep if I can help it." It is different when done in someone's company for pleasure. "Which is why I'm with you, silly.[hotaru.anyKids | Well, you and Kaori, but it's the same thing really, isn't it? ]"
rows.translation: 对于一份需要良好时尚品味才能胜任的工作来说，萤说到做到，而且一提到进城逛街，她就格外随性放松。这位裁缝几乎是一路拉着你的手把你拽出了她的家；你心里并没有明确的目的地，但萤有。这只黑毛的狐妖非常擅长从后面带路——她拽着你的手腕，脚步还时不时蹭一下你的脚后跟，就是要让你把她带到她想去的地方。她本可以直接告诉你，但那样还有什么乐趣可言？ [hotaru.isMILF |那么你呢？[hotaru.isPregnant |看着萤挺着巨大的孕肚摇摇晃晃地走动，还得靠那副结实的身板才撑得住她那个肚子，这本身就是一种享受。尽管她的孕期已经相当沉重——而且沉的可不只是腰腹——但只要心情好，萤似乎就有用不完的精力。她贴在你身边扭腰摆臀地走着，脚步轻快，这位狐女还隐隐透出一股占有欲，恰好与她如今这副母性十足的模样相得益彰。 |即便已经生完，萤的胯部也因为这一遭宽了不少，走路的姿势都变了，即使身上已经没有大肚子坠着也一样。当然，她另一只手臂里还挎着香织，这也算是个原因，不过…… 只是她如今已经很好地安顿进了母亲这个身份，这一点连她轻快的脚步都能看出来，更别提她那身厚衣服下明显已经变得多么丰满。 ] 要是能从她背后看就更带劲了，但萤贴着你蹭来蹭去的样子——每走一步尾巴就左右甩动——她那份天赋在变得癫狂时反倒没那么麻烦，那股热情还挺动人的。尤其是在萤已经多少变得温顺了些之后[hotaru.isPregnant |，肚子里怀着你的女儿 |，已经生完了 ]，在某些情况下，这甚至也挺动人的…… |[hotaru.pregStage 2 |更何况，看着萤挺着越来越沉的肚子摇摇晃晃地走动，本身就是一种享受，尤其是想到要和你一起消磨时光明显让她心情大好，明明身子已经这么沉重了，这位裁缝还是精力充沛。受她这身体状况影响，萤的天赋又在作祟了，但至少她的癫狂这次是站在你这边，而不是跟你作对——她那张脸上挂着梦幻般的大笑容，急匆匆地跟上你的脚步。 ] ] 出来透透气感觉怎么样？ “过来吧[pc.ra kitsune |，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]。你装得好像只要能不出门，我就绝不会迈出自家门槛似的。” 有人作伴、为了享乐而出游，确实不一样。 “所以我才跟你一起出来呀，傻瓜。[hotaru.anyKids | 嗯，是你和香织，不过说到底是一回事，对吧？ ]”

rows.original: As things turn out, your steps lead you down from the branches, through the roots, and eventually right outside the storehouse. It feels like Hotaru's been not-so-subtly shepherding you here all this while, and your suspicions are confirmed when she folds her ears forward and makes what can only be described as smug fox noises as you pause by the entrance. The storehouse's closed at this time of night. Hotaru pauses her fox noises for just a moment to address you in Belharan. "For business? Yes. For pleasure? Perhaps not[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. And especially not for me." The seamstress shouts again in her native tongue, and this time she's answered from within. A very scruffy Kohaku pushes open a window high up and peers down at the both of you; several moments later, you hear bars being drawn and Kohaku ushers the both of you in. "How nice of you to come around, and to bring [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship |[pc.name] ], too. [hotaru.anyKids |I'm just glad that having Kaori hasn't meant you stopped showing up — would be a shame after all these years |[hotaru.isPregnant |One would imagine being with child would drain all your energy, but you just keep going |It's been a long day, and I was starting to wonder if you were going to show up as usual ] ], nojya." Huh. So this was planned all along? "Just a couple of vixens getting together in the evening[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence; we've been doing this ever since we left the den matron's foster care. N |, n ]othing strange about that in the slightest," Kohaku replies as she leads Hotaru and you up to her tiny apartment. "Not that I'd be in bed anyway — [kohaku.anyKids |the little bundle of mischief had a nightmare or something and won't go back to sleep. I'd nod off myself, but then she'd crawl off somewhere and get into trouble, nojya.[hotaru.anyKids | Kaori is a good, calming influence on her half-sister, so I'm honestly glad she showed up, ehe. ] |[kohaku.isPregnant |everything feels so heavy, and this little bundle of mischief won't let me rest easy, nojya." [hotaru.isPregnant | "Ha. Convenient, then, that another pregnant vixen should show up and keep you company. Such a pity that you have to get up in the mornings, and I don't." Kohaku scowls. "Your kit is well-behaved and obliging even before being born, and you carry on a robust frame. I'm tiny, and some days I swear to the gods this child thinks I wronged her somehow with how often she beats me up from the inside. We aren't the same, nojya." Hotaru just laughs. ] |the nights have been getting colder of late, and the season brings with it melancholic thoughts, nojya." "Best chased away with a little warm liquor, but..." "...It's easy to overdo it when drinking alone." Kohaku sighs. "I'm really glad the two of you showed up, nojya." Hotaru? Being the responsible one? "No, it's just that this tiny creature doesn't have much space to hold her drink." ] ] Kohaku ushers you in and has the both of you seated, then [var0 |waddles into the back to fetch her little golden gremlin. It takes a little while for her to return, and you're just starting to get worried when Kohaku returns looking considerably scruffier and with the tiny kit firmly attached to one breast. "Sorry about that. All I wanted was to bring her out, but she was really fussy and insistent, nojya." Hotaru chuckles at the sight as Kohaku takes a seat at the table, then pats her own daughter in her arms. "Can't say I get you. Kaori here is always perfectly behaved — they may be half-sisters, but whatever makes them like this, it didn't come from [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence |[pc.name] ]. "Ha. What's the matter[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]? There's nothing on display there that you haven't seen before, I'm reliably informed." No. It's just that... well. You turn your gaze between the two gossips, one golden and one black, then slowly shake your head. Kitsune women do fill out while with child, but what these two have done to each other thanks to their schemes is quite ridiculous, schemes that you just happened to enable. It's less noticeable on Hotaru because of the way she dresses, but even the heavy fabric can't conceal much at this point. And with Kohaku nursing her daughter right in front of you, providing a front-row view of just how she's expanded — "[pc.ra kitsune |I'm glad that you like what you see, your Eminence |I guess this makes up a little for not being able to wear my old clothes ], but it's a little embarrassing," Kohaku murmurs as she hugs her daughter a little closer. "I'm not getting any younger, nojya." "Just because you never paid it any mind doesn't mean it wasn't going to happen." You can hear the sheer smug dripping from Hotaru's voice. "That's the colonial blood starting to creep into your line. Give it two or three more generations, and your descendants will be nice and round without even needing any help." "Help. By the gods, you sure helped, nojya." "You happily ate everything I put in front of you, and had the cheek to ask for more." "You didn't even hesitate to reach for the wyldsap every time you started going crazy." There was a time when Kohaku and Hotaru arguing might have been cause for concern, but with them all very much maternal with a pair of half-sisters in their arms, it's impossible to take their petty bickering seriously. Reaching out in turn, you wrap an arm about each vixen and pull her close, feeling your forearm sink into the firm, dense squishiness of their bodies as you pull them close. On their part, Kohaku and Hotaru get the message and change tack to vying for your attention. The glances both Hotaru and Kohaku throw in your direction as they show off their daughters by you are hardly surreptitious — if you were to be honest, their need for your approval in not just how they're raising your get, but also what having kits has done to them is quite gratifying. There, there. Knowing how kitsune work, this wouldn't have happened if they didn't want it deep down — and you wouldn't have helped, either, if you didn't like how they were turning out. All of this is just their bodies preparing for the next time, isn't it? "N-next —" Kohaku looks at her now-giggling kit in her arms, then deflates in resignation. Hotaru reaches across you to smack her lightly on the side of her haunch, grinning evilly at the meaty noise it makes. "With the likes of you, it's only a matter of time before it happens again. Can you even get any curvier at this point, I wonder? And your belly was so big on your tiny body you had to carry it with both hands. Why the long face? Weren't you planning to turn what ought to be a civil service position into a family business?" Little Kohaku's so red-faced she might just explode, but forces down her emotions with a sniff and clings to you all the tighter with her tails. You give her a pat on the head — for all that she needs to do business with people from all over, at least she can be genuine when it comes to Hotaru, her daughter, and you. Oh well — at this point, you can comfortably tune out both vixens and enjoy having their fluff pressed up against you, great armfuls of it. Even if they're a bit more scruffy than they used to be, becoming mothers has really improved Kohaku and Hotaru's hair and fur, being absolutely glossy and lustrous at this point. |disappears into the back and returns with the little golden gremlin in her arms. "By the gods, what an attention-seeker," she sighs, taking a seat across from you and Hotaru. "Leave her for a moment and she starts fussing, nojya. Well, if she weren't fussing I'd probably have slept right through your arrival, so I guess it's not all bad." Hotaru grins. "She keeps you awake at night, does she? You used to keep me awake at night with your squirming. Finally, the gods have some small sense of justice." Kohaku looks like she's going to break into a screaming match with her friend-enemy, then huffs, clears the low table, and sets her giggling daughter atop it; the infant still has a lot of energy despite the late hour, no doubt to her mother's exasperation. By contrast, Kaori is quiet and morose as always, not exactly sleepy but tired and burdened with the sheer effort of existence in a farcical play. The infant foxes by and large ignore each other — at least outwardly — but even their sheer proximity dampens the extremes of their demeanor somewhat. "It's hard to believe they're even remotely related, let alone half-sisters, nojya. They don't just look, but act so different. If I didn't know better..." Together, both Kohaku and Hotaru turn to you, and you feel their gazes burning against your skin. What? "Nothing. Just intrusive thoughts, nojya." %"Intrusive thoughts" was how she ended up with a big belly the last time, so they're hardly just intrusive thoughts. "Ehe, I said what I said[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." "What Kohaku means is that surely another kit would prove or disprove her line of thinking." Hotaru smiles ever so pleasantly and boops her friend on the nose. "Aren't I right?" "C-come on, even I know that's a bad idea, nojya!" "It was a bad idea the first time, too. Didn't stop you." You watch the byplay with some amusement — childhood friends and now the mothers of half-sisters as these two are, the underlying tone of their teasing is that they're vying for your attention. The glances both Hotaru and Kohaku throw in your direction as they show off their daughters by you are hardly surreptitious — if you were to be honest, their need for your approval in how they're raising your get is quite gratifying. Ha. One only wonders if Komari got as exasperated raising these two, with their endless intrigues and alternating between helping and sabotaging the other. They'll never actually stop, but you know exactly how to broker a truce between the two. Grabbing each vixen by the scruff of her neck, you pull them to your side and let them press their palpably more maternal bodies against you with sighs of satisfaction. There, there. They're both needed. And as outwardly aloof as their daughters may be to each other as half-sisters, you're sure they'd notice if one of them were removed. "That's not a very high bar to clear[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]," Kohaku murmurs as she pushes her little nose against the side of your neck. "But it's more than their mothers have, ehe." "Oh, really? When are you going to give up on that stupid superstition and name your little gremlin already? You told me you were already thinking of weaning her, and she still hasn't —" There they go again, nipping at each other despite being friends. Oh well — at this point, you can comfortably tune out both vixens and enjoy having their fluff pressed up against you, great armfuls of it. Even if they're a bit more scruffy than they used to be, becoming mothers has really improved Kohaku and Hotaru's hair and fur. |casts a longing glance at the far cupboard before joining you. "Sorry. I haven't kept anything to serve guests since... well." She pats her large, round middle. "There's tea, but it isn't suitable for nights like this, nojya." "Just serve hot water like you always do when I come around these days. There's no need to be an overachiever all the time." "But —" Kohaku eyes both you and Hotaru, then bows her head and looks sheepish. "I guess it can't be helped, nojya." "Sorry for dragging you here, ha." Hotaru chuckles as Kohaku waddles off. "But you seriously didn't expect to go on a very long walk while I'm all big and round, did you?" You don't know about that — you know Hotaru well enough to be aware that she's capable of summoning up lots of energy when the mood takes her, pregnant or not. Which, admittedly, isn't now. Kohaku returns shortly with a steaming teapot and serves the three of you; no sooner has she settled back in that the vixens immediately launch into an energetic discussion of their respective pregnancies, the presence of the very person responsible for both pregnancies notwithstanding. Both vixens dip in and out between their mother tongue and Belharan, equally comfortable with both languages. "Would you..." "Maybe..." "No, [pc.heShe] took me out for a walk, and I'd like to keep it that way." "Aww, nojya. You're no fun." The vixens know exactly what they're doing, and as the gossip session progresses, snuggle in against you in a bundle of gold and black. Reclining against you from either side, hands on their kit-filled bellies, Hotaru and Kohaku sigh softly in unison and caress you with their tails. "You don't regret making us look like this, do you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]?" The circumstances may have been rather forceful, especially in Kohaku's case, but... no, otherwise you'd have rejected the advances outright. And before they get any ideas, this admission doesn't absolve either of them of any responsibility for their situations. "Trust me, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]we know. The den matron won't let me forget, nojya." The kits will be half-sisters, won't they? "I hope that means they'll get along better than we do." Hotaru and Kohaku roll over and cuddle against you, their protruding pregnant bellies rubbing and jostling against each other atop you while they press themselves in with sighs of contentment. A sense of weighty contentment emanates from their warm, gravid wombs, and they clearly intend to pull you into this swamp with them. It wouldn't be so bad, admittedly... but you do have to keep your wits around, if only to walk Hotaru back home afterwards. |brings out a small earthenware flask from a cupboard and tosses it lazily to Hotaru with a shout in her mother tongue. Hotaru laughs and receives the catch perfectly, small wisps of foxfire rising from her palms as she cradles it in her hands and a strong alcohol scent starts rising from the flask's neck. "You brought out the good stuff, I see. I thought you didn't go to the peninsula often?" "No, but [pc.ra kitsune |we have the divine champion [pc.himHer]self drinking with us tonight |you brought [pc.name] along ]. The twintailed cats make the best liquor — and having [pc.ra kitsune |such an esteemed guest |so many friends ] tonight warrants it, nojya." This is from the Old Country? "No, no! But it originates from a nearby nation, nojya — it's similar to what we foxes have, but not quite. Once Hotaru has it all warmed up, you can give it a go. You'll see what I mean." Strong, warm liquor on a cold night — well, what did you expect when you asked Hotaru out for a walk? An intense medicinal smell blooms into the air as Hotaru unseals the earthenware flask with a grin, then pours out small measures for the three of you. No toasts, no rousing words — just [pc.ra kitsune |three foxes |two foxes and [a] [pc.race] ] in each others' company. Warmed by Hotaru's foxfire, the liquor has a heavy earthen flavor, with a dash of what might be nuts of some kind, you're not sure. "Familiar enough to warm the heart, foreign enough to be interesting," Hotaru mutters, ears gradually flattening. "Damn nekomata on their peninsula, always up to no good." Kohaku just laughs, and you feel a heat churn in the pit of your stomach, rising up into your chest. "Take it slowly, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]. |okay? ] You don't want to fall over before the little gremlin does." You turn to Hotaru, and the black-furred vixen's eyelids have already started to droop and her cheeks color. Is this stuff really that strong, or are they just lightweights? With just enough drink to loosen their tongues, Hotaru and Kohaku break out into all kinds of inane, rambling gossip — which after another shot of warm liquor, they badger you into joining as well. Your travels, the people you've met, your sexual exploits — despite the liquor, you know full well that anything you say here will likely be all across the entire den by tomorrow, so you don't say anything which you wouldn't want absolutely public. On their part, these two vixens are an absolute almanac of just about everything that's happened in the arcology: births and deaths, people who've come through the torii, those who've stayed and others who left and who likely will never be seen again. Interpersonal drama between foxes you don't know and will never meet — the minutiae of just about everything doesn't escape the pair of miserable gossips. They love it, and they love you — [pc.ra kitsune |someone so explicitly favored by their god, joining them in their mischief, lending them a veneer of not-quite-respectability |an exotic local with experience they don't have, willing to indulge their questions and listen ] to their chatter while they drink themselves silly. ] This may not have been exactly what you had in mind when you asked Hotaru out for a walk, but it's an acceptable outcome nevertheless. Hotaru and Kohaku catching up with each other while you enjoy the company of both vixens — everyone wins, right? But as the hours pass, the realization that you eventually have to leave creeps up on you, especially as a tired Kohaku starts nodding off. Carefully pulling away from Kohaku, you make the little golden kitsune as comfortable as possible with the sitting cushions, then follow Hotaru out.

他们就喜欢这样，他们乐在其中。你 — [pc.ra kitsune |这样一个被自己的神明明示偏爱的人，加入了他们的恶作剧之中，从而使他们的行为看起来不那么不体面了。 |一位拥有他们所没有的经验的异国当地人，愿意耐心回答他们的问题并倾听他们的想法。 ]一边喝酒，一边聊个不停。 ] 当你邀请萤一起去散步时，这可能并不是你原本所设想的结果，但无论如何，这仍然是一个可以接受的结局。萤和琥珀得以重新建立联系，而你也能同时和这两位美女相处在一起——这样对大家来说都是双赢，不是吗？ 但随着时间的推移，你会逐渐意识到自己最终还是必须离开的，尤其是当疲惫的黄泉开始打瞌睡时。终于，萤用肘子轻推了你一下，引起你的注意，然后把手指放在嘴唇上，指向门口。你指向小白，问题显而易见，而她则带着调皮的笑容挥了挥手，表示不予理会。 她会没事的。 好吧，如果她这么说的话……你小心翼翼地拉开与小红之间的距离，用坐垫让那只小金色的狐妖尽可能地舒服一些，然后跟着小萤一起离开。
rows.raw: " As things turn out, your steps lead you down from the branches, through the roots, and eventually right outside the storehouse. It feels like Hotaru's been not-so-subtly shepherding you here all this while, and your suspicions are confirmed when she folds her ears forward and makes what can only be described as smug fox noises as you pause by the entrance. The storehouse's closed at this time of night. Hotaru pauses her fox noises for just a moment to address you in Belharan. "For business? Yes. For pleasure? Perhaps not[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. And especially not for me." The seamstress shouts again in her native tongue, and this time she's answered from within. A very scruffy Kohaku pushes open a window high up and peers down at the both of you; several moments later, you hear bars being drawn and Kohaku ushers the both of you in. "How nice of you to come around, and to bring [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship |[pc.name] ], too. [hotaru.anyKids |I'm just glad that having Kaori hasn't meant you stopped showing up — would be a shame after all these years |[hotaru.isPregnant |One would imagine being with child would drain all your energy, but you just keep going |It's been a long day, and I was starting to wonder if you were going to show up as usual ] ], nojya." Huh. So this was planned all along? "Just a couple of vixens getting together in the evening[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence; we've been doing this ever since we left the den matron's foster care. N |, n ]othing strange about that in the slightest," Kohaku replies as she leads Hotaru and you up to her tiny apartment. "Not that I'd be in bed anyway — [kohaku.anyKids |the little bundle of mischief had a nightmare or something and won't go back to sleep. I'd nod off myself, but then she'd crawl off somewhere and get into trouble, nojya.[hotaru.anyKids | Kaori is a good, calming influence on her half-sister, so I'm honestly glad she showed up, ehe. ] |[kohaku.isPregnant |everything feels so heavy, and this little bundle of mischief won't let me rest easy, nojya." [hotaru.isPregnant | "Ha. Convenient, then, that another pregnant vixen should show up and keep you company. Such a pity that you have to get up in the mornings, and I don't." Kohaku scowls. "Your kit is well-behaved and obliging even before being born, and you carry on a robust frame. I'm tiny, and some days I swear to the gods this child thinks I wronged her somehow with how often she beats me up from the inside. We aren't the same, nojya." Hotaru just laughs. ] |the nights have been getting colder of late, and the season brings with it melancholic thoughts, nojya." "Best chased away with a little warm liquor, but..." "...It's easy to overdo it when drinking alone." Kohaku sighs. "I'm really glad the two of you showed up, nojya." Hotaru? Being the responsible one? "No, it's just that this tiny creature doesn't have much space to hold her drink." ] ] Kohaku ushers you in and has the both of you seated, then [var0 |waddles into the back to fetch her little golden gremlin. It takes a little while for her to return, and you're just starting to get worried when Kohaku returns looking considerably scruffier and with the tiny kit firmly attached to one breast. "Sorry about that. All I wanted was to bring her out, but she was really fussy and insistent, nojya." Hotaru chuckles at the sight as Kohaku takes a seat at the table, then pats her own daughter in her arms. "Can't say I get you. Kaori here is always perfectly behaved — they may be half-sisters, but whatever makes them like this, it didn't come from [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence |[pc.name] ]. "Ha. What's the matter[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]? There's nothing on display there that you haven't seen before, I'm reliably informed." No. It's just that... well. You turn your gaze between the two gossips, one golden and one black, then slowly shake your head. Kitsune women do fill out while with child, but what these two have done to each other thanks to their schemes is quite ridiculous, schemes that you just happened to enable. It's less noticeable on Hotaru because of the way she dresses, but even the heavy fabric can't conceal much at this point. And with Kohaku nursing her daughter right in front of you, providing a front-row view of just how she's expanded — "[pc.ra kitsune |I'm glad that you like what you see, your Eminence |I guess this makes up a little for not being able to wear my old clothes ], but it's a little embarrassing," Kohaku murmurs as she hugs her daughter a little closer. "I'm not getting any younger, nojya." "Just because you never paid it any mind doesn't mean it wasn't going to happen." You can hear the sheer smug dripping from Hotaru's voice. "That's the colonial blood starting to creep into your line. Give it two or three more generations, and your descendants will be nice and round without even needing any help." "Help. By the gods, you sure helped, nojya." "You happily ate everything I put in front of you, and had the cheek to ask for more." "You didn't even hesitate to reach for the wyldsap every time you started going crazy." There was a time when Kohaku and Hotaru arguing might have been cause for concern, but with them all very much maternal with a pair of half-sisters in their arms, it's impossible to take their petty bickering seriously. Reaching out in turn, you wrap an arm about each vixen and pull her close, feeling your forearm sink into the firm, dense squishiness of their bodies as you pull them close. On their part, Kohaku and Hotaru get the message and change tack to vying for your attention. The glances both Hotaru and Kohaku throw in your direction as they show off their daughters by you are hardly surreptitious — if you were to be honest, their need for your approval in not just how they're raising your get, but also what having kits has done to them is quite gratifying. There, there. Knowing how kitsune work, this wouldn't have happened if they didn't want it deep down — and you wouldn't have helped, either, if you didn't like how they were turning out. All of this is just their bodies preparing for the next time, isn't it? "N-next —" Kohaku looks at her now-giggling kit in her arms, then deflates in resignation. Hotaru reaches across you to smack her lightly on the side of her haunch, grinning evilly at the meaty noise it makes. "With the likes of you, it's only a matter of time before it happens again. Can you even get any curvier at this point, I wonder? And your belly was so big on your tiny body you had to carry it with both hands. Why the long face? Weren't you planning to turn what ought to be a civil service position into a family business?" Little Kohaku's so red-faced she might just explode, but forces down her emotions with a sniff and clings to you all the tighter with her tails. You give her a pat on the head — for all that she needs to do business with people from all over, at least she can be genuine when it comes to Hotaru, her daughter, and you. Oh well — at this point, you can comfortably tune out both vixens and enjoy having their fluff pressed up against you, great armfuls of it. Even if they're a bit more scruffy than they used to be, becoming mothers has really improved Kohaku and Hotaru's hair and fur, being absolutely glossy and lustrous at this point. |disappears into the back and returns with the little golden gremlin in her arms. "By the gods, what an attention-seeker," she sighs, taking a seat across from you and Hotaru. "Leave her for a moment and she starts fussing, nojya. Well, if she weren't fussing I'd probably have slept right through your arrival, so I guess it's not all bad." Hotaru grins. "She keeps you awake at night, does she? You used to keep me awake at night with your squirming. Finally, the gods have some small sense of justice." Kohaku looks like she's going to break into a screaming match with her friend-enemy, then huffs, clears the low table, and sets her giggling daughter atop it; the infant still has a lot of energy despite the late hour, no doubt to her mother's exasperation. By contrast, Kaori is quiet and morose as always, not exactly sleepy but tired and burdened with the sheer effort of existence in a farcical play. The infant foxes by and large ignore each other — at least outwardly — but even their sheer proximity dampens the extremes of their demeanor somewhat. "It's hard to believe they're even remotely related, let alone half-sisters, nojya. They don't just look, but act so different. If I didn't know better..." Together, both Kohaku and Hotaru turn to you, and you feel their gazes burning against your skin. What? "Nothing. Just intrusive thoughts, nojya." %"Intrusive thoughts" was how she ended up with a big belly the last time, so they're hardly just intrusive thoughts. "Ehe, I said what I said[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." "What Kohaku means is that surely another kit would prove or disprove her line of thinking." Hotaru smiles ever so pleasantly and boops her friend on the nose. "Aren't I right?" "C-come on, even I know that's a bad idea, nojya!" "It was a bad idea the first time, too. Didn't stop you." You watch the byplay with some amusement — childhood friends and now the mothers of half-sisters as these two are, the underlying tone of their teasing is that they're vying for your attention. The glances both Hotaru and Kohaku throw in your direction as they show off their daughters by you are hardly surreptitious — if you were to be honest, their need for your approval in how they're raising your get is quite gratifying. Ha. One only wonders if Komari got as exasperated raising these two, with their endless intrigues and alternating between helping and sabotaging the other. They'll never actually stop, but you know exactly how to broker a truce between the two. Grabbing each vixen by the scruff of her neck, you pull them to your side and let them press their palpably more maternal bodies against you with sighs of satisfaction. There, there. They're both needed. And as outwardly aloof as their daughters may be to each other as half-sisters, you're sure they'd notice if one of them were removed. "That's not a very high bar to clear[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]," Kohaku murmurs as she pushes her little nose against the side of your neck. "But it's more than their mothers have, ehe." "Oh, really? When are you going to give up on that stupid superstition and name your little gremlin already? You told me you were already thinking of weaning her, and she still hasn't —" There they go again, nipping at each other despite being friends. Oh well — at this point, you can comfortably tune out both vixens and enjoy having their fluff pressed up against you, great armfuls of it. Even if they're a bit more scruffy than they used to be, becoming mothers has really improved Kohaku and Hotaru's hair and fur. |casts a longing glance at the far cupboard before joining you. "Sorry. I haven't kept anything to serve guests since... well." She pats her large, round middle. "There's tea, but it isn't suitable for nights like this, nojya." "Just serve hot water like you always do when I come around these days. There's no need to be an overachiever all the time." "But —" Kohaku eyes both you and Hotaru, then bows her head and looks sheepish. "I guess it can't be helped, nojya." "Sorry for dragging you here, ha." Hotaru chuckles as Kohaku waddles off. "But you seriously didn't expect to go on a very long walk while I'm all big and round, did you?" You don't know about that — you know Hotaru well enough to be aware that she's capable of summoning up lots of energy when the mood takes her, pregnant or not. Which, admittedly, isn't now. Kohaku returns shortly with a steaming teapot and serves the three of you; no sooner has she settled back in that the vixens immediately launch into an energetic discussion of their respective pregnancies, the presence of the very person responsible for both pregnancies notwithstanding. Both vixens dip in and out between their mother tongue and Belharan, equally comfortable with both languages. "Would you..." "Maybe..." "No, [pc.heShe] took me out for a walk, and I'd like to keep it that way." "Aww, nojya. You're no fun." The vixens know exactly what they're doing, and as the gossip session progresses, snuggle in against you in a bundle of gold and black. Reclining against you from either side, hands on their kit-filled bellies, Hotaru and Kohaku sigh softly in unison and caress you with their tails. "You don't regret making us look like this, do you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]?" The circumstances may have been rather forceful, especially in Kohaku's case, but... no, otherwise you'd have rejected the advances outright. And before they get any ideas, this admission doesn't absolve either of them of any responsibility for their situations. "Trust me, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]we know. The den matron won't let me forget, nojya." The kits will be half-sisters, won't they? "I hope that means they'll get along better than we do." Hotaru and Kohaku roll over and cuddle against you, their protruding pregnant bellies rubbing and jostling against each other atop you while they press themselves in with sighs of contentment. A sense of weighty contentment emanates from their warm, gravid wombs, and they clearly intend to pull you into this swamp with them. It wouldn't be so bad, admittedly... but you do have to keep your wits around, if only to walk Hotaru back home afterwards. |brings out a small earthenware flask from a cupboard and tosses it lazily to Hotaru with a shout in her mother tongue. Hotaru laughs and receives the catch perfectly, small wisps of foxfire rising from her palms as she cradles it in her hands and a strong alcohol scent starts rising from the flask's neck. "You brought out the good stuff, I see. I thought you didn't go to the peninsula often?" "No, but [pc.ra kitsune |we have the divine champion [pc.himHer]self drinking with us tonight |you brought [pc.name] along ]. The twintailed cats make the best liquor — and having [pc.ra kitsune |such an esteemed guest |so many friends ] tonight warrants it, nojya." This is from the Old Country? "No, no! But it originates from a nearby nation, nojya — it's similar to what we foxes have, but not quite. Once Hotaru has it all warmed up, you can give it a go. You'll see what I mean." Strong, warm liquor on a cold night — well, what did you expect when you asked Hotaru out for a walk? An intense medicinal smell blooms into the air as Hotaru unseals the earthenware flask with a grin, then pours out small measures for the three of you. No toasts, no rousing words — just [pc.ra kitsune |three foxes |two foxes and [a] [pc.race] ] in each others' company. Warmed by Hotaru's foxfire, the liquor has a heavy earthen flavor, with a dash of what might be nuts of some kind, you're not sure. "Familiar enough to warm the heart, foreign enough to be interesting," Hotaru mutters, ears gradually flattening. "Damn nekomata on their peninsula, always up to no good." Kohaku just laughs, and you feel a heat churn in the pit of your stomach, rising up into your chest. "Take it slowly, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]. |okay? ] You don't want to fall over before the little gremlin does." You turn to Hotaru, and the black-furred vixen's eyelids have already started to droop and her cheeks color. Is this stuff really that strong, or are they just lightweights? With just enough drink to loosen their tongues, Hotaru and Kohaku break out into all kinds of inane, rambling gossip — which after another shot of warm liquor, they badger you into joining as well. Your travels, the people you've met, your sexual exploits — despite the liquor, you know full well that anything you say here will likely be all across the entire den by tomorrow, so you don't say anything which you wouldn't want absolutely public. On their part, these two vixens are an absolute almanac of just about everything that's happened in the arcology: births and deaths, people who've come through the torii, those who've stayed and others who left and who likely will never be seen again. Interpersonal drama between foxes you don't know and will never meet — the minutiae of just about everything doesn't escape the pair of miserable gossips. They love it, and they love you — [pc.ra kitsune |someone so explicitly favored by their god, joining them in their mischief, lending them a veneer of not-quite-respectability |an exotic local with experience they don't have, willing to indulge their questions and listen ] to their chatter while they drink themselves silly. ] This may not have been exactly what you had in mind when you asked Hotaru out for a walk, but it's an acceptable outcome nevertheless. Hotaru and Kohaku catching up with each other while you enjoy the company of both vixens — everyone wins, right? But as the hours pass, the realization that you eventually have to leave creeps up on you, especially as a tired Kohaku starts nodding off. Eventually, Hotaru elbows you to get your attention, raises a finger to her lips, and points at the door. You point down at Kohaku, the question obvious, and she waves dismissively with a mischievous grin on her face. She'll be fine. Well, if she says so. Carefully pulling away from Kohaku, you make the little golden kitsune as comfortable as possible with the sitting cushions, then follow Hotaru out. "

rows.original: As things turn out, your steps lead you down from the branches, through the roots, and eventually right outside the storehouse. It feels like Hotaru's been not-so-subtly shepherding you here all this while, and your suspicions are confirmed when she folds her ears forward and makes what can only be described as smug fox noises as you pause by the entrance. Is there something she needs to pick up? "By the gods, no. We're here for pleasure, remember? Now, if there was something Kohaku has for me while we're in, I'm fine with collecting it as an afterthought, but... really, I just want to see the things she's brought back from all over before they get handed out or shipped across the ocean. She always brings back the most interesting things." Ah. Window shopping. Hotaru huffs. "That's such a crude way to put it. I'd like to think myself above gawking at things I'll never have." Says the slightly scruffy vixen who doesn't get changed to go out in public. All you get in response to that is a sniff, and Hotaru pushes aside the door to step into the storehouse. Several heads turn at her entrance, but clearly Kohaku's underlings are familiar with Hotaru's presence as they quickly turn back to their jobs [hotaru.isMILF |[hotaru.isPregnant |after it becomes clear she's not approaching with murderous intent this time |, perhaps a little too quickly ] |loading a pretty large shipment onto an oversized handcart to be drawn by one of the wooden puppets ]. [pc.ra kitsune |The fact someone of your stature is with her certainly disinclines others to stare — or openly so, at any rate. ]Eventually, the mistress of the storehouse herself comes down from her perch to greet the both of you, all smiles and business. "Welcome! Welcome, nojya! It's so good to see the both of you again![pc.ra kitsune | Having someone so esteemed like your Eminence come down in person is always a pleasure! ]" "Tch. If only I could feign good humor as sincerely as she does," Hotaru mutters not quite under her breath. Kohaku's large ears twitch, but she doesn't break her stride. "Did either of you come for something in particular, nojya? I'm afraid there isn't anything waiting for you on my side, so..." "I'm just here to see your newest acquisitions, hear what stories they have to tell before they vanish from your shelves and go to someplace dreary like that Astrida museum you were telling me about the other day... what was its name?" "Fukakusaya temple, nojya." [pc.swornGod nareva |As a member of the order and Nareva's personal champion, you feel like you should at least know that name. Sure, the order has its proverbial finger in every pie and gothmanders all over Savarra, but even if you haven't been with the order that long, all things considered... Just something you'll need to get used to, you suppose. Back to the point — l |L ]ong story short, Hotaru wants to go window shopping. "I know, nojya. This isn't her first time — she's been doing this ever since the den matron appointed me to this position. Well, enjoy yourselves — just please put everything back the way they were, if you please."
rows.translation: 结果证明，你的脚步引领你从树枝上下来，穿过树根，最终来到了仓库的外面。感觉萤一直在暗中引导你来到这里，而当你停在仓库入口处时，她把耳朵向前贴住，发出那种只能被形容为“得意洋洋的狐妖叫声”，这让你的怀疑得到了证实。 她是不是有什么东西需要去取呢？ “天啊，绝对没有。我们来这里是来享受乐趣的，记得吗？现在，如果是既然琥珀在这段时间里给了我这些东西，我当然可以事后再去收集它们，但是……说真的，我更想先看看她从各地带回来的那些东西，等它们被分发掉或者被运到海外之后，我就再去看也不迟了。她总是能带回一些最有趣的东西。” “啊，原来是在浏览商品而已。” 热夜气得哼了一声：“这么说未免太粗俗了。我可不想被认为只是个会盯着那些永远买不到的东西发呆的人。” 说这话的可是个连出门时都不愿意换身衣服、看起来有点邋遢的狐妖精啊。 她得到的回应只是一声轻哼，萤推开门走了进去。几个人在看到她进来时转过头来，但显然琥珀的手下们已经习惯了萤的存在，他们很快又继续忙自己的工作了。 [hotaru.isMILF |[hotaru.isPregnant |在确定她这次并没有杀人的意图之后 |也许速度有点太快了。 ] |将一大批货物装上一辆超大的手推车，然后由其中一个木制傀儡来拉动它 ]。 [pc.ra kitsune |像你这样地位崇高的人与她在一起，确实会让其他人不愿意盯着看——至少不会公然这么做。 ]最终，仓库的主人亲自走下高处，面带笑容、态度热情地迎接了你们两人。 “欢迎欢迎，诺雅！能够再次见到你们真是太好了！[pc.ra kitsune | 能有像您这样尊贵的人物亲自来拜访，实在是一件令人荣幸的事情！ ]啧，要是我也能像她那样真诚地装出欢笑的表情就好了，”萤低声说道。 红叶的大耳朵微微一动，但她并没有放慢脚步。“你们俩来这里，是有什么特别的事情吗，诺贾？恐怕我这边没有什么可以招待你的，所以……” “我只是来看看你新收购的那些藏品，想在它们从你的书架上消失之前，听听它们能讲述些什么故事。不然的话，它们就会像你前几天跟我提到的那个阿斯特里达博物馆一样，被送到某个阴沉的地方去。……它叫什么名字来着？” “福乐寺，对吧。 [pc.swornGod nareva |作为这个组织的一员，同时也是娜瑞瓦的私人勇士，你觉得自己至少应该知道那个名字。当然，这个组织确实涉足各个领域，在萨瓦拉各地都有他们的代理人，但即便你并没有直接加入这个组织那个长话短说…… 我想，这只是你需要慢慢适应的事情罢了。言归正传—— |L ]长话短说，萤想去商店里随便看看东西。 “我知道的，野蔷薇。这对她来说已经不是第一次了——自从女主人安排我担任这个职务后，她就经常这样做了。好吧，你们去玩吧，不过请务必把东西都放回原来的位置，好吗？

"Welcome! Welcome, nojya! It's so good to see the both of you again![pc.ra kitsune | Having someone so esteemed like your Eminence come down in person is always a pleasure! ]" "Tch. If only I could feign good humor as sincerely as she does," Hotaru mutters not quite under her breath. Kohaku's large ears twitch, but she doesn't break her stride. "Did either of you come for something in particular, nojya? I'm afraid there isn't anything waiting for you on my side, so..." "I'm just here to see your newest acquisitions, hear what stories they have to tell before they vanish from your shelves and go to someplace dreary like that Astrida museum you were telling me about the other day... what was its name?" "Fukakusaya temple, nojya." [pc.swornGod nareva |As a member of the order and Nareva's personal champion, you feel like you should at least know that name. Sure, the order has its proverbial finger in every pie and gothmanders all over Savarra, but even if you haven't been with the order that long, all things considered... Just something you'll need to get used to, you suppose. Back to the point — l |L ]ong story short, Hotaru wants to go window shopping. "I know, nojya. This isn't her first time — she's been doing this ever since the den matron appointed me to this position. Well, enjoy yourselves — just please put everything back the way they were, if you please." "

rows.original: For the next few hours, Hotaru and you wander the storehouse, the seamstress getting her grubby hands on everything within reach. You get why Kohaku implored Hotaru to behave herself — she just can't help but fiddle with anything that passes through her hands, be they ceramics, geodes, bolts of fabric, sundries, and just about anything the den could want. Ears straight and eyes bright, Hotaru's positively animated as her gift chugs away, [hotaru.anyKids |and more remarkably for once Kaori shows interest in her surroundings as opposed to her usual morose self, grasping with her little hands whatever trinkets and gewgaws her mother deems safe enough to pass on to her. Isn't that remarkable? Kaori's usually so cynical and listless, even for an infant. "Well, there's no doubt she's my daughter in this regard. Like I said, everything Kohaku brings back has a story to it — no doubt she finds that just as enthralling." Hmm. You look at little Kaori in her mother's arms, squeezing a Tychrisian glass figure of a snake — with any other infant, one would worry about such a fine piece of art, but the quiet interest and contemplation coming from the child's gift is recognizable. That, or you're reading too much into things because you want your daughter to do well in life. "Like me, she spends a lot of time in her own mind, so it's only natural that she's interested in decorations for the inside of her head." Hotaru continues, gently taking back the glass figurine from Kaori and replacing it on its shelf. "Or maybe I'm just projecting myself onto her." No, no. You were just thinking something along the same lines, too. As Kaori gets older, the nature of Kaori's gift is gradually becoming clearer, and that's to you, who can only visit intermittently. How much more, then, to her mother who minds her every day? |drawn to anything with a shred of novelty. She really is fascinated by all the knick-knacks Kohaku acquires while trading, isn't she? "How do I explain it[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]?" Hotaru taps her chin. "Even the most mundane bauble that little gremlin brings back says something about the people who made and used it. It's fun to try and work backwards from the end point, if you know what I mean, and make up stories that explain what's there. Then if it's particularly interesting, I may extend that out into a tale of its own." But wouldn't it be better to go to those places like Kohaku does and meet those people for herself? "I wouldn't say so, that would get in the way of my fantasies. My goal here is to spin threads and make up tall tales, not to bog myself down with what is and isn't like some humorless scold. I'll join the threads the way I want, into the story I weave, and I don't need troublesome reality getting in the way. After all, it's not as if anyone takes my stories seriously, right? No one actually thinks I'm telling the truth?" With her? Mostly not, but sometimes Hotaru's brutally honest just to throw people off. "Come now. I would never. Also... I by far prefer to let Kohaku do the walking and bring things home — being of mountain provincial stock, she's got the legs for crossing hills and valleys. My legs are good for other things, as you should know well." ] Hotaru may be a homebody, but it isn't that she's not interested in the world; she merely prefers to interact with it on her own terms and at a comfortable distance. [hotaru.anyKids |The same goes for Kaori, although there's the lingering suspicion the reason for her interest is rooted in something else as opposed to her mother's |Little wonder that she and Kohaku are ostensibly friends, even if they do backbite each other from time to time ]. Window shopping with all the fruits of Kohaku's travels is a wonderful way to do that, and Hotaru has no problem chattering excitedly about all the goods her friend's brought in from all over. "It's remarkable, isn't it? Our parents dumped us here and left to find the buried treasure that they imagined would make us wealthy and respectable... yet in a mere fraction of the time, Kohaku's become more respectable and got the locals to happily hand her their treasures without needing to dig around." And in this time, Hotaru herself has... "Become a very respectable nobody, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |thank you very much ]." Hotaru puts down the raw silver she'd been eyeing. "Being a stellar over-achiever at a young age is really tiring, and I don't care for it. I have my silkworms, my stories, [hotaru.anyKids |Kaori, ]and you." You spend a little more time window shopping — that's really what it boils down to — with Hotaru, exploring all the exotic goods put away in the storehouse. Kohaku's underlings give the both of you awkward glances as you pass through, but seem used to Hotaru's presence; one can only surmise that having free run of the storehouse is a privilege of being friends with Kohaku since childhood. On her part, Hotaru endeavors to not get in anyone's way as she continues to make up all sorts of nonsense while [hotaru.anyKids |delighting Kaori with the sights and scents of Kohaku's exotic stock. For an infant who's usually morose and vaguely jaded, your daughter showing such animated interest is like night and day compared to her usual self. "She's not stunted," Hotaru says, more to herself than to you. "She just doesn't see the need to get excited about something she already knows." How does she know so many things, then, being an infant? The both of you joke that Kaori was born old, but that was more a note of her demeanor than suggesting actual knowledge. |working herself up into a fit of energetic mania. It's tempting to just write it off as her gift acting up again like many of her mood swings, and yet... "Look, look! The lustre on this Tychrisian glass, the way it catches the light. How do they draw it out so thinly, consider it so commonplace to make tableware out of it?" For being so full-figured, Hotaru can really act childish when one of her moods takes her. ] Hotaru is thorough, making but one slow round through Kohaku's domain, but is absolutely satisfied at the end of it[hotaru.anyKids |, as is a giggling Kaori ]. It's one way to approach life, watching it from one's window while in comfort and safety — and clearly what Hotaru prefers. But eventually, Hotaru's seen everything there is, and [hotaru.anyKids |Kaori's getting tired from all the stimulation |she knows she's starting to outstay her welcome ]. Still firmly hand in hand with you, the seamstress says her goodbyes, and leads you out of the storehouse.
rows.translation: 在接下来的几个小时里，萤和你一起在仓库里四处逛荡，那位裁缝把她那双脏兮兮的手伸向了所有她能够拿到的东西。你现在应该明白为什么琥珀会恳求萤要守规矩了——她就是忍不住要摆弄任何她手边能拿到的东西，无论是陶瓷制品、晶洞、一卷卷的布料，还是各种各样的杂物，几乎仓库里有的东西她都想动手试试。萤听得聚精会神，眼睛也亮晶晶的，她正在兴致勃勃地挑选她的礼物呢。 [hotaru.anyKids |更令人惊讶的是，这一次，香织终于对周围的环境产生了兴趣，不再像往常那样闷闷不乐。她用自己小小的手，去抓那些妈妈认为足够安全、可以给她的东西。 这难道不值得注意吗？香织平时总是那么愤世嫉俗、无精打采，就连对于一个婴儿来说，也应该算是异常的表现吧。 嗯，毫无疑问，在这一点上她确实是我的女儿。就像我之前说的，科哈库带回来的每一样东西都背后有着故事——毫无疑问，她也会觉得这些故事同样令人着迷。” 嗯，看看小薰坐在妈妈怀里，紧紧地抱着那个提克里西亚风格的蛇形玻璃雕像吧……换作其他婴儿，人们可能会担心这样一件精美的艺术品会被弄坏，但从这个孩子对这份礼物的专注与喜爱来看，她的兴趣确实是非常真挚的。要么就是你把事情想得太复杂了，只是因为你想让你的女儿在生活中取得成功而已。 就像我一样，她也会花很多时间沉浸在自己的思绪中，所以她对‘装饰自己内心的世界’感兴趣，这也完全合情合理。”萤继续说道，轻轻从香织手中接过那个玻璃小雕像，放回了原处。“或者，也许只是我把自己的想法投射到了她身上罢了。 不，不。你其实也在考虑类似的事情吧。随着香织逐渐长大，她所拥有的这份天赋的本质也渐渐变得清晰起来——而对于你来说，由于只能偶尔去看她，这种感受自然更加深刻。更何况，对于每天都在照顾她的母亲来说，这种感受更是无法用言语来形容的。 |任何有点新奇的东西都能吸引她。 她真的对科哈克在交易中获得的那些小玩意儿充满了兴趣，不是吗？ “我该怎么解释呢[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]嗯……”萤托着下巴思考道，“就连那个小捣蛋鬼带来的最普通的小物件，也能反映出制作它和使用它的人的一些特点。如果你明白我的意思的话，试着从最终的结果出发，反向推导出其中的故事，然后编造出解释这些物品存在原因的传说，其实是一件很有趣的事情。如果某个故事特别有趣，我可能会把它发展成一篇独立的故事。” 但是，难道不不如像小红那样亲自去那些地方，亲自去遇见那些人吗？ 我可不这么认为，那样会妨碍我发挥想象力。我的目的就是编故事、编一些离奇的传说，而不是像某个毫无幽默感的严厉批评者那样，被现实中的种种琐事所束缚。我会以自己的方式加入这些故事情节中我想要深入了解这个故事吧。我编织故事时，我可不需要那些烦人的现实来干扰我。毕竟，也没人会认真对待我的故事，对吧？其实根本没人认为我在说真话。 和她在一起的时候吗？大多数情况下不会，但有时候萤会故意说一些残酷的实话，只是为了迷惑别人罢了。 “来吧，我愿意永远不会另外……我更愿意让小红来负责跑腿、把东西带回家。毕竟她出身于山区，她的双腿可适合翻山越岭啊。我的你应该很清楚，腿还有很多其他用途。 ] 萤虽然喜欢待在家里，但这并不是因为她对这个世界不感兴趣；她只是更喜欢按照自己的方式，在一个让自己感到舒适的距离上与这个世界互动而已。 [hotaru.anyKids |对于香织来说也是如此，尽管人们仍然怀疑，她之所以对这件事感兴趣，其实另有原因，而非出于对母亲的爱。 |也难怪她和琥珀表面上虽然是朋友，但偶尔也会互相背后说坏话。 ]在琥珀的旅行中收集到的各种商品，简直就是进行这种体验的绝佳方式。萤也总是兴致勃勃地谈论着她朋友从各地带来的那些商品。 “真是太棒了，不是吗？我们的父母把我们丢在这里，然后去寻找他们想象中能让我们变得富有和受人尊敬的那些埋藏的宝藏……然而，在短短的时间内，小红就已经变得受人尊敬了，当地人们也都很乐意地把他们的宝藏交给她，而她甚至都不需要去挖掘。而在这段时间里，萤自己也…… “变成了一个非常不起眼的‘无名小卒’。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |非常感谢您 ]萤放下了她一直看中的那块原始银矿。‘在这么年轻的时候就成为一位出类拔萃的佼佼者，真的非常累人，而我并不喜欢这样。我更喜欢我的蚕，还有我的故事。 [hotaru.anyKids |香织， ]还有你。” 你和萤花了一些时间在商店里浏览商品——归根结底，就是这个意思——你们一起探索仓库里那些各式各样的奇特物品。当你们经过时，琥珀的手下们会向你们投来一些尴尬的目光，但看来他们已经习惯了萤的存在；可以推测，能够自由使用这个仓库，应该是从小就和琥珀是朋友才享有的特权吧。 就她而言，萤努力不妨碍任何人，同时继续说着各种荒谬的话[hotaru.anyKids |让香织看到红鹤那些奇特的外表与闻到它散发出的独特气味，一定会让她感到非常开心。对于一个通常总是闷闷不乐、显得有些厌世的婴儿来说，你的女儿表现出如此浓厚的兴趣，与她平时的状态相比，简直简直是天壤之别。 她并没有发育迟缓，”萤自言自语道，倒更像是在对自己说，而不是在跟你说话。“她只是觉得，对于那些自己已经知道的事情，没有必要感到兴奋或激动罢了。” 那么，作为一个婴儿，她是怎么知道这么多事情的呢？你们俩总开玩笑说香织是一出生就显得很成熟，但那其实更多是在形容她的性格特点，而不是表示他们真的知道什么。 |她把自己情绪激动到近乎疯狂的程度。人们很容易认为，这只是她那反复无常的情绪又在作祟罢了，就像她那些情绪波动一样……然而…… “看啊，看！这种提克里斯玻璃上的光泽，它如何折射光线……他们是怎么把玻璃磨得如此薄，又如何把它制成如此常见的餐具呢？” 尽管萤身材丰满，但当她情绪激动的时候，真的会表现得像个小孩子一样。 ] 萤非常细致，她只绕着琥珀的领地缓慢地飞了一圈，但当她完成这次飞行后，她感到非常满意。[hotaru.anyKids |还有那个总是咯咯笑的香织…… ]这是一种看待生活的方式：在舒适安全的环境中，通过自己的窗口观察世界——显然，这正是萤所偏爱的方式。 但是，最终，萤还是会看遍所有能看到的东西，然后[hotaru.anyKids |薰因为接受了太多的刺激而感到疲惫了。 |她知道自己已经待得太久了，不再受欢迎了。 ]仍然紧紧地牵着你的手，那位裁缝道别后，带你走出了仓库。

rows.original: You don't have far to go in order to find a good scenic spot: Hotaru guides you out of the apartments and residential district, then higher up into the cherry tree where the branches aren't sturdy enough for any serious development yet — or at least, that's what you assume. The sounds of the arcology gradually fade, replaced by the rustling of leaves and [dayNight |birdsong |chirp of crickets ], and Hotaru swings herself over the last of the guardrails and quite literally out on a limb. "What's the matter[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]?" she calls back over her shoulder, a teasing lilt to her voice. "Scared of heights, or perhaps you're [pc.ra kitsune |taking to being one of us a little too well and being a stickler for the rules |worried about going where you shouldn't ]?" You're just worried that... well, it's pretty windy this high up, and it's a long way to the Frostwood below. [hotaru.isMILF |Sure, Hotaru may have done this a lot, but her body's looking a lot more maternal of late, and no doubt her sense of weight and balance's changed with it. [hotaru.isPregnant |"Ha. You think I'm ungainly? I suppose you do have a point there," Hotaru purrs, patting her large, round middle. "Mai says I'm bigger and carrying lower than I ought to be for being this far along, and it's not just my middle that's put on weight. But at the same time, like I once said... that'd be too easy. If dying in childbirth would be me getting off too lightly, then my gift isn't going to let me get out of my misery from a simple fall." |"Ha. It's nice of you to be worried... and yes, I'm well aware of how differently my body moves these days," Hotaru purrs, giving the side of her hips a firm smack. "But... you know full well that my gift won't let me get out of my misery that easily ] No, wait! Oh, by the gods, she really does believe what she's saying, doesn't she? "You were the one who suggested we go on a walk," Hotaru teases. "Maybe my gift set it up so that you're around to keep me from falling, if it comes to that. Isn't that such a romantic notion?" |[hotaru.anyKids |Maybe her antics don't concern her, but you can't help but worry when she's got Kaori in one arm. rows.translation: 你不必走太远就能找到一个风景优美的地方：萤会带你离开公寓区和住宅区，然后带你来到那些樱桃树所在的区域——那些树枝还不够结实，还不适合进行大规模的开发……至少你是这么认为的。拱形建筑区里的嘈杂声渐渐远去，取而代之的，是树叶的沙沙声[dayNight |鸟鸣声 |蟋蟀的鸣叫声 ]萤纵身跳过了最后的护栏，简直就像是在悬在半空中一样。 “怎么了？[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]？”她回头喊道，声音里带着一丝戏谑的调子，“是怕高吗，还是说[pc.ra kitsune |太过于融入我们的圈子，而且对规则也过于苛刻了。 |担心会走到不该去的地方 ]你只是担心……嗯，这么高的地方风确实很大，而且距离下面的霜木林也有很长的距离。 [hotaru.isMILF |当然，萤可能经常这样做，但最近她的体态看起来更加像一位母亲了，毫无疑问，她的体重感知和平衡能力也因此发生了变化。 [hotaru.isPregnant |哈，你认为我笨手笨脚的？我想你说得确实有道理，”萤轻声说道，一边拍着自己圆滚滚的肚子。“舞说，考虑到我已经怀孕到这个阶段了，我的体型应该更小一些，肚子也不应该这么大，而且不只是我的肚子变胖了。但与此同时，就像我之前说过……如果生孩子就能让我摆脱这些痛苦，那就太简单了。如果生孩子都能让我这么轻易地摆脱困境，那么我的‘天赋’也就无法让我从那些更普通的痛苦中解脱出来了。 |哈，你这么担心我真是太好了……没错，我也很清楚这些天我的身体变得多么不灵活了。”萤轻声说道，同时用力拍了拍自己的臀部。“但是……你心里很清楚，我的这份天赋根本不可能让我那么轻易地摆脱这种痛苦。 ] 不，等等！哦，天啊，她真的确实相信她说的吧，不是吗？” “其实是你提议我们一起去散步的，”萤调皮地说道，“也许是我的礼物让一切变得如此，让你能够在我需要帮助的时候出现在我身边。这样的想法，是不是很浪漫呢？ |[hotaru.anyKids |也许她的那些行为并不影响她自己，但当她把薰抱在怀里的时候，你就忍不住会担心起来。 “哦，担心是很正常的——如果薰只是个普通的角色，我也不会责怪你。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]但是，我们女儿送的礼物所散发出的光芒，比我的礼物要明亮得多，而我知道她将会过上一种漫长、健康，但却会让人感到无比压抑的生活。然后还会对此付之一笑。我的台词里并没有包含大多数人所担心的那些问题——我们当中没有人能够如此轻易地摆脱这种生存状态。 从这里看到的景色真是太美了！”萤边走边回头说道，“如果这样能让香织不再总是看起来那么疲惫、那么严肃的话，我愿意不惜付出任何代价！哦，天啊，她真的是认真的。换作别人，这话肯定只是开玩笑，但萤……她就是那种会说出来并且真心这么认为的人。 |[hotaru.isPregnant |毫无疑问，萤在年轻时可能经常这样做，但现在的她体重明显增加了，而且最近几个月她的重心也发生了变化。 “啧，你说话的方式越来越像舞了——就因为我现在怀孕了，就希望我能够成为你的依靠。我并没有笨到连自己的身体都无法随意移动。再说，这根本算不上什么问题——只是稍微远一点而已，这样我们就能获得更好的视野，而不会被那些树叶挡住视线。哦，现在她要把你也牵扯进这件事里了？ “你当然会陪我一起去吧[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]。 |你不会也是这样吧？ ]毕竟，是你要提议我们去散步的。” 萤已经走得远远的，摇摇摆摆地离开了；而那位裁缝那种坚信自己还会继续存在的喜悦，仅仅是因为这样就能让自己的天赋带来更多的折磨，这种心态实在是与萤的情况截然不同。 “诅咒也是一种祝福。你只需要用不同的角度来看待它罢了。 |知道萤会表现得如此随意是一回事，但亲眼看到她这么做又是另一回事了。 “你竟然会为我担心，真是太浪漫了……但说实话，这根本不是什么大事。就算我真的摔倒了，把所有的骨头都摔断，有些事情也是值得的。[pc.ra kitsune | 说实话，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]你真的已经融入得非常好——听起来简直就像那个家庭的主妇一样。 ]她的热情与活力仿佛孩童般纯真，她的动作也完全符合她这种性格。尽管穿着厚重的衣服，萤火虫依然灵活地跳到树枝上，将几片巨大的树叶拨到一边。 “你总是把自己置于危险之中，不是吗？关键不在于避免危险，而在于权衡你愿意承受什么，以及你能从中获得什么。而你，绝对是值得这样做的，对吧？ ] ] ]

rows.original: You've little choice but to hop over and follow Hotaru; the black-furred vixen eventually finds a comfy perch with a good view of the sky and takes a seat, urging you to follow her stead. Shafts of [dayNight |sun |moon ]light fall between the cherry blossom tree's gigantic leaves, and Hotaru sighs as she sinks against you. [dayNight |"We're so high up, you can see a long way. That glint by the horizon, I think that's the northern glacier, and the sea beyond it. Then to the south, the mountain ranges and valleys." She's never felt the need to go there, like Kohaku has? "The knowledge that there's a world out beyond the horizon is enough to keep me humble, I don't need to travel with Kohaku to know that. As for being interesting, I prefer the world in my head, thank you very much." So much for being humble, ha. "It's a side effect of being gifted, thank you. A small mercy." Hotaru takes a deep breath, [hotaru.isPregnant |hugs her round belly to herself, ]then deflates and folds her ears. "And honestly? I wish that world would continue to stay at arm's length, let Kohaku and you bring it to me in manageable pieces. I have so much inside of me to deal with, that any energy left for dealing with what's outside is hard to come by. "Unlike some others, I wasn't exiled in all but name, and neither am I here to make my fortune or have adventures in a new, exciting continent an ocean away. Those things come with a price, and even if the fancy ever struck me to begin with I've outgrown such fancies long ago[hotaru.anyKids | — I'm a mother, after all |[hotaru.isPregnant | — it won't be long before I'm a mother, now ] ]." This doesn't have anything to do with her parents dumping her in Komari's care and going prospecting for the next couple decades or so, does it? "I'm not going to outright say I'm bitter — I may not agree with their reasons, but I can see where they were coming from. And what better way to not have to deal with a gifted girl growing up setting everything around her on fire, whether she means to or not?" [hotaru.anyKids |Grinning maniacally, Hotaru rolls Kaori out of her arms and into her hands, holding her daughter up high against the Marches sun in the clear sky. "I'd like to think I'm made of sterner stuff than my mother. She ran away, I won't." She really does see it that way, does she? "Call me miserably cynical, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ] but I don't think her finally deciding to retire just when I've established my life firmly enough to pop a kit is a coincidence. Now, I'm not saying it was all my fault that led to that decision — Mom's gift has made her a lot more cavalier than most. But you can hardly drag a gifted infant across the continent for years." |Hotaru's pensive for a moment, then her expression settles into a resigned smile. "I'll be honest — I always knew I was the result of an impulse that Mom never thought much of, but just like I have my particular problems, she does hers, too. As does every single one of my matrilineal line, to be honest." ] ...If Hotaru didn't exist, would these gifts have ended too? "Probably, but..." Hotaru's smile hardens. "[pc.ra kitsune |Begging your pardon, your Eminence, but is this going where I think it is?" You didn't quite mean it that way, but — The black-furred vixen waves off your words. "I'd be lying if I didn't say it hasn't occurred to me, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |Look, there's no need to dance around the subject — I've thought about it myself for a long time now, wondering why I was living an orphan's life when my parents were still alive and kicking ]. I'm well aware that most would consider the term 'gift' a euphemism for what it really is. Although the den matron refuses to discuss it further, it was likely why my great-great-great grandmother was shipped across the ocean with her in the first wave of settlers, to keep such — ha — disturbances away from upstanding folk. Before then, it was the mountain provinces, now it's the colonies. "It would be easy, wouldn't it? To just give up, cut off my lineage with me and die with my so-called gift?" This should have been a lighthearted walk, and now it's taken this melancholy turn. Maybe — "No. I want to say it[pc.ra kitsune |, and especially to someone so favored by not just the gods, but the August Master at the Center of Heaven himself ]. I don't regret living life, I don't regret my existence, and all I have to do to turn things around is to look at what others would regard as a curse from another perspective. Everyone across the ocean is so fixated on seeing things only from one angle, you understand? "The way I've lived life, it really is a gift. And I want to have daughters who can share in it. You just need to see it like I do — misery and suffering is fun." You give Hotaru a hard look, but there isn't the slightest trace of sarcasm in her as she beams at you, all starry-eyed. She's a good actor, but if this is just a show, it's a very good one. |"Kohaku and I, we'd throw stones at the stars when we were young. The little creature once saw a shooting star and thought lots of people would want such a thing, so she got me to lug up a whole lot of stones up here and we'd spend all night trying to knock down the stars." Well, she wasn't wrong about such things being highly prized. Starmetal and the like is valuable, and not just as a novelty. "But by throwing stones at them?" Hotaru chuckles. "It continued until one of the rocks fell all the way down and gave someone a good bruise on the head. The den matron was pretty furious at us for that; for how high up we are, we ought to have been glad it was just a bruise. "Honestly, though? The stars are better up in the sky where they are. Good thing no matter how many of them fall, there're always more." No doubt there's a deep and meaningful lesson to be learned here, but now's not the time for that. The soft stir of the chill evening Marches wind, the gentle creak and sway of the branch you're sitting on, the heat of Hotaru's unstable gift burning in her body[hotaru.isPregnant |, wrapped around the kit growing in her womb ] — this is what you've gone so high and far out for. "Mmmmh." Hotaru turns her gaze up to the twinkling night sky. "I feel like I ought to have outgrown such fancies at this point[hotaru.anyKids | — I'm a mother, after all — |[hotaru.isPregnant | — it won't be long before I'm a mother, now — |, ] ] but if anything, it's actually gotten worse. [hotaru.anyKids |Seeing Kaori all jaded and world-weary in a body so young has me valuing that sense of wonder all the more |Having another person going out there and bringing back the world to my doorstep has been quite interesting so far ]." The both of you spend several more moments of silence under the stars, then Hotaru smiles and elbows you. "You know, years later Kohaku did manage to get her hands on some starmetal. Some old crater far down south on this continent, where even the winters are mild; the locals had dug some up along with their usual copper, and she managed to get a great price. She showed it to me — while it was good, it wasn't the stuff we'd dreamed of trying to hit the stars down with our rocks. "And honestly, those nights spent tossing stones at the sky with her are what I miss." Well, there's her important lesson. Hotaru huffs. "Well, I'm refusing to learn it. I'm not in the mind to learn from my mistakes tonight, not while I'm with you." ] [pc.ra kitsune |Heh. By the by, it hasn't escaped your notice that Hotaru's gotten relaxed enough that she's dropped even the cursory veneer of respect for you and your position. Not that you're complaining — even if the way her tails are unknowingly seeking out yours for cuddles is most scandalous, what does it matter [hotaru.anyKids |when she's gone so far as to birth you a daughter |[hotaru.isPregnant |when she's already weighed down with your child |at this point ] ]? Decorum be damned, at least here and now. "Mmh. I've been pestered all my life by the den matron to be more presentable. Not to raise my voice. Take smaller steps instead of running around. I get why those exist, but it's just between the two of us here and now. My [pc.mf |lord |lady ]." ]
rows.translation: 你别无选择，只能跳过去跟着萤；那只黑毛狐妖最终找到了一个视野开阔、非常舒适的栖息处，然后坐了下来，还催促你也跟着她坐。一道道光芒[dayNight |太阳 |月亮 ]樱花树的巨大叶片间洒下了柔和的光芒，萤轻轻靠在你身上，叹了口气。 [dayNight |我们站得这么高，视野非常开阔。地平线上那道闪光，我想应该是北边的冰川，以及它后面的大海。而向南望去，则是连绵的山脉和山谷。” 她从未有过像小花那样想去那里的冲动，对吧？ 知道地平线之外还有一个世界，这一事实就足以让我保持谦逊。我并不需要跟随琥珀一起去探索才能明白这一点。至于哪个世界更有趣，我更喜欢我脑海中的那个世界，非常感谢你。 所谓的谦虚，也就这么回事吧，哈。” “这是天赋带来的副作用，谢谢。也算是一个小小的恩赐吧。”萤深吸一口气说道。 [hotaru.isPregnant |把她圆滚滚的肚子紧紧抱在怀里， ]然后它就瘪下去，把耳朵折起来。“说实话？我希望那个世界能一直保持距离，让小花和你一点一点地把那些事情告诉我。我内心有太多事情需要处理，所以几乎没有什么精力再去应对外界的事情了。 与其他人不同，我实际上并没有被流放，只不过名义上是而已。我来这里也不是为了发财，也不是为了去那个遥远的大陆上冒险。那些事情都需要付出代价的，而且就算我曾经有过这样的念头，现在也已经彻底放弃了。[hotaru.anyKids | — 毕竟，我也是一个母亲。 |[hotaru.isPregnant | — 不久之后，我就会成为一名母亲了。 ] ]这和她的父母把她丢给麻里照顾，然后自己去寻找下一个几十年的生活目标这件事，应该没有关系吧？ “我并不想直接说自己心里怨恨什么——我可能并不认同他们的做法，但我也能理解他们的出发点。而且，还有什么比让这样一个有天赋的女孩在成长过程中不断破坏周围的一切更好的办法呢？无论她是故意的还是无意的。 [hotaru.anyKids |萤疯狂地笑着，将香织从自己的怀里抱到手中，高高举起女儿，让她的脸迎向晴朗天空中明媚的阳光。“我愿意相信，我比我的母亲更加坚强。她选择了逃跑，但我不会。” 她真的是这么认为的，对吧？ “你们可以称我为一个极度愤世嫉俗的人[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]， ]但我认为，就在我刚刚安定下来、准备好好享受生活的时候，她却突然决定退休，这绝非巧合。当然，我并不是说这是有人故意安排的所有正是我的失误导致了那个决定——妈妈的这份天赋让她的态度比大多数人都要随意、不拘小节。但是，你总不可能带着一个有天赋的婴儿跨越整个大陆，一路奔波多年吧。 rows.raw: " You've little choice but to hop over and follow Hotaru; the black-furred vixen eventually finds a comfy perch with a good view of the sky and takes a seat, urging you to follow her stead. Shafts of [dayNight |sun |moon ]light fall between the cherry blossom tree's gigantic leaves, and Hotaru sighs as she sinks against you. [dayNight |"We're so high up, you can see a long way. That glint by the horizon, I think that's the northern glacier, and the sea beyond it. Then to the south, the mountain ranges and valleys." She's never felt the need to go there, like Kohaku has? "The knowledge that there's a world out beyond the horizon is enough to keep me humble, I don't need to travel with Kohaku to know that. As for being interesting, I prefer the world in my head, thank you very much." So much for being humble, ha. "It's a side effect of being gifted, thank you. A small mercy." Hotaru takes a deep breath, [hotaru.isPregnant |hugs her round belly to herself, ]then deflates and folds her ears. "And honestly? I wish that world would continue to stay at arm's length, let Kohaku and you bring it to me in manageable pieces. I have so much inside of me to deal with, that any energy left for dealing with what's outside is hard to come by. "Unlike some others, I wasn't exiled in all but name, and neither am I here to make my fortune or have adventures in a new, exciting continent an ocean away. Those things come with a price, and even if the fancy ever struck me to begin with I've outgrown such fancies long ago[hotaru.anyKids | — I'm a mother, after all |[hotaru.isPregnant | — it won't be long before I'm a mother, now ] ]." This doesn't have anything to do with her parents dumping her in Komari's care and going prospecting for the next couple decades or so, does it? "I'm not going to outright say I'm bitter — I may not agree with their reasons, but I can see where they were coming from. And what better way to not have to deal with a gifted girl growing up setting everything around her on fire, whether she means to or not?" [hotaru.anyKids |Grinning maniacally, Hotaru rolls Kaori out of her arms and into her hands, holding her daughter up high against the Marches sun in the clear sky. "I'd like to think I'm made of sterner stuff than my mother. She ran away, I won't." She really does see it that way, does she? "Call me miserably cynical, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ] but I don't think her finally deciding to retire just when I've established my life firmly enough to pop a kit is a coincidence. Now, I'm not saying it was all my fault that led to that decision — Mom's gift has made her a lot more cavalier than most. But you can hardly drag a gifted infant across the continent for years." |Hotaru's pensive for a moment, then her expression settles into a resigned smile. "I'll be honest — I always knew I was the result of an impulse that Mom never thought much of, but just like I have my particular problems, she does hers, too. As does every single one of my matrilineal line, to be honest." ] ...If Hotaru didn't exist, would these gifts have ended too? "Probably, but..." Hotaru's smile hardens. "[pc.ra kitsune |Begging your pardon, your Eminence, but is this going where I think it is?" You didn't quite mean it that way, but — The black-furred vixen waves off your words. "I'd be lying if I didn't say it hasn't occurred to me, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |Look, there's no need to dance around the subject — I've thought about it myself for a long time now, wondering why I was living an orphan's life when my parents were still alive and kicking ]. I'm well aware that most would consider the term 'gift' a euphemism for what it really is. Although the den matron refuses to discuss it further, it was likely why my great-great-great grandmother was shipped across the ocean with her in the first wave of settlers, to keep such — ha — disturbances away from upstanding folk. Before then, it was the mountain provinces, now it's the colonies. "It would be easy, wouldn't it? To just give up, cut off my lineage with me and die with my so-called gift?" This should have been a lighthearted walk, and now it's taken this melancholy turn. Maybe — "No. I want to say it[pc.ra kitsune |, and especially to someone so favored by not just the gods, but the August Master at the Center of Heaven himself ]. I don't regret living life, I don't regret my existence, and all I have to do to turn things around is to look at what others would regard as a curse from another perspective. Everyone across the ocean is so fixated on seeing things only from one angle, you understand? "The way I've lived life, it really is a gift. And I want to have daughters who can share in it. You just need to see it like I do — misery and suffering is fun." You give Hotaru a hard look, but there isn't the slightest trace of sarcasm in her as she beams at you, all starry-eyed. She's a good actor, but if this is just a show, it's a very good one. |"Kohaku and I, we'd throw stones at the stars when we were young. The little creature once saw a shooting star and thought lots of people would want such a thing, so she got me to lug up a whole lot of stones up here and we'd spend all night trying to knock down the stars." Well, she wasn't wrong about such things being highly prized. Starmetal and the like is valuable, and not just as a novelty. "But by throwing stones at them?" Hotaru chuckles. "It continued until one of the rocks fell all the way down and gave someone a good bruise on the head. The den matron was pretty furious at us for that; for how high up we are, we ought to have been glad it was just a bruise. "Honestly, though? The stars are better up in the sky where they are. Good thing no matter how many of them fall, there're always more." No doubt there's a deep and meaningful lesson to be learned here, but now's not the time for that. The soft stir of the chill evening Marches wind, the gentle creak and sway of the branch you're sitting on, the heat of Hotaru's unstable gift burning in her body[hotaru.isPregnant |, wrapped around the kit growing in her womb ] — this is what you've gone so high and far out for. "Mmmmh." Hotaru turns her gaze up to the twinkling night sky. [hotaru.anyKids |Seeing Kaori all jaded and world-weary in a body so young has me valuing that sense of wonder all the more |Having another person going out there and bringing back the world to my doorstep has been quite interesting so far ]."
