rows.original: The both of you bide a little longer, sitting amidst the rustle of leaves and under [dayNight |warm, gentle sunshine |wan starlight coupled with a chill that makes Hotaru's fur all the more appealing ]. By and large, the seamstress [hotaru.anyKids |pulls little Kaori in against her breast |[hotaru.isPregnant |cradles her [hotaru.pregStage 3 |large, overripe |swollen ] middle with a sigh that's just a little lewd |murmurs something in her mother tongue under her breath ] ], then lays her head on your shoulder. "You know, I've never had any lack of prospective suitors despite my infamy. Every one of them thought they were up to the challenge — knowing better than everyone else, being more prepared, simply being different. All the excuses to not heed the lessons of those who've gone before. Usually, they make their excuses and leave when I set them on fire, accidentally or otherwise. "But you... you're one of the two whom I genuinely felt would honestly stick with me throughout — and despite — everything. And you haven't let me down[hotaru.anyKids | in the slightest, not when you still try to be around for Kaori despite having genuine matters drawing you away." Kaori is... "Gifted. With all that it entails." Yes. That. You know that Hotaru has thought this through and been preparing for it longer than you know, but even so... "How sweet of you. Funnily enough, her trouble is that she doesn't cause trouble and thus unsettles others. Well, it could be worse |[hotaru.isPregnant |, even though I clearly said that you'd fulfilled what was expected of you. You grin and pat Hotaru on the head between her ears. Maybe this is why she's never managed to go steady with any of her past prospective suitors — these kinds of things are never as transactional as she's making them out to be. "I meant it, though." The seamstress sighs and pats her [hotaru.pregStage 3 |hugely swollen |rounded ] belly. "I was fully prepared to — well — one of us is still better than being fostered, as experienced as the den matron was at it." Yes, you know she was being serious. Hotaru flicks her ears. "I still don't get you, but I'm not going to pretend to try and understand |, even if I've grown to expect such things by now. For once, the surprise's in my favor." Given how much Hotaru enjoys novelty, that's a plus, you suppose. "Ha. I could tell you obviously were something when I first set eyes on you ] ]. [pc.ra kitsune |I suppose this kind of gallantry and honor would be expected of a divine champion, even of — haha, you know full well as I do the August Master's temperament. But I do appreciate you sticking with me even when you don't have to, truly |When all's said and done, it really stands out that it took a [pc.race] from outside to stick with me despite everything, doesn't it? Maybe you're the new perspective I needed to get over myself ]." Without warning, the black-furred vixen lets out a moaning sigh and squishes herself against you, tails curling about your waist possessively as [hotaru.isPregnant |she presses the heat of her pregnant belly close |the warmth of a body made curvaceous from kit-bearing grows too great to contain ]. For the blink of an eye, Hotaru's heavy breathing fills your world, and then she melts in her seat, ears turning down. Now what was all that about? "[pc.ra kitsune |Forgive me, your Eminence |Aha, it isn't important ]. I just had a number of intrusive thoughts, that's all." It hasn't escaped your notice that the more maternally-shaped Hotaru becomes, the more of these intrusive thoughts she has. "Truly a mystery[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." ] The both of you sit in silence a little longer, [pc.ra kitsune |tails intertwined, ]but eventually Hotaru nudges you and clambers to her feet[hotaru.isPregnant | unsteadily, waving off your help ]. "So... thanks for coming out for a walk with me [dayNight |today |this evening ][pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. It's really appreciated. It's hard to talk about these things in a frank manner, but honestly, you're really easy to talk to. I bet you have everyone spilling their life's story and little secrets within minutes of meeting, don't you?" With that, Hotaru graces you with another kiss, then [hotaru.isMILF |sashays |walks ] off, leaving you to admire the seamstress' back and tails as the door slides closed behind her...
rows.translation: 你们俩再耐心等一会儿吧，就坐在树叶沙沙作响的地方，就在下面。 [dayNight |温暖而柔和的阳光 |黯淡的星光，再加上那丝寒意，使得萤的毛皮显得更加诱人。 ]总的来说，这位裁缝[hotaru.anyKids |将年幼的香织拉到自己怀里 |[hotaru.isPregnant |将她拥入怀中[hotaru.pregStage 3 |又大又熟透的 |肿胀的 ]叹息着，语气里带着一丝调皮的味道 |她用母语小声地嘟囔着什么。 ] ]然后，她把头靠在你的肩上。 “你知道吗，尽管我名声不好，但我从来都不缺追求者。他们每个人都认为自己有能力应对这个挑战——他们自以为比别人更了解情况，准备得也更充分，总之，他们都认为自己能够胜任。不同这些借口都是为了不去吸取前人的教训。通常，每当我无意中或故意惹他们生气时，他们就会找各种借口然后离开。 “但是你……你是我真正认为会在任何情况下都一直陪伴在我身边的两个人之一。而你并没有让我失望。[hotaru.anyKids | 一点也不。尤其是当你明明有更重要的事情要处理，却还是努力想要陪伴在香织身边的时候。” 香织…… “她是个有天赋的人。这意味着她拥有许多非凡的能力。” 没错。萤早就考虑过这个问题，并且为此做了比你想象中更长时间的准备。但即便如此…… “你真是太好了。说来也挺讽刺的，她的麻烦就在于她从不主动惹麻烦，因此反而让别人感到不安。不过，情况本可能更糟的 |[hotaru.isPregnant |尽管我已经明确说过，你已经做到了人们对你的期望。” 他微笑着，轻拍了一下萤耳朵中间的位置。也许这就是为什么她过去那些追求者始终没能和她发展成稳定的关系吧——这些事情其实并不像她所说的那样纯粹是利益交换的关系。 “不过，我是认真的。”裁缝叹了口气，轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀。 [hotaru.pregStage 3 |肿胀得非常厉害 |圆润的 ]我本来是做好了充分准备的——嗯，我们当中有一个人被寄养总比被送到别的地方去要好，毕竟那位巢穴的女首领在照顾孩子方面经验丰富。” 是的，你知道她是认真的。 萤摇动着耳朵：“我还是不太明白你的意思，但我也不会假装自己理解了。 |即使我现在已经习惯了这类事情，但这一次，惊喜确实降临到了我身上。 考虑到萤如此喜欢新鲜事物，这应该算是一个优点吧。 “哈，我第一眼看到你的时候，就觉得你一定不是普通人。 ] ]。 [pc.ra kitsune |我想，这样的英勇与荣誉确实是一个神圣战士应该具备的，更何况——哈哈，你和我一样，都非常了解那位尊贵的大师的性格。不过，我真的很感激你，在本不必如此的情况下，依然选择陪伴在我身边 |归根结底，真正值得注意的是，完成这项工作确实花费了相当长的时间。 [pc.race]无论发生什么，你始终陪伴在我身边，对吧？也许你正是我所需要的那个新的视角，帮助我克服自我束缚，走出困境 ]。" [hotaru.isMILF |萤的毛发因为寒冷而开始蓬松起来。 [dayNight | |晚上 ]空气中弥漫着某种气息，她突然感到一阵寒意袭来，全身不由得绷紧了。毫无征兆地，那只黑毛狐妖发出一声呜咽，紧紧地依偎在你身边，它的尾巴像是在 possessively 地缠绕着你的腰肢[hotaru.isPregnant |她将怀孕时隆起的腹部紧紧贴在身上。 |那因穿戴装备而形成的曲线美所散发出的温暖，已经变得太过强烈，难以被束缚在体内。 ]就在那一瞬间，萤急促的呼吸声充满了你的整个世界，随后她便在座位上瘫软下来，耳朵也耷拉了下来。 那么，刚才发生的一切到底是怎么回事呢？[pc.ra kitsune |请原谅我，阁下。 |啊哈，其实这并不重要。 ]我只是有些烦人的念头罢了，没什么别的。” 你肯定也注意到了：萤越是变得像母亲一样，这些烦人的念头就越多。 “真是个谜啊[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]。" ] 你们俩又安静地坐了一会儿。 [pc.ra kitsune |命运彼此交织， ]但最终，萤会推了你一下，然后站了起来。[hotaru.isPregnant | 摇摇晃晃地，却摆手拒绝了你的帮助 ]虽然没有人明说，但你心里明白，你们共度的时光即将结束。于是你小心翼翼地带着她离开那棵树，回到了她的家门口。 “那么……谢谢你陪我一起散步。 [dayNight |今天 |今晚 ][pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]真的非常感激。这类事情本来很难坦率地谈论，但说实话，你真的很容易让人敞开心扉。我敢打赌，刚认识几分钟，大家就会开始向你倾诉自己的人生故事和那些小秘密，对吧？” 说完，萤又给了你一个吻，然后[hotaru.isMILF |摇摆着走 |行走 ]门在她身后关上，只剩下你可以欣赏那位裁缝的背影了……
rows.raw: " The both of you bide a little longer, sitting amidst the rustle of leaves and under [dayNight |warm, gentle sunshine |wan starlight coupled with a chill that makes Hotaru's fur all the more appealing ]. By and large, the seamstress [hotaru.anyKids |pulls little Kaori in against her breast |[hotaru.isPregnant |cradles her [hotaru.pregStage 3 |large, overripe |swollen ] middle with a sigh that's just a little lewd |murmurs something in her mother tongue under her breath ] ], then lays her head on your shoulder. "You know, I've never had any lack of prospective suitors despite my infamy. Every one of them thought they were up to the challenge — knowing better than everyone else, being more prepared, simply being different. All the excuses to not heed the lessons of those who've gone before. Usually, they make their excuses and leave when I set them on fire, accidentally or otherwise. "But you... you're one of the two whom I genuinely felt would honestly stick with me throughout — and despite — everything. And you haven't let me down[hotaru.anyKids | in the slightest, not when you still try to be around for Kaori despite having genuine matters drawing you away." Kaori is... "Gifted. With all that it entails." Yes. That. You know that Hotaru has thought this through and been preparing for it longer than you know, but even so... "How sweet of you. Funnily enough, her trouble is that she doesn't cause trouble and thus unsettles others. Well, it could be worse |[hotaru.isPregnant |, even though I clearly said that you'd fulfilled what was expected of you. You grin and pat Hotaru on the head between her ears. Maybe this is why she's never managed to go steady with any of her past prospective suitors — these kinds of things are never as transactional as she's making them out to be. "I meant it, though." The seamstress sighs and pats her [hotaru.pregStage 3 |hugely swollen |rounded ] belly. "I was fully prepared to — well — one of us is still better than being fostered, as experienced as the den matron was at it." Yes, you know she was being serious. Hotaru flicks her ears. "I still don't get you, but I'm not going to pretend to try and understand |, even if I've grown to expect such things by now. For once, the surprise's in my favor." Given how much Hotaru enjoys novelty, that's a plus, you suppose. "Ha. I could tell you obviously were something when I first set eyes on you ] ]. [pc.ra kitsune |I suppose this kind of gallantry and honor would be expected of a divine champion, even of — haha, you know full well as I do the August Master's temperament. But I do appreciate you sticking with me even when you don't have to, truly |When all's said and done, it really stands out that it took a [pc.race] from outside to stick with me despite everything, doesn't it? Maybe you're the new perspective I needed to get over myself ]." [hotaru.isMILF |Hotaru's fur has begun to puff out from the nip of the chill [dayNight | |evening ]air, and a shiver runs through her body as she suddenly tenses. Without warning, the black-furred vixen lets out a moaning sigh and squishes herself against you, tails curling about your waist possessively as [hotaru.isPregnant |she presses the heat of her pregnant belly close |the warmth of a body made curvaceous from kit-bearing grows too great to contain ]. For the blink of an eye, Hotaru's heavy breathing fills your world, and then she melts in her seat, ears turning down. Now what was all that about? "[pc.ra kitsune |Forgive me, your Eminence |Aha, it isn't important ]. I just had a number of intrusive thoughts, that's all." It hasn't escaped your notice that the more maternally-shaped Hotaru becomes, the more of these intrusive thoughts she has. "Truly a mystery[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." ] The both of you sit in silence a little longer, [pc.ra kitsune |tails intertwined, ]but eventually Hotaru nudges you and clambers to her feet[hotaru.isPregnant | unsteadily, waving off your help ]. It's unspoken, but you understand your time together is drawing to a close, and carefully lead her off the branch and back to her doorstep. "So... thanks for coming out for a walk with me [dayNight |today |this evening ][pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. It's really appreciated. It's hard to talk about these things in a frank manner, but honestly, you're really easy to talk to. I bet you have everyone spilling their life's story and little secrets within minutes of meeting, don't you?" With that, Hotaru graces you with another kiss, then [hotaru.isMILF |sashays |walks ] off, leaving you to admire the seamstress' back and tails as the door slides closed behind her... "

rows.original: You remain alert, wondering where Hotaru wants you to take her[hotaru.anyKids | and Kaori ], but while she continually nipping at you and driving you forward she's more concerned with keeping you moving rather than having a concrete destination in mind. Well, since she's letting you pick your destination... Without being quite aware of it yourself, you've wandered down into the tree's roots and by the sacred gardens, your feet moving of their own accord. Hotaru follows you like an eager puppy every step of the way, humming a hauntingly wistful tune [hotaru.anyKids |as she hugs Kaori close |in your wake ]. Why the sudden good mood? "I'm with you[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. That's as fine a reason as any, isn't it?" And is that all? "Of course not, look at where you're taking us. [pc.ra kitsune |Not entirely surprising considering you're the divine champion, but piety even now? You're starting to make me feel all guilty and inadequate, your Eminence." Hotaru giggles and cozies up to you, brushing her tails against yours. For all her teasing, she's right; you've come up to the shrine without even realizing it. Maybe someone else is guiding your footsteps without you knowing, too... |I know the August Master is worshipped by other peoples in other places, but piety even now? You're starting to make me feel all guilty and inadequate, that a [pc.raceCute] like you should be more observant than me." Hotaru giggles and cozies up to you, reaching for your leg with her tails. She's obviously teasing, but even so... ] The shrine draws into view, somehow much more imposing than its usual peaceful if not quite unassuming self. Maybe it's because you have Hotaru with you and she's arguably the least pious fox you've ever met for a culture that's rather observant about the gods, but... well, she doesn't come here often, does she? [hotaru.anyKids |[hotaru.isMILF |"To be perfectly honest... I've found quite a few things to be thankful for of late[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Not that piety is transactional in nature to begin with — it's still expected of us even in hard times — but it's a lot easier to be observant when the going is easy, isn't it? Sure, I could be considered pretty religious as a girl, but that's more because I was raised by the den matron than anything else. And now that I'm coming of my own accord... well, it's not an obligation if you do it yourself, right?" You can already guess some of the things Hotaru's thankful for. "It's quite obvious, isn't it? Kaori here, for one. The fact that you're here with me, that's another thing to be grateful for. How I've got my life arranged so that I can keep the hours I want. And how Kohaku's little prank ended up with me looking quite fetching without turning into a cow like Miko. Not too much, not too little." Ha. You still remember when Hotaru was fit to strangle her ostensible friend for doing that to her. "Oh, I was[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Hotaru grins and gives you a little dip of a half-bow. "I still am. But when you look at a curse from another angle... well, it may not be an outright blessing, but maybe it isn't so bad. Thanks to her meddling, the next kit should come out much easier." So long as she doesn't once again reach for more wyldsap to ease her mood swings. "Ha. Surely that'll never happen, right?" |"Well[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]... it's not like I'm coming here for myself, am I? When it was just me, I figured simply continuing to exist as some giant divine prank was being pious enough, but I can't say the same for a good girl like Kaori. I've learned to live with my gift, and she doesn't really seem bothered by hers, so for once I dare to hope enough that praying seems worth it, ha.[pc.ra kitsune | You should know better than anyone that petitioning the August Master at the Center of Heaven has mixed results. ]" You look aside at your daughter, clinging to her mother with little fists as she deigns to be carried with that ever-resigned air of quiet acceptance. If anything, Kaori should be the one doing to praying when she's a little older — seems like something she'd take to, with so serious a personality. "Petitioning the gods implies you have hope they can be moved by your sincerity, isn't that true? But Kaori doesn't know how to hope, so I have to have enough for the both of us." As imposing as Kaori's demeanor is, that's reading a lot into an infant's personality. "Ah, but most kits aren't gifted." ] |[hotaru.isPregnant |[hotaru.isMILF |"Actually, I've been coming more often ever since... well, you know." Hotaru smiles ruefully and pats her huge, kit-filled womb. "And even more so ever since I started growing out like no tomorrow. It feels good, but Mai wants to check in on me regularly given that I'm measuring a lot further along than I ought to be. And whose fault is that[pc.ra kitsune | — ahem — my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]?" Kohaku's, of course.[kohaku.wellFed | Or, poetically, her own for doing the same to Kohaku to begin with. ] "Mmmh. And you certainly enabled [kohaku.wellFed |the both of us |her ], didn't you? Well, regardless of how that little gremlin feels, this isn't such a bad outcome. Still, if Mai says it's cause for concern, then I feel obligated to at least present myself to her every so often. "I know how it is to have the den matron run you ragged, and Mai's got a lot on her hands: religious duties, being the local physician and midwife, even cleaning out the baths when she's done something to displease her ancestor — it's not really fair to ask her to come all the way to my doorstep every single time[mai.isPregnant |, especially when she's with child herself ]." And no doubt Hotaru keeps the veneer of piety just so it isn't painfully obvious. "Of course[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Word would get out that I can be motivated to care — it'd be terrible for my reputation. I'd never hear the end of how I'm going soft not just in body." |"A bit more these last several months." Hotaru sighs. "I didn't really care for it because I've always felt my mere existence was a giant prank, an act of worship for the August Master in and of itself, but coming here helps with the more troubled moments when staying in bed and hiding under the covers just isn't enough.[pc.ra kitsune | You're the divine champion, surely you understand what I mean, what with working with the August Master all the time. ]" ... "Sometimes you just need someone else in those moments, and you're not around when I would really prefer you be." The seamstress looks askance and pats her protruding belly with a rueful smile. "And while Kaori's being obedient as always, it's her gift that's agitating mine to begin with, so she's not much of a help, either. "At least my role gives me the freedom to come and go as I please, avoid the dawn and dusk crowds. Can't stand all the people and noise. And in those quiet moments with just me and the Kurokawa sisters, I ask the same question that I've done so many times: why?" Has she ever received any answer?[pc.ra kitsune | Keros is quite the chatty guy, so it wouldn't be out of turn. ] "An answer? I'm carrying her right now." ] |"Less than I used to. Remember who raised me[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]?" Komari always struck you as pious, but with a generous dash of cynicism about that's no doubt born of her rather unique circumstances. "Oh, I was taught to respect the gods, all right. But when your mere existence is one big prank worthy of the August Master himself, just persisting is a form of worship in itself, wouldn't you say? A good tale and endless font of entertainment?[pc.ra kitsune | A little like the duties of your station, if I may be blunt with someone as esteemed as you. ] "Nevertheless, I still come, just somewhat less than the den matron had Kohaku and I do when we were younger. Neither Miko nor Mai are amused when I suggest sending myself up as an offering, despite the truth of the situation and my willingness to consecrate myself beforehand. No, only they get to have such fun." ] ] You sigh and shake your head; Hotaru's ability to stay cavalier and cheerful in the face of her existence is quite remarkable. "And you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence |? You're certainly not bound by any social obligation to petition, pay respects or make offerings... so why have you brought us here?" ] Hotaru's teasing tone suggests she already knows the answer — impossible as that may be — and just wants to hear it from your lips. Well, the answer is obvious, isn't it? [hotaru.anyKids |You're going to pray for both mother and daughter. [hotaru.isMILF |Bearing kits has changed Hotaru a lot — whatever taking that much wyldsap for her troubles during her pregnancy has done to her, it's scarcely budged even after Kaori left her womb. At this point, one might as well consider the changes permanent; they clearly aren't inclined to go anywhere in the slightest. "Ah, you intend to give thanks in my stead[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]? That's a great idea. I have so much more energy these days — not that Kaori is difficult to mind, but it's better to have it and not need it than the other way around." That's... well, that's one way to see it. Hotaru's old mood swings were already a sight to see, for them to get even more intense is... well, at least they tend more towards cheerful mania these days, compared to the alternatives. Hotaru titters. "You're not entirely convinced[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]? Well, I am, and I'm sure the August Master sees it as a blessing too. Come on, we're nearly there." |Even if they're fine most of the time and Kaori's quiet moroseness balances out her mother's mood swings and mania, they're still gifted and you can't help but worry about them. "Don't worry. Kaori and I only set fire to things we mean to." That doesn't make it any better, even if it were true. Hotaru titters. "I'd tell you not to be such a worrywart, but I don't mind praying with you if it'll make you feel better. [pc.ra kitsune |You're the August Master's divine champion, your Eminence — there's no need to be so uptight about things |Me, I already know the gods have their gazes on my poor self, so there isn't much difference whether I pray or not, ha ]." At the end of the day, it's all about Kaori. Hotaru herself — well, it would be tremendously easy for someone in her position to grow bitter and rail against the heavens, for which her bouts of mania is a small reprieve. But with a daughter such as Kaori in tow... that changes one's perspective, doesn't it? Gives one a reason to care just a little more? "She's such a serious child, refuses to brush anything off. There was that thing she did with the silkworms the other day —" A kit that you've never seen smile even once — that warrants prayer indeed. ] |[hotaru.isPregnant |[hotaru.isMILF |You'd expected Hotaru to become round, but at this point she's exceeded all expectations, and not just in her middle. Sure, the wyldsap she's been taking for her moods probably exacerbated the situation, but there wouldn't have been this drastic a reaction if she wasn't inclined that way to begin with, right? "Oh, how sweet of you to worry about me[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. But rest assured, I'm very well taken care of in your absence, even if I really would have you visit more." Mai? "Remember all of what I just said? You'd think she of all people would be the least worried, considering how she and her sister have their own tendencies, ha.[mai.anyKids | That, and she's a mother herself, so it's not like she hasn't been through this. |[mai.isPregnant | That, and she's pregnant herself, so she should really understand. ] ] It's nice to have attention, but there can be too much of a good thing." Is it that strange? Mai's just doing her job as the den's physician and midwife. "I don't know, that kind of behavior's awfully similar to when I'm just about to sniff out a juicy rumor[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]." Hotaru grins as one of her tails grabs yours and tugs teasingly. |." Hotaru grins and bats you with one of her tails. ] "Sure, I'm measuring quite a bit further along that I ought to be, but I don't think it's something to get worried over. If anything, having this weight in me is quite calming, ehehe; the thought of having a kit growing strong in my womb is... arousingly gratifying, to say the least. With all of me getting just as huge, I'm sure Kaori will slip right out when the time comes with no problems." |You're here to pray for both her and Kaori's health. Sure, Hotaru's always been fatalistic in that she's not getting out of this life that easy... but being certain of the end doesn't mean there aren't easier and harder paths leading to it. "I..." Hotaru smiles wanly and gently places her hands on her middle. "I won't say no if that's what you wish[pc.ra kitsune |, especially if it's coming from the divine champion [pc.himHer]self. You have just a little more sway with the gods than most, your Eminence; maybe they'll listen if you're the one petitioning |. Hope springs eternal, after all ]." Even if your prayers fall on deaf ears, a little peace of mind wouldn't hurt. Hotaru tends to start fires during her crying fits, by accident or otherwise. If praying for her will soothe her gift and ease her mood swings, it's more than worth it. And if it doesn't... you still get to be with her, so you don't lose anything. "Or you could visit me more, that usually helps. More than praying for me would, anyway — I'm sure the August Master considers my daily life at this point to be some kind of big show for his entertainment. I'd be mad about it, but... it's fitting that a storyteller should tell a story, isn't it? "Which reminds me. It's a little strange, but..." But? Hotaru rests her hands on [hotaru.pregStage 1 2 3 |the slight bump of her middle |her rounded kit carrier |the huge, heaving baby bump that protrudes forth from her middle ]. "I'd expected to get more moody while with child, but it's been the exact opposite so far, ehe. The bigger Kaori gets in my belly, the more at peace I feel. I wonder if any of that will linger once she's born; these last months have been a pleasant reprieve. Not that it hasn't happened at all, but it's more manageable when it does." Hopefully that's the case, otherwise Hotaru might be tempted to see just how much of the next few decades she can be pregnant for. "Tch. Please don't joke with a straight face, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |silly ] — you might say something plausible and I might take it seriously." ] |You're going to petition for an easing of her burdens. Not to remove them — Hotaru clearly likes her gift well enough, even if some might argue it's a rationalization of bad circumstances — but just to make her daily life a little more livable. "That, well..." Hotaru squeezes your arm and taps her chin. "[pc.ra kitsune |I suppose you do have a little more sway with the gods as a divine champion, don't you? Not that one such as me would be in any position to say what you should or shouldn't do; that would be far beyond my station." Hotaru grins up at you, and one of her tails coils over to give yours a teasing squeeze. |I'd save my breath if I were you. If petitioning the divine was going to work, it would've worked any time in the last five generations." You glance over at Hotaru, only to receive a resigned smile and upturned palms in reply. ] Well. As the stories go, the strongest wishes are those made for another's sake. It's not like you have anything to lose, do you? "On the contrary, the stories do have a lot to say about what happens to those with the audacity to ask, both good and bad. But [pc.ra kitsune |you've clearly faced that down already and came out the victor, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |you're obviously no ordinary [pc.race] ], so this will be interesting. Petition the divine for my sake, if you will — I'll be watching." ] ]

你自己可能也没有完全意识到，不知不觉中，你已经走到了树的根部，来到了那些神圣的花园旁，脚步仿佛自己有了意识般地向前移动。萤像一只充满热情的小狗一样，一步不落地跟在你身后，同时还哼着那首令人回味无穷、充满忧伤旋律的歌。 [hotaru.anyKids |当她紧紧地将香织拥入怀中时 |在你之后 ]为什么突然心情变好了？ “我支持你。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] Maybe someone else is guiding your footsteps without you knowing, too... |I know the August Master is worshipped by other peoples in other places, but piety even now? You're starting to make me feel all guilty and inadequate, that a [pc.raceCute] like you should be more observant than me." Hotaru giggles and cozies up to you, reaching for your leg with her tails. She's obviously teasing, but even so... ] The shrine draws into view, somehow much more imposing than its usual peaceful if not quite unassuming self. Maybe it's because you have Hotaru with you and she's arguably the least pious fox you've ever met for a culture that's rather observant about the gods, but... well, she doesn't come here often, does she? [hotaru.anyKids |[hotaru.isMILF |"To be perfectly honest... I've found quite a few things to be thankful for of late[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Not that piety is transactional in nature to begin with — it's still expected of us even in hard times — but it's a lot easier to be observant when the going is easy, isn't it? Sure, I could be considered pretty religious as a girl, but that's more because I was raised by the den matron than anything else. And now that I'm coming of my own accord... well, it's not an obligation if you do it yourself, right?" You can already guess some of the things Hotaru's thankful for. "It's quite obvious, isn't it? Kaori here, for one. The fact that you're here with me, that's another thing to be grateful for. How I've got my life arranged so that I can keep the hours I want. And how Kohaku's little prank ended up with me looking quite fetching without turning into a cow like Miko. Not too much, not too little." Ha. You still remember when Hotaru was fit to strangle her ostensible friend for doing that to her. "Oh, I was[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Hotaru grins and gives you a little dip of a half-bow. "I still am. But when you look at a curse from another angle... well, it may not be an outright blessing, but maybe it isn't so bad. Thanks to her meddling, the next kit should come out much easier." So long as she doesn't once again reach for more wyldsap to ease her mood swings. "Ha. Surely that'll never happen, right?" |"Well[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]... it's not like I'm coming here for myself, am I? When it was just me, I figured simply continuing to exist as some giant divine prank was being pious enough, but I can't say the same for a good girl like Kaori. I've learned to live with my gift, and she doesn't really seem bothered by hers, so for once I dare to hope enough that praying seems worth it, ha.[pc.ra kitsune | You should know better than anyone that petitioning the August Master at the Center of Heaven has mixed results. ]" You look aside at your daughter, clinging to her mother with little fists as she deigns to be carried with that ever-resigned air of quiet acceptance. If anything, Kaori should be the one doing to praying when she's a little older — seems like something she'd take to, with so serious a personality. "Petitioning the gods implies you have hope they can be moved by your sincerity, isn't that true? But Kaori doesn't know how to hope, so I have to have enough for the both of us." As imposing as Kaori's demeanor is, that's reading a lot into an infant's personality. "Ah, but most kits aren't gifted." ] |[hotaru.isPregnant |[hotaru.isMILF |"Actually, I've been coming more often ever since... well, you know." Hotaru smiles ruefully and pats her huge, kit-filled womb. "And even more so ever since I started growing out like no tomorrow. It feels good, but Mai wants to check in on me regularly given that I'm measuring a lot further along than I ought to be. And whose fault is that[pc.ra kitsune | — ahem — my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]?" Kohaku's, of course.[kohaku.wellFed | Or, poetically, her own for doing the same to Kohaku to begin with. ] "Mmmh. And you certainly enabled [kohaku.wellFed |the both of us |her ], didn't you? Well, regardless of how that little gremlin feels, this isn't such a bad outcome. Still, if Mai says it's cause for concern, then I feel obligated to at least present myself to her every so often. "I know how it is to have the den matron run you ragged, and Mai's got a lot on her hands: religious duties, being the local physician and midwife, even cleaning out the baths when she's done something to displease her ancestor — it's not really fair to ask her to come all the way to my doorstep every single time[mai.isPregnant |, especially when she's with child herself ]." And no doubt Hotaru keeps the veneer of piety just so it isn't painfully obvious. "Of course[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Word would get out that I can be motivated to care — it'd be terrible for my reputation. I'd never hear the end of how I'm going soft not just in body." |"A bit more these last several months." Hotaru sighs. "I didn't really care for it because I've always felt my mere existence was a giant prank, an act of worship for the August Master in and of itself, but coming here helps with the more troubled moments when staying in bed and hiding under the covers just isn't enough.[pc.ra kitsune | You're the divine champion, surely you understand what I mean, what with working with the August Master all the time. ]" ... "Sometimes you just need someone else in those moments, and you're not around when I would really prefer you be." The seamstress looks askance and pats her protruding belly with a rueful smile. "And while Kaori's being obedient as always, it's her gift that's agitating mine to begin with, so she's not much of a help, either. "At least my role gives me the freedom to come and go as I please, avoid the dawn and dusk crowds. Can't stand all the people and noise. And in those quiet moments with just me and the Kurokawa sisters, I ask the same question that I've done so many times: why?" Has she ever received any answer?[pc.ra kitsune | Keros is quite the chatty guy, so it wouldn't be out of turn. ] "An answer? I'm carrying her right now." ] |"Less than I used to. Remember who raised me[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]?" Komari always struck you as pious, but with a generous dash of cynicism about that's no doubt born of her rather unique circumstances. "Oh, I was taught to respect the gods, all right. But when your mere existence is one big prank worthy of the August Master himself, just persisting is a form of worship in itself, wouldn't you say? A good tale and endless font of entertainment?[pc.ra kitsune | A little like the duties of your station, if I may be blunt with someone as esteemed as you. ] "Nevertheless, I still come, just somewhat less than the den matron had Kohaku and I do when we were younger. Neither Miko nor Mai are amused when I suggest sending myself up as an offering, despite the truth of the situation and my willingness to consecrate myself beforehand. No, only they get to have such fun." ] ] You sigh and shake your head; Hotaru's ability to stay cavalier and cheerful in the face of her existence is quite remarkable. "And you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence |? You're certainly not bound by any social obligation to petition, pay respects or make offerings... so why have you brought us here?" ] Hotaru's teasing tone suggests she already knows the answer — impossible as that may be — and just wants to hear it from your lips. Well, the answer is obvious, isn't it? [hotaru.anyKids |You're going to pray for both mother and daughter. [hotaru.isMILF |Bearing kits has changed Hotaru a lot — whatever taking that much wyldsap for her troubles during her pregnancy has done to her, it's scarcely budged even after Kaori left her womb. At this point, one might as well consider the changes permanent; they clearly aren't inclined to go anywhere in the slightest. "Ah, you intend to give thanks in my stead[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]? That's a great idea. I have so much more energy these days — not that Kaori is difficult to mind, but it's better to have it and not need it than the other way around." That's... well, that's one way to see it. Hotaru's old mood swings were already a sight to see, for them to get even more intense is... well, at least they tend more towards cheerful mania these days, compared to the alternatives. Hotaru titters. "You're not entirely convinced[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]? Well, I am, and I'm sure the August Master sees it as a blessing too. Come on, we're nearly there." |Even if they're fine most of the time and Kaori's quiet moroseness balances out her mother's mood swings and mania, they're still gifted and you can't help but worry about them. "Don't worry. Kaori and I only set fire to things we mean to." That doesn't make it any better, even if it were true. Hotaru titters. "I'd tell you not to be such a worrywart, but I don't mind praying with you if it'll make you feel better. [pc.ra kitsune |You're the August Master's divine champion, your Eminence — there's no need to be so uptight about things |Me, I already know the gods have their gazes on my poor self, so there isn't much difference whether I pray or not, ha ]." At the end of the day, it's all about Kaori. Hotaru herself — well, it would be tremendously easy for someone in her position to grow bitter and rail against the heavens, for which her bouts of mania is a small reprieve. But with a daughter such as Kaori in tow... that changes one's perspective, doesn't it? Gives one a reason to care just a little more? "She's such a serious child, refuses to brush anything off. There was that thing she did with the silkworms the other day —" A kit that you've never seen smile even once — that warrants prayer indeed. ] |[hotaru.isPregnant |[hotaru.isMILF |You'd expected Hotaru to become round, but at this point she's exceeded all expectations, and not just in her middle. Sure, the wyldsap she's been taking for her moods probably exacerbated the situation, but there wouldn't have been this drastic a reaction if she wasn't inclined that way to begin with, right? "Oh, how sweet of you to worry about me[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. But rest assured, I'm very well taken care of in your absence, even if I really would have you visit more." Mai? "Remember all of what I just said? You'd think she of all people would be the least worried, considering how she and her sister have their own tendencies, ha.[mai.anyKids | That, and she's a mother herself, so it's not like she hasn't been through this. |[mai.isPregnant | That, and she's pregnant herself, so she should really understand. ] ] It's nice to have attention, but there can be too much of a good thing." Is it that strange? Mai's just doing her job as the den's physician and midwife. "I don't know, that kind of behavior's awfully similar to when I'm just about to sniff out a juicy rumor[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]." Hotaru grins as one of her tails grabs yours and tugs teasingly. |." Hotaru grins and bats you with one of her tails. ] "Sure, I'm measuring quite a bit further along that I ought to be, but I don't think it's something to get worried over. If anything, having this weight in me is quite calming, ehehe; the thought of having a kit growing strong in my womb is... arousingly gratifying, to say the least. With all of me getting just as huge, I'm sure Kaori will slip right out when the time comes with no problems." |You're here to pray for both her and Kaori's health. Sure, Hotaru's always been fatalistic in that she's not getting out of this life that easy... but being certain of the end doesn't mean there aren't easier and harder paths leading to it. "I..." Hotaru smiles wanly and gently places her hands on her middle. "I won't say no if that's what you wish[pc.ra kitsune |, especially if it's coming from the divine champion [pc.himHer]self. You have just a little more sway with the gods than most, your Eminence; maybe they'll listen if you're the one petitioning |. Hope springs eternal, after all ]." Even if your prayers fall on deaf ears, a little peace of mind wouldn't hurt. Hotaru tends to start fires during her crying fits, by accident or otherwise. If praying for her will soothe her gift and ease her mood swings, it's more than worth it. And if it doesn't... you still get to be with her, so you don't lose anything. "Or you could visit me more, that usually helps. More than praying for me would, anyway — I'm sure the August Master considers my daily life at this point to be some kind of big show for his entertainment. I'd be mad about it, but... it's fitting that a storyteller should tell a story, isn't it? "Which reminds me. It's a little strange, but..." But? Hotaru rests her hands on [hotaru.pregStage 1 2 3 |the slight bump of her middle |her rounded kit carrier |the huge, heaving baby bump that protrudes forth from her middle ]. "I'd expected to get more moody while with child, but it's been the exact opposite so far, ehe. The bigger Kaori gets in my belly, the more at peace I feel. I wonder if any of that will linger once she's born; these last months have been a pleasant reprieve. Not that it hasn't happened at all, but it's more manageable when it does." Hopefully that's the case, otherwise Hotaru might be tempted to see just how much of the next few decades she can be pregnant for. "Tch. Please don't joke with a straight face, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |silly ] — you might say something plausible and I might take it seriously." ] |You're going to petition for an easing of her burdens. Not to remove them — Hotaru clearly likes her gift well enough, even if some might argue it's a rationalization of bad circumstances — but just to make her daily life a little more livable. "That, well..." Hotaru squeezes your arm and taps her chin. "[pc.ra kitsune |I suppose you do have a little more sway with the gods as a divine champion, don't you? Not that one such as me would be in any position to say what you should or shouldn't do; that would be far beyond my station." Hotaru grins up at you, and one of her tails coils over to give yours a teasing squeeze. |I'd save my breath if I were you. If petitioning the divine was going to work, it would've worked any time in the last five generations." You glance over at Hotaru, only to receive a resigned smile and upturned palms in reply. ] Well. As the stories go, the strongest wishes are those made for another's sake. It's not like you have anything to lose, do you? "On the contrary, the stories do have a lot to say about what happens to those with the audacity to ask, both good and bad. But [pc.ra kitsune |you've clearly faced that down already and came out the victor, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |you're obviously no ordinary [pc.race] ], so this will be interesting. Petition the divine for my sake, if you will — I'll be watching." ] ] "

rows.original:
As the shrine draws ever closer, you find [var0
        |both Miko and Mai on duty, but none of the usual dawn and dusk crowds that warrant both sisters' presence. It's as if someone knew the both of you were coming and contrived for you to skip ahead to the front of the queue. As one, both Kurokawa sisters [pc.ra kitsune
            |step forward and bow in unison, eyeing Hotaru at your side with some suspicion.
            
            "Well, if'n it ain't yer Eminence. We done thought ya were jus' comin' to pay yer respects, but if'n ya got that gossip by yer side then the matter's quite more serious, ain't it?"
            
            With Hotaru? Everything's serious, no matter how much she smiles and laughs about it.
            |sashay forward and acknowledge you with nods, although their greeting to Hotaru is a lot more muted.
            
            "Well, that there's somethin' ya don't see every day. I guess only someone as persuasive as ya could've done dragged Hotaru outta her hole and all th' way down here to be properly observant. Such a pity — ya were always so pious as a kit, Hotaru."
            
            Hotaru thins her lips and folds back her ears, and her fingertips dig into your arm. "Watch your tongue, Mikoto. Let's not sully this sacred space with petty backbiting."
        ]
        |Miko on duty, looking absolutely bored as she works a broom, less to actually clean the shrine and more to give the pretense of work — a pretense that's readily dropped the moment she sees the two of you coming up the path. Perking up at your approach, Miko [pc.ra kitsune
            |steps forward to meet you halfway, all smiles and barely contained glee to contrast the sudden tension in Hotaru's body as the seamstress sharply tugs on your arm.
            
            "Well, if'n it ain't yer Eminence. Lil' ol' me done thought ya were jus' comin' to pay yer respects, but if'n ya got that gossip by yer side then the matter's quite more serious, ain't it? She never comes these days unless she ain't got no choice — more's the pity, 'cause she was so pious as a kit. Stands to reason it'd take th' divine champion [pc.himHer]self to convince Hotaru to done leave that hole of hers."
            |sashays forward to meet you, the way she's flaunting herself clearly meant as a jab to Hotaru — and it works, considering the sudden tensing of the seamstress' body.
            
            "Why, if'n it ain't [pc.name]. And Hotaru too, of course. Lil' ol' me missed the both of ya, f'r different reasons of course, so it's great ya should be pickin' this fine day to be payin' yer respects to th' divine."
        ]
        
        Hotaru grits her teeth. "Thank you, Mikoto. We'll manage on our own."
        
        "Ya sure 'bout that? [hotaru.isMILF
            |Yer lookin' kinda unsteady on yer feet these days. Still gettin' used to havin' whole bunch more weight on ya, I take it — good thing ya got [pc.ra kitsune
                |[pc.hisHer] Eminence
                |[pc.name]
            ] to lean on, eh?
            
            "No need to make that face, Granny done warned ya years ago that something like this here would be happenin' if'n you kept up as ya did, an' it has. But cheer up. Two or three more kits in yer belly, and ya'll be almost as plump as lil' ol' me."
            |[pc.ra kitsune
                |Well, if'n ya done got [pc.mf
                    |his divine lord
                    |her divine lady
                ]ship at yer side, I ain't got nothin'
                |Wouldn't wanna make a mistake and end up cursed or anythin', jus' sayin'
            ]. Make sure to have fun, okay?"
        ]
        |Mai on duty, looking wistful as she [mai.isPregnant
            |half-dozes off on one of the shrine benches, looking most undignified for someone in her position, as weighed-down as she might be
            |[mai.anyKids
                |contemplates the moon through the gaps in the tree's roots
                |takes long, deep pulls on her pipe
            ]
        ]. It's just her at this time of night, and the shrine maiden's melancholy idleness quickly dissipates as she notices Hotaru and you coming up the garden path. Perking up, Mai [pc.ra kitsune
            |steps
            |sashays
        ] forward and gives the both of you [mai.isPregnant
            |as deep a bow as her kit-heavy womb will allow
            |a bow
        ], her eagerness at seeing the both of you plain.
        
        "Well, if'n it ain't [pc.ra kitsune
            |yer Eminence an' Hotaru," she purrs with no small delight. "Gettin' such fine guests as an item at this time of evenin' when normal folk are headin' to bed, unlike us creatures."
            |Hotaru an' [pc.name]," she purrs, looking between the both of you. "Didja rope [pc.himHer] into comin' 'long with ya, Hotaru?" 
        ]
        
        "Actually, [pc.ra kitsune
            |[pc.mf
                |his lord
                |her lady
            ]ship
            |[pc.name]
        ] had the idea of coming out for a walk, and here we are. Just spending a little time together, that's all." The tone of Hotaru's voice makes it clear she thinks of it as anything but. "And since we're out of doors, might as well get something done, right?"
        
        "[pc.ra kitsune
            |Pumpin' th' divine champion f'r juicy gossip
            |Seekin' new from far-off, are ya
        ]? Yer makin' me kinda jealous, havin' [pc.himHer] all to yerself for th' night."
        
        Nothing so mercenary. You're just enjoying an evening together, since Hotaru isn't obliged to keep regular hours.
        
        "If'n ya say so. [hotaru.anyKids
            |Oh, an' ya brought Kaori too. Well, since yer all here, ya might as well let me look over the both of ya while yer busy petitionin' an' all. Kill two birds with one stone, as th' locals say."
            
            That's not disrespectful to the gods in any way, is it?
            
            "[pc.ra kitsune
                |Yer th' divine champion, m'[pc.mf
                    |lord
                    |lady
                ]. If'n ya don't mind, ain't no one's sayin' no
                |Granny ain't here to countermand me, an' th' August Master ain't steppin' in all offended-like. If they ain't complainin', 's all good
            ]."
            
            You can't argue with that. If it comes down to it, you can be observant for all three of you.
            |[hotaru.isPregnant
                |Well, since ya came all th' way down, ya might as well let me look over ya while yer doin' yer petitionin'. Gettin' ya outta doors to see me is trouble enough."
                
                "Um, I don't have anything against it, but we did come down here to pray for the child, so..."
                
                Hotaru hasn't missed any appointments or the like, has she?
                
                "Well, [pc.ra kitsune
                    |yer Eminence, 
                ]'s kinda hard to miss appointments ya never made to begin with."
                
                Hiding from the physician is childish, but it's also so very like Hotaru and her neuroses. Not knowing about a problem — should one exist — isn't the same as not having it. Yeah, Mai should probably look over her; you have enough time in a night to get everything done.
                |Ya should really come by more often — ya were much more pious as a kit even beyond granny's expectations, an' now I hardly see ya."
                
                Hotaru sighs and averts her gaze.
                
                "I know ya done lost hope 'bout most things an' ya think yer still livin' jus' 'cause ya ain't allowed to quit that easily, but it ain't everythin'. Ya know what I mean."
                
                "I don't. Maybe I once thought I did, but I don't." Hotaru sighs. "You're not that much different from me in that regard, Mai — one could say Miko and you are gifted like I am."
                
                "Ain't wrong."
                
                "And yet you can see it this way..."
                
                "Yer here, ain't ya? Doesn't matter if'n [pc.ra kitsune
                    |[pc.mf
                        |his lord
                        |her lady
                    ]ship
                    |[pc.name]
                ] talked ya into comin', if'n that's what it takes. Jus' have a good time an' don't mind nothin' else, okay?"
            ]
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
随着神社越来越近，你发现[var0
        |宫子和小梅都在值班，但通常在黎明和黄昏时分才会出现的那些需要两位姐妹同时出动的顾客却一个也没有。就好像有人早就知道你们会来，特意安排让你们排在了队伍的最前面。黑川姐妹俩，真是太巧了[pc.ra kitsune
            |他们纷纷上前齐声鞠躬，同时用有些怀疑的目光看着身旁的萤。

“哎呀，原来是您啊。我们还以为您是来表达敬意的呢，不过如果萤也参与了这件事的话，那事情就严重多了吧？”

只要有萤的参与，无论她如何笑言欢语，事情都肯定不会简单。
            |他们大步走上前，点头致意，不过他们对萤的问候则显得更为谨慎、低调。

“哇，这可真是难得一见的场景啊。我想，只有像你这样有说服力的人，才能把萤从她的世界里拉出来，让她来到这里，认真观察这一切。真是太遗憾了——你一直以来都那么虔诚啊，萤。”

萤抿紧嘴唇，把耳朵向后翻折，手指则紧紧抓住你的手臂。“注意你的言辞，美琴。我们不要用这些琐碎的闲言碎语来玷污这个神圣的空间。"
        ]
        |正在值班的巫女看起来无聊至极，她拿着扫帚打扫，其实并不是真的在清理神社，只是在做做样子罢了——不过当她看到你们两个人沿着小路走来时，这种假象立刻就被打破了。看到你们靠近，巫女立刻精神了起来。 [pc.ra kitsune
            |他向前迈出几步，面带笑容，竭力压抑着内心的喜悦，但当那位裁缝突然用力拉住你的手臂时，萤体内的紧张情绪却瞬间显现了出来。

“哎呀，原来是您啊，尊贵的…… 我本来还以为你只是过来表示一下敬意的呢，但如果你也是听信了那些流言蜚语的话，那事情就严重多了，不是吗？这些天她除非实在没别的选择，否则根本不会来——真是太可惜了，因为她本来是个非常虔诚的人啊。按常理来说，这确实需要一位神圣的英雄才能完成。 [pc.himHer]我必须说服萤离开她那个地方。
            |她大步向前走去迎接你，那种刻意展示自己的姿态显然是在针对萤——而这一招确实奏效了，因为那位裁缝的身体突然变得僵硬起来。

“哎呀，难道不是这样吗[pc.name]当然，还有萤火虫也是。我这个老家伙确实很想念你们两个，原因嘛……当然各有不同。所以，你们能在这样一个美好的日子里前来祭拜这位神明，真是太好了。
        ]
        
        热夜咬牙说道：“谢谢你，美琴。我们自己能够应付得来。”

“你真的确定吗？ [hotaru.isMILF
            |你看，这些天你的脚步似乎有点不稳了。我猜你还在适应身上多了这么多重量的感觉吧——幸好你有[pc.ra kitsune
                |[pc.hisHer]尊贵的人士
                |[pc.name]
            ]没必要摆出那种表情，奶奶多年前就警告过你，如果你继续这样下去，就会发生这种事，现在果然发生了。不过别难过，再怀上两三个孩子，你就会变得和我一样圆润了。
            |[pc.ra kitsune
                |嗯，如果你已经准备好了的话[pc.mf
                    |他的主公
                    |她的尊贵夫人
                ]就在你身边，我什么都不缺。
                |总不想犯错，结果招来诅咒之类的，只是说说而已。
            ]一定要玩得开心，好吗？
        ]
        |舞正在值班，她看起来有些忧愁。 [mai.isPregnant
            |她坐在神社的长椅上小睡片刻，对于她这样的身份而言，这一幕显得实在有些不体面——尽管她可能已经疲惫不堪了。
            |[mai.anyKids
                |透过树根间的缝隙凝视着月亮
                |她深深地吸了几口烟斗里的烟。
            ]
        ]就在这个时候，只有她一个人在这里。当她看到萤和你们沿着花园的小路走来时，那位神社少女那忧郁的闲适心情立刻烟消云散了。她立刻精神振奋起来，舞[pc.ra kitsune
            |步骤
            |摇摆着走
        ]继续前进，把你们两个都带上。 [mai.isPregnant
            |以她那充满各种装备的“肚子”所能允许的最大限度鞠躬

rows.original: Ignoring the teasing, you wrap a possessive arm about Hotaru's waist and pull her along with you into the little shrine. Clean as always, statue, altar, offerings all, and the seamstress whimpers and trembles at your touch as you guide her deeper in. "Guess it's a good thing there's no one else around," Hotaru murmurs, sinking against you. "I don't think I'd have been able to stand it, even with [hotaru.anyKids |Kaori and you with me |[hotaru.isPregnant |Kaori calming my gift with hers and you at my side |your presence ] ]. It really bothers her that much, doesn't it? [dayNight |Did Miko's teasing really cut that deeply? ] She looks away. "When you're before the gods, you're not allowed to be dishonest with yourself, especially about the hard questions." All right. If she wouldn't mind leading you? [pc.ra kitsune |You may be the divine champion and all, but you haven't had much time to learn the formalities, even if they could be waived for someone in your circumstances. |After all, you are [a] [pc.race], and aren't familiar with the formalities ]. Hotaru smiles weakly — she knows what you're on about, but nevertheless accedes. [hotaru.anyKids |With Kaori up against her shoulder, t |T ]he seamstress leads from behind, guiding you up before the statue and altar. You're half-expecting Keros himself to manifest and greet you, but the Trickster seems content to watch this particular joke unfold today without personal intervention. "The den matron was always big on the proper way to perform the rites, but if it's just us... well, I've always been one for more the spirit of the law rather than its letter." Hotaru squishes herself up against you. "Still, since it's for you, I'll do things properly..." [pc.ra kitsune |Remembering your place as divine champion, you try and remember what — if anything — Miko and Mai have said about what's expected of you here |[pc.swornGod nareva lumia |Despite you knowing the pantheon isn't jealous and people pay respects to all the Seven regularly, you can't help but feel just a twinge of apprehension — you are specially favored, after all. |Well, as far as the divine's concerned, you're just someone unimportant. ] ] Good thing the Trickster himself will see any misstep as a big joke, right? You do your best anyway, following Hotaru's lead and hoping that the August Master at the Center of Heaven himself is hearing your prayers for Hotaru[hotaru.anyKids | and Kaori ][hotaru.isMILF |, and that Hotaru continues being as comfortable with her more matronly appearance ]... [hotaru.anyKids |[hotaru.isMILF |For once, though... here in the shrine's heavy atmosphere, you can sense both Hotaru's and Kaori's gifts ever clearer than before[pc.ra kitsune |, especially so since you're the divine champion and all ]. Perhaps it's just you being hopeful about how the future will turn out, but it feels like mother and daughter stabilize each other pretty well, even when apart. Hotaru elbows you lightly. "Don't let your mind wander[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Terrible thing to have happen while petitioning the August Master[pc.ra kitsune |, especially since he's bound to listen to his hand-picked champion ]." About her, about Kaori... you hope that Hotaru continues to change, and you don't mean just on the outside. A sigh. "I stopped taking wyldsap after Kaori was born — there was no longer any need, and Mai's right in that I don't want to form a habit of it. But even after I stopped, my gift hasn't acted up like it used to, not in full force. Even if it's only because I'm too occupied with minding Kaori to really throw fits, that's still something to be thankful to the gods for. "I know all of this started because of my own craziness about my parents, and in retrospect it seems laughable that I'd go so far as to actually bear a kit because of it... but I don't regret how this has turned out. Another thing to be thankful for." Sometimes, tricks and surprises aren't always for the worse. "[pc.ra kitsune |Sounds like something someone in your station would say, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |Flattering the August Master in his own shrine won't tip the scales in our favor, ha ]." Maybe nothing's actually changed that much. Maybe she's just seeing things in a new light, and — A giggle. "You can't be serious. Look at me; it's only because my old clothes were always so heavy, loose and baggy that they still fit, and that's just the surface of things. "But let's focus. As amusing as the August Master no doubt finds us, it's still on us to be respectful." With that, Hotaru hugs Kaori close and bows her head once more, which you follow. In spite of everything that's happened and with an obviously gifted kit in tow, Hotaru does seem a lot happier these days — not fevered mania, but genuine contentment. How five generations of her matrilineal line would've been comfortable with passing down gifts from mother to daughter is perhaps, now, just a little less opaque. |For once, though, what you're doing starts to get through to Kaori. Your daughter doesn't cry, but grows increasingly restless, uneasy and outright fussy in her mother's arms instead of her usual impenetrably morose self. Hotaru doesn't miss a beat, though, quietly soothing her daughter even as she by all appearances keeps her mind focused on her prayers. You — Hotaru gives a light elbow in the side. "Don't worry about it and keep your mind focused[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. I too was... sensitive when I was younger. If you're worried, then pray for our child. "It doesn't fade. It never fades. But when you live with it long enough, when you see things from a different perspective, you start believing that curses can turn into blessings." With that, Hotaru hugs Kaori close and bows her head once more, which you follow. Maybe it's the shrine's atmosphere, maybe it's how agitated Kaori is all of a sudden, but it's hard to think straight, your only resource being to send general sentiments of intent in the hopes of petitioning the divine that way. Well. They know the need, don't they? ] |[hotaru.isPregnant |[hotaru.isMILF |That's a thought, isn't it? Even if Hotaru's moods have become more volatile, she's more well-adjusted on average these days, which is saying something. Despite her promise to only take wyldsap for her neuroses when necessary, precious as it is, one can't help but worry what'll happen when she finally pops... Your quiet reflections are interrupted by Hotaru [pc.ra kitsune |curling one of her tails about yours and giving it a gentle tug |elbowing you gently in the side ]. "Stop worrying so much[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]," Hotaru whispers. "I can feel it coming off you — it's ruining the atmosphere." Isn't that the point of coming here to pray, though? To unload one's burdens onto the divine? Hotaru raises a finger to her lips. "Yes, but I know you're worried about me, and that's throwing me off, too. I've thought this through as deeply as I could before I even asked you about this, and —" — And yet she didn't foresee Kohaku [kohaku.wellFed |getting revenge for turning her into a ball of boob and baby |pulling this kind of prank on her that went just a bit too far ]. A sigh. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |Well ]... you just have to look at it from a different angle, right? Sure, I wanted to strangle her at the time... but when I think about it now, maybe having such a selfish body isn't so bad. Not that I was a stick before, but you get what I mean. So stop wasting your energy worrying about me, and instead pray for our future, okay?" Ha. That's one thing you've noticed about her — the bigger Hotaru's belly has become with child, the more she's been able to see things from a more... reconciliatory perspective. It's not a bad change, but nevertheless a change, and you hope it's going to stick around after she pops, much like her three sizes right now. "I hope it will. I'm going to have to take care of a smaller version of me for the next couple of decades, after all. Now, let's turn our thoughts back to where they should be, shan't we?" |Your quiet reflections are interrupted by Hotaru [pc.ra kitsune |curling one of her tails about yours and giving it a gentle tug |elbowing you gently in the side ]. "Mmhh." Something the matter? Even you know this is a moment to be quiet and contemplative. "Well[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]... it's just that I haven't been here for a long time, prior to getting with child, that is. It feels like I've a lot of catching up to do, and... well." She was fostered by Komari — one would've expected her upbringing to be fairly religious, even if not to the extent that Miko and Mai were. "I don't deny being fairly observant back in those days. Maybe I was hoping for answers — you certainly don't beseech the August Master for the kind of succor I could've used, being saddled with my gift. It was more than what the den matron strictly demanded of me, at any rate." And now she feels like there's something worth coming back for? "Two things, actually. No, three. It's been a bitter pill to swallow, having to humble myself and admit I was being petulant about it all. But now..." There's someone else with her, now. "Ha. Yes. It's not like I've never considered it before actually coming up to you and — well, you know — but actually being here is one thing. And for once —" Hotaru gives you a small smile in the shrine's dim light — "I feel like there's something worth making the effort for, what with you at my side and Kaori in my belly. "Yes yes, I know piety doesn't work that way; the den matron drilled it into my head that you take both the good and the bad together, and if anyone has any reason to rage against the gods it's her, while my burdens are nothing in comparison. But... it really helps to be able to hope." ] |Your quiet reflections are interrupted by Hotaru [pc.ra kitsune |curling one of her tails about yours and giving it a gentle tug |elbowing you gently in the side ]; when you turn, she's grinning right at you. [pc.ra kitsune |Come now. Teasing the divine champion in a sacred place? |Oh, please. You're supposed to be the bumbling outsider, and she's acting worse than you are. ] What's the matter? "I was going to pray for you... but then I realized I wasn't sure what you'd want." Hotaru fidgets on the spot and looks away. "I mean, I have some guesses, but someone [pc.ra kitsune |of your station |like you ] needs more than just wishy-washy platitudes like health and safety. And the more I thought about it, the more it troubled me that despite coming down all the way here to entreat the gods in your stead, I wasn't sure what would be the most useful..." Honestly? It's better that she doesn't know the details of what you get up to, or at least not more than what would make for a good story. When you come to visit Hotaru, she can be assured that the stories you bring at least have you live to see another day... but as to the stories yet untold, who knows? If she wants to pray for you, then you'll be content with something to do between the two of you. That's within her knowledge and control. And no, you'd rather she not tell you; it being a surprise is best. Hotaru doesn't appear fully convinced, but nods and retreats to her own little sphere of space, bowing her head and clasping her hands. You can feel the constant tension rising from the seamstress and her desire to be closer to you, but to her credit the seamstress manages to hold in her gifted impulses and focus. That being said, it doesn't take a genius to figure out roughly what she's really beseeching the gods for... ] ] Silence falls once again, [hotaru.anyKids |but it doesn't last long. A soft, haunting tune drifts through the air as you finish your prayers, and it's only after you're done that you realize it's actually Hotaru singing to Kaori. Yet it seems to also come from all around the both of you, as if the air in the shrine itself is joining in the melody. It's nice to know someone's paying attention, at the very least, and your prayers haven't fallen on deaf ears. [pc.ra kitsune |Hopefully the perks of having sold your soul will extend to those around you, too... ] |[hotaru.isPregnant |but it doesn't last long. A soft, haunting tune drifts through the air as you finish your prayers, and it's only after you're done that you realize Hotaru's singing to herself even as she drums her fingers on her round, protruding middle. Yet the air in the shrine itself joins in the melody, echoing her voice with its own cadence — Whether this is good or bad — or more likely, both — remains to be seen. [pc.ra kitsune |Hopefully the perks of having sold your soul will extend to those around you, too... ] |and by the time you finish your prayers, Hotaru's already done and waiting for you. The seamstress worms her hand into yours, then gives it a petulant tug. Is it just you, or has the air gotten heavier? "I've been here so many times when I was younger, asked the same questions and sent the same hopes. And while I still haven't received any answer... it'd be wrong to say nothing's changed." ...You'll be content with that, then. ] ]

Maybe I was hoping for answers — you certainly don't beseech the August Master for the kind of succor I could've used, being saddled with my gift. It was more than what the den matron strictly demanded of me, at any rate." And now she feels like there's something worth coming back for? "Two things, actually. No, three. It's been a bitter pill to swallow, having to humble myself and admit I was being petulant about it all. But now..." There's someone else with her, now. "Ha. Yes. It's not like I've never considered it before actually coming up to you and — well, you know — but actually being here is one thing. And for once —" Hotaru gives you a small smile in the shrine's dim light — "I feel like there's something worth making the effort for, what with you at my side and Kaori in my belly. "Yes yes, I know piety doesn't work that way; the den matron drilled it into my head that you take both the good and the bad together, and if anyone has any reason to rage against the gods it's her, while my burdens are nothing in comparison. But... it really helps to be able to hope." ] |Your quiet reflections are interrupted by Hotaru [pc.ra kitsune |curling one of her tails about yours and giving it a gentle tug |elbowing you gently in the side ]; when you turn, she's grinning right at you. [pc.ra kitsune |Come now. Teasing the divine champion in a sacred place? |Oh, please. You're supposed to be the bumbling outsider, and she's acting worse than you are. ] What's the matter? "I was going to pray for you... but then I realized I wasn't sure what you'd want." Hotaru fidgets on the spot and looks away. "I mean, I have some guesses, but someone [pc.ra kitsune |of your station |like you ] needs more than just wishy-washy platitudes like health and safety. And the more I thought about it, the more it troubled me that despite coming down all the way here to entreat the gods in your stead, I wasn't sure what would be the most useful..." Honestly? It's better that she doesn't know the details of what you get up to, or at least not more than what would make for a good story. When you come to visit Hotaru, she can be assured that the stories you bring at least have you live to see another day... but as to the stories yet untold, who knows? If she wants to pray for you, then you'll be content with something to do between the two of you. That's within her knowledge and control. And no, you'd rather she not tell you; it being a surprise is best. Hotaru doesn't appear fully convinced, but nods and retreats to her own little sphere of space, bowing her head and clasping her hands. You can feel the constant tension rising from the seamstress and her desire to be closer to you, but to her credit the seamstress manages to hold in her gifted impulses and focus. That being said, it doesn't take a genius to figure out roughly what she's really beseeching the gods for... ] ] Silence falls once again, [hotaru.anyKids |but it doesn't last long. A soft, haunting tune drifts through the air as you finish your prayers, and it's only after you're done that you realize it's actually Hotaru singing to Kaori. It's nice to know someone's paying attention, at the very least, and your prayers haven't fallen on deaf ears. rows.original: Ignoring the teasing, you wrap a possessive arm about Hotaru's waist and pull her along with you into the little shrine, Mai trailing along and sliding the doors shut in your wake. Clean as always, statue, altar, offerings all, and the seamstress whimpers and trembles at your touch as you guide her deeper in. Something the trouble? "Ain't it always." Sidling up, Mai takes Hotaru's hand in hers and gestures at one of the benches by the wall. "Why don't ya take a seat and let me take a look at ya while [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence |[pc.name] ] done petitions th' August Master f'r th' both of ya?" Hotaru looks up to you for approval, and you nudge her away. You can be pious enough for the both of you, until Mai's done giving her a checkup. Hotaru still looks pensive, but at least she doesn't look fit to burn down the shrine around her, and lets Mai lead her off to the side. [hotaru.isPregnant |[mai.isPregnant |The sight of two pregnant vixens bumping bellies as they waddle off — ha. Physician, heal thyself. |Within the dim light of these four walls, with Hotaru waddling away while Mai guides her — it's a rare sight to see, but here and now Hotaru appears especially vulnerable... ] |No matter the circumstances, she's always got Kaori clutched close to her breast, as if perpetually fearful some contrivance might snatch her infant from her at any moment. ] Well, let them do what they must. Approaching the statue and altar, you briefly wonder if Keros himself is going to step in and join the fun, but the statue remains as stony — ha — as ever. [pc.ra kitsune |Remembering your place as divine champion, you try and remember what — if anything — Miko and Mai have said about what's expected of you here |[pc.swornGod nareva lumia |Despite you knowing the pantheon isn't jealous and people pay respects to all the Seven regularly, you can't help but feel just a twinge of apprehension — you are specially favored, after all. |Well, as far as the divine's concerned, you're just someone unimportant. ] ] Good thing the Trickster himself will see any misstep as a big joke, right? You do your best anyway, clasping your hands and hoping that the August Master at the Center of Heaven himself is hearing your prayers for Hotaru[hotaru.anyKids | and Kaori ][hotaru.isMILF |, and that Hotaru continues being as comfortable with her more matronly appearance ]... As you continue to pray, snippets of conversation drift over from the two vixens off to the side: [hotaru.anyKids |[hotaru.isMILF |"...Honestly, Mai, I can live with it, but at the same time it's quite frustrating." "Ya done took what's basically concentrated life energy f'r months an' thought there wouldn't be no problems?" "N-not like this! Kaori's obliging enough, but there's just so much and I get so full so quickly! Sure, I can squeeze it out, but then it bothers me to no end that it's being wasted, and —" "Y'all just calm down, take a deep breath. So lemme get yer problem: yer overflowin' an' there ain't no way Kaori can drink it all, but yer heart aches to throw it away. Ain't I right?" "Y-yes." "Ya considered being a wet nurse f'r a bit? [kohaku.anyKids |I done heard Kohaku's lil' gremlin always has a good appetite — sucks it all down like a bottomless pit an' bawls for more in a couple hours. If'n ya got that much left over, why don't ya help out yer friend?" "That 'friend' of mine turned me into this, and you're suggesting —" "[kohaku.wellFed |Can't say ya didn't deserve it none |Ain't th' kid's fault ]." |[miko.anyKids |'S what Miko does, an' my sis can hardly keep up once word got out, bless her heart." The ensuing silence is deafening. Then, after what feels like an eternity: "I don't look like Miko, do I?" "Not jus' yet. If'n ya keep expandin' at this rate, though, I'd give it two or three more kits. Surely th' next time won't be as drastic as this, ain't I right?" "You think there'll be a next time?" "Lil' ol' me jus' happens to be a midwife, I done know yer type. Might take a lil' while, but ya ain't gonna be able to hold it in forever." |Lil' ol' me knows a few households who could use th' help, I could hook ya up if'n yer interested." "A-a what?" "Ya don't like th' idea none?" "No, it's just... a little sudden." "I know ya don't like crowds none, bein' a homebody an' all. 'S a chance f'r ya to go out an' make yerself useful, ingratiate yerself with other folks. Ya don't need to say yes now, but people do notice if'n ya make an effort to be helpful." ] ] Mumbled grumbling. "Hey, ya asked f'r a solution and lil' ol' me jus' done gave ya one. Think 'bout it and lemme know what ya decide." |"Don't see nothin' wrong with yer kit, at least in body. 'S yer first time doin' this, so 's only natural to worry. Take a page from yer kit — ain't she jus' th' most centered baby I've ever done seen." "I've never once heard her cry or have her fuss. Oh, I know when Kaori's upset — she has an absolutely withering gaze — but she's quiet about it." "Ain't nothin' I can do anythin' 'bout, an' ya know that as well as I do. Yer daughter's done got her own gift, as do you. Relax. Stop worrying. Neither o' ya are getting outta this life that easy, so jus' be glad ya got each other. Ain't no cure f'r an old soul." ... "Honestly, lil' ol' me thinks Kaori done left something o' herself in ya, 'cause yer a lot less crazy these days, an' that's a good thing. Th' Hotaru I once knew wouldn't have gotten this worried 'bout nothin'." "I just worry." A sigh. "She's not interested in people, which is understandable, but not showing interest in just about anything —" "Ya an' I done know she's gifted. Don't worry so much, 'kay? Ya won't be much good to either o' ya if yer a nervous wreck." ] |[hotaru.isMILF |"Tch. Yer absolutely massive f'r how far along ya oughta be. Any problems gettin' around?" "I just have to be careful about my balance and accidentally bumping into things. Everything's heavier, but... well, your grandma always said every generation a lineage spends in the colonies makes our bodies all that more robust." "An' thank th' gods f'r that — I'd be a lot more worried if'n it were jus' yer middle that were swellin' out with child." Some shuffling, and you hear the rustling of fabric. "Just lookit ya an how much more yer measurin' since th' last time I done looked ya over; yer body's absolutely seflish. Small mercy yer always wearin' baggy clothes and yer a seamstress." "At least I won't have a difficult birth." "Not f'r th' reason yer thinkin', no. Well, probably. 'S too important — an' dangerous — to take f'r granted. No trouble on th' inside, either?" "Not any more than I would be otherwise, I think." "I'll still be keepin' an eye on ya." Mai tuts. "Honestly, ya done took what's basically concentrated life energy f'r months; might be a small price to pay f'r ya not burnin' down yer home, but still. Maybe I oughta have stopped ya, but there's a part o' me that wants to see jus' what ya end up lookin' like by th' time ya pop." "I want to be huge." Hotaru's voice trembles as it grows distant. "Getting so pregnant, growing so large that I can stay in bed all day without qualms. Birthing the largest, healthiest kit I can possibly squeeze out of me. I —" "Oh, no no no no. That's yer gift speakin', yer goin' crazy. If'n things get that bad, lil' ol' me's steppin' in an' settin' yer head right." |"Yer jus' fine. Everythin's as it should be — at least in yer body. Yer head, that's another matter there." "I-I've been able to keep it under control. Just sleep away the worst parts." Hotaru sighs. "[hotaru.pregStage 2 |Kaori helps a lot — the further along I get, the more my body tries to make trouble, but as she comes into herself, her gift calms mine." "That's a whole passel' o' wishful thinkin' ya have no evidence f'r... but sometimes, even that's enough |I feel like I'm not being a good mother if I can't even take something like this in stride; there're still so many months to go and I'm sure it'll only get more intense." "Don't sweat it none, yer still gettin' to grips with havin' a life growin' in yer belly an' doin' all kinds of things to ya ]. I'll hand ya somethin' f'r yer nerves tomorrow, but ya gotta use it only when ya really need it, 'kay?" [hotaru.pregStage 2 |"It's just like anything else, honestly. The more I do it, the easier it gets. I'm not sure why you'd think it so surprising." |"Honestly, I'd rather not have anything at all. I-I'm terrified of poisoning Kaori just to give myself a little relief. It doesn't make sense, but there it is." ] "Lil' ol' me jus' wants to make sure yer okay. Granny's parti-cularly interested in yer lineage, since ya came over with her. Sentimental value an' all that. Yer gift ain't that much different from what Miko an' I done share, so... I wanna see where this goes, too." ] ] The voices fade, to be replaced by Mai's soft singing in the dim light of the shrine; as you complete your prayers, Hotaru [hotaru.pregStage 2 |waddles |shuffles ] in and joins you at your side. By her own admission, she's never been very pious after leaving Komari's care, but perhaps in the end all she needed was hope and a reason. For Hotaru, for [hotaru.isPregnant |an unborn ]Kaori, and... well, sometimes her gift is just that. All worth another round of silent prayer, this time with her at your side.
