]她加入了你们的行列，站在你们身边。她自己也承认，在离开麻里的照顾后，她其实从未真正虔诚过，但也许，她最终所需要的，只是希望和一个理由。 为了萤，为了[hotaru.isPregnant |尚未出生的 ]香织，还有……嗯，有时候她的这份天赋就是这样的。这一切都值得我们再次默默祈祷，而这一次，她会在你身边陪伴着你。
rows.raw: " Ignoring the teasing, you wrap a possessive arm about Hotaru's waist and pull her along with you into the little shrine, Mai trailing along and sliding the doors shut in your wake. Clean as always, statue, altar, offerings all, and the seamstress whimpers and trembles at your touch as you guide her deeper in. Something the trouble? "Ain't it always." Sidling up, Mai takes Hotaru's hand in hers and gestures at one of the benches by the wall. "Why don't ya take a seat and let me take a look at ya while [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence |[pc.name] ] done petitions th' August Master f'r th' both of ya?" Hotaru looks up to you for approval, and you nudge her away. You can be pious enough for the both of you, until Mai's done giving her a checkup. Hotaru still looks pensive, but at least she doesn't look fit to burn down the shrine around her, and lets Mai lead her off to the side. [hotaru.isPregnant |[mai.isPregnant |The sight of two pregnant vixens bumping bellies as they waddle off — ha. Physician, heal thyself. |Within the dim light of these four walls, with Hotaru waddling away while Mai guides her — it's a rare sight to see, but here and now Hotaru appears especially vulnerable... ] |No matter the circumstances, she's always got Kaori clutched close to her breast, as if perpetually fearful some contrivance might snatch her infant from her at any moment. ] Well, let them do what they must. Approaching the statue and altar, you briefly wonder if Keros himself is going to step in and join the fun, but the statue remains as stony — ha — as ever. [pc.ra kitsune |Remembering your place as divine champion, you try and remember what — if anything — Miko and Mai have said about what's expected of you here |[pc.swornGod nareva lumia |Despite you knowing the pantheon isn't jealous and people pay respects to all the Seven regularly, you can't help but feel just a twinge of apprehension — you are specially favored, after all. |Well, as far as the divine's concerned, you're just someone unimportant. ] ] Good thing the Trickster himself will see any misstep as a big joke, right? You do your best anyway, clasping your hands and hoping that the August Master at the Center of Heaven himself is hearing your prayers for Hotaru[hotaru.anyKids | and Kaori ][hotaru.isMILF |, and that Hotaru continues being as comfortable with her more matronly appearance ]... As you continue to pray, snippets of conversation drift over from the two vixens off to the side: [hotaru.anyKids |[hotaru.isMILF |"...Honestly, Mai, I can live with it, but at the same time it's quite frustrating." "Ya done took what's basically concentrated life energy f'r months an' thought there wouldn't be no problems?" "N-not like this! Kaori's obliging enough, but there's just so much and I get so full so quickly! Sure, I can squeeze it out, but then it bothers me to no end that it's being wasted, and —" "Y'all just calm down, take a deep breath. So lemme get yer problem: yer overflowin' an' there ain't no way Kaori can drink it all, but yer heart aches to throw it away. Ain't I right?" "Y-yes." "Ya considered being a wet nurse f'r a bit? [kohaku.anyKids |I done heard Kohaku's lil' gremlin always has a good appetite — sucks it all down like a bottomless pit an' bawls for more in a couple hours. If'n ya got that much left over, why don't ya help out yer friend?" "That 'friend' of mine turned me into this, and you're suggesting —" "[kohaku.wellFed |Can't say ya didn't deserve it none |Ain't th' kid's fault ]." |[miko.anyKids |'S what Miko does, an' my sis can hardly keep up once word got out, bless her heart." The ensuing silence is deafening. Then, after what feels like an eternity: "I don't look like Miko, do I?" "Not jus' yet. If'n ya keep expandin' at this rate, though, I'd give it two or three more kits. Surely th' next time won't be as drastic as this, ain't I right?" "You think there'll be a next time?" "Lil' ol' me jus' happens to be a midwife, I done know yer type. Might take a lil' while, but ya ain't gonna be able to hold it in forever." |Lil' ol' me knows a few households who could use th' help, I could hook ya up if'n yer interested." "A-a what?" "Ya don't like th' idea none?" "No, it's just... a little sudden." "I know ya don't like crowds none, bein' a homebody an' all. 'S a chance f'r ya to go out an' make yerself useful, ingratiate yerself with other folks. Ya don't need to say yes now, but people do notice if'n ya make an effort to be helpful." ] ] Mumbled grumbling. "Hey, ya asked f'r a solution and lil' ol' me jus' done gave ya one. Think 'bout it and lemme know what ya decide." |"Don't see nothin' wrong with yer kit, at least in body. 'S yer first time doin' this, so 's only natural to worry. Take a page from yer kit — ain't she jus' th' most centered baby I've ever done seen." "I've never once heard her cry or have her fuss. Oh, I know when Kaori's upset — she has an absolutely withering gaze — but she's quiet about it." "Ain't nothin' I can do anythin' 'bout, an' ya know that as well as I do. Yer daughter's done got her own gift, as do you. Relax. Stop worrying. Neither o' ya are getting outta this life that easy, so jus' be glad ya got each other. Ain't no cure f'r an old soul." ... "Honestly, lil' ol' me thinks Kaori done left something o' herself in ya, 'cause yer a lot less crazy these days, an' that's a good thing. Th' Hotaru I once knew wouldn't have gotten this worried 'bout nothin'." "I just worry." A sigh. "She's not interested in people, which is understandable, but not showing interest in just about anything —" "Ya an' I done know she's gifted. Don't worry so much, 'kay? Ya won't be much good to either o' ya if yer a nervous wreck." ] |[hotaru.isMILF |"Tch. Yer absolutely massive f'r how far along ya oughta be. Any problems gettin' around?" "I just have to be careful about my balance and accidentally bumping into things. Everything's heavier, but... well, your grandma always said every generation a lineage spends in the colonies makes our bodies all that more robust." "An' thank th' gods f'r that — I'd be a lot more worried if'n it were jus' yer middle that were swellin' out with child." Some shuffling, and you hear the rustling of fabric. "Just lookit ya an how much more yer measurin' since th' last time I done looked ya over; yer body's absolutely seflish. Small mercy yer always wearin' baggy clothes and yer a seamstress." "At least I won't have a difficult birth." "Not f'r th' reason yer thinkin', no. Well, probably. 'S too important — an' dangerous — to take f'r granted. No trouble on th' inside, either?" "Not any more than I would be otherwise, I think." "I'll still be keepin' an eye on ya." Mai tuts. "Honestly, ya done took what's basically concentrated life energy f'r months; might be a small price to pay f'r ya not burnin' down yer home, but still. Maybe I oughta have stopped ya, but there's a part o' me that wants to see jus' what ya end up lookin' like by th' time ya pop." "I want to be huge." Hotaru's voice trembles as it grows distant. "Getting so pregnant, growing so large that I can stay in bed all day without qualms. Birthing the largest, healthiest kit I can possibly squeeze out of me. I —" "Oh, no no no no. That's yer gift speakin', yer goin' crazy. If'n things get that bad, lil' ol' me's steppin' in an' settin' yer head right." |"Yer jus' fine. Everythin's as it should be — at least in yer body. Yer head, that's another matter there." "I-I've been able to keep it under control. Just sleep away the worst parts." Hotaru sighs. "[hotaru.pregStage 2 |Kaori helps a lot — the further along I get, the more my body tries to make trouble, but as she comes into herself, her gift calms mine." "That's a whole passel' o' wishful thinkin' ya have no evidence f'r... but sometimes, even that's enough |I feel like I'm not being a good mother if I can't even take something like this in stride; there're still so many months to go and I'm sure it'll only get more intense." "Don't sweat it none, yer still gettin' to grips with havin' a life growin' in yer belly an' doin' all kinds of things to ya ]. I'll hand ya somethin' f'r yer nerves tomorrow, but ya gotta use it only when ya really need it, 'kay?" [hotaru.pregStage 2 |"It's just like anything else, honestly. The more I do it, the easier it gets. I'm not sure why you'd think it so surprising." |"Honestly, I'd rather not have anything at all. I-I'm terrified of poisoning Kaori just to give myself a little relief. It doesn't make sense, but there it is." ] "Lil' ol' me jus' wants to make sure yer okay. Granny's parti-cularly interested in yer lineage, since ya came over with her. Sentimental value an' all that. Yer gift ain't that much different from what Miko an' I done share, so... I wanna see where this goes, too." ] ] The voices fade, to be replaced by Mai's soft singing in the dim light of the shrine; as you complete your prayers, Hotaru [hotaru.pregStage 2 |waddles |shuffles ] in and joins you at your side. By her own admission, she's never been very pious after leaving Komari's care, but perhaps in the end all she needed was hope and a reason. For Hotaru, for [hotaru.isPregnant |an unborn ]Kaori, and... well, sometimes her gift is just that. All worth another round of silent prayer, this time with her at your side. "

rows.original:
"[dayNight
        |Hope ya had a good time! Don't be a stranger, now! Mai an' I kinda miss ya, ya know — ya done grew up with us an' we see ya as a sister."
        
        Hotaru doesn't answer Miko's teasing as the latter closes up the shrine behind you, her earlier serenity souring somewhat as you emerge back into daylight
        |Didja feel his divine lordship's presence? Well, come as often as ya please. Nights can be cold an' lonely sometimes... but lil' ol' me would rather be here than cleanin' out th' baths, and ya would rather see my face than Miko's."
        
        "Thanks for being here for me."
        
        "Anytime." Mai closes up the shrine behind you. "Come back when yer heart's in it. Ya'll feel much better then."
        
        Something in Mai's last words scuttles Hotaru's mood, the both of you quietly emerging into the wan moonlight
    ]. As you pass by the donation box, her footsteps slow, and her fingers tremble against yours.
    
    You give Hotaru's hand a reassuring squeeze. Something the matter?
    
    Hotaru pauses a moment, then sighs. Reaching into her clothes, the seamstress pulls out a coin of obviously foreign make, then carelessly and most irreverently tosses it into the donation box before continuing at your side with a note of finality in her step.
    
    "Before you say anything, I know I ought to come and it's good for me. Still, I don't have to like it[dayNight
        |, especially if I have to see Miko in the bargain
    ]. But... you make it tolerable[pc.ra kitsune
        |, my [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]
    ], so thank you."
    
    The two of you continue in heavy silence up into the branches and all the way to Hotaru's doorstep; before you part, the seamstress [pc.heightRange 70
        |stands on tiptoe
        |leans in
    ] to give you a quick, small kiss.
    
    [pc.ra kitsune
        |"Having the divine champion with me made all the difference. Good bye, your Eminence."
        |"It's much easier when you don't have to do it alone. I'll see you around, then."
    ]
    
    With that, Hotaru disappears, leaving but a brief glimpse of her tails before those, too, vanish behind the closing door...
rows.translation:
"[dayNight
        |希望你玩得开心！现在可别再当陌生人啦……我和舞都有点想你呢，你知道的——你本来就是和我们一起长大的，我们把你当亲姐妹一样看待。
        
        萤并没有回应米可的调侃，后者在你身后关上了神社；当你重新回到阳光下时，她先前的那份平静似乎也有些变味了。
        |“你感觉到那位神圣领主大人的气场了吗？好吧，随时欢迎你来。夜晚有时候会变得寒冷而孤独……但比起去打扫浴室，我宁愿待在这里；而比起看到米可的脸，你肯定更愿意看到我的脸吧。谢谢你一直在我身边。”
        
        “谢谢。”
        
        “随时都可以。”舞在你身后关上了神社，“等你真心想来的时候再回来吧，到那时你会感觉好很多。”
        
        舞的这番话让萤的心情有些低落，两人就这样在微弱的月光中静静地离开了那里。
    ]当你经过捐款箱时，她的脚步变得缓慢，手指也开始微微颤抖，与你的手指相触时显得有些不稳。
    
    你轻轻地握了握萤的手，安慰道：“怎么了？”
    
    萤停顿了一下，然后叹了口气。她从衣服里掏出一枚明显是外国制造的硬币，随意地、甚至有些不敬地将它扔进了捐款箱，然后继续跟在你身边，步伐中带着一种决绝的感觉。
    
    “在你开口之前，我就知道我应该来，而且这对我也有好处。不过，我并不一定非得喜欢这件事才行。[dayNight
        |尤其是如果我还能顺便见到米可的话
    ]。但是……你让这一切变得可以忍受了。[pc.ra kitsune
        |我的[pc.mf
            |领主
            |女士
        ]
    ]，所以，谢谢你。”
    
    随后，两人陷入了沉闷的沉默，一路上都没有说话，直到来到了萤的家门口；在分开之前，那位裁缝[pc.heightRange 70
        |踮起脚来
        |靠近一些
    ]给你一个快速而轻柔的吻。
    
    [pc.ra kitsune
        |“有这位神圣的英雄在我身边，确实让一切变得不同。再见了，阁下。”
        |“当不需要独自完成这些事情时，一切都会变得容易得多。那么，回头见吧。”
    ]
    
    说完这句话，萤便消失了，只留下她那条尾巴的短暂身影，随后那尾巴也随着关上的门一起消失了……

rows.original: "A bath? At this time of day?" Is this one of those unspoken kitsune etiquette things [pc.ra kitsune |that you're expected to learn and no doubt are giving your new patron god no end of amusement by blundering over? |that you happily and willingly serve as a source of amusement over thanks to your blundering? ] Hotaru titters. "Perish the thought. I know we foxes are a miserable lot when it comes to such things, but this isn't one of them. No, it's all me." Oh. The seamstress turns her gaze from yours. "I just... well... I don't like the daytime crowds. Having that many people in that kind of setting... [hotaru.anyKids |Kaori doesn't like crowds, and unsurprisingly so; she's her mother's daughter, after all. I can put up with it if I absolutely must, but she's still too young for that kind of self-control and needs to be delicately handled." Or maybe said mother's hiding behind her daughter as an excuse. "Maybe[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. But the point of going out is to have fun, and it's not fun sharing a bath with that much noise. |[hotaru.isMILF |the stares were flattering at first, but at this point they just make me self-conscious. It wouldn't be so bad if they only stared at my big belly, but I can't help but feel fat and ungainly all over. I'd complain about it not being polite, but given the things I've done in the past, it's hard to argue I don't deserve it. "Then my gift starts acting up, and I start wanting a bit more sap to help quell the intrusive thoughts... and well, that's how I got into this predicament to begin with, right?" Perhaps, but you don't think Kohaku's prank would've worked as well as it had if she weren't inclined to such to begin with. Hers is one of the oldest lineages on this side of the ocean, isn't it? "It wouldn't have worked as well as it had if you didn't keep on giving me more[pc.ra kitsune |, oh mighty divine champion ]. Or if I had a stronger will. But maybe this is how the gods want things to be, and I can stay home for the rest of my life. Not such a bad prospect when you think about it, right? |[hotaru.isPregnant |I know no one's staring at me, but I can't help but shake off the feeling that people are watching me out of the corner of their eyes. How I got to be with child is hardly the most orthodox of reasons, after all." Or maybe it's just the village gossip projecting her own behavior and guilty conscience onto others. Hotaru might once have argued, but instead the seamstress slumps her shoulders and hugs the roundness of her kit-filled womb close. "Mmmh. It feels like... that is... hey, why am I agreeing with you?" Maybe her unborn kit is having a good influence on her. "Not that I'm complaining about an obedient daughter, but..." Hotaru's clearly trying to summon up the will to get all indignant, but ultimately fails after several false starts. Eventually, she concedes defeat and sinks back onto her cushion with a sigh. "I was always a homebody, but ever since I got with child I can't shake the feeling that I'm being watched and judged, and I don't like it one bit. If I'm going to go out to bathe with so many people who could be quietly judging my naked body — |it makes me antsy and my gift act up. People are one thing, a crowd of kits gathered to hear a story is another, and yet... I don't want to share a bath with a crowd. It feels unsanitary. When you hear Mai complain about all the hair clogging the drain at the end of the day... well, that's one thing, but there's also a cleanliness that's more than skin-deep. ] ] ] "That's why I usually go in the dead of night, when it's just me, Kohaku when she finally gets off work, and Mai when she comes in to clean up. The atmosphere's completely different when it's just you and maybe a friend or two, isn't it? If you want to go out with me, maybe you can ask again then." So, no bath? "Oh no, I didn't say that! I just don't want to go out, that's all." Hotaru's dejection inverts itself in the blink of an eye, the vixen's ears perking up as she leans in conspiratorially. "But if it were just me and you, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]I think we could have a wonderful time together." You're all ears. What does she have in mind? The black-furred mischief maker just grins and rises from her cushion, [hotaru.pregStage 2 |waddling |stepping out ] of the sitting room to where she keeps her work stuff. You hear the sounds of rummaging, followed by Hotaru returning with a large wooden tub on a trolley. The tub's absolutely huge, enough to accommodate the both of you comfortably, and it absolutely dwarfs Hotaru[hotaru.isMILF | despite the seamstress having expanded considerably over the course of her pregnancy ]. "Help me get this out onto the balcony, won't you?[hotaru.isPregnant | This big belly of mine is weighing me down enough as it is. ]" She just had this lying around? "I usually use it for dyeing." Hotaru scrutinizes your expression as you move to help her, then titters. "Don't worry, it won't stain or smell. Look at me, I use it all the time, and I'm perfectly fine. Did you imagine I don't bathe just because I'm a homebody? Ew, perish the thought." Well, no — She clearly isn't listening. "Just me and you, under the warm sun, up to our necks in the same tub. Isn't that absolutely romantic[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]? Better than going out to the bathhouse at this hour and having to deal with having absolutely no privacy. I like people, but I prefer it to be on my own terms." As you wheel the tub out onto the balcony and face the warm sun and crisp Marches air, you have to admit Hotaru has a point: just you[hotaru.isPregnant |, her, and the kit you made together | and her ] under the open sky — it's a much more intimate setting. You fill the tub, while Hotaru brings a kettle to boil; steam rises into the air as the black-furred vixen pours in the kettle and tests the water by hiking up her skirts and stepping right in without even bothering to toe the surface first. "Ah," she sighs, starting to undress. "Absolutely perfect. Please, join me[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. I may not have fine liquor or fancy drinking sets, but I can offer myself. And truth be told, isn't that the greatest treasure of all?" The water isn't boiling, but it is uncomfortably hot; Hotaru doesn't mind in the least, neatly folding her clothes and then slipping in up to her neck with a sigh that's an inch from being outright orgasmic. The seamstress demurs a moment, letting her hair fall free and tails soak, then [hotaru.pregStage 2 |rests her hands on the [hotaru.pregStage 3 |mound |tip ] of her tummy as it protrudes above the water. "Ehehe. Our daughter likes being warm, too. But more than that... I haven't felt this satisfied for a long time. Please, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]join us. |ducks her head under the water before resurfacing and waving for you to join her. ] "It's the decent thing to do to wash yourself before getting in the water, but I don't have such luxuries when all I have is a dyeing tub. And let's face it, we have the privilege of not caring when it's just the both of us." When it's the both of you, huh? Seeing Hotaru reclining in the lightly steaming water, [hotaru.pregStage 1 2 3 |seemingly actually raising the temperature by virtue of her body heating up from pregnancy |fussing over and caressing the portion of her bump that insists on being above the surface |instinctively hugging the weight of her huge bump to herself while her four tails cocoon about herself to form a little nest |[hotaru.isMILF |showing off how she's no less agile for being that much more sumptuous |beckoning you over with her inviting demeanor ] ] — you slowly pull off your [pc.armor] and make to join her in the water. Hotaru chuckles at your hesitation and coils a tail-tip about your ankle, gently but insistently tugging away and urging you on. "Oh, it's fine. It might be a little warm, but I'm sure [pc.ra kitsune |the August Master's handpicked champion can stand a little hot water, can't [pc.heShe] |you'll get used to the heat, won't you ]? Besides, if it so happens that you do faint in the bath..." The black-furred vixen exhales deeply, her [hotaru.isMILF |milky, maternal |[hotaru.pregStage 2 |tender and sensitive ] ]bosom visibly heaving with the effort. "...Then I get to take care of you until you come to. Wouldn't that be nice?" One has to admit, for all of Hotaru's eccentricities that her gift's imposed on her, there is an appeal. Nevertheless, you don't intend to pass out in the bath, as warm as it might be. Hotaru titters, her gaze growing distant, the seamstress herself seemingly unaware of the little wisps of foxfire flickering in and out of existence about her head like azure fireflies. Oh, she's not completely sane at times, but if this was any kind of serious issue you wouldn't [hotaru.anyKids |have given her Kaori |[hotaru.isPregnant |have fucked a kit into her belly |be sharing a tub with her this very moment ] ]. "Feels good, doesn't it[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]? Being in hot water is one of the few times I can really let go and feel comfortable — people tend to freak out when you set yourself on fire, so this is all I have that's socially acceptable." But when it's just the two of you — "Alas, self-immolation's not something you'd be able to join me in. And...     萤？

    萤强迫自己睁开眼睛，你能感觉到她胸中的烈火极不情愿地重新燃起。她的思绪一时还在设法让这一刻永远持续下去，随后才颤抖着叹息一声，把身体从你身上拖开。她直起身时，水流顺着后背和肩膀倾泻而下。
    
    她打了个哈欠。“我还是没有满足[pc.ra kitsune
        |，尊贵的阁下
    ]。”
    
    她永远不会满足，坦白说你也一样，正因如此，这一刻终究必须过去。你和她的工作永远也做不完。
    
    “可不是嘛。”萤依旧不肯离开；你从仍冒着热气的水中爬出来、开始擦干身体时，她盯着你看。“不过我还是想再泡一会儿，嘿嘿。等穿好衣服，你不介意自己出去吧[pc.ra kitsune

rows.original:
"A bath? At this time of day?"
    
    Is this one of those unspoken kitsune etiquette things [pc.ra kitsune
        |that you're expected to learn and no doubt are giving your new patron god no end of amusement by blundering over?
        |that you happily and willingly serve as a source of amusement over thanks to your blundering?
    ]
    
    Hotaru titters. "Perish the thought. I know we foxes are a miserable lot when it comes to such things, but this isn't one of them. No, I was just surprised that you know me this well. A bath in the evening, when the crowds have left... mmmmh. Kohaku didn't tell you, did she?"
    
    No, you just thought an evening soak would be atmospheric, if not outright romantic.
    
    The tittering grows into an outright laugh. "It's always carried different meaning for me, given that I'm usually in the water with Kohaku when I go. But hey, I'm open to you showing me a good time.[hotaru.anyKids
        | Let me leave Kaori with my mom, and then we can be off.
    ]"
rows.translation:
洗澡？现在这个时间？”
    
    这该不会是那些关于狐妖的隐含礼仪吧[pc.ra kitsune
        |那些你本应该学会的东西，而你却一再犯错，无疑让你的新庇护神感到非常有趣吧？
        |正是因为你的这些失误，人们才会开心地、自愿地把你当作笑料来取乐，而不是感谢你吗？
    ]
    
    萤火虫轻声笑了起来。“别这么想。我知道我们狐妖在这些事情上确实挺不中用的，但这次不一样。其实，我只是觉得你太了解我了……晚上，等人群都散去之后，再泡个澡吧。嗯……科哈库没有告诉你吧？”
    
    “没有，你只是觉得在晚上泡在水中会有一种特别的氛围，甚至会让人觉得很有浪漫气息吧。”
    
    她的笑声逐渐变得响亮起来：“对我来说，这种体验总是有着不同的意义。因为每次我去泡水的时候，通常都会和科哈库在一起。不过，嘿，我也很乐意让你带我享受一段美好的时光。[hotaru.anyKids
        | 让我把薰留给我妈妈，然后我们就可以出发了。
    ]"

rows.original: Down to the roots, then off to one side — the den's bathhouse isn't small, but you can see why it'd get crowded during the day with just one common pool, and neither are there any private baths. This time of evening, though, it's just you and Hotaru, and you're greeted out front by a rather damp Mai out of her shrine maiden's outfit and with rags bound about her elbows and knees. "Oh, if'n it ain't ya. Jus' don't cause no trouble while I'm cleanin' —" Mai's eyes register you by Hotaru's side and throws her hands up. "Welp. [pc.ra kitsune |You'd be a handful in and of yerself, but draggin' someone like th' divine champion into yer schemes — I ain't stoppin' ya, by the gods, no. |One's bad enough, but two's askin' f'r more than a good girl can handle. ] The both of ya have fun; tell lil' ol' me when yer done so I can come clean up th' mess afterwards. Hotaru sheds like no one's business; ain't no point scrubbin' when ya get to see yer work undone before yer eyes, it kills th' spirit." It's fine, you'll take care of Hotaru and make sure she behaves.[hotaru.pregStage 2 | Besides, what kind of mischief can she get up to with a big belly weighing her down? ] "Lots. Especially when th' other one's in this evening, too." %"The other one" turns out to be Kohaku, who's soaking in a corner of the bath after Hotaru and you have undressed and stepped into the chamber. Hotaru's a familiar sight to her — it was mentioned that the two met up in the bathhouse in the evening to catch up — but the little golden fox looks positively conflicted when you step in after the black-furred vixen. Two's a gathering, three's a crowd; now the dynamic's changed, and Kohaku [kohaku.wellFed |glares daggers at Hotaru as she |[kohaku.fucked |twitches restlessly while Hotaru |looks away bashfully as Hotaru ] ] helps you rinse down in preparation for getting in the water. "Y-you brought [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence |[pc.name] ] here with you, nojya? This is kind of awkward..." Well, it was your idea to have a bath this evening, not Hotaru's; she's not to blame, not that there's any fault to apportion to begin with. And [kohaku.fucked |you'd imagine that you're familiar enough with the both of them at this point that having you around shouldn't be awkward for either of them. There's a moment of tense silence in the air as both vixens small and tall share a glance, and you can envision the gears turning in their heads. "We-ll... why don't you join me in the water, nojya? Then we can work a good deal for everyone." |while the two of them can get together and hang out any time, you're not around every day. Why not have a change for just an evening? "[pc.ra kitsune |Oh, I wouldn't dare begrudge your company, your Eminence, not in the least |Hotaru and I have been doing this since we were kits, and you get used to it I guess. Don't get me wrong, it's not like I'm saying you shouldn't be here, especially if Hotaru invited you ]. It just wasn't what I was expecting this evening, nojya. If you're done washing up, why don't you come join me in the water? Mai just scrubbed out the bath, which means we get to really let go, right?" ] Chuckling, Hotaru finishes her scrub-down and upends the bucket over your head, then steps back to admire her handiwork. "There, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ]. Now you're ready to get in — Mai already complains about all the hair and fluff clogging the drains, imagine if everyone tracked their dirt and dust right into the public bath." And so you do. No sooner have you stepped in the water that [var0 |both vixens black and gold come in at you from either side, gently but firmly pulling you down with them into the tepid bath before sandwiching you between their plump figures. One tall, one small, Hotaru and Kohaku cuddle in under your arms and rub themselves all over you, making no secret of how much bearing your kits has changed them... well, that and what they've done to each other. Why, is the fact that they're content to be with you proof they've made up with each other for their pranks? "You mean, feeding me when I couldn't help myself, nojya? Turning me all round and fat like some kind of goblin?" "Or did you mean taking advantage of my moodiness to push on me what effectively was comfort food? Not that I didn't already have a colonial physique, but this is..." "Fat, nojya." "You're fatter." For childhood friends who grew up together, the both of them really do deserve each other. "We do[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. And what does that say when you deserve us in turn?" |Hotaru and Kohaku come in at you from either side, grabbing onto your arms and cozying up to you in the tepid water. Now, now, there's enough of you for everyone. "I suppose that's true," Hotaru chuckles as she rests her head on your shoulder and curls a tail possessively about your waist. "At least I thought things through before doing them, as opposed to someone listening to the intrusive thoughts in her mind." "Better than thinking through it for days and still arriving at a stupid decision that was only saved by [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship's grace |[pc.name] ]." There, there, this isn't the time for that; you want your time in the bath with black and golden vixens alike to be pleasant. Hopefully the daughters get on better than their mothers. "Enough that we're fine letting them play together, nojya. Well, my daughter tries. Kaori just lies around and mostly ignores her." "You'd never imagine they were half-sisters if you didn't know beforehand." For childhood friends who grew up together, the both of them really do deserve each other. "We do[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. And what does that say when you deserve us in turn?" |both vixens black and gold cuddle in on you from either side. With how intent their start is, it's likely they intended something more, but cozying up against you neck-deep in tepid water has a way of mollifying pregnant vixens. Sighing with satisfaction, Hotaru leans against you and gives you a light pinch on the arm, then the last of her mischievous intent drains away. Sure, kitsune pregnancies do take a little longer than most, but having both Kohaku and Hotaru carrying your kits at the same time is either fortune coincidence, or devious planning on someone's part. "Hey, Hotaru. Remember how when we were young, we'd make bets on who would have kits first, nojya?" "Oh, I remember. I also remember saying that you'd never settle down, so I'd be first." "And I remember saying you were so crazy no one would ever put up with you, so I'd be first." A moment's silence. And then: "the August Master at the Center of Heaven is having fun with us, nojya. [pc.ra kitsune |Even sent his champion to us to punish us for our sins |This has to be our punishment for all our sins when we were young ]." "I'm not so sure I see it as a punishment, but you do as you please, you little creature." You're not sure when it happened, but as the warmth of the water sinks in, you gradually become aware of both Hotaru and Kohaku pushing in on you with their kit-filled wombs, a pressing reminder of what you've done to them — or given their circumstances, they've done to themselves. Not that it matters: judging by the smiles on both vixens' faces, they've decided you're at fault and intend to make it stick. "Oh, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ]," Hotaru stage-whispers, hooking an ankle about your leg and giving you a taste of how warm her body's gotten, warmer than even the bath. "I should bring up the fact that my back's been quite bothersome of late from all the weight I've been carrying. [hotaru.isMILF |It may be true that my body's gotten more robust as well, but it's hardly enough to compensate for how large our daughter's getting, let alone all the other parts of me that're considerably heavier from how they used to be. |Sure, I'm hardly Miko-proportioned even as I am, but since you've chosen to stick with me you wouldn't begrudge lending me a hand, would you? ]" "You think you have it bad? Just look at me, nojya." The very picture of pouting petulance, Kohaku bumps her pregnant belly right into your side with a vulpine whinge. "I'm so small, my burden is that much larger in proportion to the rest of me, and I still have to walk all day, unlike you." One can only wonder if the two of them have been playing this sort of game for years now, but there's an easy way to solve this. Gathering up both Kohaku and Hotaru in your arms, you plant the heels of your palms right into the small of their backs, just above their tails. Once the initial shock's worn off, both mothers of your children melt under the influence of your firm rubbing and the warm water, your comforting touch working with the quiet of night to turn both vixens tall and small into giggling messes. Yes, the so-called back pain is no doubt a transparent pretext for you to get hands-on with them while they flaunt their pregnancies, but is it really that bad to indulge two big-bellied vixens all at once? |both Hotaru and Kohaku get clingy all of a sudden, attaching themselves to either of your arms and easing you into the tepid water with them. Maybe it's the heat making you light-headed, but the insistent tugging and vulpine giggling from both vixens tall and small have a way of being very persuasive. "Never thought I'd share a benefactor with you, nojya. Makes me feel like I'm eating your leftovers." "There's enough of [pc.name] not just for the both of us, but for everyone. [pc.ra kitsune |The August Master at the Center of Heaven wouldn't have chosen [pc.himHer] as a champion if there weren't enough for everyone to get a little piece |A few benefactors are just big-hearted like that, treasures to be cherished ]." It's not that you're unfamiliar with Kohaku and Hotaru, but having both gossips pester you all at once, caressing you with their tails, grabbing you where convenient — this is supposed to be a bath, but on the other hand, it is just the three of you at this time of night. Do they act like this all the time in the bath? "[pc.ra kitsune |My [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |Well ], I suppose it's an answer somewhere between yes and no, nojya. But you being here, it changes things, like I said. Gives us something to fight over, nojya." "And while the prize is indeed quite delicious, sometimes the fun is in the fighting." Oh no, two vixens vying for [pc.ra kitsune |the attention and favor of someone sitting on a higher rung of the social ladder |your attention and favor ]. How terrible — truly, you'll never live down such ignominy. "[pc.ra kitsune |It can't be helped |We're greedy creatures by nature ], nojya. Although there's more than enough of you to go around, the instinct is to want all of you to ourselves." With that, Kohaku goes off and fetches an evening drink set. The tray is wooden, the porcelain flask and cups small, and the liquor eye-wateringly strong. With the tray made for floating on the bath's calm surface, Kohaku pours out tiny portions of drink for each of you, and even that small thimbleful is enough to burn your stomach. Hotaru grins and flicks her ears at you. "Too many people during the day to pull this off. But when it's just us, with a proper atmosphere..." She really isn't being subtle about it, is she? Both vixens yip and squeal in delight as you wrap your arms about their waists and pull them close, the warmth of the bath lending a comforting edge to the heat of their bodies. Uneasy enough that they still feel the need to vy for your attention, secure enough that they don't scheme against you — that's how vixens should be. Mai is going to be so exasperated at having to scrub out the bath again when you're done here, but this promises to be worth it. |Hotaru and Kohaku come in at you from either side, tails swishing in the water and blocking your escape. Now, what would these two be up to that they'd be worried about spooking you to begin with? And can it even be considered a trap if you walk into it of your own accord anyway? "[pc.ra kitsune |Forgive me my earlier reluctance at your arrival, your Eminence |Well, this is looking up, ehe ]. As I said, I wasn't expecting Hotaru to bring you along, nojya. But..." But? "...But since you're here, you can regale us with stories of what's been going on, yes? I travel a lot for work, too, but unlike you I try to avoid trouble, not find it." More grist for the gossip mill? "And perhaps the seeds of several new stories. Properly translated by yours truly, of course." Hotaru's cheeks are reddening as the heat and steam get to her. "You did bring the drinks, didn't you? We have to adequately compensate [pc.ra kitsune |someone like the divine champion |[pc.name] ] for [pc.hisHer] time." None needed, being able to spend time with Kohaku and Hotaru is reward in itself. But if they intend to ply you with something to loosen your tongue, you won't say no. "Tch. Just for that flattery, I'll save you if you do happen to faint in the bath." While Hotaru's been teasing you, Kohaku's gone off and fetched an evening drink set. The tray is wooden, the porcelain flask and cups small, and the liquor eye-wateringly strong. With the tray made for floating on the bath's calm surface, Kohaku pours out tiny portions of drink for each of you, and even that small thimbleful is enough to burn your stomach. Hotaru grins and flicks her ears at you. "Too many people in the bath during the day to pull this off. But when it's just us, with a proper atmosphere..." "...It's a good way to unwind after work, nojya. So! Tell us[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]! Tell us all about everything you've been doing these days!" For once, these two gossips finally shut up and listen — if only for the sake of fomenting more hearsay. You regale them with several tales of your more recent exploits, taking long enough that Kohaku has refill the liquor jar several times; they aren't concerned in the slightest about the veracity of the yarn you're spinning, only that it's novel. Once the both of them run the rumor mill, your tales will have been embellished several times over, so [pc.isDK |talking yourself up a little isn't going to hurt that much, right? |there's no need to give yourself additional airs when you've others more than willing to do it for you. ] ]

哦，果然是你。我就不在我打扫的时候惹麻烦了——”舞的目光在萤的身边停了下来，然后她举起了双手。“好吧。 [pc.ra kitsune |你自己单枪匹马或许还能应付得来，但要是把像那位神圣冠军这样的人牵扯进你的计划里……我绝对不会阻止你，真的，绝对不会。 |一个就已经够糟糕了，但两个的话，就连一个好女孩也难以应付了。 ]你们俩玩得开心点；等玩完了告诉我，这样我就可以来收拾残局了。萤总是把东西弄得一团糟；要是看到自己的努力白费了，再打扫也没什么意义了，那样会让人失去做事情的兴趣的。 没关系，你会照顾好萤的，确保她不会惹麻烦的。[hotaru.pregStage 2 | 再说，肚子这么大，她还能搞出什么鬼把戏来呢？ ] 很多。尤其是当另一个人也在这个房间里的时候。” Oh, and it's not her place to question you, either. A rueful smile. "You've learned to pull rank quite well, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |And you're not bound to their social niceties — you can just do things, and honestly you suspect that's one of the reasons the kitsune put up with you. Hotaru stops sniffling long enough to choke out a laugh. "You're closer to the truth than you know, [pc.name] ]. But I'm quite serious, too — I know the den matron only dares tap the tree every few years. This is rare, for actual emergencies, not for my gift's foibles." rows.original: All right, you've heard enough. She's taking it, and that's final; this is a gift, not some convoluted social exchange that'll weigh her down with an obligation. "I-I guess I have no choice but to accept, then. Thank you[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. "Now, I wonder how this works — or if it even works?" Hotaru wrings her hands, and you realize she's scrubbing her hands, moving as if rinsing them with water, only it's with foxfire. That's one way to do it, you suppose, and satisfied that her hands are cleansed, the black-furred vixen pops open the flask and tests its contents with a finger, raising it to her lips. "Sweet." Her gaze softens, and her ears swivel. "Comforting." So, it works? Hotaru thinks a moment, setting the flask down on the low table and reclining in her seat. Slowly, she takes several deep breaths, her hands planted on her rounded belly. "I think so," she says at last. "More than if I'd just had something sweet, but you must understand even I can't be sure of my own senses at times. I'll confess, I don't want to end up dependent on something this precious, so I'll save it for when my gift really start acting up." There she goes again — now you're the one shouldering the burden of worrying. "Oh, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. I suppose you could solve everything by staying here with me forever, but you and I know that's not possible. We make do with what we must. That being said... since you're willing to spare no expense on my well-being, you truly do care a lot for me, don't you? I'm truly [pc.ra kitsune |honored, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |flattered ]. "Once more, thank you. Now that the unpleasantries are out of the way, shall we return to more cheerful topics?"
rows.translation: 好吧，你听够了。她必须收下，就这么决定；这是礼物，不是什么会让她背上人情债的复杂社交交换。 “我、我想我也只能收下了。谢谢你[pc.ra kitsune |，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女主人 ]阁下 ]。 “现在嘛，我很好奇这东西是怎么起效的——又或者，它到底有没有效？” 萤搓起双手，你随即发现她是在清洗双手，像用水冲洗一般活动着，只不过用的是狐火。你想，这也算一种办法；黑毛雌狐确认双手已经洁净，便弹开瓶塞，用手指蘸了一点里面的液体，抬到唇边。 “很甜。”她的目光变得柔和，双耳转动起来。“令人安心。” 所以，它有效？ 萤思索片刻，把瓶子放在矮桌上，向后靠进座椅。她缓缓做了几次深呼吸，双手按着圆润的腹部。 “我想是的，”她终于说道。“效果比单纯吃点甜食更强，不过你得明白，就连我有时也无法确信自己的感觉。老实说，我不想最终依赖如此珍贵的东西，所以我要留到我的天赋真的发作时再用。” 她又来了——现在反倒是你肩负起了担忧的重担。 “哦，[pc.ra kitsune |尊贵的阁下 |[pc.name] ]。我想，只要你永远留在这里陪我，一切问题便都能迎刃而解；不过你我都知道那不可能。我们只能靠手头所有的东西想办法。话虽如此……既然你为了我的安康不惜代价，那你真的非常在乎我，对不对？我实在深感[pc.ra kitsune |荣幸，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女主人 ] |受宠若惊 ]。 “再一次，谢谢你。既然令人不快的话题已经结束，我们可以回到更愉快的话题了吗？”

If it's about my welfare, I've planned for this and there are others looking out for me, so you don't have to concern yourself with that if you don't want to. "You don't owe me anything else, nor do you have to involve yourself further if [pc.ra kitsune |your duties keep you away |you'd rather not get involved in the tangled webs we weave ]... but if you do, I can make it worth your time. And of course, I would really like it. The old wives' tales are true: the heavier with child I become, the more demanding certain needs become, and they aren't just physical." Those last words are a little too breathy to be completely sane, but they do fit Hotaru well, don't they? And as for involving yourself further... well, you came to see her in the first place. Why don't you start there? "Of course. Please, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, do ]come in." Beyond herself with smugness at how well all this went, Hotaru leads you into her home, tails swaying all the while — and everything attached to said tails, too. For all that she was already curvaceous to begin with, baby weight isn't something Hotaru's been able to avoid, either. While you seat yourself at the low table, she has to scoot out a little to accommodate her round middle. "Now... with the stage properly set, what can I do for you today?" |So... what happens now? Sighing softly, Hotaru composes herself and gives you a small [pc.ra kitsune |bow |nod ]. "We've been over this, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence. |haven't we? ] Since this was my idea to begin with, and you were so kind to help... I'll take it from here, as we agreed. You don't owe me anything else, nor do you have to involve yourself further if you don't want to... but if you do, I can make it worth your time. And of course, I would really like it." Those last words are a little too breathy to be completely sane, but they do fit Hotaru well, don't they? And as for involving yourself further... well, you came to see her in the first place. Why don't you start there? "Of course. Please, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, do ]come in." Beyond herself with smugness at how well all this went, Hotaru leads you into her home, tails swaying all the while. Once you're seated at the low table, she plants her elbows right atop it and leans dangerously towards you. "Now... with that commotion done with, what can I do for you today?" ]
rows.translation: [hotaru.pregStage 2 |那么……现在该怎么做呢？ 萤轻轻叹了口气，平静下来，然后对你说道[pc.ra kitsune |鞠躬 |点头 ]在过去几个月里一直没有联系我，现在突然感到内疚了吗？我一直以来都为自己做得够好了[pc.ra kitsune | 我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]， ]并且我打算继续这样做。如果这与我的福祉有关，我已经做好了相应的安排，而且还有其他人在照顾我，所以如果你不愿意的话，其实不必再为此担心了。 “你不需要再为我做任何事，也不必再继续介入这件事了。 [pc.ra kitsune |工作太忙，无暇顾及其他事情。 |你最好别卷入我们编织的这些错综复杂的麻烦中。 ]……但如果你愿意尝试，我一定能让你觉得这些努力是值得的。当然，我也非常希望你能这么做。真的确实如此。那些老妇人的说法是真的：随着怀孕时间的增加，我的某些需求也会变得越来越强烈，而这些需求并不仅仅局限于身体方面。” 最后那句话的语气有点过于激动，听起来似乎不太理智，但这样的表达确实很适合萤，不是吗？至于是否应该进一步介入她的生活……嗯，你当初不就是来找她的吗？为什么不从这里开始呢？ “当然。请吧[pc.ra kitsune |阁下，请便。 ]进来吧。”萤满心得意地领着你走进她的家，她的尾巴一直在摇摆着——那些尾巴上挂着的东西也在一起晃动。虽然她本来就身材曲线优美，但怀孕后增加的体重也是她无法避免的。当你坐在矮桌旁时，她不得不稍微挪动一下身体，才能让自己圆润的腹部有地方坐下。“那么……现在环境已经准备好了，今天我能为你做些什么呢？ |那么……现在该怎么做呢？ 萤轻轻叹了口气，调整好自己的情绪，然后对你说道[pc.ra kitsune |鞠躬 |点头表示同意。 ]我们已经讨论过这个问题了， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下。 |不是吗？ ]既然这个想法最初是我提出的，而且你也这么热心地帮助我……那么就像我们之前约定的那样，接下来这个任务就由我来负责吧。你并不欠我什么，如果你不想继续参与的话，也不必再继续了……但如果你愿意帮忙的话，我一定会让你的付出得到回报的。当然，我也非常希望你能继续支持我。真的喜欢这样。” 最后那句话听起来有点语无伦次，似乎不太正常，但这个词确实很适合萤，不是吗？至于是否要进一步介入……嗯，你当初不就是来找她的吗？为什么不从这里开始呢？ “当然。请吧[pc.ra kitsune |阁下，请便。 ]进来吧。”萤满心得意地领着你走进她的家，尾巴一路摇摆着。当你坐在那张矮桌旁时，她把肘部搁在桌子上，然后危险地朝你倾斜过来。“现在……既然那些麻烦事都已经解决了，今天我能为你做些什么呢？ ]

rows.original: No sooner have you drawn near the sliding door of Hotaru's apartment that you hear the commotion from within — several words in the kitsune mother tongue, followed by hasty footsteps beelining for you. Within moments, the door slams open, revealing a red-faced Hotaru with a bundle in her arms. The seamstress [pc.ra kitsune |fumbles an attempt to bow before righting herself, remembering the kit she's cradling against her. "Oh, your Eminence. Has his divine lordship kept you on campaign so long that you return after all this time |, bracing herself against the doorframe to catch her breath before turning to you, kit slung in one arm. "Oh, [pc.name]. Finally you deign to show up, hmm ]?" It has been a while, but eventually you dredge up the memories of Hotaru's plea, your acceptance, and... well, the babe in her arms is the result. You did remember all that happened, right? You didn't forget and just happen to visit Hotaru at this very moment? But enough about you. Hotaru certainly knew you were coming, with how quick she was to greet you. Hotaru tilts her head. "There is that[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Our daughter is usually so calm, I'm able to tell something's amiss by when she deigns to stir. I suppose her sense for you is far keener than mine, and that's saying something given that she's never met you. "Of course, my sense of smell has gotten considerably sharper ever since... well. Even if Kaori didn't sense you coming, I would've." Her name's Kaori, is it? So, it took. "It roughly translates to 'fragrance of fire', and it should be obvious why. As for it taking, of course it did." Hotaru leans in dangerously close, her free hand reaching [pc.heightRange 70 |up ] for your shoulders, [pc.heightRange 70 |pulling herself close such that her nose's |her nose ] right up against to yours. "With all the things I did before and after to make sure it did, how could it not? Look at your daughter — [pc.ra kitsune |it's not done for a divine champion to doubt [pc.himHer]self that way, you know. Have more confidence. |it's obvious that I've spared no expense in making good use of your gift, isn't it? ]"
rows.translation: 你刚走近萤公寓的推拉门，便听见里面传来动静——先是几句狐族母语，随后急促的脚步直奔你而来。转眼间，门被猛地拉开；满脸通红的萤出现在门口，怀里还抱着一个襁褓。裁缝[pc.ra kitsune |笨拙地试图鞠躬，随即想起怀中正抱着幼崽，连忙重新站稳。 “哦，尊贵的阁下。神圣的主君让您出征了这么久，竟到现在才终于回来 |扶着门框稳住身体、喘匀气息，随后转向你，一条手臂抱着幼崽。 “哦，[pc.name]。你终于肯屈尊露面了，嗯 ]？” 确实已经过去很久了，不过你最终还是从记忆深处捞出了萤的请求、你的应允，以及……好吧，她怀中的婴儿就是结果。你确实记得发生过的一切，对吧？你没有把事情忘得一干二净，只是恰巧在此刻前来拜访萤吧？ 不过别再说你的事了。看她这么快就来迎接你，萤显然知道你要来。 萤歪过脑袋。“也有这个原因[pc.ra kitsune |，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女主人 ] ]。我们的女儿平常十分安静；每当她难得动起来，我便知道有事发生。我想她感知你的能力远比我敏锐；考虑到她从没见过你，这已经很说明问题了。 “当然，自从……那件事以后，我的嗅觉也敏锐了许多。就算香织没有感觉到你来了，我也会发现。” 原来她叫香织？这么说，成功怀上了。 “这个名字大致意为‘火焰的芬芳’，缘由应该很明显。至于有没有怀上，当然怀上了。”萤危险地凑近，空着的手[pc.heightRange 70 |向上 ]伸向你的肩膀，[pc.heightRange 70 |把自己拉近，令她的鼻尖 |让她的鼻尖 ]与你的鼻尖紧紧相抵。“为了确保成功，我在事前事后都做了那么多，怎么可能怀不上？看看你的女儿——[pc.ra kitsune |一位神选勇士可不该这样怀疑[pc.himHer]自己，知道吗？自信一点。 |我显然不惜代价地充分利用了你赠予的东西，不是吗？ ]”

rows.original:
You eye the black-furred fox kit swaddled against Hotaru's arm — and she eyes you right back with a completely straight face. Kaori doesn't laugh or cry, or even grace you with that wide-eyed stare that some infants have, but simply acknowledges your presence with a half-lidded gaze, as if this entire interaction were a social obligation she can't escape.
        
        [pc.ra kitsune
            |And amidst all that... the faint scent of foxfire, familiar cool heat, only with a faint sweetness to it as if some kind of incense were burning in the distance. There isn't any obvious source to it, or point where it's strongest; if it were to come from anywhere, it'd have to be her skin.
        ]
        
        You have the sinking feeling this child is just as gifted as her mother, albeit in a different way.
rows.translation:
你注视着那只被包在萤手臂上的黑毛狐妖幼崽——而她也同样用一脸严肃的表情注视着你。香织既没有笑，也没有哭，甚至没有像一些婴儿那样用那双大眼睛盯着你看，她只是用半闭的眼睛确认你的存在，仿佛这种互动是一种她无法逃避的社会责任。
        
        [pc.ra kitsune
            |而在这一切之中……弥漫着淡淡的狐火气息，那种熟悉的清凉感，只不过其中还带着一丝丝甜意，仿佛远处有人在焚烧某种香草。这种气味并没有明显的来源，也没有任何地方的气味最为浓烈；如果要说它究竟来自哪里的话，那一定就是她的皮肤。
        ]
        
        你有一种预感，这个孩子和她母亲一样有天赋，只不过表现的方式不同而已。

rows.original: [party.has kiyoko |A gentle touch on your shoulder — and it's not from Hotaru. While Hotaru holds your attention, [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife's |Kiyoko's ] sidled up against you and wrapped her tails [pc.ra kitsune |about yours |around your legs ], looking just as smug as Hotaru is. Hotaru seizes the chance to come in from the other side, and soon enough both vixens have you caught in their trap between their lush bodies, making you well aware of how much bearing your kits has changed both of them. "Well done, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]," she whispers into your ear. "Look at the girl, how readily she's embraced what she's become; that's another conquest for you, another addition to the colonies. Do you feel accomplished now?" What? "Ehehe. I tease, I tease." Before you know it, two sets of tails firmly ensnare you, followed by the insistent pressing of cool heat and soft bodies. "But I hope this feels as good for you as it does for me, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]." |Breathing heavily, Hotaru slinks up to you in the blink of an eye, happily sidling up against you and wrapping her tails [pc.ra kitsune |about yours |around your legs ]. The cool heat of foxfire's distinct under her skin, and the constant trembling of excitement down her nerves gives the impression she's mere inches from boiling over. Holding a kit, of course, does mellow her impulses somewhat, but the tight knot in Hotaru's lower belly isn't shy about announcing its intentions: now that it's found you and what you have to offer, it's determined to have it again. Not now, not so soon. But there's lots of time, [silly |especially after the game's over, ]and when seen from a different perspective mellowing out merely means being more focused about one's desires, doesn't it? But that's why you're here right now, aren't you? To live life on the edge? ] After taking several deep breaths, Hotaru shudders and pulls away from you with a moan; her bosom heaves raggedly, the fabric peaking the mounts growing damp. Slowly, the seamstress shakes her head, looks between herself, her daughter, and you, then sighs wistfully. Kaori looks extremely unimpressed by her mother's antics, inasmuch as she acknowledges them at all. "My three sizes filling out is the most obvious difference these days... but what's on the inside is more important, isn't it?" [party.has kiyoko |"It's always gratifying to see another girl awaken to the joys of motherhood, isn't it, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]?" Kiyoko whispers, nuzzling your shoulder. "Especially when you had a hand in the matter. Pregnancy is fine, but what's more important is that which comes after. The girl has a reputation, to be sure, but there's the will to do right by the kit, which I believe will smooth things out despite her eccentricities. "I'm so proud of you — your ability does reflect well on me, after all. Perhaps you should've seen to the girl earlier, have had more of a chance to guide her in the right direction, but she seems to have done just fine on her own. There are others here to care for her, after all, and you can't be everywhere at once. That being said... spend what time you do have carefully, Beloved. Before you know it, the years will have passed." ]
rows.translation: [party.has kiyoko |有人轻轻拍了拍你的肩膀——不过这个人并不是萤。虽然萤正吸引着你的全部注意力， [kiyoko.married |你那狐狸精老婆的 |清子的 ]却靠了过来，把尾巴缠上你的[pc.ra kitsune |尾巴 |腿 ]，那副得意洋洋的样子和萤没什么两样。萤抓住机会从另一边凑了过来，没过多久，两个狐妖就把你夹在她们诱人的身躯之间，让你清楚地意识到，孕育你的孩子对她们两个的改变有多大。 “干得不错， [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |我的丈夫 |亲爱的 ] |亲爱的 ]，”她凑到你耳边低声说道，“看看那个女孩，她如此坦然地接受了自己现在的身份；这对你来说又是一次征服，又给你的聚居地添了一员。现在，你觉得自己有所成就了吧？ 什么？ 嘿嘿，我只是在开玩笑而已。”还没等你反应过来，两束尾巴就已经牢牢缠住了你，随后，清凉的热度与柔软的身体不断挤压着你。“不过，我希望这对你来说，和对我一样愉快吧[kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |我的丈夫 |亲爱的 ] |亲爱的 ]。” |呼哧呼哧地喘着气，萤转眼间就溜到了你身边，开心地依偎在你身旁，把尾巴缠上你的[pc.ra kitsune |尾巴 |腿 ]。狐火那独特的清凉热度在她皮肤下流转，那种兴奋带来的颤抖不断沿着她的神经窜动，让她仿佛随时都可能“沸腾”起来。 当然，怀里抱着幼崽确实让她的冲动稍微缓和了一些，但萤小腹里那团紧绷的结毫不掩饰它的意图：既然已经找到了你以及你能提供的东西，它就决心再次得到它们。不是现在，还不是马上，但时间还有很多， [silly |尤其是在这场游戏结束之后， ]而从另一个角度来看，所谓“变得成熟”，其实只是对自己的欲望更加专注而已，不是吗？ 但正因为如此，你才现在在这里，对吧？就是为了体验那种充满刺激的生活吧？ ] 深吸了几口气后，萤颤抖着从你身边拉开距离，发出一声呻吟；她的胸脯剧烈地起伏着，衣料在凸起的部位已经变得潮湿了。慢慢地，这位裁缝摇了摇头，目光在女儿和自己与你之间来回扫视，然后无奈地叹了口气。薰对母亲的这些举动显然并不感兴趣，甚至几乎没有给予任何反应。 “这些天来，我的三围都长开了，这是最明显的变化……但内在的东西才更重要，不是吗？” [party.has kiyoko |“看到另一个女孩意识到成为母亲的快乐，总是让人感到欣慰的，不是吗？” [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |我的丈夫 |亲爱的 ] |亲爱的 ]？”清子轻声说道，一边用脸颊蹭着你的肩膀。“尤其是当你也参与了这件事之后。怀孕本身没什么问题，但更重要的是之后的事。那个女孩确实有些名声，但她也有好好对待这个孩子的意愿，我相信尽管她有些古怪，这些都会把事情理顺。 “我真为你感到骄傲——毕竟，你的能力也为我增添了光彩。或许你当初应该早点去照看那个女孩，给她更多引导她走向正路的机会，但看起来她自己也能把事情处理好。毕竟，这里还有其他人会照顾她，你不可能同时兼顾所有地方。话虽如此……亲爱的，还是要珍惜你拥有的每一分时间。否则，不知不觉间，岁月就会匆匆流逝。” ]
rows.raw: " [party.has kiyoko |A gentle touch on your shoulder — and it's not from Hotaru. While Hotaru holds your attention, [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife's |Kiyoko's ] sidled up against you and wrapped her tails [pc.ra kitsune |about yours |around your legs ], looking just as smug as Hotaru is. Hotaru seizes the chance to come in from the other side, and soon enough both vixens have you caught in their trap between their lush bodies, making you well aware of how much bearing your kits has changed both of them. "Well done, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]," she whispers into your ear. "Look at the girl, how readily she's embraced what she's become; that's another conquest for you, another addition to the colonies. Do you feel accomplished now?" What? "Ehehe. I tease, I tease." Before you know it, two sets of tails firmly ensnare you, followed by the insistent pressing of cool heat and soft bodies. "But I hope this feels as good for you as it does for me, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]." |Breathing heavily, Hotaru slinks up to you in the blink of an eye, happily sidling up against you and wrapping her tails [pc.ra kitsune |about yours |around your legs ]. The cool heat of foxfire's distinct under her skin, and the constant trembling of excitement down her nerves gives the impression she's mere inches from boiling over. Holding a kit, of course, does mellow her impulses somewhat, but the tight knot in Hotaru's lower belly isn't shy about announcing its intentions: now that it's found you and what you have to offer, it's determined to have it again. Not now, not so soon. But there's lots of time, [silly |especially after the game's over, ]and when seen from a different perspective mellowing out merely means being more focused about one's desires, doesn't it? But that's why you're here right now, aren't you? To live life on the edge? ] After taking several deep breaths, Hotaru shudders and pulls away from you with a moan; her bosom heaves raggedly, the fabric peaking the mounts growing damp. Slowly, the seamstress shakes her head, looks between herself, her daughter, and you, then sighs wistfully. Kaori looks extremely unimpressed by her mother's antics, inasmuch as she acknowledges them at all. "My three sizes filling out is the most obvious difference these days... but what's on the inside is more important, isn't it?" [party.has kiyoko |"It's always gratifying to see another girl awaken to the joys of motherhood, isn't it, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]?" Kiyoko whispers, nuzzling your shoulder. "Especially when you had a hand in the matter. Pregnancy is fine, but what's more important is that which comes after. The girl has a reputation, to be sure, but there's the will to do right by the kit, which I believe will smooth things out despite her eccentricities. "I'm so proud of you — your ability does reflect well on me, after all. Perhaps you should've seen to the girl earlier, have had more of a chance to guide her in the right direction, but she seems to have done just fine on her own. There are others here to care for her, after all, and you can't be everywhere at once. That being said... spend what time you do have carefully, Beloved. Before you know it, the years will have passed." ] "

rows.original: So... what happens now? And what about her parents? Sighing softly, Hotaru composes herself and gives you a small [pc.ra kitsune |bow |nod ]. "Suddenly feeling guilty after having missed the chance to see me with a big belly? [silly |Well, you'll just have to wait until the game's done and over with. ]I've done well enough for myself,[pc.ra kitsune | my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ] and intend to continue doing so. As for my parents, they haven't made it back all the way, but last I heard they were almost there, so I'd expect them soon. "If you're concerned for my welfare, I wouldn't have started this if I didn't have a plan to see it through, you know. That, and there are others looking out for me, so you don't have to concern yourself with that if you don't want to. Despite having another soul to feed, I'm actually feeling hungry less often than before. No idea why, but it suits a homebody like me just fine. "We had an agreement. You don't owe me anything else, nor do you have to involve yourself further if [pc.ra kitsune |your duties keep you away |you'd rather not get involved in the tangled webs we weave ]... but if you do, I can make it worth your time. With the need out of the way, you know that if we're together, it'll be because of desire. And isn't that far more gratifying?" [pc.ra kitsune |Oh, no. While you still have some things to learn about the tangled webs foxes weave, you're more than aware this is a I-want-it-but-I'm-not-going-to-say-I-want-it thing |She doesn't have to play coy with you — not having to play at social niceties is one of the privileges not being a fox affords you. If she wants it, she's more than welcome to say so ]. And as it just so happens, you've come to see her, so you can get started this very moment. "That would make both Kaori and me very happy[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] | indeed ]. Please, come in." Beyond herself with smugness at how well all this went, Hotaru leads you into her home, tails swaying all the while — and everything attached to said tails, too. Part of it is the weight she's obviously put on between then and now, but she's also a lot more confident than you remember her being as she seats the both of you at the low table and hugs Kaori to herself. "Shall we have a little family time, then?"
rows.translation: 那么……现在会发生什么呢？她的父母又该怎么办呢？ 萤轻轻叹了口气，平静下来后，对你说道[pc.ra kitsune |鞠躬 |点头表示同意。 ]竟然因为在错过与我一起看看我大肚子的机会后，突然感到内疚起来？ [silly |嗯，你只能等到游戏结束之后再知道了。 ]我已经为自己取得了足够的成就。[pc.ra kitsune | 我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]， ]并且我也有继续这样做的打算。至于我的父母，他们还没有完全回来，但据我最后一次得到的消息，他们已经快到家了，所以应该很快就会回来。 “如果你真的担心我的安危，那么如果我没有完成这个计划的打算，我是不会开始这么做的，你明白我的意思吧。而且，还有其他人也在照顾我，所以如果你不想担心的话，其实也没必要担心。虽然现在还要养活另一个人，但实际上，我反而觉得有点饿较少现在这种情况比以前更常见了。虽然不知道为什么，但这种生活方式对我来说反而很合适，毕竟我本来就是一个喜欢待在家里的人。 “我们之前有过约定。你不再欠我什么了，也不必再继续介入这件事了。 [pc.ra kitsune |工作太忙，无暇顾及其他事情。 |你最好别卷入我们编织的这些错综复杂的麻烦中。 ]…但如果你愿意这样做，我可以让你的时间得到充分的回报。既然需求已经得到满足，你知道，如果我们在一起，那一定是出于彼此的意愿。这样不是会让人感到更加满足吗？ [pc.ra kitsune |哦，不。虽然你还有很多关于狐狸们编织的错综复杂的网状关系需要去了解，但你心里很清楚，这其实就是那种“我想要，但又不敢说出来”的情况。 |她没有必要对你故作矜持——不必拘泥于社交礼仪，正是身为“非狐狸”所能享受的特权之一。如果她真的想要什么，她完全可以直接说出来。 ]正好你今天来见了她，所以你可以马上开始行动了。 “这样的话，我和香织都会非常开心的。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] | 确实如此。 ]请进来吧。”萤满心得意地领你走进她的家，她的尾巴一直在摇动——那些连接在尾巴上的东西也在一起晃动。其中一部分原因显然是因为这段时间她体重增加了，但你也注意到，她现在比你记忆中的要自信得多。当她把你们俩请到矮桌旁，然后将香织搂在怀里时，她说：“那我们就来点家庭时光吧？

rows.original:
As you approach Hotaru's corner of the den's living quarters, you stop at the door and announce your presence by [pc.ra kitsune
        |clapping
        |gently rapping on the wood
    ]. When no response is forthcoming, you're just about to conclude that Hotaru's not in at the moment when a breathless voice sounds from the interior:
    
    "Come in!"
    
    Entering, you find Hotaru attending to several trays of silkworms, a basket full of mulberry leaves resting on her bump — one notes that while pressed up against something like she is now, her heavy clothes aren't able to hide her pregnancy any longer. How the months fly...
    
    It looks like she's busy right now, though. Did you come at a bad time?
    
    "Oh no, [pc.ra kitsune
        |your Eminence
        |not at all
    ]. While I'm a bit overworked right now, your arrival is most welcome. As you can see —" she says through gritted teeth — "I'm rather on edge, and the silkworms do need to be cared for, temperamental little gluttons that they are. Mai promised me yesterday she'd come up with something for my nerves that I can take while with child — [pc.ra kitsune
        |I know I'm overstepping myself by asking a favor of you, but on the other hand I'm pretty sure helping the helpless is part of a divine champion's job."
        |you came all the way here to dally with me, so surely you have the time to run a small errand lest I, um, please."
    ]
    
    Hotaru's tails swish and twitch, and you note she's grabbing the leaves so hard they're leaving stains on her palms as she scrunches them into little balls. Hotaru's moods have been fickle for as long as you've known her, but it's clear the black-furred vixen is struggling under the weight of this burden.
    
    Mai, she said?
    
    "Thank the gods. I was at my wits' end, but —" Hotaru swallows hard. "Anyway. It's [dayNight
        |still daylight, so she should be still at home
        |night now, so she should be at the shrine
    ]. Just let me know if she's made good on her promise."
    
    And if Mai doesn't have this — whatever it is of Hotaru's she's supposed to have?
    
    "Then don't tell me at all[pc.ra kitsune
        |, your Eminence, 
    ]and pretend that none of this ever happened; I don't think my heart could take it. I've lived with frayed nerves all my life, I know how to deal with my gift, but disappointment would —" A nervous laugh, and something shifts in Hotaru's gaze. "Aren't I perfectly suited for motherhood? Feeding fat little ever-hungry squirming things at all hours is second nature to me."
    
    Hotaru's always been the melodramatic sort, but the terrible attempt at levity makes plain the stress she's under. All right, you'll go and find Mai for her, then.
rows.translation:
当你走近巢穴生活区中萤所在的区域时，你会在门口停下脚步，然后宣布自己的到来。 [pc.ra kitsune
        |鼓掌
        |轻轻敲击木头
    ]就在你准备认为萤此刻不在家时，里面突然传来一个急促的声音：
    
    “进来吧！”
    
    走进房间，你看到萤正在照料几盘蚕，她的肚子上还放着一个装满桑叶的篮子。仔细观察就会发现，由于她现在身体被压在某些东西上，那些厚重的衣服已经无法掩盖她怀孕的事实了。时间过得真快啊……
    
    不过现在她看起来很忙，你来得是不是不太巧呢？
    
    “哦，不[pc.ra kitsune
        |阁下
        |一点也不
    ]虽然我现在确实有点忙得不可开交，但你的到来真是太及时了。如你所见——”她咬紧牙关说道，“我现在整个人都处于紧张状态中，而这些蚕宝宝也确实需要有人照顾，那些脾气古怪的小贪吃鬼……昨天舞答应我，会想办法让我在怀孕期间也能服用一些有助于缓解紧张情绪的药物。 [pc.ra kitsune
        |我知道向您请求这个帮助有点过分了，但另一方面，我也很确信帮助那些无助的人正是一位神圣英雄的职责所在。
        |你大老远跑到这里来就是为了和我闲逛，那么你肯定有时间去办点小事吧，这样我就不会，嗯，麻烦你了。
    ]
    
    萤的尾巴轻轻摆动着，你注意到她抓着那些叶子的手掌上已经留下了痕迹，因为她把叶子紧紧地捏成了小团。自从你认识她以来，萤的情绪就一直很不稳定，但很明显，这只黑毛狐妖正在为这个沉重的负担而苦恼。
    
    “是叫舞吗？”
    
    “谢天谢地，我真的已经束手无策了，但是……”萤艰难地咽了口唾沫，“总之，现在总算有办法了。 [dayNight
        |现在还是白天，所以她应该还在家里。
        |现在是晚上，所以她应该已经在神社里了。
    ]只要她履行了自己的承诺，就告诉我吧。”
    
    那么，如果舞没有得到这个——无论那是萤应该给她的什么东西——该怎么办呢？
    
    “那就根本别告诉我。[pc.ra kitsune
        |阁下， 
    ]然后假装这一切从未发生过；我想我的心脏根本承受不了。我一生都生活在神经紧绷的状态中，我知道该如何应对自己的这种“天赋”，但失望……” 萤紧张地笑了笑，她的目光也发生了变化。我难道不是最适合当母亲的吗？随时给那些胖乎乎、永远饿个不停、还总在扭动的小东西喂食，对我来说简直就是天性。”
    
    萤一直都是那种喜欢夸大其词的人，但这次她试图用幽默的方式来缓解压力，反而暴露了她所承受的巨大压力。好吧，那你去把舞找出来吧。

rows.original: It doesn't take long to find the lovelier of the Kurokawa sisters: she's exactly where Hotaru said she'd be. [dayNight |One wonders if it'd be a breach of etiquette, given that you've always bothered Miko and Mai when they were ostensibly on the job, but you're not alone, either. When you cross the tree's upper branches to the chambers Mai shares with her sister |By the time you descend from branches to roots and made your way through the sacred gardens to the shrine ], someone else's there as well: Kohaku's out and about making deliveries, lugging about a crate of bitter-smelling herbs almost as large as she is and chatting animatedly with Mai[kohaku.anyKids |, while her tiny golden daughter's slung on her back in a wrapped bundle ]. As you approach, the two kitsune stop and turn [pc.ra kitsune |to give you a bow. "Yer Eminence |to give you a nod. "Why, if'n it ain't [pc.name] ]. [dayNight |Lil' ol' me would be gettin' some shut-eye at 'bout this time, but Kohaku don't wait for no one |Slow evening we're havin', jus' how I like it ]." "Eeeh? Good to see you around, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]! Don't let me get in your way — I'm just getting these Old Country herbs over to Mai, and then I'll leave you to your business, nojya!" Actually, it's you who should be getting out of their hair — you quickly explain the situation, and the cheerful atmosphere quickly dissipates as you detail Hotaru's distress. Whatever it is she was seeking from Mai, is it ready? That turns the mood from silent to sullen as Mai and Kohaku steal glances at the overflowing crate of herbs. At last, the former sighs and shakes her head. "[pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer pardon, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |Sorry, [pc.name] ] — I know what ya mean, but I were waitin' for jus' these here reagents to begin th' compoundin'. Were waitin' f'r them, 'cause ya can't jus' give a vixen with child any old medicine. Can Hotaru wait some?" Hotaru said she'd be fine even if she it weren't ready, but given her obvious levels of distress you think she was just doing the kitsune thing of refusing to complain — or at least too egregiously, in Hotaru's case. Mai purses her lips and draws a sharp breath, ears flattening. "Now ain't that a problem. [dayNight |I coulda stay up an' get to compoundin' right now, but it'd take hours |Even if'n I were to drop everythin' here at th' shrine — an' I ain't — to get back home an' start compoundin', it'd take hours before it were ready ]. Unfortunate, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]but there ain't nothin' that can be done 'bout it." "Actually, there is something that can be done about it, nojya."
rows.translation: 没过多久，你就找到了黑川姐妹中更可爱的那位：她果然正在萤所说的地方。[dayNight |考虑到你每次打扰米可和舞时，她们表面上都正在工作，或许有人会怀疑这是否有违礼数；不过这次不只你一个人。当你沿着树木高处的枝干前往舞与姐姐共用的房间时 |等你从枝头下到树根，穿过神圣庭园来到神社时 ]，那里还有别人：琥珀外出送货，正费力搬运一个几乎与她一般大的箱子，里面装满气味苦涩的草药；她还兴高采烈地与舞聊着天[kohaku.anyKids |，襁褓包裹着她娇小的金毛女儿，背在她身后 ]。你走近时，两名狐妖停止交谈，转过身[pc.ra kitsune |向你鞠躬。 “尊贵的阁下 |向你点头致意。 “哎哟，这不是[pc.name]嘛 ]。[dayNight |俺这会儿本该睡美容觉了，可琥珀从不等人 |今晚可真清闲，俺就喜欢这样 ]。” “咦？很高兴在这里见到你，[pc.ra kitsune |尊贵的阁下 |[pc.name] ]！别让咱妨碍了你——咱只是把这些古国草药送给舞，之后就不打扰你办事了，诺雅！” 其实，该避免打扰她们的人是你——你迅速解释了情况；听你详述萤所受的折磨，欢快的气氛很快消散。无论萤想从舞这里得到什么，准备好了吗？ 这让气氛由沉默转为愁闷；舞和琥珀偷偷看向装得满满当当的草药箱。最终，前者叹了口气，摇摇头。 “[pc.ra kitsune |恕俺冒犯，尊贵的[pc.mf |领主 |女主人 ]阁下 |抱歉，[pc.name] ]——俺明白你的意思，可俺就等着这些试剂送来，才能开始调配。得等它们，是因为你不能随便拿什么药都喂给怀孕的雌狐。萤能再等一会儿吗？” 萤说就算药没准备好，她也不会有事；可看她那明显痛苦的程度，你觉得她只是在依照狐妖的习惯，拒绝开口抱怨——至少以萤而言，是拒绝抱怨得太过头了。 舞抿紧双唇，猛吸一口气，耳朵向后贴平。“这可麻烦了。[dayNight |俺可以熬夜，现在就开始调配，可那得花上好几个小时 |即便俺丢下神社里的一切——当然俺不会——赶回家开始调配，也得好几个小时才能完成 ]。很遗憾，[pc.ra kitsune |尊贵的阁下， ]这件事无能为力。” “其实，有办法解决，诺雅。”
rows.raw: " It doesn't take long to find the lovelier of the Kurokawa sisters: she's exactly where Hotaru said she'd be. [dayNight |One wonders if it'd be a breach of etiquette, given that you've always bothered Miko and Mai when they were ostensibly on the job, but you're not alone, either. When you cross the tree's upper branches to the chambers Mai shares with her sister |By the time you descend from branches to roots and made your way through the sacred gardens to the shrine ], someone else's there as well: Kohaku's out and about making deliveries, lugging about a crate of bitter-smelling herbs almost as large as she is and chatting animatedly with Mai[kohaku.anyKids |, while her tiny golden daughter's slung on her back in a wrapped bundle ]. As you approach, the two kitsune stop and turn [pc.ra kitsune |to give you a bow. "Yer Eminence |to give you a nod. "Why, if'n it ain't [pc.name] ]. [dayNight |Lil' ol' me would be gettin' some shut-eye at 'bout this time, but Kohaku don't wait for no one |Slow evening we're havin', jus' how I like it ]." "Eeeh? Good to see you around, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]! Don't let me get in your way — I'm just getting these Old Country herbs over to Mai, and then I'll leave you to your business, nojya!" Actually, it's you who should be getting out of their hair — you quickly explain the situation, and the cheerful atmosphere quickly dissipates as you detail Hotaru's distress. At last, the former sighs and shakes her head. "[pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer pardon, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |Sorry, [pc.name] ] — I know what ya mean, but I were waitin' for jus' these here reagents to begin th' compoundin'. Were waitin' f'r them, 'cause ya can't jus' give a vixen with child any old medicine. Can Hotaru wait some?" Hotaru said she'd be fine even if she it weren't ready, but given her obvious levels of distress you think she was just doing the kitsune thing of refusing to complain — or at least too egregiously, in Hotaru's case. Mai purses her lips and draws a sharp breath, ears flattening. "Now ain't that a problem. [dayNight |I coulda stay up an' get to compoundin' right now, but it'd take hours |Even if'n I were to drop everythin' here at th' shrine — an' I ain't — to get back home an' start compoundin', it'd take hours before it were ready ]. Unfortunate, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]but there ain't nothin' that can be done 'bout it." "Actually, there is something that can be done about it, nojya." "

rows.original: As the two of you turn your gazes down on Kohaku, the little golden kitsune bends over comically, reaching into the crate of herbs. After several moments' rummaging, she pulls out a small flask of thick liquid, familiar to you at this point. Mai winces and wrings her fingers. "I know ya mean well, but ya can't mean to be givin' away sap from a divine tree!" It's wyldsap, isn't it? You know its reputation as a panacea, but would it actually help Hotaru, whose issue by and large isn't physical? "[pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer pardon, but that ain't exactly right, yer Eminence |It would ]. Kohaku ain't wrong: body an' mind weigh on each other an' all. That there's a two-way street, an' it should be obvious, ain't no one's concentratin' while in pain. "Problem is... ya can't jus' be givin' out things like that." "But I can!" A big, eager smile works its way onto little Kohaku's face. "It's entirely within my authority as storehouse manager to apportion it to my dear friend Hotaru, nojya." "That ain't wrong, but —" "If your granny has any problems with it, Mai, she knows where I live. I think it's justified, and will take full responsibility — do you remember how we were made to clean up all those scorch marks years ago? The way [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |[pc.name] ] puts it, we really don't want another incident after more than a decade of Hotaru being fine." "But it ain't —" "I know it's meant for your stocks, but you don't have any other patients in dire need right now, nojya." The back and forth between the two is all very amusing, but can they just come to a decision? Hotaru was pretty strained when you left her, and if it'll take Mai some time to put together something for the seamstress' nerves, then something to help in the interim would be welcome. "See? That's sense [pc.ra kitsune |our champion's |[pc.name]'s ] speaking." Kohaku's smile widens as she's caught up in the heat of her brilliant idea. "[kohaku.wellFed |Hotaru was so kind to me while I was pregnant myself, always making sure I had more than enough to eat, and having lots of food whenever I wanted it did help me through those months, nojya. All I want to do is pay back the favor, and if it means potentially getting in trouble with your granny for overstepping my authority then I'm willing to stick my neck out for taking some initiative |[kohaku.anyKids |Hotaru was so kind to me while I was pregnant myself, always bringing me food I couldn't finish and had to pass on to others. I owe it to her as her friend to stick my neck out for her, even if it means possibly getting in trouble with your granny for overstepping my authority, nojya |Hotaru's my friend, and we all know full well what happens when she really goes crazy, right? Sure, sometimes it's in a good way, but I don't want to see how much worse it can get when she's got a kit in her belly making her gift act up all the more, nojya. If that means getting in trouble with your granny, then so be it ] ]." [pc.isCunning |[kohaku.anyKids |Slung in a bundle across her back, Kohaku's tiny golden kit picks up on her mother's mood and starts giggling, which is a little odd considering the topic at hand. More telling is the haste with which Kohaku brings her daughter in her arms and tries to hush the infant's mirth. Even a mere few months out of her mother's belly, the little golden gremlin has established a reputation about the den as a mischief magnet — not necessarily causing it herself, but always being around when the pot boils over |Maybe it's just you having dealt with your fair share of merchants in the Marches, if not before, but you sense that Kohaku's trying to make a sale here. It's subtle, but her demeanor's shifted from that of casual conversation, her words coming out that much more swiftly and smoothly, akin to soothing platitudes ]. You don't have any actual evidence, it's more of a gut feeling, but it's clear that there's more to Kohaku's enthusiasm for this idea than simple concern for a friend. ] "I ain't saying yer wrong, Kohaku, but —" "The den matron isn't just your granny, Mai. She raised both Hotaru and I, at least when it comes to this generation. Once more, I'll take responsibility if she complains about me misappropriating goods, nojya. If you're okay with it, and I am too, what's the problem?" It's clear that Mai still doesn't like the idea — and understandably so, given how valuable wyldsap is — but it doesn't take much of Kohaku's chipper enthusiasm to get her to relent. "Fine, if'n it'll stop her from doin' that again. When granny done asks where the emergency medication went — well, I guess this here's an emergency if'n there were ever one.[dayNight | Gods, it's too early in th' mornin' f'r this kinda nonsense. ]" "Thanks, nojya!" Bubbling over with concern at this point, Kohaku [kohaku.anyKids |holds her daughter close with one hand and passes you the flask of wyldsap with the other |hands you the flask of wyldsap ] with a sheepish grin. "Sorry to keep you waiting this long, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. It's not perfect, but this should keep Hotaru from winding herself too tight until Mai can compound some proper medicine for her nerves. It's all my fault, really — the delivery was stuck on the other side of the torii and took half the day to be cleared, nojya. Good thing she has you to mind her in her time of need." Looks like everything turned out well in the end, though. It's nice of Kohaku to stick her neck out for Hotaru like that. "Well, it's only natural. Our parents are friends, and we've known each other since we were little, nojya. Oh, oh! If Hotaru wants more sap later... well, I can't guarantee that I can get more that isn't already earmarked for someone else. But I'm sure that [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |someone as well-traveled as you ] runs into rare finds all the time, right?" You'd ask why Kohaku would suddenly bring that up, but she's already turned back to Mai [pc.ra kitsune |in a most uncharacteristically disrespectful manner for someone like you, ]and is fussing over the rest of the delivery; Mai just seems to want to extract herself out of this awkward situation with the least of fuss. Everything about this has been a little sudden and strange, one has to admit. That being said, while it isn't exactly what Hotaru asked for, you now have something that ought to help with what ails her; you can return and hand over the wyldsap[pc.isCunning |, or not if you think there's more to this than meets the eye ].
rows.translation: 当你们两人将目光转向小金狐科哈库时，只见它滑稽地弯下腰，伸手去翻那个装满草药的箱子。经过一番翻找，它终于拿出一小瓶浓稠的液体——这时，你们应该已经认出这种液体是什么了。 舞皱了皱眉头，绞着手指说道：“我知道你是好意，但你可不能随便就赠送来自神树的树液啊！” 那应该是“野生树液”吧？你也知道它有着包治百病的名声，但萤的问题主要并不在于身体方面，这种树液真的能帮到她吗？ "[pc.ra kitsune |恕我直言，阁下，这么说并不完全准确。 |那样做的话…… ]琥珀说得没错：身体和心灵确实是相互影响的。这种影响是双向的，这一点应该很明显吧——当人们感到疼痛时，根本不可能集中注意力。 “问题在于……你不能随便就说出这种话来。” “但是我可以！”小红脸上露出了兴奋而灿烂的笑容。“作为仓库管理员，把这些东西分给我的好朋友萤火虫，完全是在我的职权范围内。” “这话没错，但是——” “如果你奶奶有什么意见，舞，她知道我住在哪里。我觉得这样做是合理的，也应该得到认可。完整责任——你还记得多年前我们是如何被要求清理那些烧焦痕迹的吗？就是通过那种方式[pc.ra kitsune |神圣冠军 |[pc.name] ]说实在的，经过十多年萤一直都很顺利，我们真的不希望再发生任何意外了。” “但是事情并不是这样的——” “我知道这样做是为了你们的股价，但你们其实并没有因此获得任何好处。其他现在有很多人正处于极其危急的状态，Nojya。” 他们之间的来回争论确实很有趣，但他们能不能尽快做出决定呢？当你离开萤时，她看起来非常焦虑；如果舞需要一些时间来为那位裁缝准备些什么，那么在此期间能有一些帮助的话，肯定会很有用。 “看吧？这才是理智的做法。 [pc.ra kitsune |我们英雄的 |[pc.name]的 ]说起来……”小白的笑容愈发灿烂，她完全被自己这个绝妙的主意所吸引住了。[kohaku.wellFed |在我怀孕期间，萤对我非常关照，总是确保我有足够的食物吃，而且只要我想吃什么，她就会立刻准备给我。这些帮助确实让我度过了那段艰难的时光，nojya。我现在唯一想做的就是报答她这份恩情。即使这意味着可能会因为越权而惹上你奶奶的麻烦，我也愿意挺身而出，去做这些事情 |[kohaku.anyKids |在我自己怀孕的时候，萤对我非常友善，总是给我带来那些我吃不完、只好分给别人的食物。作为她的朋友，我欠她一个人情债——即使这意味着可能会因为越权而惹上你奶奶的麻烦，我也愿意为她挺身而出，nojya。 |萤是我的朋友，我们所有人都很清楚，当她……会发生什么。真的会变得疯狂吧？当然，有时候这种疯狂也会带来好的结果，但我真不敢想象，当她肚子里有个小家伙在捣乱时，情况会变得多糟糕——那小家伙只会让她的“礼物”行为变得更加过分，真是让人头疼。如果因此会惹上你奶奶的麻烦，那也只能这样了。 ] ]。" [pc.isCunning |[kohaku.anyKids |科哈克把小小的金色婴儿包挂在背上，当她感受到母亲的情绪时，婴儿立刻开始咯咯笑起来，考虑到当时讨论的主题，这一现象显得有些奇怪。更值得注意的是，科哈克立刻把女儿抱在怀里，试图让婴儿停止笑声。 这个小小的金色小精灵，才出生短短几个月，就已经在大家心目中留下了这样一个名声：这个窝点简直就是调皮的聚集地——虽然不一定是它自己惹的麻烦，但每当事情变得一团糟的时候，它总是在现场。 |也许只是因为你之前在边境地区与太多商人打过交道，才会产生这种感觉，但你确实觉得琥珀这次是在试图推销什么。这种意图很微妙，她的态度已经从随意的交谈状态转变了过来，说话的速度也快了许多，语气也更加流畅自然，仿佛在说一些安抚人的客套话罢了。 ]你并没有任何实质性的证据，这只是一种直觉，但很明显，琥珀对这个想法表现出的热情并不仅仅是因为关心一个朋友而已。 ] 我并不是说你错了，琥珀，但是——” “那个巢穴的女头目可不只是你的奶奶，舞。至少对于这一代人来说，她把萤和我都抚养大了。如果她因为我认为我擅自使用了某些物品而抱怨，我愿意再次承担责任，nojya。如果你没意见，我也同意，那还有什么问题呢？” 显然，舞仍然不喜欢这个主意——考虑到野性之汁的价值，这也完全可以理解——但科哈克的热情足以让她改变主意。好吧，只要这样能阻止她继续做下去就行。那个再说一次。当奶奶问起那些急救药物去哪儿了的时候——嗯，我想，如果真有什么紧急情况发生的话，这应该就算得上是紧急情况了吧。[dayNight | 天啊，大清早的，搞这种无聊的事情未免太早了吧。 ]谢谢你，诺雅！”此时，小花已经充满了担忧之情。 [kohaku.anyKids |她一只手紧紧抱着女儿，另一只手将那瓶野生植物的汁液递给了你。 |将那瓶野性之液递到你手中 ]带着一丝尴尬的微笑说道：“实在抱歉让你们等了这么久[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]虽然这个方法并不完美，但至少可以防止萤过于紧张，直到舞能够为她配制出有效的镇静药物。其实这一切都是我的错——运输过程中出了问题，导致药物没能及时送到她手中。鸟居清理这些东西竟然花了好半天的时间，真麻烦。幸好在她需要的时候有你在照顾她。” 不过，看起来最终一切还是顺利解决了。科哈库能够为萤这样挺身而出，真是太好了。 “嗯，这也是理所当然的。我们的父母是朋友，我们从小就认识了，对吧？哦，对了！如果萤以后还需要更多的那种东西……嗯，我不敢保证还能再弄到一些没有被别人预定的资源。但我相信[pc.ra kitsune |神圣冠军 |像你这样见多识广的人 ]总是能遇到一些稀有的发现，对吧？” 你可能会好奇为什么琥珀会突然提到这个话题，但她已经转过身去，继续和舞聊天了。 [pc.ra kitsune |以你这样的一个人来说，这种行为实在显得极其不尊重人。 ]而其他人都在为剩下的交付事宜忙得不可开交；舞似乎只是想尽快摆脱这种尴尬的局面。 不得不承认，这一切发生得都太突然、太奇怪了。不过，虽然这并不完全符合萤的期望，但你现在手头上确实有东西可以帮助她解决她所面临的问题；你可以把那种“野性汁液”交还给她。[pc.isCunning |或者，如果你认为这件事背后还有不为人知的原因的话…… ]。
