rows.original: But at last, all the fuss is dying down: mother and newborn are doing as well as can be expected under their circumstances, and [party.has kiyoko |both Kiyoko and Mai are |Mai's ] busy with cleaning up the worst of the mess, Hotaru herself included. The seamstress having scorched half her home in the bargain isn't lost on any of you, but you can't [pc.isDK |babysit Hotaru's neuroses all day |fight all of Hotaru's battles for her ]. [party.has kiyoko |"Well, that was exciting, wasn't it?" You turn to find [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] slinking up to you, a triumphant smile on her lips. Cozying up to you, she wraps several of her tails about your legs and pulls you close before speaking in a theatrically conspiratorial whisper. "It's always gratifying to see another girl awaken to the joys of motherhood, isn't it, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]? Judging by how the light in her eyes has changed, it's only a matter of time before she's hankering for another — ideally from you[pc.ra kitsune |, especially if you deign to take her as an official concubine ], but someone else will do in a pinch." Of course Kiyoko would be thinking of such things immediately after Hotaru's popped, wouldn't she? "How should I put it, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]? It's part and parcel of establishing a power base[kiyoko.numKits 16 32 |, and I'm leading by example, aren't I? |, and I can say that mine is extremely secure, thanks to you ]. The girl's talents can be troublesome, but they have their uses, and the colonies exist to turn perceived weaknesses into strengths, if nothing else. I'm so proud of you — your ability does reflect well on me, after all. As to what happens from here... well, that's between the two of you, although I have some guesses from having studied how these things run their course, and I'll always be there to push you swiftly forward should you need assistance. "With that in mind, spend what time you do have carefully, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ], and do mind who you favor. Before you know it, the years will have passed." ] Turning back to Hotaru, you ask if she's feeling better. She's certainly reverting to her old talkative self with astounding speed, if nothing else. "Strangely enough, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]yes." A dreamy smile. "It can't have been more than an hour since the birth, but I've never been this at peace, not as far back as I can remember. It's as if that part of me departed alongside the fire... or Kaori left me a present as thanks for bringing her into this world. "And afterwards? I guess we continue living our lives, ha; silkworms are always hungry, and so am I. [kohaku.anyKids |Kohaku keeps on moaning about how her kit is a mischievous brat |You keep on hearing things about how children are a handful ], but I know our daughter isn't going to be trouble, or at least not in the usual way of children." And of the people that inspired all this to begin with...? "As for my parents, they haven't made it back all the way; traveling across the continent takes time, even for seasoned prospectors like them. Nevertheless, last I heard they were almost upon the Marches, so I'd expect them soon. I'm sure they'll have something to say to a new grandchild[pc.ra kitsune |, especially one that's the get of a divine champion ]. Ha." ... "Don't look at me like that." Hotaru's ears twitch, then flatten. "Nothing can be done about it. That being said, what can be done... " Yes? "These last several months have proven that I've done well enough for myself,[pc.ra kitsune | my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ] and intend to continue doing so. If you're concerned for my welfare, I wouldn't have started this if I didn't have a plan to see it through, so don't fret. That, and there are others looking out for me. "I know this is awkward after I've just pushed a kit out of my belly, so I think it's best if I make this clear[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. We had an agreement, and it is concluded. You don't owe me anything else, nor do you have to involve yourself further if [pc.ra kitsune |your duties keep you away |you'd rather not get involved in the tangled webs we weave ]... but if you do, I can make it worth your time. With the need out of the way, you know that if we're together, it'll be because of desire. And isn't that far more gratifying?" [pc.ra kitsune |Oh, no. While you still have some things to learn about the tangled webs foxes weave, you're more than aware this is a I-want-it-but-I'm-not-going-to-say-I-want-it thing |She doesn't have to play coy with you — not having to play at social niceties is one of the privileges not being a fox affords you. If she wants it, she's more than welcome to say so ]. You'll continue seeing her, if she'll have you. "That would make both Kaori and me very happy[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] | indeed ]. That being said, all this talking's tired me out and given me a dry mouth." As opposed to giving birth and setting her own bedchambers alight? "Very funny[pc.ra kitsune |,my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." "Ya don't need to worry 'bout her none, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence; ]lil' ol' me will make sure she has a lie-down before runnin' off to flaunt that kit to anyone who done cares a whit. That, an' stop granny from killin' her when she finds out Hotaru done started another fire." As the kitsune are fond of saying, nothing can be done about it. All right, then, you'll leave things in Mai's capable hands. The last several hours have been quite harrowing, but at the same time... were Hotaru and Kaori ever in danger? No, that's not something you'd ever want to take a risk on. All's well ends well, and you'll be content leaving it at that.
rows.translation: 但最终，所有的喧嚣都平息了：在当前的情况下，母亲和新生儿的表现都符合预期。 [party.has kiyoko |清子和小美都是 |迈的 ]萤本人也在忙着清理那些最严重的混乱局面。想必大家都注意到了，那位裁缝在清理过程中几乎把她的整个家都烧毁了，但你们也没办法做什么[pc.isDK |一整天都在帮萤处理那些心理问题/神经症症状 |为萤参加她所有的战斗 ]。 [party.has kiyoko |嗯，那真是太刺激了，不是吗？” 你转过身，发现[kiyoko.married |你的狐狸精妻子 |清子 ]她带着胜利般的微笑，悄悄靠近你，用她的尾巴缠住你的腿，将你拉近自己，然后以一种充满戏剧性的、仿佛在密谋什么的语气低声说道： “看到另一个女孩也体会到做母亲的快乐，总是让人感到欣慰的，不是吗？ [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |我的丈夫 |亲爱的 ] |亲爱的 ]从她眼中光芒的变化来看，她很快就会渴望得到另一个了——最好是来自你。[pc.ra kitsune |尤其是当你决定正式将她收为妾室的时候。 ]不过，在紧急情况下，总会有人愿意帮忙的。” 当然，当萤提出这样的请求后，清子肯定会立刻想到这些事情，对吧？ “该怎么说呢[kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |我的丈夫 |亲爱的 ] |亲爱的 ]？ 这是建立势力基础不可或缺的一部分。[kiyoko.numKits 16 32 |我也在以身作则，不是吗？ |我可以说，由于你们的帮助，我的系统安全性非常高。 ]这个女孩的天赋虽然有时会带来麻烦，但它们也有其用途。而殖民地的存在，就是为了将那些看似弱点的东西转化为优势。我真的为你感到骄傲——毕竟，你的能力也为我带来了荣誉。至于接下来会发生什么……嗯，这取决于你们两个人。不过，根据我对这类事情发展规律的了解，我倒是有一些猜测。当然，如果你们需要帮助，我随时都会在你们身边，帮助你们顺利前进。 考虑到这一点，请谨慎地安排你现有的时间吧。 [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |我的丈夫 |亲爱的 ] |亲爱的 ]而且，你可要小心自己偏爱谁。不知不觉间，岁月就会匆匆流逝。 ] 回到萤身边，你问她是否感觉好了一些。至少，她恢复到以前那个话多的状态的速度快得惊人。 “说来也奇怪， [pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]， ]是的。”她露出一种恍若梦中的微笑，“孩子出生才一个多小时，但我从未感到如此平静过，至少在我的记忆中从未有过这种感觉。就好像我内心的一部分随着那团火焰一起消失了……又或者，香织给了我一份礼物，作为感谢我让她来到这个世界上。” “之后呢？我想我们还是继续过我们的生活吧，哈哈；蚕总是饿的，而我也是如此。 [kohaku.anyKids |小白一直抱怨说，她的技能组合简直就像个调皮捣蛋的小鬼。 |你总是听到各种说法，说孩子们真是让人头疼。 ]不过我知道，我们的女儿不会惹麻烦，至少不会以孩子们通常会惹麻烦的那种方式。” 那么，那些最初激发这一切的人呢……？ “至于我的父母，他们还没有完全回来；即使是对他们这样的经验丰富的探矿者来说，横跨整个大陆也需要时间。不过，据我最后一次得到的消息，他们已经快到边境地区了，所以应该很快就会回来。我敢肯定，他们一定有话要对这个新出生的孙子说。[pc.ra kitsune |尤其是那种由神圣英雄所诞生的存在。 ]哈。” …… “别用那种眼神看我。”萤的耳朵微微一动，然后又恢复了平静。“对此我们无能为力。话虽如此，但是可以已经完成了……” “是吗？” “过去这几个月证明，我已经为自己做得够好了。[pc.ra kitsune | 我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]， ]我知道，在我刚生下这个孩子之后说这些有点尴尬，所以我觉得最好把事情说清楚[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]我们之前有过约定，而且那个约定也已经履行完毕了。你不再欠我任何东西，也不需要再继续介入这件事了。 [pc.ra kitsune |工作太忙，无暇顾及其他事情。 |你最好别卷入我们编织的这些错综复杂的麻烦中。 ]……但如果你愿意这样做，我可以让你的时间得到充分的回报。既然需求已经得到满足，你知道，如果我们在一起，那一定是出于彼此的意愿。这样不是会让人感到更加满足吗？ [pc.ra kitsune |哦，不。虽然你还有很多关于狐狸们编织的错综复杂的网状关系需要去了解，但你心里很清楚，这就是那种“我想要，但又不敢说出来”的情况。 |她没有必要对你故作矜持——不必拘泥于社交礼仪，正是身为“非狐狸”所能享有的特权之一。如果她真的想要什么，她完全可以直接说出来。 ]如果她愿意接受你的话，你还会继续见到她的。” “那样的话，我和香织都会非常开心的。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] | 确实如此。 ]话虽如此，但这些谈话真的让我感到疲惫，还让我的嘴巴变得干涩。” 与生孩子或者放火烧自己的卧室相比，这些事情似乎也没那么重要吧？ “真是太好笑了。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]你完全不需要为她担心， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下； ]我一定会确保她先好好休息一下，然后再跑去向那些根本不在乎的人炫耀她的装备。另外，还得防止奶奶在发现萤真的开始行动后把她给杀了。另一个点火吧。” 正如狐族们常说的那样，对此也无能为力。好吧，那么就把事情交給舞吧。过去的几个小时确实相当煎熬，但同时……萤和香织真的曾经处于危险之中吗？不，这种事情你绝对不愿意去冒险。一切最终都会好起来的，你只要这样想就会感到安心了。
rows.raw: " But at last, all the fuss is dying down: mother and newborn are doing as well as can be expected under their circumstances, and [party.has kiyoko |both Kiyoko and Mai are |Mai's ] busy with cleaning up the worst of the mess, Hotaru herself included. The seamstress having scorched half her home in the bargain isn't lost on any of you, but you can't [pc.isDK |babysit Hotaru's neuroses all day |fight all of Hotaru's battles for her ]. [party.has kiyoko |"Well, that was exciting, wasn't it?" You turn to find [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] slinking up to you, a triumphant smile on her lips. Cozying up to you, she wraps several of her tails about your legs and pulls you close before speaking in a theatrically conspiratorial whisper. "It's always gratifying to see another girl awaken to the joys of motherhood, isn't it, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]? Judging by how the light in her eyes has changed, it's only a matter of time before she's hankering for another — ideally from you[pc.ra kitsune |, especially if you deign to take her as an official concubine ], but someone else will do in a pinch." Of course Kiyoko would be thinking of such things immediately after Hotaru's popped, wouldn't she? "How should I put it, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]? It's part and parcel of establishing a power base[kiyoko.numKits 16 32 |, and I'm leading by example, aren't I? |, and I can say that mine is extremely secure, thanks to you ]. The girl's talents can be troublesome, but they have their uses, and the colonies exist to turn perceived weaknesses into strengths, if nothing else. I'm so proud of you — your ability does reflect well on me, after all. As to what happens from here... well, that's between the two of you, although I have some guesses from having studied how these things run their course, and I'll always be there to push you swiftly forward should you need assistance. "With that in mind, spend what time you do have carefully, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ], and do mind who you favor. Before you know it, the years will have passed." ] Turning back to Hotaru, you ask if she's feeling better. She's certainly reverting to her old talkative self with astounding speed, if nothing else. "Strangely enough, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]yes." A dreamy smile. "It can't have been more than an hour since the birth, but I've never been this at peace, not as far back as I can remember. It's as if that part of me departed alongside the fire... or Kaori left me a present as thanks for bringing her into this world. "And afterwards? I guess we continue living our lives, ha; silkworms are always hungry, and so am I. [kohaku.anyKids |Kohaku keeps on moaning about how her kit is a mischievous brat |You keep on hearing things about how children are a handful ], but I know our daughter isn't going to be trouble, or at least not in the usual way of children." And of the people that inspired all this to begin with...? "As for my parents, they haven't made it back all the way; traveling across the continent takes time, even for seasoned prospectors like them. Nevertheless, last I heard they were almost upon the Marches, so I'd expect them soon. I'm sure they'll have something to say to a new grandchild[pc.ra kitsune |, especially one that's the get of a divine champion ]. Ha." ... "Don't look at me like that." Hotaru's ears twitch, then flatten. "Nothing can be done about it. That being said, what can be done... " Yes? "These last several months have proven that I've done well enough for myself,[pc.ra kitsune | my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ] and intend to continue doing so. If you're concerned for my welfare, I wouldn't have started this if I didn't have a plan to see it through, so don't fret. That, and there are others looking out for me. "I know this is awkward after I've just pushed a kit out of my belly, so I think it's best if I make this clear[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. We had an agreement, and it is concluded. You don't owe me anything else, nor do you have to involve yourself further if [pc.ra kitsune |your duties keep you away |you'd rather not get involved in the tangled webs we weave ]... but if you do, I can make it worth your time. With the need out of the way, you know that if we're together, it'll be because of desire. And isn't that far more gratifying?" [pc.ra kitsune |Oh, no. While you still have some things to learn about the tangled webs foxes weave, you're more than aware this is a I-want-it-but-I'm-not-going-to-say-I-want-it thing |She doesn't have to play coy with you — not having to play at social niceties is one of the privileges not being a fox affords you. If she wants it, she's more than welcome to say so ]. You'll continue seeing her, if she'll have you. "That would make both Kaori and me very happy[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] | indeed ]. That being said, all this talking's tired me out and given me a dry mouth." As opposed to giving birth and setting her own bedchambers alight? "Very funny[pc.ra kitsune |,my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." "Ya don't need to worry 'bout her none, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence; ]lil' ol' me will make sure she has a lie-down before runnin' off to flaunt that kit to anyone who done cares a whit. That, an' stop granny from killin' her when she finds out Hotaru done started another fire." As the kitsune are fond of saying, nothing can be done about it. All right, then, you'll leave things in Mai's capable hands. The last several hours have been quite harrowing, but at the same time... were Hotaru and Kaori ever in danger? No, that's not something you'd ever want to take a risk on. All's well ends well, and you'll be content leaving it at that. "

rows.original: No sooner have you drawn near the sliding door of Hotaru's apartment that you hear the commotion from within — several words in the kitsune mother tongue, followed by hasty footsteps beelining for you. Within moments, the door slams open, revealing a red-faced Hotaru with a bundle in her arms. The seamstress [pc.ra kitsune |fumbles an attempt to bow before righting herself, remembering the kit she's cradling against her. "Oh, your Eminence. You're finally back |, bracing herself against the doorframe to catch her breath before turning to you, kit slung in one arm. "Oh, [pc.name]. I was just thinking of you and you show up — maybe I should've been reminiscing more of you beforehand ]? It's a shame you had to miss the birth, but [hotaru.isMILF |I was already getting dangerously huge |it's not like I could've held it in ], haha." Oh, right. She was with child when you last saw her, and judging by the amount of time that's passed and the usual duration of kitsune pregnancies, Hotaru would've popped some time back. The black-furred, two-tailed kit swaddled in floral-print cloth is no doubt the result — you were kept away by something important, right? You didn't just forget about Hotaru's imminent birth until you decided to drop by now? But enough about you. Hotaru certainly knew you were coming, with how quick she was to greet you at the door. Hotaru tilts her head. "There is that[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Our daughter is usually so calm, I'm able to tell something's amiss by when she deigns to stir. I suppose her sense for you is far keener than mine, and that's saying something given that she's only ever known you while in my womb. Or is it that your force of personality is that strong that it's impressed her even so?" Why not both? "I like the way you think." A smile. "Well, I suppose it's not so bad that you missed the whole debacle, anyway. I wouldn't want you to think less of me, especially when all that I wanted to do then was crawl into a dark corner alone and get it over with. Which I did. There was a bit of trouble, but everything worked out in the end, so you don't need to worry about it[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Kaori was born, and that's what's important."
rows.translation: 你刚走到萤公寓的推拉门前，就听到里面传来一阵嘈杂声——先是几句用狐语说出的话，紧接着就是急促的脚步声朝你这边奔来。不一会儿，门被猛地推开了，只见萤满脸通红，怀里抱着一个包裹。那位裁缝[pc.ra kitsune |她试图鞠躬，但动作有些笨拙，随后才稳住身体，想起自己怀中的那些物品。 “哦，尊贵的阁下，您终于回来了 |她靠在门框上喘了口气，然后转身看着你，一只手臂还挎着装备包。 “哦， [pc.name]我刚刚还在想着你，你就出现了——也许我之前应该多回想一些关于你的往事 ]？ 真遗憾你没能亲历这个时刻，不过[hotaru.isMILF |我的体型已经变得大得有些危险了。 |我又不是那种能忍住不做的性格。 ]哈哈。” 哦，对了。你上次见到她的时候，她已经怀孕了吧。考虑到已经过去这么长时间，再加上狐妖怀孕通常需要的时间，萤应该早就生下孩子了。那个身上覆盖着花纹图案布料、长着黑色毛发和两条尾巴的小家伙，肯定就是她的孩子吧——你当时肯定是因为有重要的事情而无法去看她，对吧？你直到现在才想起萤即将出生这件事，是吧？ 不过，先不说你。萤肯定早就知道你会来，否则她也不会那么快就在门口迎接你。 萤歪了歪头。那里是那个[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]我们的女儿平时总是那么安静，只有当她决定动一下的时候，我才能察觉到有些不对劲。我想，她对你的感知能力比我敏锐得多——毕竟她认识你，也只是在我肚子里的时候而已。还是说，你的个性太过鲜明，以至于即便她没有亲耳听到那些话，也依然被你吸引了呢？” “为什么不能两者都是呢？” “我喜欢你的思维方式。”他微笑着说道，“嗯，其实你错过了那一整系列闹剧，也没什么坏处吧。我并不希望你因此而对我产生不好的看法，尤其是当时我真正想要的，只是独自躲在一个暗影的角落里，把这件事彻底结束。而我确实这么做了。虽然过程中遇到了一些麻烦，但最终一切都解决了，所以你不必为此担心。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]薰诞生了，这才是最重要的。

rows.original: You eye the black-furred fox kit swaddled against Hotaru's arm — and she eyes you right back with a completely straight face. Kaori doesn't laugh or cry, or even grace you with that wide-eyed stare that some infants have, but simply acknowledges your presence with a half-lidded gaze, as if this entire interaction were a social obligation she can't escape. [pc.ra kitsune |And amidst all that... the faint scent of foxfire, familiar cool heat, only with a sweetness to it as if some kind of incense were burning in the distance. There isn't any obvious source to it, or point where it's strongest; if it were to come from anywhere, it'd have to be her skin. ] You have the sinking feeling this child is just as gifted as her mother, albeit in a different way. [party.has kiyoko |A gentle touch on your shoulder — and it's not from Hotaru. While Hotaru holds your attention, [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife's |Kiyoko's ] sidled up against you and wrapped her tails [pc.ra kitsune |about yours |around your legs ], looking just as smug as Hotaru is. Hotaru seizes the chance to come in from the other side, and soon enough both vixens have you caught in their trap between their lush bodies, making you well aware of how much bearing your kits has changed both of them. "Well done, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]," she whispers into your ear. "Look at the girl, how awkward she was when you last met. Compare that to how readily she's embraced what she's become; that's another conquest for you, another addition to the colonies. Do you feel accomplished now?" What? "Ehehe. I tease, I tease." Before you know it, two sets of tails firmly ensnare you, followed by the insistent pressing of cool heat and soft bodies. "But I hope this feels as good for you as it does for me, [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |my husband |Beloved ] |Beloved ]." |Breathing heavily, Hotaru slinks up in the blink of an eye, happily sidling up against you and wrapping her tails [pc.ra kitsune |about yours |around your legs ]. The cool heat of foxfire's palpable under her skin, and the constant trembling of excitement down her nerves makes it clear she's mere inches from boiling over. Holding a kit, of course, does mellow her impulses somewhat, but the tight knot in Hotaru's lower belly isn't shy about announcing its intentions: now that it's found you and what you have to offer, it's determined to have it again. Not now, not so soon. But there's an entire future, [silly |especially after the game's over, ]and having shared at least part of the journey to this point with you retreading this path is a tempting prospect some time down the line. The destination is nice, but the journey that which makes the memories, and besides, an ending is just another beginning... ] After taking several deep breaths, Hotaru shudders and pulls away from you with a moan; her bosom heaves raggedly, the fabric peaking the mounts growing damp. Slowly, the seamstress shakes her head, looks between herself, her daughter, and you, then sighs wistfully. Kaori looks extremely unimpressed by her mother's antics, inasmuch as she acknowledges them at all. "[hotaru.isMILF |Just look at me[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. I thought I might become a little less plump after Kaori was born, but I'm still as round as ever, with the exception of my middle. And even that has thickened... although I admit it'd be weird to have my old waist measurements with my other two sizes. That golden creature has a lot to answer for; I still want to strangle her." [kohaku.wellFed |You can't say Hotaru doesn't deserve it for stuffing Kohaku full of food while she was pregnant. Now both childhood friends can be stuck together down the same well, just as it's always been. For all of their antics, Hotaru and Kohaku deserve each other. "Hmph! You'd like that, wouldn't you? A pair of fat vixens at your beck and call, just — just — hmph!" |Given that by all accounts the two have been messing with each other since they were children, your only surprise is that it's taken this long for something like this to happen. All you're going to say is that Hotaru and Kohaku deserve each other. Hotaru draws herself together with a sniff. "That has so many possible meanings, hidden or otherwise. But this isn't over. Kohaku's going to get what's coming to her." If it helps her nerves any, Hotaru does look more fetching with some firm meat on her bones. Whether she wants to believe this is just you being polite — well, that's up to her. "Hmph! Kaori doesn't laugh or cry, or even grace you with that wide-eyed stare that some infants have, but simply acknowledges your presence with a half-lidded gaze, as if this entire interaction were a social obligation she can't escape. [pc.ra kitsune |And amidst all that... the faint scent of foxfire, familiar cool heat, only with a sweetness to it as if some kind of incense were burning in the distance. " So... what happens now? And what about her parents? Hotaru doesn't answer at first, instead turning her gaze between Kaori in her arms and you. "Well... I'm still working on cleaning up all the scorch marks and replacing all the furniture that was, uh, damaged during the birth. That much is clear[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. Afterwards, I guess we continue living our lives, ha. [kohaku.anyKids |Kohaku keeps on moaning about how her kit is a mischievous brat |You keep on hearing things about how children are a handful ], Kaori's been nothing but obliging ever since she came out of me. If all my children are going to be — ah, humorless sticks in the mud, as Kohaku puts it, the prospect of having several more in a few years, maybe under more stable conditions, doesn't sound so bad. "But for now? I'll bask in the attention while it lasts. These last several months have proven that I've done well enough for myself,[pc.ra kitsune | my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ] and intend to continue doing so. If you're concerned for my welfare, I wouldn't have started this if I didn't have a plan to see it through, so don't worry. That, and there are others looking out for me. Despite having another soul to feed, I'm actually feeling hungry less often than before. No idea why, but it suits a homebody like me just fine." That's... well. You knew that someone as meticulous as Hotaru — while she's not being gifted, anyway — would've have this all planned out, but hearing it from her with such confidence does put you at ease. And of the people that inspired all this to begin with...? "As for my parents, they haven't made it back all the way; traveling across the continent takes time, even for them. Nevertheless, last I heard they were almost upon the Marches, so I'd expect them soon. I'm sure they'll have something to say to a new grandchild[pc.ra kitsune |, especially one that's the get of a divine champion ]. Ha." "

rows.original: As you approach Hotaru's apartments, you hear conversation from within — it sounds like she's having guests over. That wouldn't be surprising in and of itself, but the other voice doesn't sound like anyone you know; nevertheless, when no response comes after you announce yourself by [pc.ra kitsune |clapping at the doorway |rapping your knuckles on the wooden part of the door ], you decide to let yourself in. After having gotten to the point of the seamstress running the whole gamut of conceiving, carrying and birthing your kit, you're familiar enough for that, aren't you? When you near Hotaru's sitting room, you catch a glimpse of her visitor: another four-tailed, black-furred vixen like Hotaru herself, her back turned to you as the two gossip animatedly. No sooner have you shown your face, though, that Hotaru cuts off mid-sentence and stiffens; in the blink of an eye, her guest follows suit, ears perking up and muscles tensing. [pc.agilityRange 70 |Your gut instincts scream unease, and it's by sheer dint of your reflexes that you're able to dance out of the way before a plume of green-tinged foxfire erupts where you were standing a moment ago, leaving the woven straw flooring singed. |The air thickens, and sidestep the worst of the plume of green-tinged foxfire that erupts where you were standing a moment ago. What tongues of flame do manage to catch on your legs cling to your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with relentless tenacity, and while [pc.ra kitsune |your own foxfire prevents you from coming to any real harm |it's not much more than an annoyance for a seasoned [pc.class] like you ], they nevertheless absolutely refuse to be beaten out. ] Hotaru quickly yips several words in her mother tongue, pointing urgently at you; when the other vixen realizes what's going on, the flames recede and she turns in her seat, ears folding forward and looking appropriately contrite and sheepish. "Ah! Sorry I freaked out and [pc.agilityRange 70 |almost ]set you on fire — my daughter told me she was bringing company, and I completely forgot...!" "What? Mom, I didn't tell you that — I didn't even know [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |[pc.name] ] was even going to show up today!" "What? But I..." the elder Sadakata blinks, and you can envision the thoughts jostling as they line up in her head, trying to form an orderly line before giving up and scattering to the winds. "I suppose I must've forgotten that I forgot, then! Please accept my apologies[pc.ra kitsune |, divine champion ]!" [pc.ra kitsune |Wait. She knows that Keros has anointed you as his personal champion? "Oh yes, it's the talk of the den and even before that, my daughter has been very explicit about your circumstances in her letters. The August Master at the Center of Heaven hasn't had a personal champion ever since the time of the —" she pauses a moment — "how should I translate it? Ever since the time of the records of ancient events, which obviously go way back. "You have a very special... aura? Intention? I'm not sure there's a good word in Belharan for it, but it was plain what, if not necessarily who you were the moment I set eyes on you. Hence, uh, I freaked out." "Other lineages might worry about the portents mingling with such blood might bring, but since you've known my daughter you should also be aware we're used to such gifts, ah-ha. So, as the head of this familial line, I ought to welcome and thank you for gift that is Kaori." You throw a glance at Hotaru, who's quite relieved that you've swung the conversation away from her mother's attempt to set you on fire. |Hotaru clears her throat and yanks on her mother's tails, urging the elder Sadakata to sit back down. "Sorry for the awkwardness, [pc.name]. After traveling as she has for so long, my mom's far too used to reacting to people sneaking up from behind with foxfire first and questions after. Not ideal, you may agree, but it's saved her life enough times that it's an ingrained reflex at this point." ] She doesn't need to worry. These are trying times, with many, uh, unique circumstances attached. And you did invite it by feeling mischievous. From the context of the situation... this is Hotaru's mother, then? Clutching Kaori to her breast, Hotaru steps in to right the situation. "Right. Proper introductions are in order, aren't they? [pc.ra kitsune |My [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ], this is my mother, Hisako. Mom, this is [pc.name]."
rows.translation: 当你走近萤的公寓时，里面传来了谈话声——听起来她好像在招待客人。这本身倒也不足为奇，但另一个声音听起来并不像是你认识的人；不过，当你自我介绍后却没有任何回应[pc.ra kitsune |在门口拍手 |用指关节敲打门的木制部分 ]你决定让自己进去。既然已经经历了裁缝从构思、制作到完成你的装备这一整个过程，你应该已经对此非常熟悉了吧？ 当你接近萤的客厅时，你瞥见了她的访客：另一个和萤一样、有着四条尾巴、黑色毛发的狐妖。当时她正背对着你，和那个人兴致勃勃地聊着天。然而，你刚一露面，萤就突然停住了话，身体也变得僵硬起来；转眼间，她的客人也跟着做出了同样的反应——耳朵竖了起来，肌肉也紧绷了起来。 [pc.agilityRange 70 |你的直觉在强烈地提醒你危险即将降临，正是依靠快速的反应能力，你才在那一团带有绿色光芒的狐火即将喷发出来的瞬间及时躲开了，否则你刚才站立的地方的草编地板早就被烧焦了。 |空气变得浑浊，你不得不避开刚才你还站在那里时突然喷发出来的、带有绿色光芒的狐火。那些火焰究竟是如何附着在你的腿上的，它们紧紧地缠住了你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]以无比坚韧的毅力，始终不懈地[pc.ra kitsune |你自身的“狐火”阻碍了你受到真正的伤害。 |对于经验丰富的人来说，这只不过是一种烦人的事情罢了。 [pc.class]喜欢你 ]然而，他们绝对拒绝被击败。 ] 萤迅速用她的母语说了几句话，急切地指向你；当另一只狐妖意识到发生了什么时，火焰消退了，它转过身来，耳朵向前贴着，显得非常懊悔和羞愧。 “啊！对不起，我刚才吓坏了[pc.agilityRange 70 |几乎 ]害我慌了神——我女儿跟我说会带朋友来，我完全给忘了……” “什么？妈妈，我并没有跟你说这个啊——我当时根本不知道。 [pc.ra kitsune |神圣冠军 |[pc.name] ]她甚至今天还打算来呢！” “什么？可我……”年长的Sadakata眨了眨眼，你可以想象她脑海中那些思绪正在混乱地碰撞、排列，试图形成一条有条理的思路，但最终还是放弃了，四散而去。“我想，我一定是把这件事给忘了吧！请接受我的歉意吧。[pc.ra kitsune |神圣冠军 ]！" [pc.ra kitsune |等等。她知道凯罗斯已经指定你为他的私人冠军了吗？ “哦，是的，整个基地都在讨论这件事。而且在我女儿写的信里，她也明确提到了你的情况。自从……”她停顿了一下，“该怎么表达呢？‘自从那个时代以来’，天心中心的奥古斯特大师就再也没有过私人冠军了。自从有记载以来，这些古老的事件显然可以追溯到很久以前。 “你身上有一种非常特别的……气场？或者说，某种特殊的意图？我不确定在贝尔哈兰语中有什么合适的词语来形容它，但当我第一眼看到你的时候，我就清楚地意识到了你的特殊性——即使不能确定你究竟是谁。所以，呃，我当时真的吓坏了。” “其他家族可能会担心这种血脉融合会带来什么后果，但既然你认识我女儿，你也应该知道，我们对这样的‘礼物’已经习以为常了，哈哈。因此，作为这个家族的族长，我应该欢迎并感谢你送来的这份礼物——香织。” 你瞥了瞥萤火虫，她看到你把话题从她母亲试图让你陷入困境的事情上转移开了，顿时松了一口气。 |萤清了清嗓子，拽了拽母亲的衣角，示意年长的贞孝重新坐下。“实在是为刚才的尴尬场面感到抱歉[pc.name]经过这么长时间的旅行，我妈妈已经习惯了先用狐火击退那些从背后悄悄接近的人，然后再去询问他们的来意。你可能会觉得这种做法并不理想，但事实上，这种反应已经多次救了她的命，因此现在这已经成了她的一种本能反应了。 ] 她不必担心。现在正是艰难的时刻，面临着许多特殊的情况。而你确实怀着些许调皮的心思，主动邀请她吧。从当前的情况来看……这位应该是萤的母亲吧？ 萤将香织紧紧抱在怀里，上前来化解这个尴尬的局面。“对，应该先进行正式的介绍，不是吗？ [pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] |[pc.name] ]这是我的母亲，希纱子。妈妈，这是[pc.name]。"
rows.raw: " As you approach Hotaru's apartments, you hear conversation from within — it sounds like she's having guests over. That wouldn't be surprising in and of itself, but the other voice doesn't sound like anyone you know; nevertheless, when no response comes after you announce yourself by [pc.ra kitsune |clapping at the doorway |rapping your knuckles on the wooden part of the door ], you decide to let yourself in. After having gotten to the point of the seamstress running the whole gamut of conceiving, carrying and birthing your kit, you're familiar enough for that, aren't you? When you near Hotaru's sitting room, you catch a glimpse of her visitor: another four-tailed, black-furred vixen like Hotaru herself, her back turned to you as the two gossip animatedly. No sooner have you shown your face, though, that Hotaru cuts off mid-sentence and stiffens; in the blink of an eye, her guest follows suit, ears perking up and muscles tensing. [pc.agilityRange 70 |Your gut instincts scream unease, and it's by sheer dint of your reflexes that you're able to dance out of the way before a plume of green-tinged foxfire erupts where you were standing a moment ago, leaving the woven straw flooring singed. |The air thickens, and sidestep the worst of the plume of green-tinged foxfire that erupts where you were standing a moment ago. What tongues of flame do manage to catch on your legs cling to your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with relentless tenacity, and while [pc.ra kitsune |your own foxfire prevents you from coming to any real harm |it's not much more than an annoyance for a seasoned [pc.class] like you ], they nevertheless absolutely refuse to be beaten out. ] Hotaru quickly yips several words in her mother tongue, pointing urgently at you; when the other vixen realizes what's going on, the flames recede and she turns in her seat, ears folding forward and looking appropriately contrite and sheepish. "Ah! Sorry I freaked out and [pc.agilityRange 70 |almost ]set you on fire — my daughter told me she was bringing company, and I completely forgot...!" "What? Mom, I didn't tell you that — I didn't even know [pc.ra kitsune |the divine champion |[pc.name] ] was even going to show up today!" "What? But I..." the elder Sadakata blinks, and you can envision the thoughts jostling as they line up in her head, trying to form an orderly line before giving up and scattering to the winds. "I suppose I must've forgotten that I forgot, then! Please accept my apologies[pc.ra kitsune |, divine champion ]!" [pc.ra kitsune |Wait. She knows that Keros has anointed you as his personal champion? "Oh yes, it's the talk of the den and even before that, my daughter has been very explicit about your circumstances in her letters. The August Master at the Center of Heaven hasn't had a personal champion ever since the time of the —" she pauses a moment — "how should I translate it? Ever since the time of the records of ancient events, which obviously go way back. "You have a very special... aura? Intention? I'm not sure there's a good word in Belharan for it, but it was plain what, if not necessarily who you were the moment I set eyes on you. Hence, uh, I freaked out." "Other lineages might worry about the portents mingling with such blood might bring, but since you've known my daughter you should also be aware we're used to such gifts, ah-ha. So, as the head of this familial line, I ought to welcome and thank you for gift that is Kaori." You throw a glance at Hotaru, who's quite relieved that you've swung the conversation away from her mother's attempt to set you on fire. |Hotaru clears her throat and yanks on her mother's tails, urging the elder Sadakata to sit back down. "Sorry for the awkwardness, [pc.name]. After traveling as she has for so long, my mom's far too used to reacting to people sneaking up from behind with foxfire first and questions after. Not ideal, you may agree, but it's saved her life enough times that it's an ingrained reflex at this point." ] She doesn't need to worry. These are trying times, with many, uh, unique circumstances attached. And you did invite it by feeling mischievous. From the context of the situation... this is Hotaru's mother, then? Clutching Kaori to her breast, Hotaru steps in to right the situation. "Right. Proper introductions are in order, aren't they? [pc.ra kitsune |My [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ], this is my mother, Hisako. Mom, this is [pc.name]." "

rows.original: Hisako rises and bows with all four tails. "[pc.ra kitsune |It's good to meet Kaori's [pc.mf |father |sire ] — no wonder my granddaughter's gift is so unique, ah-ha. Thank you for acceding to my daughter's request — now that you've made a grandchild with Hotaru, will you make one with me and bless our line even further with your divinity?" "M-m-m-mom!? What are you saying?! Can you even have kits at your age?" The elder Sadakata chuckles at her daughter's distress and flicks a gob of foxfire onto Hotaru's hair where it fizzles out. "Ah-ha, I'm just kidding, Hotaru. I didn't come home just to steal away your prize — that being said, your Eminence, now that she's birthed you a child, have you ever considered taking my daughter as a concubine? She's one in all but name at this point, so you might as well make it formal." "MOM!" Honestly? The offer's tempting, and on its merits alone it would be a step up for Hotaru if she were to enter into concubinage. That being said, Hotaru's not the kind of vixen for such things, just doesn't have the temperament for it. After so many kitsune talking in circles around the subject they really want to discuss, Hisako's ability to be direct is a breath of fresh air. "Ah-ha, I see; thank you for the compliment. Divinity aside, my daughter wouldn't have chosen you if you weren't anything special, and that much is plain. |Oh, oh, this will be interesting! I think you're the first native of these lands that Komari has allowed to come and go as [pc.heShe] pleases — the arcology is usually obscured from all but the most determined. But then, my daughter wouldn't have chosen you if you weren't anything special. ] "Please forgive my husband's absence — he's out drinking with the Kobayashis at the moment, celebrating uh, what I guess is our retirement from the prospecting life. I'm not completely sure about that myself, given how restless our bodies can be, but we are getting a little too old for hopes of receiving an imperial commendation and starting a new life back in the Old Country as respectable people." How old is the elder Sadakata? "Forty-four summers at last count[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Forty-four? And if Hotaru looks to be about — that means — hmm. Considering the wide variability in kitsune lifespans, uh — "I was about the same age Hotaru is now when I had her," Hisako adds cheerfully and without the slightest hint of shame. "Nights get cold in this part of the world, I was newly wedded, and while it wasn't an accident, it was rather impulsive. I don't regret it, but it's only because of our gifts and the den matron's care that Hotaru turned out as well as she has despite being fostered for most of her young life and by and large doesn't resent me for it." Hotaru's expression tells quite a different story, but Hisako is oblivious to her daughter's fuming in her cheerfully ditzy fashion. But with both mother and daughter standing and facing you, you're able to compare them side by side — Hisako's a little shorter than Hotaru and far wirier and leanly muscled, unsurprising considering the differences in their lives. [hotaru.isMILF |But when it comes to the rest... well, Hotaru might once have been comparable to her mother. Now, though? She's MILFed out so readily, so intensely that Hisako can't compare. Sure, Kohaku and you might've given her a push, but Hotaru's three sizes put her mother's to shame, and Hisako's no slouch, either. Your gaze turns between Hotaru and Hisako, then finally to little Kaori in Hotaru's arms. If the trend continues... one can only wonder if two decades from now, your daughter will be beating off suitors with that same deadpan expression on her little face. No wonder Komari's been interested in the generational changes that've taken root in the lineages under her charge. |But when it comes to overall body shape and silhouette... well, you can see where Hotaru got her three sizes from, as befits the stereotype of a foreign-born fox. Both mother and daughter buzz with an intense sense of mania, and while Hisako rambles on you get that feeling you sometimes have with Hotaru, that of a pot bubbling over. Only unlike Hotaru, it's got a happy, cheerful bent to it, the kind of destructive maelstrom that'll leave a trail of destruction in its wake with its innocence whole and conscience untarnished. ] Wow. Come to think of it, have you really spent that much time around Hotaru that you're able to pick up on her family's neuroses that easily? "...So there I was,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Hisako continues, having sat herself back down and nattered on while you were occupied with your own thoughts. "By the time I realized what was happening, Hotaru was already halfway out of me. It happened all so quickly, I barely had enough time to set out a sheet before the rest of her followed, lively little kit that she was. Common sense would say that prospecting isn't a pregnant vixen should do, but sometimes common sense isn't the be-all-end-all of things, wouldn't you say? The exercise I got during those months did the both of us good." "Mom, you're not a prospector. You do adventurer things and the search for good iron was always just a pretext to get you and Dad out the door. The natives are only interested in copper and tin; Kohaku's laid her hands on far more than you've ever found by trading for what the locals consider mining waste. Prospectors don't regale their daughters with tales of derring-do in their letters home." You'd imagine Hotaru's mom detailing the circumstances of her birth would be far more mortifying than what she labels her profession, but then again if mother is anything like daughter, she sure has her priorities in order... Hisako happily ignores her daughter. "I couldn't have been gone more than two hours at most; my husband and the Kobayahis were so shocked when I returned to our camp with a flatter belly and a kit in my arms. Thoroughly unsanitary doing it out in the wild and alone to boot, but it's not as if I had a choice, right? I was surprised myself at how fast it happened... but I think my daughter took her time with Kaori's birth, didn't she? Or at least that's what the Kobayashi girl said when she recounted the affair in considerable detail. A lot of screaming and burning everything within reach, I hear. Hours of miserable agony. Hotaru, I always said you needed to get more exercise, but [hotaru.isMILF |you've let yourself go to the point where you've gotten all fat from the neck down |you keep on insisting on being a homebody and letting others come to you ]. That's not a healthy way to live." Keeping her smile fixed rigidly on her face, Hotaru turns to you apologetically. "I'm so sorry about my mom. Barely a few days home, and she's already lecturing me on how to live. As for Kohaku, I am so going to [hotaru.isMILF |finish the job I started and ]snap her little lying neck." You share a glance with Kaori in her mother's arms, and the deadpan look of exasperation your infant daughter gives you mirrors the heavy churning in the pit of your stomach. Two decades of growing up, cared for adults prone to such antics — children caring for, well, Kaori is a child regardless of being born old.
rows.translation: 希纱子站起身来，同时摆动着她那四条尾巴，行了一个鞠躬礼。[pc.ra kitsune |能遇到香织真是太好了。 [pc.mf |父亲 |陛下 ]难怪我孙女的礼物这么特别，啊哈。感谢你答应了我女儿的请求——既然你已经和萤有了一个孙子，那么能不能也和我生一个孩子，用你的神力让我们的家族更加繁荣呢？” “妈、妈、妈！你在说什么啊？！这可能吗拥有你这个年纪，还玩这种把戏？” 老萨达卡塔看着女儿尴尬的表情，轻笑了一声，然后把一小团狐火弹到萤火的头发上，那里立刻迸发出火花。“哈哈，我只是在开玩笑而已，萤火。我回家可不是为了抢走你的奖品……不过，尊贵的夫人，既然她已经为您生下了孩子，您有没有考虑过让我的女儿成为您的侧室呢？她现在其实已经差不多算是正式的妾室了，不如正式确定下来吧。妈妈！说实话？这个提议确实很有吸引力，仅从其本身来看，就已经很吸引人了。会如果萤真的选择了纳妾这种做法，那对她来说反而是一种退步。不过，萤并不是那种适合这种事情的人，她根本没有这样的性格和气质。在这么多狐妖围绕这个话题喋喋不休之后真的啊哈，我明白了；谢谢你的夸奖。先不说神格不神格的，如果你没有什么特别之处，我的女儿也不会选择你，这一点是很明显的。 |哦，哦，这一定会很有趣！我想你是这些地方的第一位被麻里允许自由来去的人吧。 [pc.heShe]请注意——这个生态城通常只会被那些意志最为坚定的人发现。不过，如果你没有什么特别之处，我的女儿也不会选择你。 ] 请原谅我丈夫的缺席——他现在正和小林一家一起喝酒庆祝，庆祝我们结束勘探工作吧。其实我自己也不太确定，因为我们的身体总是那么不安分，但无论如何是年纪已经太大，再也没机会获得皇帝的赏赐，也无法回到旧国重新开始一段体面的生活了。” “到底多大年纪呢？是那位年长的萨达卡塔？ “据最新统计，他已经活了四十四个夏天了。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]四十四岁？如果萤现在大概也是这个年纪的话，那就意味着……嗯，考虑到狐妖的寿命有着很大的差异，嗯…… “我生下萤的时候，年龄也和她现在差不多。”希纱子开心地说道，丝毫没有丝毫羞愧之情。在这个地区，夜晚会变得非常寒冷。我当时刚刚结婚，虽然这个决定并非出于偶然，但确实有些冲动。我并不后悔，正是因为我们之间的感情，以及窝主母的照顾，萤才能在大部分时间都由别人抚养的情况下，依然成长得如此出色。而且，她基本上也没有因此而怨恨我。萤的表情显然在诉说着另一番故事，但希纱子却完全没有注意到自己女儿那愤怒而又故作欢快的神情。当母女俩站在一起面对你时，你就可以将她们进行对比了——希纱子比萤矮一些，身体也更加结实，肌肉线条更为分明，考虑到她们生活的环境差异，这一点也就不足为奇了。 [hotaru.isMILF |但说到其他方面……嗯，萤或许曾经可以和她母亲相提并论。不过现在呢？她太容易、太频繁地展现出那种成熟女性的魅力了，以至于希纱子根本无法与之相比。当然，琥珀和你或许也对她起到了一定的推动作用，但萤的三围实在让她母亲相形见绌——而希纱子本身也毫不逊色啊。 你的目光在萤和希纱子之间来回移动，最后落在了萤怀中的小香织身上。如果这种趋势持续下去……人们不禁会想：二十年后，你的女儿是否还会用那种面无表情的表情来拒绝追求者呢？难怪麻里会对她负责这些家族中逐渐形成的代际变化如此感兴趣。 |但说到整体体型和轮廓……嗯，你就能明白萤为何会有那样的身材了，这完全符合“外国出生的狐狸”这一刻板印象。母女俩都充满了强烈的活力，而当希纱子喋喋不休时，你会产生那种与萤相处时有时会感受到的感觉——就像一锅水快要沸腾了一样。只不过与萤不同，它的性格更加快乐、开朗。这种具有破坏性的力量在肆虐之后，会留下一片废墟，但它自身的纯真与良知却丝毫未受影响。 ] 哇，仔细想想，你真的在萤身边待了那么长时间，以至于能够如此轻易地察觉到她家庭的那些心理问题吗？ “……就在那时，[pc.ra kitsune | 阁下， ]他的子继续说道，她重新坐下来，趁你还在沉思的时候不停地唠叨着。‘等我反应过来发生了什么的时候，萤已经差不多完全从我体内出来了。一切都发生得太快了，我几乎来不及铺一张纸，她的其他部分就都跟着出来了——那个活泼可爱的小家伙。按常理来说，探矿这种事情根本不是怀孕的女性应该去做的，但有时候，常理并不是衡量一切的标准，你不觉得吗？在那几个月里进行的锻炼，对我们俩都有好处。 妈妈，你又不是探矿者。你做的都是冒险家才会做的事，而寻找优质的铁矿，其实只是个借口，好让你和爸爸能出门去探险。当地人真正感兴趣的只是铜和锡；而通过用他们认为只是废料的东西进行交易，琥珀得到的东西，远比你找到的要多得多。真正的探矿者，在给家里人的信里，是不会夸耀自己那些冒险经历的。 你可能会认为，萤的母亲详细描述她自己的出生经历，这种场面应该会比她所从事的职业更令人尴尬才对。不过，如果母亲和女儿有什么相似之处的话，那么她确实很清楚自己的优先事项是什么。希纱子开心地无视了女儿的话。“我最多也就离开了两个小时而已；当我回到营地时，肚子圆润了些，怀里还抱着一个工具包，我的丈夫和小林一家都吓坏了。在野外独自进行那种事情，卫生条件肯定很差，但我也别无选择，对吧？我自己也感到很惊讶，这一切发生得竟然如此之快……不过我想，我女儿在生香织的时候应该花了不少时间吧？至少小林那个女孩在详细讲述这件事的时候是这么说的。我听说，当时到处都是尖叫声，人们把能点燃的东西都烧掉了。那是长达数小时的痛苦与煎熬。热亚鲁，我一直都说你应该多锻炼身体，但是[hotaru.isMILF |你已经完全放任自己，结果从脖子往下都胖起来了。 |你一直坚持做一个喜欢待在家里的人，让别人主动来找你。 ]那样的生活方式并不好。” 萤强忍着笑容，歉意地转向你：“关于我妈妈的事，我真的非常抱歉。她才回家没几天，就开始教训我该如何生活。至于琥珀，我一定要[hotaru.isMILF |完成我开始的工作，然后…… ]扭断她那撒小谎的脖子。” 你与怀在母亲怀中的薰对视了一眼，你那幼小的女儿那副无动于衷、充满无奈的表情，正好反映了你内心深处那种翻江倒海的感受。二十年来，你一直生活在这样一群喜欢搞这种恶作剧的成年人身边……而孩子们，嗯，薰毕竟还是个孩子，无论她出生时年纪多大。
rows.raw: " Hisako rises and bows with all four tails. "[pc.ra kitsune |It's good to meet Kaori's [pc.mf |father |sire ] — no wonder my granddaughter's gift is so unique, ah-ha. Thank you for acceding to my daughter's request — now that you've made a grandchild with Hotaru, will you make one with me and bless our line even further with your divinity?" "M-m-m-mom!? What are you saying?! Can you even have kits at your age?" The elder Sadakata chuckles at her daughter's distress and flicks a gob of foxfire onto Hotaru's hair where it fizzles out. "Ah-ha, I'm just kidding, Hotaru. I didn't come home just to steal away your prize — that being said, your Eminence, now that she's birthed you a child, have you ever considered taking my daughter as a concubine? She's one in all but name at this point, so you might as well make it formal." "MOM!" Honestly? The offer's tempting, and on its merits alone it would be a step up for Hotaru if she were to enter into concubinage. That being said, Hotaru's not the kind of vixen for such things, just doesn't have the temperament for it. After so many kitsune talking in circles around the subject they really want to discuss, Hisako's ability to be direct is a breath of fresh air. "Ah-ha, I see; thank you for the compliment. Divinity aside, my daughter wouldn't have chosen you if you weren't anything special, and that much is plain. |Oh, oh, this will be interesting! I think you're the first native of these lands that Komari has allowed to come and go as [pc.heShe] pleases — the arcology is usually obscured from all but the most determined. But then, my daughter wouldn't have chosen you if you weren't anything special. ] "Please forgive my husband's absence — he's out drinking with the Kobayashis at the moment, celebrating uh, what I guess is our retirement from the prospecting life. I'm not completely sure about that myself, given how restless our bodies can be, but we are getting a little too old for hopes of receiving an imperial commendation and starting a new life back in the Old Country as respectable people." How old is the elder Sadakata? "Forty-four summers at last count[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Forty-four? And if Hotaru looks to be about — that means — hmm. Considering the wide variability in kitsune lifespans, uh — "I was about the same age Hotaru is now when I had her," Hisako adds cheerfully and without the slightest hint of shame. "Nights get cold in this part of the world, I was newly wedded, and while it wasn't an accident, it was rather impulsive. I don't regret it, but it's only because of our gifts and the den matron's care that Hotaru turned out as well as she has despite being fostered for most of her young life and by and large doesn't resent me for it." Hotaru's expression tells quite a different story, but Hisako is oblivious to her daughter's fuming in her cheerfully ditzy fashion. But with both mother and daughter standing and facing you, you're able to compare them side by side — Hisako's a little shorter than Hotaru and far wirier and leanly muscled, unsurprising considering the differences in their lives. [hotaru.isMILF |But when it comes to the rest... well, Hotaru might once have been comparable to her mother. Now, though? She's MILFed out so readily, so intensely that Hisako can't compare. Sure, Kohaku and you might've given her a push, but Hotaru's three sizes put her mother's to shame, and Hisako's no slouch, either. Your gaze turns between Hotaru and Hisako, then finally to little Kaori in Hotaru's arms. If the trend continues... one can only wonder if two decades from now, your daughter will be beating off suitors with that same deadpan expression on her little face. No wonder Komari's been interested in the generational changes that've taken root in the lineages under her charge. |But when it comes to overall body shape and silhouette... well, you can see where Hotaru got her three sizes from, as befits the stereotype of a foreign-born fox. Both mother and daughter buzz with an intense sense of mania, and while Hisako rambles on you get that feeling you sometimes have with Hotaru, that of a pot bubbling over. Only unlike Hotaru, it's got a happy, cheerful bent to it, the kind of destructive maelstrom that'll leave a trail of destruction in its wake with its innocence whole and conscience untarnished. ] Wow. Come to think of it, have you really spent that much time around Hotaru that you're able to pick up on her family's neuroses that easily? "...So there I was,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Hisako continues, having sat herself back down and nattered on while you were occupied with your own thoughts. "By the time I realized what was happening, Hotaru was already halfway out of me. It happened all so quickly, I barely had enough time to set out a sheet before the rest of her followed, lively little kit that she was. Common sense would say that prospecting isn't a pregnant vixen should do, but sometimes common sense isn't the be-all-end-all of things, wouldn't you say? The exercise I got during those months did the both of us good." "Mom, you're not a prospector. You do adventurer things and the search for good iron was always just a pretext to get you and Dad out the door. The natives are only interested in copper and tin; Kohaku's laid her hands on far more than you've ever found by trading for what the locals consider mining waste. Prospectors don't regale their daughters with tales of derring-do in their letters home." You'd imagine Hotaru's mom detailing the circumstances of her birth would be far more mortifying than what she labels her profession, but then again if mother is anything like daughter, she sure has her priorities in order... Hisako happily ignores her daughter. "I couldn't have been gone more than two hours at most; my husband and the Kobayahis were so shocked when I returned to our camp with a flatter belly and a kit in my arms. Thoroughly unsanitary doing it out in the wild and alone to boot, but it's not as if I had a choice, right? I was surprised myself at how fast it happened... but I think my daughter took her time with Kaori's birth, didn't she? Or at least that's what the Kobayashi girl said when she recounted the affair in considerable detail. A lot of screaming and burning everything within reach, I hear. Hours of miserable agony. Hotaru, I always said you needed to get more exercise, but [hotaru.isMILF |you've let yourself go to the point where you've gotten all fat from the neck down |you keep on insisting on being a homebody and letting others come to you ]. That's not a healthy way to live." Keeping her smile fixed rigidly on her face, Hotaru turns to you apologetically. "I'm so sorry about my mom. Barely a few days home, and she's already lecturing me on how to live. As for Kohaku, I am so going to [hotaru.isMILF |finish the job I started and ]snap her little lying neck." You share a glance with Kaori in her mother's arms, and the deadpan look of exasperation your infant daughter gives you mirrors the heavy churning in the pit of your stomach. Two decades of growing up, cared for adults prone to such antics — children caring for, well, Kaori is a child regardless of being born old. "

rows.original: If she wouldn't mind? Hisako blinks and stops mid-sentence, pausing several seconds before realizing she's been monopolizing the conversation for far too long. "Ah! [pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?" All in all... is she satisfied with how things have turned out? Contrary to what you'd expect of a kitsune in such a delicate situation, Hisako doesn't hesitate to reply. "Oh! I am! Hotaru's turned out so well despite me and her father being away all the time, and I didn't think she'd be so filial as to uh, actually do it. Well, the desire was genuine, but I wasn't really expecting —" Hotaru deflates. "Mom." "It's quite like us, I'd say. Our line has never been one to take the well-trod path because of our gifts." Good. If the elder Sadakata is going to be retiring and hanging around these parts, then at the very least you can head off any friction between mother and daughter ahead of time. [pc.ra kitsune |"So, your Eminence..." Yes? Hisako clasps her hands, looking every bit the picture of an airhead. "About what I said regarding my daughter being your concubine — that wasn't wholly in jest. Since she's gone so far as to bear you a kit, uh, she and Kaori would benefit from you extending your wing over them. I think that's how the Belharan saying goes? Make sure they receive what they need, benefit from your station a little to make life easier." Well, since she's being honest, she deserves a honest reply. And you're going to repeat yourself: while you would be willing — she's not wrong in that Hotaru's your concubine in all but name — a creature like Hotaru would also chafe in concubinage. Her daughter's come this far without feeling obliged to you, or at least as far as is possible given your difference in station, and you want to keep it that way. The informality's part of what you like about her, and while you're sure Hotaru would agree to concubinage for you, you also don't want to crush her spirit. "Oh. Okay!" For someone pushing so hard on the point, that was a pretty quick capitulation. Why, does she intend to give Hotaru a little brother or sister, then? "Despite what my daughter says, I'm not that old that it's impossible, so..." |"One more thing." Yes? "I repeat myself: I can see why Hotaru picked you instead of any of her own. These last two decades, her father and I have travelled around much of this continent, and you're the first [pc.race] we've met that has this certain, uh, something about you. Don't know what it is — I'm tempted to say it's a gift like those that've been bestowed upon my line, but I wouldn't wish that burden on anyone." Like was mentioned, you have to be special in order to waltz in and out of this den of foxes as you please. "That's not the same thing. I'm just hoping that... well, my ancestors were never very orthodox even before we left for the colonies. This has only become more true... what, six generations on now? So yes, please continue to treat her well." ] "I think that's enough for now, Mom. You've come onto [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship |[pc.name] ] pretty strongly ever since [pc.heShe] arrived, it's a lot to take in all at once." "Yes, yes. I've been talking far too much. Have I? Oh, it doesn't matter — you want to be alone with [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship |[pc.name] ], don't you dear? This old woman will just get out of your way, then; I've been imposing on you for quite a few hours now." How thoughtful of her. That being said... presumably Hisako is going to be around the den for good, or at least until she and Kohaku's parent decide they weren't really intending to retire just yet. Presumably she's not staying with Hotaru, so..." "Dear gods, no," Hotaru groans. "I'd never get any work done if Mom and Dad were staying with me. Not that I have any space for it — since my sleeping chambers are still being worked on, there's barely enough room in this home for Kaori and me." Hisako beams. "It's fine, we get out and about; so many years of sleeping under the stars means beds are uncomfortable anyway. We're better than to impose on our daughters, especially with how tiny their homes are. At least Hotaru's done better than the Kobayashi girl, who has to live in her workplace. Now that's truly miserable, isn't it?" Hotaru's gaze turns between her mother, you, and the various sewing knickknacks and scraps of cloth that you know are carefully just tucked out of sight. And that's not to mention the smell of mulberries in the air... "[pc.ra kitsune |No disrespect, your Eminence, but p |P ]eople don't find Mom[pc.ra kitsune | |, [pc.name] ]," Hotaru says at last. "Mom finds them. I'll try to get the message across if you ever have need of her." You turn to Hisako, but the elder Sadakata is already on her feet and bowing to you; you don't have time to return the gesture before Hotaru embarrassedly ushers her mother out of the sitting room. A few minutes later, the seamstress returns, tucks in her tails, and plops down on her cushion with a huge exasperated groan. "I'm sorry for all of that, my mom is such a ditz. She really means well, it's just that... well, there's a lot of emptiness under those ears of hers. If not for her gift keeping her and our folks alive, I don't think she'd have survived all these years to be able to retire." If not for her gift, she wouldn't be an airhead to begin with. That brings a small, tired smile to Hotaru's face. "Ha. Yes. We all have our burdens to bear. I've seen how Kaori looks at people sometimes, especially me, and I can't help but wonder if I embarrass her as much as Mom embarrasses me. "Anyway, enough of that; I'm sure Mom will show up again like the adventurer she is if you ever have need of her. Now, it's our time — why'd you even drop by to begin with, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?"
rows.translation: 如果她不介意的话…… 希纱子眨了眨眼，话说到一半突然停住了，过了几秒钟才意识到自己已经占据了整个谈话的主动权太久了。“啊！ [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]总而言之……她对目前的结果感到满意吗？ 与人们对于处于这种困境中的狐妖的预期不同，希纱子毫不犹豫地回答道：“哦！我非常满意！尽管我和她的父亲一直不在她身边， 萤还是成长得如此出色，而且她还表现得如此孝顺，真的做到了我期望她做到的事情。嗯，这份愿望确实是发自内心的，但我其实并没有预料到会这样—— 萤的情绪瞬间低落下来：“妈妈。” “我觉得这和我们很像。因为我们的天赋，我们这一代人从来都不会选择那些大家都在走的常规道路。” 很好。如果年长的Sadakata打算退休后继续留在这一带，那么至少你可以提前避免母亲和女儿之间发生任何矛盾。 [pc.ra kitsune |那么，阁下……” “有什么事？” 希纱子双手交叠在胸前，活脱脱就是一个傻大姐的形象。“关于我提到让我的女儿成为您的妾室这件事——那并非完全是开玩笑的。既然她不惜为你生下孩子，那么她和香织都应该得到你的帮助和支持。我想贝尔哈兰人有这样一句俗话吧？就是要确保她们得到所需的一切，让她们能够稍微受益于你的帮助，从而让生活变得更容易一些。嗯，既然她这么诚实，那么她也应该得到一个诚实的回答。而你的话又会重复一遍：虽然你愿意——她说得没错，毕竟萤名义上虽然是你的妾室，但实际上已经相当于你的妻子了。像萤这样的性格，若一直处于妾室的地位，肯定会感到不满。你的女儿能够走到今天这一步，也没有觉得对自己有什么义务，至少在你们这种身份差距的情况下，她已经做到了最好。而你，也确实希望保持这种现状。她的这种随性正是你喜欢她的地方之一。虽然你确信萤会同意与你建立这种关系，但你也不想打击她的积极性。 “哦，好吧！” 对于一个一直在坚持自己立场的人来说，这样的迅速让步确实有些出乎意料。那么，她是打算给萤找个弟弟或妹妹吗？ “不管我女儿怎么说，我并不这么打算。那个古老到已经无法改变，所以…… |还有一件事。” “什么事？” “我再说一遍：我明白为什么萤会选择你，而不是她自己的其他亲人。在过去的二十年里，我和她的父亲走遍了这个大陆的大部分地区，而你是第一个[pc.race]我们遇到过这样的人，他们身上有种特别的特质。我不知道具体是什么——我甚至想说，这或许是一种天赋，就像那些遗传给我的特质一样，但我也不愿让任何人承受这样的负担。 正如之前所说，要想随心所欲地进出这个充满狡猾之人的圈子，你本身就必须具备一些特别的特质。 那不是一回事。我只是希望……嗯，其实在我们前往殖民地之前，我的祖先们就从来都不是那种守旧的人。这种性格特点在我们这一代人身上表现得更加明显了……已经六代了，对吧？所以，请你们继续好好对待她吧。" ] 妈妈，我觉得现在这样就够了。你已经做得够多了。 [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.mf |大人 |夫人 ]运输 |[pc.name] ]从那以后，我的想法就一直很明确。 [pc.heShe]到了，一下子要接受这么多信息确实有点困难。” “是的，是的。我确实说得太多了吧？哦，没关系——你应该是想独自待一会儿吧。 [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.mf |大人 |夫人 ]运输 |[pc.name] ]你不会这么做的吧，亲爱的？那么这个老妇人就不再打扰你们了……我已经打扰你们好几个小时了。” 她真是太体贴了。不过……看来希纱子应该会一直待在那个小屋里，至少直到她和琥珀的父母决定让她离开为止。真的看来她并不打算现在就退休吧。那么，她应该不会和萤住在一起吧……” “天啊，千万别这样，”萤呻吟道，“如果爸爸妈妈和我住在一起，我根本就没法工作了。当然，我也并不是说他们拥有实在没有地方容纳我们了——因为我的卧室还在建设中，家里几乎已经没有足够的空间让香织和我住了。” 雅子开心地笑了：“没关系，我们可以在外面活动；这么多年在星空下睡觉，已经让我们习惯了床铺并不舒适的环境。我们总不能给女儿们带来麻烦，尤其是她们的住处那么小。至少萤比小林家的女孩要好，她竟然不得不在工作场所生活。那就是真是太糟糕了，不是吗？” 萤的目光在她的母亲、你，以及那些你明知被仔细地藏了起来、却依然显眼地摆在那里的缝纫工具和布片之间来回移动。更不用说空气中弥漫着的桑树的味道了[pc.ra kitsune |恕我直言，阁下，但是…… |P ]人们找不到妈妈[pc.ra kitsune | |， [pc.name] ]热田终于开口说道：‘妈妈会找到他们的。如果你们有需要，我会尽力帮你们把消息传达到妈妈那里。’” 你转向希纱子，但年长的贞孝已经站了起来，向你鞠躬；你还没来得及回礼，热田就尴尬地带着她的母亲走出了客厅。几分钟后，那位裁缝回来了，她整理好自己的衣角，然后气呼呼地坐在垫子上。 “真为这一切感到抱歉，我妈妈就是个傻瓜。她其实是好意，只是……就是这样而已。嗯，她的耳朵下面其实空空如也。要不是因为她那特殊的能力让她和我们的家人活了下来，我想她根本不可能活到现在，更不可能退休了。 要不是因为她那能力，她本来就不会是个傻瓜。 这让萤的脸上浮现出一丝疲惫而微弱的微笑。“哈，没错。我们每个人都有自己的负担要承担。我曾经注意到香织看别人的眼神，尤其是看我的时候，我不由会想：我是否像妈妈让我感到尴尬那样，也让她感到难堪呢？ 不管怎样，这些就说到这里吧。我相信，如果你们真的需要妈妈的帮助，她一定会像那位勇敢的冒险家一样再次出现来帮助你们的。现在，该我们的时间——你当初究竟为什么还要过来呢？ [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]？"

Keros rocks back and forth lazily on the well-tended grass, his tails rolling about in his wake. "Nice woman, just too serious for my tastes." You can see why. |"I... guess it can't hurt?" Brint scratches the back of his head and shrugs helplessly. "I dunno. In Khor'minos it's the women who mostly handle these things, religion and all. If he wants to talk to you and you can just walk away, I don't see the problem." |"I... guess it can't hurt?" Brienne scratches the back of her head and shrugs helplessly. "I dunno. In Khor'minos it's the women who mostly handle these things, religion and all, so I never really got into these matters growing up — I guess I'll have to learn sometime now, won't I? But if he wants to talk to you and you can just walk away, I don't see the problem." |"I... can't say I have anything against it," Quintillus says at last. "Sure, I wouldn't trust him as far as I could throw him, but you could've said the same of me and chose to give me a chance when everyone in Hawkethorne wouldn't so much as look at me twice. rows.translation: 当你穿过那些花园时，一种不安的感觉突然涌上心头。[pc.hasEmoteEars |你的耳朵开始不由自主地抽动起来。 ] ——这并非预示着即将到来的危险，也没有什么紧迫而急切的事情，但仍然让人感到不安。某种超自然的吸引力迫使你将视线从眼前的小路移开，看向那一片修剪整齐的草地和花坛，以及米可和麻衣为保持神社花园的完美状态而付出的不懈努力。 你当然认识他；他的形象被刻在了姐妹们精心照料的小神龛里。凯罗斯躺在那片柔软的草地上，用尾巴当垫子，尽情地享受着片刻的宁静[dayNight |云监控 |观星 ]那个被称为“戏弄者”或“中央天界的奥古斯特大师”的存在，正如米可会称呼他的那样，正懒洋洋地用一只手向你招手，而他的那条白色毛茸茸的尾巴也在做着同样的动作。 "[pc.name]请稍等片刻，好吗？ [party.hasCompanions |你回首望去[party.compNames]也无需犹豫；凯洛斯会理解你的担忧，并会让你放心。你想带谁来听都行，我又不是想把这件事保密起来。 |他说话的方式确实会让人陷入思考，或者也许，你对这位被称为“骗子”的神明所说的话，天生就会保持警惕。凯罗斯注意到了你的犹豫，于是咧嘴一笑，消除了你的顾虑。看来我的名声已经传开了。别担心，我并不会真的咬你的头什么的。 ]我只有一个提议，你或许有兴趣听一听。不过，如果你不感兴趣的话……嗯，也没什么损失，对吧？ 也许吧。也许也不一定。正如俗话所说，在与那些有权势的人打交道时，你必须保持警惕。并不是因为他们有可能不履行自己的承诺，而是因为有很多例子表明，有些人确实得到了他们想要的一切——不仅完全符合协议的规定，也完全符合其精神实质。 嗯，确实是这样。人们想要的东西有时候可能会带来危险。大多数人也缺乏这样的智慧——不一定是指智力，而是那种能够判断自己想要的东西是否与自己的实际需求相符合的智慧。但就像我说的，这只是一种观点而已；如果你不喜欢，你随时都可以离开。 他有没有习惯向别人提出各种提议呢？[pc.bg acolyte | 等等，不。这是个愚蠢的问题——他当然是这样的。毕竟你接受的是宗教教育，而即便抛开这些因素不谈，他那些非凡的功绩所流传下来的故事，也足以证明这一点。 那个狡猾的角色露出了一丝狼一般的笑容。那么你也应该明白，除非你做了值得受到这种对待的事情，否则我绝对不会对你采取任何行动。没有什么好担心的，对吧？ | 那个狡猾的角色向你露出了狼一般的笑容。无论是对高贵的人，还是对平凡的人；无论是对地位高的人，还是对地位低的人。这种公平的交易，往往只是为了看看他们的反应，了解他们真正看中什么。毕竟，我可是那七个最喜欢与普通人打交道的人之一，不是吗？ ] [party.hasCompanions |你回首望去[party.compNames]用于输入。 ][party.randComp cait arona brint brienne quintillus einin atugia |凯特向你露出了鼓励的微笑。嘿，能有机会直接与一位神明交谈可不是每天都能遇到的。我真的很想有机会直接和马拉克对话，把我的一些问题都问清楚。嘿，凯罗斯，你能不能帮我联系上他呢？ 我可以这么做，但前提是我也需要你回报我一个恩惠。你知道，对于我来说，这类事情就是这样的。另外，他更喜欢自己来决定出现的时间和地点。你觉得自己对自己的信念有足够的信心吗？ 这让凯特有些犹豫，她那只粉红色的小猫的热情显然大大减弱了。哦，嗯，也许我改天会再问一次吧。不过，是的[pc.name]，我觉得，至少听他把话说完，应该不会有什么问题。 |阿罗娜只是耸了耸肩，然后哼了一声。别那样看着我，这些事情都是赫蕾莎在负责处理的。据我所知，她其实从未真正见过卢米娅，但作为她的祭司，她做得还算不错。 那个人对待她的追随者相当不错，口碑也不错。我们之间的关系并不是十分融洽，但这也是可以理解的。凯罗斯懒洋洋地在修剪整齐的草地上来回滚动，它的尾巴在身后不断摆动。是个不错的女人，只是太严肃了，不符合我的口味。 你现在应该明白为什么了。 |我……想应该没什么坏处吧？布林特挠了挠后脑勺，无奈地耸了耸肩。我也不太清楚。在科尔米诺斯，这些事情大多是由女性来处理的，包括宗教相关的事务。如果他想和你谈话，而你可以直接走开，我觉得没什么问题。 |我……想应该没什么坏处吧？布蕾妮挠了挠后脑勺，无奈地耸了耸肩。我也不太清楚。在科尔米诺斯，这些事情大多是由女性来处理的，包括宗教相关的事务，所以我在成长过程中其实从未真正接触过这些领域——我想现在我总得学一学了，对吧？不过如果他想和你谈话，而你只是简单地走开，我觉得应该没什么问题。 |我……不能说我反对这个提议。昆蒂卢斯终于开口说道。当然，我对他根本不会信任，甚至会认为他完全不可信赖；但你对我的看法也应该是同样的，可当鹰棘镇的所有人都连看我一眼都不愿意的时候，你还是选择了给我一个机会。你真是个容易轻信那些根本不值得信任的人的人[pc.name]……所以，不妨先听他把话说完吧。毕竟他说过你可以随时离开的。 |艾宁双臂交叉，咬着嘴唇。我一点也不信任他。这种自称是神明的人，还不断提出各种条件……换作是我，早就走开了，但你对于神明的信仰显然比我深厚得多。 [pc.name]只要小心点就行，好吗？别被人骗了或被耍了——知己知彼，我想说我对这个角色可是相当了解的。 哦，现在你才明白啊。 |我会给他一个机会的。当你将目光投向她时，阿图吉娅如此说道。人们总是对卡门说各种各样的坏话，但只要你真正了解她，就会发现她其实是个很好的人。你不应该相信那些道听途说的言论，也不应该根据那些话来评判别人。这样做只会浪费你的一点时间而已。 ]
