rows.original: All right, you'll hear him out. "Excellent!" Keros beams and claps his hands. "Join me on the grass?" You do so, [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames] settling down beside you as you smooth out a spot to make yourself comfortable on |smoothing out a spot for you to be comfortable on ]. Now, what's this all about? "What else, but the state of your immortal soul? Ah, but in a different context than your average annoying preacher might put it. You see, we've become aware of the situation in which you've become entangled in. There are various forces out there which would like, for their own reasons, to forcibly extricate your soul from your person. That particular aspect of you's quite the fascinating natural phenomenon, that can't be denied. That's also in light of the matter of your constant mutability given the magical residue that hangs about you — it must be terribly tiring to constantly worry about changing from anything you put in your mouth, mustn't it?" Where is he going with this? He claps excitedly. "Like I said, I have an offer of a solution for you. Demons and horrors from the void between the spheres can't quite devour your precious, immortal soul if you don't keep it on you. Someone could safely extricate it from you and hold it in safekeeping — that way, you could go out and face these nasty characters without fear of accidentally empowering them considerably by your demise, am I not wrong?" So basically, he wants your soul for himself. "There are worse fates that could befall it than putting it to good use in the right hands, and getting quite a number of boons in exchange. Everything must be equitable and reciprocal, after all. At this point, you must know it's quite valuable to the people to realize its worth, so I wouldn't even bother trying to undercut you in that regard. For someone with my reputation to deal with you straightforwardly — it is quite a gesture of goodwill, isn't it?" Whether you agree or not, the thought of you not having your soul inside of you is disquieting, frankly. "It's something you've known all your life, that is to be sure. Change, even when it's for the better, has to overcome inertia in order to be realized. And frankly, being soulless isn't necessarily all that terrible as it's cut out as being. After all, every kitsune is technically soulless." Keros gestures out over the fields [dayNight|and the figures toiling in the paddies|and the rest of the den at large]. "Their state of being is as natural to them as yours is to you. What you consider normal isn't necessarily so for other people." You swallow hard. If that's true... but then why aren't they rampaging demons, then? From everything you know, the soul is what gives you your ability to empathize, your compassion and moral compass. It is also what binds the body into the shape of, well, you. When lost, that essence — what some might call your humanity, for lack of a better term — is lost. "Why, you're quite learned on the subject. Yes, sometimes they do, hence the concept of being declared no-face. Over centuries, the judgement has been passed down on other heinous or shameful acts... but its original purpose was to mark those of mine who had lost their connection to... well, perhaps a communal soul would be the best way to put it." A communal soul. That's the first you've heard of such a thing. "It is a natural quirk of their being which makes them the way they are. By banding together, they are strengthened in certain metaphysical aspects at the cost of losing their individuality in the same arena. It's the reason why my favored people, for example, are impervious to many transformative effects, or why they always breed true. But individually, all of my favored folk are dead inside. In order to maintain that link, they must feed. So no. If you allow your soul to join with all the others... you will not be lost to yourself. "Now then, what metaphor would be appropriate... ah, I have it. Imagine, if you will, that you're a cup." Keros presses his palms together, and when he draws them apart there's indeed a cup in his grasp, one of those tall lacquered tea cups done in the Old Country style. You watch it closely, still wary as to what he's about. "Now then, let's say that the cup is filled with water." And in the blink of an eye, it is. No gradual filling, no coalescence — one moment the cup is empty, and then it isn't, filled to the brim with the freshest, cleanest, most pristine water that you know it can't possibly be real. Water that pure doesn't exist, and if it did it'd taste off and foul for being that clean. "What I would like to do is to drink the water..." He tips his head back and downs the cup's contents in one gulp, smacking his lips when he's done and reclining back into his self-made nest of fluffy tails. Keros holds out the ceramic cup to you, clearly expecting you to take it; you do just that. "...And then after that, the cup remains a cup." You test the cup in your hands. It's heavy, it's real. It is, very undeniably, a cup in every aspect of cup-ness that you can bring to mind. Of course, it's empty now save for a few drops and a wet sheen on the cup's interior, but that's the point, isn't it? "Well, did that serve to illustrate what I'm trying to get across?" Maybe. "The cup does not need the water, nor does it feel its loss; if anything, it is freer for being unburdened. Place your soul in safekeeping with me, allow it to join in harmony with that of every other kitsune who has ever existed, and in doing so strengthen all the others. In return, you will be recompensed for your troubles with various boons I can provide. That is the long and short of the offer I am making."
rows.translation: 好吧，你会听他把话说完的。 太棒了！凯罗斯举起手来，拍手庆祝。一起来到草地上吧？ 你这样做吧。 [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames]当你找了一个舒适的地方坐下来时，我就挨着你坐了下来。 |为您安排一个舒适的环境，让您能够安心地待着。 ]那么，这一切到底是为了什么呢？ 还能是什么呢，不就是你那不朽灵魂的处境吗？啊，不过我的表达方式可能与那些烦人的传教士有所不同。你看，我们已经了解到你目前所处的困境。外面有各种各样的势力，它们出于各自的理由，都想强行将你的灵魂从你的身体中分离出来。你身上的这一特点确实是一种非常有趣的自然现象，这一点不可否认。考虑到你身上始终存在着那种神奇的影响，你身体不断发生变化，这也确实让人感到十分疲惫吧？毕竟，每次吃了什么东西之后，都不得不担心自己会因此发生变化，这样的生活肯定很辛苦吧？" 他这么做到底想达到什么目的呢？ 他兴奋地拍起手来。正如我所说，我有一个解决方案可以提供给你。如果你不将你那珍贵的、不朽的灵魂带在身上，那些来自位面间隙的恶魔与恐怖生物就无法将其吞噬。有人可以安全地将你的灵魂取出并妥善保管，这样你就可以毫无顾虑地去面对那些讨厌的家伙们，而不用担心自己的死亡会无意中增强它们的力量，我说得对吧？ 所以，本质上来说，他是想要你的灵魂。 比起让它在合适的人手中得到妥善利用并因此获得诸多好处，还有更糟糕的结局等着它。毕竟，一切都应该是公平且互惠的。现在，你们应该已经意识到，让人们认识到它的价值其实是非常有意义的，所以我甚至都不会考虑在这方面压低你们的价格。对于像我这样的人来说，坦诚地与你们交易，其实已经是一种表示善意的举动了，不是吗？ 不管你是否认同，坦率地说，认为你没有将自己的灵魂融入到自己的生活中，这种想法确实会让人感到不安。 这肯定是你一生都明白的一点：变革，即便是向更好的方向发展，也必须克服惯性才能真正实现。坦白说，没有灵魂并不一定就是那么糟糕的事情，至少从某种角度来看是这样。毕竟，每一个狐妖都是严格来说毫无灵魂。凯罗斯朝那些田野的方向做了个手势。 [dayNight|以及在稻田里辛勤劳作的农民们|还有窝里的其他成员们]。 他们的这种生存状态对他们来说，就如同你的生存状态对你一样自然。你认为正常的事情，对别人来说未必也是如此。 你艰难地咽了口唾沫。如果那是真的……那么为什么它们不会变成肆虐的恶魔呢？根据你所知道的一切，灵魂才是赋予你共情能力、同情心以及道德准则的东西。它也是将身体凝聚成特定形态的关键所在。你当这种本质——有些人可能会称之为“人性”，因为没有更好的词语来表达它——丧失之时，一切也就随之消失了。 哎呀，你在这个话题上还真挺有见地的。没错，有时候他们确实会确实因此，才有了“被宣告为无面者”这一概念。几个世纪以来，这一判决也被用来指代其他那些极其恶劣或可耻的行为……但它的初衷，其实是用来标记那些与嗯，或许用“共同体灵魂”来形容最为恰当……失去了与这种共同体灵魂联系的人。 一个共同的灵魂。你应该是第一次听说这种东西吧。 这种天生的特性使他们成为了现在的样子。当他们团结在一起时，确实在某些抽象的层面上得到了强化，但与此同时，他们在这些方面失去了自身的个性。这就是为什么我偏爱的那些生物能够抵抗许多变形效果，或者为什么它们总是能够生育出与自己一模一样的后代。但就我个人而言，我所喜爱的那些人，他们的内心都已经空虚了。为了维持那种联系，他们就必须不断地“摄取”某些东西。所以，不行。如果你让自己的灵魂与那些人融为一体……你就不会再迷失自我了。 那么，用什么比喻才合适呢……啊，我想到了。你可以想象自己是一只杯子。 凯罗斯将双手掌心相对，当他分开双手时，手中确实出现了一个茶杯——一个那种高高的、漆面光滑的、具有传统风格的茶杯。你仔细观察着他的一举一动，依然对他接下来要做什么心存疑虑。 那么，我们就假设这个杯子里面装满了水吧。 转眼间，它就变成了那样。没有逐渐充满的过程，也没有任何融合的迹象——前一刻杯子还是空的，下一刻就已经被最纯净、最清澈的水填得满满的，这种水的纯净程度简直让人觉得不真实。如此纯净的水根本不存在，就算真的存在，它的味道也一定会很糟糕、很难喝。那个干净。 我想做的就是喝掉那杯水…… 他仰起头，一饮而尽杯中的液体，喝完后还咂了咂嘴，然后又靠回自己用那些柔软的尾巴堆成的“小窝”里。凯洛斯把那个陶瓷杯递给你，显然是在期待你接过来；你也就照做了。 ……之后，那个杯子依然只是个杯子而已。 你将这个杯子拿在手中仔细端详。它很重，确实是个实实在在的杯子。从任何你能想到的与“杯子”相关的特征来看，它确实就是一个杯子，这一点毋庸置疑。当然，现在它里面什么也没有，只有几滴水以及杯内壁留下的湿痕，但这就是关键所在，不是吗？ 嗯，这样是不是能够说明我想表达的意思了呢？ 也许吧。 这个杯子并不需要水，也不会感受到失去水的痛苦；相反，没有了负担，它反而更加自由。把你的灵魂托付给我，让它与所有曾经存在过的狐妖的灵魂融为一体，这样就能增强他们所有的力量。作为回报，我能够为你提供各种恩惠，来补偿你所经历的种种困扰。这就是我提出的这个提议的要点。
rows.raw: " All right, you'll hear him out. "Excellent!" Keros beams and claps his hands. "Join me on the grass?" You do so, [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames] settling down beside you as you smooth out a spot to make yourself comfortable on |smoothing out a spot for you to be comfortable on ]. Now, what's this all about? "What else, but the state of your immortal soul? Ah, but in a different context than your average annoying preacher might put it. You see, we've become aware of the situation in which you've become entangled in. There are various forces out there which would like, for their own reasons, to forcibly extricate your soul from your person. That particular aspect of you's quite the fascinating natural phenomenon, that can't be denied. That's also in light of the matter of your constant mutability given the magical residue that hangs about you — it must be terribly tiring to constantly worry about changing from anything you put in your mouth, mustn't it?" Where is he going with this? He claps excitedly. "Like I said, I have an offer of a solution for you. Demons and horrors from the void between the spheres can't quite devour your precious, immortal soul if you don't keep it on you. Someone could safely extricate it from you and hold it in safekeeping — that way, you could go out and face these nasty characters without fear of accidentally empowering them considerably by your demise, am I not wrong?" So basically, he wants your soul for himself. "There are worse fates that could befall it than putting it to good use in the right hands, and getting quite a number of boons in exchange. Everything must be equitable and reciprocal, after all. At this point, you must know it's quite valuable to the people to realize its worth, so I wouldn't even bother trying to undercut you in that regard. For someone with my reputation to deal with you straightforwardly — it is quite a gesture of goodwill, isn't it?" Whether you agree or not, the thought of you not having your soul inside of you is disquieting, frankly. "It's something you've known all your life, that is to be sure. Change, even when it's for the better, has to overcome inertia in order to be realized. And frankly, being soulless isn't necessarily all that terrible as it's cut out as being. After all, every kitsune is technically soulless." Keros gestures out over the fields [dayNight|and the figures toiling in the paddies|and the rest of the den at large]. "Their state of being is as natural to them as yours is to you. What you consider normal isn't necessarily so for other people." You swallow hard. If that's true... but then why aren't they rampaging demons, then? From everything you know, the soul is what gives you your ability to empathize, your compassion and moral compass. It is also what binds the body into the shape of, well, you. When lost, that essence — what some might call your humanity, for lack of a better term — is lost. "Why, you're quite learned on the subject. Yes, sometimes they do, hence the concept of being declared no-face. Over centuries, the judgement has been passed down on other heinous or shameful acts... but its original purpose was to mark those of mine who had lost their connection to... well, perhaps a communal soul would be the best way to put it." A communal soul. That's the first you've heard of such a thing. "It is a natural quirk of their being which makes them the way they are. By banding together, they are strengthened in certain metaphysical aspects at the cost of losing their individuality in the same arena. It's the reason why my favored people, for example, are impervious to many transformative effects, or why they always breed true. But individually, all of my favored folk are dead inside. In order to maintain that link, they must feed. So no. If you allow your soul to join with all the others... you will not be lost to yourself. "Now then, what metaphor would be appropriate... ah, I have it. Imagine, if you will, that you're a cup." Keros presses his palms together, and when he draws them apart there's indeed a cup in his grasp, one of those tall lacquered tea cups done in the Old Country style. You watch it closely, still wary as to what he's about. "Now then, let's say that the cup is filled with water." And in the blink of an eye, it is. No gradual filling, no coalescence — one moment the cup is empty, and then it isn't, filled to the brim with the freshest, cleanest, most pristine water that you know it can't possibly be real. Water that pure doesn't exist, and if it did it'd taste off and foul for being that clean. "What I would like to do is to drink the water..." He tips his head back and downs the cup's contents in one gulp, smacking his lips when he's done and reclining back into his self-made nest of fluffy tails. Keros holds out the ceramic cup to you, clearly expecting you to take it; you do just that. "...And then after that, the cup remains a cup." You test the cup in your hands. It's heavy, it's real. It is, very undeniably, a cup in every aspect of cup-ness that you can bring to mind. Of course, it's empty now save for a few drops and a wet sheen on the cup's interior, but that's the point, isn't it? "Well, did that serve to illustrate what I'm trying to get across?" Maybe. "The cup does not need the water, nor does it feel its loss; if anything, it is freer for being unburdened. Place your soul in safekeeping with me, allow it to join in harmony with that of every other kitsune who has ever existed, and in doing so strengthen all the others. In return, you will be recompensed for your troubles with various boons I can provide. That is the long and short of the offer I am making." "

rows.original: You're beginning to see where this is going. If you do take him up on his offer, will you need to feed as the kitsune do? "Well... no." That seems to contradict everything that he just told you about the communal soul of the foxen. "Like I said, there are those who are out there looking to acquire your soul for themselves, friend; it is such a brilliant, lovely thing that would spark avarice in anyone who has even an inkling of its potential. After removing your soul, I will fashion a very convincing decoy for you — enough to fool anyone who's looking for a while. And as with most deceptions, it is best built around the truth. You will not need to feed in such a fashion... but at the same time, while your physical mutability will be suppressed, I can't guarantee all transformations will be negated in that case. But if you should wind up changed and need help getting back to what you ought to be, return to me and I'll set you right. "There's no need to be overly concerned about the loss of your soul — not in this fashion, at least. You will retain your capability for empathy as well as any other kitsune — access to the benefits of having a soul, while not risking losing it to any number of never-do-wells looking to rob you of it." ... Keros grins and holds out his hands palms-up. "How about it? Consider my offer, if nothing else. Something you can't really use in and of itself in exchange for considerable boons and power. That, and a measure of respectability... give me your soul, swear yourself to me, and become one of mine. Learning the language and culture is still up to you... but everyone will be obligated to give you the respect you're due as my champion, should you take up the cause." That... "Don't give me your answer just yet; I understand that this kind of decision isn't to be rushed. You know how to get ahold of me, should you be tempted. Oh, and one last thing... "Should any of my colleagues make you a similar offer and you do take it up, don't bother bringing up the topic with me. You would not believe the number of people who've tried to do things like promise souls upon death and then try to find ways to never die, or promise themselves to everyone so a big argument breaks out over the rightful owner and no one can enforce the claim — that sort of nonsense to wriggle out of actually paying the dues for services rendered. Don't try that on us, we've seen it all and don't appreciate such bad faith, mm?" With that, the Trickster grabs two of his tails, and pulls them over himself in what should be an impossible folding of time and space. In the blink of an eye, he's folded himself upon himself, disappearing into thin air with the only sign that he was ever here a Keros-shaped indentation upon the [dayNight|sun|star]lit grass. You look around, but no one save [party.compNames] seems to have noticed that he was ever here to begin with. An offer, indeed. You are about to give up your soul. This is life-changing, and something that once you do, can never be taken back. In exchange, you will gain power, and certain parts of your body will become inert to transformations. Those around you, especially those closely related to your transformation, may view you in a different light. To review the details of what this particular transaction entails, consult Keros at his shrine anytime, so long as you have not already bound yourself to another in a similar fashion.
rows.translation: 你开始明白事情会朝着什么方向发展了。如果你接受了他的提议，那么你是否也需要像那只狐妖一样进食呢？ 嗯……不是的。 这似乎与他刚才所说的关于那些狐妖们所拥有的共同灵魂的一切观点相矛盾。 正如我所说，确实有一些人正在试图夺取你的灵魂，朋友。灵魂这种东西如此珍贵、如此美好，以至于任何意识到它价值的人都会被贪婪所驱使。在夺取了你的灵魂之后，我会为你制作一个非常逼真的诱饵——足以骗过那些搜寻你一段时间的人。就像大多数欺骗手段一样，最好的办法就是以事实为基础。你不需要用这种方式来误导他人……但与此同时，虽然你的身体变化会被抑制，但我也不能保证所有在这种情况下，那些变化将会被撤销。但如果你真的发生了改变，需要帮助才能恢复到原本的状态，那就来找我，我会帮你把事情纠正过来。 没有必要过于担心自己的灵魂会丢失——至少以这种方式来说并非如此。你依然会保持像其他狐妖一样具备的同理心，也能享受到拥有灵魂所带来的种种好处，而不会面临那些企图夺走你灵魂的卑鄙之徒带来的威胁。 凯罗斯咧嘴一笑，然后双手掌心向上地伸了出来。怎么样？至少可以考虑我的提议吧。这个提议本身或许并不能直接为你带来什么实际利益，但换来的却是巨大的好处与力量。此外，你还能获得一定的尊严与尊重……只要你把灵魂交给我，向我宣誓效忠，成为我的追随者。学习这种语言和文化则完全取决于你自己的意愿……但如果你接受了这个提议，所有人都会尊重你作为我的捍卫者应得的地位。 那个…… 先别急着给我答复，我知道这种决定确实不能草率做出。如果你有需要，你知道怎么联系我。哦，还有一件事…… 如果我的任何同事向你提出类似的邀请，而你接受了的话，就不用再跟我提这件事了。你不会希望我……的。相信那些试图通过承诺死后将灵魂献给某人来逃避履行应尽义务的人，或者试图向所有人做出承诺，从而导致关于谁才是这些承诺的合法拥有者的激烈争论，最终却没人能够执行这些承诺——这类荒谬的行为其实都是为了逃避为所获得的服务支付应有的费用。别想对我们耍这种把戏，我们都见多了，我们可不喜欢这种缺乏诚意的行为，明白吗？ 说着，这个骗子抓住自己的两条尾巴，将它们拉到自己身上，完成了一个看似不可能的时间与空间折叠。转瞬间，他就把自己完全包裹在了自己体内，消失得无影无踪。唯一能证明他曾经存在过的痕迹，就是地上留下的那个呈凯洛斯形状的凹痕[dayNight|太阳|星星]点燃的草丛。你环顾四周，却发现除了自己之外，根本没有其他人。 [party.compNames]似乎有人注意到了，他其实从一开始就在这里。 确实，这是一个提议。 你即将放弃自己的灵魂。这一举动会改变你的人生，而且一旦做出选择，就再也无法挽回了。作为交换，你将获得力量，同时你身体的某些部位也将不再能够发生变形。你周围的人，尤其是那些与你的这种变化密切相关的人，可能会以不同的方式来看待你。 如果你想要了解这笔具体交易的具体细节，随时都可以去凯罗斯的神龛前向他咨询，只要你还没有以同样的方式与另一个人订立类似的协议而已。

rows.original: As you make to move past [var0 |Miko and Mai |Mai |Miko ] into the little shrine, a wave of unease washes over you. This is a heavy decision, and one that you won't be able to walk back once you take it. You still have time to back out and think about it some more; so long as you don't sell your soul to another of the Seven, there's no expiry date on Keros' offer. You think back on your conversation with him, and your mind's suddenly assailed by the knowledge of what he offered you, and what he expected in exchange: Your physical form will become that of a kitsune. You will never be able to change your race away from kitsune. As a result of stabilising the portal magics which caused you to be highly mutable, transformations that fall into these categories, and sub-categories thereof, will be blocked and made ineffectual: face, head, limbs, wings, tail and body. Some transformations may slip through nevertheless; if you wish to change or realign your form, you may return to Keros to restore your form. You will become Soulbound. This signifies that you are dead inside and your soul has been claimed. While you will get a decoy implanted to fool your enemies, those of the Seven will know what's up and you will not be able to make any further deals of this nature, should they be offered.[silly| You do not get to pull an Elder Scrolls on these people, they've seen it all already.] Keros will name you his champion. This will significantly change the attitude of all kitsune towards you; you will be given the respect and deference that your station accords by decree of the August Master at the Center of Heaven. It will not make you magically fluent in the language and cultural nuances, but at least you will be properly revered as you ought to be. Now, knowing all this, will you still step up to the shrine?
rows.translation: 当你正要走过[var0 |米可与舞 |梅 |米可 ]身旁、走进那座小神龛时，一股不安的情绪涌上心头。这是一个沉重的决定，一旦做出就再也无法回头。你还有时间退出，再仔细考虑一下；只要你不把灵魂出卖给七神中的另一位，凯罗斯的提议就没有期限。你回想起与他的对话，脑海中突然浮现出他开出的条件，以及他期望得到的回报： 你的肉身将变为狐妖的形态。你将永远无法把种族从狐妖改为其他种族。 由于稳定了那些使你极易变形的传送门魔法，属于这些类别及其子类别的变形都会被阻止并失去效果：面部、头部、四肢、羽翼、尾巴以及身体。不过，仍有一些变形可能会漏过；如果你想要改变或重新调整自己的形态，可以回到凯罗斯那里来恢复你的形态。 你将变成“灵魂绑定者”。这意味着你内心已经死去，你的灵魂已被他人据为己有。虽然你会被植入一个替身来迷惑敌人，但七神会知道真相，而你将无法再进行任何此类交易——即使有人向你提出。[silly| 你可没法对这些人玩《上古卷轴》那一套，他们早就见怪不怪了。] 凯罗斯会册封你为他的冠军。这将显著改变所有狐妖对你的态度；依照天之中央尊主的敕令，你将获得与你身份相称的尊重与敬意。这不会让你神奇地通晓这种语言与文化中的细微之处，但至少你会得到应有的尊崇。 现在，知道了这一切，你还会走上那座神龛吗？

rows.original: You swallow hard, your feet feeling leaden, yet force yourself forward. Naturally, there's a sense of trepidation that follows you as you pace up the path and close the final few steps to the shrine, but you push it down. Given the nature of the tasks that lie ahead of you, you'll need every advantage available to you, and let's face it — you aren't really using your soul anyway. Sure, it might rankle a bit, but trading it away for some concrete benefits... perhaps it would be more palatable to think of it as a noble sacrifice. [party.has kiyoko |"Hesitating, beloved?" Your fox-wife slides on over and takes your hand in her own, giving it a small squeeze. You are. Just a moment to calm yourself, first... "It is natural... we prefer to stick with what we know, and a major change can seem frightening for simply being a change. People say that they want tomorrow to be better — that is not strictly true. More often than not, they want tomorrow to be like today, because one knows that one has lived through today." You squeeze her hand back. Yes, you know that it's going to be different, but you've made up your mind now. It's just that you need a little while to gather yourself, that's all. This whole affair is insane if you look at it rationally, but there cannot be bravery without at least a little madness, can there? Kiyoko smiles. ] [var0 |Miko and Mai greet you as you approach the shrine, both sisters approaching from either side of the path and giving you a bow in perfect unison |Mai greets you as you approach the shrine, setting aside the broom she's sweeping the flagstones with and giving you a bow in the flickering foxfire of the lanterns |Miko greets you as you approach the shrine, bowing so deeply that you wonder if her spine'll bend from the weight of her chest alone ]. "Well, ain't ya a sight to see, [pc.name]. Wouldn't have figured ya for th' devout type... but there ain't complainin' if'n ya want to pay yer respects to his divine lordship an' all." You think you're going to do more than just that — you have an appointment with Keros. Without waiting for a reply, you swish on past and step into the little kitsune shrine, coming to a stop before the altar and statue; it's a gesture that you think he would appreciate. No doubt you violated several important rites and rituals with regards to seeking an audience with him and breached several dozen unspoken rules of etiquette, but if you're going to sell your soul to the Trickster you may as well get into the spirit of things. Hey. Hey! Is anyone home? Nothing happens for a moment, then there's a dense heaviness in the air, the atmosphere within the shrine palpably pressing down on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. This is followed by a small pop of rushing air, and then Keros steps out from behind his statue, lazily climbing down from the dias on which it's set; he rolls his shoulders and gives you a lazy grin just as [var0 |Miko and Mai come rushing into the place after [party.combatNames], stopping as they see their patron deity apparate in the shrine. Lazily, Keros saunters up and slides smoothly between them both, grabbing the twin sisters by their waists and pulling them close to him. A mass of squirming fluff ensues as Miko and Mai yelp in mock protest, acting all huffy and outraged for all of three seconds before rubbing up against their patron deity, twining their tails with his. |Mai comes rushing into the place after [party.combatNames]. She stops as she sees her patron deity apparate in the shrine, then bows her head and slinks on up to Keros, hooking her hands about the crook of his arm — eagerly serving as arm candy while making little yipping, foxy noises in the back of her throat. The trickster smirks and gives his shrine maiden a pat on the head between the ears, which just makes her purr harder. |Miko comes rushing into the place after [party.combatNames]. She stops as she sees her patron deity apparate in the shrine, then lets out a little squeal as Keros gathers up his shrine maiden by about the waist and pulls her close, two of her tails instinctively wrapping about his legs. ] [party.has cait |"Look at [var0 |those two |her |her ] suck up to him," Cait whispers. "Completely shameless, I tell you. No different from kittens trying to win the temple matron's favor back home." Well, if Mallach were to apparate before her, wouldn't she want to be a deity's arm candy, if only for a little bit? It's an experience few actually have, if nothing else. "That's different!" ] "[pc.name]. I had a feeling you'd show up." Keros continues limbering up his body without a care for decorum or propriety, working out the kinks in his joints as if he'd just gotten out of bed. "If you wanted a personal audience, I take it you're here about the offer I made you?" Yes. You'll take him up on it. "Splendid!" [var0 |Keros disentangles himself from the sisters, reaching up to give the two of them a double headpat before prying himself loose of them |Keros reaches over and slowly pries Mai off his arm, sending her off with a smack on the ass with one of his tails |Keros ruffles Miko's hair, then sends her off with a slap on the ass before disentangling himself from her ]. "Now, I take it you know everything you're getting yourself into and still want this, so I won't patronise you by going through everything again. We can begin whenever you're ready — this is your last chance to back out, if you like." No, you didn't come all this way and meet him in person to get cold feet at the last moment. You take it that there's some long and involved ritual that's been handed down the generations for this sort of thing? "Actually, no. For all the rites and rituals that are involved in honoring me as a grand kami, this hasn't happened... well, not in living memory, certainly, and not often enough for there to be any formal or proper way of doing this. Shocking, I know, when it comes to my favored people; we'll just have to make it up as we go along. Isn't that fun?" [var0 |As one, the sisters bow. "We will be glad to be of any assistance during the proceedings, your divine lordship." |Mai bows. "I will be glad to be of any assistance during the proceedings, your divine lordship." |Miko bows. "I will be glad to be of any assistance during the proceedings, your divine lordship." ] "Good. You can stand there and look pretty. It lifts the spirits to be surrounded by beauty while you're working, makes the whole affair far more pleasant." You have to say, the frankness with which he conducts himself, while being completely at odds with how his chosen people behave in public, is refreshing at times. "Mm. Someone has to have fun for all of them, isn't it true?" Sighing, Keros clicks his tongue and leans against one of the shrine pillars. "Before we begin, [pc.name], just follow my thread of thought for a moment, please. Consider that strictly speaking, in theological terms, no kitsune — not from the Emperor to the lowest peasant — is possessed of an individual soul. [var0 |These mischievous sisters here who take care of this lovely little shrine and serve me tea when I drop by — they are both |This collected young woman here who takes care of this lovely little shrine and serves me tea when I drop by — she is |This lovely young woman here who takes care of this lovely little shrine and serves me tea when I drop by — she is ] completely and utterly dead inside. Perhaps you may say I'm not being quite correct, that they have a communal soul they rely on... but that doesn't change their nature, nor the boons and banes which that nature grants them." ... Stepping past you to the shrine doors, the nine-tailed trickster gazes out over the sacred gardens and to the fields beyond. "And the people, the hundred or so families who have the privilege of living in the colonial governor's seat of power... they are dead husks, too. And the handful of adventurers and prospectors exploring the new and exciting land. And an entire nation of them across the eastern ocean. All of them, as far as common theological and metaphysical parlance would put them, demons. Dead inside. Creatures incapable of possessing nobility or empathy." ... His smile becomes sad as he turns to [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko at your side, catches your fox-wife by the chin with thumb and forefinger and lifts her eyes to his. "Kiyoko Otomo, many times descended from my beloved concubine Chizuru — ah, she has loved you, held you, given of herself to you, known you carnally and borne your kits. She has done everything that is expected of a devoted wife wholeheartedly and enthusiastically, and yet she is dead inside. And your firstborn daughter together — [kinu.isInari |sincere, resolute, wilful, filled with energy and life |refined, elegant, impeccable in all matters ] — and though you have loved and laughed and fed her sweet things and played together, Kinu Otomo is dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, she is a demon, a monster." ...Just what is his fucking point here?! It doesn't matter. It's never mattered. Whatever your fox-wife and daughter may be, you'll still love them with all your heart. |[var0 |Miko and Mai, catches both shrine maidens by their chins with thumbs and forefingers and lifts both their gazes to meet his. "Ah, the two Kurokawa sisters. Descendants of the retainer who failed her liege and was cursed by their god for it — and yet that fact troubles them none. Hard, single-minded workers when the mood takes them, and yet unending fonts of small mischief that keep the people around them on their toes. Truly young women after my own heart, and I couldn't have asked for more fitting servants in this part of the world... full of energy and care for those around them. But for all of their pleasant natures, they are dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, they are demons, monsters." |Mai, catches his shrine maiden by the chin with thumb and forefinger and lifts her eyes to his. "Miyuki Kurokawa. Perpetual smoker, though not by choice — calm, level-headed, a bundle of deadened nerves and a master at medication, both of the self and others. Her bedside manner's a bit brusque, but necessary given the dangers of the colonies, and her honesty is refreshing at times. For all her melancholic, pleasant nature, poor Miyuki is dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, she is a demon, a monster." |Miko, catches his shrine maiden by the chin with thumb and forefinger and lifts her eyes to his. "Mikoto Kurokawa. Truly a young woman after my heart — voluptuous, energetic, impulsive, and striving to be larger than life in every aspect of her personality and everything she does. I couldn't have asked for a more fitting servant in this part of the world... and though she laughs and loves and gets into all sorts of good-natured mischief, poor Mikoto is dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, she is a demon, a monster." ] ...What's his point, already? ] Keros lets go and slowly turns to you. "The point, my friend, is that not being possessed of an individual soul does not quite have the monstrous implications that common knowledge would have you believe it has. All of these people that live beneath the boughs of this sacred tree whom you have come to know in at least some capacity up to this point — have they shown themselves to be anything but people in their foils and foibles? There is a need inherent in their nature, to be sure... but as the saying goes, is it better to not be challenged to begin with? Or is it better, through not just individual will, but also the bindings of all those around you and the structure of the society you live in to not just overcome your nature, but put it to beneficial, constructive use? "Certainly you've come to some conclusion about this, or you would not have made up your mind to join them, even in this capacity." [kiyoko.isFree |Or maybe you don't know anything about that at all and just love your fox-wife and daughter. Maybe you just trust them enough to want to be with them. Maybe you feel enough for them that you want to be with them, as closely as possible, as properly and respectably as possible, and if that means becoming one of their kind then a soul is a small price to pay. |Or maybe you're just tempted by the amazing pitch he made about all the things he could do for you. ] "Ah ha ha ha. That certainly is a possibility. Very well, then. Let's see this done."
rows.translation: 你艰难地咽了口唾沫，双脚仿佛被铅块绑住一般沉重，但还是强迫自己继续前进。当你加快脚步，距离神社只剩下最后几步时，心中自然会涌起一阵忐忑，但你强压下了这些情绪。考虑到前方等待着你的任务，你必须利用一切可用的优势——而事实上，你并没有这些优势。真的无论如何，这都是需要付出全部心血的。当然，这样做可能会让人感到有些不适，但为了换取一些实际的好处……或许将其视为一项高尚的牺牲，会让人更容易接受这个事实。 [party.has kiyoko |在犹豫吗，亲爱的？你的狐狸妻子走过来，握住了你的手，轻轻捏了捏。 你……先稍等片刻，让自己平静下来吧…… 这是很自然的……我们更倾向于坚持自己熟悉的事物，而任何重大的变化，仅仅因为它是变化，就可能会让人感到恐惧。人们常说他们希望明天能变得更好——但这种说法并不完全正确。实际上，他们更多希望明天能和今天一样，因为只有经历过今天，他们才明白今天的价值。 你握住了她的手。是的，你知道这一切都会不同，但你现在已经下定了决心。只是需要一点时间来让自己平静下来，而已。如果理性地看待这件事，整个过程确实显得有些疯狂，但如果没有一点疯狂，又怎么会有勇气呢，不是吗？ 清子笑了。 ] [var0 |当你走近神社时，米可与舞从道路的两侧迎了上来，两人同时向你鞠躬致意 |当你走近神社时，梅将她正在用来清扫石板的扫帚放在一旁，然后在灯笼闪烁的微光中向你鞠了一躬 |当你走近神社时，米可向你鞠躬致意，她的鞠躬幅度如此之大，以至于你不禁怀疑，仅仅她的胸腔所承受的重力，是否就已经让她的脊椎快要弯曲了 ]。 哇，你看起来可真帅啊[pc.name]真没想到你竟是那种虔诚的人……不过，如果你想表达对这位神圣君主的敬意，那也没什么好说的。 你认为自己能做的远不止这些——你还有与凯罗斯的约会。没有等待任何回复，你径直走进了那座小型的狐神神社，在祭坛和雕像前停了下来；你认为他会欣赏这样的举动。毫无疑问，你在试图与他搭讪的过程中违反了几项重要的礼仪规范，也违背了数十条不成文的行为准则。但既然你决定“向那位狡黠的玩弄者出卖自己的灵魂”，那么至少也应该彻底融入这种氛围之中才对。 嘿。嘿！有人在吗？ 过了一会儿，空气中突然弥漫着一种沉重的压抑感，神社内的气氛仿佛真的在压迫着人们。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]紧接着，一阵轻风吹过，然后凯洛斯从他的雕像后面走了出来，懒洋洋地从雕像所在的基座上爬了下来；他耸了耸肩膀，然后向你露出了一个懒散的笑容[var0 |米可与舞匆忙地赶到了那里。 [party.combatNames]他们看到自己的守护神出现在神龛中，便立刻停下了动作。凯罗斯懒洋洋地走上去，轻松地从他们中间穿过，然后抓住那对双胞胎姐妹的腰，把她们拉到自己身边。紧接着，一团乱糟糟的绒毛出现了——米可与舞假装愤怒地叫嚷着，装出一副生气的样子，但仅仅持续了三秒钟，就立刻依偎在他们的守护神身边，把尾巴缠在了他的尾巴上。 |舞冲进了那个地方。 [party.combatNames]当她看到自己的守护神出现在神龛中时，她立刻停下了脚步，然后低下头，悄悄地走到凯罗斯身边，双手搭在他的手臂上——她兴高采烈地充当着他的“陪衬”，同时还不停地发出狐妖般的轻叫声。诡计之神咧嘴一笑，轻轻拍了拍神龛少女耳朵中间的位置，这让她发出更加欢快的呼噜声。 |米可冲进了那个地方。 [party.combatNames]当她看到自己的守护神出现在神龛中时，她立刻停下了脚步，然后发出一声轻呼——因为凯罗斯一把抓住了那位神龛少女的腰，将她拉到了自己身边，她的两条尾巴也本能地缠在了凯罗斯的腿上。 ] [party.has cait |看看吧[var0 |那两个人 |她 |她 ]巴结他。凯特轻声说道。真是厚颜无耻，毫不客气地说。跟家里那些试图讨好庙里管事的小猫没什么两样。 嗯，如果马拉克突然出现在她面前，她难道不会想哪怕只是短暂地，成为那位神明的宠儿吗？至少，这是一种很少有人能够拥有的体验吧。 那就是了。完全不同！" ] "[pc.name]我就觉得你会出现的。凯罗斯毫不在意礼仪或规矩，继续活动着自己的身体，活动着关节，仿佛他刚刚从床上起来一样。如果你是想单独与我谈谈，那么我想你应该是为了我之前给你的那个提议而来吧？ 是的，你会答应他的请求的。 太棒了！ [var0 |凯罗斯从姐妹俩身边挣脱开来，伸手轻轻拍了拍她们的头，然后才终于摆脱了她们的牵扯 |凯罗斯伸出手，缓缓地将梅从自己的手臂上拉开，然后用自己的尾巴轻轻拍了一下她的屁股，将她赶了出去 |凯罗斯拨了拨米可的头发，然后拍了一下她的屁股，让她离开，自己则从她的怀抱中挣脱出来 ]。 现在，我想你已经完全了解自己将要面对的一切，但还是决定继续下去，所以我就不会再重复这些内容了。只要你准备好了，我们就可以开始——如果你愿意的话，现在还是退出的最后机会。 不，你大老远跑来亲自见他，总不会在最后关头临阵退缩吧。该不会你觉得这种事情需要遵循一些世代相传的、繁琐复杂的仪式吧？ 其实并不是这样。尽管人们会举行各种仪式来表达对我的尊敬，但这一切都只是表面形式而已。神明这种事以前从未发生过……至少在我有记忆以来是如此，而且发生的次数也不多，因此根本没有什么正式或固定的处理方式。对于我特别喜欢的人来说，这确实令人震惊；不过我们只能边做边想办法解决了，不是吗？这样不是很有趣吗？ [var0 |姐妹们一起鞠躬。在本次活动中，如果您需要任何帮助，我们必将竭诚效劳，您的神圣阁下。 |梅鞠了一躬。在本次活动中，如果能为您提供任何帮助，我将感到非常荣幸，尊贵的阁下。 |米可鞠了一躬。在本次活动中，如果能为您提供任何帮助，我将感到非常荣幸，尊贵的阁下。 ] 很好。你可以站在那里，欣赏那些美景。在工作时被美丽所环绕，确实能让心情变得愉悦许多，让整个过程变得更加愉快。 不得不说，他的这种坦率行事方式，与他所挑选的人在公共场合的表现方式截然相反，这种反差有时反而让人感到耳目一新。 嗯，总得有人为大家带来欢乐，不是吗？叹息着，凯罗斯吐了吐舌头，然后靠在神龛的一根柱子上。在开始之前， [pc.name]，请稍候跟随我的思路想一想。严格来说，从神学的角度来看，没有任何一只狐妖——无论是皇帝还是最底层的农民——拥有独立的灵魂。 [var0 |这里这两位调皮的小姐妹，总是负责照料这个可爱的小神龛，每当我路过时还会为我奉上茶水——她们两个都是…… |这位年轻的女士负责照料这个可爱的小神龛，每当我来访时，她还会为我泡茶——她就是这个人。 |这位可爱的年轻女士，她负责照料这个漂亮的小神龛，每当我来访时，她还会为我沏茶——她就是这个人。 ]他们的内心早已彻底枯萎、死寂无声。或许你会说我的说法并不完全正确，因为他们拥有某种共同的灵魂作为依靠……但这也改变不了他们的本质，更改变不了这种本质所带来的种种福祸。 从你身边走过，走向神龛的大门，那个九尾捣蛋鬼将目光投向那片神圣的花园，以及更远处的田野。而那些居住在殖民地总督权力中心的那一百来户家庭……他们也不过是空壳罢了。还有那少数几个探索这片崭新而令人兴奋的土地的冒险家和探矿者而且在东方的海洋彼岸，生活着整个这样的民族。用常见的神学和形而上学术语来说，他们都是恶魔——内心早已死去，根本无法拥有高尚的品质或同理心。 当他转过身来时，他的笑容变得黯淡了。 [party.has kiyoko |清子站在你身旁，用拇指和食指捏住你那位狐狸妻子的下巴，迫使她抬起头看着他。乙女清子，她其实多次是我的爱妾千鹤的后代——啊，她曾经深爱着你，呵护着你，全心全意地奉献着自己，与你有着亲密的关系，还为你生下了孩子。她全心全意、热情洋溢地做着一个忠诚妻子应该做的一切，然而她的内心却是空虚的。而你们共同生的第一个女儿[kinu.isInari |真诚、坚定、任性，充满活力与生机 |精致、优雅，在所有方面都无可挑剔。 ]尽管你曾经关爱她、与她一起欢笑、给她喂食甜点、一起玩耍，但实则小娟·大友的内心早已死去。在几乎所有人的眼中，她就是个恶魔，一个怪物。 ……他到底想表达什么啊？！其实根本无关紧要，从来都无关紧要。无论你的妻子和女儿是什么样的人，你都会全心全意地爱她们。 |[var0 |米可与舞用拇指和食指捏住两位神社少女的下巴，使她们的视线都抬起，与他对视。啊，那两位黑川姐妹。那位背叛主君、因此遭到神明诅咒的家臣的后代——然而这个事实却丝毫没有影响到她们。当她们决定努力的时候，会变得无比专注、勤奋认真；但与此同时，她们又会不断制造各种小麻烦，让周围的人始终处于紧张状态。真正符合我心意的年轻女性啊，在这个世界上，我再也找不到比她们更合适的仆人了……她们充满活力，也关心周围的人。然而，尽管她们性格讨人喜欢，但内心却已经死了。在几乎所有人的眼中，它们都是恶魔、怪物。 |梅用拇指和食指捏住那位神社少女的下巴，迫使她抬起头看着自己。黑川美雪。一个长期吸烟的人，不过这并非她的本意——她性格冷静、头脑清醒，内心却充满麻木与痛苦，同时也擅长为自己和他人用药。她在病人床边的态度有时显得有些粗鲁，但考虑到殖民地的危险环境，这种做法也是必要的；而她的坦诚有时也会让人感到耳目一新。尽管她外表忧郁、性格温和，但实际上，这个可怜的女孩内心早已死去。在几乎所有人的眼中，她就是一个恶魔，一个怪物。 |米可用拇指和食指捏住那位神社少女的下巴，迫使她抬起头看着自己。黑川美琴……她确实是我心目中理想的年轻女性——充满活力、冲动任性，而且在性格的方方面面以及所做的每一件事上，都努力追求超越平凡的人生。在这个世界上，我再也找不到比她更合适的仆从了……虽然她总是笑眯眯的，充满爱心，还会搞各种各样善意的恶作剧，但可怜的美琴，内心其实是空虚的。在几乎所有人的眼中，她其实就是个恶魔，一个怪物。 ] …他到底想表达什么意思呢？ ] 凯罗斯松开手，慢慢转向你。关键在于，我的朋友，没有独立的灵魂并不意味着会有常识所认为的那些可怕后果。所有那些生活在这棵神圣树木之下的人们，你们至今至少已经对他们有了一定的了解——他们不也正是有着自己的优点和缺点的人吗？他们的天性中确实存在着这样的需求……但正如那句俗话所说，一开始就避免面对挑战，难道不是更好的选择吗？还是说，仅仅依靠个人的意志力，再加上周围人的影响以及你所生活的社会结构，才能真正克服这种天性，并将其转化为有益、建设性的力量呢？ 你肯定已经对此得出了一些结论，否则你也不会决定以这样的身份加入他们。 [kiyoko.isFree |或者，你其实对那些事情一无所知，只是深爱着你的狐狸妻子和女儿。也许你足够信任她们，因此愿意与她们在一起。也许你对她们怀有深厚的感情，所以希望尽可能地与她们紧密地在一起，以最恰当、最体面的方式相处；而如果这意味着要成为她们中的一员，那么牺牲一个灵魂也不算什么。 |或者，你只是被他所承诺的、那些能为你做的事情所吸引罢了。 ] 啊哈哈，那确实是个可能性。好吧，那就这么办吧，让我们把这件事搞定。
rows.raw: " You swallow hard, your feet feeling leaden, yet force yourself forward. Naturally, there's a sense of trepidation that follows you as you pace up the path and close the final few steps to the shrine, but you push it down. Given the nature of the tasks that lie ahead of you, you'll need every advantage available to you, and let's face it — you aren't really using your soul anyway. Sure, it might rankle a bit, but trading it away for some concrete benefits... perhaps it would be more palatable to think of it as a noble sacrifice. [party.has kiyoko |"Hesitating, beloved?" Your fox-wife slides on over and takes your hand in her own, giving it a small squeeze. You are. Just a moment to calm yourself, first... "It is natural... we prefer to stick with what we know, and a major change can seem frightening for simply being a change. People say that they want tomorrow to be better — that is not strictly true. More often than not, they want tomorrow to be like today, because one knows that one has lived through today." You squeeze her hand back. Yes, you know that it's going to be different, but you've made up your mind now. It's just that you need a little while to gather yourself, that's all. This whole affair is insane if you look at it rationally, but there cannot be bravery without at least a little madness, can there? Kiyoko smiles. ] [var0 |Miko and Mai greet you as you approach the shrine, both sisters approaching from either side of the path and giving you a bow in perfect unison |Mai greets you as you approach the shrine, setting aside the broom she's sweeping the flagstones with and giving you a bow in the flickering foxfire of the lanterns |Miko greets you as you approach the shrine, bowing so deeply that you wonder if her spine'll bend from the weight of her chest alone ]. "Well, ain't ya a sight to see, [pc.name]. Wouldn't have figured ya for th' devout type... but there ain't complainin' if'n ya want to pay yer respects to his divine lordship an' all." You think you're going to do more than just that — you have an appointment with Keros. Without waiting for a reply, you swish on past and step into the little kitsune shrine, coming to a stop before the altar and statue; it's a gesture that you think he would appreciate. No doubt you violated several important rites and rituals with regards to seeking an audience with him and breached several dozen unspoken rules of etiquette, but if you're going to sell your soul to the Trickster you may as well get into the spirit of things. Hey. Hey! Is anyone home? Nothing happens for a moment, then there's a dense heaviness in the air, the atmosphere within the shrine palpably pressing down on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. This is followed by a small pop of rushing air, and then Keros steps out from behind his statue, lazily climbing down from the dias on which it's set; he rolls his shoulders and gives you a lazy grin just as [var0 |Miko and Mai come rushing into the place after [party.combatNames], stopping as they see their patron deity apparate in the shrine. Lazily, Keros saunters up and slides smoothly between them both, grabbing the twin sisters by their waists and pulling them close to him. A mass of squirming fluff ensues as Miko and Mai yelp in mock protest, acting all huffy and outraged for all of three seconds before rubbing up against their patron deity, twining their tails with his. |Mai comes rushing into the place after [party.combatNames]. She stops as she sees her patron deity apparate in the shrine, then bows her head and slinks on up to Keros, hooking her hands about the crook of his arm — eagerly serving as arm candy while making little yipping, foxy noises in the back of her throat. The trickster smirks and gives his shrine maiden a pat on the head between the ears, which just makes her purr harder. |Miko comes rushing into the place after [party.combatNames]. She stops as she sees her patron deity apparate in the shrine, then lets out a little squeal as Keros gathers up his shrine maiden by about the waist and pulls her close, two of her tails instinctively wrapping about his legs. ] [party.has cait |"Look at [var0 |those two |her |her ] suck up to him," Cait whispers. "Completely shameless, I tell you. No different from kittens trying to win the temple matron's favor back home." Well, if Mallach were to apparate before her, wouldn't she want to be a deity's arm candy, if only for a little bit? It's an experience few actually have, if nothing else. "That's different!" ] "[pc.name]. I had a feeling you'd show up." Keros continues limbering up his body without a care for decorum or propriety, working out the kinks in his joints as if he'd just gotten out of bed. "If you wanted a personal audience, I take it you're here about the offer I made you?" Yes. You'll take him up on it. "Splendid!" [var0 |Keros disentangles himself from the sisters, reaching up to give the two of them a double headpat before prying himself loose of them |Keros reaches over and slowly pries Mai off his arm, sending her off with a smack on the ass with one of his tails |Keros ruffles Miko's hair, then sends her off with a slap on the ass before disentangling himself from her ]. "Now, I take it you know everything you're getting yourself into and still want this, so I won't patronise you by going through everything again. We can begin whenever you're ready — this is your last chance to back out, if you like." No, you didn't come all this way and meet him in person to get cold feet at the last moment. You take it that there's some long and involved ritual that's been handed down the generations for this sort of thing? "Actually, no. For all the rites and rituals that are involved in honoring me as a grand kami, this hasn't happened... well, not in living memory, certainly, and not often enough for there to be any formal or proper way of doing this. Shocking, I know, when it comes to my favored people; we'll just have to make it up as we go along. Isn't that fun?" [var0 |As one, the sisters bow. "We will be glad to be of any assistance during the proceedings, your divine lordship." |Mai bows. "I will be glad to be of any assistance during the proceedings, your divine lordship." |Miko bows. "I will be glad to be of any assistance during the proceedings, your divine lordship." ] "Good. You can stand there and look pretty. It lifts the spirits to be surrounded by beauty while you're working, makes the whole affair far more pleasant." You have to say, the frankness with which he conducts himself, while being completely at odds with how his chosen people behave in public, is refreshing at times. "Mm. Someone has to have fun for all of them, isn't it true?" Sighing, Keros clicks his tongue and leans against one of the shrine pillars. "Before we begin, [pc.name], just follow my thread of thought for a moment, please. Consider that strictly speaking, in theological terms, no kitsune — not from the Emperor to the lowest peasant — is possessed of an individual soul. [var0 |These mischievous sisters here who take care of this lovely little shrine and serve me tea when I drop by — they are both |This collected young woman here who takes care of this lovely little shrine and serves me tea when I drop by — she is |This lovely young woman here who takes care of this lovely little shrine and serves me tea when I drop by — she is ] completely and utterly dead inside. Perhaps you may say I'm not being quite correct, that they have a communal soul they rely on... but that doesn't change their nature, nor the boons and banes which that nature grants them." ... Stepping past you to the shrine doors, the nine-tailed trickster gazes out over the sacred gardens and to the fields beyond. "And the people, the hundred or so families who have the privilege of living in the colonial governor's seat of power... they are dead husks, too. And the handful of adventurers and prospectors exploring the new and exciting land. And an entire nation of them across the eastern ocean. All of them, as far as common theological and metaphysical parlance would put them, demons. Dead inside. Creatures incapable of possessing nobility or empathy." ... His smile becomes sad as he turns to [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko at your side, catches your fox-wife by the chin with thumb and forefinger and lifts her eyes to his. "Kiyoko Otomo, many times descended from my beloved concubine Chizuru — ah, she has loved you, held you, given of herself to you, known you carnally and borne your kits. She has done everything that is expected of a devoted wife wholeheartedly and enthusiastically, and yet she is dead inside. And your firstborn daughter together — [kinu.isInari |sincere, resolute, wilful, filled with energy and life |refined, elegant, impeccable in all matters ] — and though you have loved and laughed and fed her sweet things and played together, Kinu Otomo is dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, she is a demon, a monster." ...Just what is his fucking point here?! It doesn't matter. It's never mattered. Whatever your fox-wife and daughter may be, you'll still love them with all your heart. |[var0 |Miko and Mai, catches both shrine maidens by their chins with thumbs and forefingers and lifts both their gazes to meet his. "Ah, the two Kurokawa sisters. Descendants of the retainer who failed her liege and was cursed by their god for it — and yet that fact troubles them none. Hard, single-minded workers when the mood takes them, and yet unending fonts of small mischief that keep the people around them on their toes. Truly young women after my own heart, and I couldn't have asked for more fitting servants in this part of the world... full of energy and care for those around them. But for all of their pleasant natures, they are dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, they are demons, monsters." |Mai, catches his shrine maiden by the chin with thumb and forefinger and lifts her eyes to his. "Miyuki Kurokawa. Perpetual smoker, though not by choice — calm, level-headed, a bundle of deadened nerves and a master at medication, both of the self and others. Her bedside manner's a bit brusque, but necessary given the dangers of the colonies, and her honesty is refreshing at times. For all her melancholic, pleasant nature, poor Miyuki is dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, she is a demon, a monster." |Miko, catches his shrine maiden by the chin with thumb and forefinger and lifts her eyes to his. "Mikoto Kurokawa. Truly a young woman after my heart — voluptuous, energetic, impulsive, and striving to be larger than life in every aspect of her personality and everything she does. I couldn't have asked for a more fitting servant in this part of the world... and though she laughs and loves and gets into all sorts of good-natured mischief, poor Mikoto is dead inside as well. By the reckoning of almost all the world, she is a demon, a monster." ] ...What's his point, already? ] Keros lets go and slowly turns to you. "The point, my friend, is that not being possessed of an individual soul does not quite have the monstrous implications that common knowledge would have you believe it has. All of these people that live beneath the boughs of this sacred tree whom you have come to know in at least some capacity up to this point — have they shown themselves to be anything but people in their foils and foibles? There is a need inherent in their nature, to be sure... but as the saying goes, is it better to not be challenged to begin with? Or is it better, through not just individual will, but also the bindings of all those around you and the structure of the society you live in to not just overcome your nature, but put it to beneficial, constructive use? "Certainly you've come to some conclusion about this, or you would not have made up your mind to join them, even in this capacity." [kiyoko.isFree |Or maybe you don't know anything about that at all and just love your fox-wife and daughter. Maybe you just trust them enough to want to be with them. Maybe you feel enough for them that you want to be with them, as closely as possible, as properly and respectably as possible, and if that means becoming one of their kind then a soul is a small price to pay. |Or maybe you're just tempted by the amazing pitch he made about all the things he could do for you. ] "Ah ha ha ha. That certainly is a possibility. Very well, then. Let's see this done." "

rows.original: The whole affair is quite muted, as it were. Keros has [var0 |Miko bring you up a high stool, while Mai shuts and bars the shrine doors before lighting a small censer and allowing calming smoke to fill the room |Mai bring you up a high stool, setting it down before the altar |Miko bring you up a high stool, setting it down before the altar ]. You take a seat as is expected of you[party.som|| while [party.compNames] takes a step back towards the door| while [party.compNames] take a step back towards the door], then swallow hard as the Trickster — or rather, here and now, the August Master at the Center of Heaven — approaches, wiggling his fingers. There's something wrong in their movements — they look humanlike enough, but the way they bend and flex as he limbers them up is disquieting. Human fingers shouldn't be able to twist at such angles. "Find something to hold on to," he says. "This may not necessarily hurt, but I assure you it will be disorienting." [var0 |That something happens to be both sisters, who come up from either side and grab you by under your arms, holding you firm as they press their bodies against you, warm and voluptuous |That something happens to be Mai, who comes up and grabs you by under the arm, steadying you |That something happens to be Miko, who purrs as she comes up behind you and allows you to sink back into her warm, voluptuous body ]. Then in the blink of an eye, Keros thrusts his hand forward through your [pc.armor] and into your chest, his person melding into your flesh, immaterial as he reaches inside of you. There's a horrible twisting sensation within the core of your being, and you realize that he wasn't wrong; while the process doesn't actually hurt, a powerful wave of nausea washes over you, a sense of disorientation and vertigo akin to falling backwards while lying in bed. Even though the sensation's already beginning to pass, you lurch forward and vomit your guts out onto the shrine's floor, [var0 |Miko and Mai |Mai |Miko ] keeping you from pitching off the stool completely. When you refocus your vision, you're met with the sight of Keros holding a fist-sized crystal of solidified incandescence, pulsing [pc.corruptionRange 0 25 75 |a brilliant gold |all hues of the rainbow |a seething, angry red ], resplendent with energy. He holds it up to the light, examining it as a jeweler would, examining it from a few angles, then folds his hands with a smile and makes it disappear like a magician's parlour trick before producing a silk handkerchief and offering it to you. "Well. How does it feel to be a soulless abomination?" A little dizzy, to be honest. You hope this isn't going to last. "See? You've kept your sense of humor, if nothing else. And now, it's time for me to uphold my end of the bargain.
rows.translation: 整个事件可以说相当低调。凯洛斯已经[var0 |米可为你搬来一张高脚凳，而舞则关上并锁上神社的大门，随后点燃了一只小香炉，让淡淡的烟雾弥漫在整个房间里。 |让我为你搬来一张高脚凳，把它放在祭坛前。 |米可为你搬来一张高脚凳，然后将其放在祭坛前。 ]你按照惯例坐下了。[party.som|| 当[party.compNames]时向门口退了一步| 当[party.compNames]时向门口退了一步]然后，当你看到诡计之神——或者说，在此刻，那位位于天中心的天之中央尊主——正摇着手指朝你走来时，你不得不硬着头皮咽下口水。因为有些事情错误在他们的行动中——他们看虽然看起来足够像人类的手指，但当他活动这些手指时，它们弯曲和活动的方式却让人感到不安。人类的手指根本不应该能够以这样的角度弯曲。 找到可以依靠的东西吧。他说。这不一定会造成伤害，但我可以向你保证，这肯定会让人感到困惑。 [var0 |恰好有两位姐妹从不同的方向走来，她们抓住你的手臂，将你紧紧抱住，身体紧贴着你，温暖而充满魅力。 |正好是梅走了过来，她抓住你的胳膊下方，帮你稳住了身体。 |恰好是米科出现了，它轻轻发出呼噜声，从你身后靠近，让你能够重新沉浸在它温暖而柔软的身体之中。 ]然后，在转瞬之间，凯罗斯将手向前伸去。通过你的[pc.armor]他的身体融入你的肉体，仿佛与他合为一体，当他进入你的内部时，这一切都显得如此自然。在你的内心深处，有一种令人恐惧的、扭曲的感觉，这时你才意识到，他并没有说错；虽然这个过程本身受伤一股强烈的恶心感涌上心头，那种迷失方向、头晕目眩的感觉，就像是在床上躺着却突然向后倒下一样。尽管这种感觉已经开始消退，你还是不由自主地向前倾倒，将胃里的东西全部吐在了神龛的地板上。 [var0 |米可与舞 |梅 |米可 ]这让你暂时无法完全失去平衡。当你重新集中视线时，你会看到凯罗斯手中握着一颗拳头大小的、已经凝固的、会闪烁光芒的晶体。 [pc.corruptionRange 0 25 75 |灿烂的金色 |彩虹的种种色彩 |一种炽热而愤怒的红色 ]它散发着耀眼的光芒，仿佛蕴含着无穷的能量。他将它举到光线下，像珠宝匠一样仔细地观察着，从几个不同的角度进行审视。然后，他微笑着双手合十，就像魔术师表演戏法一样，让那件物品瞬间消失了。紧接着，他拿出一块丝绸手帕递给你。 嗯，作为一个没有灵魂的怪物，这种感觉究竟是怎样呢？ 说实话，有点头晕。真希望这种感觉能快点过去。 看到了吧？至少你还是保留了自己的幽默感。现在，轮到我来履行我的承诺了。

rows.original: You're ready for this, perhaps more than you've ever been.
rows.translation: 你已经为这一切做好了准备，或许比以往任何时候都更加充分。
rows.raw: "You're ready for this, perhaps more than you've ever been."

rows.original:
You think a moment, then shake your head. Maybe this is too big of a step for you to make just yet, maybe you don't want to commit to this action for now, maybe you want a little more time to think it over and consider your options before selling off a part of yourself you won't be able to get back.

        Either way, you're not ready to do this right now. Maybe later.
rows.translation:
你思考了一会儿，然后摇了摇头。也许这对你来说还是一项过于重大的决定，也许你暂时还不想做出这个选择，也许你需要更多的时间来仔细考虑各种可能性，再决定是否要放弃那些以后可能再也无法拿回的东西。

        无论如何，你现在还没有准备好做出这个决定。也许以后会吧。
rows.raw:
"
        You think a moment, then shake your head. Maybe this is too big of a step for you to make just yet, maybe you don't want to commit to this action for now, maybe you want a little more time to think it over and consider your options before selling off a part of yourself you won't be able to get back.

        Either way, you're not ready to do this right now. Maybe later.
        "

rows.original: "Thank you. I think that's all we need... let's get to it, then." Keros stretches his fingers forth once more, and you fight the instinctive urge to recoil from them. Despite their now too-long appearance, the wrongness with which they move, you know he doesn't mean you harm — what he's taken from you, he's obliged to give back in equal measure. His touch isn't cold, nor is it pleasant — instead, the sensation is thick, as if he's pushing at clay. In a sense, he is... [party.has kiyoko |Your fox-wife is behind you in all this, her hands on your shoulders as she keeps you steady while Keros works on you. Her touch is gentle, warm and reassuring; you can feel her smile on the back of your neck. If there was no other reason for you to take this step, she would be enough; the thought of you being closer to Kiyoko, to make your relationship a little less... well, scandalous wouldn't be the exact term for it, but it's certainly in the same spirit. The power is nice and all, but you're really doing it for her, aren't you? She's someone who's worth losing your soul over without so much as a smidgen of regret. |[party.randComp cait brint brienne arona etheryn atugia einin quintillus azyrran berwyn |Cait swallows hard at the sight. "So that's how they do it back at the temple. Still looking young despite being fifty... I didn't know this sort of thing was possible. Sally might have, but..." |Brint shuffles his feet on the shrine's flooring where he's standing, looking distinctly unnerved as the operation begins. The minotaur looks just about fit to excuse himself from your presence, but thinks better of it and settles for bowing his head wordlessly and very not pointedly looking at the... well, the only real way to put it would be the remaking that's going on in front of him. |Brienne shuffles her feet on the shrine's flooring where she's standing, looking distinctly unnerved as the operation begins. The cowgirl looks just about fit to excuse herself from your presence, but thinks better of it and settles for bowing her head wordlessly and very not pointedly looking at the... well, the only real way to put it would be the remaking that's going on in front of her. It's true that something similar happened to her, but that transformation was swift and over before anyone really knew it. This, however... |"Reminds me of when Hretha finally got me that dick I'd been wanting," Arona says to no one in particular, crossing her arms as she waits for the operation to be done. "Won't say I didn't have second thoughts, but it was the best thing I'd ever gotten done to me. You turn yourself into whatever you want, [pc.name]. It'll just make you more fuckable." |Ryn watches the process with a sense of shocked fascination, clearly unsettled by the sight yet unable to tear her eyes away. "Is this how Lumia does it?" she murmurs. "The valkyries... this is how she creates them? It doesn't have to be this disquieting, does it?" |Atugia appears completely unfazed by the sight — but then, she's in quite similar straits. With familiarity comes contempt and all that... |Einin looks ready to flee this very moment — if not for you, she probably would've been long gone by now. The sight of flesh melting and shifting, directed by little more than a touch, must have triggered something deep and visceral within the poor little mecian. Given her past, that's not really surprising... and you can't really say this whole affair is improving her opinion of the gods, as necessary and consensual as it may be. |Quintillus appears completely nonplussed at the sight, leaning back against a wall and folding his arms as he waits for you to be done. Brint just laughs and saunters up to give you a big bull hug. "Soul or no soul, you're still pretty great, [pc.name]. You haven't changed one bit in the ways that matter." |"Hey, looking sharp!" Brienne flashes you a thumbs-up with a beefy hand. "I'm personally used to bigger and thicker, but this isn't bad, either. Just different." Yeah, that's right. And more importantly, even though you've changed, you're still you. "Of course — I'd have to get mad otherwise, and it's hard to get mad at such [a] [pc.mf |handsome |pretty ] face. Old Keros there really did a number on you." "It's only expected of a god," the Trickster replies with a faux-prideful sniff. "The outcome was never really in doubt — anything less than my best would be shameful." Brienne just laughs and saunters up to give you a big cow hug. "Soul or no soul, you're still pretty great, [pc.name]. You haven't changed one bit in the ways that matter." |Arona folds her arms as she eyes you up and down. "Hmm. Not as good as an elf, but still a pretty decent cocksleeve, I'd say." Well, you can't deny that there are some similarities in the general aesthetic. That gets the orcess to grinning. "Well, come find me after we're through here and we can give it a go. Take this new body of yours out for a spin, see how well it measures up. Sure, it looks like it's shaping up to be a pretty little thing, but you never know until you try." |Ryn's been transfixed throughout this whole process, quietly staring and taking mental notes. It's only now that she heaves a huge sigh, perhaps of relief, perhaps of exhilaration at the whole sight. "Wow! That was amazing!" "Of course it was," Keros replies with a sniff. "I was the one handling it, if nothing else." "Now I'm really wondering if this is how Lumia makes valkyries — I never really had the chance to see for myself, Alissa was always the one to attend the ceremonies when the royal line was invited." Why the sudden interest? Does she want a similar deal for herself from Lumia? "M-maybe! I'll need all the strength I can get going forward, and if it's for the Winter City and the boer'alvar... giving up my soul doesn't sound like too high a price to pay." The Trickster smiles. "Oh, you're certainly brave when the mood takes you, little elf. I'm sure that were you to gather the courage to ask your mistress, she'd be happy to take you on. But first, you'd probably have to learn a few things about strength and power." "What do you mean?" "You'll find out in time." "Okay..." |"Wow," Atugia says as you study yourself in the mirror. "You don't look half-bad." Why, thanks. You'd like to say the same of yourself, too. "I wonder if you're feeling the same way as I did when... I became the way I am. We'll have to compare notes later." That's one way of putting it! |Einin stares at the new you, wide-eyed in shock. "Wow. I..." She looks a little disquieted. Is it that much of a change? Given your previous mutability due to the portal magic and all, you'd imagine you changing back and forth at the drop of a hat would be something she's used to at this point. "It's not that," your little mousy follower says, turning away from you. "Sure, I know you can change, but each time I was always sure that whatever happened, you were you. But now after seeing all that..." Ah, you get it. There's nothing to worry about in that regard. You're still as you ever were, and she'll come around to that in the days that follow. "The people whom the cult changed didn't just transform physically, they weren't the people whom they were before, and that was what scared me most." She forces a smile. "You seem to be all right so far, I guess, but it's only been a few moments. That's not much to go on." Well, you hope to prove each and every one of her fears wrong in the days to come. |"Well, if you aren't looking all fresh and chipper. [pc.mf |Handsome fellow you've become — though not as handsome as me, of course |Pretty little thing you've become, although there's room for improvement, of course. Half of your looks are in your attitude ]." Quin punctuates his point with a flip of his hair, smoothing back his big bunny ears with a smirk. "This bunny isn't afraid of any foxes, just so you know." Well, is that so. You'll just have to put the fear of vulpines in him... in bed. "Oho! I'll take that as a challenge, then. But first —" the bunny boy jerks a thumb at Keros — "get your makeover done, and then we'll have you out for a spin. Can't wait to see what the new you's capable of." |"Well! If you aren't just the most adorable cutie!" Azyrran says, putting her hands together with a warm yet predatory smile on her face. "You did a good job on [pc.himHer], Trickster." "Pleasing to the eye and spirit. Thank you for the praise. My champion should be someone who's captivating to all, and most of the [pc.hisHer] allies, don't you think?" "Oh, very much so." Azyrran looms over you. "Traveling with [pc.name] was always plenty of fun, but I think it'll be even more so from here on out. Looking on the bright side of things, hm?" |"Well, that's something," Berwyn says at last. The dog-boy's been silent throughout the whole process and feigning disinterest, although you've caught him sneaking peeks while he thinks no one's looking. "I guess you do look better coming out than you did going in." Of course you do. |That's reassuring to hear. ] "Well, that's it for the physical side of things. I did have fun working on you, [pc.name]. It's been a long while since I've had a willing participant in such an effort." the Trickster says as he taps you on the back with one of his tails. Speaking of which, you've got to learn how to do that sort of thing... you can feel your tails, all right, and know how to move them, but it's like having an extra pair of limbs that you have no coordination over. You'll eventually get used to it, you hope. ] With that, Keros puts away the hand mirror, making it disappear into wherever he places these things when he's not using them. "Now, there's the matter of the substitute... can't let it get out that you're walking around as a dead husk, can we?" There he goes, using that term again. It's very... negative. Keros just laughs at that. "To you, maybe. To the people who have adopted you, 'dead inside' is merely a statement of fact and the nature of existence. A deeply profound statement of the long-suffering state of affairs that life is — it's up there with 'nothing can be done about it' and 'one day at a time' as the watchword of the kitsune. Is it physical? Spiritual? Cultural? Metaphysical? Or more likely, an agglomeration of it all? "Ah, you will soon discover it for yourself. It will be such an exciting journey for the likes of you. Now, once more, you may feel a little disorientation..." With that, the Trickster cups his hands, the fingers once again starting to blur at the edges and move in ways that shouldn't be possible with joints of mere flesh and bone. Keros produces from nothingness a glowing crystal about the size of your fist — at a first glance, it's not too different from the one he just extracted from you. But that's the point of a decoy, isn't it? To appear real? A chill runs down your spine as he presses the glowing crystal against your chest and it melds through your [pc.armor] and into your flesh, sinking into your being as if skin and muscle were no more than thick, soupy clay. Maybe it's because you're one of his people now, but you feel Keros' touch far more keenly now than when he was extracting your soul — the way he's moving his hand inside of your ribcage, a warm-cold sensation not too unlike foxfire, really... For a moment there's a sensation of heaviness within your chest, as if you swallowed a large rock and it's on its way down into your stomach. Then it fades rapidly, replaced with yet another — if smaller — rush of vertigo. It passes quickly, though, and when you steady yourself once more Keros is extending a hand to you, offering to help you up and off the stool. "That's it." That's it? He nods. "That's it. Symbols and ritual have their purpose, but I'll admit I was in a bit of a rush there, so I cut out most of the chaff. Everything should work right — if you start having problems, or if you want to realign your form in case you should accidentally get transformed away from being a kitsune, you know where to find me. I've only done this a few times before and it's still somewhat of a work in progress; the decoy soul really throws the rest for a loop. I guess there should be some ceremony or something where I declare you my champion, but at this point I'm not really feeling it. "Don't worry, [var0|Miko and Mai|Mai|Miko] here will let everyone know what's happened and of your new status about these parts; they'll just tell Kohaku and that little chatterbox will take care of the rest. It'll be so fun to see the results of my handiwork spread out from this point — liven things up around here for a bit. It'll be just like when I was touring my power base all over again, I say — never a boring moment to be had. Ah, the Celestial Restoration were such good years." He rubs his hands together, then smacks you on the back encouragingly. "All right, off with you! You've got a whole new life ahead of you to live, so spend it wisely, and don't let the novelty wear off for as long as you can keep it!" [party.has kiyoko |Your fox-wife makes a happy, sultry little noise in the back of her throat as she cosies up to you and presses herself against your side, two of her tails seeking yours out and twining the tips together. By some instinct you didn't know you had up until now, your tails react by twining back against hers, pressing your fluff together in a dense, warm, bunch. [silly |This is even more scandalous than unprotected handholding; even if you're an item, it really isn't done to engage in such lewd behavior in public! At least the two of you could get a room or something... |To say that it feels very, very nice would be the understatement of a lifetime — you're already starting to warm to this state of being. ] ] That being said, though, wasn't he supposed to make you his champion as part of this deal? What's with that? Given how the kitsune do things as a people, you'd imagined there would be some kind of days or weeks-long ceremony involved, full of ceremony and stricture. Even if he wants to do away with that — as is his right — you'd need to know the roles and responsibilities involved in being his champion. How are you supposed to behave? What're his expectations of you? Other people — how should they treat you? Going into this, you had the impression he'd explain all of it to you... "Oh, that." Keros gives your concerns a dismissive wave, a twinkle in his eye. "You'll find out soon enough. Now, I could tell you, but that would diminish the sheer enjoyment — both on your part and mine — on finding that out for yourself. More impactful that way, I'd think, and all the better for driving home the reality of your new state of affairs. I don't think it should be anything too terrible, really, and save for a hiccup here and there you'll find it fun. For starters, why don't you make a round of the den and introduce yourself to everyone all over again? That should make for quite a show." So, this is for his entertainment. "Well, partially, yes. I wouldn't do something boring unless I absolutely had to. Life's much better when it's full of pleasant and fun surprises, isn't it? Off you go now, I've got some other matters to discuss with [var0|my lovely girls|my lovely shrine maiden|my lovely shrine maiden] here. I'm sure by the time you manage to get to anyone, anyone at all, the news will have spread like wildfire. Between the import of such a happenstance and that little golden gossip, everyone will know what's happened before the hour's out." [party.has kiyoko |"Don't you worry, your divine lordship," Kiyoko says as she continues to tease the tips of your tails. "I'll make sure things don't spiral out of control... too badly. My beloved won't get into any awkward social situations when I'm around, hmm?" ] Uhh... "Come now, it'll be fun! Here, you can even have a freebie from me." Keros reaches into his kimono again, and draws out from the rainbow-sheened fabric a lovely teardrop-shaped jewel, smooth to the touch and colored a deep blue. A flame dances eternally in the clear jewel's heart, pulsating steadily; with a start, you realize that the flame's pulsing in time with your heartbeat. "A fox jewel, straight from the Old Country. I'm sure you can get up to all kinds of shenanigans with it, now that you're one of mine. Goodbye, now!" As you stand and leave, [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames] in tow, ][var0|Miko and Mai|Mai|Miko] bow deeply, their gazes burning into the back of your neck, practically boring a hole on you. You shut the door behind you, trying to ignore the vapid giggling that's coming from behind it, and gaze out over the shrine gardens to a new sense of... well, it feels like an awakening, but not exactly. Everything feels not necessarily better, but different... For what profits it [a] [pc.mf |man |woman ] should [pc.heShe] gain the world and yet lose [pc.hisHer] soul? Well, time to find out! You have been granted a kitsune form in accordance with the details you supplied Keros with. You've also gained a fox jewel. Being a kitsune means you can get a lot more out of this than other people can. The foxfire and kitsunetsuki abilities are now open to you. You may be able to train with someone in the den in order to learn more thematic powers. Finally, you have gained the Soulbound perk. You may not take another permanent transformation. "

rows.original: [var0 |Miko and Mai don't |Mai doesn't |Miko doesn't ] stop you as you approach the shrine, instead moving to close the door behind you and turning to [dayNight |deal with the remaining petitioners |other matters ][party.hasCompanions | while [party.compNames] wait[party.oneCompanion |s ] outside as well ]. It's a bit claustrophobic inside of the place with the altar and statue taking up most of the place and the scent of winterstem incense heavy in the air, but you take a moment to steady yourself nevertheless. No matter how many times you do this, the sense of unease and potentially impending chaos never fades. Putting your hands together before you in the appropriate fashion, you bow your head and focus on just how convenient it would be if the Trickster showed up right about now to help you with your little problem... [rand |"You were looking for me?" Keros' voice comes from just behind your shoulder, and you [pc.isDK |almost whirl your fist straight into his face, but manage to catch your instincts at the last moment. Then again, you get the feeling that you wouldn't have been able to strike him if he didn't want to be punched in the first place. |feel your entire body tense from head to toe and your heart stop, until your instincts realize that no, you're not in imminent danger and it's just an ass of a god having a little harmless fun, for a definition of harmless. He can't help it, really, it's practically mandated by his nature. ] |Nothing happens for a moment, and then your patron deity apparates right at your feet before the altar, half-naked from the chest on down and wet, as if he'd just gotten out of the bath. Keros has a long-handled pipe in one hand and a white porcelain jug of strong-smelling clear liquor in the other, and is about to tip the contents of the latter straight into his mouth when he looks up and apparently realizes he's not... wherever he was before. "Oh. Uh." Through all the surprise, he gives you a little wink, letting you know it's all feigned. "Well!" Is this a bad time for him? "No, not really. I needed to get back to work, anyway." ] ...Oh, just get on with it already. "Ha!" Keros claps his hands, and circles around to your front. "I know why you're here — the need's clear in your eyes. Just hop on up and I'll start work." Well, that's an invitation if you ever heard one. You wait for Keros to push aside some of the daily offerings to the altar's side, then accept and swing yourself into a sitting position atop it when he thumps the empty space left behind. Keros looks over you for a bit, tsking and tutting, then rubs his hands and stretches his fingers.
rows.translation: [var0 |米可与舞并不这样。 |梅并不这么认为。 |米可不会。 ]就在你即将靠近神龛的时候，有人阻止了你，而是去关上了你身后的门，然后转身[dayNight |处理剩余的请愿人 |其他事项 ][party.hasCompanions | 当[party.compNames]时等等。[party.oneCompanion | ]外部也是如此 ]这个地方的内部有点令人感到压抑，因为祭坛和雕像占据了大部分空间，空气中也弥漫着浓重的冬茎香的味道。不过，你还是花了一点时间让自己平静下来。无论你经历这种场景多少次，那种不安感以及潜在的混乱氛围始终不会消失。 你以正确的方式将双手合十在胸前，低下头，心中默默想着：要是那个调皮捣蛋的家伙现在能出现，帮你解决这个小麻烦该有多好啊…… [rand |你在找我吗？ 凯罗斯的声音从你背后传来，就在你的肩膀后面，而你[pc.isDK |你几乎要一拳打在他的脸上，但在最后一刻还是抑制住了自己的冲动。不过，你总觉得，如果他本来就不想被揍的话，你也是打不中他的。 |你会感觉到自己的全身从头到脚都处于紧张状态，心脏仿佛也停止了跳动，直到你的本能告诉你：不，你并没有面临迫在眉睫的危险，只不过是某个家伙在无聊地闹着小把戏而已……当然，这种行为确实属于“无害”的范畴。他其实也没办法控制自己，这简直就是他的天性使然。 ] |过了一会儿，你的守护神突然出现在祭坛前的你脚下，上半身赤裸，浑身湿漉漉的，仿佛刚从浴缸里出来。凯罗斯一手拿着一根长柄烟斗，另一手则拿着一个白色瓷罐，里面装着气味浓烈、清澈透明的酒。他正准备把罐子里的酒直接喝下去，这时他抬头一看，似乎才意识到自己并不在……之前所在的地方。 哦，呃。尽管满脸惊讶，他还是会向你眨眨眼，让你知道这一切都是装出来的。嗯！ 现在对他来说，是不是一个不好的时机呢？ 不，其实不是这样的。反正我也得回去工作了。 ] …哦，赶紧开始吧。 哈！凯罗斯拍手示意，然后绕到你的面前。我知道你为什么来这里——你的眼神里充满了迫切的需求。上来吧，我马上就开始工作。 嗯，这可真是个再好不过的邀请了。你就等着凯罗斯把祭坛上那些日常供品挪到一边，然后当你看到他敲打那些被挪开的空位时，立刻坐上去吧。凯罗斯会看着你一会儿，发出“啧啧”的声音，然后搓搓手部、活动活动手指。
