rows.original: "Mm-mm-mmm," he replies as you give your answer. Let's begin, then." The kitsune deity's fingers twist and writhe, sending your instincts screaming and running for cover, but you know what's coming and force yourself to be still as Keros steps up and begins working on you once more. His red slitted eyes gleam with a barely constrained mischievous glee as his fingers sculpt your face and body — maybe it's because you're already one of his, maybe it's because there's less in total to work on, but the process is much swifter than it was the first time you went through it. Still, the sensation of his too-long fingers digging into your flesh is something that you may never get used to. Perhaps he's making the whole process disquieting on purpose, to encourage you to keep yourself in one piece. Who knows? It's certainly a possibility — he is the Trickster, after all. [rand |"So, how're you taking to being my champion?" Keros says nonchalantly as he adds a few details to your shoulderblades. "Enjoying the reverence you're getting as befits your station?" It's... unsettling, for lack of a better term to put it. You're simply not used to everyone bowing and scraping before you all the time[pc.bg nobleScion | — sure, you were nobility before all this started, but even so nobles in this part of the world don't get this degree of forelock-tugging ]. Whether it's the truth or not, you can't shake the feeling that they're being less than genuine about it. "Mm. Such suspicion. Such doubt. Expecting such of me is one thing, of course, but expecting such from my people..." Keros tsks. "Well, it will take some time. Then again, if a fox does wish to slight you, we've perfected the art of insult by being just a bit too polite for the recipient's station. Done properly, the slighted never even notices. A very nice thing that preys upon those who're self-inflated beyond their actual achievement, hmm?" ...He just said that to make you even more paranoid, didn't he? "Now, whyever would I do such a thing? It is the truth, after all. Old Country social dynamics are a morass to wade through, kitsune ones even more so, and high-status kitsune etiquette the top of the top." Keros gives you a knowing wink. "Don't worry about it, though. As my personal champion, you're worthy of nothing but the utmost respect." |"Enjoying your new senses? Your new faculties?" Keros says nonchalantly as he adds a few details to your shoulderblades. "That sort of reshaping of not just the body, but other less tangible aspects of a person really does need a god's personal attention to come out right. Imagine what might have happened if that portal had gotten to your ki as well as your chi — you wouldn't be the same person one day to the other. Horrible!" They're... interesting. Kitsune have been with foxfire all their lives, so they wouldn't know the difference, but you do. It's something, all right. That, and the ears and tails — having erogenous zones of your body so prominently exposed and sensitive to touch is something else altogether." Keros chuckles at that. "Remember, don't drag our tails on the ground when you walk. Lift them up — there's more than good posture at stake there." It's just... vexing when you keep on getting distracted when the slightest breeze or brush tickles your ears. That, and the way they have a life on their own, especially when you're not paying attention to them, but you'll get used to it. "And in the meantime, it's going to be a lot of fun. An average kitsune would have been getting used to it right from within their mother's womb... but ah, seeing you deal with it is no end of entertainment, admittedly." [kiyoko.isFree |Well, maybe that's why Kiyoko's kits are always so active when she's with child. Sensitive indeed, to need to get used to it all from the first moments of life... |It's nice to know that one of your duties as the Trickster's champion, amongst your many other weighty responsibilities, is to be a source of amusement. "Hey, don't say that you didn't see it coming." Keros tries to slap you on the back, and his hand passes straight through you and comes out the other side. "It's not as if it requires you to do anything beyond what you're already coming to grips with, so it's no extra effort on your part. Just do as you've been doing, and everything will eventually turn out fine. Remember, we're all behind you a hundred and one percent!" ] |"You know, someday I wonder if I'll be able to take you back to the Old Country, show you off a bit, let you have a vacation when this is all done and let you soak up the culture. An invitation by a deity himself to let his newly-appointed champion tour his power base. You'd like that, wouldn't you?" It would certainly be an experience. If it were just you alone, going to a completely foreign culture might give you pause, but given that it's literally the patron god who's offering to show you around and you'd be in a reasonable position of honor — "Oh no no no. If we do go, it'd be incognito. Of course, you'd have an appropriate cover identity to explain why you're a bumbling fool who can't be expected to know the proper etiquette, but that's part of the fun. You'd get away with a lot more than I would, eh?" Okay, that's a bit more intimidating, but it'd still be all right since he would be the one showing you around. "It's been about two and a half centuries since I properly surveyed the land — took ten years of getting deep and personal with everyone and everything until matters were to my satisfaction. Of course, you wouldn't need to come for the entire trip — maybe a month or so at the outset or the middle, like what Komari did back in the day. She joined me on my little adventure for a year before crossing the ocean for good... wasn't a bad traveling companion, to tell the truth. Every good comic needs a straight man to play off of, after all." [kiyoko.isFree |And what of Kiyoko? Would she be able to join you on this sojourn if it came to be? Keros' ears twitch at that, then droop. "Ah, well... not quite likely, to be honest." You understand that there're some political matters that're involved in her — well, resurrection? Reincarnation? Neither are quite the correct terms for her situation, but that's beyond the point. She can never return, even if it's just for pleasure? "Nothing is 'just for' pleasure in the matters of the Imperial Court. Merely setting foot upon the shores of the Old Country is likely to instil panic in several individuals, most of all her sister's descendants. Even formally abdicating her claim hasn't really done much to allay their fears, I'm afraid." But he could disguise her, right? Didn't he say the trip would be incognito? "Yes. So the question is really one of whether she will hold to her promise even if there's nothing to be lost — or at least, from that standpoint — by breaking it. And she really will. She really will." ] Well, for all that to happen, you'd have to deal with matters in the Marches first. One thing at a time. "No doubt. And let's face it — with a god at your back, how can you ever hope to fail, hmm? If you did, there would be no end of shame to it, given every conceivable advantage and still managing to fall. Ah, but I digress. We're just about done now." ] Keros finishes putting up the last touches on you, then as always, hold up the hand mirror for you to examine yourself. Everything seems to be in order, and you give the Trickster an appreciative nod. His attention to detail is much appreciated. "Oh, it's not a problem, trust me on that. I do have to keep my champion looking [pc.hisHer] best, after all! All right, then, off with you! There's still a lot to be done out there in the world, much mischief to be made and interesting happenstances to participate in!" Keros urges you off the stool with a firm [pc.buttRange 5 |swat on your [pc.ass] |smack on the back ], then gives you a final wink before pulling his tails in on himself and disapparating in his usual fashion of folding his person upon himself. You push open the shrine doors and step out into the [dayNight |sun |moon ]light revitalised, ready to take on anything[party.hasCompanions |as [party.compNames] fall[party.oneCompanion |s ] in line behind you ].
rows.translation: 嗯嗯嗯……在他回答之前，你先给出了自己的答案。那我们开始吧。 那只九尾狐神的手指不断扭曲、蠕动，让你的本能发出剧烈的警报，驱使你想要立刻躲藏起来。但你知道接下来会发生什么，于是强迫自己保持静止。当凯罗斯再次走上前来开始操作时，他那双红色、带有裂隙的眼睛中闪烁着几乎难以抑制的顽皮光芒。他的手指轻轻塑造着你的脸庞和身体——或许是因为你早已成为了他的一部分，又或许是因为这次需要改造的部位已经变少了，总之，这个过程比你第一次经历时要快得多。然而，他那过长的手指深入你的肌肤所带来的那种感觉，可能是你永远都无法习惯的。也许他故意让整个过程变得如此令人不适，就是为了迫使你保持冷静、不要做出任何冲动的行为。谁知道呢？这当然是有可能的——毕竟，他可是那个善于玩弄诡计的人啊。 [rand |那么，你当我的英雄感觉怎么样？凯罗斯漫不经心地说道，同时还轻轻敲了敲你的肩胛骨，补充了一些细节。享受着人们因你的地位而给予你的尊敬，是不是？ 用一个不太恰当的词来形容的话，这种感觉确实挺让人不安的。你根本不习惯总是有人对你毕恭毕敬、讨好奉承的。[pc.bg nobleScion | — 当然，在这一切发生之前你确实是贵族，但即便如此，在这个地区的贵族们也不会如此卑躬屈膝。 ]无论这是不是事实，你都无法摆脱这样的感觉：他们在这件事上的态度不够真诚。 嗯，这样的怀疑，这样的不信任。当然，对我抱有这样的期望是可以理解的，但对我的手下也抱有这样的期望……喀嚓声。嗯，它会这需要一些时间。不过，如果真有狐妖想要怠慢你的话，我们早已掌握了如何用最轻微的言辞来表达侮辱的技巧。太这种做法对接收方来说确实显得很有礼貌。如果处理得当，被冒犯的人甚至根本不会察觉到。这种策略专门针对那些自视甚高、实际能力远不如他们所宣称的人，嗯？ …他这么说只是为了让你更加多疑，对吧？ 现在，我究竟为什么要做这样的事情呢？毕竟，这是事实。旧国的社会关系错综复杂，而狐族的社会结构更是让人难以理清头绪，至于那些地位较高的狐族，他们的礼仪规范更是复杂到了极点。凯罗斯向你投来一个会意的眨眼。不过，你不必担心。作为我的私人守护者，你理应得到最高的尊重。 |享受你新获得的能力吧？这些全新的感官功能……凯罗斯若无其事地说道，同时还轻轻敲了敲你的肩胛骨，补充了一些细节。这种不仅是对身体，而且是对一个人其他那些无形方面的重塑，确实需要神的亲自关注才能做到完美。想象一下，如果那个通道真的进入了你的身体，会发生什么ki以及你的气人不可能一天到另一天就变得完全不同。太可怕了！ 它们……确实挺有意思的。狐妖们一生都与狐火相伴，所以他们根本分不清这两者的区别，但你知道。这一点确实很特别。再加上它们的耳朵和尾巴——身体的这些部位如此显眼，且对触碰极为敏感，这也使得它们与众不同。 凯罗斯听到这话，不禁笑了起来。记住，走路的时候不要让我们的尾巴拖在地上。把它们抬起来——这可不仅仅是为了保持良好的姿势。 当最轻微的微风或声响都会让你分心时，真的会让人感到很恼火。还有那些东西似乎有着自己的“生命”，尤其是在你没有注意它们的时候，它们依然会继续“活动”。不过，慢慢地你就会习惯这种情况的。 而在这段时间里，过程一定会非常有趣。普通的狐妖从母体里出来就应该已经习惯了这种事情……不过，说实话，看你应对这些情况，确实是一件非常有趣的事情。 [kiyoko.isFree |嗯，也许这就是为什么纪代子在怀孕期间使用的那些道具总是那么有效的原因。确实很敏感，从孩子出生的那一刻起就需要适应这一切…… |知道作为“骗子”的代言人，你在众多重要职责之外，还肩负着为人们带来欢乐的任务，真是件令人欣慰的事。 嘿，可别说你没预料到会发生这种事。凯罗斯试图拍你的后背，但他的手直接穿过了你，从另一侧穿了出去。这并不会要求你去做任何超出你目前能力范围的事情，所以这对你来说并不会增加任何额外的负担。只要你继续按照之前的方式去做，一切最终都会好起来的。记住，我们所有人都在百分之百地支持你！ ] |你知道吗，有一天我会在想，是否能够带你回到旧国，让你好好看看那里的风轻型，等这一切都结束后，让你去度个假，让你亲身感受那里的文化。毕竟，这是一位神明亲自发出的邀请，让他的新任命的冠军去参观他的势力基地。你肯定也会想要这样的机会吧？ 那肯定会是一次非常特别的体验。如果只有你一个人去面对一种完全陌生的文化，你可能会犹豫不决，但既然有那位赞助者支持你上帝谁愿意带你参观一下呢？这样做未免太失礼了 哦不不不，如果我们确实去吧，这样就可以隐姓埋名了。当然，你得准备一个合理的伪装身份，来解释为什么你会表现得像个连基本礼仪都不懂的笨蛋，但这也正是其中的乐趣所在。比起我，你肯定能更顺利地混过去，对吧？ 好吧，这听起来确实有点吓人，但既然会是由他来带您参观，那就应该没什么问题了。 自从我最后一次彻底勘测这片土地以来，已经过去了大约两个半世纪。我花了十年的时间，与这里的每一个人、每一样事物进行深入的接触，直到一切都达到我的要求为止。当然，你们并不需要全程都来这里——也许只需要在开始或者中途停留一个月左右，就像当年麻里所做的那样。她陪伴我度过了那一年的冒险时光，之后便永久地远渡重洋离开了……说实话，她确实是个不错的旅伴。毕竟，每一部优秀的喜剧都需要有一个“正经角色”来与之形成对比，才能让喜剧效果更加突出。 [kiyoko.isFree |那么，清子呢？如果真的发生了这样的事情，她能够和你一起踏上这段旅程吗？ 听到这里，凯罗斯的耳朵微微一动，然后又耷拉了下来。啊，嗯……说实话，可能性不大吧。 你明白，她的处境涉及到一些政治因素——嗯，复活？转世？这两个词都不足以准确描述她的状况，但这一点已经无关紧要了。她永远无法回归，哪怕只是为了寻求片刻的快乐也好。 在宫廷事务中，没有任何事情是纯粹为了取悦他人而存在的。仅仅是因为有人踏上了故国的土地，就很可能引发某些人的恐慌，尤其是她姐姐的后代们。恐怕，即使她正式放弃了自己的继承权，也并没有真正缓解他们的恐惧。 但他可以伪装她，对吧？他不是说过这次旅行会保持隐秘身份吗？ 是的。所以问题其实就在于：即使违背承诺并不会让她失去任何东西——或者至少从那个角度来看，违背承诺并不会带来任何负面影响——她是否还是会坚守自己的承诺。而她确实会这么做的。她真的会。 ] 嗯，要想让所有这些事情发生，你首先得处理边境地区的一些问题。一件事情接一件事情来处理吧。 毫无疑问。而且我们必须承认——有神明支持你，你还怎么可能失败呢，嗯？如果你真的失败了，那将会是无比羞耻的事情，毕竟你拥有所有可能的优势，却还是没能成功。啊，不过我有点跑题了。我们差不多要结束了。 ] 凯罗斯完成了对你最后的修饰工作，然后像往常一样递过来手镜让你检查自己的模样。一切看起来都井井有条，你向那个善于搞恶作剧的人点了点头表示感谢——他这种对细节的关注确实令人十分欣赏。 哦，这没什么问题，相信我。我确实得让我的英雄看起来[pc.hisHer]毕竟，这是最好的选择！那么，快去吧！世界上还有许多事情等着你去完成，还有很多有趣的事情等着你去体验呢！ 凯罗斯用力一推，让你从凳子上摔了下来。 [pc.buttRange 5 |拍打你的[pc.ass] |轻拍后背以示鼓励 ]然后，它还会向你最后眨一下眼，接着便将自己蜷缩起来，以它惯常的方式消失不见了。你推开门，走出了那座神龛[dayNight |太阳 |月亮 ]光芒重新焕发，已准备好迎接任何挑战[party.hasCompanions |如同[party.compNames]掉落[party.oneCompanion | ]排在你的后面 ]。
rows.raw: " "Mm-mm-mmm," he replies as you give your answer. Let's begin, then." The kitsune deity's fingers twist and writhe, sending your instincts screaming and running for cover, but you know what's coming and force yourself to be still as Keros steps up and begins working on you once more. His red slitted eyes gleam with a barely constrained mischievous glee as his fingers sculpt your face and body — maybe it's because you're already one of his, maybe it's because there's less in total to work on, but the process is much swifter than it was the first time you went through it. Still, the sensation of his too-long fingers digging into your flesh is something that you may never get used to. Perhaps he's making the whole process disquieting on purpose, to encourage you to keep yourself in one piece. Who knows? It's certainly a possibility — he is the Trickster, after all. [rand |"So, how're you taking to being my champion?" Keros says nonchalantly as he adds a few details to your shoulderblades. "Enjoying the reverence you're getting as befits your station?" It's... unsettling, for lack of a better term to put it. You're simply not used to everyone bowing and scraping before you all the time[pc.bg nobleScion | — sure, you were nobility before all this started, but even so nobles in this part of the world don't get this degree of forelock-tugging ]. Whether it's the truth or not, you can't shake the feeling that they're being less than genuine about it. "Mm. Such suspicion. Such doubt. Expecting such of me is one thing, of course, but expecting such from my people..." Keros tsks. "Well, it will take some time. Then again, if a fox does wish to slight you, we've perfected the art of insult by being just a bit too polite for the recipient's station. Done properly, the slighted never even notices. A very nice thing that preys upon those who're self-inflated beyond their actual achievement, hmm?" ...He just said that to make you even more paranoid, didn't he? "Now, whyever would I do such a thing? It is the truth, after all. Old Country social dynamics are a morass to wade through, kitsune ones even more so, and high-status kitsune etiquette the top of the top." Keros gives you a knowing wink. "Don't worry about it, though. As my personal champion, you're worthy of nothing but the utmost respect." |"Enjoying your new senses? Your new faculties?" Keros says nonchalantly as he adds a few details to your shoulderblades. "That sort of reshaping of not just the body, but other less tangible aspects of a person really does need a god's personal attention to come out right. Imagine what might have happened if that portal had gotten to your ki as well as your chi — you wouldn't be the same person one day to the other. Horrible!" They're... interesting. Kitsune have been with foxfire all their lives, so they wouldn't know the difference, but you do. It's something, all right. That, and the ears and tails — having erogenous zones of your body so prominently exposed and sensitive to touch is something else altogether." Keros chuckles at that. "Remember, don't drag our tails on the ground when you walk. Lift them up — there's more than good posture at stake there." It's just... vexing when you keep on getting distracted when the slightest breeze or brush tickles your ears. That, and the way they have a life on their own, especially when you're not paying attention to them, but you'll get used to it. "And in the meantime, it's going to be a lot of fun. An average kitsune would have been getting used to it right from within their mother's womb... but ah, seeing you deal with it is no end of entertainment, admittedly." [kiyoko.isFree |Well, maybe that's why Kiyoko's kits are always so active when she's with child. Sensitive indeed, to need to get used to it all from the first moments of life... |It's nice to know that one of your duties as the Trickster's champion, amongst your many other weighty responsibilities, is to be a source of amusement. "Hey, don't say that you didn't see it coming." Keros tries to slap you on the back, and his hand passes straight through you and comes out the other side. "It's not as if it requires you to do anything beyond what you're already coming to grips with, so it's no extra effort on your part. Just do as you've been doing, and everything will eventually turn out fine. Remember, we're all behind you a hundred and one percent!" ] |"You know, someday I wonder if I'll be able to take you back to the Old Country, show you off a bit, let you have a vacation when this is all done and let you soak up the culture. An invitation by a deity himself to let his newly-appointed champion tour his power base. You'd like that, wouldn't you?" It would certainly be an experience. If it were just you alone, going to a completely foreign culture might give you pause, but given that it's literally the patron god who's offering to show you around and you'd be in a reasonable position of honor — "Oh no no no. If we do go, it'd be incognito. Of course, you'd have an appropriate cover identity to explain why you're a bumbling fool who can't be expected to know the proper etiquette, but that's part of the fun. You'd get away with a lot more than I would, eh?" Okay, that's a bit more intimidating, but it'd still be all right since he would be the one showing you around. "It's been about two and a half centuries since I properly surveyed the land — took ten years of getting deep and personal with everyone and everything until matters were to my satisfaction. Of course, you wouldn't need to come for the entire trip — maybe a month or so at the outset or the middle, like what Komari did back in the day. She joined me on my little adventure for a year before crossing the ocean for good... wasn't a bad traveling companion, to tell the truth. Every good comic needs a straight man to play off of, after all." [kiyoko.isFree |And what of Kiyoko? Would she be able to join you on this sojourn if it came to be? Keros' ears twitch at that, then droop. "Ah, well... not quite likely, to be honest." You understand that there're some political matters that're involved in her — well, resurrection? Reincarnation? Neither are quite the correct terms for her situation, but that's beyond the point. She can never return, even if it's just for pleasure? "Nothing is 'just for' pleasure in the matters of the Imperial Court. Merely setting foot upon the shores of the Old Country is likely to instil panic in several individuals, most of all her sister's descendants. Even formally abdicating her claim hasn't really done much to allay their fears, I'm afraid." But he could disguise her, right? Didn't he say the trip would be incognito? "Yes. So the question is really one of whether she will hold to her promise even if there's nothing to be lost — or at least, from that standpoint — by breaking it. And she really will. She really will." ] Well, for all that to happen, you'd have to deal with matters in the Marches first. One thing at a time. "No doubt. And let's face it — with a god at your back, how can you ever hope to fail, hmm? If you did, there would be no end of shame to it, given every conceivable advantage and still managing to fall. Ah, but I digress. We're just about done now." ] Keros finishes putting up the last touches on you, then as always, hold up the hand mirror for you to examine yourself. Everything seems to be in order, and you give the Trickster an appreciative nod. His attention to detail is much appreciated. "Oh, it's not a problem, trust me on that. I do have to keep my champion looking [pc.hisHer] best, after all! All right, then, off with you! There's still a lot to be done out there in the world, much mischief to be made and interesting happenstances to participate in!" Keros urges you off the stool with a firm [pc.buttRange 5 |swat on your [pc.ass] |smack on the back ], then gives you a final wink before pulling his tails in on himself and disapparating in his usual fashion of folding his person upon himself. You push open the shrine doors and step out into the [dayNight |sun |moon ]light revitalised, ready to take on anything[party.hasCompanions |as [party.compNames] fall[party.oneCompanion |s ] in line behind you ]. "

rows.original: Seeing you approach [var0 |Miko and Mai step |Mai steps |Miko steps ][pc.ra kitsune |out of your way, [dayNight |the other petitioners who've come this day parting before you like curtains. After all, everyone knows the proper etiquette to respond to the presence of someone as eminent as you... except you yourself, perhaps |sliding open the shrine doors to admit you entry without question. There is no question, after all, of whether you're supposed to be here or not ]. |forward to block your path, all smiles and geniality. "Beggin' yer pardon, but jus' gotta ask, 'cause it's our job an' all... ya got any business headin' in?" You wish to see their lord and master, petition him for some personal time together. Private time, as it were. Hearing this, [var0 |the sisters wink |Mai winks |Miko winks ] back at you as [var0 |they |she |she ] usher your forward and slide[var0 | |s |s ] open the shrine doors. "Ooooh. If'n yer in th' mood to be petitionin' his divine lordship so directly, no one ain't gonna stop ya or anythin'. Jus' don't overextend yerself, ya hear?" Sounds like something [var0 |they'd |she'd |she'd ] know by experience... "It ain't wrong that his divine lordship looks like he needs some private supplicatin' from time to time, ya know..." ] [pc.hasFootwear |You remove your [pc.shoes] |You dust off your feet in the approved fashion ] as you step inside the little shrine, the scent of incense light in the air, the day's offerings of fresh fruit and vegetables laid out on the altar before the statue of the Trickster. The doors slide shut behind you with a final-sounding thud, and the silence within the room presses heavily upon you, the noises of the world beyond dulled as they come to you through the walls. Now to get the attention of a god... Surprisingly — or unsurprisingly, given who you're dealing with — it's not that hard[pc.bg acolyte |, despite everything you were taught in your youth growing up as an acolyte in a monastery ]. You've barely begun thinking about it when the August Master at the Center Of Heaven himself steps off the little plinth where his statue was a moment ago, picking up a plum from the altar on the way down. "Well, if it isn't [pc.ra kitsune |my chosen champion |[pc.name] ]!" he exclaims, voice as smooth as buttered silk. "Come to petition me directly, have you?" That's... that's about the long and short of it. You haven't come at a bad time, have you? Not interrupting anything important? "Oh, don't worry about that. If you were, I wouldn't have shown up in the first place. Now, that's not to say that I don't have several pressing issues on my agenda, but then I always have several pressing issues on my agenda. If I put off having fun until I got everything out of the way, I'd never get around to having any 'me' time, as it were! The trick, of course, is to have fun while you're working, but that's not always possible. "Besides, [rand |I really don't mind visiting the colonies; everything grows so big and robust in this part of the world." He waggles the plum in his hand for emphasis, and takes a rich bite out of it. "Four or five generations compared to their relatives across the ocean, and the colonials are starting to fill out nicely. Just look at dear Mikoto and Miyuki outside — brought here when they were six, and now all full and ripe. Is it something in the food and water, or is it just plain magic dirt?" |it's nice to get away from all the ceremony and ritual for a little bit without needing to travel incognito. Where you can really let your tails hang free and be yourself for a bit, you know? Yes, I was the one who set down the precepts which became the laws which codify the society of not just kitsune but all Old Country peoples, but even so, they're not really for me, but for them, right?" |I really do enjoy my hands-on approach to everything — it lets you have that personal touch to your work that you really can't have directing things from a distance. And part of that is showing your face often and meeting the people petitioning you in person, as opposed to the way stuffy schoolmarms like Tira and Lumia handle their affairs. Isn't it better when you can speak to your god directly and receive a concrete, direct response?" |I wouldn't be a very good patron deity if I couldn't be personally moved to take personal action from time to time, right? Even if it's just having a friendly little chat with [pc.ra kitsune |my chosen champion |a petitioner like you ] — seeing people home safely at night, watching out for little children, that sort of thing. Lumia says that you shouldn't coddle people, that they need to work out their own problems to help them grow stronger, but there's simply no fun in backing off all the time, is there? For all the things on the face of this world, people are simply the most fascinating things in their own right." |I was planning to head down later today and invite myself to dinner with Komari and her family; it's been a while since I last did that. I wonder what Miko will cook up today once she gets off her shift at the shrine. Between her, her mountain of a cousin, and their appetites, sharing a meal with them is never boring. Hence, it's not too big a deal if I stop by and tend to [pc.ra kitsune |my champion |a petitioner ] first, is it? Maybe you should come along with me once we're done here — the table conversation may not be riveting, but the food's always good." ] You don't really have an answer for that... "I didn't expect you to." Keros tilts his head and wiggles his ears at you, then finishes off the plum and tosses the pit over his shoulder, where it burns up cleanly in a sharp burst of foxfire. "Now then, what would you like to ask of the August Master at the Center Of Heaven himself?"

rows.raw: " Seeing you approach [var0 |Miko and Mai step |Mai steps |Miko steps ][pc.ra kitsune |out of your way, [dayNight |the other petitioners who've come this day parting before you like curtains. "Beggin' yer pardon, but jus' gotta ask, 'cause it's our job an' all... ya got any business headin' in?" You wish to see their lord and master, petition him for some personal time together. Private time, as it were. Hearing this, [var0 |the sisters wink |Mai winks |Miko winks ] back at you as [var0 |they |she |she ] usher your forward and slide[var0 | |s |s ] open the shrine doors. "Ooooh. If'n yer in th' mood to be petitionin' his divine lordship so directly, no one ain't gonna stop ya or anythin'. Jus' don't overextend yerself, ya hear?" Sounds like something [var0 |they'd |she'd |she'd ] know by experience... "It ain't wrong that his divine lordship looks like he needs some private supplicatin' from time to time, ya know..." ] [pc.hasFootwear |You remove your [pc.shoes] |You dust off your feet in the approved fashion ] as you step inside the little shrine, the scent of incense light in the air, the day's offerings of fresh fruit and vegetables laid out on the altar before the statue of the Trickster. The doors slide shut behind you with a final-sounding thud, and the silence within the room presses heavily upon you, the noises of the world beyond dulled as they come to you through the walls. Now to get the attention of a god... Surprisingly — or unsurprisingly, given who you're dealing with — it's not that hard[pc.bg acolyte |, despite everything you were taught in your youth growing up as an acolyte in a monastery ]. You've barely begun thinking about it when the August Master at the Center Of Heaven himself steps off the little plinth where his statue was a moment ago, picking up a plum from the altar on the way down. "Well, if it isn't [pc.ra kitsune |my chosen champion |[pc.name] ]!" he exclaims, voice as smooth as buttered silk. "Come to petition me directly, have you?" That's... that's about the long and short of it. You haven't come at a bad time, have you? Not interrupting anything important? "Oh, don't worry about that. If you were, I wouldn't have shown up in the first place. Now, that's not to say that I don't have several pressing issues on my agenda, but then I always have several pressing issues on my agenda. If I put off having fun until I got everything out of the way, I'd never get around to having any 'me' time, as it were! The trick, of course, is to have fun while you're working, but that's not always possible. "Besides, [rand |I really don't mind visiting the colonies; everything grows so big and robust in this part of the world." He waggles the plum in his hand for emphasis, and takes a rich bite out of it. "Four or five generations compared to their relatives across the ocean, and the colonials are starting to fill out nicely. Just look at dear Mikoto and Miyuki outside — brought here when they were six, and now all full and ripe. Is it something in the food and water, or is it just plain magic dirt?" |it's nice to get away from all the ceremony and ritual for a little bit without needing to travel incognito. Where you can really let your tails hang free and be yourself for a bit, you know? Yes, I was the one who set down the precepts which became the laws which codify the society of not just kitsune but all Old Country peoples, but even so, they're not really for me, but for them, right?" |I really do enjoy my hands-on approach to everything — it lets you have that personal touch to your work that you really can't have directing things from a distance. And part of that is showing your face often and meeting the people petitioning you in person, as opposed to the way stuffy schoolmarms like Tira and Lumia handle their affairs. Isn't it better when you can speak to your god directly and receive a concrete, direct response?" |I wouldn't be a very good patron deity if I couldn't be personally moved to take personal action from time to time, right? Even if it's just having a friendly little chat with [pc.ra kitsune |my chosen champion |a petitioner like you ] — seeing people home safely at night, watching out for little children, that sort of thing. Lumia says that you shouldn't coddle people, that they need to work out their own problems to help them grow stronger, but there's simply no fun in backing off all the time, is there? For all the things on the face of this world, people are simply the most fascinating things in their own right." |I was planning to head down later today and invite myself to dinner with Komari and her family; it's been a while since I last did that. I wonder what Miko will cook up today once she gets off her shift at the shrine. Between her, her mountain of a cousin, and their appetites, sharing a meal with them is never boring. Hence, it's not too big a deal if I stop by and tend to [pc.ra kitsune |my champion |a petitioner ] first, is it? Maybe you should come along with me once we're done here — the table conversation may not be riveting, but the food's always good." ] You don't really have an answer for that... "I didn't expect you to." Keros tilts his head and wiggles his ears at you, then finishes off the plum and tosses the pit over his shoulder, where it burns up cleanly in a sharp burst of foxfire. "Now then, what would you like to ask of the August Master at the Center Of Heaven himself?" "

[pc.ra kitsune |Responsibility — and hence, shame — flows upwards; if I do not take you in hand, then I, too, bear the shame of my wayward underlings." He chuckles, just a hint of darkness creeping into the undertones of his oh-so-smooth voice. And given the circumstances and your actual desires, I think I have a good idea of what it is that the likes of you needs ]. "Now then, take off your clothes and lie down right here," Keros purrs, gesturing to his lap as he lounges atop the altar amidst the offerings. "It's for your own good." The mere sound of his voice is enough to have your [pc.cockVagBoth |[pc.cocks] jump and twitch |[pc.vag] moisten |[pc.cocks] jump and twitch even as your [pc.vag] moistens ], something about his words that brook no discussion about even the possibility of you disobeying. For a moment you wonder if he's using some kind of tricksy mind-meld to addle you into doing his bidding, then realize that no, he's doing nothing of the sort; the simple surety of the Trickster's words is enough to wield power like that of its own without needing to drag in outside influences. [pc.ra kitsune |And when your body starts moving of its own accord, taking eager, subservient steps towards the August Master at the Center of Heaven, the simple fact that he owns you in every sense of the word is unavoidable. That, and you willingly sold yourself into his service with full knowledge of all this, and it brings you so much joy |Your apprehensiveness melts away under the rich smoothness of the deity's words, every proposition he makes sounding ever so measured and reasonable. This is what you asked for after all, and as you step forward you know you're going to get your wish granted good and hard ]. Keros' gaze is calm but intense, burning holes in your [pc.ass] as you undress and lay yourself across his lap without question. You feel his slitted red eyes penetrating you from every angle, and something pours off his person in waves, something you don't have a name for but is very, very palpable when you feel it stir up your insides and cause them to ache oh-so-deeply. A mixture of something between longing and need... and perhaps a bit of security. Warmth, perhaps... but in the form of an imminent wildfire, distilled chaos in its purest form. Despite the fine-fingered grasp the deity has and his leanly muscled arms, Keros has little trouble in grabbing your wrists and pinning your arms behind your back, locking them in place with another of his radiant white fluffy tails. Biting your lip, you shudder in arousal and anticipation. This is exactly what you wanted, and from a god, no less! You don't get much higher than that! "[pc.ra kitsune |Well, then. As my champion, each and every one of your actions — like being an unrepentant slut and glutton for punishment — reflects upon me and my choices, my dear. I hope you will keep this in mind as I properly chastise you in a fashion appropriate to your actions and temperament. |Well then. Now then, to chastise you in a fashion appropriate to your actions and temperament... ]" [pc.hasTail |Grabbing your [pc.tails] with a hand, Keros pushes them up and forward against your back, exposing the entire fullness of your [pc.ass] to him. He [pc.ra kitsune |takes the time to run his fingers through your fur, pressing down firmly on the warm core of your tails from base to tip and back again, and you moan aloud. When several moments slip by and you still haven't received your just desserts, you relax a little and look up at your divine disciplinarian. That's when he crooks the corner of his wry little smile upwards and slaps you hard on your [pc.ass]. The breath rushes out of your lungs at the stinging sensation that sinks deep into your flesh, prickling echoes fanning outward into the rest of your body; Keros himself reads you like an open book, angling his palm and fingers to strike the exact same spot on your posterior with delicate, superb finesse the moment you've begun to recover. rows.original: Approaching the little fox shrine, you're struck by the sight of [dayNight |there being absolutely no petitioners at this time of day. [var0 |It's that time of day between the changing of light and dark when both sisters are up and on duty at the shrine, but that's usually to deal with the number of petitioners at dusk and dawn. And there aren't any at the moment, strange that |For Miko to be up and about at this time of night... she's almost certainly the kind of girl who sleeps soundly, so whatever's keeping her up with her sister should be important |For Mai to be up and about during the bright of day... wonder if something's pressing ]. Then you notice who they're conversing with — a fine-featured, rather conventionally pretty kitsune with nine tails and white fur. One of their high aristocrats, maybe? You do remember the significance of natural white fluff for their kind, and she does carry herself with that bearing... [pc.ra kitsune |And then it hits you. That same feeling — in the dim confinesnot quite of uneasiness, but certainly yearning and knowing that you felt when Keros removed your soul and replaced it with a decoy, that sensation that's always at the back of your mind when he's nearby. Yes, there's no doubt about it, and your only regret is that you didn't realize it sooner. The colorful, multihued clothes should've been a dead giveaway, after all; without really knowing what you're doing or to be honest, in complete control of your body to begin with, you step up to the trio and give your patron deity a bow in the approved fashion even as Miko and Mai bow to you in acknowledgement of your presence. Keros titters, half-raising a hand as if to obscure her face with a fan, and then thinking better of it. "Why, what a surprise, my dear champion. I was wondering when you'd make the connection, or if you'd recognize me in this guise to begin with. But then, you know that I'm unmistakable to you, right?" Yes, yes. Very much so. "Call it a divine sense after a fashion." |Oh, of course. But it has to be — there's no other explanation for it, is there? Miko and Mai don't treat even their own great-great-grandmother with such reverence; there's only one person in the entire world who might warrant that. Besides, the colorful, multihued clothes that look like they're constantly in flux are a dead giveaway. Miko and Mai titter amongst themselves as you approach, but Keros half-raises a hand to quiet down her priestesses. "My, my, what a surprise, [pc.name]. I was half-wondering when you'd get it, or how long it'd take for you to work up the courage to stick your foot into what's almost certainly a bundle of trouble." ] What's up with the guise, anyway? Sure, you don't doubt that a god can look like anyone or anything he — or she — wants to, but is there a special occasion for this? "I can't go walking around in my usual guise without people falling over to bow and scrape to the divine — things are no fun that way, you know." So in order to avoid that, she chose a guise that almost certainly would have people bowing and scraping, if you understand the kitsune pecking order well enough. "It's something I'm accustomed to doing at this point, often in less obvious guises; I did make a round of ten or so years as a tanuki noodle seller with a pushcart, just walking from place to place and taking in the sights and sounds. People and their foibles, their concerns, though no doubt petty and everyday to you, are quite fascinating to me. The average village which may be a hundred paces from end to end and where a shout may be heard by all the neighbors nevertheless easily holds enough petty drama to provide entertainment for days on end." And this translates to walking around as a pretty genderbent version of his usual depiction how? "Why, do you like how it looks[pc.ra kitsune |, my dear champion ]? "Call it a divine sense o' sorts — 's th' best way to put it simply." "You don't have to give me an answer now, and I'm quite busy dealing with these two," Keros replies, her fingers worming their way atop the two sisters' heads and delivering firm pats that have both vixens yipping and squealing in no time at all. "But if you'd like to see more of me like this, [pc.ra kitsune |I don't see why I can't indulge my champion for a bit. You've certainly proven yourself capable as an agent provocateur wherever you go ]." ...You'll see whether that offer interests you. "It may. Or it may not. But that's part of the fun in all of this, isn't it? Finding out what is, and what isn't?" Smiling, Keros sends you off with a cheerful wave. "Now, I know I look quite fetching like this, but I do have actual business to take care of with these two girls of mine. “到现在为止，我已经习惯了这样做，只不过方式通常不那么明显罢了；我曾经有十年左右的时间，以推着手推车卖狸猫面这样的身份四处游荡，只是简单地走走看看，感受一下周围的景象和声音而已。人们以及他们的种种怪癖、烦恼，虽然对你来说可能显得微不足道、平淡无奇，但却让我觉得非常有趣。一个平均长度不过一百步的普通村庄，一个喊声就能传遍所有邻居耳中的地方，却总能产生足够多的琐碎戏剧性事件，让人连续数天都乐个不停。那么，这就意味着他在行动举止上，会呈现出与他通常被描绘的形象截然不同的、带有明显性别模糊特征的版本，对吧？ “嗯，你难道不喜欢这样的外观吗？[pc.ra kitsune |我亲爱的勇士， ]如果你愿意的话，我并不介意继续以这样的形象与你交谈。毕竟，这只是我的众多伪装之一罢了。这些年来，美琴和美雪肯定也见过我使用过很多种这样的伪装。我们从来都不知道他的神明身份究竟是什么，他的长相也根本不重要，”舞慢条斯理地说道，“只能说这是一种神赐的直觉吧——简单来说，就是这么回事。” “你现在不必回答我，我正忙着处理这两个人的事情呢，”凯罗斯回答道，她的手指轻轻触碰着那两位姐妹的头顶，轻轻一拍，顿时让那两只狐妖发出了尖锐的叫声。但如果你想看到我更多这样的样子， [pc.ra kitsune |我不明白为什么就不能稍微奖励一下我的英雄呢。毕竟，你已经付出了足够的努力，理应得到我的一些表扬。 |我想不出有什么理由不能满足像你这样有趣的人的一个小请求。无论你走到哪里，你都早已证明了自己有能力充当“惹事者”的角色。 ]……你会看看这个提议是否会引起你的兴趣。” “也许会，也许不会。但这就是整个过程的乐趣所在，不是吗？弄清楚什么会吸引你，什么不会。” 凯罗斯微笑着，愉快地向你挥了挥手：“现在，我知道我这样看起来确实挺吸引人的，但我确实还有正事要处理，得去陪我的这两个女儿。如果你以后想见我，你知道该去哪里找我。 [pc.ra kitsune |我亲爱的勇士。 |不是吗？ ]"
rows.raw: " Approaching the little fox shrine, you're struck by the sight of [dayNight |there being absolutely no petitioners at this time of day. Sure, the number of foxes coming to make offerings to their patron deity ebbs and flows throughout the day, but to have absolutely none while it's still light out is a little odd |silhouettes conversing in the darkness. While the stone lanterns along the path provide lighting to and from the shrine, it's hard to make out exactly what's going on ]. [var0 |It's that time of day between the changing of light and dark when both sisters are up and on duty at the shrine, but that's usually to deal with the number of petitioners at dusk and dawn. And there aren't any at the moment, strange that |For Miko to be up and about at this time of night... she's almost certainly the kind of girl who sleeps soundly, so whatever's keeping her up with her sister should be important |For Mai to be up and about during the bright of day... wonder if something's pressing ]. Then you notice who they're conversing with — a fine-featured, rather conventionally pretty kitsune with nine tails and white fur. One of their high aristocrats, maybe? You do remember the significance of natural white fluff for their kind, and she does carry herself with that bearing... [pc.ra kitsune |And then it hits you. That same feeling — in the dim confinesnot quite of uneasiness, but certainly yearning and knowing that you felt when Keros removed your soul and replaced it with a decoy, that sensation that's always at the back of your mind when he's nearby. Yes, there's no doubt about it, and your only regret is that you didn't realize it sooner. The colorful, multihued clothes should've been a dead giveaway, after all; without really knowing what you're doing or to be honest, in complete control of your body to begin with, you step up to the trio and give your patron deity a bow in the approved fashion even as Miko and Mai bow to you in acknowledgement of your presence. Keros titters, half-raising a hand as if to obscure her face with a fan, and then thinking better of it. "Why, what a surprise, my dear champion. I was wondering when you'd make the connection, or if you'd recognize me in this guise to begin with. But then, you know that I'm unmistakable to you, right?" Yes, yes. Very much so. "Call it a divine sense after a fashion." |Oh, of course. But it has to be — there's no other explanation for it, is there? Miko and Mai don't treat even their own great-great-grandmother with such reverence; there's only one person in the entire world who might warrant that. Besides, the colorful, multihued clothes that look like they're constantly in flux are a dead giveaway. Miko and Mai titter amongst themselves as you approach, but Keros half-raises a hand to quiet down her priestesses. "My, my, what a surprise, [pc.name]. I was half-wondering when you'd get it, or how long it'd take for you to work up the courage to stick your foot into what's almost certainly a bundle of trouble." ] What's up with the guise, anyway? Sure, you don't doubt that a god can look like anyone or anything he — or she — wants to, but is there a special occasion for this? It's not as if the usual depictions of the fox god are of him as a woman, is that right? "Oh, I was just having a little fun touring my power base, that's all," Keros replies, waving a hand dismissively. "I can't go walking around in my usual guise without people falling over to bow and scrape to the divine — things are no fun that way, you know." So in order to avoid that, she chose a guise that almost certainly would have people bowing and scraping, if you understand the kitsune pecking order well enough. "But for a different reason," Keros purrs. "A reason that's fun. And lest you imagine that this appearance is paper-thin at hiding who I am, people are very good at not seeing things that they know ought to be impossible. You're an exception to that, [pc.ra kitsune |my dear champion |[pc.name] ]. Sometimes. An exemplary specimen of a [pc.race], I must say." All right, now you're pretty sure she's flattering you. But all right, then, a little walking amidst the mortals it is, then? "It's something I'm accustomed to doing at this point, often in less obvious guises; I did make a round of ten or so years as a tanuki noodle seller with a pushcart, just walking from place to place and taking in the sights and sounds. People and their foibles, their concerns, though no doubt petty and everyday to you, are quite fascinating to me. The average village which may be a hundred paces from end to end and where a shout may be heard by all the neighbors nevertheless easily holds enough petty drama to provide entertainment for days on end." And this translates to walking around as a pretty genderbent version of his usual depiction how? "Why, do you like how it looks[pc.ra kitsune |, my dear champion ]? If it pleases you, I don't mind conversing with you more looking like this. It's just an appearance, after all, one of many guises I've taken to blend in. Mikoto and Miyuki here certainly have seen a number of them over the years." "We always done know who his divine lordship is, don't matter what he looks like none," Mai drawls. "Call it a divine sense o' sorts — 's th' best way to put it simply." "You don't have to give me an answer now, and I'm quite busy dealing with these two," Keros replies, her fingers worming their way atop the two sisters' heads and delivering firm pats that have both vixens yipping and squealing in no time at all. "But if you'd like to see more of me like this, [pc.ra kitsune |I don't see why I can't indulge my champion for a bit. You've worked hard enough to deserve a little commendation on my part, after all |I don't see why I shouldn't oblige someone as interesting as you are, just for a little while. You've certainly proven yourself capable as an agent provocateur wherever you go ]." ...You'll see whether that offer interests you. "It may. Or it may not. But that's part of the fun in all of this, isn't it? Finding out what is, and what isn't?" Smiling, Keros sends you off with a cheerful wave. "Now, I know I look quite fetching like this, but I do have actual business to take care of with these two girls of mine. If you'd like to see me later, you know where to find me, [pc.ra kitsune |my dear champion. |don't you? ]" "

rows.original: Seeing you approach [var0 |Miko and Mai step |Mai steps |Miko steps ] [pc.ra kitsune |out of your way, [dayNight |the other petitioners who've come this day parting before you like curtains. After all, everyone knows the proper etiquette to respond to the presence of someone as eminent as you... except you yourself, perhaps |sliding open the shrine doors to admit you entry without question. There is no question, after all, of whether you're supposed to be here or not ]. |forward to block your path, all smiles and geniality. "Beggin' yer pardon, but jus' gotta ask, 'cause it's our job an' all... ya got any business headin' in?" You wish to see their lord and master, petition him for some personal time together. Private time, as it were. Hearing this, [var0|the sisters wink|Mai winks|Miko winks] back at you as [var0|they|she|she] usher your forward and slide[var0||s|s] open the shrine doors. "Ooooh. If'n yer in th' mood to be petitionin' his divine lordship so directly, No one ain't gonna stop ya or anythin'. Jus' don't overextend yerself, ya hear?" Sounds like something [var0|they'd|she'd|she'd] know by experience... "It ain't wrong that his divine lordship looks like he needs some private supplicatin' from time to time, ya know..." "Or were ya rather hopin' f'r her instead?" Now then, that's inquiring just a bit too deeply into the personal matters of [pc.ra kitsune |someone who outranks their social station |a lewd and lustful native ], isn't it? Why, one might even imagine that they might be wanting to get a piece of the action themselves. "Ain't needin' to be wantin' nothin'. If'n her divine ladyship done need somethin', it don't need to be said none." ] [pc.hasFootwear |You remove your [pc.shoes] |You dust off your feet in the approved fashion ] as you step inside the little shrine, the scent of incense light in the air, the day's offerings of fresh fruit and vegetables laid out on the altar before the statue of the Trickster. The doors slide shut behind you with a final-sounding thud, and the silence within the room presses heavily upon you, the noises of the world beyond dulled as they come to you through the walls. Now to get the attention of a god... Surprisingly — or unsurprisingly, given who you're dealing with — it's not that hard[pc.bg acolyte |, despite everything you were taught in your youth growing up as an acolyte in a monastery ]. You've barely begun thinking about it when the atmosphere in the chamber shifts, the fragrance of fruit and incense filling the air out of nowhere. And then sitting cross-legged lazily on the altar with the bounty of the fields to either side of her is the August Master — or in this case, Mistress — at the Center of Heaven herself, lazily propping herself up with one hand while the other tosses and catches a sweet-sour mandarin like some kind of plaything. If anything, she's got the carefully disinterested look of a cat down pat... "Well, if it isn't [pc.ra kitsune |my chosen champion |[pc.name] ]!" she purrs, voice as smooth as buttered silk. "Come to petition me directly, have you?" That's... that's about the long and short of it. You haven't come at a bad time, have you? Not interrupting anything important? "Ah, ah, if I were, I wouldn't be looking like this when you asked me for my time, would I?" Keros tosses the mandarin one last time, and just when you think she's going to incinerate it in a burst of sweet-smelling foxfire it lands in the pile of vegetables unharmed instead. "This is hardly a proper guise for standing on ceremony, of course. Just look at how revealing these clothes are... certainly improper." Psh, you know full well that she'd put on this skin to an official function just to make people squirm for the amusement of it all. If you didn't think you knew her well enough, you wouldn't have [pc.ra kitsune |signed up to sell off your soul to a trickster god well-known for fickleness |dared to petition her in the first place ], would you? "No, I suppose you wouldn't." Keros flows off the altar and is before you in the blink of an eye, smiling sweetly as she reaches [pc.heightRange 62 72 |out with a finger and deftly hooks the crook of your chin, drawing your |up with a finger and deftly hooks the crook of your chin, drawing your gaze down and |down with a finger and deftly hooks the crook of your chin, drawing your gaze up and ] lips closer to hers. "[pc.ra kitsune |or maybe I took the trouble of keeping tabs on the desires of the first champion I've bothered to have in a long time, take a personal interest in whether [pc.heShe]'s horny, hmm? You were certainly hoping to see me like this, otherwise you wouldn't have been as distracted as you were when petitioning for my attention |Few would have the bravery to directly petition a deity considered foreign in these parts for little more than personal pleasure, it's true. I feel like I ought to be impressed by your audaciousness in a locale traditionally considered a Lumian power base, but that's why I'm here to begin with, aren't I? ]" You don't really have an answer for that... "I didn't expect you to." Keros is already gleefully violating your personal space, but the August Mistress at the Center of Heaven can always take that extra inch; it's just out of your sight, but you swear you feel just the very tips of several of her tails stroking away at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "Now then, you've taken the trouble to be such a dear and petition me... surely you have some great request you'd like to make[pc.ra kitsune | of your patron ], don't you?"
rows.translation: 看到你走了过来[var0 |米可与舞步 |迈步前行 |米可迈步前行 ] [pc.ra kitsune |不辞辛劳，特意而为。 [dayNight |今天前来向您请愿的其他人，都像窗帘一样在您面前悄然退下了。毕竟，每个人都知道该如何以恰当的礼仪来回应像您这样尊贵的人的到来……也许，除了您自己之外 |神龛的门缓缓打开，毫无阻碍地让你走了进去。毕竟，你是否应该来到这里，这一点根本不存在任何疑问 ]。 |那些人带着满面的笑容与热情，挡在了你的面前。 “实在不好意思，但我必须问一下，因为这是我们的工作……您是有事情要办吗？” 你想见见他们的主人，请求与他单独见面。可以说是想要一些私人时间吧。 听到这些， [var0|姐妹们使了个眼色|梅眨了眨眼|米可眨了眨眼。]你也有同样的问题吧[var0|他们|她|她]向前推进，然后滑行。[var0|||]打开神殿的大门。“哦哦哦，如果你真有心情直接向他的神圣陛下请愿，没人会阻止你。不过千万别过度劳累，听见了吗？” 听起来挺有意思的[var0|他们会|她会|她会]以经验来说…… “他的那位神圣大人看起来确实偶尔需要进行一些私人祈祷，这一点没错，你知道的……” “还是说，你其实更希望看到的是另一幕呢？她那又怎样呢？” 现在看来，这个问题未免太深入地探究了某人的私人事务了[pc.ra kitsune |地位高于自己社会阶层的人 |一个好色淫荡的本地人 ]不是吗？其实，人们甚至可以想象，他们可能也想参与到其中来呢。 “根本不需要有什么特别的想法。如果她的尊贵夫人真的需要什么，根本不需要说出来。 ] [pc.hasFootwear |你取下了它。 [pc.shoes] |你按照规定的方式拍去脚上的灰尘。 ]当你走进那座小神龛时，空气中弥漫着焚香的气息，祭坛上摆放着当天人们献上的新鲜水果和蔬菜，它们都摆放在那个狡黠之神的雕像面前。门在你身后缓缓关上，发出沉闷的声响，房间内的寂静仿佛压得你喘不过气来，外界的声音透过墙壁传进来，也变得模糊不清。 现在，要想引起一位神的注意…… 说来奇怪——或者说，考虑到你正在与谁打交道，这也并不奇怪——其实并没有那么难。[pc.bg acolyte |尽管你在年轻时作为修道院的学徒接受了种种教导，但事实依然如此。 ]你还没来得及仔细思考，房间里的氛围就已经发生了变化——果香与熏香的气息突然弥漫在空气中。接着，你看到那位被称为“天中尊主”的人——或者说，在这种情况下，应该称为“八月女大师”——正盘腿坐在祭坛上，身旁摆满了田野里收获的果实。她用一只手懒洋洋地支撑着自己，另一只手则把一颗酸甜口味的橘子抛来抛去，仿佛那只是她手中的玩物罢了。如果说她有什么特点的话，那就是她那副看似冷漠、实则充满戒心的神情，简直就像一只被抚摸过的猫…… “哎呀，没想到会是你[pc.ra kitsune |我选择的英雄 |[pc.name] ]来直接向我请愿吧，”她轻声说道，声音如同丝般柔滑。“是吧？” 其实…差不多就是这个意思。你来得正是时候，对吧？并没有打扰到什么重要的事情吧？ 啊，啊，如果我是那样的话，当你向我请求时间的时候，我应该不会是这个样子吧？”凯罗斯将那枚 Mandarin 最后一次抛掷出去，就在你以为她会用一阵芬芳的狐火将其烧毁的时候，它却毫发无损地落在了那堆蔬菜上。当然，这种装扮根本不适合用来参加正式场合。看看这些衣服有多暴露……显然很不合适。” “哼，你心里很清楚，她就是为了惹人尴尬、取乐，才会在正式场合穿上这种装扮的。如果你觉得自己还不够了解她，你就不会这么说了。 [pc.ra kitsune |决定向那位以反复无常而闻名的骗子之神出卖自己的灵魂。 |当初竟敢向她提出请求。 ]不会吧，我想你应该是不会的。”凯罗斯说道。流畅地进行她刚从婚礼的祭坛上走下来，转眼间就出现在你面前，微笑着向你伸出手来[pc.heightRange 62 72 |用手指轻轻一拨，便巧妙地勾住了你的下巴，将你的头拉了过来…… |用一根手指轻轻一勾，巧妙地托住你的下巴，让你的视线向下移…… |只需用一根手指轻轻一按，就能巧妙地勾住你的下巴，让你不由自主地抬起头来看。 ]他的嘴唇靠近了她的嘴唇。[pc.ra kitsune |或者，也许我确实花了一些精力去关注这位我很久以来才真正关心的首位英雄的愿望，真正关心他的处境和需求[pc.heShe]你肯定很期待看到我这样的样子吧？否则你在试图吸引我的注意时，也不会那么分心了。 |的确，很少有人会有勇气直接向这些地区被视为“外来神明”的存在祈求些许个人乐趣。在这个传统上被认为是卢米安势力据点的地方，你的胆量确实让我感到钦佩——但这也正是我来到这里的原因，不是吗？ ]你其实并没有答案……” “我也没指望你会有。”凯罗斯已经兴高采烈地侵犯你的个人空间了，但那位位于天之中央的八月女神总是能再侵占那么一点点空间；虽然那些空间不在你的视线范围内，但你发誓，你能感觉到她的几条尾巴的尖端正在轻轻拂过你的身体[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]那么，你竟然还特意费心来向我请求……想必你一定有什么非常重要的请求想要提出来吧。[pc.ra kitsune | 您的赞助人 ]不是吗？

Bringing one of her pristine white tails around to the fore, she gathers it in her hands and idly starts running her fingers through the thick fluff. The strokes are slow and deliberate — she knows full well that you're watching her every move, and loves the attention. "Now, now. You should've been with my people long enough to know what you're asking, dear petitioner. What you truly mean when you say you want to stick your face in my tails and rub your cheeks all over their silken fur. When you want to bury your senses in in not just fluff, but the very standard by which fluff is judged. How absolutely and utterly perverse of you to desire to sink those coarse fingers of yours into my tails and grab great big handfuls until you're satisfied. How absolutely degenerate of you to manifest such a desire, knowing full well what it means, what it entails. "As much as you may think of yourself, dear [pc.name], and as enthusiastic as you are, I shall have to decline your marriage proposal." Y-you just wanted to huff her fluff! You said nothing about wanting to marry her! "But it is tantamount to a marriage proposal, isn't it? The act of shamelessly indulging in each others' most erogenous and yet most exposed parts, of being vulnerable to each other..." The August Mistress at the Center of heaven tuts and waggles a finger at you admonishingly. "The act of stroking another's tail is reserved for one's spouse, hmm? And as a divinity, I do have to maintain some semblance of self-dignity instead of allowing myself to be stroked off into a moaning, orgasmic mess. Such sensitivity really is a fetching trait of my favored people, but at the same time I can't just let anyone who asks nicely to fluff me, hmm? Think of the terrible, terrible message that would send." You're pretty sure that other foxes have allowed you to touch their tails without outright marrying them, though... "Then perhaps you should go and fluff them, dear, and indulge them in their desires most vulgar. When it comes to someone as illustrious as yours truly, I have to have standards. Given your unfamiliarity with this particular line of thinking and the customs that sprang from it, I can only conclude that you were so completely awestruck by my foreign, exotic beauty that the only thing that you could think of was to throw yourself at me in the most direct manner possible. Oh, to be so attractive weighs so heavily on the self. Kh ha ha!" Really, she's just talking herself up so much that all this is so much hot air. All you wanted to do was to huff her fluff... "Would it really be that bad to be wedded to a divinity?" Smug positively drips off Keros as the goddess delicately raises a hand to her cheek. "There are benefits to such an arrangement, to be sure, and it's not like such happenstances are unprecedented. One of those benefits, of course, being 'huffing my fluff', as you would put it." You'll take a rain check on that one for now. There's nothing else that she'll accept? "Hmm." Keros makes a show of considering the question, sitting back down on her altar and leaning into her mass of tails, continuing to pat the one she's holding like some sort of toy animal. Then, she's upon you in the blink of an eye, tails wrapping about your body and lips up against your ear as she whispers huskily: [pc.isSoulbound |"I'm afraid that's no longer in the cards, my dear. For you to favor her so deeply, I'm sure she'll be more than willing to do all sorts of weird and kinky things for your sake, am I not right? Go on, get. |"Sell me your soul." "Not just the right to perform an act that should be reserved for the union of matrimony, but it certainly is amongst the things you'll get if you do indeed choose to make the deal. Perhaps you might be convinced to give it some consideration, [silly|ufu|aha]?" Well, without elaborating on the other things you'd be getting for your soul, it does indeed sound like the deal could be better on its face. "As you will. But let's face it: I can't let just anyone rub their hands all over my immaculately kept tails, oh no. If you were to become my champion, I might be able to make an exception for someone as eminent... but alas, that is not the case. ] "Now then, given that your request is off the table, perhaps you might be more interested in something else I can offer? Bringing one of her pristine white tails around to the fore, she gathers it in her hands and idly starts running her fingers through the thick fluff. The strokes are slow and deliberate — she knows full well that you're watching her every move, and loves the attention. She drags this out for half a minute, letting the anticipation build up appropriately, then as she senses that your attention is starting to wane slinks up to your side and gives you a dainty peck on the cheek. Of course, the tail she's holding conveniently happens to be pressed between your bodies in the process, fur flattening and warmth spreading outwards along your skin, seeping into your bones and making you feel all warm and good inside. "If you were anyone else, I'd have assumed that you were proposing to me, that you were asking for my hand in marriage," she says with a chuckle. Sweeping her tails about your legs, the August Mistress at the Center of Heaven leans in ever closer, the warmth of her breath upon you, tickling your skin with tantalizing fragrance. "But I also know that my dear handpicked champion just so happens to be an incorrigible pervert who wishes to have the milk without buying the cow, as the saying goes. How brazen of you to freely express the desire to sink your fingers into not just a fluffy tail, but the fluffy tail by which all other fluffiness is measured. How audacious of you to want to use the most sensitive part of your goddess' body for indulging in your richest and wildest fantasies. "Would it really be that bad to be wedded to a divinity?" Smug positively drips off Keros as the goddess delicately wraps her tail about her hand and tails it along your skin, leaving warmth in its wake. "There are benefits to such an arrangement, to be sure, and it's not like such happenstances are unprecedented. One of those benefits, of course, being 'huffing my fluff', as you would put it. There are other things I could do for you in exchange, of course, but somehow I don't imagine that you would be interested in them when you have a goal in mind, would you?" She's really pushing this joke as far as it'll go, isn't she? "Joke? Who, me? When you, my dear champion, so brazenly asks for a perverse act of exposing one's weakness to another, an act that should be confined within the bounds of holy matrimony? An act that has the capability to reduce you to a crying, moaning mess even faster than if I were to pat you on the head? If there were a joke... that would be it. As one would expect of someone fit to be my champion, of course." The August Mistress at the Center of Heaven hooks her fingers into your [pc.armor] and pulls; causing the garment to rip apart into a small shower of inky wisps. She makes a show of hiding your newfound nudity with her tails, a shameless pretext to tickle, stroke and tease you with soft fur and light touches, preludes to the aggressive warmth you love so much. While she holds you in the cradle of her fluffy warmth, Keros rolls her shoulders and her clothes simply flow off her body like water off a rock. The colorful fabric pools on the floor like your own clothes did, where it simply melts away into tendrils of shimmering, multihued smoke before dissipating completely. A sweet smile still fixed upon her face, she takes hold of your shoulders and starts kneading gently in an impromptu massage, the gesture holding you in place firmly for her tails to play their trade on you.

rows.original: Stepping into this small office, you're immediately struck by how sharp and effective it is, for lack of better words to put it. The interior of this chamber is tastefully decorated in a mixture of reds and whites, but perhaps the most striking feature of it is that the walls are practically covered with scroll paintings of all kinds. Big and small, simple and detailed, each one usually depicting some scene from nature and all with a poem or the other written upon it in fine calligraphy. This is the office of a man who is trying way too hard to be cultured, and it shows. The only person in here is a black-furred kitsune man, working away [dayNight|industriously|by lamplight] at several scrolls lined with writing in the kitsunes' mother tongue. His desk is positioned such that anyone entering by the doorway is brought into his field of view, and as you watch, he brings up a seal, dips it in red ink, and presses it against the paper with what can only be described as determined resolve. [flags.FLOOF_HAUS_NAKANO_RESOLUTION 1 2 3 |Of course, you recognize him at once. he may not be wearing his helmet, but he's doing his paperwork in the same armor that he was wearing when you met him in battle. He's doing paperwork in his armor. Who in the gods' names is insane enough to do that? That aside, though, [pc.isDK|you're privately glad you were able to give this little brat a good drubbing, humble him a little. Just looking at him reminds you of a stick in the mud|you're glad that he's still all right despite your earlier altercation. Not that you're going to say it out loud or anything, though, since he looks the type to throw any expressed concern for his well-being back in your face]... You see the kitsune's white-tipped ears twitch, and he raises his eyes from his paperwork and sets down the brush, folding his hands in front of him, elbows poised on the table. There's a flicker of something on his face — shame, perhaps — but it's gone in a flash as he throws you a sharp gaze. "You're here, outsider. Great-great-grandmother told me you might stop by to introduce yourself." He speaks the Belharan tongue with a certain stiffness, as if not quite used to the words. "We have been acquainted, but not yet introduced." You didn't want to have to beat him down like that, but he didn't leave you any choice. "No single instance of outsiders having entered the den without permission has ever resulted in anything good. The witch living on the south end of the forest hires mercenaries from time to time to act in her stead, and one of the things she likes to do for amusement is to send them at us. There are also... other concerns which I don't need to discuss with you, but nevertheless have resulted in policy being the way it is." And what would he have done with you, if you'd lost? A shrug. "Great-great-grandmother is more merciful than I am. I would have beheaded you on the spot, [pc.race]." ...That's a direct answer, all right. "It is what I would be obliged to do." And would he have minded if you'd done the same to him? "For my failure in my duties and given the shame involved in being defeated by an outsider, it would be entirely within great-great-grandmother's right as my liege to demand my life as forfeit." Yes, you can see that you're really going to have an excellent relationship here. Well, it's a good thing you have official permission from Komari to be here and all. The kitsune winces when he hears the den matron's name. "Would you — never mind." Yes, never mind. Now then, introductions... |Of course, you recognize him at once: he may not be wearing his helmet, but he's doing his paperwork in the same armor that he was wearing when you met him in battle. He's doing paperwork in his armor. Who in the gods' names does that? At length, the black-furred kitsune raises his gaze from the scrolls and throws you a sharp gaze. The way he speaks the Belharan tongue is somewhat stiff, accented with something or the other from his own native language. "We have met, but we have yet to be acquainted. Great-great-grandmother said you might pay me a visit so that we might formally introduce ourselves." It was nice for him to spare your life. You still have to thank him for that. He ignores your mirroring of his stiff, dry tone and sniffs. "Do not imagine that I stayed my hand out of any personal compassion for you; those were extenuating circumstances. As an aside, I note that you are as prone to dropping in unannounced into other peoples' abodes unannounced as you were before." So... should you stand in the doorway and announce yourself? The door was open. Is this not a place that's at least partway public? "That would be preferable to barging into someone's workspace unannounced, yes. I understand that the central plaza outside is a public space and that native custom is more relaxed about these things, but you will make a better impression on people around these parts if you put in the effort to do as they do." [pc.isDK|What a fucking ass, but of course, saying that out loud at this point would be counterproductive|Well, that's one way of putting that]. "I will refrain from being contentious and not question great-great-grandmother's decision to allow you [party.hasCompanions|and your entourage|and any entourage you may bring] free run of the den; Mikoto and Miyuki are already ecstatic at the idea of having food come to them instead of the other way around. However, it falls under the scope of my duties to keep an eye on you. Should you face the temptation to fall out of line or give undue distress to anyone living in the den, I would strongly suggest you reconsider your course of action." You can tell that this is going to be just a lovely relationship here. Well then, now that the necessary nastiness is out of the way, perhaps introductions are in order. |You've yet to meet this particular fox, but judging by the sharp gaze he throws you as he raises his eyes from the paperwork, this looks like it might be a bit of a rocky start. "I was wondering when you might get around to paying me a visit," he says at last. "I had heard great-great-grandmother had granted an outsider permission to come and go as [pc.heShe] pleased, and that I should expect [pc.himHer] to come by in order for us to get acquainted with each other." That is the case, yes. He doesn't seem too happy about it. "You didn't even bother announcing yourself." There's just the slightest accusatory undertone in his voice. "But of course you didn't; as a native, you wouldn't have known the proper etiquette. I suppose I can neither blame you, nor could the matter be helped." So... should you stand in the doorway and announce yourself? "That would be preferable to barging into someone's workspace unannounced, yes. I understand that the central plaza outside is a public space and that native custom is more relaxed about these things, but you will make a better impression on people around these parts if you put in the effort to do as they do." That's a nice way of putting it. "I will refrain from being contentious and not question great-great-grandmother's decision to allow you [party.hasCompanions|and your entourage|and any entourage you may bring] free run of the den; Mikoto and Miyuki are already ecstatic at the idea of having food come to them instead of the other way around. However, it falls under the scope of my duties to keep an eye on you. Should you face the temptation to fall out of line or give undue distress to anyone living in the den, I would strongly suggest you reconsider your course of action." What a lovely character this one's turning out to be. [pc.cunningRange 50|Two|You may not be the most socially adept, but it's been barely two] minutes into the conversation, and you can already tell you're dealing with a stick in the mud. ] "Yes. I am Nakano Kurokawa. My formal appointment here, as it is, is as commander of the western imperial colonial regiment." Now that's something to think about. Every other kitsune you've seen hasn't had even the slightest whiff of a military air to them, not in the way Nakano here does; the foxes are mostly an easygoing lot and not outwardly disciplined like he is. Neither, come to think of it, is there anywhere in the den soldiers could conceivably be garrisoned, there aren't even so much as bunks, let alone any kind of proper barracks. A whole regiment? That doesn't sound quite right; people would've spoken of an army of foxes traipsing around the Marches. How many are there in this western imperial colonial regiment he speaks of? The twitch in Nakano's eye resurfaces. "Six, not including myself." A regiment of six. "Yes. All of them are dispersed amongst the colonies, but can be recalled at a moment's notice. Enough of that; while great-great-grandmother told me not to lie to you, I do not wish to discuss this any further. Your name, then?" Why yes, you're [pc.name]. "[pc.name]. I will remember it quite well. [ flags.FLOOF_HAUS_NAKANO_RESOLUTION 1 2 3 |It is not often that I find a native as matched in martial prowess as you are. That is quite memorable in and of itself. |I hope sparing you is not an action I will come to regret in the days ahead. |It is not everyday I have the opportunity to be introduced to a native. ] So, we have been formally introduced despite the circumstances of our meeting. In a way, it is a weight off my shoulders. Thank you." He's welcome, you suppose? So... what does he do around these parts? Nakano thinks a moment, clearly choosing his words carefully. "I am what you might consider in your culture a military provost. I am not only expected to fight, myself, but also generally organize the security of the colonies and all those who live within them as they go about their business. This involves correspondence with my homeland in order to ensure that imperial interests are properly defended as a matter of course." That's rather vague, but given the nature of what he's speaking of you understand why he wouldn't want to go into further detail in front of an outsider like you. Isn't Azami responsible for the kitsunes' security, though? "[silly|Ishida-san|Azami]'s responsibilities do not stretch beyond this den and its immediate environs; her position entails less responsibility than mine. My charge is that of the western imperial colonies as a whole." So she's his subordinate? "Yes and no." That's not really an answer. "To say that she is my subordinate would be to assert that I have certain powers over and obligations to [silly|Ishida-san|Azami] in formalised roles, which we do not have; in the hierarchy of things, she answers to great-great-grandmother as an authority, not me. Yet it is correct to say that the purview of her duties falls under the larger scope of mine, and I would be able to pressure her and her little militia into my needs if I were to lean on her in an official capacity. Subordinate...the word as you say it carries implications that I hear, which you in turn probably did not mean. It is... complicated." Like how she has more underlings than he does, if the hammocks strung up in the wardens' lodge is any sign of that. There were definitely more than six. "Numbers are not everything." You stare hard at Nakano's face for several moments, but everything in his steely expression radiates full-on genuinity at what he just said. As far as you can tell, this high-strung, black-furred zealot has been completely and utterly wholehearted in everything he's said in your conversation so far. There's no doubt that he might very well be insane — well, by Marches standards anyways — the question is how much, and whether it's the good or bad kind. Well then, introductions have been made, pleasantries exchanged. You'll leave him to his work, then. "Your thoughtfulness is appreciated." His words are perfectly calm and flat, polite in every way, but you nevertheless feel as if you've just been handed a stiff salute. Nakano picks up his brush once more and turns back to his paperwork, studiously ignoring you as he continues to work [dayNight|in a most pointedly industrious fashion|by the faint light of the foxfire-paper lamp]. There's nothing for it now, you suppose — while it may have been about as difficult and painful as pulling teeth, at least you've gotten the necessary introductions out of the way. You can always return later if you've any business with Nakano here...
