I — I — " Berwyn fumbles about for something to say, then gives up and turns off to the side, clearly not wanting to put his foot deeper inside of his mouth at a time like this. |Quintillus winces at the sight of the disfigured kitsune, lowering his voice to a whisper. "Ouch. Now that had to be painful, whatever happened to her. I've seen a number of things in my time, both before and after the cult... and this is pretty high up." Uh, that is — ] The white-furred kitsune says nothing but bows even further, folding her ears forward as she awaits your reply; you note that her left ear is slightly shorter than the right, no doubt a product of the same thing that caused her scarring. Uh, yes, that's you. "My name is Rindo Igarashi. Might I ask for yours?" It's [pc.name]. [pc.name], [pc.title]. And no, you're not lost. You were just looking around, that's all. The inside of this tree is very different in every aspect from anywhere else in the Marches; you'd just like to stand around for a bit and soak in the atmosphere. "I'm pleased to make your acquaintance, [pc.name]. There are occasionally new arrivals here in the governor's holdings, but most of them arrive by way of the torii gate and not the front door. This is a public space, after all." Is she the garden's caretaker? A nod. "It is not my primary duty, and Miko and Mai are obliged to assist me from time to time, but it is correct to say that because of my talents and what limited education I have, the responsibility of its upkeep falls upon my shoulders."         "Ah. Well, as Mai says, getting angry takes a lot of energy that could be used on more productive pursuits. And speaking of productive pursuits, I still have to finish [dayNight

rows.original:
Rindo closes her one good eye, and then her smile broadens, what's by all appearances a genuine, warm smile like the flowers about her. "There's something you want to say, isn't there? Go ahead, say it."
        
        I-Is she sure?
        
        "I've lived some years now with all kinds of people wishing to express their sympathies for the state of my being. Could someone else find it aggravating? Perhaps. But that is someone else, not me, and I understand where your feelings are coming from. Taking quick offense would be pointless, and if I can do something to foster a compassionate spirit in others and to be cognizant of the hurts of those around us, it's but a small price to pay."
        
        [party.has cait
            |Swooping up past you, your pink kitty unabashedly pulls Rindo into a big hug, threatening to smother the slighter, shorter girl with her body, especially her ample chest. You take the chance to join in the group hug, squeezing both your plush kitty and the slender fox in your embrace.
            |Since she's given you the okay, there's nothing to hold you back anymore. Swooping forward, you unabashedly pull Rindo into a big hug, holding it there for several moments and trying to be comforting without being overly familiar or intimate. You're already severely breaching etiquette, you know, but there's no need to make it any worse unnecessarily... right?
        ]
        
        You're so sorry, you're so sorry that this has happened to her. While you don't know the hows or whys, just looking at her tells you it must have been terrible.
        
        "Some would say that this is far too forward for a first meeting, but I'm a special case," she says with a chuckle, gently wriggling free of the hug[party.has cait
            |, giving Cait a gentle nod as she does so
        ]. "Thank you for that."
rows.translation:
林多闭上了她那只还完好的眼睛，然后她的笑容变得更加灿烂了——那显然是一份真诚而温暖的笑容，就像她周围盛开的那些花朵一样。“你有什么话想说，对吧？快说吧。”
        
        我……她确定吗？
        
        “这些年来，我遇到了各种各样的人，他们都想表达对我目前处境的同情。会不会也有人觉得这种行为让人感到恼火呢？也许吧。但那是别人的感受，不是我的，我能够理解你的感受从何而来。轻易生气是没有意义的，如果我能够做一些事情来培养他人富有同情心的品质，让他们能够体谅我们周围人的痛苦，那么这样的付出其实也是值得的。”
        
        [party.has cait
            |你的粉色小猫从你身边飞过，毫不羞涩地将林多紧紧抱在怀里，似乎要用它那丰满的身体把这个身材娇小、个子较矮的女孩压得喘不过气来。你趁机也加入了这个拥抱，将你那毛茸茸的小猫和那只纤细的狐狸一起搂在怀里。
            |既然她已经同意了，那就没有什么能阻碍你了。你猛地向前冲去，毫不羞涩地将林多紧紧抱在怀里，抱了好一会儿，试图给予她安慰，同时又不会显得过于亲密或过分随意。你知道，你这样已经严重违背了礼仪规范，但也没必要再让情况变得更糟吧……对吧？
        ]
        
        你感到万分抱歉，为她身上发生这样的事感到万分抱歉。虽然你并不了解事情的来龙去脉，但只要看看她的样子，你就知道那一定是非常糟糕的事情。
        
        “有些人可能会说，对于第一次见面来说，这样的举动未免太过于亲密了，但我的情况特殊一些，”她笑着说，轻轻挣脱了对方的拥抱。[party.has cait
            |她这样做的同时，还轻轻地向凯特点了点头
        ]。“谢谢你这么做。”

rows.original: You can't take it any more. Even though you just met, the mere sight of someone so badly disfigured so young hurts you deeply, and you can't help but feel sympathy for her. She has to know she's not alone, even if it's coming from a near-stranger.
rows.translation: 你再也无法忍受下去了。虽然你们才刚相识，但看到一个人在如此年轻的时候就遭受如此严重的伤害，你内心会感到无比痛心，不由得对她产生同情。她必须知道，她并不孤单，即使这份同情来自一个几乎陌生的人。
rows.raw: "You can't take it any more. Even though you just met, the mere sight of someone so badly disfigured so young hurts you deeply, and you can't help but feel sympathy for her. She has to know she's not alone, even if it's coming from a near-stranger."

rows.original:
Rindo closes her dead eye and continues watching you stutter and stumble over your words with her good eye, the slitted pupil thinning to a line as her smile broadens. Finally, her ears fold forward and she shakes her head.
        
        "You're pretty bad at acting normal. I understand it can be hard when faced with someone like me."
        
        You... you tried. You didn't want to draw attention... you didn't want her to feel self-conscious... 
        
        "I've lived some years now with all kinds of people doing this exact thing, and it's become quite easy to tell when others are trying really hard not to notice something." A dry chuckle. "I understand where you're coming from, though, and appreciate it. Mindfulness of others is a trait that should be encouraged in more people, and if I can do something to help it along, a little discomfiture is but a small price to pay."
        
        You... you're sorry. You didn't want her to feel self-conscious about her appearance, and now you've just ended up drawing attention to it.
        
        The smile doesn't waver. "You meant well, and that's what matters from my perspective. Thank you for thinking of others, by the by."
rows.translation:
林多闭上了那只没有神采的眼睛，继续用她那只有神的眼睛注视着你结结巴巴、语无伦次的样子。她的瞳孔逐渐缩成一条细线，而她的笑容却愈发灿烂。最后，她的耳朵向前耷拉下来，她轻轻摇了摇头。
        
        “你装作若无其事的样子实在不擅长。我理解，面对像我这样的人，这样做确实很难。”
        
        你……你确实努力过了。你并不想引起别人的注意……你也不想让她感到尴尬或不自在…… 
        
        “这些年来，我见过各种各样的人做着完全相同的事，所以现在我已经很容易就能分辨出，别人是不是在拼命试图不去注意什么。”她干笑了一声，“不过，我确实理解你的处境，也很感激。关心他人是一种应该被更多人拥有的品质，如果我能为此出一份力，那么稍微有些不自在也不过是很小的代价。”
        
        你……你感到很抱歉。你本来并不想让她因为自己的外貌而感到不自在，但现在你反而把注意力引到了这上面。
        
        她的笑容始终没有改变。“你出发点是好的，从我的角度来看，这才是最重要的。顺便说一句，感谢你总是为他人着想。”

rows.original: Even though the mere sight of someone so badly disfigured so young is heart-aching, it's clear that Rindo is acting perfectly normal. Her life shouldn't be defined by her disfigurement, and you should act accordingly.
rows.translation: 尽管看到一个人在如此年幼的时候就遭受如此严重的毁容，实在令人心碎，但很明显，林多表现得非常正常。她的生命不应该被她的毁容所定义，你们也应该如此看待她。

rows.original:
Nothing, really. You swallow down your instinct to pity the girl, and steel your nerves. Just because the girl has been disfigured doesn't mean she's getting in with you ahead of anyone else freshly introduced to you. She starts on the level like everyone else, fair's fair.
        
        Rindo turns her head slightly to the side so she can regard you with her good eye, then dips her head again in a small bow. "People have been talking about you, [pc.name] — your presence in our home is making some waves, as your saying goes. It's good to be able to finally meet you in person; you must be someone to be here, after all."
        
        Well, given your humble estimation you'd like to say that you're anything but normal.
        
        The white-furred fox raises a hand to her mouth and giggles a bit. "The same could be said of everyone living in the colonies; we are all special in our own ways. You'll fit right in, then. Thank you for humoring my joke."
rows.translation:
其实没什么。你必须压下那种想要同情这个女孩的冲动，让自己保持冷静。仅仅因为这个女孩的外貌受到了损伤，并不意味着她就能比那些刚被你认识的人更有优先权。她和其他人一样，都是从同一个起点开始的，公平才是最重要的。
        
        林多微微侧头，用她那只视力良好的眼睛看着你，然后再次低头轻轻鞠了一躬：“人们一直在谈论你呢，[pc.name]——用你们的话说，你出现在我们家里，正引起一些波澜。终于能够与你当面见面，真是太好了；毕竟，能够来到这里的人，肯定都是些不平凡的人。”
        
        “嗯，按照你这种谦虚的说法，你应该算是非常不平凡的人吧。”
        
        那只白毛狐狸把手放在嘴边，轻声笑了起来：“生活在这些殖民地里的每个人，其实都是不平凡的；我们每个人都有自己独特的地方。所以你肯定也会在这里适应得很好的。谢谢你陪我开了这个玩笑。”

rows.translation: [pc.ra kitsune |[rand |你一靠近林多，她立刻僵住了，她的耳朵和那只完好的眼睛不停地来回转动。最终，她的目光落在了你的身上，随后她转身放下手中的[rand |修枝剪 |洒水壶 |园艺剪 |小铲 ]，弯腰深深行礼。“我的[pc.mf |大人 |夫人 ]。感谢您在这样一个美好的日子里赏光光临。有什么需要我帮忙的吗？” “拜托，她没必要这样表现的。你现在对狐族礼仪已经有了足够的了解，应该明白，鉴于她身上流淌着神圣之血，她完全没有必要在你面前做出这样的举动。你只是想进行一次普通的对话而已。 就在这时，她那冷漠的外表消失了，她那双善良的眼睛角微微上扬，嘴角浮现出一丝微笑。“如您所愿。如果您需要我做些什么的话[pc.name]？" |当你走近林多时，你会发现她正在照料的那片土地，其布局并非出于美观考虑，而是有着明确的实用目的。那里种植的植物，都是你在霜木地区随处可见的品种。当你靠近时，她站了起来，拍掉身上的灰尘，然后深深鞠了一躬。 “我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]正在测量一些常规数据而已，没什么重要的；绝对不会有什么事情比您的到来更重要。如果我没有时间，我一定会抽时间陪您的。阁下，您需要我帮忙吗？” 嗯…… |当你走近时，看到林多站在一片外形奇特的小树丛旁，她正在指挥着一个傀儡——那是那位工匠制造的——让这个傀儡手持锯子，按照她的指令修剪那些枯死的树枝。当她注意到你正在靠近时，她清了清嗓子，然后用她母语说了几句话来指挥那个傀儡，而这些话你是听不懂的。那个木制自动装置开始收集那些被砍下的树枝，看到这一幕，林多显得非常满意，然后走上前来，深深地向你鞠了一躬。 “阁下，这真是个意外的惊喜。我差不多已经完成了所有的照料工作；从现在开始，这个木偶会继续负责剩下的事情。 那些树…… “它们来自我的故乡——或者更准确地说，来自我们的现在，是时候回到故乡了。”她微微转过头，用她那只健康的眼睛注视着你。“那些‘公主树’，粗略地翻译过来就是……不过我有点跑题了。阁下究竟有什么事需要我帮忙，才会专程来到这里找我呢？” 啊…… ] |[rand |看到你走过来，琳多用她那只健康的眼睛微笑着注视着你，然后点了点头表示认出你。“你好啊[pc.name]你是来欣赏这些花园的吗？” “也许吧，或者只是顺路经过，顺便来看看她。无论如何，今天这里的一切都显得格外美丽。” “您太客气了。难道所有外国人都会说这么动听的话吗？不，事实就是，她那种热情开朗的态度，以及她刻意去微笑、努力营造愉快氛围的行为，完全弥补了她可能存在的任何身体上的缺陷。说出这样一个显而易见的事实，难道有什么错吗？ 她装作正在认真考虑这件事的样子，说道：“嗯…… |你呼唤着林多，她的耳朵一听到声音就立刻竖了起来，转头朝你的方向看去。虽然她并没有放下手中的东西[rand |剪刀 |浇水壶 |剪刀 |抹刀 ]或者阻止她的工作，她示意你靠近，于是你便走了过去。 今天很忙吗？ “严格来说并不算很忙，但我的很多工作都需要细心照料。我负责照顾的所有东西都是‘活生生的生命’，它们都有自己的思想——有些表现得更加明显而已。不过今天天气很好，正是这样的日子里，我必须继续工作，这样才能让来花园的游客们享受到这些‘成果’。这一切，都是活生生的生命啊。 请稍等片刻，我马上就来陪您。 |你走到凛朵面前；这个身材娇小的狐妖即使你已经几乎站在她面前，她仍在花坛里挖土，丝毫没有反应。直到你准备清了清嗓子时，她才突然转过身来，轻轻低头示意你，仿佛早就知道你在那里一样。 “你好， [pc.name]真是美妙的天气，不是吗？阳光明媚，鸟儿歌唱——在这样的日子里，像你这样的人应该花些时间停下来，欣赏周围大自然的美丽。” 自然之美与人工创造之美各有千秋。当这两种美以恰当的方式结合在一起时，才会显得更加美好。 “嗯……你在逗我吧。不过，知道当地人并不完全地完全不懂什么是高雅的艺术品味啊。”她轻笑着，“今天有什么我可以帮您的吗？ [pc.name]？" ] ] [party.has kiyoko | 向您致意之后，林多转向清子，再次向您的狐狸妻子鞠了一躬，说道：“我也向您致以问候。 [silly |大友大人 |妙布大人 ]愿今日健康与幸福降临在你和你的家人身上。” “嗯，你真是个善良的女孩。”你的狐妖妻子向前倾身，轻拍了一下林多耳朵中间的位置，而林多也只是微微动了一下尾巴作为回应。“我相信你在殖民地一定会取得成功。” 林多再次鞠了一躬。 ]

rows.original: [flags.RINDO_CONCUBINE_APPR |Seeing you approach, Rindo carefully sets down her gardening tools and greets you with a warm smile and [pc.ra kitsune |dip of her head with her hands clasped in front |nod ], all three bushy tails slowly swaying behind her. It's familiar, but given that she's your concubine at this point a little familiarity is more than warranted. "It's a joy to see you, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. That you should come and visit me today brings warmth into my life." Maybe, or maybe you were just passing through on your way to see the gardens. Both are equally lovely this day, so does it really matter? Rindo's smile widens a fraction, and she raises a hand to a slightly flushed cheek. "It does." [rand |Well, you have to admit that after all of this, seeing someone in her position still manage to keep a joyous outlook on life isn't simply endearing, it's outright inspiring. If she simply moped about all day, one would be more predisposed to notice her scars... but while they're part of her, she doesn't allow them to define her existence, either. That's why she's truly a treasure, and why you didn't hesitate to accept her as your concubine. "You flatter me so, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." |Does it, now? "[pc.ra kitsune |My [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ], both the gardens and I are living creatures in our own right. We respond to love, to sunlight, to companionship... and we have our function in our own right. That we are equally lovely is testament to what we receive not just between ourselves, but from others as well." Others like you, then? "Just so, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." |Well, as they say, the whole is greater than the sum of the parts. Alone, Rindo herself and the gardens may be impressive in their own right, but there's something about the picture of her working while surrounded by so much verdance that's truly fetching in its own right. Rindo's blush deepens. "Well, I cannot deny that... but I do not labor in these gardens for my own benefit but for that of others. Maybe that is what truly makes the picture so perfect?" |Well, as pretty as the gardens may be, you came all the way here to see her smile. Won't she, as your concubine, smile for you? "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ], I already am..." No, she wasn't. See, her smile just got a little brighter right there. Come on, she needs to give it her all for you, doesn't she? "Ah..." See, there she is, the Rindo that you've come to know and love. It would be great if you would never forget that smile, a smile that beams all the brighter for the person whom holds it. "You flatter me so, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." ] Absolute picture-perfection, your dear Rindo is — a fine concubine. "Such a tease you are, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." She chuckles. "Might I do something for you today?" [party.has kiyoko |Having greeted you, Rindo turns to Kiyoko and proffers another bow to your fox-wife. "And my greetings to you too, [silly |High Lady Ōtomo |Myōbu-Sama ]. May good health find you and yours this day." "Hm. You are quite the gracious girl." Reaching forward, your fox-wife pats Rindo on the head between the ears, which is received with barely more than a little wiggle and swish of the tails. "Comport yourself well in my consort's service, and you will do just marvelously over the course of your concubinage. I have high hopes for you." Rindo bows again. ] |When you draw close to Rindo, she turns towards you, half-closing her good eye and folding her ears forward against her head. You're half-expecting a bow from her, but the way she's holding her head out with the tops of her ears pointed at you... oh, of course. While you don't know if this is proper etiquette, that she's now permitted to be more familiar with you after having become your concubine, you're not going to pass up an opportunity to pat the poor girl on the head. So you do just that, sinking your fingers into her bushy hair — it still feels as thick and pattable as ever, as opposed to the silken flow of other foxes, with a slight coarseness to it that adds to its body. Rindo sighs softly and nuzzles her head against your palm, pushing her scalp against your touch with growing insistence even as you pick up the pace of your patting. It's only when your skin is tingling and buzzing that you finally pull away and Rindo lifts her gaze, although you notice that she still avoids your eyes. "What can I do for you today, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |Marcher-Baron[pc.mf | |ess ] ]?" Gods, there's no need to be like that. While she may be your concubine now, little in the practical sense of things has changed, as Komari pointed out. So long as her attachment to you keeps her out of any trouble with whatever politics she may have gotten mixed up in by accident of her birth, you're more than willing to keep formalities to a minimum. For one, you don't see how bowing and scraping — or any more than she usually does — is going to keep her and hers safe, so you don't want her to do it. Does she understand? Rindo lowers her eyes. "I understand, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ]." Good, good. How's concubinage treating her so far? "Well, my existence hasn't changed much, to be sure. Still, this is the first time I've seen you since you accepted the offer, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]so that might result in me eating my words in short order. I will enjoy my time under your wing while it lasts, that's to be sure." While it lasts... she doesn't see it as a permanent position, then. "Even under more mundane circumstances, concubinage is almost never seen as a final resting place[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Concubines fall in and out of favor all the time, and even though I understand that you would not set me aside for having grown bored of me, they eventually find other purposes or simply fall away for other reasons. The den matron is trying to resolve the matter at its root alongside some of the people she knows on the other side of the ocean, so once that is resolved there'd be no need for this." But although there may be no need of this arrangement in the future, will she want it? She still doesn't meet your gaze. "Forgive my directness, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]but I was taught not to make promises I did not know I would be able to keep. But then, I was also taught not to worry so much about gaining more time that I would neglect to spend what time I did have wisely. Certainly this stint of concubinage will not damage any prospects I have for the future, or at least, not that I can foresee, so you need not worry about that. "You're frowning, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]; I can tell as much without needing to see it. Please, set your consternation aside and let us enjoy our time together; with how convoluted and tangled the situation is, it will not be a problem for the [silly |extent of the game's duration |foreseeable future ]." Making a small vulpine noise in the back of her throat, Rindo suddenly steps forward and embraces you in a hug, pressing her lithe body against you, the softness of her untouched skin juxtaposed against the scars and calluses of her other half. Her three tails sway softly from side to side as her head sinks into your [pc.chest], and she mumbles something that's neither here nor there as you stroke her brow. Maybe... maybe she's right, and you don't need to think about this too deeply; all it does is making troubles for you that may or may not merely just be all in your mind. But what is real is Rindo and her affection for you, and should the day come when you need to dissolve this relationship then let it come when it may. In the meantime... there is much the both of you need to do together. Together, that's the thing. The both of you linger a moment, Rindo's head pressed against you as she basks in the sound of your heartbeat, and then after what feels like an eternity, she pulls away. Half-lidding her eyes and letting her ears fold forward, Rindo bows her head forward deferentially. "Now, then... is there anything you wish of your concubine, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |Marcher-Baron[pc.mf | |ess ] ]?" ]

“即使在更加平凡的处境下，纳妾这种行为也几乎从来不会被视为一种最终的归宿。[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 ]妾室们的地位总是时起时落，虽然我明白你不会因为对我感到厌倦而抛弃我，但她们最终还是会找到其他用途，或者因为其他原因而被抛弃。女主人正在尝试与她在大洋彼岸认识的一些人一起从根本上解决这个问题，一旦这个问题得到了解决，这一切就都不必要了。 kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]; 我就算不看也能猜到。请放下你的忧虑，让我们一起享受这段时光吧；鉴于目前的局势如此复杂混乱，这应该不会成为什么问题[silly |游戏的持续时间 |可预见的未来 ]林多在喉咙深处发出轻柔的声音，突然向前迈了一步，紧紧地拥抱了你，将她那柔韧的身体贴在你的身上。她那未受损伤的肌肤所带来的柔软感，与她身体另一侧那些疤痕和老茧形成了鲜明的对比。她的三条尾巴轻轻摇摆着，她的头也靠在了你的肩上[pc.chest]当你轻抚她的额头时，她喃喃地说了一些模棱两可的话。 也许……也许她是对的，你没有必要太深入地思考这个问题；这样做只会给你带来麻烦，而这些麻烦或许只是你自己的想象而已。但现实的是，林多以及她对你的感情才是真实的。如果有一天你需要结束这段关系，那就让它自然发生吧。而在那之前……你们还有很多事情需要一起去做。 一起就是这个意思。 你们俩就这样静静地待了一会儿，林多把头靠在你身上，聆听着你的心跳声，仿佛过了很长时间，她才慢慢拉开距离。她半眯着眼睛，耳朵微微向前倾，恭敬地低下了头：“那么……您有没有什么想要对您的妾室说的？ [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |马谢尔-男爵[pc.mf | |ess ] ]？" ]
rows.raw: " [flags.RINDO_CONCUBINE_APPR |Seeing you approach, Rindo carefully sets down her gardening tools and greets you with a warm smile and [pc.ra kitsune |dip of her head with her hands clasped in front |nod ], all three bushy tails slowly swaying behind her. It's familiar, but given that she's your concubine at this point a little familiarity is more than warranted. "It's a joy to see you, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. That you should come and visit me today brings warmth into my life." Maybe, or maybe you were just passing through on your way to see the gardens. Both are equally lovely this day, so does it really matter? Rindo's smile widens a fraction, and she raises a hand to a slightly flushed cheek. "It does." [rand |Well, you have to admit that after all of this, seeing someone in her position still manage to keep a joyous outlook on life isn't simply endearing, it's outright inspiring. If she simply moped about all day, one would be more predisposed to notice her scars... but while they're part of her, she doesn't allow them to define her existence, either. That's why she's truly a treasure, and why you didn't hesitate to accept her as your concubine. "You flatter me so, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." |Does it, now? "[pc.ra kitsune |My [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ], both the gardens and I are living creatures in our own right. We respond to love, to sunlight, to companionship... and we have our function in our own right. That we are equally lovely is testament to what we receive not just between ourselves, but from others as well." Others like you, then? "Just so, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." |Well, as they say, the whole is greater than the sum of the parts. Alone, Rindo herself and the gardens may be impressive in their own right, but there's something about the picture of her working while surrounded by so much verdance that's truly fetching in its own right. Rindo's blush deepens. "Well, I cannot deny that... but I do not labor in these gardens for my own benefit but for that of others. Maybe that is what truly makes the picture so perfect?" |Well, as pretty as the gardens may be, you came all the way here to see her smile. Won't she, as your concubine, smile for you? "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ], I already am..." No, she wasn't. See, her smile just got a little brighter right there. Come on, she needs to give it her all for you, doesn't she? "Ah..." See, there she is, the Rindo that you've come to know and love. It would be great if you would never forget that smile, a smile that beams all the brighter for the person whom holds it. "You flatter me so, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." ] Absolute picture-perfection, your dear Rindo is — a fine concubine. "Such a tease you are, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]." She chuckles. "Might I do something for you today?" [party.has kiyoko |Having greeted you, Rindo turns to Kiyoko and proffers another bow to your fox-wife. "And my greetings to you too, [silly |High Lady Ōtomo |Myōbu-Sama ]. May good health find you and yours this day." "Hm. You are quite the gracious girl." Reaching forward, your fox-wife pats Rindo on the head between the ears, which is received with barely more than a little wiggle and swish of the tails. "Comport yourself well in my consort's service, and you will do just marvelously over the course of your concubinage. I have high hopes for you." Rindo bows again. ] |When you draw close to Rindo, she turns towards you, half-closing her good eye and folding her ears forward against her head. You're half-expecting a bow from her, but the way she's holding her head out with the tops of her ears pointed at you... oh, of course. While you don't know if this is proper etiquette, that she's now permitted to be more familiar with you after having become your concubine, you're not going to pass up an opportunity to pat the poor girl on the head. So you do just that, sinking your fingers into her bushy hair — it still feels as thick and pattable as ever, as opposed to the silken flow of other foxes, with a slight coarseness to it that adds to its body. Rindo sighs softly and nuzzles her head against your palm, pushing her scalp against your touch with growing insistence even as you pick up the pace of your patting. It's only when your skin is tingling and buzzing that you finally pull away and Rindo lifts her gaze, although you notice that she still avoids your eyes. "What can I do for you today, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |Marcher-Baron[pc.mf | |ess ] ]?" Gods, there's no need to be like that. While she may be your concubine now, little in the practical sense of things has changed, as Komari pointed out. So long as her attachment to you keeps her out of any trouble with whatever politics she may have gotten mixed up in by accident of her birth, you're more than willing to keep formalities to a minimum. For one, you don't see how bowing and scraping — or any more than she usually does — is going to keep her and hers safe, so you don't want her to do it. Does she understand? Rindo lowers her eyes. "I understand, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |[pc.name] ]." Good, good. How's concubinage treating her so far? "Well, my existence hasn't changed much, to be sure. Still, this is the first time I've seen you since you accepted the offer, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]so that might result in me eating my words in short order. I will enjoy my time under your wing while it lasts, that's to be sure." While it lasts... she doesn't see it as a permanent position, then. "Even under more mundane circumstances, concubinage is almost never seen as a final resting place[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Concubines fall in and out of favor all the time, and even though I understand that you would not set me aside for having grown bored of me, they eventually find other purposes or simply fall away for other reasons. The den matron is trying to resolve the matter at its root alongside some of the people she knows on the other side of the ocean, so once that is resolved there'd be no need for this." But although there may be no need of this arrangement in the future, will she want it? She still doesn't meet your gaze. "Forgive my directness, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]but I was taught not to make promises I did not know I would be able to keep. But then, I was also taught not to worry so much about gaining more time that I would neglect to spend what time I did have wisely. Certainly this stint of concubinage will not damage any prospects I have for the future, or at least, not that I can foresee, so you need not worry about that. "You're frowning, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]; I can tell as much without needing to see it. Please, set your consternation aside and let us enjoy our time together; with how convoluted and tangled the situation is, it will not be a problem for the [silly |extent of the game's duration |foreseeable future ]." Making a small vulpine noise in the back of her throat, Rindo suddenly steps forward and embraces you in a hug, pressing her lithe body against you, the softness of her untouched skin juxtaposed against the scars and calluses of her other half. Her three tails sway softly from side to side as her head sinks into your [pc.chest], and she mumbles something that's neither here nor there as you stroke her brow. Maybe... maybe she's right, and you don't need to think about this too deeply; all it does is making troubles for you that may or may not merely just be all in your mind. But what is real is Rindo and her affection for you, and should the day come when you need to dissolve this relationship then let it come when it may. In the meantime... there is much the both of you need to do together. Together, that's the thing. The both of you linger a moment, Rindo's head pressed against you as she basks in the sound of your heartbeat, and then after what feels like an eternity, she pulls away. Half-lidding her eyes and letting her ears fold forward, Rindo bows her head forward deferentially. "Now, then... is there anything you wish of your concubine, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |Marcher-Baron[pc.mf | |ess ] ]?" ] "

rows.original: The moment you approach Rindo, she instinctively tenses, ears perking and swivelling and tails fluffing up until she turns her good eye towards you and realizes who it is. Being blind in one eye means that her other senses have had to grow stronger to compensate, but there are just some things that can't be covered for. There, there, easy now. She doesn't need to be so jumpy, does she? Given that she's recently married, she should be safer considering the circumstances. [pc.ra kitsune |Slowly, Rindo turns and sets down the [rand |clippers |watering can |shears |trowel ] in her hand before bowing deeply from the waist. "My [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Thank you for gracing me with your presence this fine day. How may I be of assistance to you?" |The tension draining from her body, Rindo makes a relieved little noise in the back of her throat and sets down the [rand |clippers |watering can |shears |trowel ] in her hand by her side. "Yes, you're right. It's irrational, but still... never mind that. Fancy that you'd come to visit me, [pc.name]. Good weather, isn't it?" ] [party.has kiyoko |Having greeted you, Rindo turns to Kiyoko and proffers another bow to your fox-wife. "And my greetings to you too, [silly |High Lady Ōtomo |Myōbu-Sama ]. May good health find you and yours this day." "Hm. You have only grown more fetching ever since you were wedded." Reaching forward, your fox-wife pats Rindo on the head between the ears, which is received with barely more than a little wiggle and swish of her tails. "That is good; more often than not the exterior reflects the inner being more than we'd like to admit." Rindo bows again. ] "Is there something you need of me, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?" Not out of the ordinary, no. [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko and you have |You've ] just come to see how married life's treating her. "Um, yes." Suddenly tongue-tied, Rindo turns so that her burnt half's the one that's facing you, presumably because it's easier for her to hide her blush amidst the color of her scarred skin. "I... certainly have no complaints[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. [kinu.isInari |Given the circumstances of my childhood, I was raised to have a practical perception of being wedded, so this is certainly far more than I could have ever hoped for. To not only have my long-standing infatuation not just indulged, but outright insisted upon by the den matron herself... ah, I feel like a fool for allowing myself to by paralyzed by my own indecision all these years |Given what I'd lost and how I was raised, I've come to realize in the last five years that material matters lose a lot of their appeal once one's basic needs are fulfilled. The joys to be found in being wedded are not so much constant excitement which fades with time, but that which endures; it feels so foolish in retrospect how I wasted so much time of my youth when I should have been working towards what was achievable ]. Yes, I am more than content with this; to be true, I have not been wedded for very long, but this is a situation I can be content with for the rest of my life." So long as she's happy. "I'm not as naive as to imagine happiness is something I can have all the time, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. But it is what it is, and like everything else, it won't prevent me from striving towards having more of it." So... about, um, now that she's married... will anything change? Between the two of you, that is. Rindo eyes you, thinks a moment, then shakes her head. "Oh, do you mean that, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]?" If by the way she said that she also means what you meant, then yes. A shrug. "Married couples have to eat too, you know. You don't imagine that each and every one of the kitsune in those groups roaming the woods seeking benefactors are all unattached?" Well, no, but — she seems completely and absolutely blaise about it. You'd have imagined that a society as bound by stricture as her is would have more complaints about infidelity. [pc.ra kitsune |"Ah, your Eminence, that is where the rift in understanding occurs — infidelity is not defined that way, at least not here |"Which is exactly the thing — I understand your background is not ours, but infidelity is not defined that way for me and mine ]. How could it be, when sexual congress and the attendant pleasure is the easiest way of giving back to those we take from? Standards originating from old Belhar do not apply to us in the least. "So long as no kits are conceived, it's not an issue. If you desire to continue to be my benefactor, that is more than welcome, inasmuch as my husband is free to seek such of his own as he has done in the past." Oh. You... well, you were expecting more resistance. It just feels a little too easy. "Different peoples live by different rules, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ], rules that don't always deviate from what you know in only one direction. If I were still living across the ocean, I'm sure that I would've had the privilege of having a dedicated tanuki retainer or two for days when I didn't want to go out and seek benefactors. While I could go back to doing what I did before we met, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ], and to be sure I'll still be doing some of that, it's not as if there won't be any point in seeking benefactors. "The den matron has been so kind as to take measures to keep my public life as stable as it used to be, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. I still have my job here in the gardens, and she's even kept my little room nearby clean for me to rest in until someone else needs the space. Even though I'm sure that she's told no one else about my exact circumstances everyone's been so kind as to let me remain in familiar surroundings." You don't blame her, having one's life uprooted and turned upside-down by circumstances outside your control once was enough for you; having it happen another time isn't anything you'd wish on anyone you cared for. "Of course[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Half-lidding her eyes and letting her ears fold forward, Rindo bows her head forward deferentially. "I... certainly have no complaints[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Well, no, but — she seems completely and absolutely blaise about it. You'd have imagined that a society as bound by stricture as her is would have more complaints about infidelity. [pc.ra kitsune |"Ah, your Eminence, that is where the rift in understanding occurs — infidelity is not defined that way, at least not here |"Which is exactly the thing — I understand your background is not ours, but infidelity is not defined that way for me and mine ]. "So long as no kits are conceived, it's not an issue. If you desire to continue to be my benefactor, that is more than welcome, inasmuch as my husband is free to seek such of his own as he has done in the past." Oh. You... well, you were expecting more resistance. It just feels a little too easy. "Different peoples live by different rules, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ], rules that don't always deviate from what you know in only one direction. If I were still living across the ocean, I'm sure that I would've had the privilege of having a dedicated tanuki retainer or two for days when I didn't want to go out and seek benefactors. While I could go back to doing what I did before we met, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ], and to be sure I'll still be doing some of that, it's not as if there won't be any point in seeking benefactors. "The den matron has been so kind as to take measures to keep my public life as stable as it used to be, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. You don't blame her, having one's life uprooted and turned upside-down by circumstances outside your control once was enough for you; having it happen another time isn't anything you'd wish on anyone you cared for. One might wonder if she's self-conscious about her height, but that's unlikely given that she doesn't feel that way about any other part of her appearance. She's wearing what looks to you like white cloth wraps about her torso and long, pleated skirts that fall down all the way to her calves and ankles, a flame pattern embroidered in white about the hem — with how it opens at the front and how the entire ensemble is held together by knotted bands of cloth about her waist, there's a resemblance to the shrine maiden uniforms worn by Miko and Mai. Of course, the white-and-violet colors actually preclude her getup from being one, but nevertheless, the similarity's still there. Given how she's got a good eye for aesthetics, it's probably intentional to help her fit into her natural surroundings better. The girl herself is thin and slender, with a [var0 |smallish chest — her top hugs her torso closely enough to cleanly define the outlines of her small, pointed breasts, the fabric thin enough to betray just the hint of cherry-colored nipples beneath |growing chest — her top was form-fitting to begin with, but you notice that her breasts are bigger, heavier, less pointed about their zenith. The change is quite pronounced given that she's still early into her pregnancy, and her nipples have become fat enough to be outlined against the fabric, if just barely |heavy chest — with how much her breasts have ballooned out from the small pointed things they once were, her top's getting seriously crowded. You can see the places where she's had to loosen the knots that keep her clothes together, and even so the fabric is tight, leaving no doubt as to the shape of her increasingly motherly bosom. Rindo's tits are mommy milkers in every sense of the word, and they're only going to get bigger before this is done; the shape of her nipples protrude blatantly against the fabric, and you wonder if she gets some kind of perverse pleasure from having them rub against her clothes all day |milky, motherly pair of tits that would look completely out of place on her if she hadn't put on a bit of meat while pregnant. Even though she doesn't leak just looking at them confirms the sense of weight about them that can only be described as maternal even as her fat nipples and areolae stand out blatantly as they push against the thin fabric, straining to burst free ]. While you don't know how kitsune age exactly, but were she to be human you'd place her at roughly nineteen or twenty. Her lips are thin, her nose small, and the corners of her mouth are turned upwards in a cheery smile almost all of the time; her radiant white hair has been neatly clipped to shoulder-length save for a loose ponytail tied together with a violet length of ribbon, long enough to hang to the small of her back. Noticing you taking her in, Rindo's smile broadens just a bit on her small mouth and she tilts her head and wiggles her ears playfully. Several facial markings lie just above and under her eyes — they don't seem to be tattoos of any kind, but rather a natural quirk of her appearance. You certainly haven't seen them on any other kitsune, though, not those splashes of vivid red on the skin, and have to wonder just how rare they are in her people. She's also possessed of three tails — each one distinctly shorter, thicker, and brushier compared to the other denizens of the den. That's where the pleasant side of Rindo ends. Past her nose, the left side of her body is a mangled mess, her pale and smooth complexion giving way to the deep red-brown of burn scars piled upon burn scars, leathery and warped, wrinkled and uneven with bumps and pits. [var0 |Rindo's belly is flat and concave, her waist slender; if you didn't know better, you'd have said the girl was lithe, bordering on gaunt; the scars on her abdomen stop just short of her navel, curving in from under her breastbone and falling away as they approach her hips. To say it looks painful would be an understatement, that's for sure. Her hips are finely-formed and delicate even as they curve outwards from her waist, but that's more indicative of how lithe her midriff is instead of how lush her thighs might be. Ah... for all that it might pain her, Rindo's appearance does try its best to inspire sympathy for such a lovely, finely-formed girl thrust into the flames and pulled out again... |The gentle inward curvature of Rindo's midriff has been turned inside-out, the gentle swell of a nascent pregnancy pushing her lower belly outwards. She's not so slender any more, and even though her scars are beginning to stretch along with the rest of her, the overall change to her figure in that she doesn't look so underfed anymore is an improvement. Is she putting on baby fat? You're not exactly sure, given how it could be muscle or more likely, a mixture of both, but at least being with child is really helping the poor girl's figure come in, complete with her thighs and hips thickening as pregnancy hormones begin to reshape her body in as-yet small but perceptible ways. |Rindo's belly is swelling rapidly as her pregnancy grows, and even though her figure's filled out from being with child it's still lithe enough for her womb to appear even more outsized than it actually is when juxtaposed against the rest of her. You can tell how big her pregnancy is getting just by the way the rough, scarred skin of her burnt half is stretched, the bumps pulled taut in what looks like a painful manner, but Rindo herself looks anything but pained from being with child. If anything, the rosy patch that's appeared just about her navel and the zenith of her big kit-filled belly fills her with joy despite blending into the unsightly half of her body, and she keeps on stroking and petting it along with her popped-out belly button when she thinks no one's looking. Impending motherhood must be hard on her despite the rapid changes that're happening to her body in preparation for such, but she's uniquely placed to find happiness in the midst of suffering, if anyone ever could be. And speaking of her body, her hips have widened and thighs thickened even more than before, enough that you notice that her gait's shifted. Yet in spite of all that has happened to her and the injustices that must have occurred to leave this kind of mark on her body, Rindo Igarashi stands before you and your gaze, smiling and unafraid; perhaps a little self-conscious at being examined thus as evidenced by the slight blush on her cheeks, but not shying away from it, either. 这个女孩本身就身材苗条、纤细。 [var0 |略显娇小的胸部——她的上衣紧贴着身躯，将她那小巧而尖挺的胸部的轮廓清晰地展现了出来；面料又足够薄，以至于能隐约看到下面樱桃色般的乳头。 |她的胸部变得格外丰满——与当初那些小巧而尖挺的形状相比，她的上衣现在明显变得有些紧绷了。你可以看到她为了固定衣服而打的结有些地方已经被松开了，但即便如此，布料依然紧贴着她的身体，清晰地凸显出她那逐渐变得成熟、充满母性的胸部轮廓。从任何角度来看，林多的胸部都完全符合“成熟女性”的特征，而且这种变化只会继续下去更大在这之前；她的乳头轮廓在布料上清晰地凸显出来，你会不禁怀疑，她是否会因为乳头整天与衣物摩擦而获得某种变态的快感。 |那对乳白色、充满母性魅力的乳房，要是她没有在怀孕期间长些肉的话，放在她身上肯定会显得很不协调。天啊，即使她确实长胖了一些，这些乳房依然看起来有点别扭——它们搭在她隆起的腹部上，让上衣的布料显得十分紧绷，仿佛随时都会从束缚中挣脱出来一样。那些原本细长小巧的乳头，如今已变得饱满而沉重，形状如同泪滴，其中充满了乳汁。尽管她并没有溢奶，但仅仅看着它们，就能感受到那种只有母亲才会拥有的沉重感。她那肥厚的乳头和乳晕在薄薄的衣物下显得格外突出，仿佛随时都会突破衣料束缚而显现出来。 但林多的美好之处也就到此为止了。她的鼻子以下，身体的左侧全都变成了残缺不堪的废墟：原本苍白光滑的皮肤上，布满了层层烧伤疤痕，那些疤痕呈现出深红棕色，质地如同皮革般坚韧，而且已经变形、起皱，表面还不均匀，布满了凹凸不平的坑洞。 [var0 [pc.ra kitsune
        |"I am honored that you'd deign to show me such favor, your [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]ship. Please, steer the conversation as you wish — I'll not hesitate to answer as honestly and directly as I can."
        
        You sure you aren't taking her away from her job?
        
        "While I'm in this place, your Eminence, part of my duties is to make sure that visitors to the governor's sacred gardens are made welcome and at ease. This, of course, includes being friendly to them should they wish to hold conversation with the keeper. Please, you are too kind, but fret not about it. Someone of your station and with direct and personal relations with his divine lordship should have no expense spared upon [pc.hisHer]; a mere conversation is but little to ask of me."
        |"Ah. You want to talk?"
        
        If she doesn't mind.

Besides, I wouldn't mind an excuse to put down my things and rest a little." She gives you a wink. "I need to pace myself, after all."
        
        Well, if she's sure about that, you're not going to turn down such an invitation.
    ]

rows.original: "That's one way to put it, I suppose. Strictly speaking, the appointment I was given by the imperial governor was that of naturalist; given what little prior education I possessed before being sent here to the colonies and my aptitude for various kinds of work she deemed necessary, it seemed like the best option. The governor has had centuries' worth of experience to assess people and her judgement has yet to be wrong in living memory. "It is my task to collect various specimens of flora native to the colonies, study them and detail their natures, and assess their suitability for their usefulness and productivity as resources. Some efforts in this regard have been informally carried out by prior generations of colonists, but the matter of survival and carving out homes in this relative backwater has meant that intellectual work by and large has fallen by the wayside until recent times. The only other kitsune in these parts who could be said to engage in cerebral labor is the artificer, and while he is a brilliant savant, the absolute disorganization of his mind means that he is quite unsuited to meticulous tasks which may at times edge over into tedium. Mai is only concerned with what relates to her practice of seifukujutsu and ignores the rest. Yet, it is a job that must be done, and someone must do it; the necessity has been ignored for too long. "Sometimes Kohaku brings me specimens and seeds that are sold in native markets, sometimes visitors from prospectors' holdings bring them; I am permitted to offer a small ration of rice as a reward for anything new and interesting brought to me. I certainly am not able to gather specimens myself given... well." She gestures at the scarred half of her body and dead, glassy eye. So, by what standards does she judge the plants of this continent across the ocean? "A myriad; few things are truly completely and utterly useless, after all. Food. Medicine, and other drugs. Fibers. Building materials. Dyes. Suitability for cultivation. And most importantly, responsiveness to being shaped. All my observations and findings are to be compiled for the appropriate governmental bodies back across the ocean; the colonial governor handles that part for me, for which she has my gratitude. "Here, I am to care for the sacred gardens that surround the shrine to the August Master at the Center of Heaven, and further away from the path there are several plots for me to cultivate some of the native plants and experiment upon them." What then, after a plant has been deemed to be suitable? Is it then shipped across the ocean? "Oh, no. Certainly not!" You don't quite follow. "There is a concept in my line of work where plants and animals, when introduced into a land where they have no natural checks and predators, proliferate in a rapid manner and destroy everything in their path by sheer dint of rampant breeding. Because the art of shaping is what it is, the people of the Old Country have a very close relationship with the plants of the islands. We are careful to not introduce... potentially invasive species without considerable thought as to their impact on what already exists. The same could be said of ideas, technologies and even peoples; before they are permitted in larger society, all of the above must be determined to be in harmony with our land, society, and philosophies. "Identifying potentially dangerous plant species which could prove a problem should their seeds be inadvertently carried across as exports from the colonies is also part of what I do. But if the native plants are to be harnessed, it is best that they are done so here in the colonies — grown, processed, and turned into finished goods for consumption or export all in one place with minimal risk of contamination. Much like what Mai does, but on a bigger scale; this principle is one of the reasons why the imperial governor has stressed the need for self-sufficiency right from the colonies' founding." That's a lot of work... "We enjoy our land the way it is and the close connection we have built with its features over generations. Certainly anything worth preserving is worth a great deal of effort[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence, and remember that it is now your land, too ]." All right, you think you've got an idea of what Rindo's supposed to be about here. You wouldn't know it from how she spends a lot of the day tending to the plants in the shrine garden, but much of the work that goes on in the colonies has a very hands-on element to it. "Appearances are easily deceiving, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]." Rindo's smile broadens a little. "But I'm glad to have been of assistance. Is there anything else you would like to ask me about?"
rows.translation: 这么说也是可以的。严格来说，帝国总督给我的任命是‘博物学家’这个职位；考虑到在我被派往这些殖民地之前我所受的教育非常有限，再加上我在她认为必要的各种工作中表现出了相当的才能，这个职位似乎确实是最好的选择。总督拥有几个世纪以来积累的经验来评估人才，而在我们有生之年内，她的判断从未出过错。 我的任务是收集这些殖民地本土植物的各种标本，研究它们，详细了解它们的特性，并评估它们作为资源所具有的实用性和生产力。此前，前几代殖民者也曾在一定程度上进行过这方面的工作，但由于生存问题和在这个相对偏远的地方建立家园的需要，这些学术研究在很大程度上被忽视了，直到最近才重新得到重视。在这个地区，唯一可以被称为从事脑力劳动的狐族成员就是那位工匠。虽然他是个才华横溢的学者，但他思维的极度混乱使得他完全不适合那些需要细致耐心、有时甚至会让人感到枯燥乏味的任务。舞只关心那些与她的修行有关的事情。秘传武术而忽略了其他方面。然而，这项工作必须完成，而且必须有人来承担它；这种必要性已经被忽视太久了。 有时候，琥珀会带来一些在当地市场上出售的标本和种子，有时候则是来自探矿者驻地的访客们带来的；对于他们带来的任何新奇有趣的物品，我被允许用少量大米作为奖励。考虑到……嗯，”她指了指自己身上那些伤痕以及那只已经失去光泽的玻璃般的眼睛，“我确实没有能力亲自去采集这些标本。” 那么，她究竟是根据什么标准来评判这片大洋对岸大陆上的植物的呢？ 其实，几乎没有什么东西是完全无用的。食物、药品、各种材料、纤维、建筑材料、染料，还有那些适合用于耕作的物品……最重要的是，它们都可以被加工成人们所需要的形态。我所有的观察结果和发现都将被整理起来，报送给远在大洋彼岸的相应政府机构；负责处理这部分事务的是那位殖民地总督，我对此心怀感激。 在这里，我的职责是照料环绕着天中心域那位尊贵大师神殿的那些神圣花园。而在道路的远处，还有几块土地供我种植一些当地的植物，并对这些植物进行实验研究。那么，当一种植物被认为适合在某地种植之后，它就会被运往大洋对岸去种植吗？ “哦，不。绝对不会！” 你可能还不太明白我的意思。 “在我的工作中，有一个概念：当植物和动物被引入到一个没有天敌和自然制约因素的环境中时，它们会迅速繁殖，凭借其强大的繁殖能力摧毁沿途的一切。由于塑造艺术本身的特性，古老国度的人们与这些岛屿上的植物保持着非常密切的关系。我们在引入任何可能具有入侵性的物种时，都会格外谨慎，会充分考虑这些物种对当地原有生态系统可能造成的影响。对于理念、技术，甚至人群而言，也是如此；在它们被允许应用于更广泛的社会之前，必须先确认它们与我们这片土地、我们的社会以及我们的哲学观念是相协调的。 识别那些可能带来危险的植物物种也是我的工作内容之一——这些物种的种子如果通过殖民地的出口产品被无意中带出去，就可能会造成问题。不过，如果真的要利用这些本地植物，那么最好在殖民地本地进行这些加工活动：从种植、加工到最终制成可供消费或出口的成品，整个过程都应该在同一个地方完成，这样就能将污染的风险降到最低。这与舞的做法非常相似，只不过规模要大得多；正是这一原则，使得总督从殖民地建立之初就一直强调自给自足的重要性。 这确实是一项繁重的工作……我们喜欢这片土地现在的样子，也珍视几代人以来与它所拥有的各种特征建立起来的紧密联系。当然，任何值得保护的东西都值得我们付出巨大的努力。[pc.ra kitsune |阁下，请记住，现在正是你的也该降落了。 ]好吧，你大概以为自己已经明白林多在这里到底是做什么的了。但从她每天大部分时间都在照料神社花园里的植物这一行为来看，你可能根本想错了——实际上，在这些殖民地里，很多工作都需要亲自动手来完成。 “外表往往具有欺骗性。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]琳多的笑容变得更加灿烂了。‘不过，能帮上你的忙，我真的很高兴。还有其他什么你想问我的事情吗？

rows.original: Rindo looks thoughtful for a moment before formulating her answer. "To be sure, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]that's because there is no one precise answer to that question. Shaping — that is the closest approximate translation of the term in Belharan — is a catch-all for the various practices we apply to the plants of our native land in order to coax them into working with our desires. This involves the manipulation, transmutation, and general re-shaping of flora to fit one's needs, hence the term — it is considered a respectable profession in my homeland, and has many uses in adjoining fields such as agriculture, architecture, urban development, landscaping, puppetry, plumbing and water purification and more. By guiding the natural inclinations of living plants with the firm hand of artifice, it is possible to produce wonders such as this living tree which we now stand in." You... see, or at least are beginning to understand. But you would like to know more[pc.ra kitsune |, especially if it is such an important trade amongst the people who have adopted you ] — if you're hearing her correctly, it could be considered a more extreme form of domestication, then. Shaping has been practiced a long time in the Old Country, has it not? "As long as its peoples have existed. Practices can be extremely local, down to individual fiefdoms; they can add a lot of provincial flavor for visitors. But wherever you go, no matter the details of the situation, the practice grew out of several common needs of our peoples. For example, the severe lack of many important metals and other resources meant that people had to improvise in many aspects of their life. Tanuki, who form most of our population and tend to have large families, are always seeking to increase the agricultural yields that can be sustainably wrought from arable land. Historically, fortifications required defenses against hexes, spells, curses and evil influences and spirits as much as they needed physical ones, and of course there are many myths valourising the practice; the Imperial Palace itself is supposed to have been grown from a cherry blossom seed Keros himself planted. "Methods employed in shaping can range from the mundane such as simple pruning and crossbreeding, to elaborate magical and alchemical techniques. Because the definition of shaping is so broad, everyone can conceivably be expected to know at least a little and have it play some role in their lives, regardless of social station." So the definition is something that you have to live in order to truly understand. "Many such things fall into that category, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |friend ]. Shaping is something you make a part of your daily life, whether you know it or not. The art of bonsai, erecting an archway for your home by growing two trees together, reinforcing a wall with roots, developing a higher-yielding crop cultivar, growing roofing for your home — all of these are common applications that even a nekomata can understand[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. On the other end of the spectrum, water coming into the arcology is treated by filtration between the roots of specially cultivated plants, and once more before wastewater is drained into the wild to neutralise toxins and diseases. And then there is the matter of the madman [silly |Fukuizumi-san ]and his puppets and prosthetics..." Those are examples of shaping, too? You can understand the arm, but when you encountered his automatons, they appeared more like dolls and golems of Belharan make rather than living plants. "The artificer is... unorthodox. His methods are not recognized, and he certainly does not respect many traditional limits that others in his profession adhere to. Not that he is unethical, or else he would not be amongst the living, but there's an unfortunate wantonness to his actions when he gets excited about his craft." Rindo graces you with a sad smile. "I think the contrast between him and I is enough to fully illustrate the true broadness with which the art of shaping can be painted, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence. |am I not wrong? ]" While you don't think you fully understand what shaping is about, that's something that won't be achieved just by poor Rindo here standing here and explaining it to you. At least, now you know enough to have an idea, and that's sufficient. The naturalist bows. "Is there anything else I can help you with, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?"
rows.translation: 琳多沉思了一会儿，才给出了回答：“当然。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]因为对于那个问题，并没有一个确切的答案。在贝尔哈兰语中，“Shaping”这个术语是最接近其原意的翻译。它实际上指的是我们采取的各种方法，用来引导我们家乡的植物按照我们的意愿生长。这涉及到对植物进行改造、加工以及重新塑造，以使其符合人们的需要，因此才有了这个名称。在我的家乡，这一行业被视为一种受人尊敬的职业，它在农业、建筑、城市发展、景观设计、木偶制作、管道工程以及水净化等多个相关领域都有着广泛的应用。通过运用人工的技术，巧妙地引导这些植物的自然生长习性，我们就能够创造出像这棵活生生的树这样的奇迹——现在我们就站在它的面前。 你……看吧，或者至少你已经开始理解这一点了。但你肯定还想了解更多。[pc.ra kitsune |尤其是当这种贸易对于那些收养了你的人们来说如此重要时。 ] — 如果你听对了的话，那么这种做法可以被视为一种更为极端的驯化形式。在古老的国家，这种塑造行为已经存在了很长时间，不是吗？ “只要那个国家还有人民存在，这种习俗就会一直延续下去。这些习俗往往具有很强的地方特色，甚至会因不同的领地而有所差异；对于游客来说，这些地方特色无疑会带来丰富的体验。但无论你走到哪里，无论具体情况如何，这种做法都是源于我们各国人民的一些共同需求。例如，由于许多重要金属和其他资源严重匮乏，人们不得不在生活的许多方面进行即兴创造和应对。狸猫构成了我们人口的大多数，而且它们往往喜欢生育很多后代。因此，狸猫们总是致力于提高可从耕地中持续获得的农业产量。从历史上来看，防御工事不仅需要抵御各种物理攻击，还需要防范咒语、诅咒以及邪恶的力量和幽灵；当然，也有很多神话故事颂扬这种做法的必要性。据说，皇宫本身就是由凯罗斯亲手种下的一颗樱花种子生长而成的。 在“塑形”这一过程中所采用的方法，既可以是一些简单的手段，比如修剪和杂交，也可以是一些复杂而神奇的魔法或炼金术技巧。由于“塑形”的定义本身非常广泛，因此无论人们的社会地位如何，都可以被认为至少对其中的一些方法有所了解，并且这些方法也在他们的生活中发挥着一定的作用。 所以，这个定义其实意味着直播许多这类事情都属于那一范畴， [pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 |朋友 ]事实上，无论你是否意识到，塑造这些事物早已成为了你日常生活的一部分。盆景艺术、通过将两棵树一起种植来为家中搭建拱门、利用植物的根系来加固墙壁、培育高产的农作物品种、甚至为房屋种植遮荫植物——所有这些都属于常见的应用实例，就连一只猫也能理解这些概念。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]而在另一个极端，流入这种生态建筑的水会先经过专门培育的植物根系的过滤处理，然后再经过一次净化，之后这些废水才会被排放到野外，以此来中和其中的毒素和有害物质。至于那个疯子……那就是另一个故事了。 [silly |福岛先生 ]还有他的木偶与假肢……” “这些也算是艺术创作的例子吧？你可以理解那些手臂的含义，但当他制作的自动机出现时，它们看起来更像是贝尔哈兰人制造的玩偶或傀儡，而不是有生命的植物。” “这位工匠……相当特立独行。他的创作方法并未被传统所认可，而且他显然也不遵守同行们所遵守的许多传统规范。不过，这倒也不是说他不道德的否则，他现在也不会还活着。不过，每当他对自己的手艺感到兴奋时，他的行为就会表现出一种不幸的鲁莽。林多带着一丝悲伤的微笑对你说：“我认为，他与我之间的这种对比，足以充分说明‘塑造艺术’这一领域其实有着多么广阔的发展空间。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下。 |我难道错了吗？ ]虽然你可能认为自己还没有完全理解“塑形”究竟意味着什么，但仅仅靠林多站在这里向你解释，是远远不够的。至少，现在你已经了解了足够多的信息，从而对这个概念有了一个初步的认识，这就已经足够了。 这位博物学家鞠了一躬，说道：“还有什么我可以帮您的吗？ [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]？"
