At least, now you know enough to have an idea, and that's sufficient. The naturalist bows. "Is there anything else I can help you with, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?" '

rows.original: Rindo smiles and swishes her three tails, clearly taking mischievous pleasure in your unease. "Is something the matter, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]?" It's just that... well, it would be easy for someone to take offense if he or she were to be asked a deeply personal question like that. [pc.ra kitsune |"You are the chosen one of the August Master at the Center of Heaven, your Eminence; I could not bear to even harbour such sentiments against you. If anything, I should be glad that someone in your station and of your position should show a personal interest in my condition. Would more be as compassionate as you. |Rindo sighs, but it's a good-natured sigh. "I don't deny that it would be easy to get angry, and for a while after it happened I did feel that way whenever someone expressed sympathy for my condition, but... there's not really much point in that, is there? My pride, or what was left of it, wasn't worth pushing away people who only wanted to genuinely help — those who were pitying me to prop themselves up in the eyes of others or otherwise wanted to make use of me were so obvious. ] "But no, there is no reason for me to be angry about it. There's no use in pretending — I know I can't be like other people any more, and while it's a little sad at some point you just have to move on or else the biggest obstacle in your way is yourself. And once I realized that, I was able to accept helping hands that much more easily. So yes, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]I'm willing to share how I ended up like this to anyone who asks. Maybe it's a little strange to pour out your life story so easily, but at this point I'm strange, am I not?" Perhaps you should take a seat? This sounds like it's going to be a long story. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence is gracious |Yes, let's ]." Picking up her gardening tools, Rindo leads you to the nearby gazebo in the gardens and pulls out a seat for you[pc.ra kitsune | before bowing, folding her ears forward. "Your Eminence." Well, best not make this any more awkward than it already is. It's only when you're seated and comfortable that she [party.has kiyoko |pulls out another seat for your fox-wife beside you, bowing again and waiting for her to be seated as well before finally taking her own place at the table |takes her own place at the table, her face carefully neutral ] |[party.has kiyoko |, then does the same for your fox-wife, folding her ears forward as she bows. "[silly |High Lady Otomo |Myobu-sama ]." It's only when the both of you make yourselves comfortable that she takes her own place at the table opposite you two, and begins |, waiting for you to make yourself comfortable before taking her own place at the table opposite you ] ]. "It is not really much, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |truth be told ]. There was an accident in my bedchambers. A fire. I... the smoke must have asphyxiated me as I slept, for I did not rouse until much my person had been set alight and the pain was simply too great for my body to ignore. I... I was burned. There was an inquest by the local magistrate, and the investigation found that a lamp had been knocked over by where I was sleeping, and well, mulberry paper is flammable, and so is rapeseed oil. The case was closed with a ruling of misadventure..." Oh dear. Was anyone else hurt?[silly | Usually when these stories come up, the person surviving also happens to be the sole survivor of such terrible accidents and spends the rest of the visual novel moping about why she was the only one to live and other manifestations of survivor's guilt. ] Rindo slowly shakes her head. "No, the fire didn't make it through the support beams. Paradoxically, by protecting the rest of my family, the structure of my bedchamber focused the worst of the heat onto my person, since it had nowhere to go. If not for my brother pulling me out of the flames with the assistance of a brave passerby who just happened to be present by my family's holdings, I would have perished that day. "I... I remember that I blew out the lamp when I turned in for the night, that much is clear. The flames... they were concentrated in my chambers. But my recollections... there was so much smoke, and my nightgown was already burning, and so was my skin... my recollections may have been jumbled from the shock of everything that happened. It does not matter, not at this point, anyway. But that's how I came to bear these scars[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ][party.has kiyoko |, [silly |High Lady |Myobu-sama ] ]. A simple misadventure, with no evidence of wrongdoing by the magistrate's office." She's holding something back — not necessarily outright lying or even attempting to deceive you, but you can tell her smile's just a bit too enthusiastic, the pose she's holding just a bit too forward, as if she's overcompensating for something that she herself may not even know or admit even in her own mind. "Better that it not have happened at all in the first place, but since it came to pass it was better that one person take the brunt of it all than everyone in the building perish, isn't it? Nothing can be done about it — just another one of the many fickle happenstances that go on every day, that's all. After the fact... my body recovered as much as it was able to over the course of several months. But still, nothing could be the way it was any more. My fiance's clan broke off the arrangement with my family that they'd planned since I was a kit... I was asked if I would like to pursue opportunities in service of the Cherry Blossom Throne across the ocean in the colonies. The smart thing to do, of course, was to accept, lest I become more of a problem for those around me than I already was." ... "One day at a time, just for today," Rindo finishes at last, keeping her placid little smile fixated upon her lips. "After all, nothing can be done about it." Is there truly nothing that can be done for her scars? Her eye? "[pc.ra kitsune |The concern your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship shows is appreciated, but it's as much as I wish |It's as far as I'm willing to go ]. When I first arrived in the colonies some years prior, the artificer was extremely excited at my condition and proposed several novel methods by which he would restore my faculties. For example, he wanted to remove my now-useless eye and replace it with a globe filled with sap and the seed of a certain species of plant native to [pc.ra kitsune |our |my ] homeland, properly altered with several shaping methods. As the plant grew, it would extend its roots into my skull, and in his own words, 'stimulate my optic nerve and pressure points appropriately.' It would not be better than an actual eye, but be an improvement over sightlessness. "I declined, but not because I was squeamish — whatever one may think of Kazuo's works, they function as he intends them to. It was not an easy trip to get from where I was to where I stand now, but I feel... ah, how should I put it? There are species of pines in this forest that require fire to propagate, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence. |did you know that? ] Wildfires sear their cones, and the seeds fall to ground cleared by fire and filled with ash. Even if you strike the cones open, new growth cannot take root without cleaning out old wood and underbrush. "Being here in the colonies has brought a lot of things in perspective. Everyone here is broken in some fashion, whether it's obvious or not; you get sent — or even worse, voluntarily come — here for a reason, and even those born here carry that shame in their blood and lineage. Being around people like that who have nevertheless managed to band together and move forward while being productive leaves little time for self-pity. I wouldn't have achieved such acceptance of what has happened if I'd stayed back across the ocean with my family or even married into my fiance's clan as planned. "So no, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. There are indeed several procedures that could be performed to restore my body in a sense, but I don't want to undergo any of them. This is part of who I am now, and I've come to accept that; so long as it doesn't get in the way of me being useful, I'm content to let things be." "Rin!" Miko's voice sounds out from the end of the gardens, carrying cleanly across the air. "I ain't been seein' ya f'r a good hour now, ya ain't slackin' off none now, are ya? By his divine lordship's tails, if'n ya don't show yer face this very instant I'mma go straight up an' start tattlin' on ya to Granny!" Looks like she's needed elsewhere. "Ah." Rindo raises a hand to her cheek. "So I am. Well then, I must take my leave. Please excuse me, [pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence |[pc.name] ][party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ] ]." With that, the white-furred girl stands, bows[party.has kiyoko | to the both of you ], and withdraws — gracefully at first, but breaking into a run for the shrine. Then, she's gone... [party.has kiyoko |nothing left for the two of you but to leave, too. So, what does your fox-wife think of all this? There's more to the matter that meets the eye, isn't there? "There is," Kiyoko replies as she pushes her seat back in and falls in step beside you as you leave the gazebo. You've managed to pick up on a few things, but don't have the cultural background to make sense of it. If she would weigh in? "Well, what is obvious is that the fire that caused the girl's scarring was almost certainly not an accident. The girl may tell herself that and even believe it herself, but self-delusion is no substitute for reality. By her clan name, I would place her background as somewhere in the middle to lower-middle classes; she clearly has had some education, but it is limited in depth and scope. Yet she's possessed of not just radiant white fur, but brands of divinity. Her very existence would have complicated matters." You think you've covered this before in your conversations with Kiyoko, but those traits are limited to the Old Country's ruling families, aren't they? "They are. Every so often, though, maybe once or twice a century, someone from the middle or lower classes is born with white fur, or one or more brands of divinity. She has both. Usually, the family can trace some distant ancestry to the Twelve to explain why the blood has surfaced amongst them. Other times, suspicion of being a bastard child arises, the kit being some wayward branch family's by-blow. Whatever the cause, the accepted recourse is for the individual to be married into that of the Twelve which controls the fiefdom in which they reside. For centuries, that has been the way these anomalies are handled, and it matches up with the girl's story — she would have been betrothed to another from a very young age, to be married when she reached her majority. I would not be surprised if this is why she was able to receive some small measure of education despite her humble background." Oh. [pc.bgMulti noblescion minstrel courtesan |You're beginning to see the familiar patterns in this song and dance — you had a front-row seat to it during your childhood as a noble scion, and it was part of why you left your family. Guess things aren't really any different an ocean away |You're beginning to see the familiar patterns in this song and dance — you had a front-row seat to it during your time amongst noble courts as a minstrel. Guess things aren't really any different an ocean away |You're beginning to see the familiar patterns in this song and dance — you had a front-row seat to it during your time amongst noble courts as a courtesan with all the pillow talk you had to endure. Guess things aren't really any different an ocean away |While you don't know much about this, you can tell it's a sticky situation ]. "An assasination attempt? Without knowing the details, I can only guess. Certainly plausible — any number of actors would have been sharpening their proverbial knives from the moment she emerged from the womb. The girl may have been possessed of arahitogami and hence considered divine and untouchable, but there is no shortage of the ruthless and shameless to be had, especially if a powerful hand is guiding them. An accidental fire in one's sleeping chambers, a misadventure, the fact that she did not rouse until the flames were already consuming her clothes and body... chances are if she had not chosen to accept her thinly-veiled exile to the colonies, she might not be amongst the living now. "Do not worry, such things will not happen to the likes of me and our [kiyoko.numKits 2 |children |daughter ]. I have taken steps to soothe any concerns that might arise from our returned existence." You're glad — you didn't go to all that effort to bring your fox-wife back to the land of the living just to be separated again. Kiyoko chuckles, but then her expression turns serious. "Please do not jest about such things, beloved. But now... shall we be on our way?" ]
rows.translation: 林多微笑着摇动着她的三条尾巴，显然从你的不安中获得了某种调皮的乐趣。“是不是出了什么问题？ [pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 |[pc.name] ]就是……嗯，如果有人被问到这样一个非常私人的问题，很容易会感到被冒犯。 [pc.ra kitsune |您乃是天心城中天之中央尊主选中的人，尊贵的阁下；我实在不忍心对您怀有这样的想法。相反，能够有像您这样地位崇高、身份显赫的人关心我的处境，我应该感到庆幸。还有谁会像您一样充满同情心呢？ |林多叹了口气，但那是一种出于善意的叹息。“我并不否认，有时候会很容易生气，而且在事情发生后的那段时间里，每当有人对我的处境表示同情时，我确实会感到愤怒。但是……这样做其实并没有什么意义，对吧？我的自尊心，或者说我所剩下的那一点点自尊心，根本不值得让我去拒绝那些真正想要帮助我的人。那些只是出于同情而接近我，或者想利用我来在别人面前显示自己的价值的人，其实一目了然。 ] 但不，我没有理由为此生气。假装也没有意义——我知道我再也不能像其他人一样了，虽然有时候这会让人感到难过，但你必须继续前进，否则阻碍你前进的最大障碍就是你自己。一旦我意识到了这一点，我就能够更加坦然地接受别人伸来的帮助了。所以，是的[pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]如果有人问起，我愿意分享自己是如何变成现在这样的。也许这么轻易地倾诉自己的人生经历会有点奇怪，但在这个时候，我已经变得很奇怪了，不是吗？ “或许你应该先坐下来听吧？这个故事听起来会很长呢。[pc.ra kitsune |阁下真是宽宏大量。 |好的，我们开始吧。 ]她拿起园艺工具，带着你来到花园附近的凉亭，然后为你搬来一把椅子。[pc.ra kitsune | 在鞠躬之前，她先将耳朵向前折叠，然后说道：“尊贵的阁下。” 好吧，最好别让这种情况变得更加尴尬了。只有当你坐下来，感到舒适的时候，她才会[party.has kiyoko |他又为你身边的那位“狐狸妻子”拉来一把椅子，再次鞠躬，等到她坐下来后，自己才最终在桌旁找了个位置坐下。 |她在餐桌上找了个位置坐下，脸上保持着谨慎中立的表情。 ] |[party.has kiyoko |然后你也对你的狐狸妻子做同样的事，让她在鞠躬时把耳朵向前折。[silly |大友高级女侍 |宫部大人 ]只有当你们俩都感到舒适之后，她才会坐在你们对面的座位上，然后开始行动。 |等着你先安顿好自己，她才会在你对面的座位上坐下。 ] ]其实也没什么特别的， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |说实话 ]我的卧室发生了一场火灾。烟雾一定在我睡觉时让我窒息了，因为我直到全身大部分都被火焰吞噬、疼痛变得难以忍受时才醒了过来。我……我被烧伤了。当地法官进行了调查，结果发现，我睡觉的地方有一盏灯被碰倒了，而桑纸和菜籽油都是易燃物。最终，这个案件被认定为意外事故而结案了……" 哦天哪，还有其他人受伤吗？[silly | 通常，当这类故事被提起时，幸存者往往也是这类可怕事故中唯一的生还者。在接下来的整个视觉小说剧情中，她都会一直沉浸在为什么只有自己活了下来这样的思绪中，同时也会表现出其他典型的幸存者内疚心理。 ] 琳多缓缓摇了摇头。“不，大火并没有烧毁那些支撑梁。具有讽刺意味的是，正是因为我的卧室结构在保护了我的家人的同时，也将最强烈的热量集中到了我的身上，因为热量无处可散。如果不是我的哥哥在一位恰好路过我家附近的勇敢路人的帮助下将我从火中救出来，我那天就会丧命。 我……我记得在准备睡觉的时候，我把灯给吹灭了，这一点我很清楚。火焰……它们主要集中在我的卧室里。但我的记忆中……当时有太多的烟雾，我的睡衣在燃烧，我的皮肤也在被烧伤……发生的一切带来的冲击让我的记忆变得混乱了。不过现在这些都无所谓了。但我就是因此留下了这些伤痕。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ][party.has kiyoko |， [silly |高阶女巫 |宫部大人 ] ]只是一次意外的小插曲，并没有任何证据表明法官办公室的行为存在不当之处。” 她肯定在隐瞒什么——虽然不一定是什么重大的事情。撒谎甚至试图欺骗你，但你可以看出，她的笑容显得过于热情，摆出的姿势也有些过于前倾，仿佛在试图弥补某些连她自己可能都不清楚、甚至不愿承认的事情。 “最好这件事一开始就从未发生过，但既然已经发生了，让一个人来承担所有的后果，总比整栋楼里的人全部遇难要好，不是吗？对此无能为力——只不过是每天都会发生的那些变幻莫测的意外事件之一罢了。事后……我的身体在几个月的时间里尽其所能地恢复了。但无论如何，一切都已经回不去了。我未婚夫的家族取消了他们从我还是个孩子时就为我安排好的婚事……他们问我是否愿意前往海外殖民地，为“樱花王座”效力，寻求发展机会。当然，最明智的做法就是接受现实，这样我就不会给周围的人带来更多的麻烦了。” …… “一天天地过，就先过好今天吧，”林多终于说道，她那平静而温柔的微笑始终挂在唇边。毕竟，对此也无能为力。” 难道真的没有任何办法可以消除她的伤痕，也无法恢复她的视力吗？[pc.ra kitsune |你所关心的问题[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]虽然很感谢大家的支持，但这也只是我内心的愿望而已。 |这就是我所能做的最大努力了。 ]几年前我初次来到这些殖民地时，那位工匠对我的状况感到非常兴奋，他提出了一些新颖的方法来恢复我的各项功能。例如，他打算摘除我那已经失去作用的眼睛，然后用一个装满某种特定植物汁液和种子的球体来替代它——这种植物原本就生长在这些地方。 [pc.ra kitsune |我们的 |我的 ]这种植物经过特殊的改造，通过多种培育方法得以生长。随着它的生长，它的根会延伸到我的颅骨中，用他自己的话来说，这些根会“适当刺激我的视神经和穴位”。虽然这种替代物无法比得上真正的眼睛，但至少能让我摆脱失明的困境。 我拒绝了，但并不是因为我胆小——无论人们对和雄的作品有什么看法，它们确实达到了作者想要的效果。从我之前的状态走到现在这个位置，这一路走来并不容易，但我感觉……啊，该怎么表达呢？在这片森林里，有些松树种类是需要火才能繁殖的。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下。 |你知道吗？ ]野火烧焦了这些松果，种子便落在了被大火清理出来、布满灰烬的土地上。即便你把松果敲开，如果没有清除掉旧的树枝和灌木，新的幼苗也无法生根生长。 来到这些殖民地之后，很多事情都变得清晰明了了。这里的每个人，都在某种程度上存在着问题，无论这些问题是否显而易见；人们被送到这里——或者更糟糕的是，自愿来到这里——肯定是有原因的；而那些在这里出生的人，他们的血液和基因中也承载着这种‘耻辱’。与那些尽管面临种种困难，却依然能够团结一心、积极向前的人在一起，让人几乎没有时间去自怜。如果我当时留在大洋彼岸和家人在一起，或者按照计划嫁入未婚夫的家族，我想我也不会对所发生的一切有这样的接受态度。 所以，不是这样的[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]确实有几种方法可以某种程度上恢复我的身体状况，但我并不想接受任何这些方法。这些特征已经成为了我现在的自我的一部分，我也已经接受了这一点；只要它们不会妨碍我发挥自己的作用，我就愿意让一切保持现状。凛！”米可的声音从花园的尽头传来，清晰地传遍了空气。“我都一个小时没见到你了，你该不会在偷懒吧？看在神的份上，如果你现在不立刻出现，我就去告诉奶奶了！看来她被需要去别的地方了。” “啊。”凛朵用手捂住脸颊。“是啊，我确实该走了。那我就先告辞了，还请见谅。 [pc.ra kitsune | 阁下 |[pc.name] ][party.has kiyoko |， [silly |宫部大人 |高阶女士 ] ]说完这句话，那个白毛女孩站了起来，鞠了一躬。[party.has kiyoko | 你们两个 ]她先是优雅地后退，但随后突然加速朝着神社跑去。转眼间，她就消失不见了…… [party.has kiyoko |对于你们两个人来说，也只能离开了。 那么，你的狐狸妻子对这一切是怎么看的呢？事情肯定没有表面上看起来的那么简单，对吧？ “确实如此，”清子一边说，一边把椅子往后推，然后跟在你身边离开了凉亭。 你确实注意到了一些事情，但缺乏相关的文化背景，因此无法完全理解其中的内涵。如果她能发表一下意见的话会怎么样呢？ “嗯，很明显，导致那个女孩留下疤痕的那场火灾，几乎可以肯定不是一场意外。这个女孩可能会这样告诉自己，甚至也会相信自己的话，但自我欺骗并不能取代现实。从她的家族名称来看，她的背景应该属于中下阶层；她显然接受过一些教育，但这种教育的深度和范围都非常有限。然而，她不仅拥有洁白无瑕的毛皮，还具备某种神圣的气质。她的存在本身就会使事情变得复杂起来。 你以为在和清子交谈时已经讨论过这些话题了，但这些特征其实只存在于旧国的统治家族中，不是吗？ “确实如此。不过，偶尔也会出现这样的情况——大概每个世纪有一两次吧——会有来自中下层阶级的人出生时就拥有白色的毛发，或者身上带有某种神迹。她两者皆有。通常，这个家族可以追溯到一些与“十二大家族”有远亲关系的祖先，以此来解释为什么这种血统会出现在他们中间。而有时候，人们也会怀疑某个孩子是私生子，认为他的血统源自某个旁支家族的意外产物。无论原因是什么，人们普遍接受的解决办法就是让这个人嫁给统治他们所在领地的十二大家族之一。几个世纪以来，人们一直都是用这种方式来处理这类问题，而这个做法也与那个女孩的故事相符——她从很小的时候就被许配给了另一个人，等到成年后才会结婚。如果这就是她尽管出身卑微却仍能够接受一定程度教育的原因，我一点也不会感到惊讶。 哦。 [pc.bgMulti noblescion minstrel courtesan |你开始发现，在这种歌舞之中存在着一些熟悉的模式——当你还是贵族子弟的童年时期，你就亲身体验过这一切，而这也正是你离开家庭的原因之一。看来，即使远在大洋的另一边，事情其实也没有什么不同。 |你开始发现，在这种歌舞表演中确实存在一些熟悉的模式了——当你作为吟游诗人生活在贵族宫廷中时，你可是亲身体验过这些的。看来，即使远在大洋的另一边，事情其实也并没有什么不同啊。 |你开始发现，在这种尔虞我诈的游戏中，那些熟悉的模式不断重复出现——当你作为宫廷女侍生活在贵族们的宫廷中时，你就亲身体验过这一切，那些甜言蜜语、虚情假意，你不得不一一忍受。看来，即使远在大洋的另一边，事情其实也并没有什么不同。 |虽然你对这件事了解不多，但你可以看出这确实是一个棘手的局面。 ]一次暗杀企图？由于不了解具体情况，我只能猜测。这种可能性确实存在——从她出生的那一刻起，就有无数人开始磨刀霍霍了。那个女孩，或许真的遭遇了arahitogami因此，她们被视为神圣不可侵犯的。然而，世上总是不缺乏那些冷酷无耻之人，尤其是当有强大的势力在背后支持他们的时候。如果她的寝室发生了意外火灾，或者遭遇了其他不幸，如果她没有在火焰已经开始烧毁她的衣物和身体之前醒来……那么，很有可能，如果她没有选择前往殖民地接受这种表面上看似体面的流放，她现在可能就已经不在人世了。 别担心，这种事情不会发生在像我和我们这样的人身上。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 |孩子们 |女儿 ]我已经采取了一些措施，来缓解因为我们的重生而可能引发的任何担忧。” 你肯定很高兴吧——毕竟你费了那么大劲把你的狐妖妻子带回人间，难道只是为了再次与她分开吗？ 清子轻笑了一声，但随后她的表情变得严肃起来：“亲爱的，请不要拿这种事情开玩笑。那么……我们现在该出发了吗？ ]
rows.raw: " Rindo smiles and swishes her three tails, clearly taking mischievous pleasure in your unease. "Is something the matter, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]?" It's just that... well, it would be easy for someone to take offense if he or she were to be asked a deeply personal question like that. [pc.ra kitsune |"You are the chosen one of the August Master at the Center of Heaven, your Eminence; I could not bear to even harbour such sentiments against you. If anything, I should be glad that someone in your station and of your position should show a personal interest in my condition. Would more be as compassionate as you. |Rindo sighs, but it's a good-natured sigh. "I don't deny that it would be easy to get angry, and for a while after it happened I did feel that way whenever someone expressed sympathy for my condition, but... there's not really much point in that, is there? My pride, or what was left of it, wasn't worth pushing away people who only wanted to genuinely help — those who were pitying me to prop themselves up in the eyes of others or otherwise wanted to make use of me were so obvious. ] "But no, there is no reason for me to be angry about it. There's no use in pretending — I know I can't be like other people any more, and while it's a little sad at some point you just have to move on or else the biggest obstacle in your way is yourself. And once I realized that, I was able to accept helping hands that much more easily. So yes, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]I'm willing to share how I ended up like this to anyone who asks. Maybe it's a little strange to pour out your life story so easily, but at this point I'm strange, am I not?" Perhaps you should take a seat? This sounds like it's going to be a long story. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence is gracious |Yes, let's ]." Picking up her gardening tools, Rindo leads you to the nearby gazebo in the gardens and pulls out a seat for you[pc.ra kitsune | before bowing, folding her ears forward. "Your Eminence." Well, best not make this any more awkward than it already is. It's only when you're seated and comfortable that she [party.has kiyoko |pulls out another seat for your fox-wife beside you, bowing again and waiting for her to be seated as well before finally taking her own place at the table |takes her own place at the table, her face carefully neutral ] |[party.has kiyoko |, then does the same for your fox-wife, folding her ears forward as she bows. "[silly |High Lady Otomo |Myobu-sama ]." It's only when the both of you make yourselves comfortable that she takes her own place at the table opposite you two, and begins |, waiting for you to make yourself comfortable before taking her own place at the table opposite you ] ]. "It is not really much, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |truth be told ]. There was an accident in my bedchambers. A fire. I... the smoke must have asphyxiated me as I slept, for I did not rouse until much my person had been set alight and the pain was simply too great for my body to ignore. I... I was burned. There was an inquest by the local magistrate, and the investigation found that a lamp had been knocked over by where I was sleeping, and well, mulberry paper is flammable, and so is rapeseed oil. The case was closed with a ruling of misadventure..." Oh dear. Was anyone else hurt?[silly | Usually when these stories come up, the person surviving also happens to be the sole survivor of such terrible accidents and spends the rest of the visual novel moping about why she was the only one to live and other manifestations of survivor's guilt. ] Rindo slowly shakes her head. "No, the fire didn't make it through the support beams. Paradoxically, by protecting the rest of my family, the structure of my bedchamber focused the worst of the heat onto my person, since it had nowhere to go. If not for my brother pulling me out of the flames with the assistance of a brave passerby who just happened to be present by my family's holdings, I would have perished that day. "I... I remember that I blew out the lamp when I turned in for the night, that much is clear. The flames... they were concentrated in my chambers. But my recollections... there was so much smoke, and my nightgown was already burning, and so was my skin... my recollections may have been jumbled from the shock of everything that happened. It does not matter, not at this point, anyway. But that's how I came to bear these scars[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ][party.has kiyoko |, [silly |High Lady |Myobu-sama ] ]. A simple misadventure, with no evidence of wrongdoing by the magistrate's office." She's holding something back — not necessarily outright lying or even attempting to deceive you, but you can tell her smile's just a bit too enthusiastic, the pose she's holding just a bit too forward, as if she's overcompensating for something that she herself may not even know or admit even in her own mind. "Better that it not have happened at all in the first place, but since it came to pass it was better that one person take the brunt of it all than everyone in the building perish, isn't it? Nothing can be done about it — just another one of the many fickle happenstances that go on every day, that's all. After the fact... my body recovered as much as it was able to over the course of several months. But still, nothing could be the way it was any more. My fiance's clan broke off the arrangement with my family that they'd planned since I was a kit... I was asked if I would like to pursue opportunities in service of the Cherry Blossom Throne across the ocean in the colonies. The smart thing to do, of course, was to accept, lest I become more of a problem for those around me than I already was." ... "One day at a time, just for today," Rindo finishes at last, keeping her placid little smile fixated upon her lips. "After all, nothing can be done about it." Is there truly nothing that can be done for her scars? Her eye? "[pc.ra kitsune |The concern your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship shows is appreciated, but it's as much as I wish |It's as far as I'm willing to go ]. When I first arrived in the colonies some years prior, the artificer was extremely excited at my condition and proposed several novel methods by which he would restore my faculties. For example, he wanted to remove my now-useless eye and replace it with a globe filled with sap and the seed of a certain species of plant native to [pc.ra kitsune |our |my ] homeland, properly altered with several shaping methods. As the plant grew, it would extend its roots into my skull, and in his own words, 'stimulate my optic nerve and pressure points appropriately.' It would not be better than an actual eye, but be an improvement over sightlessness. "I declined, but not because I was squeamish — whatever one may think of Kazuo's works, they function as he intends them to. It was not an easy trip to get from where I was to where I stand now, but I feel... ah, how should I put it? There are species of pines in this forest that require fire to propagate, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence. |did you know that? ] Wildfires sear their cones, and the seeds fall to ground cleared by fire and filled with ash. Even if you strike the cones open, new growth cannot take root without cleaning out old wood and underbrush. "Being here in the colonies has brought a lot of things in perspective. Everyone here is broken in some fashion, whether it's obvious or not; you get sent — or even worse, voluntarily come — here for a reason, and even those born here carry that shame in their blood and lineage. Being around people like that who have nevertheless managed to band together and move forward while being productive leaves little time for self-pity. I wouldn't have achieved such acceptance of what has happened if I'd stayed back across the ocean with my family or even married into my fiance's clan as planned. "So no, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. There are indeed several procedures that could be performed to restore my body in a sense, but I don't want to undergo any of them. This is part of who I am now, and I've come to accept that; so long as it doesn't get in the way of me being useful, I'm content to let things be." "Rin!" Miko's voice sounds out from the end of the gardens, carrying cleanly across the air. "I ain't been seein' ya f'r a good hour now, ya ain't slackin' off none now, are ya? By his divine lordship's tails, if'n ya don't show yer face this very instant I'mma go straight up an' start tattlin' on ya to Granny!" Looks like she's needed elsewhere. "Ah." Rindo raises a hand to her cheek. "So I am. Well then, I must take my leave. Please excuse me, [pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence |[pc.name] ][party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ] ]." With that, the white-furred girl stands, bows[party.has kiyoko | to the both of you ], and withdraws — gracefully at first, but breaking into a run for the shrine. Then, she's gone... [party.has kiyoko |nothing left for the two of you but to leave, too. So, what does your fox-wife think of all this? There's more to the matter that meets the eye, isn't there? "There is," Kiyoko replies as she pushes her seat back in and falls in step beside you as you leave the gazebo. You've managed to pick up on a few things, but don't have the cultural background to make sense of it. If she would weigh in? "Well, what is obvious is that the fire that caused the girl's scarring was almost certainly not an accident. The girl may tell herself that and even believe it herself, but self-delusion is no substitute for reality. By her clan name, I would place her background as somewhere in the middle to lower-middle classes; she clearly has had some education, but it is limited in depth and scope. Yet she's possessed of not just radiant white fur, but brands of divinity. Her very existence would have complicated matters." You think you've covered this before in your conversations with Kiyoko, but those traits are limited to the Old Country's ruling families, aren't they? "They are. Every so often, though, maybe once or twice a century, someone from the middle or lower classes is born with white fur, or one or more brands of divinity. She has both. Usually, the family can trace some distant ancestry to the Twelve to explain why the blood has surfaced amongst them. Other times, suspicion of being a bastard child arises, the kit being some wayward branch family's by-blow. Whatever the cause, the accepted recourse is for the individual to be married into that of the Twelve which controls the fiefdom in which they reside. For centuries, that has been the way these anomalies are handled, and it matches up with the girl's story — she would have been betrothed to another from a very young age, to be married when she reached her majority. I would not be surprised if this is why she was able to receive some small measure of education despite her humble background." Oh. [pc.bgMulti noblescion minstrel courtesan |You're beginning to see the familiar patterns in this song and dance — you had a front-row seat to it during your childhood as a noble scion, and it was part of why you left your family. Guess things aren't really any different an ocean away |You're beginning to see the familiar patterns in this song and dance — you had a front-row seat to it during your time amongst noble courts as a minstrel. Guess things aren't really any different an ocean away |You're beginning to see the familiar patterns in this song and dance — you had a front-row seat to it during your time amongst noble courts as a courtesan with all the pillow talk you had to endure. Guess things aren't really any different an ocean away |While you don't know much about this, you can tell it's a sticky situation ]. "An assasination attempt? Without knowing the details, I can only guess. Certainly plausible — any number of actors would have been sharpening their proverbial knives from the moment she emerged from the womb. The girl may have been possessed of arahitogami and hence considered divine and untouchable, but there is no shortage of the ruthless and shameless to be had, especially if a powerful hand is guiding them. An accidental fire in one's sleeping chambers, a misadventure, the fact that she did not rouse until the flames were already consuming her clothes and body... chances are if she had not chosen to accept her thinly-veiled exile to the colonies, she might not be amongst the living now. "Do not worry, such things will not happen to the likes of me and our [kiyoko.numKits 2 |children |daughter ]. I have taken steps to soothe any concerns that might arise from our returned existence." You're glad — you didn't go to all that effort to bring your fox-wife back to the land of the living just to be separated again. Kiyoko chuckles, but then her expression turns serious. "Please do not jest about such things, beloved. But now... shall we be on our way?" ] "

rows.original: [var0 |[rand |"Some of those who are banished here see the colonies as a freezing backwater, and in a sense they're not wrong[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Many of the comforts that accompany civilization, that we take for granted, are not present here; on the less material side of things, being torn away from your clan and neighbors has a profound impact on people. It is not an easy life, and even the likes of me are obliged to engage in manual labor — there is simply no room for laziness or malingering. "On the other hand... it is a calming existence in other aspects. Even though you have but swapped one set of problems for another, the problems of existence and survival are simple and direct as opposed to the political jockeying between the provinces and the capital, or within the capital itself. There are no Imperial Examinations filled with thousands of hopeful applicants for the handful of positions within the civil service every five years... "...Life in the colonies in my current condition is more enjoyable than the first fourteen years of my life with a whole body. This is not to say I don't miss the family and other people I left behind, but I see that it's better for them that I came to live here. My presence would have been a continued danger to them, because of who I am. There's a strange sense of peace and trust here that feel has been lost in the cities where I came from." |"Current events? There are none for me to share, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. Life today is as it was yesterday, and I'm content. Oh, but perhaps there is. Would you like to see the gentians I have been cultivating? Those from my homeland have blue flowers, but the breed native to this land has violet ones. The Imperial Governor tells me that they were blue when her first expedition brought them over from the Old Country, but over many generations they became violet. Isn't that interesting?" To a naturalist like her, you can imagine that it would. "Is it the air? The soil? The water? Or perhaps the influences of native flora? Why did the changes take place, and can they be reliably replicated? And of course, the question is... are people similarly affected, only on a timespan so slow that no single one of us can observe the entire process by ourselves?" Has she asked Komari? "The colonial governor will not speak of it, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |alas ], and after the first time, I dare not try again. It clearly hurts her a lot, and we need to be mindful of others. Besides, the process of figuring it out for myself will make me stronger in the long run." |"They say that the Trickster himself has been manifesting in the colonies quite often, more than some of even the greatest shrines back across the ocean. The Colonial Governor has had to decline several requests to make pilgrimages through the torii gates, saying that she could not guarantee their safety should they wander away from the arcology, and that we don't have the capability to accommodate a large number of pilgrims." Is Keros known to manifest often? Historically, that is. "The other grand kami are often distant, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]but the August Master at the Center of Heaven has been involved in the lives of many since his return, just as the old legends say. If I may, I think that this is a good thing — that deities should meet not just their petitioners, but the people they are responsible for in person. He takes a much more active role in matters than the other grand kami, and for that I think most people are grateful. There is a personal touch there that say, Lumia does not have. "Of course, wherever he is known to have manifested without disguising himself, people will flock to for all sorts of reasons... those who would ask gifts or boons of him should remember the divine law of equivalent exchange, and temper their wishes accordingly. While more respectability for the colonies in the homeland would be nice, we simply are not established enough to be a stopping-point for anyone on a pilgrimage." |"It has been getting dangerous outside of late, has it not? More dangerous, that is..." Well, there's been the whole Kasyrra business, yes, and all the echoes and ripples she leaves in her wake. Of course, she's not the only one with agency in all of this, but you digress. Yes, things are getting more dangerous in all of the Marches. "I suspected as much. Fewer people return from prospecting to bring me samples of the local flora, and the military provost and his six subordinates are being run ragged on tasks set by the governor. We have been asked not to leave the arcology, unless it is to seek out benefactors. "...Please be careful out there[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence. The tasks his divine lordship have set before you will no doubt place you in mortal peril repeatedly. It would be a blow to the morale of the colonies, perhaps even an irrecoverable one, were our champion to perish |. For an outsider, you are quite likeable and I would notice if you ceased to come around any longer ]. Stay healthy." You most certainly intend to. |"You can feel the tension in the air, can you not[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]?" No, actually, you can't. But maybe that's just because you've been living like this long enough that you've gotten used to it and don't really feel it any more... "A sense of foreboding despite our current peace, like something is about to happen. Sometimes, my skin feels tight, or my ears twitch... and I get uneasy. Not that I can actually tell fortunes like Miko does, but I feel that life can be more interesting if we don't dismiss hunches and premonitions out of hand. That, and I've been noticing untoward changes in the plants which are brought to me from beyond the arcology." With the alraune's defeat, hopefully the corruption of the Old Forest and Frostwood will be halted, but you get the feeling that it's not going to be so easy. It never is. "Ah." Rindo turns her one good eye away from you. "In the case, if there is something I can do to assist you, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]please do not hesitate to ask. While my formal education may not have been very much, I nevertheless have some years spent studying this natural history of this land, if nothing else." ] |[rand |Rindo looks down at the words. "Ah! Word has been going around the den[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ] — I am so sorry that such a thing happened to the young lady Otomo. To assault your daughter as she slept and when her parents were out[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |, not to mention her sister, too |, not to mention her siblings, too ]... these villains are truly the worst. So much of your home burned down and reduced to ashes... at least buildings can be rebuilt, but lives are irreplaceable." Huh, she sure feels strongly about the whole matter, and unsurprisingly, too. You have to thank her for her deep concern over Kinu. The white-furred naturalist gives you a little bow and dip of her head. "No, thank you[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Although I have come to terms with my injuries, I would not wish someone else to have to walk the same path in order to get to where I am today, not in such a manner. That the young lady Otomo emerged without permanent injuries is a blessing that you should give thanks for at the shrine. Certainly she was more than fortuitous in waking up when she did, in time to prevent misfortune from befalling her and hers." The words, of course, go unspoken, but are nevertheless heard clearly: unlike me. You'll go pay your dues to Keros later, maybe make an offering, although you're not quite sure how it's done. That, and you're sorry if you brought up any painful memories for her. Rindo just dips her head. "Fret not[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Everyone in the colonies loves the young lady Otomo, and that includes me amongst their number. Some small discomfiture is nothing if it can help her in any way at all." |"Things are more tense about the den. You can feel it, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]even if people are trying to get on with their lives as best as they can. This is no gathering of natives seeking to drive out vampiric creatures from their midst — this is a coordinated attack by an unknown enemy. There is a certain effect on morale." And is she feeling it? "I... it would not be as bad if they had not decided to try and bar the young lady Otomo in her chambers and set it alight. Several more moments, and she would have suffered my fate, or worse. The way these outsiders attempted to murder her... it strikes a little too close to home for me. "But please forgive me. This conversation should be about the young lady Otomo, and not my own insecurities." She doesn't need to apologize, you're the one who asked her. [pc.ra kitsune |"Your Eminence, I am sure you will do an excellent job in your appointement. Perhaps this is what his divine lordship was considering when he decided he needed a champion, and in the colonies. |Rindo simply turns her head, refusing to look you in the eye. " ]People are uncertain about the immediate future, even if they may not show it. Please watch over us." |"The heavens be praised that no lasting harm came to the young lady Otomo. She is our princess, regardless of whether her mother has abdicated her position or not; neither blood nor arahitogami can be wiped out with a piece of paper. If it were not for the alien appearances and behaviors of the assailants, I might have suspected foul play by any number of peoples on the other side of the ocean. Politics by other means, as the saying goes." What would have happened if it'd been foul play by anyone who might resent the existence of your family? Rindo thinks a moment, then shakes her head. "I don't know[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]; that web is too complex for someone as simple as me to navigate. But another of the reasons that in retrospect, I'm glad that the marriage that was arranged for me never came to pass. Even in a branch family, I would've been caught up in such plots whether I liked it or not. Here in the colonies, things are simpler... even the enemies one faces are more direct. "But I should not be talking about myself. Even in the comparatively short time she has been with us, the young lady Otomo has played true to her clan name and captured the hearts of the colonials. While it's been truly great for morale, the inverse would happen if tragedy were to befall her. Hence, do be assured that everyone will be watching out for her from here on out[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." And as her parent, you'll be keeping an eye out, too. This whole business may demand that you leave your daughter unattended for extended periods of time, but if you don't deal with the matter of Kasyrra, there won't be much of a world for Kinu to inherit. Kinu may be a grown woman, but even so you're glad the other foxes are looking out for her. "I have but one eye, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]but I'll do my part. The young lady Otomo is fun to talk to." |Ever since your home was invaded, everyone's been on edge. You really liked the calming atmosphere the fox den had before all this happened, and now it's soured even though people are trying to get on with their lives as normally as they can. Even the gardens about the shrine have lost some of their tranquil atmosphere; you miss the way things were. "We are one people, of one mind, and possessed of one soul[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Especially here in the colonies... an attack against one of us from outside is an attack against all of us. Everyone feels the trepidation and unease — we have no illusions about what is at stake here. Life must continue, but to pretend that nothing has happened is not possible, either. Now that others have attempted to harm one of our own, everyone is vigilant. Not necessarily afraid — although there is some of that, too — but vigilant." There is that. You've noticed how quickly moods spread throughout the kitsune den and the foxes who live within, as quickly as a school of fish decides to turn itself around. Sure, similar things can happen in a close-knit community like Hawkethorne, but this is uncanny. "Everyone is hoping for the full recovery of the young lady Otomo posthaste, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. Not just in body, but in spirit as well." You don't think you'll be able to rest easy after everything that's happened, but at least you'll feel better knowing that Kinu has so many people backing her up. She's your daughter and ultimately your responsibility here, but the help is appreciated. A small bow. "Even though her mother may have abdicated, we are still eager and willing to serve." |"The governor has requested that I prepare several seedlings for the purpose of restoring the High Lady Otomo's home[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. [kiyoko.married |Since it is also your home, you will be pleased to know that I've shaped but the best for this purpose. ]While a fair few have already been put into the earth, more will be needed for the long-term effort; even though the raiders razed much of the structure, we will build it anew and better. We will see to it that some good will come out of this tragedy." What are the seedlings intended for, if you may ask? "Vines for binding materials together, roots to fix burnt earth, and other sundry construction purposes. Your home will look exactly the same, but emerge stronger, more fireproof, and easier to defend. Now that we know there's a threat and some of the forms it can take, that makes it easier to design countermeasures. Everyone is coming together in this time of need, as we always have for one of our own." Still, you have to thank her. "There's no need to thank me[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]; it's understood that everyone is bound by reciprocity. There's no doubt that the young lady Otomo will come to us, too, when the situation calls for it. Such is our way." ] |[rand |"Ah, to be the attempt of not just one, but two targeted assassinations and survive... it must be terrible on one's peace of mind." Rindo keeps her small, placid smile, but her voice perceptibly softens. "While my brother asked me to come to the colonies for the sake of my health and a more suitable environment for me recovery, I also know what he was trying to say by omission. For the young lady Otomo to continue leading a normal life despite what she must be feeling right now must be no small feat; I will admit to being a little envious at such immense resolve." Ah, Kinu [kinu.isInari |is as stolid and solid as a rock; her head is hard, her skull thick and her will indomitable. She wouldn't let something as trivial as her own safety or concern for her life tear her from the fields she loves so much; if she were to cease surrounding herself with green growing things, it would be death in a sense, wouldn't it? |is every bit like her lady mother, silk hiding iron despite grace and soft-spokenness. She wouldn't let something as trivial as her own safety or concern for her life tear her from her duties to those around her; she wouldn't be your darling daughter if that weren't the case, would it? ] "[pc.ra kitsune |Your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |Ah ]... even when you put it that way, someone like me would not be able to withstand the thought, let alone do so unflinchingly. That the young lady Otomo is able to do so makes her a cut above us all where I would be sorely tempted to hide in my quarters and not come out like I did when I first arrived in the colonies." Rindo dips her head at you in a respectful nod. "Please, admiration is due where it is. I would find it immensely difficult to live as I do constantly watching over my shoulder, reminded of the stark nature of my mortality any more than I already am." |"The colonial governor has instructed me to shift several beds of nadeshiko flowers off to the east, as well as plant several new paulownia saplings by the water. Not exactly aesthetic, to be sure, but the geomantic purpose in doing so is crystal clear. Not only does the new arrangement repel hexes with greater efficiency, but it also casts a cloak of obscurity over us such that alternative means of spying upon our location are harder. It is subtle, but the increased focus on our security betrays her worry." Mm, that's not surprising. It is Komari's duty to ensure the security of everyone living in the colonies, after all, and she is a practical enough woman to know where her priorities lie, even if it means making her gardens a little less pleasing to the eye. What is that compared to the lives of the people under her charge, after all? "Just so[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Anything else she's been doing to step up security about these parts? While everything looks as it always has been, you've also been around the foxes long enough to know that they're good at subtle touches and hidden surprises concealed in plain sight. "The den matron has asked both Kazuo[silly |-san ] and I to focus on the development of more intricate and better skilled blade puppets to make up for the lack of numbers which the military provost has under his command. They are not very intelligent and are only able to take simplistic commands, but they are also disposable and fight well enough, given that they are fashioned with a single task in mind." Rindo pauses a moment and sighs. "I think my colleague is a little too excited to be able to work on something that has genuinely captured his interest of late. After that business with analysing that control rod from the first time, he really needed a project he could feel passionate about as opposed to that which he performed as a matter of duty." The man does love his puppetry, doesn't he? "Automation has always been an interest of Kazuo[silly |-san ]'s, and what little remnants of the Belharan empire's old constructs that have been unearthed in this region have captured his attention. I'm sure he truly desires to have genuine targets to test his creations against in earnest..." Rindo looks pensive a moment, then shudders. "Please, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]perhaps we can speak of something else?" |Rindo puts her fingers together and turns her gaze from you. "Well, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]I am not entirely sure if it's proper to voice this particular of mine..." It's all right for her to speak her mind; you won't get mad or anything. What's up? "It's extremely foolish of me, but I find my more emotional side wishing that I were in the young lady Otomo's shoes, if only because it meant the provost would be showering me with so much attention. [kinu.isInari |It's not as if she appreciates having him try to put a security detail on her, even if keeping her safe is part of his job, so why not let someone who would appreciate it have as much? It's not fair... I would certainly enjoy the attention far more than she does. |Seeing her being taken care of like that as his fiancee and walking side by side with him... ah, I know it is about your daughter and you should take offense, and all it does is remind me of my failings. I had a whole five years and never even moved to express myself even subtly ] "But here I am, foolishly speaking ill of my betters... and even so! Even so! Ah, I should [kinu.isInari |do something about it, take this as an impetus to let the provost know of my feelings for him before it's too late; I have had five years in the colonies since I was a girl and never said anything, and yet it is only a matter of time before the colonial governor arranges for him to be married. That I have not said anything is my own fault, but to see the young lady Otomo get all that attention from him even if it is unrequited and will never go anywhere makes me so upset. Given that she is already engaged to Hitoshi, I should not worry, that is true |give up already, they are already engaged under the auspices of [silly |Myobu-sama |the high-lady ]; I should not even dream of settling for being a second wife or even a concubine ]. And yet, my body is aching deep inside with resentment and, um, something else... it is foolish, is it not?" Given that she's talking about wanting to put her own life in danger in order to catch the eye of the man she's infatuated with, yes, it's foolish to the highest degree. And yet, you did promise that you wouldn't get mad with her... even if she did take a jab or two at Kinu, if unavoidably given the nature of the discussion. Rindo bows her head and folds her ears down and to the side. "You said you would not get angry if I were forthright[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." And you aren't. [kinu.isInari |Maybe this should serve as a wake-up call for her — she had five years to make a move, and dithered out of her own indecision and insecurity. She can't control what she looks like, not with scars like these, but she can control how she behaves and it's made worse because she's already overcome so much and knows that for herself. If she's infatuated with Nakano, she'd better start moving forward on things; neither of them are getting any younger |She had five years to make a move, and didn't. When it comes down to it, even she admits it was her own indecision that led to this point — since she's not willing to be a second wife or concubine, something that's rare even if permissible in Old Country society, she should start looking forward and seeing about being more proactive the next time she gets infatuated with someone ]. "...The wrenching sensation has not gotten any better; if anything, it has gotten worse..." Then perhaps it will provoke her to action. |"I am very glad that the young lady Otomo did not suffer any permanent injuries to her person even after two attempts on her life. The gods must be watching over her, as expected of someone who is of direct matrilineal descent from them." Given that Rindo herself has white fur, they don't seem to have done much for her... "Ah, but I do not have — forgive me, but it is complicated[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Maybe we can sit down another time and discuss the intricacies of divine favor, but for now let me just say that it would be a terrible pity if a flower as fine as the young lady Otomo were to be blemished or marred in any way. Consider my fate — " she touches the uneven scars of her burned cheek — "and think if she had awoken minutes later on the first night. It is nothing that should happen to anyone, and so we should thank the gods for their providence, should we not?" Well, you're certainly thankful that Kinu is whole and unhurt. "Mm." Rindo lowers her gaze. "Everyone in the colonies is concerned for her well-being[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." |"Even though the colonial governor has ordered a lockdown of the torii gate, my life has not changed much[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. But thank you for being concerned about my well-being." You're just [pc.ra kitsune |doing the job that you signed up for as their patron deity's champion |doing your part to prove to the kitsune that you're capable of caring for other people as people, that's all ]. "My life is simple and my work fulfilling; I suppose I will miss soybeans as they do not grow easily in this climate and soil, but that is a small matter. Furthermore, I have confidence in the colonial governor and the sacred tree in their ability to keep us safe. Unless further developments happen — which the young lady Otomo seems to be keeping from us by drawing them to herself in an act of noble self-sacrifice — I think I will be fine. Save for the occasional departure every ninety days or so to feed, I do not leave the den much..." She doesn't desire more, then. Rindo shakes her head. "Once, I was slated for more, much more than most people will have in their lifetimes. All that was taken from me in an instant; I was taught in the harshest of manners how transient such worldly attachments can be. Now that we are under threat, I am still content with the little I have, because I have always intentionally made do with as much when I could have Kohaku bring me more. "Y[pc.ra kitsune |our Eminence, you |ou ] will find that us colonials are not unaccustomed to making do with little, even though we have come so far in the time we have been here under the governor's guidance. Please, do not worry about us and see to your family first; they are the ones to be bearing the brunt of this ordeal, especially the young lady Otomo. We will be as we have always been." ] ]
rows.translation: [var0 |[rand |那些被流放到这里的人中，有些人认为这些殖民地是一片荒凉落后、与世隔绝的地方，从某种意义上说，他们并没有错。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]许多我们习以为常的、与文明生活相伴而来的便利，在这里都是不存在的；从物质层面来看，与自己的氏族和邻居分离，对人们来说无疑会产生深远的影响。这样的生活并不容易，就连像我这样的人，也不得不从事体力劳动——在这里，根本没有任何可以偷懒或逃避责任的空间。 另一方面……从其他角度来看，这种生活方式其实相当宁静。虽然你只是用一套问题替换了另一套问题，但生存与生活本身面临的挑战往往更为直接、简单。相比之下，那些省与首都之间，或是首都内部的权谋斗争就复杂得多了。也没有每隔五年就会举行一次科举考试，成千上万的应试者为了那为数不多的公务员职位而竞争激烈…… 以我现在的状况来说，在这些殖民地生活反而比我拥有完整身体的前十四年更加愉快。这并不是说我不想念留在家乡的家人和朋友们，但我认为，对我来说来到这里生活反而是对他们最好的选择。因为我的身份，我的存在对他们来说始终是一种威胁。在这里，我感受到一种奇异的宁静与信任，这种感觉在我曾经生活的城市里已经消失了。 |当前发生的事件吗？我没有什么可以分享的[pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 |[pc.name] ]如今的生活和昨天一样，我对此很满足。哦，不过也许还是有些不同吧。你想看看我培育的龙胆花吗？那些来自我家乡的龙胆花开的是蓝色花朵，而这种原产于这里的品种则开紫色的花。帝国总督告诉我，当她第一次远征将这些植物从旧大陆带回来时，它们的颜色是蓝色的，但经过许多代的变化，它们的颜色变成了紫色。这不是很有趣吗？ 对于像她这样的博物学家来说，这种变化肯定非常有趣吧。 是空气的原因吗？是土壤吗？是水吗？还是当地植被的影响呢？为什么会发生这些变化，而且这些变化能否被可靠地再现呢？当然，还有一个问题……人类是否也会受到类似的影响，只不过这个过程发生得如此缓慢，以至于我们中的任何一个人都无法亲自观察到整个过程呢？她问过麻里吗？ “那位殖民地总督是不会谈论这个话题的。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |唉…… ]第一次尝试之后，我就再也不敢试了。那显然会给她带来很大的痛苦，而我们毕竟需要考虑别人的感受。另外，通过自己摸索来解决问题的过程，从长远来看会让我变得更坚强。 |据说，诡计之神本人经常在那些殖民地出现，其出现频率甚至超过了大洋对岸一些最著名的神殿。因此，殖民地总督已经拒绝了几次人们前往那些地方朝圣的请求。鸟居大门管理员们表示，如果人们离开那座生态建筑，他们无法保证这些人的安全；而且我们也根本没有能力接待如此大量的朝圣者。” “那么，凯罗斯这种现象在历史上是否经常发生呢？” “还有那座其他的宏伟建筑神明往往相距甚远， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]但正如古老的传说所说，自回归以来，这位位于天庭之心的天之中央尊主确实一直参与着许多人的生活。恕我直言，我认为这是一件好事——神明不仅应该回应信徒的祈愿，更应该亲自去关心那些他们所负责的人们。与其他几位大神明相比，他在这些事务中扮演的角色要积极得多。神明我认为，大多数人都为此感到感激。这种人性化设计是卢米娅所没有的。 当然，无论他在哪里以真面目现身，人们都会出于各种原因蜂拥而至……那些希望向他祈求礼物或恩惠的人，应该牢记‘等价交换’这一神圣法则，并据此调整自己的期望。虽然如果能让家乡的殖民地获得更多的尊重固然很好，但我们的实力目前还远远不足以成为任何朝圣者的必经之地。 |最近外面的情况越来越危险了，不是吗？可以说是越来越危险了……” 嗯，毕竟还有卡希拉那件事，以及她身后留下的种种影响和后果。当然，在这整件事中，她并不是唯一有影响力的人，不过这已经有点偏离主题了。是的，整个边境地区的形势都在变得越来越危险。 “我早就有这种猜想。回来向我带回当地植物样本的人越来越少了，而军事长官和他的六名下属也被总督布置的任务搞得忙得不可开交。我们被要求不要离开这个生态建筑群，除非是去寻找愿意提供帮助的人。 ……在外面请务必小心。[pc.ra kitsune |阁下，您所肩负的这些任务无疑会让您多次面临生命危险。如果我们的勇士因此丧生，那将对殖民地的士气造成沉重打击，甚至可能是不可挽回的。 |对一个外人来说，你确实挺讨人喜欢的，如果你不再来这里了，我肯定会注意到的。 ]保持健康。” 你肯定也是这么打算的。 |你能感觉到空气中弥漫着的紧张气氛，对吧？[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]不，实际上，你是做不到的。但也许只是因为你已经习惯了这样的生活，所以已经不再有这种感觉了……” “尽管现在很平静，却总有一种不祥的预感，总觉得有什么事情即将发生。有时候，我的皮肤会感到紧绷，或者耳朵会突然抽动……这些感觉会让我感到不安。虽然我并不能像米可那样预测未来，但我认为，如果我们不要轻易忽视这些直觉和预感，生活可能会变得更加有趣。此外，我还注意到那些从弧形建筑区外带来的植物们出现了一些异常的变化。 随着阿尔劳恩的被击败，希望古林和霜木地的恶化趋势能够得到遏制，但总觉得事情并不会那么简单。啊。”琳多将她那只完好的眼睛从你身上移开，“如果有什么我可以帮忙的地方[pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]请随时随时提问。虽然我的正规教育可能并不丰富，但我确实花了一些时间研究这片土地的自然历史，至少也是这么做的。 ] |[rand |林多低头看着那些文字，说道：“啊！这些消息已经在整个巢穴里传开了[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ] — 我对这样的事情发生在奥托莫小姐身上感到非常抱歉。在您的女儿熟睡时，在她的父母都不在家的时候，有人对她实施了袭击。[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |更不用说她的妹妹了。 |更不用说她的兄弟姐妹们了。 ]……这些恶棍真的是最恶劣的。你们的家园被烧成灰烬，损失如此之大……至少建筑物还可以重建，但生命却是无可替代的。” 哈，她对这件事确实非常在意，这也并不奇怪。你真的应该感谢她对小娟的深切关怀。 那位白毛的自然学家向你微微鞠了一躬，低下了头：“不，不用谢。你[pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 ]虽然我已经接受了自己的伤势，但我真的不希望别人也必须走过同样的道路才能达到我现在的境地，尤其是不能以这样的方式。小琴小姐能够毫发无伤地脱离危险，实在是一件值得我们在神社里感恩的事情。她能够在那个时候醒来，及时避免了自己和他人遭遇不幸，这无疑也是命运的眷顾。” 这些话虽然没有说出口，但却被所有人清晰地听到了。不像我你之后会去向凯罗斯缴纳应缴的费用，或许还会献上一些祭品，尽管你还不太清楚该怎么做。另外，如果你无意中触发了她的一些痛苦回忆，你也感到很抱歉。 琳多只是低下了头，说道：“不必担心。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]殖民地里的每个人都喜欢那位名叫奥托莫的年轻女士，我也不例外。如果这些小麻烦能对她有所帮助的话，那也就没什么大不了的。 |那个巢穴里的气氛变得紧张起来了，你能感觉到这一点[pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]即使人们都在尽力继续自己的生活。但这并不是原住民们为了将吸血鬼怪物赶出自己的家园而举行的集会——这是一场由未知敌人发动的协同攻击。这种局势无疑会对人们的士气产生负面影响。那么，她现在感觉到了吗？ “我……如果他们没有试图阻止那位奥托莫小姐进入她的房间，也没有放火烧屋的话，情况应该不会这么糟糕。再晚几秒钟，她就会遭遇和我一样的命运，甚至更糟。这些外人试图谋杀她的方式……对我来说，这实在是太触动了我的内心了。 但请原谅我。这次谈话应该是关于大友小姐的，而不是关于我自己的不安情绪。” 她其实没有必要道歉，毕竟是你先问她的。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下，我相信您一定能够胜任这一职责。或许，当他的神圣主君决定需要一位捍卫者，尤其是去那些殖民地的时候，他正是考虑到了这一点。 |琳多只是简单地转过头去，拒绝与你对视。 ]人们对即将到来的未来感到不确定，尽管他们可能不会表现出来。请照顾我们吧。 |真是万幸，奥托莫小姐没有受到任何永久性的伤害。她是我们的公主，无论她的母亲是否已经放弃了她的王位；无论是血缘关系还是arahitogami用一张纸就能把它彻底抹掉。要不是那些袭击者的外貌和行为如此怪异，我可能会怀疑是大洋彼岸的某些人搞的鬼。正如那句话所说，这就是“用其他手段进行的政治斗争”罢了。会如果这是那些对你家庭的存在心怀不满的人所为，那么还会发生其他什么事情呢？ 林多思考了一会儿，然后摇了摇头：“我不知道。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]那个复杂的关系网，对于像我这样单纯的人来说，实在难以理清。但事后想来，我庆幸那场被安排好的婚姻最终没有成真。即使在旁支家族中，无论我愿不愿意，我也难免会卷入这样的阴谋之中。而在殖民地这里，事情要简单得多……就连遇到的敌人，也都更加直接、明了。 但我不应该谈论自己。即使在她与我们共处的这段相对较短的时间里，奥托莫小姐也确实不负她家族的名号，赢得了殖民地居民们的心。这对我们的士气确实有着极大的鼓舞作用；然而，如果她遭遇不幸，情况就会完全相反。因此，请大家放心，从现在起，我们一定会时刻关注她的安危。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]作为她的父母，你也会密切关注她的状况。虽然这件事可能要求你让女儿在较长的时间内独自待着，但如果你不解决卡希拉的问题，小娟将来能继承的世界将会变得非常有限。虽然小娟已经成年了，但你也还是希望其他狐妖能照顾她。 “我只有一只眼睛， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]但我会尽自己的一份力的。与那位名叫Otomo的年轻女士交谈确实很愉快。
