细雨洒在落下的灰烬之上——只有这种感觉，才能形容从她毛发与皮毛中散发出来的气息所带给人的感受。你将手指轻轻悬在她的伤痕上方，轻轻抚过那些旧日伤痕留下的记忆，同时用呼吸轻拂她的耳朵，带来一丝丝痒意。琳朵的哭声和喘息声越来越剧烈，她那娇小的胸部随着兴奋感的加剧而不断起伏；而当你用手指和手掌更加用力地按压她的身体时，这些声音和动作只会变得更加频繁。没错，她已经彻底崩溃了。…但这恰恰意味着，当她重新组合在一起时，会变得更加美丽。 难道不是这样吗？ 你继续逗弄那只可怜的小烧伤狐妖，让你想传达给它的道理真正深入它的脑海：你用挤压、揉捏和抚摸等各种方式，用充满爱意和戏弄的触碰，抚摸它的全身。正是她整个人构成了她现在的自我，她不应该忘记这一点。有太多人帮助她走到了今天这一步，如果没有他们的支持，你也就无法站在他们的肩膀上继续前进，而她也就无法最终接受你，从而消除她对自己存在的那些疑虑。 那么，现在就让我们把这件事完成吧。再最后一次抚摸一下琳多那被烧伤的身体，再许下一次充满矛盾与希望的承诺，然后你的手便缓缓滑向她那穿着长筒袜的膝盖——那细腻的布料已经被汗水和努力弄得湿漉漉的。琳多闭上眼睛，满怀期待地咬住嘴唇，随着紧张气氛的逐渐加剧，她突然发出尖叫声和呻吟声。当你分开她的双腿时，她那处女般的私密部位呈现出晶莹湿润的状态，一切都被你一览无余，她再也无法隐藏自己的羞涩与尴尬。她伸出双手，抓着你的腰身，你让她紧紧抱住你，两人的脸紧紧相贴，而她那穿着长袜的足部则缠在了你的腿上。看起来她正在努力寻找合适的词语来表达自己的心情，但林多只能发出哽咽的声音。她用双手轻轻抚摸着你的脸，将你拉得更靠近自己。 一只眼睛充满生机，呈现出鲜艳的红色，瞳孔与巩膜之间的对比极为鲜明；而另一只眼睛则毫无生气，松弛下垂，呈现出均匀的粉红色，宛如玻璃一般……但这两只眼睛都在流泪。 你把太多的注意力都放在了林多身上，甚至都不记得自己是什么时候脱掉衣服的；不过，你肯定还是脱掉衣服了，因为[pc.armor]它就躺在地上，混在你的其他衣物和她那些衣物之中，被随意地丢弃在一旁，而此刻，激情的火焰正在熊熊燃烧。林多的动作缓慢而犹豫，充满恐惧与试探，她不敢抱有太大的希望感受到太过分了。然而，敢于迈出这一步本身就体现了一种勇气——正如那句话所说，勇气并非意味着没有恐惧，而是即便面对恐惧依然勇往直前。林多走到今天这一步，每一步都充满了来自外界和内心的阴影与困扰，而你就要以自己的勇敢和无畏，通过坚定的步伐，为他人树立榜样，引领大家走向光明。 从某种意义上来说，这一切其实是在教会她如何重新感受情感。
rows.raw: " Upon hearing your proposition, Rindo turns her gaze away from you and to the side, her dead eye facing you. While her three tails aren't long enough to curl around to her front to be fiddled with, the white-furred fox starts wringing her hands and biting her lip, ears folding forward and down. [pc.ra kitsune |"Please, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship... while I am honored to receive such favor from you, even as a jest, it is still unkind to toy with a young woman's feelings like this." She pauses for a moment, then realizes what she's just said considering the social difference between the two of you, swallowing hard. "That is, I mean, no — I meant to say I didn't mean — " You reach out and shush her quietly. No, this is not a joke, it's not an elaborate prank. Every word of what you just said, that you think she's beautiful on the inside, if not necessarily the outside, is true. You're not going to lie to her and say that her disfigurement doesn't matter — it does, and she's spent the last handful of years having that point driven home deep into her heart. There's no point denying what is true — yes, her face and body are marred. But there's also another truth to be had there, that she can be beautiful not just in spite of her damaged nature, but because of it. "Such flattering words, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Yet I'm already aware of such sentiments — embracing the imperfect is already quite the popular philosophy across the ocean." |"You don't have to tease me like this. I know you're trying to cheer me up and make me feel better about myself, [pc.name], but it's still unkind to toy with a young woman's feelings in such a fashion. Hope is one thing, but it's another to have false hope." You reach out and shush her quietly. No, this is not a joke, it's not an elaborate prank. Every word of what you just said, that you think she's beautiful on the inside, if not necessarily the outside, is true. You're not going to lie to her and say that her disfigurement doesn't matter — it does, and she's spent the last handful of years having that point driven home deep into her heart. There's no point denying what is true — yes, her face and body are marred. But there's also another truth to be had there, that she can be beautiful not just in spite of her damaged nature, but because of it. Rindo sighs and shakes her head slowly. "Trust me, I am aware of that. Across the ocean in the Old Country, embracing the imperfect is already quite the popular philosophy; many pay lip service to it. At least natives of this land like you are quite honest and direct about expressing their disdain for my appearance, and I'm reminded of that every time I have to leave to sate the hunger..." ] Actions speak louder than words, don't they? "..." Well, you'll just have to show her. Reaching out, you plant your hand squarely on Rindo's head between her ears and start moving about in small circles, lightly pushing down on each side before allowing them to spring up again. She instinctively flinches and draws back, but you catch the back of her head with your fingertips and gently but firmly halt the retreat. Rindo's instinctive skittishness soon melts away, and then she leans into your touch, if tentatively. "Are you patting my head[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]?" She shouldn't ask questions when the answers are right in front of her. Rindo turns away from you in that same way, unknowingly turning her dead, sightless eye upon you; you're tempted to force her gaze back to meet yours, but maybe it's better to ease her into the idea. The way she's reacting, you can only wonder how many times she's had someone get proverbial cold feet on her... "[pc.ra kitsune |I am thankful, your Eminence |I don't mind, I suppose ], but... we are in public... " You move your fingers to the white-furred kitsune's left ear and start teasing the lightly-furred edges, rubbing the cartilaginous flesh beneath and making her sigh softly. Even so, despite all this, Rindo looks more confused than anything, perhaps expecting the punchline of the joke she's convinced she must be the butt of to be sprung any moment. "...Is there any meaning in doing this? I don't really understand[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]..." You answer that by moving your thumb and forefinger to the very tips of Rindo's left ear, feeling the notch where the original tip should have been, burned away beneath the new growth of fur that hides it. She winces, her muscles tensing and her body trembling; even the lids over the dead, glassy eye of hers twitch a bit, as opposed to their usually slack and motionless state. At last, Rindo sighs softly and bows her head forward, allowing your fingers to truly dig into her soft hair and feel the heat of her body through the fine white strands. The sensation tickles your fingertips like dancing flames... "Do as you will[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]; I cannot stop you. If you find this entertaining, I will acquiesce to your desires.[pc.ra kitsune | Even if I do have the blood, I have neither authority nor any standing that could match the likes of you, your Eminence... if the champion of the August Master at the Center of Heaven [pc.himHer]self commands it — ]" Oh, enough of this; if she still doesn't want to believe you're sincere about this, it's time to commit to this course of action. Curling your fingers about the back of Rindo's head just under the base of her cute little ponytail, you pull her forward into a kiss. That red eye of hers widens in shock and surprise, the slitted pupil turning into a thin, dark line, and then at last the wariness in Rindo's dissipates and she leans in to press her lips against yours. They're warm, her breath hot, and even as you hold the kiss your fingers continue rubbing and patting the back of her head, occasionally reaching up to rub the firm bits at the base of her ears where they join into her head.[party.has kiyoko | All this while, you feel an all-too-familiar sense of smugness coming from behind you, someone watching and quietly evaluating your performance with a lesser concubine... psh. Ah, your fox-wife wouldn't be herself otherwise; how magnanimous of her to share. ] Now does she think you're teasing her, having a joke at her expense? No, of course not, not when her face's red like this. It's so adorable. "Well, it's not a bad feeling..." Now then, she said something about you being out in public... is she done for the day? If so, [party.hasCompanions |you can leave [party.compNames] to have a bit of their own fun around the place while you follow up on this in private |you're sure you can follow up on this in private ]. Rindo pulls away from you, still a little dizzy and overwhelmed from the kiss; at length, she manages a nod. "I... I will put my things away and return posthaste." Good. She vanishes, and true to her word, returns [party.hasCompanions |just after you've dismissed [party.compNames] to have fun on your proverbial coin |shortly after ]. You sense a bit of wariness returning to her demeanour after the rush of the kiss fades, even though her slightly sweet taste lingers on your lips... sweet, yet ashen. [pc.ra kitsune |Rindo bows deeply before you. "I... I am done for the day, and am willing to attend to your needs, your Eminence." Oh, come on. She doesn't have to be so stiff and formal — the two of you are about to have sex, and here she is bowing and scraping. "When I was taking etiquette lessons in preparation for the marriage I thought I was to have, this is how — " Well, that was then and this is now. You want to see that smile of hers you know she has, instead of this. Can she do that for you, or are you going to have to command her to do it before she can finally be the person you know she can be? |"I've put away my things and informed Miko that I'll be leaving a bit early. She didn't seem to mind." Excellent. Rindo swallows hard. "I still can't quite believe all of this is happening..." ] Well, time for her to lead the way, then. You'd like to see what kind of place she lives in. Rindo bows her head and falls into step beside you. "...Why all of this[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]?" Why? Why indeed — as a person, she's made quite the stunning recovery considering what happened to her. But given how she just behaved, there's still one last wound on her that hasn't healed yet, and you can't just stand by and do nothing about it when you can step in and set things right, can you? The Rindo who arrived in the colonies wouldn't have accepted anything that had just transpired, but the person she is today... well, the both of you saw how she reacted. Everything Komari, Miko and Mai have done for her has been building up to this point. She should know full well that wounds shouldn't be left untended. "Did they set you up to this?" No. She studies your face for a good long, while, then relents. "All right." As it turns out, Rindo's abode lies on the western side of the gardens, directly opposite the path that leads to the storehouse. She hesitates a bit at the entrance, clearly still unsure about all of this, then steps up onto the little porch, slides open the screen door and invites you in, stopping to remove her platform sandals. You follow after her, removing your shoes, and shutting the door behind you, and then Rindo turns to you. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ] — " This time, it's not her head you reach for, but the burnt half of her face, your thumb resting on her cheekbone just under the dead, glassy eye and your palm and fingers gently cupping her jaw. She gasps in shock, a small vulpine noise emerging unbidden from her throat, her good eye darting about as if looking for a way to flee. There, there. The scars are rough and uneven, stiff to the touch like dried parchment; a tough exterior hardened by trauma to cover the tender flesh beneath. Rindo watches you in what can only be described as worried confusion, turning her ears to the sides and flattening them against her head as she realizes what you're trying to do. "Not that side, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]," she says quietly, a small, pained smile crossing her lips. "Many of the nerves were burned off; I can't feel much there. Try this instead." And as she says that, Rindo takes hold of your other wrist with both hands, guiding it to the other, unblemished side of her face. It's a little awkward, but now that she's taking the lead you don't want to spook her; you drop your hand from the scarred half of her face and instead slip a couple fingers into her neckline, pulling apart her top even as you pat the smooth, gentle skin on what remains of her fine features. "Ah..." Is she crying? Oh, she's trying to hold the tears back... you roll your thumb, press in on her cheek and jaw, feel her chest heave as her breathing grows ever deeper and face warms considerably. It doesn't take long for you to fall into a comfortable rhythm with her motions, gently supporting her weight as she leans more into you. "A bit more. Please, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ], just a bit more..." Of course. While Rindo is whimpering and sighing, her good eye half-closed in contentment, you proceed to pull apart the cotton top off her body; Old Country wear has so many folds and knots, but that just makes for less fumbling about. Loosened and down across her shoulders, her top falls about her waist, and then it's time for the sash and bow that hold up those pleated skirts... She's crying openly now, her breathing turned to small, choking sobs. "Even the notoriously lustful natives didn't want me, I wasn't good enough for them..." The tears run down her cheeks in small streams, joining at her chin; for all that her left eye is sightless, it can still weep. They wet your fingers and palm, but you don't stop rubbing at her face until it's all warm and squishy. And then with a pull, the skirts and smallclothes fall away, and the entirety of Rindo's body is open to you, with only her stockings left; you think you'll keep those on, they look really cute on her. "...Cute?" It's not surprising why she would question that statement; the entirety of the left side of her body is covered in those angry, brown-red scars, streaks of darker, angrier crimson spread out haphazardly over uneven skin. Her arm, her side, the outside of her thigh... and especially about her midriff, where the ugly burns spread all the way to her navel. It would be a lie to say that they weren't horrible to look at. Yet at the same time, it's because of these things, because of her struggle and everything that she's overcome to this point — with help, of course — where she can smile as she did back in the gardens, that makes the unblemished side of her shine all that brighter. And without that juxtaposition of the two, she wouldn't be who she is today. "D-do you really mean it[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]? This... this isn't false sympathy, is it?" Such a wounded creature, to ask such a question even at this juncture. If everything up to this point wasn't enough for her... Rindo's gone weak in the knees, and doesn't resist in the slightest as you ease her right down onto the woven straw flooring of what passes for her living room. Perhaps it would have been better to do this in the adjoining bedchambers, but here and now, you want to show her that even as she is, a girl like her is still able to inflame such passion in others that you have to have her now. The softness of her ruffled, thick tails cushions the impact of the landing, and you hold her by her shoulders, wiping away the last of her tears before drawing in close. “我认为，这与它们生长的环境有关。这些花园被设计成尽可能模拟那些被认为有助于植物自然生长的古老地区的环境；我确保从环境温度到土壤的条件和成分，所有因素都处于可接受的范围内，而这就是最终的结果。啊。
rows.raw:
"
    Once more, you find yourself entering the tranquil gardens just south of the fox shrine — Rindo's little domain, or at least the one she's been delegated to. The gardens' caretaker, though, is nowhere in sight — or at least, in the usual spots you've grown accustomed to in finding her when she's about her duties. It's then that you spy the petals blowing in with the wind — not the pink cherry blossoms that are ever present on this tree in eternal bloom, but blue ones, broad petals with a deep hue that twist and whirl in the stiff breeze that whips through the tree's roots.

    And then you find her: sitting alone on a bench draped with red cloth by the pool's edge, a large bed of deep blue flowers at her feet; Rindo holds a single, slightly wilted specimen of said blossoms in her hand, watching the petals detach from the stem and be carried off by the breeze.
    [var0]
    Is something the matter?
    
    "Ah!" She looks up and tries to hide the flower in her hands, fumbling about for a second or two before realizing that she's got nowhere proper in which to hide it. "[pc.ra kitsune
        |Your Eminence
        |[pc.name]
    ][party.has kiyoko
        |, [silly
            |Myobu-sama
            |High Lady
        ]
    ]. Forgive my lack of manners, I did not expect your arrival. You should not have to see me indulge my melancholy like that; it is shameful for me to be skiving while on the job."
    
    Smiling, you slide in on the bench beside Rindo, [party.has kiyoko
        |your lovely fox-wife taking up the other side and wrapping her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] long and fluffy tails about Rindo's own short and ruffled trio
        |wrapping an arm about her such that your hand comes to rest on the burned half of her body at the waist
    ]. You can feel the poor girl tremble as she suppresses a flinch from the intimate contact, but she rights herself in the blink of an eye and strives to be as genuinely pleasant as she can.
    
    No, it's all right that she has a moment of weakness like that from time to time. You understand that it's taken years for her to get from where she was to where she is now, and that's fine, but putting the past behind oneself doesn't mean one has to forget it, if that could even be possible for someone like her.
    
    "[pc.ra kitsune
        |Your [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]ship indulges me too much. Even if you personally do not mind, one's propriety is not just between two people, but society as a whole. I am sure that as you come to understand your adoptive people more, your Eminence, that will become clear.
        |Ah... I cannot agree. Even if you personally do not mind, one's propriety is not just between two people, but society as a whole. But I do not blame you for disagreeing, no doubt
    ]"
    
    Perhaps you should take her mind off all this and move it to more pleasant matters, then. These flowers...
    
    "They are my namesake; I believe the Belharan name for them is the gentian; those that grow in this part of the world are purple, as are those which are transplanted from my homeland here."
    
    But then these are blue?
    
    "It has to do with the environment in which they are cultivated, I believe. These gardens are made to mimic as closely as possible certain environs of the Old Country which are considered conducive to natural beauty; I ensure that everything from the ambient temperature to soil conditions and composition are within acceptable parameters, and this is the result."
    
    Ah.
    "

rows.original: Unconsciously, Rindo's started fiddling with the flower in her hands again, her fingers plying along the stem as she bites her lip. Her eyes dart from side to side[party.has kiyoko |, flicking between you and your fox-wife ], and then she raises the slightly wilted flower to her lips and blows, watching the few remaining petals tear off the stem and spiral away in the breeze. "Back across the ocean, cherry blossoms are considered the pinnacle of ephemeral beauty; they last for one week or two, and then fall from the bough to await the next year. I do not mean to impugn the Matron's efforts here, of course, but the fact that our home remains constantly in blossom detracts from its beauty, I feel. People become used to the sight, overly familiar with it, and take it for granted. Of course, my own personal circumstances predispose me to certain feelings, but..." Reaching down, Rindo picks another of the gentians — is she allowed to do that? She must be, right? — and focuses her good eye on it once more, watching the petals blow away in the wind. "These blossoms... they're wilting, as they must. The petals lose their consistency, and the stem droops, yet the roots remain, and next year they will grow once more, stronger this time. Sadness and parting is the price that we pay for joy, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]yet you cannot forgo happiness because you will be hurt in the end. That suffering has meaning, too; without pain, we would not have any measure with which to understand sweetness. The roots of the gentian, the heart of the plant which ensures it lives from year to year, they are used as a tonic to treat illnesses of the liver, and yet they are painfully, painfully bitter." You hold Rindo close to you, [party.has kiyoko |as does your fox-wife; together, you sandwich the poor girl between your bodies and [pc.ra kitsune | |Kiyoko's ]tails alike. Locking your hands behind the poor girl, the both of you ensconce her in fluffy warmth, even though it does little to dispel her melancholy |pressing your body against hers and [pc.ra kitsune |ensconcing her in fluffy warmth |holding her tight ], hopefully making her feel just that bit better ]. No, she doesn't look sad, but this is certainly something akin to it, even if far more philosophical. Yes, she's told you about the Old Country philosophy of beauty to be found in broken things, or at least things that have seen use. It's not wrong, but that long-suffering and fatalistic spirit that has helped her deal with her circumstances can be really upsetting at times. "My deepest apologies if I have caused you [party.has kiyoko |or [silly |the high lady |Myobu-sama ] ]any discomfort, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]." No, not at all. She's just so gentle and cheerful all the time, and you want to see more of that. At the same time, you want her happiness to be genuine. It's...complicated, and almost certainly too much to ask of her. [party.has kiyoko |"My beloved simply wishes for you to be happier, as do I for all those who reside in my retainer's domain," Kiyoko adds with a smile. "You are certainly a resilient young woman, and should have no problems applying yourself." ] "Ah, but if I ate sweets all the time, I would grow tired of them, if not outright sick of their taste. When I was younger, I would wonder why anyone would add bitter flavors to food, why anyone would put that upon themselves; after all, many poisons carry bitterness with them. With age comes wisdom and the understanding that bitterness can not only be useful and enjoyable in itself, but is also necessary to bring out the other flavors present in the dish. "Please, do not fret overly about my situation. Such bouts are necessary for me to... to continue as I am, to remind me of the truth of not just the way things are, but how they ought to be. I am sorry for making [party.has kiyoko |the both of ]you worry." Standing from the bench, Rindo gently eases herself out of [party.has kiyoko |both of your grips and turns to give Kiyoko and you a bow. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ], [silly |High Lady |Myobu-sama ], if I may take my leave." |your grip and turns to give you a bow. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ], if I may take my leave. I can hear my duties calling me, and I have dithered too long; Mikoto will be upset with me." ] You swallow hard and nod, but find no words. Rindo bows, then quietly turns and leaves, the wilting gentian still in her hand. [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko and you quietly watch her go, then you heave a small sigh. That girl... "She would not be the same without her scars, beloved," Kiyoko says, her voice barely a whisper as she turns the attention of her tails upon you, making sure you're keenly aware of their fluff. "Just as I would not be who I am without my long imprisonment and that which I was subjected to; it was bitter in the moment, but if it allowed me to meet both you and Kinu, as well as be reunited with Komari in order to forgive her, perhaps it was all worth it in the end. "Yes, she is damaged, but not only is there no attempt to hide the damage, but the repair upon her spirit is illuminated, ceramic repaired with gold in the traditional fashion. The vicissitudes of existence over time and the cosmic injustices to which all of us are susceptible, cannot be clearer than in the breaks, the knocks, and the shattering to which ceramics, too, are subject." Being around Kiyoko for some time, you think you begin to understand, even in some small part, how the kitsune people think about these things. The ephemeral nature of beauty – the quietly elated, bittersweet feeling of having been witness to the dazzling circus of life, all knowing that none of it can last. To be saddened by and yet appreciative of transience, and through it becoming aware of how significant those moments are. "The girl is right, and so are you," your fox-wife continues, leaning in to give you a little kiss. "But you left out the most important part of that — that in passing and loss, new things can grow and take their place." [kiyoko.pregStage 2 |Kiyoko pats her rounded tummy to emphasise her point, and you place a hand on the firm swell, feeling the kit taking shape within her womb. ] Yes. Yes, indeed. Perhaps... perhaps you should stay here and take Rindo's place for a while. She would like that, wouldn't she? "I would, beloved." |You quietly watch her go, then heave a small sigh. That girl... even after having known her intimately, she nevertheless continues to be as she is. But then again, she wouldn't be Rindo without her scars, would she? ]
rows.translation: 不知不觉中，琳多又开始摆弄手中的那朵花，她的手指沿着花茎轻轻滑动，同时咬着嘴唇，目光也在不停地左右扫视。[party.has kiyoko |在你们俩以及你那个狐狸妻子之间来回切换着注意力…… ]然后，她将那朵已经有些凋谢的花朵凑到唇边轻吹，看着剩下的几片花瓣从花茎上脱落，在微风中旋转着飘远。 “在海洋的另一边，樱花被视为短暂美丽的象征；它们只能绽放一两周，然后从枝头落下，等待来年的再次绽放。我当然并不是想贬低女管家的努力，但我觉得，如果我们家的环境总是处于这种“盛开”的状态，反而会削弱它的美感。人们会逐渐习惯这种景象，对它变得过于熟悉，从而认为这是理所当然的。当然，我个人的处境让我更容易产生某些特定的情绪，但是…… 琳多弯下腰，又摘了一朵龙胆花——她这样做可以吗？应该可以的吧？——然后她用那只视力较好的眼睛再次仔细观察那朵花，看着它的花瓣在风中飘散。 这些花朵……它们正在枯萎，这也是必然的。花瓣失去了原有的弹性，花茎也垂了下来，但根依然存在，明年它们会再次生长，而且会比今年更加茁壮。悲伤与离别，正是我们为快乐所必须付出的代价。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]然而，你却无法放弃幸福，因为最终你还是会受到伤害。那种痛苦也有它的意义；如果没有痛苦，我们就无法理解什么是甜蜜。龙胆草的根部，这种植物赖以生存的关键部分，被用来制作补药来治疗肝脏疾病，然而，它们的味道却是极其苦涩的。 你将林多紧紧抱在怀里[party.has kiyoko |你的狐狸妻子也是这样；你们俩一起把那个可怜的女孩夹在中间。 [pc.ra kitsune | |清子的 ]尾巴紧紧相连。你们将那可怜的女孩的手握在身后，用你们的温暖将她包围起来，尽管这并不能消除她的忧郁之情。 |将你的身体紧贴着她[pc.ra kitsune |将她包裹在柔软温暖的怀抱之中 |紧紧握住她的手 ]希望这能让她感觉好一点。 ]不，她看起来并不像。难过虽然这与之有些相似，但无疑在哲学层面上要深刻得多。 是的，她已经跟你讲过关于那种“美存在于破损之物中，或者至少存在于那些被使用过的物品之中”的古老观念。这种观点并没有错，但那种忍耐与宿命论的精神，在帮助她应对现实处境的同时，有时也会让她感到非常痛苦。 “如果我的行为给你带来了困扰，我真诚地表示最深的歉意[party.has kiyoko |或者[silly |那位高贵的女士 |宫部大人 ] ]如果有任何不适， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]不，完全不是这样。她总是那么温柔、开朗，人们自然希望看到更多这样的她。同时，人们也希望她的幸福是发自内心的。这种心情……很复杂，要求她做到这一点，几乎可以说是过分了。 [party.has kiyoko |我亲爱的只是希望你能更快乐，就像我希望我领地里的所有人们都能幸福一样，”清子微笑着补充道，“你确实是一个坚韧不拔的年轻女性，只要你努力去追求，肯定不会有任何问题。 ] 啊，但如果我一直吃甜食的话，很快就会对它们感到厌烦，甚至会讨厌它们的味道。小时候，我常常想不明白为什么有人要在食物里添加苦味，为什么有人要让自己吃这种东西；毕竟，很多毒药都是苦的啊。随着年龄的增长，人们会变得更加睿智，也会明白：苦味本身不仅具有独特的意义和乐趣，而且还是激发食物中其他风味的必要元素。 “请不要为我目前的处境过于担忧。这样的较量对我来说是必要的，因为它们让我能够保持现状，让我时刻牢记事物的现状以及它们应有的样子。对于之前造成的困扰，我感到非常抱歉。 [party.has kiyoko |他们两个 ]别担心。” 从长椅上站起来的琳多轻轻活动了一下身体，然后走下了长椅。 [party.has kiyoko |你们两人同时鞠躬，向清子表示敬意。[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]， [silly |高阶女士 |宫部大人 ]那么，我就先告辞了。 |你稳稳抓住它，然后转身向你鞠了一躬。[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]如果可以的话，我先告辞了。我感觉到自己的职责在召唤我，而我已经拖延得太久了；美琴一定会生我的气的。 ] 你艰难地咽了口唾沫，点了点头，却找不到任何话语可以说。 凛朵鞠了一躬，然后静静地转身离开了，她手中仍然握着那朵已经枯萎的龙胆花。 [party.has kiyoko |清子和你静静地望着她离去，然后你轻轻叹了口气。那个女孩…… “如果没有那些伤痕，她就不会是现在的她了，亲爱的，”清子轻声说道，她将尾巴的方向转向你，确保你能清楚地看到它们那柔软的毛茸茸。正如如果没有那段漫长的监禁以及我所经历的一切，我就不会成为现在的我一样；那些经历在当时确实令人痛苦，但正因为有了它们，我才能遇见你和小娟，也能与麻里重逢并原谅她。或许，这一切最终都是值得的。 是的，它确实受到了损坏，但人们非但没有试图掩盖这些痕迹，反而将这些修复工作做得非常明显——用传统的方法，用黄金来修补那些陶瓷碎片。岁月带来的变迁，以及我们所有人都无法避免的宇宙中的种种不公，都在这些破损的痕迹中得到了淋漓尽致的体现。陶瓷制品同样无法逃脱这些自然规律的影响，它们也会经历破损、撞击和粉碎。 与清子相处了一段时间后，你会觉得自己开始稍微理解那些狐族是如何看待这些事情的。美丽的短暂性——那种在目睹生命中那些绚丽多彩的场景时所产生的既欣喜又苦涩的感觉，同时也明白这一切都不可能永恒。为这种短暂而感到伤感，却又对其心存感激，正是通过这种体验，人们才会意识到那些瞬间究竟有多么珍贵。 那个女孩说得对，你也是，”你的狐狸妻子继续说道，同时倾身给了你一个轻吻。“但你忽略了一点最重要的——在失去与分离之中，新的东西会诞生并取代旧的东西。 [kiyoko.pregStage 2 |清子轻轻拍着自己圆润的腹部，以此来强调自己的观点，而你也将手放在那坚实的腹部上，能感受到胎儿正在她的子宫里逐渐成形。 ] 是的，确实如此。或许……或许你应该留在这里，暂时代替林多的位置。她也会希望这样吧？ “我愿意，亲爱的。 |你静静地看着她离去，然后轻轻叹了口气。 那个女孩……即使已经和她如此亲密地相处过，她依然保持着原来的样子。不过，话说回来，如果没有那些伤痕，她还能叫做林多吗？ ]

"Yes, she is damaged, but not only is there no attempt to hide the damage, but the repair upon her spirit is illuminated, ceramic repaired with gold in the traditional fashion. The vicissitudes of existence over time and the cosmic injustices to which all of us are susceptible, cannot be clearer than in the breaks, the knocks, and the shattering to which ceramics, too, are subject." Being around Kiyoko for some time, you think you begin to understand, even in some small part, how the kitsune people think about these things. The ephemeral nature of beauty – the quietly elated, bittersweet feeling of having been witness to the dazzling circus of life, all knowing that none of it can last. To be saddened by and yet appreciative of transience, and through it becoming aware of how significant those moments are. "The girl is right, and so are you," your fox-wife continues, leaning in to give you a little kiss. "But you left out the most important part of that — that in passing and loss, new things can grow and take their place." [kiyoko.pregStage 2 |Kiyoko pats her rounded tummy to emphasise her point, and you place a hand on the firm swell, feeling the kit taking shape within her womb. ] Yes. Yes, indeed. Perhaps... perhaps you should stay here and take Rindo's place for a while. She would like that, wouldn't she? "I would, beloved." |You quietly watch her go, then heave a small sigh. That girl... even after having known her intimately, she nevertheless continues to be as she is. But then again, she wouldn't be Rindo without her scars, would she? ] '

rows.translation: [var0 |林多愣了一下，然后低下头，耳朵向前耷拉下来。“啊！原来你收到了中野发来的消息啊[pc.ra kitsune |阁下，您真是太慷慨了，愿意帮助我处理这件事——我保证不会耽误您太久。” “好吧，如果她不想让您等待，那就直接说她需要您帮忙什么吧。” “嗯，啊……”琳多结结巴巴地说着，显然因为您真的把她的话当回事而有些不知所措。“这就来，我的[pc.mf |大人 |夫人 ]。我来解释。 |我希望他并没有为难你太多。” 他本可以在这整件事上表现得更友善一些，这一点是肯定的。 她露出一个有些尴尬的笑容：“请不要因此而责怪他。当我第一次来到这些殖民地的时候，我的处境和他差不多——只要有一点小小的借口，我就会对周围的一切人和事发怒、攻击他们。我……嗯[kinu.isHime |小琴小姐和他，可以说是典型的“强强联合”吧？他们在一起确实非常般配，我这么说应该没有错。我只是有点希望……嗯…… |前几天他在泳池边绘制他的卷轴画，还征求了我的意见，然后…… ]啊，如果这让她感到尴尬的话，她其实什么都不必说。 林多那唯一的一只眼睛里闪过一丝复杂的情绪，她的表情变得警惕起来，显得有些防备。“当然，”她说道。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |当然 ]嗯，关于那个请求…… ] 你在听。 “我敢肯定[pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]飞船已收到指令。 |你明白的。 ]这里的整个殖民地驻军人数恰好为七人，包括那位指挥官本人；这种状况不仅给他本人带来了巨大的压力，也使他的下属们在维持秩序方面面临相当大的困难。这种局面某些事项实际情况是，要想让他能够指挥更多的力量，几乎是不可能的，但这并不排除使用自动化技术的可能性。 “传统上，由于一些原因，木偶技术在制造守护者角色时被使用的频率一直很低，具体原因我就不在这里详细说明了。不过，我们对用石头甚至金属制成的传统构造方式进行了深入研究，结果发现这些方法非常有效，尤其是那些被称为‘滴水嘴’的装饰性结构。一夫[silly |-san ]我设计了几种实验模型，这些模型甚至比他最出色的作品也要先进许多。当然，它们还远远比不上真正的战士，但至少足以满足殖民地在安全方面的一些基本需求。那么，这些潜在的威胁是从哪里来的呢？哦，你们可以猜，但最好还是直接听她亲口说出来。” 林多坐立不安，把手指交叉在一起，说道：“嗯，那些可能会威胁到那些在边远地区探险或勘探的人的潜在危险，几乎肯定都来自这片土地本身。虽然这位教务长和他的下属们无疑都具备丰富的能力，但他们并没有接受过与当地人作战方式相对应的训练，因此他们也不具备那种能够让我们对所创造的事物进行充分测试、并确保其达到我们期望标准的经验。 [pc.ra kitsune |然而，阁下还是这么做了。 |然而，你却可以。 ]啊，原来你是这么想的。那么，她打算怎么做呢？ “等你准备好了， [pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输船只。 ]请告诉我。我会把那些木偶从我同事的工作室拿过来，然后我们就可以开始啦——用任何你们想要的方式战斗，尽量破坏我的作品吧。不用担心会弄坏它们，这些木偶是设计用来大量使用的，而且重新组装起来也相当简单，所以你们完全不必有所顾虑，尽情发挥吧。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]一旦你的体力耗尽，或者你觉得自己受够了，这个实验就会停止；我会解除对那些傀儡的控制，届时这一切就会结束。” 听起来很简单。 林多向你说道[pc.ra kitsune |充满敬意且深入探讨 |小的 ]如果你现在准备好了， [pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输工具。 ]我们可以立即开始。否则，如果你需要时间准备，等你做好充分准备后，随时可以在我值班的时候来找我。 “你准备好了吗？还是想稍后再讨论这个话题？ [var1] |当你表示已经准备好的时候，林多会低下头，把耳朵贴平。“太棒了！[pc.ra kitsune|你的[pc.mf|领主|女士]运输]由于我们很不幸没有真正的道场可供使用，这让教务长感到非常失望，所以我们只能将就着用了。如果你能在神社后面的空地上找到我，我会把和雄带过来。[silly|-san]我们会把这些木偶带给大家。 ]

rows.original: "I understand fully,[pc.ra kitsune| your Eminence,]" Rindo replies, dipping her head. "This is meant to be a stress test of our creations — it would do no one any good if the matter were rushed and you were not performing at the peak of your abilities. Please, bring the subject up with me any time I am on duty and we will be able to begin at your leisure."
rows.translation: “我完全理解。[pc.ra kitsune| 阁下，]”林多低着头回答道，“这其实是对我们成果的一次压力测试——如果仓促进行，而你又无法发挥出自己的最佳状态，那么这对任何人都没有好处。请随时在我值班的时候跟我提起这件事，我们可以根据你的时间安排来开始行动。”

rows.original: Once you enter the little glade behind the fox shrine, you don't have long to wait — Rindo returns in about fifteen minutes with Kazuo in tow, a small army of wooden puppets trailing in their wake. You can't help but notice they move a little stiffly and jerkily, perhaps a result of the fact that they're made to be disposable, but also perhaps to truly highlight the fact that they're constructs and very much not people. "...And that is the future, I tell you, puppets. Not just dealing with our lack of hands, but preventing unnecessary loss of life and unquestioning obedience in all things in the bargain. The native continentals created those things they called gargoyles — fascinating creatures that by all means should be constructs, and yet — " Kazuo suddenly realizes that he's arrived and stops talking to Rindo, giving you [pc.ra kitsune |a bow. "Thank you for assisting us in this manner, your Eminence. We appreciate it deeply. |a nod. "Your presence today is appreciated. ] Rindo[silly |-san ] has informed you what we are about?" Yes. Rindo steps up alongside her fellow shaper. "Once more, please defeat as many of them as you are able to[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. The more of our creations you can overcome, the more information we will be able to collect in order to improve our next model of puppet. Do not worry about making us look bad; it is just us here." Is that a thing that one should be worried about in Old Country society? Silly you, of course it is. Nevertheless, Rindo gestures for the puppets to start moving into the glade, and you ready your [pc.weapon] even as Kazuo sits down with a ceramic mug of tea and starts to watch the spectacle... Looks like it's a fight!
rows.translation: 一旦你走进狐妖神社后面的那片小树林，就不用等待太久——大约十五分钟后，林多就会带着一夫回来，后面还跟着一大群木制玩偶。你会忍不住注意到，这些玩偶的动作显得有些僵硬、不自然，这可能是因为它们被设计成一次性使用的物品，但同时也可能是为了更加突出它们其实是人造物、根本不是真正的人这一事实。 ……这就是未来，我告诉你们，这些傀儡。它们不仅能弥补我们人手不足的缺陷，还能避免不必要的生命损失，同时在各种情况下都能让我们毫无异议地服从命令。那些大陆原住民创造了他们称之为‘滴水嘴兽’的生物——这些迷人的生物明明应该是人造的，然而……”一夫突然意识到自己已经说到了目的地，于是停止了与林多的交谈。 [pc.ra kitsune |鞠了一躬。“感谢您以这样的方式帮助我们，阁下。我们对此深表感激。 |点了点头说道：“非常感谢您今天的出席。 ]林多[silly |-san ]我们究竟是来做什么的，这一点你们已经知道了吧？” “是的。” 林多与她的同伴一起走上前。“再一次，请尽你们所能击败尽可能多的敌人吧。[pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 ]你能克服我们创造的这些障碍，我们就能够收集到更多信息，从而改进我们下一个版本的木偶模型。别担心会让我们难堪，其实只是我们自己在这里而已。” 在旧国社会中，这种事情真的值得担心吗？傻瓜，当然值得担心了。不过，林多还是示意那些木偶开始向林间空地移动，而你也做好了准备[pc.weapon]就在和雄端着陶瓷茶杯坐下来开始观看这一幕时…… 看起来要发生一场争斗了！

She frowns at that. "Hmm. Well, please treat yourself to the tea that I've brewed for Kazuo[silly |-san ] while we discuss our observations; it should refresh you." It is. "Your injuries are not too grievous, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?" Yeah, you think you're fine. You're... you're just a little out of breath, that's all. Well, please treat yourself to the tea that I've brewed for Kazuo[silly |-san ] while we discuss our observations; it should refresh you[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]." Of course. rows.original: You whirl around after that last puppet falls, ready to face yet another horde of the constructs, but there aren't any more to be had. Scattered about you are wooden fragments and the constituent parts of puppets upon puppets — all smashed and broken, although judging by what Rindo said it shouldn't be too hard for her and the artificer to put them back together again. Assuming that you didn't break them too hard, that is. From the bench, Kazuo claps his hands — once, twice, thrice, each one careful and measured, then he stands and gives you a [pc.ra kitsune |bow. "Excellently done, your Eminence. |nod. "Not bad, not bad. ] You've certainly exposed several important deficiencies in our creations." Rindo steps out to the glade, picking her way through the scattered puppet pieces as she draws near. "You are fine, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?" Yeah, you think you are. No lasting damage, at the very least. She frowns at that. "Hmm. Well, please treat yourself to the tea that I've brewed for Kazuo[silly |-san ] while we discuss our observations; it should refresh you." It is. While Rindo and Kazuo enter a rather animated discussion in their native language, [party.combatNames] empty the pot of the clear, bitter brew; true to her word, the tea is refreshing, although with a taste that you can't quite place. Maybe Mai had something to do with it? At the very least, the worst of your pains and aches from all the fighting you've just done subsides somewhat, which is a relief. Either way, looks like you've still got it; you can only hope the little display impressed the two more than they let on. [pc.ra kitsune |You are the chosen champion of their people, handpicked by their patron deity, after all... no doubt they expect no less of you, and to be honest, it feels good to live up to these expectations. |Maybe that'll give them a little pause before putting down the people of the Marches for any reason... no doubt they expected less of you, and to be honest, it feels good to prove them wrong even if it's in such a small fashion. ]
rows.translation: 最后一具傀儡倒下后，你猛然转身，准备面对又一大群构装体，然而已经没有更多敌人了。你周围散落着木头碎片和一具又一具傀儡的组成零件——全都被砸得支离破碎；不过按林多所说，她和那名工匠要把它们重新拼起来应该不会太难。 当然，前提是你没把它们砸得太烂。 一夫坐在长椅上拍起双手——一下、两下、三下，每一次都慎重而有分寸；随后他站起身，朝你[pc.ra kitsune |鞠躬。“完成得十分出色，尊贵的阁下。 |点头。“不错，不错。 ]你的确暴露出了我们作品中几项重要缺陷。” 林多走进林间空地，靠近时小心穿过散落的傀儡零件。“你没事吧，[pc.ra kitsune |尊贵的阁下 |[pc.name] ]？” 嗯，你觉得自己没事。至少没有留下持久的伤势。 她闻言皱眉。“嗯。好吧，我们讨论观察结果时，请喝些我为一夫[silly |先生 ]泡的茶；它应该能让你恢复精神。” 的确如此。林多和一夫用母语展开颇为热烈的讨论时，[party.combatNames]喝光了壶里清澈苦涩的茶；正如她所说，这茶令人精神焕发，只是滋味让你有些琢磨不透。或许舞也参与了调配？至少，刚才那一连串战斗带来的剧痛与酸楚消退了几分，令你松了口气。 无论如何，看来你仍宝刀未老；只希望这场小小展示给两人留下的印象，比他们流露出来的更深。[pc.ra kitsune |毕竟，你可是他们族人的天选勇士，由其守护神亲手挑选……他们无疑认为你理应有这番表现；坦白说，不负这些期望的感觉真好。 |或许这能让他们今后想随意贬低边境居民时，多少有所迟疑……他们无疑低估了你；坦白说，哪怕只是用这种小事证明他们错了，感觉也很不错。 ]

"I hope you're refreshed?" ] You eye the artificer morosely picking up the numerous smashed wooden bits of his creations strewn all over the little glade and allow yourself a smile of satisfaction before turning back to Rindo. So, how are the results? You broke a fair few of those puppets; hopefully it won't take the two of them too long to clean up this mess. Given all this trash lying about the place, Miko and Mai will surely get mad if they leave it for too long. "Ah." Rindo smiles and flattens her ears against her head. "I think you broke Kazuo[silly |-san ] a little. While he did design the puppets to be cheap and disposable, they outnumbered you considerably. "Things don't have to be perfect the first time around — that's exactly why we're collecting data via field testing, to be able to make iterative improvements upon the design. Even so, it is a bit embarrassing[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." You won't deny it — being able to let loose like that and break every single last puppet that the two of them were able to throw at you feels good. "Hmm. It certainly was interesting seeing you at your work,[pc.ra kitsune | your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]" Rindo muses. "[pc.ra kitsune |There is no doubt the August Master at the Center of heaven made the right choice in elevating you to this position. |It certainly is a different approach to things than what the provost would do, but that is the point, is it not? ] "Be that as it may, I am glad that I made this request of you[pc.ra kitsune |r [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. As remuneration for a job well done, I've prepared something for you. Here." She holds it out in both hands, and you carefully receive the little wrapped box. What is it? "It's a black monkshood — very poisonous, especially the roots, but the flowers are dangerous, too. Even so, we use it in medicine after it's been properly compounded, and similarly the flowers are possessed of certain properties after having been preserved and treated. Don't worry, the process neutralises the toxins, so you may handle it without fear." Phew. So... a pretty flower? That's kind of like her. Rindo's smile broadens a little. "Keep it on your person[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ], and you may find that it does more than simply look pretty. Consider it not just a reward for helping us out today, but also a gift from me to you. "That's not all, of course. rows.original:
"Ah... you wish to have another go, [pc.ra kitsune|your Eminence|[pc.name]]?"

    You didn't feel like you had it all in the last time. You'll take another go at it.
    
    Rindo considers this a moment. "I suppose we would not be against testing the next iteration of models for their practicality. Kazuo[silly|-san] sometimes makes adjustments which are innovative, but rather unorthodox at the same time. However, since our supplies are limited, I cannot reward you as richly as the previous time."
    
    That's fine.
    
    Rindo dips her head and flattens her ears when you mention that you're ready. "Most excellent[pc.ra kitsune|, your [pc.mf|lord|lady]ship]. Since we are unfortunately not blessed with the presence of an actual dojo, much to the provost's dismay, we will have to make do. If you would meet me in the empty space behind the shrine, I will get Kazuo[silly|-san] and we will bring the puppets to you."
rows.translation:
“啊……你想再试一次吗，[pc.ra kitsune|殿下|[pc.name]]？”

    你觉得上次还没尽兴，打算再来一轮。
    
    林道思考了片刻。“我想，我们不会反对测试下一代模型是否实用。和夫[silly|大人]有时会作出既创新又不循常规的调整。不过，我们的物资有限，所以这次无法像上次一样给予你丰厚的奖励。”
    
    没关系。
    
    你表示准备就绪时，林道低下头，双耳伏平。“好极了[pc.ra kitsune|，[pc.mf|大人|夫人]]。遗憾的是，我们没有得到真正道场的眷顾，教务长对此十分失望，只能因陋就简了。请到神社后面的空地与我会合；我会去叫和夫[silly|大人]，然后把人偶带给你。”

rows.original: Once you enter the little glade behind the fox shrine, you don't have long to wait — Rindo returns in about fifteen minutes with Kazuo in tow, a small army of wooden puppets trailing in their wake. The shaper gives her colleague a nod, and bows to you. "Once more, please defeat as many of them as you are able to[pc.ra kitsune|, your [pc.mf|lord|lady]ship]. The more of our creations you can overcome, the more information we will be able to collect in order to improve our next model of puppet. Do not worry about making us look bad; it is just us here." All right, you understand. Looks like it's a fight!

[pc.ra kitsune |Stepping into the den matron's office, you hear a voice that's not usually present in the upper branches of the tree — both Rindo and Komari are by the window, holding a conversation in their mother tongue. You're just about to wonder if you should turn back and come back at a more opportune time when the former spots you out of the corner of her eye and instinctively shies away; this prompts what's clearly a question from the elder matron until she, too, notices you in the doorway. The change in their demeanor is quite blatant even to you as both women give you a bow as one and switch to speaking Belharan. "Your Eminence, [party.has kiyoko |[silly |Myōbu-sama |High Lady Ōtomo ], ]please come in. There's no need to stand on ceremony — I should have noticed you the moment you arrived; the favored champion of our deity is welcome anytime." You're not interrupting anything, are you? "Oh no, of course not. In fact, the matter the girl and I were just discussing would pertain to you, if you would choose to involve yourself, that is." You shift your gaze from Komari to Rindo, and the latter lifts a a hand to her lips, unknowingly biting on the long sleeves of her clothes until the den matron gives her a sharp glance. Oh all right, enough of this beating about the bush, propriety and all. What's the matter — and it would help if the two of them could put it simply. "Very well, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship." Komari clears her throat. "Suffice to say that after the five or six years that the girl here has been living in the colonies, I have reason to suspect that exile an ocean away has become no longer sufficient for those who would prefer that she not exist. "Well, girl, from this day onward you're [pc.hisHer] Eminence's concubine, up till the moment [pc.heShe] dismisses you for any reason whatsoever. "I-I will!" Though she tries to control herself, you still see the spark of absolute, irrational panic buried in Rindo's good eye as she turns to you and gives you a deep bow from the waist. "Please be kind to me, your Eminence. I will serve you with everything I have." rows.original: [pc.ra kitsune |"Oh." The pupil of Rindo's good eye narrows to a thin line and her ears fold sideways and against her head, then she remembers where she is and who she's with, snapping back to pleasant neutrality in the blink of an eye. While the poor girl looks like she's got more to say, she holds her tongue, clasps her hands and bows her head, taking a step back to bring Komari to the fore. Look, it isn't because of any personal dislike of her or anything — you wouldn't have agreed to copu — Komari coughs discreetly, and while she's probably out of turn here you realize that she's trying to help you not run your tongue here. "There is absolutely no need to justify your decision to us, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship; your word is final and we trust that you have your reasons. As I said, I have the means and time to make alternative arrangements for Rindo, so rest assured that she'll be fine. Girl, return to your duties; we'll discuss this later when [pc.mf |his lordship |her ladyship ] no longer requires my time." Half-closing her one good eye, Rindo bows deeply from the waist to you, then to Komari, before edging along the wall and disappearing into the doorway. rows.original: [rindo.isConcubine |Seeing you approach from across the sacred gardens, Rindo sets down her tools and half-turns her head to fix you with her good eye. Without hesitation, she folds her ears forward against her head and gives you a deep bow from the waist. "A pleasant [dayNight |day |evening ] to you, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]." Gods, she's your concubine now, there's no need to be this way. She's technically part of your household, after all. "That may be as it is, but I feel obligated to express my thanks to you for extending your grace upon my situation. It is a risk that you did not have to take, and — " Rindo hesitates a moment, then lets her shoulders slump. "Well, it's a relief[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. While not that much might have materially changed, knowing that I've [pc.ra kitsune |someone this prominent |you ] on my side and looking out for me really does make me feel better." Shaking your head, you step forward and pull Rindo into a hug; you see her instinctively move to flinch as she senses something approached her burnt and scarred half, but stifles it with a conscious effort and returns the embrace. Her fur smells faintly of flowers — not a strong floral scent that would've have come from perfumes or oils, but simply something that she's picked up from working with them all day. "T-this is a little embarrassing, [pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. I-is it okay if we take this somewhere more private? While we may have deliberately set the rumor mill into motion, Kohaku tends to get overzealous about trading in gossip." But of course. |Seeing you approach from across the sacred gardens, Rindo sets down her tools and half-turns her head to fix you with her good eye. Without hesitation, she folds her ears forward against her head and gives you a deep bow from the waist. "A pleasant [dayNight |day |evening ] to you, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]." Ah, there's no need for her to be so formal about things. You're still reeling a little from the suddenness of that last meeting you had with her and Komari. "There is absolutely no cause for guilt or concern,[pc.ra kitsune | my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]" Rindo replies. "You were perfectly within your rights to not need to trouble yourself with my problems, and frankly speaking, it would not have been well for my conscience to impose upon you." Seriously, she wouldn't have been imposing upon you, but you had your own reasons. "There's no need to sugar-coat it, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. Or were you not as appraised of the potential dangers involved in accepting me as your concubine as you said you were?" You didn't mean that... A sigh. "It is what it is, and it really can't be helped. In a way, these events have turned out to be a good thing, so I must be grateful to you for it. Even in your declination, there's something to be learned from [pc.ra kitsune |such a decision when it comes from one as illustrious as you |it ]." How so? Rindo sighs, half-turning her body to hide the scarred, lesioned, discolored half of her face and body from you. "I have been living in the colonies for five years now, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. The first weeks were less than pleasant — days of doing nothing but sitting on my bed, jumping at the slightest noise that came through the walls. The following years were spent building my life and purpose, and despite losing half my body I went and clawed them back." Admirable, but you don't see how that follows. "For a while now, I've been content, allowing myself to become sedentary from comfort. I need to get back what I ought to have had, even without the business of my birth and blood... these recent developments, as well as your rejection of the offer of concubinage, have pointed out to me that I need to be more proactive about matters regarding my own life. I'm not going to be young forever, after all." You give Rindo a long, hard look. If she were human, she wouldn't look that much older than nineteen or so — if Komari is any measure of how kitsune age, they do so pretty well. Asking Rindo her exact age is probably a social faux pas, so you settle for a nod. What's she going to do, then? "I need to stop merely pining for people from afar and take concrete action." And what would that be? Would it be related to what Komari said about alternative arrangements if you refused to take her in? "I'm not sure myself, but I do have some idea of the potential avenues which the den matron might take to extend what protection has to someone in my situation. But instead of waiting on the providence of other people, I think it's about time I took action to improve my situation once more, no matter how small a fashion it might be. I'd gotten too comfortable with my current achievements — if you can call them that — and was on the path to wasting my youth being largely aimless. "For that, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ], I have to thank you, in addition for all that you've done for me up to this point." You sigh. While you know that Rindo is trying to be nice and being genuine about it — inasmuch as these people can wear their hearts on their sleeves — the way she's saying it just feels like a bit of a letdown. Maybe it's her tone, maybe it's her wording, but even though she's really trying to convey that she's got no hard feelings towards you and cheer you up — well, there's no real good way to have this kind of conversation, is there? Rindo clearly senses your unease, for she turns her scarred side back to you and takes your hand in both of hers. "It'll be all right, it really will. I have trust in myself and the den matron's capabilities — she has been playing this game for a couple centuries at this point, after all. Perhaps, if I may go so far as to suggest such, you may wish to offer your beneficence to take your mind off these matters?" Is... is that fine? You did reject her as your concubine, after all. "Of course it is fine. Even were I to be married, I must feed as well. But as I said, let's not dwell on these matters[pc.ra kitsune |, [pc.mf |lord |lady ]my ship ] — surely you approached me to speak of other matters less heavy?" Yes, yes. Perhaps you should get to the actual business you came with her to discuss? ]

rows.original: Rindo leads you away from the main body of the gardens to a small grove by the side of the pool, and you take a seat on a moss-covered boulder that has been very deliberately placed such that it appears completely and absolutely natural. At this time of day, no one's around to fetch water, and so it's just the two of you, shielded from sight by the willows. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ]." While you'd really prefer her to be more informal with you at this point, you also understand that it does make her uncomfortable, and — well, the entire point of this is presumably for her benefit, so you won't press her. It'll come as she eases into this arrangement, you're sure. "And I'm sure there's no need to doubt the depth of my affection for or gratitude to you," Rindo replies with a small smile. "Sometimes, less is more when it comes to the matters of one's heart. But down to the matter you wished to discuss in more detail, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]..." Yes, that. Just what does she know about the situation which Komari's been picking over at the moment? A sigh. "Neither I nor the den matron held anything back from you at that meeting, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. So far, it's just been questioning of my kinsmen — it might escalate, it might not. Certainly, if it had, say, involved the genuine risk of bloodshed, the den matron wouldn't have contented herself with a single measure like this. But it is an unknown with the possibility of spiraling out of control, and you willingly taking on an unknown risk is extremely brave. "For now, this arrangement will suffice. We'll then see what response there is from across the ocean, if there's any, or if my concubinage to [pc.ra kitsune |an unknown yet esteemed personage |an enigmatic personage of foreign nobility ] like you will be sufficient to calm the situation in and of itself. It could last weeks, months, maybe even years depending on what happens next, whether alternatives are available, and whether you want me around or not at that point." Ah, such silly words that're coming from her lips. Smiling, you reach up and smooth out Rindo's ears, sliding your palm over them one at a time, pressing them against her scalp and feeling the girl underneath shiver with twinges of comfort and lust alike. You knew what you were getting into when you agreed to this; she can be your concubine for as long as she likes, even if the day should come where there's no actual need for it any further. Look, is she sure that she doesn't want to come and live with you in your wayfort? If another attempt should be made on her life, her assailants would know that she's here, and — " "No." For someone who's usually so soft-spoken, the vehemence and resolution with which Rindo says that singular word strikes you like a boulder rolling down a slope. Her one good eye widens, she herself realizing the faux pas she's just made, and the instincts for politeness and propriety war with the horrible thing that's bubbling in the pit of her stomach until her expression softens just slightly. Rindo still looks torn between throwing herself down at your feet, kowtowing and begging for your forgiveness, and the simmering fire that bubbles beneath her scarred exterior; nevertheless, she pulls herself together with a small measure of defiance. "I know of the Wayfort that you speak — it's that thing down by the river." She does? "It's not hard to spot — you can see all the way across the woods from the uppermost branches in the tree's crown. Not only would I be separated from the people I know, but I'd also be apart from those most well-versed in the tangled web that exists across the ocean. What would I do there? Just sit in a room and stare at the blank gray walls, whiling away the time, waiting for a knock on the door that may or may not be you? "I know you mean well, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ], but no. I will not be moved from this place; that was made clear in the discussion we had with the den matron and I don't like the idea of trying to go around her back on this when the matter's already been talked about and thought dealt with. I've been there, days of doing nothing but sitting on my bed, jumping at the slightest noise that came through the walls; it took me years to drag myself out of that hole, and I am not going back to that existence. Those years were spent rebuilding my life and purpose, and despite losing half my body I went and clawed them back. Once, I was forced to throw everyone and everything I had away for the sake of preserving my life. I am not going to lose it all again, and I would rather die." Having said all this, Rindo gasps and catches her breath; her hands ball into fists and you see tears seep into the corners of her good and dead eyes alike. With a soft sniffle, she half-turns away from you, hiding her burnt half from your sight. All right, you get it. Asking her to pack up and live somewhere else where you thought she might be safer is out of the question. You just... didn't expect her to have such a strong reaction to it. "Perhaps I should have been more circumspect,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Rindo mumbles, still not looking directly at you as she calms from her outburst. "But my words still stand all the same. If I throw away everything that's been earned in between my arrival in the colonies and now, what's the point?" Look, maybe you shouldn't dwell on that, now that you know how much it troubles her; maybe the both of you should think about how your relationship will grow going forward given this new arrangement. Rindo demurs, and you reach over to give her a light peck on the forehead. It's okay, she's just got to trust in the wisdom of her elders, and it'll work out just fine. She looks less than completely convinced at that, but bows her head. "I will do my utmost to serve you as I ought and more[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." You'd have preferred a more enthusiastic response coming from her, but given someone as reticent as she is, this is the enthusiastic response. All right, then — you feel like you've cleared up some more of the questions you had about this whole concubinage business. Now then... "[pc.ra kitsune |My [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |Hm ]?" Perhaps you should get to the actual business you came with her to discuss?

]虽然在这个时候你确实希望她能对你更随意一些，但你也明白这样做会让她感到不适。而且，毕竟这一切都是为了她的利益着想，所以你不会强迫她。你放心，当她逐渐适应这种安排时，一切都会好起来的。 “而且我敢肯定，你完全不需要怀疑我对你的感情有多深，或者我对你的感激之情有多重，”林多微笑着回答道，“有时候，在涉及内心情感的事情上，少说反而更好。但说到你希望进一步详细讨论的那个问题， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]就是这个。她究竟了解关于目前麻里正在调查的那件事情的哪些情况呢？” “唉……在那次会议上，我和女头目都没有对你隐瞒任何事情。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]到目前为止，这些只是对我的同族们的质疑而已——事情可能会升级，也可能会平息。当然，如果真的涉及到流血冲突的真正风险，那么族长也不会仅仅采取这样的措施就罢休的。但这无疑是一个充满不确定性、有可能失控的局面，而你自愿承担这样的风险，实在是非常勇敢。 “目前，这样的安排应该已经足够了。接下来，我们就等着看看大洋彼岸会有什么反应——如果真的有反应的话……或者，看看我这个侧室的身份能否[pc.ra 不。 我知道你说的那个荒废驿堡——就是河边的那个地方。” 她知道？ “那个地方很容易找到——从树顶的最高树枝处，就能看到河对岸的那个地方。我不仅会与认识的人分开，还会远离那些最了解横跨大洋的错综复杂的关系网的人。在那里，我该做些什么呢？难道只是坐在房间里，望着那些灰白的墙壁，虚度时间，等待着那也许会来、也许不会来的敲门声吗？ 我知道你是出于好意， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] 好吧，你明白我的意思了。让她收拾行李去一个你认为她会更安全的地方生活，这个想法根本就行不通。你只是……没有预料到她会对这个提议有如此强烈的反应。 “也许我当初应该更加谨慎一些。[pc.ra kitsune | 阁下， rows.raw: " Rindo leads you away from the main body of the gardens to a small grove by the side of the pool, and you take a seat on a moss-covered boulder that has been very deliberately placed such that it appears completely and absolutely natural. At this time of day, no one's around to fetch water, and so it's just the two of you, shielded from sight by the willows. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ]." While you'd really prefer her to be more informal with you at this point, you also understand that it does make her uncomfortable, and — well, the entire point of this is presumably for her benefit, so you won't press her. It'll come as she eases into this arrangement, you're sure. "And I'm sure there's no need to doubt the depth of my affection for or gratitude to you," Rindo replies with a small smile. "Sometimes, less is more when it comes to the matters of one's heart. But down to the matter you wished to discuss in more detail, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]..." Yes, that. Just what does she know about the situation which Komari's been picking over at the moment? A sigh. "Neither I nor the den matron held anything back from you at that meeting, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. So far, it's just been questioning of my kinsmen — it might escalate, it might not. Certainly, if it had, say, involved the genuine risk of bloodshed, the den matron wouldn't have contented herself with a single measure like this. But it is an unknown with the possibility of spiraling out of control, and you willingly taking on an unknown risk is extremely brave. "For now, this arrangement will suffice. We'll then see what response there is from across the ocean, if there's any, or if my concubinage to [pc.ra kitsune |an unknown yet esteemed personage |an enigmatic personage of foreign nobility ] like you will be sufficient to calm the situation in and of itself. It could last weeks, months, maybe even years depending on what happens next, whether alternatives are available, and whether you want me around or not at that point." Ah, such silly words that're coming from her lips. Smiling, you reach up and smooth out Rindo's ears, sliding your palm over them one at a time, pressing them against her scalp and feeling the girl underneath shiver with twinges of comfort and lust alike. You knew what you were getting into when you agreed to this; she can be your concubine for as long as she likes, even if the day should come where there's no actual need for it any further. Look, is she sure that she doesn't want to come and live with you in your wayfort? If another attempt should be made on her life, her assailants would know that she's here, and — " "No." For someone who's usually so soft-spoken, the vehemence and resolution with which Rindo says that singular word strikes you like a boulder rolling down a slope. Her one good eye widens, she herself realizing the faux pas she's just made, and the instincts for politeness and propriety war with the horrible thing that's bubbling in the pit of her stomach until her expression softens just slightly. Rindo still looks torn between throwing herself down at your feet, kowtowing and begging for your forgiveness, and the simmering fire that bubbles beneath her scarred exterior; nevertheless, she pulls herself together with a small measure of defiance. "I know of the Wayfort that you speak — it's that thing down by the river." She does? "It's not hard to spot — you can see all the way across the woods from the uppermost branches in the tree's crown. Not only would I be separated from the people I know, but I'd also be apart from those most well-versed in the tangled web that exists across the ocean. What would I do there? Just sit in a room and stare at the blank gray walls, whiling away the time, waiting for a knock on the door that may or may not be you? "I know you mean well, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ], but no. I will not be moved from this place; that was made clear in the discussion we had with the den matron and I don't like the idea of trying to go around her back on this when the matter's already been talked about and thought dealt with. I've been there, days of doing nothing but sitting on my bed, jumping at the slightest noise that came through the walls; it took me years to drag myself out of that hole, and I am not going back to that existence. Those years were spent rebuilding my life and purpose, and despite losing half my body I went and clawed them back. Once, I was forced to throw everyone and everything I had away for the sake of preserving my life. I am not going to lose it all again, and I would rather die." Having said all this, Rindo gasps and catches her breath; her hands ball into fists and you see tears seep into the corners of her good and dead eyes alike. With a soft sniffle, she half-turns away from you, hiding her burnt half from your sight. All right, you get it. Asking her to pack up and live somewhere else where you thought she might be safer is out of the question. You just... didn't expect her to have such a strong reaction to it. "Perhaps I should have been more circumspect,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Rindo mumbles, still not looking directly at you as she calms from her outburst. "But my words still stand all the same. If I throw away everything that's been earned in between my arrival in the colonies and now, what's the point?" Look, maybe you shouldn't dwell on that, now that you know how much it troubles her; maybe the both of you should think about how your relationship will grow going forward given this new arrangement. Rindo demurs, and you reach over to give her a light peck on the forehead. It's okay, she's just got to trust in the wisdom of her elders, and it'll work out just fine. She looks less than completely convinced at that, but bows her head. "I will do my utmost to serve you as I ought and more[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." You'd have preferred a more enthusiastic response coming from her, but given someone as reticent as she is, this is the enthusiastic response. All right, then — you feel like you've cleared up some more of the questions you had about this whole concubinage business. Now then... "[pc.ra kitsune |My [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |Hm ]?" Perhaps you should get to the actual business you came with her to discuss? "

rows.original: As you approach the little shrine, you're struck by fact that there're a lot of foxes lining the path that winds its way through the sacred gardens and all the way to the hilltop — not quite enough to be a sea of [silly |floof |fluffy tails ], but it looks like the bulk of the community at large's turned out for some kind of event. It certainly isn't the usual crowd of kitsune who turn up at dawn and dusk to make offerings and petition their patron deity, at any rate. [party.has kiyoko |Turning to your fox-wife, you ask her if she's any idea what's going on. "Oh!" she says, ears perking up. "It's a wedding, beloved[kiyoko.married |, much like our own ]. It would appear that just about everyone has been invited." Is that normal?[kiyoko.married | While you know that all of the den's denizens showed up for your wedding with her, you've also picked up enough of kitsune social hierarchy to know that that Kiyoko's kind of a big deal, so that makes sense. A normal wedding, though? ] "It should not be surprising, given that this is a relatively small community of no more than a hundred families. Come now, let us make inquiries. This has piqued my interest, and I would like to learn more." And so would you. Taking your fox-wife's hand in yours, you circle around the back of the little building and find Komari and Kinu in some kind of discussion while the procession makes its way uphill in the distance. |You throw a glance [party.hasCompanions |at [party.compNames] |around you ], but no concrete answers are forthcoming. Feet tromping heavily on the path to the shrine, you circle around the back of the little building and find Komari, Kiyoko, and Kinu in some kind of discussion while the procession makes its way uphill in the distance. ] Your daughter's the first to notice you, and turns to give [party.has kiyoko |both you and her mother |you ] [kinu.isHime |a deep bow from the waist. "Ah, [party.has kiyoko |Mother, ][kinu.dad]. "Hey, [party.has kiyoko |Mother, ][kinu.dad]. Nice timing that you should show up now — I couldn't have planned a better unexpected showing myself. Nice one." ] Well, you didn't plan on turning up to whatever everyone's got going on out of the blue, but here you are. What's the big occasion? [party.has kiyoko |Kinu [kinu.isInari |scratches the back of her head and gives you a sheepish smile. "Oh! Uh, it's a pretty good day, and a cause for celebration. Looks like Rindo's getting married, [kinu.dad]!" That... well, you knew that alternative plans were in the books when you chose to reject the poor girl's offer of concubinage, that much is certain. Assuming that the two are related to begin with, of course — it's likely given the timing, but there's no hard proof of that. Even so, the suddenness of it all... it feels like just yesterday that you tried to set Rindo down lightly, and the day before that when she came up with her offer of concubinage. Things can move quickly, and Rindo herself had told you that she wasn't going to be content with resting on her laurels any longer. But to have a marriage finalized within days...! It shouldn't feel odd, since you know full well that [kiyoko.married |the proceedings can take place extremely quickly once everyone's in agreement, as happened to you |the kitsune don't do things as you do, but even Marches culture is quite speedy about marital matters once both parties can admit that they do indeed give a damn about each other ]. It's just... well. And you weren't invited?[pc.ra kitsune | One would imagine that the champion of their patron deity would be welcomed at the proceedings. ] "Yeah, that's the thing, [kinu.dad]. You and Mother are always out there [pc.ra kitsune |doing his divine lordship's work |getting stuff done ], it's kind of hard to get ahold of you on short notice. The invitation to our household arrived just really, really recently, and as Mother's heir I am empowered to fill in for her in an official capacity when she's out on business." "At least you've done so with reasonable propriety for such an occasion," Kiyoko adds dryly from your side. "Our household may have much in the way of standing, but not enough for you to fritter it all away by losing face at another's wedding." Ahem, anyways! Good for Rindo, that she's getting married! Just who is it that she's being wedded off to, anyway? Kinu makes a show of thinking over the matter, raising a finger to her chin. You know it's all for theatrical effect, but indulge your dear daughter as she teasingly draws out the moment. "Why, Nakano." Oh. Your fox-daughter doesn't bother hiding her emotions as she smiles and crosses her arms under her bosom, ears folding forward under her headscarf as she leans in to you for a conspiratorial whisper. "Couldn't have imagined a better outcome myself, [kinu.dad]. It's tantamount to a public admission of defeat that there's no hope that she can ever hope to steal Hitoshi from me, so she's settling for second best by marrying his cousin instead. rows.raw: " As you approach the little shrine, you're struck by fact that there're a lot of foxes lining the path that winds its way through the sacred gardens and all the way to the hilltop — not quite enough to be a sea of [silly |floof |fluffy tails ], but it looks like the bulk of the community at large's turned out for some kind of event. It certainly isn't the usual crowd of kitsune who turn up at dawn and dusk to make offerings and petition their patron deity, at any rate. [party.has kiyoko |Turning to your fox-wife, you ask her if she's any idea what's going on. "Oh!" she says, ears perking up. "It's a wedding, beloved[kiyoko.married |, much like our own ]. It would appear that just about everyone has been invited." Is that normal?[kiyoko.married | While you know that all of the den's denizens showed up for your wedding with her, you've also picked up enough of kitsune social hierarchy to know that that Kiyoko's kind of a big deal, so that makes sense. A normal wedding, though? ] "It should not be surprising, given that this is a relatively small community of no more than a hundred families. Come now, let us make inquiries. This has piqued my interest, and I would like to learn more." And so would you. Taking your fox-wife's hand in yours, you circle around the back of the little building and find Komari and Kinu in some kind of discussion while the procession makes its way uphill in the distance. |You throw a glance [party.hasCompanions |at [party.compNames] |around you ], but no concrete answers are forthcoming. [kiyoko.married|By the looks of it... you think that this might be a wedding given the similarity of the proceedings to your own marriage to Kiyoko, but there's no reason to be absolutely certain until you check it out for yourself |It looks like some kind of big deal and the atmosphere is generally upbeat, so at the very least you don't believe there's any cause for worry, but then again there's only one way to be absolutely certain]. Feet tromping heavily on the path to the shrine, you circle around the back of the little building and find Komari, Kiyoko, and Kinu in some kind of discussion while the procession makes its way uphill in the distance. ] Your daughter's the first to notice you, and turns to give [party.has kiyoko |both you and her mother |you ] [kinu.isHime |a deep bow from the waist. "Ah, [party.has kiyoko |Mother, ][kinu.dad]. How fortuitous that you should arrive at this moment — I would imagine that there could be no better timing for an unexpected arrival than if his divine lordship arranged for it himself." |a cheery wave. "Hey, [party.has kiyoko |Mother, ][kinu.dad]. Nice timing that you should show up now — I couldn't have planned a better unexpected showing myself. Nice one." ] Well, you didn't plan on turning up to whatever everyone's got going on out of the blue, but here you are. What's the big occasion? [party.has kiyoko |Kinu [kinu.isInari |scratches the back of her head and gives you a sheepish smile. "Oh! Uh, it's a pretty good day, and a cause for celebration. Looks like Rindo's getting married, [kinu.dad]!" That... well, you knew that alternative plans were in the books when you chose to reject the poor girl's offer of concubinage, that much is certain. Assuming that the two are related to begin with, of course — it's likely given the timing, but there's no hard proof of that. Even so, the suddenness of it all... it feels like just yesterday that you tried to set Rindo down lightly, and the day before that when she came up with her offer of concubinage. Things can move quickly, and Rindo herself had told you that she wasn't going to be content with resting on her laurels any longer. But to have a marriage finalized within days...! It shouldn't feel odd, since you know full well that [kiyoko.married |the proceedings can take place extremely quickly once everyone's in agreement, as happened to you |the kitsune don't do things as you do, but even Marches culture is quite speedy about marital matters once both parties can admit that they do indeed give a damn about each other ]. It's just... well. And you weren't invited?[pc.ra kitsune | One would imagine that the champion of their patron deity would be welcomed at the proceedings. ] "Yeah, that's the thing, [kinu.dad]. You and Mother are always out there [pc.ra kitsune |doing his divine lordship's work |getting stuff done ], it's kind of hard to get ahold of you on short notice. The invitation to our household arrived just really, really recently, and as Mother's heir I am empowered to fill in for her in an official capacity when she's out on business." "At least you've done so with reasonable propriety for such an occasion," Kiyoko adds dryly from your side. "Our household may have much in the way of standing, but not enough for you to fritter it all away by losing face at another's wedding." Ahem, anyways! Good for Rindo, that she's getting married! Just who is it that she's being wedded off to, anyway? Kinu makes a show of thinking over the matter, raising a finger to her chin. You know it's all for theatrical effect, but indulge your dear daughter as she teasingly draws out the moment. "Why, Nakano." Oh. Your fox-daughter doesn't bother hiding her emotions as she smiles and crosses her arms under her bosom, ears folding forward under her headscarf as she leans in to you for a conspiratorial whisper. "Couldn't have imagined a better outcome myself, [kinu.dad]. Knowing full well that Kiyoko is more well-versed in etiquette than you are, you look to her for instruction on the matter. Your fox-wife simply shakes her head and waves off your daughter's offer with a smile. "No, this is perfectly acceptable," Kiyoko says, hooking your arm into yours. Kinu bows to her mother and turns to you expectantly. You're not sure how much she actually knows about the whys and wherefores of Rindo suddenly being wedded out of the blue, but given that your darling daughter's inserted herself into the top of the local social and authoritative hierarchy, you'd wager that she knows more than it would be polite to let on. One day, she'll have the strings of every kitsune in the colonies wrapped about her fingers... one day. But for today, there's still something of that girlish charm in her eyes and demeanor in the glee and excitement at officiating at a wedding, and you're reminded of when she was just a kit not that long ago — for you, anyway. Kinu makes a show of thinking over the matter, half-lidding her eyes and raising a finger to her chin as she smiles. You know it's all for theatrical effect, but indulge your dear daughter as she teasingly draws out the moment. "Why, Hitoshi." Oh. "It is a very good match that Matron Komari made, if I dare say so. They have similar interests and temperaments... and the matron's great-great-grandson is reliable if nothing else, which is what Rindo needs in her life. While she was deep in conversation with Komari, Kiyoko excuses herself and saunters over to you, unabashedly throwing herself against your side and giving you a small kiss before hooking her arm into yours. You don't care, and give Kiyoko an kiss right back to tease your poor firstborn daughter as much as it is to cherish your fox-wife.
