rows.original: "Hey, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]," Setsuna says, tapping your shoulder. "You were dozing off again, weren't you?" You take in the familiar pastoral beauty of the kitsune den before turning your attention to Setsuna and tousling her hair. Whatever the case may be, you're glad to be back. "Okay, but if you start dozing off again, I'm taking you home" Setsuna makes a pouty face, but can't hold it as the little kitsune breaks into giggles. "If you're feeling up to it, there's something we could do that'll get you up and moving." Oh? What does your little girl have in mind? "Well... we can go on an adventure together. Doesn't that sound fun?" An adventure — with her? You tell her that you could be convinced. "Yaaaay!" Setsuna cheers, leaping to her feet. She then takes hold of one of your hands and begins tugging insistently. You let her pull you up off the park bench but do not budge after that. Before the two of you go on this adventure, you need to know where she's planning to go. "I want to go outside!" Go where outside? Your little girl's going to need to be more specific. [pc.isCunning |But, upon asking her to elaborate, it finally clicks in your head about what she likely meant. She wants to go outside — to venture out from the colonial den and play in the Frostwoods. You ask her if this is the case. Setsuna hesitates and then bashfully nods. |The two of you are already outside. "Nooooo," Setsuna fusses, shaking her head. She then points to the forest's edge and says, "I want to go there! I want to see what's outside!" ] You suppose there's no inherent harm in letting her explore the Frostwoods. Plus, it'll be good for her mental health to get out and play in the snow. Very well. You acquiesce but with the ground rule that she must remain within eyesight of you at all times. The woods are a beautiful yet dangerous place; as her [pc.mf |father |mother ], you'll do everything in your power to make sure she has a fun and safe time. Setsuna beams. "Okay, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]. I'll make sure to stick to you like honey. Can we go now?" Not quite. Before the two of you can leave the den, there's one more thing that must happen: she needs to change into something warmer. Unlike the arcology, the Frostwoods are cold all-year long, hence the name. Your daughter will freeze if she goes out in those clothes. It might sound boring to her, but the key to a good adventure is preparation. "Alright," Setsuna sighs, dragging her feet as the two of you begin your march back home. Once you arrive at your destination, you place your hand on the door handle and slide it open. Ever the ball of excitable energy, your daughter wastes no time getting inside, rushing past you and racing towards her room. You have half a mind to follow her there, but you let the thought pass. If she needs help, she'll let you know. In the meantime, while she's getting dressed, you go to your room and do so as well. It isn't long before you hear a knocking on your door. "I'm ready, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]!" Setsuna announces from the other side. You tighten the final piece of your winter garbs before making your way to the door; when you slide it open, you see your daughter putting a glove on. She's dressed in appropriately thick robes and socks, but there's something missing. You go over to a drawer, reach inside, and produce a thick, fluffy scarf before returning to your daughter and wrapping it snugly around her neck. You then tousle her hair and tell her you're ready too. Together, you and Setsuna leave the house and make a beeline for the exit. Your foxy daughter leads you down foot-paved trails and past the arcology's giant roots. Crossing the threshold isn't quite stepping into a whole new world, but the shift in aesthetics, if nothing else, is noticeable. Snow-capped pines and evergreen trees stretch as far as the eye can see. Eventually, during the course of your exploration, the both of you end up trudging into a wide forest clearing, sunlight pouring in from the clear blue sky. Before you lies a field of soft, fresh-driven snow — pristine and untouched. "Woah..." Setsuna stares out at the snowfield in awe. She then taps your arm and gives you an expectant look. You smile and tell her she can go ahead and play. Setsuna brightens and begins dashing through the snow, giggling all the while. It isn't long before she jumps head first into a snowdrift and emerges with a light layer of frost covering her. Time passes, and you're watching for dangers when a snowball hits and crumbles against your chest. "I got you, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]!" Setsuna begins packing another ball. "If you keep standing there, I'm going to hit you with another one!" You reach down and scoop up some snow before returning with a snowball of your own. However, you watch it phase right through her shoulder — an illusion! You then hear your daughter's laughter. "Missed me!" Setsuna teases, her presence unseen. Your foxy daughter is still here; she's just invisible. It warms your heart to see her expressing her precocious talent with illusions. She, no doubt, must've set this up while you were distracted. With a snowball in hand, you wait for your daughter's next strike; when you see a ball hurdling towards you from the corner of your vision, you snap around and return fire. It's too late to dodge what she's already thrown, and you flinch, expecting to get hit with a faceful of snow... but a faceful of snow isn't what happens. Opening your eyes, you see a tree and the light dusting of snow where you hit it. A snowball then collides with your shoulder; you turn to where the shot came from and see your daughter skittering away and vanishing again. "Ehehehe." She's a clever girl. [pc.isCunning |She isn't clever enough, though. You know she just used her snowball on you and will have to spend a few seconds making another one. While she's distracted with that, you [pc.isKitsune |go invisible as well. It's only fair, after all. You won't get anywhere chasing after illusions; you'll have to draw her out. You project an image of yourself and wait nearby. "There you are!" Setsuna says, reappearing. She then throws a snowball which goes through your illusion. "Wait, what?" Now's your time to strike. You spring from your hiding place and rush towards her; she goes invisible again, but you wrap your arms around her waist and pick her up before she can get away. |slink into the shadows and begin skulking from tree-to-tree. Keeping your senses sharp, you focus on the soft sound of crunching, being mindful of your own in this game of cat and mouse. Soon enough, you get a bead on her location — she's close. Now that you know where she is, you can plan your attack. For this to work, though, you need her to believe she's still hunting you. Keeping a mental tab on her position, you wander out into the middle of the clearing and turn so your back is towards her. This'll prevent her from using any more illusory tricks on you; if you can lure her out, all you have to do is dodge her attack. It isn't long before you hear faint, crunching footsteps in the snow behind you. Now's your time to strike. You turn around and charge towards your invisible daughter. This sudden turn of event catches her off-guard, so much so that it disrupts her concentration and causes her to reappear. She's still a couple yards away and is winding her arm back to throw a fist-sized snowball at you, but you've caught her flat-footed. She's clumsy, and clumsy kids over-correct. You move to the right; Setsuna aims further right. And, right as she slings the snowball, you leap to the left, causing her to overshoot and miss you entirely. Closing the distance, you wrap your arms around your daughter's waist and pick her up. ] "Eehee. You caught me, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]." Setsuna rests her head against you. "I guess this means you win. That said... you never actually hit me with a snowball." If that's the case, you crouch down, grab a handful of snow, and gently slap it against her arm. There. Now she can't say you didn't get her with a snowball. |[pc.bg hunter barbarian |However, she hasn't quite realized that her footprints in the snow aren't invisible, and all you have to do is follow them to track her down. You know she just used her snowball on you and will have to spend a few seconds making another one. This'll give you enough time to find her. You spend a few moments trailing Setsuna's footsteps until you finally get a bead on her location — she's close, but she's moving now. You know you won't be able to hit a target that's small, invisible, and moving. So, you drop your snowball and decide to toss a plume of snow in her general direction, covering and outlining her in glistening particles. "Gah! No fair!" Now's your chance. You begin charging towards your invisible daughter. A snowball crashes against your chest in the process, but you manage to close the distance and ultimately scoop Setsuna up. "Eehee. You caught me, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]." Setsuna rests her head against you and continues, "I think I won that." How so? "Well... I hit you a lot, didn't I? Also, you never actually hit me with a snowball." If that's the case, you crouch down, grab a handful of snow, and gently slap it against her arm. There. Now she can't say you didn't get her with a snowball. |Try as you might to track your little girl down, you simply can't get a bead on her. She effortlessly dances circles around you, misleading you with illusions and then hitting you with flanking shots. However, after a few minutes, your daughter appears a couple yards away from you. You're skeptical that it's actually her, though. This could be another one of her projected images. "Here, catch!" Setsuna hurls the snowball and — much to your surprise — it actually hits your chest. Wait. That means she's not an illusion! You swing back and retaliate with your own snowball; she giggles when it connects. "Yay, you finally got me! Don't worry, [pc.mf |papa |mama ], I won't use any more tricks on you." From that point onwards, you and Setsuna engage in a genuine snowball fight. No tricks. No illusions. Just playful family bonding time together. ] ] Setsuna giggles. "Thanks for playing with me. I had fun running around and digging in the snow, but it got boring real fast when it was just me. It means a lot to me that we could do this together." You had fun too and — even if you wouldn't have — seeing her happy makes you happy, too. "Aww, hearing that makes me feel special!" You tell Setsuna she is special and poke her chest. Your daughter gasps. "I am?!" Of course! You tell her how impressed you are with her level of control over illusions. But, above all else, she's special because she's your precious golden child. Being around her is just a treat; her energy is simply infectious. As the two of you make the trek back to the colonial den, a familiar thinness in the air begins to envelop you; the scene around you blends and blurs into an abstract, dancing mess of hues. This must be all the time you could afford. You wish you could stay longer. Nevertheless, you leave the dream feeling satisfied.

啊！太不公平了！” 现在就是你的机会。你开始朝着那个看不见的女儿冲去。在这个过程中，一个雪球击中了你的胸口，但你还是成功缩短了距离，最终将刹那抱在了怀里。 嘻嘻，被你抓到啦[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]刹那把头靠在你身上，继续说道：‘我想我赢了。’” “怎么会这样呢？” “嗯……我打你的次数比较多吧？而且，你其实从来没有用雪球打中过我。” rows.raw: " "Hey, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]," Setsuna says, tapping your shoulder. "You were dozing off again, weren't you?" You take in the familiar pastoral beauty of the kitsune den before turning your attention to Setsuna and tousling her hair. Whatever the case may be, you're glad to be back. "Okay, but if you start dozing off again, I'm taking you home" Setsuna makes a pouty face, but can't hold it as the little kitsune breaks into giggles. "If you're feeling up to it, there's something we could do that'll get you up and moving." Oh? What does your little girl have in mind? "Well... we can go on an adventure together. Doesn't that sound fun?" An adventure — with her? You tell her that you could be convinced. "Yaaaay!" Setsuna cheers, leaping to her feet. She then takes hold of one of your hands and begins tugging insistently. You let her pull you up off the park bench but do not budge after that. Before the two of you go on this adventure, you need to know where she's planning to go. "I want to go outside!" Go where outside? Your little girl's going to need to be more specific. [pc.isCunning |But, upon asking her to elaborate, it finally clicks in your head about what she likely meant. She wants to go outside — to venture out from the colonial den and play in the Frostwoods. You ask her if this is the case. Setsuna hesitates and then bashfully nods. |The two of you are already outside. "Nooooo," Setsuna fusses, shaking her head. She then points to the forest's edge and says, "I want to go there! I want to see what's outside!" ] You suppose there's no inherent harm in letting her explore the Frostwoods. Plus, it'll be good for her mental health to get out and play in the snow. Very well. You acquiesce but with the ground rule that she must remain within eyesight of you at all times. The woods are a beautiful yet dangerous place; as her [pc.mf |father |mother ], you'll do everything in your power to make sure she has a fun and safe time. Setsuna beams. "Okay, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]. I'll make sure to stick to you like honey. Can we go now?" Not quite. Before the two of you can leave the den, there's one more thing that must happen: she needs to change into something warmer. Unlike the arcology, the Frostwoods are cold all-year long, hence the name. Your daughter will freeze if she goes out in those clothes. It might sound boring to her, but the key to a good adventure is preparation. "Alright," Setsuna sighs, dragging her feet as the two of you begin your march back home. Once you arrive at your destination, you place your hand on the door handle and slide it open. Ever the ball of excitable energy, your daughter wastes no time getting inside, rushing past you and racing towards her room. You have half a mind to follow her there, but you let the thought pass. If she needs help, she'll let you know. In the meantime, while she's getting dressed, you go to your room and do so as well. It isn't long before you hear a knocking on your door. "I'm ready, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]!" Setsuna announces from the other side. You tighten the final piece of your winter garbs before making your way to the door; when you slide it open, you see your daughter putting a glove on. She's dressed in appropriately thick robes and socks, but there's something missing. You go over to a drawer, reach inside, and produce a thick, fluffy scarf before returning to your daughter and wrapping it snugly around her neck. You then tousle her hair and tell her you're ready too. Together, you and Setsuna leave the house and make a beeline for the exit. Your foxy daughter leads you down foot-paved trails and past the arcology's giant roots. Crossing the threshold isn't quite stepping into a whole new world, but the shift in aesthetics, if nothing else, is noticeable. Snow-capped pines and evergreen trees stretch as far as the eye can see. Eventually, during the course of your exploration, the both of you end up trudging into a wide forest clearing, sunlight pouring in from the clear blue sky. Before you lies a field of soft, fresh-driven snow — pristine and untouched. "Woah..." Setsuna stares out at the snowfield in awe. She then taps your arm and gives you an expectant look. You smile and tell her she can go ahead and play. Setsuna brightens and begins dashing through the snow, giggling all the while. It isn't long before she jumps head first into a snowdrift and emerges with a light layer of frost covering her. Time passes, and you're watching for dangers when a snowball hits and crumbles against your chest. "I got you, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]!" Setsuna begins packing another ball. "If you keep standing there, I'm going to hit you with another one!" You reach down and scoop up some snow before returning with a snowball of your own. However, you watch it phase right through her shoulder — an illusion! You then hear your daughter's laughter. "Missed me!" Setsuna teases, her presence unseen. Your foxy daughter is still here; she's just invisible. It warms your heart to see her expressing her precocious talent with illusions. She, no doubt, must've set this up while you were distracted. With a snowball in hand, you wait for your daughter's next strike; when you see a ball hurdling towards you from the corner of your vision, you snap around and return fire. It's too late to dodge what she's already thrown, and you flinch, expecting to get hit with a faceful of snow... but a faceful of snow isn't what happens. Opening your eyes, you see a tree and the light dusting of snow where you hit it. A snowball then collides with your shoulder; you turn to where the shot came from and see your daughter skittering away and vanishing again. "Ehehehe." She's a clever girl. [pc.isCunning |She isn't clever enough, though. You know she just used her snowball on you and will have to spend a few seconds making another one. While she's distracted with that, you [pc.isKitsune |go invisible as well. It's only fair, after all. You won't get anywhere chasing after illusions; you'll have to draw her out. You project an image of yourself and wait nearby. "There you are!" Setsuna says, reappearing. She then throws a snowball which goes through your illusion. "Wait, what?" Now's your time to strike. You spring from your hiding place and rush towards her; she goes invisible again, but you wrap your arms around her waist and pick her up before she can get away. |slink into the shadows and begin skulking from tree-to-tree. Keeping your senses sharp, you focus on the soft sound of crunching, being mindful of your own in this game of cat and mouse. Soon enough, you get a bead on her location — she's close. Now that you know where she is, you can plan your attack. For this to work, though, you need her to believe she's still hunting you. Keeping a mental tab on her position, you wander out into the middle of the clearing and turn so your back is towards her. This'll prevent her from using any more illusory tricks on you; if you can lure her out, all you have to do is dodge her attack. It isn't long before you hear faint, crunching footsteps in the snow behind you. Now's your time to strike. You turn around and charge towards your invisible daughter. This sudden turn of event catches her off-guard, so much so that it disrupts her concentration and causes her to reappear. She's still a couple yards away and is winding her arm back to throw a fist-sized snowball at you, but you've caught her flat-footed. She's clumsy, and clumsy kids over-correct. You move to the right; Setsuna aims further right. And, right as she slings the snowball, you leap to the left, causing her to overshoot and miss you entirely. Closing the distance, you wrap your arms around your daughter's waist and pick her up. ] "Eehee. You caught me, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]." Setsuna rests her head against you. "I guess this means you win. That said... you never actually hit me with a snowball." If that's the case, you crouch down, grab a handful of snow, and gently slap it against her arm. There. Now she can't say you didn't get her with a snowball. |[pc.bg hunter barbarian |However, she hasn't quite realized that her footprints in the snow aren't invisible, and all you have to do is follow them to track her down. You know she just used her snowball on you and will have to spend a few seconds making another one. This'll give you enough time to find her. You spend a few moments trailing Setsuna's footsteps until you finally get a bead on her location — she's close, but she's moving now. You know you won't be able to hit a target that's small, invisible, and moving. So, you drop your snowball and decide to toss a plume of snow in her general direction, covering and outlining her in glistening particles. "Gah! No fair!" Now's your chance. You begin charging towards your invisible daughter. A snowball crashes against your chest in the process, but you manage to close the distance and ultimately scoop Setsuna up. "Eehee. You caught me, [pc.mf |papa |mama ]." Setsuna rests her head against you and continues, "I think I won that." How so? "Well... I hit you a lot, didn't I? Also, you never actually hit me with a snowball." If that's the case, you crouch down, grab a handful of snow, and gently slap it against her arm. There. Now she can't say you didn't get her with a snowball. |Try as you might to track your little girl down, you simply can't get a bead on her. She effortlessly dances circles around you, misleading you with illusions and then hitting you with flanking shots. However, after a few minutes, your daughter appears a couple yards away from you. You're skeptical that it's actually her, though. This could be another one of her projected images. "Here, catch!" Setsuna hurls the snowball and — much to your surprise — it actually hits your chest. Wait. That means she's not an illusion! You swing back and retaliate with your own snowball; she giggles when it connects. "Yay, you finally got me! Don't worry, [pc.mf |papa |mama ], I won't use any more tricks on you." From that point onwards, you and Setsuna engage in a genuine snowball fight. No tricks. No illusions. Just playful family bonding time together. ] ] Setsuna giggles. "Thanks for playing with me. I had fun running around and digging in the snow, but it got boring real fast when it was just me. It means a lot to me that we could do this together." You had fun too and — even if you wouldn't have — seeing her happy makes you happy, too. "Aww, hearing that makes me feel special!" You tell Setsuna she is special and poke her chest. Your daughter gasps. "I am?!" Of course! You tell her how impressed you are with her level of control over illusions. But, above all else, she's special because she's your precious golden child. Being around her is just a treat; her energy is simply infectious. As the two of you make the trek back to the colonial den, a familiar thinness in the air begins to envelop you; the scene around you blends and blurs into an abstract, dancing mess of hues. This must be all the time you could afford. You wish you could stay longer. Nevertheless, you leave the dream feeling satisfied. "

As you drift off deeper into sleep, you find yourself in the den's garden. Several shafts of silvery moonlight falling in between the roots of the tree. 当你渐渐进入更深层的睡眠时，你发现自己置身于巢穴的花园之中。几道银色的月光穿透树根照射下来，清冽而明亮，与路旁石灯中闪烁的蔚蓝色狐火，以及轻风拂过花坛和灌木丛时发出的微弱声响，共同构成了一幅美妙的画面。不知不觉间， [tetsuya.numKits 1 4
        |刹那紧紧握住你的手，坚持不懈地拉着你前进。

“快来吧， [pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]我们必须赶到那座神社去！”

你那位狡黠的女儿带着你沿着花园的小路前行。最终，你们俩来到了那座具有殖民地风格的神社，眼前呈现出一幅令人震撼的景象：成群的成年人和孩子们聚集在那里，树木上挂满了五颜六色的彩纸[kiyoko.isFree
            |[kinu.isHime
                |小娟
                |梅
            ]
            |舞
        ]为观众表演一场神圣的舞蹈。这一切都为现场增添了生机与热闹的气氛。

“哦！在那边！”刹那松开了你的手，冲向了一群聚集在竹子旁的狐族孩子们。当她赶到那里时，那些孩子们都热情地欢迎了她。
        
        当你站在那里，远远地注视着你的女儿时，她也回头看了你一眼，热情地向你挥了挥手，然后又继续和其他小伙伴们聊天去了。知道她有很好的伙伴陪伴，你便把注意力转向了其他地方。 [kiyoko.isFree
            |[kinu.isHime
                |小娟
                |梅
            ]
            |舞
        ]然后欣赏她那优雅的表演。不久之后，刹那就会跑回来，重新站在你身边。

“好了， [pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]我的愿望已经实现了，现在我准备离开了。”

你要让她知道，她不必因为你的缘故而离开。你希望她能玩得开心，如果她愿意的话，完全可以留下来和朋友们一起玩。

            |爸爸
            |爸爸
        ]等等，我们应该去那个……咕嘎兹古扎布……地方找他。”

“凉亭吗？”

“对，就是那个！我们快走吧！”

没有等待任何回应，刹那就抓住你的手，又开始拉着你走了。你那个活泼好动的女儿总是牵着你的手，沿着小路奔跑，踩过树根，整个人仿佛吃了太多甜食一样兴奋不已。仔细想想，如果看这些接连不断的庆祝活动的话，她确实可能是吃太多了甜食吧……当你来到凉亭时，你看到你深爱的铁也正在那里，他正仰望着繁星点点的夜空。你没有浪费任何时间，立刻走进凉亭，和家人一起坐了下来。

她的兄弟姐妹们确实让人头疼，不是吗？
        
        刹那的身体微微一僵，但她的脸上浮现出坚定的神情，嘴唇紧抿成一条几乎看不见的线，抬头看着你说道：“他们是我的可爱傻瓜们，我绝不会用他们去换取任何东西。不用担心他们[pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]你那超级聪明的公主把一切都控制得井井有条呢！”

“嘿嘿。”那个金发女孩脸上露出了狡黠的笑容。我本可以告诉他们，今晚会有一颗流星划过天空，如果我们不够快，就会有人抢走最好的观看位置。现在他们把所有的精力都耗在了那里，而我根本什么都不用做！

不久之后，你们就来到了一座可以清晰欣赏夜空及其繁星美景的凉亭旁。在那个结构里，你的其他孩子们也都蜷缩成了小小的绒球。他们的小奔跑肯定让他们累坏了。

走进建筑物后，你找了个座位坐下来，然后靠在椅背上。
    ]然后，你在家人陪伴下整晚聊天，繁星在夜空中闪烁，月光照亮了这间殖民地风格的小屋。渐渐地，周围人群的喧闹声也慢慢消失了，你以为庆祝活动快要结束了。然而，在夜晚即将结束之前，你突然看到有什么东西划过了天空。

“是流星！”刹那惊呼道。

你把女儿紧紧抱在怀里，问她许了什么愿望。

刹那抬头看着你，微笑着说：“我许了一个愿望[rand
        |为了[tetsuya.numKits 1

            |另一个
        ]兄弟姐妹
        |为了获得更多的桃子与抚摸头部的奖励
        |茁壮成长
        |学习一项新技能
    ]！"

rows.original:
As you slide the door open, a curious sight greets you: sitting on her knees is Setsuna, her head hanging low and her fists pressing into her lap. And, on the floor in front of her, is a motionless chicken and a pile of dried beans. She sniffles and wipes her face with her sleeve, fighting back the waterworks. Seems like this is an appropriate time as any for [pc.mfn
        |her dad
        |her mom
        |one of her parents
    ] to step in. You take a seat beside her and ask what's going on.
    
    "It's Pebble... she's dead. She's dead and it's all my fault."
    
    Oh, dear. No it's not. Of course it's not her fault.
    
    "But it is! I gave Pebble those stupid beans that got her sick."
    
    You pick up a dried bean and tell her it was an honest mistake. This isn't something she could've easily known. Her heart was in the right place.
    
    "But... Pebble's my friend. Is there anything I can do to bring her back?"
    
    Unfortunately, there isn't. You rest a hand on her shoulder and explain to her the finality of death. It's just one of those things that inevitably happens, even when one doesn't want it to. Nothing lasts forever.
    
    "It's not fair, [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ]. It's not fair!" Setsuna buries her face against your body.
    
    You give Setsuna a few pats on the head, smoothing out the backs of her large, foxy ears and console her as she blubbers and wails, getting your garments all wet and soppy with tears. There, there. She's free to let it all out. It's only fair to mourn for the loss of a loved one. You pet Setsuna's head for a little longer, only stopping when the little kitsune's sniffling ceases. Her eyes are all red and her face is wet, but she's still hugging you as ferociously as ever.
    
    You tell Setsuna it'll be okay — Tira will take good care of Pebble. All that can be done now is honor Pebble's passing and carry on; you'll stay by your daughter's side until she's ready.
rows.translation:
你拉开门，眼前出现了一幕奇怪的景象：刹那跪坐着，脑袋低垂，双拳紧压在大腿上。她面前的地板上，是一只一动不动的鸡和一堆干豆子。她抽着鼻子，用袖子擦脸，竭力忍住泪水。看来现在正是[pc.mfn
        |她爸爸
        |她妈妈
        |她的一位家长
    ]出面的时候。你在她身旁坐下，询问发生了什么。
    
    “是小石子……她死了。她死了，全都是我的错。”
    
    哦，亲爱的。不，不是。那当然不是她的错。
    
    “可就是我的错！是我给小石子吃了那些蠢豆子，害她生了病。”
    
    你捡起一颗干豆子，告诉她这只是无心之失。她不可能轻易知道会发生这种事。她的本意是好的。
    
    “可是……小石子是我的朋友。我能做什么让她回来吗？”
    
    很遗憾，没有办法。你把一只手放在她肩上，向她解释死亡不可挽回。这只是不可避免会发生的事，即使没有人希望它发生。没有任何东西能够永远存在。
    
    “这不公平，[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]。这不公平！”刹那把脸埋进你的身体。
    
    你拍了拍刹那的脑袋，抚平她那对狐族大耳的后侧，在她哭喊抽噎时柔声安慰；泪水把你的衣服弄得湿漉漉、黏糊糊。好啦，好啦。她尽管把一切都宣泄出来。为失去所爱之人哀悼是理所当然的。你又抚摸了一会儿刹那的脑袋，直到小狐妖终于停止抽泣。她的双眼一片通红，脸上湿漉漉的，却仍和之前一样用力抱着你。
    
    你告诉刹那，一切都会好起来——蒂拉会悉心照料小石子。现在能做的只有纪念小石子的离世，继续生活；你会陪在女儿身边，直到她准备好为止。

    “什—— [pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]世奈猛地站起身来，惊讶地望着你，她的耳朵紧紧贴在脑袋上。她的目光在你和那个篮子之间来回移动，然后她用手捂住嘴，清了清嗓子，说道：“我能帮上什么忙吗？ [pc.mf
        |父亲
        |母亲
    ]？"
    
    [pc.isDK
        |你应该告诉你的女儿不要隐瞒秘密——尤其是不要对你隐瞒。
        |你与女儿平视着对方，询问发生了什么。一切都还好吗？
    ]
    
    她的目光停留在那个篮子上，然后无奈地叹了口气。“我[pc.isDK
        |抱歉
        |好的。
    ]， [pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]我本来希望把这个秘密保守下去。”
    
    什么秘密呢？

        |你和爸爸

            |爸爸

rows.original:
As you're gathering dry sticks and leaves by hand, the sound of flowing water catches your ear, and you ask aloud if a certain someone would like to take a quick break. When you ask your question, a golden set of ears pop out from a bush before their owner crawls out, her hair and fur covered in twigs.
    
    "But [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ], we don't have enough," Setsuna says, holding up the basket with both hands as she jogs toward you.
    
    If she wants to keep going, that's perfectly fine; there's no harm in taking a little side adventure if she's up to it, though.
    
    "Alriiight..."
    
    Together, the two of you wade through the dense underbrush. Gradually, the foliage fades away to reveal a pond, its clear surface sparkling with reflected warmth, its bottom clearly visible even from where you stand. A small stream flows outwards from whatever underground spring feeds the pool, trickling over mossy rock as it leads off into the Frostwoods.
    
    This is nice — a secluded place for you and your daughter to relax. Setting down the basket, you take a seat at the water's edge; as you're soaking your feet in the pond, Setsuna crawls onto your lap and slumps against your chest. You wrap an arm about her and hold her close.
    
    "Hey, [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ]?"
    
    Yeah?
    
    "Thanks."
    
    It's no problem. She's your precious girl. You bring your fingertips to her head, giving her fluffy scalp a quick scritch before scratching at the sensitive back of one of her ears. Setsuna's pair of tails wrap around her and curl about your waist in turn.
    
    "I promise I'll make you proud of me, [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ]."
    
    You already are. She doesn't have to try hard to impress you.
    
    Setsuna giggles. "Of course I do! I know how much you and [pc.mf
        |dad
        |papa
    ] have to take care of me. My body isn't the bestest and I get sick a lot, but that's why I have to work extra super hard to catch up! It'll be hard for me to make my own foxfire, but I think I can take it now! Once I finally learn how to do it it'll be easy!"
    
    The dawning realization of your daughter's sickly condition hits you like a bag of bricks. And she says it all with a smile too! This entire time... your poor baby... she thought she was a burden. Instinctively, you wrap your arms around her and hug her tightly. When you finally release Setsuna and let her stand up, you pick up her basket with emboldened purpose.
    
    "Try and keep up, [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ]!" Setsuna challenges, her tails streaming behind her like fluffy golden ribbons as she runs ahead.
    
    And, just like that, you spend the rest of the afternoon gathering tinder. Once the sun begins to set, you and Setsuna head home with a full basket. This should be enough.
rows.translation:
你正徒手收集干枯的枝叶，流水声忽然传入耳中；于是你大声问某个人想不想稍微休息一下。问题刚出口，一对金色耳朵便从灌木丛里冒了出来；随后耳朵的主人爬出灌木，头发和毛皮上沾满细枝。
    
    “可是[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]，我们收集得还不够，”刹那双手举着篮子，慢跑到你面前说道。
    
    如果她想继续，那也完全没问题；不过只要她有兴致，稍微偏离路线冒个险也无伤大雅。
    
    “好——吧……”
    
    你们一起涉过茂密的下层灌木。树叶渐渐稀疏，露出一方池塘；清澈的水面倒映着温暖光芒，从你所站的位置甚至也能清楚看见池底。一条小溪从为池塘供水的地下泉眼向外流出，潺潺淌过覆满苔藓的岩石，伸向冰霜森林深处。
    
    这里真不错——是一处供你和女儿放松的僻静之地。你放下篮子，在水边坐下；你把双脚泡进池塘时，刹那爬上大腿，软绵绵地靠住你的胸口。你伸出一条手臂环住她，把她搂紧。
    
    “嘿，[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]？”
    
    怎么了？
    
    “谢谢你。”
    
    没什么。她可是你的宝贝女儿。你把指尖落到她头上，飞快挠了挠蓬松的头皮，又搔弄一只耳朵后方的敏感部位。刹那的一对尾巴先环住她自己，接着又卷上你的腰。
    
    “我保证会让你为我骄傲，[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]。”
    
    你已经为她骄傲了。她不必拼命努力来打动你。
    
    刹那咯咯笑道。“我当然得努力！我知道你和[pc.mf
        |父亲
        |爸爸
    ]需要多费心照顾我。我的身体不是最最健康，还经常生病，不过正因如此，我才必须加倍、加倍努力才能赶上！要生出自己的狐火对我而言很难，可我觉得现在自己能够承受了！等我终于学会怎么做，以后就会很容易！”
    
    意识到女儿身体虚弱的那一刻，现实犹如一袋砖头砸中你。而且她竟然一直微笑着诉说这一切！这么久以来……你可怜的宝贝……一直认为自己是个负担。你本能地伸出双臂，用力抱紧她。终于松开刹那、让她站起身后，你带着更加坚定的目标提起她的篮子。
    
    “努力跟上哦，[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]！”刹那发起挑战，跑向前方；尾巴在身后飞扬，犹如蓬松的金色丝带。
    
    就这样，你们用余下的整个下午收集引火物。太阳开始落山时，你和刹那带着满满一篮东西回家。这应该足够了。

rows.original:
The faint pitter patter of small feet running down a hall rouses you from the dark fog of dreamless sleep. The next thing your mind registers is the soft cushion you're resting on. 
    
    "[pc.mf
        |Papa
        |Mama
    ]! [pc.mf
        |Papa
        |Mama
    ]!"
    
    You begin to wake up, cracking and blinking your eyes in response to the commotion, but the door to the room slides open, and in comes Setsuna, running and jumping onto you. This catches you off guard — the little lady is far from heavy, but her sudden, excitable presence snaps you to your senses.
    
    "Wake up, [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ]! I did it!"
    
    Setsuna squeaks and wriggles against you for a second or so, then jumps off you and scampers out of the room just as quickly as she entered. You reckon that your effervescent daughter has something to show you.
    
    You sit up with a groan and pull your [pc.legs] out of bed before following after her.
rows.translation:
小脚沿走廊奔跑的轻微啪嗒声，把你从无梦沉睡的黑雾中唤醒。接着，你察觉到身下柔软的垫子。 
    
    “[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]！[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]！”
    
    你开始醒来，因这阵喧闹睁开眼睛，不断眨眼；房门却在此时滑开，刹那跑进来，一跃扑到你身上。你被吓了一跳——小姑娘远不算重，但她突然兴奋地出现，让你彻底清醒。
    
    “醒醒，[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]！我成功了！”
    
    刹那尖叫着在你身上扭动片刻，又从你身上跳下，像进来时一样迅速跑出房间。看来活泼的女儿有东西要给你看。
    
    你呻吟着坐起，把[pc.legs]挪下床，随后跟在她身后。

rows.original:
When you find her waiting in her room, you see that she's practically vibrating on the spot, all of her tails wagging back and forth. [pc.cunningRange 0 50
        |Something seems different about her but you can't quite put your finger on what
        |Wait... her tails — your daughter must've grown a third
    ]. Smiling, you kneel so that you're on eye level with your daughter, and [pc.cunningRange 0 50
        |ask her what she wants to show you.
        
        "This, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]!" Setsuna closes her eyes and rubs her hands together. A moment later, she reveals a pale, floating orb of foxfire in the palm of her hands and giggles gleefully. "I can make foxfire now."
        
        That's amazing! You give your daughter a few pats on the head, smoothing out the backs of her large, foxy ears.
        
        "There's more, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]!" Setsuna adds.
        
        Oh?
        
        Your daughter gives you a proud smile before twirling around and showing you her tails. "I grew my third tail this morning! I think it's because I learned how to use my foxfire. Go on, touch it!"
        
        Setsuna offers you one of her lovely tails — no doubt the new one — the appendage coming within reach. It's almost as long as she is tall. Starting off with long, languid strokes, you trail your fingers through the proffered tail, running its entire length from base to furry tip.
        
        "Are you proud of me, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]?"
        |congratulate her on getting her third tail.
        
        "Ehehe. I grew it this morning! Go on, touch it!"
        
        Setsuna offers you one of her lovely tails — no doubt the new one — the appendage snaking around from behind her and coming within reach. It's almost as long as she is tall. Starting off with long, languid strokes, you trail your fingers through the proffered tail, running its entire length from base to furry tip. Twisting and squirming in your grasp, Setsuna's fluffy tail instinctively tries to escape your fingers, not too unlike your excitable daughter herself.
        
        "Sorry, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]. I'm still getting used to having it. It just does what it wants sometimes."
        
        It's okay. Under your tender ministrations, your daughter's expression softens considerably as you lavish her tail with all the love and affection you have to give. A quiet yip escapes her throat as she falls against you with a thud, pupils dilated and expression dreamy.
        
        "There's more, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]," Setsuna mutters.
        
        Oh?
        
        "Yeah..." Setsuna groans and pushes herself away from you before patting her cheeks to compose herself. She then closes her eyes and rubs her hands together. A moment later, she reveals a pale, floating orb of foxfire in the palm of her hands. "I kept practicing, and now I finally know how to use my foxfire. Are you proud of me, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]?"
    ]
    
    Of course! But that goes without saying, though. You and [pc.mf
        |Tetsuya
        |her father
    ] would still be proud of her even if she didn't learn how to control her foxfire. She should never beat herself up because of her condition. Being aware of one's expectations is one thing and laudable in any child, but agonizing over them will only do her more harm than good. The fact she struggles doesn't make her a disappointment, far from it. Her experience learning how to use her foxfire proves as such. What truly matters is that she finds the strength to keep going, in spite of her handicap. If she can do that, then that's reason enough to be proud of her.
    
    For a whole handful of seconds, Setsuna just wordlessly absorbs your words. Then, she buries her face against your body and throws her arms around you, hugging you as best as her tiny arms will allow her. "I promise, [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ]! Oh! Can we go to the gardens today? I want to show off my tail!"
    
    Perhaps a family picnic in the park? Now that sounds like a magnificent idea. [tetsuya.numKits 4
        |You and Tetsuya will gather the rest of your kits while she sets up the parasols
        |You'll go set up one of the parasols while she gets [pc.mf
            |Tetsuya
            |her father
        ]
    ].
    
    And so it happens that the rest of the day is spent with your foxy husband and daughter, slicing apart melons and savoring them while making small talk. [tetsuya.numKits 4
        |
        Every now and then, one of Setsuna's siblings will come up and beg for a slice of melon, which your daughter is more than happy to share.
    ] Just sitting and talking like this makes time seem to pass in the blink of an eye... 
    
    Indeed, when you do leave, it's not a conscious thing. One moment you're debating father and daughter alike on the merits of sweet over sour in one's choice of melons, feeling safe in the knowledge that Setsuna is on her way to self-improvement.

刹那将她那条漂亮的尾巴递给你——毫无疑问，那是她新长出来的尾巴，那条触手可及的尾巴几乎和她的身高一样长。你开始用手指轻轻触摸它的表面，从根部一直滑到那毛茸茸的尾巴尖端。
        
        你为我感到骄傲吗？ [pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]？"
        |恭喜她长出了第三条尾巴。”

        “嘿嘿，我今天早上才长出来的呢！来，摸摸看吧！”

        火焰纹章的刹那将她那条崭新的尾巴递给你——那条从她身后蜿蜒伸出来的尾巴，正好在你能触及的范围之内。它的长度几乎和她的身高一样。开始时，你可以用缓慢而轻柔的动作，用手指沿着那条柔软的尾巴从根部一直抚摸到毛茸茸的尾尖。在你的手中，刹那的尾巴会不停地扭动、蠕动，试图逃脱你的手指——这和你们那个活泼的女儿的行为简直一模一样。
        
        对不起， [pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]我还在慢慢适应拥有它。只不过有时候，它还是会随心所欲地行动。”

没关系。在你的细心照料下，你的女儿脸上的表情变得柔软了许多——因为你倾注了所有爱与关怀来抚摸她的尾巴。她轻轻叫了一声，然后扑到你怀里，眼睛瞪得大大的，神情仿佛沉浸在梦境之中。

“还有呢[pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]月海低声说道。

“哦？”

“嗯……”月海叹了口气，推开你，然后轻拍自己的脸颊让自己平静下来。接着她闭上眼睛，双手相互摩擦。片刻之后，她手掌中出现了一个淡色的、漂浮着的狐火球。“我一直在练习，现在终于学会如何使用狐火了。你为我感到骄傲吗？ [pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]？"
    ]
    
    当然！不过，这当然是理所当然的。你和[pc.mf
        |哲也
        |她的父亲
    ]即使她没有学会如何控制自己的“狐火”，她依然会为自己感到骄傲。她绝不应该因为自己的这种状况而自责。了解自己的期望是件好事，任何孩子这样做都值得称赞，但过分纠结于这些期望只会给她带来更多的伤害，而没有任何好处。她遇到困难这一事实并不会让她成为让人失望的人，恰恰相反。她学习如何运用自己的“狐火”这一经历就证明了这一点。真正重要的是，尽管她有这样的障碍，她依然能够找到继续前进的力量。如果她能够做到这一点，那么就有足够的理由为她感到骄傲了。

有那么几秒钟的时间，刹那只是静静地听着你的话，没有说一句话。然后，她把脸埋在你的怀里，用她那小小的手臂紧紧地抱住了你。我保证， [pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]！ 哦！今天我们能去花园里玩吗？我想展示一下我的尾巴！

或许在公园里举行家庭野餐吧？这个主意听起来真是太棒了。 [tetsuya.numKits 4
        |你和哲也去把剩下的装备收集起来，而她则去搭遮阳伞。
        |你去搭其中一个遮阳伞吧，她去准备其他东西。 [pc.mf
            |哲也
            |她的父亲
        ]
    ]于是，这一天剩下的时间，你就可以和你的丈夫以及女儿一起愉快地度过：切开甜瓜，品尝它们的美味，同时闲聊几句。 [tetsuya.numKits 4
        |
        偶尔，刹那的某个兄弟姐妹会过来讨要一片瓜，而你的女儿也非常乐意与他们分享。
    ]就这样坐着聊天，时间仿佛在眨眼间就过去了……

的确，当你真正离开的时候，这个过程其实并不是有意识地发生的。前一刻你还在和塞丝娜一起讨论挑选西瓜时甜味和酸味哪个更好，心里也觉得她一定会在自我提升的道路上不断前进。

"
    When you find her waiting in her room, you see that she's practically vibrating on the spot, all of her tails wagging back and forth. [pc.cunningRange 0 50
        |Something seems different about her but you can't quite put your finger on what
        |Wait... her tails — your daughter must've grown a third
    ]. Smiling, you kneel so that you're on eye level with your daughter, and [pc.cunningRange 0 50
        |ask her what she wants to show you.
        
        "This, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]!" Setsuna closes her eyes and rubs her hands together. A moment later, she reveals a pale, floating orb of foxfire in the palm of her hands and giggles gleefully. "I can make foxfire now."
        
        That's amazing! You give your daughter a few pats on the head, smoothing out the backs of her large, foxy ears.
        
        "There's more, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]!" Setsuna adds.
        
        Oh?
        
        Your daughter gives you a proud smile before twirling around and showing you her tails. "I grew my third tail this morning! I think it's because I learned how to use my foxfire. Go on, touch it!"
        
        Setsuna offers you one of her lovely tails — no doubt the new one — the appendage coming within reach. It's almost as long as she is tall. Starting off with long, languid strokes, you trail your fingers through the proffered tail, running its entire length from base to furry tip.
        
        "Are you proud of me, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]?"
        |congratulate her on getting her third tail.
        
        "Ehehe. I grew it this morning! Go on, touch it!"
        
        Setsuna offers you one of her lovely tails — no doubt the new one — the appendage snaking around from behind her and coming within reach. It's almost as long as she is tall. Starting off with long, languid strokes, you trail your fingers through the proffered tail, running its entire length from base to furry tip. Twisting and squirming in your grasp, Setsuna's fluffy tail instinctively tries to escape your fingers, not too unlike your excitable daughter herself.
        
        "Sorry, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]. I'm still getting used to having it. It just does what it wants sometimes."
        
        It's okay. Under your tender ministrations, your daughter's expression softens considerably as you lavish her tail with all the love and affection you have to give. A quiet yip escapes her throat as she falls against you with a thud, pupils dilated and expression dreamy.
        
        "There's more, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]," Setsuna mutters.
        
        Oh?
        
        "Yeah..." Setsuna groans and pushes herself away from you before patting her cheeks to compose herself. She then closes her eyes and rubs her hands together. A moment later, she reveals a pale, floating orb of foxfire in the palm of her hands. "I kept practicing, and now I finally know how to use my foxfire. Are you proud of me, [pc.mf
            |papa
            |mama
        ]?"
    ]
    
    Of course! But that goes without saying, though. You and [pc.mf
        |Tetsuya
        |her father
    ] would still be proud of her even if she didn't learn how to control her foxfire. She should never beat herself up because of her condition. Being aware of one's expectations is one thing and laudable in any child, but agonizing over them will only do her more harm than good. The fact she struggles doesn't make her a disappointment, far from it. Her experience learning how to use her foxfire proves as such. What truly matters is that she finds the strength to keep going, in spite of her handicap. If she can do that, then that's reason enough to be proud of her.
    
    For a whole handful of seconds, Setsuna just wordlessly absorbs your words. Then, she buries her face against your body and throws her arms around you, hugging you as best as her tiny arms will allow her. "I promise, [pc.mf
        |papa
        |mama
    ]! Oh! Can we go to the gardens today? I want to show off my tail!"
    
    Perhaps a family picnic in the park? Now that sounds like a magnificent idea. [tetsuya.numKits 4
        |You and Tetsuya will gather the rest of your kits while she sets up the parasols
        |You'll go set up one of the parasols while she gets [pc.mf
            |Tetsuya
            |her father
        ]
    ].
    
    And so it happens that the rest of the day is spent with your foxy husband and daughter, slicing apart melons and savoring them while making small talk. [tetsuya.numKits 4
        |
        Every now and then, one of Setsuna's siblings will come up and beg for a slice of melon, which your daughter is more than happy to share.
    ] Just sitting and talking like this makes time seem to pass in the blink of an eye... 
    
    Indeed, when you do leave, it's not a conscious thing. One moment you're debating father and daughter alike on the merits of sweet over sour in one's choice of melons, feeling safe in the knowledge that Setsuna is on her way to self-improvement.

rows.original: Keros' shimmering realm welcomes you all the same but something doesn't feel right; particularly due to the small congregation of multi-tailed kitsune awaiting at the gate leading up the sprawling, massive tree. There's not many that stand out... until you spot Azami and Nakano. The two of them stick out like sore thumbs... but no more than the other tall five-tailed kitsune standing before the pair of them with a hooked spear clasped in his right hand and a flask in his left. "You act as if I failed in my quest!" The shorter, polearm-wielding male pokes a finger at Nakano's chiseled chest before swishing the drink haphazardly toward Azami. "All I did-" [silly |Chadzumi |Azami ] catches his wrist and turns it over, the smell of rice wine filling your nostrils. "You did fail, Takahiro." Two fingers extend out from her bow-clasped grip, poking the disheveled man between a pair of thick caterpillar-like black eyebrows. "If it were up to me, your negligence would have been punished by now! You have no idea what's been going on here while you were out prancing!" Annoyed and twisting her grip, Azami simply drops the staggering and baffled man with a motionless turn of the hand. You're shocked, to say the least; it's an impressive enough display to draw the oddly-silent Nakano to pry her fingers from the gourd-carrying soldier... only for Takahiro to collapse to the ground and onto his back with a sour groan. Instead of trying to deal with Azami, his head tilts toward you and draws the angry scout's eyes your way. "I am sorry that you had to see that, [pc.name]." Nakano's voice booms with an almost superior air, releasing Azami and twirling his fingers over. "Our dearest guest here decided to come home drunk and caught one of our most upstanding members at her best while at his worst!" [flags.FLOOF_HAUS_AZAMI_RESOLUTION 1 3 |Azami's scowl darkens at the sight of you — perhaps still sour about your treatment of her underlings and her — yet relents from her berating long enough to fully face you. |Azami's cheeks blossom for a few seconds in embarrassment, sharing a moment of silence before hesitantly clearing her throat and looking to you. ] "Takahiro here is simply returning with yet another failure. Number twenty-two, if memory serves. But I'm not here to take out this... wastrel; I'm heading out to coordinate the others so try not to dawdle with this buffoon for too long." You're sure there'd have been a nice conversation but getting in Azami's path right now would probably just lead to [flags.FLOOF_HAUS_AZAMI_RESOLUTION 1 3 |another |a ] fight. Nakano at least stays... albeit only to poke his foot against the facedown kitsune. But only when the lady-fox is out of earshot does Takahiro move; setting his spear against his shoulder, the kitsune hoists his gourd to his face and turns just enough to look your way. The bushel of five white-tipped black tails sways dismissively toward Azami's fading back just as you get your first good look at the man. Takahiro's lean, athletic build accents his modest height of 5'11" well. His facial features border on androgynous with his jawline well-formed yet smoothing and black hair's bangs parted to crown his narrow eyes and thick eyelashes. Although his hair isn't terribly long in the front, the kitsune's hair is drawn into a high ponytail that sits as tall as black. His massive, white-tipped fox ears appear wider than any of the other kitsune ears around. Yet his attire draws your attention more than anything else; Takahiro wears some kind of sage green, multi-plated armor; compared to the other sets of armor, it's completely unique and more form-fit. Compared to the other kitsune, it seems unnecessarily old with its chipped paint and battle scarring. One might fathom him the sort to be an elite among the [silly |floofs |kitsune ], experienced with countless battles under his belt. Still, you can smell defeat on him; despite his gear's unusual presence, Takahiro looks beaten and weathered. There's no form of injury or outward weakness but instead a sense of unease and a lack of confidence. Apart from the two circles between his eyebrows from Azami's mocking blow, you'd think he was more of a thief than part of this honorable lot. "Nakano-buddy," Takahiro drones, slowly stepping closer to his fellow fox. "It's been a while; you got tall...er." Taka's thumb plugs the gourd's mouth, raising his forearm against Nakano's in a soldier's greeting. The gesture catches Nakano off-guard, yet still, he tries to return it. All of the onlookers left burst into laughter or turn and leave... but Nakano doesn't retreat. With their arms crossing, he deflatedly sighs, jabbing a thumb accusingly over his shoulder at you. "It didn't make me any tougher than them being a little taller. But it's good to hear you actually remembered something while drowning in all your booze!" Nakano pauses, ignoring the black-haired fox's scowl and looking over to you properly. "Let me introduce you to our ally, [pc.name]! They're going to-" Takahiro interrupts him, pushing past Nakano and moving to [pc.isHeight 70 |directly face you |glare you down ]. "Who cares what they're gonna do or who they are! They're weak, aren't they?" The drunk isn't done yet, however; he turns his frustration fully onto you just as he had done before, both of his glassy eyes glaring into yours. "Why the fuck should I care who you are, huh? Ally or not, you should be thankful to stand in my graces and presence! I am the mighty Takahiro, third-born of his line and Keros' seeker and future champion! Why should I care who you are, manuke?"
rows.translation: 凯罗斯那闪烁的光芒依然欢迎着所有人，但总觉得有些不对劲——尤其是那些站在通往那棵巨大树木的入口处的、拥有多条尾巴的狐妖们。其中并没有多少特别引人注目的个体。直到你看到阿扎米和中野，他们两个确实非常显眼……但比起站在他们面前的那位高个子的五尾狐妖来说，他们也算不上特别引人注目。那位五尾狐妖右手握着一把钩状长矛，左手拿着一个水壶。 你说话的样子就好像我完成了任务一样失败了一样！”那个手持短柄武器的男人用手指指着中野那结实的胸膛，然后随意地把饮料扔向了浅美。“我所做的只不过是 [silly |查德兹米 |阿兹米 ]她抓住他的手腕，将其翻转过来，顿时一股米酒的味道扑入了你的鼻孔。 “你确实失败了，贵弘。”她紧握着他的手腕，伸出两根手指，戳了戳那个头发凌乱的男人浓密如毛虫般的黑色眉毛之间。如果由我来做主，你的疏忽早就应该受到惩罚了！你在外面胡闹的时候，根本不知道这里发生了什么！” 阿扎米恼怒地收紧手中的力量，只是轻轻一甩手，就把那个惊愕不已、不知所措的男人甩到了地上。至少可以说，你感到非常震惊；这一幕确实令人印象深刻，甚至让一向沉默寡言的中野也忍不住将注意力从那个拿着葫芦的士兵身上移开……然而，贵弘却突然发出一声闷哼，倒在了地上，面朝下躺着。他没有试图去处理阿扎米的事情，而是将头转向了你，从而将那个愤怒的侦察兵的注意力引向了你。 “很抱歉你不得不看到那一幕[pc.name]中野的声音带着近乎居高临下的语气响起，他松开了绫美，手指轻轻一捻说道：‘我们这里最尊贵的客人喝得酩酊大醉地回来了，正好让我们那位品行端正的成员在最糟糕的状态下被她看到了！ [flags.FLOOF_HAUS_AZAMI_RESOLUTION 1 3 |看到你时，阿扎米的脸色顿时阴沉下来——或许她仍在为你对她的下属以及她本人的恶劣态度而愤愤不平——但最终她还是忍住了责骂，转而完全正面地面对你。 |浅美的脸颊因尴尬而瞬间泛红，两人陷入短暂的沉默，随后她犹豫着清了清嗓子，将目光投向了你。 ] 我是贵弘，又一次带着失败的结果回来了。应该是第二十二次了吧。但我这次来，并不是为了再次面对这个…… 挥霍无度的人我得去协调其他人了，所以别和这个傻瓜浪费太多时间。” 你本来肯定可以进行一段愉快的谈话的，但现在去打扰阿兹米，恐怕只会惹来麻烦[flags.FLOOF_HAUS_AZAMI_RESOLUTION 1 3 |另一个 |a ]打架……至少中野还会留在那里……尽管他只是为了踢那只趴在地上的狐妖。但直到那只狐妖女士听不见他们的谈话后，贵弘才动了。他把长矛架在肩上，那只狐妖则把葫芦举到面前，稍微转过头来看向你的方向。就在你终于有机会仔细观察那个男人时，那一束由五只白色尾端的黑尾鸟组成的队伍，却漫不经心地摇摆着，从亚萨米的背后掠过。 贵弘那结实而充满运动感的体格，使得他那5英尺11英寸的身高显得更加突出。他的面部特征带有几分中性色彩：下颌线条分明且轮廓流畅，一头黑色的头发从前额分开，垂落在他那狭长的眼睛和浓密的睫毛上。虽然他的前额头发并不是特别长，但那只狐妖的头发被扎成了一个高高的马尾，颜色如同黑夜一般漆黑。他那巨大的、尖端呈白色的狐妖耳朵，比其他任何狐妖的耳朵都要宽大。然而，最吸引人注意的还是他的装束——贵弘穿着一套深绿色的多层铠甲；与其他铠甲相比，这套铠甲既独特又贴合身体轮廓。与其他狐妖精相比，它的油漆已经剥落，身上也布满了战斗留下的伤痕，看起来显得格外陈旧。人们可能会认为，它属于那种精英级别的存在[silly |毛茸茸的东西 |狐狸 ]他经历过无数场战斗，积累了丰富的经验。 然而，你依然能从他身上感受到失败的气息；尽管他装备了一些不寻常的武器，但贵弘看起来却显得疲惫不堪。他并没有受到任何伤害，外表上也没有表现出任何虚弱之处，但内心却充满了不安与缺乏自信的情绪。除了因为阿扎米的嘲讽一击而在他眉毛间留下的两道伤痕外，你真会以为他更像是个小偷，而不是这个光荣团体的一员。 “中野兄弟，”贵弘低声说道，一边慢慢走向他的这位狐妖伙伴。好久不见，你长高了不少啊……” 贵弘用拇指堵住葫芦的口，然后将前臂举起来，以士兵礼的方式与中野打招呼。这个动作让中野有些措手不及，但他还是试图回以同样的礼节。在场的所有旁观者都爆发出笑声，或者转身离开了。但是中野并没有退缩。他双臂交叉，沮丧地叹了口气，然后用拇指指着你，责备地说道： “长得比他们高一点，并没有让我变得更强壮。不过，听到你真的还记得这件事，还是挺不错的。某个东西当你沉溺于酒精之中时……”中野停顿了一下，没有理会那只黑发狐妖的怒容，而是认真地转向你，“让我来向你介绍我们的盟友吧。 [pc.name]他们要——” 贵弘打断了他，挤过中野，走了过去。 [pc.isHeight 70 |正对着你 |用目光逼视对方 ]谁他妈在乎他们会做什么，或者他们是谁！他们又弱小又无能，不是吗？” 然而，这个醉汉还没有完；他像之前一样，将所有的愤怒都发泄在了你身上，他那双呆滞的眼睛紧紧地盯着你。“我他妈为什么要在乎你是谁，哼？不管你是不是我的盟友，能得到我的青睐和关注，你就应该感到庆幸！我是强大的贵弘，他这一代家族中的第三个孩子，也是凯罗斯的追寻者，未来的冠军！我为什么要在乎你…… 你是吗，马努克？

Nakano at least stays... albeit only to poke his foot against the facedown kitsune. But only when the lady-fox is out of earshot does Takahiro move; setting his spear against his shoulder, the kitsune hoists his gourd to his face and turns just enough to look your way. The bushel of five white-tipped black tails sways dismissively toward Azami's fading back just as you get your first good look at the man. Takahiro's lean, athletic build accents his modest height of 5'11" well. His facial features border on androgynous with his jawline well-formed yet smoothing and black hair's bangs parted to crown his narrow eyes and thick eyelashes. Although his hair isn't terribly long in the front, the kitsune's hair is drawn into a high ponytail that sits as tall as black. His massive, white-tipped fox ears appear wider than any of the other kitsune ears around. Yet his attire draws your attention more than anything else; Takahiro wears some kind of sage green, multi-plated armor; compared to the other sets of armor, it's completely unique and more form-fit. Compared to the other kitsune, it seems unnecessarily old with its chipped paint and battle scarring. One might fathom him the sort to be an elite among the [silly |floofs |kitsune ], experienced with countless battles under his belt. Still, you can smell defeat on him; despite his gear's unusual presence, Takahiro looks beaten and weathered. There's no form of injury or outward weakness but instead a sense of unease and a lack of confidence. Apart from the two circles between his eyebrows from Azami's mocking blow, you'd think he was more of a thief than part of this honorable lot. "Nakano-buddy," Takahiro drones, slowly stepping closer to his fellow fox. "It's been a while; you got tall...er." Taka's thumb plugs the gourd's mouth, raising his forearm against Nakano's in a soldier's greeting. The gesture catches Nakano off-guard, yet still, he tries to return it. All of the onlookers left burst into laughter or turn and leave... but Nakano doesn't retreat. With their arms crossing, he deflatedly sighs, jabbing a thumb accusingly over his shoulder at you. "It didn't make me any tougher than them being a little taller. But it's good to hear you actually remembered something while drowning in all your booze!" Nakano pauses, ignoring the black-haired fox's scowl and looking over to you properly. "Let me introduce you to our ally, [pc.name]! They're going to-" Takahiro interrupts him, pushing past Nakano and moving to [pc.isHeight 70 |directly face you |glare you down ]. "Who cares what they're gonna do or who they are! They're weak, aren't they?" The drunk isn't done yet, however; he turns his frustration fully onto you just as he had done before, both of his glassy eyes glaring into yours. "Why the fuck should I care who you are, huh? Ally or not, you should be thankful to stand in my graces and presence! I am the mighty Takahiro, third-born of his line and Keros' seeker and future champion! Why should I care who you are, manuke?" "

rows.original:
You throw your sucker-punch so fast it catches Takahiro right between the eyes — exactly where Azami was prodding him moments ago. Both of his ears twitch before his eyes roll back and, like clockwork, his weapon drops from his grip and the kitsune faceplants into the hidden realm's ground hard. Nakano doesn't even seem surprised, slipping over and squatting down to gently pat Takahiro's back.
        
        "He's not going to be happy about that but I don't blame you." His fingers curl gently around Takahiro's straps, hefting him up out of a puddle of drool. "Takahiro might be older but he's always been an outsider because of his drunken temper. One day, maybe he'll cool off on the drinks and not get knocked out his first day back."
        
        Nakano simply hefts the big — but apparently not too heavy — oaf from the ground and gives you a wink farewell, setting off up the tree to likely deposit the poor fool somewhere to sleep himself back to consciousness. But he does make sure to wave farewell, leaving you to think that this isn't unusual for him nor the drunkard.
rows.translation:
你的偷袭速度极快，那一拳正好击中了贵弘的双眼——正是刚才绫美曾经戳他的那个位置。他的两只耳朵都微微一颤，随后双眼翻白，手中的武器也应声掉落，那只狐妖面具就这样重重地摔在了隐藏领域的地面上。中野似乎一点也不感到惊讶，他滑过去蹲下来，轻轻拍了拍贵弘的背。
        
        “他肯定不会高兴的，但我也不怪你。”他的手指轻轻握住贵弘的背带，将他从那一滩口水里拉了出来。贵弘虽然年纪大了些，但因为他那爱喝酒、脾气暴躁的性格，一直都被人视为局外人。也许有一天，他会戒掉酒瘾，不再在第一天回来就喝得酩酊大醉、失去意识吧。”
        
        中野干脆地把那个看起来虽然块头很大，但实际上并不太重的家伙从地上抱起来，冲你眨了眨眼表示再见，然后便把他抱到树上，大概是要把他放在某个地方让他睡一觉，等他清醒过来吧。但他确实会挥手道别，让你觉得这对他来说并不罕见，对那个醉汉来说也是如此。

His booze-stinking breath rolls over you and the kitsune points his drink-holding hand at you with a booming laugh. "I couldn't care what your dumbass thinks anyway! You're not even one of us! You're just an outsider!"

Nakano steps forward but doesn't make it more than that before the cackling drunk's wavy digit pokes your shoulder. The onlooking fox's frown grows alongside Takahiro's boldness.

            "You think you're so tough!? Fighting is easy! Seeking treasures and a bigger purpose is a thousand times more difficult than your puny-brain and weak arms can handle! I er... er... oh right! I think you're [silly|a chicken-fly! No wait... you're... a fried chicken! No... that's... that's not right either...|just another punk nipping at our lord's favor!]"

中野向前迈了一步，但还没来得及采取进一步行动，那个哈哈大笑的醉汉就用他那弯曲的手指戳了戳你的肩膀。在旁观看的狐狸也皱起了眉头，而贵弘的勇气似乎也在逐渐减弱。

            “你以为自己很厉害吗！？打架很容易！但寻找宝藏、追求更崇高的目标，这些事情可比你那弱小的头脑和软弱的四肢所能承受的要困难上千倍！我……我……对了，我觉得你就是[silly|一只飞鸡！不对……你是……一只炸鸡！不……还是不对……|另一个想讨好我们主人的小混混！]"

rows.original:
"..."

                At last, his silence matches your inaction... and his hand drops to his side as if all the fire leaps out of him at once. Nakano's hand gently squeezes Takahiro's shoulder and turns him around, gently shoving him toward the tree. It takes a few stumbles and trips but eventually the drunk makes his way out of sight.
                
                "Sometimes Takahiro can be a handful... especially when you know he's supposedly around the same age as Miss Azami." Nakano's tails twirl behind him and his grin returns, sticking a thumb up your way. "[kiyoko.isFree|Even old ones can be a bit childish though, right?|I guess it's up to you and I to keep things on track around here now, eh [pc.name]?]"
                
                You'd rather not comment; it took everything in you to avoid that turning into a fight. All you came for was to pay everyone a visit; Nakano doesn't mind if you get to your business, does he?
                
                "Nope!" His answer is short and delivered mid-turn, trotting away from you. "I need to make sure Takahiro doesn't get lost anyway! Later!"
                
                Alone at last — or as alone in a realm of Kitsune as you can be — you can't help but feel like this isn't the last time you might run into that drunken trainwreck of a kitsune. Hopefully, he'll have cooled off by then.
rows.translation:
“……”

                终于，他的沉默与你的不作为相互呼应……他的手垂落到身侧，仿佛全身怒火同时熄灭。中野轻轻捏了捏贵弘的肩膀，让他转过身，再轻推着他走向那棵树。醉汉一路踉跄、绊了几次，最终消失在视野之外。
                
                “贵弘有时确实很难应付……尤其是当你知道，他据说和阿兹米小姐差不多年纪的时候。”中野的尾巴在身后旋转，脸上重新浮现笑容，又朝你竖起拇指。“[kiyoko.isFree|不过，年纪大的人也会有点孩子气，对吧？|看来现在得靠你和我来维持这里的秩序了，对吧，[pc.name]？]”
                
                你宁愿不作评论；为了避免事态演变成打斗，你已经竭尽全力。你来这里只是想拜访大家；中野应该不介意你去办自己的事吧？
                
                “当然不介意！”他转身小跑离开，回答简短利落。“反正我也得确保贵弘不会迷路！回头见！”
                
                终于只剩你一人——或者说，在狐妖的领域里已经算是尽可能独处。你不禁觉得，自己以后恐怕还会碰上这个烂醉如泥、一团糟糕的狐妖。希望到那时他已经冷静下来。

rows.original:
Takahiro's lean, athletic build accents his modest height of 5'11" well. His facial features border on androgynous with his jawline well-formed yet smoothing and black hair's bangs parted to crown his narrow eyes and thick eyelashes. Large eyebrows, almost comically so, sit above either eye and narrow at their ends as if they've been painstakingly groomed. Although his hair isn't terribly long in the front, the kitsune's hair is drawn into a high ponytail that sits as tall as black and white-tipped fox ears that appear wider than the other kitsune you've met so far.
    
    Takahiro wears a sage green go-mai dou — or an open-back multi-plated armor vest — over a simple shirt and a pair of black tobi pants. But his true weapon is the large hooked spear either in his hand or on his back depending on his mood. Five fluffy black, white-tipped fox tails swish in unison and a mind of their own. And though he's only wearing a pair of white tabi, a pair of straw sandals are never too far from his side.
    
    [flags.TAKA_FUCKED
        |But you know the important parts of how Takahiro looks; beneath his clothes. Bulging against his trousers is an entire foot of knotted kitsune cock, with a modest sack beneath them holding his unnatural supply of seed. Takahiro's pert butt holds a tight but not virgin pucker.
        |You're not too sure just how big he is but the sizeable bulge of his trousers gives you a hint he's packing at least a pretty moderate-sized pecker. Paired with his androgynous butt, it'd be hard to see him not living up to a man or woman's desires.
    ]
rows.translation:
贵弘那结实而充满运动感的体格，使得他仅有5英尺11英寸的身高显得更加醒目。他的面部特征带有些中性色彩：下颌线条清晰而流畅，一头黑色的头发将前额的头发分开，从而凸显出他那狭长的眼睛和浓密的睫毛。浓密的眉毛几乎有些滑稽，横跨在他的两只眼睛上方，眉梢逐渐变细，仿佛是经过精心打理的。虽然他的前额头发并不是很长，但那只狐妖的头发被扎成了高高的马尾，马尾的高度与它那黑白相间的狐妖耳朵差不多，而那些耳朵看起来比你迄今为止见过的其他狐妖的耳朵要宽一些。
    
    贵弘穿着一件深绿色的护胸甲——这种护甲是开放式结构，由多层金属片制成——里面套着一件普通的衬衫，下身则穿着黑色宽裤。不过，他真正的武器是一支长矛，根据他的心情不同，这支长矛要么被他拿在手中，要么被挂在背上。五根毛茸茸的、尖端呈白色的狐妖尾巴齐刷刷地摆动着，仿佛有着自己的意志。尽管他只穿着一双白色的短袜，但一双草编凉鞋始终陪伴在他的身边。
    
    [flags.TAKA_FUCKED
        |但你知道，贵弘的外表中有些重要的部分——那些隐藏在他的衣服之下。他的裤子里鼓鼓囊囊的，是一整只缠着结的狐妖阴茎，而它的下方还有一个小小的囊袋，用来储存他那异常丰富的精液。贵弘那圆润的臀部虽然紧致，却并非处女之身。
        |你不太确定他的尺寸到底有多大，但他的裤子鼓起的部分明显说明，他的阴茎至少也相当大。再加上他那兼具男性与女性特征的臀部，很难想象他不会满足男女双方的欲望。
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    Takahiro's lean, athletic build accents his modest height of 5'11" well. His facial features border on androgynous with his jawline well-formed yet smoothing and black hair's bangs parted to crown his narrow eyes and thick eyelashes. Large eyebrows, almost comically so, sit above either eye and narrow at their ends as if they've been painstakingly groomed. Although his hair isn't terribly long in the front, the kitsune's hair is drawn into a high ponytail that sits as tall as black and white-tipped fox ears that appear wider than the other kitsune you've met so far.
    
    Takahiro wears a sage green go-mai dou — or an open-back multi-plated armor vest — over a simple shirt and a pair of black tobi pants. But his true weapon is the large hooked spear either in his hand or on his back depending on his mood. Five fluffy black, white-tipped fox tails swish in unison and a mind of their own. And though he's only wearing a pair of white tabi, a pair of straw sandals are never too far from his side.
    
    [flags.TAKA_FUCKED
        |But you know the important parts of how Takahiro looks; beneath his clothes. Bulging against his trousers is an entire foot of knotted kitsune cock, with a modest sack beneath them holding his unnatural supply of seed. Takahiro's pert butt holds a tight but not virgin pucker.
        |You're not too sure just how big he is but the sizeable bulge of his trousers gives you a hint he's packing at least a pretty moderate-sized pecker. Paired with his androgynous butt, it'd be hard to see him not living up to a man or woman's desires.
    ]
    "

    "You wanna talk with me? About what?"

rows.original: [rand |[kiyoko.isFree |[kinu.isInari |"That kid of yours," Takahiro sighs. "She's... a real pain, you know that? She keeps poking those big ears of hers in my business, snooping around my shed. Just because I'm gone for a while doesn't mean brats get to stick around and bug me!" You frown and feel a bit torn; you don't think he has any right to address Kinu that way. What exactly has she been doing that's bugging him? The five-tailed male looks over at the stack of his barrels. He points, in particular, to a tapped one on its own. "She keeps trying to figure out how I make them, that's what! She's at least a hundred years too young to pry her nose into this craft!" |"Your daughter needs to chill out." Takahiro rolls his eyes, sighing and lowering his gourd. It looks like he's suddenly exhausted just bringing this up, his shoulders sagging and the man's gaze falling on the nearby barrels. You think you might have an idea of why, but indulge him: what has Kinu been doing? "Well," he starts, pausing to look back at you. But before he speaks, he takes a quick swig of his beverage. "For starters, she's messing with my business; when I'm back and around, I'm supposed to make more booze. But she keeps trying to make a mess out of me! She rants on and on about how I'm taking Nakano from her or something. That runty foxling and Nakano make a cute couple, I guess, but he drinks of his own volition! That young lady is rowdier than Azami when her tits were still coming in and I called her flat..." ] |"The younger kitsune are always a hic-... hassle." Takahiro sets his booze down on a nearby barrel, recovering his spear and using its length to tap against the stack of barrels. "So get this; I make more booze only whenever I'm around. That's one of my deals with Komari, after all. I do something she deems productive, she lets me continue my dedicated pursuits to Keros. This last time was a bit different but the point of it is that this stuff is how I earn my keep." Taka sets the spear back, both of his ears twitching when his fingers curl around his gourd. "But these kids think it's easy to brew at my level... yet all they ever end up doing is botching it and wasting the extra I make to supplement my thirst. My gourd's swill puts them to shame, but sometimes I like to mix things up. Hard to do that when all these small, two-tailed runts keep messing things up..." ] |Takahiro's ears sink lower, the man reaching up to run his fingers through his lengthy ponytail. It seems like he's searching for the right words, peering off with a glassy-eyed grumble. "Er... well... I guess you know about Azami, right? I bet you didn't know that when we were younger, we were stronger friends than blood is thick." Then why does he fight with her? "I," he starts, pausing and finally lowering his hand. The man returns his gourd to his mouth, drinking a few gulps before lowering it. And then repeating the same set of motions three more times. Noticeably buzzed and tearing up from his rapid drinking, Takahiro finally sets his gourd back down in the hammock beside him. "I didn't want to stick to all the traditions; my form of worshipping Keros is actively pursuing his relics. She said I should help them but... urgh. Azami doesn't understand; my parents followed tradition and amounted to little at all. If it wasn't for Komari giving me a chance, I'd have been some lowly farmer without a purpose. Now? Now I'm a man who's warm-bellied and proud of his job!" The stench of his drink makes it hard to believe him, but arguing with Takahiro about his life choices in this more moody air wouldn't be a wise idea. |"Believe it or not," he starts, shifting back and comfortably shifting his weight onto his tails. "Among the whole village, I'm actually one of the best with spears." Does Takahiro take pride in his spear skills? You never really hear him brag about it, yet this less-than-humble statement reeks of susceptibility. If he's actually that good, why isn't he a warrior instead of running off on treasure hunts or making booze all day? Your kitsune host rubs the back of his head, hiking his thumb back at the wall behind him. "This shed is why; my parents led the efforts making all sorts of drinks for the others. Given I was an only child, roles had to be filled and I have the knowledge for making the best kinds of sake, whiskeys, and all sorts of beverages both local and historical." Among many things, Takahiro's dedication to his ancestry at least makes sense there. But this isn't explaining his spear skills; how and where did he learn them? "Women are taught to use them for home defense, whilst my father was a samurai who specialized in using polearms." Taka points at his spear, accenting the curvature of his weapon's catching spike. "The difference was that he learned to use a traditional yari; my spear can be swung. Given that, my expertise never quite reached the level of a true warrior... until years later, when I began exploring, I bested the best warrior among the scouts and reformed my old man's notes. Beyond his beer recipes, his line of thinking was very old fashioned; this land's weapons are so different in design that even the subtle differences in our spears and theirs make certain techniques or weapon styles better. Keros may be great, but our history is both a blessing and chain; some things must be lost or broken free so that we can truly relish and blossom." That's... oddly poetically put for him. Takahiro immediately ruins it, chugging a few swigs of his gourd and smugly settling one arm over his cuirass' belly. "Pft. Don't get me started on that whole warrior-poet stuff. You're going to turn into that sappy Nakano. Real warriors do diversify their lifestyle... but that mushy poem-writing is far from the true test of a warrior's mettle. Keros wants us pranking, not ad-libbing verses about sakura flowers or young, pretty girls." ]
rows.translation: [rand |[kiyoko.isFree |[kinu.isInari |你家的那个孩子啊，”贵弘叹了口气，“她真的挺让人头疼的，你知道吗？她总爱把她的那对大耳朵伸进我的事情里，还总在我的小屋里翻来翻去。就因为我去了一会儿，并不意味着那些小鬼就可以留在那里打扰我！你皱起了眉头，感到有些纠结——你认为他根本没有权利那样称呼小娟。究竟她做了什么让他如此不满呢？ 那只五尾雄性动物望了一眼自己堆放好的桶子。他特别指出了其中其中一个被敲过的物品。“她一直试图弄清楚我是怎么制作这些东西的，就是这个！她年纪还小得可怜，根本不应该插手这种手艺！ |你女儿需要冷静一下。” 贵弘翻了个白眼，叹了口气，然后放下了手中的葫芦。看来，仅仅提到这件事就已经让他感到疲惫不堪了，他的肩膀耷了下来，目光也落在了附近的那些桶上。你或许自认为知道原因，但就让他继续说吧：小娟这些天都在做些什么呢？ “嗯，”他开始说道，停下来看了你一眼。但在继续说话之前，他先喝了一大口饮料。首先，她扰乱了我的生意安排；等我回来后，本来应该继续生产酒的。但是她总是想把我搞得一团糟！她没完没了地抱怨说我在抢她的中野什么的。那个矮小的狐狸精和中野倒也算是挺配的一对，不过他喝酒完全是自愿的！那个年轻姑娘，甚至在她胸部还没发育完全的时候，就已经比绫美还要吵闹了，当时我还直接叫她“平胸”来着…… ] |那些年幼的狐妖总是会惹一些小麻烦…… 麻烦事贵弘把酒杯放在旁边的桶上，拿回自己的长矛，用矛杆敲了敲那些桶堆。‘听好了，我只有在有空的时候才会酿酒。毕竟，这是我和麻里之间的约定——我做些她认为有意义的事情，她就会允许我继续专注于制作凯罗斯酒。上一次的情况有点不同，但关键在于，这些酒确实是我赚取真是的……” 塔卡将长矛放回原处，手指握住葫芦时，他的两只耳朵都不由得抽动了一下。“但这些孩子们以为，以我的水平来说，酿造这种东西应该很容易……可他们最终总是把事情搞砸，浪费了我额外准备的材料来解渴。我用葫芦酿造的酒让他们都相形见绌，不过有时候我也想换换口味。不过，当这些整天捣乱的小家伙们总是在旁边干扰我的时候，就真的很难做到这一点了…… ] |贵弘的耳朵耷拉得更低了，那个男人伸手捋了捋自己那长长的马尾。他似乎在寻找合适的词语，目光呆滞地嘟囔道：“呃……那个……你应该知道阿扎米吧？我打赌你肯定不知道，在我们年轻的时候，我们的友谊比亲兄弟之间的关系还要深厚。 那么，他为什么还要和她吵架呢？ “我……”他开始说道，停顿了一下，最终还是放下了手。那人将葫芦重新放到嘴边，喝了几口后才将其放下。接着他又重复了这个动作三次。由于喝得太快，他的喉咙明显感到不适，眼泪也开始涌出。最终，贵弘将葫芦放回身旁的吊床上。 我并不想拘泥于所有那些传统……我崇拜凯罗斯的方式，就是积极寻找与他的遗物有关的线索。她说我应该帮助他们，但是……唉。阿扎米根本不明白；我的父母只是遵循了传统，结果什么也没得到。要不是麻里给了我一个机会，我现在恐怕也只是个毫无目标的普通农民罢了。现在吗？现在我已经成为一个对自己的工作充满自豪感的人了！” 不过，他喝的酒散发出的臭味让人很难相信他的话……不过，在这种阴郁的氛围中，与贵弘就他的生活选择争论下去，显然也不是什么明智的做法。 |信不信由你，”他开始说道，同时向后靠了靠，将身体重量舒适地转移到尾巴上，“在整个村庄里，其实我是用长矛最在行的人之一。” 难道贵弘真的为自己的长矛技艺感到自豪吗？你从来没听他夸耀过这一点，然而这种看似谦虚的话语中却透露出一种自豪感。如果他真的那么擅长使用长矛，为什么不去成为一名战士，而不是整天去寻宝或者酿酒呢？ 你的九尾狐宿主挠了挠后脑勺，拇指抵在身后的墙上。“就是这个小屋让我有了这个机会——我的父母负责为其他人准备各种饮品。由于我是独生子，所以必须有人来承担这些任务，而我也具备制作最上等的清酒、威士忌以及各种本地传统饮品的知识。 在很多方面，贵弘对自身祖先传统的执着至少是可以理解的。但这并不能解释他的长矛使用技巧——他是如何、在哪里学会这些技能的呢？ “女性被教导如何使用长矛来进行家庭防御，而我的父亲则是一名专门使用长柄武器的武士。塔卡指着自己的长矛，特别强调了这把武器上那根弯曲的尖刺。‘不同之处在于，他学会了如何使用传统的长矛；而我的长矛是可以挥动的。正因如此，我的技艺永远无法达到真正战士的水平。直到许多年后，当我开始深入探索时，我击败了侦察队中最为出色的战士，并整理完善了我父亲的笔记。除了那些啤酒酿造配方之外，他的思维方式确实显得过于陈旧了——这片土地上的武器在设计上存在着诸多差异，就连我们与他们使用的长矛之间那些细微的差别，也会使得某些战斗技巧或武器使用方式更具优势。凯洛斯或许很棒，但我们的历史既是一种恩赐，也是一道枷锁；有些东西必须被抛弃或摆脱，这样我们才能真正享受到自由与成长带来的乐趣。 用这种方式来形容他，倒也挺有诗意的…… 不过贵弘立刻破坏了这种氛围，他大口喝了几口葫芦里的酒，然后得意洋洋地把一只手臂搭在自己的胸甲上，说道：“哼，别让我开始谈论那些‘战士诗人’之类的东西。不然你会变成那个多愁善感的中野的。真实的战士们确实会多样化自己的生活方式……但那种充满感伤的诗歌创作，远远算不上检验战士真正勇气的方式。凯洛斯希望我们的是开玩笑，而不是即兴创作关于樱花或年轻漂亮女孩的诗句。 ]
