rows.original: [flags.TAKA_TALK_GOURD|an he tell you about his gourd again?|As often as you've seen it, what's the story behind his gourd?] "Easy," Takahiro chuckles. His knuckles wrap tight around the booze-filled container, hoisting it into your view. It looks rather simple and basic, carved and shaped from either a hardened fruit's shell or wood. Whilst you can't determine which it is, its grainy surface curves and dances with enough depth to make you see the slightest outlines of flames. Rather than a traditional cork, it has a cloth-guarded wooden straw poking from its top with a small plug at its end to keep it fresh. "This gourd is Keros' Flask. An artifact made by our god with the sole purpose of playing the most commendable of pranks: getting someone drunk." His thumb pushes the straw up, and he carefully bites it. The cork doesn't come out, yet it raises enough that it allows him to sip a mouthful of booze; once he removes his thumb, you spot the small stopper slip back firmly into place. "It's actually pretty impressive," Takahiro slurs, his five tails all waving in-sync from left to right. "I've never found something made quite like it, yet it's styled just like the carvings from the Old Country. I pulled it outta some crypt about... ten or so years ago, maybe? Back then, my travels took me pretty far south; I ran into some nation of those tiny green goblins and got drafted into some mercenary work. By the time I was wrapping up a small transport job, I found 'em pilfering the place and discovered it among some old king's bones." Graverobbing a magical flask as a mercenary for some nation, despite being a foreigner? That story doesn't make a whole ton of sense. Your kitsune companion waves your idea off, carefully setting the relic back down. "You don't have to believe me, [pc.name]. No one else did. But I gave the notes to Komari that I found with that king. Maybe you can convince her to share them with you sometime; but it's unlikely you will, [pc.ra kitsune|Keros' Champion|friend of ours] or not. That whole affair didn't end well." [flags.TAKA_TALK_GOURD |Yeah, you remember well enough. Does he regret it at all? "No," Taka immediately replies. The confidence in his face and the smirk cements just how honest the statement is for the five-tailed kitsune. "Although, I guess I am curious how it'd have been if I stayed. Komari would have been pissed if I settled down with a cute goblin girl and brought that sort of political trouble our way. That'd be a prank to put a chuckle in Keros' chest though, don't you think?" |What's that supposed to mean? The man looks over at his weapon, grumpily rubbing the back of his head and his right ear. "I er... well, I may or may not have fucked the goblin's princess or chief's daughter. We were too wasted trying out the relic and by the end of it, the whole army was trying to take my tails and hang me by my toes." ]
rows.translation: [flags.TAKA_TALK_GOURD|他又会跟你讲他的葫芦故事吗？|无论你见过多少次，他那个葫芦背后究竟有什么故事呢？] 很简单，”贵弘笑着说道。他的指关节紧紧握住那个装满酒的容器，将它举到你面前。这个容器看起来非常简单朴素，是由某种硬化的果壳或木头雕刻而成的。虽然你无法分辨它究竟是由什么材料制成的，但它那粗糙的表面上布满了复杂的纹理，这些纹理呈现出丰富的层次感，甚至让你仿佛能看到火焰的微弱轮廓。与传统的软木塞不同，这个容器的顶部装着一根用布包裹着的木制吸管，吸管的末端还有一个小塞子，用来保持酒的新鲜度。 这个葫芦就是凯罗斯的酒壶。这是我们的神明制造出来的神器，其唯一用途就是用来玩最有趣、最值得称赞的恶作剧——把别人灌醉。” 他用拇指把吸管往上推了推，然后小心翼翼地咬住吸管。软木塞并没有被拔出来，但吸管被抬高了足够的高度，让他能够喝上一口酒；当他松开拇指时，你会看到那个小塞子又牢牢地回到了原来的位置。 其实挺令人印象深刻的，”贵弘说道，他的五条尾巴同时从左向右摆动着。“我从未见过这样的东西，它的风格和古老国度的雕刻作品一模一样。我是从某个地下室里找到的它。大概是在十多年前吧。那时候，我的旅行路线一直向南延伸，我遇到了那些身形矮小、皮肤呈绿色的哥布林，还被他们招募去从事雇佣兵的工作。当我完成一项运输任务后，发现那些哥布林正在偷窃那里的财物，而那些被偷的东西被藏在一位老国王的骨骸之中。" 作为一个为某个国家效力的雇佣兵，却去盗取一个魔法药剂瓶？这个故事实在让人觉得有些荒谬。 你的九尾狐伙伴轻轻摆了摆手，将那件遗物重新放回原处，说道：“你不必相信我[pc.name]没有其他人这么做过。但我把在那个国王那里找到的那些笔记给了麻里。也许你可以试着说服她，让她把这些笔记分享给你；不过，这个可能性应该不大吧。 [pc.ra kitsune|凯罗斯的冠军|我们的朋友]不管结果如何，那整件事的结局都不太好。 [flags.TAKA_TALK_GOURD |没有，”孝太立刻回答道。他脸上的自信与那抹微笑清楚地表明，对于这只五尾狐来说，这个回答是真诚的。“不过，我确实很好奇，如果我留下来的话，结果会怎样。麻里应该也会愤怒至极要是我和一个可爱的地精女孩结婚了，然后因此惹上了那些政治麻烦，那未免太搞笑了——肯定能让凯罗斯开怀大笑吧，你不觉得吗？ |这到底是什么意思？ 那个男人看了看自己的武器，烦躁地揉着后脑勺和右耳，说道：“呃……其实，我是不是和那个地精的公主或者首领的女儿发生了关系，这也很难说。当时我们都在研究那件神器，喝得烂醉如泥，到最后，整个军队都想要抓住我的尾巴，把我吊起来处死。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.TAKA_TALK_GOURD|an he tell you about his gourd again?|As often as you've seen it, what's the story behind his gourd?] "Easy," Takahiro chuckles. His knuckles wrap tight around the booze-filled container, hoisting it into your view. It looks rather simple and basic, carved and shaped from either a hardened fruit's shell or wood. Whilst you can't determine which it is, its grainy surface curves and dances with enough depth to make you see the slightest outlines of flames. Rather than a traditional cork, it has a cloth-guarded wooden straw poking from its top with a small plug at its end to keep it fresh. "This gourd is Keros' Flask. An artifact made by our god with the sole purpose of playing the most commendable of pranks: getting someone drunk." His thumb pushes the straw up, and he carefully bites it. The cork doesn't come out, yet it raises enough that it allows him to sip a mouthful of booze; once he removes his thumb, you spot the small stopper slip back firmly into place. "It's actually pretty impressive," Takahiro slurs, his five tails all waving in-sync from left to right. "I've never found something made quite like it, yet it's styled just like the carvings from the Old Country. I pulled it outta some crypt about... ten or so years ago, maybe? Back then, my travels took me pretty far south; I ran into some nation of those tiny green goblins and got drafted into some mercenary work. By the time I was wrapping up a small transport job, I found 'em pilfering the place and discovered it among some old king's bones." Graverobbing a magical flask as a mercenary for some nation, despite being a foreigner? That story doesn't make a whole ton of sense. Your kitsune companion waves your idea off, carefully setting the relic back down. "You don't have to believe me, [pc.name]. No one else did. But I gave the notes to Komari that I found with that king. Maybe you can convince her to share them with you sometime; but it's unlikely you will, [pc.ra kitsune|Keros' Champion|friend of ours] or not. That whole affair didn't end well." [flags.TAKA_TALK_GOURD |Yeah, you remember well enough. Does he regret it at all? "No," Taka immediately replies. The confidence in his face and the smirk cements just how honest the statement is for the five-tailed kitsune. "Although, I guess I am curious how it'd have been if I stayed. Komari would have been pissed if I settled down with a cute goblin girl and brought that sort of political trouble our way. That'd be a prank to put a chuckle in Keros' chest though, don't you think?" |What's that supposed to mean? The man looks over at his weapon, grumpily rubbing the back of his head and his right ear. "I er... well, I may or may not have fucked the goblin's princess or chief's daughter. We were too wasted trying out the relic and by the end of it, the whole army was trying to take my tails and hang me by my toes." ] "

rows.original: On one hand he calls himself a 'Seeker' and on the other he works for the others by making various alcohols and drinks while in town. What's his favorite job, exactly, or at least what does he like about his work life? [rand|"As a Seeker, I get a lot of shit when I fail." Takahiro's tone is sobering, yet patiently you wait for him to lean forward and turn a smile. "But... in my few successes, I have brought back relics that connect us evermore to Keros. To me, nothing is more rewarding than seeing the older or true-hearted kitsune rejoice in my discoveries. No matter how big or small."|Takahiro reaches over and pats one of the many barrels. "Seeing the new barrels is pretty cool. Barrels? "Yeah," Takahiro adds, nodding and releasing it. Instead, his hand points at the barrels holding up his bedding. "Old barrels need to be reused for other things, after all; I can take older designs and ones that can't be repaired for new furniture. Waste not, want not."|Rather than immediately answer, Takahiro's brows furrow in thought. Two of his tails coil around his waist, whilst the other three twine into a fine blob of softness. "I... enjoy both of them. Although seeking things in Keros' name is fulfilling, my duties here keep me grounded. Azami and I used to joke about how I'd end up spending all my days here, too, but I'd get torn apart if I didn't take some time off."] At last, he pats his gourd and winks. "But the best perk is this gourd of mine; no matter who you are, being able to get a strong drink at the right time can make any and every night a chance at some alcoholic-fueled fucking. It helps with either job, too, since I can give everyone a drink from mere water."
rows.translation: 一方面，他自称是一名“探索者”；另一方面，在城镇里，他通过制作各种酒精饮料来为他人服务。那么，他真正最喜欢的工作是什么呢？或者说，他究竟喜欢自己工作生活中的哪些方面呢？ [rand|作为一名探索者，我获得了很多当我失败的时候，我会觉得一切都毫无意义。”贵弘的语气十分严肃，但人们还是会耐心地等待他继续说下去。这时，他微微倾身，脸上露出了笑容：“不过……在我为数不多的成功经历中，我确实找到了一些能够让我们与凯罗斯建立更紧密联系的遗物。对我来说，没有什么比看到那些年长或者心地善良的狐族人为我的发现而感到高兴更让我有成就感的了。无论这些发现有多么微小。|贵弘伸手拍了拍那些桶中的一个。“看到这些新桶真是太棒了。” “桶？” “对，”贵弘点头说道，然后松开了手。他的手指指向那些用来放置他的被褥的桶，“毕竟，旧桶应该被重新利用起来；那些设计老旧或者无法修复的桶，我可以把它们改造成新家具。浪费就是没有得到。|贵弘并没有立即回答，而是皱起眉头陷入了思考。他的两条尾巴缠绕在腰间，另外三条则盘绕成了一团柔软的团状物。 “我……两者都挺喜欢的。虽然以凯罗斯的名义去追求那些目标确实很有意义，但在这里履行我的职责也让我感到很有成就感。我和亚纱美以前还开玩笑说，说不定有一天我也会在这里度过所有的日子，但如果不去做这些事，我就会感到内心很不安一些请休假吧。] 最后，他拍了拍自己的葫芦，眨了眨眼说道：“但最棒的好处就是这个葫芦了；无论你是谁，只要能在合适的时候喝到一杯烈酒，那么每一个夜晚都有可能变得充满欢乐与激情。这对任何工作也都很有帮助，因为只要用普通的水，我也能让大家喝到酒。

rows.original: "... Really?" Takahiro's good mood goes right to shit, grabbing his gourd and shaking it at you. "You are actually going to tell me I have a problem? Fuck off and stick your dick in a pile of reeds!" You didn't- Takahiro grabs his weapon, standing up and snarling. "Leave! Now!! Or I'll make sure you're drinking medicinal potions through a straw!" Whether or not you want to fight, this isn't the time or place. [pc.isDK |You roll your eyes |You sigh and relent ], raising your hands and backing out of his shack. You can't believe his reaction was that intense but fixing his drinking habit isn't going to be something you can do so easily; you need to look out for chances to get someone to help you out.
rows.translation: ……真的吗？”贵弘的好心情立刻荡然无存，他抓起自己的葫芦，朝你晃了晃。你们到底想告诉我我有什么问题吗？滚开，去把你的鼻子塞进一堆芦苇里吧！” “你并没有……” 贵弘抓起武器，站起身来，怒吼道：“走开！现在！否则，我就让你非得用吸管喝那些药水不可！” 不管你愿不愿意打架，现在都不是合适的时候和地点。 [pc.isDK |你翻了个白眼。 |你叹了口气，最终还是让步了。 ]你举起手，走出了他的小屋。你简直无法相信他的反应会如此激烈，不过要改掉他的饮酒习惯显然不是一件容易的事；你需要寻找机会，让别人来帮助你。

rows.original:
[flags.TAKA_DRINKS 0 1 2 3
        |"Ha! You want to drink with me?" Takahiro's smile grows, hastily readying his gourd. "Well then, come here! Take a sip!"

        The kitsune reaches beneath his hammock and fishes out two wooden cups, balancing them masterfully in his palm. Your gracious host feeds one of them a healthy shot's worth of booze, letting it swirl and swish yet not spilling a drop. After flooding the second with a similar amount, Takahiro sets the gourd down in his lap and plucks one of the cups out, passing it to you.
        
        "Thanks," you chime, studying the cup for a moment before raising it. "Anything you'd like to drink to?"
        |"Alright," you [pc.mf|chuckle|giggle]. "What are we toasting to this time?"
        |"Ha!" You shuffle side-to-side, yet catch yourself on the nearby barrel. "Whaddaya... say... we toast to, Takabiro?"
    ]
    
    "[rand|To Azami's fine ass!|[flags.KIYOKO_FUCKED|To your girl's health! May she have many pregnancies!|To the future of the den's ladies!]|To Keros' favor! We pranked, then drank!|How about to Komari's longevity?" Takahiro's smile fades a tad. "Without her... well, no one would be here, right?|Beyond the Old Country and to the colony's future!|All of the people we've lost!" His words started as cheer but you see him realize how that sounds instantly. "Er... that we've lost time to fuck. Or cherish. Fuck it, you get the point!|To Miko's massive tits! Damn treasures that they are!|May our swords and wit stay sharp, so no one bests us!|[kiyoko.isFree|To your daughter's future! Let's hope she marries a keeper!|To your future! Be well and be merry!]|Let's toast to more booze! Drink ourselves under the barrel!|To the heavens above and the Emperor afar! Drink!|Gathering coin, to slip in Kohaku's shirt! How else will we get her to let us fuck her silly?|To a fine harvest! The better the grain, the better the brew!|To Yuushio! One day, I'll get her to let me drink in her onsen!]"
    
    [flags.TAKA_DRINKS 0 2 3
        |Both of you lift your cups and chug down your shots; neither of you stops until they're empty, lowering the empty vessels. Takahiro's face flushes red, smirking and bonking your wooden glasses together.

        "Not bad!" The kitsune's tails swirl merrily, reaching his hand out beneath your emptied drink. You drop it into his palm, feeling all the alcohol buzzing in your head in seconds; thankfully you're not too ruined by it, yet the strength of its quality definitely has you rocking back and forth.
        
        "Y-Yeah," you wheeze, finally steadying yourself. "You drink some strong stuff!"
        
        Unsurprisingly, Takahiro sets the cups down on the nearby barrel. "Well yeah; anything weaker wouldn't even work on me!"
        |The pair of you down your drinks, but you feel the drink hit no differently than before. You lower the drink and smile... but when you look at where Takahiro was, you don't see him.

        Instead, Takahiro is facedown on his hammock with his tails splayed out over his back and legs like a blanket. His cup lies on the floor nearby, empty and circling around on its rim.
        
        "Nn," Takahiro grumbles, peeking out of the corner of his eye. "S-Ssssorry. Keros' gourd... makes it... hit har... when I drink... too man-"
        
        You smile and set your cup down, watching Takahiro drift into a liquor induced slumber without even finishing his statement. You're just glad that it somehow doesn't seem to be affecting you too greatly. For now, he's out of it and needs time to sleep some of this off. After two hours or so, Takahiro should bounce back... if he doesn't immediately start drinking or sleep all day.
    ]

        那只狐狸从他的吊床下面拿出了两个木杯，熟练地将它们稳稳地握在手中。你那位慷慨的主人给其中一个杯子倒满了适量的酒，让酒在杯中晃动却一滴也没有溢出来。接着，他又给第二个杯子倒了同样多的酒，然后将葫芦放在自己的腿上，取出一个杯子递给了你。
        
        谢谢，”你说道，仔细端详着那杯饮料片刻，然后才将其举到嘴边。“你想喝点什么吗？

        “不错嘛！那只九尾狐的尾巴欢快地摆动着，它伸出手来，接住了你喝空后的杯子。你把杯子放在它的掌心里，瞬间，酒精的作用让你的头脑变得昏沉起来；幸好，这种影响还没有让你完全失去理智，不过这种酒的劲头确实让你摇摇晃晃地站不稳了。

        |你们俩喝下了饮料，但感觉饮料带来的效果和以前没什么不同。你放下杯子，微微一笑……然而当你看向贵弘刚才所在的位置时，却发现他不见了。

        取而代之的是，贵弘面朝下躺在吊床上，他的尾巴像毯子一样铺在背部和双腿上。他的杯子就放在附近的地板上，里面什么都没有，杯子边缘还在不停地转动着。
        
        “嗯……”贵弘嘟囔着，用眼角余光瞥了一眼。“对……对不起。是凯洛斯的葫芦……导致我喝的时候……杯子会不停地晃动……真的……
        
        你微笑着放下杯子，看着贵弘在酒精的作用下渐渐陷入沉睡，他甚至都没有说完自己想说的话。你只是庆幸，这种影响似乎并没有对你造成太大的影响。目前来说，他需要时间来睡一觉，让这些酒精的影响消退掉。大约两个小时后，贵弘应该就能恢复过来了……前提是他不会立刻开始喝酒，或者一整天都睡懒觉。
    ]

Your gracious host feeds one of them a healthy shot's worth of booze, letting it swirl and swish yet not spilling a drop. After flooding the second with a similar amount, Takahiro sets the gourd down in his lap and plucks one of the cups out, passing it to you.
        
        "Thanks," you chime, studying the cup for a moment before raising it. "Anything you'd like to drink to?"
        |"Alright," you [pc.mf|chuckle|giggle]. "What are we toasting to this time?"
        |"Ha!" You shuffle side-to-side, yet catch yourself on the nearby barrel. "Whaddaya... say... we toast to, Takabiro?"
    ]
    
    "[rand|To Azami's fine ass!|[flags.KIYOKO_FUCKED|To your girl's health! May she have many pregnancies!|To the future of the den's ladies!]|To Keros' favor! We pranked, then drank!|How about to Komari's longevity?" Takahiro's smile fades a tad. "Without her... well, no one would be here, right?|Beyond the Old Country and to the colony's future!|All of the people we've lost!" His words started as cheer but you see him realize how that sounds instantly. "Er... that we've lost time to fuck. Or cherish. Fuck it, you get the point!|To Miko's massive tits! Damn treasures that they are!|May our swords and wit stay sharp, so no one bests us!|[kiyoko.isFree|To your daughter's future! Let's hope she marries a keeper!|To your future! Be well and be merry!]|Let's toast to more booze! Drink ourselves under the barrel!|To the heavens above and the Emperor afar! Drink!|Gathering coin, to slip in Kohaku's shirt! How else will we get her to let us fuck her silly?|To a fine harvest! The better the grain, the better the brew!|To Yuushio! One day, I'll get her to let me drink in her onsen!]"
    
    [flags.TAKA_DRINKS 0 2 3
        |Both of you lift your cups and chug down your shots; neither of you stops until they're empty, lowering the empty vessels. Takahiro's face flushes red, smirking and bonking your wooden glasses together.

        "Not bad!" The kitsune's tails swirl merrily, reaching his hand out beneath your emptied drink. You drop it into his palm, feeling all the alcohol buzzing in your head in seconds; thankfully you're not too ruined by it, yet the strength of its quality definitely has you rocking back and forth.
        
        "Y-Yeah," you wheeze, finally steadying yourself. "You drink some strong stuff!"
        
        Unsurprisingly, Takahiro sets the cups down on the nearby barrel. "Well yeah; anything weaker wouldn't even work on me!"
        |The pair of you down your drinks, but you feel the drink hit no differently than before. You lower the drink and smile... but when you look at where Takahiro was, you don't see him.

        Instead, Takahiro is facedown on his hammock with his tails splayed out over his back and legs like a blanket. His cup lies on the floor nearby, empty and circling around on its rim.
        
        "Nn," Takahiro grumbles, peeking out of the corner of his eye. "S-Ssssorry. Keros' gourd... makes it... hit har... when I drink... too man-"
        
        You smile and set your cup down, watching Takahiro drift into a liquor induced slumber without even finishing his statement. You're just glad that it somehow doesn't seem to be affecting you too greatly. For now, he's out of it and needs time to sleep some of this off. After two hours or so, Takahiro should bounce back... if he doesn't immediately start drinking or sleep all day.
    ]

rows.original: Between the two of you, there can be only one superior drinker; you demand Takahiro to accept a challenge... a proper drink-off! Your enthusiastic air does wonders for the kitsune's sobering demeanor, two of his tails bristling the others whilst Takahiro clutches his gourd firmly. "Oh? Do you actually think you can drink me out? I've gone through entire barrels before! The only way it'd be fair..." Takahiro raises the small container, leaning in and offering it to you. "We'll need to make a deal," he laughs. "But if I win, I'm going to definitely play a prank on you. And I'm sure you know our kind is a bit more... sexually thinking, mm?" [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |And if you win, you get electrum coins? "Of course," Takahiro matter-of-factly quips. You watch him pluck free a pouch, setting it on the nearby barrel supporting his hammock. "It's only right that we use the same terms!" |Fine, whatever. And if you win? "You need coin as an adventurer, right?" Takahiro reaches over to the barrel nearby, sliding a hand behind it and groping around. After a moment, he sits upright and drops a coin bag on the barrel beside him. "If you win, you can take some of my profit from the last sale I had." ] You flash your own excited [pc.isDK |smirk |smile ], yet the foxling hastily lifts his free hand to stop you. "Before we drink, though... you mustn't back out. If you lose and don't pay up, I'll allow you to leave... but only a real [pc.mf |man |woman ] upholds their end of the deal. I'd never short you the coinage you're owed, so don't short me. If that all sounds good, then let's get to it!"
rows.translation: 你们两个当中，只能有一个人是真正的酒鬼；你们要求贵弘接受一场挑战……一场真正的酒斗！ 你们这种热情的态度，让这只狐妖原本清醒的态度也变得有些松动了。它的两条尾巴都竖了起来，而贵弘则紧紧地握着他的葫芦。 哦？你真以为你能把我喝醉吗？我以前可是喝过整桶酒的！要想公平的话……” 贵弘举起那个小容器，凑近你来递给你。 “我们得先达成一个协议，”他笑着说。但要是我赢了，我肯定要捉弄你一下。而且我相信你也很清楚，我们这类人就是有点…… 性方面地在思考什么呢，嗯？ [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |那么如果你赢了，就能得到electrum硬币吗？ “当然可以，”贵弘理所当然地回答道。你看到他取出一个小袋子，把它放在支撑他吊床的桶子上。“使用相同的奖励名称才是公平的嘛！ |好吧，随便你。那如果你赢了呢？ “作为冒险者，你肯定需要硬币吧？”贵弘伸手去拿旁边那个桶，把手伸到桶后面摸索了一会儿。过了一会儿，他坐直身子，把一个装着硬币的袋子放在旁边的桶上。“如果你赢了，就可以拿走我上一次交易所得的一部分利润。 ] 你兴奋地亮出了自己的东西。 [pc.isDK |露出得意的笑容 |微笑 ]然而，那只小狐妖急忙抬起它空着的那只手来阻止你。 “不过，在我们喝酒之前……你绝对不能反悔。如果你输了却不付钱，我就允许你离开……但前提是你必须是真正的[pc.mf |男人 |女性 ]请务必履行你们在协议中承担的义务。我绝对不会拖欠你们应得的报酬，所以也请你们不要拖欠我。如果这些条件都没有问题，那我们就开始吧！

rows.original: Much to the fox's amusement, Takahiro's eyes glint at your acceptance. "I see! Then let's get to it! You versus me: the Seeker teaching the outsider what it means to really praise Keros!" Takahiro's open gourd dips low over the pair of cups; [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |just like before, both of the containers get filled up to their brims and topped off. Takahiro corks the gourd and sets it down. The kitsune slides your drink with enough force it nearly topples over the edge of the barrel and to the floor below. "Pick it up, then! I'm going to run you down so hard you end up under the floor drunk off your ass!" |although he never shares the gourd with others, this time he fills your glass whole before topping up his own mug. "Let me remind you," he chuckles, gently corking the vessel once both were full-up. "This stuff isn't like any booze you'll drink outside of here. This stuff? This stuff converts limitlessly, changing so that it always hits someone as hard as the first drink. People who are super tough have a good tolerance... but people who are weak? You'll never be able to train your gut to conquer it." ] Taking your own mug is a no-brainer; you took his challenge on and no matter what, you're not backing down now. [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |This time, you know what to expect. |How bad could it really be, anyway? ] "To Keros!" The boozemaster raises it, clinking their wood just hard enough to sprinkle the pair of you in the magical liquor. [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |Takahiro's drunk-switch flicks, the predatory grin on his face looking hungrier and thirstier than [flags.KIYOKO_FUCKED |Kiyoko |Miko ]. |Unlike his normal demeanor, something changes; Takahiro's presence grows almost suffocatingly, all of his tails whipping with a sudden brimming energy. ] "To Keros! Kanpai!" Both of you quickly raise and start drinking; rather than some mere swill, his magical mixture goes down easier than any drink you've ever had. Its smell is perfect, its texture mouthwatering, and the aftertaste making you gasp in shame. You lower the mug and see Takahiro's gourd popped open again without any need to ask. No time wasting in his world, he fills both cups in seconds with an insane accuracy so that lifting it again doesn't spill a drop. One of his tails float into view and wrap around your arm, giving him ample time to hook his arm around yours and bring both of you closer together. The still-relatively sober man's eyes meet yours, his gourd-holding hand flicking the bottom of your glass. You nearly fall forward but catch yourself on the barrel, yet Taka dips his head so his furry ears bar your vision and he can get close to his drink. "Kanpai!" When he chugs and leans back, you hastily follow suite. "Kanpai! But can't you stay still!?" More of his tails surge forward and Taka stands up, the instant you finish swallowing immediately gifted with a refill. "Staying still? Haven't you ever drank with a son of a warrior!?" Even though it's been merely two drinks, this one hits you in perfect sync with the swirling hum of drink hitting the bottom of the mug. That moment from before seems like nothing now that Takahiro's standing and all of his tails are extended; your host and challenger seems almost twice the size and more akin to the visage of Nakano. It's like the mere act of fighting you in this drinking contest has unleashed his innermost potential or talents, riling up the devilish desire of a glutton contesting his most prized sin. [pc.cunningRange 0 66 |[pc.toughnessRange 0 70 |Fear tugs at you, leaving you snared in his steadily more feral and wild presence. Even if you wanted to, you can't possibly stop him from refilling your mug. |Takahiro might look tough, but you are the champion Keros needs right now. You grab the oppressive fox's collar, gently shaking him back while he fills your drink. Some of the booze spatters to the floor below, yet Takahiro doesn't notice amidst preparing the next round. ] |Keros' trickery is lulling you into a sense of prank potential and making him seem insurmountable. Toughness isn't any part of this, but the mastery comes from keeping calm. Takahiro is shaking while pouring: you simply angle your cup while he pours, playing the simple prank of merely not getting the same amount in this round. ] Right now, nothing is as important as keeping him drinking until the very end of this; the winner will be the [pc.cunningRange 0 66 |[pc.toughnessRange 0 70 |with the best luck |the toughest gut ] |the prankster god's blessing ]. "Bottoms up," you [pc.cunningRange 0 66 |[pc.toughnessRange 0 70 |grumble |confidently [pc.mf |laugh |giggle ] ] |coyly reply ]. "Warrior!" Clanks of wood-on-wood seal his agreement, yet this time the frenzied kitsune sits down and raises the mug with a smirk. "Banzai, [pc.name]! Time to drink ourselves blind!"
rows.translation: 令狐妖感到十分有趣的是，贵弘在听到你同意后，眼中闪过一丝光芒。“明白了！那我们就开始吧！你和我对决：寻找者向这个外来者展示‘真正含义’是什么真的赞美凯罗斯！” 贵弘手中的敞口葫芦在两个杯子上方低低地悬着； [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |就像之前一样，两个容器都被装得满满的，然后还被倒满了液体。贵弘把葫芦的盖子拧紧，放了下来。而那只狐狸推倒你的饮料时，用力之大，差点让饮料从桶边溢出来，掉到下面的地板上。 “那你就把它捡起来吧！我可要把你打得晕头转向，让你醉得躺在地板上呢！ |虽然他从不与他人分享这壶酒，但这次他在给自己倒满酒之前，先把你杯中的酒也倒满了。 “让我提醒你一下，”他笑着说道，等两人的杯子都装满了酒后，他轻轻地把壶盖拧上。“这种酒和你在外面喝的任何酒都不一样。这个这种东西可以无限地转化，其形态会不断变化，但每次摄入时，对人体的影响总是和第一次饮用时一样强烈。那些身体素质极佳的人，对这种东西的耐受性很强……但那些体弱的人呢？你永远无法训练自己的肠胃来适应它。 ] 自己拿杯子这件事根本不需要考虑——你已经接受了他的挑战，现在无论如何都不会退缩了。 [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |这一次，你们应该知道会发生什么了。 |不管怎样，情况能有多糟糕呢？ ]为了凯罗斯！” 酒馆老板举起了酒杯，轻轻一碰，那美妙的酒液便洒在了你们两人身上。 [flags.TAKA_DRINKOFF |贵弘在醉酒状态下做出的那些动作，他脸上那副贪婪的笑容，显得比以往任何时候都要更加饥渴[flags.KIYOKO_FUCKED |清子 |米可 ]。 |与他平时的表现不同，这次似乎有些不同变更贵弘的存在感几乎让人感到窒息，他的所有尾巴都突然充满了能量，剧烈地摆动着。 ] 去凯洛斯干杯！” 你们俩立刻举杯开始饮酒。与他那些普通的饮品不同，他调配的这种魔法混合物入口即化，比你喝过的任何东西都要顺口。它的香气令人陶醉，口感令人垂涎，而余味更是会让你忍不住惊叹不已。你低下杯子，无需询问就看到贵弘的葫芦再次自动裂开。在他的世界里，没有浪费时间这种概念——他以惊人的精准度在几秒钟内就倒满了两个杯子，这样再次举起杯子时，一滴酒都不会洒出来。他的一条尾巴浮现在视野中，缠绕在你的手臂上，这让他有足够的时间将自己的手臂也搭在你的手臂上，让你们俩的距离变得更近了一些。那个仍然还算清醒的男子与你的目光相遇，他手中拿着葫芦，轻轻敲打着你的酒杯下装。你差点向前栽倒，但及时抓住了酒桶才稳住了身体。然而，塔卡却低下了头，他那毛茸茸的耳朵挡住了你的视线，这样他就能更靠近自己的酒杯了。 干杯！” 当他大口喝下酒然后向后仰靠时，你也急忙跟着做了同样的动作。“干杯！但你能不能别动啊！？” 他的尾巴又猛地向前摆动了几下，塔卡立刻站了起来。就在你刚喝完酒的那一刻，他又递来了新的酒杯。“别动？你难道从来没有和真正的武士一起喝酒过吗！？ 虽然只喝了两杯酒，但这杯酒的滋味却与酒液落入杯底的那一瞬间所产生的漩涡般的声音完美地同步了。现在，当贵弘站立起来，他的所有“尾巴”都伸展开来时，之前发生的那一幕似乎已经变得微不足道了；你的主人兼挑战者，此刻看起来几乎有原来的两倍大，而且他的面容也更加像中野了。仿佛仅仅是因为参加了这场饮酒比赛与你较量，他就释放出了自己内心深处的潜能与天赋，那种渴望大吃特吃的欲望也被彻底激发了出来——这简直就像是在与自己最难以克服的恶习作斗争。 [pc.cunningRange 0 66 |[pc.toughnessRange 0 70 |恐惧不断地牵引着你，使你陷入他那日益狂野、不可控的力量之中。即使你想要反抗，也根本无法阻止他继续“填满”你的内心。 |贵弘虽然看起来很强硬，但实际上你这些正是凯洛斯现在所需要的英雄。你抓住那只令人窒息的狐狸的脖子，轻轻摇晃它，同时它也在为你倒酒。有些酒液溅到了下面的地板上，但贵弘在准备下一轮酒水时根本没有注意到这些。 ] |凯罗斯的诡计让你误以为他一定会耍一些恶作剧，从而让他看起来仿佛不可战胜。其实，真正的关键并不在于强硬，而在于保持冷静。贵弘在倒酒的时候都在颤抖，而你只需要在他在倒酒的时候稍微调整杯子的角度，就能轻松地完成这个简单的恶作剧——让这一轮倒出的酒量不一样而已。 ]目前，没有什么比让他一直保持清醒、坚持到最后更重要的了；因为最终的胜者将会是[pc.cunningRange 0 66 |[pc.toughnessRange 0 70 |祝你好运 |最坚强的意志 ] |恶作剧之神的祝福 ]干杯，”你说。 [pc.cunningRange 0 66 |[pc.toughnessRange 0 70 |抱怨 |自信地[pc.mf |笑 |轻笑 ] ] |羞涩地回答 ]。 "战士！木头相互碰撞发出的声响象征着他的承诺得到了确认，然而这一次，那只疯狂的狐妖却坐了下来，带着一丝笑意举起了杯子。万岁！， [pc.name]是时候喝得烂醉如泥了！

rows.original: After that, everything turns into a blur. Each moment you're either drinking, watching him pour, or drinking some more; Takahiro leaves you no time to think of anything but the sensory overload from the magical beverage or the humming in your head as the drink plasters you. Neither of you get a chance to slow down, either, since Takahiro's fervor only grows with each completed chugging. All of his tails fluff out, both ears puff out slightly, and the disheveled drinker's face burns brighter and rosy with the simulated warmth in his belly. You can't see yourself but now that you're seeing multiples of Takahiro, you know you must be quite similar. Even the mere hovel of a drinking storage seemed like a raving party, each clink of the mugs resounding like a chorus dispatched by the gods. [silly |"Doya hear it," Takahiro slurs, one of his eyelids fluttering as he pours your next drink. "Doya hear the liquor, [pc.name]?" rows.original: Staring up at the branches, you get a tad lost in the vast sea of petals. It's hard to appreciate the beauty of the tree that the kitsune colony lives in but there's something about this quiet situation that lets you truly enjoy everything. [var0|Including one of the petals breaking free of the mass. You snap around just in time to see both Takahiro and Nakano turn to face each and try pushing the other's arm. Their arms tense and you can see both of their muscles flex. As far as physique, Nakano should be the instant winner... but Takahiro actually holds him upright, much to both your and Nakano's surprise. "Bastard," Nakano curses. "How the hell are-" Before Nakano can finish his sentence, Takahiro nearly drops his gourd... and simultaneously turns his attention to grab the wrist-bound container. That single moment of drunken attention lapse results in a scene so fantastically awful that no one would believe it unless they saw it. Nakano throws Takahiro; their arms swing with enough force that Takahiro's hand hits the barrel and his arm stiffens up, rolling him backwards and to the side. Not just him but the barrel skids out and rolls the other direction whilst the drunkard tumbles, pulling loose of Nakano's grip and passing you. And he just keeps going, bouncing and falling down a small incline into a nearby irrigation ditch. If not for the five tails that all umbrella out and cushion the impact at its bottom, it'd not only have been utterly embarrassing but outright dangerous. However it ends, though, the tell-tale drunken grin makes you doubt that Takahiro felt even a drop of it. Nakano gets up and rushes over to the ditch, staring worryingly at Takahiro. "Taka, are you-" "Phew," the drunk chuckles. He raises his gourd for Nakano to see. "Almost dropped the gourd!" The samurai sighs and grabs his sword's hilt, carefully stepping down into the ditch and extending a hand. "Yeah, yeah. You lost so I hope it was worth it." Neither of the men seem anywhere near as intense but you can't help notice Nakano's relief turns back into a layer of disbelief once Takahiro is on his feet. They walk back to the arm wrestling zone, Takahiro plopping back onto the pillow whilst Nakano goes to fetch the tossed barrel. It had rolled its way into the street and annoyed quite a few people, yet a quick apology and bow of Nakano's head mostly smooths things over. Sometimes seeing someone's obsession in drinking is worth the wait. |Watching the treetops so diligently, however, you feel lost in the scale of this colony. So lost, in fact, it takes you a while longer to notice one of the petals drifting through the air. "Bastard! How the hell are-" Nakano's cursing isn't the only thing that takes you off-guard, though; seconds after, a loud bang makes you jump and spin around. Takahiro isn't sitting down but sailing toward you, forcing you to dive out of the way. Whilst you catch yourself, the drunkard tumbles and crashes a second time in one of the nearby irrigation ditches. Taka uses his tails to cushion the impact, yet his blinks and gourd-carrying hand shaking betray just how unexpected that all was. Nakano rushes past you with a worried frown and hilt-in-hand. "Takahiro! Are you okay!?" [rand|Admittedly, it's no surprise that Takahiro frowns. "I'd be better if you hadn't thrown me. I nearly dropped Keros' gourd! It might be near indestructible but what if I lost it!?" "Who cares about the gourd?" Nakano angrily barks, yet reigns his rage in with a grumble. "What happens if you get hurt, moron?" Takahiro's frown fades for a small smirk. Instantly, Nakano curses. "Gods, Takahiro! A prank!? Really!?"|"I'm fine," Takahiro sighs. The gourd dangles on its cord whilst he reaches a hand out expectantly. When Nakano takes it, the drunkard gets up and brushes himself off momentarily before letting his tails continue the dust-down. "Trying to kill me with that killer arm of yours?" "Of course not." The samurai lets go of his blade's hilt, raising a hand to massage his temples. It takes Takahiro a few sips before Nakano composes himself, grumbling while he grabs Takahiro's shoulder. "But stop worrying so much about that damn drink of yours." ] Although the pair of them can argue, it's at least good to know Takahiro isn't entirely without friends among the village's head figures. [flags.TAKAHIRO_NAKANO_SEEN|If not for having seen this bout before, you might think Takahiro got punched instead of lost in an arm wrestling bout.|Arm wrestling normally doesn't send someone flying, though; you're not terribly sure whether or not Takahiro got punched instead of merely lost so badly he went flying.] For now, though, they set about cleaning up the mess and recovering the barrel that had been the base for their contest. You, on the other hand, leave them to it so you can get back to your business. |Yet after a few minutes, there is still nothing; none of the petals above are falling. Do you keep waiting and watching? ]
rows.translation: 仰望着那些树枝，你仿佛迷失在了这片繁花似海的景象之中。虽然很难完全领略这只狐族群体所栖息的这棵树的美丽，但正是这种宁静的氛围，让你能够真正欣赏到这一切。 [var0|其中一片花瓣从花丛中脱落了。 你及时转过身去，看到贵弘和中野都转过身来面对对方，试图推对方的胳膊。他们的手臂紧绷着，你可以看到他们的肌肉都在用力收缩。就体力而言，中野应该是立刻就能获胜的人……但贵弘竟然让他站稳了，这让你们俩都感到非常惊讶。 “混蛋，”中野咒骂道，“你到底是怎么做到的—— 在中野还没说完这句话之前，贵弘差点把他的葫芦掉在地上……同时，他也注意到了那个绑在手腕上的容器。那一瞬间的分心，导致发生了一幕如此荒诞可笑的事情，除非亲耳所见，否则根本没人会相信。 中野抛出贵弘；他们的手臂挥动的力量如此之大，以至于贵弘的手撞到了枪管上，他的手臂也因此僵硬起来，导致他向后侧翻滚而去。不仅仅是贵弘，那根枪管也随着他的动作滑出了原位，朝着另一个方向滚去，而那个醉汉则摔了个四脚朝天，松开了中野的手，从你身边滚了过去。 他就这样继续着，沿着一个小斜坡弹跳着往下掉，最终掉进了附近的一条灌溉沟里。要不是他那五条尾巴及时展开，缓冲了他落地的冲击力，那么这次摔倒不仅会让他尴尬至极，甚至还会十分危险。不过，无论结果如何，他那醉醺醺的笑容实在让人怀疑，贵弘是否真的感到了任何疼痛。中野立刻站起来，冲到沟边，忧心忡忡地望着贵弘。 孝，你是不是——” “呼，”醉汉笑着说道。他举起手中的葫芦让中野看，“差点把葫芦掉掉了！” 武士叹了口气，握住剑柄，小心翼翼地走下沟渠，伸出手去。“好吧，好吧。既然你输了，希望这是值得的吧。 这两个男人看起来都没有那么激动人心，但你不得不注意到，当贵弘站起来的时候，中野的松了一口气，却又立刻转为难以置信的表情。他们走回了摔跤区，贵弘重新坐回了垫子上，而中野则去把那个被扔到街上的桶捡回来。那个桶滚到了街上，惹恼了很多人，不过中野迅速道了歉并鞠了一躬，这才让事情平息下来。 有时候，看到某人对饮酒的痴迷，这种等待也是值得的。 |然而，当你如此专注地观察那些树梢时，你会发现自己完全迷失在这个群体的规模之中。 事实上，这种迷失感如此强烈，以至于你过了好一会儿才注意到有一片花瓣正在空气中飘动。 混蛋！你到底是怎么做到的——” 不过，中野的咒骂并不是唯一会让你措手不及的东西；几秒钟后，一声巨响让你猛地一跳，转过身去。贵弘并没有坐下来，而是朝你飞了过来，迫使你赶紧躲开。就在你反应过来的瞬间，那个醉汉又跌倒了，第二次掉进了附近的灌溉沟里。塔卡用它的尾巴缓冲了撞击力，但它的眨眼动作以及那只拿着葫芦的手的颤抖，都暴露了这一切发生得是多么突然、多么出乎意料。 中野忧心忡忡地匆匆从你身边经过，手中还握着剑柄。“贵弘！你没事吧！？ [rand|诚然，贵弘皱起眉头也并不奇怪。“要是你没有把我扔出去，我会好很多。我差点把凯罗斯的葫芦弄掉了！虽然那东西几乎坚不可摧，但要是真的丢了怎么办？！” “谁会在乎那个葫芦啊？”中野愤怒地吼道，但很快又压住了怒火，嘟囔着说道：“你要是受伤了怎么办，笨蛋？” 贵弘的眉头微微舒展，露出了一丝笑容。中野立刻咒骂道：“天啊，贵弘！你在开玩笑吧？！真的吗？！|我没事，”贵弘叹了口气。葫芦挂在绳子上，而他则期待地伸出了手。 当中野接过葫芦时，那个醉汉站了起来，稍微整理了一下自己的衣衫，然后继续让他的尾巴继续“整理”身上的灰尘。想用你那条厉害的手臂来杀我吗？” “当然不是。”武士松开了剑柄，抬手揉了揉太阳穴。过了好一会儿，中野才平静下来，边抱怨边抓住贵弘的肩膀。但别再为那该死的饮料操心了。 ] 虽然他们俩经常会争吵，但至少可以确定，贵弘在村里的那些重要人物中并非完全没有朋友。 [flags.TAKAHIRO_NAKANO_SEEN|如果之前没有看过这场比赛，你可能会以为贵弘其实是被打了，而不是在掰手腕的比赛中输了。|不过，通常情况下，掰手腕并不会把人甩得飞出去吧……你也不太确定，是贵弘真的被打了，还是仅仅因为输得太惨而被甩了出去。]不过，目前他们还是开始清理混乱的局面，并把那个原本是他们比赛基础的桶找了回来。而你，则让他们自己去处理这些事情，这样你就可以继续做你自己的事了。 |然而几分钟后，依然什么都没有发生——上方的花瓣一片也没有掉落。你还会继续等待并观察下去吗？ ]
rows.raw: ' Staring up at the branches, you get a tad lost in the vast sea of petals. It's hard to appreciate the beauty of the tree that the kitsune colony lives in but there's something about this quiet situation that lets you truly enjoy everything. [var0|Including one of the petals breaking free of the mass. You snap around just in time to see both Takahiro and Nakano turn to face each and try pushing the other's arm. Their arms tense and you can see both of their muscles flex. As far as physique, Nakano should be the instant winner... but Takahiro actually holds him upright, much to both your and Nakano's surprise. "Bastard," Nakano curses. "How the hell are-" Before Nakano can finish his sentence, Takahiro nearly drops his gourd... and simultaneously turns his attention to grab the wrist-bound container. That single moment of drunken attention lapse results in a scene so fantastically awful that no one would believe it unless they saw it. Nakano throws Takahiro; their arms swing with enough force that Takahiro's hand hits the barrel and his arm stiffens up, rolling him backwards and to the side. Not just him but the barrel skids out and rolls the other direction whilst the drunkard tumbles, pulling loose of Nakano's grip and passing you. And he just keeps going, bouncing and falling down a small incline into a nearby irrigation ditch. If not for the five tails that all umbrella out and cushion the impact at its bottom, it'd not only have been utterly embarrassing but outright dangerous. However it ends, though, the tell-tale drunken grin makes you doubt that Takahiro felt even a drop of it. Nakano gets up and rushes over to the ditch, staring worryingly at Takahiro. "Taka, are you-" "Phew," the drunk chuckles. He raises his gourd for Nakano to see. "Almost dropped the gourd!" The samurai sighs and grabs his sword's hilt, carefully stepping down into the ditch and extending a hand. "Yeah, yeah. You lost so I hope it was worth it." Neither of the men seem anywhere near as intense but you can't help notice Nakano's relief turns back into a layer of disbelief once Takahiro is on his feet. They walk back to the arm wrestling zone, Takahiro plopping back onto the pillow whilst Nakano goes to fetch the tossed barrel. It had rolled its way into the street and annoyed quite a few people, yet a quick apology and bow of Nakano's head mostly smooths things over. Sometimes seeing someone's obsession in drinking is worth the wait. |Watching the treetops so diligently, however, you feel lost in the scale of this colony. So lost, in fact, it takes you a while longer to notice one of the petals drifting through the air. "Bastard! How the hell are-" Nakano's cursing isn't the only thing that takes you off-guard, though; seconds after, a loud bang makes you jump and spin around. Takahiro isn't sitting down but sailing toward you, forcing you to dive out of the way. Whilst you catch yourself, the drunkard tumbles and crashes a second time in one of the nearby irrigation ditches. Taka uses his tails to cushion the impact, yet his blinks and gourd-carrying hand shaking betray just how unexpected that all was. Nakano rushes past you with a worried frown and hilt-in-hand. "Takahiro! Are you okay!?" [rand|Admittedly, it's no surprise that Takahiro frowns. "I'd be better if you hadn't thrown me. I nearly dropped Keros' gourd! It might be near indestructible but what if I lost it!?" "Who cares about the gourd?" Nakano angrily barks, yet reigns his rage in with a grumble. "What happens if you get hurt, moron?" Takahiro's frown fades for a small smirk. Instantly, Nakano curses. "Gods, Takahiro! A prank!? Really!?"|"I'm fine," Takahiro sighs. The gourd dangles on its cord whilst he reaches a hand out expectantly. When Nakano takes it, the drunkard gets up and brushes himself off momentarily before letting his tails continue the dust-down. "Trying to kill me with that killer arm of yours?" "Of course not." The samurai lets go of his blade's hilt, raising a hand to massage his temples. It takes Takahiro a few sips before Nakano composes himself, grumbling while he grabs Takahiro's shoulder. "But stop worrying so much about that damn drink of yours." ] Although the pair of them can argue, it's at least good to know Takahiro isn't entirely without friends among the village's head figures. [flags.TAKAHIRO_NAKANO_SEEN|If not for having seen this bout before, you might think Takahiro got punched instead of lost in an arm wrestling bout.|Arm wrestling normally doesn't send someone flying, though; you're not terribly sure whether or not Takahiro got punched instead of merely lost so badly he went flying.] For now, though, they set about cleaning up the mess and recovering the barrel that had been the base for their contest. You, on the other hand, leave them to it so you can get back to your business. |Yet after a few minutes, there is still nothing; none of the petals above are falling. Do you keep waiting and watching? ] '

rows.original: As great as the sight will be, you can't be asked to wait for a tree to drop a petal. You walk away and leave both of the leaf-staring men to their game. You can swear you hear a loud thump when walking away but you don't care anymore.
rows.translation: 尽管这一景象十分壮观，但你总不能等着一棵树主动掉下一片花瓣吧。你转身离开，让那两个盯着树叶发呆的男人继续他们的“游戏”。走开的时候，你仿佛听到了什么沉重的撞击声，但你现在已经不再在意了。
rows.raw: "\n            As great as the sight will be, you can't be asked to wait for a tree to drop a petal. You walk away and leave both of the leaf-staring men to their game. You can swear you hear a loud thump when walking away but you don't care anymore."

rows.original: Waiting for trees to wilt isn't something you're very fond of as far as daily plans go.
rows.translation: 在日常安排中，等待树木枯萎显然不是你喜欢做的事情。
rows.raw: "Waiting for trees to wilt isn't something you're very fond of as far as daily plans go."

rows.original:
While walking through the colony, someone catches your eye: Takahiro.

    And it looks like he's with [kinu.isInari|Kinu's fiancé|Hitoshi], the hard-working farmer perplexingly looking at Takahiro whilst the brewmaster holds a large sack.
    
    "Takahiro," you overhear Hitoshi start, the wide-shouldered man circling around him. He reaches out for the bag but the brewmaster turns, his gourd rattling with every motion. "Come on, give it back!"
    
    [flags.TAKAHIRO_HITOSHI_HAGGLE|It looks like Takahiro is trying to steal rice again.|The drunk is acting a bit unusual but you spot why Hitoshi is trying to take the bag from him. As stuffed and full as the fibrous container is, you can see an occasional grain of rice slip loose of its secured mouth.]
    
    Takahiro merely keeps evading, using his tails to hinder the gigantic oaf. For once, he's not holding onto his gourd so he's actually fairly agile in his movements. "No way! I need rice to make a proper rice wine!"
    
    "But Takahiro, we still have plenty of rice wine and other alcohols from your last batch," the innocent farmer grumbles.
    
    "So what?" Takahiro spouts, casting a dirty look and squeezing his hold on the sack. "I want something for myself and those barrels are off-limits to me anytime we're not in festival season!"
    
    At the rate things are going now, maybe it'd be best for you to step in and help one of them...
rows.translation:
在穿过这个殖民地时，有一个人吸引了你的注意：贵弘。

    看起来他正和[kinu.isInari|小娟的未婚夫|仁志]在一起。那位勤奋的农夫困惑地望着贵弘，而那位酿酒师则拿着一个大袋子。
    
    “贵弘，”你听到仁志开口说道，这个肩膀宽阔的男子正在他周围转圈。他伸手去拿那个袋子，但酿酒师转过身来，他的葫芦在移动时发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。“快把袋子还给我！
    
    [flags.TAKAHIRO_HITOSHI_HAGGLE|看来贵弘又打算偷大米了。|那个醉汉的行为确实有点反常，但你现在应该明白为什么Hitoshi会试图从他手里抢走那个袋子了。尽管那个纤维材质的容器已经装得满满当当，但你还是能看到，偶尔会有几粒米从袋子的开口处掉出来。]
    
    贵弘只是一味地躲避，用尾巴来阻碍那个巨大的笨蛋。这一次，他没有拿着他的葫芦，因此动作实际上相当敏捷。“不行！我需要大米来制作真正的米酒啊！”
    
    “但是贵弘，你上次生产的米酒和其他酒类还有很多啊，”那个天真的农夫抱怨道。
    
    那又怎样？”贵弘恶狠狠地说道，同时紧紧抓住那个袋子。“我想要属于自己的东西，而在节日期间之外，那些桶根本就不是我的！”
    
    照目前这种情况来看，你或许最好介入进来，帮助他们中的某个人……

rows.original: "Wait a moment, Hitoshi." You walk in and [kinu.isInari|your future son-in-law|Hitoshi] looks over, letting Takahiro step away with a proud smirk. Farmer boy notices, of course, and immediately shoots him a look to make him stop; once Takahiro is standing still and sipping on his gourd's straw, Hitoshi turns his attention on you. "[pc.name], is there something you need? Takahiro and I are currently havin' a problem and-" "Actually," you interject, raising a hand. "There is. Why don't you let Takahiro have it? After all, you can just make him give you the majority of whatever he makes, right?" Hitoshi opens his mouth but doesn't speak. Instead of immediately replying, it looks more like he's lost in the suggestion. Takahiro on the other hand seems momentarily grumpy in his alcohol greed, yet realizes that this is helping him get what he wants. All five of his tails sway excitedly, his green gaze shifting over to the oaf before the straw falls out of his mouth. "Heh... they have a point. No one loses if I do that, right? Besides, [pc.name] is willing to vouch for me. Isn't that enough to just let me have one bag?" [var0|"That's what you said last time," he sighs. "It wasn't that long ago that I gave you bag and-" "Hitoshi," the drunkard smoothly rolls with the suggestion, redirecting it whilst patting the bag. "I'm a huge drunk but I'm not this huge. Come on.... you know I'm good for it!"|Although Komari's gentle giant descendent is at first seemingly frustrated, his resistant demeanor softens. Both of you asking him clearly tugs at the good-hearted lad's willpower, yet the final string of resistance must surely have been the idea that it might hinder the colony.] A long minute or two passes but the huge kitsune shifts his hand to the back of his head, scratching and rubbing behind one of his ears anxiously. "... Well... alright, fine. We should be able to make up for it in the harvest schedule but... you better bring stuff you don't drink right back to me, understand?" With his approval, Hitoshi instantly sets the brewmaster smiling and laughing. He hoists the sack over his right shoulder and casts you a wave... and doesn't even pay either of you another glance whilst heading back toward his shack. You hope Takahiro keeps his word but worst case scenario, at least he probably likes you more now.
rows.translation: “等一下，仁志。” 你走上前，[kinu.isInari|你未来的女婿|仁志]看了过来，让贵弘带着得意的坏笑退开。农家男孩当然注意到了，立刻瞪了他一眼，让他别再胡闹；等贵弘站定，用吸管啜饮葫芦里的酒，仁志才把注意力转向你。“[pc.name]，你有什么需要吗？贵弘和我眼下正有点争执，而——” “其实，”你举起一只手，插话道。“确实有。为什么不把东西交给贵弘？反正你可以让他把酿出来的大部分都交给你，对吧？” 仁志张开嘴，却没有说话。他没有立刻回答，反而像是沉浸在这项建议中。另一边，贵弘一时还因贪酒而闷闷不乐，不过很快便意识到这会帮他拿到想要的东西。五条尾巴兴奋地摆动，绿色目光移向那个大块头，吸管也从嘴里滑了出来。 “嘿……你说得对。我这么做，谁都不会有损失，对吧？而且[pc.name]愿意替我担保。难道这还不足以让我拿走一袋吗？” [var0|“你上次也是这么说的，”他叹息道。“我才刚给过你一袋，还没过去多久——” “仁志，”醉鬼顺势接过提议，一边拍着袋子，一边把话题引向另一边。“我是个大酒鬼，但也没那么夸张。拜托……你知道我会还的！”|麻里那名温柔的巨人后裔起初显得十分沮丧，抗拒的态度却渐渐软化。你们两人的请求显然牵动了这个善良小伙的意志；而压垮最后一丝抵抗的，无疑是此举或许会妨碍聚居地的想法。] 漫长的一两分钟过去，高大的狐妖把手挪到后脑，不安地抓挠揉弄一只耳朵后方。“……嗯……好吧，行。收成安排应该能弥补这些，可是……那些没喝掉的东西，你最好原封不动地还给我，明白吗？” 获得准许，仁志立刻令酿酒师眉开眼笑、放声大笑。贵弘把麻袋扛上右肩，朝你挥挥手……接着径直走回自己的小屋，甚至没再看你们任何一人。 你希望贵弘信守诺言，不过最坏的情况下，至少他现在大概更喜欢你了。

rows.original: You can't help it; Takahiro is just too fun to watch in his cycle of self-destruction.
rows.translation: 你也没办法啊，观察贵弘在自我毁灭的过程中表现得如此滑稽可笑，实在让人忍俊不禁。
rows.raw: "You can't help it; Takahiro is just too fun to watch in his cycle of self-destruction."

rows.original: "Takahiro, stop!" You rush in at the rotating kitsune, reaching out and grabbing the sack. Although his arms are wrapped around it, your ambush takes him completely off-guard; Takahiro tries to hold the sack but your pull makes him lose his grip and balance in one go. The drunkard starts falling but Hitoshi instantly grabs him by the back of his breastplate's straps. Without the sack, Takahiro is able to stand back upright without much issue thanks to his aid... but his eyes immediately turn to you with a snarl. [flags.TAKAHIRO_HITOSHI_HAGGLE_SIDE 2|"You interfere again!?" The drunkard isn't very quiet or veiling about how he feels this time. "It's one bag of rice! One! Come on!"|"Come on," he grumbles, tails swirling and ears shaking in veiled anger. Following along behind the twins, you follow them through the bathhouse. Much to your surprise, Takahiro gets allowed inside without issue.[flags.TODO_YUU_MET| Yuu actually seems happy to see the drunk doing something besides drinking.] The large-chested attendant waves him off before both Miko and Mai approach.

        "You both are coming to bathe?" [flags.TODO_YUU_MET|Yuu|The woman] asks, furrowing her brows. "You aren't up to your normal tricks, are you?"
        
        "No, darlin'." Mai puffs on her pipe, rolling her eyes. "We're jus' followin' Takahiro so we k'in clean 'em proper."
        
        The sarcastic response makes the motherly attendant sigh, yet ultimately fetch a sign from behind the counter.
        
        "Don't make things too hard to clean, okay?"
        
        "Of course," Miko giggles, tails reassuringly patting the woman's hands as she struts. "N' make sure nobody comes knockin' on our fun. 'Specially Azami."
        
        The mistress merely gives them a passing wave, whispering under her breath whilst both kitsune girls head along inside. She turns and bends to retrieve a sign, giving you just a large enough window to sneak along and into the changing room.
        
        Neither twin seems to notice you, both of them smiling at each other nearby. Takahiro's armor and weapon lies at the bench near them, including his shirt. [var0|
        
        Yet the fox himself isn't quite in the onsen yet; Takahiro is sitting at a mirror with just his gourd and pants. The drunkard pulls his socks and footwear off, setting them neatly in a basket before setting down a brush atop them.
        
        Takahiro grumbles, just barely audible to you and the girls stalking along in his tracks. "I asked Yuu to gimme a towel... is she mad because I passed out last time?"
        
        Although he's complaining now, you doubt he will be for much longer; Miko sets forward with a smile, circling around the seated male and folding her fan in a single graceful motion. The level of acting she wears on her face could trick any man into thinking she might be modest, slightly agasp at the shirtless fox. "My my, Takahiro'll be joinin' us? Mai, thinkin' what I'm thinkin'?"
        
        On her cue, the smoker takes a long drag from her pipe and strides up alongside him. Takahiro looks up at Miko first, turning just as the silver fox sat cross-legged on the bench with him.
        
        "Mm," she agrees mid-inhale. She lowers the pipe and exhales the wave of smoke down into her mountain of cleavage. "Still not marryin' Azami? My my... aren' ya devout ta' Keros, Takahiro? How k'n you serve 'em without a wife?"
        
        Takahiro looks at her with a sideways grumble, raising his gourd's straw to his mouth. "You two smooth talking makes me think you're trying to taste my knot again."
        
        Miko feigns disbelief whilst Mai smirks. The silver-haired smoker caresses his back with her tails whilst the orange foxgirl drops onto her knees before him, sliding her hands to take the basket from him. Takahiro looks down at her but the instant he does, Mai reaches her free hand out to grab his chin. She turns him right back to looking at her, shifting her pipe around and angling its end toward him.
        
        "Jus' take a smoke, Taka... n' think a bit."
        
        Takahiro furrows his brow, dismissively pushing her hand away. He raises his gourd for her to see, ignoring Miko caressing his thighs and leaning ever closer to his crotch. "I don't smoke."
        
        "Nn." Mai looks between the gourd and his face... and then slides closer, shifting her pipe into her other hand so that she can wrap an arm around Takahiro. She pulls him close, kissing him without any warning; neither of them seems shy of it, yet Takahiro's unease softens into curiosity when their lips pop apart.
        
        "You don't," she huffs, smoke and saliva trailing between their mouths. "N' that's fine. Drink... n' so will Miko."
        
        The third member of the group grabs Takahiro's pants, pulling them down while you scuttle into a perfect hiding spot near a few baskets. She almost gets his pants down but he looks down and reaches his own free hand out to grab her by the ear.
        
        "I might be buzzed but you girls aren't working me over that easily."
        
        Takahiro looks at the pouting and even slightly angry Miko, grumbling and gently pushing her back from his crotch. Mai doesn't seem terribly annoyed but she does seem let down, watching Takahiro straighten his pants before recovering his basket of supplies. The drunkard stands up and turns, looking right at the more restrained of the siblings with a sigh.
        
        "Not that I don't appreciate it. Last thing I need is Yuushio getting another reason to get upset when I drink in the onsen. You two always spell trouble for me... so go find another guy to play with, priestesses."
        
        Although the seeker's interests in Keros might be similar, it's almost like he caught a prank before it could be sprung. Both of the twins pout with their own emotional restraint whilst he slinks off to the bathhouse's warm waters.
        
        Well, that's a killjoy. You wait until both twins leave to get up, heading out into the mainroom. The mistress is sitting proudly at the counter, looking toward you with a smile whilst the twins trudge their way back out to the street.
        
        "Sometimes, even Takahiro can get something right."

跟在双胞胎身后，你跟着他们走进了浴室。令你惊讶的是，贵弘竟然毫无障碍地被允许进入了里面。[flags.TODO_YUU_MET| 悠似乎真的很高兴看到那个醉汉除了喝酒之外还能做点别的事情。]那个胸膛宽大的侍从将他打发走了，随后米可与舞才走了过来。

        “你们两个都是来洗澡的吗？ [flags.TODO_YUU_MET|悠|那个女人]她皱着眉头问道：“你肯定又在耍什么花招吧？”
        
        “没有，亲爱的。”舞一边抽着烟斗一边翻着白眼说：“我们只是跟着贵弘，想把那些家伙彻底收拾干净而已。”
        
        这种讽刺的回答让这位慈母般的侍者叹了口气，但最终还是从柜台后面拿来了一个指示。
        
        别把东西弄得太难清理，好吗？”
        
        “当然不会，”米可咯咯笑着，一边摇着尾巴一边安慰地拍着那位女士的手部。“一定要确保没人来打扰我们的乐趣，尤其是秋美。
        
        女主人只是朝她们挥了挥手，同时低声说了些什么，然后那两个狐妖女孩便走进了里面。她转过身，弯下腰去拿了一个牌子，这样一来，你就有了足够的空间悄悄地跟进去，进入更衣室。
        
        似乎没有哪对双胞胎注意到你，他们俩正站在旁边互相微笑。贵弘的盔甲和武器放在他们旁边的长椅上，他的衬衫也在那里。 [var0|
        
        然而，那只狐狸自己却还没有进入温泉；贵弘只是坐在镜子前，身上只穿着葫芦衣和裤子。那个醉汉脱下了自己的袜子和鞋子，将它们整齐地放在一个篮子里，然后把一支刷子放在上面。
        
        贵弘嘟囔着什么，声音小得几乎听不见，而那些跟在他后面的女孩们也听不清他在说什么。“我让由宇给我拿条毛巾来……难道是因为上次我晕倒了，她生我的气了吗？
        
        虽然他现在在抱怨，但你也怀疑他还能抱怨多久吧；米可微笑着向前走去，绕着坐在那里的男子转了一圈，然后以一个优雅的动作将扇子收了起来。她脸上那副表演得来的姿态，足以让任何男人误以为她其实是个害羞的人，甚至会对那个不穿衬衫的狐狸感到一丝惊讶。“哎呀，贵弘也要加入我们吗？真没想到……
        
        在她发出信号后，那个吸烟者深深地吸了一口烟，然后大步走到了他的身边。贵弘首先抬头看向米可，就在这时，那只银狐也盘腿坐在长椅上，与他面对面。
        
        “嗯，”她一边吸着烟一边说道。她把烟斗放低，将那一缕缕烟雾吐向自己的胸前。“还是不娶亚纱美吗？哎呀……你难道不对凯罗斯忠心耿耿吗，贵弘？没有妻子，你怎么能为他们效力呢？
        
        贵弘侧着头，不满地看了她一眼，然后把葫芦里的吸管拿到嘴边：“你们两个嘴甜舌滑的，让我觉得你们又在想方设法想尝尝我的‘秘密’了。”
        
        米可假装不相信，而麻衣则露出了得意的笑容。那位银发吸烟者用尾巴轻抚着他的后背，而那位橙发狐狸女孩则跪在他面前，伸手从他手中接过篮子。贵弘低头看着她，但就在他这么做的瞬间，舞伸出了空着的手，抓住了他的下巴。她让他又把目光转向她，同时调整了一下烟斗的位置，将烟斗的末端朝他的方向倾斜。
        
        就抽根烟吧，贵弘……好好想想吧。”
        
        贵弘皱起眉头，不耐烦地推开了她的手。他举起手中的烟壶让她看，完全无视了米可正抚摸着他的大腿，还不断靠近他的裆部。“我不抽烟。
        
        嗯……”梅将目光在葫芦和他的脸上来回移动，然后慢慢靠近他，把烟斗换到另一只手上，这样就可以用一只手臂搂住贵弘了。她把他拉近，毫无征兆地吻了他；他们似乎都不觉得害羞，而当他们的嘴唇分开时，贵弘内心的不安也渐渐变成了好奇。
        
        你不会的，”她气呼呼地说，说话时烟雾和唾液从他们的口中飘出。“没关系……喝吧，米可也会喝的。”
        
        小组中的第三个人抓住贵弘的裤子，往下拉，而你则迅速躲到了几只篮子附近的一个绝佳藏身之处。她差点就把他的裤子拉下来了，但贵弘低头，用另一只空着的手抓住了她的耳朵。
        
        我可能有点醉了，但你们这些女孩可没那么容易把我搞垮。”
        
        贵弘看着正撅着嘴、甚至还有点生气的米可，嘟囔着轻轻把她从自己的大腿上推开。茉莉看起来并没有太生气，但确实显得有些失望，她看着贵弘整理好自己的裤子，然后拿起了装满物资的篮子。那个醉汉站了起来，转过身来，叹了口气，直视着那对表现得较为克制的兄妹。

He lifts his fists, stands up, and bows... before standing upright with a snarl. "Yes, Den Matron. I... will reflect on this, as always." Although he says that, he turns and leaves, taking a long drink much to Komari's dismay. "I hope you mean that, Takahiro."
rows.translation: 当你在殖民地中漫步时，有一个人吸引了你的注意：贵弘。 更重要的是，你看到他正与那只狐妖族的领袖坐在一起。麻里面带微笑地坐在他对面，而贵弘则沮丧地喝下一口酒，然后将手指放在桌子上。 他举起一个被涂成黑色的游戏棋子，沮丧地嘟囔着，将其放在了桌子的另一个位置。“我不喜欢玩这个游戏。” 与他的犹豫相比，那位生态城领导者只是轻声笑了笑，几秒钟后便移动了自己的棋子。贵弘内心的沮丧情绪不断涌现，但麻里的存在让就连这个醉汉也守规矩地待着。 “你以前可很喜欢这个游戏的，还总爱吹嘘自己下围棋是如何打败你父母的。” “我父母太笨了，”贵弘反驳道。他把葫芦里的吸管重新塞回去，让吸管悬挂在绳子上，然后伸手拿了一块食物。“你们两个也都不是其中之一。或者笨。只是老了而已。” 虽然你没有加入他们，但你可以看出，当麻里失望地摇着头时，她其实注意到了你；她的尾巴摇动着，她短暂地将头转向你的方向，脸上露出了笑容。不过，这只狐妖首领很快又将注意力转回了贵弘身上，而贵弘也丝毫没有察觉到有什么不对劲，只是抓住棋盘的边缘，微微倾身看着棋盘。 隆弘，我知道你不喜欢他们总是强行将自己的职业强加给你……尤其是因为你本身就天赋异禀。但如果你少喝点酒，放弃这种试图取悦凯罗斯的愚蠢行为，你就可以真正向他表达敬意，过上更有意义的生活。我觉得绫美会是一个非常适合你的伴侣，你不觉得吗？ 她一提到阿兹米，那个喝酒的人立刻捂住了耳朵，抓起一块棋子，移动它的同时瞪了她一眼。“我虽然尊重你，但想撮合我们俩是不可能的。阿兹米太傲慢了。我们偶尔也会有一些互动，但是……” 麻里靠回椅背，移动了自己的棋子。“你输了。 贵弘脸上那副震惊的表情，实在无法完全表达他的难以置信。他盯着棋盘，颤抖着将自己的手指移到那些本该是他走过的棋路上。而麻里只是静静地等待着，带着一丝调皮的笑容注视着这个寻找宝藏的人。 “你总是犯同样的错误……是喝了酒的缘故，还是你真的太笨了？ 我可不傻，”塔卡嘟囔着，一边继续移动着身体，一边继续喝着酒。当吸管从他嘴里拔出来时，他赶紧又拿了一根吸管继续喝起来。“看到了吧？我还没完呢！麻里叹了口气……然后用尾巴做出了自己的动作。当那个游戏棋子停下来的瞬间，那个醉汉的脸就更红了；他们一遍又一遍地重复这个动作，这让贵弘的内心燃起了斗志，使他逐渐减少了饮酒量。虽然你看不见棋盘，但可以明显感觉到，起初麻里只是在故意逗弄他——她只是轻轻哼着曲子，放松地坐着，丝毫没有表现出任何紧张或焦虑的神情。而贵弘则逐渐失去了耐心：麻里之所以让他控制自己的动作，其实并不是为了让他开心，而是为了阻止他继续喝酒。 这意味着贵弘正在从醉酒状态中恢复过来，正在承受宿醉带来的初期不适。 他在棋盘上的行动变得迟缓了许多，他咬紧牙关，用一种你根本想不到他会有的激烈神情盯着棋盘。贵弘整个举止都显得更加从容、充满气势，他缓慢而自信地移动着那些棋子，这种沉稳与自信在他目前的状况下实在令人难以置信。有那么几秒钟，你会看到贵弘的另一面——不是那个野心勃勃的寻宝者，也不是那个总是找借口喝酒的家伙，而是那些人们口中所谓的天才、聪明的狐妖，麻里和浅美。他眼中的锐利与竞争力如此强烈，足以与中野那种对剑术的狂热相匹敌。 就连她最终也平复了情绪，对着那个愤怒的狐妖笑了笑：“你不喝酒的时候表现得要好得多。如果你能再保持几年清醒，这场比赛或许就会属于你，贵弘。当然，我这次确实放水了……但这丝毫改变不了你那被酒精侵蚀的头脑中潜藏的才华。 她的其中一条尾巴移动了一枚棋子，贵弘猛地一拳砸在棋盘上，导致所有棋子四散飞溅，她也忍不住叹了口气。 “去休息吧。像往常一样，我把这个建议当作是对你的关心。我不想违背你的意愿，但你的饮酒已经让你看不清事情的真相了。我只希望你能对自己诚实一些……明白我的意思吗，贵弘？ 他举起拳头，站起身来，鞠了一躬……然后又猛地挺直身体，低吼道：“是的，女主管。我……会像往常一样认真考虑这个问题的。” 尽管他这么说了，却还是转身离开了，还喝了一大口酒，这让麻里感到非常失望。“希望你是认真的，贵弘。
rows.raw: ' While walking through the colony, someone catches your eye: Takahiro. More importantly, you see him sitting down with the leader of the kitsune. Komari sits across from him with a smile whilst Takahiro frustratingly takes a swig of his brew down and sets his fingers atop the table. He lifts up a black-painted game piece, setting it down in a different spot on the table with a frustrated grumble. "I don't like playing this game." Compared to his hesitation, the arcology leader simply laughs under her breath and moves a piece seconds later. Takahiro's frustration bubbles up but Komari's presence keeps even the drunkard in line. "You used to love this game; you would always brag about how you bested your parents playing Go." "My parents are dumb," Takahiro retorts. He thumbs the straw of his gourd back down and lets it dangle from its strap, reaching out to grab one of the pieces. "And you aren't either of them or dumb. Just old." Although you don't join them, you can tell Komari detects you whilst shaking her head disappointedly; her tails swish and she briefly turns her head in your direction, letting her smile grow. The fox leader turns her attention back to Takahiro before he notices anything amiss, grabbing the side of the board to slightly lean over it. "Takahiro, I know you dislike them for trying to thrust their occupation on you... particularly because you were always gifted. But if you drank less and gave up this foolish endeavor to impress Keros, you could pay tribute to him and live a more fruitful life. I think Azami would make an excellent partner for you, do you not agree?" Her mentioning Azami makes the drinker tuck his ears and grab a piece, moving it and shooting her a glare. "I may respect you but trying to matchmake us wouldn't work. Azami is too stuck-up. We have a thing or two every once in a while but-" Komari sits back and moves her piece. "You lose." The look of shock Takahiro wears can't quite encapsulate his disbelief. He follows the board and shakily moves his hand along paths that must have been his moves. Komari merely waits, staring toward the treasure-seeker with a coy grin. "You always make the same mistakes; is it the booze or are you just dumb?" "I ain't dumb," Taka slurs, raising his gourd and continuing his movement tracking even whilst sipping more alcohol down. When the straw pops out of his mouth, he hastily grabs another piece and moves it. "See? I'm not out yet!" Komari sighs... and makes her own move using her tail. The instant the game piece stops, the drunk's face burns redder; the pair repeat this cycle again and again, igniting a fire in Takahiro that has him slowing his drinking down. Even though you can't see the board, you can tell that Komari is toying with him at first; she simply hums and relaxes, never letting her demeanor waiver. Takahiro on the other hand begins losing his frustration; Komari didn't just excite him to control his movements, but she did it to stop him from drinking. That means Takahiro is coming down from his drunk state and suffering the initial effects of a hangover. His actions on the board are much slower, gritting his teeth and glaring at the board with an intensity you'd never expected to see in him. Takahiro's entire air feels bigger and room-filling, clacking the pieces with slowness and confidence no one should muster in his state. For a few wonderous seconds, you see a different side of Takahiro; not the ambitious treasure-seeker and excuse-making drunk, but the supposed genius and intelligent kitsune Komari and Azami mentioned. The sharpness and competitiveness in his eyes burn bright enough that he'd be a match for Nakano's sword-warrior fanaticism. And even she finally lets her air mellow, smiling at the angered kitsune. "You did much better when you did not drink. If you had a few more years of being sober, this game might have been yours, Takahiro. Of course, I am going quite easy... but that does nothing to change the amount of skill you have dormant within that booze-addled mind." One of her tails moves a piece and Takahiro cracks his fist down atop the board, sending all the pieces scattering and forcing a sigh from her. "Go and rest. As usual, consider this advice for you. I do not want to order you against your will, yet your drinking blinds you. I only wish you would be honest with yourself... am I understood, Takahiro?" He lifts his fists, stands up, and bows... before standing upright with a snarl. "Yes, Den Matron. I... will reflect on this, as always." Although he says that, he turns and leaves, taking a long drink much to Komari's dismay. "I hope you mean that, Takahiro."'

rows.original:
While walking through the colony, someone catches your eye: Takahiro.

    Or you think it is based on the amount of tails you see poking out of Kazuo's workshop window. The loud clanking and clattering of mechanical parts alone already has you worried but more worrying is the sight of Kazuo at the doorway, nervously grabbing his hair.
    
    "Takahiro! Out!" He stomps his foot. "Out! You're making a mess of everything!"
    
    It might be a good idea to help him out. It'd at least be a nice thing to do for Kazuo, if not to spare Takahiro any more embarrassment.
rows.translation:
当你在殖民地中漫步时，有一个人吸引了你的注意：贵弘。

    或者，你可能会因为看到有许多尾巴从和雄的工作室窗户里伸出来而注意到他。仅仅是那些机械零件发出的嘈杂声响就已经让你感到不安了，而更令你担忧的是，看到和雄站在门口，紧张地抓着自己的头发。
    
    隆弘！出去！”他狠狠地跺了跺脚，“出去！你把一切都搞得一团糟了！”
    
    或许帮他一把是个不错的主意。至少，这对和雄来说是一件好事，就算不能让隆弘再尴尬下去，至少也能让他好受一些。

rows.original:
As much as you hate it, it'd sit poorly with you if you just left Kazuo to Takahiro's drunken destruction. You take a deep breath and walk up to the machinist, crossing your arms over your [pc.chest].

        "Kazuo, is there anything I can do to help?"
        
        [flags.TAKAHIRO_KAZUO_WORKSHOP
        |Kazuo turns to you and lets out a relieve sigh. "[pc.name], you're here again! Thank Keros!"
        |The craftsman turns in a shock but catches his gasp mid-release, instead sighing in relief. "It's just you, [pc.name]. For a moment, I was worried that Komari was coming to investigate all the noise."
        ]
        
        "It's not like I can just ignore him," you sigh, waving a hand toward the doorway. "Takahiro causing problems for everyone is one thing, but your workshop is practically full of things that could cause serious damage. Your golems weren't a pushover so-"
        
        "Right you are!" Kazuo excitedly interrupts, smiling and adjusting his goggles. "All the more reason we must remove him! If you assist me, I am certain we can do it in a timely manner!"[flags.TAKAHIRO_KAZUO_WORKSHOP|
        
        As much as you'd love to believe him, you don't think this will be quick.]
        
        The specialist turns and leads the way through the door and you follow, moving from the [dayNight|well-lit|moonlit] outside to the dark and cramped interior. Kazuo stops occasionally to relight a torch or two but in a matter of minutes, you both arrive at the main section of the workshop. Parts and prototypes litter the floor in various states of assembly, yet some of it seems mostly untouched and simply part of Kazuo's messy manner of work. Other works are clearly snapped and broken, their woodwork and magical etchings bashed from being knocked down. Your disappointed guide sighs at the sight of them before ultimately raising his synthetic arm and releasing an illuminating foxfire.
        
        [rand|Takahiro is at least stationary now, buried facedown up to the waist in a pile of woodworkings. His legs kick and his tails try their best to grab for anything that might give him leverage but there's no freedom for him. It's obvious that Kazuo would have had a terrible time trying to grab hold of him alone with how much the drunk buffoon is resisting. Even if he gets stuck, a drunkard is still going to be blitzed beyond belief.|Takahiro laughs and chugs, surrounded by miniature cutouts and sculptures of what appear to be kitsune.
        
        "Not bad, Azami," he chuckles, pouring some of his gourd's mixture into a makeshift cup for one of the models. "To imagine you'd admit my greatness!"
        
        He turns to look at another model with feigned shock. "Komari, you shouldn't say such a thing! I know I am great for finding all of Keros artifacts but the other kitsune may think you are picking favorites!"
        
        Kazuo angrily furrows his brow and you can't help join him with your own exasperated sigh.|Takahiro's clothes are all over the place; his armor is strung up on a larger golem, the pants over a prototype weapon of some kind, and the rest is on the floor or hanging from a wall-mounted shelf.
        
        And unfortunately for both of you, the naked drunk is staggering around with his gourd in one hand and his cock in the other.
        
        "Haha!" Takahiro smacks his knotted rod on a full-helmet that looks fit for Kazuo. "Awww, Kazzy... it's okay if you're not a girl! I don't mind! You're cute in your own way, ya know!"
        
        "Every time," Kazuo grumbles. "Every time he does this, I have to tell him that I am not into someone who's going to rub their genitals all over my work. If I were to dedicate time to something as pathetic as a relationship, it would certainly not be with this damn drunk..."]
        
        Kazuo's ears lower and he buries his face in his hands, perhaps feeling defeated before the two of you even got started... but you can't have that. You take his shoulder and give him a reassuring grin.
        
        "Don't worry. It'll be easy if we work together. Now come on... we have work to do."
        
        Even though you said it, you had no idea how awful it'd be; you both try to corner and catch Takahiro for the better part of an hour and only end up making a bigger mess of things. Particularly when he [rand|somehow ends up naked|knocks over a large prototype|lands balls-first on Kazuo's face]. As much trouble as it is catching him, it's even more to get him to calm down with how wasted he is. Takahiro teeters and laughs while both Kazuo and you walk on needles to avoid him damaging anything too important. The sole benefit to your cooperation is that Takahiro eventually relents to your grabbing hands and orders, settling down and relaxing outside the workshop sipping on his gourd.
        
        The instant he's outside and the workshop is clear, Kazuo closes the door behind you and lets out a long, drained groan.
        
        "I swear, Takahiro, you will be the death of my work."
        
        "Hehe." The green-eyed fox lets his five tails swirl around him, taking a large swig. "Relax, Kazzy... suck a dick or fuck a girl sometime. You're too distracted with your books n' stuff."
        
        Kazuo rolls his eyes and to be honest you think both of them could use some time apart. So you turn and tell Takahiro the one thing no party drinker wants to hear.
        
        "Takahiro, go home. You're drunk."
        
        The kitsune shoots you a look but ultimately sighs and stumbles up to his feet, relocating to probably find himself another place to drink in peace. Even if he wants to argue, it'd kill his buzz to bother trying. You turn to Kazuo and cross your arms.
        
        "Can I get anything for helping you with him?"
        
        Payment didn't seem to cross Kazuo's mind... or at least not since you started all this. The shocked look he initially has melts away and he hastily shuffles through his pockets before ultimately pulling out a small pouch.
        
        "Here," he mumbles. "I will have to take a small delay since these funds were for Kohaku to acquire me more supplies... but it is worthwhile to enlist the aid of someone to deal with Takahiro. Perhaps Komari will find a new task to occupy his time with since his brewing work is so easy. At this rate, he may very well give me a heart attack... or worse, set backs."
        
        You take the pay and shrug. If Komari has a solution for Takahiro, that's for her to handle. As far as you're concerned, this whole tiring ordeal is better off being left behind you.
rows.translation:
尽管你很不愿意，但如果你任由和雄在酒醉后肆意破坏一切，你的良心会感到非常不安的。你深吸一口气，走上前去，双臂交叉在胸前，对那位机械师说道[pc.chest]一夫，有什么我可以帮忙的吗？
        
        [flags.TAKAHIRO_KAZUO_WORKSHOP
        |一夫转向你，松了一口气，说道：[pc.name]，哦，你又来了！多亏了凯洛斯！
        |工匠顿时一愣，但在即将松口呼气的瞬间又忍住了，反而松了一口气：“原来是你啊[pc.name]有那么一刻，我担心麻里会过来调查这一切吵闹声。
        ]
        
        我总不能无视他吧，”你叹了口气，朝门口挥了挥手，“贵弘给大家惹麻烦是一回事，但你的工作间里其实堆满了可能会造成严重破坏的东西。你的魔像可不是好对付的……”

“说得太对了！”一夫兴奋地插话道，一边笑着调整着自己的护目镜，“这就更说明我们必须除掉他！如果你能帮忙的话，我相信我们一定能及时解决这个问题！[flags.TAKAHIRO_KAZUO_WORKSHOP|
        
        尽管你很愿意相信他，但你认为这件事不会很快就能解决。]
        
        专家转身率先走了进去，你跟在后面，一起走了进去。 [dayNight|照明良好的|月光照耀下的]从外面走进那昏暗而狭窄的空间，和雄不时停下来重新点燃一两支火把，但几分钟后，你们就来到了工作室的主区域。地上散落着各种处于不同组装阶段的零件和原型，不过其中有些似乎几乎未被触碰过，这些只是和雄那杂乱无章的工作习惯罢了。其他作品显然已经损毁严重，木结构与魔法雕刻都在被撞倒的过程中受到了破坏。看到这些景象，你那位感到失望的向导叹了口气，最终还是举起了他的机械手臂，释放出了一道光芒四射的狐火。
        
        [rand|贵弘现在至少已经静止不动了，他的上半身埋在一堆木屑中，脸朝下。他的双腿不停地蹬动，尾巴也拼命试图抓住任何能够让他获得支撑的东西，但他根本无法获得任何自由。很明显，如果只有一夫一个人试图抓住他，的话，肯定会遇到巨大的困难——毕竟这个醉醺醺的家伙正在拼命抵抗。即使一夫能够抓住他，一个醉汉的力量依然会让他陷入难以想象的困境之中。|贵弘边笑着边大口喝着，周围摆满了那些看起来像是狐妖的微型剪纸和雕塑。

“不错嘛，绫美，”他轻笑着，将葫芦里调制好的饮料倒入一个临时制作的杯子里，递给其中一个模型。真不敢相信你居然会承认我的伟大！”

他假装惊讶地转向另一位模特说道：“麻里，你不该这么说啊！我知道自己在寻找凯罗斯的文物方面确实很在行，但其他那些狐狸可能会觉得你在偏袒某个人呢！一夫愤怒地皱起了眉头，你也不由得发出一声同样无奈的叹息。|贵弘的衣服乱七八糟地扔得到处都是；他的盔甲被挂在一个较大的傀儡身上，裤子则搭在某种原型武器上，其余的东西要么放在地上，要么挂在墙上的架子上。

而对你们俩来说，不幸的是，这个醉醺醺的家伙正摇摇晃晃地走着，一只手拿着葫芦，另一只手则……嗯，你们应该能猜到他在干什么。
        
        哈哈！”贵弘用他那根结实的棍子敲打着一顶看起来很适合和雄的满顶头盔。“哎呀，和雄……就算你不是女孩子也没关系啊！我一点也不在意！你也有自己独特的可爱之处，你知道的吧！”

“每次都是这样，”和雄嘟囔道。每次他这样做，我都得告诉他，我可不喜欢那种总把他们的私处往我工作上蹭来蹭去的人。如果我真的要花时间在一段如此可悲的恋爱关系上，那肯定不会是和这个该死的酒鬼在一起……"]
        
        一夫的低下了头，把脸埋在双手之间，或许在你们俩还没开始行动之前，他就已经觉得自己失败了……但你们不能让他这样想。你抓住他的肩膀，给了他一个安慰的微笑。

“别担心。如果我们齐心协力，这件事就会很容易完成。快吧……我们还有工作要做。

rows.translation: 环顾四周，你突然意识到：试图找到某样东西其实是件相当困难的事情。单一的一群狐妖中的那一只生态城市规划对居民们来说，这项任务其实比你想象的要艰巨得多；尤其是当你根本不知道该去哪里寻找的时候。当然，你可以挨家挨户地去询问，直到找到合适的人选，但是[pc.isBimbo | 呃，那得花上好长时间啊！ |请记住，你是非常珍视自己的时间的。因此，做那种事情是完全不可取的。 ]漫无目的地游荡只会让你更加迷失方向。想到这里，你开始试图寻找并接近路人，希望能从他们那里得到指引。你寻找的那个人绝对不会不引人注意，所以肯定有人知道他的去向，对吧？ [pc.ra kitsune |这需要一些时间。 |这并不容易。 [dayNight |最值得注意的是，因为你遇到的任何人都会试图完全避免与你交谈。 |尤其是在这么晚的时候。 ] ]但最终总会有人告诉你该往哪里走。有了详细的指示和明确的路线，你就能顺利到达目的地。 当你接近那栋房子时，你会看到入口处的各个位置都贴着几张纸条；每张纸条上都用黑色墨水用粗犷有力的笔触写了一些文字[pc.ra kitsune |你的子民 |那只狐狸妖精 ]她的母语。看着这些饰物上精美的书法， [pc.ra kitsune |你非常清楚他们每个人所拥有的潜在力量。 |你完全搞不懂他们说的那些话到底是什么意思。[pc.isMage |但你本质上明白它们所有的作用：每一个这样的饰品都有着其特定的用途。真实的这些物体上刻有储存法术的符文，等待被激活。 ]最好不要去招惹它们，这样或许才是最好的选择。 ]希望这里是正确的地点。你挺直肩膀，走上前去敲了敲门。 喂？有人在吗？ [dayNight |家 |醒来 ]？ [dayNight |几乎瞬间 |几秒钟过去了…… 一片寂静。 那个人应该已经睡着了；不过，你还是再次敲了敲门。不过这一次…… ]你听到一些拖步声。然后，不久之后[dayNight |一个模糊的轮廓出现在那里，从障子纸的装饰图案后面显露出它的存在。那个身影逐渐变得清晰起来，直到 | ]门终于滑开了。
rows.raw: " Looking around, you're hit with the dawning realization that trying to find a single fox amidst a whole arcology of residents is much more of an onerous task than you thought; even more so considering you were never told where to go. Sure, you could go door to door until you found the right one, but[pc.isBimbo | uuugh, that would take forever! |, bear in mind, you actually value your time. Doing that is entirely out of the question. ] Wandering around aimlessly won't do anything but get you even more lost. With that in mind, you try to find and approach passersby in hopes of getting directions from them. The person you're looking for is far from inconspicuous, so surely someone has to know, right? [pc.ra kitsune |It takes some time |It's not easy, [dayNight |most notably due to the fact that anyone you run into tries to avoid conversation altogether |especially at this late hour ] ], but eventually someone tells you where you have to go. With instructions on hand and a path laid out, you make your way over there. As you approach the domicile, affixed to various spots around the entrance, you see several strips of paper; marked upon on each of them, in broad, flowing strokes of black ink, is writings in [pc.ra kitsune |your people |the kitsune ]'s mother tongue. Looking at the exquisite calligraphy on these charms, [pc.ra kitsune |you're well aware of the latent power that each of them contain |you cannot make heads or tails as to what any of them say[pc.isMage |, but you intrinsically understand the purpose that all of them serve: each and every one of these charms have ACTUAL spell-storing glyphs inscribed onto them which await activation ]. It's probably for the best to not mess with them ]. Hopefully this is the right place. Squaring your shoulders, you step forth and knock on the door. Hello? Is anyone [dayNight |home |awake ]? [dayNight |Almost instantly |A few seconds pass... Silence. The person's probably asleep; nevertheless, you knock once more. This time, however ], you hear some shuffling. Then, moments later, [dayNight |a faint silhouette appears and reflects its presence from behind the decorative paper of the shoji screen. The figure grows in shape until | ]the door finally slides open."

rows.original: Standing on the other side of the doorway is a face you recall, his fur and lengthy hair pristinely tinted in solid white. As for what the fox-man is wearing, he's dressed in a three-piece outfit. Atop everything, he's adorned in a white, long-sleeved jacket whose color is only slightly darker than his hair. Underneath that, he wears a light gray under-shirt with a sash wrapped around his waist. Completing the set is a white, pleated skirt which goes all the way down to his ankles. Despite the fine quality of the material, it's still considerably less ostentatious than what he was wearing when you first met him. When he sees [party.yall], he smiles and then graces you with a small, formal bow. "Good [dayNight |day |evening ], friend. It is my honor to receive you once more." It's good to see him again, but you must admit, with how woefully brief your last run-in with him was, you'd wish he at least gave you more information to work with before he left. Not only did he not give any directions on how to find him, but you don't even know the man's name! He rubs his chin and hums. "I suppose so. That negligence falls on me. I have no doubts that the road must have been long; however, despite all odds, here we stand once more. Through your own ingenuity you sought me out; so, in turn, allow me to make amends through the comforting respite of a proper, hostly welcome. I err to let such matters remain half-finished." The genteel fox-man looks over his own shoulder to the smell coming from deeper within. Standing outside, you smell it too. Mixing in with the clean scent of distant breezes and the fragrance of cherry blossoms from the [pc.ra kitsune |sacred |massive ] tree, there's the bitter aroma of plain, hot tea which hangs in the air. "[dayNight | |Regardless of the hour, I welcomed you all the same." The man beckons you inside. " ]Please, come inside and let us carry this conversation inside over some tea.[pc.hasFootwear | You can put your footwear right here." He then gestures to a spot by the door. " |" He hands you a cloth. "Use this to wipe your feet before you enter. ][pc.ra kitsune |You know how it is |Perish the thought if any sordid spirits were to make a home here." Taking your shoes off because it's a cultural thing, you can believe that. But bringing in wayward entities from outside just by walking in, that can't be real, right? "Who knows?" [silly |The sly bastard |He ] smirks and shrugs. "In truth, it's mainly to keep the floor clean ]." After [pc.hasFootwear |taking your [pc.footwear] off |wiping your [pc.feet] off ], your host leads you deeper into his humble abode; down the hallway and into a small living room with a few decorative pieces hanging on the wall. In the middle of the room, there's a low table with four cushions ringing it. Setting himself down onto one of them, he pours [party.yall] a cup of tea from the teapot nearby, serves himself, and then waits for you to make the first move. You pick up the cup of tea, bringing its bitter green contents to your lips, and look around the room. It's a nice place he has here — very quaint, homely even. But therein lies your confusion: its humble design feels under-fit for someone of his sublime class. Who is he? From behind his cup, he raises a brow and eyes you with his golden orbs. He's in no rush and leisurely swallows his drink before setting his tea down. Leaving it on the table, he presses both sets of fingers in front of himself. "And so we begin..."
rows.translation: 站在门道另一边的是一张你熟悉的面孔，它的毛皮和长长的毛发都被染成了纯白色。至于这个狐妖人穿着什么，他全身穿着一套三件套的服装。最外层是一件白色长袖夹克，它的颜色仅比他的毛发稍深一些。在它的下面，他穿着一件浅灰色的汗衫，腰间还系着一条腰带。整套装扮的最后一部分是一条白色的百褶裙，这条裙子一直垂到他的脚踝。尽管这些衣物的材质都非常精致，但与你们初次见到他时他穿的那身衣服相比，这些装扮还是要低调许多。 当他看到时[party.yall]他微笑着，然后向你行了一个简短而正式的鞠躬。“好的[dayNight |天 |晚上 ]朋友，能够再次与您见面，我感到非常荣幸。” 再次见到他确实很高兴，但你必须承认，上次与他的会面实在太短暂了，他至少应该留下更多信息让你们参考，才对吧？他不仅没有提供任何关于如何找到他的线索，而且你们甚至都不知道那个人的名字！ 他摸着下巴，哼着曲子说道：“我想也是吧。这种疏忽确实应该由我来负责。我毫不怀疑，那段路一定很漫长；然而，尽管遇到了种种困难，我们还是再次来到了这里。正是由于你的聪明才智，你找到了我；因此，也请允许我以一场热情周到的欢迎仪式来弥补我的过失。让这类事情半途而废，确实是我的疏忽。“这位风度翩翩的狐妖人回头看了看从内部传来的气味。 站在外面，你也能闻到这种气味。它与远处吹来的清新的微风所带来的芬芳，以及樱花散发出的香气混合在了一起[pc.ra kitsune |神圣的 |庞大的 ]树上，空气中弥漫着浓烈的纯绿茶香。[dayNight | |无论什么时间，我都会欢迎你们的到来。”那个男人邀请你们进去。 ]请进来吧，我们边喝茶边继续这个谈话。[pc.hasFootwear | 你可以把鞋子放在这里。”他随后指向门边的一个位置。 |他递给你一块布，”他说，“进去之前用这块布擦擦脚吧。 ][pc.ra kitsune |你懂的吧。 |但愿不会有任何阴秽的灵魂在这里安家。” “因为这是文化习俗，所以脱鞋是理所当然的，这一点你可以相信。但仅仅因为走进这个地方，就会有一些外来的邪灵随之进入，这种事情肯定不会是真的吧？” “谁知道呢？ [silly |那个狡猾的混蛋 |他 ]他咧嘴一笑，耸了耸肩：“说实话，主要是为了保持地板干净。 ]之后[pc.hasFootwear |拿走你的[pc.footwear]关闭 |擦你的[pc.feet]关闭 ]你的主人带你走进他那简陋的居所；沿着走廊，你来到一间小客厅，墙上挂着一些装饰品。房间中央有一张矮桌，周围摆着四个靠垫。 他坐在其中一个靠垫上，然后开始倒酒[party.yall]他从附近的茶壶中倒了一杯茶，自己先喝了下去，然后等着你先采取行动。 你拿起那杯茶，将其中那苦涩的绿茶送入口中，同时环顾房间。他选择的这个地方真是不错——非常不错。古朴而有趣甚至显得有些朴实无华。但恰恰在这里，你就犯糊涂了：这样低调的设计，似乎与他那高贵的身份极不相称。那么，他究竟是谁呢？ 他透过茶杯，挑起眉毛，用那双金色的眼睛注视着你。他并不着急，慢条斯理地喝完茶，然后将茶杯放在桌上。接着，他将双手的指关节并拢在身前，说道：“那么，我们开始吧……
