rows.original:
"I am Tetsuya Oja, scion of the Oja clan — one of the twelve inheritor clans to be vaunted for its service to the Cherry Blossom Throne and the divine pedigree we carry as descendants of the August Master, Keros." He then crosses his arms and sighs. "Unfortunately, such gilded titles lose their luster once bereft of its cradle. Dull, I may be, I still walk the erudite path of the onymoji.

            [var0
                |Oh, so he's [pc.isBimbo
                    |good with
                    |a practitioner of the ways of divination and invocation
                ] magic, then? 
                |You're not familiar with the term.
                
                "Not many are," Tetsuya replies. "One could make comparisons to arcanists or priests; while not entirely accurate, amidst the reeds of intricacies, I feel it to be the best approximation I can give for now. While I would gladly relish the occasion to lecture and discuss the matter further, I fear our drinks will turn cold before I finish."
                
            
            ]Is there a particular field in which he falls under as an arcanist?
            
            "Aside from divinations or purifications, I primarily focus on the art of inscription."
            
            [pc.isBimbo
                |What's that?
                
                "In this instance, I refer to the art of imbuing an object — typically charms or scrolls — with magic. Even beyond the usage of spellcasting or the dismissal of hexes, you would be surprised how much power and authority there is within our own words."
            ]
            
            You recollect the many charms that were outside. What would've happened if you set them off?
            
            Tetsuya picks up his tea and says, "It would be rude." He then takes a sip.
            
            If what he says is true — that he's some highborn noble from a faraway land — then why's he here? On top of that, when Komari asked you to meet the important faces here, why didn't she mention him?
            
            Tetsuya hums and idly swirls his drink. "While I cannot speak on the governor's behalf, I can verily surmise an answer to that question. Though I must admit, the truth is far from exotic expectation. Simply put, I have only recently come to this land from yonder gate, withal the lack of an identity. Unlike the quartermaster or the shrine sisters, I have not established myself with a proper role in the arcology as of yet. As for your prior question: I travel because I seek an adventure — I wish to see the numerous vistas our world has to offer. In that regard, you can consider me to be an explorer."
            
            Fair enough. Though, if that's the case, does that mean you ran into him right as he arrived at the den?
            
            "Indeed," Tetsuya answers. "Now prithee, [pc.swornGod keros lumia nareva
                |kindred
                |warrior of light
                |[silly
                    |magic sponge
                    |spellborn
                ]
                |traveler
            ], might I have the honor of knowing who my company is?"
            
            It's [pc.name].
            
            [party.hasCompanions
                |"And what of [party.oneCompanion
                    |you
                    |those that have come with you, [pc.name]
                ]?"
                
            ]After [party.som
                |you've introduced yourself
                |[companion1.name] introduces [companion1.himHer]self
                |everyone's introduction
            ], the kitsune man smiles and claps his hands once. "Wonderful! This has the makings of a fine beginning. Mayhaps you found it equally riveting? If you wish to continue this further, albeit casually, I am free of the hour. If not, no harm done. At the very least, you know where I live and will be welcomed all the same."
rows.translation:
我是尾田哲也，尾田一族的后裔——这个拥有十二个世袭家族之一，因为我们为樱花皇座做出了贡献，同时也因为作为尊贵大师凯罗斯的后代而拥有神圣的血统而备受赞誉。”他双臂交叉，叹了口气，“可惜，这样的荣耀头衔一旦离开了它诞生的土壤，就会失去光彩。虽然我可能显得有些乏味，但我依然走在研究这些专有名词的道路上。

            [var0
                |哦，原来他是这样的。 [pc.isBimbo
                    |能与相处得很好
                    |一位从事占卜与祈求仪式的人士
                ]那么，魔法呢？ 
                |你可能不太熟悉这个术语。”
                
                “确实没多少人了解，”哲也回答道，“可以把它比作术士或牧师；虽然这种比喻并不完全准确，但在这些复杂的概念中，我觉得这是目前最合适的描述了。虽然我很乐意借此机会进一步探讨这个话题，但恐怕在我讲完之前，我们的酒就已经凉掉了吧。
                
            
            ]作为一位奥术师，他具体专攻哪个领域呢？
            
            “除了占卜和净化术之外，我主要研究铭文艺术。
            
            [pc.isBimbo
                |那是什么？
                
                “在这里，我指的是将魔法注入某种物品——通常是护身符或卷轴——这种技艺。其实，即便不涉及施法或解除诅咒，你也会惊讶地发现，我们日常说出的话语本身就蕴含着如此强大的力量与权威。
            ]
            
            你还记得外面那些美丽的装饰品吧？如果把它们都点亮了，会发生什么呢？
            
            哲也端起茶杯说道：“那样做未免太失礼了。”然后他喝了一口茶。
            
            如果他说的是真的——如果他真的是来自遥远国度的贵族——那么他为什么会在这里呢？更何况，当麻里让你来见这里的一些重要人物时，她为什么没有提到他呢？
            
            哲也低声哼着，漫不经心地转动着杯中的饮料。“虽然我不能代表州长发表意见，但我确实可以推测出这个问题的答案。虽然我必须承认，现实与我原本的想象大相径庭。简单来说，我也是最近才通过那扇门来到这片土地的，而且目前还没有确定自己的身份。与军需官或神殿中的姐妹们不同，我在这个生态系统中还没有找到属于自己的位置，也没有被赋予任何明确的职责。关于你之前的问题：我之所以旅行，是因为我想追求冒险——我想看看我们这个世界所拥有的那些令人惊叹的风景。从这个角度来看，你可以把我看作是一个探险家。
            
            嗯，有道理。不过，如果真是这样的话，那么是不是意味着你在他刚到达那个地方的时候遇到了他呢？
            
            确实如此，”哲也回答道，“现在，请你[pc.swornGod keros lumia nareva
                |同族之人
                |光明战士
                |[silly
                    |魔法海绵
                    |spellborn
                ]
                |旅行者
            ]请问，我有幸知道我的公司是哪家吗？”
            
            “是[pc.name]。
            
            [party.hasCompanions
                |那么，其他的呢？ [party.oneCompanion
                    |你
                    |那些一直陪伴在你身边的人， [pc.name]
                ]？"
                
            ]之后[party.som
                |你已经做了自我介绍了。
                |[companion1.name]引入[companion1.himHer]自己
                |每个人的自我介绍
            ]那只狐妖人微笑着，拍手示意了一下。“太好了！这确实是一个很好的开始。你是不是也觉得这段经历非常有趣？如果你愿意继续的话，虽然我们可以随意地进行，但我现在有空。如果不想继续，也没关系。至少你知道我住在哪里，随时都可以欢迎你再来。

[tetsuya.numKits |Setsuna |A kit ] mewls and hugs a fluffy tail as she starts to fidget in her sleep, but you crouch down and pick her up. It's okay little one, [pc.papaMama]'s here. Your daughter nestles against your [pc.hasBreasts |bosom |chest ] and snoozes peacefully, as if your presence is enough to ameliorate her troublesome dreams. Now, it's time to wake Tet[pc.isBimbo |ty |su ] up, but who says you can't have a little fun with it? You have time, after all, so why not savor the moment? You place your hand between Tetsuya's ears and begin tousling his long, glossy white locks. Reveling in the warm silkiness of his hair, you run and scratch the top of his head with gusto. Considering he was out like a light when you found him, you can assume that the estimate is closer to one or two hours. You look down at your sleeping daughter and smile. Setsuna is still nestled against you, albeit sleeping with her back against your abdomen. She must've shifted around while you were out cold.

                |she
                |they
            ]'ll be asleep, but we should have enough time."

            两三个小时？听起来并不算糟；这是一场充分的小睡。考虑到你发现他时，他已经睡得不省人事，你可以推测这个估计更接近一两个小时。你低头看向熟睡的女儿，露出微笑。刹那依旧依偎着你，不过已经转成背靠你腹部的姿势入睡。她一定在你熟睡时挪动过身体。

        | The moonlight above causes his white complexion to gleam with a soft, ghostly pale glow.
    ] 
    
    A peculiar sight, to say the least. 
    
    The man doesn't notice your presence; moreover, he doesn't even stir. He's just standing there, unmoving, save for the gentle swaying of his tails as he watches his own reflection and the colorful school of fish which swim peacefully in the pond. Admittedly, the vibrant display is very gorgeous, but you get the impression that there's probably more things on his mind than just fish. The man then raises his head and looks [dayNight
        |to the
        |toward the night
    ] sky.
    
    This stranger is seemingly lost in his own little world, but as you stand there, motionless in peaceful observation, you realize that you've been doing just the same. Although, [pc.isDK
        |does anyone have the power to
        |can anyone
    ] blame you? With the soft, relaxing burbling of rushing water — its constant flow resonating in your ears — and the soothing [dayNight
        |warmth
        |chill
    ] in the air, there's an ethereal, breathtaking quality to it all — a feeling of transient peace.
    
    Is he, or even this moment, real? If you blink, will he be gone?
    
    A cool breeze sweeps through the field, rustling grass and flowers alike, gently beckoning you forward."

rows.original:
[party.has kiyoko
            |A pointed ear atop the stranger's head stands up and swivels around to face you. He then presses his fingertips together and turns around; however, his cordial expression falters as his golden slits land on the other person in your company — Kiyoko. The fox-man furrows his brow and cocks his head. Be it confusion or disbelief, your fox-wife's presence has thrown him for a loop.
            
            [silly
                |"High Lady Ōtomo? I... I thought you were dead!"
                
                Kiyoko raises a finger to her lips and frames a playful smile. "My death was... greatly exaggerated."
                
                "Bullshit! When the records speak of you, they regarded your ass in the past tense. Wa happun?"
                
                Kiyoko looks over her shoulder at you, cracking a coy smile. "[pc.name] has regarded my ass in the present tense and can confirm that it is very much not dead. Perhaps history is wrong?"
                |"Yes?" Kiyoko palms the bottom of her elbow and adds, "You seem rather lost. Perhaps my [kiyoko.husband] and I can be of assistance." 
                
                "Mayhaps so." An ear flicks. The kitsune then closes his eyes and bows his head. With his composure regained, he opens his eyes and admits, "the words are ready in mind, but I err to speak them..."
                
                "I appreciate your tact, but you need not concern yourself with secrets on my part." Your fox wife remains calm and collected as ever, bidding him to speak his mind with the flick of her wrist. "If I am given no question, then how can I reciprocate with a proper response?"
                
                "I see..." The fox-man rests his chin in his palm and rhythmically taps his cheek. After a few seconds, he shrugs. "Then by your leave, I shall speak my mind and pray you understand my reluctance; for as the mimic would cry, there is no better substitute than a firsthand account. Simply put, I have studied the annals and seen your visage upon many a page, but by all rights, its youth should long since have passed. Yet the whispers in the wind and the irrefutable evidence before me speaks volumes otherwise. Furthermore, if you and the High Lady Ōtomo of centuries ago are one in the same, my question is this: how is this possible? You are neither yūrei nor yasha."
            ]
            
            Your fox-wife gestures to you — she's not wrong to do so. If anyone has the honor of saying what happened, it's you. For all intents and purposes, you're the [pc.raceShort] that's responsible for bringing her back. Without your help and nothing short of divine intervention, your family still would've been in that orb. As you regale him with tales of your travels, you see his features spark with intrigue. You've got his full attention.
            
            "I do not believe we have formally met." He [pc.mascFem
                |puts his hand to his chest and bows
                |kisses your hand
            ]. "May I have the honor of an introduction?"
            |[shopsOpen
                |"Do you believe in fate?"
                
                The question catches you off-guard, but you give your answer.
                
                Satisfied with the response, the foxen stranger croons. He then presses his fingertips together and goes to greet you; however, once the man turns around, you see his features spark with intrigue. You've got his full attention.
                
                "[pc.ra kitsune
                    |So, you must be the emissary — Keros' Champion, if you will."
                    
                    [pc.dcb
                        |He's not wrong and you're flattered that this guy already knows how much of a big deal you are, but you have every right to be suspicious. Before you confirm or deny anything to him, you need some answers first: who the fuck is he and how does he know this?
                        |That's correct, but what gave it away?
                        |Yup, that's right! You puff your chest out and smile proudly.
                    ]
                    
                    [pc.isDK
                        |"I am a diviner," the white kitsune says, "and I am a diviner."
                        
                        That doesn't answer anything, and he knows it! Scrunching your nose and grimacing at the disrespect, you have half a mind to shove his pretty-boy ass into the water.
                        
                        "Evasion begets evasion, your Eminence — I merely reciprocated the move you made. I can see you do not trust me; allow me to rectify that. If it will ease your concern, know that I hold no record of iniquity nor do I bear an ulterior motive toward you. The explanation is rather simple: gossip spreads fast, and it was only a matter of time before I heard the news of our patron deity's champion. Furthermore, I need only behold your grace to put two and two together. Of course, I could be horribly incorrect and this is an illusory trick; however, it is easier to deal with a misunderstanding than it is to recover from grave irreverence."
                        
                        Fair enough, but you still intend to get back at him. You'll enjoy washing that smarminess off of his face.
                        
                        "To answer your other question," he bows, "my name is—" 
                        |He raises one corner of his lips and taps the side of his head. "You bear the mark of our liege."
                        
                        That just raises even more questions...
                        
                        "The simpler reason is due to your reputation preceding you, but where are my manners? I do not believe we have formally met." He [pc.mascFem
                            |puts his hand to his chest and bows
                            |kisses your hand
                        ]. "May I have the honor of an introduction?" 
                    ]
                    |Well met, traveler. I presume you are the one that has everyone talking."
                    
                    What makes him say that?
                    
                    "For starters, you are the only [pc.race] that can roam the arcology freely."
                    
                    Fair point.
                    
                    "I also heard you managed to push your way through the den and get an audience with the governor, but that is neither here nor there — I do not believe we have formally met yet." He [pc.mascFem
                        |puts his hand to his chest and bows
                        |kisses your hand
                    ]. "May I have the honor of an introduction?" 
                ]
                |A pointed ear atop the stranger's head stands up and swivels around to face you; its foxen owner, however, only tilts his head and gives you a side-eye glance.
                
                "Peculiar time to be out and about, is it not?"
                
                [pc.isCunning
                    |Pot, meet kettle.
                    
                    The fox-man folds his arms and chuckles. "Fair enough, you have me beat there. I suppose that makes [party.solo
                        |both of us
                        |us all
                    ] equally culpable, then
                    |Huh, did you catch him at a bad time?
                    
                    He returns to his usual calm, peaceable demeanor and dispels your concern with a casual, dismissive wave. "Not quite. Pay it no mind, it is just the harmless banter of a tired mind. Truth be told, your arrival is an auspicious one
                ]." He looks back up to the sky and asks, "Do you believe in fate?"
                
                The question catches you off-guard, but you give your answer.
                
                Satisfied with the response, the white kitsune croons and walks over to you. "I do not believe we have formally met." He [pc.mascFem
                    |puts his hand to his chest and bows
                    |kisses your hand
                ]. "May I have the honor of an introduction?" 
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
[party.has kiyoko
            |那个陌生人的头顶上有一只尖耳朵，它会竖起来并转动过来朝向你。然后他把指尖并拢，转过身去；然而，当他那金色的眼睛落在你公司里的另一个人——纪代子上时，他那友好的表情立刻消失了。那个狐狸人皱起了眉头，歪了歪头。无论是出于困惑还是难以置信，你那位狐狸妻子出现在这里，确实让他感到十分意外。
            
            [silly
                |大友大人？我……我还以为您已经去世了呢！”

清子用手指轻按嘴唇，露出一个俏皮的微笑：“我的死……被大大夸大了呢。”

“胡说八道！那些记录里提到您的时候，用的都是过去时态啊。真的吗？”

清子侧过头看着你，露出一个调皮的笑容。[pc.name]一直在关注着我，而且可以肯定的是，我绝对没有死。或许历史记载错了？
                |是吗？”清子用手掌轻按着自己的肘部，接着说道：“你看起来有些困惑。也许我的[kiyoko.husband]和我能帮上忙。”

“也许吧。”那只狐妖甩了甩耳朵，然后闭上了眼睛，低下了头。当他重新恢复镇定后，睁开眼睛说道：“话已经在心里准备好了，但我就是不敢说出来。我很感激你的谨慎，但你不必为我保守任何秘密。”你的狐妖妻子依然像往常一样镇定自若，只是轻轻一甩手腕，示意他直说吧。如果我没有被提出任何问题，那我该如何给出恰当的回答呢？”

“我明白了……”那个狐妖人将下巴搁在手掌上，有节奏地轻敲着自己的脸颊。几秒钟后，他耸了耸肩。那么，在得到您的允许之后，我就直说了吧。我希望您能理解我的犹豫——因为正如那位模仿者所说，没有什么比亲历者的描述更可靠了。简单来说，我研究过那些历史记载，在许多页面上都看到了您的面容，但按照常理来说，您的青春早已应该逝去才对。然而，风中的低语以及我眼前这些无可辩驳的证据却表明了相反的事实。更何况，如果你和几个世纪前的大 lady Ōtomo是同一个人，那么我的问题是：这怎么可能呢？你既不是幽灵，也不是妖怪。"
            ]
            
            你的狐妖妻子向你示意——她这么做并没有错。如果有人有资格描述发生了什么，那个人就是你。事实上，你才是那个应该讲述这一切的人。 [pc.raceShort]正是你的帮助让她重获新生。如果没有你的援助，甚至需要神的干预，你的家人可能至今仍在那个黑暗的深渊中。当你向他讲述自己的旅行经历时，你看到他的眼神中充满了好奇与兴趣，他完全被你吸引住了。

“我想我们还没有正式相识吧。”他说。 [pc.mascFem
                |将手放在胸前鞠躬
                |亲吻你的手
            ]能否请您介绍一下呢？
            |[shopsOpen
                |你相信命运吗？”

这个问题让你措手不及，但你还是给出了回答。

那个狐狸般的陌生人似乎对你的回答很满意，他轻声笑了起来。然后他把手指并拢，准备向你走去；然而，当那个人转过身来时，你发现他的眼神中充满了好奇与兴趣——他完全被你吸引住了。[pc.ra kitsune
                    |所以，你一定是那位使者——也就是所谓的“凯罗斯的勇士”吧。
                    
                    [pc.dcb
                        |他并没有错，而且他能认识到你的重要性，这确实让你感到荣幸。但你有完全的权利保持怀疑。在向他确认或否认任何事情之前，你首先需要一些答案：这家伙到底是谁？他是怎么知道这些的？
                        |没错，但是什么暴露了这一点呢？
                        |没错，就是这样！你挺起胸膛，自豪地笑了起来。
                    ]
                    
                    [pc.isDK
                        |我是一名占卜师，”那只白色的狐妖说道，“我确实是一名占卜师。”

但这根本没有回答任何问题，他也心知肚明！你皱着鼻子，对这种无礼的行为感到十分恼火，甚至都有冲动想把这家伙推进水里去。
                        
                        逃避只会招致更多的逃避，阁下——我只不过是在回敬您的举动而已。我看您并不信任我，那么请允许我澄清这一点。如果这能缓解您的疑虑，那么请相信，我没有任何不正当的行为记录，也对您没有任何不可告人的意图。原因其实很简单：流言传得飞快，我听到关于我们守护神的冠军的消息也只是时间问题而已。更何况，只要看一眼您的风采，我就立刻明白了。当然，我也有可能完全弄错，这可能只是一个错觉或诡计；不过，比起纠正严重的不敬行为，处理这种误解要容易得多。确实如此，但你还是打算报复他吧。你会很享受把他脸上的那副得意的表情洗掉的。”

“至于你的另一个问题，”他鞠了一躬说道，“我的名字是—— 
                        |他微微上扬嘴角，轻敲着自己的脑门：“你身上带着我们主君的印记。”

这反而引发了更多的疑问……

“最简单的解释就是，你的名声早已传开了……不过，我忘了自我介绍——我们应该还没有正式见过面吧？”他说道。 [pc.mascFem
                            |将手放在胸前鞠躬
                            |亲吻你的手
                        ]能否请您给我介绍一下呢？ 
                    ]
                    |很高兴见到你，旅行者。我想你就是那个让大家都在谈论你的人吧。

他为什么会这么说呢？

首先，你是唯一一个[pc.race]那个能够在生态城市中自由活动的生物。”

“说得有道理。”

“我还听说你成功闯入了那位高官的办公室并与他进行了会面，不过这也不是重点——我想我们还没有正式见过面吧。”他说。 [pc.mascFem
                        |将手放在胸前鞠躬
                        |亲吻你的手
                    ]能否请您介绍一下呢？ 
                ]
                |那个陌生人的头上长着一只尖耳朵，它会竖起来然后转动过来朝向你；然而，它的主人却只是微微歪着头，侧眼瞥了你一眼。

“现在这个时候出门，真是有点奇怪，不是吗？
                
                [pc.isCunning
                    |真是冤家路窄啊。

那个狐狸人双臂交叉，轻声笑了起来：“确实，你在这点上确实胜过我。我想，这就意味着[party.solo
                        |我们两个人
                        |我们所有人
                    ]那么，这些人同样应该承担责任。
                    |哈，你是不是在他心情不好的时候碰到他了？

他立刻恢复了平时那种冷静、平和的态度，随意地挥了挥手，让你不必担心：“没那么严重，别放在心上，只是我有点累了，随便说些闲话而已。说实话，你的到来真是件好事。
                ]他再次抬头望向天空，问道：“你相信命运吗？”

这个问题让你措手不及，但你还是给出了回答。

听到你的回答，那只白色的狐妖满意地轻声说道，然后走到了你身边：“看来我们还没有正式相识呢。 [pc.mascFem
                    |将手放在胸前鞠躬
                    |亲吻你的手
                ]能否请您给我介绍一下呢？ 
            ]
        ]

rows.original:
His introduction is interrupted by a faint rustling from within the underbrush. Then, just as quickly as it came, it stops. It didn't seem like it was just the wind and if you had to guess, it was probably a small animal that got spooked. Much to everyone's surprise, though, a foxen child leaps out like a little amber ribbon from her cover and then goes to dash away, but partway through her dastardly escape, she trips and falls face-first with a cushioned thud.

            "Bweh!"
            
            [pc.hasKids
                |That was adorable, but oh no! Your parental instincts kick in as you rush over to the kit's side. The gentleman you were talking to earlier also joins in to help. You get down to one knee and help her up. Once you pick the child back up onto her feet, you then ask if she's okay. Since you have this under control, he opts to crouch down, as to be roughly eye level with the little lady, and sets himself to the task of tidying her up with a small handkerchief. 
                
                To your question, the red-headed [silly
                    |floof
                    |fox
                ] child mutters, "I dunno."
                
                After a cursory inspection, you glean that she's just a bit anxious and tousled from the fall, but otherwise unharmed. From what you can tell, this fox-girl couldn't be more than eight years of age. What was she doing here and why's she trying to hide?
                
                "I dunno," she mutters again.
                
                It's okay.
                
                "You have quite the knack for this," the white fox remarks.
                
                Considering you have your own kid[var0
                    |s
                ] and know from experience, you reckon you would. Once you become a [pc.fatherMother], these things just come naturally with the role. You turn your attention back to the kid and ask if she's lost.
                |[pc.ptc
                    |Oh no, is she all right? She's probably fine... probably. If anything, the little rascal likely had the wind knocked out of her sails. Still, it's better to be safe than sorry; you go and check up on the small [silly
                        |floof
                        |fox
                    ] child. From what you can tell, she couldn't be more than eight years of age. Additionally, you note that she's anxious and tousled from the fall, but otherwise unharmed.
                    
                    You get down to one knee and check your person for anything to clean her off with. As you're searching around, you notice the gentleman come over, sit down next to the little lady, and then pull something out from within his sleeve.
                    
                    "Use this," he says, handing you a white handkerchief.
                    
                    Accepting the cloth from the man, you then apply yourself to the task of tidying up the fox kit. You brush the twigs from her hair and wipe the dirt off her face. He, on the other hand, mollifies the child with gentle words and small, albeit captivating, tricks with his foxfire.
                    |It's not quite the small critter you're expecting, but at least there's that question accounted for. Alas, as one question gets answered, many more take its place.             "Why did you do that?"
            
            The fox child fidgets on her feet, but ultimately says what's on her mind. "I saw you. Papa told me not to talk to anyone with white hair, but you don't look scary, just different. Maybe you needed a friend."
            
            He chuckles and then pats her head. "Your eagerness is far from being in short supply. If you keep this up, I see a bright future filled with wonder ahead of you. rows.original: You pipe up and offer a better idea. "Oh?" The man stops. "What secrets does your mind hold?" What if the discussion didn't have to wait? Perhaps the three of you can walk and talk. "Three? Wait—" Yup, you're going with him. Someone has to keep an eye on them and make sure they both make it home. Besides, it's not like this stranger told you where he lives, so looking for him down the line would be like trying to find a needle in a fur pile! Kneeling down to the little lady[pc.isDK | | and smiling ], you ask if she thinks having more friends to walk home with would be nice. She gasps and her eyes widen as her tails swish around in an excited flurry. "It does!" As the fox-girl takes your hand and pulls you along, you look up at the white-haired kitsune and smirk: it's two against one. "Come on! Daddy needs to see you!" "[silly |Yare yare |Good grief ]." The man sighs, looks at the child, and then smiles. "I suppose he does. Someone has to tell him about your adventures." "Nooooo," the girl whines, grabbing his sleeve. "Don't tell him — I'll get in trouble." He chuckles. "Don't worry, I won't say anything bad." "You promise?" The white-haired kitsune crouches down and holds up his pinky. "I pinky swear, ten thousand punches, whoever lies will be made to swallow a thousand needles." She lets go of his sleeve, interlocks her pinky with his, and then does the same for you. It's now an official promise. Without further ado, the three of you set off in search of this girl's home. You reckon that the best place to start looking is in the residential section of the den.

rows.original: You walk alongside the red-headed kit, but every so often, she either lags behind with her small strides or she gets a burst of speed and dashes a few paces ahead. Eventually, though, the three of you fall in step with each other — it's slow, but the leisurely stroll is a nice change from your usual pace. You then feel a gentle tug on your arm and look down. "Hey, [pc.mf |mister? Can I have your name?" [var0 |She'll call you 'your Eminence', but [pc.name] works, too |The name's [pc.name] ]. She nods and then looks toward the white-haired man walking beside her |can you be my mom?" [pc.isDK |No. That said — thinking to yourself — you'll probably consider if you want to become someone's mommy when you get to her home. The kit deflates. "Oh. Well, can I at least have your name?" [pc.ra kitsune |She'll call you 'your Eminence', but [pc.name] works, too |The name's [pc.name] ]. |You apologize and tell her that you can't be her mom. The offer is too sudden. Letting her down easy, you tell her that the two of you can still play together and you can show her around... like a big sister. You then give her your name. ] "Huh... big sis, [pc.name]. I like it!" She turns and look up at the white-haired man ]. "What about you, mister?" "Me?" He places a hand on his chest. "I'm actually a prince from across the sea, but you can just call me Oji Oja." [pc.bg noblescion |Oh, another noble. |A prince — more genuine article nobility? ] Well, that at least explains his features and [pc.isBimbo |silly way of speaking |his etiquette ]. If what he's saying is true, you wonder why he's so far from home: did he get in trouble for something, or is this just a leisurely vacation for the guy? "You don't act like one, Mister Oja," the girl says. "If anything, you remind me more of my papa. Are you a dad like him, too?" Prince Oja stops and is lost in thought. After a few seconds, he shakes his head. "Can't say that I am; although, one day, I wish to become one," he pats her head and adds, "especially if my kits end up being as lively and adorable as you are. Your family must be proud of you." You watch the little girl preen and join in on the fun.

rows.original:
After some time, you find the place and the kit runs ahead, her tails streaming behind her like fluffy orange ribbons.

                        "There it is!" she exclaims, pointing enthusiastically at the door.
                        
                        [var0
                            |Just in time too, you're beginning to feel a tad peckish and could go for a quick bite. You think about what you should whip up after this: maybe something hearty like a nice bowl of soup, or perhaps something savory like a hot and fresh meat bun.
                        ]
                        
                        You see the door slide open, and standing there, is a thin, dark-haired kitsune that you can only assume is the girl's father.
                        
                        "Papa!" She throws herself against him as he catches her in his arms, giggling as she's wrapped up in a tight embrace.
                        
                        "We did a good thing, [pc.name]."
                        
                        You look at the fox prince and [pc.isDK
                            |wave your hand. It was nothing, really; regardless, you accept the praise. You mostly just followed along to learn more about him.
                            
                            The white kitsune arches a brow. "Mostly?"
                            
                            Shut up...
                            |agree with him.
                        ]
                        
                        The girl's father[pc.ra kitsune
                            | tentatively
                        ] stands up and gives you a deep bow. "[pc.ra kitsune
                            |I'm sorry for the trouble, your Eminence."
                            
                            Prince Oja raises his palm. "Please stand, and know this: you need not apologize for an inconvenience which does not exist. I verily believe a simple gesture of gratitude should suffice, and thus... I give you my thanks."
                            
                            "Wait. You're... thanking me?"
                            
                            He presses his fingertips together and gives a formal nod. "Indeed, I am! Your daughter has been an endearing and gracious host to give me a tour of the arcology. After all, since I am to be staying here in the colonies for an indeterminate amount of time, I hope to familiarize myself with the land. For that, I give your daughter my thanks, which in turn, extends to you as her father
                            |Thank you for bringing her back home
                        ]."
                        
                        As an offer of appreciation, the girl's father invites the two of you to share a meal with him. Prince Oja refuses at first, but the girl's insistence wins him over. You, however, need no convincing — [var0
                            |the notion of something warm to eat is a tantalizing enough
                            |free food is free food
                        ].
                        
                        You step inside [pc.hasFootwear
                            |and take your [pc.footwear] off before following
                            |and follow
                        ] everyone else. Giving the place a cursory glance, you note its rustic charm: farming tools lean against the wall, clay jars with root plants rest by the window, and the occasional wooden toy litter the floor. You even see numerous cut marks made into a wall, denoting a person's growth over the years. This is a place that's clearly lived in. It's a small, but cozy place, that's for sure.
                        
                        "Papa, Papa! Do you like my friends?"
                        
                        "I sure do, sweetie," the dark-haired kitsune says, patting his daughter's head. "Since we have guests over, can you be a dear and fetch them each a bowl? Don't worry, I made some food earlier, so there should be enough. Just remember what I taught you, okay?"
                        
                        "Don't worry, papa, I won't burn myself again."
                        
                        "Do you promise?"
                        
                        "Pinky promise!" The girl holds her pinky out and interlocks it with her father's before scampering off.
                        
                        You sit down at a low-hanging table and continue looking around, but something feels off. From the knitted expression on the white kitsune's face, it seems like he notices something, as well.
                        
                        The prince looks left and right when the girl's father sits down at the table. He then asks, "Is it just you and your daughter here?"
                        
                        The dark-haired colonial clasps his hands together and makes sure his daughter isn't nearby. "Noticed that, did you? Yeah, it's just me and my little girl."
                        
                        "I see." Prince Oja closes his eyes and exhales. "In that case, I am sorry if my question opened an old scar."
                        
                        The man holds up a hand. "Please, don't be.[pc.ra kitsune
                            | Didn't you say not to apologize for something that isn't a problem?
                        ]"
                        
                        "If you do not wish to talk about it, I understand. We all have our masks to wear, our burdens to bear."
                        
                        He shakes his head. "It's fine. You went out of your way to make sure my daughter was okay. That, to me, makes you good people. I won't go into the details, but yeah, my wife... she's not with us anymore."
                        
                        [pc.isDK
                            |He's not going to whine about it, is he?
                            
                            "No, I'm not. After I lost my wife, I was given a choice: I could sit around and feel sorry for myself or I could find myself a new purpose. I saw my options and made my choice. It's painful, but what happened, happened. All that's important now is giving my little girl a better upbringing than I had.
                            |That's... yeah. It must be difficult being a single parent.
                            
                            "It is. I've seen what it can do to a person and it's not pretty. When I lost my old man, I also lost a mother. With him gone, I saw my mom just give up — like her flame was snuffed out. Eventually, she grew to be a cold and bitter woman. As a neglected kit, the only thing I felt for my old lady was resentment. It's a cruel cycle, and without a proper upbringing, I fell into delinquency. As you can imagine, this kind of behavior got me and my mom a one-way trip to the colonies; however, that was probably for the best as that's where I met my wife and started to improve myself."
                            
                            That's an optimistic way of looking at it. From the sound of his story, she clearly meant a lot to him if she's able to help turn his life around.
                            
                            "She gave me purpose and saved me from becoming my mom. When I lost my wife, though, I was devastated. With her absence, however, I finally understood the emptiness my mother felt. Nevertheless, I had a choice in front of me: I could sit around and feel sorry for myself like she did or I could break the cycle. And so, I made my choice: I made it my purpose to respect the memory of my partner and do what I can to give my little girl a better upbringing than I had. I've accepted what happened
                        ]. Just... don't bring it up around her, okay?"
                        
                        [pc.isFemale
                            |That explains why she asked you to be her mom. 
                        ]You go to speak, but see his daughter coming back with a set of bowls and stop yourself.
                        
                        "I'm back!" Walking briskly, but paying careful attention to the bowls she's carrying, she gets to the table and gives each of you your food. "Here you go, [var1
                            |[pc.mf
                                |Mister
                                |Miss
                            ] Emmynance
                            |[pc.mf
                                |[pc.name]
                                |big sis
                            ]
                        ], and here's yours, Oji!"
                        
                        "Thank you." Prince Oja gives her a curt nod and accepts the bowl.
                        
                        Grabbing your dish[var0
                            |, you take in its savory smell. You feel the sensation of a soothing warmth spread through you before finding a home in your chest. Your stomach tingles at the invitation. Ready to dig in
                        ], you inspect its contents. Within the bowl, you see a medley of meat, potatoes, and noodles that's been fried and simmered in a sweet sauce and then garnished with green onions.
                        
                        "See, papa?"
                        
                        You pull your attention away from the hearty stew and see the red-headed kit presenting both hands to her father.
                        
                        "I didn't burn myself!"
                        
                        "I'm proud of you, sweetie," he says, looking at her palms and smiling.
                        
                        Glancing over at the white kitsune, you watch his eyes follow the two of them. He hasn't even touched his food, yet. It's going to get cold if he doesn't get to it. You gently tap the table to get his attention.
                        
                        The prince closes his eyes and smiles. He then tilts his head slightly to look at you and raises his bowl.
                        
                        You look back to your food before digging in.
rows.translation:
过了一会儿，你终于找到了那个地方，那只小动物兴奋地跑在了前面，它的尾巴像一串串蓬松的橙色丝带一样在身后飘动。

“就是这里！”它兴奋地叫道，热情地指向那扇门。
                        
                        [var0
                            |正好在这个时候，你开始感到有点饿了，想吃点东西。你思考着吃完这顿之后应该做什么：也许可以煮一碗热腾腾的汤来填饱肚子，或者吃点香喷喷的肉包子也挺不错的。
                        ]
                        
                        你看到门缓缓打开，站在那里的，是一个身材瘦削、头发黝黑的狐妖，你只能认为他就是那个女孩的父亲。

“爸爸！”她扑进他的怀里，他紧紧地将她拥在怀中，她咯咯笑着，享受着这个温暖的拥抱。

“我们做了一件好事[pc.name]你看着那位狐妖王子， [pc.isDK
                            |你挥了挥手。其实也没什么大不了的；不过，你还是接受了这份赞美。你这么做主要是为了更多地了解他而已。

白色的狐妖挑了挑眉毛：“主要是为了这个目的吗？”

闭嘴……
                            |同意他的观点。
                        ]
                        
                        那个女孩的父亲[pc.ra kitsune
                            | 暂定地
                        ]站起来，向你深深地鞠了一躬。[pc.ra kitsune
                            |给您带来麻烦，实在抱歉，阁下。”

奥贾王子抬手示意对方站起身来，然后说道：“请站好，你要明白：对于根本不存在的麻烦，根本不需要道歉。我真心认为，一个简单的感谢举动就足够了，因此……我向您表示感谢。”

“等等，你是在……感谢我吗？”

他将手指尖轻轻相触，然后郑重地点了点头。确实如此！您的女儿非常热情且周到，还专门陪我参观了这座生态城市。毕竟，既然我将在这些殖民地居住一段不确定的时间，我自然希望熟悉这里的环境。为此，我想要向您的女儿表示感谢，而这份感谢也同样适用于您，作为她的父亲。
                            |感谢你把她带回了家。
                        ]作为表达感激之情的方式，女孩的父亲邀请你们两人与他共进晚餐。奥贾王子起初拒绝了，但在女孩的坚持下，他最终同意了。而你，则根本不需要任何劝说—— [var0
                            |能够吃到热乎乎的食物，这个想法本身就已经足够诱人了。
                            |免费的食品就是免费的食品。
                        ]你走了进去。 [pc.hasFootwear
                            |带上你的[pc.footwear]先离开，然后再跟上。
                            |并遵循之。
                        ]其他所有人也是如此。你随意扫视了一下这个地方，便注意到了它那朴实的魅力：农具靠在墙上，装有根茎植物的陶罐放在窗边，地上还散落着一些木制玩具。你甚至看到墙上有许多切割的痕迹，这些痕迹记录了一个人这些年来成长的过程。显然，这是一个有人居住的地方。虽然面积不大，但确实非常温馨。
                        
                        爸爸，爸爸！你喜欢我的朋友们吗？”

“我当然喜欢了，宝贝，”那位黑发的狐人一边说，一边轻拍着女儿的脑袋。“既然我们有客人来了，你能帮忙给他们每个人拿一碗食物吗？别担心，我早些时候准备了一些食物，应该够用的。只要记住我教你的方法，好吗？
                        
                        别担心，爸爸，我不会再烫伤自己了。”

“你真的保证吗？”

“用小指许诺！”女孩伸出小指，与爸爸的手指交叉在一起，然后欢快地跑开了。
                        
                        你坐在一张低矮的桌子旁，继续环顾四周，但总觉得有些不对劲。从那只白色狐妖脸上那凝重的表情来看，他似乎也注意到了什么。

当那个女孩的父亲坐到桌子旁时，王子左右看了看，然后问道：“这里就只有你和你的女儿吗？
                        
                        那位黑发殖民者将双手交叠在胸前，确保自己的女儿不在附近，然后说道：“你注意到了吧？没错，就只有我和我的小女儿在这里。”

“我明白了。”奥贾王子闭上眼睛，轻轻呼了口气，“既然如此，如果我的问题触动了你的伤痛，那我真的很抱歉。
                        
                        那人举起了手。“求你了，别这样。[pc.ra kitsune
                            | 你不是说过，对于那些根本不是问题的事情，根本不需要道歉吗？
                        ]如果你不愿意谈论这件事，我理解。我们每个人都有自己的面具要戴，都有自己的负担要承担。”

他摇了摇头：“没关系。你特意去确认我女儿是否安好，这一点就足以让我认为你们是好人。具体细节我就不赘述了，不过，我的妻子……她已经不在我们身边了。
                        
                        [pc.isDK
                            |他应该不会为此抱怨吧？

“不，我不会。在我失去妻子之后，我面临着一个选择：要么整天沉浸在自怜之中，要么为自己找到新的目标。我仔细考虑了自己的选择，然后做出了决定。虽然这很痛苦，但事情已经发生了。现在最重要的是，要给我的女儿一个比我当年更好的成长环境。
                            |那……确实吧。作为单亲父母，肯定很不容易。

“确实如此。我亲眼见过这种处境会对一个人造成多大的影响，而那种影响绝对不好看。当我失去我的丈夫时，我也仿佛失去了一位母亲。他离开后，我看到妈妈彻底放弃了生活——仿佛她内心的火焰被彻底熄灭了。渐渐地，她变成了一个冷漠而刻薄的女人。作为一个被忽视的孩子，我对这位年迈的母亲唯一的感觉就是怨恨。这是一个残酷的循环，而由于缺乏正确的家庭教育，我也走上了违法犯罪的道路。可以想象，这种行为让我和妈妈不得不前往殖民地；不过，那或许也是件好事，因为在那里我遇到了我的妻子，也开始不断努力提升自己。
                            
                            这种看法确实比较乐观。从他讲述的故事来看，如果她能够帮助他改变生活，那么她显然对他来说意义重大。  

“她给了我生活的目标，也让我避免了重蹈我母亲的覆辙。然而，当我失去妻子时，我彻底崩溃了。在她的离去之后，我终于明白了母亲曾经感受到的那种空虚。尽管如此，我面前还是有一个选择：我可以像她那样整天沉浸在自怜之中，也可以打破这种恶性循环。因此，我做出了自己的选择：我将尊重伴侣的回忆作为自己的使命，尽我所能为我的女儿提供一个比我当年所拥有的更好的成长环境。我已经接受了发生的一切。
                        ]就是……别在她面前提起这个话题，好吗？
                        
                        [pc.isFemale
                            |这就解释了为什么她会请求你成为她的妈妈。 
                        ]你正要开口说话，却看到他的女儿拿着一套碗走了回来，于是你立刻住了口。

“我回来了！”她脚步轻快地走过来，同时格外小心地拿着那些碗，然后把食物分发给在座的每个人。“给你们，拿好。 [var1
                            |[pc.mf
                                |先生
                                |小姐
                            ]埃米南斯
                            |[pc.mf
                                |[pc.name]
                                |大姐
                            ]
                        ]给你，Oji！”

“谢谢。”Oja王子简短地点了点头，接过了那个碗。

快拿上你的盘子吧。[var0
                            |你闻到了它那诱人的香气，一种令人感到舒适的热量开始在体内蔓延，最终停留在你的胸腔里。你的胃部因为这种诱惑而开始跳动，迫不及待地想要开始品尝它了。
                        ]你仔细观察它的内容。在碗里，你看到的是混合了肉类、土豆和面条的食材，这些食材被油炸过，然后加入甜酱小火炖煮，最后还撒上了葱花作为装饰。

“看到了吗，爸爸？你将注意力从那美味的炖菜上移开，看到那个红头发的小女孩正双手伸向她的父亲。

“我没有烫到自己！我为你感到骄傲，亲爱的，”他说道，目光注视着她的手掌，脸上带着微笑。

你瞥了一眼那只白色的狐妖，发现他的目光也在注视着他们两个人。他甚至还没动过食物。如果再不开始吃，食物就会变凉了。你轻轻敲了敲桌子，想引起他的注意。

王子闭上了眼睛，露出了微笑，然后微微偏头看着你，把碗举了起来。
                        
                        在开始进食之前，你会先看看自己准备的食物。

                        "I'm back!" Walking briskly, but paying careful attention to the bowls she's carrying, she gets to the table and gives each of you your food. "Here you go, [var1
                            |[pc.mf
                                |Mister
                                |Miss
                            ] Emmynance
                            |[pc.mf
                                |[pc.name]
                                |big sis
                            ]
                        ], and here's yours, Oji!"
                        
                        "Thank you." Prince Oja gives her a curt nod and accepts the bowl.
                        
                        Grabbing your dish[var0
                            |, you take in its savory smell. You feel the sensation of a soothing warmth spread through you before finding a home in your chest. Your stomach tingles at the invitation. Ready to dig in
                        ], you inspect its contents. Within the bowl, you see a medley of meat, potatoes, and noodles that's been fried and simmered in a sweet sauce and then garnished with green onions.
                        
                        "See, papa?"
                        
                        You pull your attention away from the hearty stew and see the red-headed kit presenting both hands to her father.
                        
                        "I didn't burn myself!"
                        
                        "I'm proud of you, sweetie," he says, looking at her palms and smiling.
                        
                        Glancing over at the white kitsune, you watch his eyes follow the two of them. He hasn't even touched his food, yet. It's going to get cold if he doesn't get to it. You gently tap the table to get his attention.
                        
                        The prince closes his eyes and smiles. He then tilts his head slightly to look at you and raises his bowl.
                        
                        You look back to your food before digging in.'

rows.original: "Your hospitality was greatly appreciated. I pray we stay in touch during the coming days." The white prince brings his hands together to his lips and takes his leave. Following him, you grab your belongings along the way[silly |, but before you leave, you crouch down and give the little lady a gift: a rusty knife. "For me?!" Yes. Now go, do a crime. The rascal child smiles impishly and takes the dagger before scampering off with it | and set out ]. Stepping out into the open air, the foxen dignitary connects his sleeves and turns around. "I am glad you accompanied me in escorting the girl home, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. I must say: I thoroughly enjoyed this little expedition." You must admit, you [pc.isDK |didn't have a terrible time |had a good time ], but this is still far from over: you still have to get him back home and find out who he is. "That we do. My residence should not be far from here. We can converse along the way." The genteel fox-man spins on a heel and begins walking. First thing's first, you'd like a proper introduction. Who is he? You have the idea that he's royalty from the Old Country, but not much else to go on. "I suppose you are long overdue for an answer. Very well." The fox-man flourishes his hands from his sleeves and says, "I am Tetsuya. As you already know, I am a prince of the Oja clan — one of the twelve inheritor clans to be vaunted for its service to the Cherry Blossom Throne and the divine pedigree we carry as descendants of the August Master, Keros. Unfortunately, such gilded titles lose their luster once bereft of its cradle. Dull, I may be, I still walk the erudite path of the onymoji." [var0 |Oh, so he's [pc.isBimbo |good with |a practitioner of the ways of divination and invocation ] magic, then? |You're not familiar with the term. "Not many are," Tetsuya replies. "One could make comparisons to arcanists or sorcerers; while not entirely accurate, amidst the reeds of intricacies, I feel it to be the best approximation I can give for now. While I would gladly relish the occasion to lecture and discuss the matter further, I fear we will reach our destination long before I finish." ]Is there a particular field in which he falls under as an arcanist? "Aside from divinations or purifications, I primarily focus on the art of inscription." [pc.isBimbo |What's that? "In this instance, I refer to the art of imbuing an object — typically charms or scrolls — with magic. Even beyond the usage of spellcasting or the dismissal of hexes, you would be surprised how much power and authority there is within our own words." ] Okay, follow-up question: if he's some highborn noble from a faraway land, then why's he here? On top of that, when Komari asked you to meet the important faces here, why didn't she mention him? Tetsuya shrugs and says, "While I cannot speak on the governor's behalf, I can verily surmise an answer to that question. Though, I must admit, the truth is far from exotic expectation. Simply put, I have only recently come to this land from yonder gate, withal the lack of an identity. Unlike the quartermaster or the shrine sisters, I have not established myself with a proper role in the arcology as of yet. As for your prior question: I travel because I seek an adventure. It is my dream to see the numerous vistas our world has to offer. In that regard, you can consider me to be an explorer." Fair enough. Though, if that's the case, does that mean you ran into him right as he arrived at the den? The genteel fox-prince gives an affirmative hum. "More or less. Ah, there it is." As the two of you approach his domicile, affixed to various spots around the entrance, you see several strips of paper; marked upon on each of them, in broad, flowing strokes of black ink, is writings in [pc.ra kitsune |your people |the kitsune ]'s mother tongue. Looking at the exquisite calligraphy on these charms, [pc.ra kitsune |you're well aware of the latent power that each of them contain |you cannot make heads or tails as to what any of them say[pc.isMage |, but you intrinsically understand the purpose that all of them serve: each and every one of these charms have ACTUAL spell-storing glyphs inscribed onto them which await activation ] ]. "I would invite you inside for a cup of tea; unfortunately, my abode is far from presentable at this current time. Nevertheless, you now know where I live and can seek me out if you soever wish to speak again. Now, before I release you, is there anything else you wish to ask?" Actually, yes. Back at the house, when you were having [dayNight |a meal |dinner ] together, you saw him take a peculiar interest with the family's interactions. Why's that? "It's complicated." Tetsuya crosses his arms and leans against a wall. "Do you remember your dreams?" [pc.isDK |You try not to think of such things, especially if they're irrelevant to the topic. "And yet the thought comes. Please, humor this fool's question." ] [var1 |Yes, you remember your dreams — your family. You remember your time together with Kiyoko and your daughter, Kinu. While the Astral Plane isn't technically a dream, the process and sensation of being there is close enough to be considered one. "And you cherish these dreams, right?" Yes, without a doubt. You cherish being with your family and— "Wish it ne'er end." ... It's complicated. Make no mistake, you'll do whatever it takes to help free your family from their gilded cage, but deep down, you understand this means the end of an idyllic dream. Regardless of what happens, you love your family and don't want to lose them. "I too |Sometimes after you wake up, yes; however, [pc.isCunning |the moment is fleeting |only for a short while ] as your recollection of them fades over time. It's hard to remember them all, but what about him? How does this relate to back at the house? "It is because I ] covet a dream. The girl's exchange with her father brought back memories of that dream — it stirred a profound yearning to settle down and have a family."

]但是，这件事远未结束：你仍然需要把他送回家，并找出到底是谁干的。他正是如此。我的住处应该离这里不远，我们可以边走边聊。”那位风度翩翩的狐妖人转过身，开始向前走去。 首先，你确实需要一个恰当的介绍。他究竟是谁呢？你大概认为他是来自那个古老国家的王室成员，但除此之外，你也并不了解太多关于他的信息。 “我想，你早就应该得到这个答案了。很好。”狐妖人从袖子里伸出双手说道，“我叫铁也。正如你们已经知道的，我是奥贾氏族的王子——这个氏族是十二个继承氏族之一，它们因为为樱花王座做出的贡献，以及我们作为伟大先祖凯罗斯的后裔所拥有的神圣血统而备受尊崇。遗憾的是，这样的华丽头衔一旦离开了其诞生的环境，就会失去光彩。虽然我可能显得有些乏味，但我依然坚守着那些富有学问的符号所代表的道路。 [var0 |哦，原来他是这样。 [pc.isBimbo |能与相处得很好 |一位从事占卜与祈求仪式的人士 ]那么，魔法呢？ |没多少人熟悉这个术语，”铁也回答道，“可以把它比作术士或巫师；虽然这种比喻并不完全准确，但在这些复杂的概念中，我觉得这是目前最合适的描述了。虽然我很乐意有机会进一步阐述和讨论这个问题，但我担心在我们到达目的地之前，我还没来得及讲完呢。 ]作为一位奥术师，他具体专攻哪个领域呢？ “除了占卜和净化术之外，我主要研究铭文艺术。 [pc.isBimbo |那是什么？ “在这里，我指的是将魔法注入某种物品——通常是护身符或卷轴——这种技艺。其实，即便不涉及施法或解除诅咒，你也会惊讶地发现，我们日常说出的话语本身就蕴含着如此强大的力量与权威。 ] 好的，再问一个问题：如果他是来自遥远国度的高贵贵族，那么他为什么会出现在这里呢？更何况，当麻里让你去见这里的一些重要人物时，她为什么没有提到他呢？ 哲也耸了耸肩说道：“虽然我不能代表州长发表意见，但我确实可以推测出那个问题的答案。不过，我必须承认，真相与大家预想的截然不同。简单来说，我也是最近才从那扇门来到这片土地的，而且目前还没有任何身份证明。与军需官或神殿姐妹不同，我至今在生态城里还没有找到一个明确的角色定位。至于你之前的问题：我之所以四处游历，是因为我渴望冒险。能够欣赏我们这个世界所拥有的种种美景，正是我的梦想。在这方面，你可以把我看作是一个探索者。 有道理。不过，如果真是那样的话，是不是意味着你在他刚到达巢穴的时候遇到了他？ 那位彬彬有礼的狐妖王子点了点头：“差不多吧。啊，就是这里了。” 当你们两人走近他的住所时，你会看到入口处的各个地方贴着几张纸条；每张纸条上都用黑色墨水用粗犷而流畅的笔触写了一些文字[pc.ra kitsune |你的子民 |那只狐狸妖精 ]她的母语。看着这些饰物上精美的书法， [pc.ra kitsune |你非常清楚他们每个人所拥有的潜在力量。 |你完全搞不懂他们说的那些话到底是什么意思。[pc.isMage |但你本质上明白它们所有的作用：每一个这样的饰品都有着其特定的意义。真实的这些物体上刻有存储法术的符文，等待被激活。 ] ]我邀请你进来喝杯茶吧；可惜，目前我的住处实在不太适合接待客人。不过，你现在知道我住在哪里了，如果以后还想再找我谈话，随时都可以来。那么，在放你走之前，还有什么你想问的吗？” 其实，还有。就在刚才在房子里的时候，当你[dayNight |一顿饭 |晚餐 ]你们都注意到，他对这个家庭之间的互动表现出了异常的兴趣。这是为什么呢？ “原因很复杂。”铁也双臂交叉，靠在墙上说道，“你还记得自己的梦境吗？ [pc.isDK |你尽量不去想这些事情，尤其是当它们与当前的话题无关时。 然而，这样的念头还是会浮现出来。拜托了，请包容这个傻瓜的提问吧。 ] [var1 |是的，你还记得自己的梦想——你的家人。你还记得与清子以及你的女儿小娟一起度过的那些时光。虽然“星界”从技术上来说并不属于梦境，但身处那里的体验与感觉确实与梦境极为相似，足以被视作梦境。 你非常珍视这些梦想，对吧？” “是的，毫无疑问。你珍惜与家人在一起的时光，还有……” “希望这种时光永远不要结束。…… 这很复杂。请不要误解，你会不择一切手段来帮助自己的家人摆脱那种金笼子般的束缚，但在内心深处，你明白这意味着一个美好梦想的终结。无论发生什么，你都爱着自己的家人，也不愿意失去他们。 “我也是。 |有时候，在你醒来之后，确实会这样；不过， [pc.isCunning |这一刻转瞬即逝。 |只是短暂的一段时间而已 ]随着时间的流逝，你对他们的记忆也会逐渐模糊。要记住所有的人确实很难，但那个人呢？这与之前在房子里发生的事情有什么关联呢？ “正是因为我…… ]渴望那个梦想。女孩与父亲的对话让她重新想起了那个梦想——这唤起了她安定下来、组建家庭的强烈愿望。

rows.original:
You move in closer and work your magic on the prince, but he [pc.isHeight 72
                                    |shakes his head at
                                    |puts his hand on your head and stops
                                ] you.
                                
                                "While I find you physically attractive, I cannot reciprocate your advances at this point and time. Please understand that my reservation does not reflect disinterest nor should you think less of your own qualities — I simply do not know enough about your character and wish to reserve such encounters to a person I have formed a lasting bond with."
                                
                                [pc.isBimbo
                                    |You huff. He better not keep you waiting, then. You have lots of love to give and he has lots of hair that needs to be messed with
                                    |Well, it was worth a shot
                                ].
                                
                                "I have no doubt that I will find my destined partner in due time. As the saying goes: the red thread of fate may stretch or tangle, but it will never break. Depending on how our relationship develops during the coming days, that person could very well be you. [var0
                                    |Take heart: I noticed the initiative you took to help the little lady out. For that, you have my respect. 
                                ]However, I must call the conversation to a close as there is much work to be done. Hopefully, by [QUEST_FHAUS_MEETNGREET.isCompleted
                                    |tomorrow, I should have everything set up
                                    |the time of your next visit, I should have everything set up. In the meantime, I recommend you resume the task the colonial governor set for you
                                ]." 
                                
                                Sounds good. You bid Tetsuya farewell.
                                
                                "Thank you, and may fortune favor you in your travels."
                                
                                As you leave[party.som
                                    |
                                    | and make your way back to [companion1.name]
                                    | and make your way back to your companions
                                ], you take comfort in the fact that he didn't completely turn down the idea for something more. It's hard to deny that the prince has a mysterious charm to him. Only time will tell if anything comes of this.

rows.original: You step forth and knock on the door. Taking a step back, you wait patiently for it to slide open, but as the seconds turn into a full minute, there's only silence. Something feels off. Is anyone there? You knock once more. More time passes... Nothing. [party.hasCompanions |"Maybe he's not home," [companion1.name] says. |Is he not here right now? With the numerous charms hanging around, you dare not take the chance to check; who knows what these wards would do if you [pc.isBimbo |made them mad |triggered them ]! ] There's always tomorrow or the next day. Giving up, [party.yall] turn to leave[flags.TETTY_NEW 2 |, but as you start walking, a young, dainty voice speaks up. "[pc.name]?" A familiar red-headed kit edges closer to [party.yall], stopping when she's a couple feet away. You distinctly recall her mug back when you first met Tet[pc.isBimbo |ty |suya ]: she was spying on the two of you and then you helped her get back home. [dayNight |Did she wander off again |Shouldn't she be in bed right now ]? She hangs her head low, like a wilted flower, and kicks the ground. "Are you looking for Oji Oja?" Yeah, [pc.isBimbo |how'd she know?! |you were hoping to at least check in on the guy. Why's she asking? Does she know something, or is she trying to find him too? ] "I saw you knocking on his door. If you're looking for him, he's not here: he's by the shrine, but he looks sad. Can you help make him feel better?" You tousle her hair and assure her that you will. So, there's something on his mind. This at least accounts for his absence. It's rather odd, though, what's even troubling him? Tetsuya strikes you as a self-assured kind of guy. Only way to find out is to look somewhere around the shrine until you find him ].
rows.translation: 你走上前敲门。退后一步耐心等待门扉滑开，可几秒变成整整一分钟后，周围依旧只有寂静。感觉不太对劲。 有人在吗？你再次敲门。 更多时间过去…… 毫无动静。 [party.hasCompanions |“也许他不在家，”[companion1.name]说道。 |他现在不在这里吗？周围挂着这么多符咒，你不敢冒险进去查看；谁知道你要是[pc.isBimbo |把它们惹火 |触发了它们 ]，这些结界会做出什么事！ ] 总还有明天或后天。你们放弃了，[party.yall]转身准备离开[flags.TETTY_NEW 2 |，可你们才刚迈步，一个年轻娇柔的声音便响了起来。 “[pc.name]？” 一只熟悉的红发幼狐慢慢靠近[party.yall]，在几英尺外停下。你清楚记得第一次见到哲[pc.isBimbo |蒂 |也 ]时她那张小脸：她当时正在偷窥你们两个，之后你又帮助她回了家。[dayNight |她又到处乱跑了吗 |她现在难道不该躺在床上吗 ]？ 她像朵枯萎的花一样低垂脑袋，用脚踢着地面。“你们在找奥贾叔叔吗？” 没错，[pc.isBimbo |她怎么知道的？！ |你希望至少去看看那个人。她为什么这么问？她知道什么，还是也在找他？ ] “我看见你敲他的门。要是你在找他，他不在这里：他在神社旁边，不过看起来很伤心。你能让他好受些吗？” 你揉乱她的头发，向她保证自己会帮忙。 所以，他有心事。这至少解释了他为什么不在。不过这相当奇怪，究竟什么事在困扰他？哲也给你的印象一直很自信。要弄清答案，唯一的办法就是在神社附近寻找，直到发现他 ]。

rows.original: Walking along the stone path, you enter into the broad expanse that is the gardens. The air's silent, save for a calm breeze through the open bed of flowers which surround the small shrine. You almost get lost in the breathtaking tranquility of the scenery, but the familiar sight of a certain lone fox brings you back to your senses. The same cannot be said for the other figure, however. He seems to be lost in his own world. [dayNight | |The moonlight streaming in from above makes his pale complexion shine with a ghostly glow. ]The otherworldly nature of this scene is just like when you first met him. A gentle breeze from the north sweeps through the garden, rustling grass and flowers alike before flowing past him. The foxen prince's hair and fur offer no resistance against the blowing breeze as his attention is raised toward the distant heavens. You [pc.isBimbo |sneak up behind the fox-man and ambush him with a surprise hug |step forward and call out to Tetsuya ]. Something's clearly troubling him. "Oh, good [dayNight |day |evening ], [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. To what do I owe the pleasure?" You give him the rundown of your journey, starting from his house and then coming here. If it wasn't for the help of a familiar face pointing you this way, you doubt you would've even found him. [silly |The reserved fox-man closes his eyes and presses a curled finger to his lips. "I see." He then looks at you and smirks. "Thine aptitude in indefatigable pursuit is truly remarkable. Perchance, art thou surveilling my every step?" [pc.isBimbo |You pout and [pc.heightRange 48 59 |kick his shin |flick his head ]. "Ow, what was that for?!" Speak normally! You can't understand what he's saying when he's talking like a dweeb. |Who knows? Whether it's true or not is irrelevant. You just want to check up on him. ] Wordlessly, he spreads his arms out and gives a dramatic shrug. |"And so it has." The foxen prince folds his arms and graces you with a smile. "I know not whether I should owe it to serendipity or personal appetency. Whatever the case may be, I welcome your arrival." ] What was that earlier? Tetsuya hums and arches a brow. "Could you perhaps be more specific than that?" You tell him that he's acting strange. You're not the only one that's noticing this, either. Before you were pointed in this direction, your little friend mentioned that something was off; however, you can naturally come to that conclusion from just looking at him. If there's something wrong, you want to know. "Oh, that?" Tetsuya waves his hand to the side. "Pay it no mind. I simply felt compelled to go on a mid[dayNight |day |night ] stroll. I apologize if my disappearance caused you any concern. If you wish, we may return to my abode and continue this conversation. I do enjoy hearing about your tales of adventure."
rows.translation: 沿着石径前行，你便走进了那片广阔的花园。空气中一片寂静，只有微风轻拂着环绕着小神龛的开阔花丛。你几乎会被这令人叹为观止的宁静所吸引，然而，那只孤独的狐妖的出现让你重新恢复了清醒。然而，对于另一个身影来说，却并非如此——他似乎完全沉浸在自己的世界里。 [dayNight | |从上方洒下来的月光使他苍白的面容泛起一种幽灵般的微光。 ]这一场景所营造出的超凡脱俗的氛围，就如同你初次遇见他时的那种感觉。一阵轻柔的北风穿过花园，吹动着草地和花朵，随后从他身边掠过。这位狐妖王子的长发与皮毛丝毫没有阻挡这阵风，他的目光则投向了远方的天空。 你[pc.isBimbo |悄悄潜到那个狐狸人的背后，然后突然抱住他，给他一个突然的惊喜 |上前叫住铁也吧 ]。 显然有些事情在困扰着他。哦，太好了。 [dayNight |天 |晚上 ]， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]我究竟该如何感谢您才算合适呢？” 你向他详细讲述了自己的旅程，从他家开始，一直走到这里。如果没有那位熟人指路，你恐怕根本找不到他。 [silly |那位沉默寡言的狐狸人闭上了眼睛，将一根卷曲的手指放在嘴唇上。“我明白了。”然后他看着你，露出了一丝讥笑：“你在不懈追踪方面的能力确实令人印象深刻。难道说，你一直在监视我的一举一动吗？ [pc.isBimbo |你撅着嘴， [pc.heightRange 48 59 |踢他的胫骨 |摇摇头 ]哎哟，搞什么啊？！” 正常点说话吧！他说话这么古怪，别人根本听不懂他在说什么。 |谁知道呢？这件事是不是真的并不重要。你只是想看看他的近况而已。 ] 他默默地张开双臂，戏剧性地耸了耸肩。 |确实如此。”狐妖王子双臂交叉，微笑着对你说：“我不知道这应该归功于偶然的机遇，还是我个人的兴趣。但无论如何，我都欢迎你的到来。 ] 刚才那是怎么回事？ 哲也哼了一声，挑了挑眉毛：“你能说得再具体一点吗？” 你告诉他，他的行为很奇怪。注意到这一点的并不只有你。在别人指出这个方向之前，你的小朋友就已经说过有些不对劲；不过，光是看他现在的表现，你也自然会得出这个结论。如果出了什么问题，你肯定想知道原因。 “哦，那个吗？”铁也摆了摆手，表示那没什么大不了的。“别在意，我只是觉得有必要中途停下来[dayNight |天 |夜晚 ]散步吧。如果我的突然离开让您感到担心，我在此表示歉意。如果您愿意，我们可以回到我的住处，继续这次谈话。我真的很乐意聆听您讲述那些冒险故事。

rows.original: You very well know that you can't drop the matter. It's simply not in your nature to back down. Whatever's going on is more than he's letting on and it's clearly eating away at him. Something's wrong and you need to know what that is. Better to confront it now than to let it fester. You demand to know what's going on! Slowly, his smile disappears and is replaced with a tired expression. He then rubs his face and sighs. "I see. I hoped you ne'er had to see this side of me." [pc.isDK |A little late for that, pal. Everyone has their faults. If it's any consolation, you're by no means a saint either. |It's okay, he can trust you. ] "Therein lies my reluctance," he says. "[pc.isDK |I respect you |You're a good person ] and I appreciate your company, [pc.name]. Were it up to me, we would forget this ever happened and carry on like normal." What? Is he really asking you to bury your head in the sand and pretend everything is fine? You ask how turning a blind eye is going to fix the problem? "It won't, but neither will things get worse. With no extraneous information, no unhinging discovery to contradict your pristine image of me, this narrative can stay in sweet, perpetual equilibrium." So, that's his plan then: making you live in willful ignorance so he can keep running from his problems, whatever they may be. This is no way to live! "You think I don't know this?!" Then why's he intent on living like this? [silly |"Tch!" Tetsuya |Tetsuya opens his mouth to say something, but stops. He then ] scrunches his face, pinches his nose, and lets out a long sigh. "The reason is because we all have our masks to wear... our burdens to bear. This is my contrition. The thought of estranging someone because I am burdening them with my problems is a poison I do not wish to swallow. I do it because It is easier to just be the perfect prince that everyone wants me to be." It's okay, you're not so easily pushed away. You're here because you want to help. "Fine. If you still bear your convictions and want to know the real me, then you shall have it. But know this: once the seal is broken, there is no going back. We stand upon the threshold, but the choice to turn back or see what lurks beyond the veil is yours to make. You at least deserve that right." [pc.isBimbo |You[pc.heightRange 48 57 60 88 | put your hands on your hips and pout. Oh, you'll tell him your answer alright. As he bends down, you [pc.hasToes |stand on your toes |reach up ] and | [pc.hasToes |stand on your toes |reach up ] and | | crouch down to be eye level with him and ] [pc.hasClawedHands |[silly |boop his snoot |poke his nose ] |flick his forehead ]. "Ow!" Tetty flinches. "What was that for!?" He's acting like a silly bean, that's why! It's not good for him to think like this! He's a super smart guy, but he can also be very dumb. That's why you're here — to help him out. Yes, you may not know as many things as him or what exactly caused an ouchy-wouchy to his heart, but what you do know, is that the only person keeping him trapped in this sadness is him. So stop it! He shouldn't think so much and just let you help him to fight those nasty thoughts of his. Astonished, Tetty blinks and stares back at you with wide eyes. "[pc.name]..." That's your name, don't wear it out! But, you know... for someone that promised to spill the beans, they're not doing a lot of talking right now. "Right!" He brings a closed fist up to his lips. Tetty then |You tell him that you already made up your mind long before he even asked. You're dead set on hearing the unabridged truth. No point in dancing around the problem: you know it exists now. Sure, the two of you could go about pretending that nothing is wrong, but there'll always be a small part silently ringing in the back of your head, telling you there's something more just beneath the surface. Unfortunately, no matter how hard he tries to hide it, turning a blind eye and living ignorantly cannot be done anymore. Whatever secret he's hiding is clearly eating away at him, and not knowing what that is would eat away at you too. "Very well," Tetsuya says. He stands up straight and ], with a wave of the hand, beckons you to follow. [party.som |Y |Leaving [companion1.name] behind, y |Leaving your companions behind, y ]ou follow along beside the foxen prince for a leisurely stroll. Shafts of natural light pierce down from the roots, starkly brilliant against the muted air. Beds of delicate pink and white flowers dot the surrounding area amidst vibrant green grass and low bushes. Were it not for the oppressive air of melancholy, you could see yourself getting lost in the slow serenity of the scenery. It's truly a majestic place, but as the last person leaves earshot range, the two of you find a bench and sit down. "Do you remember our talk of dreams?" Tetsuya asks, holding a finger out for a [dayNight |butterfly |lightning bug ] to land. It's been some time, but yes, you recall that he wants to have a family. The prince watches the [dayNight |butterfly |lightning bug ] [dayNight |flutter |fly ] away and says, "Dreams are a strange thing. They can show us beautiful and impossible things which our hearts yearn for, but when they're over and we have to wake up, we're left with an emptiness in our heart. You can cling onto the memory and try to remake the dream, but the result will never be the same. This is the story of how I lost a dream. "It all starts with a young boy from a noble family. Growing up, the prince had numerous peers who would come to give their adoration, but no one to consider a friend. He was alone in a world that decided his fate. The boy wanted to be free, and so he found a secret garden where he could hide and be himself. In this garden, however, he found another: a girl. Her name was Sakura. She was the first person to treat him like a friend and he was happy. Over the years, the two of them grew close and she told him her dream — she wanted to run away and see the outside world with him, but he wanted to have a family. So, she gave up her dream for him." Tetsuya sighs. "It all feels like a lifetime ago, now. Everything seemed so perfect, but fate had other plans. On a night like any other, I returned home from one of my lessons, but saw Sakura lying there on the floor. Running over to her, I tried to help her, but there was nothing I could do — she was gone. There was neither mark nor injury; in fact, she looked like she was peacefully asleep, dreaming. Whoever did it must've used poison, but all I could think about at the time was holding her close and begging the heavens to end this nightmare. The silence was deafening and I was alone again. During my grieving, I was discovered by Kenji, the brother of my lost companion. When he saw me over her body, he must've assumed I was the one responsible for that crime. Eventually, there was a trial and I was proven innocent, but I knew that there was nothing left for me in the Old Country. So, I assumed Sakura's dream... and left for the colonies in the hopes of fading away." Wait, so during your first meeting with him— "Yes. The reason for my behavior tonight and back then is because I covet a dream of what could've been. There are nights when I wonder what would've happened if I had just ran away with her; would none of this have happened? At this point, I'm just... tired." [silly |Why does almost every kitsune you meet have some kind of cowabummer narrative? This is just getting ridiculous! |So, that's his story, then? ] Getting up, you stand in front of Tetsuya and offer a hand out to him. He needs to stop running from his past; if need be, you'll help him through this process. "How do I just forget the pain?" You tell him that isn't possible, but he can at least accept what happened and let his wounds heal over time. You then ask if he remembers the little redhead's father. "I do, yes. What about him?" Perhaps the lesson of that man's story might be relevant here. Tetsuya can either mope around for the rest of his life... or he can give himself a new purpose to fill that hole in his heart. He doesn't have to be alone. Speechless, Tetsuya looks at you, blinks, and then stares at the proffered hand. After a few seconds, he accepts it and lets himself be pulled up. "Thank you. I... sorry, I need time to think over this." You tell him to take all the time he needs. It's a shame you can't share this over a warm drink. "The invitation is always open if you wish to have tea. On this note, I shall excuse myself and begin deliberations over what has been said to[dayNight |day |night ]. You know where to find me if you wish to speak further." You let him go and watch him leave the gardens. Afterwards, you [party.som |head |return to [companion1.name] before heading |regroup with your party and head ] off.
rows.translation: 你很清楚，这件事不能就这么搁置不管。你的性格本来就不适合退缩。目前发生的事情远比他表现出来的要严重，这些事情显然正在对他造成伤害。肯定有什么问题，你必须弄清楚到底是什么。现在就面对这个问题，总比让它慢慢恶化要好。你必须知道到底发生了什么！
