]你跟随那位狐妖王子一起悠闲地散步。自然光从树根处透射下来，在昏暗的空气中显得格外明亮。周围环绕着翠绿的草地和低矮的灌木丛，其间点缀着淡粉色和白色的花朵。要不是那压抑而忧郁的氛围，你一定会沉醉于这片景色所带来的宁静与祥和之中。这里确实是一个令人赞叹的地方，但当最后一个人走远，消失在视线之外后，你们俩找了一张长椅坐了下来。 你还记得我们曾经谈论过的梦想吗？”铁也伸出一根手指，问道。 [dayNight |蝴蝶 |萤火虫 ]为了能够安定下来。 虽然已经过去了一些时间，但你们应该还记得，他一直想要建立一个家庭。 王子注视着[dayNight |蝴蝶 |萤火虫 ] [dayNight |颤动 |飞行 ]他走开了，说道：“梦想是一件奇妙的东西。它们能向我们展示那些美丽而看似不可能实现的东西，那些我们内心深处所渴望的东西。但当那些梦想结束，我们不得不醒来的时候，心中就会留下一种空虚的感觉。你可以紧紧抓住那些回忆，试图再次重温那个梦想，但结果永远都不会一样。这就是我失去一个梦想的故事。 一切都始于一个出身贵族家庭的男孩。在成长过程中，有许多同龄人前来表达对他的崇拜，但却没有人愿意将他视为朋友。在这个决定着他命运的世界里，他感到孤独无助。这个男孩渴望获得自由，于是他找到了一座秘密花园，在那里他可以隐藏自己，做真正的自己。然而，在这个花园里，他遇到了另一个人：一个女孩。她的名字叫樱。她是第一个把他当作朋友对待的人，他因此感到非常开心。随着时间的推移，他们之间的关系变得越来越亲密，她告诉了他自己的梦想——她想要和他一起逃离这里，去看看外面的世界；而他却想要组建一个家庭。所以，她为了他放弃了自己的梦想。 铁也叹了口气。“现在回想起来，仿佛一切都发生在很久以前。一切看起来都那么完美，但命运却另有安排。某个平常的夜晚，我上完课回到家，却看到小樱躺在地板上。我立刻跑过去想要帮助她，但却无能为力——她已经离开了人世。她身上既没有痕迹也没有伤痕，事实上，她看起来就像是在安静地睡觉，做着梦。作案者肯定使用了毒药，但当时我所能想的，只是紧紧地抱住她，祈求上天能够结束这场噩梦。寂静得令人耳聋，我又一次陷入了孤独。在我悲痛欲绝的时候，被我那位逝去同伴的弟弟健二发现了。当他看到我站在她的遗体旁时，他一定认为就是我犯下了那桩罪行。最终，一场审判证明了我的清白，但我知道，在那个旧国，我已经没有任何东西可以留恋了。于是，我选择了实现小樱的梦想……然后前往那些殖民地，希望能就此消失在人们的记忆中。 等等，那么在你第一次见到他的时候—— “是的。我今晚以及当初的那些行为，都是因为我在憧憬着那些本可能发生的事情。有时候我会想，如果当时我跟着她一起离开，会发生什么呢？难道这一切都不会发生了吗？现在，我只是……感到疲惫罢了。 [silly |为什么你遇到的几乎每一个狐妖都有一些糟糕透顶的故事呢？这简直太荒谬了！ |那么，这就是他的故事了？ ]你站起身，走到哲也面前，伸出一只手。他必须停止逃避自己的过去；如果有必要，你会帮助他度过这个难关。 “我该如何才能忘记那些痛苦呢？” 你告诉他，这是不可能的，但至少他可以接受已经发生的一切，让自己的伤痛慢慢愈合。然后你问他是否还记得那个红发小女孩的父亲。 “我记得，当然记得。那他呢？” 或许那个男人的故事所传达的道理在这里也适用。铁也要么就这样终其一生消沉度日，要么……或者，他可以给自己找一个新的目标，来填补心中那空缺。他并不一定非得独自面对这一切。 泰介无言地望着你，眨了眨眼，然后盯着你伸出的手。几秒钟后，他接受了你的帮助，让自己被拉了上来。 谢谢。我……抱歉，我需要一些时间来考虑这件事。” 你可以告诉他，他可以花任何他需要的时间来考虑。真遗憾你们不能边喝着热饮边讨论这件事。 “如果你想一起喝茶的话，这个邀请永远有效。基于此，我先告辞了，接下来要好好思考今[dayNight |天 |晚 ]谈到的事。如果你还想继续谈话，你知道该去哪里找我。” 你放他走了，然后看着他离开花园。之后，你[party.som |头部 |返回到[companion1.name]在出发之前 |与你的小队会合，然后一起前进。 ]关闭。
rows.raw: " You very well know that you can't drop the matter. It's simply not in your nature to back down. Whatever's going on is more than he's letting on and it's clearly eating away at him. Something's wrong and you need to know what that is. Better to confront it now than to let it fester. You demand to know what's going on! Slowly, his smile disappears and is replaced with a tired expression. He then rubs his face and sighs. "I see. I hoped you ne'er had to see this side of me." [pc.isDK |A little late for that, pal. Everyone has their faults. If it's any consolation, you're by no means a saint either. |It's okay, he can trust you. ] "Therein lies my reluctance," he says. "[pc.isDK |I respect you |You're a good person ] and I appreciate your company, [pc.name]. Were it up to me, we would forget this ever happened and carry on like normal." What? Is he really asking you to bury your head in the sand and pretend everything is fine? You ask how turning a blind eye is going to fix the problem? "It won't, but neither will things get worse. With no extraneous information, no unhinging discovery to contradict your pristine image of me, this narrative can stay in sweet, perpetual equilibrium." So, that's his plan then: making you live in willful ignorance so he can keep running from his problems, whatever they may be. This is no way to live! "You think I don't know this?!" Then why's he intent on living like this? [silly |"Tch!" Tetsuya |Tetsuya opens his mouth to say something, but stops. He then ] scrunches his face, pinches his nose, and lets out a long sigh. "The reason is because we all have our masks to wear... our burdens to bear. This is my contrition. The thought of estranging someone because I am burdening them with my problems is a poison I do not wish to swallow. I do it because It is easier to just be the perfect prince that everyone wants me to be." It's okay, you're not so easily pushed away. You're here because you want to help. "Fine. If you still bear your convictions and want to know the real me, then you shall have it. But know this: once the seal is broken, there is no going back. We stand upon the threshold, but the choice to turn back or see what lurks beyond the veil is yours to make. You at least deserve that right." [pc.isBimbo |You[pc.heightRange 48 57 60 88 | put your hands on your hips and pout. Oh, you'll tell him your answer alright. As he bends down, you [pc.hasToes |stand on your toes |reach up ] and | [pc.hasToes |stand on your toes |reach up ] and | | crouch down to be eye level with him and ] [pc.hasClawedHands |[silly |boop his snoot |poke his nose ] |flick his forehead ]. "Ow!" Tetty flinches. "What was that for!?" He's acting like a silly bean, that's why! It's not good for him to think like this! He's a super smart guy, but he can also be very dumb. That's why you're here — to help him out. Yes, you may not know as many things as him or what exactly caused an ouchy-wouchy to his heart, but what you do know, is that the only person keeping him trapped in this sadness is him. So stop it! He shouldn't think so much and just let you help him to fight those nasty thoughts of his. Astonished, Tetty blinks and stares back at you with wide eyes. "[pc.name]..." That's your name, don't wear it out! But, you know... for someone that promised to spill the beans, they're not doing a lot of talking right now. "Right!" He brings a closed fist up to his lips. Tetty then |You tell him that you already made up your mind long before he even asked. You're dead set on hearing the unabridged truth. No point in dancing around the problem: you know it exists now. Sure, the two of you could go about pretending that nothing is wrong, but there'll always be a small part silently ringing in the back of your head, telling you there's something more just beneath the surface. Unfortunately, no matter how hard he tries to hide it, turning a blind eye and living ignorantly cannot be done anymore. Whatever secret he's hiding is clearly eating away at him, and not knowing what that is would eat away at you too. "Very well," Tetsuya says. He stands up straight and ], with a wave of the hand, beckons you to follow. [party.som |Y |Leaving [companion1.name] behind, y |Leaving your companions behind, y ]ou follow along beside the foxen prince for a leisurely stroll. Shafts of natural light pierce down from the roots, starkly brilliant against the muted air. Beds of delicate pink and white flowers dot the surrounding area amidst vibrant green grass and low bushes. Were it not for the oppressive air of melancholy, you could see yourself getting lost in the slow serenity of the scenery. It's truly a majestic place, but as the last person leaves earshot range, the two of you find a bench and sit down. "Do you remember our talk of dreams?" Tetsuya asks, holding a finger out for a [dayNight |butterfly |lightning bug ] to land. It's been some time, but yes, you recall that he wants to have a family. The prince watches the [dayNight |butterfly |lightning bug ] [dayNight |flutter |fly ] away and says, "Dreams are a strange thing. They can show us beautiful and impossible things which our hearts yearn for, but when they're over and we have to wake up, we're left with an emptiness in our heart. You can cling onto the memory and try to remake the dream, but the result will never be the same. This is the story of how I lost a dream. "It all starts with a young boy from a noble family. Growing up, the prince had numerous peers who would come to give their adoration, but no one to consider a friend. He was alone in a world that decided his fate. The boy wanted to be free, and so he found a secret garden where he could hide and be himself. In this garden, however, he found another: a girl. Her name was Sakura. She was the first person to treat him like a friend and he was happy. Over the years, the two of them grew close and she told him her dream — she wanted to run away and see the outside world with him, but he wanted to have a family. So, she gave up her dream for him." Tetsuya sighs. "It all feels like a lifetime ago, now. Everything seemed so perfect, but fate had other plans. On a night like any other, I returned home from one of my lessons, but saw Sakura lying there on the floor. Running over to her, I tried to help her, but there was nothing I could do — she was gone. There was neither mark nor injury; in fact, she looked like she was peacefully asleep, dreaming. Whoever did it must've used poison, but all I could think about at the time was holding her close and begging the heavens to end this nightmare. The silence was deafening and I was alone again. During my grieving, I was discovered by Kenji, the brother of my lost companion. When he saw me over her body, he must've assumed I was the one responsible for that crime. Eventually, there was a trial and I was proven innocent, but I knew that there was nothing left for me in the Old Country. So, I assumed Sakura's dream... and left for the colonies in the hopes of fading away." Wait, so during your first meeting with him— "Yes. The reason for my behavior tonight and back then is because I covet a dream of what could've been. There are nights when I wonder what would've happened if I had just ran away with her; would none of this have happened? At this point, I'm just... tired." [silly |Why does almost every kitsune you meet have some kind of cowabummer narrative? This is just getting ridiculous! |So, that's his story, then? ] Getting up, you stand in front of Tetsuya and offer a hand out to him. He needs to stop running from his past; if need be, you'll help him through this process. "How do I just forget the pain?" You tell him that isn't possible, but he can at least accept what happened and let his wounds heal over time. You then ask if he remembers the little redhead's father. "I do, yes. What about him?" Perhaps the lesson of that man's story might be relevant here. Tetsuya can either mope around for the rest of his life... or he can give himself a new purpose to fill that hole in his heart. He doesn't have to be alone. Speechless, Tetsuya looks at you, blinks, and then stares at the proffered hand. After a few seconds, he accepts it and lets himself be pulled up. "Thank you. I... sorry, I need time to think over this." You tell him to take all the time he needs. It's a shame you can't share this over a warm drink. "The invitation is always open if you wish to have tea. On this note, I shall excuse myself and begin deliberations over what has been said to[dayNight |day |night ]. You know where to find me if you wish to speak further." You let him go and watch him leave the gardens. Afterwards, you [party.som |head |return to [companion1.name] before heading |regroup with your party and head ] off."

I write to you because I wish to apologize for my sudden absence; moreover, [tetsuya.truth |there's something I have to get off my chest |I wish to tell you that I too have undergone my own expedition. During my travels, I beheld many wondrous vistas, but this is one I wish to share with you ]. Before you seek me out, know that our meeting shall be in the south region — in the Harvest Valley. There, I shall wait for you. Seek me out at your earliest convenience. If possible, please come when the sun is low in the sky and the hour is golden. At the bottom of the letter, you see a rough sketch of the Harvest Valley and a cross mark at the northern section of the farmlands. He must be there. You wonder what he has to [tetsuya.truth |talk about |show you ]; the only way to find out is to speak with the guy."

rows.original: You see something in the distance. Straining your eyes, you can just make out the shape of a person's figure. His long alabaster hair, swaying in the faint breeze, makes him [dayNight |stand out amidst the bright gold of the wheat field |almost glow under the night sky ]. This must be Tetsuya. Without a second thought, you approach from behind. The long strands of wheat brush against your legs as you wade through them. [var0 |Tetsuya cocks an ear toward you, but goes back to facing the western mountains and says, "It's beautiful, isn't it?" [tetsuya.wooed |You [pc.isFeline |begin purring |croon ]. While the scenery is nice and all, your eyes remain fixed to the solitary figure. There's something more breathtaking which has caught your attention. "I'm glad you came, [pc.name]." |You draw your gaze toward the horizon and observe the rising dawn, watching it color the soft blue sky with its reddish-gold hue. ] |Tetsuya cocks an ear toward you, but goes back to facing the western mountains and says, "It's beautiful, isn't it?" [tetsuya.wooed |You [pc.isFeline |begin purring |croon ]. While the scenery is nice and all, your eyes remain fixed to the solitary figure. There's something more breathtaking which has caught your attention. "I'm glad you came, [pc.name]." |You draw your gaze toward the horizon and watch as the sun sets behind the Greyvale mountains, bathing everything in the valley with its golden-red hue before the eventual coming of twilight. ] |Tetsuya cocks an ear in your direction and says, "While it's no golden hour, I'm glad you came, [pc.name]." ] The strands of wheat sway from side to side while a deafening pause passes, the only sound being their rustling. The ever-present wind which comes from the west creates a pleasant white noise. As you stand in the field with him, you get right to the point. [tetsuya.truth |What's on his mind? "Catharsis, and an enigma..." While you can't quite place it, you can tell that there's something different about him. It's as if there's a sense of gravitas and weight to him now, giving resistance to the gentle breeze. No longer does it seem like he'll be swept away by the wind. You put a hand on his shoulder and ask if he found what he's looking for out here. "Not quite," Tetsuya says, shaking his head and turning around. "I'm close, but there's just one mystery left to be solved. That's where you come in." Sure. You roll your shoulders nonchalantly and ask what this enigma is. "You." He continues. "Ever since I told you the truth about my past, I had some time to think... and to reflect. When I first came to the colonies, I was lost, hollow — a listless spirit trapped in a phantasmagorical prison. That's until you came along and gave me form through purpose. With your help, I found the greatest treasure of all: a chance at salvation." [pc.dcb |You don't feel like you did much to put him back together. All you did was tell him a few words to snap him out of his moping, but if he wants to thank you for it, then by all means you'll accept every bit of his praise he's willing to give. Patting his shoulder, you tell him to keep his chin up and not to get stuck worrying about things |It's as you said before: he doesn't have to be alone. He's stronger than he thinks he is; after all, he's the one that pulled himself out of that pit |Awww! You smile and blush before thanking him. Then, you rub his shoulder and tell him that, for as long as you're around, he doesn't have to worry about those nasty thoughts of his ]. "[pc.dcb |I'll make sure to keep that in mind |Yet you're the one who threw the rope down |I appreciate it ]. Nevertheless, it's due time I tell you why I called you here[tetsuya.wooed |; after all, my choice for holding our meeting at a scenic place such as this was very deliberate. I'm aware of your feelings for me, and I would be lying if I said I didn't yearn for something intimate with you. I have no reservations about my heart's desires. You[pc.cupRange flat E |[pc.higherStat strength toughness cunning willpower presence |'re a powerful [pc.manWoman] |'re an athletic [pc.mf |guy |woman ] |'re a smart [pc.mf |guy |lady ] |'ve got a strong heart |'re a charming [pc.mf |guy |woman ] ] |'re a rather buxom [pc.mf |guy |woman ] ] with an equally prodigious [pc.isSoulbound |spark |soul ]. Relationship or not, you'll always be a trusted friend, but if you seek something more, then I'll stand alongside you as your prince." Tetsuya proffers a hand to you and smiles. "Shall you take my hand as a friend... or as a lover?" |. As you already know, you're someone I deeply respect. No matter what happens, you'll always be a trusted friend to me. In truth, I know not what the future has in store for me. What I do know is that I'll stand tall and face it. My only question is," Tetsuya proffers a hand to you and asks, "what'll your role be when we get there?" ] |Why'd he ask you to come this far out? If he wanted to talk, surely the den — or even his place — would've been easier alternatives. "I'm not without my reasons." The foxen prince raises a balled up fist and stares at it before he finally opens his hand. In his palm, there's a single cherry blossom petal, which the gentle breeze then takes away. He then turns to face you and says, "I[tetsuya.wooed | expressly chose this locale for its scenic qualities. I recall your attempts to court me, and I would be lying if I said I didn't yearn for something intimate. So, think of this as my confession. I have no reservations about my heart's feelings for you. I can see you[pc.cupRange flat E |[pc.higherStat strength toughness cunning willpower presence |'re a powerful [pc.manWoman] |'re an athletic [pc.mf |guy |woman ] |'re a smart [pc.mf |guy |lady ] |'ve got a strong heart |'re a charming [pc.mf |guy |woman ] ] |'re a rather buxom [pc.mf |guy |woman ] ] with an equally prodigious [pc.isSoulbound |spark |soul ]. I know not if your feelings still ring true, but if what you seek is companionship, then I'll gladly stand alongside you as your prince. Relationship or not, you'll always be special to me. Only question is," he holds a hand out to you and says, "does destiny have us be friends... or shall we embrace the [dayNight |future |night ] as lovers?" |'m here because I'm an explorer at heart. When I left my ancestral home, I did so in search of adventure and fulfillment; however, this also made me a lone wanderer in a strange new world. That's until you came along. The reason I called you here today is because I wish to know what the future has in store for us. I would very much like to share this adventure with you, but the only question is how it'll go." That depends... "Over the course of a few days, you've managed to enthrall me with your wondrous tales and prodigious heart. We've broken bread with one another; in that regard, that makes you a trusted associate. Yet, I know not the road ahead. In our quest for self-actualization, I wonder if the eventualities have brought us together as mutual friends or if there's a red thread which binds our fates." The white prince extends a hand out to you. "Do we walk as friends... or as lovers embracing destiny together? You hold all the cards, but regardless of your decision, I shall remain as someone you can rely upon." ] ] [var1]
rows.translation: 你看到远处有什么东西。你眯起眼睛仔细看，勉强能辨认出一个人的身影。他那雪花石膏般的长发在微风中轻轻摇曳，让他[dayNight |在金黄色的麦田中格外醒目 |在夜空下几乎散发着微光 ]。这一定就是哲也。你没有多想，便从背后靠近他。当你在麦田中穿行时，长长的麦秆拂过你的双腿。 [var0 |哲也朝你侧了侧耳朵，随后又转回去望着西边的群山，说道：“真美啊，不是吗？” [tetsuya.wooed |你[pc.isFeline |开始发出呼噜声 |轻声哼唱 ]。虽然景色确实不错，但你的目光始终停留在那个孤零零的身影上。还有更令人屏息的东西吸引了你的注意。 “我很高兴你来了，[pc.name]。” |你将目光投向地平线，注视着初升的黎明，看它为柔和的蓝色天空染上红金色的光辉。 ] |哲也朝你侧了侧耳朵，随后又转回去望着西边的群山，说道：“真美啊，不是吗？” [tetsuya.wooed |你[pc.isFeline |开始发出呼噜声 |轻声哼唱 ]。虽然景色确实不错，但你的目光始终停留在那个孤零零的身影上。还有某种更加动人心魄的东西吸引了你的注意。 “我很高兴你来了，[pc.name]。” |你将目光投向地平线，看着太阳落到灰谷山脉背后，为山谷中的万物镀上金红色的余晖，随后暮色终于降临。 ] |哲也朝你的方向侧了侧耳朵，说道：“虽然现在并非黄金时刻，但我很高兴你来了，[pc.name]。” ] 麦穗左右摇摆，一阵令人窒息的沉默随之而来，唯一的声响就是它们沙沙的摩擦声。从西边吹来的风始终不停，营造出一种令人愉悦的白噪音。当你和他一起站在田里时，你直接切入正题。 [tetsuya.truth |他在想什么？ “宣泄，以及一个谜团……” 虽然你说不清原因，但你能看出他有些不一样了。他如今仿佛带着一种庄重与分量，让轻柔的微风都受到了阻力。他看起来再也不像会被风卷走的样子。你把手搭在他的肩上，问他是否在这里找到了他想要找的东西。 “还没有，”哲也摇着头，转过身来说道，“我就快找到了，但还剩一个谜题有待解开。这就需要你出场了。” 当然。你漫不经心地转了转肩膀，问这个谜团究竟是什么。 “就是你。”他继续说道，“自从我把自己过去的真相告诉你之后，我花了一些时间去思考……去反省。我初到殖民地时，迷失又空虚——一个无精打采的灵魂，被困在幻影般的牢笼里。直到你出现，用目标赋予了我形体。在你的帮助下，我找到了最珍贵的宝物：一次获得救赎的机会。” [pc.dcb |你觉得你并没有做什么让他重新振作的事。你只是说了几句话，让他从自怨自艾中清醒过来而已。但如果他想为此感谢你，那么你当然愿意接受他愿意给予你的每一句赞美。你拍拍他的肩膀，告诉他要抬起头来，不要总为那些事纠结 |就像你之前说的：他不必独自一人。他比自己以为的更坚强；毕竟，是他自己把自己从那个深坑里拉了出来 |哇哦！你微笑着涨红了脸，向他道谢。接着，你揉揉他的肩膀，告诉他，只要你在，他就不必担心自己那些糟糕的念头 ]。 “[pc.dcb |我会牢记在心的 |可绳子是你扔下来的 |我很感激 ]。不过，也是时候告诉你我为什么把你叫到这里来了[tetsuya.wooed |；毕竟，我特意把我们的会面选在这样一个风景优美的地方。我知道你对我的感情，如果我说自己不曾渴望与你亲密，那就是在撒谎。我对自己内心的渴望毫无顾虑。你[pc.cupRange flat E |[pc.higherStat strength toughness cunning willpower presence |你是一位强大的[pc.manWoman] |你是一位健壮的[pc.mf |男人 |女人 ] |你是一位聪明的[pc.mf |男人 |女士 ] |你有一颗坚强的心 |你是一位迷人的[pc.mf |男人 |女人 ] ] |你是一位相当丰满的[pc.mf |男人 |女人 ] ]并拥有同样出众的[pc.isSoulbound |火花 |灵魂 ]。无论是否发展成恋人关系，你永远都是我值得信赖的朋友；但如果你想寻求更多，那我会以你王子的身份站在你身旁。”哲也向你伸出一只手，微笑着说：“你愿意作为朋友牵起我的手……还是作为恋人呢？” |。“如你所知，你是我深深敬重的人。无论发生什么，你永远都是我可以信赖的朋友。说实话，我不知道未来为我准备了什么。我只知道，我会挺直腰杆去面对它。我唯一的问题是，”哲也向你伸出一只手，问道，“当我们走到那一步时，你会扮演什么角色？” ] |他为什么要把你叫到这么远的地方来？如果他想谈话，那么巢穴——甚至他自己的住处——不是更方便的选择吗？ “我并非没有理由。”狐妖王子攥起拳头，盯着它看了一会儿，最后才张开手。他的掌心里有一片樱花花瓣，随即被和煦的微风带走。接着他转身面对你，说道：“我[tetsuya.wooed | 我特意选择了这个地方，因为这里的风景优美。我记得你曾试图追求我，如果我说自己不曾渴望亲密之事，那就是在撒谎。所以，就把这当作我的告白吧。我对自己心中的感情毫无保留。我可以看出你[pc.cupRange flat E |[pc.higherStat strength toughness cunning willpower presence |你是一位强大的[pc.manWoman] |你是一位健壮的[pc.mf |男人 |女人 ] |你是一位聪明的[pc.mf |男人 |女士 ] |你有一颗坚强的心 |你是一位迷人的[pc.mf |男人 |女人 ] ] |你是一位相当丰满的[pc.mf |男人 |女人 ] ]并拥有同样出众的[pc.isSoulbound |火花 |灵魂 ]。我不知道你的感情是否依然如初，但如果你寻求的是陪伴，那么我很乐意以你王子的身份站在你身旁。无论是否发展成恋人，你对我来说永远都是特别的。唯一的问题是，”他向你伸出手，说道，“命运是让我们成为朋友……还是让我们作为恋人拥抱[dayNight |未来 |夜晚 ]作为恋人？” |“我来到这里，是因为我骨子里是个探险家。当我离开祖辈的家园时，是为了追寻冒险与成就；然而，这也让我成了陌生新世界中一个孤独的流浪者。直到你出现。我今天把你叫来这里，是因为我想知道未来为我们准备了什么。我非常愿意与你分享这段冒险，但唯一的问题是它会如何发展。” 那得看情况了…… “在这几天的时间里，你用那些奇妙的故事和非凡的胸襟折服了我。我们曾一同进餐；就此而言，你算得上是我值得信赖的伙伴。然而，我并不知道前路如何。在追求自我实现的过程中，我在想，究竟是种种际遇让我们成了彼此的朋友，还是有一条红线将我们的命运系在一起。”白衣王子向你伸出一只手。“我们是作为朋友同行……还是作为恋人共同拥抱命运？你手里握着所有的牌，但无论你做出什么决定，我都会是你可以依靠的人。” ] ] [var1]

rows.original:
In the heat of the moment, you push Tetsuya's hand aside and throw your arms around him as you go in for a kiss. The foxen prince freezes in place, but after a pregnant pause, he settles into the kiss and wraps an arm about your waist. The only movements you feel is his racing heartbeat and the calm [dayNight
            |[var0
                |morning
                |afternoon
            ]
            |midnight
        ] breeze. Pulling away from the kiss, you smile at Tetsuya and ask if that answers his question.
        
        The white kitsune parts his lips, as if to speak, but nothing comes out. You can imagine the wheels that are spinning in his head, the slight movements of his eyes as he tries to arrange his thoughts into words. He then smiles and gives you a single, slight nod. Riding the wave of emotions, you close your eyes and [pc.isHeight 66
            |bring your head down to his shoulder
            |nuzzle against his chest
        ].[pc.hasTailTags long fluffy
            | Behind you, your [pc.tails] begin[singular
                |s
            ] to wiggle — an indication of your profound excitement and heartfelt glee.
        ] Tetsuya brings a hand up and holds the back of your head, keeping you steady in his warm embrace.
        
        "I'm still here, and I'll always be here for you. I want to be there to share in your happiness, to support you in your sadness... but most of all," he leans back and gently pinches your chin, "I want to see you smile. I love you, [pc.name]. I can only fathom what we'll find as we explore this brave new world together."
        
        With that, you hold him tight and kiss him once more. This kiss, however, is deeper and longer than the one before...

在那一刹那，你将哲也的手推开，紧紧搂住他，吻了上去。那位狐妖王子愣在原地，但过了一会儿后，他也回应了这个吻，将手臂环绕在你的腰间。你能感受到的，只有他急速跳动的心跳，以及那份平静[dayNight
            |[var0
                |早晨
                |下午
            ]

The foxen prince freezes in place, but after a pregnant pause, he settles into the kiss and wraps an arm about your waist. The only movements you feel is his racing heartbeat and the calm [dayNight
            |[var0
                |morning
                |afternoon
            ]
            |midnight
        ] breeze. Pulling away from the kiss, you smile at Tetsuya and ask if that answers his question.
        
        The white kitsune parts his lips, as if to speak, but nothing comes out. You can imagine the wheels that are spinning in his head, the slight movements of his eyes as he tries to arrange his thoughts into words. He then smiles and gives you a single, slight nod. Riding the wave of emotions, you close your eyes and [pc.isHeight 66
            |bring your head down to his shoulder
            |nuzzle against his chest
        ].[pc.hasTailTags long fluffy
            | Behind you, your [pc.tails] begin[singular
                |s
            ] to wiggle — an indication of your profound excitement and heartfelt glee.

        "I'm still here, and I'll always be here for you. rows.original: [party.som |You |You and [companion1.name] |You and your coterie ] make the trek back. By now, your group has reached the sloped ascent which leads out of the valley and into town. Tagging along is Tetsuya, himself; after all, no fox-lover of yours should be going on a daylong trip through the wilderness alone. During your stroll along the packed gravel road, you [var0 |hold Tetsuya's hand as your [pc.tails] play with his foxen set |and Tetsuya hold hands ]. As Hawkethorne's southern gate crests into view, Tetsuya's gentle voice ends the silence. "Thank you, [pc.name]." For what? "For returning my feelings," he replies. Did he think you wouldn't? "There was the possibility." [tetsuya.wooed |No, not really. Your advances toward him were pretty clear |It's funny, actually. You were going to tell him about your own feelings at some point if he didn't confess. In a way, he saved you the effort ]. Tetsuya gives an amused chuckle. "[tetsuya.wooed |I guess you did |It took a while, but we got there. In the end, I'm glad I asked ]." You remove your hand from his as you then put an arm around his waist and [tetsuya.truth |ask how he's feeling. Is he still having trouble with his past? "You're thoughtful, [pc.name]. That's why I like you. To answer your question, though, the pain is still there. Even after it heals, the loss will always be there in the form of an odious scar. But, in knowing pain, the kindness of the world becomes so much brighter. I'm done feeling sorry for myself," he says with surprising conviction. "I won't squander this second chance. You've given me the world, so it's only fair I do the same." You're proud to see how much he's grown as a person. In the end, it's perhaps his charming personality which draws you to him, in addition to his romantic mentality. There's also his good looks, but that goes without saying. "I'm sorry I was —" Don't. You stop and run your [pc.hasClawedHands |claws |[pc.nails] ] through your sweetheart's hair. His long, alabaster locks feel smooth against your fingers as you brush downwards and trace the contours of his face. You then settle a palm on his cheek and tell him that he's a beautiful person; he should never apologize for that. Tetsuya holds your hand against his cheek and smiles. "I'm glad to have met someone as wonderful as you." The |lean your head against his shoulder. The ] two of you are a couple of right old fools, aren't you? "We are..." Without further ado, you and [party.hasCompanions |your group |Tetsuya ] return to town. [shopsOpen |Townsfolk and merchants treat your group with brief, yet curious stares — namely, the white kitsune accompanying you — before going back to their business. By and large, Tetsuya isn't an inconspicuous guy, but it's nothing this town hasn't seen before; if there is anyone with ill will toward the foxen prince, they don't show themselves while he's under your ward. When you arrive at the Waystone statue, you activate the your charm and traverse the Ways Between |The dim streets are silent as you make a beeline for the Waystone statue and activate your charm ]; before long, you're back at the Kurokawa Den. Tetsuya closes his eyes as he breathes a sigh of relief. "Sweet respite. It's good to be back." [dayNight |Miko |Mai ] approaches and says, "Well ain't ya two a sight fer sore eyes." The [dayNight |orange |ashen ]-haired sister then turns to Tetsuya and continues. "I reckon ya oughta speak with Granny if'n ya get th' chance. When ya up an' left without a word, she thought ya done started skivin' yer duties. Where'd ya go?" You chime into the conversation and vouch for Tetsuya, filling the shrine maiden in on what happened. "So, th' prince here done confessed to ya? I give him props f'r wantin' to be romantic and all, but he could've just done that here in th' den, no?" Well, despite being beautiful in its own right, the place you see every day isn't exactly the most romantic spot for a confession. Wouldn't she agree? Nonchalantly, [dayNight |Miko |Mai ] shrugs. "Whatever works f'r ya. Just make sure ya darlin' prince speaks to Granny if'n he gets the time, okay? I don't want him getting chewed out none." "Thank ya kindly fer th' concern, miss," Tetsuya says. "I'll make sure to visit th' matron an' clear th' situation with her. I'm sure she's the understandin' type." After you leave the shrine with Tetsuya, you lean in and ask if he really didn't tell anyone about his absence. "I did. I made sure to send both you and Komari a letter. Why she hasn't received hers is beyond me." He sighs. "I should've just gone to her office and personally put the letter on her desk. No matter, this shouldn't put a damper on our [dayNight |day |night ]." You offer to go with him and speak with Komari on his behalf. "The gesture is appreciated, but I fear the austere nature of that exchange would ruin the mood. Besides, this is a conversation that can be held at a later point in time — a conversation which I don't imagine lasting more than a couple minutes. I should be fine; after all, I have violated neither rule nor expectation placed upon me. For the most part, I'm under no contractual obligation to provide a service for the colony. As for the assistance I do provide, I do out of philanthropy to better the co[silly |o |m ]munity. In other words," Tetsuya kisses your hand, "we can spend as much time as we want together." If he's offering, how can you say no? Well, since the troubles began with the demoness, you've been shunted from one task to another — one place to another — hardly ever having the time to slow down and enjoy the moment. While the matter at hand prevents you from settling down and living a sedentary life, it's comforting to know that there'll always be a place for you — here, with him. That said, before you can continue with this, you need to know if your partner is fine with you being potentially absent for long periods of time. With your duties causing you to be blown about by the wind, you need to know if he's willing to wait for you or not. Above all else, you need to know if there'll be a safe place for you to come back to. Can he do that? Without hesitation, and assurance in his tone, he says, "Yes. No matter what happens, my home and I will always have a place for you. Were it in my power, I'd join you on your expeditions and fight alongside you, but we both know somebody's got to hold down the castle. Whenever — or however — you return to me, I'll be there and I'll be ready to receive you. The red thread which binds our destinies may stretch or tangle, but it'll never break." Your foxen-lover smiles serenely and brushes a thumb across your cheek. "You mean the world to me, [pc.name]. Plus, I like hearing your tales of adventure." The two of you arrive back his residence[party.hasCompanions | while [party.oneCompanion |[companion1.name] splits off and waits |your companions split off and wait ] for you in the communal guest quarters ]. Being the proper gentleman he is, Tetsuya slides the door open and permits you to enter first before following suit. Entering the living room, you go over and sit down at the low table as Tetsuya fetches a tea set from a cabinet and begins brewing a pot. Before long, the room fills with a bitter, yet soothing aroma in the process. It's funny, but in a way, this place could be like a second home to you. "Are you thirsty, dear?" Oh yes, you're actually quite parched after the trip. Tetsuya nods and dutifully pours tea into your cup before filling one up for himself. Once the tea has cooled down, you bring the drink to your lips and feel its soothing hydration run down your throat. Oh, that's nice. "[silly |So |Now ]." Tetsuya takes a single sip of his drink. "[silly |Wanna fuck? |Let's begin. ]"

Well, since the troubles began with the demoness, you've been shunted from one task to another — one place to another — hardly ever having the time to slow down and enjoy the moment. While the matter at hand prevents you from settling down and living a sedentary life, it's comforting to know that there'll always be a place for you — here, with him. That said, before you can continue with this, you need to know if your partner is fine with you being potentially absent for long periods of time. With your duties causing you to be blown about by the wind, you need to know if he's willing to wait for you or not. Above all else, you need to know if there'll be a safe place for you to come back to. Can he do that? Without hesitation, and assurance in his tone, he says, "Yes. No matter what happens, my home and I will always have a place for you. Were it in my power, I'd join you on your expeditions and fight alongside you, but we both know somebody's got to hold down the castle. Whenever — or however — you return to me, I'll be there and I'll be ready to receive you. The red thread which binds our destinies may stretch or tangle, but it'll never break." Your foxen-lover smiles serenely and brushes a thumb across your cheek. "You mean the world to me, [pc.name]. Plus, I like hearing your tales of adventure." The two of you arrive back his residence[party.hasCompanions | while [party.oneCompanion |[companion1.name] splits off and waits |your companions split off and wait ] for you in the communal guest quarters ]. Being the proper gentleman he is, Tetsuya slides the door open and permits you to enter first before following suit. Entering the living room, you go over and sit down at the low table as Tetsuya fetches a tea set from a cabinet and begins brewing a pot. Before long, the room fills with a bitter, yet soothing aroma in the process. It's funny, but in a way, this place could be like a second home to you. "Are you thirsty, dear?" Oh yes, you're actually quite parched after the trip. Tetsuya nods and dutifully pours tea into your cup before filling one up for himself. Once the tea has cooled down, you bring the drink to your lips and feel its soothing hydration run down your throat. Oh, that's nice. "[silly |So |Now ]." Tetsuya takes a single sip of his drink. "[silly |Wanna fuck? |Let's begin. ]""

Locked in place by your beloved's breeding bulb, it doesn't look like either of you will be going anywhere any time soon, but you can't find it in yourself to really complain. Your muscles feel like jelly, and it's a monumental effort just to lift your arms. Nevertheless, you bring your fingers to the exhausted kitsune's chest, idly tracing the grooves of his toned physique. His pale skin is smooth to the touch yet firm in a wonderfully masculine way. But, all too soon, your eyes grow heavy, your accumulated fatigue finally catching up to you.

    "Feeling tired?"
    
    [pc.isHeight 69
        |Lower
        |Rais
    ]ing your gaze to answer your foxen bedfellow, you're met with an earnest smile; there's a very paternal warmth behind his expression. Smiling back at him, you give him a nod. Tetsuya chuckles before affectionately wrapping tails and an arm around you and pulling you in close. You gasp for a moment, but you quickly adjust and mirror him[pc.ra kitsune|, forming a mutual ball of fluff around yourselves].
    
    "You[tetsuya.numKits 0 1 2
        |
        | and Setsuna
        | and our children
    ] mean the world to me. That may sound obvious right now, but I feel it bears repeating. I mean it, [pc.name] — I love you."
    
    You murmur your appreciation and hold [pc.isHeight 69
        |[pc.cupRange flat E
            |him against your chest
            |his face against your pillowy cleavage
        ]
        |nuzzle against Tetsuya's muscled chest
    ] before [pc.isBimbo

        |gently stroking
    ] his sweat-soaked hair and scratching his ears. Eventually, you just bury your face in your [tetsuya.married
        |husband
        |lover
    ]'s hair and let yourself doze off[dayNight
        | until his knot deflates enough for you to move around again
    ].

Slowly, your senses come to. The first thing your mind registers is the soft cushion you're on. [tetsuya.married
            |Your husband
            |Tetsuya
        ] must've tucked you into bed while you were sound asleep. He really is a thoughtful guy. Staying under the covers to stay warm, you stretch and roll over onto your side, reaching out for the comforting embrace of your beloved. After a few probing touches fail to find the man you're looking for, you open your eyes and pull the sheets down to see that you're alone in the bed.
        
        You sit up with a groan and rub the sleep from your face. There's no sign of Tetsuya here, but you do see most of his clothes folded neatly next to your [pc.gear]. But, as you begin to pull your [pc.legs] out of bed to investigate, the door to the room slides open, and in walks Tetsuya wearing nothing but his pleated pants, holding a bowl in one hand and a neatly wrapped box in the other. Even from the bed, you can smell how delicious the food is and see how steaming hot it is.
        
        "Good morning, sweetie." Tetsuya sits next to you on the bed and hands you the cloth-wrapped box. "It's no breakfast in bed, but it should suffice. So, did you sleep well?"
        
        Of course!
        
        As he goes for the utensil in his bowl, you quickly snatch it and put it in your mouth, taking a bite out of his hearty food before he can. Tetsuya watches you eat his food with a warm smile on his face.
        
        "I'm glad to see you enjoy my cooking." [pc.bellyPregRange 0 2
            |Gently, he takes the spoon out of your hand and grabs a bite for himself. "[tetsuya.numKits 0 1 12
                |Guess this means I'll have to keep making it
                |I wonder if our Setsuna will like it too when she grows up
                |With how big our family has grown, I suppose that means I'll be making a lot of it
            ]
            |He places a hand on your belly and rubs the baby bump. "Them, too
        ]."
        
        You stretch your limbs, yawning as you shake the last bit of stiffness from your body before placing the cloth-wrapped box on your lap and asking what his plans are for the day.
        
        "I just need to [rand
            |submit a report to Komari
            |deposit some charms at the storehouse
            |clean up the place
            |make a petition at the shrine
        ]," Tetsuya says, getting up and handing you your attire. "After that, I should have an open schedule if you want to stop by."
        
        Once the two of you are dressed, Tetsuya plants an affectionate kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste] and helps you out of bed. "See you around, [pc.name]." He then goes to the door and gives you a wave goodbye. [tetsuya.married
            |
            |"Don't be a stranger, now."
        ]
        
        You return his wave, still feeling the lingering presence of his kiss on your lips. As you watch Tetsuya leave the room, you [tetsuya.married
            |begin making plans for what kind of fun the two of you will get up to later
            |wonder when you can do this again with him
        ].

'
        Slowly, your senses come to. The first thing your mind registers is the soft cushion you're on. [tetsuya.married
            |Your husband
            |Tetsuya
        ] must've tucked you into bed while you were sound asleep. He really is a thoughtful guy. Staying under the covers to stay warm, you stretch and roll over onto your side, reaching out for the comforting embrace of your beloved. After a few probing touches fail to find the man you're looking for, you open your eyes and pull the sheets down to see that you're alone in the bed.
        
        You sit up with a groan and rub the sleep from your face. There's no sign of Tetsuya here, but you do see most of his clothes folded neatly next to your [pc.gear]. But, as you begin to pull your [pc.legs] out of bed to investigate, the door to the room slides open, and in walks Tetsuya wearing nothing but his pleated pants, holding a bowl in one hand and a neatly wrapped box in the other. Even from the bed, you can smell how delicious the food is and see how steaming hot it is.
        
        "Good morning, sweetie." Tetsuya sits next to you on the bed and hands you the cloth-wrapped box. "It's no breakfast in bed, but it should suffice. So, did you sleep well?"
        
        Of course!
        
        As he goes for the utensil in his bowl, you quickly snatch it and put it in your mouth, taking a bite out of his hearty food before he can. Tetsuya watches you eat his food with a warm smile on his face.
        
        "I'm glad to see you enjoy my cooking." [pc.bellyPregRange 0 2
            |Gently, he takes the spoon out of your hand and grabs a bite for himself. "[tetsuya.numKits 0 1 12
                |Guess this means I'll have to keep making it
                |I wonder if our Setsuna will like it too when she grows up
                |With how big our family has grown, I suppose that means I'll be making a lot of it
            ]
            |He places a hand on your belly and rubs the baby bump. "Them, too
        ]."
        
        You stretch your limbs, yawning as you shake the last bit of stiffness from your body before placing the cloth-wrapped box on your lap and asking what his plans are for the day.
        
        "I just need to [rand
            |submit a report to Komari
            |deposit some charms at the storehouse
            |clean up the place
            |make a petition at the shrine
        ]," Tetsuya says, getting up and handing you your attire. "After that, I should have an open schedule if you want to stop by."
        
        Once the two of you are dressed, Tetsuya plants an affectionate kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste] and helps you out of bed. "See you around, [pc.name]." He then goes to the door and gives you a wave goodbye. [tetsuya.married
            |
            |"Don't be a stranger, now."
        ]
        
        You return his wave, still feeling the lingering presence of his kiss on your lips. As you watch Tetsuya leave the room, you [tetsuya.married
            |begin making plans for what kind of fun the two of you will get up to later
            |wonder when you can do this again with him
        ].'

"Let[tetsuya.isAcquaintance
        | us take a short recess for now. It would do our legs well to move around
        |'s take a short break for now
    ]. Feel free to explore the place at your own leisure," Tetsuya says, picking both himself and a long, but empty, smoke pipe up. He then walks over to a nearby wall, turns around, and rests his back against it with pipe in hand. "I[tetsuya.isAcquaintance
        | shall remain here until we are both ready to resume
        |'ll be here until we're both good to go
    ]. You know where to find me."
    
    Following suit, you get up and walk around until you find a place to relax and think.[party.hasCompanions
        | Off to the side, you see [party.manyCompanions
            |both [companion2.name] and [companion1.name] keeping themselves distracted with small talk
            |[companion1.name] is minding [companion1.hisHer] own business as [companion1.heShe] idly takes the whole place in
        ].
    ] As you rest against the wall, your attention slowly drifts over to your foxen [tetsuya.friendLover
        |friend
        |[pc.mf
            |partner
            |darling
        ], [pc.isBimbo
            |Tetty
            |Tetsu
        ],
        |host
    ] as you decide to inspect him while he's not looking.
    
    Standing at five feet nine inches, Tetsuya is a thin, yet remarkably wiry individual. Save for the red markings on his ears, his hair and fur is the exact same white tint. Unlike the voluminous plushiness of his [tetsuya.tailCount] tails and ear fuzz, his rich, lengthy hair is silky smooth in comparison. Sure, his hairstyle might not be completely straight, but it's not for a lack of trying on account of how pristine it looks. You even pick up a faint, aromantic floral scent coming from the fox-man; likely the oils which give his hair and fur their glossy sheen. Personal hygiene clearly means a lot to him. After all, what kind of noble would he be if he didn't maintain his own immaculate appearance?
    
    Framed by a set of alabaster locks, Tetsuya's noble features and pale complexion exude a certain air of regality. Not the irksome, pompous attitude that comes from an overinflated ego, nor the imperial entitlement which sports a callous, oppressive air. No, this is a sublime, yet welcoming regalness, and that means comfort. [silly
        |In other words: he's not a complete dick. 
    ]Through his actions and grace, this noble scion earns his respect rather than expecting it from others. Nevertheless, while the air is still peaceful, you use this time to fully take in his pretty boy looks.
    
    First and foremost, there's his eyes: they may be closed at the moment, but there's no mistaking the power of those red markings to draw your attention to his golden irises. Then, there's the rest of his face to consider. Trailing your gaze down the bridge of his nose, the journey quickly comes to an end at his pert tip, and below that is his soft[tetsuya.isLover
        |, kissable
    ] lips. Furthermore, starting from his pointed chin, it rises and meets his sharp jawline. And, to top it all off, his pale face is free of any blemishes or grime. Overall, Tetsuya is an easy man to look at.
    
    "Looking for something, [tetsuya.isLover
        |dear
        |[pc.name]
    ]?"
    
    The lilted tune of his voice catches you off guard. Instinctively, you snap your attention back up, only to be greeted by a mischievous gaze staring back at you.
    
    An ethereal glow then ignites in the kitsune's leering gaze as, with a small, sly smile on his face, he says, "[tetsuya.isLover
        |If you keep staring at me like that, it's only fair for me to do the same
        |[silly
            |The machinations of your mind are an enigma
            |Curious, are we? If your intention is simple observation, then who am I to protest? Take all the time you need
        ]
    ]." He brings the brass mouthpiece of his pipe to his lips.
    
    Continuing downwards, you stop to look at his arms. And, it's just as you expected: there are no calluses or scars on his hands. Save for the faded ink marks on a couple tips of his fingers, his palms are as pure as the fresh driven snow. Furthermore, Tetsuya's wiry physique has a lean muscle definition to it. By no means is he a feeble guy; that said, you don't get the impression that he does much physical labor. He's athletic, but he's no warrior or field worker.
    
    [var0
        |As for the fox-man's attire, you see that he's adorned in a fine three-piece outfit. Atop everything, he's adorned in a loose, silver gown with long sleeves. Beneath the robes, Tetsuya wears a gray under-shirt that's held together with a black and gold sash. With how his shirt is folded and kept in place to comfortably fit his physique, you're treated to a v-shaped show of his firm chest. Completing the set is his white, pleated skirt, which flows all the way down to his ankles.
        |As for the fox-man's attire, you see he's adorned in an exquisite three-piece outfit that's topped off with a fluffy scarf wrapped around his shoulders. Due to the complexity of its ornate design, you spend a few seconds admiring what's there. The first article your eyes land upon is the loose, redwood-colored gown. Inside of his robes, however, it's a deep, crimson red fabric which matches the seams along the edges. Judging by the fine silken material and the faded floral designs, just this part of his outfit must've cost a fortune![silly| Those silk worms' sacrifice will not be remembered.] Beneath his robes, Tetsuya wears a black patterned under-shirt that's held together with an extravagant black and gold sash. With how his shirt is folded and kept in place, you're treated to a v-shaped show of his firm chest. Completing the set is his white, pleated skirt, which flows all the way down to his ankles.
    ]

            You suck in a faltering breath, triggering a quirk to his lips as he [pc.isHeight 68

腾也身高五英尺九英寸，身材瘦削，但却有着惊人的结实度。除了耳朵上的红色斑纹外，他的头发和毛发都是同样的白色。与那些柔软蓬松的毛发不同[tetsuya.tailCount]他的尾巴和耳朵上长满了绒毛，而他那浓密而长长的毛发相比之下则显得丝般顺滑。当然，他的发型可能并不是完全笔直的，但看起来如此整齐，显然也是他精心打理的结果。你甚至能闻到从这个狐妖人身上散发出来的淡淡花香——很可能是那些让他的毛发和皮毛充满光泽的油脂在作祟。个人卫生对他来说显然非常重要。毕竟，如果他不能保持自己整洁的外表，那他还算什么贵族呢？

被一头雪白的头发衬托着，铁也的贵族气质与苍白的肤色共同营造出一种威严的气息。这种威严并非源于过度膨胀的自我，也不是那种带着冷漠与压迫感的傲慢态度。不，这是一种崇高而亲切的王者风范，而这种风范带来的，正是舒适与安详。 [silly
        |换句话说：他并不是个彻头彻尾的混蛋。 
    ]通过自己的行为与风度，这位高贵的贵族后裔赢得了他人的尊重，而非被动地获得它。然而，在此刻宁静的氛围中，你却有足够的时间来仔细欣赏他那俊美的外表。

首先，就是他的眼睛：虽然此刻他的眼睛可能闭着，但那些红色的眼纹无疑会吸引你的注意力，让你看到他那金色的虹膜。然后，还有他脸部的其他部分需要观察。当你的视线沿着他的鼻梁向下移动时，很快就会到达他那挺立的鼻尖，而在鼻尖下方，则是他柔软的[tetsuya.isLover
        |令人想要亲吻的
    ]嘴唇。此外，从他尖尖的下巴开始，脸部线条逐渐向上延伸，与轮廓分明的下颌线相交汇。更值得一提的是，他那苍白的脸上没有任何瑕疵或污迹。总的来说，铁也确实是个非常赏心悦目的男人。

“在找什么吗？ [tetsuya.isLover
        |亲爱的
        |[pc.name]
    ]他那轻快的语调让你措手不及。本能地，你立刻重新集中注意力，却看到他正用一种调皮的眼神注视着你。

这时，那只狐妖那戏谑的眼神中突然闪过一道莹光，他脸上带着一丝狡黠的微笑，说道：[tetsuya.isLover

你屏住呼吸，而他嘴角却浮现出一丝笑意[pc.isHeight 70

            ]

|“鱼实在太难打动了。不管我把池塘装饰成什么样，它们总是装酷。” ] [pc.isBimbo |过了片刻，你终于反应过来，嘴角一扬。这个笑话不错！ |你呻吟了一声。 ] |此刻没什么别的事可做，你便靠在椅背上，和哲也闲聊了几分钟，互相说着些简单的客套话，被彼此的笑话逗得哈哈大笑。他很乐意陪你聊天，也确实证明了自己很会说话！ ] |你花了一些时间，向[tetsuya.isLover |你深爱的那个人 |哲也 ]讲述你的旅途见闻，他认真地听着你说的每一句话。对这只好奇的狐狸来说，没有什么话题是太琐碎的。随后他又问了你几个关于冒险的问题。这样你来我往聊了大约一个小时，却感觉只过了几分钟。唉，时间过得真快。 谈话接近尾声时，他说：“谢谢你，[tetsuya.friendLover |朋友 |亲爱的 |[pc.name] ]。 [tetsuya.isLover |[tetsuya.anyKids |由于我在这里职责在身，很少能听到外面世界的事，所以你讲的冒险故事总是让我很愉快。你只要知道，等这一切结束后，这里永远有你的位置。” 谁也不知道这一切结束后会发生什么，但和他一起安定下来、共同抚养刹那，这主意听起来也不坏。这件事你会好好想想。 |“你的故事一如既往地令人愉快。我不知道具体是什么时候，但总有一天，等这一切结束后，我会很乐意和你一起去进行一场大冒险。无论是去贾西拉还是提克里斯，我们想去哪里都可以，不过去哪里并不重要。重要的是我们一起去了。” 谁也不知道这一切结束后会发生什么，但环游世界这主意听起来也不坏。这件事你会好好想想。 ] |“听你讲你的冒险经历[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | 总 |总 ]是件很愉快的事。” “没问题，知道有人对你说的故事这么着迷，感觉挺好。” ] ]
rows.raw: " [weightedRand 1 1 1 5 5 |There's actually something you wanted an answer to for some time now — you've seen [tetsuya.isLover |your beloved |[tetsuya.isFriend |your friend |the prince ] ] pull things out from his sleeves, and it's got your interests peaked. Does he just keep everything he needs on his person? If so, how many talismans are up there in his sleeves? "Curious, are you?" Tetsuya says, reaching into his robes. He then pulls out a thin, chiseled stick and stirs his tea with it. Afterwards, he puts the stirring stick back into his sleeve and continues, "I[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | am |'m ] afraid I [tetsuya.isAcquaintance |cannot elucidate your question |can't tell you that ]. Trade secrets, and all. [tetsuya.isAcquaintance |You are |You're ] free to look, but I can assure you that you [tetsuya.isAcquaintance |will not |won't ] like what you[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | will |'ll ] see." You'll be the judge of that. Reaching forward, you grab one of [tetsuya.isLover |your beloved |[pc.isBimbo |Tetty |Tetsuya ] ]'s wrists. He doesn't fight back; he just closes his eyes and takes a sip from his [silly |trusty canteen |teacup ]. It's time to see what he's got hiding up his sleeve. You pinch the hem and look inside, expecting it to be a cluttered mess... but the truth of the matter leaves you disappointed: there's nothing there. There's no paper charms, no scrolls, no gems. There's not even the stirring stick you saw him using earlier! There's just his arm and the barren interior of his robes. Tetsuya opens one eye and regards you with a playful smirk. "[tetsuya.isAcquaintance |I did warn you |Told you ]." |"In my youth, I was captivated by the spinning of tops. Whether by acorn or seashell upon the flagstones, their motions were enough to satisfy the adolescent mind. As I matured, I had set aside such children's toys; in time, however, I came to understand and appreciate the elegant strength they exuded. For in a battle of tops, it was a contest of speed, precision, and endurance. More often than not, on an equal field, the fastest and first one to strike was usually the winner as slowness is what emboldens our rivals. A simple battle of wills, if you will. Even now, the balance and hum of its mesmerizing dance clings to me, still." |Is Tetsuya a cup empty or half full kind of guy — is he an optimist or a pessimist? [tetsuya.truth |"Hmmm. Good question." Tetsuya spends a good few seconds thinking about your question, reflecting upon the question. "I'd like to say I'm an optimist. I certainly try my best to see the goodness in things. That said, I'm by no means an infallible individual; after all, I have good and bad days just like everyone else. Regardless, I feel it best to see reality for whatever form it takes." For a self-proclaimed dreamer, that sounds rather... pragmatic. Continuing further, you ask if his stance extends to his worldview. What's his opinion on the world? "My views are the same as they've always been[tetsuya.married |, albeit under a whole new light. For that, you have my eternal gratitude ]. Be it good or bad, big or little, it all contributes to the bigger picture with its vibrant pattern. The world, and life in turn, is one of multitudes: friends, enemies, love, hate. To reduce it to a black or white image is an exercise in foolishness. I cherish it all for the profound effects it has on us." |He chuckles behind a closed smile and presses his fingertips against his chest. "I am an explorer — a man who yearns to experience all the wonders the world has to offer. In each scenic view and person, from emperor upon high, to servant low, I see a tale which stands worthy of remembrance. For it is our memories which keep these things alive. By holding onto this creed wholeheartedly, does this not make me an optimist?" It's a noble way of looking at things, that's for sure. That said, there's little room to contest what he's said: the drive to leave a mark on the world is a strong one. Also, who doesn't like watching a good sunset every now and again? It's funny though, with how much he preaches about the world's beauty, you'd think he was a devout Mallachite instead of a Kerosite. ] |[tetsuya.anyKids |[rand |"There's one unspoken rule about dad jokes," Tetsuya says. You ask him what that is. ... |"I used to have a pet dog, once, but the ducks at the pond kept attacking him." He sighs. "Guess that's what I get for owning a pure bread dog." |"How many apples grow on a tree?" [pc.bg hunter scholar barbarian |That's a difficult question. It really depends on the size of the tree and its surroundings |You don't know ]. "All of them," he says, smiling afterwards. |"Making tea isn't hard, but waiting for the kettle to boil sure is tea-dious." |"Fish are terribly hard to impress. No matter how I decorate the pond, they always play koi." ] [pc.isBimbo |After a second, it finally clicks and you smirk. That's a good one! |You groan. ] |Having nothing better to do at the moment, you sit back and spend a few minutes making small talk with Tetsuya, exchanging simple pleasantries with him and laughing at each other's jokes. He's more than willing to entertain and proves himself to be quite the conversationalist! ] |You spend some time filling [tetsuya.isLover |in your beloved |Tetsuya in ] on your travels, and he attentively listens to everything you have to say. No part is too banal for the curious fox. He then asks you a few questions about your adventures. This back and forth goes on for roughly an hour, but it feels like it's only been a few minutes. Oh, how time likes to fly. As the conversation winds down to a close, he says, "Thank you, [tetsuya.friendLover |friend |dear |[pc.name] ]. [tetsuya.isLover |[tetsuya.anyKids |It's not often that I get to hear about the outside world due to my obligations here, so your tales of adventure are always a pleasure to hear. Just know that, once this is all over, there's always a place for you here." There's no telling what'll happen once this is all over, but the idea of settling down with him and raising Setsuna together doesn't sound too bad. It's something you'll think about. |Your tales are, as always, a pleasure to hear. I don't know when, but one of these days, when this is all over, I would relish the opportunity to go on one big adventure with you. Be it to Jassira or Tychris, we could go anywhere we'd like, but where we go doesn't matter. What matters is that we did it together." There's no telling what'll happen once this is all over, but the idea of traveling the world doesn't sound too bad. It's something you'll think about. ] |It[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | is |'s ] always a pleasure to hear about your adventures." No problem, it's good to know that there's someone fascinated with what you have to say. ] ]"

rows.translation: 询问一下他的家庭情况。

rows.original: You're not able to have kids.

"Ah, yes. The wildling taskmaster. I have seen and heard of her in passing, but I'm afraid my knowledge of her is limited at best. My position as an outside observer, however, affords me a unique privilege to see the forest for more than just its trees. From our rare interactions, I have been able to get a glimpse into the fire which burns within her — she's a polite yet passionate woman, that much I can say for certain. There's nothing wrong with a boisterous attitude, mind you. I just find it refreshing because it's honest. As for the flame within her, only time will tell if it roars into something great... or fades into obscurity."
rows.translation: “啊，没错。那位野性难驯的教头。我只是偶尔见过她，也听人提起过她，但恐怕我对她的了解极为有限。不过，身为一个局外的观察者，我拥有一种独特的便利：我能看到一片森林，而不仅仅是其中的树木。从我们寥寥几次交往中，我得以窥见她内心燃烧的那团火——她是个彬彬有礼却又充满热情的女性，这一点我可以肯定。您要知道，喧闹的性情本身并无不妥。我只是觉得它令人耳目一新，因为它是诚实的。至于她心中的那团火焰，究竟会咆哮着燃成了不起的东西……还是会归于黯淡，唯有时间能给出答案。”
