rows.original:
Looking at the mess of tails sprawled out behind Tetsuya, a mischievous thought comes to mind. They're so graceful, yet appear so full-bodied — entranced by the glossy sight, you can't help but stand up and cross over to Tetsuya's side of the table.
    
    "Hm?" [tetsuya.isLover
        |Your beloved
        |Tetsuya
    ] remains seated, his eyes following you as he sips at his tea. From the glint in his eye, it's clear that he already knows you're up to something. It's not as if you were hiding it, after all.
    
    One of his fluffy white tails flick before you, clearly goading you into action with its tantalizing allure. [tetsuya.isLover
        |Plucking it free by the tip, so as to not give it the opportunity to slip away, you lift Tetsuya's tail and drag your palm along the silken underside of his defenseless tail. The sensation of full, rich fox-fur against your palm runs prickles and shivers down your shoulders and back. With the slightest pressure from both of your hands against opposite ends, you expel air from his voluminous fur.
        
        It's so soft... so warm...
        
        "Please, enjoy! [tetsuya.married
            |Since we're married now, it's only fair that you get to touch and enjoy my fluffy tails as much as you like
            |I think it's only fair repayment, since you take the time to come and visit with me so often. And if you like it, that means I'm doing something right
        ]."
        
        Now that's an invitation if you ever saw one. You begin stroking his tail in earnest, starting from a little ways past mid-length to the tip, always careful to not get too close to the base. Mid to tip in long, languid strokes, then divesting your fingers of his snow-white fur so you can sink your [pc.nails] back in and start the process all over again. After the first pass, your beloved's expression has softened considerably; after the fifth, he sighs happily and sways from side-to-side in slow, lazy motions.
        
        "This... feels nice," Tetsuya murmurs in delight.
        
        As you continue to stroke and groom Tetsuya's tail, you can feel a soft core inside, twitching with a life of its own, brimming with pent-up energy. Unsurprisingly you're offered with very little, if any at all, in the way of resistance of any would-be snags or snarls of fur as you stroke from base to tip. Gods, for your beloved's fur to be this immaculate, he must spend an inordinately long time taking care of his tails each morning.
        
        Before long, your [tetsuya.married
            |husband
            |fox-lover
        ]'s gentle swaying comes to a stop, and he cocks his head to the side, regarding you from behind his shoulder. "I'm glad my tails bring you joy. It's comforting to know that my hard work is worth it. Feel free to partake at your heart's content — my tails are yours[tetsuya.anyKids
            | and our kits
        ]."
        
        Unable to suppress your desire any further, you bury your face into Tetsuya's tails. As you breathe in his warmth, your nostrils and lungs fill with the sweet, floral fragrance of the herb oil he uses. Your heart and mind fall into bliss but, deep down, there's a needy, indulgent desire for more. One, two, three more tails — you grab all of Tetsuya's tails in a giant hug amidst the furry flurry. Rolling your hands along the plush expanse and huffing in that intoxicating allure, you pour every bit of energy in your body into nuzzling against him. You don't care about how shameful this might look — getting to do this with your [tetsuya.married
            |husband
            |lover
        ] just feels so right.
        
        Once you've had your fill of fox-fur, you pull away and let out a contented sigh. As you make your way back to your side of the table, you relish in your beloved's lingering aroma, memorizing the sweet-smelling herb oil he uses and the warm undertones of his natural masculinity on your senses. [tetsuya.anyKits
            |This is the scent of your mate.
        ]
        
        "I'll give you a moment to gather your bearings — get your thoughts together. Once you're ready, we can continue."
        |However, as you attempt to grasp it, your fingers just end up with nothing, the fur of the lustrous, fluffy tail flowing through your fingers like water. 
        
        Tetsuya sets down his cup of tea and looks at you from over his shoulder. "Are you having fun back there, [pc.name]?"
        
        You try again, but the fluffy appendage jerks back and playfully swats your hand.
        
        Tetsuya clicks his tongue. "Darn. You almost had it that time. Keep trying — maybe the third time's the charm."
        
        Driven by the singular purpose of capturing this elusive tail, you chase it down with gusto until you finally manage to pin down its warm core through all the thick fox-fur and take it firmly in your grasp. Tetsuya's tail playfully tugs and pulls against your hold a bunch of times — you're certain that if its owner wanted it to escape in earnest, it'd have succeeded long ago. Yet he continues to tease you for a bit, letting you get a good feel for the carefully cultivated fluffiness of his tail.
        
        "Congratulations, [pc.name]." The fox-prince regards you with a small, pleasant smile. "You have caught what you have sought, and thus earned the right to partake in their majesty."
        
        As he speaks, more of his tails snake their way to you, their tips snugly wrapping about your wrist and gently pulling your hand into all the divine white fox-fur you could ever hope to need.
        
        "Each and every tail on a kitsune is very important to them; I urge you to treat mine with respect. For a prince of my lineage and social standing, I cannot let them lose their glossy splendor."
        
        You start stroking his tail in earnest, starting from a little ways past mid-length to the tip, always careful to not get too close to the base. Mid to tip in long, languid strokes, then divesting your fingers of silky-smooth fox-fur so you can sink them back in and start the process all over again. No matter how tightly you try to grip the fine fur between your fingers, it's simply an impossible task. Everywhere you move your hand, there's just more and more kitsune fur to be had.
        
        "You really like my tails, don't you? I do not blame you — their fluffiness is the result of herb oil and plenty of loving care every morning. It can be tiring, but in the end, I think my hard work is worth it."
        
        It's so fluffy... so warm...
        
        At this point, you're just grabbing tail fluff as it comes within reach, gathering it together in both your hands and feeling it run across your palms before flowing away in little glimmering strands of silvery white. It's all simply wonderful.
        
        "Okay, [pc.name], that is enough fun for now." With several final taps of their brush-like tips, Tetsuya's tails slink away from you and return to their master. "If you want to partake in my tails again, there is always next time."
        
        With how wonderful his tails feel, it won't be too long before that next time comes.
    ]
rows.translation:
看着哲也身后那一排杂乱无章的尾巴，一个调皮的想法突然浮现在脑海中。它们看起来如此优雅，却又显得如此结实有力——被这闪亮的景象吸引，人们不禁会站起身，走到哲也那一侧的桌子旁。

“嗯？ [tetsuya.isLover
        |你深爱的那个人
        |铁也
    ]他依然坐在原地，一边喝茶一边注视着你。从他眼中的光芒可以看出，他早已察觉到你正在暗中策划着什么。毕竟，你也没试图隐瞒这一点。

他的那条蓬松的白尾巴在你面前轻轻摆动，那诱人的姿态显然是在挑衅你，促使你采取行动。 [tetsuya.isLover
        |你紧紧抓住它的尾巴尖端，生怕它会从手中滑脱，然后将手掌沿着它那柔软无防的尾巴内侧滑动。那种充满弹性的狐狸毛皮触感让你的手掌感到一阵刺痛，这种感觉顺着你的肩膀和后背一直蔓延开来。当你用双手分别按压它的尾巴两端时，它那蓬松的毛皮里的气就被排了出去。

真是太柔软了……太温暖了……

“请尽情享受吧！ [tetsuya.married
            |既然我们现在结婚了，你完全有权利随心所欲地抚摸和享受我那柔软的尾巴。
            |我认为这样才算是公平的回报，毕竟你总是抽时间来看我。而如果你喜欢这样，那就说明我做得没错。
        ]这可真是个再好不过的邀请了。你开始认真地抚摸它的尾巴，从尾巴中部稍远的位置开始，一直抚到尾巴尖端，始终注意不要太靠近尾巴的根部。用长而轻柔的动作从尾巴中部一直抚到尖端，然后让手指从它雪白的毛皮上滑落[pc.nails]重新开始整个过程。经过第一次尝试后，你心爱之人的表情已经变得柔和了许多；到了第五次尝试时，他会开心地叹气，然后开始缓慢而懒散地左右摇晃起来。

“这个…………感觉真好，”铁也愉悦地低声说道。

当你继续轻轻抚摸和整理铁也的尾巴时，你能感觉到尾巴内部有一团柔软的组织在微微蠕动，仿佛拥有自己的生命，充满了积蓄的能量。毫不奇怪，当你从尾巴根部一直抚摸到尖端时，它几乎没有表现出任何抗性，也没有任何毛发会因为你的抚摸而竖起来。天啊，为了能让自己的毛发保持得如此整洁，他每天早上肯定要花很长时间来打理自己的尾巴。

用不了多久，你的[tetsuya.married
            |丈夫
            |爱狐之人
        ]它轻轻的摇摆停止了，然后将头偏向一侧，从肩后看着你。“我很高兴我的尾巴能给你带来快乐。知道自己的努力是值得的，这种感觉真好。请随意享用吧——我的尾巴都是你的。[tetsuya.anyKids
            | 以及我们的配套工具包
        ]再也无法抑制自己的渴望，你将脸埋进了铁也的尾巴里。当你吸入他身上散发出的温暖气息时，你的鼻孔和肺部充满了他使用的那种带有花香味的草本精油的味道。你的心与思绪都沉浸在幸福之中，但内心深处，却仍存在着一种渴望得到更多、想要满足这种欲望的冲动。再来一条、再两条、再三条尾巴吧——在那一片毛茸茸的绒毛中，你紧紧地抱住了哲也的所有尾巴。你用手抚摸着那柔软的毛发，深深地吸着那令人陶醉的气息，然后将自己全部的能量都投入到与他亲密相拥的举动中。你根本不在乎这样做会显得多么可耻——能和你一起做这件事，就已经足够了。 [tetsuya.married
            |丈夫
            |恋人
        ]简直太让人满足了。

当你尽情享受了那些狐毛制品带来的愉悦之后，你会心满意足地离开，轻轻叹了口气。在走回自己座位的过程中，你会陶醉于恋人身上残留的香气，仔细回味他使用的那种芳香草本精油，以及他身上那种自然而散发出的男性魅力给你的感觉。 [tetsuya.anyKits
            |这就是你伴侣身上的气味。
        ]
        
        我给你一点时间来整理思路，理清想法。等你准备好了，我们就可以继续了。
        |然而，当你试图抓住它的时候，你的手指却什么也抓不到，那条光亮而蓬松的尾巴就像流水一样从你的指缝中滑过。

铁也放下手中的茶杯，侧过头看着你：“你在那里玩得开心吗？ [pc.name]再试一次吧，”你说道，但那只毛茸茸的触手却突然弹了回来，还顽皮地拍了一下你的手。

铁也啧了啧舌头：“真可惜，这次你差点就成功了。继续努力吧——也许第三次就会成功呢。出于抓住这条难以捉摸的尾巴这一唯一目的，你满怀热情地追捕它，直到最终穿透那层厚厚的狐妖毛皮，牢牢抓住它温暖的身体。铁也的尾巴顽皮地在你手中拉扯了好几次——你敢肯定，如果它的主人真的想让它逃脱，它早就成功了。然而，它还是继续逗弄你，让你好好感受一下它那被精心呵护过的柔软尾巴。
        
        恭喜你， [pc.name]那位狐妖王子正用那抹温柔而愉悦的微笑注视着你。‘你已经得到了自己所追求的东西，因此，你有权加入他们的行列。’”

说着，他的尾巴们纷纷向你伸来，它们的尖端紧紧地缠绕在你的手腕上，轻轻地将你的手拉进了那无尽的、神圣的白色狐妖毛皮之中——那正是你梦寐以求的东西。
        
        对于狐妖来说，它们每一根尾巴都至关重要；我恳请您务必尊重我的尾巴。对于像我这样出身高贵、地位显赫的王子来说，我绝不能让它们失去那光彩夺目的外观。”

于是，你开始认真地抚摸它的尾巴，从尾巴的中段稍远的位置开始，一直抚到尾巴的尖端，始终注意不要过于靠近尾巴的根部。用长而缓慢的动作将那些柔软如丝的狐毛从指缝间抽出，然后再次将手指插入其中，重新开始这个过程。无论你如何努力地用手指抓住这些细软的毛发，这都是一项根本无法完成的任务。无论你把手伸向哪里，都能找到越来越多的狐毛。
        
        你真的很喜欢我的尾巴，对吧？我并不怪你——它们的柔软度可是得益于草本精油以及每天早晨精心照料的结果。虽然这个过程有点辛苦，但我觉得我的努力都是值得的。”

它们的柔软度真是让人感到无比舒适……温暖极了……
        
        此时，你只需抓住那些触手可及的尾毛，将它们汇集在双手之中，感受它们在手掌上滑动，然后又化作一缕缕银白色的细丝飘散开来。这一切，实在美妙至极。

“好了， [pc.name]，这样就已经够有趣了。”随着它们的刷子般的尾尖最后几次轻轻一触，铁也的尾巴便从你身边滑开，回到了主人的身边。“如果你还想再体验我的尾巴，下次还有机会的。”

既然他的尾巴摸起来这么舒服，那么下一次到来的时间应该不会太久吧。
    ]

rows.original:
The two of you arrive back at his residence. Being the proper gentleman he is, Tetsuya slides the door open and permits you to enter first before following suit.

                Entering the living room, you go over and sit down at the low table once more.
                
                "Are you still thirsty, dear? I can make us a fresh pot of tea. I'm afraid our last batch went cold."
                
                Oh yes, you're actually still quite parched since you didn't get to drink much from your first cup. Tetsuya nods and goes through the motions of cooking up a new pot. Before long, the room fills with a bitter, yet soothing aroma in the process. It's funny, but in a way, this place could be like a second home to you.
                
                "Now that we're partners, we can spend as much time as we want together," Tetsuya says as he pours tea into your cup. He then fills one up for himself and continues, "I can always make time for you in my schedule."
                
                If he's offering, how can you say no? Well, since the troubles began with the demoness, you've been shunted from one task to another — one place to another — hardly ever having the time to slow down and enjoy the moment. While the matter at hand prevents you from settling down and living a sedentary life, it's comforting to know that there'll always be a place for you — here, with him. That said, before you can continue with this, you need to know if your partner is fine with you being potentially absent for long periods of time. With your duties causing you to be blown about by the wind, you need to know if he's willing to wait for you or not. Above all else, you need to know if there'll be a safe place for you to come back to. Can he do that?
                
                Without hesitation, and assurance in his tone, he says, "Of course. No matter what happens, my home and I will always have a place for you. Were it in my power, I'd join you on your expeditions and fight alongside you, but we both know somebody's got to hold down the castle. Whenever — or however — you return to me, I'll be there and I'll be ready to receive you. The red thread which binds our destinies may stretch or tangle, but it'll never break." Your foxen-lover smiles serenely and brushes a thumb across your cheek. "You mean the world to me, [pc.name]. Plus, I like hearing your tales of adventure."
                
                "[silly
                    |So
                    |Now
                ]." Tetsuya takes a single sip of his drink. "[silly
                    |Wanna fuck?
                    |Let's begin.
                ]"

You set your drink down and regard [pc.isBimbo
            |Tetty
            |Tetsuya
        ] with a smile before giving a curt apology and telling him how much you've been thinking about him and appreciating the fact that you have a friend like him. [pc.isKitsune
            |It's difficult to find a mutual peer in the colonial den, what with a handful of its residents keeping their distance from you out of divine reverence
            |Many of the residents here give you a wide berth just because you're not one of them — an outsider
        ]. He, however, has done nothing but treat you with amicable respect ever since you've first met him. You would be remiss to lose a friend like him.
        
        Tetsuya closes his eyes and lets out a relieved sigh, relaxing in his seat. "I'm pleased to hear that, [pc.name]. As long as you keep your nose clean and don't cause any trouble, I see no reason why we can't be friends. Plus, I'm just as much [pc.isKitsune
            |an intimidating idol
            |a stranger
        ] as you are."
        
        You can definitely toast to that.
        
        "Cheers!" [pc.isBimbo
            |Tetty
            |Tetsuya
        ] raises his cup. "To our health and fortune!"
        
        You take a sip from your drink once more, emboldened by your decision. There's no telling if your feelings for him will change in the future. But, for now, he is one of your closest friends, a man who you're sure would hurl himself into danger if the whole world came crashing down upon you right now. If that's not love, then you don't know what is.

rows.raw: " [var0 |You put your hand on your belly and appraise the gravitas of your body. The changes are as plain as day: you're well and truly pregnant now. Your body has gotten bigger and it's not just your outward bulge you're talking about, either. The foremost obvious change is those [pc.chest] of yours. Lifting one up from the bottom, you note its soft heft and sensitivity. You know that if you tried giving your [pc.breastsNoun] a gentle squeeze, [pc.milk] would come leaking out of your [pc.nipple] and trail down your chest. Looking at the rest of your body, you see how much broader your hips have become, a shapely form befitting your furthering transition into motherhood. Driven by a sense of maternal pride, you make it your duty to seek out Tetsuya. He has to be around here somewhere. Your [tetsuya.married |[pc.isBimbo |hubby |husband ] |lover ] needs to see how much you've grown; after all, the kit you're carrying is a part of him — just as much as it's a part of you. Once you spot Tetsuya, you waste no time in running over to him. "Oh, h-" You throw your arms around Tetsuya, interrupting him with a surprise hug. [pc.isHeight 74 |Keeping [tetsuya.married |your husband |the father of your child ] in an effusively tight embrace, you hold him close and stand up to your full height, picking the man up off his feet. As you swing back and forth, Tetsuya's legs and tails pendulously dangle[pc.bgcl minstrel noblescion scholar charmer | like some kind of foxen metronome ]. "Someone's... happy," he says with constrained difficulty, delivering a few quick taps to your back. Setting him down | He smiles and hugs you in return. "Someone's excited." Releasing him ], the two of you sit down together and enthuse about your pregnancy. As the conversation reaches an intermission, Tetsuya rests his palm on the side of your head and nudges you closer, letting you rest comfortably against him. Basking in the protection of his intimate embrace, you relax and listen to the fluttering heartbeats within your [tetsuya.married |husband |lover ]'s chest. Despite his front of a calm and collected demeanor, the truth is, he's completely head over heels with excitement and is no doubt just as anxious as you are, right now, for this child. Scratching and stroking [pc.isBald |your scalp with his fingernails |his fingernails through your [pc.hairColor] [pc.hairsNoun] ] while his other hand brushes your fecund belly, your beloved leans in and [pc.hasEmoteEars |kisses the tip of your ear |nuzzles against your head ]. "It's not long now. I'm proud of you, [pc.name]," Tetsuya whispers, his warm words a hair's breadth away from you. Your chest swells with aplomb. Turning your head to face him, you tell him how you're glad to have someone like him and lean in to give him a quick peck. However, he interrupts your approach by catching your chin with a thumb and forefinger. "I love you too." He then meets you halfway. The gentle kiss lasts for ten seconds, but for you, it felt like it lasted for only one — like a moment that came and went. Feeling his lips part from yours, you're left wanting for more; Tetsuya, however, leaves you with a parting gift: a kiss to your forehead. After that, Tetsuya stands up and proffers a hand to help pull you up. "You mean a lot to me. [tetsuya.numKits 0 1 |I still can hardly believe I am going to be a father |Be it the first time or the twentieth time, the impact of fatherhood has yet to diminish ]. The feeling is surreal, but exhilarating all the same. I'm glad you decided to stay here with me so I can see how much our little miracle has grown. When the time comes for them to enter into the world, please return to me so I can help you through this. You don't have to do this alone." You know. When the time comes, you'll be back here.[var1 | You flash your Waystone Charm to reinforce your point. ] That's if he doesn't accidentally trash the place while you're gone. "No promises." Despite his cheeky answer, you know you can trust him; he'll hold the place down in your absence. Written thereupon, it reads: Dear [pc.name], [tetsuya.numKits 0 32 |This is your ever faithful companion[tetsuya.married | and husband ]. I pray this message finds you in good health. [tetsuya.numKits 0 4 |While I am not there to tell you this in person, know that my love for you transcends any distance[tetsuya.numKits 0 1 | |. It's not long now until our little miracle is brought into this world. [tetsuya.numKits 0 1 |Even as the ink of my words dries on this sheet, I still can hardly believe I am going to be a father |Be it the first time or the twentieth time, the impact of parenthood has yet to diminish ]. Although, one can only wonder what profound effect this is having on you; after all, you're the one [silly |carrying our potato |doing most of the work here in carrying our ] child. You breathe a sigh of relief, and holding your arms out, you ask to see your baby. "It's a girl," he says, handing her over to you with a weak smile. "What're your thoughts on Setsuna?" There's a moment's silence as you look down at your mewling daughter in your arms. A dreamy smile wanders onto your face as you look at her golden hair and fluffy tails, and at last you let out a small, almost relieved giggle before bursting out into tearful laughter. Holding Setsuna close, you tell him that it's a wonderful name. "Thanks." Tetsuya looks up, slumps his shoulders, and drags a long breath until he regains his composure. "I can hardly believe it. We finally did it." You wish you could throw your arms around the loveable guy. Regrettably, you can't exactly stand up, let alone move much at the moment; furthermore, your arms are a little preoccupied with your daughter. Best you can do is hug him in spirit. "Then how about a kiss?" your beloved asks. He then plants a chaste kiss on your forehead |It's a healthy baby [rand |boy |girl ]! Tetsuya cleans the wet kit off and swaddles the mewling newborn with a fresh towel, and as your senses slowly return, you take the kit from him in your weak arms and hold the fluffy newborn close. As Tetsuya goes over to the closet and rummages around, you look down at the snuffling child wiggling in your arms and pawing at your milk-filled mounds. Raising the little one to a nipple, you sigh happily as the fox kit latches on and begins to nurse. After a few moments, Tetsuya returns with fresh bedding and helps carry the two of you to the new one before taking the soiled futon out to be cleaned. "I can only imagine how much that must've taken out of you, so feel free to rest here." Resting sounds nice, but what about him? What's he going to do? "Well, after I clean all of this up and [tetsuya.numKits 0 1 2 |I [party.has kiyoko |inform the High Lady of your situation |[party.som |send a missive to Komari about this addition |tell your friend [companion1.name] of your circumstance |tell your friends of your circumstance ], I'll be back to snuggle you and our daughter ] |bring Setsuna in, I'll be right there snuggling with you. I'm sure our daughter will be glad to have a sibling to play with |bring in the rest of our kits, I'll be right there snuggling with you. It'll be good for our children to meet their new sibling ]. Until then, hold the place down." It's not like you can go anywhere, and after Tetsuya leaves, you just lay there and bask in the blissful afterglow. After a couple of back and forth trips, you'[silly |re buried beneath a sprawling pile of floof |ve already got a sprawling pile on top of you ], but [pc.isBimbo |Tetty |Tetsuya ] just keeps coming in with more. In the meantime, you do your best in wrangling your children. Eventually, your partner returns with one last kit in his arms — Setsuna. "This should be the last of them." Tetsuya sets her down with the rest of her siblings on the bed ] and lays down with you. Cuddling together, you and your partner spend hours enthusing about [tetsuya.numKits 0 18 |your precious newborn |the massive family you've created ] before exhaustion takes its toll and you doze off. [tetsuya.numKits 0 1 |When you wake up, you roll over and quietly observe your sleeping [tetsuya.married |husband |companion ]. With a finger, you brush one of his long bangs aside to get a better look at your beloved's face. Tetsuya looks so peaceful and happy; that smile on his face is too adorable. You wonder what he must be dreaming about. Yesterday must've taken a lot of him; that said, he's not the one that gave birth to your daughter. By all rights, you shouldn't even be awake right now, no less first... but here you are. As you gaze at your sweet, sleeping prince, you get the impression that there's something different about him. You can't quite ascribe the difference to anything tangible; at least, not from what you can immediately see. It may just be postpartum or motherly intuition kicking in, but you swear something has changed. The best way to describe it, is that there's simply more... him there. It's like there's a grander presence and charisma about Tetsuya. Before you know it, you're looking at his tails. Unfortunately, counting all of them is easier said than done when all you can see is a white bundled lump of fur. Nevertheless, you push yourself up and begin counting those bad boys. With inspection, comes validation as you spot the difference... Tetsuya has gained a new tail! ]
rows.translation: [tetsuya.numKits 0 1 |哲也满怀惊奇地仔细清理着那件湿漉漉的婴儿用品，然后用一条干净的毛巾为新生儿包好身体。他说不出话来，泪水在眼眶中打转，身体也开始颤抖。最终，他再也控制不住自己了——哲也紧紧抱住那套婴儿用品，放声大哭起来。 你松了一口气，伸出双臂，想要看到自己的宝宝。 “是个女孩，”他微笑着将她交到你手中，“你觉得‘刹那’这个名字怎么样？ 当你低头看着怀中正在呜咽的女儿时，一阵短暂的沉默降临了。当你看到她金色的头发和蓬松的尾巴时，脸上浮现出一丝恍惚的微笑。最终，你轻轻发出一声几乎带着如释重负的轻笑，随即放声大笑起来。将刹那紧紧抱在怀里，你对他说，这个名字真是太棒了。 “谢谢。”铁也抬起头，耸了耸肩，深深地吸了一口气，终于恢复了平静。“我简直不敢相信——我们终于成功了。你真希望能抱住那个可爱的家伙。可惜，目前你连站起来都做不到，更别提移动了；更何况，你的双手此刻还在忙着照顾你的女儿呢。你所能做的，就是在精神上拥抱他。 “那亲一下怎么样？”你的爱人问道。于是，他在你的额头上轻轻吻了一下。 |这是一个健康的婴儿。 [rand |男孩 |女孩 当哲也走向衣柜翻找东西时，你低头看着怀中的孩子——那个正在抽鼻子、不停扭动身体、还用小爪子抓着你怀里那些装满牛奶的容器。你把孩子举到奶嘴旁，看到那只小狐狸紧紧地吸住奶嘴开始吃奶，你开心地叹了口气。过了一会儿，铁也拿来了干净的被褥，帮你们俩搬到了新床上，然后把那张脏被子拿出去清洗了。 “我只能想象这一定让你耗费了大量的精力，所以请在这里好好休息吧。休息听起来确实很惬意，但他呢？他打算做什么呢？ |把刹那叫过来吧，我马上就去陪你们。我相信我们的女儿一定会很高兴有個兄弟姐妹可以一起玩耍的。 |把我们其他的用品都拿过来，我马上就会过去陪在你身边。让我们的孩子们见到他们的新弟弟或新妹妹，对他们来说也会是一件好事。 ]在那一刻到来之前，就保持这个状态吧。” 反正你也无处可去，等哲也离开后，你就躺在那儿，尽情享受这份幸福的余韵吧。 [tetsuya.numKits 0 1 18 |一小时后，你的[tetsuya.married |狐丈夫 |亲爱的 ]返回结果 |几分钟后，你的[tetsuya.married |你的那个狐狸丈夫 |[pc.isBimbo |泰蒂 |铁也 ] ]带着你的女儿一起回来 |不久之后，你的[tetsuya.married |狐丈夫 |亲爱的 ]每次都抱着一个孩子回来，把他们放在蒲团上，然后离开房间，再回来时又抱着另外两个孩子。这样来回几次之后[silly |被一大堆柔软的绒毛彻底覆盖住了 |你已经有一大堆东西压在身上了。 ]但是[pc.isBimbo |泰蒂 |铁也 ]新的东西源源不断地出现。与此同时，你也要尽力照顾好你的孩子们。最终，你的同伴抱着一个最后的包裹回来了——那就是刹那。 “这个应该是最后的了。” 铁也把刹那和其他兄弟姐妹一起放在床上。 ]然后与你依偎在一起。你们一起拥抱着，花费数小时的时间兴奋地讨论着[tetsuya.numKits 0 18 |你珍贵的新生儿 |你创建的这个庞大的家族 ]在精疲力竭之前，你还没有睡着。 [tetsuya.numKits 0 1 |当你醒来时，你会翻身轻轻观察正在熟睡的[tetsuya.married |丈夫 |伴侣 ]你用手指轻轻拨开他那一绺长长的刘海，以便更清楚地看到你心爱之人的脸庞。铁也看起来如此宁静而幸福，他脸上的那抹笑容实在太过可爱了。你不禁想知道，他此刻一定在做什么梦。昨天发生的事情一定让他承受了很大的压力吧……不过，毕竟生下你女儿的并不是他。按常理来说，你现在根本就不应该醒着，更不用说还站在这里了……但事实就是如此。 当你凝视着那位正在熟睡的、可爱的王子时，你会觉得他有些不一样。你很难将这种变化归因于任何具体的原因；至少，从你眼前所能看到的情况来看，是找不到原因的。也许这只是产后反应，或是母性直觉在起作用，但你确信，有些东西确实发生了变化。用最简单的说法，就是——现在的感觉就是不一样了…… 他就在那里。泰孝身上似乎散发着一种更为强大、更为迷人的气质。不知不觉间，你的目光就被他的尾巴吸引住了。可惜，当你看到的只是一团白色的毛球时，想要数清它们实在是一件件困难的事。不过，你还是强迫自己开始仔细数那些尾巴。 在仔细观察之后，你终于发现了其中的不同之处…… 铁也长出了一条新的尾巴！ ]

rows.original: "Oh, of course!" Tetsuya says, his ears perking up. "Please, stay right there, I[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | will |'ll ] go get my things." The fox diviner leisurely flicks a mote of foxfire at the teapot, lighting the fuel beneath in a glow of blue and orange, and then goes into another room. After a minute of waiting, he comes back with [flags.TETTY_CHECK_TS |everything that's needed for the ritual and sets them down on the table. |an assortment of items: cups; paper; thin, hollow cylinders made of split reed; there's even a nice, hot bowl of rice with red beans. Color you slightly confused, but if he doesn't mind answering, can he explain why all of this stuff is important? [pc.isBimbo | |Save for maybe the calendar, none of this exactly comes to mind when you think of divination. ] "[tetsuya.friendLover |I'm glad you asked. Everything you see here will help us with the ritual |It's for the ritual, dear |Each instrument comes part and parcel for the ritual ]." One by one, [pc.isBimbo |Tetty |[tetsuya.friendLover |your friend |Tetsu |Tetsuya ] ] points to each article on the table and explains their significance. "The set of reeds, once combined with our soup here, will start collecting any grains that decide to stick onto them. After a minor incantation, each of the reeds will be removed and cut open. From there, all I need to do is cross reference the results with a few dates." He taps two fingers on the parchment. "That[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | is |'s ] why I brought the calendar." And what of the cups? Is he going to use the deposits from the tea for anything? "No. The tea is just tea," Tetsuya says, filling a cup up and then handing it to you. [var0 |With another cup in hand, he then pours himself one and takes a sip. However, once he tastes his drink, he stops, looks down at it, and mentions, "It could use a little milk. You wouldn't have any spare cream, would you?" ] ] Ready to begin, Tetsuya inserts the hollow cylinders into the soup and has you uncover your [pc.belly]. Then, with his eyes half-lidded, [tetsuya.friendLover |[pc.isBimbo |Tetty |Tetsuya ] |your beloved |the arcanist ] lays a hand on your midriff, holds two fingers in front of his face, and murmurs an incantation. Once his chant ends, he snaps back to attention and removes the reeds from the bowl, cutting each of them open with a small knife and then comparing the results with his sheet. After some time, he stops, looks at you, and nods. "[pc.pregStage 1 2 3 |You[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | have a |'ve got a good ] while before [var1 |our child is |your [var2] [var3] [var4 |child is |children are ] ] born |It[tetsuya.isAcquaintance | will |'ll ] still be some time before you give birth[var1 |. It won't be long now ]. Unless conditions somehow change, you have roughly [var5] [var6 |day |days ] left to go." [flags.TETTY_CHECK_TS | |With just the things he had on hand, he was able to discern [var1 |how long you have left for your pregnancy |not only the date, but the exact number and species of the [var4 |child |children ] inside of you ] — that's impressive! "[tetsuya.isLover |Thanks, and yes, this method isn't a professional one; or rather, it's not one you'd see from most certified diviners as the method itself is considered antiquated and fallen out of official use |Your words humble me, [pc.name]. You apologize to Tetsuya and inform him that you must excuse yourself for a short while — it's important that you see your daughter, and perhaps even attend to her needs if the situation calls for it. [pc.isDK
        |It doesn't matter if he gives you his permission or not, but it doesn't hurt to give [tetsuya.married
            |your husband
            |him
        ] the courtesy of knowing why you have to cut the conversation short
        |Surely [tetsuya.married
            |your husband
            |he
        ] understands and doesn't mind
    ].
    
    "By all means, go ahead. Setsuna should still be in her room." He gestures towards the door behind you. "If, perchance, our daughter isn't there, notify me immediately. A kit like her is too young to be building a penchant for mischief. Nevertheless, I'm sure our daughter will be an excited bundle of fluff once she sees you coming to visit her."
    
    You get up and give Tetsuya a quick kiss before making your way to Setsuna's room. Once you slide the door open, alerting the [tetsuya.numKits 1 2
        |single fox-kit
        |numerous fox-kits
    ] in the room to your presence with the audible tap of lacquered wood against wood, you watch as excitement begins to surface on your firstborn's features. At first, it's her fluffy tails, and then it's an overjoyed squeal of delight. She knows [pc.mf
        |you're
        |her mom is
    ] here now, and she makes it known through her adorable babbling.
    
    There, there. Who's a good girl? You walk over to Setsuna and pick her up, holding her close to your [pc.hasBreasts
        |bosom
        |chest
    ]. Looking down at your sweet, baby girl, you begin deciding what you want to do with her.

rows.original: You hold a finger in front of Setsuna and waggle it around, watching as the little fox kit clumsily tries to chase and catch it within her tiny palms. Despite her futile attempts, she persists in her efforts to catch your finger. Spreading your fingers wide, you go in and give both her golden ears and hair a good rubbing, lavishing her with all the love and affection you have to give; as you dote over Setsuna, you watch your giggling daughter melt further and further into a puddle of saccharine joy. You can't help but admire her radiating vulpine innocence — this bundle of effervescent joy is something you made. There's no doubt about it: she's going to be a lively and sweet lady when she grows up. One has to wonder if this energy is something she inherited from you or Tetsuya. Whatever the case may be doesn't matter. The fact that she's an adorable little thing is good enough for you. You ponder to yourself about the many fun activities you and your [tetsuya.numKits 1 2 |daughter |kits ] might get up to once they're fully able to laugh and run around. You look forward to the day when Setsuna is finally able to catch your finger and call you [pc.dadMom].
rows.translation: 你把一根手指放在刹那面前，晃来晃去，看着这只小狐狸笨拙地试图用它那小小的手掌去追逐并抓住你的手指。尽管她的尝试一次次失败，但她仍然坚持不懈地努力着。你张开双手，轻轻抚摸着她金色的耳朵和头发，倾注出你所有的心爱与关怀；在宠爱着刹那的同时，你也看到自己那个爱笑的女儿正在渐渐变得无比开心、快乐。你不禁会为她那散发出的纯真与活力所折服——这个充满欢乐与活力的小女孩，实在让人无法忽视。制作完成毫无疑问，她长大后一定会成为一个活泼可爱、温柔善良的女孩子。人们不禁会想，这种活力是遗传自你，还是遗传自哲也……不过，无论原因是什么，这些都无关紧要。重要的是，她现在就是一个如此惹人喜爱的小宝贝，这对你来说已经足够了。 你暗自想着，等[tetsuya.numKits 1 2 |女儿 |孩子们 ]能够尽情欢笑、四处奔跑后，你们能一起做多少有趣的事。你期待着刹那终于能抓住你的手指，叫你[pc.dadMom]的那一天。

Pulling a [pc.breast] from out of your [pc.gear], you raise Setsuna to a [pc.nipple] and sigh happily as she latches and begins nursing, suckling and kneading away at your teat without a care in the world |Holding an index finger in front of Setsuna, you watch as the little fox kit reaches out with her clumsy little hands and grasps onto it. Since she isn't quite strong enough to pull your finger closer on her own, you give her a little bit of help and allow your finger to be guided into her open mouth. Once it's in, she closes her mouth and begins sucking away at your digit without a care in the world. The effects are immediately felt: fatigue builds in your body as essence gradually drains from your fingertip. The sensation can best be compared to sap slowly being spigoted from a tree, or rather, milk from a mother to their nursing child. After all, that's what this whole exchange is about, right? This is your daughter and you're sharing a part of yourself with her to make sure she has the nutrition she needs ]. Setsuna's vulpine ears flatten against her head as she happily takes whatever you can give her; [pc.isTainted |as a loving [pc.fatherMother], how could you deprive your child of such joys? Keeping [pc.isMilky |her close to your bosom as warm [pc.milk] continuously strikes her tongue |your finger in her mouth ], you cannot bring yourself to stop her until she's well and truly had her fill. Moderation be damned — your daughter will have all the nutrition she needs, and she'll grow to be big and healthy! Eventually, Setsuna finishes her meal and cozies herself against you |eventually, you pull [pc.isMilky |her away with an audible pop — the sound of her mouth detaching from your breast |your finger out of her mouth ]. That's enough feeding for now; moderation is key, after all. Hypothetically, you could let her keep going, but that means you might run the risk of her developing a nasty, gluttonous habit down the line ]."

rows.original: Give your infant daughter some of your [pc.isMilky|milk|essence].
rows.translation: 给你年幼的女儿喂一些你的[pc.isMilky|奶水|精华]。
rows.raw: "Give your infant daughter some of your [pc.isMilky|milk|essence]."

rows.original:
With your daughter curling up into a little ball in your arms, her tails tucked about herself as she begins drifting off to sleep, you carefully set her back down onto the cushion[tetsuya.numKits 1 3
            |
            | with the rest of her siblings
        ]. Afterwards, you leave the room, doing your best as to not wake [tetsuya.numKits 1 2
            |your sleeping daughter
            |any of your kits
        ], and make your way back to your beloved, Tetsuya.
rows.translation:
当你的女儿蜷缩在你的怀里，把小尾巴紧紧围在身上，渐渐进入梦乡时，你小心翼翼地将她放回垫子上。[tetsuya.numKits 1 3
            |
            | 和她的其他兄弟姐妹们一起
        ]之后，你离开了房间，尽量不吵醒[tetsuya.numKits 1 2
            |你正在熟睡的女儿
            |你的任何一个孩子
        ]然后，回到你深爱的哲也身边吧。
rows.raw:
"
        With your daughter curling up into a little ball in your arms, her tails tucked about herself as she begins drifting off to sleep, you carefully set her back down onto the cushion[tetsuya.numKits 1 3
            |
            | with the rest of her siblings
        ]. Afterwards, you leave the room, doing your best as to not wake [tetsuya.numKits 1 2
            |your sleeping daughter
            |any of your kits
        ], and make your way back to your beloved, Tetsuya."

rows.original: Take in the sight of the lovelier of the Kurokawa sisters.
rows.translation: 欣赏黑川姐妹中更为美丽的那位吧。
rows.raw: "Take in the sight of the lovelier of the Kurokawa sisters."

rows.original: This is a form of divination, isn't it?
rows.translation: 这是一种占卜的方式，对吧？
rows.raw: "This is a form of divination, isn't it?"

rows.original: You've already asked for one of the sisters' services today. Best not take too much of an advantage of their hospitality...
rows.translation: 你今天已经享受过其中一位姐妹的服务了。最好别过分利用她们的热情好客……
rows.raw: "You've already asked for one of the sisters' services today. Best not take too much of an advantage of their hospitality... "

rows.original: You know it's inviting trouble considering how nymphomaniacal Miko reputedly is, but hey, trouble's never put you off.
rows.translation: 你知道，考虑到米可那所谓的“淫荡性格”，这样做简直是在自找麻烦，但嘿，麻烦从来都不会让你退缩不是吗？
rows.raw: "You know it's inviting trouble considering how nymphomaniacal Miko reputedly is, but hey, trouble's never put you off."

rows.original: See if Miko can help you upgrade your wayfort.
rows.translation: 看看米可是否能帮你升级你的驿堡。
rows.raw: "See if Miko can help you upgrade your wayfort."

rows.original: Ask Miko about a way to protect the Wayfort's dungeons from spellcasters.
rows.translation: 向米科请教如何保护荒废驿堡的地牢，使其免受施法者的攻击。
rows.raw: "Ask Miko about a way to protect the Wayfort's dungeons from spellcasters."

rows.original: You'd like to hear Miko talk about herself.
rows.translation: 你想听听米可谈谈她自己。
rows.raw: "You'd like to hear Miko talk about herself."

rows.original: Discuss the locals with Miko. Given her position here, she must know quite a bit about everyone living in the den, right?
rows.translation: 你可以和米可聊聊这里的居民。以她的地位，她肯定对住在巢穴里的所有人都很了解，对吧？
rows.raw: "Discuss the locals with Miko. Given her position here, she must know quite a bit about everyone living in the den, right?"

rows.original: So, what kind of services does Miko offer here at the shrine?
rows.translation: 那么，米可在这座神社里提供哪些服务呢？
rows.raw: "So, what kind of services does Miko offer here at the shrine?"

rows.original: Could she tell you something about worship of the Trickster and the traditions she follows?
rows.translation: 她能告诉你一些关于对“戏弄者”的崇拜，以及她所遵循的传统吗？
rows.raw: "Could she tell you something about worship of the Trickster and the traditions she follows?"

rows.original: Inquire about the state of her pregnancy.
rows.raw: "Inquire about the state of her pregnancy."

rows.original: Inquire about the state of your kits with Miko.
rows.translation: 向米可询问你的幼崽们的情况。
rows.raw: "Inquire about the state of your kits with Miko."

rows.original: Take in the sight of the more elegant of the Kurokawa sisters.
rows.translation: 欣赏黑川姐妹中那位更为优雅的一位吧。
rows.raw: "Take in the sight of the more elegant of the Kurokawa sisters."

rows.original: Have Mai see about purging evil influences from your person.
rows.translation: 让舞来帮你清除身上的邪恶影响吧。
rows.raw: "Have Mai see about purging evil influences from your person."

rows.original: You've already asked for one of the sisters' services today. Best not take too much of an advantage of their hospitality...
rows.translation: 你今天已经享受过其中一位姐妹的服务了。最好别过分利用她们的热情好客……
rows.raw: "You've already asked for one of the sisters' services today. Best not take too much of an advantage of their hospitality... "

rows.original: This isn't quite a religious thing, but you could ask Mai to help redirect and clear obstructions from the flow of life-force about your body...
rows.translation: 这其实算不上什么宗教仪式，但你可以请舞帮忙引导并清除你体内那些阻碍生命能量流动的障碍……
rows.raw: "This isn't quite a religious thing, but you could ask Mai to help redirect and clear obstructions from the flow of life-force about your body... "

rows.original: You've already asked for one of the sisters' services today. Best not take too much of an advantage of their hospitality...
rows.translation: 你今天已经享受过其中一位姐妹的服务了。最好别过分利用她们的热情好客……
rows.raw: "You've already asked for one of the sisters' services today. Best not take too much of an advantage of their hospitality... "

rows.original: Mai is so elegant and refined in her movements... surely those apply to her other skills, too.
rows.translation: 舞的动作如此优雅娴熟……想必她的其他技能也同样如此。
rows.raw: "Mai is so elegant and refined in her movements... surely those apply to her other skills, too."

rows.original: See if Mai can help you upgrade your wayfort.
rows.translation: 看看舞是否能够帮助你升级你的传送装置。
rows.raw: "See if Mai can help you upgrade your wayfort."

rows.original: Ask Mai about a way to protect the Wayfort's dungeons from spellcasters.
rows.translation: 询问舞，看看有没有办法保护荒废驿堡的地牢，让施法者无法侵入。
rows.raw: "Ask Mai about a way to protect the Wayfort's dungeons from spellcasters."

rows.original: You've come about these shiny rocks she's looking for...
rows.translation: 你找到了她一直在寻找的那些闪亮的石头……
rows.raw: "You've come about these shiny rocks she's looking for... "

rows.original: You'd like to hear Mai talk about herself.
rows.translation: 你肯定想听听舞讲述关于她自己的故事。
rows.raw: "You'd like to hear Mai talk about herself."

rows.original: Discuss the people of the den with Mai.
rows.translation: 和舞一起讨论那些躲在洞穴里的人吧。
rows.raw: "Discuss the people of the den with Mai."

rows.original: What kind of services can Mai do, and more specifically, for you?
rows.translation: 舞能提供哪些服务，尤其是能为您做些什么呢？
rows.raw: "What kind of services can Mai do, and more specifically, for you?"

rows.original: Could she tell you something about worship of the Trickster and the traditions she follows?
rows.translation: 她能告诉你一些关于对“戏弄者”的崇拜，以及她所遵循的传统吗？
rows.raw: "Could she tell you something about worship of the Trickster and the traditions she follows?"

rows.original: Inquire about the state of her pregnancy.
rows.raw: "Inquire about the state of her pregnancy."

rows.original: Inquire about the state of your kit with Mai.
rows.translation: 向舞咨询你的装备状态吧。
rows.raw: "Inquire about the state of your kit with Mai."

rows.original: Ask Mai to bring out your daughter.
rows.translation: 让舞把你的女儿带出来。
rows.raw: "Ask Mai to bring out your daughter."

rows.original: It's probably too early in Mai's shift to ask her to remove herself from her post. Maybe you should ask near the end of it, when Miko's come in as well.
rows.translation: 现在让舞辞去她的职务可能还为时过早。或许等到米科也加入进来时，再问她这个问题会更好。
rows.raw: "It's probably too early in Mai's shift to ask her to remove herself from her post. Maybe you should ask near the end of it, when Miko's come in as well."

rows.original:
[var0|
        Both Kurokawa twins are on duty right now, [rand|dealing with the influx of petitioners that arrive at both the start and end of the day, before work begins and when work winds down. Most of the foxes here to pay respects to their patron deity manage pretty well on their own, but every now and then either of the shrine maiden sisters have to step in to deal with more complicated requests.|one sister handing over the shrine to the other before she heads off. The way Miko and Mai follow a day-night cycle is certainly cute — one has to wonder if this is a natural thing, or do they consciously do it?|finishing up the few duties and rites that require both of them to be present. You're not exactly sure what their meaning is nor why they have to wear those stylised fox masks throughout the whole thing, but it certainly seems and sounds very solemn.[pc.ra kitsune| To be quite honest, it really brings out the inadequacy in your understanding of it all despite being their patron deity's handpicked champion...]] 
        |[var1|
            Miko is on duty during the day, [rand|helping the petitioners who come to the shrine with their various requests. You can see why she's so suited the day job — she's gregarious, talkative, cheerful and interacting with people energises rather than drains her. A perfect face for her profession, to be quite honest... and the massive tits don't hurt, either.|seeing to it that the statue of the kitsune's patron deity is dusted and clean and the censer filled. While most petitioners do arrive with incense of their own, it looks like it's up to Miko to supply it for those who don't... and who doesn't want any excuse to interact with a pretty shrine maiden of the likes of her?|fanning herself with an elegant silk fan as she gazes out over the fields. Looks like today's a slow day — not that the foxy temptress of a shrine maiden minds in the least.]
            |Mai is on duty during the night, [rand|watching over the shrine by the ghostly light of foxfire. Well, that and the glow of her long-handled pipe — winterstem smoke floats into the air as she leans against the shrine's entrance, puffing away placidly. With few to no petitioners in the hours of dark, she's mostly free to do as she pleases... Keros would probably approve, wouldn't he?|cleaning up the dust and dirt accumulated during the day with a long-handled broom. She's certainly very unhurried about it, humming a haunting, melancholy tune to herself as she sweeps away in long, lazy yet efficient strokes.|her face buried in a book and her pipe alike as she watches over the shrine in the night hours, winterstem smoke rising into the air and blending with the incense aroma. She looks up as you approach, but makes no move to do anything unless you need something from her... ]
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0|
        黑川兄弟俩现在都在值班。 [rand|在一天开始和结束的时候，在工作开始之前以及工作即将结束的时候，总会有一大批请愿者前来。在这里，大多数前来祭拜他们的守护神的人都能自己处理好这些事务，但偶尔也会有一些情况需要神社中的两位少女出手，来处理那些更为复杂的请求。|一位姐姐在离开之前将神龛交给了另一位姐姐。米可和舞遵循昼夜节律的行为确实很可爱——人们不禁会想，这是天性使然，还是她们有意识地这样做的呢？|完成那些需要他们两人共同参与的仪式和流程。你其实并不清楚这些仪式的具体含义，也不明白为什么在整个过程中他们都必须戴着那些造型独特的狐狸面具，但这一切看起来确实非常庄严、隆重。[pc.ra kitsune| 说实话，尽管你是他们守护神亲自挑选的英雄，但这反而凸显出你对整个局势的理解是多么的肤浅……]] 
        |[var1|
            米可白天正在值班。 [rand|帮助那些带着各种请求来到这座神社的人们。你就能明白为什么她如此适合这份日常工作了——她性格开朗、健谈、热情洋溢，与人们交流反而会让她充满活力，而不会让她感到疲惫。说实话，她的性格真的非常适合这份工作……而且她那迷人的身材也为她的职业增色不少。|确保那只狐妖的守护神像被擦拭得干干净净，香炉里也装满了香。虽然大多数祈求者都会自带香火，但看来那些没有带香的人，就需要由巫女来为他们提供香火了……而谁会不愿意找这样一个机会，与如此美丽的神社少女互动呢？|她手持一把优雅的丝质扇子，凝视着远处的田野。看来今天会是闲适的一天——不过，这位狡黠迷人的神社少女可丝毫没有这种想法。]
            |舞在夜间值班。 [rand|在狐火幽幽的光芒照耀下，她守望着那座神龛。嗯，再加上她那根长柄烟斗散发出的光芒——当她倚靠在神龛入口处悠闲地抽着烟时，冬日的烟雾便缓缓升向空中。在夜幕降临的这几个小时里，几乎没有什么人前来祈求帮助，因此她大多时候都可以随心所欲地做自己想做的事情……凯罗斯大概也会赞同吧，不是吗？|她用一把长柄扫帚清扫了一整天积累下来的灰尘和污垢。她做这件事时显然非常从容不迫，一边清扫，一边轻声哼着那首悠扬而忧郁的歌曲，每一扫都动作悠长、缓慢，但却十分高效。|她把脸埋在书中，手中也拿着烟斗，整夜都在守护着那座神龛。冬日的烟雾升向空中，与香火的气息融为一体。当你靠近时，她抬起头，但除非你需要她帮忙，否则她并不会采取任何行动…… ]
        ]
    ]

            |舞在夜间值班。 [rand|在狐火幽幽的光芒中，她守望着那座神龛。嗯，再加上她那根长柄烟斗散发出的光芒——当她倚靠在神龛入口处安静地抽着烟时，冬日的烟雾便缓缓升向空中。在夜深人静的时刻，几乎没有什么人会前来请愿，因此她大多时候都可以随心所欲地做自己想做的事情……凯罗斯大概也会赞同吧，不是吗？|她用一把长柄扫帚清扫了一整天积累下来的灰尘和污垢。她做这件事时显然非常从容不迫，一边清扫，一边轻声哼着那首悠扬而忧郁的歌曲，每一扫都动作缓慢而有力，却丝毫不影响清扫的效果。|她将脸埋在书中，手中也拿着烟斗，整夜都在守护着那座神龛。冬日的烟雾升向空中，与香火的气息融为一体。当你靠近时，她抬起了头，但除非你需要她的帮助，否则她并不会采取任何行动…… ]
        ]
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    \n[var0|
        Both Kurokawa twins are on duty right now, [rand|dealing with the influx of petitioners that arrive at both the start and end of the day, before work begins and when work winds down. Most of the foxes here to pay respects to their patron deity manage pretty well on their own, but every now and then either of the shrine maiden sisters have to step in to deal with more complicated requests.|one sister handing over the shrine to the other before she heads off. The way Miko and Mai follow a day-night cycle is certainly cute — one has to wonder if this is a natural thing, or do they consciously do it?|finishing up the few duties and rites that require both of them to be present. You're not exactly sure what their meaning is nor why they have to wear those stylised fox masks throughout the whole thing, but it certainly seems and sounds very solemn.[pc.ra kitsune| To be quite honest, it really brings out the inadequacy in your understanding of it all despite being their patron deity's handpicked champion...]] 
        |[var1|
            Miko is on duty during the day, [rand|helping the petitioners who come to the shrine with their various requests. You can see why she's so suited the day job — she's gregarious, talkative, cheerful and interacting with people energises rather than drains her. A perfect face for her profession, to be quite honest... and the massive tits don't hurt, either.|seeing to it that the statue of the kitsune's patron deity is dusted and clean and the censer filled. While most petitioners do arrive with incense of their own, it looks like it's up to Miko to supply it for those who don't... and who doesn't want any excuse to interact with a pretty shrine maiden of the likes of her?|fanning herself with an elegant silk fan as she gazes out over the fields. Looks like today's a slow day — not that the foxy temptress of a shrine maiden minds in the least.]
            |Mai is on duty during the night, [rand|watching over the shrine by the ghostly light of foxfire. Well, that and the glow of her long-handled pipe — winterstem smoke floats into the air as she leans against the shrine's entrance, puffing away placidly. With few to no petitioners in the hours of dark, she's mostly free to do as she pleases... Keros would probably approve, wouldn't he?|cleaning up the dust and dirt accumulated during the day with a long-handled broom. She's certainly very unhurried about it, humming a haunting, melancholy tune to herself as she sweeps away in long, lazy yet efficient strokes.|her face buried in a book and her pipe alike as she watches over the shrine in the night hours, winterstem smoke rising into the air and blending with the incense aroma. She looks up as you approach, but makes no move to do anything unless you need something from her... ]
        ]
    ] "

rows.original: A shiver crawls down your spine as you pass under the torii gate. Despite the cheery atmosphere of the gardens past the fields, you're painfully aware of just exactly how different the internals of the tree are, how they've changed since your last visit here, and drastically so to boot. The path winding up to the small shrine is lined with kitsune, clearly here to petition their patron deity; they give you nervous glances as you pass them by and shuffle away in that utterly passive-aggressive manner of theirs when they're being obtusely polite. Nevertheless, you make it to the front of the line and come face to face with the two shrine maiden sisters; Miko scowls as you approach the simple hut-like shrine, her beautiful lips twisting and curling. "Oh. You." "Granny said ya had permission to visit, so there ain't no problem with ya bein' here even as an outsider," Mai adds. "Still, if'n ya wanna proper introductions, yer gotta wait till we finish dealin' with th' day's petitioners. Ain't often th' both of us are needed here, an' ya jus' done happened to show up at crunch time." You look over your shoulder to see the long line of foxy petitioners, their faces all carefully blank and impassive, their gazes all pinpointed on the back of your neck. Fine, fine. It'll be a good opportunity to watch them at work, anyway. [party.has cait |"Just look at them go," Cait mutters as she settles in beside you to wait. "With clothes like that, I wouldn't be surprised if they performed services other than religious ones." She really doesn't like having competition, does she? "Well, temple prostitutes are Mallach's thing. It's not nice seeing someone else nose in on the business, you know?" Assuming that Miko and Mai do do that sort of thing, is it that much of a loss if none of the petitioners were ever going to a temple of Mallach to begin with? "It's the principle of the matter, [pc.name]! Ah, you wouldn't really understand, would you? [pc.bg acolyte|Sure, you may have had a religious upbringing, but you didn't grow up in the Temple.|You'd have to have grown up in the Temple to understand.]" ] It takes about half an hour for the last of the petitioners to be fulfilled and depart, and then the twin kitsune sisters turn their attention upon you. Tails swaying and eyes locked, they sashay over to the bench where you've parked yourself and bow in unison. "Sorry to keep ya waitin'. I'm Mikoto Kurokawa." "An' I'm Miyuki Kurokawa. About that drubbin' ya gave us last time..." "We'll forget all 'bout it if'n ya do us th' same favor." "Sound fair to ya?" They were responsible for precipitating that whole mess to begin with, weren't they? "Like we said... we'll call it water under th' bridge an' won't say no more if'n ya'll do th' same." Hmm. [pc.isDK|While it might be fun to hold it over their heads for a little longer, you're feeling magnanimous today.|Well, if they're willing to drop it, you will — so long as they don't cause any more trouble for you.] "Well then! If'n yer our friend now, I guess ya can jus' call us Miko an' Mai. It's a whole right less o' a mouthful than Mikoto and Miyuki." Friend? Whoa whoa whoa, maybe that's moving a bit too fast — Purring, Miko slips behind the bench you've been sitting on and presses her prodigious boobs against the back of your head, a slice of marshmallow hell — or perhaps heaven — snuggling up against you while she cradles your chin in her arms. How... how does she move that quickly with tits that size? Even after having gone up against the orange-furred shrine maiden, it's still hard to believe. "C'mon now, yer ain't half-bad lookin', and really [pc.mascFem|handsome|cute] to boot. Ya sure ya don't wanna be friends after clearin' up that there ol' misunderstandin' we had back then?" Miko leans more of her weight onto you, the back of your head sinking into the pliable titflesh. The aura of the shrine maiden's raw sexuality is palpable as it envelopes you, [pc.willpowerRange 75 |and it takes all of your will to push her arms away and force yourself aside before her most unsubtle charms overwhelm you |and you can feel your hindbrain begging and drooling, fighting your better judgement for control of your actions ]. Thankfully, [party.has cait |Cait steps in to save you, interposing herself between you and the voluptuous vixen. "Just stop it already, you harlot! You're making a fool of yourself — think you can just shake your tits at anyone and get them to fall for you like that?" Miko flutters her fan and smiles. "Takes one to know one, darlin'. Thought 'harlot weren't no insult amongst yer kind." |Mai steps in to save you, planting herself between you and her sister. "C'mon, sis. Ain't nothin' good from comin' on so strongly so early. Give [pc.name] here some time, 'kay?" ] Time out, time out. Maybe turning the conversation to something else might help. "If'n that's what ya want."
rows.translation: 当你从下面穿过时，一阵寒意会顺着你的脊椎爬上去。托里大门。尽管田野旁那些花园里洋溢着欢乐的气氛，但你却清楚地意识到，这棵树的内部结构已经发生了多么巨大的变化——自从你上次来到这里之后，它已经发生了翻天覆地的改变。通往那座小神社的小路上，到处都是狐妖的身影，它们显然是在向自己的守护神祈愿。当你从它们身边经过时，它们会紧张地瞥了你一眼，然后以那种既客气又带点消极抵抗的方式，慢悠悠地走开了。然而，你还是排到了队伍的前面，与那两位神社少女面对面地站在了那里。当你走近那座简陋得像小屋一样的神社时，米可露出了不悦的表情，她那美丽的嘴唇紧紧地抿在一起，显得非常生气。 哦，是你。 奶奶说你得到了允许来拜访，所以即使你是外人，来这里也没有任何问题。舞补充道。不过，如果你真的想要正式的介绍，那就得等到我们处理完当天所有来访者的请求之后。我们俩同时在这里工作的情况其实并不常见，而你正好在最关键的时候出现了。 你回头望去，看到那一排排狡黠的请愿者，他们的脸上都带着刻意伪装出的茫然与冷漠，目光全都紧盯着你的后颈。好吧，反正这也是观察他们如何行事的绝佳机会。 [party.has cait |看看他们跑得有多快。凯特轻声说着，然后坐在你旁边等待起来。穿成那样的话，他们提供除了宗教服务之外的其他服务，我也不会感到惊讶。 她其实真的很不喜欢竞争，对吧？ 嗯，寺庙里的妓女都是属于马拉赫的。东西你知道，看到别人插手自己的事情，确实让人很不爽，对吧？ 假设米可与舞确实如果那些请愿者本来就从未去过玛拉赫的神庙，那么做那种事情，真的会有那么大的损失吗？ 就是这个原则关于这件事， [pc.name]啊，你其实根本不会明白的，对吧？ [pc.bg acolyte|当然，你可能接受过宗教教育，但你的成长环境并不是在寺庙里。|只有在那座神庙中长大的人，才能真正理解其中的内涵。]" ] 大约半个小时后，最后一位请愿者也得到了满足并离开了，这时那对双生狐姐妹将注意力转向了你。她们摇着尾巴，目光紧盯着你，迈着优雅的步伐走到你坐着的长椅旁，然后一起向你鞠躬。 抱歉让你们等待了。我是黑川美琴。 我是黑川美雪。关于你上次对我们的那次严厉批评…… 如果你也能为我们做同样的事，我们就把这一切都忘掉吧。 你觉得这样公平吗？ 他们当初不就是导致了那一连串麻烦的根源吗？ 就像我们之前说的……我们就把这件事翻过去吧，如果你们也能这样做，我们就不再提这件事了。 嗯。 [pc.isDK|虽然再把这件事悬在他们头上一段时间可能会让人觉得有趣，但今天你表现得确实很大度。|嗯，如果他们愿意放弃这个要求，你也可以这么做——只要他们不再给你带来任何麻烦。] 那好吧！既然你现在是我们朋友了，我想你可以直接叫我们米可和舞吧。这样比叫美琴和美雪要省事多了，也容易记。 朋友？哇哦，这个发展未免太快了吧…… 咪科发出轻柔的呼噜声，悄悄溜到你坐的长凳后面，然后将她那巨大的胸部贴在你的后脑勺上——这种感觉简直就像是置身于天堂之中……她用双臂托住你的下巴，紧紧依偎在你身边。拥有那样的胸部，她究竟是怎么做到动作如此敏捷的？即使之前已经见识过那位橙色毛发的神社少女，现在还是觉得难以置信。 得了吧，你长得也挺不错的，真的。 [pc.mascFem|英俊的|可爱]更何况，等我们把当时那些误会都弄清楚了，你肯定也不想再继续做朋友了吧？ 米可将更多的体重压在你身上，你的后脑勺深深地陷进了她柔软的胸部之中。这位神社少女身上散发出的那种原始的性魅力，仿佛触手可及，将你完全包围在其中。 [pc.willpowerRange 75 |你必须竭尽全力才能推开她的手臂，将自己从她那极具诱惑力的魅力之中拉开，否则你就会彻底被她征服。 |你会感觉到自己的大脑后部正在拼命挣扎、试图控制你的行为，而你的理智却在与之抗争，试图阻止这些冲动。 ]幸好， [party.has cait |凯特挺身而出救了你，她站在你和那个妖艳的女子之间，保护了你。别闹了，你这个荡妇！你这样只会让自己出丑——你真以为随便摇晃一下胸部，别人就会立刻爱上你吗？ 米可轻轻摇动她的扇子，微笑着。知己知彼，亲爱的。我还以为在你们这类人当中，‘妓女’这个词并不算是一种侮辱呢。 |梅介入替你解围，挡在你和她姐姐之间。 来吧，姐。这么早就来劲儿这么大，也没什么好处啊。别这样[pc.name]过一会儿再来，好吗？ ] 暂停一下，暂停一下。或许把话题转向其他事情会有所帮助。 如果那就是你想要的的话。

rows.original: You feel an undeniable sense of unease as you pass under the torii gate. Despite the calming atmosphere of the gardens that lie beyond the fields, you're reminded of just how different the tree is this time around, how it's changed since your last visit here. During your prior visit, you certainly didn't pass through any fields or paddies to get to where you are... Thankfully, there are no man-eating vixens waiting for you this time by either gatepost — instead, they're up by the shrine, dealing with a small handful of foxy petitioners. Gray and orange apiece, the two shrine maidens are performing some kind of ritual over a family of kitsune, waving what looks like a wand with paper strips affixed to the tip over their heads. The ritual doesn't take long — within a moment, the petitioners pass you coming back along the path, and you're painfully aware of the careful stares they give you, an outsider. Eventually, you come up to the shrine; at least this is still somewhat as you remember it. The screen doors in the front are open, though, allowing you a peek into the simple interior. Before you can focus, though, your vision is filled with a pair of very familiar, very expansive tits. Miko's sashayed up to you, fanning herself ostentatiously while she shamelessly thrusts her rack in your face, brazenly invading your personal space. "Well, if'n it ain't th' [pc.race] who done came last time. Were my tits so great that ya couldn't jus' help yerself an' come f'r a second helpin'?" "Sis!" Still under the eaves of the shrine's roof, Mai folds her arms and twists her lips in a scowl. "Yer ain't done causin' us enough trouble, are ya?" "Eh, no harm done. Ain't nothin' but a bit of sweet talkin', that's all..." "An' it wouldn't have stopped none at jus' talk. Granny's already rightly mad with th' likes of you." "Pfff." Turning back to you, Miko gives you a sweet, saccharine smile. "Well then, friend. Why don'tcha go on ahead an' tell Mai an' I why yer here, then? Ain't here f'r a good cleansin', are ya?" No, you're just here scoping out the place and saying hi to the locals. Which includes them, of course. "Yer such a sweetie. Well, if'n I may say so, I — eeek!" While Miko's been plying her charms on you, Mai's crept up behind her more voluptuous sister and grabbed one of her six tails. With a sharp yank, she sends Miko stumbling back, taking the fore as her sister struggles for balance and rubs the sore base of her tail. "Ah, my apologies an' all. My sis does like to come on pre-tty hard when she meets new folks, y'see. We ain't been formally introduced yet — I'm Miyuki Kurokawa, an' that vixen there is my sis, Mikoto Kurokawa. Kinda sorry f'r doin' what we did to y'all back then, but them's the rules: can't be lettin' outsiders jus' waltz on in onto hallowed ground an' all. But since ya got granny's permission to be here, ya'll be fine." So no more marshmallow hell? Mai rolls her eyes and takes a long drag from the long-handled pipe in her hands. The scent rising from it is unmistakable: winterstem. "Ain't gonna be none of that from me, an' it's only comin' from Miko if'n ya ask her for it. Don't let th' likes of her take advantage of ya, ya hear?" "I ain't taking advantage of no one!" a very grumpy Miko sounds from behind Mai. "Either ways, my sis an' I, we're in charge of handlin' this here shrine to our divine lord. Granny used to do it, but then she's gettin' up in years in spirit if not body. We've taken over th' daily runnin' of things from her hands now..."
rows.translation: 当你从下方穿过时，会不由得感到一种莫名的不安。鸟居大门。尽管田野彼端的花园营造出一种宁静的氛围，但你依然能清楚地意识到，这一次这棵树已经发生了多大的变化——自从你上次来到这里之后，它确实发生了改变。在之前的那次访问中，你肯定没有穿过任何田野或水塘才能到达现在这个地方。幸运的是，这次在两边的门柱旁并没有什么吃人的狐妖在等着你——相反，它们都在神社附近，正在处理一些前来请愿的狐妖们。两位身穿灰色和橙色服装的神社少女正在为一群狐妖举行某种仪式，她们头顶上挥舞着一种末端绑着纸条的类似魔杖的物品。这个仪式并不需要很长时间——转眼间，那些提交请愿书的人就沿着小路回到了你的身边，而你也能明显感受到他们那充满戒备的目光，因为他们把你视为一个外人。最终，你来到了那座神社面前；至少是这样。这个它依然和你记忆中的一样。不过前面的玻璃门是开着的，你可以从中窥见那简朴的内部装饰。 然而，在你还没来得及仔细观察之前，你的视线就被一对非常熟悉、非常惹眼的胸部所吸引。米可大步走到你面前，夸张地摇着扇子，同时还毫不羞耻地将自己的胸部凑到你的面前，公然侵犯你的个人空间。 嗯，如果不是这样的话[pc.race]上次是谁来的啊？难道我的胸部真的那么诱人，以至于你们忍不住又来了一次帮忙吗？ 姐！仍然站在神社的屋檐下，舞双臂交叉，撇着嘴，露出不悦的表情。你还没给我们惹够麻烦吧？ 呃，也没什么坏处嘛。只不过就是些甜言蜜语而已，没什么大不了的…… 光是说说而已是根本阻止不了他们的。奶奶对你们这种人早就气得够多了。 呼。米科向你回过头来，露出一个甜美而略带甜腻的笑容。那么，朋友，你为什么不先去告诉舞和我说你为什么来到这里呢？这里不是用来好好清洗身体的地方吗？ 不，你只是来这里考察一下环境，然后跟当地人打个招呼而已。当然，也包括他们在内。 你真是个贴心的人啊。嗯，如果我可以这么说的话，我——哎呀！ 当米可正在用她的魅力吸引你的时候，舞却悄悄地走到她那更加丰满的姐姐身后，抓住了她那六条尾巴中的一条。随着她猛地一拉，米可被拽得踉跄后退，而舞则趁机占据了领先位置。她的姐姐则努力保持平衡，同时揉着自己被拉痛的尾巴根部。 啊，实在不好意思。我妹妹见到新朋友的时候，有时候会表现得有点过分，您见谅。我们还没有正式介绍过——我是黑川美雪，而那个调皮的女孩就是我的妹妹，黑川美琴。之前我们对你们做了那些事，确实挺抱歉的，但规矩就是规矩，不能让外人随便进入我们的‘圣地’吧。不过既然你们得到了奶奶的允许才能来这里，应该就没问题了。 那么，再也不用忍受那种像棉花糖一样糟糕的情况了吗？ 舞翻了个白眼，然后深深地吸了一口手中的长柄烟斗。从烟斗里散发出来的气味再明显不过了：那是冬茎的味道。这种事我绝对不会做，而且只有米科才会这么做，如果你愿意的话询问抓住她吧。别让像她这样的人占你的便宜，听见了吗？ 我可没有在占任何人的便宜！舞的背后传来一个脾气极其暴躁的米可的声音。 不管怎样，我和我姐姐负责照料这座供奉我们神圣主神的圣所。以前是奶奶在负责这些事，但现在她年纪大了，身体也不如从前了。所以我们已经接手了日常的管理工作……
rows.raw: " You feel an undeniable sense of unease as you pass under the torii gate. Despite the calming atmosphere of the gardens that lie beyond the fields, you're reminded of just how different the tree is this time around, how it's changed since your last visit here. During your prior visit, you certainly didn't pass through any fields or paddies to get to where you are... Thankfully, there are no man-eating vixens waiting for you this time by either gatepost — instead, they're up by the shrine, dealing with a small handful of foxy petitioners. Gray and orange apiece, the two shrine maidens are performing some kind of ritual over a family of kitsune, waving what looks like a wand with paper strips affixed to the tip over their heads. The ritual doesn't take long — within a moment, the petitioners pass you coming back along the path, and you're painfully aware of the careful stares they give you, an outsider. Eventually, you come up to the shrine; at least this is still somewhat as you remember it. The screen doors in the front are open, though, allowing you a peek into the simple interior. Before you can focus, though, your vision is filled with a pair of very familiar, very expansive tits. Miko's sashayed up to you, fanning herself ostentatiously while she shamelessly thrusts her rack in your face, brazenly invading your personal space. "Well, if'n it ain't th' [pc.race] who done came last time. Were my tits so great that ya couldn't jus' help yerself an' come f'r a second helpin'?" "Sis!" Still under the eaves of the shrine's roof, Mai folds her arms and twists her lips in a scowl. "Yer ain't done causin' us enough trouble, are ya?" "Eh, no harm done. Ain't nothin' but a bit of sweet talkin', that's all..." "An' it wouldn't have stopped none at jus' talk. Granny's already rightly mad with th' likes of you." "Pfff." Turning back to you, Miko gives you a sweet, saccharine smile. "Well then, friend. Why don'tcha go on ahead an' tell Mai an' I why yer here, then? Ain't here f'r a good cleansin', are ya?" No, you're just here scoping out the place and saying hi to the locals. Which includes them, of course. "Yer such a sweetie. Well, if'n I may say so, I — eeek!" While Miko's been plying her charms on you, Mai's crept up behind her more voluptuous sister and grabbed one of her six tails. With a sharp yank, she sends Miko stumbling back, taking the fore as her sister struggles for balance and rubs the sore base of her tail. "Ah, my apologies an' all. My sis does like to come on pre-tty hard when she meets new folks, y'see. We ain't been formally introduced yet — I'm Miyuki Kurokawa, an' that vixen there is my sis, Mikoto Kurokawa. Kinda sorry f'r doin' what we did to y'all back then, but them's the rules: can't be lettin' outsiders jus' waltz on in onto hallowed ground an' all. But since ya got granny's permission to be here, ya'll be fine." So no more marshmallow hell? Mai rolls her eyes and takes a long drag from the long-handled pipe in her hands. The scent rising from it is unmistakable: winterstem. "Ain't gonna be none of that from me, an' it's only comin' from Miko if'n ya ask her for it. Don't let th' likes of her take advantage of ya, ya hear?" "I ain't taking advantage of no one!" a very grumpy Miko sounds from behind Mai. "Either ways, my sis an' I, we're in charge of handlin' this here shrine to our divine lord. Granny used to do it, but then she's gettin' up in years in spirit if not body. We've taken over th' daily runnin' of things from her hands now...""

rows.original: Reaching the end of the tranquil gardens and passing under the huge red archway at the end of the path, you're faced with a small shrine of simple make — from a glance, it looks to be little more than a simple one-room hut of wood, paper and sloping tiles, raised above the finely-mown grass on a wooden foundation. It's practically the exact opposite of the Chapel of Velun back in Hawkethorne, which despite only housing Sanders is all imposing, statuesque and grandiose — this little thing is far less imposing and a lot more personal. A couple of statues in the stylised likenesses of foxes sit on plinths, but if it weren't for the kitsune petitioners and perhaps the existence for a donation box one might have mistaken it for a simple home out by the fields. At the head of the petitioners, though, are two sisters, each with six tails apiece and golden slitted eyes, black chokers about their necks and kindly smiles on their lips as they deal with the petitioners' requests. That's where the similarity ends. The kitsune to your right, the one with the paper fan in hand — she's an oversexed vixen goddess. Each of her tits is as large as her head, if not bigger, and her hips are blatant to match. Both assets strain at her sleeveless red-and-white clothing, those sinfully short skirts exposing just the right amount of thigh between them and her tall stockings. Her outfit... there's a clear sense of formality here, yet at the same time it's undeniably a temptress' toolkit, allowing her long, orange hair to spill down over her shoulders and join her curling tails. Come to think of it, it's not too much unlike Cait's own passion priestess garb, or at least possessed of the same energy. [party.has cait |"Baaah," Cait spits, sounding more than a little aggrieved as her tail lashes irritably from side to side. "Didn't know any other gods were getting into temple prostitutes too. That's Mallach's domain, and where almost all the Temple's income comes from." Why, checking out the competition? "I'd hardly call this one competition. Look at her strut. She's got no subtlety." ] Conversely, the kitsune to your left is more modestly proportioned with sharper, more delicate features, although that still gives her plenty of room to be voluptuous. The long, flowing sleeves and skirts of her red-and-white uniform are nevertheless altered to strategically show off choice sections of tits and thigh; instead of the full frontal desire of her sister designed to overwhelm, this one wields her sexuality like a knife between the ribs. Her gray hair's been done up in a loose bun, held in place with a couple of golden hairpins save for a couple of tresses that flow down the sides of her head and down her shoulders. [party.has Cait |And this one? "Mmmm." Cait pouts. "Looks cold and bitchy to me." You laugh. She really doesn't like competition, does she? Well, she's going to have to step up her game and make Mallach proud if she doesn't want to lose out to competition from other deities, eh? Cait sticks her tongue out and blows you a raspberry, but doesn't deign to reply any further. ] What's most prominent about the gray kitsune, though, is the long-stemmed pipe she's carrying, the calming aroma of winterstem smoke clinging to her person like an aura of ennui. There's still whitish vapour rising from the pipe's bowl, much like what one might find in almost every watering hole in the Marches... guess some things never change. You're not sure if a religious woman like her is supposed to be smoking on the job, but given the nature of the foxes' patron deity one can hardly be surprised. As the last of the kitsune petitioners fall away, the two junior priestesses are free to turn their gazes upon you, golden slitted eyes glinting in mischief. "Lookit who's done come an' paid little ol' us a visit," the orange-furred sister drawls, fanning herself conspicuously as she steps from under the shrine's eaves and towards you. "While I heard granny done give permission for an outsider to enter th' den, I wouldn't done think [pc.heShe]'d come up all th' way to th' shrine. Ya think, Mai?" "Don't be forgettin' yer manners, Miko. [party.som|This one's a guest|This one and [pc.hisHer] friend's are guests|This one and [pc.hisHer] friends are guests] here." Stepping forward to her sister's side, the gray-furred of the two junior priestesses gives you a formal bow. "Beggin' yer pardon. That over there is my sis Mikoto an' I'm Miyuki, but since we're friends an' all ya can just call us Miko an' Mai. We're shrine maidens, an' our job is to, uh, take care of this here lil' slice o' divine ground right here." "Amongst other things," Miko adds. You have some recollection of what happened after your rather unfortunate defeat within these walls. Weren't they — "Eeeeeh." Hurriedly, Miko waves a hand dismissively, the long white sleeves of her garb fluttering in the air. "All that there's water under th' bridge, ain't it? Let bygones be bygones an' all?
rows.translation: 走完这些宁静的花园，穿过小路尽头那座巨大的红色拱门，你会看到一座构造十分简单的小神龛——乍一看，它不过是一间用木头、纸张和倾斜的瓦片搭建而成的单间小屋，架在修剪整齐的草地上，基座也是木制的。这与鹰棘镇的维伦小教堂简直截然相反。尽管维伦小教堂里只安置着桑德斯，但它依然显得气势恢宏、雕像般庄严而宏伟；而这个小小的空间则远没有那么气势磅礴，反而显得更加亲切、更加个人化。几座造型像狐妖的雕像矗立在基座上，但若不是那些祈求狐仙帮助的人们，以及那个捐款箱的存在，人们可能会误以为这只是田野边的一座普通小屋罢了。 然而，在这些请愿者的行列中，走在最前面的是两位姐妹。每一位都拥有六条尾巴，眼睛呈金色且带有裂隙，脖子上戴着黑色的项圈，当她们处理请愿者们提出的请求时，嘴角总是挂着亲切的微笑。 但相似之处也就到此为止了。你右边的那只九尾狐，手里拿着纸扇的那只——她其实是一位性欲旺盛的狐妖女神。她的每个乳房都大得跟她的头差不多，甚至更大，而她的臀部也同样引人注目。她那无袖的红白相间的服装将她的身形衬托得格外动人，那短得恰到好处的裙子暴露出了她的大腿与高筒袜之间那诱人的曲线。她的装扮……明显带有正式场合的意味，但与此同时，这也无疑是一套用来诱惑他人的装扮——她那长长的橙色头发披散在肩头，与卷曲的尾巴相映成趣。仔细想来，这与凯特自己所穿的激情祭司服装颇为相似，至少它们散发着同样的气息。 [party.has cait |哇哦……凯特吐了口唾沫，听起来明显非常恼火，她的尾巴也急躁地左右摆动着。没想到还有其他神明也涉足寺庙中的妓女交易。那可是玛拉赫的势力范围，也是寺庙几乎所有收入的来源地。 哦，是在查看竞争对手的情况吗？ 这根本算不上什么竞争。看看她的样子，完全没有任何技巧可言。 ] 相反，你左边的那只九尾狐身材比例更为匀称，五官也更为精致纤细，但这依然为她留下了足够的空间来展现其性感魅力。她那红白相间的制服上，长长的飘逸袖子和裙子被巧妙地设计成能够巧妙地凸显她的胸部和大腿线条；与她姐姐那种直接而强烈的性感表现方式不同，这只九尾狐将她的魅力像一把利刃一样巧妙地运用起来，让人在不知不觉中感受到她的诱惑。她的灰发被扎成一个松散的发髻，用几根金色的发夹固定着，只有几缕头发垂在头两侧，一直延伸到肩膀上。 [party.has Cait |这个呢？ 嗯……凯特撅起了嘴。在我看来，这看起来既冷酷又刻薄。 你笑了。她其实真的很不喜欢竞争，对吧？不过，如果她不想被其他神明的竞争者击败，那就必须加把劲，让马拉克感到骄傲才行，嗯？ 凯特吐了吐舌头，冲你做了个“嘘”的手势，但并没有再继续回答。 ] 然而，这只灰色狐妖最引人注目的，是她手中那支长柄烟斗——冬日烟草散发出的宁静气息仿佛环绕在她身周，营造出一种悠然自得的氛围。烟斗的烟嘴处仍不断冒着白色烟雾，这种景象在边境地区的酒馆里随处可见。……看来有些事情确实永远不会改变。你不确定像她这样的虔诚女性是否应该在工作时吸烟，但考虑到那些狐妖们的守护神的性格，这也实在不足为奇了。当最后一位向狐妖们祈愿的少女离开后，那两位年轻的女祭司便可以将目光转向你——她们那金色的眼睛中闪烁着调皮的光芒。 看看是谁来拜访我们这个小家伙了。那位毛色呈橙色的姐妹拖着长长的声音，一边明显地用扇子扇风，一边从神龛的屋檐下走出来，朝你的方向走来。虽然我听说奶奶已经允许外人进入那个密室，但我当时根本没往这方面想。 [pc.heShe]我们大老远跑到这座神社来，你觉得呢，舞？ 别忘了你的礼貌，米可。 [party.som|这个是客人。|这个，还有[pc.hisHer]朋友就是客人。|这个，还有[pc.hisHer]朋友就是客人。]在这里。走到她妹妹的身边，那两位灰毛的初级女祭司向您行了一个正式的鞠躬。不好意思，请问。那边的是我的姐姐美琴，而我叫美雪。不过因为我们是朋友，所以你们可以直接叫我们米可或者舞。我们是神社的女仆，我们的工作就是负责照顾这片神圣的土地。 除此之外，米科补充道： “你应该还记得自己在这座城堡里遭遇惨败之后发生了什么吧？那些人……不是吗？ 呃……米科急忙挥了挥手，表示不予理会，她那件白色长袍的袖子在空中飘动。过去的都已经过去了，对吧？就让那些事情成为过去吧。

rows.original: So, what do they do here? "Ya done caught us at a good time, I guess," Miko replies. "Usually, Mai an' I take to th' shrine in shifts, so that there's always someone around to handle anythin' that crops up whenever. I take th' day, she's here at night, an' th' both o' us are here at dawn an' dusk. Ya got that? Only reason both of us are here now is 'cause we kinda got caught up with a whole bunch o' petitioners..." That doesn't answer your question, though. Mai shrugs and blows an exquisite smoke ring. "A bit o' this, a bit o' that, really. Like Miko said, we jus' got done dealin' with a whole passel o' petitioners, an' there ain't much that we gotta pass onto granny these days. We're pretty darn skilled, if'n I dare say so. "We also gotta guide petitioners through any rites they be needin' done, an' can do a couple small services f'r ya. Yer an' outsider an' all, so I wouldn't be expectin' ya to know th' proper rites an' etiquette; that there's okay 'cause Miko an' I will guide ya as necessary. It's fun to watch an outsider bumble along not knowin' where they're goin' or what they're doin'. Ya got all that?" You think so... "Of course, if'n ya wanna speak to the Trickster himself all personal-like, all ya gotta do is step on up into th' shrine an' see if'n he'll grace ya with an audience. He's a friendly, personable guy that way, y'know. Likes a nice ol' chat when he ain't otherwise busy." You'll take a rain check on that. "Some o' th' simpler stuff ain't that hard to figure out. Even an outsider like ya oughta be able to figure how to go about omikuji, f'r example," Miko adds. "Ya oughta be glad. Ain't many outsiders who get to look up at our ways up close, ya know? If'n ya need to know somethin', just ask. Mai an' I, we'll be glad to educate an outsider like ya on our ways, or leastways th' etiquette expected of ya when ya come to this here place. Mightn't get stared at so much, then." Yeah, you noticed that... Mai looks a little thoughtful, raising a finger to her lips. "It's kinda a tricky situation, that one. Most of ya natives still consider us monsters an' all, an' I can't rightly blame ya lot. Ya ain't so bad, since granny said ya could visit an' all, but still. If'n ya'll respect us in our home, we'll pay ya back in th' same coin. Deal?" Deal. "One of us will always be on duty at this here shrine. Ya have questions, ya ask. Don't be a stranger, now!"
rows.translation: 那么，他们在这里是做什么的呢？ 看来你抓到我们正好处于一个好时机啊。米可回答道。通常，我和舞会轮流去那座神社值班，这样随时都有专人负责处理可能出现的任何事情。我负责白天的值班，她负责晚上的工作，而我们在黎明和黄昏时分也会一起去那里。明白了吗？我们现在之所以都在那里，是因为有一群请愿者把我们给缠住了…… 不过，这并没有回答你的问题。 舞耸了耸肩，然后吐出一个精美的烟圈。这个一点，那个一点，真的。就像米科说的，我们刚刚处理完一大堆请愿书，这些天也没什么事情需要交给奶奶处理了。说实话，我们的能力已经相当不错了。 我们还需要帮助那些提出请求的人完成他们所需要的各种仪式，也可以为他们做一些小忙。你毕竟是个外人，所以我也不指望你了解这些正确的仪式和礼仪；不过没关系，因为米科和我会在需要的时候指导你。看着一个外人手忙脚乱、不知道该往哪里走、该做什么，其实还挺有意思的。你明白我的意思吗？ 你也是这么认为的…… 当然了，如果你想亲自和诡计之神聊聊的话，只需要走进那座神殿，看看他是否愿意接见你。你知道的，他是个很友善、很随和的人，只要没有其他事情忙，他就喜欢聊聊天。 这件事你就先缓一缓吧。 有些简单的东西其实并不难理解。就算是像你这样的外人，也应该能够弄清楚该怎么做吧。占卜纸条例如，米可补充道。你应该感到高兴才对。毕竟，没多少外人有机会如此近距离地了解我们的生活方式，你知道吗？如果你有什么不明白的地方，随时都可以问。我和迈都会很乐意为你这样的外人讲解我们的习俗，或者至少告诉你来这个地方应该遵守的礼仪。这样，你就不会经常受到别人的注视了。 是的，你注意到了那个…… 舞看起来有些若有所思，她把手指放在嘴唇上。这种情况有点棘手。大多数当地人仍然把我们当成怪物来看待，我也不能怪他们。不过奶奶说你们可以来拜访，所以你们也不是那么坏……不过，如果你们能在我们的家里尊重我们，我们也会以同样的方式回报你们。怎么样？ 成交。 我们当中总会有一个人在这里的圣地值班。如果有任何问题，尽管提问吧。别再像个陌生人一样了！
