rows.original: [var0 |As you approach, Mai turns slowly, shuffling around. [pc.ra kitsune |She keeps a respectful distance and gives you as deep bow as she can manage with her pregnant belly, hands clasped atop the gravid dome of her baby bump and eyes trained on the ground. The shrine maiden's movements are slow and deliberate, as if walking around something unpredictable and volatile — her, to be exact. When she speaks, her voice is tinged with a wisp of wistful melancholy that makes you want to squeeze her body as it ripens in maternity and reassure her that she's beautiful... [rand |"Ah, welcome, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], can I be servin' ya today? His divine lordship is always open to be receivin' a favored one such as ya if'n ya wanna pay yer respects." Well, she can be doing more than just serving you. Softening your stance, you reach out and plant your hands on Mai's cheeks, drawing the corners of her mouth up into a little smile. There, she looks a lot more fetching. A pregnant woman shouldn't be as upset as she is all the time — it's not good for the kit. "Yer concern is touchin', my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, an' I thank ya f'r doin' more than lil' ol' me coulda hope f'r. And yet I'm still on duty, an' I gotta ask: how can I be servin' ya?" |"Ya honor us with yer presence today, yer Eminence. Can I do anythin' f'r ya today, or would ya like a lil' time to yerself to be with our divine lord?" Mai pauses, looks away from you despite herself, and heaves a few deep breaths that only serve to make her milk-laden mammaries appear even more ripe and taut. "I'm here to be servin' ya in any way ya need." |"It's an honor to be receivin' th' likes o' ya here today, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Can I help ya, or would ya be okay by yerself?" Mai shivers a little and raises a hand to her cheek, the other idly drumming its fingers upon her round tummy. "Either one's fine with me, yer Eminence, ya jus' gotta say th' word." ] |She daubs at her cheeks with her fingers, searching for any stray tears that might've escaped when she wasn't paying attention, then half-lids her eyes and gives you a nod of her head. No bow, of course, not with her milky tits and pregnant belly getting in the way. With her ears turned down like that and her quiet voice tinged with a wisp of wistful melancholy, you're suddenly struck by the impulse to squeeze her body as it ripens in maternity and reassure her that she's beautiful... [rand |"Well, if'n it ain't th' [pc.mf |father |sire ] o' the kit growin' inside o' my tummy. Ya came all th' way to see lil' ol' me, or ya came to be petionin' his divine lordship an' all?" Why not both? Softening your stance, you reach out and plant your hands on Mai's cheeks, drawing the corners of her mouth up into a little smile. There, she looks a lot more fetching. Pregnant women should not be upset, or at least not as much as she's been of late, and if she smiles enough she'll start to feel better, no matter how marginally so. "Yer mindfulness is done appreciated, an' I can't say that yer not welcome, but... well, never mind that none. 'S mostly my fault, I know, even if'n it woulda be so easy to be foistin' th' blame on ya. "That ain't th' point, though, an' I'm on duty. Need anythin'?" |As you draw closer, Mai's expression changes from one of melancholy to that of wistfulness, perhaps dredging up some long-standing aching memory that soothes as much as it hurts. For what reason would you be the star of such a recollection? Ah, but all that is but red dust on the wind soon enough... "Ain't it a poetic evenin', [pc.name]. A different petitioner from th' usual crowd, I'll be sayin'. There anythin' I can be helping ya with?" You don't reply immediately, letting the sensation draw itself out, fully unravelling before being carried off on the evening breeze. Mai understands what you're doing and carefully lets the moment play itself to the end before speaking again, the corners of her lips turning up. "So... unless ya ain't here to seek guidance from our divine lord Keros an' came all th' way here jus' to see a poor lil' vixen an' tease her 'bout how emotional she's done gettin' all th' time, maybe there's somethin' yer need?" |"Saw yer aura comin' in all th' way in from th' fields, risin' like th' fire in th' sky," Mai says wistfully, trailing fingers over the rounded curve of her kit-filled womb. "Ain't no mistakin' it, not when there's one jus' like it inside o' me, if a lil' smaller." What is it like, to finally see things clearly? Mai pauses, and you wonder if she's going to burst into tears or try to rip you apart on the spot. It's with great effort that she collects herself and shakes her head. "That ain't no conversation f'r a greetin' [pc.name]. But yer full o' life, an' framed against all them green growin' things it done make f'r a beautiful sight, that's all I'm sayin'. "Now, open yer mouth if'n ya need anythin'. I'd be glad to help th' [pc.mf |father |sire ] of my kits in th' matters of th' gods an' all... we're jus' about family now, an' family done take care o' each other." ] ] [party.has kiyoko | Turning to Kiyoko, Mai gives your fox-wife a bow, bending forward as far as she can without the weight of her tummy sending her pitching forward. "An' ya, [silly |Myōbu-sama |Lady Ōtomo ]... I humbly welcome ya to a house of th' gods this evenin'. Or rather, one god. Yer accomplished in yer own right... but I await to be of help in any way I can." Kiyoko remains calm and collected as ever, bidding Mai to rise with a flick of her wrist. "Excellent. I will surely avail myself of your services should I have need of them." "Same as yer consort, [silly |Myōbu-sama |Lady Ōtomo ]... anythin' ya need, jus' holler." ] |As you approach, Mai rises, extinguishes her pipe with a snap of her fingers and [pc.ra kitsune |steps forward, keeping a respectful distance, her figure outlined by the light of the shrine's lanterns behind her. Clasping her hands in front of her, the gray-furred shrine maiden clears her throat and bows deeply. [rand |"Good evenin', m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Are ya here to commune with th' divine?" No, you're here to see her, maybe share a smoke. "Beggin' yer pardon, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], but it ain't nice to tease a shrine maiden when she's on duty. Not that lil' ol' me would ever insinuate that someone of yer station would ever do such a thing." Oh, never, never. "It ain't unheard of for folk to come in th' dead of night f'r certain rites... anyways, if'n ya be needin' somethin' or th' other, I'll be right here, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. |"Welcome an' watch yer step at night, yer Eminence. I keep th' garden lanterns lit an' all, but it's still a long walk through the fields here an' back." The concern's appreciated, thank you very much. "Now then, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]... there somethin' I can help ya with?" |"Evenin', m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Th' moon is out tonight... ya can see it through th' roots an' all. It feels all mysterious-like, don't it?" There is... a certain air of mysticism that you're able to perceive, yes. One that's especially centered about this place. "This here is our hour," Mai continues. "Miko's nature keeps her up at day, an' mine at night... th' longer ya spend in that there body, th' more ya'll be able to sense it instinctively, th' ebb an' flow. Th' shift in powers makes certain rites far easier at night, an' that's why I'm here... it's why yer here, ain't it?" Hmm... "If'n ya need anything, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], ya jus' holler, ya hear?" ] |slinks forward towards you, her pipe still heavy with rich winterstem smoke that rises and curls in the air. [rand |Mai doesn't stop, draping herself onto your front and cupping your chin between thumb and forefinger. "My, my... yer up late f'r a petitioner. Maybe ya wanted one of my special cleansings under th' light of th' moon? Extra effective in wardin' off evil influences, I'll have ya know." Um, would this %"cleansing" happen to involve — "Ahahaha. Don'tcha worry, I ain't no glutton, unlike Miko. 'Sides, I ain't supposed to be snackin' on the job. Smokin' is already pushin' it. Now then... ya need anything, [pc.mascFem |handsome |cutie ]?" |Mai swiftly invades your personal space with a few broad steps and curls her tails about your body, letting you get just the slightest taste of fluff in the cool night air. "Evenin', [pc.name]. Fancy seein' ya out here this late... ya don't happen to be a night person like I am, would ya?" It has a certain quality to it, yes. "Yer aren't able to feel it like I can, but this here's our hour, [pc.race]. Miko... she don't know what she's missin', the silly thing. Certain rites are... uh, more effective when one's performin' them at th' right time of day, or night f'r that matter. That's what ya came all th' way out here f'r, din't ya?" That... The tail-tips press just a little more insistently against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "Oh well. Yer welcome to do as ya please... within reason. Ya need anythin', ya jus' holler, okay?" |Smiling, the gray-furred shrine maiden leans forward and plants a sweet, dainty kiss on your cheek, the warmth of her lips lingering on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "Well, lookit who it is. Now ain't you a sight for sore eyes... an' to break up some o' th' tedium of bein' on duty. Wouldn't have expected [a] [pc.race] like ya to be out an' about at this here time o' night..." You're kind of surprised at it yourself. "Th' way th' light moves... better watch yer step later on th' way home, that's all I'm sayin'. Now, ya certainly came to this here shrine f'r somethin', didja?" ] ] [party.has kiyoko | Done with you, Mai turns to your fox-wife and gives her a deep, formal bow, perhaps a little more than what's strictly necessary for someone of her station. "[silly |Myōbu-sama |Lady Ōtomo ]. It's an honor to be receivin' ya at this hour. Would ya like lil' me to prepare th' shrine f'r yer own purposes?" Ever poised and collected, Kiyoko inclines her head briefly and gestures for Mai to rise. "Perhaps. That will depend on what my consort here decides." "I understand. If'n ya'll need anythin'... I'm at yer service." ] ]

rows.translation: [rand |米可将扇子举到面前，夸张地倒退一步，装作震惊。哎呀，天哪。你想听我这小女子的故事？[pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|领主|女士]您真是给了我莫大的荣幸|一个外人竟然会对我感兴趣……而不是对那方面感兴趣]。我跟你说，这可真叫人受宠若惊…… |哦，太好了。这正是我最喜欢谈论的话题！ 看着米可……是啊，她确实是那种能一连好几个钟头大谈特谈自己的姑娘，对吧？不过，你真正想听到的是有用的信息，而不是没完没了的空话……除非这也只是她的一层伪装。唉，你是不是想太多了？ 所以，就像我刚才说的…… |米可把一根手指弯到唇边，冲你露出狡黠的笑容。你说你想聊天？[pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|领主|女士]，如果您乐意的话，我还能为您做点别的事|比起闲聊，您难道不想做点更有意思的事吗？反正我是想的]…… 算了，目前来说，交谈就足够了。 米可摆出她最可爱的嘟嘴表情，那模样实在是可爱极了。呜呜呜……好吧。总不能什么都想得到、什么都不用努力就能得到吧。那你想聊些什么呢？啊，我知道了…… ] [rand |我和舞不是在殖民地出生的；我们大概九岁或十岁那年被送到这里，开始接受教育。黑川家族在比较偏远的省份有些产业，我们就是从那里来的。那儿的生活要更悠闲、更随性一些——没人急着赶路、做事、看风景。有点像殖民地，但没那么紧张；我猜他们就是因为这个才觉得我和舞能融入这里。事实证明，他们没猜错。 但也正因为这样，别人不带这种口音，我们说话却带着。你真该听听我们用母语交谈的样子——那口音还要重得多。不过这样也挺好，你知道吗？偶尔有藤原家的人之类穿过大门来办帝国公务，来的时候还以为这儿全是些无知的乡巴佬……偶尔被低估一下，倒也不坏。 |哦，这把丝扇啊？它的设计灵感来源于几百年前宫廷女眷们常用的款式。她们会拿着这些扇子轻轻摇动，既显得优雅大方，又不会让人觉得她们在故作姿态……虽然这种风尚早已不再受宫廷青睐，但这样一来，我就可以随心所欲地享受这份惬意，而没人会因为我‘摆架子’而来打扰我。正如人们所说，‘天高皇帝远’——在殖民地，这句话再真实不过了。 |我和舞一直都知道，我们总有一天会成为神社巫女，最终成为女祭司。我们生来就是神职——出身于侍奉神明的祭司家族，黑川家世代都是如此。在故乡我们还有几座神社——算不上宏大华美，但我们为它们感到自豪。 她和她姐姐的命运早在出生之前就已注定，这件事有没有困扰过她？ 我们并不是非得当女祭司不可，米可一边扇着扇子一边回答。不过，要是我们不当，那才是浪费了自己的天赋。从小就知道、也一直盼着这件事，多少能冲淡其中的苦涩——如果本来有苦涩的话……而且，奶奶和族里反正也需要我们留在这里，去摸清这片依旧陌生而未知的土地，还有同样陌生而未知的神明。奶奶让跳，我们就跳，绝不多问。我们欠她太多了。 |要是你听到有人说我贪吃，你可别信那种胡话。没错，我确实比一般姑娘吃得多了点，但那只是因为[var0|——" 舞哼了一声。因为你就是头猪，你越是嘴硬否认，就越显得可悲，姐姐。 可不是猪！ 我跟你保证，这种曲线美绝对不是靠吃米饭和豆子就能练出来的，相信我！ 姑娘们，姑娘们！ |我可是个大姑娘，得保持好身材。 嗯，米可并不胖，这一点你一眼就能看出来。那种结实、饱满的健美体态，绝不会被误认成单纯的臃肿，这完全是另一回事。 ] 总之，就像我刚才说的，米可继续说道，我正在好好报答我所有的恩人，所以没什么可抱怨的。我没有违反任何神律，谁都不该违反，尤其是我这样家族出身的人。所以，你就别理会那些针对我这小姑娘的恶毒流言了，好吗？ ]

We got some shrines back in th' homeland — ain't anythin' big or fancy, but we're proud o' them." Has it ever bothered her both her and her sister's fate were decided before they were even born? "There weren't no need f'r us to be priestesses," Miko replies, fanning herself. "Still, woulda been a waste o' our talents if'n we din't. Growin' up knowin' an' expectin' it takes out a lot o' th' sting, if'n there were any to begin with... an' Granny an' th' clan needed us here, anyways, to suss out a land that's still pretty strange an' unknown, with equally strange an' unknown kami. When Granny says to jump, we obey, no questionin'. We owe her a lot." |"If'n ya hear talk that I'm summat o' a glutton, don't you go around believin' such nonsense. That kind of firm, full-bodied robustness could never be mistaken as simply mere rotundity. This is something else altogether. ] "Anyways, like I was sayin'," Miko continues, "I'm repayin' all my benefactors nice an' proper, so there ain't no cause for complaint. I ain't breaking any divine laws, wouldn't be right f'r anyone to do so, least someone from a clan like mine. So ya jus' go on an' dismiss such horrible gossip against a lil' ol' gal, okay?" ]"

rows.original: "Ya got that right. Kohaku may think she's th' best at gossip-mongerin' 'round these parts, but she ain't beaten me yet. Ya'd think folks would be more tongue-tied about a shrine maiden an' all, but they jus' can't stop talkin' in front o' a nice girl like me. Can't imagine why, must be my charmin' face." Miko flutters her eyes at you, and smiles in a way that leaves absolutely no doubt that she knows full well it's not her face — however fetching it is — that's doing the brunt of the work in her general charismatic appeal.
rows.translation: 你说得对。虽然琥珀可能自认为自己是这一带最会传播流言蜚语的人，但她还没能胜过我。你可能会觉得，对于一位神社少女来说，人们应该会保持沉默才对，但实际上，在我这样的漂亮女孩面前，他们就是停不下来聊天。真不明白为什么，大概是因为我这张迷人的脸吧。 米可眨了眨眼睛，微笑着，那笑容清楚地表明：她非常清楚，真正让她具备这种魅力的，并非她那张无论多么动人的脸庞。

rows.original: [var1 |"No matter how old we are, no matter how long it's been, Mai an' I have slept in th' same bed. Been that way since we were kits, gonna be that way until one o' us gets married off or somethin'. I know some folks think it's right weird that we do it that way, but it ain't bothered us none an' besides, ain't no one gonna say nothin' 'bout it to our faces." Why, though? Is there any particular reason? "Ehehe. Mai leaves th' best warm spots..." What, seriously? "Jus' kiddin'. Well, kinda. I get up at dawn an' get ready f'r th' day, and that's when Mai heads in to bed. Then when I'm all tuckered out an' ready to turn in, Mai's up an' runnin'. It's a nice way o' doin' things an' I don't see no problem with it, so... 'sides, it means a bigger bed f'r th' both o' us!" [var0 | "It's done worked f'r th' last twenty-odd years," Mai says with a shrug. "I ain't changing what ain't broke, if'n ya understand me." ] |So, when did Mai pick up her smoking habit? You've never seen her without her pipe. [var0 |"Ya know, I'm right here an' can hear ya jus' fine," Mai calls out from the other side of the shrine. "Sis, talkin' 'round my back is kinda uncalled f'r an' all, I'm hopin' ya understand that." ] "Oh, Mai picked it up right 'bout when she was fifteen summers o' age. Think it was from one o' our aunties — she was coughin' all the time when she started, but it ain't no problem f'r her no more." [var0 | "Sis, if'n I were ya, I'd stop talkin' right 'bout now..." ] You see. "Won't smoke anythin' but th' stuff she grows, either. She's been crossbreedin' the wild types, tryin' to find th' strongest weed in th[var0 |—" That's about as far as Miko gets before her sister storms over, grabs her by the ears, and pulls. Miko shrieks, her tails flailing, as she falls right on her ass with an "oof". "Sheesh, sis, ain't as if I wasn't telling [pc.name] nothing that everyone don't know already. What's th' big fuss?" "Th' big fuss is that yer talkin' 'bout me as if I ain't here," Mai replies, watching her sister scramble to her feet. "If'n [pc.name] wants to know 'bout my plants, [pc.heShe] can come up an' ask me [pc.himHer]self." |e lot she can grow. What my sis wants is winterstem that'll give her a right ol' buzz while not gettin' in th' way of her thinkin'." That sounds rather contradictory. "Ain't stoppin' her none. Kohaku's watchin' my sis like a bug, plannin' on swoopin' in an' makin' a pile f'r th' den once she perfects it. I jus' know it." ] |"Mai's always been more sensitive to th' energies o' livin' things. Crops, plants, people... that there last one most o' all. I can perform harai jus' fine, but she's got so good a touch at perceivin' evil influences, misaligned chi and ki, that kinda thing, so she handles most o' that stuff." [var0 | Mai sticks her tongue out at her sister. "Ya know, I still think ya let me do it 'cause it takes far more preparation an' is far more tirin'..." "And not 'cause yer so good at it, sis?" "Ain't that much better that yer perfectly fine with leavin' it all to me." ] Uh-huh. What's she good at, then? "Lil' ol' me? I'm better at sensin' the energies o' nature. Th' light o' th' sun, the flow o' th' winter breeze... I ain't ever been wrong on th' next day's weather. Not once. There're other things that I'm good at, too... there's a reason why I'm in charge o' handlin' th' omikuji, after all." |"Might surprise ya, but our fur color aside, Mai an' I weren't so different when we were lil' kits. Then we started growin' up, ya see, an' started growin' apart, too." A nasty grin on her face, Miko runs her hands down her chest, past her waist and over her hips, pressing the silk of her shrine maiden's garb against the curves of her body. "Ya can see f'r yerself... ah, the difference a bunch o' years can make." [var0 | "Ain't nothin' to be proud of, ya oversexed vamp," Mai says, sticking out her tongue at her sister. "Not as if ya worked f'r any o' it." ] Uh-huuuh. "Don't get me wrong, my sis' ain't small by no means. But I guess I musta been eatin' well or somethin', 'cause every part o' me started expandin', an' quite vigorously to boot." Miko's grin fades to a dreamy smile as she takes another step into your personal space, tails waving. "At eleven summers, folks wouldn't be able to tell us apart if'n not for our fur... at seventeen summers, folks wouldn't believe we were kin when meetin' us f'r th' first time. Granny says youth an' beauty are fleetin', sure... an' that jus' means I oughta make th' best o' th' three or four decades I got, eh?" |"Well, if'n yer askin' me, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]'s kinda hard to believe lil' ol' me done got promoted to aunt already. Here I were hopin' it'd be a year or two more 'fore Granny done an' made a match f'r either o' us an' split us up by marryin' one o' us off... but life ain't fond o' movin' as we please." Miko chuckles and puts her fingers together. "I dunno. I kinda feel lonely." Because Mai has someone else in her life that isn't her any more. Miko[var0 | throws a look at her sister's back to make sure Mai isn't listening in on your conversation, then ] nods. "Ya done got a way o' statin' things bluntly without givin' offense, an' in a good way[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.ra kitsune |lord |lady ]ship ]. Sure, we done still sleep in th' same bed an' all, but she's spendin' more time dealin' with my niece than me. I ain't mad at her or nothin', but it still done feel odd... we always done used to do things together, even if'n it were carin' for other folks like Rindo. "It's a whole passel o' selfishness, I know, an' it were bound to be happenin' to one o' us someday, but it don't change the fact none that it's kinda lonely. We done always ever had th' other 'round, an' th' day one there'd only be one o' us in our childhood bed — that day was always comfortably distant, that ya din't need to be thinkin' 'bout it none. Kinda like sis always tellin' herself that she'd get off smokin' in th' future..." And now that it's finally happened, she's looking back on all those days long past and wondering just where have they gone. "Ain't that th' truth. Well, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]better it be happenin' now than later, ain't I right? Auntie. Auntie. Keros' tails, I ain't jus' feelin' old, lil' ol' me feels decrypt jus' lettin' th' word leave my tongue. This here is jus' too sad. Too sad. I oughta be happy f'r Mai an' all, but I jus' can't help but be sad." |So, Komari's finally picked her as her heritor over Mai... "Ain't wrong[pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence ]. An' even so, what does it done do? Guess it's done worth a lil' status in th' eyes o' folks 'round these parts, but it's really jus' one o' those promotions which done come with more responsibilities an' no benefits." Miko laughs and swishes a tail at you. "Oh, it ain't wrong that somethin' done changed, an' it ain't all 'well, yer doin' what ya were doin' anyway', but lil' ol' me gotta agree that it done got pumped up a lot more than it oughta be." Does she care for the position, though? "Whether lil' ol' me cares f'r it or not ain't in th' runnin', I do what's asked o' me. [pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer permission to be speakin' freely, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, but things are what they done happen to be. ]Ain't changin' th' fact none that I'm not expectin' his divine lordship to be lettin' Granny go in Mai an' my's lifetime — he's done keepin' th' length of her chastisement to himself f'r a reason.[kiyoko.isFree | An' even though th' [silly |myobu |high lady ] may be back an' forgiven her an' all, that don't change none that Granny was done asked to be stayin' with her f'r one more lifetime at least... ]" Look, you understand that Miko's cavalier approach to life is part of her signature style, but you'd expected her to consider the matter a bit more seriously — the weight of the increased responsibility on her head and the added problem of her sister's emotional outbursts, if nothing else. "It is what it done is an' ain't what it ain't[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence, ]" Miko replies matter-of-factly. You're tempted to ask what that's even supposed to mean, but the both of you know full well she's evading the topic. Pressing Miko on it right now isn't going to produce anything useful. |"Lookin' at Mai an' my niece, she done seem pretty content," Miko says with a chuckle. "Leastways, when she's not screamin', weepin' an' kickin' up a fuss over somethin' she ain't gonna remember in a couple minutes. Sure, it ain't all peachy keen an' smooth sailin', but I done think sis is better than she were before." Mai didn't use to feel very much of anything, and now she's feeling too much. "Depends on who you done ask[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. Jus' like Mai an' I ain't able to stay so close together forever as sisters, I were tellin' her all th' time that she couldn't be clinging none to that smoke o' hers for th' rest o' her life, ya know? She wouldn't listen none... imagine if I were th' one to be gettin' a big belly instead o' her, tellin' her to be takin' that there smoke away from me all th' time... more than ten years ago now when lil' ol' me done first told her to be droppin' it. "Well, ya have my thanks[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Couldn't have done it without you none." It may not have been the perfect way of going about it, but if Mai eventually winds up in a better place because of all this you'll be content. That, and you're surprisingly taking a lot less blame than you thought you'd be, given that you were the one to knock her up and all. "Well, ya know what they say. Gettin' with child an' given' birth done change how ya think, an' mebbe that'll be helpin' sis get along with th' new program. Ya done kicked her into kickin' th' habit... Granny ain't lettin' ya off th' hook scot-free, but she knew that somethin' like this were comin' f'r th' longest time. Hard to be mad that way." |You hear that Miko is getting involved in helping her sister keep her mood swings under control without the use of drugs. How's that coming along? "Doin' pretty well, actually. Ain't gonna magically make her fine — it done took me years to be gettin' where I'm now — but she's makin' better progress than I thought she were, f'r her daughter's sake if'n nothin' else. Ain't easy when I gotta be bringin' out th' bindings, but ya know, there're times when I'm glad f'r bein' all big an' heavy." Miko chuckles. "Still, her condition ain't th' exact same as mine, so Granny done went an' got a couple meditation manuals from her friends in Macah to check out them techniques she thought mighta help. "D'ya know them tiger people wanted to be writin' th' lot on jade slips, rack up th' price? Granny was like heck no, I ain't payin' f'r that, you do it on paper 'cause I ain't payin' f'r th' book, I'm payin' f'r what's done written in it. Aaaann'... she done got enough pull that them tigers listened to her. Crazy, I tell ya; lil' ol' me had no idea her reach went that far." So, Mai's feeling better these days, since they're trying to let her out and go about her usual business? "Better is a heavy word[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence | an' one lil' ol' me wouldn't be bandyin' 'bout easily none ]. It ain't all smooth sailin', but Mai's workin' things out, an' Granny an' I are playin' it by ear a lot, too. Wouldn't be surprised none if'n we got a half-dozen or more public screamin' fits by th' year's end." ]
rows.translation: [var1 |无论我们多大年纪，无论过去了多久，我和梅一直都是睡在同一张床上。从我们还是小孩子的时候就开始这样，以后也会一直保持这个习惯，直到我们其中一个人结婚或者发生别的什么事情为止。我知道有些人觉得我们这样做很奇怪，但这对我们来说根本没有任何影响，而且也没人会当面指责我们。 不过，为什么呢？是不是有什么特别的理由呢？ 嘿嘿，梅总是把最好的温暖地方留给自己…… 什么，真的吗？ 开个玩笑啦。嗯，也算吧。我总是天刚破晓就起床准备一天的工作，而这个时候梅才会去睡觉。等我忙完一切准备睡觉时，梅却已经起床开始活动了。这种安排其实挺好的，我也没觉得有什么问题，所以……反正这样我们俩就能共用一张更大的床了！ [var0 | 这东西已经用了二十多年了。梅耸了耸肩说道。如果你明白我的意思的话，那些没有坏的地方，我是不会去改变它们的。 ] "Well, ya have my thanks[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Couldn't have done it without you none." It may not have been the perfect way of going about it, but if Mai eventually winds up in a better place because of all this you'll be content. That, and you're surprisingly taking a lot less blame than you thought you'd be, given that you were the one to knock her up and all. "Well, ya know what they say. Gettin' with child an' given' birth done change how ya think, an' mebbe that'll be helpin' sis get along with th' new program. Ya done kicked her into kickin' th' habit... Granny ain't lettin' ya off th' hook scot-free, but she knew that somethin' like this were comin' f'r th' longest time. Hard to be mad that way." |You hear that Miko is getting involved in helping her sister keep her mood swings under control without the use of drugs. How's that coming along? "Doin' pretty well, actually. Ain't gonna magically make her fine — it done took me years to be gettin' where I'm now — but she's makin' better progress than I thought she were, f'r her daughter's sake if'n nothin' else. Ain't easy when I gotta be bringin' out th' bindings, but ya know, there're times when I'm glad f'r bein' all big an' heavy." Miko chuckles. "Still, her condition ain't th' exact same as mine, so Granny done went an' got a couple meditation manuals from her friends in Macah to check out them techniques she thought mighta help. "D'ya know them tiger people wanted to be writin' th' lot on jade slips, rack up th' price? Granny was like heck no, I ain't payin' f'r that, you do it on paper 'cause I ain't payin' f'r th' book, I'm payin' f'r what's done written in it. Aaaann'... she done got enough pull that them tigers listened to her. Crazy, I tell ya; lil' ol' me had no idea her reach went that far." So, Mai's feeling better these days, since they're trying to let her out and go about her usual business? "Better is a heavy word[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence | an' one lil' ol' me wouldn't be bandyin' 'bout easily none ]. It ain't all smooth sailin', but Mai's workin' things out, an' Granny an' I are playin' it by ear a lot, too. Wouldn't be surprised none if'n we got a half-dozen or more public screamin' fits by th' year's end." ]"

rows.original: [var0 |"Mai an' I, we were sent here to study under granny's tutelage when we were kits. She was lookin' to retire and ask Keros' permission to be one with th' land an' all... but someone like her, she can't jus' up an' leave without handin' matters over to a successor. That's where Mai an' I come in." Retire. That's one way of wrapping it up in a nice euphemism, if you're understanding Miko correctly. "...We ain't elves, we weren't designed to live thousands o' years without battin' an eye — an' even so, there's a reason most elves keep to themselfs an' don't mix around that much with other peoples. Granny's a yasha an' don't age none, but the decades wear on ya after long enough, grind ya down. Mai an' I know that once we're ready, she's gonna petition th' Trickster to let her be one with th' land... an' we don't even know if'n he's gonna say yes." |"Granny figured out my talents pretty quick after Mai an' I arrived on her doorstep in th' colonies. Soon enough, she was teachin' me how to read th' weather — th' phases o' th' moon an' what they mean, different kinds o' clouds an' th' kind o' tidings they're bringin' with them. Weren't long 'fore I was flawlessly tellin' th' weather — first one day ahead, then three, then a whole whoppin' week. Once I got started, I ain't ever been wrong." Impressive. "Ya coulda say I've got an eye an' a nose f'r this kinda thing. Bein' able to easily suss out th' local kami o' this land an' its features, even when they're tryin' to hide — that there's a talent Granny helped me hone, too. Some days I have a hard time sayin' it, but Mai an' I owe lots to her." |"Granny was amongst th' first settlers to found th' Western Imperial Colonies — came across with th' Godswar an' never returned home. Well, not for good, leastways. As th' years dragged on, everyone except her just gave up th' ghost — couple from injuries, couple from sickness, but most from plain ol' age. Not that she ever wanted th' title o' governor to begin with, but it jus' ain't done to turn down a direct appointment like that to begin with. "Not jus' seein', but bein' kin to someone who saw everythin' unfold... it gives ya a certain appreciation f'r what happened in th' past." |"I hear tell that Granny was quite th' looker when she was younger, and then some," Miko says with a chuckle. "If'n Mai an' I are anythin' like her in her heyday, she must've been quite th' head-turner." Hah. If nothing else, you can see the family resemblance between Komari and Miko. Mai... is probably a little more removed from the stem of the family free. "Eh, Granny's really well-preserved for someone her age. Ya don't have to look like a hag when ya get older... bein' a yasha aside, she does put in th' effort to be lookin' decent day in, day out — an' so am I." |The moment you ask about Komari, Miko's eyes narrow. Gone is the perpetual, sultry grin she sports, replaced by a mixture of apprehension and disgust. You have a pretty good feeling that you know what this is about, and when Miko speaks up, your suspicions are confirmed. "[pc.ra kitsune |Yer Eminence |[pc.name] ]... [silly |didja fuck my granma |what'n the world didja get up to recently ]?" Despite your best efforts, you can't stop the knowing smirk from forming on your face. Opting to play dumb, you cover your mouth with a hand, before asking Miko whatever she could be referring to. The provocative gambit succeeds, and you swear one of Miko's eyes twitches as she looks at you. "I'm askin' if ya done fucked granny Komari, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |[pc.name] ]. And don't be playin' dumb with lil' ol' me. Everybody's been talkin' about how ya done strode on inta' her office an' did Keros-knows-what fer hours; an' I can see it on yer face that ya look proud to boot." Miko appears genuinely agitated, voice wavering as she attempts to maintain her composure. You can't recall ever seeing her get this worked up before[var1 |; save for after you beat her during your first meeting |, and it's a bit unnerving to watch ]. Regardless, Miko continues to chew you out. "So, I'm gonna ask ya one more time, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |[pc.name] ]: did ya go an' fuck granny Komari?" Well, hold on just a moment here. Rather than answering, you ask Miko just why exactly it's such a concern for her. After all, she ought to be happy; with how much Komari and her look alike, you can vouch for the fact she'll still be turning heads wh— Your reply is cut short as Miko — looking utterly aghast — abruptly places her hands over her ears, and begins shouting over you. "NANANANANANANA I AIN'T HEARIN' IT!" Your attempts to speak up are repeatedly cut off by Miko's immature caterwauling, and you're left to watch her childish tantrum for what feels like minutes. Eventually, it comes to an end, as [var2 |an annoyed Mai stomps over and smacks her sister upside the head. Miko lets out a yelp, before flinching a bit as Mai yells at her. "Quit yer damn hollerin', sis! I could hear ya 'cross the shrine, fer cryin' out loud!" Miko doesn't respond to that, wordlessly glowering as Mai storms back off. Eventually, her attention turns back to you, and |Miko abruptly notices that the two of you aren't alone. Awkwardly looking over the baffled stares of several petitioners, Miko slowly straightens her posture, before ] she clears her throat, composing herself. "A-anyway, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |[pc.name] ], what else'd ya wanna know?" ]
rows.translation: [var0 |我和梅都是小时候被送到这里，在奶奶的指导下学习的。当时奶奶打算退休了，想得到凯罗斯的允许，然后与大地融为一体……但是像她这样的人，不可能不把所有事情安排妥当就直接离开。这就是我和梅被派来这里的原因。 退下吧。如果你正确理解了米可的意图，那么用这种委婉的说法来表达这个意思也是可以的。 ……我们可不是精灵，我们并不是被设计成能够千年不战而安地生活的生物——即便如此，大多数精灵之所以选择独来独往，不太与其他种族来往，也是有原因的。奶奶就是这样的亚莎它们永远不会变老，但岁月终究会侵蚀人，逐渐消磨人的意志。我和梅都知道，等我们准备好的时候，她会向那个狡猾的神祈求，让他让自己与大地融为一体……但我们甚至不知道他是否会答应。 |在我和梅一起来到殖民地的那天，奶奶很快就发现了我的天赋。不久之后，她就开始教我如何预测天气——月相的变化及其含义、不同种类的云朵以及它们所预示的天气情况。没过多久，我就能够准确地预测天气了：一开始只能预测一天后的天气，后来能预测三天，最后甚至能预测整整一周。一旦我开始尝试预测天气，就再也没有犯过错误。 真是令人印象深刻。 你完全可以这么说：我对这类事情可是很有敏锐度的，能够轻松地察觉到当地的情况。神明对于这片土地及其各种特征，即使人们试图隐藏它们，我也能够察觉到——有一种天赋，是奶奶帮助我培养出来的。有时候，我很难承认这一点，但舞和我确实欠她很多。 |奶奶是最早一批建立西部帝国殖民地的移民之一——她与神战军一同来到这里，之后就再也没回家。至少，不是永久性地回家。随着岁月流逝，除了她之外，其他人全都去世了：有些人是因伤去世，有些人是因病去世，而大多数人则是自然老去。其实她本来就并不想担任总督这个职位，但这样的直接任命，她总不能拒绝吧。 不仅仅是旁观者，而是作为那些亲历了这一切的人的亲人……这种经历会让你对过去发生的事情产生一种特殊的理解与感慨。 |我听说，奶奶年轻的时候可是个大美女，真的非常漂亮。米可轻笑着说道。如果我和迈在她的鼎盛时期有几分相似，她肯定也会是个非常吸引人注意的人。 哈，至少你可以看出麻里和米可之间有着家族相似之处。而茉……大概与这个家族的血缘关系已经疏远了一些吧。 呃，对于她这个年纪的人来说，奶奶的身体状况真的相当不错。年纪大了也不一定非得像个老巫婆……撇开她是夜叉不谈，她确实每天都花心思保持好仪容——我也一样。 |当你提到麻里里这个名字时，米可的双眼立刻眯了起来。她那一贯带着魅力的微笑消失了，取而代之的是一种既担忧又厌恶的表情。你心里很清楚，这次谈话肯定与这个话题有关，而当米可开口说话时，你的猜测果然得到了证实。[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]…… [silly |这家伙真敢对我的奶奶不敬！ |你最近到底干了些什么啊？ ]尽管你已经竭尽全力，但还是无法阻止自己脸上浮现出那种心照不宣的微笑。你决定装作不知情，用手捂住嘴巴，然后询问米可她到底在说什么。这个挑衅的举动果然奏效了——当你看着她的时候，你发誓看到她的眼睛在抽搐。” “我问呢如果你已经和麻里奶奶发生了关系[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]别跟我装傻了。大家都在议论你是怎么大摇大摆地走进她的办公室，然后在那里待了好几个小时；从你的脸上也能看出来，你心里肯定在想些什么。自豪的更何况……” 米可明显非常激动，声音都在颤抖，尽管她在努力保持镇定。你实在想不起来以前见过她如此激动过。[var1 |等你在第一次见面时击败她之后再保存这个进度吧。 |看着这一幕，确实会让人感到有些不安。 ]无论如何，米可还是会继续训斥你。 “那么，我再问你一次[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]你该不会去跟麻里奶奶搞什么吧？” 嗯，等一下。与其直接回答，不如先问问米可，为什么这件事会让她这么在意。毕竟，她应该感到高兴才对啊；麻里和她长得那么像，你可以肯定，她依然会吸引很多人的注意…… 你的回答还没说完，米科就突然露出惊恐的表情，双手捂住耳朵，开始大声喊叫，盖过了你的声音。 “啊啊啊啊啊，我听不见啊！” 你试图继续说话，但米科那幼稚的喊叫声一次又一次地打断了你，你只能眼睁睁地看着她发这种小孩子气的脾气，感觉这一刻简直持续了好几分钟。最终，这一切都结束了。 [var2 |恼怒的梅大步走过去，一记耳光打在妹妹的头上。米可发出一声尖叫，随后在梅的怒斥下缩了缩脖子。 “别再大声喊叫了，妹妹！你把声音都传到神社那边去了，大家都能听到你哭闹的声音！” 米可没有回应，只是沉默地瞪着梅，而梅也气呼呼地走开了。过了一会儿，她的注意力才重新回到你身上。 |米可突然注意到，你们两个人并不是独自一人在这里。她尴尬地瞥了一眼那些满脸困惑的请愿者们，然后慢慢挺直了身子，接着…… ]她清了清嗓子，努力让自己平静下来。 “总之， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]你还想知道些什么呢？ ]

rows.original: [rand |Miko rolls her eyes at the question. "Eh. She's always chewin' me out f'r not closin' th' door behind me when Mai an' I go out. I get it, really I do, an' she ain't wrong to be raisin' a concern, but th' woman ain't got no sense o' fun. Psh. Complete killjoy." |"Th' Ishida an' Kurokawa clans have been good with one another f'r a long time now. To hear Granny say it, Azami's ancestors were eager to be off from th' homeland an' out in th' newly formed imperial colonies; not to be sayin' there ain't plenty of wildlands in th' Old Country, but to be explorin' a whole new land done tickled their fancy pretty damn good. They were right alongside Granny on th' first boat back to these lands after th' war, an' this was before we got th' torii gate set up an' all. More'n a month on th' ocean don't sound like a fun trip to me." |"Eh. Y'know, weren't th' other day that I saw her prayin' here at th' shrine... wouldn't be no surprisin' thing in an' o' itself, but guess what she was prayin' for?" You'll bite. What was it? "Ahaha. She was prayin' to find a husband-consort! Good luck with that, 'cause ain't no one goin' to put up with her schoolmarm attitude f'r any length o' time. Still... she oughta started younger 'cause she ain't no spring chicken now, but better late than never, ain't I right?" |"That woman usually stops by th' shrine, asks me f'r the weather 'fore she goes out. Sure, I can understand why someone with that mindset o' hers would be askin' to know if'n it's gonna be rainin' or snowin', but..." But? "Don't get why she'd wanna drop by every mornin' an' ask for th' next day's weather instead o' jus' askin' me f'r th' whole week. Ain't like I can't do that, an' it'd save her th' walk through th' fields an' back." Maybe she just likes the routine of walking to the shrine every morning, or maybe she's just here to see Miko's pretty face. Miko folds her arms over her prodigious chest. "Eh, please don't be jokin' about such things. I couldn't imagine — nah, ferget it, I ain't wastin' more time on this." ]
rows.translation: [rand |米可听到这个问题，翻了个白眼。“唉，每次我和舞出去的时候，她总是唠叨我为什么不把门关上。我确实明白她的担忧，她这么说也没错，但这个女人完全不懂怎么享受乐趣，真是个扫兴的人。” |“石田家族和黑川家族长期以来一直保持着良好的关系。据奶奶说，阿兹米的祖先们很早就渴望离开故乡，前往那些新建立的帝国殖民地；倒不是说旧国的荒野不多，但能去探索一片全新的土地，确实让他们兴奋得不行。战争结束后，他们和奶奶一起乘第一艘返回这片土地的船而来，而那时我们连鸟居都还没有立起来。在海上漂泊一个多月，对我来说可算不上什么愉快的旅行。” |“呃，你知道吧，前几天我看见她在这座神社里祈祷……这本身倒也不奇怪，但你知道她当时在祈祷什么吗？” 你上钩了。到底是什么事？ “啊哈哈。她原来是在祈祷能找到一个丈夫！祝她好运吧，因为没人会长期忍受她那种女教师般的做派。不过……她还是应该早点开始行动，毕竟她已经不是年轻姑娘了，不过晚做总比不做好，对吧？” |“那个女人通常会顺路来这座神社，出门之前会问我天气怎么样。当然，我能理解一个有着她那种想法的人为什么会想知道会不会下雨或者下雪，但是……” 但是呢？ “真不明白她为什么每天早上都要过来问第二天的天气，而不是直接问我这一整周的天气。我又不是不能告诉她，这样她也不用穿过那些田地走这一趟了。” 也许她只是喜欢每天早上去神社散步的这种习惯，又或许她只是想看看米可的漂亮脸蛋。 米可将双臂交叉在自己那引人注目的胸前。“呃，千万别拿这种事情开玩笑。我简直无法想象——算了，不说了，我可不想在这上面再浪费时间。” ]

More'n a month on th' ocean don't sound like a fun trip to me." |"Eh. Y'know, weren't th' other day that I saw her prayin' here at th' shrine... wouldn't be no surprisin' thing in an' o' itself, but guess what she was prayin' for?" You'll bite. What was it? "Ahaha. She was prayin' to find a husband-consort! Good luck with that, 'cause ain't no one goin' to put up with her schoolmarm attitude f'r any length o' time. Still... she oughta started younger 'cause she ain't no spring chicken now, but better late than never, ain't I right?" |"That woman usually stops by th' shrine, asks me f'r the weather 'fore she goes out. Sure, I can understand why someone with that mindset o' hers would be askin' to know if'n it's gonna be rainin' or snowin', but..." But? "Don't get why she'd wanna drop by every mornin' an' ask for th' next day's weather instead o' jus' askin' me f'r th' whole week. Ain't like I can't do that, an' it'd save her th' walk through th' fields an' back." Maybe she just likes the routine of walking to the shrine every morning, or maybe she's just here to see Miko's pretty face. Miko folds her arms over her prodigious chest. "Eh, please don't be jokin' about such things. I couldn't imagine — nah, ferget it, I ain't wastin' more time on this." ]"

rows.original: "Huh. Yer askin' about my cus, eh? Yeah, I can see why ya'd do that — [pc.ra kitsune|even if'n yer one o' us now, it's still a hard tack f'r him to let go of... so as his cus' I gotta ask you to bear with him, okay?"|he ain't th' most welcomin' o' folks when it comes to outsiders like ya. Askin' him personal questions... jus' wouldn't be done f'r th' likes o' you."] [rand |"Cus din't always use to be like this, ya know. He was a fairly carefree kit an' used to smile a whole lot more. Then he gets his coming-of-age ceremony an' goes off to th' Old Country to study f'r five years... when he comes back, he's like this. "It ain't his fault, or leastways not wholly. From what I've seen o' th' natives, it ain't easy bein' a warrior in a time o' relative peace no matter where ya are, an' that there's only th' beginnin' o' cus' problems." Problems, eh? "He was done given' an imperial appointment at th' end o' his five years. Gained rank an' title, which were meaningless. Given command of a freshly made regiment — th' western colonial garrison — but I can count th' number o' actual bushi in th' colonies on two hands. It's a downright sham, an' when ya think 'bout it... ya'd be bitter too, yeah?" [pc.isDK|Damn right you would, that kind of shit wouldn't have been anything other than a direct insult. You wouldn't have put up with it like he did.|You don't know about that. Sure, it might have been a slap in the face, but you'd have made the best of a poor situation and shown them what's what.] "So jus'... bear with him a lil' if'n ya can. He ain't th' easiest to get along with[pc.ra kitsune||,especialy since yer an' outsider an' all]. Do it as a favor to lil' ol' me, if'n nothin' else. Please." |"I think cus' is overcompensatin' f'r somethin' with that sword o' his," Miko says with a chuckle. "Aah, it's an ol' joke, but it never gets ol'. Still... it weren't that long ago that swords th' length o' his nodachi were outright forbidden by law in th' Old Country an' were mostly used f'r religious ceremonies an' all. It was only 'cause our clan's a priestly one that he could lay his hands on one of those were more than a decade ol', hah." So, it's a heirloom? "Ya could say that. Th' actual situation's jus' a lil' bit more complicated than words can do it justice... but it's not as if he done grabbed th' blade off an altar an' made off with it. There's been talk, an' I think I'll leave it at that." |"Mai an' I weren't born in th' colonies, but our cus Nakano was. Colonials... well, th' capital jus' thinks of us as far-flung provinces, really, an' that ain't too off th' mark. Provincials... well, they ain't really well regarded in th' capital, an' colonials even less so. Jus' a lil', though. Even then, that jus' makes our cus really intent on provin' himself... but there ain't really an enemy f'r him to fight. Not until recently, yeah." ...Recently, he says? "He's been wantin' to go out an' fight demons, put 'em to th' sword an' earn honor an' glory f'r th' clan. He's got it in his head that if'n he puts down enough evil, th' capital will accept an' honor him despite him bein' a colonial an' all... he's said he's gonna earn a commendation from th' emperor someday. I think he's jus' gonna get himself killed, an' he don't care none either. Which is frankly to be expected from one o' his station, but still..." |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 1 |"Cus is rightin' himself a lot better now that yer lil' darlin' an' him are an item. Used to be that Granny made several matches f'r him with some o' th' provincial lasses, but he kept on declinin', sayin' he needed to prove himself first or summat. Things weren't at a good end when lil' sis came on th' scene, heh. "Though that's all settled now. Maybe cus' Nakano jus' needed someone who wouldn't mind sittin' down f'r hours an' not jus' listen to his poetry, but write some o' her own, too. He ain't completely turned tail an' I wouldn't want him to, but leastways he's mellowed out some and ain't so much o' a loose cannon no more." |"Granny's bein' tryin' to get cus married off f'r some time now. Says that havin' a wife will settle him down some... each time she's tried playin' matchmaker, though, he's always gone an' said no. At this rate, it ain't gonna be long 'fore she jus' blows her top an' orders him to accept a match. Now that'll be a sight to see..." ] ]
rows.translation: “哈，你是想打听我表哥的事吧？嗯，我也能理解你为什么会这么问[pc.ra kitsune|即使你现在也是我们中的一员，对他来说，放下这些仍然是一件非常困难的事情……所以，作为他的表亲，我得请你多担待他一点，好吗？”|“对于像你这样的外人来说，他可不是个特别好相处的人。向他提出私人问题……对你这种人来说，本来就不该做。”] [rand |“表哥以前可不是这样的，你知道的。他曾经是只相当无忧无虑的小狐狸，笑得也多得多。后来他参加了成年礼，去旧国求学五年……等他回来，就变成现在这个样子了。” “这不是他的错，至少不能全怪他。据我对那些当地人的观察，在这样一个相对和平的年代，无论身处何地，当一名战士都不容易，而这还只是表哥麻烦的开始。” 问题啊，是吧？ “五年期满时，他获授了一项帝国任命。得到了官职和头衔，可这些都毫无意义。他被派去指挥一支新组建的团——西部殖民地守备队——但整片殖民地里真正的武士，我用两只手就数得过来。这完全是个骗局，你想想看……换了你也会心怀怨恨的，对吧？” [pc.isDK|你当然会这么做，那种话根本就是赤裸裸的侮辱。你肯定不会像他那样忍气吞声地忍受下去。|你并不了解内情。当然，那可能确实是一种侮辱，但你会尽力扭转这种糟糕的局面，让他们明白什么才是正确的做法。] “所以……如果可以的话，就稍微包容他一下吧。他确实不是最好相处的人，[pc.ra kitsune||尤其对你这个外人而言]。就算只是给我这个小家伙一个面子也好，拜托了。” |“我觉得表哥是用他那把剑在弥补什么吧，”米可轻笑着说道。“啊，这是个老笑话了，可它从来不会过时。不过……就在不久以前，像他那把野太刀这么长的刀，在旧国还是被法律明令禁止的，大多只用于宗教仪式之类的场合。正是因为我们家族是祭司世家，他才能弄到一把有十多年历史的这种刀，哈哈。” 所以，这是一件传家宝吗？ “也可以这么说吧。实际情况其实比语言所能描述的还要复杂一些……但也不至于说他是从祭坛上抓了那把刀就跑了。这事一直有些传言，不过我想我就说到这里吧。” |“我和舞不是在殖民地出生的，但我们的表哥中野是。殖民地人嘛……嗯，首都其实只把我们当成边远的行省，这说法倒也不算太离谱。行省人在首都本来就不怎么受待见，殖民地人就更不用说了——不过也就差那么一点。即便如此，这也让我们的表哥格外想证明自己……可他其实并没有什么敌人可打。直到最近才有了，是吧。” ……最近，你是说？ “他一直想出去和恶魔作战，把它们斩于剑下，为家族赢得荣誉与荣光。他脑子里认定，只要自己铲除足够多的邪恶，首都就会接纳并嘉奖他，哪怕他是个殖民地人……他还说过，总有一天要从皇帝那里挣到一份嘉奖。可我觉得他只会把自己害死，而他根本不在乎。老实说，以他的身份，这也在预料之中，但还是……” |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 1 |“自从你那位小宝贝和他好上以后，表哥现在振作多了。以前奶奶给他安排过好几次相亲，对象是一些行省的姑娘，可他总是推辞，说要先证明自己什么的。小妹刚出现那会儿，事情可不怎么顺，嘿。” “不过现在这一切都已经解决了。也许表哥中野只是需要一个愿意陪他坐上几个小时，不仅听他念诗、自己也能写上几首的人吧。他并没有彻底打消念头，我也不希望他那样，但至少他现在平和了一些，不再那么冲动了。” |“奶奶想给表哥成个家已经有些日子了。她说有了妻子，他就能安定下来……可每次她试着做媒，他都一口回绝。照这样下去，用不了多久，她就会大发雷霆，直接命令他接受一门亲事。那场面可有得看了……” ] ]

rows.original: [rand |"If'n ya'll see that good-f'r-nothin' slippin' our cus Nakano any drink, ya have my permission to smack him upside th' head. We're makin' cus have ta go through Kohaku to get his liquor so's we know how much he's been drinkin', an' I ain't havin' that wastrel lettin' him have a go-around. Ya hear me? Smack him upside th' head good an' tell him it's on my authority. Ain't got nothin' to be ashamed of in tryin' to cure his ways." |"Cold? Cold? Of course I'm cold. Bless th' bugger's heart, but ya don't leave th' den to flounder f'r months or years at a time an' expect everything to be all nice-like an' peachy keen when ya return. I'm supposed to be th' easygoin' one here, an' I've jus' about had it up to here with him." |"I guess he's good at what he does, but that's 'bout all th' credit I'm gonna give to that bugger. Wish he'd picked up makin' somethin' that don't cause so much trouble — like tofu, or miso, or amazake... nah, we gots to have liquor, an' with all sorts o' weird stuff in. Me, I'd rather ask Kohaku to get me some nice stuff from th' other side o' th' gate instead of dealin' with th' likes o' him..." |"Me? Drinkin'?" Miko laughs. "Wouldn't catch me doin' it, not when I've got far more... ah, delicious things to consider. Ain't one f'r drinkin' past th' odd ceremonial cup as part o' th' rites an' all, an' I'm careful to get th' clear, good stuff from the homeland. That drunken sop ain't got no power over me..." ]
rows.translation: [rand |要是你们看到那个没用的家伙给中野送酒，就尽管打他的头吧。我们让所有人都必须通过琥珀来获取酒类，这样我们就能知道他到底喝了多少酒。我可不会让那个浪费钱的家伙为所欲为。听明白了吗？狠狠地打他的头，然后告诉他这是我授权你们做的。试图让他改掉这个坏习惯，没什么可羞愧的。 |冷？冷？我当然觉得冷了。天啊，但当你离开洞穴好几个月甚至几年，回来时却指望一切都能恢复如初、变得美好无比，这未免太不现实了。本来应该是我这种性格比较随和的人来忍受这些的，但我真的受够了。 |我想他确实很擅长自己做的事情，但也就只能承认这一点吧。真希望他能做一些不会带来这么多麻烦的东西——比如豆腐、味噌，或者酒……不过，我们终究还是需要酒，而且还是那种含有各种奇怪成分的酒。对我来说，我宁愿让小花从门的另一边给我拿来一些好东西，也不想和他这种人打交道…… |我？喝酒？米可笑了。你绝对抓不到我干的，尤其是当我还有更多……啊，美味可口有些事情是需要考虑的。当然，作为仪式的一部分，喝下那些特殊的仪式用酒也是其中的一部分，而且我也会小心挑选来自故乡的优质酒液。那种劣质的酒根本无法对我产生任何影响…… ]

rows.original: [kohaku.anyKids |[rand |"Can ya believe it[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]? Lil' Kohaku's ass didn't flatten out even a lil' after she done popped that kit outta her belly! It ain't odd f'r hips to be widenin' while with child, but [miko.anyKids |even I slimmed down a bit after all that 'cause I had two hungry kits to be feedin'! |when yer feedin' a hungry kit yer pullin' from yer reserves, ya know? ] Ya think those tiny tits of hers ain't up to th' task of feedin' that lil' gremlin that she done popped out? 'Cause th' way I see it, she's hoardin' all the good stuff in her body an' ain't givin' any of it away!" For any other kitsune, that would be remarkably frank, but Miko's just being Miko. Is she sure she isn't just envious that Kohaku's maternal changes have stuck around in their entirety even after having birthed her kit? "Envious? Ehhhh... that kind o' proportions ain't f'r lil' ol' me, if'n ya know what I mean[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. Gals like me, we done like to be full both above an' below, maybe a bit more above. Kohaku done looks like she [silly |only ever done leg day at th' gym |tried a mimic a pear a lil' too hard, if'n ya get my meaning ]. I'll be passing on that, thank ya kindly." |"Lil' Kohaku came by th' shrine to make offerin's th' other day, an' she done brought her kit with her. Sure as I swear on my here office as shrine maiden, I predict that there kid's gonna be a handful once she gets older. Ya don't need to be able to see auras like sis and I to tell that that gremlin's gonna get up to no end of mischief, but if'n ya could then there ain't no question 'bout it. Ain't often that lil ol' me's wrong about th' future, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]an' I'm willing to stake my reputation on it." Oh, she doesn't need to convince you in the least. One look at Kohaku's daughter and you know that the girl is destined for great mischief. Miko's eyes glint. "Oughta keep an eye out on that one an' all. Wouldn't want her to be fallin' to bad influences while growin' up — 's my duty as a servant of his divine lordship to be guidin' the youth in th' right direction.[pc.ra kitsune | Ya should know, yer Eminence |Eheheh ]." |"Lil' Kohaku done brought her kit in th' other day to be blessed, an' I noticed that she din't take her eyes off th' lil' gremlin f'r one moment. Now, that ain't usually wrong or nothin', but she were so intense that lil' ol' me thinks she might just be takin' it a step too far[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence | an' all ]." Does she want you to talk to Kohaku about it? It's a bit of a touchy subject, after all — you have the lingering suspicion that her behavior is at least partly inspired by the experiences of her youth. "Maybe. I dunno[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. Mindin' yer kits is expected of everyone, sure, but on th' other hand ya done gotta need to give them th' space to breathe instead of bein' in sight at all times. It's cute and mighta be okay when they're still jus' lil' things, but if'n ya keep that attitude when they done get older yer gonna choke the tykes. Jus' sayin'." Well then. As one of the spiritual and moral guides of this little fox colony, surely Miko is in a position to lecture Kohaku on child-raising at length, hmm? Miko [miko.anyKids |snorts at that. "[pc.ra kitsune |Forgive me f'r my directness, yer Eminence, but I s |S ]ure am, given lil' ol' me's got two an' she's only got one, so there's that |scratches her brow. "Sure am, even if'n they ain't my own ]. But if'n ya would be so [pc.ra kitsune |magnanimous |kind ] to pitch in as well, it couldn't hurt, ya know? Jus' a word here an' there to stop that there terrible feelin' of wakin' up and gettin' into a tizzy 'cause she dint instantly remember where her kit were." All right, all right... |"Ahaha. If Kohaku were pleasin' to th' eye before, she's even more so now." Is that because she's gotten rounder? "Well, it ain't jus' that, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya know ]. If'n it were jus' 'bout bein' round then all y'all woulda be sayin' lil' ol' me's the cutest thing around, an' that ain't th' case. No, 's 'bout bein' round an' rosy-cheeked, an' totin' 'round a little golden gremlin to boot. All that on top of all th' things she had before... it's hard to keep my hands off her when she done come to pay respects to his divine lordship an' all. Don't ya agree[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]?" It's even harder to keep one's hands off her when bearing your kit has made poor Kohaku even more of a patslut. If those big old ears of hers were sensitive before, she's now succumbed into being a complete mess. Reacting well to affection only elicits more of said affection; you get what you incentivize, obviously. Miko chuckles. "Now yer talkin'[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. Ya know what I mean... her fur's gotten all rich an' shiny an' good to touch[miko.anyKids |, an' even though mine done got nicer and glossier while I were with child it ain't holdin' a candle to what she's got ]. It's th' least that lil' gremlin can do for her mom after a whole year of bein' carried around in her belly, ha." It's not odd for kitsune mothers to get a touch-up after having had children, is it? "It ain't, but how much done varies between folks," Miko replies thoughtfully. "Guess it's a small mercy an' th' least our kits can be doin' f'r us after bein' with us f'r a whole year, innit? Lil' Kohaku really done hit th' jackpot with jus' one, though. Now I'm startin' to worry that she mighta be tempted to have another even before this here gremlin's outta swaddling clothes... "In th' meantime, though, lil' ol' me's gonna be giving her pats, lots of pats. Keep her mind off gettin' into trouble. Ain't no reason ya shouldn't be doin' th' same[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]." ] |[kohaku.pregStage 1 |[rand |"Well, well. Looks like ya really went an' done a number on lil' Kohaku, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, |did ya? ]" Miko purrs. "[pc.ra kitsune |Forgive me f'r my directness, yer Eminence, but I s |S ]ure am, given lil' ol' me's got two an' she's only got one, so there's that |scratches her brow. If those big old ears of hers were sensitive before, she's now succumbed into being a complete mess. Reacting well to affection only elicits more of said affection; you get what you incentivize, obviously. Miko chuckles. "Now yer talkin'[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. "It ain't, but how much done varies between folks," Miko replies thoughtfully. "Guess it's a small mercy an' th' least our kits can be doin' f'r us after bein' with us f'r a whole year, innit? Lil' Kohaku really done hit th' jackpot with jus' one, though. Now I'm startin' to worry that she mighta be tempted to have another even before this here gremlin's outta swaddling clothes... "In th' meantime, though, lil' ol' me's gonna be giving her pats, lots of pats. Keep her mind off gettin' into trouble. "An' to think I once imagined she was an odd one f'r havin' such proportions an' all... now she's done gotten even worse! Sure, those tiny tits done swelled up a bunch an' they ain't so lil' no more... but her ass? That thing jus' expanded to the point it's ridiculous! "Even I ain't jealous of her, 'cause I prefer to be heavy both up top an' down below... poor lil' thing's jus' a ball of boob an' baby at this point. An' when she's done squeezin' that kit outta her belly, her old waist's just gonna make her ass look even bigger! Poor Kohaku, I hope she fattens up a lil' for her own sake, 'cause otherwise she's jus' gonna be all tail by the end of this!" |"Now, I'm kinda biased an' all, but I really do think lil' Kohaku done looks much better in these clothes than her old ones. Can you even imagine her tryin' to fit that massive butt into all that? I remember the lil' yellow skirt, that'd be on her waist if she were to try it! No, no, this is much better, an' I ain't sorry f'r sayin' it." |"Every time lil' Kohaku done walks by with that ass of hers, lil' ol' me can't help but sneak up behind her an' give it a right ol' slap," Miko says with a happy, trembling sigh. "Yer likely already doin' it yerself, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]but ain't no reason you shouldn't be slappin' it more. I wouldn't be wantin' an ass like it myself, but it ain't wrong to be appreciatin' it when it done show itself, either." Yes, Miko would definitely be the kind of girl to get up to that kind o' mischief. And she's never been found out? Her grin widens. "Ya see, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]lil' ol' me's had all her life to be gettin' used to carryin' weight around. Kohaku, on the other hand, clearly ain't used to havin' an ass this fat. By th' time she done wrangled her tails an' ass to turn 'round, I'm already long gone. Tried to grab me with her tails a couple o' times, but them things have gotten just as slow as her ass. "Trust me on this — hearin' that there slap, feelin' yer fingers sinkin' into that bouncy butt an' havin' them push back on ya is great, an' th' lil' golden slut moanin' like she done mean it when her weak spot's struck jus' makes it all better. Music to th' ears, an' don't let no one tell you otherwise." |As someone who grew up with Kohaku, does Miko think that she resents having her duties removed from her, even if temporarily? "Couldn't say for sure[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. Lil' ol' me may be able to see auras, but while that there may be a bit more insight, it's still a guess. If'n ya wanna know f'r sure, only way would be to ask Kohaku herself — but I know yer askin' me 'cause ya don't wanna do that." Just so. [pc.ra kitsune |Even if your station is higher than hers, you get that there's the whole %"I'll answer any question you ask of me so long as you don't ask the hard questions" unspoken agreement that goes on between foxen superior and subordinate, so meeting the problem head-on could be complicated. "Congratulations, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship — yer certainly settlin' into th' role that his divine lordship laid out f'r ya jus' fine |Even if the both of you are close enough for you to have put a kit in her tummy, it'd still be rather awkward given the current atmosphere. "Well, if'n ya ain't gettin' used to bein' 'round us ]. But to answer yer question, one of th' things she used to do as a kit was to copy Hotaru, Sis an' me 'cause she thought it'd get her to fit in, ya know? It weren't just mimicry — like when th' three o' us got together with Granny to do flower arrangement and painting, she'd be findin' her way in too 'cause she din't wanna be left out none. Dunno if'n she were actually interested in it, but she did it anyway 'cause it were what we were doin', so to speak..." You're beginning to see where this is going. Does she really think that Kohaku took on the role as an obligation? "It probably ain't all one or th' other, but I'm jus' sayin' how I see it[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. While it ain't wrong th' li' thing's wrapped up so much of how she sees herself as part o' her job, that ain't any better than jus' doin' things 'cause ya wanna fit in. If'n she done cared so much, she'd be throwin' a tantrum instead of gettin' pouty — it ain't done to be openly glad that yer gettin' off th' hook, that's all. Maybe with this shake-up an' a chance to live her life f'r others, but in a good way, th' poor lil' thing won't have to feel like she's gotta fit in all th' time." That's one way to look at it, you guess. "Ya done asked f'r my opinion, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]so I done gave it. A gal like me tends to be lookin' on th' bright side of things, ya know? Maybe this is a good time for Kohaku to be figurin' out who she is instead of who she thinks she oughta be, or who she thinks other folks want her to be. Move outta th' bad by lookin' at it from a new perspective an' all." ] |[rand |"Lil' Kohaku's a bit o' a strange one, lemme tell ya. She's tiny up top, yet even thicker than me down below. Makes her look kinda weird an' more than a lil' unbalanced, but she an' her bodyguards are th' only ones who travel 'round these here parts, so I guess havin' good legs helps. "Me, I think bein' evenly spread out an' all is better. Big up top an' down below." Miko gives you a sly grin. "O' course, I probably got some personal stake in sayin' that... so don't mind me words none." |"I remember Kohaku when she was jus' a kit. Her father was away prospectin' in th' mountains an' that kind o' place ain't f'r a child, so he left her in Granny's good hands. We grew up together... she had a bit o' wanderlust like her dad, but her head f'r numbers was better. Ain't a surprise she turned out th' way she did." |"Merchants... eh. Granny trusts her an' I grew up with her an' all, but if'n that weren't the case then I wouldn't be trustin' her, either. She ain't a bad person, but havin' to wear a mask an' lie to folks all day places shame on yer soul[pc.ra kitsune | even if'n they're natives ] an' it jus' ain't done. Storehouse work is fine an' all, but th' business of buyin' an' sellin', even if its' done f'r th' benefit o' th' den... as someone who done grew up at her side I do find myself wishin' she'd turn up here more often an' let Mai drive off any lingerin' evil influences hangin' 'round her. Merchants in th' Ol' Country done got a bad rep f'r a reason, ya know, an' even if she says she ain't one, if it walks like a duck an' quacks like a duck..." |"Folk 'round these parts don't really like lil' Kohaku that much. Sure, she's gotta look like th' locals to do business with them an' all, but there've always been those who think that she's gone jus' a lil' bit too native. Still, ain't no one sayin' she don't do valuable work or pull her weight 'round here, so eh. I jus' wish she din't need to wear those native clothes even at home. Jus' ain't done. At least she changes into somethin' more fittin' for th' proper occasions..." ] ] ] "

rows.original: Miko winks at you conspiratorially and rubs her hands together. "Ya lookin' to hear all 'bout yer darlin' girl? Hmm, a good girl like lil' ol me really shouldn't be snitchin', but on th' other hand, it woulda be fun to see what comes of it an' all... okay, I'll tell ya. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |[rand |"I'm not really a gal f'r workin' in th' fields myself, but yer lil' darlin' seems to really like it. She ain't jus' satisfied with tillin' her own fields, but comes all th' way here to help till ours as well... cus' really don't mind 'cause she does make herself useful, but ya know what happens when a young gal like yer darlin' daughter likes a guy?" No, do tell. "Well, she finds excuses to be around him. Don't matter how silly or spurious — my silly cus Hitoshi could be shovellin' fertiliser an' she'd join him without complainin'. Ya get what I mean?" |"Didja know yer darlin' daughter has taken to picklin'?" Pickling? "That's what I jus' said, picklin'. Putting fruits an' veggies in all kinds o' stuff so it keeps an' don't spoil none. Not a big fan myself — I prefer my meals fresh if'n I can help it. But yer lil' darlin' — she really loves it, looks like. Packs up a whole bunch o' jars an' vinegar an' head on into th' shed with my cus; sometimes they spend hours in th' place an' it's only when someone comes in to yell at them that they break up an' get out." Hours... pickling, in a storage shed. Miko smiles and points down the path, towards the fields. "Ya can see it from here — it's that small, dark one at th' foot o' the hill. They go in. F'r hours. An' don't come out. Jus' sittin' together in the dim light, cleanin' and preparin' vegetables. Over an' over again. Then she comes back th' next day to do it some more. "Ah think lil' sis really likes picklin' as much as my cus. Whaddya think?" |"If ya were hopin' to hear juicy gossip of yer darlin's mischief, I'm afraid ya ain't gettin' none from me. Not 'cause I ain't gonna snitch on her to her parents, but she really is a good girl an' all. Lil' sis comes in sometime past noon after she's done with her own work back at home, with a big lunch box f'r my cus Hitoshi. She puts in work on our fields here, washes up at th' bathhouse, then goes 'home. Happens like dawn an' dusk every day; th' girl works so hard that she ain't got no time to get up to any mischief." Well. On one hand, it's nice that Kinu's walking the straight and narrow with ease. On the other hand, this sounds just about too good to be true. Given how Kinu was when she was a child, while it's not hard to believe that she's grown into a responsible young woman, believing that she's eschewing even the slightest bit of mischief is stretching it just a bit too thinly. Miko shrugs. "Maybe she's gettin' up to things with my cus, but if'n she is, I ain't seen it. I've only got these two eyes o' mine up here, an' that's all; I'm supposed to be good at sussin' out kami, an' not mischievous foxes." |"Yer darlin's pre-tty darn great at playin' th' shakuhachi. So good, in fact, that we done asked her if'n she'd be willin' to help in th' a bunch of th' next ceremonies, provide a bit o' extra musical accompaniment. Ain't really orthodox f'r some o' them, but then a lot of what we do here in th' colonies ain't what ya'd call orthodox in th' homeland." Is she allowed to do that, though? You were under the impression that participation in the rituals required much training and practice. Miko laughs, a hearty motion that sets her entire voluptuous body trembling. "Yer darlin' daughter has white fur! She's descended from divinity itself! So's long as she don't make no fool of hersself an' plays well — which she does — she's more than qualified." You're not sure exactly how these things work in the labyrinthine system of kitsune religious systems, but if Miko says it's fine then it ought to be, right? "Folks are already takin' a shine to seein' her around these parts an' playing her shakuhachi. Her music, it's got soul to it, I'm tellin' ya. I'm already talkin' to Granny 'bout possibly gettin' her more involved in more things 'round th' shrine. Would certainly help take a load off Mai an' I." Ah... ] |[rand |"Yer lil' gal's a fine connoisseur o' th' arts, ain't she?" You do know from talks with her mother that she's been educated to have some grounding in appreciation for such, yes. Is there a reason? "It's 'cause she's been spendin' more an' more time with my cus Nakano. Like, first thing when she's done helpin' out granny is to head straight for his place an' ask to see his poetry an' paintings. I thought th' two o' them were up to no good, but every time I peek they're jus' talkin' 'bout th' latest prose an' styles comin' outta th' old country. Ain't nothin' naughty goin' on between them... kinda a letdown, to be honest. Jus' talkin' 'bout art f'r hours on end." That's a relief, and a joy — it's important for Kinu to get to know people outside of her immediate family, given how sheltered her upbringing was. "Yer lil' girl's a good influence on my cus, that's all I'm gonna say," Miko continues. "He looks more determined these days, an' ain't drinking that much no more. Now, yer her parent an' all... but I really think they get along well despite what Granny says." |"Lil' sis is a right beauty, an' that's high praise comin' from me," Miko says with a chuckle. "Of course, she ain't as glamorous as lil' ol' me or Mai f'r that matter, but we've spent plenty o' time learnin' how to present ourselves in th' most flatterin' way. F'r her natural charms to carry her this far — well, she coulda be so much more if'n she tried. But now, though... seein' her come outta th' torii gate an' strollin' down th' path... I've seen more'n one woman smackin' her consort f'r starin' too long." Well, she does take after her mother. That Kinu would be a head-turner isn't any surprise. "Eheheh. Good thing she an' my cus are an item an' everyone knows it even if they ain't sayin' it out loud. Else yer lil' darlin' would be swamped with all kinds o' love letters an' th' like. Jus' sayin'." |"Mmm... sometimes lil' sis will drag out Granny's ol' koto from out back an' play somethin' or th' other in th' main square, just before evenin'. It's a treat f'r everyone, an' she's doin' it f'r free, too. Not quite th' sort o' thing I'd want durin' a ceremony, but the tunes she's able to pluck from those strings are downright movin'. She always draws a bit o' a crowd whenever she decides to do that these days." It's not surprising that Kinu is so proficient — her mother was instrumental in providing an excellent education. "She jus' sets up a lil' stand by th' benches an' goes at it. Ain't exactly th' settin' you'd expect to find a koto in, but she makes it work. Sittin' in th' shade o' th' leaves, lettin' the music pour from her fingers... I hearsay lil' sis is good enough that granny don't mind th' minor breach of etiquette an' all." |"If'n ya don't mind,[pc.ra kitsune| m'[pc.mf|lord|lady],] I've been teachin' lil' sis all about gussyin' up proper-like. She's got plenty o' natural charms an' knows enough not to be walkin' around with frizzled hair an' mussed fur, lookin' like she justo done got outta bed. Still, if'n ya don't take care of yer looks right, they'll be fadin' long before yer fifty or even forty. Shame to waste such looks if'n ya don't take care of yerself..." You're just glad she's looking out for Kinu when you're out, and appealing to her interests to boot. "Tch, thank ya kindly. She's got th' best teachin' her — me. Don'tcha worry one bit — I'll be here to set her on th' right path." ] ]
rows.translation: 米可向你眨了眨眼，露出一副心照不宣的表情，然后搓了搓手。你是想听关于你心爱的女孩的那些事吧？嗯，像我这么乖的女孩其实不应该打小报告的，但另一方面，看看最终会发生什么也会挺有意思的……好吧，我就告诉你吧。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |[rand |我自己其实并不是个喜欢在田里干活的人，但你家的小姑娘似乎真的很喜欢干这个。她不仅满足于自己耕种自己的田地，还专门跑过来帮忙我们耕种……说实话，我并不介意，因为她确实帮上了忙。但是，你知道当像你家女儿这样的年轻姑娘喜欢上一个男孩时，会发生什么吗？ 不，一定要告诉我。 嗯，她总是找各种借口去和他在一起。那些借口再愚蠢或多么牵强附会都没关系——只要是为了和Hitoshi在一起，就算让我去铲肥料，她也会毫无怨言地陪着我。你明白我的意思吧？ |你知不知道你亲爱的女儿最近开始学做腌制品了？ 腌制吗？ 我刚才就是这么说的，小家伙。把水果和蔬菜加到各种食物里，这样食物就能保存得更久，也不会变质。我自己其实不太喜欢这个做法——如果可以的话，我还是更喜欢新鲜的食物。不过你这个小宝贝，看起来真的很喜欢这个方法。她会准备很多罐头、醋之类的东西，然后和我一起把它们放到棚子里；有时候，她们会在那里小时就在那里，直到有人进来对他们大喊大叫，他们才会散开并离开。 数小时……在储藏棚里进行腌制。 米可微笑着，指着小路的方向，朝着田野走去。从这里就能看到——就是那座小山脚下那个又小又黑的房子。他们走进去，一待就是几个小时，然后却一直没有出来。他们只是坐在昏暗的光线下，一遍又一遍地清洗和准备蔬菜。第二天，她又会回来继续做这些事情。 啊，想小妹妹了真的他和我一样喜欢腌制食物。你怎么看？ |如果你指望从我这里听到关于你宝贝女儿的趣闻轶事，那恐怕你要失望了。并不是因为我不想向她父母告发她，而是她确实是个好孩子。下午一点多，等她在家忙完自己的事情后，就会带着一个装满食物的午餐盒来看我，也是为了我的儿子Hitoshi。她在这里的田地里干活，然后在澡堂里帮忙洗漱，之后就回家了。每天都是这样，从早到晚都在忙碌地工作，根本没时间去做什么坏事。 嗯，一方面，小娟能够如此顺利地走上正道，确实是一件好事。但另一方面，这种说法听起来好得有些不真实。考虑到小娟小时候的样子，虽然相信她已经成长为一个负责任的年轻女性并不难，但认为她完全不再犯任何小错，那就有点夸张了。一点太单薄了。 米可耸了耸肩。也许她在我兄弟们面前耍什么花招，但就算真是这样，我也没看出来。我就只有这一双眼睛，也只能靠这个来判断神明而不是那些调皮的狐狸。 |你家宝贝玩这个游戏的技术简直高得离谱啊尺八事实上，我们觉得她太出色了，所以才邀请她参加接下来的几场仪式，为她提供一些额外的音乐伴奏。虽然对于某些仪式来说，这种做法并不算传统，但在这里的殖民地，我们做的很多事情本来就不符合家乡的传统习俗罢了。 不过，她真的被允许这样做吗？你原本以为参加这些仪式需要经过大量的训练和练习才行啊。 rows.raw: " Miko winks at you conspiratorially and rubs her hands together. "Ya lookin' to hear all 'bout yer darlin' girl? Hmm, a good girl like lil' ol me really shouldn't be snitchin', but on th' other hand, it woulda be fun to see what comes of it an' all... okay, I'll tell ya. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |[rand |"I'm not really a gal f'r workin' in th' fields myself, but yer lil' darlin' seems to really like it. She ain't jus' satisfied with tillin' her own fields, but comes all th' way here to help till ours as well... cus' really don't mind 'cause she does make herself useful, but ya know what happens when a young gal like yer darlin' daughter likes a guy?" No, do tell. "Well, she finds excuses to be around him. Don't matter how silly or spurious — my silly cus Hitoshi could be shovellin' fertiliser an' she'd join him without complainin'. Ya get what I mean?" |"Didja know yer darlin' daughter has taken to picklin'?" Pickling? "That's what I jus' said, picklin'. Putting fruits an' veggies in all kinds o' stuff so it keeps an' don't spoil none. Not a big fan myself — I prefer my meals fresh if'n I can help it. But yer lil' darlin' — she really loves it, looks like. Packs up a whole bunch o' jars an' vinegar an' head on into th' shed with my cus; sometimes they spend hours in th' place an' it's only when someone comes in to yell at them that they break up an' get out." Hours... pickling, in a storage shed. Miko smiles and points down the path, towards the fields. "Ya can see it from here — it's that small, dark one at th' foot o' the hill. They go in. F'r hours. An' don't come out. Jus' sittin' together in the dim light, cleanin' and preparin' vegetables. Over an' over again. Then she comes back th' next day to do it some more. "Ah think lil' sis really likes picklin' as much as my cus. Whaddya think?" |"If ya were hopin' to hear juicy gossip of yer darlin's mischief, I'm afraid ya ain't gettin' none from me. Not 'cause I ain't gonna snitch on her to her parents, but she really is a good girl an' all. Lil' sis comes in sometime past noon after she's done with her own work back at home, with a big lunch box f'r my cus Hitoshi. She puts in work on our fields here, washes up at th' bathhouse, then goes 'home. Happens like dawn an' dusk every day; th' girl works so hard that she ain't got no time to get up to any mischief." Well. On one hand, it's nice that Kinu's walking the straight and narrow with ease. On the other hand, this sounds just about too good to be true. Given how Kinu was when she was a child, while it's not hard to believe that she's grown into a responsible young woman, believing that she's eschewing even the slightest bit of mischief is stretching it just a bit too thinly. Miko shrugs. "Maybe she's gettin' up to things with my cus, but if'n she is, I ain't seen it. I've only got these two eyes o' mine up here, an' that's all; I'm supposed to be good at sussin' out kami, an' not mischievous foxes." |"Yer darlin's pre-tty darn great at playin' th' shakuhachi. So good, in fact, that we done asked her if'n she'd be willin' to help in th' a bunch of th' next ceremonies, provide a bit o' extra musical accompaniment. Ain't really orthodox f'r some o' them, but then a lot of what we do here in th' colonies ain't what ya'd call orthodox in th' homeland." Is she allowed to do that, though? You were under the impression that participation in the rituals required much training and practice. Miko laughs, a hearty motion that sets her entire voluptuous body trembling. "Yer darlin' daughter has white fur! She's descended from divinity itself! So's long as she don't make no fool of hersself an' plays well — which she does — she's more than qualified." You're not sure exactly how these things work in the labyrinthine system of kitsune religious systems, but if Miko says it's fine then it ought to be, right? "Folks are already takin' a shine to seein' her around these parts an' playing her shakuhachi. Her music, it's got soul to it, I'm tellin' ya. I'm already talkin' to Granny 'bout possibly gettin' her more involved in more things 'round th' shrine. Would certainly help take a load off Mai an' I." Ah... ] |[rand |"Yer lil' gal's a fine connoisseur o' th' arts, ain't she?" You do know from talks with her mother that she's been educated to have some grounding in appreciation for such, yes. Is there a reason? "It's 'cause she's been spendin' more an' more time with my cus Nakano. Like, first thing when she's done helpin' out granny is to head straight for his place an' ask to see his poetry an' paintings. I thought th' two o' them were up to no good, but every time I peek they're jus' talkin' 'bout th' latest prose an' styles comin' outta th' old country. Ain't nothin' naughty goin' on between them... kinda a letdown, to be honest. Jus' talkin' 'bout art f'r hours on end." That's a relief, and a joy — it's important for Kinu to get to know people outside of her immediate family, given how sheltered her upbringing was. "Yer lil' girl's a good influence on my cus, that's all I'm gonna say," Miko continues. "He looks more determined these days, an' ain't drinking that much no more. Now, yer her parent an' all... but I really think they get along well despite what Granny says." |"Lil' sis is a right beauty, an' that's high praise comin' from me," Miko says with a chuckle. "Of course, she ain't as glamorous as lil' ol' me or Mai f'r that matter, but we've spent plenty o' time learnin' how to present ourselves in th' most flatterin' way. F'r her natural charms to carry her this far — well, she coulda be so much more if'n she tried. But now, though... seein' her come outta th' torii gate an' strollin' down th' path... I've seen more'n one woman smackin' her consort f'r starin' too long." Well, she does take after her mother. That Kinu would be a head-turner isn't any surprise. "Eheheh. Good thing she an' my cus are an item an' everyone knows it even if they ain't sayin' it out loud. Else yer lil' darlin' would be swamped with all kinds o' love letters an' th' like. Jus' sayin'." |"Mmm... sometimes lil' sis will drag out Granny's ol' koto from out back an' play somethin' or th' other in th' main square, just before evenin'. It's a treat f'r everyone, an' she's doin' it f'r free, too. Not quite th' sort o' thing I'd want durin' a ceremony, but the tunes she's able to pluck from those strings are downright movin'. She always draws a bit o' a crowd whenever she decides to do that these days." It's not surprising that Kinu is so proficient — her mother was instrumental in providing an excellent education. "She jus' sets up a lil' stand by th' benches an' goes at it. Ain't exactly th' settin' you'd expect to find a koto in, but she makes it work. Sittin' in th' shade o' th' leaves, lettin' the music pour from her fingers... I hearsay lil' sis is good enough that granny don't mind th' minor breach of etiquette an' all." |"If'n ya don't mind,[pc.ra kitsune| m'[pc.mf|lord|lady],] I've been teachin' lil' sis all about gussyin' up proper-like. She's got plenty o' natural charms an' knows enough not to be walkin' around with frizzled hair an' mussed fur, lookin' like she justo done got outta bed. Still, if'n ya don't take care of yer looks right, they'll be fadin' long before yer fifty or even forty. Shame to waste such looks if'n ya don't take care of yerself..." You're just glad she's looking out for Kinu when you're out, and appealing to her interests to boot. "Tch, thank ya kindly. She's got th' best teachin' her — me. Don'tcha worry one bit — I'll be here to set her on th' right path." ] ]"
