rows.original: [rand |"Ya know that constipated look my cus Nakano always has on his face? Time were he didn't always look like he's got somethin' stuck up his ass — he was a blockhead when he was a kit, an' he's still a blockhead, jus' a different kind o' blockhead. Now, it ain't wrong to say that if'n ya wear th' face f'r th' job, ya'll feel it, but he's jus' tryin' too hard on all fronts an' it ain't jus' useless, it's actually havin' negative results an' all. Methinks if'n he weren't so hard-assed all th' time, it'd be better f'r him — that kinda constant ambition ain't good f'r anyone's spiritual health an' all. Creates too much o' a fixation on worldly affairs an' th' like." You can't see auras like Mai can, but Nakano's demeanour is as easy to read as an open book. The young man is perhaps a little too driven. "Jus' take a look at his poetry. Would be much better if'n he din't try an' force it, an' instead emptied his mind an' let it come naturally like he does his paintin's. O' course, cus is burnin' up inside an' won't listen to me none. Maybe I done teased him a lil' too hard when we was kits... oh well." |"Ya seen that there sword that cus' loves like it were his wife? 'S a family heirloom — wasn't so long ago that blades past a certain length done got forbidden in th' Old Country. Still are, in some places. Most those that done survived were in th' hands o' th' Twelve Divine Clans... either that, or used in worship." Mai chuckles. "That thing... it used to sit in th' shrine my father an' mother used to tend, believe it or not. That's how it done got preserved so well an' so long." Hmm. If it was an object used in ritual worship, he must've done something quite impressive to be granted use of it. From everything you know of the kitsune, you'd imagine such a boon wouldn't come lightly. "To hear it bein' told, it's an entire story all on its own. Cus owes us big time, 'cause without us backin' him up, he wouldn't ever have gotten his hands on it. But I think that there was th' first time I saw that drive in him — that fire an' th' willingness to do what it took to achieve his goals, an' how horrible it could turn if'n it weren't guided none. I'd... I'd like to think Miko an' I did our job jus' fine. Things coulda turned out much worse with a young man like him." |"To be honest, I think one o' th' reasons Granny allowed someone like ya to visit in th' first place was 'cause she done wanted our cus Nakano to simmer down a lil' when around outsiders. [pc.ra kitsune |I don't rightly think she imagined ya'd be made an offer by his divine lordship, yer Eminence, but things done turned out jus' fine f'r everyone. Seein' him burnin' up inside when he has to offer ya th' proper respect an' all, especially how seriously he takes that kinda thing — I know it ain't right o' me to find it funny an' all, but 's jus' so amusin', beggin' m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]'s pardon. |Seein' him have to put up with th' likes o' you waltzin' around is ticklin' my funny bone somethin' powerful. It's takin' all I got to not snigger when I see him with smoke pourin' outta his ears. Still got a lot to learn 'bout patience, that my cus does. ] A lesson in dealin' with problems through... ah, other means instead o' th' straight an' narrow, if'n yer understandin' my meanin'. Should come to him naturally as a fox, if'n he jus' could relax a moment an' all." You think you do. On the other hand, it might just drive him further up the wall. "Could be, but ain't no one gonna know how strong an edge is until it done get used. Sure, he done got appointed to such a position at such a young age, but it don't take a genius to figure out it's all a sham. Given a command with a fightin' force ya can count on two hands, an' he's supposed to cover th' entirety o' th' western colonies... he's been set up to fail, an' horribly too. Th' way I reckon those folks in th' capital see it, if'n he succeeds, all the better f'r them, an' if'n he fails, that there's one more provincial — no, colonial — upstart dealt with. rows.translation: [rand |你知道中野那副总是愁眉苦脸的样子吧？其实他以前也不是总是摆出一副闷闷不乐的样子的——在组队玩的时候他就是个笨蛋，现在依然是个笨蛋，只不过是变成了另一种类型的笨蛋罢了。现在，可以说，如果为了工作而强装出一副特定的样子，你确实会感受到其中的压力，但他现在在各个方面都做得太过分了。这种做法不仅毫无效果，反而还会产生负面的影响。我认为，如果他不要总是这么固执己见，对他的处境反而会有好处——这种持续的野心对任何人的心理健康都是有害的。这会让人过于专注于世俗事务之类的东西。 你无法像梅那样看到气场，但中野的态度却像一本敞开的书一样一目了然。这个年轻人或许有点太充满干劲的。 你看看他的诗吧。如果他不要强行表现，而是放空自己的心灵，让灵感自然而然地流淌出来，就像他作画一样，效果肯定会好很多。可惜他内心充满了压抑，根本不听我的建议。也许在我们一起写诗的时候，我确实有点逼他太紧了……唉，算了。 |你见过那把剑吗？它的主人对它爱护有加，就像对待自己的妻子一样。那可是家族传家宝啊——就在不久前，在那个古老的国家，长度超过一定标准的剑还被明令禁止使用。现在在一些地方，这种禁令依然有效。那些幸存下来的剑，要么掌握在十二个神圣氏族的手中，要么被用来进行祭祀活动。梅轻声笑了起来。那个东西……事实上，它曾经放在我父母曾经照料过的神龛里。信不信由你，正是因为这样，它才能保存得如此完好，而且保存了这么久。 嗯。如果这是一个用于仪式崇拜的物品，那么他肯定做了些什么非常了不起的事情，才能获得使用它的资格。根据你对狐妖的了解，你应该知道，这样的恩赐绝非轻易就能得到的。 听别人讲起来，这本身就是一个完整的故事。因为Cus欠我们很多人情债，如果没有我们的支持，他根本不可能得到那个机会。但我记得，那是我第一次看到他身上那种决心——那种为了实现目标而不惜付出任何代价的勇气，同时也意识到，如果这种力量没有得到正确的引导，后果会多么可怕。我……我愿意相信，我和米可做得已经很好了。对于一个像他这样的年轻人来说，事情本可能发展得更加糟糕。 |说实话，我觉得奶奶当初允许像你这样的人来拜访，原因之一就是她希望我们在外人面前能让中野冷静一点。 [pc.ra kitsune |我其实不认为她会想到他的尊贵大人会向您提出这样的请求，但事实证明，对大家来说，这一切都进展得很顺利。看到他不得不以应有的尊重来对待您时，内心是多么的不情愿啊，尤其是他对待这种事情是如此认真……我知道，我把这当成一件有趣的事情来笑，并不合适，但事实就是如此。很有趣，从现在开始[pc.mf|领主|女士]请原谅。 |看到他不得不忍受你这样的家伙到处招摇过市，真的让我觉得非常好笑。每次看到他气得耳朵里都“冒烟”，我真的差点笑出声来。看来，在耐心这方面，我确实还有很多要学习的……我的这位朋友就是最好的例子。 ]这就是一种通过……嗯，一些非直接的方式来解决问题的方法，如果你明白我的意思的话。如果他能放松一会儿的话，这件事应该会像对狐妖一样自然而然地解决掉。 你以为自己知道。但另一方面，这样做反而可能会让他更加恼火。 有可能吧，但直到真正被使用之前，没人能知道这种优势到底有多强。至于我，我更愿意相信我的优势是由比那更强大的东西构成的。 |我知道，考虑到我的家人肯定对你态度不好，我这个请求可能有点过分了，但我真心希望你能对他多一些宽容。当然，他这么年轻就被任命到了那个职位上，但谁都能看出来，这一切其实都是表面现象而已。给他的部队数量少得可怜，根本不足以应对任何挑战，而他却要负责保卫整个西部殖民地……很明显，他的任务注定会失败，而且失败得一塌糊涂。在首都的那些人看来，如果他成功了，对他们来说反而是件好事；而如果他失败了，那就又多了一个需要处理的省级地区……不，应该说是又多了一个麻烦。殖民地的一个自命不凡的小子，根本不值得理会。而那些穷人呢，也根本不会心生怨恨，因为他们是真心相信那些荣誉与荣耀的……这种处境，实在糟糕。 [pc.isDK|没关系。|你可以理解中野的困境，或者至少，尝试去理解它，但是……]但这并不能成为他对待所有人，尤其是你，时好时坏、脾气暴躁的借口。 我……我不是要求你视而不见。我只是请求你手下留情。在这种时候，无论一个人怎么做，都难免会感到羞耻，他的心灵也会受到玷污。但是，在两种坏事中选择较轻的一种，这确实符合我的性格。凯罗斯的那些家伙啊，我只是……我只是一直在鼓励他来这里，让我们共同向神圣的神明和祖先的灵魂祈祷，希望能得到一些启示，从而知道该如何应对这种局面。这是目前为数不多的确实有效的方法之一，我绝对不会让他再因为酗酒而让家族的名声蒙羞。" ]
rows.raw: " [rand |"Ya know that constipated look my cus Nakano always has on his face? Time were he didn't always look like he's got somethin' stuck up his ass — he was a blockhead when he was a kit, an' he's still a blockhead, jus' a different kind o' blockhead. Now, it ain't wrong to say that if'n ya wear th' face f'r th' job, ya'll feel it, but he's jus' tryin' too hard on all fronts an' it ain't jus' useless, it's actually havin' negative results an' all. Methinks if'n he weren't so hard-assed all th' time, it'd be better f'r him — that kinda constant ambition ain't good f'r anyone's spiritual health an' all. Creates too much o' a fixation on worldly affairs an' th' like." You can't see auras like Mai can, but Nakano's demeanour is as easy to read as an open book. The young man is perhaps a little too driven. "Jus' take a look at his poetry. Would be much better if'n he din't try an' force it, an' instead emptied his mind an' let it come naturally like he does his paintin's. O' course, cus is burnin' up inside an' won't listen to me none. Maybe I done teased him a lil' too hard when we was kits... oh well." |"Ya seen that there sword that cus' loves like it were his wife? 'S a family heirloom — wasn't so long ago that blades past a certain length done got forbidden in th' Old Country. Still are, in some places. Most those that done survived were in th' hands o' th' Twelve Divine Clans... either that, or used in worship." Mai chuckles. "That thing... it used to sit in th' shrine my father an' mother used to tend, believe it or not. That's how it done got preserved so well an' so long." Hmm. If it was an object used in ritual worship, he must've done something quite impressive to be granted use of it. From everything you know of the kitsune, you'd imagine such a boon wouldn't come lightly. "To hear it bein' told, it's an entire story all on its own. Cus owes us big time, 'cause without us backin' him up, he wouldn't ever have gotten his hands on it. But I think that there was th' first time I saw that drive in him — that fire an' th' willingness to do what it took to achieve his goals, an' how horrible it could turn if'n it weren't guided none. I'd... I'd like to think Miko an' I did our job jus' fine. Things coulda turned out much worse with a young man like him." |"To be honest, I think one o' th' reasons Granny allowed someone like ya to visit in th' first place was 'cause she done wanted our cus Nakano to simmer down a lil' when around outsiders. [pc.ra kitsune |I don't rightly think she imagined ya'd be made an offer by his divine lordship, yer Eminence, but things done turned out jus' fine f'r everyone. Seein' him burnin' up inside when he has to offer ya th' proper respect an' all, especially how seriously he takes that kinda thing — I know it ain't right o' me to find it funny an' all, but 's jus' so amusin', beggin' m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]'s pardon. |Seein' him have to put up with th' likes o' you waltzin' around is ticklin' my funny bone somethin' powerful. It's takin' all I got to not snigger when I see him with smoke pourin' outta his ears. Still got a lot to learn 'bout patience, that my cus does. ] A lesson in dealin' with problems through... ah, other means instead o' th' straight an' narrow, if'n yer understandin' my meanin'. Should come to him naturally as a fox, if'n he jus' could relax a moment an' all." You think you do. On the other hand, it might just drive him further up the wall. "Could be, but ain't no one gonna know how strong an edge is until it done get used. Me, I'd like to think my cus is made o' stronger stuff than that." |"I know I'm askin' a lot given how my cus must be treatin' ya, but I'm hopin' ya can show him a lil' forbearance an' all. Sure, he done got appointed to such a position at such a young age, but it don't take a genius to figure out it's all a sham. Neither can poor cus bring himself to resent them none, 'cause he really believes in all th' honor an' glory with th' bottom o' his heart... 's a bad position to be in." [pc.isDK|It doesn't matter,|You can understand Nakano's dilemma, or at least, try to approach it, but] it doesn't excuse his ornery behavior towards everyone, let alone you. "I... I ain't askin' ya to turn a blind eye. I'm askin f'r leniency. 'S one o' those times when no matter what one does, ain't no way he ain't incurring shame an' stains upon his spirit no matter what he does, but acceptin' th' lesser o' two evils ain't in my cus' blood. Keros' tails, I jus'... I jus' been encouragin' him to turn up here an' pray to both our divine lord an' ancestral spirits f'r some kinda inspiration as to how to handle th' situation. It's one o' th' handful o' things that done helped so far, an' I ain't lettin' him incur more shame upon th' clan name by drinkin' to excess again." ]"

rows.original: [rand |"Well, that there's a good-f'r-nothin' fellow. Half th' time he's drunk, an' th' other half, he spends preparin' t' get drunk. Ain't nothin' in his life that don't revolve 'round gettin' the next drink — Granny woulda kicked him out a long time ago f'r being gone all th' time an' bein' a no-good with his head in th' clouds, but... far too many folks done like a social cuppa every now an' then an' buyin' it from th' homeland an' shippin' it here costs a lil' more than what most colonials are able to pay. He's one o' those annoyances that ya can't quite get rid of 'cause you kinda sorta need him, yet would rather put off in one corner an' try not to be a bad influence on everyone else. Each village done gots to have its idiot, I guess." |"See, it wouldn't be so bad if'n the idiot were lookin' f'r practical things. All kinds o' goods th' homeland could do with from th' colonies — high quality wood, rock salt, and o' course, metal. Taka coulda make a fortune if'n he done discovered a good claim o' coal or iron, which th' natives don't have no use f'r, yet he's dead set on findin' treasure. "Sure, there's still plenty o' ruins lyin' 'bout these parts an' not jus' elf ones, but they all done been picked clean o' anything worth havin' in th' last two centuries. Ain't nothin' left... he woulda have better luck searchin' through th' private collections o' what few native noblemen are left in these here parts, to be honest. Th' days o' treasure huntin' are over, an' th' days o' treasure makin' are here. Maybe someday our treasure will done get sought by those who come after us... now ain't there a thought." |Mai scowls. "Festivals done give me headaches, an' it ain't jus' 'cause o' th' crowds. Dealin' with that idiot in advance an' gettin' him to set aside enough for th' occasion makes me want to pack my pipe with th' good stuff an' just sit inside th' shrine f'r the whole day." Why? Does he get plastered on his own supply and fail to come up with enough for everyone? "Oh, were it as simple as that, lil' ol' me woulda been happy at leavin' it at that. Nah, there's always enough. Far more'n enough, to be quite honest. An' then everyone done gets roarin' drunk an' all, which gives me th' biggest o' headaches. 'S one o' th' few times durin' which I feel all tuckered out at night." Does... does she ever get inebriated herself? Mai pouts and folds her arms. "I ain't ever touched drink save f'r ceremonial purposes, an' don't intend to start anytime soon. I'll have my sake any time o' th' day over that, thank ya kindly." |"That braggart done says he can brew anythin', so I went an' called his bluff. Gave him a bunch o' cabbage leaves an' told him to go brew 'em up. An' he did. Th' madman actually done went an' brewed up them cabbages with a lil' sugar. I don't know how he got them things to ferment, but if'n he's so talented I jus' wish he'd go make tofu or amazake or natto or something that ain't drink. Anythin' but drink." How... how did the cabbage brew taste? "Yer askin' me? Damned if'n I know, I weren't getting close to th' damn thing, let alone puttin' it in my mouth. Smelled something foul an' strong, all fierce-like, as if'n it were rarin' to leap outta th' bottle and choke me dead. I jus' hope he weren't fool enough to try an' drink it... nah, he is fool enough to try it, jus' to see how it done tasted. Well, if'n he did, it ain't killed him an' he's none the worse, so..." ]
rows.translation: [rand |“哎，那家伙就是个废物。一半时间他都在喝醉，另一半时间则花在准备喝醉上。他这辈子没有一件事不是围着下一杯酒转的——他整天不着家、吊儿郎当、满脑子胡思乱想，奶奶早就该把他赶出去了，可是……太多人偶尔都想喝上一杯茶来应酬，而从家乡买来再运到这里，价钱比大多数殖民者能负担的要贵上一点。他就是那种你甩不掉又有点离不开的麻烦——你多少还是需要他，却又宁可把他撂在角落里，尽量别让他带坏其他人。我想，每个村子总得有个自己的傻瓜吧。” |“你看，要是那傻瓜肯找些实用的东西，情况也不会这么糟。家乡能从殖民地里得到各种各样的货物——上好的木材、岩盐，当然还有金属。要是贵弘能发现一处好的煤矿或铁矿，他本可以发大财，因为当地人根本用不上这些，可他却一门心思要寻宝。” “当然，这一带还散落着不少废墟，而且不只是精灵的。可在过去两个世纪里，凡是值钱的东西都被搜刮干净了。什么也没剩下……说实话，他还不如去翻翻这一带仅存的少数本地贵族的私人收藏。寻宝的时代结束了，造宝的时代已经来临。也许有一天，我们的宝藏也会被后来人追寻……这念头可真有意思，不是吗？” |舞皱起了眉头。“节日真让我头疼，而且不光是因为人多。提前跟那个笨蛋打交道，让他为节日留出足够的货，这简直让我想把烟斗装满好货，然后整天坐在神社里不出来。” 为什么？难道他把自己的存货都喝光了，结果拿不出足够的量给大家？ “哦，要是真有那么简单就好了，我也乐得就此打住。不是那样，货从来都够，说实话，还多得很。然后所有人都喝得酩酊大醉，这才是我最大的头疼来源。这也是为数不多会让我晚上累得筋疲力尽的时候。” 她……她自己也会喝得酩酊大醉吗？ 舞撅起嘴，双臂交叉抱在胸前。“除了仪式场合，我从来不碰酒，也不打算在短期内开始喝。比起那个，我一天到晚随时都宁愿喝自己的清酒，多谢你的好意。” |“那个吹牛的家伙说他什么都能酿，于是我就去激他。给了他一堆卷心菜叶子，让他拿去酿。他真去做了。那疯子居然真的加了点糖，把那些卷心菜酿了出来。我不知道他是怎么让那东西发酵的，但既然他这么有本事，我只希望他去做豆腐、甘酒或者纳豆之类不是酒的东西。什么都行，就是别再酿酒了。” 这……这白菜酿的味道怎么样？ “你问我？我哪知道啊，我压根没靠近那鬼东西，更别说把它放进嘴里了。闻起来又臭又冲，凶得很，好像随时要从瓶子里窜出来把我掐死似的。我只盼着他没蠢到去尝它……不，他就是蠢到会去尝，就为了看看那东西什么味道。嗯，要是他真喝了，也没要了他的命，人也没什么大碍，所以……” ]

rows.original: [kohaku.anyKids |[rand |"Miko done worries too much 'bout how Kohaku's raisin' her kit, keeps on sayin' that she's bein' overprotective an' all. [miko.anyKids |I don't know where she gets th' time to be botherin' with other folks' kits when she's done popped out two of her own, but I guess all that energy's gotta go somewhere |With how Sis has been handlin' work of late, though, she shoulda be seein' more to her own life than botherin' with others, even if'n all that energy's gotta be spent somewhere ]. Honestly, though... sis shoulda jus' mind her own business, 'cause it ain't odd f'r folks to get all antsy with their first kit an' all. Ya start to worry, ya start to fret... [pc.ra kitsune |when ya think about it, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]lil' ol' me's helped deliver enough kits to be seein' th' change in attitude from th' first to th' second an' then on an' on. Ya worry less when ya get used to it." [mai.anyKids |Is that why Mai's so relaxed when it comes to caring for her own daughter? "Oh, a gal like me jus' makes it look easy, that's all. Like... like th' kind of ne'er-do-well who could take a dozen dozen folks f'r everythin' they had an' not lose a wink of sleep over it. If'n there's anyone who can whip that kinda mischief in line, it would hafta be his divine lordship, innit?" Maybe. But there are no doubt enough of such types all over — [pc.bg slumrat |you've met, and might even have been one of those types before, knowingly or otherwise, ]so what makes Kohaku's kit that different? "Buggered if'n I know[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. But it's th' explanation which makes most sense to lil' ol' me, even if'n the others don't make much sense either." |"Ya know how Hotaru sometimes babysits f'r Kohaku when she done goes outta th' den on caravan[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]?" Sort of. What about it? "Well, when she ain't got nothin' to do, she takes the lil' gremlin down to th' shrine and Miko helps set up a seat by th' donation box. Folks come in, they gotta go by her, an' when that happens they can't help but give the lil' gremlin a pat on th' head. Kit's jus' too cute f'r her own good, I tell ya — by th' time Hotaru's gotta go home, th' gremlin's gotten over a hundred headpats. A hundred[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]." That's... "An' now Miko's goin' 'round tellin' folks that if'n they pat th' tiny golden fox on her head, it'll be good luck f'r a week. Ever since th' two of them started that there nonsense th' number of petitioners on Miko's shift done increased by half again. That just ain't right, if'n ya know what I mean." Because no one ever visits Mai in the evening? "No one ever visits lil' ol' me nohow, so it ain't a problem. It's jus'..." Mai takes a deep breath and exhales slowly. "It jus' ain't right, ya know? Makes everythin' feel like some kinda store or somethin'." Well, does patting Kohaku's kit actually bring people good luck? "Th' lil' gremlin's got floof the color of rich gold. If'n folks believe it, might as well be real." And does Keros himself care? "His divine lordship done think it's absolutely hilarious[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]." Well, if the deity himself doesn't mind and enjoys the show, there really isn't any reason to fret over it, is there? Besides, the more offerings that Miko and Hotaru's scheme bring in, the better the sisters will be eating. "That ain't th' —" Mai deflates. "Never mind, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence. I |i ]t weren't nothing nohow." ] |[kohaku.pregStage 1 |[rand |"[pc.ra kitsune |Wait till ya hear this, yer Eminence. ]I done saw lil' Kohaku on one o' th' benches when I were headin' in f'r my shift th' other evenin'. Poor thing were all tuckered out, jus' fallen asleep while sittin' an' holding that big ol' kit-filled belly o' hers. Lil' ol' me thinks she were heading up to th' shrine to properly petition his divine lordship an' make offerings, but wanted to be restin' her eye for a bit before she did. "Poor thing. She didn't use to do that before, but carryin' 'round a weight like that on her lil' body — by the time she's done, she'll be more kit than Kohaku.[pc.ra kitsune | Congratulations, yer Eminence — ya really done filled her to th' brim. ]" So, did Mai wake her up? "Naaah. She were so cute an' all, I didn't have th' heart to be disturbin' her. Told Miko to be gettin' a blanket from th' shrine storage and be coverin' her up, plus I done gave her a rub on th' tummy f'r good luck." Kohaku's good luck, or her good luck? And how did that get started, anyway? "My good luck, of course." Mai smirks. "[pc.ra kitsune |With all respect, yer Eminence, it ain't hard to figure out. ]She's a cute lil' thing with lots o' rich golden fur an' a big ol' life-filled tummy. Ya don't need to be able to be seein' auras like Miko an' I to be knowin' that someone like that there's overflowin' with luck to spare to th' point that all ya need to do to share in it is give her a rub." So, she and Miko were the ones who started it? They'd be able to tell for sure if pregnant Kohaku was a good-luck charm, or if the rumors are false, quash them with a word. "Ya done give me too much credit, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya really do ]. But if'n it weren't real, then I might not be sayin' nothin' nonetheless. Can ya really tell me that a line of folks waitin' to be pettin' a rich golden fox like lil' Kohaku is a bad thing[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]?" No... you suppose you can't. |"Lil' Kohaku came by th' shrine in th' middle of th' night, not so much to be petitonin' his divine lordship or makin' offerin's, but jus' to have me check over her tummy. Lil' thing was feelin' poorly an' couldn't sleep, felt like th' weight o' her body were crushin' her." Whoa. That bad? "It weren't, really, or leastways it weren't nothin' wrong with her body. Jus' a bunch o' nerves, but ya know how Kohaku can be when she done get worked up[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. I spoke with her some an' she done right calmed down, then had her sleep on th' stone table out back. Next mornin' she were right as rain, if'n a bit worried 'bout bein' an hour or two late to th' job. Really, she oughta be takin' better care of herself an' not worryin' 'bout such things." It's good to hear that all that turned out well, then. Carrying your child has definitely been stressful on her mind at times, even if her body's pretty fit. "Jus' an emotional fit of th' kind that happens, weren't nothin' more. Kohaku done wear a mask most of th' time, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya know ]. Ya don't notice it much 'cause she makes it look so natural, but when it done comes off, it comes off." |"Ya know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]lil' ol' me's been seein' expectin' mothers in th' den since I were thirteen, an' lil' Kohaku is kinda a rare case." Is that the case? Because if it's about her being bottom-heavy, she can't have been the only one, can she? "Oh, it ain't got nothin' to do with that[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]," Mai replies with a chuckle. "Even if it ain't wrong. What I'm gettin' at is how it all started, ya see." That... well... "Most kits that come into th' world are 'cause folks wanted them an' copulated with those ends in mind," Mai continues, making several gestures with her hands that are thankfully shrouded from broader view by the gloom of evening. "Then there're a few who come 'bout 'cause someone or th' other din't have enough presence o' mind to avoid an accident." [var0 |She'd be extremely well-acquainted with that, then. "This ain't no time to be teasin' a poor gal, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya ass ]. We're talkin' 'bout lil' Kohaku here, not me. |Yeeeah. Miko might've killed you — she definitely wasn't in any mental frame to avoid accidents then. "Usually, them accidents ain't as dramatic as th' one Sis had, but ya ain't wrong[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence | either ]." Mai sighs. "Thing is, unlike with sis, it weren't a shoo-in with lil' Kohaku. |Does that actually happen, with how a whole bunch of foxes go out to collect essence? "Well, in those cases folks are especially mindful not to get carried away an' all; it simply ain't done to kill a benefactor for any reason whatsoever. That way when these things done happen, it's usually amongst our own an' ain't f'r th' purpose of feedin', if'n ya understand me. Things carry over, so even someone like me only done seen it a couple times so far[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. ] "When all's said an' done, though... Kohaku weren't either of those. Ya were there, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]so ya know it weren't no accident — she damn well got herself this way on purpose. On th' other hand, it ain't right to say that it were all planned f'r to begin with, can ya?" Does everyone in the den — no, that's a silly question given that Kohaku's the biggest gossip around. Of course they know. So, she thinks it's one of those I-want-it-but-don't-want-it situations? "Jus' so. Or maybe she done knew it were a bad idea she were goin' to pay outta th' nose f'r, to use th' Jassiran sayin', but th' gremlin in her made her do it anyway." |As someone who grew up with Kohaku, does Mai think that she resents having her duties removed from her, even if temporarily? "Hard to tell, [pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence, ]even if'n I can see auras. Sure, I can tell if'n she's in a bad mood, but ya don't need a sixth sense to be able to figure that one out." It's all right — you just want her thoughts. It's okay if she's not sure about it. But since she's known Kohaku for far longer than you have, you'd like to hear her thoughts on the matter. And yes, you know that you're close enough to Kohaku to have knocked her up, but two people can be close to the same thing and yet see it from different perspectives. [var1 |"Well, I ain't exactly impartial, ya know? [pc.ra kitsune | |An' to be makin' things worse, who woulda thought it were the same person responsible f'r th' both of, us, too? ]One day yer jus' doing everythin' as normal an' th' next yer position which kinda defined much of what ya did is jus' up an' gone. "Now, th' difference between her an' me is that I weren't myself f'r missing my smokes, an' she knew what she were doin' with her full faculties an' all. If'n she's all pouty that Granny done forbade her from caravaning with a big belly — an' I'm not sayin' she is[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ] — then she done deserved every moment of it an' I ain't sorry in sayin' so." Hm. You were originally expecting sympathy in that regard, but the way Mai explains it makes sense. With Mai getting moodier by the moment, it looks like you aren't going to get a useful answer to your original question, though. |"Kinda? I dunno, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]on one hand she does get grouchy from time to time. On th' other, she knew what she were doing. Hard for folks to feel sorry f'r someone who walked straight into a trap knowin' it were there to begin with. I jus' put on a face an' smile when she done come in f'r me to look over her, hear her bitch, whine an' cry then have her leave smilin'. ] "If'n ya ask me, I think she's more worried 'bout th' possibility of havin' to return Granny's pendant than actually changin' up her duties an' all[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]." Mai huffs. "Never figured her to be th' covetous type, but she's done clearly taken a shine to th' thing and forgot that it ain't really hers. Kinda understandable, but ya can't jus' be givin' out that kinda thing." It's valuable, unbelievably so, and being able to cross great distances in the blink of an eye is how she gets a leg up on almost everyone else. You'd have thought that would be obvious the moment she was entrusted with it. "[pc.ra kitsune |Yer Eminence... t |T ]h' heart wants what th' heart wants, jus' sayin'. Ain't gotta make sense or be reasonable." ] |[rand |"Lil' Kohaku is really th' only one amongst us all who done handles local currency an' all. Some o' us like Granny an' Nakano keep a bit o' cash on hand if'n they ever wanna take a stint to th' homeland — after all, ya gotta have just a bit o' spendin' money, no matter how accommodatin' yer relatives are. Still, when it comes to yer local electrum hawks, she's th' only one to which they have any value. "Reason f'r that is simple — we ain't walkin' into a native city o' other kinda settlement an' tryin' to buy or sell. Remember than most o' the natives regard us as monsterfolk an' all; only reason Kohaku dares try is 'cause she's amazin' at mimicry an' disguise. Bein' doin' it so long, some folks are wonderin' if she's goin' native... "But that ain't none o' my business. She done do good work an' all her ledgers balance out, so she's good in my book. Good enough that I can forgive a couple eccentricities that're needed f'r her job an' all." |If'n ya remember one thing when dealin' with lil' Kohaku, it's to never call her a merchant. I'm dead serious — ain't no more certain way o' makin' her mad with ya." She travels from place to place in order to buy and sell, though. You suppose that while those are part of what a merchant does, they don't in and of themselves make her a merchant... do they? "A merchant is a swindlin', lyin', thievin' no-good asshole who ain't got no roots an' wanders from place to place, stoppin' only long enough to cheat local folk o' their mothers' undergarments 'fore disappearin' into th' night. Existin' only to milk ya of every last coin f'r shoddy goods that barely work jus' good enough so's ya don't come up an' stove his head in. A storehouse keeper is an honest, hardworkin' fellow who's trusted enough to handle not jus' th' money, but th' entire den's provisions an' goods. A trusted member o' th' community who does hard work that's honorable an' coordinates gettin' stuff from th' homeland while also riskin' his life dealin' with th' natives. That's th' difference, as she'll tell ya no sweat." That's just reframing the issue, isn't it? "With questions like these, half th' time th' problem is framin' it," Mai replies idly. "Best foot forward an' all, right?" |"Ya know that there pendant that lil' Kohaku wears all th' time? It was one o' Granny's first projects after th' colony was settled, an' done got passed from storehouse keeper to th' next. Th' last one wanted to retire to th' homeland an' bring his family over, so it done got passed down to her. Bein' able to use th' ol' warpstones left behind by th' empire makes th' job a whole sight easier, lemme tell ya that. We don't really need it 'cause where we're goin' usually has a torii gate to get back from, but she has to use th' ol' warpstones to get out from native lands an' cut her travel time down by days. To someone who does tradin', that there's a godsend." |"Kohaku is really tiny, an' when I say tiny I mean tiny. We foxes already ain't too tall compared to th' local folk, but when ya put her up against most o' th' natives she's a downright midget. If'n nothin' else, that there's makin' sure she ain't bein' mistaken f'r a native anytime soon. "Can't really figure why, either. I've seen her dad, an' her mom reputedly weren't a midget, either. If'n it weren't f'r her massive thighs an' ass — f'r someone her size, anyway — her proportions ain't off none. Someone's got to be th' smallest fox in th' den, sure, but why it's to that extent is one o' those mysteries o' th' world that ain't ever gonna get solved." ] ] ]"

rows.original: Mai raises an eyebrow at you, then nods. "Ah, well. If'n anyone has th' right to be askin' after lil' sis, it's ya an' Lady Ōtomo. Okay, I'll tell ya what she's been up to." That's rather forthright of her... "As her parent, ya got every right to be concerned f'r her well-bein' an' all. I ain't hidin' nothin' from ya." Many thanks. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |[rand |"Well then. Now, I ain't usually one to complain 'cause pots, kettles an' all, but lil' sis... she kinda smells o' fertiliser all th' time. It ain't surprisin', considering how much time she spends around th' stuff with my cus, an' it's really faint so I guess ya wouldn't be able to smell it if'n ya weren't looking f'r it, but I've got a pretty good nose an' all." Fertiliser, she says. Mai looks thoughtful. "Yup, that's right. Fertiliser. I see her in th' bathhouse before I start my shift sometimes an' I try to give her a good scrubbin', but I think at this point ain't no amount of scrubbin' gonna ever remove it from her. Yer darlin's grown up to be a good ol' hard-workin honest ton o' soil. People in th' fields greet her with big smiles an' all when she done passes 'em by." [party.has kiyoko |Beside you, Kiyoko has her face buried in her palms, her ears folded down and to the sides in despair. "Where did I go so wrong as a mother? What did I do to deserve my daughter wasting her talents on this?" ] So, what does she want you to do about it? Mai shrugs. "Dunno; she certainly ain't givin' up workin' in th' fields. But ya asked about yer darlin' an' I told ya what's up with her, that's all. Beggin' yer pardon, but lil' sis stinks. I know, pot, kettle an' all, but at least winterstem don't smell so bad." |"Lil' sis is kinda fun to tease," Mai says with a chuckle. "She's like my cus Hitoshi in that sense... both o' them are so straight an' narrow that teasin' them don't take no effort at all. They're practically made f'r each other, completely oblivious; their hearts are tryin' their damndest to get together without lettin' their heads know. As a woman an' a shrine maiden, there ain't no greater pity than a couple like that... I do what I can to give them a prod in each other's way every now an' then." She's trying to set your daughter up with her cousin? "Set up is kinda pushin' it, don'tcha think? No need to set those two up when they're already together... even if they don't know it yet. Ya'll see in time... ya wanna yer darlin' to be happy, don'tcha? I feel th' same way 'bout lil' sis, too..." |"Ain't no need to worry none. Yer lil' darlin' is really well-loved around these here parts. People love seein' her workin' with them in th' fields an' pullin' her weight. Most provincial girls ain't got a year or two of beauty at most 'fore the hard work gets to them, but there's something about lil' sis that makes her stay lovely despite how dirty she gets." She's well-liked, eh? Mai nods and chuckles. "Most o' th' folks here were born an' raised in th' colonies an' ain't ever seen much of th' homeland, let alone seen any of th' high nobility. For a white-furred girl bearin' divine blood to be comin' down to work in th' fields and pullin' her weight, makin' everythin' grow at her touch... it's like summat outta an' old story, ya know? Gives people hope. The fact that lil' sis is a looker don't hurt any, either. F'r th' colonials, she's our noble, one who ain't afraid to get her hands dirty an' all." Hmm... "As th' sayin' goes, 'Heaven is high an' th' Emperor far away.' 'S got several meanings, but th' context we're takin' here is that ain't any of the folks livin' here gonna see any o' th' upper crust from th' Old Country. 'S kinda hard to form attachments to th' folks sittin' in the capital... but yer girl is someone they can see an' talk to. I think she's gonna be right popular 'round these parts in th' years to come." |"Miko an' I had a bunch o' leeks an' napa cabbage yer lil' darlin' brought in th' other day as an offerin'. Put them in a hotpot with some stock an' stewed 'em up. Weren't bad." Coming from Mai, you know full well that those two words of contented acceptance would be glowing praise from anyone else. "Miko an' I, we're glad yer darlin' daughter is th' pious sort. Ain't gonna say no to fresh veggies from her — she's practically givin' them away at this point. [kiyoko.numKits 8 |Ya think she'd have problems given how many mouths she has to feed, but th' land really loves yer lil' girl. Ain't that an' accomplishment. |Ya oughta get with th' lady Ōtomo an' make some more mouths f'r her to feed, maybe that'll slow her down a lil'. Ha! Ha! Th' land really loves yer lil' girl, [pc.ra kitsune|m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]|[pc.name]]. Ain't that a sight to see." ]] | [rand |"Some days, Miko an' I wonder if'n yer lil' darlin' can see auras an' th' like, an' jus' ain't tellin' no one. She's got a knack for knowin' things like we did when we were younger..." Can't she tell for certain whether Kinu can or can't? "Eeeeh. Maybe she don't recognize it herself either, an' jus' thinks that's th' way th' world is. Unless yer trained, yer don't really consciously leverage th' talent, either... I dunno whether I'd talk to her 'bout it, but it wouldn't surprise me none if'n she did. Lil' sis has divine blood, after all." |"Yer lil' gal is pretty well-liked 'bout these parts. Folk respect her an' all, it's like she's got this thing 'bout her that naturally draws folks to her, makes them pretty disposed to like her an' all. Brightens up their day, as it were — I remember Miko an' I were much th' same when we first done come to th' colonies." That's a good thing; it's important for Kinu to interact with people who aren't her immediate family. "Th' colonials look up to her... no one born in th' colonies has ever gone all th' way to th' capital an' looked upon any o' th' twelve divine clans when they make public appearances an' all. But here we have one o' our own an' she's all kind and elegant-like and not all stuck-up like th' courtiers are supposed to be... she's our white-fur, damn it, an' folks like her that way. Young an' refined an' affectionate, like outta th' tales. She keeps this up, she's gonna go far around these parts." You just want the best for Kinu. Mai laughs at that. "Not a bad thing to aim f'r[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]. |"Sometimes, I'll break out th' ol' shogi board an' have a go at it with yer darlin' daughter. She's fun to play against, 'cause she's th' only one who can put up some kinda fight. Miko stopped playin' with me since we were eleven summers, an' Granny ain't got th' time — I know she'd drop what she was doin' and make th' time, but I ain't about to go imposin' meself on her." Oh boy, oh boy. You have memories of Kinu and the board games kitsune play... Mai chuckles and takes a deep drag from her pipe. "She's at that sweet spot, ya know? Just good enough that I'm learnin' new things when I play with her. Not quite good enough that I ain't able to whup her an' send her packin'. I gotta keep up meself, else she'll be overtakin' me one o' these days an' without me noticin' it, too." She was like this when she was a kit, always begging other people to play with her because she outshone everyone else. You're glad Mai's here to bring her down to earth a bit. "Oh, she was in need o' a bit o' deflatin' first few games we played. Would like to think she's learnin' to take the likes o' me seriously at this point." |"Oh, I oughta let ya know. Lil' sis has been learnin' how to dance from me — she says it's one o' th' skills a lady o' her station should have, an' I agree. Only problem is..." There's a problem? "...We-ll, most o' th' dances I actually know are ritual dances f'r ceremonies an' th' like. Now, since lil' sis done got white fur an' divine blood, ain't against no tradition or law to teach her 'em... but at th' same time, it don't quite feel right to be passin' on this knowledge to someone outside a priestly family, ya get me? I've gotten her started on some styles, but she'll soon be clamourin' f'r more... ah, what to do, what to do. Lil' sis does make for a damn good sight dancin', though — so long as she remembers to put her heart in it." ] ]
rows.translation: 舞挑了挑眉毛看着你，然后点了点头。啊，好吧。如果说有谁有资格关心小妹妹的近况，那肯定就是你和大友女士了。好吧，我就告诉你们她最近都在做些什么。 她这样直率，真是挺特别的…… 作为她的父母，你完全有权利关心她的安危之类的问题。我并没有对你隐瞒任何事情。 非常感谢。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |[rand |好吧，其实我平时也不爱抱怨什么，毕竟锅碗瓢盆之类的东西嘛，但是我妹妹……她身上总是有一股肥料的味道。这也难怪，毕竟她经常和我家那些种植东西的人待在一起，而且这种味道其实很淡，除非你特意去闻，否则可能根本察觉不到。不过我的鼻子还算挺灵的，所以还是能闻出来的。 肥料，”她说。 梅显得若有所思。没错，就是肥料。有时候在我开始上班之前，我会看到她在澡堂里，我就会试着好好帮她清洗干净，但我觉得，现在再怎么清洗也洗不掉那些东西了。你家宝贝已经长成了一块勤劳、诚实、肥沃的‘土壤’啊……每当她从田里经过时，那里的农民们都会对她露出灿烂的笑容。 [party.has kiyoko |在你身旁，清子将脸埋在双手之中，双耳也无力地耷拉在身体两侧，满脸都是绝望的神情。作为母亲，我究竟哪里做错了？我究竟做了什么，才会让我的女儿把她的才华浪费在这个？" ] 那么，她希望你对此采取什么行动呢？ 舞耸了耸肩。不知道；她肯定还在田里干活呢。但你问起了你亲爱的妹妹，所以我只是告诉了你她的情况而已。实在不好意思，不过我这个妹妹糟透了我知道，这听起来有点牵强，但至少冬茎的味道没有那么难闻。 |逗弄妹妹还挺有意思的。舞轻笑着说道。从某种意义上说，她就像我的亲弟弟仁……他们俩都太过直率、太过固执，因此捉弄他们根本不需要费什么力气。他们简直就是为彼此而生的，却完全没有意识到这一点；他们的心一直在努力让彼此靠近，却不让自己的头脑察觉到这一点。作为一名女性，也作为一名神社少女，没有什么比这样的情侣更让人感到遗憾的了……我也会时不时地想办法让他们互相有所察觉。 她想把你的女儿介绍给她表弟/表妹吗？ 把他们安排在一起未免有点太刻意了，你不觉得吗？既然他们已经在一起了，就没有必要再刻意安排什么……即使他们自己还不知道这一点。随着时间的推移，你们会明白的……你们肯定也希望自己的宝贝能够幸福，对吧？对于我妹妹，我也有同样的感受…… 舞点了点头，轻声笑了起来。这里的大多数人都是在殖民地出生的，也在那里长大的，他们几乎从未见过自己的祖国，更别说那些高贵的贵族了。对于一个拥有神圣血脉、皮肤白皙的女孩来说，她竟然愿意下到田里干活，尽自己的一份力，让一切在她触碰之下都能生长……这简直就像古老故事里发生的情节一样，你知道吧？这给人们带来了希望。而且，这位小姑娘长得也很漂亮，这一点更是为她增色不少。对殖民地的人们来说，她我们的高尚的人，就是那些不怕亲自动手去做那些事情的人。 嗯…… 俗话说：“天高皇帝远。”这句话有多种含义，但在这里我们指的是，这里生活的普通人根本不可能见到来自那个古老国家的上层人士。对于那些住在首都的人们来说，确实很难建立起深厚的感情……但你的姑娘不同，她是那些人能够见到、能够交谈的对象。我想，在未来的几年里，她一定会在这附近地区变得非常受欢迎。 |前几天，米科和我还吃了你送来的很多韭菜和大白菜呢。把它们放进火锅里，再加点高汤炖一下，味道还不错哦。 作为迈的亲信，你心里很清楚，对于别人来说，那句“心满意足地接受”其实是一种极高的赞美。 米科和我都很高兴你亲爱的女儿这么虔诚。对于她送来的新鲜蔬菜，我们当然不会拒绝——她现在简直是把它们当成礼物送给我们了。 [kiyoko.numKits 8 |你可能会觉得，考虑到她要养活那么多人，她肯定会遇到很多麻烦，但这片土地真的很眷顾你家的小姑娘。这难道不也是一种成就吗？ |你真该和大友小姐在一起，多生几个孩子让她养，这样或许能让她稍微消停一点吧。哈！哈！这个国家真的很喜欢你家的小姑娘啊。 [pc.ra kitsune|m[pc.mf|领主|女士]|[pc.name]]那场面真是太壮观了。 ]] | [rand |有时候，我和米可会想，你那个小宝贝是否也能看到气场之类的东西，只不过她并没有告诉任何人而已。她天生就有一种能力，能够察觉到一些我们年轻时也能察觉到的东西…… 她难道就不能确定小娟到底能不能做到吗？ 呃……也许她自己也不清楚这一点，只是认为世界本来就是这样的。除非你接受过专门的训练，否则你也不会有意识地运用这种天赋……我不知道是否应该和她谈论这件事，但如果她真的这么做了，我也不会感到惊讶。毕竟，她可是拥有神之血脉的。 |你家姑娘在这附近挺受欢迎的。大家都很尊重她，她似乎有一种天然的魅力，能让人们不由自主地喜欢上她。她能让人们的一天都变得愉快起来——我记得我和米科刚来到这些殖民地的时候，也是这样。 那真是太好了；对于小娟来说，与那些并非她直系亲属的人进行交流是非常重要的。 那些在殖民地出生的人都非常敬重她……从来没有任何一个在殖民地出生的人能够专程前往首都，亲眼看到那十二个贵族家族的成员在公开场合出现。然而，我们这里有这样一个人，她既善良又优雅，一点也不像那些宫廷贵族应该有的那种傲慢态度……她真的与众不同。我们的白肤金发的，真是太完美了，像她这样的女孩确实很受欢迎。年轻、优雅又充满爱心，简直就像故事里走出来的角色一样。如果她能继续保持这样的状态，肯定会在这个地区取得很大的成功。 你只是希望小娟得到最好的。 舞对此笑了笑。把目标定得高一些也没什么坏处。[pc.ra kitsune|，嗯[pc.mf|领主|女士]]。 |有时候，我就会拿出那把老家伙来将棋上去和你亲爱的女儿一起玩吧。和她对战真的很有趣，因为她是唯一一个会真正反抗的人。从我们十一岁那年开始，米科就不再和我一起玩了，而奶奶也没时间——我知道，只要一有空，她一定会放下手头的事情过来陪我玩的。制作那次倒是想，但我可不想强行打扰她。 哦天啊，哦天啊。你竟然还记得小娟以及那些狐妖主题的棋盘游戏套装…… 舞轻笑着，深深地吸了一口烟斗里的烟。她现在正处于那个完美的状态，你知道吧？她的水平正好好，让我在和她对战时能够学到新的东西。但同时又不是强到让我根本无法战胜她，否则她很快就会超过我，而我甚至都不会察觉到。 她小时候就是这样的，总是缠着别人和她一起玩，因为她的实力确实比所有人都强。现在有舞在，总算让她有点收敛了吧。 哦，在我们玩的最初几局游戏中，她确实需要一些引导和帮助。不过现在看来，她应该已经学会了认真对待像我这样的人了吧。 |哦，我应该告诉你。我妹妹一直在向我学习跳舞——她说，对于她这样的身份来说，掌握这种技能是必要的，我也觉得有道理。不过问题在于…… 有问题吗？ 嗯，其实我所知道的那些舞蹈大多都是用于仪式之类的庆典活动。既然小妹妹现在已经拥有了白色的毛皮和神圣的血液，教她这些舞蹈并不会违反任何传统或规定……但同时，把这种知识传授给一个不属于祭司家族的人，总觉得有点不太对劲，你明白我的意思吧？我已经让她尝试了一些舞蹈风格，不过她很快就会吵着要尝试更多了……唉，真不知道该怎么办。不过，妹妹跳舞的时候确实挺好看的——只要她能全身心地投入其中就行。 ] ]
rows.raw: " Mai raises an eyebrow at you, then nods. "Ah, well. If'n anyone has th' right to be askin' after lil' sis, it's ya an' Lady Ōtomo. Okay, I'll tell ya what she's been up to." That's rather forthright of her... "As her parent, ya got every right to be concerned f'r her well-bein' an' all. I ain't hidin' nothin' from ya." Many thanks. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |[rand |"Well then. Now, I ain't usually one to complain 'cause pots, kettles an' all, but lil' sis... she kinda smells o' fertiliser all th' time. It ain't surprisin', considering how much time she spends around th' stuff with my cus, an' it's really faint so I guess ya wouldn't be able to smell it if'n ya weren't looking f'r it, but I've got a pretty good nose an' all." Fertiliser, she says. Mai looks thoughtful. "Yup, that's right. Fertiliser. I see her in th' bathhouse before I start my shift sometimes an' I try to give her a good scrubbin', but I think at this point ain't no amount of scrubbin' gonna ever remove it from her. Yer darlin's grown up to be a good ol' hard-workin honest ton o' soil. People in th' fields greet her with big smiles an' all when she done passes 'em by." [party.has kiyoko |Beside you, Kiyoko has her face buried in her palms, her ears folded down and to the sides in despair. "Where did I go so wrong as a mother? But ya asked about yer darlin' an' I told ya what's up with her, that's all. Beggin' yer pardon, but lil' sis stinks. I know, pot, kettle an' all, but at least winterstem don't smell so bad." |"Lil' sis is kinda fun to tease," Mai says with a chuckle. "She's like my cus Hitoshi in that sense... both o' them are so straight an' narrow that teasin' them don't take no effort at all. They're practically made f'r each other, completely oblivious; their hearts are tryin' their damndest to get together without lettin' their heads know. As a woman an' a shrine maiden, there ain't no greater pity than a couple like that... I do what I can to give them a prod in each other's way every now an' then." She's trying to set your daughter up with her cousin? "Set up is kinda pushin' it, don'tcha think? No need to set those two up when they're already together... even if they don't know it yet. Ya'll see in time... ya wanna yer darlin' to be happy, don'tcha? I feel th' same way 'bout lil' sis, too..." |"Ain't no need to worry none. Yer lil' darlin' is really well-loved around these here parts. People love seein' her workin' with them in th' fields an' pullin' her weight. Most provincial girls ain't got a year or two of beauty at most 'fore the hard work gets to them, but there's something about lil' sis that makes her stay lovely despite how dirty she gets." She's well-liked, eh? Mai nods and chuckles. "Most o' th' folks here were born an' raised in th' colonies an' ain't ever seen much of th' homeland, let alone seen any of th' high nobility. For a white-furred girl bearin' divine blood to be comin' down to work in th' fields and pullin' her weight, makin' everythin' grow at her touch... it's like summat outta an' old story, ya know? Gives people hope. The fact that lil' sis is a looker don't hurt any, either. F'r th' colonials, she's our noble, one who ain't afraid to get her hands dirty an' all." Hmm... "As th' sayin' goes, 'Heaven is high an' th' Emperor far away.' 'S got several meanings, but th' context we're takin' here is that ain't any of the folks livin' here gonna see any o' th' upper crust from th' Old Country. 'S kinda hard to form attachments to th' folks sittin' in the capital... but yer girl is someone they can see an' talk to. I think she's gonna be right popular 'round these parts in th' years to come." |"Miko an' I had a bunch o' leeks an' napa cabbage yer lil' darlin' brought in th' other day as an offerin'. "Miko an' I, we're glad yer darlin' daughter is th' pious sort. Ain't gonna say no to fresh veggies from her — she's practically givin' them away at this point. [kiyoko.numKits 8 |Ya think she'd have problems given how many mouths she has to feed, but th' land really loves yer lil' girl. Ain't that an' accomplishment. |Ya oughta get with th' lady Ōtomo an' make some more mouths f'r her to feed, maybe that'll slow her down a lil'. Ha! Ha! Ain't that a sight to see." ]] | [rand |"Some days, Miko an' I wonder if'n yer lil' darlin' can see auras an' th' like, an' jus' ain't tellin' no one. Folk respect her an' all, it's like she's got this thing 'bout her that naturally draws folks to her, makes them pretty disposed to like her an' all. That's a good thing; it's important for Kinu to interact with people who aren't her immediate family. "Not a bad thing to aim f'r[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]. |"Sometimes, I'll break out th' ol' shogi board an' have a go at it with yer darlin' daughter. Oh boy, oh boy. You have memories of Kinu and the board games kitsune play... Mai chuckles and takes a deep drag from her pipe. "She's at that sweet spot, ya know? She was like this when she was a kit, always begging other people to play with her because she outshone everyone else. You're glad Mai's here to bring her down to earth a bit. "Oh, she was in need o' a bit o' deflatin' first few games we played. Would like to think she's learnin' to take the likes o' me seriously at this point." |"Oh, I oughta let ya know. I've gotten her started on some styles, but she'll soon be clamourin' f'r more... ah, what to do, what to do. rows.original: [var0 |[rand |"Rin an' I get together most nights to play shogi[kiyoko.isFree | with lil' sis ]. The poor gal ain't ever won more'n a handful o' times, but when it comes to her, it ain't 'bout winnin' or losin' none. It's about gettin' her out to show her face an' talk to folks... 's 'bout having a nice cup o' tea and plenty o' pleasant conversation. Livin' a good life in spite o' who we are an' where we come from; oftentimes, healin' ain't jus' in th' body, but also in th' mind. "Seen a few cases in my time where folks didn't really die o' their illness or injuries, but jus' lost th' will to live. Once that goes, yer body ain't long to follow, either. Playin' games an' eatin' snacks with folks helps ya avoid fallin' into that pit and bein' buried alive; 's a genuine reminder that other folks need ya, too. We all need each other here in th' colonies." |"Rin's always been weak in th' left half o' her body. Granny an' I gave her a look-over not too long after she done arrived on our doorstep, and whoever treated her burns botched the job, maybe on purpose. It weren't obvious, but the muscles under th' scarrin' weren't gonna grow back right none. Workin' in th' gardens an' a good environment done helped some, but her left side ain't ever gonna fully heal. "Rin hides it well, but if'n ya look closely, ya can see how th' poor gal favors her right arm an' leg when doin' anythin'. They've grown stronger to try an' compensate, but it ain't ever gonna be enough, especially on a slight gal like her. Anytime she needs heavy labor done, she's gotta go borrow a puppet from Granny's pet madman to do the liftin', haulin' and choppin' — even if'n strength weren't an issue none, them muscles and pressure points are unsteady an' she'd tremble all over th' place. That ain't to mention she can't judge distance an' depth well 'cause she's only got one good eye..." And yet somehow, life still goes on. "If'n ya learn somethin' from the experience, it's that life ain't 'bout avoidin' sufferin'. If'n that were the case, ya might as well off yerself — ya can't feel pain or loss if'n yer dead. An' when ya've got th' mindset to find th' meanin' in sufferin, that there's when ya get closer to th' Way." |"Rin comes in to see me at dusk jus' when I'm gettin' on my shift and she's gettin' off hers. Even years after th' fact, those scars o' hers still trouble th' poor gal from time to time — sometimes they itch, other times th' skin goes all tight an' dry. I've made up a coupla salves she takes home to ease th' aches, and she done grows a bunch of what goes into them herself... it's kinda a 'help me help ya' kinda situation, if'n ya know what I mean. "I give her a look-over when he comes in, an' she's as fit as she'll ever be. Five years in this here freezin' backwater with its clean, cold air done th' gal a whole bunch o' good, I daresay. As far as th' likes o' lil' ol' me is concerned, cities are pits o' filth an' disease an' I don't want nothin' to do with them. Rin bein' shipped straight outta that kinda environment was th' best thing that ever happened to th' gal, whether she admits it or not." |"Oh? I know full well that Rin don't like me smokin' none. Oh, she ain't ever gonna say so to my face, but I can see th' little ugly looks she done gives me when I light up." Mai blows a lazy smoke ring. "Ya know, I don't do this to look good or get high or nothin'... but if'n I'm gonna have to do it, I might as well do it in style." That does raise the question, though. Does Mai have to chain-smoke winterstem in perpetuity? Could she live without it and keep herself together through sheer force of will, like Miko does? "I coulda, I guess, but ain't no point in riskin' it. Rin's a nice gal an' all, but I ain't given' up winterstem f'r her sake. Not when I kinda need it to stay sane. Okay, maybe that was a little over th' top, but still. I need this stuff or my senses all go crazy." |"Sometimes, I'll go over to Rin's in th' mornin' when I get off my shift, do a house call f'r th' poor gal. Some nice acupressure in th' form o' a good massage always wakes her right upan' gets her ready to start th' day, so she don't trouble Miko none. When she done came over here to th' colonies, granny told us she'd like us to see her as our lil' sis... but that weren't possible, not even today. That kinda connection jus' weren't possible for th' likes o' us... but we got to be friends anyways, so it kinda worked out in th' end. We look out f'r her, she does her best to look out f'r us, and it's all hunky-dory from there on out. Miko an' I never really got to dote on rin like we woulda done f'r a lil' sis, but she weren't th' type to be doted on anyways. That there were our childish desires speakin... has it really only been five years?" ] |[rand |"Hey[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Wanna hear a juicy secret 'bout Rin?" Mmm... depends on what it is. "I'll be takin' that there as a yes, then. Th' night before she were to be confirmed as yer concubine, Granny had me check over Rin's internals one more time, make sure nothin' was wrong with th' poor gal's insides. We done looked her over once when she arrived on our doorstep, but these kinds o' problems can be takin' years to show up after th' fact." You take it this sudden concern is related to — Mai blows a lazy ring of smoke and snorts. "Eeeeh, her womb's workin' jus' fine. Pretty active thing, too, given that she's likely been pent up f'r a long time. Most o' th' locals don't wanna be benefactor to a half-scarred weirdo like she is, an' I can't blame them. That's how it is. But yeah. She can catch a kit inside o' her belly jus' fine, thank th' gods. Ya oughta keep that in mind when yer bein' her benefactor an' all, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence. |'kay? ]" ...Why the wait until the last minute to examine Rindo again? Now, then: beats me why Granny waited, maybe she were confident in th' old look-over and didn't start worryin' until the night before. Hmm, that's a hard question. Your instinct is that of course you'd say no, but it's hard to know what you'd really have done until you were truly tested. Then again, you have no desire to be... "I know th' locals say that deserve ain't got nothin' to do with it an' that ain't wrong either, but there's what is and what oughta be. You don't really know much about kitsune politics, but you don't expect it to be so different at the root that you can't apply common sense to this whole mess. Don't worry, you'll take care of Rindo to the fullest of your abilities until all this is over, at least, then she can decide for herself whether she wants to stay on as your concubine without duress or not. Mai nods. "Thank ya kindly[pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. That's 'bout th' most Granny, Miko an' I can hope f'r. If'n no one tries anythin' funny an' this mess dies down... mighta be a while, but it'll be a good day when Rin done gets to be makin' that there decision, eh?" |"Jus' so you know, [pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence, ]Rin's been comin' by th' shrine more these days. Makes them jus' a bit more pious an' all." So she's saying that Rin's afraid? Maybe you should talk to her about that. "[pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer pardon, yer Eminence. ]If'n I may, I'd advise against it." Oh? "Rin kinda needs to feel in control o' her life, even if'n it's in some small part o' it. It may not seem like it 'cause Granny's doin' a bang-up job o' keepin' a lid on all th' trouble that's brewin', but ya oughta be someone stable f'r Rin in these tryin' times. An' most importantly... ya shouldn't make it obvious. Rin needs to be feelin' like she's not just doin' somethin', but doin' somethin' that matters. She's done spent a long time in realizin' to her self that she ain't helpless no matter how bad things get, an' everyone doin' everythin' f'r her ain't gonna help. "I ain't sayin' ya shouldn't be helping[pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence ]... jus' be circumspect 'bout it all, if'n ya please." All right, then. You'll have to figure out some ways you can be quietly supportive for Rindo while still remaining in the background and not making it obvious, but you're sure that it can be done. "Thank ya kindly[pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. I know it may not be soundin' like much, but 's important to everyone that they're feelin' like they at least have some say in steerin' th' ship they're on. Even if'n it means prayin' f'r divine intervention... that kinda stuff still helps." |"Don't ya worry none 'bout Rin when yer out[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence | an' about on whatever it is ya marcher baron[pc.mf |esse ]s do ]. "All o' us have a vested interest in keepin' her alive, an' we'd rather prefer she stay breathin'. If'n nothin' else, my sis an' I will be keepin' an eye on Rin, not jus' f'r outside threats but also so that th' poor gal don't break down none. She's puttin' up a strong face, but ya can tell all this has been botherin' her." Well, thank them for looking after Rindo while you're gone. This whole concubinage thing would've been much more of a hassle if not for everyone else helping out. "Ain't it easy to be helpin' those who in turn wanna help out? Ya were th' first to be stickin' out yer neck f'r us,[pc.ra kitsune | yer Eminence, ]so 's only right that we do th' same an' take some o' that burden off yer shoulders. Not like Rin's th' kind who's hard to mind, anyways. Jus' remember to do yer part and make her happy every now an' then, an' we'll be takin' care o' th' rest f'r ya all nice-like. Th' gal will be all flowers an' smiles when she's greetin' ya at th' door, ain't no question 'bout it." ] |[rand |So... you understand that the rationale for Komari marrying off Rindo to her cousin was to bring the poor girl into the clan's fold and hence extend the protection of her name to Rindo[kinu.isInari |; the fact that Rindo had been crushing on Nakano for the last handful of years being completely tangential to the matter, if a happy coincidence ]. Does Mai actually think it'll work? Mai considers that a moment, then wiggles her ears and blows a smoke ring. "Granny wouldn't have done it if'n she didn't think woulda worked none." Yes, but you're not asking what Komari thinks of the matter, you're asking what Mai thinks. "We-ll, it coulda work either way[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. On one hand, Granny ain't supposed to be meddlin' with politics across th' ocean, not that it ain't stoppin' no one since she's supposed to have autonomy over th' colonies, too. On the other hand, Granny's th' kind o' monster 'nukis tell their kits about at night to scare them straight into behavin' an' properly respectin' th' gods. Multiple lifetimes don't pass by easy without ya gainin' some kinda wisdom outta that. "Now, if'n I were a bettin' woman, I'd wager on th' latter, but then I'm biased anyways." Yes, you understand that family and clan does put a thumb on the scales, as it were, but let's say that it wasn't. What would she say was her reasoning, then? "It ain't too hard to be guessin', [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence. |ain't it? ] Anyone they done send over to be gettin' a hold on Rin is gonna be far, far away from their power base. Logistics an' all. Granny, Miko and I done keep a close eye on th' comin's an goin's o' anyone through th' torii gate, so it'd have to be either someone who slipped through or sent by ship. A buncha other reasons too, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]but that there's th' biggest one." You see. Well, thanks for her help; that perspective is interesting. |"Hey[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Wanna hear a juicy secret 'bout Rin?" Mmm... depends on what it is. "I'll be takin' that there as a yes, then. Th' night before th' wedding was meant to take place, Granny had me check over Rin's internals one more time, make sure nothin' was wrong with th' poor gal's insides. We done looked her over once when she arrived on our doorstep, but these kinds o' problems can be takin' years to show up after th' fact." You take it this sudden concern is related to — Mai blows a lazy ring of smoke and snorts. "Eeeeh, her womb's workin' jus' fine. [kinu.isInari |Pretty active thing, too, given that she's likely been pent up f'r a long time. Most o' th' locals don't wanna be benefactor to a half-scarred weirdo like she is, an' I can't blame them. That's how it is |I dunno if the poor slip of a gal can stand a kit o' the size Hitoshi is bound to be putin' inside o' her, but it's not gonna be for lack o' tryin' ]. But yeah. She can catch a kit inside o' her belly jus' fine, thank th' gods." ...Why the wait until the last minute to examine Rindo again? Wouldn't it have been better to look her over earlier? And what would've happened if it'd turned out that she were barren? Would it have meant that the wedding would've been called off? "Hold yer horses, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]that there's a whole passel o' questions all at once. Rin's fine an' safe, so ya can right be takin' a breath 'fore ya pass out. Now, then: beats me why Granny waited, maybe she were confident in th' old look-over and didn't start worryin' until the night before. An' no, it wouldn't have been called off if'n it were revealed that Rin were indeed damaged... although it mighta changed some plans. Granny's ain't that kinda person." Hmm. Well, given that it all turned out nicely in the end you're perfectly fine with leaving it at that. "You shoulda seen her,[pc.ra kitsune | yer Eminence, ]" Mai says with a dry chuckle. "Laid out before me like a slab o' meat at market, lookin' all embarrassed... tryin' to stifle those moans o' hers while I was pinchin' an' proddin' at her both inside an' out... finally losin' it an' cryin' out when I done stuck my fingers into her ears... ah. I kinda envy my cus', given that he's gonna be doing such horribly lovely things like that there to th' poor flower o' a gal. So horrible." |"Sorry, f'r not bein' able to be gettin' ya an invite to Rin's wedding an' all. [pc.ra kitsune |Ain't no doubt someone o' yer standin' oughta be invited, yer Eminence |Yer th' high lady's consort after all an' that there counts f'r somethin' ], but yer also travelin' all th' time an' can be hard to get ahold of. That, an' th' weddin' was a snap decision, a real bang-up rush job. Under those circumstances, th' only real person from yer household we coulda be countin' on to be 'round was lil' sis Kinu..." We-ll, that's what she's there for, you suppose, to take care of the household affairs when both you and her mother are gone. It doesn't take the bitter sting out of your mouth, but at least it's understandable, if nothing else. "Ain't able to be helped none[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. But as providence woulda have it, ya turned up jus' in time f'r th' show, so it's all good, ain't it? Th' gods done have mysterious ways o' makin' sure things all work out nice-like. Ya gotta have faith, ya know." You'd rather have had an invitation and be clued in to what was going on... but point taken, considering the circumstances. Maybe when Mai herself gets married off, okay? "Mighta be waitin' a long time f'r that, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |friend ]," Mai replies coolly. "But I guess that there jus' means we'll have plenty o' time to track ya down an' hand ya an invite, ain't it?" |"An' that's that," Mai says, taking a deep drag from her pipe. "While [kinu.isInari |she weren't exactly swept off her feet none, Rin done got wedded to her crush. Now to see |she didn't get to be wedded to th' man she done crushed on f'r the last handful o' years, Rin coulda do worse than be learnin' how to be content. 'S not as ] if'n feelin's that came 'bout from bein' young an' horny are gonna be lastin' th' rest o' her life." That's a pretty dry way to put it... but Mai isn't wrong with that ugly truth of hers. No one has any illusions about the circumstances surrounding Rindo's rushed wedding, and that she's more than content is better than most could hope for in a similar position. In a way, one could suppose it would still count as being swept off her feet and saved, but a lot less romantic than the usual portrayal. Mai's ears twitch. "Hah. Romantic. Ain't no one in th' colonies got time f'r that kinda stuff. There's happiness to be found f'r most folk, to be sure, but that kinda fairytale stuff done gets ya badly hurt o' even killed. Right now th' best thing f'r Rin is that she lives out th' rest o' her life in a content an' borin' fashion, 'cause lil' ol' me thinks that she'll agree that she done got enough excitement f'r a lifetime.[kinu.isInari | Hopefully that there attitude rubs off on my cus' Nakano some, don't want him up and leavin' poor Rin a young widow or something equally dumb. ]" ] |[rindo.isConcubine |Mai sighs, folding her ears forward and blowing a ring of smoke. "Ya know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]my sis done loves playin' with kids, but when it comes to feedin', cleanin' an' dealin' with screamin' kits it were always me who were doin' it. Since I got stuck with th' job o' teachin' Rin all th' ropes o' th' family business, I might as well teach her how to be a mother, too. Miko ain't doin' it, that's f'r sure, and yer away [pc.ra kitsune |doin' his divine lordship's work, so no one can be complainin' |half th' time ]. This kind o' thing ain't f'r sinkin' or swimmin' if'n ya get my point." That's very kind of her. "Jus' doin' my assigned duty, ain't worth praise or thanks none," Mai waves off the compliment. "Ya do what ya need to; someone's gotta be th' responsible one 'round here and it sure ain't Miko. [kiyoko.isFree|Might even take th' chance to get lil' sis Kinu in on th' act, use Rin to teach her how to teach. ]Ain't no rest f'r the only woman with her head screwed on right 'round these parts, plenty o' reasons why lil' ol' me smokes so much. "Leastways Rin's willin' to learn, which is more than what lil' ol' me can say f'r some that I've tried to teach in the past, my sis included. She'll be a good mom if'n she can get over her fear of doin' somethin' wrong. 'S good to be concerned over yer kits, but frettin' over th' matter like she does ain't helpin' no one an' nothin'. Still, it ain't th' worst o' problems we done got here amongst the folk in th' colonies; I can work with that, and work with her." Please do. You'll be around for Rindo as much as possible — you certainly don't expect to be having one of those those once-a-year relationships, but it isn't as much as you'd like. "[pc.ra kitsune |Coulda be worse, so don't ya worry none, yer Eminence. We were watchin' her before, an' we'll be watchin' her f'r ya when yer away. |Okay, yeah, sure. "Ya know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]my sis done loves playin' with kids, [miko.anyKids |but now that she's done got one o' her own she's learnin' that mindin' other folks' kits ain't like mindin' yer own. |but when it comes to feedin', cleanin' an' dealin' with screamin' kits it were always me who were doin' it. ] Since I got stuck with th' job o' teachin' Rin all th' ropes o' th' family business, I might as well teach her how to be a mother, too. rows.translation: [var0 |[rand |每晚我都会和凛一起玩将棋。[kiyoko.isFree | 和妹妹一起 ]那个可怜的女孩从来没赢过几次，但对她来说，输赢并不重要。重要的是能让她走出家门，露面与人交谈……就是能和她一起喝杯茶，进行愉快的聊天。无论我们是谁，来自哪里，都应该过上美好的生活；很多时候，治愈并不仅仅发生在身体上，也发生在心灵里。 在我工作中，确实遇到过一些这样的情况：有些人就是没有真的他们可能因为疾病或受伤而死去，但其实是失去了生存的意志。一旦失去了这种意志，身体也会很快随之衰竭。和朋友们一起玩游戏、吃零食，能够帮助你避免陷入那种困境，避免“活埋”自己；这也是一种提醒，让你意识到别人也需要你。在殖民地这个大家庭里，我们所有人都是彼此需要的。 |凛的身体左侧一直都比较虚弱。她刚来到我们家门口不久，我和奶奶就为她做了一次检查。那些治疗她烧伤的医生显然搞砸了，或许他们是故意这么做的。虽然看不出来，但那些疤痕下面的肌肉已经无法再正常恢复了。虽然在花园里干活、保持一个良好的生活环境确实有所帮助，但她身体的左侧永远也无法完全康复了。 琳把这一点掩饰得很好，但如果你仔细观察，就会发现这个可怜的女孩在做任何事情时都会更多地使用她的右臂和右腿。她的这些肢体已经变得更强壮了，试图以此来弥补缺陷，但这对她这样的身材纤细的女孩来说，仍然远远不够。每当她需要做重体力活时，就不得不去奶奶养的那个“疯狂宠物”那里借一个木偶来帮忙搬运东西、进行切割等工作——即使力气根本不是问题，但她的肌肉和压力敏感点并不稳定，一干活就会全身发抖。更不用说，因为她只有一只眼睛能看得清楚，所以她根本无法准确判断距离和深度…… 然而，生活依然在继续。 “如果从这段经历中能学到什么的话，那就是生活并不是为了逃避痛苦。如果真是那样的话，那你还不如干脆去死吧——反正死了就感觉不到痛苦和失落了。而只有当你能够以一种积极的心态去理解苦难的意义时，你才真正能够接近那条“道”。 |黄昏时分，就在我准备开始上班、而她即将结束工作的时候，琳来找我了。即便过了这么多年，她身上的那些伤痕仍然会时不时地困扰着她——有时候会发痒，有时候皮肤会变得又紧又干。我给她配了一些药膏，让她带回家使用，这些药膏能缓解她的疼痛，而她自己也学会了制作其中的一些成分……可以说，这是一种“我帮助你，你也帮助我”的关系，你懂我的意思吧。 等他回来的时候，我仔细看了看她，她确实已经恢复得非常好。在这片寒冷偏远的地方生活了五年，清新的空气对她肯定大有好处。就我个人的看法而言，城市就是充满污秽和疾病的场所，我根本不想与它们有任何瓜葛。对她来说，能够立刻离开那种环境，无疑是件好事，不管她是否承认这一点。 |哦？我心里很清楚，凛其实不喜欢我看烟……她永远不会当面这么说，但我能看出，每当我点烟的时候，她脸上总会露出那种不喜欢的表情。”舞懒洋洋地吐出一个烟圈，“你知道，我抽烟并不是为了好看，也不是为了追求那种快感……但如果非得抽的话，那我还不如抽得有风格一点。” 不过，这确实引出了一个问题：舞为什么非要抽烟呢？拥有难道要永远不停地抽着冬茎烟吗？她能不抽烟，仅仅依靠坚强的意志力来维持自己的生活吗？就像米可那样…… “我想我是可以的，但也没必要去冒险。凛是个很好的女孩，但我不会为了她而放弃抽冬茎烟。毕竟我还得靠它保持理智。好吧，这话可能有点夸张，但事实就是如此。我必须得到这些东西，否则我的感官就会彻底混乱。 |有时候，我会在下班后早上去凛家，为她做些护理。轻轻的按摩加上适当的穴位按压，总能让她迅速清醒过来，准备好开始新的一天，这样就不会打扰到米可了。当她来到这些殖民地的时候，奶奶告诉我们，她希望我们能把她当作我们的小妹妹来对待……但那是不可能的，即使到了今天也不可能。对于我们这样的身份来说，这样的关系根本就不存在……不过我们还是成为了朋友，所以最终事情也还算圆满解决了。我们照顾她，她也尽力照顾我们，从那以后，一切都很顺利。我和米可其实从来都没有真正有机会宠爱我们本来也是会像对待妹妹一样对待她的，但她本来就不是那种需要被宠溺的人。看来还是我们那些幼稚的念头在作祟……真的才过了五年吗？ ] |[rand |嘿[pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 ]想听一个关于凛的有趣秘密吗？” “嗯……那得看是什么秘密才行。” “那我就把你的回答理解为‘想听’了。在她被正式确定为你的妾室之前的那个晚上，奶奶让我再检查一次凛的身体，确保她的内脏没有任何问题。她刚来到我们家门口的时候，我们确实仔细检查了她一番，但这类问题往往要过很多年才会显现出来。 那么，你认为这种突然表现出的担忧与什么有关呢？ 舞懒洋洋地吐出一圈烟雾，然后哼了一声：“哎，她的子宫运作得挺正常的。考虑到她很可能已经被关了很长时间，她的活动频率还挺高的呢。大多数当地人都不想帮助像她这样的半残废的怪人，我也不能怪他们。事实就是如此。不过，谢天谢地，她的肚子里确实能够容纳那些装备。当你打算帮助她的时候，可千万要记住这一点。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下。 |好吧？ ]……为什么非要等到最后一刻才再去检查林多呢？早点检查不是更好吗？如果结果发现她不能生育，那又会怎么样呢？难道这意味着整个计划就要取消了吗？ “先别急， [pc.ra kitsune |尊贵的阁下， ]一下子出现了好多问题啊。琳现在没事，也很安全，所以你可以先松口气再继续担心了。那么，让我想想：真不明白奶奶为什么一直等到最后才采取行动，也许她对之前的检查结果很有信心，直到前一天晚上才开始担心起来。至于如果发现琳确实受到了伤害，这次行动会不会被取消……奶奶不是那种会因为外界影响而改变决定的人。ya如果真是那样的话，你会选择这么做吗？” 嗯，这是个很难回答的问题。你的直觉会告诉你你当然会选择拒绝，但真正遇到那种情况时，你又会怎么做呢，其实也很难说。真的你真该看看她当时的样子[pc.ra kitsune | 尊贵的阁下， ]舞看到你那尴尬的样子，干笑了一声，然后巧妙地转移了话题。‘就像市场上摊开的肉块一样，被摊开在我面前，看起来那么尴尬……当我不停地捏她、戳她的时候，她努力忍住哭声……最后，当我把手指伸进她的耳朵里时，她终于忍不住哭了出来……啊，我有点羡慕你呢。 [pc.ra kitsune |尊贵的阁下， ]想想看，你竟然会对那个可怜的女孩做出如此可爱又糟糕的事情……真是太糟糕了。 rows.original: Looking thoughtful, Mai sets down her pipe and taps her chin. "Hm. That's a darn good question, an' it's one I'm having trouble answerin'. Ya ain't goin' through any ceremonies that I could bless, an' ya ain't got any home 'round these here parts I could bless an' consecrate, either.[pc.ra kitsune| 'Sides... let's be honest here, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]... there ain't really nothin' I could do f'r ya that ya couldn't be askin' our divine lord for to his face as his champion an' all... ehehehe.] "But if'n yer still askin'... I can perform a cleansin' f'r ya, drive off impurities an' evil influences, that kinda thing. I'm good at bein' thorough an' payin' attention to th' details, so it ain't gonna be anythin' to sneeze at. I also handle th' paperwork an' all, records, census o' th' colonies, keepin' th' calendar... though I'm thinkin' th' likes o' you ain't rightly interested in that kind o' thing." The ritual cleansing, maybe. The rest... a little less. "We ain't got big reason to be caterin' to th' like o' wanderers an' their ilk. I know some Mallachite an' Lumian temples are mostly lookin' after travelers an' such, but this here ain't a shrine f'r pilgrims, it's one f'r the local folk who live 'round these parts. Mebbe if'n ya participated in one o' th' festivals... nah. Sorry, really. Them's th' breaks. Can't do much, 'cause so much o' what I do is f'r folks who've put down roots, an' yer tasks require ya to be blown about by th' wind."
rows.translation: 舞若有所思地放下烟斗，轻轻敲了敲下巴。嗯，这确实是个非常好的问题，不过我也很难回答。你们既不会举行任何我可以为之祝福的仪式，这些地方也没有任何我可以为之祝福和神圣化的场所。[pc.ra kitsune| 各方……说实话吧，伙计。[pc.mf|领主|女士]…其实没什么事情是我能为你做的，而这些事情你完全可以直接去请求我们的神圣领袖，让他以你冠军的身份来为你解决……嘿嘿嘿。] 不过如果你还想知道的话……我可以为你进行净化仪式，驱除那些杂质和邪恶的影响之类的。我做事一向很细致，也很注重细节，所以效果肯定不会让你失望的。另外，文件处理这类工作我也擅长，比如记录管理、殖民地的人口统计，还有日程安排……不过我想，像你这样的人应该对这类事情不太感兴趣吧。 或许需要进行仪式性的净化吧。至于其他方面……就不用太在意了。 我们并没有什么特别的理由要去迎合那些流浪者之流。我知道有些马拉克信徒和卢米安的神庙主要是为旅行者服务的，但这个神殿并不是为朝圣者准备的，而是为生活在这一带的当地居民服务的。或许如果你能参加他们的节日活动的话……算了，实在抱歉。那些活动是有固定时间的，我们也没办法改变什么，因为我的工作主要是为那些已经在这里安顿下来的人们服务的，而你的任务要求你四处漂泊、随风而行。
