当你悄悄离开时，舞会给你一个吻，然后继续忙她女儿的事情去了。当你走出门口时，心中会感到一丝隐隐的酸痛——想到他们两个人在如此艰难的处境下依然能够表现得如此出色，而这一切其实都与你有关……但最终，结果却变得更好了，不是吗？
rows.raw: " Well, then. Given that she's just about to finish her shift, she wouldn't mind if she took you up to see your daughter once she's done, right? [pc.ra kitsune |Smiling, Mai gives you a bow, perhaps deeper than what the situation warrants. "Lil' ol' me woulda be overjoyed to show off yer pride, yer Eminence. If'n ya don't mind none, lemme finish up here an' pass th' shrine to Miko, then we can be seein' yer daughter in all her lil' regal glory." |Mai chuckles and tosses her hair, her demeanor lifting instantly. "Well now. Wouldn't I jus' be th' happiest lil' vixen to be showin' her off to ya. Jus' lemme finish up here an' pass th' shrine to Miko, then we can all be rushin' up together." ] Mai is good to her word — it doesn't take more than half an hour before she's done and leading you away from the shrine. Miko sends the both of you off with a little wave, and the both of you pass through the fields, up the tree's trunk, and into the little bedchamber which she shares with Miko. Komari's hanging around, busying herself with a miniature tree on the windowsill when you walk in; the imperial governor gives the both of you a quick nod before thumbing at the crib in the corner. "[pc.ra kitsune |Well, if it isn't your Eminence and my dear Miyuki. Welcome, welcome, do many yourself comfortable. Your daughter's been very well-behaved today |Ah, I thought I felt someone else coming. Yes, that would make sense — here to see your daughter, are you? Welcome then, [pc.name] — do make yourself comfortable, and don't mind any messes you might see. ]." "She din't spit up none today, did she?" "Only twice, and both times on me. Which is more than what can be said for [rand |Mikoto when she was your age." The way she says it, sounds like there's a story to be had there. "It... well, it isn't much and certainly nothing that you couldn't figure out from what you already know[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ], so I suppose I can tell you. When Mikoto was very young, her hunger drove her to eat a lot, more than her little body could take. Of course, that led to her throwing it right up again, which made a mess and certainly didn't help with the hunger pangs." Komari sighs. "She could never feel sated, so she wouldn't stop crying until her strength gave out. It wasn't her fault, but until we figured out what was wrong with her it was nerve-wracking." ...It must've been hard. |Miyuki when she was your age." The way she says it, sounds like there's a story to be had there. "Granny, ya don't — " Mai begins, but it's already too late. "Hush, girl, your parents went through this, and your grandparents, and so forth; now it's your turn. Now then[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ], when Miyuki was younger she would choose the most absolutely embarrassing times to spit up in public, and with no warning at all. One moment you'd be carrying a cute vixen kit and showing her off to everyone, and the next everyone would be smelling of infant vomit. Her parents eventually got to the point where they didn't dare take her out for fear of her just doing her thing." "Gra-nny!" While amusing in hindsight, it can't have been fun for anyone while it was happening. ] "Four generations have been what they have been, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |that's all I'll say ]. You have a lot of free time when you don't need to eat or sleep; better to do something useful with it than wallow in guilt. Now then, I think I'll leave the both of you to it." Another nod, and then she's gone, taking the bonsai with her. Once she's sure that the coast is clear, Mai skips over to the little bamboo crib and eagerly reaches in, looking amazingly proud and pleased with herself all at the same time. She does have every reason to be, after all, and this Mai as a mother is much better than the one you knew before, if only for that smile. "An' there we have her," Mai purrs as she picks the snoozing two-tailed fox kit out of her crib. "Ain't she jus' th' most amazin' thing ever?" With a mother like that, how could you disagree? You peek down at the tiny figure bundled up in Mai's arms, and can't help but smile. Soft, gray fur the same color as her mother has already begun to sprout in a fuzzy coating, and like an actual fox, she's a lot poofier when young, too. As Mai starts to fuss over your daughter, the little kit starts to stir awake, not so much to demand anything from the either of you but simply content to watch these new and interesting developments. Guess the kid's learned the value of playing hard to get even at a young age; time for you to reach out to her, as it were. [rand |Looking to Mai, you ask her if it's all right for you to hold your daughter for a bit. "I woulda been upset if'n ya din't ask, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ahaha ]. Here, she's all yers." Receiving the little bundle of fluff is an experience unto itself. Mai doesn't need to caution you to be careful with your daughter, although she probably should — holding a tiny fox kit is ticklish given all the squirming going on within the bundle, despite the calm exterior. Four limbs and two tails, coupled with the underlying fluff, make for a wriggly little thing even swaddled up as she is. She's warm. She's fluffy. She's poofy. And those little ears... well, if all of these qualities stay when she grows up, she'll be every bit just as cute a creature as her mother is. "Ya don't need to be flatterin' me none," Mai says, lightly swatting you on the back of the head. "I know that Miko an' I ain't cute in th' least, cute is what Rin does, not us." Haha, if she says so. Your daughter's a pretty hefty creature for being so young, isn't she? Not that your arms are getting tired, but you can certainly feel her weight. "Now imagine what it were like to be keepin' it all in yer belly," Mai chuckles. "Waddlin' 'bout lookin' like yer were two, three months overdue, wonderin' how in all th' gods' names ya were goin' to be gettin' that child outta yer belly, needin' to be balancin' yerself all th' time. I gotta say, ya don't mess 'round when it comes to knockin' folks up, 'cause ya did me good." Ah, she's giving you too much credit. Maybe it's just that she's got a good [silly |baby bag |womb ] on her. You heft your daughter again, prompting her tails to squirm from within the swaddled bundle, and catch her little gaze. She stares back at you, perhaps expectantly, perhaps watchfully. Not going to make a move? Just content to watch? Those big, amber eyes just continue to fix themselves on you. Well then, that's fine. Just existing is enough on her part to bring you contentment. You fuss over your gray-furred daughter for a bit, squeezing gently at her chubby little infant body, then hand her back to her mother. "Feels good, don't it?" Yeah... "Always did when I were younger an' minding other folks' kits, but yer own are always th' best." |Looking to Mai, you ask her if it's all right for you to hold your daughter for a bit. "I woulda been upset if'n ya din't ask, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ahaha ]. Here, she's all yers." As Mai moves to hand you your daughter, though, the little fox kit extends a tiny hand and thumps it against her rack, then squirms up in the swaddled bundle to nuzzle her chest. It's clear what the kit wants, now that she's been woken up from her nap... "Oh, pardon me[pc.ra kitsune, yer Eminence]. Looks like she done want a feedin' now." [pc.isMilky |Can you have a go? You're milky yourself. Mai pauses a second, contemplating your request, then nods and hands your daughter over. "I'm kinda full, but that ain't no matter. Our daughter ain't ever hungry enough that I don't need to be squeezin' meself none, so she's all yers. I know how much this must mean to ya." Well... yes. Mai passes over your daughter, and you find a chair by the window to make yourself comfortable on before pulling aside your [pc.armor] to expose a breast. Sensing the change, your daughter quietly nuzzles up against you expectantly, brushing the firm flesh of your bosom before latching on and pulling at length. Given the reputation for kitsune hunger, you expected to feel tired immediately, but that doesn't happen; looks like your daughter's simply hungry in one sense as the suction begins in earnest and you feel your milk begin to let down. This goes on for a little while, the rhythmic pulling at your [pc.chest] strangely comforting and pleasant in a soothing manner... "Ain't all as cracked up as some folk make it out to be," Mai says, a note of satisfaction in her voice as she watches you with folded arms. "But it ain't as bad as others say it done be, either. Ya jus' do what ya gotta do, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. |ain't I right? ]" That's one way of putting it. Looks like your daughter's a picky eater, too — scarcely has she started that she pulls away from you, satisfied. You hand her back over to Mai, who wipes off and burps the little fox kit before cradling her in her arms. |You understand, watching and spending time together will be just fine for you. Mai dips her head and pulls her top aside to expose a breast; you can only wonder at how much more improved motherhood has made them. Heavy, turgid and ripe with their milky cargo, they're weighty and shapely enough in their own right — it's not just about size, or else Miko could never be dethroned. With just one pregnancy, Mai's body has expanded so well into every possible aspect of glorious maternity, her chest packed with milk-making potential; you inadvertently feel a pang of regret at the prospect of never being able to see how bearing another kit might further improve her, especially in the chest department. Oh, she knows you're watching for, she has to feel her eyes upon you. But Mai is as graceful as her old self as she raises your daughter to her bosom and hums contentedly to herself as she gives suck. Well, there's nothing saying that you can't be a part of this, too. Just as Mai's cuddling your daughter, so do you slide on over and wrap an arm about her waist, pulling mother and daughter close in. The cool heat of Mai's body tickles you as you press her close, and she sighs contentedly before snuggling in. "Well, ain't ya jus' a treat[pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Thank ya kindly." It doesn't last long — looks like your daughter is a picky eater, pulling away from her mother scarcely before she's even started to get going. It's a little hard to believe, but she looks satisfied enough as she snuggles back into Mai's arms, who wipes off and burps the little fox kit before cradling her with a sigh. ] Now then, any chance that you could get some cream too? "Maybe, but it sure ain't now. Gotta tuck th' lil' one in tight an' make sure she don't spit up none. Ya wanna join me?" That sounds fine, especially with a mother as fetching as she is and a daughter that well-behaved. Mai sniffs at the flattery, but clears a space nearby for you to pull up a seat while she sets your daughter back into the crib; the both of you bide your time for a moment while the little fox kit rolls around and eventually dozes off. "Ya ain't wrong, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |ya know ]. Really well-behaved, maybe jus' a lil' too much so." |You reach out with a finger and offer it to the little fox kit, who eyes it warily; she makes a little half-motion, reaching out as if to grab the offered digit, then thinks better of it and snuggles back into her swaddling with a little whuff of breath. Looks like she's learned the art of I-want-it-but-also-don't-want-it extremely well, and at such a young age, too; no doubt she'll be vexing many a lover when she gets older. The only question is, which side of the family did she get this from? Mai very deliberately turns her gaze away from you. "Ain't me, if'n that what yer gettin' at. I were dead inside an' not feelin' much, weren't playin' these push-pull I-weren't-lookin'-at-ya games. An' Miko, she's th' kind o' gal who'll tell ya outright if'n she likes ya." You waggle your finger at the tiny kitsune kit in Mai's arms a little more, and aren't quick enough to jerk it back just as your daughter reaches out and snatches the very tip, squeezing with all the might an infant can muster. Ah... and she instinctively knows when to pounce on the unsuspecting, too. Very nice, very nice. You let your daughter hold on for a little while, savor her victory, and then wiggle your fingertip free. [pc.ra kitsune |Mai thins her lips. "Beggin' yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship's pardon, but I wouldn't be too hasty none in takin' her antics too deeply to heart |Mai raises an eyebrow at that. "I think yer jus' readin' a lil' too much into what a baby's doin', if'n ya ask me ]. I know yer fond o' her an' all, but well, she's really too young to be rememberin' anythin'..." Perhaps, but it's nice to dream, isn't it? "If'n ya ask me, my only dream is that she don't suffer nothin' like Miko an' I done." ] Well, it looks like things are wrapping up just nicely. With everyone and everything at peace, you ought to be going, then. "Stay safe out there, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence. |okay? ] We'll done be waitin' f'r ya. After all, ya'll be needin' to be comin' to this here child's naming ceremony when the time done come, ain't ya?" Yeah... Mai blows you a kiss as you slip out, then returns to the business of minding your daughter. There's a small ache in your heart as you step out the doorway, at how the both of them are taking this extremely well despite the circumstances they're really in and how you're responsible for it all... but it really has turned out all for the better, hasn't it? "

rows.original: [rand |"Every evenin' 'fore I done come on shift with Miko an' every mornin' 'fore I leave her to it, I always done entreat his divine lordship to be takin' care and watchin' over our gal, amongst all th' other things I ask for." Very nice. You don't suppose he's tried to personally involve himself in — well, this is the god of mischief and trickery you're talking about here. Of course he's tried to personally involve himself, hasn't he? "[pc.ra kitsune |Ya'll ain't havin' one on me, are ya, yer Eminence? O' course he is — yer his personal champion an' all, that'd be like not mindin' yer own [pc.mf |son |daughter ]'s kits or somethin'. Yer a lil' ways outside from th' usual structure o' things, but everyone can done tell how fond o' ya his divine lordship is. 'Sides, he's always been close with my family, so that's double reason for him to be comin' in every now an' then to play with th' kit. Ya can be sure he'll be at th' namin' ceremony when it's time, yeah? |Ain't much f'r his divine lordship to be doin' right now, but he did promise to be comin' to their namin' ceremony when it happens. ]" Naming — oh, wait, she hasn't given the kit a name yet? "Nope." Some quaint custom that you're not aware of, no doubt... "Used to be in th' mountain provinces that livin' were bad, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]an' if'n ya had a kid it still weren't a sure thing they'd be makin' it. Common folks... they din't wanna get attached too soon, not until it were more sure the lil' one would be makin' it outta infancy. Where my dad done come from, they din't name Mai an' I until we were six months old an' all..." Their own parents didn't have confidence in their future. "Weren't so much that, but everyone done knew that Granny's bloodline were cursed by her failure. It weren't much in my mom, but she was agreed with my dad that hedgin' their bets were th' smart thing to do. We weren't expected to die or nothin', but... well, ya never know. I sure din't expect to get knocked up none, yeah? "Times are better now f'r most folks since the Celestial Restoration, but it's still done... folks love any reason to be stoppin' work an' havin' fun, an' a naming ceremony is jus' as good an excuse as any other. Sure, th' custom's mostly changed to making th' name official an' all rather than worryin' that th' kit mighta not make it, but Mai an' I agree that in my case stickin' to the true meanin' o' th' custom has more soul to it. "It ain't all bad. I hear in Macah they done do somethin' like that too, have a lil' celebration when a kid done make it through th' first month when it's most dangerous." So, when do your kits get named? "Maybe when they done turn six months like Miko an' I were.[silly | That, by the way, means that it'll probably be epilogue stuff and outside the scope of this game. Don't bother waiting for it in anything but an ending, so there. ]" |Who's caring for your daughter while she's out here at the shrine? "Miko or Granny. They don't mind none, an' Miko done love playin' with children, she don't get tired none o' messin' with her niece. She were always th' one to go about mindin' other folks' babies when we were young, an' Granny... well, she done brought up both Mai an' I, as well as a whole bunch o' others..." And what of Mai herself? Hopefully now that she isn't pregnant any more her mood swings have stabilized somewhat, enough for her to better receive instruction on handling her neuroticism. Mai sighs and flattens her ears. "It goes as it goes[pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence ]. Ya can done look at Miko: sis done got years on me at handlin' herself, an' she's still a glutton on her best days. Ain't gonna be anytime soon that I can be catchin' up to her level, an' I ain't foolin' myself or anyone else." It's still a step that she needed to take. "Ya ain't th' first one to be sayin' that, Granny an' Miko all done been 'I told ya so' f'r these last months. I jus'... well, life's full o' surprises, ain't it? One day yer th' responsible one, th' most likely to be succeedin' yer granny, an' th' next yer out o' favor an' on yer ass without even a smoke to be calmin' yerself down. Buuut yeah. Ya don't need to be worryin' none 'bout our daughter none[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Miko's great an' enthusiastic at handlin' th' young, and me myself, I've dealt with plenty o' kids in my time. Sis an' I, we started trainin' early, if'n ya get what I mean; Granny done made us earn our keep as gals. Yer daughter's gonna be raised right, or at least as right as lil' ol' me can manage..." She doesn't have to put herself down like that. Here, she can have a hug. "Mmmh..." |"Y'know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]sometimes I'm wonderin' if'n there's somethin' wrong with our daughter..." What? Whyever would she say that? "She's jus' all quiet-like all day. Don't mewl, don't yip, don't cry much none." So, she's just like her mother, then. "[pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer Eminence's pardon |Hey! That ain't right. Sure, I was that way ], but that's when I were all hopped up on winterstem an' weren't feelin' nothin. An' by all rights, I were still smokin' th' stuff before Granny done figured I were carryin' yer child, so..." She's worried, huh? "Doin' our daughter a dirty jus' 'cause I were still smokin' is bad, but... I can't help but be wonderin' if'n more than a decade o' usin' that stuff done burned a scar into me or somethin'." Seeing Mai start to sniffle, you hurriedly move to pat her on the head and back. There, there. People in the Marches have been using winterstem as a social thing for a long while now; if there were any truly permanent and deleterious effects, you're sure that someone would've figured it out after generations. "But that there's it, ain't it so? [pc.ra kitsune |Th' folks o' this part o' th' world |Ya lot ] done got a long time to be smokin it, been dion' it f'r generations like ya said. I — d'ya think I'm bein' silly for startin' to be worryin' 'bout it now?" No, not really. If anything, it's a good thing : she wasn't so concerned about long-term winterstem use when it was just her on the line, but now that there's another life dependent on that matter she cares. It's a step up from what she used to be. "I jus' hope yer right an' it's all in my head[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]." |"Sis' jus' done love bein' an aunt. All th' good bits o' having a little fox kit 'round th' place, an' none o' th' bad bits." Well, you wouldn't be so hasty to say that. The sisters are still living together and sleeping in the same bed, isn't that right? Wouldn't that mean Miko still has to do all the work when Mai's out during the day? Mai's lips turn down. "[pc.ra kitsune |Far from it bein' my place to be correctin' yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |Hey! Sure, sis may be livin' under th' same roof as me ], but that don't mean too much! Ya'll make it sound like I'm foistin' th' job onto her — she jus' done take care o' her while I'm out here at th' shrine! Any other time our daughter done get fussy, I gotta drag myself outta bed an' take care o' it 'cause sis is down here, then when she gets off shift she come 'round an' plays with th' baby..." Is she jealous? She looks kind of jealous. "Miko an' I done taken care o' enough children as gals to be knowin' what to expect..." But nothing's really like having your own, right? And that's something that Miko isn't quite in a position to appreciate just yet, especially with someone as carefree as her. "Ain't that th' truth..." Mai looks thoughtful. "Ya know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]while I always knew there were a difference between havin' yer own kits an' mindin' someone else's, it din't strike me none until ya done went an' put one in me. Havin' so much o' my life be revolvin' 'bout someone else who ain't able to be carin' f'r themselves... it done give ya a different way o' lookin' at things, innit?" You wonder if Komari's hope was that Mai would finally drop her drug use after she had kits of her own... which indeed seems to have worked. Then again, while some people clean up their act after having children, others don't and that sort of thing shouldn't be left to chance. Still, it's a good thing that Mai and motherhood have gotten along reasonably well; having such violent mood swings about a fox kit could easily spell disaster should they go awry. It helps that your daughter is the quiet kind who doesn't fuss much... "I'm right here an' can hear ya think, ya know." Well, were any of your musings off the mark? "Weren't wrong, but still ain't polite." Well, she understands now that there's a difference between renting, for lack of a better term to put it, and ownership. Hopefully she keeps that attitude for the next couple of decades. |"Ya know, our daughter ain't one to eat much. When I done go to nurse her, she jus' fusses a lil an' then don't want more. That woulda be fine an' all, but it's kinda odd when yer jus' back from business an' are fit to bust, then she's all 'don't need no more, mom.' I tell ya, I gots plenty left over from squeezin' myself an' ain't able to be givin' it away fast enough. Way things are going, lil' ol' me might even take up th' offer o' bein' a wet nurse on th' side." Oh, having her full and aching isn't an easy thing... but your daughter, though? Kit's just fine, isn't she? Nothing wrong with her? "There ain't nothin' wrong with her, leastways not as far as both her body an' aura can be tellin' me; she ain't losin' weight or underfed or nothin'. She just don't eat much, maybe 's 'cause she's able to get more outta what she eats, or don't have that much comin' out. Either way, if'n it ain't harmin' her none, I'm actually quite glad. Miko's a right glutton an' after livin' with that f'r a lifetime a fox who don't eat much is a nice change." Right. And the other kind of eating... "Oh, she don't eat much in that sense, either. I done been feeding her along with mother's milk, and she don't take much. I wonder if that'll stay with her growin' up." That's... good. At least that probably means it's not a manifestation of the curse on the Kurokawa bloodline. When she first mentioned it, you were quite worried... "Nope." Some quaint custom that you're not aware of, no doubt... "Used to be in th' mountain provinces that livin' were bad, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]an' if'n ya had a kid it still weren't a sure thing they'd be makin' it. Common folks... they din't wanna get attached too soon, not until it were more sure the lil' one would be makin' it outta infancy. Where my dad done come from, they din't name Mai an' I until we were six months old an' all..." Their own parents didn't have confidence in their future. "Weren't so much that, but everyone done knew that Granny's bloodline were cursed by her failure. It weren't much in my mom, but she was agreed with my dad that hedgin' their bets were th' smart thing to do. We weren't expected to die or nothin', but... well, ya never know. I sure din't expect to get knocked up none, yeah? "Times are better now f'r most folks since the Celestial Restoration, but it's still done... folks love any reason to be stoppin' work an' havin' fun, an' a naming ceremony is jus' as good an excuse as any other. Sure, th' custom's mostly changed to making th' name official an' all rather than worryin' that th' kit mighta not make it, but Mai an' I agree that in my case stickin' to the true meanin' o' th' custom has more soul to it. "It ain't all bad. I hear in Macah they done do somethin' like that too, have a lil' celebration when a kid done make it through th' first month when it's most dangerous." So, when do your kits get named? "Maybe when they done turn six months like Miko an' I were.[silly | That, by the way, means that it'll probably be epilogue stuff and outside the scope of this game. Don't bother waiting for it in anything but an ending, so there. ]" |Who's caring for your daughter while she's out here at the shrine? "Miko or Granny. They don't mind none, an' Miko done love playin' with children, she don't get tired none o' messin' with her niece. She were always th' one to go about mindin' other folks' babies when we were young, an' Granny... well, she done brought up both Mai an' I, as well as a whole bunch o' others..." And what of Mai herself? Hopefully now that she isn't pregnant any more her mood swings have stabilized somewhat, enough for her to better receive instruction on handling her neuroticism. Mai sighs and flattens her ears. "It goes as it goes[pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence ]. Ya can done look at Miko: sis done got years on me at handlin' herself, an' she's still a glutton on her best days. Ain't gonna be anytime soon that I can be catchin' up to her level, an' I ain't foolin' myself or anyone else." It's still a step that she needed to take. "Ya ain't th' first one to be sayin' that, Granny an' Miko all done been 'I told ya so' f'r these last months. I jus'... well, life's full o' surprises, ain't it? One day yer th' responsible one, th' most likely to be succeedin' yer granny, an' th' next yer out o' favor an' on yer ass without even a smoke to be calmin' yerself down. Buuut yeah. Ya don't need to be worryin' none 'bout our daughter none[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. Miko's great an' enthusiastic at handlin' th' young, and me myself, I've dealt with plenty o' kids in my time. Sis an' I, we started trainin' early, if'n ya get what I mean; Granny done made us earn our keep as gals. Yer daughter's gonna be raised right, or at least as right as lil' ol' me can manage..." She doesn't have to put herself down like that. Here, she can have a hug. "Mmmh..." |"Y'know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]sometimes I'm wonderin' if'n there's somethin' wrong with our daughter..." What? Whyever would she say that? "She's jus' all quiet-like all day. Don't mewl, don't yip, don't cry much none." So, she's just like her mother, then. "[pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer Eminence's pardon |Hey! That ain't right. Sure, I was that way ], but that's when I were all hopped up on winterstem an' weren't feelin' nothin. An' by all rights, I were still smokin' th' stuff before Granny done figured I were carryin' yer child, so..." She's worried, huh? "Doin' our daughter a dirty jus' 'cause I were still smokin' is bad, but... I can't help but be wonderin' if'n more than a decade o' usin' that stuff done burned a scar into me or somethin'." Seeing Mai start to sniffle, you hurriedly move to pat her on the head and back. There, there. People in the Marches have been using winterstem as a social thing for a long while now; if there were any truly permanent and deleterious effects, you're sure that someone would've figured it out after generations. "But that there's it, ain't it so? [pc.ra kitsune |Th' folks o' this part o' th' world |Ya lot ] done got a long time to be smokin it, been dion' it f'r generations like ya said. I — d'ya think I'm bein' silly for startin' to be worryin' 'bout it now?" No, not really. If anything, it's a good thing : she wasn't so concerned about long-term winterstem use when it was just her on the line, but now that there's another life dependent on that matter she cares. It's a step up from what she used to be. "I jus' hope yer right an' it's all in my head[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]." |"Sis' jus' done love bein' an aunt. All th' good bits o' having a little fox kit 'round th' place, an' none o' th' bad bits." Well, you wouldn't be so hasty to say that. The sisters are still living together and sleeping in the same bed, isn't that right? Wouldn't that mean Miko still has to do all the work when Mai's out during the day? Mai's lips turn down. "[pc.ra kitsune |Far from it bein' my place to be correctin' yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |Hey! Sure, sis may be livin' under th' same roof as me ], but that don't mean too much! Ya'll make it sound like I'm foistin' th' job onto her — she jus' done take care o' her while I'm out here at th' shrine! Any other time our daughter done get fussy, I gotta drag myself outta bed an' take care o' it 'cause sis is down here, then when she gets off shift she come 'round an' plays with th' baby..." Is she jealous? She looks kind of jealous. "Miko an' I done taken care o' enough children as gals to be knowin' what to expect..." But nothing's really like having your own, right? And that's something that Miko isn't quite in a position to appreciate just yet, especially with someone as carefree as her. "Ain't that th' truth..." Mai looks thoughtful. "Ya know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]while I always knew there were a difference between havin' yer own kits an' mindin' someone else's, it din't strike me none until ya done went an' put one in me. Havin' so much o' my life be revolvin' 'bout someone else who ain't able to be carin' f'r themselves... it done give ya a different way o' lookin' at things, innit?" You wonder if Komari's hope was that Mai would finally drop her drug use after she had kits of her own... which indeed seems to have worked. Then again, while some people clean up their act after having children, others don't and that sort of thing shouldn't be left to chance. Still, it's a good thing that Mai and motherhood have gotten along reasonably well; having such violent mood swings about a fox kit could easily spell disaster should they go awry. It helps that your daughter is the quiet kind who doesn't fuss much... "I'm right here an' can hear ya think, ya know." Well, were any of your musings off the mark? "Weren't wrong, but still ain't polite." Well, she understands now that there's a difference between renting, for lack of a better term to put it, and ownership. Hopefully she keeps that attitude for the next couple of decades. |"Ya know, our daughter ain't one to eat much. When I done go to nurse her, she jus' fusses a lil an' then don't want more. That woulda be fine an' all, but it's kinda odd when yer jus' back from business an' are fit to bust, then she's all 'don't need no more, mom.' I tell ya, I gots plenty left over from squeezin' myself an' ain't able to be givin' it away fast enough. Way things are going, lil' ol' me might even take up th' offer o' bein' a wet nurse on th' side." Oh, having her full and aching isn't an easy thing... but your daughter, though? Kit's just fine, isn't she? Nothing wrong with her? "There ain't nothin' wrong with her, leastways not as far as both her body an' aura can be tellin' me; she ain't losin' weight or underfed or nothin'. She just don't eat much, maybe 's 'cause she's able to get more outta what she eats, or don't have that much comin' out. Either way, if'n it ain't harmin' her none, I'm actually quite glad. Miko's a right glutton an' after livin' with that f'r a lifetime a fox who don't eat much is a nice change." Right. And the other kind of eating... "Oh, she don't eat much in that sense, either. I done been feeding her along with mother's milk, and she don't take much. I wonder if that'll stay with her growin' up." That's... good. At least that probably means it's not a manifestation of the curse on the Kurokawa bloodline. When she first mentioned it, you were quite worried... [kiyoko.isFree |"Yeah... now that that been fixed thanks to ya, there's jus' that wee bit 'o hope that it mighta finally be lifted. Right? Everythin's fixed, th' High Lady done been restored to continue her life as it were, an' now there's th' hope that this next generation don't need to be as sis, my cousins, me, everyone done been. That there... lil' ol' me's really wantin' it to be true..." ... |[pc.ra kitsune |"Yeah... ya know, I'm actually hopin' that our gal mighta be spared the burden o' my bloodline an' all. Maybe... maybe it won't hit her 'cause she's also yer daughter, and yer th' divine champion... maybe we'll done be shown mercy f'r jus' one o' us in this case. Ya really want it to be happenin' too, don't ya?" ... |"We'll done know what it is f'r sure down th' line, don't ya worry," Mai replies, a note of forced cheerfulness in her voice. "Th' line's lived with it f'r five generations — well, six generations now, an' it's always been obvious. Ya don't need to worry 'bout it none, it ain't killed none o' us yet. After all, we couldn't be carryin' that burden none if'n we were dead, ain't I right?" ... ] ] |"Ya know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ] our daughter done scare me sometimes. She's all quiet-like when she's awake an' ain't sayin' nothin' or kickin' up a fuss, just lyin' there an' watchin' me as I go 'bout my business. Ain't laughin', ain't cryin' maybe a bit o' a smile but she don't mean it like she wants me to hold her or anythin'. Oh! And it ain't been that long since she were born, an' yet she's movin' her head 'round like it were nothin'! If'n only jus' to watch ya... but 's still amazin'!" An infant just watching her quietly... well, if that isn't something new. "It ain't my imagination none, even Miko done gets unsettled by it sometimes. Says 's like bein' burned straight through. Ain't bad or anythin', jus' intense, but it still ain't a good feelin' none." The curse on the lineage, maybe? Has she spoken to Komari about it? "Curses are supposed to be bad, ain't they? Right now I ain't that bothered, kits bein' quiet are all fine an' dandy with me... but yeah, I did speak with Granny some 'bout it, and she said there were nothin' wrong that she coulda find. I guess it's jus' a lil' creepy to be havin' someone eyein' ya jus' f'r th' sake o' it an' nothin' else. Ain't right, but nothin' ya can do 'bout it." |"Ya know[pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence ]... bein' a mom's done given me a fresh outlook on life. One moment ya can be tired an' grouchy, an' th' next ya can be weepy at how amazin' an' beautiful it all is. Sure, my head probably ain't helpin' none, but it ain't possible f'r everythin' to be up here in my skull, innit?" Well, speaking from your completely objective and unbiased point of view, you really prefer Mai this way. Sure, being all cool and collected had its merits, but at the same time Miko's right in that being deadened to just about everything isn't any way to live life. If her daughter helped her along this path of realization, then all in all this affair was probably a net positive. "That there's one way o' puttin' it, I guess." Mai's expression warms a little. "Leastways I suffered less shame 'round these parts than I woulda done back home... it still all feels kinda strange, like I don't feel like I were me any more. Like I were wakin' up from a dream an' I were someone else, but that there's all in th' past..." Does she still have moments where she goes absolutely hysterical and forgets herself completely? "I'm workin' on it[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. It ain't easy none. Expectin' myself to be learnin' in a bunch o' months what done took Miko a lifetime ain't happenin'." And yet she's doing it... and if she needs any help, she knows who to ask. "Much appreciated." ] "

rows.original: "Oh, yeah. I'm always willin' to talk 'bout this, 'cause I know how important it is. [pc.ra kitsune |Ye done become one o' us now, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady], an' it's important to someone in yer role as our divine lord's handpicked champion an' all that ya don't jus' look like a kitsune, but also know yer new roots. With in mind, it falls upon folks like lil' ol' me to do the explainin' required so that yer understandin' th' culture an' traditions that ya chose to adopt. It ain't gonna be easy, but ya understood that right clear when ya signed up f'r this, yeah? |It ain't often that an outsider like ya gets to be in a position o' askin' 'bout how we live our lives an' what we believe in... at this point, really, anythin' to disabuse th' idea that we're nowt more than monsters f'r either fuckin' or killin' is gonna help. That yer showin' an interest by askin' is already more'n what most would give us credit f'r. ] "So yeah, to begin with, my job here as shrine maiden — an' later, a priestess like Granny — is to help folks get right with their relationship to th' spiritual. Ain't really got any doctrine to be preachin' in th' first place; Keros ain't really th' kind to sit folks down an' lecture at them f'r hours — which jus' makes th' Great Rebuke so damnin'. "But I'm digressin' here, ain't I? Miko's better at sussin' out kami an' hearin' why they're angry, so she does that; while I know how to do her job if'n she say, fell ill, I far prefer to work with smaller things. It's still th' same — making sure that livin' folk an' kami are at peace with each other. Folks come in with offerin's an' all; I make sure that they're properly presented to our divine lord an' all, then taken down at th' end of th' day f'r Miko, Granny an' I to, uh, partake of after his divine lordship's had his fill." Wait... so the offerings meant for Keros eventually go to them? "Ya find that surprisin'? Donations an' offerin's are also f'r th' shrine's upkeep... ya do things differently 'round here? Was under th' impression that at least Lumians done collected somethin' called tithes, which more or less are th' same thing, ain't they?" No, you're just a bit surprised that the offerings made to Keros would be later put into Mai's dinner. "Nah, it's all right. 'Sides, it ain't good to waste food none, an' our divine lord's perfectly fine with it. He's come down once or twice an' had dinner with us, y'know. Good at holdin' a conversation, but that there's only to be expected, no?" She's talking about dining with a deity as if it was like having a friend over for a meal. A very respected and honored friend, perhaps, but a friend nevertheless. For all the etiquette, rules and unspoken social expectations kitsune live by, they're surprisingly informal when it comes to religion when compared to other peoples. Sure, it makes perfect sense for the Trickster, but at the same time with their society being the way it is... "Plenty o' observances an' ceremonies, that kinda stuff. Ya got to follow th' Way, as it stands, an' everyone's path is slightly different an' all. Still, most o' th' rules an' customs can be distilled down to four basic precepts, though, that everyone from th' greatest aristocrat to th' common folk should follow to make sure they get right with th' spiritutal an' all. "Firstly, ya gotta respect tradition an' th' family. Back in th' Old Country, ain't uncommon f'r families to have their own minor kami that done glommed onto their lineage since ages past. What they do exactly varies, but generally respectin' th' ways yer ancestors done things is a good idea to be keepin' yer ancestral spirits pleased an' all. "Secondly, ya gotta respect th' natural world. Most people ain't able to outright see auras an' kami like Miko an' I can, but that don't prevent them none from their wrath when they done get angered. Ya show appreciation f'r th' bounty o' nature, from th' food ya eat to th' clothes ya wear, an' give thanks appropriately. Sounds small, but it's an important connection to have with th' spiritual, bein' grateful f'r th' what mercies life has in store f'r ya. "Thirdly, ya oughta strive f'r purity an' shun th' impure; certain deeds an' actions create ritual impurities that ya should seek to avoid an' cast out from yerself. That's where I come in... ya go an' get yerself all filthy on th' inside, I gotta take th' time to clean ya right up so yer presentable to yer ancestors an' in balance with th' world. Ain't nothin' more important than that, spiritually speakin'; I can see the stains folks are wearin' an' a lot o' them ain't pretty. "Lastly, ya gotta honor th' festivals, th' various matsuri. Me, I love workin' th' logistics an' th' ritual dances; leaving Miko an' Granny to sort out th' organization an' dealin' with folks is jus' fine with me. Crowds make my head hurt with all th' noise they make. "An' that's 'bout it. These four precepts ain't hard to understand, but actually followin' them is harder for folks than ya think; temptation can be hard to ward off an' all, especially considerin' our natures. Th' job o' folk born into priestly clans like me, a big part o' our job is settin' things right when th' local spirits done get angered. Can be a tricky affair sussin' them out in th' first place, let alone dealin' with them." You see. Could she tell you something more from her point of view? You'd like to understand it better.
rows.translation: 哦，没错。我总是很乐意谈论这个话题，因为我知道它的重要性。 [pc.ra kitsune |你现在也是我们中的一员了，嗯。[pc.mf|领主|女士]对于你这样的角色来说，这确实非常重要——毕竟你是我们神圣领袖亲自挑选的冠军啊。你不仅得看起来像一只狐妖，还得真正了解自己新的身份与背景。因此，像我这样的小人物，就有责任为你解释这些，让你真正理解你所选择接受的文化与传统。这肯定不会容易，但你在报名参加这个任务的时候，就应该已经清楚这一点了吧？ |像你这样的外人，其实并不经常有机会来询问我们是如何生活的、我们信仰什么……在这个节骨眼上，任何能够打破那种认为我们只不过是会厮杀和杀戮的怪物这种观念的东西，都会起到帮助作用。你通过提问来表现出兴趣，这一点就已经比大多数人愿意给予我们的认可还要多了。 ] 所以，总的来说，我在这里担任神殿少女——后来又成为了像奶奶那样的女祭司——的职责就是帮助人们建立起与灵性的正确联系。其实并没有什么特定的教义需要宣扬；凯洛斯也并不是那种会坐下来给人们讲上几个小时的大师——正因为如此，‘伟大的斥责’才会显得如此有力。 不过我有点跑题了吧？米可更擅长察觉那些‘神明’的情绪，了解他们为何会生气，所以她才会去做那些事；而如果米可说她生病了，我虽然也能胜任她的工作，但我更喜欢处理一些规模较小的任务。归根结底，目的都是一样的——确保那些活生生的人们能够神明大家彼此和睦相处。人们会带来各种礼物，我会确保把这些礼物妥善呈献给我们的神明，然后在一天结束时把它们留下来，让米科、奶奶和我一起享用，等我们的神明享用过后再吃。 等等……原来原本是为凯洛斯准备的东西最终都归他们所有了？ 你觉得这很奇怪吗？捐款和自愿奉献也是用来维护这座神殿的……你们这里的做事方式确实与众不同啊。我原本以为至少卢米安人也会缴纳某种类似什一税的东西，其实这两者本质上是差不多的，对吧？ 不，你只是有点惊讶而已——原来原本给凯罗斯准备的食物，后来竟然被加到了迈的晚餐里。 没事的，真的。再说，浪费食物可不好，我们的神明大人也不会介意的。他已经有了一两次和我们一起吃晚餐了，你知道的。他很会聊天，不过这也挺正常的吧？ 她把与一位神明共进晚餐形容得就像邀请一位朋友来家里吃饭一样。当然，这位朋友或许备受尊敬和敬仰，但归根结底仍然只是朋友而已。尽管狐族严格遵守各种礼仪规范、规则以及那些不成文的社会期望，但在宗教信仰方面，他们却出人意料地表现得相当随意，与其他民族相比尤为如此。当然，对于这个以诡计多端著称的种族来说，这种行为也确实合情合理；但考虑到他们社会的整体特性…… 各种各样的仪式和规矩，就是这类东西。你必须遵循现有的道路，不过每个人的道路都有所不同。不过，大多数规则和习俗都可以归结为四条基本准则，无论是最尊贵的贵族还是普通的百姓，都应该遵守这些准则，这样才能确保自己在精神层面上得到正确的引导。 首先，你必须尊重传统和家庭。在老挝，很多家庭都会有自己的小传统或习俗。神明这些传统早已融入他们的血脉之中，世代相传。具体做法可能各有不同，但一般来说，遵循祖先们的行事方式，才是让祖先的灵魂感到满意的最佳方式。 其次，你必须尊重自然世界。大多数人根本无法看到光环之类的东西。神明就像米可和我一样，但这并不能阻止他们在愤怒时发泄情绪。我们应该感激大自然赐予的一切——从我们吃的食物到穿的衣物——并适当地表达感谢。这听起来可能很微不足道，但实际上，这种对大自然和生活中种种恩惠的感激之情，是我们与精神世界建立联系的重要纽带。 第三，你应该努力追求纯洁，远离不洁之物；某些行为会带来仪式上的污秽，你必须尽量避免这些行为，并将其从自己身上清除掉。这就是我的作用……当你的内心变得污秽不堪时，我就需要花时间将你净化，让你能够以体面的姿态面对祖先，让你的存在与这个世界保持和谐。从精神层面来说，没有比这更重要的了；我能够做到这一点。看到人们身上那些污渍，很多看起来都挺难看的。 最后，你必须尊重各种节日和庆典。祭典我，就是我。爱负责后勤工作以及那些仪式性的舞蹈表演；让米可和大奶奶来处理组织事务和与人打交道，我觉得这样完全没问题。人群发出的噪音真的会让我头痛不已。 就这些了。这四条戒律其实并不难理解，但真正遵守它们却比大家想象的要困难得多；诱惑实在很难抵挡，尤其是考虑到我们的天性。像我这样出生在祭司家族的人，我们的职责之一就是在当地的神灵发怒时设法平息事端。要首先弄清楚他们到底在生气什么，就已经是一件很棘手的事情了，更不用说如何去处理它们了。 你看，她能不能从她的角度再告诉你一些事情呢？你希望更深入地了解这件事。

Wait... so the offerings meant for Keros eventually go to them? "Ya find that surprisin'? Donations an' offerin's are also f'r th' shrine's upkeep... ya do things differently 'round here? Was under th' impression that at least Lumians done collected somethin' called tithes, which more or less are th' same thing, ain't they?" No, you're just a bit surprised that the offerings made to Keros would be later put into Mai's dinner. "Nah, it's all right. 'Sides, it ain't good to waste food none, an' our divine lord's perfectly fine with it. He's come down once or twice an' had dinner with us, y'know. Good at holdin' a conversation, but that there's only to be expected, no?" She's talking about dining with a deity as if it was like having a friend over for a meal. A very respected and honored friend, perhaps, but a friend nevertheless. For all the etiquette, rules and unspoken social expectations kitsune live by, they're surprisingly informal when it comes to religion when compared to other peoples. Sure, it makes perfect sense for the Trickster, but at the same time with their society being the way it is... "Plenty o' observances an' ceremonies, that kinda stuff. Ya got to follow th' Way, as it stands, an' everyone's path is slightly different an' all. Still, most o' th' rules an' customs can be distilled down to four basic precepts, though, that everyone from th' greatest aristocrat to th' common folk should follow to make sure they get right with th' spiritutal an' all. "Firstly, ya gotta respect tradition an' th' family. Back in th' Old Country, ain't uncommon f'r families to have their own minor kami that done glommed onto their lineage since ages past. What they do exactly varies, but generally respectin' th' ways yer ancestors done things is a good idea to be keepin' yer ancestral spirits pleased an' all. "Secondly, ya gotta respect th' natural world. Most people ain't able to outright see auras an' kami like Miko an' I can, but that don't prevent them none from their wrath when they done get angered. Ya show appreciation f'r th' bounty o' nature, from th' food ya eat to th' clothes ya wear, an' give thanks appropriately. Sounds small, but it's an important connection to have with th' spiritual, bein' grateful f'r th' what mercies life has in store f'r ya. "Thirdly, ya oughta strive f'r purity an' shun th' impure; certain deeds an' actions create ritual impurities that ya should seek to avoid an' cast out from yerself. That's where I come in... ya go an' get yerself all filthy on th' inside, I gotta take th' time to clean ya right up so yer presentable to yer ancestors an' in balance with th' world. Ain't nothin' more important than that, spiritually speakin'; I can see the stains folks are wearin' an' a lot o' them ain't pretty. "Lastly, ya gotta honor th' festivals, th' various matsuri. Me, I love workin' th' logistics an' th' ritual dances; leaving Miko an' Granny to sort out th' organization an' dealin' with folks is jus' fine with me. Crowds make my head hurt with all th' noise they make. "An' that's 'bout it. These four precepts ain't hard to understand, but actually followin' them is harder for folks than ya think; temptation can be hard to ward off an' all, especially considerin' our natures. Th' job o' folk born into priestly clans like me, a big part o' our job is settin' things right when th' local spirits done get angered. Can be a tricky affair sussin' them out in th' first place, let alone dealin' with them." You see. Could she tell you something more from her point of view? You'd like to understand it better."

rows.original: "Eh." Mai wiggles her ears and puffs on her pipe. "Since Miko an' I could walk, we were done schooled in kami-no-michi — in yer tongue, that's 'th' was o' th' spirit gods.' We were driven hard, an' even harder still when our family done realized seein' auras, energies an' kami came as easily to us as breathin'. I think that there's where Miko's bad attitude towards work done come from — she done got pushed too hard an' bounced back. Either ways, when Granny done asked us to come to th' colonies an' help her out, ain't no question about us goin'. An yeah, so here we are. "There're other things that we gotta do that ain't directly related to worship 'o th' Trickster, but are still part an' parcel of us bein' in our roles an' all. Like it or not, our kind plays quite th' role in anywhere we live, an' it's up to us to help th' aristocrats in their rule — heck, ain't there quite a few places where th' priests an' aristocrats done come from th' same clan. But back to th' point — when we're not on duty at th' shrine, we gots lotsa other things that need doin'. We gotta care f'r th' gardens an' shrine, make sure everythin's all nice-lookin'. Scrub out th' baths. Spend a couple hours every week teachin' th' local kits what their parents ain't got th' mind to teach. I do a bit o' seifukujutsu on th' side; since body an' spirit are joined closely ya gotta take a holistic approach in dealin' with either. Whole buncha stuff that I coulda go on 'bout, but I think ya get th' idea here." Yes. Yes, indeed. "Truth be told, [pc.ra kitsune|m'[pc.mf|lord|lady], ]this here ain't really so much a religion like th' way a Mallachite or Tiran mighta put it. This is a way o' life, an' jus' sittin' 'round an' flappin' ya lips ain't gonna get across th' heart o' th' matter. Ya gotta live it f'r years, maybe all yer life, to properly internalise it all. That's all I really gotta say 'bout it. "Well. Got anythin' else ya wanna know[pc.ra kitsune|, yer Eminence]?"
rows.translation: 呃。舞摇了摇耳朵，然后开始吸她的烟斗。自从我和米可会走路以后，我们就再也不用去上学了。神之道用你们的语言来说，那就是“那些属于灵神的力量”。我们被迫不停地前进，而当我们的家人开始真正看到那些光环、那些能量时，我们的压力就更大了神明对我们来说，这就像呼吸一样自然。我想，米科对工作态度消极的原因就在这里——她曾经被逼得太紧，然后又遭受了挫折。不管怎样，当奶奶邀请我们去殖民地帮她忙时，我们没有丝毫犹豫，立刻就答应了。就这样，我们来到了这里。 还有其他一些事情我们需要去做，这些事情与崇拜‘戏弄者’并没有直接关系，但它们仍然是我们履行各自职责的重要组成部分。无论我们是否愿意，我们这个群体在任何地方生活时都会扮演一定的角色，而帮助贵族们进行统治也是我们的责任——说实在的，很多地方的神父和贵族其实都来自同一个氏族吧。但回到正题——当我们不在神社值班的时候，还有很多其他事情需要去做。我们必须照顾好花园和神社，确保一切看起来都井井有条。还要清洗那些浴池。每周还要花几个小时来教导那些当地的孩子一些他们的父母没有时间教他们的知识。我稍微做了一点秘传武术从整体来看，既然身体与精神是紧密相连的，那么在处理这两者时就必须采取全面的方法。还有很多其他方面可以讨论，但我想你应该已经明白我的意思了。 是的，确实如此。 说实话， [pc.ra kitsune|m[pc.mf|领主|女士]， ]其实，这并不像马拉克信徒或蒂拉信徒所说的那样，是一种宗教信仰。这是一种生活方式，仅仅坐在那里空谈是远远无法理解其中真正的含义的。你必须亲身去体验它，也许需要花费很多年的时间，甚至是一生，才能真正将其内化为自己的生活方式。关于这一点，我真正想说的就是这些。 嗯，还有其他你想知道的事情吗？[pc.ra kitsune|阁下]？"

rows.original: [var0 |[rand |"Well, 's good lil' sis is on th' mend. Her body's jus' fine thanks to my efforts, but she's gonna need some time to set her head on th' mend — plenty o' loose ends rattlin' 'bout inside of that skull o' hers, I daresay. She's gonna need a lot o' cheerin' up in th' days to come, even if she ain't lettin' it on." And is she going to help herself? "D'ya think I'm good at cheerin' folks up, [pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]? I ain't so dead inside I don't know cheerin' folks up oughta be one o' th' last things I shoulda be doin'. I done my part tyin' her down to th' futon an' makin' sure she stayed off her feet. Ain't gonna lie, she's got a strong will an' it took a whole lotta druggin' 'fore she'd lie down an' keep quiet, recover from her wounds. But thing is, even th' strongest will done got a point where it'll break, an' lil' sis has been through a lot o' late. "Now, I ain't blamin' ya none f'r not being around when all this here stuff was goin' down; there ain't no way you coulda known yer home was gonna get raided[pc.ra kitsune | an' I woulda never accuse yer Eminence of negligence ]. All I'm sayin' is that I done my part, an' beggin' yer pardon, but now it's time f'r ya to do yers an' stand by yer family an' all. Three cornerstones of yer life and th' people 'bout ya — yer liege, yer clan an' family, an' th' gods. Make good on them, yeah?" |"I'm glad nothin' happened to lil' sis." You're glad nothing happened to Kinu, too. You — "She's th' only one in th' den aside from Granny who can play a game o' shogi worth a damn. Ain't fun in th' least playin' someone who ain't able to put up a fight, an I can't be askin' Granny to be playin' me every evenin'. Would be sad if'n she weren't 'round to play me no more." You give Mai an incredulous look; she returns your gaze by blowing a large plume of winterstem smoke into the air. "[pc.ra kitsune |Something th' matter, yer Eminence |Yer lookin' at me funny now; was it somethin' lil' ol' me said ]?" You just shake your head. Of all the things Kinu is to so many people, the most outstanding quality of your daughter's, the one Mai would miss most — or at least, the one that comes to mind immediately — is her skill at a board game? "Ain't nothin' to turn yer nose up at, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya know ]. Lil' sis an' I got plenty o' games in when she was on bedrest an' I done had to watch her, make sure she didn't sneak out. 'S were good game, especially 'cause th' both o' us were as high as damn-all while at it. Lil' sis made a couple o' plays I'd never considered... not that it done her much good, heh. There's already plenty o' people singin' her praises for bein' pretty, brave, lovin'... ain't out o' th' question f'r someone to be admirin' her for bein' able to play a killer game o' shogi. I'm sure ya agree that yer daughter's done got a whole bunch o' facets, an' every one o' them are woth somethin', ya know?" Kinu spending days upon days lying in bed drugged up on winterstem smoke, playing board games — you're not sure how to feel about that. Mai shrugs. "Had to give her somethin' f'r th' pain. Was that, or have her moanin' an' itchin' all over. Think we can agree on not causing lil' sis any unnecessary pain than it were, yes?" |"Ya know, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]I downright had a scare when th' torii gate done started malfunctionin' an' all. Ain't never seen nothin' like that, an' it's Miko and my job to keep it in shape, amongst other things. After Granny an' her pet madman done had a look-see at th' jammin' device an' figured out how it was done, I don't think it'll be happenin' again — leastways, not with th' same exploit they done used this time to lock down th' gate." It's not something she expected, was it? "The base o' the workin's, they're based on th' old waystones that were common 'bout the Belharan Empire three centuries ago. Then on top o' that, we done made a whole bunch o' refinements to th' base concept on our own. Like I said, f'r somethin' like this to show up, it means the bastards who done gone after lil' sis had backin', an' powerful backin' at that. Ya got someone with knowledge o' how these things work, an' the power to put that knowledge to use. That there's a dangerous mix, lemme tell ya. "Still, Granny just done prepared a report to send back across th' ocean, so all th' other gates can be hardened against interference an' all. Ain't no one lettin' that vulnerability stand f'r long — someone's gonna lose their head outta shame f'r this. What happened last time ain't gonna happen again, I tell you — first sign o' trouble an' we'll be gettin' to lil' sis lickety-split." |"Did ya notice any damage to th' den when ya returned home?" Actually, no. It wasn't that much different from when you left, actually — one could easily believe that nothing of import had happened while you were away. Well, there was a bit of soot here and there, now that you think about it, but until Kinu told you about what happened to her you could've believed that everything was just peachy keen. "Ain't it great when folks done come together an' get stuff done? Lil' sis weren't on bed rest that long, an' we done made th' place livable before then. A couple o' days more, an' it was mostly right as rain. Ain't a single soul 'round these parts who didn't want to pitch in an' fix up th' place — not just for High Lady Otomo, but also lil' sis as well. The old buildings that weren't in use, we let stay scorched an' burnt, but everythin' that lil' sis [kiyoko.numKits 2 |an' yer family ]done use, we all got together an' threw up new ones in record time. Ain't nothin' to be afraid of when we're all gathered together close-like." |"[kiyoko.numKits 4 |I din't quite believe it when Granny first told me she were bringin' yer lil' wispy gal Asagiri back to th' shrine and making her a shrine maiden along with th' two o' us. Then I took one look at her, an'..." Mai takes her pipe out of her mouth and whistles appreciatively. "Damn if her aura weren't an utterly amazin' an' terrifying sight. I used to see her playin' around th' den, buggin' Kohaku for taiyaki while out on' errands, an' she weren't nothin' to write home about. Now, her aura's done overflowin' like a geyser, pourin' out spiritual energy all over th' place." The experience Asagiri went through, her siblings and eldest sister went through, it changed them all. For better or for worse on the whole remains to be seen, but the change is undeniable. "Have ya seen her?" N-no, not really. It hurts to even think about it... and enrages you at the same time. "I can understand. Jus' to keep in mind... th' gal's ain't ruined by th' experience, but is stronger for it. Asagiri, she ain't any worse off than Mai or me, we jus' done got prettier faces and are better at hidin' it, that's all. Th' gal's genuinely cheerful despite all that's happened to her and her kin... 's a small mercy. Even somethin' like this ain't puttin' yer gal down an' it shouldn't make ya despair or get blinded by anger[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. Jus' remember that." You'll try. Is she doing well? "Kinda too early to tell, but by all means ter gal's doin' quite well in the days she's done been with us. Asagiri's smart — though she ain't as smart as her [silly |big sis |nee-sama ] — and can read fast. Her body still ain't done healin' an' it's hurtin' some even through th' medication, so we ain't askin' her to do many physical chores. Th' potential to be so much more is there, though — 's overflowin' off her thin lil' wispy body. Her aura ain't too different from a geyser, plumin' upward from her head in a huge wash o' color an' falling onto all th' folks 'bout her. That there's something ya don't see every day." You sigh. You've [pc.bgMulti hunter barbarian scholar acolyte |encountered certain species of pines in your past as a hunter in the wilderness |encountered certain species of pines out in the wilds back in your days as a barbarian |read about certain species of pines in this part of the world in the library |read about certain species of pines in this part of the world in the monastery's library |heard about certain species of pines in this part of the world ]. They can only scatter their seeds after a wildfire — the flames scorch the cones and release the seeds within, which find plenty of space and fertile ash to grow in after the fire has passed. This is something similar, you suppose... "Sure looks like it. Ain't no one in their right mind wants harm to come to th' defenseless... but at th' same time, one oughta not let their kits lead too sheltered a life. I ain't sayin' nothin' 'bout Asagiri, but ya get my general gist, right?" |"Lil' sis — she's been askin' me f'r some winterstem. Not yer weak stuff ya can find growin' in th' woods or what I done used to keep her down durin' her bedrest, but th' strong stuff I keep f'r myself. An' each time she's asked, I've said no; she an't gettin' none o' mine." Good call. Thanks for doing that — you certainly don't want Kinu stuck with a pipe in her mouth all day like Mai. "I ain't smokin' this stuff f'r fun, I smoke it 'cause I need to, an' probably will f'r th' rest o' my life; ain't no curin' what I have, an' I don't wanna be cured nonehow. Lil' sis, she's hurtin', but pain's got a purpose — it done tells ya what's wrong with ya, an' unlike me that hurt o' hers can heal. If'n I dope her up, make her dead inside like I am, ain't no goin' back from that — not easily anyhow." To emphasise her point, Mai takes a long drag on her pipe and blows a ring of fine white smoke. You're... you're thankful she told you this. "[kinu.isInari |Lil' sis ain't good at lyin' or hidin' her emotions, so it'd have come out sooner or later — but by then it mighta be too late |Lil' sis ain't one to let her emotions show f'r th' sake o' others, but I ain't 'bout to let her go to these lengths ]. Was worried lil' ol' me wouldn't be gettin' my point across loud an' clear." ] ] |[rand |"Oh[pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, |! ] I done heard 'bout what happened to lil' sis an' Kohaku. You wouldn't blame her — it would be like blaming the doorman for what happened on the road. That's just silly. "Ah, but perceptions are what matter, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence. 'S somethin' ya gotta experience f'r yerself |regardless of th' truth o' th' situation ]... like it or not, sis an' I, we'd still be implicated plenty. Still, it's good lil's sis don't held her ground." And the gate? "Ain't no one supposed to be usin' it except f'r ya, yer company, an' Granny. Th' passageway through to th' [silly|Myobu-sama |High Lady ]'s home don't really go through th' Ways Between — " Really? "Kinda sorta. 'S complicated, but I can tell ya that it's safe[pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence ]. Ya don't hafta worry 'bout 'lil sis gettin' ambushed when comin' an' goin' from here — she'll be as safe as can be." |[kiyoko.numKits 4 |"Yer daughter Asagiri — th' gal's cottonin' on to all th' basics really nicely. Mai blows a plume of winterstem smoke and tilts her head at you ]. "She's gonna be a sight to see when she done gets older, ain't that the truth." If that's the case, someone's got to take care of her education so she doesn't accidentally hurt herself or other people, and you're grateful that the sisters are handling that because you can't quite do it yourself as things are. "Ain't lyin' when I say working with th' gal is a right treat. She may be large, but I can see why her lady mother done named her that — she's all 'round ya, but unless yer lookin' out f'r her ya don't notice her none. Quiet thing she is, an' that kinda temperament suits her f'r workin' with th' like o' me. Ain't Miko right jealous, eh?" So... that keeps her awake at night? It won't adversely affect Asagiri's health, will it? "Don't ya worry none[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. We're foxes, we can be nocturnal if'n we wanna be. "Still mostly how to get that power o' hers under control, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |truth be told ]," Mai replies. "'S takin' a good while, ain't that the truth, but necessary if'n she knows what's good f'r her. Th' more ya have, th' finer th' degree o' control we want ya to have 'fore ya can move onto th' more flashy stuff. She don't learn things as fast as lil' sis none... but Asa sure do have a lot 'o patience f'r a kid her age. Kinda like me, if'n I may say, but I ain't normal an' frankly, neither is she, no offense." |"I've done been trying to spend a couple o' my off-duty hours with lil' sis, or leastways more than what I was doin' already. She done need th' support, even if'n it's jus' playin' shogi or go... help her take her mind off things, ya know what I mean[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]?" You have to thank her for watching out for Kinu, not just now in her time of need, but for before. Circumstances have dictated that you can't be there all the time for your fox-daughter, but that she has friends looking out for her at all times is the next best thing. "Ain't no need to thank me in th' least, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ] — spendin' time with lil' sis ain't no chore. It ain't work if'n ya enjoy it, an' she's one o' th' few people who can give me intellectual stimulation. Even my sis, bless her big ol' hungry heart, ain't able to do that — leastways not on th' level lil' sis does." Well, however she does it, however she feels about it, you still have to be grateful for her watching out for Kinu, and you mean it from the bottom of your heart. ] |[kiyoko.numKits 4 |You're never actually noticed Asagiri coming over to the shrine, even if she does it at night. Between that an' Granny takin' her in hand, lil' ol' me can still get 'bout my duties no problem, especially when it comes down to someone as [pc.ra kitsune |important as ya, yer Eminence |fetchin' as ya ]." "Despite her bein' a big gal an' already a half-head taller than lil' sis despite bein' five or six years younger, ain't no one noticin' her if'n she don't wanna be noticed. Her name ain't 'mornin' mist' f'r nothin' — she can be all 'round ya and ya'd never know it." ... "We done get some practice in f'r an hour or two every night, but most of what she does is jus' sit herself down where her big sis does in th' day an' read by lamplight. Asa's a quiet gal, quiet an' docile. Ain't nothin' like her big sis, who knows to make herself known when the mood done take her." You... when you have the time after all this is over, you should really sit down and spend some time with the rest of your children. While Kiyoko and Kinu have mostly served as your liaisons with your family, there's something to be said for getting personal. Not today, though... not today. |"Oh, did you know? Between that an' Granny takin' her in hand, lil' ol' me can still get 'bout my duties no problem, especially when it comes down to someone as [pc.ra kitsune |important as ya, yer Eminence |fetchin' as ya ]." Mai blows out a perfect ring of winterstem smoke and flutters her eyelashes at you. "Despite her bein' a big gal an' already a half-head taller than lil' sis despite bein' five or six years younger, ain't no one noticin' her if'n she don't wanna be noticed. Her name ain't 'mornin' mist' f'r nothin' — she can be all 'round ya and ya'd never know it." ... "We done get some practice in f'r an hour or two every night, but most of what she does is jus' sit herself down where her big sis does in th' day an' read by lamplight. Asa's a quiet gal, quiet an' docile. Ain't nothin' like her big sis, who knows to make herself known when the mood done take her." You... when you have the time after all this is over, you should really sit down and spend some time with the rest of your children. While Kiyoko and Kinu have mostly served as your liaisons with your family, there's something to be said for getting personal. Not today, though... not today. |"Oh, did you know? Lil' sis done refused a security detail on her th' other day." Really? "Ain't it th' truth. My cus Nakano wanted to put himself or one o' his people on her at all times — [kinu.isInari |she flat out said no, 'cause havin' a warrior lookin' over her shoulder all th' time when she was tillin' th' fields just ain't done. Can't get no work in if'n everyone's all self-conscious an' steppin' on eggshells all over th' place, she said |but she told him that ain't done f'r a princess like her an' she needs to show folks that she ain't afraid none; also, it would be kinda improper f'r anyone but him to do it, on account of them bein' engaged an' all ]. That, an' his people are already done stretched so thin — sparin' one o' them to be her bodyguard jus' ain't done when everyone's already lookin' out f'r her. Wouldn't accomplish much, and she'd be takin' folks away from where they could be doin' more good." You're conflicted on that — on one hand, Kinu rejecting a bodyguard makes sense, and her reasoning isn't spurious. On the other hand... she knows she's a target at this point, and it feels a little lackadaisical if not irresponsible. "Yer makin' th' same face my cus made, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, ]an' I can understand why. Like it or not, both o' ya are deeply concerned over lil' sis' safety, an' ya wanna be there f'r her but either she won't let ya, or ya can't." Mai chuckles dryly. "She's a big gal now, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya know ], an' if'n nothin' else she's shown she can handle a weapon. Twice ain't jus' lucky." ] |"Oh? The gate bein' on lockdown ain't bothered us none[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. 'S not like any o' us are welcome back in th' Old Country anyway... lil' Kohaku was th' only one who had any reason to make th' crossin' regularly, an' we don't actually need th' stuff that she done brings back. Oh sure, lil' ol' me might be a bit sad over not havin' miso eggplant none, but it ain't that bothersome." None of them are welcome back home, she says... "Ain't that th' truth — we're th' cursed, th' weirdos, th' disgraced an' shamed, th' folk who don't fit in right. That, or we're th' sons an' daughters of such, an' every shaper knows that cursed roots don't bear no good fruit. Just lookit Granny, an' now lookit us. This here is our home away from home, an' there ain't no reason to go nowhere most o' th' time. Most o' what we actually need can be made right here in th' colonies, be it from th' outlying camps or here in th' tree. "The gate's always open to th' likes of ya, naturally. Don't ya worry none about tryin' to drop in one day an' findin' it closed to ya." Isn't she worried that these people might try and pretend to be you in order to get direct access into the heart of their living fortress? "[pc.ra kitsune |Yer Eminence |Oh ], yer aura is kinda unique. Ain't nothin' like it Miko an' I ever done seen before, an' maybe we'll never see again f'r as long as we live. Ain't no way we're mistakin' it for anyone else's, an' I don't think there's any way anyone could ever be hopin' to fake it. That there thing defies belief, I swear." You can't see auras, so you'll have to take her word for it. But presumably the sisters know what they're about, so you won't question them any further. |There are other kitsune settlements in and about the Marches other than this place, is that right? "That ain't wrong, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence ]— ya got a bunch o' prospectors diggin' 'bout th' place, tiny rovin' tent places movin' from one digsite to another. Ain't much to speak of, really. Somethin' on yer mind?" You're just wondering why these people chose to strike in the Ways Between and not, say, these isolated groups who probably wouldn't be able to defend themselves. "Can't say f'r sure meself, but I can make a couple o' guesses[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. What I'm thinkin' is that it wouldn't achieve much, if'n ya can believe that creep when he said their goal is to drive us out o' these lands. Let's face it... we all know these lands can be summat dangerous, an' 's not th' first time folk go out prospectin' an' don't come back. Attackin' an' killin' a bunch o' diggers might make them feel good 'bout themselves, but ain't gonna do much. The whole business with th' Ways Between is that them creeps be tryin' to cut us off from th' homeland... except th' capital ain't 'bout to come to our rescue, leastways not at this stage. Maybe they're tryin' to cut off internal travel in th' Old Country, I dunno. Woulda have more of an impact there even if we didn't let the roads run to ruin none." It doesn't make sense, or does it? "If'n yer askin' me, I'd say they don't know much 'bout us none yet an' imagine we think th' same way they do. Expectin' that to change down th' line, but f'r now that there's an advantage we can use, an' we're gonna need it. Th' Ways between are thicker than th' forest, an' folks can run in an' out in th' blink of an eye; that makes them great f'r stagin' hit-an'-runs like what lil' sis suffered. Yer only safe in there 'cause there ain't no one else an' it's so vast... but I guess that there's changin' real quick-like, eh?" ] ] "

rows.original: [flags.MAI_HARAI |At your request, Mai gives you a small bow. "[pc.ra kitsune |I would be honored an' all to rid yer aura of impurities, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Guidin' someone as renowned as ya through th' steps would be my pleasure. Are ya ready? |If'n that's what ya want, I ain't gonna say no. Ain't often that outsiders sincerely wanna take a look at our ways... so, ya ready to be clean inside an' out?" ]" |"Eh? Ya wanna partake in a cleansin' ritual an' all?" Mai squints at you. "[pc.ra kitsune |Ah, I guess it's only natural ya would wanna connect an' gain an understandin' o' th' rite, since yer one o' us an' all now, yer Eminence. Ain't no problem — I'd be glad to walk ya through th' rites. Everyone could use a good cleanin' on th' inside every now an' then, so don't ya worry none 'bout troublin' me." That's about it, yes. While you understand that you still have some catching up to do, better late than never, as the saying goes. Maybe after this is all over you'll be able to sit down and actually master their mother tongue... "Ahahaha. Ain't uncommon f'r outsiders tryin' to learn our language to run into trouble, especially with th' written word, but we're gettin' sidetracked here. Now, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], if'n ya woulda let me explain jus' what this is gonna entail f'r yer edification an' all..." |Kinda surprised an outsider would wanna be subjected to such a thing... ya'll got yer own priests an' all to handle this sort of thing, right? Kohaku tells me there's a chapel an' all to Velun in that lil' village down south." That might be the case, but she's here and so are you. It's not as if Keros isn't one of the Seven, after all, and Sanders does have the Trickster's likeness amongst all the other Seven in the Hawkethorne chapel. "Aah... if'n ya say so. Still, methinks I oughta explain what that entails, f'r yer edification." ] ] If she would. Wiggling her ears, Mai sits down on a nearby railing and takes a deep puff from her pipe, calming winterstem smoke rising into the air. "Basically, as ya go 'bout yer life, ya tend to pick up all kinds o' crud on yer body. Dirt, grime, grease... th' same goes f'r yer inner self. Me, I can see auras, an' I'm particularly good at noticin' th' details o' people, th' small picture — th' things that they done pick up stick out to me. Guilt an' bad karma, evil influences, lingerin' bad luck, that kinda thing counts amongst the nasty stuff folks be carryin' around with them. What lil' ol' me is gonna do, is give ya a good scrubbin'. Figuratively, that is. I can tell which spots need tendin' to, and when yer decently clean an' all. "Usually, we do this kinda thing f'r those folks who done come to petition our divine lord an' give offerin's to both him an' ancestral spirits. Miko oversees that simple stuff — ain't usually no more than washin' th' hands an' face, an' rinsin' yer mouth out with clean water. Makin' yerself presentable before th' divine, as it were. Salt is kinda hard to come by out here in this neck o' th' woods, so we don't use it often... "What yer askin' me for is a bit more involved, but still ain't hard f'r th' likes o' me. The rites that Miko, Granny an' I undergo as those who serve th' gods... well, they're far more complicated an' folk like ya[pc.ra kitsune |, beggin' yer Eminence's pardon, ] don't really need to know th' details." So, essentially it isn't too far off from Sanders' blessings, only in a different form. Mai thinks a moment, pausing to blow a smoke ring. "Ain't able to say how th' followers o' th' other great kami handle things, but that's how we who follow his divine lordship make it work, I guess. If yer aura needs a good an thorough cleanin', I'm th' woman ya need to ask. Miko ain't unskilled as it were, but she's kinda too scatterbrained an' don't have th' attention to detail ya need for the deeper rites an' rituals — every time she's done tried it, I've had to clean up after her 'cause she misses spots all over th' place. My sis, she's a big picture gal an' all. "But that there's about it. Ya can also ask me about a, uh, special cleansin' if'n yer so interested. Sure, it'll have th' usual effects an' all... but ya also get to feel good when I'm 'bout it. If'n that's what ya wanna try... jus' say th' word[pc.ra kitsune |, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." Well, well. What do you want to do here...
rows.translation: [flags.MAI_HARAI |应你的要求，梅微微鞠了一躬。"[pc.ra kitsune |能帮助您清除身上的杂质，对我来说将是莫大的荣幸。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]能够引导像您这样杰出的人物完成这些步骤，对我来说是一种荣幸。您准备好了吗？ |如果那就是你想要的，我当然不会拒绝。毕竟，外人真正愿意了解我们的生活方式，这种情况其实并不常见……那么，你准备好彻底改变自己了吗？ ]" |呃？你想参加这种净化仪式之类的吗？舞眯着眼睛看着你。"[pc.ra kitsune |啊，我想您自然会想要了解这些仪式吧，毕竟您现在也是我们中的一员了，尊贵的阁下。没有任何问题——我很乐意为您讲解这些仪式。其实，每个人偶尔都需要进行一次内心的净化，所以您完全不必担心会给我带来麻烦。 差不多就是这样了，没错。虽然你明白自己还有许多需要学习的地方，但正如那句俗话所说，迟做总比不做好。也许等这一切都结束后，你就能真正坐下来，彻底掌握他们的母语了…… 啊哈哈哈，对于那些试图学习我们语言的外来人来说，遇到麻烦其实是很常见的，尤其是在书写方面。不过，我们现在有点跑题了。好了，继续说吧[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]如果你能让我先解释一下这到底会带来什么影响，对你来说会有哪些好处的话…… |真没想到会有外人愿意忍受这种事情……你们自己不是有祭司之类的角色来处理这类事情的吗？科哈库告诉我，在南方那个小村庄里，维尔伦那里有一座小教堂之类的地方。 虽然可能是这样，但她现在在这里，你也在。毕竟，凯罗斯也是“七人组”中的一员，而且在其他六位成员中，桑德斯确实有着“戏弄者”的特征。 啊……如果你这么说的话，那好吧。不过，我觉得我还是应该解释一下这到底意味着什么，这样对你来说会更有帮助。 ] ] 如果她愿意的话。 舞摇着耳朵，坐在附近的栏杆上，深深地吸了一口烟斗，让那缕冬日特有的烟雾缓缓升向空中。基本上，人在日常生活中，身体上会沾上各种各样的污垢：灰尘、污渍、油脂……内在的精神层面也是如此。而我，能够看到人们周围的光环，尤其擅长注意到人们身上的那些细微之处——那些他们无意中沾上的东西，往往会被我察觉到。内疚、负面的业力、邪恶的影响以及持续不断的厄运，这些都属于人们身上背负的那些负面东西。而我，这个小小的存在，所要做的，就是帮你们好好“清洗”一下这些负面东西。当然，这只是比喻而已。我能看出哪些地方需要重点保养，也能知道在把所有地方都彻底清理干净之后，该什么时候进行这些保养工作。 通常，我们会为那些前来向我们的神明祈愿、并向神明与祖先的灵魂献上祭品的人们做这类事情。米科负责监督这些简单的仪式——通常也就是洗洗脸、用清水漱漱口，让人们在见到神明之前显得整洁一些。不过在这片偏远的森林里，盐相当难得，所以我们并不经常使用它…… 你要求我做的事情其实有点复杂，但对我来说还是不难的。作为侍奉神明的人，我和米可、奶奶一起要进行的那些仪式……嗯，那些仪式要复杂得多，像你这样的人恐怕根本无法理解。[pc.ra kitsune |恕我冒昧，阁下。 ]其实并没有必要了解这些细节。 所以，从本质上来说，这与桑德斯的祝福并没有太大区别，只是表现形式不同而已。 舞思考了一会儿，然后停下来吐了一个烟圈。实在无法形容那些另一位伟大人物的追随者们神明处理这些事情吧，但我想，我们这些追随他神圣威严的人就是这么把事情做好的。如果你的灵能需要彻底清理，那我正是你该找的人。说起来，米科并不是不熟练，但她有点太心不在焉了，也缺乏进行那些复杂仪式时所需要的细致耐心——每次她尝试去做这些事情，最后总是让我来收拾残局，因为她总会把东西弄得到处都是。我妹妹嘛，她更注重整体效果罢了。 但大致就是这些内容。你们也可以问我一些其他问题，嗯特别的如果你感兴趣的话，我可以帮你清理干净。当然，这会带来那些常规的效果……但当我进行这个动作的时候，你也会感到很舒服。如果你想尝试的话……只要说出来就行了。[pc.ra kitsune |，嗯[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]。" 嗯，嗯。你在这里想做什么呢……
