rows.original: "All right, then. Gimme a sec to prepare all th' things f'r a personal purification." Mai's movements are slow and unhurried; she disappears around the back of the shrine, returning with a small basin of clean water. Taking a small ladle, Mai rinses your hands with some of the clear water, letting it spill on the grass, then takes a scoop to sprinkle some more of it over your head as you bow your head before her and the likeness of the trickster god. She's ever patient, guiding you through the entire rite step by step and even correcting your posture at times; you see why the sister with an eye for detail is in charge of these rites, as opposed to the one who prefers the big picture. "Now, if'n ya would please hold still. Jus' don't move, an' I'll handle th' rest." Mai says as she carries away the basin. A minute passes before she returns, less one basin and more one long-handled wooden wand with paper charms tied to the other end; she invites you into the shrine's main building, and ushers you before the statue of Keros, gently urging you to keep your gaze lowered. You don't look up, but can nevertheless feel the air move and hear paper rustle as Mai begins to chant in the flowing mother tongue of the kitsune people, her easygoing tone of voice melting away into something far more solemn and serious as the rite proceeds apace. She doesn't have to speak with that drawling accent when it's time to get serious, sounds like — which only makes sense given how the enunciation of her chanting must be quite precise... Power thrums within the shrine's simple confines — not direct, perhaps, but more one that slips and slides and works its way where it oughtn't go, filling nooks and crannies of your being. Mai's voice coils about you, full and husky; more than once you're sure you sense her fingers touching your person, yet that's not quite possible given the distances involved. Eventually, though, Mai's chanting comes to a stop, and she sets down the wand and gives you another small bow. "[pc.ra kitsune |Th' harai is done, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]; yer all cleaned up an' ready to go. |Th' purification ritual jus' got done, [pc.name]; I made sure yer aura's all squeaky clean an' sparkly. ]Ya can raise yer gaze upon our divine lord now... how d'ya feel?" Kind of unsteady, to be honest. It feels like you've just had a weight lifted off your shoulders, and you're having to get used to your body being so light. "Yeah, that there oughta be it. I cleaned a bunch o' crud out of your aura... ya should be feelin' sharp an' keen right now." [pc.isDK |Why yes, you do feel sharp, now that you focus and concentrate inside of yourself... sharp like a honed point, ready to strike and draw blood. "Promise?" Sure, sure. ] It is a moment — Mai does a quick check-over of the shrine, pulls the screen door shut, then bows and invites you to follow her. You do so, and she leads you behind the shrine right to the far end of the gardens within the tree's roots, where there's a large stone table with several simple seats arranged around it. She brushes a couple fallen pine needles and flower blossoms off its surface, clicking her tongue, then unwraps a bundle in her hands to reveal a simple white robe of traditional make and a small pillow, the latter of which she plants on the table's surface. The faint smell of greenery and water fill the air, mostly from a decorative water feature off to one side consisting of a dizzying array of stone and bamboo pipes. It's very... artistic. "Ain't th' most comfortable surface, but it'll do jus' fine. One's surroundings are important in gettin' in th' proper frame o' mind, an' this ain't supposed to be completely comfortable none," Mai explains as she fluffs up the pillow and gives you a wink. "Now, if'n ya would please change an' lie on yer stomach on th' table, we can begin. Ain't no need to be bashful — I promise I ain't gonna peek, if'n it'll make yer more comfortable an' all." With that, Mai turns to the task of spreading out a thin white sheet over the stone table, clearly made from the same material as the garment she intends for you to wear. You hurriedly change out of your [pc.armor] and don the white, flowing robe, wondering at how light it feels on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] and how you can plainly feel the breeze between your extremities despite how voluminous it is. When you're done, Mai thumps the table's surface and beckons you forth with a bow and smile. "Now, if'n [pc.ra kitsune|yer Eminence|ya] would be so kind as to hop on with yer back up, I can done right get started." All right... the sheet is thin and the stone cold and hard, but as Mai said, it's part of the atmosphere, isn't it? With only the stars and a single foxfire lantern to see by, it's there's a certain something or the other about this little glade behind the shrine that makes one feel at ease. Not that the darkness impedes Mai any; though at points she's but a silhouette hovering above you, her movements are swift and unimpeded, her golden slitted eyes glinting in the starlight. And then she begins. [rand |Mai is efficient if nothing, getting down to work without making a show of it; she doesn't actually knead at your muscles like one might expect a masseur to, but instead jabs swiftly at several points on your back, arms and thighs, her fingertips alight with ghostly foxfire. Each precise jab at your body doesn't break your skin, yet you feel as if Mai's thrusting needles deep into your flesh and between your joints, needles alight with cold-hot foxfire and burning as they stay lodged in your flesh. You gasp aloud, fingers gripping the edge of the table as you twist your neck to look sidelong at Mai; the gray-furred shrine maiden is unhurried as always, her expression set into one of calm neutrality in contrast to the one you're no doubt making. "Don't be surprised none if'n ya feel a lil' discomfort," she says after several seconds of this. "Crooked things ain't wantin' to be set straight; ain't odd if'n realignin' yer chi give ya a lil distress, an' doin' th' same to yer ki are little more so. Please, bear with me." As she says that, Mai presses a knuckle between your shoulderblades and presses. She can't have been using more than a frackin of her strength, but it feels like the weight of an entire avalanche's hammering down on that singular point between your shoulders, the pressure running down your spine. Even though you're braced for it, you nevertheless grit your teeth as the sensation slams down onto you, sending tendrils of cool heat racing outward to the points on your person where she pressed you before. Finally, you feel something give. Like water gushing from a cracked dam, cool heat spreads outwards from your back in steady pulses, running down your spine and curling around your ribs. You heave a sigh of relief as the crushing pressure fades abruptly, replaced with a palpable, if faint, sense of newfound power. |Mai bids you extend your limbs towards the four corners of the stone table where she can get at them, exhorting you to tense your muscles in the process. You follow suit, and she takes your limbs one by one, pressing downward with fingertips, knuckles, and the heels of her palms. Under her careful ministrations, you feel the tension in your joints and muscles intensify, like rubber pulled taut; when she lets them go you feel a corresponding sensation of looseness and limberness. Twisting your neck to look sidelong at Mai, you realize that she's closed her eyes and is instead relying on her touch... or other senses to work on you. Can she see auras with her eyes closed like that? Either way, she wasn't kidding about her massage techniques originating with the blind... "If'n ya don't mind," she says, planting her hands on your collarbone where your arms meet your shoulders. "Ya could work with me an' rotate yer joints. Th' physical an' th' spiritual ain't too different, an' this here'll make my job a whole lot quicker an' all." You're not exactly sure what's required of you here, but you're content to follow Mai's guidance, moving in accordance with her motions. Mai's flame-wreathed fingertips burn with a cool heat against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], and with each circular rotation of your shoulders, your elbows, your knees and thighs you feel something seep out from between your joints, as if she were grinding something to powder in a mortar and pestle. The movements are slow and relaxed, but powerful; the sensation of alternate stretching and compression in your joints one by one brings forth a newfound sense of power that can be only described as... well, springy. At last, though, she's done. Mai guides your ankle through one final rotation, pressing in on the spurs with the heel of her palm, and gently withdraws from the table. All done[pc.ra kitsune|, yer Eminence]. Ya should be feelin' jus' fine f'r a little while now." |Mai is precise in her movements, her foxfire-laced fingertips sparking with the sound of flint striking steel as they come into contact with your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. You feel them pressing deep into muscle and right down to your bones, as impossible as that sounds; faint blue sparks fall from her fingers as she works away, ghostly sensations piercing through your flesh and combing their way further within. "If'n ya would please, would ya turn around now?" You nod and comply, feeling the folds of your simple white robe rustle about your body as you change positions. Mai eases you into position, testing your body by planting her hands to either side of your torso and thumbing your ribs. When she's satisfied, the gray-furred shrine maiden takes aim and slams the heel of her palm straight down [pc.cupRange C|beneath your [pc.breasts], somewhere in the region between your lungs|atop your chest, landing straight in the fork between your lungs]. Your eyes widen and you gasp as the breath's knocked straight out of you; your gaze turns to Mai, but she's narrowed her eyes and biting her lip in concentration as she draws back her other palm to strike again. She does just that, striking in the exact same spot — which, against all logic, neither lands as hard or hurts as much as the first might have led you to expect. When Mai lets up for the second time, you feel strangely energised, cool heat pouring outwards from the spot she struck towards the points on you body she massaged earlier. "Tha there's one free-flowin' meridian f'r ya, [pc.ra kitsune|yer Eminence|no worries]. If'n I may say so myself, it's a damn pretty sight, especially one as radiant as yers." You can't see auras like Mai can, so you'll just have to take her word for it. |Mai looks like she's feeling playful today — the gray-furred shrine maiden wiggles her fingers in the air as she makes grabby hands, her fingertips alight with ghostly blue foxfire. Not that her face isn't completely straight as they descend upon you, sparks rising from your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with the sound of flint striking steel as her fingers press into your flesh. One hand busies itself with tracing symbols and patterns upon your back, while the other dances back and forth, lancing thin pricks of heated energy into muscle, driving them down to the bone. Not that it hurts in the slightest — quite the opposite, as you soon find out. Sparks dance across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] and you shiver with each pass of Mai's fingers atop you, feeling the gentle licking of the foxfire patterns she's tracing upon your person. "I'm creatin' new channels f'r yer chi to flow. Think o' them as reroutin' around yer usual pathways... it ain't good if'n I throw yer body too far out o' balance, so ya'll snap right back to yer ol' self after a bit," Mai explains. "In th' meantime, do make th' best use o' th' boost while it done lasts... an' don't do nothin' that'll go 'bout foulin' up th' flows, like drinkin' too much or seein' one o' yer local priests or somethin' like that. I mean, it won't harm ya none, but ya might very well lose th' effect." You think you say something in response, but you don't quite remember what it is. Just a few touches from Mai's fingers and knuckles are enough to leave you dazed with pleasure, distinctly erotic yet not quite concentrated within any one part of your body. Mai's hands slide around your body, caressing, touching and pinching, yet never outright coming anywhere close to your erogenous zones at any point. Everything is subtle, indirect, given at least a degree of separation from its final effect; you moan and whimper in pleasure, reduced to blissed-out putty in the gray-furred shrine maiden's skillful hands. She is nowhere, yet is everywhere at the same time, fingers, palms and knuckles all prodigiously applying themselves to your body with gusto, opening channels of cool fire beneath your skin that flow from flesh to bone and back again. "Glad yer enjoyin' yerself, [pc.ra kitsune|yer Eminence|friend]," Mai says with a chuckle. "It ain't proper shiatsu, but I do know ways to make folks feel pretty damn good 'bout themselves." You groan deep in your throat, what feels like a full-body climax rippling through your entire being, yet your body shows not even the slightest sign of being aroused. Pleasure flows through the fiery channels in rhythmic pulses like waves crashing onto a beach, and you body moves to follow; Mai guides these movements into stretches and rotations, supporting your limbs, chest and hips as they move unthinkingly in response to whatever mystical puppet strings she's got you hooked on. Eventually, though, Mai allows the pleasure to die down, the foxfire flickering on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] dousing itself with a hiss. The final exhilarating crest passes through you and you sag back onto the stone table with a gasp — but instead of feeling exhausted, your joints and muscles feel absolutely charged, full of energy and ready to spring at a moment's notice. Despite everything you've felt, your body is perfectly calm and restful, sex about the furthest thing it could be ready for here. ] On her part, Mai crosses to the water feature with a small basin, catching some of the flow as it gushes forth from a bamboo spout. She washes her hands in a formal and ceremonial manner, wiping her hands dry on a small white cloth, then fills the basin again and returns to you, dipping her fingers in the water and sprinkling it over your back. She does this a few times, bids you turn over for her to repeat the motions across your front, then gives you a satisfied nod. "All good now. Again[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]], th' effects will last f'r 'bout a day before yer natural flows sort themselfs out, so ya might wanna put all that there energy to use right quick f'r whatever ya got in mind." You sit up on the table and give your limbs an experimental stretch and flex. Yep, like Mai said — all good now. "Welp, I'll be needin' everythin' back now[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]. Don't forget to pick up all yer stuff before ya go." Indeed. You disrobe yourself, put on your [pc.armor] and collect your gear, and leave Mai to clean up here while you head back to the shrine.[party.has companions| It's a small matter to pick up [party.compNames], and then you're ready to be off.]"

rows.original: [flags.MAI_MASSAGE|"If'n it's a massage ya want, [pc.ra kitsune|m'[pc.mf|lord|lady], ]all ya gotta do is ask, an' ya did. Since it's a bit o' an off-period an' there ain't that many petitioners, we can take ourselfs a bit o' time an' get things done right. "Now... which kinda massage ya interested in[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" |You've heard that Mai is quite adept at giving massages. Is that correct? "[pc.ra kitsune |That ain't wrong any, yer Eminence |Mm-hmm-hmm. Ain't wrong 'bout that ]. I was done trained some in shiatsu massage by one o' my aunts when I was a gal... ain't no expert or anythin', but a basic understandin' o' th' body an' its workin's don't hurt none in my line o' work. Since Miko an' I can see auras an' I was th' one with th' defter hands, she thought it wouldn't hurt none to teach a gal like me some o' what she knew, enough to bring other people relief an' th' like." Hmm. You're asking because you're interested in seeing what she can do. Is this related to her job, though? "Nah, it ain't got nothin' to do with me bein' a shrine maiden, this stuff is kinda what I do on th' side an' all. It ain't religious or anythin'. Th' methods done came from a kind o' massage technique that done got practiced by a bunch o' blind folk back in th' homeland an' I know it probably sounds right mystical anr' all, but there ain't nothin' special like it in that way. Th' basic idea o' shiatsu is to use pressure an' stretchin' to make sure th' flow o' chi in yer body an' ki in yer aura ain't blocked or distorted. If'n yer meridians are fouled an' experiencin' stoppage, imbalance or distress, a good bit o' finger an' palm pressure can work wonders in openin' it up again an' realignin' th' flow in yer self." It sounds pretty simple, but you're sure that as with most kitsune things, it's going to be much more complicated than it appears at first glance. Still, with her description of the technique, you can see why Mai's ability to perceive auras would be invaluable in putting such knowledge into practice. "Ain't it th' truth. I keep up with th' work 'cause it makes folk feel good an' I like bein' praised an' all. Equivalent exchange — balanced, as all things should be. If'n ya wanna give it a go, [pc.ra kitsune|yer Eminence, ]there's a nice spot out back behind th' shrine with a stone table an' all. Won't take long for a short session." No oils? No scents? "Nope." No need to strip? "Shiatsu's done through light an' loose clothin', an' I got a bunch on hand to loan ouf to those interested. If ya wanna my fingers on yer bare [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], I ain't gonna object, but that there's th' traditional attire f'r the one receivin' th' massage. In th' interest o' honorin' tradition an' all... I strongly suggest ya go along with it[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]. I think it'll help ya connect more with yer new roots an' all]." Ah, you see. "I gots some idea of what th' natives o' this land think when they done hear 'bout massagin', an' this ain't quite that. I think it'll be a right experience f'r ya, if'n I may say so myself." And what can you hope to get out of this? "Mostly relief from pain an' plenty o' relaxation. Plenty o' folk find these welcome any time, life in th' colonies ain't easy even f'r th' most cushy o' jobs. Then I know yer [pc.ra kitsune|out there servin' our divine lord's will|th' adventurin' type] an' all, so there're some other things I can do f'r ya, if'n yer so inclined." Let's hear it, then. "All o' these work by messin' with th' flow o' chi in yer body, ki in yer aura, o' even both at th' same time. By doin' some, uh, realignments, I can specially toughen ya up against certain types o' harm that woulda come to ya. Hmm... 's been a while since I done last recalled this... was it that long ago that I worked on that good-f'r-nothin' Takahiro? Oh well, here goes... "First off, I can make yer body resistant to blows and cuttin, harden yer skin a little an' make it so th' natural outflow o' chi from yer body done turn away blows jus' a bit. It ain't gonna make up for actual armor, but it done works wonders if'n ya wanna stay light. "Secondly, I can make yer body resistant to elemental influences. Heat, cold, even strong winds an' lightnin' strikes... this here one's popular with a lot o' folks who're intendin' to go out prospectin' an' th' likes. Can get mighty cold out there in th' open, and mighty hot beneath th' earth. Land o' fire an' ice, as they say. "Thirdly, I can manipulate yer aura, fold it in upon itself an' strengthen yer natural defenses against otherworldly forces an' all. If yer plannin' to take on some o' those, then wouldn't be a bad idea to go f'r this one. "Finally, I can done give yer such good o' a massage that even yer aura will feel it and help ya stay calm in th' face o'... uh, perturbations. Fear an' th' like, not that I'm sayin' yer a coward or anythin' like that, o' course. Keros' tails, this would make ya so calm that a nice, pretty lass like yers truly coulda walk by and ya wouldn't even feel a thing. Ya'd be th' calmest person around in quite a ways off. Plenty of folk done want this to keep cool in th' face o' a long work day. Empty yer mind and ya feel th' pain none, as th' sayin' goes." That's quite a choice to make. "Since it involves messin' with yer chi an' ki flows, ya can only get th' effect o' one o' these at a time, so choose wisely. Wouldn't want to make a mistake an' change yer mind later an' all. These things ain't permanent, but still, no one likes wasted time, right? "So then... ya wanna give it a try[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" ]
rows.translation: [flags.MAI_MASSAGE|如果你想要的是按摩的话[pc.ra kitsune|m[pc.mf|领主|女士]， ]你只需要提出请求，而你也确实这么做了。由于现在正处于非高峰期，而且提出请求的人也不多，所以我们有足够的时间来把事情做好。 现在……你感兴趣哪种按摩方式呢？[pc.ra kitsune|，嗯[pc.mf|领主|女士]]？" |你听说过，舞在提供按摩服务方面相当在行，是吗？ "[pc.ra kitsune |您说得一点都没错，阁下。 |嗯，没错，就是这么回事。 ]我完成了一些训练。指压按摩我小时候经常让我的阿姨们给我按摩……她们虽然算不上什么专家，但对人体结构及其运作原理也有一定的了解，这些知识在我的工作中确实非常有用。既然我和米可都能看到气场，而我的手法也比较灵巧，所以她觉得教我一些她所掌握的知识也没什么坏处，至少这些知识能够帮助别人缓解疼痛之类的问题。 嗯，你这么问，应该是想看看她能做出什么来吧。不过，这和她的工作有关吗？ 不，这和我身为神社少女的身份没有任何关系。这些其实只是我业余时间会做的事情而已，并没有什么宗教意义。这些手法源自一种按摩技巧，这种技巧是由我家乡的一些盲人传承下来的。我知道这些听起来可能有点神秘，但实际上并没有什么特别之处。这些技巧的基本理念就是指压按摩其方法就是利用压力和拉伸来确保物质的流动顺畅。气你体内就有ki你的气场并没有被堵塞或扭曲。如果你的经络出现了堵塞，导致能量流动受阻、失衡或产生不适，那么通过适当的指压和手掌按摩，完全有可能帮助疏通这些经络，重新恢复能量流动的平衡。 听起来很简单，但你可以肯定，就像大多数与狐妖相关的能力一样，实际情况会比乍看之下复杂得多。不过，从她对这种能力的描述来看，也就不难理解为什么舞能够感知气场这一能力，在将这种知识付诸实践时会显得如此宝贵了。 不是吗？我会继续做这份工作，因为这能让别人感到开心，而且我也喜欢被人表扬之类的。这是一种等价的交换——平衡的，就像所有事情都应该那样。如果你也想试试看的话[pc.ra kitsune|尊贵的阁下， ]在神社后面的那片地方有个不错的地方，那里有一张石桌， 一切都准备好了。进行一次短时间的练习不会花太长时间。 没有油分？没有香味？ 不行。 不需要进行任何修改吗？ 指压按摩是通过轻柔地按压和穿着宽松的衣服来进行的，我手头准备了一些这样的衣物，可以借给有兴趣的人。如果你愿意让我的手指直接接触你的皮肤的话[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]我没什么意见，但是接受按摩的人应该穿着传统的服装。为了尊重传统嘛……我强烈建议你遵守这个规定。[pc.ra kitsune|，嗯[pc.mf|领主|女士]我觉得这会帮助你更好地融入你的新环境，与那里的人们建立更紧密的联系]。" 啊，你懂的。 我大概能想象到这片土地上的原住民们听到‘按摩’这个词时会怎么想，而这个服务其实和他们的想象有点不一样。不过，如果让我来评价的话，我觉得这对你来说会是一次非常不错的体验。 那么，你期望从中获得什么呢？ 主要是缓解疼痛，还能让人充分放松。很多人觉得这些好处非常实用，因为在殖民地生活，即使从事最舒适的工作，生活也并不容易。那么，我知道你们[pc.ra kitsune|在远方，他们正在履行我们神圣主人的意志。|喜欢冒险的人]总之，如果你愿意的话，我还能为你做其他一些事情。 那我们就来听听吧。 所有这些方法都是通过干扰某种流动过程来达到效果的。气在你体内。ki在你的气场中，甚至是可以同时拥有这两种特性。通过进行一些调整，我可以让你特别容易抵御某些类型的伤害。嗯……我已经有一段时间没有回忆起这件事了……究竟是多久以前，我曾经为那个善良的无害之徒贵弘郎做过这些事情呢？好吧，那就开始吧…… 首先，我可以让你的身体具备抵抗打击和切割的能力，让你的皮肤变得稍微坚韧一些，同时还能让身体自然产生的某种物质气身体的防御能力确实能在一定程度上抵挡攻击，但它无法替代真正的盔甲。不过，如果你想保持轻便的行动能力，这种防御方式还是相当有效的。 其次，我可以让你的身体具备抵抗自然元素影响的能力。无论是高温、严寒，还是强风和雷电……这项能力很受那些打算外出探险的人的欢迎。在野外，环境可能会变得极其寒冷，而在地下，则可能会变得极其炎热。正如人们所说，那里就是火与冰的世界。 第三，我可以操控你的气场，使其凝聚起来，从而增强你对抗外来力量的自然防御能力。如果你打算对抗那些敌人，那么掌握这项能力未尝不是个好主意。 终于，我可以为你提供一次如此出色的按摩了，就连你的气场都能感受到这种效果，帮助你在面对那些……呃，干扰因素时保持冷静。当然，我并不是说你是个胆小鬼或什么类似的意味。凯罗斯的尾巴啊，有了它，你就会变得如此平静，以至于像你这样善良漂亮的姑娘从你身边走过，你甚至都不会有任何感觉。在某种程度上，你会成为周围最冷静的人。很多人都希望在工作一整天之后，能借助这个东西来让自己冷静下来。放空你的思绪，这样你就感觉不到任何痛苦了，正如那句话所说。 这确实是一个需要慎重考虑的选择。 因为这涉及到对你的东西进行一些改动气还有ki这些效果是一次只能使用一个，所以请慎重选择。毕竟可不想犯错，之后又不得不改变主意。这些设定虽然不是永久性的，但谁也不愿意浪费时间，对吧？ 那么……你想试试看吗？[pc.ra kitsune|，嗯[pc.mf|领主|女士]]？" ]

Still, with her description of the technique, you can see why Mai's ability to perceive auras would be invaluable in putting such knowledge into practice. "Ain't it th' truth. I keep up with th' work 'cause it makes folk feel good an' I like bein' praised an' all. Equivalent exchange — balanced, as all things should be. If'n ya wanna give it a go, [pc.ra kitsune|yer Eminence, ]there's a nice spot out back behind th' shrine with a stone table an' all. Won't take long for a short session." No oils? No scents? "Nope." No need to strip? "Shiatsu's done through light an' loose clothin', an' I got a bunch on hand to loan ouf to those interested. If ya wanna my fingers on yer bare [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], I ain't gonna object, but that there's th' traditional attire f'r the one receivin' th' massage. In th' interest o' honorin' tradition an' all... I strongly suggest ya go along with it[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]. I think it'll help ya connect more with yer new roots an' all]." Ah, you see. "I gots some idea of what th' natives o' this land think when they done hear 'bout massagin', an' this ain't quite that. I think it'll be a right experience f'r ya, if'n I may say so myself." And what can you hope to get out of this? "Mostly relief from pain an' plenty o' relaxation. Plenty o' folk find these welcome any time, life in th' colonies ain't easy even f'r th' most cushy o' jobs. Then I know yer [pc.ra kitsune|out there servin' our divine lord's will|th' adventurin' type] an' all, so there're some other things I can do f'r ya, if'n yer so inclined." Let's hear it, then. "All o' these work by messin' with th' flow o' chi in yer body, ki in yer aura, o' even both at th' same time. By doin' some, uh, realignments, I can specially toughen ya up against certain types o' harm that woulda come to ya. Hmm... 's been a while since I done last recalled this... was it that long ago that I worked on that good-f'r-nothin' Takahiro? Oh well, here goes... "First off, I can make yer body resistant to blows and cuttin, harden yer skin a little an' make it so th' natural outflow o' chi from yer body done turn away blows jus' a bit. It ain't gonna make up for actual armor, but it done works wonders if'n ya wanna stay light. "Secondly, I can make yer body resistant to elemental influences. Heat, cold, even strong winds an' lightnin' strikes... this here one's popular with a lot o' folks who're intendin' to go out prospectin' an' th' likes. Can get mighty cold out there in th' open, and mighty hot beneath th' earth. Land o' fire an' ice, as they say. "Thirdly, I can manipulate yer aura, fold it in upon itself an' strengthen yer natural defenses against otherworldly forces an' all. If yer plannin' to take on some o' those, then wouldn't be a bad idea to go f'r this one. "Finally, I can done give yer such good o' a massage that even yer aura will feel it and help ya stay calm in th' face o'... uh, perturbations. Fear an' th' like, not that I'm sayin' yer a coward or anythin' like that, o' course. Keros' tails, this would make ya so calm that a nice, pretty lass like yers truly coulda walk by and ya wouldn't even feel a thing. Ya'd be th' calmest person around in quite a ways off. Plenty of folk done want this to keep cool in th' face o' a long work day. Empty yer mind and ya feel th' pain none, as th' sayin' goes." That's quite a choice to make. "Since it involves messin' with yer chi an' ki flows, ya can only get th' effect o' one o' these at a time, so choose wisely. Wouldn't want to make a mistake an' change yer mind later an' all. These things ain't permanent, but still, no one likes wasted time, right? "So then... ya wanna give it a try[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" ]"

rows.original: As soon as you state what you want, Mai raises a hand to her mouth in feigned shock. "Well, don't that just beat all, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Now how didja know that I was capable of such things?" You didn't, but given how her — your — people are about this, it was a reasonably safe bet. "Mmmh. Such things ain't talked 'bout in polite society, yer Eminence, but if'n ya command it, I guess I ain't got no choice but to obey, right? If'n ya gimme jus' a minute or two to prepare, I can have th' preparations made all quick-like. Gotta make sure his divine lordship's domain is secure an' all, an' then there's the special stuff. [party.hasCompanions | If'n yer friend[party.manyCompanions |s ] don't mind waitin' f'r 'bout half an hour here, I'll tend to ya right quick. ]" [party.has cait |Watching Mai go off to prepare the massage table and close up the shrine, Cait pouts and sticks her tongue out at you. "Oh, come on now, [pc.name]! Is an erotic massage all you want? I can give you sexual healing waaaay better than this vixen can even dream of!" Now, now. Wherever did she get that notion from? All you asked was for her to give your ears and tails a fine massage, that's all. Certainly nothing lewd or unwholesome. Cait rolls her eyes at that. "Come on, who are you kidding? Even I know that these foxes have erogenous ears and tails. Look, you're even grinning like a big silly! Seriously, now!" Is she perhaps feeling a mite jealous with direct competition in the picture? It's perfectly fine for two people in very similar lines of work to feel a certain animosity for each other; it happens. Your pink kitten simply folds her hands under her prodigious tits. "All I'm saying is that if you want something like that, you've got me right here. Sure, the Temple may not quite have refined ear-petting and head-stroking into an art, but I'm sure it can't be too hard." You chuckle and give Cait a pat on the head. She doesn't usually act this way, but perhaps Miko and Mai really bite a little too close to home. All right, all right, you'll give her some loving later when the two of you can get together. "Promise?" Sure, sure. For now, though, you really just want to have your ears massaged. ] It is but a moment — Mai does a quick check-over of the shrine, pulls the screen door shut, then bows and invites you to follow her. You do so, and she leads you behind the shrine right to the far end of the gardens within the tree's roots, where there's a large stone table with several simple seats arranged around it. She brushes a couple fallen pine needles and flower blossoms off its surface, clicking her tongue, then unwraps a bundle in her hands to reveal a simple white robe of traditional make and a small pillow, the latter of which she plants on the table's surface. The faint smell of greenery and water fill the air, mostly from a decorative water feature off to one side consisting of a dizzying array of stone and bamboo pipes. It's very... artistic. "Ain't th' most comfortable surface, but it'll do jus' fine. One's surroundings are important in gettin' in th' proper frame o' mind, an' this ain't supposed to be completely comfortable none," Mai explains as she fluffs up the pillow and gives you a wink. "Now, if'n ya would please change an' lie on yer stomach on th' table, we can begin. Ain't no need to be bashful — I promise I ain't gonna peek, if'n it'll make yer more comfortable an' all." With the shameless stare she's giving your ears and tails, you have your own doubts about that. Nevertheless, Mai turns to the task of spreading out a thin white sheet over the stone table, clearly made from the same material as the garment she intends for you to wear. You hurriedly change out of your [pc.armor] and don the white, flowing robe, wondering at how light it feels on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] and how you can plainly feel the breeze between your extremities despite how voluminous it is. When you're done, Mai thumps the table's surface and beckons you forth with a bow and smile. "Please come on up, yer Eminence. Ya desire high-impact ear fondlin'... so that's what yer gonna get, good an' hard." Oh, you can hardly wait. The sheet is thin and the stone cold and hard, but as Mai said, it's part of the atmosphere, isn't it? With only the stars and a single foxfire lantern to see by, it's there's a certain something or the other about this little glade behind the shrine that makes one feel at ease. Not that the darkness impedes Mai any; though at points she's but a silhouette hovering above you, her movements are swift and unimpeded, her golden slitted eyes glinting in the starlight. And then she begins. She starts with the very tips, taking both between thumb and forefinger before rolling them slowly back and forth. Even with this gentle stimulation, the breath rushes from your lungs in a huge, shuddering breath — she knows how to tease the fleshy tips just right to have the sensation of doing so lance straight through your skull and into your mind. You eyes cross, your jaw goes slack, and you can't help but pant uncontrollably as erotic tingles crawl over your skin — and she's barely just begun! And then, just as suddenly as they arrived, the prurient tension drains out of your body in one fell swoop, leaving you gloriously relieved — and completely relaxed. You've never felt anything quite like this before, not while one of Mai's hands remains focused on your ears while the other digs its fingers into your scalp and makes large circular motions; the telltale cold heat of foxfire penetrates your ears and skull, eliciting a glorious sigh of relief from you. It's not that you're sleepy — far from it, you feel incredibly energized — but there's simply no way for you to try and do anything despite the intense sensations of lively goodness welling up in your body. Every time you will your body to move, it's like trying to grasp water — no matter how hard you try, your intentions fall out of your grasp somewhere along the way from your mind to being turned into actuality. "Now don't that feel good, yer Eminence?" Mai purrs, her fingers still dancing away. "Any ol' silly bugger can make a guy or gal cum with ear pets, but it takes someone skilled to make another feel good. Manipulating yer bodily energy through yer head an' ears without ya cumming all over th' place is an art, I tell ya. Someone in his divine lordship's service only done deserve th' best, so if'n it pleases ya, jus' sit back an' let me do my job. Ya won't regret it none." If it pleases you? If it amazes you is more like it. Try as you might, you can't help but wag all [pc.tailCount] of your tails back and forth like a dog, arms and legs hanging limply over the edges of the stone table as Mai tends to you. She's moved on from the tips of your ears, massaging the insides and pressing fluff against flesh as she pinches you between thumb and forefinger, moving in circles over each ear one at a time while she continues to knead your scalp. You think you say something in response, but you don't quite remember what it is. Just a few touches from Mai's fingers and knuckles are enough to leave you dazed with sensation, not erotic in the least but certainly leaving you with a sensation of awakening. Mai's hands slide around your ears and scalp, caressing, touching and pinching, yet never outright petting you — for someone of her station to pat you on the head would be sacrilegious, most terrible indeed. Everything is subtle, indirect, given at least a degree of separation from its final effect; you moan and whimper in pleasure, reduced to blissed-out putty in the gray-furred shrine maiden's skillful hands. But she's far from done. Once she's satisfied that you're all nice and comfortable, Mai finishes up her high-impact ear fondling with a flick to your ear-tips and sweeps around to the foot of the table. There's little doubt in your mind as to what's coming next, and you're proven exactly right by the greedy gleam in her eye as she gathers up one of your [pc.tailCount] tails in her hands, taking her time to perversely squeeze the fluffy fur between her palms before loosing a tremendous sigh of relief. "Now that I've done th' ears, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, it's 'bout time I did yer tails, innit? Jus' holdin' yer tails, I can feel all th' tension in yer body makin' ya all hot an' stiff. Ya gotta learn to relax, yer Eminence... yer on a massage table, after all, an' that ain't no place to be anxious or nothin'. Ya gotta learn that like yer ears, yer tails are also important conduits of chi around yer body, conduits an' regulators. With all respect, it ain't done to let 'em go all tense like this; coulda be bad f'r yer health. Guess I ain't got no choice but to help ya out with a good massage like you done asked..." With that, Mai gathers up your tail in her hands, and you have a sense of ominous foreboding in the pit of your stomach. Your tails certainly respond to her touch, wriggling and writhing, but her fingers are deft, her grip is firm and she has tails of her own to coil and tug around yours, far more experienced than you are at this whole prehensile tail thing. Mai has to be dragging this out — another sigh leaves her lips as she combs her fingers through your fur, longing and expectant. "Ain't this here jus' exquisite, an' yer out an' about all th' time. His divine lordship done did a bang-up job on yer body... now, beggin' yer pardon, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship..." With great aplomb, Mai lifts the tail she's holding and pushes her face down straight into it with one sweeping motion. Like before with your ears, you expected erotic tension, but as her nose and cheeks push down through fine fox-fur into the warm core of your tail all you can feel is utter cool relaxation flowing into the base of your spine. She's shamelessly rolling her face in your [pc.furColor] strands, and yet where such an action should've produced no small amount of arousal the sensation you experience is that of relief, relief that flows up your spine and worms its way into your mind. This is absolutely amazing. It doesn't stop there, of course. With Mai's tails intermingling and twisting with your own [pc.tailCount] tails, pulling, stroking and rubbing, you can't help but want to weep at it all. It feels like you're constantly on the precipice of some grand revelation, poised to make some grand breakthrough of enlightenment, but simply cannot take that last step to whatever realization awaits you on the other side. "Glad yer enjoyin' yerself, yer Eminence," Mai says with a chuckle, pulling her face out of your tail. "It ain't proper shiatsu, but I do know ways to make folks feel pretty damn good 'bout themselves. Ya looked like ya needed a break from th' world... ain't that th' truth, eh? Good thing ya came to lil' ol' me to help ya with yer troubles, ya know Miko an' I are always willin' to help ya get used to being one o' us." This process continues over and over again — when Mai's huffed enough fluff on one tail, she passes it on and takes the next one in hand. It's in this fashion that she shamelessly rolls her face all over each and every one of your tails, inhaling deeply as she kisses the fur, teasing the very tip with her tongue and best of all, sinking her fingers in down to the muscular cores and kneading away, pressing in on bones and muscles you didn't even know you had but are very, very glad you do. Ever since becoming a kitsune, you've never really thought too deeply about your tails; they just do whatever they like with a life of their own, which matches up with how you've seen other foxes behave. But to get a massage just for them... More prickling, this time back at your ears; Mai's sent two of her own tails to tease your fox ears with their tips, sinking the soft fur into your ear canals and dipping in and out. You shudder and sigh — whatever's passing through you as your ears and tails are massaged isn't a climax, but it's a sensation of calm and inner peace that's just as powerful as a burst of sexual release would be. It truly feels like a tidal wave rolling unseen beneath the waves, and it's this sensation that brings your senses to the fore as Mai plies your body with face, fingers and tails. If feels like she's pulling you in several different directions all at once, drawing you out and teasing you thin, then allowing your muscles, spine and tendons to snap back into place like silly slime putty. Your ears, your tails... high impact massaging really doesn't do what's happening to you justice in the least. At last, though, Mai lifts her face from your tails, and purrs languidly, clearly very satisfied with herself. She allows her ministrations to die down, the foxfire flickering on your fur flickering out of existence; the final pulse of intense serenity passes through you and you sag back onto the stone table with a gasp, your body perfectly calm and restful, all the energy you possess concentrated in your ears and tails. They can't stop twitching, moving, swivelling, and you have absolutely no control over how they move and what they do. On her part, Mai crosses to the water feature with a small basin, catching some of the flow as it gushes forth from a bamboo spout. She washes her hands in a formal and ceremonial manner, wiping her hands dry on a small white cloth, then fills the basin again and returns to you, dipping her fingers in the water and sprinkling it over your back. She does this a few times, bids you turn over for her to repeat the motions across your front, then gives you a satisfied nod. "All good now. Again, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], this here massage only works f'r us, 'cause of... well, only we got these kinda ears an' tails that his divine lordship done gave us. Th' effects will last f'r 'bout a day before yer natural flows sort themselfs out, so ya might wanna put all that there peace o' mind to use right quick f'r whatever ya got in mind." You sit up on the table and give your limbs an experimental stretch and flex. Yep, like Mai said — all good now. "Welp, I'll be needin' everythin' back now, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Don't forget to pick up all yer stuff before ya go." Indeed. You disrobe yourself, put on your [pc.armor] and collect your gear, and leave Mai to clean up here while you head back to the shrine.[party.has companions | It's a small matter to pick up [party.compNames], and then you're ready to be off. ]
rows.translation: 你一说完自己的要求，舞就假装惊讶地用手捂住嘴：“哎呀，这也太离谱了吧[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]发船吧。你是怎么知道我有能力做这种事情的？” “你之前并不知道，但考虑到她的你的嗯，这种事情在体面的社交场合是不会被谈论的，阁下。但既然您命令我这么做，我想我也别无选择，只能服从吧？如果您能给我一两分钟的时间准备，我就能迅速把一切安排妥当。首先必须确保他的领地安全无恙，还有那些特别的东西也需要处理。 [party.hasCompanions | 如果是你的朋友的话[party.manyCompanions | ]在这里等上半个小时也没关系，我马上就会处理你的问题。 ]" [party.has cait |看着梅去准备按摩床并整理好那个小空间，凯特撅着嘴，吐了吐舌头对着你说：“哦，拜托啦[pc.name]你想要的就只是一场色情按摩吗？我能够为你提供比这个狐妖想象中还要美好的性爱体验哦！” “得了吧，她从哪里得来这种想法的？你只不过是让她好好按摩一下你的耳朵和尾巴而已，根本没有什么不适当或不良的含义。” 凯特听到这话，翻了个白眼：“拜托，你是在开玩笑吧？到底是谁我你知道这些狐妖的耳朵和尾巴都是敏感的部位吧。看，你甚至都笑得像个傻大个一样！说真的，现在认真点！” 她是不是因为看到了直接的竞争而感到有点嫉妒呢？对于从事相同行业的人来说，彼此之间产生一些敌意也是完全正常的；这种事情确实会发生。 你的粉色小猫只是把双手放在自己那迷人的胸部下面。“我只想说，如果你想要这样的东西，我就在这里。当然，寺庙或许还没有将轻抚耳朵和抚摸头部的动作提升成一种艺术，但我相信这应该也不是什么难事吧。你轻笑了一声，然后拍了拍凯特的头。她平时并不这样表现，不过也许米可与舞真的让她有些改变了太太贴近生活了……好吧，等你们俩有时间单独相处的时候，你再好好安慰她吧。 “真的吗？” 当然，当然。不过现在，你大概只是想让别人给你按摩耳朵罢了。 ] 只是一瞬间而已——舞快速检查了一下神龛，拉上了屏风门，然后鞠了一躬，邀请你跟她一起走。你跟着她，她将你引到神龛的背后，来到了花园的尽头，那里在树木的根部处有一张巨大的石桌，周围摆放着几把简单的座椅。她轻轻拂去松针和落花，发出“啧”的一声，然后打开手中的包裹，里面是一件传统的白色长袍和一个小枕头。她把枕头放在桌子上。空气中弥漫着淡淡的草木气息与水的气息，这些气息主要来源于一侧的装饰性水景——那里由各式各样的石制和竹制管道组成，看起来令人眼花缭乱。真的……非常有艺术感。 虽然这不是最舒适的躺姿，但应该也够用了。环境对于帮助人们进入正确的思维状态来说确实很重要，而这个姿势本来就不是为了让人感到特别舒服而设计的，”舞一边说，一边把枕头拍得松软一些，然后向你眨了眨眼。“现在，请你翻过来，趴在桌子上，我们就可以开始了。不必害羞——我保证不会偷看，只要这样你能更舒服一些就行。 看着她那毫不掩饰的目光盯着你的耳朵和尾巴，你也不禁开始怀疑起来。不过，舞还是开始把一张薄薄的白色布料铺在石桌上——显然，这种布料和她打算让你穿的衣物是用同一种材料制成的。你急忙脱下了自己的衣服[pc.armor]穿上那件白色、飘逸的长袍，感受它穿在身上是多么轻盈。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]你可以清楚地感受到那阵微风从自己的四肢间掠过，尽管它的力度其实相当大。当你完成后，舞会敲击桌子，然后微笑着示意你上前。 “请上来吧，尊贵的阁下。您想要那种力度强劲的耳部爱抚……那么您就会得到这样的体验，既热烈又充满力度。 They appear to be quite engrossed with their work, [var0 |but drop what they're doing to come around before you and bow with the appropriate respect given your station. Or well, it feels like it's appropriate to your station — they're good at that. "Ain't it a fine [dayNight |day |evenin' ] f'r ya to be visitin' us." "Anythin' th' both o' us can be helpin' ya with?" Mai cozies up to her sister in a clearly practised motion. "Ain't it a fine [dayNight |day |evenin' ] f'r yer divine grace to be visitin' us with yer consort." rows.raw: " As you approach the little shrine at the edge of the gardens, you discover that for once, neither sister is on duty to receive petitioners — the entryway has been tied off with a piece of colorful rope, white paper talismans hanging from along its length. A quick glance around reveals why: both Kurokawa sisters are off to one side by the torii gate, poking at it with what look like wands, or at least long wooden lacquered rods. They appear to be quite engrossed with their work, [var0 |but drop what they're doing to come around before you and bow with the appropriate respect given your station. Or well, it feels like it's appropriate to your station — they're good at that. "Payin' respects to yer Eminence[party.has kiyoko |an' [silly |th' Myobu-sama |High Lady Ōtomo ] ]," Miko says, rolling her words as she folds her ears forward against her head. "Ain't it a fine [dayNight |day |evenin' ] f'r ya to be visitin' us." "Anythin' th' both o' us can be helpin' ya with?" Mai cozies up to her sister in a clearly practised motion. "Ya know we're always at th' service o' one as illustrious as ya." |but drop what they're doing to come around before Kiyoko and bow with the appropriate respect, then do the same for you. "Payin' our respects to [silly |ya, Myobu-sama |th' High Lady Ōtomo ], Miko says, rolling her words as she folds her ears forward against her head. "Ain't it a fine [dayNight |day |evenin' ] f'r yer divine grace to be visitin' us with yer consort." The foxes have a very brief conversation in their native language, but quickly switch back to Belharan for your benefit, your fox-wife dismissing the twins with a nonchalant wave of her hand. "As you were, the both of you." "Anythin' th' both o' us can be helpin' ya and yer consort with?" Mai cozies up to her sister in a clearly practised motion. "Ya know we're always at th' service o' one as illustrious as ya." Kiyoko raises an eyebrow and curls one of her tail tips, taking it into her hands. "Save me the flattery, the both of you. I know your lineage well enough." |and don't realize that you're around for a little bit — either that, or they're deliberately ignoring you. The spell, though, is eventually broken as Miko notices you observing them and is up before you in a flash; it's a little shocking to see someone that, uh, big-boned move that quickly. But then again, one supposes that she has sufficient incentive... "Well, if'n it ain't [pc.name], my favorite [pc.raceCute]," Miko purrs, cozying up to you and firmly shoving herself into your personal space. "Lil' ol' me was jus' thinkin' of how nice it woulda be if someone like ya were to be showin' up on [a] [dayNight |day |evenin' ] like this, all succulent an' plump..." "Ya really gotta be changing yer approach, sis," Mai says dryly as she brings up the rear. "I think [pc.name] has jus' 'bout heard that one too many times. Sorry 'bout my sis here, ya know how she is, always thinkin' o' eatin' when that there mind o' hers should be focusing on the task at hand." "It's bo-orin'. That's what is is, borin'." "Nothin' ain't able to be holdin' yer attention none, ya vamp. Please, [pc.name] — weren't there somethin' ya were seekin' us out f'r?" ] Well, you'll take the sisters up on their offer. What're they up to that requires them to close up the shrine? Miko waves her rod? Wand? Whatever it is, you don't think there's an exact analogue you're familiar with. "Oh, ain't nothin' much. Sis an' I, we were just fixin' up th' torii gate an' all. Doin' th' equivalent o' fillin' up a few holes, makin' sure everythin's in tip-top shape so that ain't no one gonna be split down th' middle an' twisted all over if'n the gate does a thing while they're comin' through an' all. Ya know, that thing which happens when two people try to be in th' same place at once when they come outta them Ways Between?" Wait, that sort of thing can happen? Mai hurriedly pushes her sister out of the way. "Nah, [pc.ra kitsune |ain't no need to be worryin' 'bout that, yer Eminence. ]Miko's jus' pullin' yer leg. But ya gotta keep these entryways clean an' clear, elsewise them things can be gettin' all filthy. Ya seen all th' waystones 'round these parts that the Belharans done left behind, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |right ]?" You nod. "'S a small miracle an' a testament to th' wonders o' Belhar that them things are still workin' that th' worst that done happened to them is they fell silent f'r a bit. Even with th' snake goddess workin' with us to be regulatin' them, our torii gates ain't had no chance to be standin' th' test o' time an' with luck, that ain't gonna be in th' cards. One o' our jobs is to be maintainin' an' recalibratin' th' gate weekly." [pc.isMage |Can you help? You've had some training in matters magical. No sooner are the words out of your mouth that the Kurokawa sisters pull together, all [pc.ra kitsune |smiles and obsequence. At this point, you know these foxes well enough to realize that they're trying to say no without actually having to outright deny you; one of those I-promise-to-do-anything-you-say-if-you-don't-ask-anything-of-me affairs. "That is, yer Eminence..." Oh, nevermind, it was just a passing whimsy. You didn't mean to impugn their skills and imply that they were incapable. "That ain't it none, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship," Miko finally says after yet more awkward silence. "We ain't allowed to let no one who ain't a shinshoku dedicated to th' task fiddle with th' gates without clearance from th' snake goddess' people — folks 'round these parts know her as Nareva. 'S a direct order from not one, but two deities, an' as illustrious as ya may be, his divine lordship's word still done overrule yours." Mai folds her arms. "Ya coulda be more circumspect about sayin' all that, sis." "Ain't no way to be sayin' it rightly without bein' blunt." |smiles and giggles. Abruptly, though, Mai's expression turns serious, and she shakes her head. "I understand that ya ain't no fool, [pc.name], but that ain't possible. Ain't no one's supposed to be touchin' any torii gate who weren't first cleared by th' snake goddess' people — folks 'round these parts know her as Nareva. 'S a direct order from not one, but two deities, an' as much as we done like ya there ain't no goin' against a direct order from a god, if'n ya get my meanin'. "Sis an' I certainly didn't mean to say that ya were incapable or uneducated or anythin' like that. 'S jus' that ya coulda be the greatest wizard around and we'd still have to deny ya or die tryin'." Mai folds her arms. "Ya jus' had to be blunt about it, didja, sis?" "Ain't it th' truth, though?" ] |Oh. Well, you're not educated in such matters, so it'd probably be for the best if you left them to it. Mai nods at that. "Even if'n ya were, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence, we wouldn't be allowed to let ya. Not that sis an' I are in th' habit o' denyin' someone o' yer illustrious nature, ya see, but ain't no one who isn't a shinshoku dedicated to th' task fiddle with th' gates without clearance from th' snake goddess' people — folks 'round these parts know her as Nareva. 'S a direct order from not one, but two deities. "Much as we done respect ya, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, we ain't goin' against that none." |that ain't possible. Ain't no one's supposed to be touchin' any torii gate who weren't first cleared by th' snake goddess' people — folks 'round these parts know her as Nareva. 'S a direct order from not one, but two deities, an' as much as we done like ya there ain't no goin' against a direct order from a god, if'n ya get my meanin'. If'n ya tried in earnest, we'd have to stop ya or die tryin', an' no one wants that if'n ya get my meanin'." ] ] All right, all right, you get it. Sorry to have pulled them away from their work like that. "Weren't no trouble at all, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |weren't no trouble at all ]. Tell ya what, sis an' I, we'll make it up to ya right here an' now," Miko says, licking her lips. "There's been a question that's been troublin' us f'r a lil' while..." "It ain't done to be [pc.ra kitsune |troublin' [pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship with our family matters none |draggin' [pc.name] into our family business ], sis..." Miko cheerfully ignores her sister and continues. "Ya see, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ], while sis an' I were workin' on th' torii gate we were talkin' 'bout our future, as it were. How we've been together since we were kits an' always slept in th' same bed even if'n it weren't always together, that kinda thing..." Indeed, you...see. "Jus' a lil' argument, nothin' serious[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. But maybe ya could be helpin' us answer a question..." And that would be? Before Mai's swooped in and grabbed her sister, Miko's already said it. "If'n ya had to be settlin' down with one o' us f'r the rest o' yer days, who woulda it be? No cheatin' an' sayin' both or none, it's gotta be one or the other — mph mph mpppph — " Before you know it, Mai's leapt onto her sister from behind and wrapped both arms and tails about a flailing Miko. There's a lot of Miko to wrap, though, and soon the sisters are embroiled in a slapfight, propriety thrown to the wind as they yip and bark at each other like actual foxes. To see the two of them get into a downright brawl while still in their semi-formal shrine maiden's uniforms — there's something to be said for the juxtaposition of kitsune culture and their natures, but right now your time's better spent breaking up this fight. That being said, the easiest way to do that is to give them the tiebreaker they need... Indeed, in such a completely hypothetical situation, which sister would you favor? You might want to consider your answer carefully and answer honestly, because if either sister finds out that you weren't completely sincere, the yipping and barking that's rising from the scuffle will be nothing in comparison... "

rows.original: All right, that's quite enough. They want to know which sister you'd prefer? It's Miko. No sooner have the words left your lips that the fighting ceases, Mai still grabbing onto Miko's collar. Both sisters pause for several breaths, processing what you've said, then Mai falls flat on her back onto the grass as she lets go and stares upwards with a sigh. "Told ya," Miko says, dusting herself off as she gets to her feet. The voluptuous vixen sticks her tongue out at her sister and makes a childish face. "Maybe if'n ya didn't have th' scent of smoke hangin' 'round ya all th' time, sis, there wouldn't be need to be so harsh on ya." "Shut up, ya vamp." Mai sighs in reply, keeping her gaze fixed on the ceiling, the fight gone out of her. "Ya jus' flash yer tits an' thighs at everythin' an' call it a day." Miko doesn't have any reply for her sister, instead seeing to her mussed uniform and fur, then sauntering up to you and [pc.ra kitsune |giving you a small bow before ]kissing you on the cheek. She's still mighty ruffled, but at least with the smoothing out of the worst bits she manages to make her unkempt appearance fetching in its own way. "Much obliged[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]. Didn't expect ya to be sidin' with me." Hey now, she shouldn't let it get to her head. When there're only two people in the running for the pick, it's not that much of a deal if you picked her out of the two. "Still, thank ya. It done mean a lot to me... and even if'n Mai's lookin' like she done bit down on a sour plum, it done matter to her, too.[pc.ra kitsune |Havin' a direct servant of his divine lordship giving lil' ol' me an endorsement... ya might not know how much a kind word from up on high, from someone as illustrious as ya might brighten up the day of simple folk." She's the governor's descendant, she's hardly simple. But... yes, you get what she's trying to tell you. "Some folks might think that we're kinda stuffy, an' they wouldn't be wrong if'n th' only folk they saw were cus'. But there ain't nothin' wrong with givin' a kind word here an' there, so long as it's truly warranted. ]" Miko's plush lips are still dangerously close to your cheek, and her warm breath tickles your skin. Presently, she withdraws and heads back to help her sister up, but not without throwing you a wink over her shoulder. "Thank ya f'r th' endorsement, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. I won't be forgettin' it easy. All right, sis, ain't no time to be lyin' about. That there torii gate ain't gonna mind itself..." As the Kurokawa sisters pull themselves together and start back on the gate, you're left to your own devices. [party.has kiyoko |Smiling, Kiyoko cozies up to you and twines a tail about [pc.ra kitsune |one of yours |a leg ], making sure to let you get a good feel of the warm fuzzies. "You handled that quite well, beloved." You did? Well, if she says so. Personally, you can't help but wonder if you did the right thing by endorsing Miko. Ducking the question would certainly have made it worse after the sisters explicitly told you not to do that, and you did stop the scuffle, but it's just that, well, clearly this isn't going to have any repercussions down the line. Clearly. Kiyoko just laughs at that. "Ah! Double-guessing your decisions, beloved? Quite unbefitting of the one whom I love." Well... She [pc.heightRange 69 |stands on tiptoe ]and reaches to pinch your cheeks with both hands. "No sense in such thoughts after the act. If something great and terrible happens as a result of your choice here today, then we can handle it as it comes. Why worry about what might happen? You already have enough troubles to contend with in reality without adding imaginary ones to your burden." Yeah, she's right. No point thinking too much about it for now. |Sure, encouraging Miko might not have been the best of actions, but trying to duck the question would probably have made it worse, and you did stop the scuffle. [silly |Clearly this isn't going to have any repercussions down the line. Clearly |A job well done, as some might say ]. Well, while the sisters are busy with the gate, you're not going to get at either, so maybe waiting for them to be done would be best... ]
rows.translation: 好了，够了。他们想知道你更喜欢哪位姐妹吧？当然是米可。 话音刚落，争斗立刻停止了，舞依然紧抓着米可的衣领。两位姐妹都停下了动作，仔细思考着你的话，然后舞松开手，仰面倒在草地上，叹了口气。 我就说吧，”米可一边站起来一边拍掉身上的灰尘，这个性感的狐妖妹对着妹妹吐了吐舌头，做出一副孩子气的表情，“要是你身上不总是带着烟味的话，姐姐也不会对你这么严厉了吧。闭嘴吧，你这个吸血鬼。”舞叹了口气回答道，目光仍然盯着天花板，已经没有了继续争吵的力气。“你只不过是用你的胸部和大腿吸引别人的注意，然后就觉得万事大吉了。” 米可没有回答妹妹的话，而是整理了一下自己凌乱的制服和毛发，然后慢悠悠地走到了你面前[pc.ra kitsune |在此先向您微微鞠躬。 ]亲了亲你的脸颊。她还是显得有些心烦意乱，但至少在把最糟糕的部分处理掉之后，她那凌乱的外表反而以另一种方式显得别具魅力了。 “非常感谢[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 ]真没想到你会站在我这边。” 嘿，她可不能因此而得意忘形。当只有两个人在竞争同一个机会时，从这两个人中选择她，并不是什么了不起的事情。 “不过，还是谢谢你。这对我来说意义重大……而且，即使舞看起来有些不高兴，这对她来说也同样重要。[pc.ra kitsune |有他的神圣主宰亲自派一位仆从来为我提供担保……你可能不知道，来自如此崇高地位、如此显赫的人物的一句善意的话语，竟能为平凡人的生活带来多大的欢乐。 她是州长的后裔，她的身份绝非普通。不过……嗯，你应该明白她想表达的意思。 “有些人可能会认为我们有些古板守旧，如果他们见到的只有我们这类人，那么他们的看法也不无道理。不过，偶尔说几句善意的话并没有什么坏处，只要这些话确实是出于真诚。 ]米可的柔软嘴唇依然危险地靠近你的脸颊，她呼出的温暖气息轻拂着你的皮肤。这时，她退开了，回去帮助她的姐姐站起来，但在离开之前，她还回头朝你眨了眨眼。 “谢谢你的支持， [pc.ra kitsune |你的。 [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 |[pc.name] ]我绝对不会轻易忘记这件事的。好了，姐妹，现在没有时间撒谎了。就是这么回事。鸟居大门可不会自己动起来……” 当黑川姐妹重新振作起来，开始走向那扇大门时，你就只能自己想办法了。 [party.has kiyoko |基代子微笑着靠近你，然后将她的尾巴缠在你的身上。 [pc.ra kitsune |你的手下之一 |一段路程 ]这一切都是为了让你真正感受到那种温暖与愉悦。 “你处理得相当不错，亲爱的。” 是吗？嗯，如果她这么说的话……不过说实话，你还是忍不住会怀疑自己支持米科这个决定是否正确。在姐妹们明确告诫你不要那么做的情况下，如果你回避这个问题，情况只会变得更糟。确实制止了这场争执，但很明显，这件事以后不会带来任何后果，这一点显而易见。 清子只是对此笑了笑，说道：“啊！连自己的决定都要反复斟酌吗，亲爱的？这可真不符合我对你们的期望啊。” 嗯…… 她[pc.heightRange 69 |踮起脚来 ]然后她伸出双手来捏你的脸颊，说道：“事情已经发生了，再想这些也没意义。如果你今天的选择真的导致了什么重大而可怕的结果，我们到时候再想办法应对就是了。为什么要提前担心可能会发生什么呢？在现实生活中，你已经有足够的麻烦要处理了，何必再给自己增添不必要的忧虑呢。” 是啊，她说得对。现在想得太多了也没用。 |当然，鼓励米可或许并不是最好的做法，但试图回避这个问题反而可能会让情况变得更糟，你懂我的意思吧？确实停止这场争执吧。 [silly |显然，这件事日后不会带来任何后果。显然如此。 |干得真棒，有些人可能会这么说。 ]嗯，既然姐妹俩都在忙那道门的事，你也没办法拿到任何东西，所以也许等她们忙完再说会更好…… ]

It done mean a lot to me... and even if'n Mai's lookin' like she done bit down on a sour plum, it done matter to her, too.[pc.ra kitsune |Havin' a direct servant of his divine lordship giving lil' ol' me an endorsement... ya might not know how much a kind word from up on high, from someone as illustrious as ya might brighten up the day of simple folk." She's the governor's descendant, she's hardly simple. But... yes, you get what she's trying to tell you. "Some folks might think that we're kinda stuffy, an' they wouldn't be wrong if'n th' only folk they saw were cus'. But there ain't nothin' wrong with givin' a kind word here an' there, so long as it's truly warranted. ]" Miko's plush lips are still dangerously close to your cheek, and her warm breath tickles your skin. Presently, she withdraws and heads back to help her sister up, but not without throwing you a wink over her shoulder. "Thank ya f'r th' endorsement, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]. I won't be forgettin' it easy. All right, sis, ain't no time to be lyin' about. That there torii gate ain't gonna mind itself..." As the Kurokawa sisters pull themselves together and start back on the gate, you're left to your own devices. [party.has kiyoko |Smiling, Kiyoko cozies up to you and twines a tail about [pc.ra kitsune |one of yours |a leg ], making sure to let you get a good feel of the warm fuzzies. "You handled that quite well, beloved." You did? Well, if she says so. Personally, you can't help but wonder if you did the right thing by endorsing Miko. Ducking the question would certainly have made it worse after the sisters explicitly told you not to do that, and you did stop the scuffle, but it's just that, well, clearly this isn't going to have any repercussions down the line. Clearly. Kiyoko just laughs at that. "Ah! Double-guessing your decisions, beloved? Quite unbefitting of the one whom I love." Well... She [pc.heightRange 69 |stands on tiptoe ]and reaches to pinch your cheeks with both hands. "No sense in such thoughts after the act. If something great and terrible happens as a result of your choice here today, then we can handle it as it comes. Why worry about what might happen? You already have enough troubles to contend with in reality without adding imaginary ones to your burden." Yeah, she's right. No point thinking too much about it for now. |Sure, encouraging Miko might not have been the best of actions, but trying to duck the question would probably have made it worse, and you did stop the scuffle. [silly |Clearly this isn't going to have any repercussions down the line. Clearly |A job well done, as some might say ]. Well, while the sisters are busy with the gate, you're not going to get at either, so maybe waiting for them to be done would be best... ] "

rows.translation: 好了，这样就够了。他们想知道你更喜欢哪位姐妹吧？是舞。 话音刚落，争斗立刻停止了，舞仍然紧抓着米可的衣领。两位姐妹都停下了动作，仔细思考着你的话。随后，米可将妹妹推倒在草地上，自己也跟着倒下，仰面躺在地上，叹了口气，然后抬头望着天空。 算了，我再也不想打架了。” “终于明白道理了啊，”舞说着，站起身来拍掉身上的灰尘。她捡起在打斗中掉落的烟斗，小心翼翼地把它放回衣服里。也许如果你不是那么胖的话，姐姐，就不会有人对你这么苛刻了。” “闭嘴。我才不想和你说话呢。”米可叹了口气回答道，目光始终盯着天花板，因喘息而使胸部不断起伏。你真是个冷冰冰的贱人，你自己心里也清楚这一点。” 舞没有回答妹妹的话，而是整理好自己的制服和毛发，然后大步走到你面前[pc.ra kitsune |在保持适当距离的前提下停下脚步 ]她微微鞠了一躬。虽然与米可打闹了一番，整个人都显得有些凌乱，但即便头发乱蓬蓬的，毛发也竖了起来，她依然保持着那种沉着冷静的神态，这种反差反而让她的形象更加迷人。该怎么形容这种感觉呢？“俏皮地显得有些凌乱”？不太对……但差不多吧。尽管外表看起来有些随意，舞依然保持着平静与自信，然后她向你露出了一个微笑。 “非常感谢。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]真没想到你会站在我这边。” 嘿，她可不能因此而得意忘形。当只有两个人在竞争同一个机会时，从这两个人中选择她，并不是什么了不起的事情。 “不过，还是谢谢你。这对我来说意义重大……而且，即使米可像被狗追着一样大喊大叫，这对她来说也同样重要。[pc.ra kitsune |有他的神圣主宰亲自派一位仆从来为我提供担保……你可能不知道，来自如此崇高地位、如此显赫的人物的一句善意的话语，能给平凡的人们带来多大的快乐啊。 她是州长的后裔，她的身份绝非普通。不过……嗯，你应该明白她想表达的意思。 “有些人可能会认为我们有些古板守旧，如果他们见到的只有我们这类人，他们的看法也未必是错的。不过，偶尔说几句善意的话并没有什么坏处，只要这些话确实是出于真诚。 ] 有点尴尬吧，还得拖着你一起[pc.ra kitsune |r [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 ]进入了我们的家族企业，但是[pc.ra kitsune |这些话，米可根本没有任何办法否认。她现在肯定要认栽一段时间了，每次遇到那些她靠卖弄自己的身材也无法解决的问题时，她总是会这样。 |有时候，如果有人能从外部角度带来新的观点，对大家来说反而会更好。我们总不能过于执着于当前面临的问题，不是吗？ ]舞的嘴角又微微上扬，再次优雅地向你鞠了一躬。她轻轻旋转身体，让裙摆飘动起来，然后退开去帮助她的妹妹站起来——她的臀部摆动得幅度，其实比真正需要的还要大一些。 “谢谢你的支持，”她说道。 [pc.ra kitsune |你的。 [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 |[pc.name] ]我绝对不会轻易忘记这件事的。好了，姐妹，现在没有时间撒谎了。就是这么回事。鸟居大门应该不会介意吧……” 当黑川姐妹重新振作起来，开始走向那扇大门时，你就只能自己继续行动了。 [party.has kiyoko |基代子微笑着靠近你，然后将她的尾巴缠在你的身上。 [pc.ra kitsune |你的手下之一 |一段路程 ]这一切都是为了让你能够真正感受到那种温暖与愉悦。 “你处理得相当不错，亲爱的。嗯，已经尽当时机允许的范围把事情处理得井井有条了。” 你真的这么认为吗？好吧，如果她这么说的话……不过 personally speaking，你还是忍不住会怀疑自己支持舞是否真的是正确的决定。在姐妹们明确告诫你不要那么做的情况下，如果你回避这个问题，情况只会变得更糟确实停止这场争执吧，但很明显，这件事以后不会带来任何后果。毫无疑问，舞才是更明智的选择——她比另一个人更负责任、更冷静，也更受欢迎，而另一个人则不然。……与米可不同，她显得异常精力充沛，让人感到有些困扰。不过，这终究还是一个赌注而已。你肯定希望，因为选择了她的妹妹而不是米可，自己并没有伤害到米可太多吧？她肯定经常遇到这种事情。 对于这一点，清子只是笑了笑而已。啊！原来你喜欢的就是这种类型的女人啊，亲爱的。” 嗯……那只是在两人之间作出的选择。没必要想得太复杂。 [pc.heightRange 69 |踮起脚来 ]然后他伸出双手来捏你的脸颊，笑着说：“我只是开开玩笑而已，亲爱的，不必这么慌张。如果美琴的名声不好，肯定是有原因的。也许你对她妹妹的支持会激励她更加注意自己的言行，而不是让她在已经堆积如山的负面评价中再添一笔吧。无论美雪在如何称赞美琴，这两姐妹之间的关系依然非常亲密；一个人有怎样的感受，另一个人也能体会到。 是啊，她说得对——你应该考虑这件事最终会带来什么好的结果，而不是坏的结果。黑川姐妹在现实生活中已经经历了太多这样的困境，尽管她们有着一些与众不同的特点，但她们仍然在努力克服这些困难。 |当然，当你选择舞而不是米可时，后者可能会感到有些难过，因为整天都能听到别人对舞的赞扬而忽略她。不过，试图回避这个问题反而可能会让情况变得更糟。确实停止这场争执吧。希望这话是出自你之口。 [pc.ra kitsune |他们信仰的神的守护者 |具有客观视角的人 ]这或许会激励米可振作起来，改过自新，不再像刚才那样表现得那么幼稚……至少这是乐观的看法吧。 嗯，既然姐妹俩都在忙于处理那道门的事情，你暂时也接触不到她们中的任何一个，所以或许等她们忙完再行动会比较好…… ]

rows.original: Approaching the little shrine at the edge of the gardens, you pause for a moment, wondering just where everyone is today. While the majority of supplicants arrive at dawn and dusk — hence both sisters being on duty then — there're usually a few foxen at these times who're looking to beat the rush during the day. No, it's not just the lack of people, it's something in the very air [pc.ra kitsune |that tickles whatever sixth sense you've gained ever since becoming one of these people, resonates with whatever new nature that Keros implanted in you |that makes your gut twist and you feel a bit uneasy ]. It's not anything malicious, but a sense of impending mischief that really shouldn't be anything strange to you at this point, hanging around these parts. And then there comes Miko, stepping out from inside the shrine and sliding the door shut behind her. Well, that explains the feeling. Noticing you, the buxom shrine maiden [pc.ra kitsune |approaches carefully with small steps. Even so, they're definitely and unequivocally very forward steps as she keeps a barely respectful distance and gives you a deep bow, hands clasped in front of her and eyes trained on the ground. Miko's usually unabashed about her sexuality, but is it your imagination, or is she endeavouring to show off more of her cleavage today then she usually does? "It's great to be able to receive th' likes o' ya here today, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Can I help ya pay respects to yer divine lord? Or maybe ya done want somethin' else? Lil' ol' me can help with that, too." Something else... such as. Miko shivers, clearly fighting a battle with herself to keep up appearances; you get the distinct impression of a vixen poised to pounce. "Well, yer Eminence... |sashays forward, walking with a deliberate wiggle to her butt and sweeping her six tails in her wake as she gets just inside of your personal space and gives you a small bow. "Well, if'n it ain't a sight f'r sore eyes we have here," Miko purrs. " ]Ya done smell good today, real good. Ain't different or nothin', jus' more... intense. Can't say I don't like it none, myself." You personally haven't noticed any change yourself, but you're not about to tell Miko that. [pc.ra kitsune |Inclining her head further, Miko draws a long, deep breath through her teeth that sets her generous bosom to shaking within its confines, one of her tails unconsciously curling about her leg and thigh |Sweeping around to your side, Miko leans in close enough for her breath to tickle your shoulder even as one of her six tails strokes your leg, [pc.hasTail |soft fur brushing against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] before teasing your tail-tip |teasing you for a moment with soft, glossy fur against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] ] ]. "Yer aura's done lookin' real good today, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence. |ain't it? ] It's all glowy an' warm, with plumes an' tendrils an' whatnot as it done flows off ya like one o' them rock fountains Kazuo makes. Jus' lookin' at it done makes me feel all good inside." At this point, the naked hunger in Miko's golden eyes is blatant, the shrine maiden struggling to keep herself all in one piece. You don't care if it's some drastic breach of etiquette; closing what little distance remains, you grab Miko by the shoulders firmly before she can do something stupid. Just the touch of your fingers on her bare skin is enough to send her eyes to widening, their pupils narrowing to vertical lines as she pants heavily. Now! [pc.ra kitsune |With all the authority invested in you as the divine champion of her patron deity, you're going to very nicely and politely demand that she explain |Would she mind explaining ] just what's gotten into her? And is it related to the fact that there aren't any petitioners here at the shrine right now? Miko contrives to look thoughtful and raises a finger to her lips. "We-ll, it's done kinda embarrassin'[pc.ra kitsune |, yer Eminence ]..." She's already embarrassing herself enough, acting like a fool in front of [pc.ra kitsune |someone so much higher on the social ladder than her. |an outsider like you. Surely she should be looking to make a better impression than that on other peoples? ] Either way, she's already lost all semblance of propriety at this point, so there's no point in being coy about it. "Well, [pc.ra kitsune |yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |ya see ], I was kinda hungry when lil' ol' me done woke up this mornin'... " That's nothing new, coming from Miko. "So I went an' had a snack, but it didn't do nothin'. So I went an' had another one, an' was still achin' inside when I finished, both inside an' out... I know Granny an' Mai say I'm always wantin' somethin' to eat, that I'm a glutton an' a pig, but gettin' a morsel to hit th' spot makes it not as bad f'r a bit. This, though..." You're starting to see where this is going. "His divine lordship came down today to see Granny an' I asked him 'bout it: he jus' smiled in that there way he does when he knows th' answer, but ain't tellin' 'cause he done thinks it'll be more interestin'. Still, you figure that she's being completely open and honest about it all, given how off-kilter she's behaving today. To your surprise, Miko does the unthinkable: dropping to her knees with her six tails fanning out behind her, the shrine maiden kowtows to you, her forehead pressed to the ground. Perhaps in any other context Miko might have been scary, but here and now she just looks quite pathetic. "Have a heart, won't ya? I ain't one to be askin' f'r favors often, but this here hunger's gonna drive me outta my mind if'n I don't do somethin' 'bout it soon, an' I don't know what." ] [party.has kiyoko |Looking at Miko as she is, you turn to your fox-wife and ask her if she knows what's up with the poor girl, why's she acting this way. Mikoto is acting as if she has not fed for months at this point, yet she informed us that she 'had a snack' this morning. If it were not for her particular condition and earnestness of action, I would have suspected her of simply feigning desperate hunger in order to entice something out of you. "Even though I cannot quite diagnose what this is for sure, it could not hurt to let her share of your essence, could it? [pc.ra kitsune |Consider it a cocommital responsibility to your subjects to care for their well-being, even as they give you their unwavering loyalty; I'm sure that it will build up goodwill towards you and increase your standing in the eyes of those who are still privately unsure of you, even if it is by but a small amount. But certainly it would go towards building more goodwill between you and everyone else living here; one's actions do not go unnoticed in our society. ]" That's her assessment of the situation? A small, coy smile plays on Kiyoko's lips. "It is, beloved." ] Well, damn. You really do have to think about this — on one hand, Miko is being pretty genuine about her hunger. On the other hand, sating said hunger would leave you within an inch of your life, given how her particular affliction turns her into a ravening [silly |fuckbeast |glutton ] when she cuts loose. While you don't know what exactly happened to her to awaken that kind of desperate need, you know full well what she's capable of when presented with good food. In fact, given what's almost certainly going to happen if you let her feed off you, she may very well end up pregnant in the bargain. In the scheme of things, this little episode probably isn't life-threatening or detrimental if Keros himself was willing to brush off her complaints just to see her squirm. If Miko's health or sanity were truly in danger, he'd have stepped in, or at least told her what was wrong with her... presumably. Who's to know that this isn't another one of his pranks? Still, there's that reassurance that nothing seriously wrong will come out of it if you refuse her here. Knowing all this, are you going to go along with Miko and accede to her request?

rows.translation: 你最终苏醒过来——起初这令人震惊，但考虑到你的处境，倒也不算太意外。你从自己被安置的蒲团上坐起身，只觉浑身发虚、头晕目眩，最终重力再次抓住了你虚弱的身体，把你拉回那片令人安心的柔软之中。你匆匆扫了一眼四周，发现自己正身处树枝间那座小小的休憩屋里，显然有人花了心思，仔仔细细地把你安置得十分舒适。 [kiyoko.around |一道阴影笼罩在你身上，随后清子的脸庞出现在你的视野里，饶有兴致地俯视着你。不过，你那位狐妻脸上的神情打消了你对自己是否命悬一线的所有担忧——她俯下身，用力拍了拍你的头[pc.ra kitsune | 还捏了捏你的耳朵，然后随手用手指梳理起你尾巴上的毛发 ]。 “欢迎回来，亲爱的。你刚才在上面那一出可真是精彩。” 对了……她说过她会看着的。 “我确实在看，而且你的表现相当令人赞叹。”她俯下身，在你的脸颊上轻轻一吻。“或许你偶尔也能把那股劲头带到我们自己的交合里来，行不行？当然，不是现在……” 这你可说不准；她看上去随时都准备扑上来跟你亲热。当然，这些天她一向都是这副样子，怀不怀孕都一样。 清子轻笑了一声。“不管怎样，你看起来已经受够了，所以我就照先前说的做了，把你救了出来，然后才唤来美琴的妹妹去处理她、收拾残局。一切都完好如初，所以你不用为这件事担心。我只是很高兴，你还是一如既往地宽宏大量、精力充沛，能给我的子民们一份几乎比得上我们俩之间那种的待遇……” 嗯，谢了。有那么一瞬间，你觉得自己为了喂饱米可，可能把自己耗得太狠了；虽然你并没有真的有意去想这件事，但为了那样的快感，你或许已经准备好在那一刻就死掉。当然，面对清子这般可爱的脸蛋，谁都会为了能多看一眼而从死里复活。 “啧，真会奉承。不管怎么说，你刚才的表现相当出色，所以等这件事不可避免地传开后，大家肯定会对你高看那么一点——当然，我也会，毕竟我挑中了这么一位出色的配偶。好了，现在休息吧。在经历了有人或许会称之为‘死里逃生’的事情之后，你需要好好恢复体力……” |一道阴影笼罩在你身上，随后凯罗斯的脸出现在你的视野里，饶有兴致地俯视着你。不过，这位神明脸上的神情打消了你对自己是否命悬一线的所有担忧——他俯下身，用力拍了拍你的头[pc.ra kitsune | 还捏了捏你的耳朵，然后随手用手指梳理起你尾巴上的毛发。 “起来吧[silly | 从你的坟墓里 ]，我的勇士。虽然你的表现确实相当令人赞叹，但如果你因为偶然撞上我的一位神社巫女就丢了性命，那未免太可惜了——更不用说这对我的名声是多大的打击。你现在感觉身体完全健康吗？” [pc.isDK |他居然会从‘这会让他多丢脸’的角度来关心你的健康，真是贴心。不过没错，没错，考虑到你刚刚经历的这一切，你的感觉已经好得不能再好了。 “利他主义固然不错，但在自己的动机里掺进一点切身利害，总归是好事，不是吗？你应该明白。” |是的，考虑到你刚刚经历的这一切，你的感觉已经好得不能再好了。当你想自己可能要没命的时候，他把你从那里拉了出来，真是太好了——或者说，至少当时还能剩下一个‘你’的话。 “所有的传说都说了，我只对那些活该的人无礼刻薄。” ] |。 “起床啦，亲爱的朋友。虽然你的表现确实相当令人赞叹，但看着像你这么有趣的人因为偶然撞上我的一位神社巫女就丢了性命，那未免太浪费了。在我看来，你根本不该落得那么不光彩的下场，尤其是当这还是一桩相当无私之举的结果。那么，你现在感觉相当健康吗？” 头有点晕，浑身都很虚弱，但至少你的头脑还清楚。 “很好，很好。那么，没有留下什么永久性的损伤 ]。话说回来，你刚才在上面那一出可真是精彩……我还是要再夸奖你一次[pc.ra kitsune |，我的勇士。显然你对我来说是正确的人选——即便有丧命的风险，也挡不住你去寻点乐子 ]。” 对了，趁你还没忘，有件事你想问……早些时候，米可提到她曾就自己那个、呃、问题向他请教过，而他却只是随口打发了…… “是吗？” 他知道吗？ “知道什么，具体说说？知道我亲爱的美琴有喜了吗？当然知道，而且只要我盯着她，在我的眼皮底下就不会真出什么岔子。至于说你会出现，还试图去填满她那无底的虚空？我哪有那样的预知能力。这事看起来可能挺有意思，所以我就由着它顺其自然了……” “不管怎样，你刚才的表现相当出色，所以我相信等这件事不可避免地传开后，大家对你的评价肯定会更高一些。[pc.ra kitsune | — 当然，也包括我，毕竟我挑中了这么一位出色的勇士 ]。那么，现在休息吧。在经历了有人或许会称之为‘死里逃生’的经历之后，你需要好好恢复体力……” ]
rows.raw: " You eventually come to, something that's initially shocking but not quite surprising given your circumstances. Sitting up in the futon you've been laid out on, you feel faint, your head spins, and eventually gravity takes hold of your failing body once more to draw you back into welcoming softness. A quick glance at your surroundings reveals that you're in the little rest house in the tree's branches, someone having carefully taken the time to make you very comfortable. [kiyoko.around |A shadow falls over you, and eventually Kiyoko's face appears in your vision, peering down amusedly at you. The expression your fox-wife's wearing clears any concerns you may have about whether your life is in imminent danger, though, as she reaches down and gives you a firm pat on your head[pc.ra kitsune | and tweak of the ears, before idly combing the fur of your tails with her fingers ]. "Welcome back, beloved. That was quite the show you put up there." Right... she said she'd be watching. "Indeed I was, and you performed quite admirably." She leans down and gives you a small kiss on the cheek. "Perhaps you could bring some of that vigor into our own copulation every so often, could you not? Not now, of course..." You don't know about that; she certainly seems ready to jump your bones at any moment. Of course, that's how she usually looks these days, pregnant or not. Kiyoko chuckles a little. "In either case, you looked like you'd had enough, so I did what I said I was going to do and extricated you before summoning up Mikoto's sister to deal with her and clean up the mess. Everything's as good as new, so you don't have to worry about the matter. I'm just glad that you're as magnanimous and energetic as always to give to my subjects a treatment that's almost as the ones we have together..." Well, thanks. For a moment there, you thought you might've stretched yourself too thin feeding Miko; while you hadn't actually consciously thought of it, you might've been prepared to die there and then for such pleasure. Of course, for a face as lovely as Kiyoko's, anyone would rise from the dead just to be able to gaze upon it. "Tch, such flattery. Either way, you performed quite admirably back there, so I'm sure everyone will think just a little more highly of you after this inevitably gets out — and me as well, of course, for having picked such a fine consort.
