rows.original: You've made up your mind. Taking hold of Miko by the arm, you give her a firm tug and [pc.ra kitsune |haul her to her feet |send her stumbling after you ]. The silly girl complies at first, then balks when she realizes that you're not leading her into the shrine as expected, but away from it. "[pc.ra kitsune |Yer Eminence, yer takin' lil' ol' me away from th' shrine, not to it. If'n I may, maybe you might wanna |Wait up a bit — that there ain't th' right direction ya wanna be goin' in ] — " No, you have a good idea of exactly what you're doing here, and what she should've done in the first place when she'd figured out that something was wrong with her instead of trying to fix it herself. You're taking her to Komari. "[pc.ra kitsune |Y-ya can't jus' — I done mean, please be havin' mercy on a poor gal like me, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Granny is jus' gonna scold me again an' say that I'm bein' my usual self, she ain't gonna believe me on how this is so much more than usual — " That's not going to happen, because you're going to personally make sure of it with every single shred of authority invested in you by your divinely-ordained position, for whatever it's worth. Is she saying that your personal guarantee isn't enough to reassure her? "Ain't saying that none, but — " Good. Now then, she can pipe down and you can get her some actual help. |That ain't gonna help none — ya gotta understand, [pc.name]! Granny is jus' gonna scold me again an' say that I'm bein' my usual self, she ain't gonna believe me on how this is so much more than usual — " That's not going to happen, because when even someone like you can tell that something's eating her, what more so for anyone who's close to her? You'd be surprised if news of her closing the shrine for the day hasn't already reached Komari, and she's just waiting for Miko to show up at her doorstep all in a tizzy. Now, you're going to give your word — for all that it's worth in this den of foxes — that you're going to back her up on this. Is that good enough? Miko pouts, but at least doesn't fight you or make that much of a scene as you drag her on. ] Together, the both of you make it through the fields, up through the trunk, and out onto the branches where Komari's office awaits. The imperial governor is about her business as usual, and [pc.ra kitsune |stands up from her desk to give you a small bow as you enter, although you notice a flicker of irritation across her features as she spots her great-great-granddaughter in tow |a flicker of irritation passes across her features as she spots her great-great-granddaughter in tow ]. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-Sama |High Lady ] ] |[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-Sama |High Lady ], ][pc.name] ]. What brings you to me today, and with my silly great-great-granddaughter in tow when she should be working at a task that's merely not a responsibility to the community, but to the divine as well?" "Gra-nny!" Right, time for you to step in before this escalates even further. Firmly interposing yourself before two of them, you quickly explain the situation to Komari, the condition you found Miko in, and what she asked you to do about it. Komari purses her lips, thinks a moment, then sets her walking stick aside by her desk. "All this is correct, then?" [party.has kiyoko |"I will vouch for everything that my consort has expressed thus far." |That is the case. ] "Come here, girl, and bend down so I can get a better look at you." Shivering as though her body is barely under her control, Miko steps forward and complies with her great-great-grandmother's instruction. Komari gets to poking and prodding, then after a minute or so scowls and points to the back of her chambers. "Get in." The usually boisterous Miko trudges forward meekly, tails dragging on the floor in her wake. Komari follows soon after, sliding the door shut behind them. There's some coughing, some clinking, and by and large the imperial governor reappears alone, looking grim but satisfied with herself. "Well. I'm sorry you had to see that[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ], or bring my great-great-granddaughter to me, for that matter." She didn't want to come for fear of being reprimanded... "Maybe she should have thought of that before feigning illness multiple times in her youth to get out of work, but my dear Mikoto is notably short-sighted in that regard. Either way, I'm ashamed to say that our family troubles should not be troubling you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Well, if she's sorry for imposing upon you, maybe she can explain just what it is that happened. Komari sighs. "You are, of course, already aware that my great-great-granddaughters are both blessed and cursed." They see auras, yes, and everything that entails. "Starting with me, none of my descendants have managed to escape the taint of my failure in some form or fashion. No matter how much she feeds, my dear Mikoto is always at least a little hungry, because the part of her spirit that should tell her that she is sated is disordered. Unlike her twin sister, she refuses medication to alleviate the problem, unwilling to numb her senses and slow her thoughts, to use her own words. Instead, her approach to the matter has been to attempt to train her mental fortitude in order to deal with the problem." That doesn't sound like her, given how she behaves half the time. "With all respect, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]the other half is thanks to her efforts at self-control." All right. So... is Miko going to be fine? "I gave her a bit of the tree's sap, and something to knock her out. With that big a surge of chi into her system, she'll be her usual self after she comes to — impulsive, fickle, childish, and one step away from cutting loose and going feral. But I must thank you for bringing her up when she wouldn't come of her own accord[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. In the meantime, I have to go and take over her duties at the shrine; the divine takes precedence over worldly matters, after all. "Now, if [pc.ra kitsune |I may take my leave of you[party.has kiyoko |and the [silly |high lady |myobu ] ], your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship... |if you'll excuse me. ]" Carefully moving so as to not turn her back on you and break some unspoken but all-important rule of Old Country etiquette, Komari grabs her walking stick and heads right out of her office.
rows.translation: 你已经下定决心了。抓住米可的手臂，你用力拉了她一下，说道： [pc.ra kitsune |把她拉起来让她站起来 |让她追着你跌跌撞撞地跑吧 ]那个傻姑娘一开始会乖乖听话，但当她意识到你并没有像她预想的那样带她去神社时，就会开始犹豫不决了。离开从它那里获得。[pc.ra kitsune |尊贵的阁下，您这是在把我从圣殿旁边带走，而不是带我去圣殿本身啊。如果可以的话，或许您应该…… |等一下——你现在的方向显然不是你真正想要去的方向啊。 ]不，你非常清楚自己在这里要做什么，也明白她当初在发现自己的身体有问题时，本应该怎么做——而不是试图自己解决问题。你现在是要带她去麻里。[pc.ra kitsune |你总不能就这样……我是说，求你发发慈悲，可怜可怜我这个可怜的女孩吧[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]肯定会的，奶奶又会开始责骂我，说我又恢复了老样子，她根本不会相信我这次真的和以往不同……” “但这种情况绝对不会发生，因为你会利用自己这个神圣赋予的职位所赋予你的所有权力，确保这一切都不会发生，无论这个职位的价值有多大。她是想说，你的个人担保还不够让她放心吗？ “并不是说完全不够，只是——” 很好。现在她可以闭嘴了，你可以真正去帮她解决一些问题了。 |那根本没什么帮助——你得明白这一点。 [pc.name]奶奶肯定又会责备我，说我又恢复了老样子，她根本不会相信我这次的情况确实比以往任何时候都要严重……” 不过，这种事是不会发生的。因为就连你这样的外人都能看出她心里有什么烦恼，那些和她关系亲密的人更是能察觉到吧？如果她决定当天关闭神社的消息还没有传到麻里那里，那你可就太惊讶了——她现在肯定正在焦急地等待着巫女出现在她家门口呢。现在，你得发誓——在这个充满狡猾之人的地方，这个誓言虽然可能没什么分量，但你必须保证会支持她。这样够好吗？ 米可撅了撅嘴，但至少没有和你吵架，也没有闹别扭。那个当你把她拉过来时，可真是一番热闹的场景啊。 ] 你们俩一起穿过田野，爬上树干，然后来到树枝上，那里有麻里的办公室在等着他们。这位帝国总督像往常一样忙于自己的工作[pc.ra kitsune |当你走进来时，她从办公桌前站起来，向你微微鞠了一躬。不过，当你看到她身边还跟着自己的玄孙女时，你注意到她的脸上闪过一丝不耐烦的神情 |当她看到自己的玄孙女跟在旁边时，她的脸上闪过一丝不耐烦的神情 ]。 "[pc.ra kitsune |阁下[party.has kiyoko |， [silly |宫辅大人 |高阶女巫 ] ] |[party.has kiyoko |， [silly |宫本大人 |高阶女巫 ]， ][pc.name] ]今天是什么事让你们来找我呢？而且还是带着我那个调皮的小曾孙女一起来，她现在本应该去完成一些对社区来说虽然不是责任，但对神明来说却是必须完成的任务才对。” “奶奶！好了，是时候你介入了，否则事情会进一步恶化。你迅速站在他们两人面前，向麻里解释了当时的情况，以及你发现米可所处的处境，还有她要求你采取的措施。麻里紧抿着嘴唇，思考了一会儿，然后把她的拐杖放在桌边。 “那么，这一切都是正确的吗？ [party.has kiyoko |对于我的伴侣迄今为止所说的一切，我愿意为之担保。 |确实如此。 ] 过来，姑娘，弯下腰，让我能看得更清楚些。” 米科浑身发抖，仿佛自己的身体已经不受控制了，但她还是走上前，遵从了她的曾曾祖母的命令。麻里开始东翻西找，过了一分钟左右，她皱起眉头，指向自己房间的后面。 “进去。” 平时总是吵吵闹闹的米可这次却乖乖地走了过去，她的尾巴拖在地板上，一路跟着她。随后，麻里也跟了进来，关上了门。传来一些咳嗽声和叮当声，不一会儿，那位帝国总督独自走了出来，神情严肃，但看起来相当满意。 “唉，真抱歉你们不得不看到这一幕。[pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 ]或者，把我的曾曾孙女带到我身边来也行。” 她害怕受到责备，所以并不想前来…… “也许她在年轻时多次装病逃避工作之前，就应该考虑到这一点。不过，我亲爱的美琴在这方面确实显得太缺乏远见了。无论如何，我必须承认，我们家的这些麻烦事确实不应该影响到你。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]嗯，如果她为给你们带来麻烦而感到抱歉，或许她可以解释一下到底发生了什么。” 麻里叹了口气：“当然，你们已经知道我的曾曾孙女们既得到了恩赐，也承受了诅咒。他们能够看到光环，以及与之相关的一切现象。 “从我开始，我的后代中没有一个人能够摆脱我失败所带来的影响。无论她吃多少，我亲爱的美琴总是会感到饥饿，因为她灵魂中那个应该让她感到饱足的部分已经出现了紊乱。与她的双胞胎姐姐不同，她拒绝服用任何药物来缓解这个问题。她不愿意让自己的感官变得迟钝，也不愿意让自己的思维变得迟缓，用她自己的话来说，就是她选择通过锻炼自己的意志力来应对这个问题。以她的性格来看，这种行为完全不符合她的作风。” “恕我直言[pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]另一半要归功于她自我控制的努力。” 那么……米可会没事吧？ “我给了她一些那种树的树液，还有一些能让她昏睡的药物。有这么大量的气涌入体内，她醒来后就会恢复平常的样子——冲动、善变、幼稚，而且随时都有可能失控、变得野性十足。不过，我必须感谢你，她自己不肯来，是你把她带了过来。[pc.ra kitsune |，阁下 ]与此同时，我必须去接替她在神社里的职责；毕竟，神圣的事物比世俗的事情更重要。 “现在，如果[pc.ra kitsune |那我先告辞了。[party.has kiyoko |以及[silly |高贵的女士 |宫部 ] ]你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]发货…… |请原谅我。 ]麻里小心翼翼地移动着，生怕背对对方，从而违反那些古老乡村礼仪中那些虽未明说但却至关重要的规则。她拿上自己的手杖，立刻走出了办公室。
rows.raw: " You've made up your mind. Taking hold of Miko by the arm, you give her a firm tug and [pc.ra kitsune |haul her to her feet |send her stumbling after you ]. The silly girl complies at first, then balks when she realizes that you're not leading her into the shrine as expected, but away from it. "[pc.ra kitsune |Yer Eminence, yer takin' lil' ol' me away from th' shrine, not to it. If'n I may, maybe you might wanna |Wait up a bit — that there ain't th' right direction ya wanna be goin' in ] — " No, you have a good idea of exactly what you're doing here, and what she should've done in the first place when she'd figured out that something was wrong with her instead of trying to fix it herself. You're taking her to Komari. "[pc.ra kitsune |Y-ya can't jus' — I done mean, please be havin' mercy on a poor gal like me, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Granny is jus' gonna scold me again an' say that I'm bein' my usual self, she ain't gonna believe me on how this is so much more than usual — " That's not going to happen, because you're going to personally make sure of it with every single shred of authority invested in you by your divinely-ordained position, for whatever it's worth. Is she saying that your personal guarantee isn't enough to reassure her? "Ain't saying that none, but — " Good. Now then, she can pipe down and you can get her some actual help. |That ain't gonna help none — ya gotta understand, [pc.name]! Granny is jus' gonna scold me again an' say that I'm bein' my usual self, she ain't gonna believe me on how this is so much more than usual — " That's not going to happen, because when even someone like you can tell that something's eating her, what more so for anyone who's close to her? You'd be surprised if news of her closing the shrine for the day hasn't already reached Komari, and she's just waiting for Miko to show up at her doorstep all in a tizzy. Now, you're going to give your word — for all that it's worth in this den of foxes — that you're going to back her up on this. Is that good enough? Miko pouts, but at least doesn't fight you or make that much of a scene as you drag her on. ] Together, the both of you make it through the fields, up through the trunk, and out onto the branches where Komari's office awaits. The imperial governor is about her business as usual, and [pc.ra kitsune |stands up from her desk to give you a small bow as you enter, although you notice a flicker of irritation across her features as she spots her great-great-granddaughter in tow |a flicker of irritation passes across her features as she spots her great-great-granddaughter in tow ]. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-Sama |High Lady ] ] |[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-Sama |High Lady ], ][pc.name] ]. What brings you to me today, and with my silly great-great-granddaughter in tow when she should be working at a task that's merely not a responsibility to the community, but to the divine as well?" "Gra-nny!" Right, time for you to step in before this escalates even further. Firmly interposing yourself before two of them, you quickly explain the situation to Komari, the condition you found Miko in, and what she asked you to do about it. Komari purses her lips, thinks a moment, then sets her walking stick aside by her desk. "All this is correct, then?" [party.has kiyoko |"I will vouch for everything that my consort has expressed thus far." |That is the case. ] "Come here, girl, and bend down so I can get a better look at you." Shivering as though her body is barely under her control, Miko steps forward and complies with her great-great-grandmother's instruction. Komari gets to poking and prodding, then after a minute or so scowls and points to the back of her chambers. "Get in." The usually boisterous Miko trudges forward meekly, tails dragging on the floor in her wake. Komari follows soon after, sliding the door shut behind them. There's some coughing, some clinking, and by and large the imperial governor reappears alone, looking grim but satisfied with herself. "Well. I'm sorry you had to see that[pc.ra kitsune |, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ], or bring my great-great-granddaughter to me, for that matter." She didn't want to come for fear of being reprimanded... "Maybe she should have thought of that before feigning illness multiple times in her youth to get out of work, but my dear Mikoto is notably short-sighted in that regard. Either way, I'm ashamed to say that our family troubles should not be troubling you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Well, if she's sorry for imposing upon you, maybe she can explain just what it is that happened. Komari sighs. "You are, of course, already aware that my great-great-granddaughters are both blessed and cursed." They see auras, yes, and everything that entails. "Starting with me, none of my descendants have managed to escape the taint of my failure in some form or fashion. No matter how much she feeds, my dear Mikoto is always at least a little hungry, because the part of her spirit that should tell her that she is sated is disordered. Unlike her twin sister, she refuses medication to alleviate the problem, unwilling to numb her senses and slow her thoughts, to use her own words. Instead, her approach to the matter has been to attempt to train her mental fortitude in order to deal with the problem." That doesn't sound like her, given how she behaves half the time. "With all respect, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]the other half is thanks to her efforts at self-control." All right. So... is Miko going to be fine? "I gave her a bit of the tree's sap, and something to knock her out. With that big a surge of chi into her system, she'll be her usual self after she comes to — impulsive, fickle, childish, and one step away from cutting loose and going feral. But I must thank you for bringing her up when she wouldn't come of her own accord[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. In the meantime, I have to go and take over her duties at the shrine; the divine takes precedence over worldly matters, after all. "Now, if [pc.ra kitsune |I may take my leave of you[party.has kiyoko |and the [silly |high lady |myobu ] ], your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship... |if you'll excuse me. ]" Carefully moving so as to not turn her back on you and break some unspoken but all-important rule of Old Country etiquette, Komari grabs her walking stick and heads right out of her office. "

rows.original: You don't want to encourage this kind of behavior in Miko, even if she's not fully in control of her actions because of her affliction. She needs help, and you're not going to be getting her that by indulging her.
rows.translation: 你不想助长米可的这种行为，即使由于她的病痛，她并不能完全控制自己的举动。她需要帮助，而纵容她是无法让她得到帮助的。
rows.raw: "You don't want to encourage this kind of behavior in Miko, even if she's not fully in control of her actions because of her affliction. She needs help, and you're not going to be getting her that by indulging her."

rows.original: Approaching the little shrine at the edge of the gardens, you pause for a moment, caught by the sight of several shafts of silvery moonlight falling in between the roots of the tree. Crisp and clear, they go so perfectly well with the flickering of azure foxfire in the stone lanterns that line the path and the faint whispers of a gentle breeze rustling its way through the flowerbeds and shrubbery... [pc.bg acolyte scholar noblescion |While you've certainly had the chance to come across poetic works in the past, the sights that inspire them are less easily encountered. Ever since this whole business with Kasyrra happened, you've been shunted from one task to another, one location after the next... you certainly haven't had the time to stop and savor the scenery, and with good reason |While you haven't had the chance to learn or even come into contact with much poetry in your past, the sight nevertheless inspires you to want to learn, if only to be able to capture such sublime beauty in words. But even without putting such things to paper, you realize where some of the oral traditions of your youth might've stemmed from ]. It's not just the sight alone, but something in the very air that [pc.ra kitsune | tickles whatever sixth sense you've gained ever since becoming one of these people, resonates with whatever new nature that Keros implanted in you — or maybe it's that what's inside you is conforming to your outer appearance. After all, this is more than a simple alchemical transformation... or maybe it's all in your head |makes your gut twist and your breathing slow. [pc.isDK |Someone lesser might have teared over, but one such as you has merely caught a speck of dust in the eye, that's all |You can't deny that you're going all misty-eyed at this, there's not even the excuse of having something caught in your eye ]. No doubt the foxes arranged the gardens to evoke this exact feeling in people passing through in the evenings, but this night, with the moonlight striking just so, is something else altogether ]. It's a sensation not so much of energetic mischief, but of melancholy, of the ephemeral nature of just about everything, and if you drag your feet too long there's a chance that you might find yourself staying until sunrise... [pc.ra kitsune |does having changed yourself into one of these people also given you some kind of sense for melancholy beauty such as this? Is such a thing even possible? ] [party.has kiyoko |The next thing you know, your fox-wife has slid her arm into yours and is slowly guiding you down the garden path, your footsteps heavy in the flickering pools of light afforded by the foxfire lamps. She presses herself against you in the cool night air, one of her warm tails curling [pc.ra kitsune |about yours |around your leg ] and rubbing up and down with no small vigor. "Isn't this so romantic, beloved?" she purrs, her melodious voice rising from deep within her chest, so close that you can feel her speak. "Komari knows her work — this is just flower arrangement writ large, hmm? The two of us walking down a path side by side, together... don't you think there's a deep meaning to it?" [kiyoko.isPregnant |Normally, Kiyoko being in a fey mood like this would lead one to suspect that she wants another kit, but given that she's already with child she's probably just being plain old mischievous. Which doesn't necessarily make matters any less complicated, but still. |Deep meaning? You? Well, maybe she wants the usual? Your fox-wife titters at that. "Maybe, but not here, and not now. I'm capable of saying no when I want to." Well, that are words you scarcely expected to ever pass her lips! "Sometimes, beloved, one simply wishes to appreciate a scene of carefully curated beauty. Nothing more, nothing less. It does manage to speak to the soul, does it not?" ] You're about to say more when |It's sorely tempting to just find a spot on a bench or in a gazebo and simply while away the hours[party.hasCompanions | with [party.compNames] ], perhaps somehow manage to find some tea and sweets to accompany the scene. You've just managed to push the intrusive thoughts out of your mind when ] you hear a faint sniffling coming from the shrine up ahead. It sounds like someone... crying? [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko doesn't give you much choice in the matter, sweeping up her skirts and guiding you forward down the garden path — although, of course, she does so in her well-practised deferential manner that leaves little doubt to the casual observer that you're really the one leading the way and this is all your idea. With such encouragement at your back, you're obligated to pick up your pace and investigate the source of the weeping |Piqued, you pick up your pace and make your way down the path to investigate ]. While you can't help but notice [pc.ra kitsune |that your ears have started twitching like crazy |the tense feeling of trepidation crawling all over your skin ], there isn't any real danger in these gardens, is there? The source of the snivelling soon becomes clear: Mai's perched herself atop one of the fox statues that flank the steps up to the little shrine, gripping its body with her tails and her legs dangling off the side. She's got a little embroidered handkerchief in her hands instead of her pipe, and is staring up at the moonlit sky while sniffling away. By the reddish tint in her amber eyes, she's been doing this for a while; every now and then, the gray-furred shrine maiden raises the handkerchief and blows her nose noisily and miserably. She doesn't notice [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko and ]you until you're within arm's length of her, absorbed in watching the moonlit sky as it is. Is something wrong? Mai doesn't answer at first, so you repeat your question. It's only then that she rouses herself, daubing at the worst of the dampness staining her cheeks and folding her ears forward from the sides. Hello? There's nothing up with her, is there? [pc.ra kitsune |"Th' moon's pretty amazin' tonight, ain't it, yer Eminence? Th' way th' light falls down an' strikes th' flowers... it done remind me of how short-lived my childhood was when I done think 'bout it. Only a few years 'fore Miko an' I were shipped over th' ocean an' all th' way here..." Mai coughs, a wet, teary sound. "S-sorry. Ain't done o' me to be spillin' myself all over ya when ya clearly came up all th' way here f'r somethin'." Mai tries to stand up from her seat on the fox statue and give you a deep bow as your station would afford, but instead ends up tripping over her own feet and stumbling forward. You wind up catching the gray-furred shrine maiden in your arms and her face sinks against your [pc.armor], tears seeping into the underlayer of fabric and making it cling wetly to your [pc.chest]. "It's an honor to be able to receive th' likes o' ya here at th' shrine this evening, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Can I help ya pay respects to yer divine lord?" Is she even listening? You didn't come here for the usual reasons, you stepped up because you heard her moping around. |"...Oh. 'S ya, [pc.name]." It is you. Now — "Can ya see it too? Th' moon, ain't it pretty amazin' tonight? Th' way th' light falls down an' strikes th' flowers... it done remind me of how short-lived my childhood was when I done think 'bout it. Only a few years 'fore Miko an' I were shipped over th' ocean an' all th' way here... "I dunno why, but everythin' tonight jus' done feel so beautiful. Beautiful and ephemeral. Won't be long now 'fore dawn comes an' washes this all away, and it'll be pretty in its own way all right, but this here time, this here sight, ain't never gonna be another one like it. It's so sad." Mai reaches up with her handkerchief to wipe at the fresh tears, but loses her hold on the statue and tumbles forward off her seat. You wind up catching the gray-furred shrine maiden in your arms and her face sinks against your [pc.armor], tears seeping into the underlayer of fabric and making it cling wetly to your [pc.chest]. Before you can nudge her into a more respectable position, she's already rolling her cheeks all over the place, nuzzling deeply while she sniffles. "O-oh. Ya done smell good today, real good. Kinda goes well with th' moonlight an' all..." Pushing her face further into your chest, Mai draws a long, deep breath that sends her body into a fresh fit of shivering, one of her six tails stroking your leg in the process, [pc.hasTail |soft fur brushing against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] before teasing your tail-tip |teasing you for a moment with soft, glossy fur against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] ]. With a soft groan, Mai collects herself and flicks her ears about. "Lil' ol' me woulda be glad to be helpin' ya petition his divine lordship if'n ya want. Ain't able to say no to ya, not with ya makin' me so sad I could cry." Actually, you're not here for that. Could she please answer the question as to what's wrong? ] "Ya din't come f'r petitionin' our divine lord? Ya came f'r me? It ain't wrong that there're other things that I do here, but — " Mai sniffles, trembles, and raises her head from your [pc.chest] to take in your gaze, silver light glistening off her tear-stained cheeks. Something deep inside you echoes Mai's quivering as first her eyes widen, followed by her slitted pupils until they turn into dark, fat oblongs. "Be it odd of lil' ol' me to be bringin' it up, but didja know yer aura done look amazin' against th' night? 'S all nice and blue an' fuzzy-like, especially 'round the edges. Lookin' at it done move th' spirit, I can tell ya as much;[pc.ra kitsune | 's fittin' f'r someone as imperious as ya can be, yer Eminence ]." You swallow hard and consider your answer. On one hand, Mai's acting extremely out of character and is gripping your arms so hard you can feel her joints digging into you. At the same time, she's stopped pouring the entire waterworks onto your chest, although she looks like she could start up again any moment. It's not outright hunger that's bubbling up inside of the gray-furred shrine maiden, but a wellspring of hysteria, by the looks of it. You don't care if it's some drastic breach of etiquette; grabbing Mai by her shoulders, you pull her off your chest before she can burst into another crying fit. Just the touch of your fingers on her bare skin is enough to send her to shivering, fingers tightening about your arms as she starts to pant. Now! [pc.ra kitsune |With all the authority invested in you as the divine champion of her patron deity, you're going to very nicely and politely demand that she explain |Would she mind explaining ] just what's gotten into her? You get it, the night's truly beautiful, but while you yourself might have gotten a little misty-eyed it's not quite the kind of sight that would provoke this kind of lunacy. Mai tries to answer you, she truly does. You can envision the gears turning in her head, the slight movements of her eyes and lips as she tries to arrange her thoughts into a coherent sentence. Then it all comes tumbling down in a mess of senseless incoherence, the waterworks starting anew as she babbles in her native tongue and hugs you close. All right, now this has you quite flummoxed. Obviously there's something wrong with Mai to throw the girl off her usual unperturbed self and into a mess of hysterics, but what exactly is just about impossible to figure out when she's either unwilling or unable to cooperate. [party.has kiyoko |As Mai erupts into a fresh new fit of wailing and vulpine barking, you throw a helpless glance at your fox-wife and ask her if she knows what's up with the poor girl, why's she acting this way. Kiyoko thinks a moment, tapping her chin with a finger, then shakes her head. "It is quite befuddling, beloved. While our culture does value beauty in all its forms and certainly encourages one to show one's appreciation of the aesthetic, this is something else altogether. One way or the other, she is clearly not herself and might be in need of some comforting before further help can be sought for her condition." Comforting? "Comfort food, as it were. If this were her sister, I would be more cautious about indulging her wants... but Miyuki is the responsible and level-headed one, or so my dear retainer assures me." She's certainly not acting level-headed at the moment. "It is your choice, beloved. [pc.ra kitsune |Technically, Miyuki does count as one of your subjects, inasfar as you are as much outside of the hierarchy of things as you are in it. Certainly, there is a responsibility from you to her as you ought to be able to expect obedience from her to you... how you wish to wish to carry that out is up to you |I am... cautiously optimistic. If nothing else, she will owe you quite a big debt for the favor, and then there is the fact that it would go towards building more goodwill between you and everyone else living here; one's actions do not go unnoticed in our society. Yet I would not say that it is free of potential problems ]." That's her assessment of the situation? A small, coy smile plays on Kiyoko's lips. "It is, beloved." |You try to think this through, to connect the dots as to what should you do right now before getting her relatives in to help, but it's an uphill struggle with Mai interrupting your thoughts with fresh new fit of wailing and vulpine barking every few moments. ] It really does come down to this, doesn't it? On one hand, feeding Mai would probably calm her down and stop her hysterics long enough for you to be able to take control of the situation. On the other, it certainly could be seen as taking advantage of the girl when she's out of it. At least you probably don't have to worry about her draining you to within an inch of your life, unlike her sister. Probably. While Mai may not turn into a ravening [silly |fuckbeast |glutton ] when she cuts loose, she's just as neurotic as her sister when unhinged, just in her own unique fashion. In fact, given that she doesn't have the wherewithal to hold herself back if you let her feed off you, she may very well end up pregnant in the bargain. So the question remains: what does one do with a situation like this? Do you offer Mai some comfort food in the hopes of getting her sane enough to help you help her, or forcibly drag her off in search of assistance?
rows.translation: 当你走近花园边缘的小神龛时，突然停下了脚步——几道银色的月光透过树根的缝隙洒落下来，这一景象令你为之驻足。那清冽而明亮的月光与路旁石灯中闪烁的蔚蓝色狐火交相辉映，而微风轻拂过花坛与灌木丛时发出的轻柔声响，更是为这一画面增添了几分宁静与和谐…… [pc.bg acolyte scholar noblescion |虽然你过去肯定有机会接触到一些诗意的作品，但那些激发这些作品灵感的景象却并不容易遇到。自从发生了与卡希拉有关的那一系列事情之后，你就被不断地安排去完成这个任务、前往那个地点……你确实没有时间停下来欣赏周围的风景，这也是情有可原的。 |虽然你过去没有机会学习诗歌，甚至也没有接触过太多诗歌作品，但这样的景象依然激发了你学习的欲望——哪怕只是为了能够用文字将这种崇高的美妙表达出来。不过，即使你不把这些感受写下来，你也会意识到，自己年轻时所听到的一些口头传说，其实很可能就是源自这样的体验。 ]不仅仅是视觉上的效果，而是空气中的某种气息也让人们感受到这种氛围。 [pc.ra kitsune | You wind up catching the gray-furred shrine maiden in your arms and her face sinks against your [pc.armor], tears seeping into the underlayer of fabric and making it cling wetly to your [pc.chest]. Before you can nudge her into a more respectable position, she's already rolling her cheeks all over the place, nuzzling deeply while she sniffles. "O-oh. Ya done smell good today, real good. Kinda goes well with th' moonlight an' all..." Pushing her face further into your chest, Mai draws a long, deep breath that sends her body into a fresh fit of shivering, one of her six tails stroking your leg in the process, [pc.hasTail |soft fur brushing against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] before teasing your tail-tip |teasing you for a moment with soft, glossy fur against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] ]. With a soft groan, Mai collects herself and flicks her ears about. "Lil' ol' me woulda be glad to be helpin' ya petition his divine lordship if'n ya want. Ain't able to say no to ya, not with ya makin' me so sad I could cry." Actually, you're not here for that. Could she please answer the question as to what's wrong? ] "Ya din't come f'r petitionin' our divine lord? Ya came f'r me? It ain't wrong that there're other things that I do here, but — " Mai sniffles, trembles, and raises her head from your [pc.chest] to take in your gaze, silver light glistening off her tear-stained cheeks. Something deep inside you echoes Mai's quivering as first her eyes widen, followed by her slitted pupils until they turn into dark, fat oblongs. "Be it odd of lil' ol' me to be bringin' it up, but didja know yer aura done look amazin' against th' night? 'S all nice and blue an' fuzzy-like, especially 'round the edges. Lookin' at it done move th' spirit, I can tell ya as much;[pc.ra kitsune | 's fittin' f'r someone as imperious as ya can be, yer Eminence ]." You swallow hard and consider your answer. On one hand, Mai's acting extremely out of character and is gripping your arms so hard you can feel her joints digging into you. At the same time, she's stopped pouring the entire waterworks onto your chest, although she looks like she could start up again any moment. It's not outright hunger that's bubbling up inside of the gray-furred shrine maiden, but a wellspring of hysteria, by the looks of it. You don't care if it's some drastic breach of etiquette; grabbing Mai by her shoulders, you pull her off your chest before she can burst into another crying fit. Just the touch of your fingers on her bare skin is enough to send her to shivering, fingers tightening about your arms as she starts to pant. Now! [pc.ra kitsune |With all the authority invested in you as the divine champion of her patron deity, you're going to very nicely and politely demand that she explain |Would she mind explaining ] just what's gotten into her? You get it, the night's truly beautiful, but while you yourself might have gotten a little misty-eyed it's not quite the kind of sight that would provoke this kind of lunacy. Mai tries to answer you, she truly does. You can envision the gears turning in her head, the slight movements of her eyes and lips as she tries to arrange her thoughts into a coherent sentence. Then it all comes tumbling down in a mess of senseless incoherence, the waterworks starting anew as she babbles in her native tongue and hugs you close. All right, now this has you quite flummoxed. Obviously there's something wrong with Mai to throw the girl off her usual unperturbed self and into a mess of hysterics, but what exactly is just about impossible to figure out when she's either unwilling or unable to cooperate. [party.has kiyoko |As Mai erupts into a fresh new fit of wailing and vulpine barking, you throw a helpless glance at your fox-wife and ask her if she knows what's up with the poor girl, why's she acting this way. Kiyoko thinks a moment, tapping her chin with a finger, then shakes her head. "It is quite befuddling, beloved. While our culture does value beauty in all its forms and certainly encourages one to show one's appreciation of the aesthetic, this is something else altogether. One way or the other, she is clearly not herself and might be in need of some comforting before further help can be sought for her condition." Comforting? "Comfort food, as it were. If this were her sister, I would be more cautious about indulging her wants... but Miyuki is the responsible and level-headed one, or so my dear retainer assures me." She's certainly not acting level-headed at the moment. "It is your choice, beloved. [pc.ra kitsune |Technically, Miyuki does count as one of your subjects, inasfar as you are as much outside of the hierarchy of things as you are in it. Certainly, there is a responsibility from you to her as you ought to be able to expect obedience from her to you... how you wish to wish to carry that out is up to you |I am... cautiously optimistic. If nothing else, she will owe you quite a big debt for the favor, and then there is the fact that it would go towards building more goodwill between you and everyone else living here; one's actions do not go unnoticed in our society. Yet I would not say that it is free of potential problems ]." That's her assessment of the situation? A small, coy smile plays on Kiyoko's lips. "It is, beloved." |You try to think this through, to connect the dots as to what should you do right now before getting her relatives in to help, but it's an uphill struggle with Mai interrupting your thoughts with fresh new fit of wailing and vulpine barking every few moments. ] It really does come down to this, doesn't it? On one hand, feeding Mai would probably calm her down and stop her hysterics long enough for you to be able to take control of the situation. On the other, it certainly could be seen as taking advantage of the girl when she's out of it. At least you probably don't have to worry about her draining you to within an inch of your life, unlike her sister. Probably. While Mai may not turn into a ravening [silly |fuckbeast |glutton ] when she cuts loose, she's just as neurotic as her sister when unhinged, just in her own unique fashion. In fact, given that she doesn't have the wherewithal to hold herself back if you let her feed off you, she may very well end up pregnant in the bargain. So the question remains: what does one do with a situation like this? Do you offer Mai some comfort food in the hopes of getting her sane enough to help you help her, or forcibly drag her off in search of assistance? "

rows.original: Given how distraught she is, a snack would probably help Mai get her head on the right way enough to at least have a shot at making sense of the situation; while she may not be as outright ravenous as her voluptuous, oversexed sister surely some comfort food couldn't hurt. The girl may not be in any state to remember the whole equivalent exchange thing right now, but by the feel of her against you somehow you don't doubt that you'll be getting your worth out of this, if not more. With a long, drawn-out moan, Mai pushes damp cheeks against your chest and sinks her chin further in; you're compelled to reach up and pat her wavy hair and tease her large ears, which just makes the moaning all the more deep and sexual. Despite her pliant, perhaps even submissive behavior, the way her hands grip at your arms even as you run your fingers through her hair sends a chill down your spine as your animal hindbrain readies itself in the face of a predator. In that moment, you're aware how much your heart is pounding, how heavily the blood's coursing through your veins... [party.has kiyoko |Wondering if you've just stepped into a mire that you're not getting out of that easily, you cast a sideways glance at Kiyoko. Your fox-wife smiles and gives you an encouraging pat on the shoulder with one hand while the other [kiyoko.isPregnant |rubs her swollen, kit-filled belly. "Feeling guilty, beloved?" she purrs softly, her voice barely above a whisper. "You can always take good care of me and our growing child later, if your conscience needs assuaging..." |firmly pushes you forward. "Feeling guilty, beloved? You can always make it up to me later by putting a kit inside of my womb. For now... attend to my subjects, as is your duty and rightful honor as my consort." ] She's all right with this, then? "Someone has to make sure that the silly girl doesn't end up draining you into a lifeless husk, right? I'll be grading her performance on how well she repays you for the immense favor that you're doing her here, so rest assured that you'll be getting your deal's worth. Now then, go forth and make me proud. I know what you're capable of, beloved, so don't bring shame upon our family, hmm?" ] There's a tiny voice in the back of your mind telling you to double-guess your decision, but there's no backing out now. The soft animal sounds emanating from Mai's throat grow in intensity along with the cold heat wafting off her body, carnality inviting you to draw ever closer; her hands wrap about your back and her fingers lace together, ensuring there's no escape even as you continue to pat her on the head. Mai whimpers and sniffles, her body not quite under her control: her body doesn't seem inclined to listen to her, not with it acting all selfish. Silver moonlight and a gentle breeze tinged with floral scent... Mai's body shudders, and she moans. It would be nice to imagine that she's subconsciously reacting to your [pc.ra kitsune |divine authority, that she can't help herself and that this is all your fault... and in a way it is given that you made the choice to try and indulge her here and now |spiritual presence, that the mere sight and sensation of your supposedly amazing aura is making her all weak and weepy... well, you were the one who made the decision to indulge her, so it's not like even more blame can be pinned on you at this point ]. With the gray-furred shrine maiden usually so emotionally deadened, just having her up and against you like this is... unsettling. You didn't know that she could be this supple when she's finally able to cut loose, her body burning with cold heat as she continues to nuzzle your shoulders and neck, wisps of azure foxfire licking from her skin before dissipating in small puffs of scented smoke. Afraid to stop, you keep on patting Mai on the head, flattening her ears with the base of your palms while scratching her scalp with your fingertips. Each pass you make has her panting grow heavier and more filled with need — it's a small wonder she doesn't just throw off her clothes and get right to it in the sacred gardens, but then again, Mai feeling anything at all is a small wonder in and of itself. At least the tears have stilled somewhat, even if they aren't completely gone — as the gray-furred shrine maiden looks up at you with childlike wonder, you slide your hands from her hair, down her brow and onto her cheeks, spreading their dampness all over your palms. What to say, what to say... does it even matter when it's almost certain that she doesn't comprehend the words? So long as the tone's right, it should get through to her, right? That's it — she's beautiful, as beautiful as, um, the moon tonight. That's what's got her so enchanted, right? As long as you hold her gaze and sound firm and sincere, that should work, shouldn't it? It works all right, just not in the way you think. Gripping you with the desperate strength of a drowning woman, Mai hugs you close and bursts into a fresh fit of tears, bawling even louder than she was before as the waterworks start anew. Warm wetness trickles down your fingers and drips from your wrists, tears of sorrow and wonderment alike, and yet the sense of danger hasn't passed, a twisting in your gut[pc.ra kitsune | and twitching in your ears ]. No, not when you notice Mai's perfect teeth looking sharper than they were a moment ago, and the fingers digging in your back feeling more and more pointed, like claws... [party.has kiyoko |While you shouldn't doubt your fox-wife like this, a little thought in the back of your mind really hopes that she's watching right now and assessing the situation should Mai go too far... |Swallowing hard, you give the fox statue Mai was recently perched upon a pleading look, just in case the deity is watching. He ought to be, right? This is land consecrated to him, after all, he should be able to see what's going on here, right? Most importantly, he wouldn't let [pc.ra kitsune |his own chosen champion |someone ] get drained to death on his watch, in his own domain, would he? ] Mai's breathing grows heavier, her ripe breasts pushing needily against you as she nestles her body against yours; the cool scent of ice and clear rain pours off her, mingling with the slight incense of foxfire. And in that moment, it finally hits you: the haze of winterstem that usually surrounds Mai is gone, for you to be able to catch these other scents. How it managed to pass notice up till this point is a mystery — maybe it simply got to the point that you always assumed it was there? Mai without her usual dose of drugs that keep her sane... and it's far too late to pull back at this point. She may not be as full-bodied as her sister, but the passions that surge to the fore of her presence are roiling and thunderous; she presses herself against you all the more intensely, a roaring furnace that burns with cold flame more than enough to make your blood run cold. And then she snaps. You should've realized it earlier, but there's no time for regrets. Six senses feeding into a mind meant for five — once the numbing effect of winterstem was removed, this outcome was inevitable. Slitted pupils widened into fat, dark oblongs, one final tear of wonderment and melancholy runs from her eye before the hysterical maelstrom of emotion turns the other way in the blink of an eye. Her lips turn down at the corners, her pointed teeth gnash, and then she screams into your face, loud enough to leave your head ringing as her over-stimulated mind reverses course and runs amok. Claws dig into your back through your [pc.armor], just shy of drawing blood, and the waterworks begin anew — but it's rage that's fueling them, the other face of her maddened psyche. Damn it, fine! No point hedging your bets when you're this deep in; it's time to go all in on this game. There's not that much give to be had when Mai's hugging you for dear life, but there's enough to be able to grab her front and yank it down; the loose knots that hold up the fabric easily give way, allowing Mai's round tits to spill out, glistening in the moonlight. Huh, no smallclothes... with her mind off its usual medication, did she just forget? The thought is dashed by Mai as she intensifies her assault on you: clawing, screaming, her cheeks wet with tears, Mai fights you for the simple sake of doing so, emotions spilling out of her as her mind overflows from stimulation. Her weeping and vulpine shrieking rings out into the otherwise beautiful night as you manhandle her and grab her ass through her skirts; unsurprisingly, she's wearing nothing underneath there, either... Mai gasps, her breath catching in her throat, her expression turning completely and utterly stupefied as the sensation from your fingers against sensitive skin shoots directly into her raging mind. A moment of peace, the eye of the storm; in that moment, you wonder if you might have just shattered her already broken mind, and never have you been more relieved to see the feral fury return to Mai as as she screams anew and starts tearing into you. Claws rip at your [pc.armor], their tips chipping on the material as she disrobes you, caring little for how your garments are going to wind up at the end of all this; the more you stimulate her by squeezing her ass through her skirts, the more hungry and desperate Mai's movements become, more and more stray sensations coloring the edges of her hysteria. One by one, your things fall to the grass amidst the flowerbeds, carelessly discarded like the afterthoughts they've become. Several seconds pass by in the silvery moonlight, Mai eyeing your naked form like a hunk of meat to be devoured while she pants; the chill breeze through the gardens has picked up, sending her half-undone clothes aflutter. Her bosom rises and falls, her amber eyes gleaming in the dark, and just when you think she's going to launch into another screaming fit the whirlwind of her hysterics reverses course yet again. All sound and fury a moment ago, Mai collapses in on herself, shoulders slumping and letting her shrine maiden's uniform finally fall off her body and land in a crumpled heap at her feet. It's hard not to sigh inwardly. Mai's alluring and curvaceous without being oversexed, and she's got the kind of poise that keeps her fetching appearance even as bedraggled as she is[pc.bg courtesan |; half the other courtesans you left back in your previous life would've given an arm and a leg to have a body as lush and voluptuous as this ].. It's such a shame that she always has the scent of winterstem smoke about her... and sooner or later, her near-constant use of the drug will catch up with her body. Maybe that's why she keeps on oscillating between sorrow and rage — the tragedy of having such an affliction foisted upon her, and rage at not just everything, but most of all herself for her approach in dealing with it. There are so many more things that one could say about Mai, seeing her all sweaty, miserable and bedraggled now that she's without her crutch... but now, the most pressing thing you need to say is that she's beautiful. You're not sure if there's any comprehension left in that mind of hers, but at least you're certain she heard you. No sooner have you said the words that Mai breaks into another fit of miserable crying, the violent intent dissipating from her demeanor in the blink of an eye; she quivers and gasps, choking back sobs and little animal noises that rise from the back of her throat. You tug on her wrists, and more and more of Mai sinks against you as strength flags for now and her knees finally give way. Nipples grind against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] as the gray-furred shrine maiden rolls herself this way and that, blatantly far more needy and sexual than before; she tenses, and then her expression turns completely and utterly stupefied as the sensations of warmth blossom in her bosom, leaving her weak and whimpering, every part the simpering vixen. Well, it looks like you're obliged to reciprocate. Instead of continuing to toy with Mai's ass, you slide a hand over to the bases of her tails, [pc.ra kitsune |foxfire dancing on your fingers. If there's anything that'll get to her now, it's this... two can play at the same game, after all. The moment your foxfire-wreathed fingers close upon the bases of Mai's tails, she melts. Sparks and wisps of azure dance amidst damp, bedraggled fur as you comb it with your fingers, letting the sensuality of raw foxfire seep into one of the most sensitive parts on a kitsune's body. The tips of your fingers sink against the warm, muscular core of each tail in turn, spreading cold-hot love evenly into each sensitive nerve ending until the twitching in your grasp grows too much to hold |giving her several tentative tickles. If there's anything that'll get to her now, it's this... The moment your fingers close upon the bases of Mai's tails, she melts. There's a little resistance at first from her damp, bedraggled fur as you comb it with your fingers, but the coarse guard hairs soon give way to finer fur as you knead and squeeze one of the most sensitive parts on a kitsune's body. Your fingers tend to the warm, muscular core of each tail in turn, spreading love evenly into each sensitive nerve ending until she's fit to burst. Even without any foxy shenanigans like she has, you've reduced Mai to even more of a blubbering mess than she was to begin with ]. Throwing her head back, eyes lidded and lips half-parted with fangs exposed, Mai makes an anguished, needy noise in the back of her throat, a trickle of drool escaping the corner of her mouth. While it's an emotion that isn't rage or sorrow, it's just as intense, if not more. Indeed, you're going to be enjoying her to your heart's content, and not a single iota less given the price you'll be paying for it. Golden eyes wild and unfocused, Mai bears down upon you even as you continue to grope, squeeze and tease her supple body, pressing the weight of her form on yours and letting you get a sense of just how much madness is gripping her body. It should be unsurprising given the insinuation that she hasn't felt very much of anything within memory, but it takes you by surprise all the same when her body bunches up and she makes to pounce on you much like a cat would a mouse, at point blank.
rows.translation: 鉴于她现在如此心烦意乱，吃点零食或许能帮助舞调整心态，至少让她有机会弄清楚目前的状况。虽然她可能不会像她那个身材丰满、性欲旺盛的姐姐那样饿得发慌，但吃点能带来慰藉的食物总不会有坏处吧。此刻，这个女孩可能根本无暇去回想那些关于等价交换的事情，但从她与你亲密接触时的反应来看，你毫不怀疑自己从中获得的远远超过了付出。 随着一声长长的、拖长的呻吟，舞将湿润的脸颊贴在你的胸前，然后将下巴进一步埋了下去；你不由得伸手轻抚她那波浪般的头发，逗弄她那大耳朵，而这些举动只会让她的呻吟声变得更加深沉、更加充满性意味。尽管她的行为显得顺从，甚至有些卑微，但当你轻轻抚摸她的头发时，她紧紧抓住你手臂的动作，会让你不寒而栗——因为你的原始大脑正在为面对潜在的威胁而做好准备。就在那一刻，你会清楚地感受到自己的心脏正在剧烈跳动，感受到血液正急速流经自己的血管…… [party.has kiyoko |你不禁怀疑自己是否已经陷入了一个难以摆脱的困境，于是侧眼瞥了瞥清子。你的狐狸妻子微笑着，用一只手鼓励性地拍了拍你的肩膀，而另一只手[kiyoko.isPregnant |她轻轻抚摸着自己那肿胀的、怀有胎儿的腹部。 “是在感到内疚吗，亲爱的？”她轻声说道，声音几乎像是在低语。“如果你需要安抚自己的良心，以后你总可以好好照顾我和我们正在成长的孩子…… |坚定地将你推向前方。 “感到内疚吗，亲爱的？你以后总可以通过把一个孩子送到我的肚子里来弥补我的损失。现在……履行你的职责吧，作为我的伴侣，这是你的责任，也是你应得的荣耀。 ] 那么，她对此没有意见吧？有人你必须确保那个傻姑娘不会把你拖得精疲力尽，变成一个没有生气的空壳，对吧？我会根据她如何回报你给予她的这份巨大恩惠来评价她的表现，所以请放心，你肯定能够得到应有的回报。现在，去吧，让我为你感到骄傲吧。我知道你是有能力的，亲爱的，所以千万不要让我们的家族蒙羞，嗯？ ] 你脑海深处有个微小的声音在提醒你，应该重新考虑自己的决定，但现在已经没有退路了。从舞的喉咙中发出的那些轻柔的声音逐渐变得强烈起来，她身上散发出的那种既冰冷又炽热的气息也在吸引着你不断靠近；她的双手环抱住你的背部，手指紧紧地交织在一起，仿佛在告诉你，即使你继续轻拍她的头，也无处可逃。舞呜咽着、抽泣着，她的身体似乎已经不再受她的控制了——那身体完全不听使唤，表现得如此任性。银色的月光与带着花香的微风…… 舞的身体开始颤抖，她呻吟声可以想象，她其实是下意识地对你做出了这样的反应。 [pc.ra kitsune |所谓“神的权威”，让她根本无法控制自己，而这一切都是你的错……从某种意义上说，确实也是因为你选择了现在这样纵容她。 |那种精神上的影响，仅仅是因为看到你那所谓的“神奇气场”以及感受到它带来的效果，就让她变得虚弱不堪、泪流满面……嗯，毕竟是你决定满足她的这个要求的，所以现在再责怪你也没用了。 ]那个通常情绪冷漠、毛发灰白的神殿少女，如今竟如此主动地靠近你……实在让人感到不安。你根本不知道，当她终于释放出自己的情感时，她的身体会变得如此柔软；她的身体散发着冷热交织的气息，不断轻触你的肩膀和脖子，那些淡蓝色的狐火仿佛从她的皮肤上飘荡而出，又化作阵阵芳香的烟雾消散在空中。你不敢停下来，继续用手掌轻拍舞的头部，用掌根压平她的耳朵，同时用指尖挠她的头皮。每一次这样的抚摸都让她的喘息声变得愈发急促、愈发充满渴望——她居然没有直接脱掉衣服在神圣的花园里行动起来，已经算是很不可思议了；不过，话说回来，舞能够感受到这些触觉本身，就已经是个奇迹了。 至少泪水已经稍微止住了，虽然还没有完全消失——当那位灰毛的神殿少女以孩子般惊奇的目光望着你时，你将手从她的头发上移开，沿着她的额头滑到她的脸颊上，让那些湿润的泪水均匀地分布在你的手掌之中。该说什么呢……既然几乎可以肯定她根本听不懂这些话，那说些什么还有什么意义呢？只要肌肉度恰当，她应该能理解吧？就是这样——她很美丽，就像今晚的月亮一样美丽。这就是让她如此着迷的原因，对吧？只要你能与她对视，说话时肌肉度坚定而真诚，那就应该应该有效吧？ 其实效果还不错，只是方式与你想象的不同。舞用一种仿佛溺水女子那种拼命的力量紧紧抱住你，突然间又开始放声大哭，哭声比之前更加激烈。温暖湿润的泪水顺着你的手指流下，从你的手腕滴落下来，这些泪水既包含了悲伤，也包含了惊奇。然而，那种危险的感觉依然存在，你的内心仿佛被什么东西紧紧揪住一样。[pc.ra kitsune | 还有耳朵里的抽动感 rows.original: You're not having any of this — after her sudden rage the last time, you're wary of the possibility of yet another mood swing, and twist yourself to the side just as Mai lunges forward. Before she can get up and have another go at you, you're pressing the advantage, pushing her into the ground by her shoulders while her tails flail miserably; they could probably present an actual threat if she were coherent, but Mai is anything but sane in her current condition. You don't know if or when Mai's hysterics will reverse course once again, so it's time to strike when the bronze is hot. rows.original: You eventually come to, something that's initially shocking but not quite surprising given your circumstances. Sitting up in the futon you've been laid out on, you feel faint, your head spins, and eventually gravity takes hold of your failing body once more to draw you back into welcoming softness. A quick glance at your surroundings reveals that you're in the little rest house in the tree's branches, someone having carefully taken the time to make you very comfortable. [party.has kiyoko |A shadow falls over you, and eventually Kiyoko's face appears in your vision, peering down amusedly at you. Miko stands at quiet attention off to her side, a tea tray balanced in her hands as she tries to look as neutral as possible, without much success. "Welcome back, beloved. That was quite the show you put up there." Was it? Miko clears her throat, stifling a giggle in the process. "Here, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya idiot ]. Ain't ya say another word 'fore ya get a drink an' all. Ya need some fluids inside of ya given what ya did f'r sis..." The strong smell of tea assaults your nose, and it's very bitter when you down the cup that Miko offers you. Well, you know it ought to be bitter, but the sensation is dulled, what taste would be to sight if the world were grayed out. It works, though — you instantly feel better, if marginally so. "Hope you don't mind me roping Mikoto into the matter, but I needed someone with sufficient mass to pry the both of you apart when you were done. Komari is watching the shrine while we attend to you." What? Oh... she said she'd be watching. "Indeed I was, and you performed quite admirably." Kiyoko leans down and gives you a small kiss on the cheek. "Perhaps you could bring some of that vigor into our own copulation every so often, could you not? Not now, of course..." You don't know about that; she certainly seems ready to jump your bones at any moment. Of course, that's how she usually looks these days, pregnant or not. Kiyoko chuckles a little. "In either case, you looked like you'd had enough, so I did what I said I was going to do and summoned up Mikoto for aid. Don't worry about Miyuki — she's been made comfortable, and we've cleaned up the mess. Everything's as good as new, so you don't have to worry about the matter. I'm just glad that you're as magnanimous and energetic as always to give to my subjects a treatment that's almost as good as the ones we have together..." "Can't deny that lil' ol' me kinda wishes it were me out there with ya, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ain't that th' truth ]. All y'all were makin' such a ruckus, them kits will be tellin' stories 'bout howlin' spirits over th' rice fields f'r months now." D-did someone, uh, well, you were going at it in public, even if it was the dead of night... Miko chuckles and pours you another cup of tea. "Well, Granny an' I were th' first ones on the scene after being woke in th' dead o' night by the [silly |myobu |high lady ] here. "Really, Granny an' I gotta be thankin' ya f'r helpin' out with Mai. Ya done seen what happens to sis when she goes off her meds. Ain't trained to take it, so beauty, rage, joy, all that kinda stuff... th' slightest feelin', an' she turns into a right wreck. As terrible as that mighta be, bein' dead inside ain't no way to live, neither. An' th' longer she done puts off goin' clean, the worse it's gonna get." How did she miss a dose, though? Every time you've seen Mai, she always has the long-stemmed pipe of hers about. That, and given how her life revolves around the drug... Miko shrugs. Well, thanks. For a moment there, you thought you might've overextended yourself struggling with Mai; her fury while sober was enough that you might've just gotten yourself torn apart trying to quench it. Of course, for a face as lovely as Kiyoko's, anyone would rise from the dead just to be able to gaze upon it. "Tch, such flattery. "Well, yes. Consider dear Mikoto here — no matter how much she feeds, she's always at least a little hungry, because the part of her spirit that should tell her that she is sated is disordered. Miyuki, though, resorts to medication to alleviate the problem, softening the intensity of what she receives through her senses. It's... easier, so to speak, to simply allow Miyuki to smoke all she wants in order to keep her condition under control. "But as the years have gone by, poor Komari's great-great-granddaughter has built up more and more tolerance to the drug, and... well... the entirety of her life is now underlined by getting more and more of it in sufficient concentrations. "Either way, you performed quite admirably back there, so I'm sure everyone will think just a little more highly of you after this inevitably gets out[pc.ra kitsune | — and me as well, of course, for having picked such a fine champion ].
