“她现在没什么问题了。我帮她把身上弄干净了，她指甲下的污垢多得吓人。等奶奶哄她睡觉后，我就得去把那些坑填平，然后重新种上草…… 至于其他的事情，我和奶奶是在半夜被你们的吵闹声惊醒后第一个赶到现场的。我们看到你们的那位‘神圣领袖’就站在这里，看着你们像在看一场街头木偶戏一样争斗。如果还有其他人看到了你们那些举动，我们可一点都没看见。而任何有可能看到这种事情的人，都应该有足够的礼貌，选择保持沉默。 真的，奶奶，我们真的得感谢你帮助我们照顾舞。你也看到了，当她不按时服药时，会变成什么样子。她根本不习惯按时服药，所以一旦有丝毫情绪波动——无论是愤怒、喜悦还是其他什么情绪——她就会彻底失控，变得一团糟。虽然那种状态很可怕，但‘内心死寂’同样不是一种可以继续生活的方式。而且，她拖延服药的时间越长，情况就会变得越糟。 但她是怎么错过这次服药的呢？每次你见到舞，她身边总是带着那根长烟斗。再加上她的生活几乎完全围绕着毒品展开…… 凯罗斯摆了摆手，说道：“哦，我知道答案了那个但这并不是我可以泄露的秘密。至于你是否会选择继续追查这件事，过程本身应该会相当有趣。当然，也有可能出现一些意想不到的后果。不是正在追求它。[pc.ra kitsune | 亲爱的冠军，你所做的一切总是让我着迷，你至今也没有给我任何理由让我改变自己的选择。 ]所以他知道，却只是任由事情发生？ “嗯，没错。以亲爱的美琴为例吧——无论她吃多少，她总是会感到有点饿，因为她灵魂中那个应该告诉她已经吃饱的部分出现了紊乱。然而，美雪选择通过服药来缓解这一状况，从而减轻感官所接收到的刺激强度。可以说，让美雪随心所欲地吸烟，反而更容易帮助她控制自己的病情。 但随着时间的推移，可怜的麻里的曾曾孙女对这种药物逐渐产生了越来越强的耐受性，而……嗯……她整个人生现在都围绕着持续摄入足够剂量的这种药物来展开。从定期服用药物，到亲自种植这种植物，并不断培育新的品种以获取更多的药物……这种做法显然不是长久之计。 你瞧。他知道你会一起来吗？” “我可以选择不去知道，而且我也经常这么做。” 米可轻咳了一声，说道：“请原谅我的冒昧，但是—— 是的。再稍等一下，美琴。”凯罗斯轻松地挥了挥手，然后又转向你说道：“无论如何，你刚才的表现都非常出色，所以我相信等这件事传开后，大家对你的评价一定会更高一些。[pc.ra kitsune | — 当然，也包括我，毕竟我选择了这么一位出色的英雄。 ]那么，现在休息吧。在经历了有些人可能会称之为“死里逃生”的经历之后，你确实需要恢复体力…… ]
rows.raw: " You eventually come to, something that's initially shocking but not quite surprising given your circumstances. Sitting up in the futon you've been laid out on, you feel faint, your head spins, and eventually gravity takes hold of your failing body once more to draw you back into welcoming softness. A quick glance at your surroundings reveals that you're in the little rest house in the tree's branches, someone having carefully taken the time to make you very comfortable. [party.has kiyoko |A shadow falls over you, and eventually Kiyoko's face appears in your vision, peering down amusedly at you. The expression your fox-wife's wearing clears any concerns you may have about whether your life is in imminent danger, though, as she reaches down and gives you a firm pat on your head[pc.ra kitsune | and tweak of the ears, before idly combing the fur of your tails with her fingers ]. Miko stands at quiet attention off to her side, a tea tray balanced in her hands as she tries to look as neutral as possible, without much success. "Welcome back, beloved. That was quite the show you put up there." Was it? Miko clears her throat, stifling a giggle in the process. "Here, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya idiot ]. Ain't ya say another word 'fore ya get a drink an' all. Ya need some fluids inside of ya given what ya did f'r sis..." The strong smell of tea assaults your nose, and it's very bitter when you down the cup that Miko offers you. Well, you know it ought to be bitter, but the sensation is dulled, what taste would be to sight if the world were grayed out. It works, though — you instantly feel better, if marginally so. "Hope you don't mind me roping Mikoto into the matter, but I needed someone with sufficient mass to pry the both of you apart when you were done. Komari is watching the shrine while we attend to you." What? Oh... she said she'd be watching. "Indeed I was, and you performed quite admirably." Kiyoko leans down and gives you a small kiss on the cheek. "Perhaps you could bring some of that vigor into our own copulation every so often, could you not? Not now, of course..." You don't know about that; she certainly seems ready to jump your bones at any moment. Of course, that's how she usually looks these days, pregnant or not. Kiyoko chuckles a little. "In either case, you looked like you'd had enough, so I did what I said I was going to do and summoned up Mikoto for aid. Don't worry about Miyuki — she's been made comfortable, and we've cleaned up the mess. Everything's as good as new, so you don't have to worry about the matter. I'm just glad that you're as magnanimous and energetic as always to give to my subjects a treatment that's almost as good as the ones we have together..." "Can't deny that lil' ol' me kinda wishes it were me out there with ya, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ain't that th' truth ]. All y'all were makin' such a ruckus, them kits will be tellin' stories 'bout howlin' spirits over th' rice fields f'r months now." D-did someone, uh, well, you were going at it in public, even if it was the dead of night... Miko chuckles and pours you another cup of tea. "Well, Granny an' I were th' first ones on the scene after being woke in th' dead o' night by the [silly |myobu |high lady ] here. If'n anyone else saw ya satin' my sis, we didn't see them none, an' anyone chancin' upon that kinda stuff knows to be polite enough to be sayin' nothin'. "Really, Granny an' I gotta be thankin' ya f'r helpin' out with Mai. Ya done seen what happens to sis when she goes off her meds. Ain't trained to take it, so beauty, rage, joy, all that kinda stuff... th' slightest feelin', an' she turns into a right wreck. As terrible as that mighta be, bein' dead inside ain't no way to live, neither. An' th' longer she done puts off goin' clean, the worse it's gonna get." How did she miss a dose, though? Every time you've seen Mai, she always has the long-stemmed pipe of hers about. That, and given how her life revolves around the drug... Miko shrugs. Well, thanks. For a moment there, you thought you might've overextended yourself struggling with Mai; her fury while sober was enough that you might've just gotten yourself torn apart trying to quench it. Of course, for a face as lovely as Kiyoko's, anyone would rise from the dead just to be able to gaze upon it. "Tch, such flattery. Either way, you performed quite admirably back there, so I'm sure everyone will think just a little more highly of you after this inevitably gets out — and me as well, of course, for having picked such a fine consort. Now then, rest. You'll need your strength after having survived what some might call a near-death experience..." |A shadow falls over you, and eventually Keros' face appears in your vision, peering down amusedly at you, Miko standing a little ways off to the side with a tea tray while trying to keep a straight face and mostly failing. The expression the deity's wearing clears any concerns you may have about whether your life is in imminent danger, though, as he reaches down and gives you a firm pat on your head[pc.ra kitsune | and tweak of the ears, before idly combing the fur of your tails with his fingers. "Rise[silly | from your grave ], my champion. While you may have performed quite admirably, it'd be such a waste — and not to say the blow to my reputation — if you perished from a chance encounter with one of my shrine maidens. You're feeling perfectly healthy?" [pc.isDK |Nice for him to consider your health in terms of how it'd make him lose face. But yes, yes you're feeling as well as can be given the circumstances you just emerged from. "While altruism is nice, it's always well and good to add a layer of skin in the game into one's motivations, is it not? You would know |You're feeling as well as can be given the circumstances you just emerged from, yes. Very nice of him to pull you out of there when you thought you might expire — or at least, if there was a you at the end there. "All the legends do say that I'm only an irreverent prick to those who deserve it ] |. "Rise and shine, dear friend. While you may have performed quite admirably, it'd be a waste to see someone as interesting as you perish from a chance encounter with one of my shrine maidens. As far as I'm concerned, you don't deserve an end that ignoble, especially when it's a result of a rather selfless act. Now then, you're feeling quite healthy?" A little dizzy and very weak all over, but at least you're still in possession of all your faculties. "Good, good. No lasting damage, then ]. Now, that was quite the show you put up there... once again, I do commend you[pc.ra kitsune |, my champion. Clearly the right choice for me when even the risk of expiry doesn't dissuade you from testing your limits and having a little fun while at it ]." Miko clears her throat, stifling a giggle in the process. "Here, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ya idiot ]. Ain't ya say another word 'fore ya get a drink an' all. Ya need some fluids inside of ya given what ya did f'r sis..." The strong smell of tea assaults your nose, and it's very bitter when you down the cup that Miko offers you. Well, you know it ought to be bitter, but the sensation is dulled, what taste would be to sight if the world were grayed out. It works, though — you instantly feel better, if marginally so. "Hope you don't mind me roping Mikoto into the matter, but I felt it prudent to have someone with more of a stake in the matter deal with the both of you when you were done. Komari is watching the shrine while we attend to you." You... remember, you think? There was the desperate hope cast at the fox statue Mai had been sitting on — had he been watching you all this time? "I was content to not intervene unless you needed it. While I did not precipitate the events that led to Miyuki's hysterical breakdown, the events were necessary sooner or later, so I did not interfere." What does he mean? Ow... you still hurt down there. "Can't deny that lil' ol' me kinda wishes it were me out there with ya, [pc.ra kitsune |yer Eminence |ain't that th' truth ]. All y'all were makin' such a ruckus, them kits will be tellin' stories 'bout howlin' spirits over th' rice fields f'r months now." D-did someone, uh, well, you were going at it in public, even if it was the dead of night... how's Mai? "Ain't nothin' wrong with her now. Lil' ol' me done went an' cleaned her up, sis had so much dirt under her nails it weren't funny. Then after granny done went an' put her to bed, I had to go 'bout fillin' them holes and puttin' down new grass... "As f'r th' other stuff, Granny an' I were th' first ones on the scene after being woke in th' dead o' night by th' ruckus ya were makin' an' found his divine lordship here watchin' ya goin' at it like some kinda street puppet show. If'n anyone else saw ya satin' my sis, we didn't see them none, an' anyone chancin' upon that kinda stuff knows to be polite enough to be sayin' nothin'. "Really, Granny an' I gotta be thankin' ya f'r helpin' out with Mai. Ya done seen what happens to sis when she goes off her meds. Ain't trained to take it, so beauty, rage, joy, all that kinda stuff... th' slightest feelin', an' she turns into a right wreck. As terrible as that mighta be, bein' dead inside ain't no way to live, neither. An' th' longer she done puts off goin' clean, the worse it's gonna get." How did she miss a dose, though? Every time you've seen Mai, she always has the long-stemmed pipe of hers about. That, and given how her life revolves around the drug... Keros waves it off. "Oh, I know the answer to that, but it's not my secret to divulge. That, and watching you pursue the thread, if you choose to do so, will be quite interesting. Either that, or the consequences of not pursuing it.[pc.ra kitsune | Everything that you do never fails to fascinate, my dear champion, and you've yet to give me any reason to reconsider my choice. ]" So he knew, and just let it happen? "Well, yes. Consider dear Mikoto here — no matter how much she feeds, she's always at least a little hungry, because the part of her spirit that should tell her that she is sated is disordered. Miyuki, though, resorts to medication to alleviate the problem, softening the intensity of what she receives through her senses. It's... easier, so to speak, to simply allow Miyuki to smoke all she wants in order to keep her condition under control. "But as the years have gone by, poor Komari's great-great-granddaughter has built up more and more tolerance to the drug, and... well... the entirety of her life is now underlined by getting more and more of it in sufficient concentrations. From regular doses, to preparing the plant and raising a never-ending strain of cultivars to produce ever more... it's not a long-term solution." You see. And did he know that you would be coming along? "I can choose to not know, and do it quite often." Miko coughs. "Beggin' yer divine lordship's pardon, but — " "Yes. Bear with me a little longer, Mikoto." Keros waves her off breezily and turns back to you. "Either way, you performed quite admirably back there, so I'm sure everyone will think just a little more highly of you after this inevitably gets out[pc.ra kitsune | — and me as well, of course, for having picked such a fine champion ]. Now then, rest. You'll need your strength after having survived what some might call a near-death experience..." ] "

rows.original: You've made up your mind. Grabbing Mai by under her arms, you drag her off your chest and [pc.ra kitsune |haul her to her feet |send her stumbling after you ]; she complies at first, still sniffling a bit, then breaks out into screaming hysterics when she realizes you're dragging her away from the shrine and not towards it. It feels as if the little fox shrine and its sanctity are what's been tethering her to her last shreds of sanity, and without them she's simply snapped. Clawing, screaming, her cheeks wet with tears, Mai fights you every step of the way as you drag her away from the fox shrine and to her great-great-grandmother's home. Her weeping and screaming rings out into the otherwise beautiful night as you manhandle her through the fields and up through the arcology's main stairwell; her nails dig into your skin, but at least they don't draw blood. It's just short of terrifying, the sudden change in demeanor, clearly reminiscent of the few times you've actually seen the thing that lurks beneath the facade of Miko's sanity. Similar, but not identical. [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko tries to help you in all this, but your fox-wife isn't the most athletic of people and her usual methods aren't quite as applicable here. ]You'd have imagined that there would be more people staring at you, be it out of curiosity or from anger at disturbed sleep, but if anyone's watching this spectacle as it proceeds all the way to Komari's doorstep then they remain well-hidden. An impeccably polite people down to the bitter end, it would appear. Now, how does kitsune etiquette go when it comes to announcing your presence at someone's home? Do you knock? Do you clap? Every time you've had reason to visit, the door's always open — but it really is an academic question when you've got a hysterical vixen screaming and snivelling her head off while trying to claw your eyes out, isn't it? Mai only gets worse when you all but bodily drag her up to the threshold, wailing like a spectre facing its imminent exorcism. At least that serves to announce your presence, because by the time you've actually made it to the door footsteps sound from within and it opens just a crack. Miko takes one look at her sister, her usual smile gone and replaced by one of strict neutrality. "Gra-nny, Mai done got off her meds again." Again? This isn't the first time this has happened? "[pc.ra kitsune |Beggin' yer Eminence's pardon, but it ain't |Nope, ain't th' first time for sure ]. Though if'n lil' ol' me oughta put in a good word f'r my sis, it's that she ain't forgotten to light up one o' her personal blends for several years now. Last time she got off her meds an' went crazy, we were jus' yay-high. If'n ya don't mind comin' in[pc.ra kitsune |, yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]?[party.has kiyoko | Th' same invitation done extend to ya, [silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ]. ]" You'd love to, but — Miko makes an annoyed noise in the back of her throat, then steps out over the doorway and gives Mai a huge slap that rings out over the courtyard. Then, without any further explanation or mercy, she grabs Mai by the tip of one of her ears and starts dragging her indoors. It should hurt — you know [pc.ra kitsune |firsthand |full well ] how sensitive kitsune ears are — and maybe it does, but it works. The shrieking, feral Mai turns docile almost immediately, the maelstrom of emotions and sensation flooding her senses turning upon itself instead of out as she meekly allows both you and her sister to heft her indoors. "Won't last long, but it'll last long enough. Blind her senses with too much until her mind can't even feel them no more," Miko says with a sigh. "[pc.ra kitsune |Far from it being my station to ask even more of ya, yer Eminence |Ya already done so much by draggin' her all th' way home an' I appreciate that ], but could I be leaning on ya to help me set sis down? That there seat will do jus' fine — she shouldn't be lyin' down none at a time like this. We did that when she were a kit an' she started chokin' on her own tears." ...You see. Seating the whimpering Mai on the chair, [party.has kiyoko |your fox-wife and ]you deliver a steady stream of headpats and soothing nothings until Miko returns shortly with Komari in tow. Unlike the former in her nightgown, the latter's fully dressed — does she never sleep? Nevertheless, Komari's got a little wooden censer in her hands, and sets that down on a side table before Miko lights the insides with a spark of foxfire. Within moments, the familiar smell of winterstem starts rolling out of the censer — but much thicker than you remember it ever being. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ] ] |[party.has kiyoko |[silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ], ][pc.name] ]. I would gently suggest that you step a safe distance from the censer, lest you fall unconscious — over the years, my dear great-great-granddaughter has built up a considerable resistance to the drug, which requires greater and greater doses to keep her condition under control." You don't need telling twice. Even at this distance, the white haze is choking despite its thin appearance, and all of you retreat to the side of the room. Komari throws open a window, and after a few lungfuls of fresh air the haze creeping in at the edges of your consciousness retreats. Phew... "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ] ] |[party.has kiyoko |[silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ], ][pc.name] ], thank you for bringing my great-great-granddaughter home. I'm ashamed to say that our family troubles should not be inconveniencing you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Well, if she's sorry for imposing upon you, maybe she can explain just what it is that happened. Komari sighs. "You are, of course, already aware that my great-great-granddaughters are both blessed and cursed." They see auras, yes, and everything that entails. "Starting with me, none of my descendants have managed to escape the taint of my failure in some form or fashion. No matter how much she feeds, my dear Mikoto is always at least a little hungry, because the part of her spirit that should tell her that she is sated is disordered. Miyuki, though, resorts to medication to alleviate the problem, softening the intensity of what she receives through her senses. Naturally, Mikoto refuses to participate in what she perceives as numbing her senses and slowing her thoughts, instead attempting to train her mental fortitude in order to deal with her neurosis." And is she right about that? Refusing to be drugged up? Komari throws a helpless look at Mai. "It's... easier, in a sense, to simply allow Miyuki to smoke all she wants in order to keep her condition under control[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. But as the years have gone by, my great-great-granddaughter has built up more and more tolerance to the drug, and... well... the entirety of her life is now underlined by getting more and more of it in sufficient concentrations. From regular doses, to preparing the plant and raising a never-ending strain of cultivars to produce ever more... it's not a long-term solution." And yet the pain of actually taking the necessary step is enough for her to put it off a little longer. "Ya done seen what happens to sis when she goes off her meds. Ain't trained to take it, so beauty, rage, joy, all that kinda stuff... she turns into a right wreck." Miko's expression is straight and humorless. "As terrible as that mighta be, bein' dead inside ain't no way to live, neither. An' th' longer she done puts it off, the worse it's gonna get." All right, you think you've heard enough. So... is Mai going to be fine? "She ain't gonna be clawin' yer eyes out, if'n that's what you mean. Sis is th' responsible one, after all." Komari shoots Miko a sharp glance. "Of course, that leaves the question of how Miyuki managed to miss a dose — my dear great-great-granddaughter has been extremely careful about taking the drug her life revolves around for a good while now." "Why're ya lookin' at me, Granny? I ain't had nothin' to do with this." "We'll see about that, girl. Don't think I haven't noticed that you've been in a miserable fuss over your sister of late." Komari flicks a ear at Miko, then turns back to you. "Once more, you have my thanks for bringing up my dear great-great-granddaughter[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. The girl's probably calmed down enough for Miko and I to get her cleaned up and settled in; she's still a mess. "Now, if [pc.ra kitsune |I may take my leave of you[party.has kiyoko |and the [silly |myobu |high lady ] ], your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |if you'll excuse me ]... do mind your step on the way out, and try not to breathe in any of the fumes." Carefully moving so as to not turn her back on you and break some unspoken but all-important rule of Old Country etiquette, Komari grabs her walking stick and makes a beeline through the haze of white smoke for Mai. Looks like it's over — Miko shows you to the door, bows, and allows you to take your leave on your own time.

"Won't last long, but it'll last long enough. Blind her senses with too much until her mind can't even feel them no more," Miko says with a sigh. "[pc.ra kitsune |Far from it being my station to ask even more of ya, yer Eminence |Ya already done so much by draggin' her all th' way home an' I appreciate that ], but could I be leaning on ya to help me set sis down? That there seat will do jus' fine — she shouldn't be lyin' down none at a time like this. We did that when she were a kit an' she started chokin' on her own tears." ...You see. Seating the whimpering Mai on the chair, [party.has kiyoko |your fox-wife and ]you deliver a steady stream of headpats and soothing nothings until Miko returns shortly with Komari in tow. Unlike the former in her nightgown, the latter's fully dressed — does she never sleep? Nevertheless, Komari's got a little wooden censer in her hands, and sets that down on a side table before Miko lights the insides with a spark of foxfire. Within moments, the familiar smell of winterstem starts rolling out of the censer — but much thicker than you remember it ever being. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ] ] |[party.has kiyoko |[silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ], ][pc.name] ]. I would gently suggest that you step a safe distance from the censer, lest you fall unconscious — over the years, my dear great-great-granddaughter has built up a considerable resistance to the drug, which requires greater and greater doses to keep her condition under control." You don't need telling twice. Even at this distance, the white haze is choking despite its thin appearance, and all of you retreat to the side of the room. Komari throws open a window, and after a few lungfuls of fresh air the haze creeping in at the edges of your consciousness retreats. Phew... "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence[party.has kiyoko |, [silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ] ] |[party.has kiyoko |[silly |Myobu-sama |High Lady ], ][pc.name] ], thank you for bringing my great-great-granddaughter home. I'm ashamed to say that our family troubles should not be inconveniencing you[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." Well, if she's sorry for imposing upon you, maybe she can explain just what it is that happened. Komari sighs. "You are, of course, already aware that my great-great-granddaughters are both blessed and cursed." They see auras, yes, and everything that entails. "Starting with me, none of my descendants have managed to escape the taint of my failure in some form or fashion. No matter how much she feeds, my dear Mikoto is always at least a little hungry, because the part of her spirit that should tell her that she is sated is disordered. Miyuki, though, resorts to medication to alleviate the problem, softening the intensity of what she receives through her senses. Naturally, Mikoto refuses to participate in what she perceives as numbing her senses and slowing her thoughts, instead attempting to train her mental fortitude in order to deal with her neurosis." And is she right about that? Refusing to be drugged up? Komari throws a helpless look at Mai. "It's... easier, in a sense, to simply allow Miyuki to smoke all she wants in order to keep her condition under control[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. But as the years have gone by, my great-great-granddaughter has built up more and more tolerance to the drug, and... well... the entirety of her life is now underlined by getting more and more of it in sufficient concentrations. From regular doses, to preparing the plant and raising a never-ending strain of cultivars to produce ever more... it's not a long-term solution." And yet the pain of actually taking the necessary step is enough for her to put it off a little longer. "Ya done seen what happens to sis when she goes off her meds. Ain't trained to take it, so beauty, rage, joy, all that kinda stuff... she turns into a right wreck." Miko's expression is straight and humorless. "As terrible as that mighta be, bein' dead inside ain't no way to live, neither. An' th' longer she done puts it off, the worse it's gonna get." All right, you think you've heard enough. So... is Mai going to be fine? "She ain't gonna be clawin' yer eyes out, if'n that's what you mean. Sis is th' responsible one, after all." Komari shoots Miko a sharp glance. "Of course, that leaves the question of how Miyuki managed to miss a dose — my dear great-great-granddaughter has been extremely careful about taking the drug her life revolves around for a good while now." "Why're ya lookin' at me, Granny? I ain't had nothin' to do with this." "We'll see about that, girl. Don't think I haven't noticed that you've been in a miserable fuss over your sister of late." Komari flicks a ear at Miko, then turns back to you. "Once more, you have my thanks for bringing up my dear great-great-granddaughter[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. The girl's probably calmed down enough for Miko and I to get her cleaned up and settled in; she's still a mess. "Now, if [pc.ra kitsune |I may take my leave of you[party.has kiyoko |and the [silly |myobu |high lady ] ], your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |if you'll excuse me ]... do mind your step on the way out, and try not to breathe in any of the fumes." Carefully moving so as to not turn her back on you and break some unspoken but all-important rule of Old Country etiquette, Komari grabs her walking stick and makes a beeline through the haze of white smoke for Mai. Looks like it's over — Miko shows you to the door, bows, and allows you to take your leave on your own time. "

rows.original: Mai's clearly not in control of her actions thanks to her affliction. She needs help, and the best way to do it is to get her to people who know her better than you do.
rows.translation: 由于这种疾病的影响，舞显然已经无法控制自己的行为了。她需要帮助，而最好的办法就是将她交给那些比你更了解她的人。
rows.raw: "Mai's clearly not in control of her actions thanks to her affliction. She needs help, and the best way to do it is to get her to people who know her better than you do."

rows.original: As you draw close to the fox shrine, you sense a certain crawling on the back of your neck[pc.hasEmoteEars |, followed by your ears starting to twitch furiously ] — it feels exactly as if someone were staring at you hard enough to bore a hole into you. And as it turns out, that someone happens to be Komari — instead of [var0 |Miko and Mai on duty |Mai on duty this evening |Miko on duty this fine day ], their great-great-grandmother is standing under the awning of the shrine roof, feet firmly planted on the stone path leading up to the donation box. Her arms are firmly folded in her sleeves, and her lips are set into a thin, straight line; the den matron may have empty eyes, but you don't need them to judge her mood at the moment. Uh-oh. Your feet pause mid-step for a moment, hesitating on whether to advance or retreat, but your body makes up your mind for you as if compelled by some kind of spell and drags the rest of you forward. Komari gives you a curt nod [pc.ra kitsune |instead of the bow you've come to expect from her, which tells you just how off-kilter she is. "My [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Mikoto foresaw your coming, and I took the liberty of placing myself in your path." Is something the matter? She looks serious. "Something's the matter all right, something's the matter, enough for me to come down and kindly request your time for a moment." The tone of her voice implies that she's not going to take no for an answer, the difference in your social stations notwithstanding. "You'll come to understand it a bit more when you see what's happened." [party.has kiyoko |"What has happened that involves my consort so, Komari?" Kiyoko asks. "Surely such impropriety on your part — " ] You have a bad feeling about this, but that much should be obvious at this point. Maybe if she explained — "I am explaining it. You have to see it for yourself for the full weight of your actions to come to bear. If you please, your Eminence." |and glare, looking definitively sour. "There you are, finally deigning to show up. Mikoto foresaw your coming, so I thought I'd put myself in your way." Is something the matter? She looks serious. "Something's the matter all right, something's the matter, enough for me to come down and kindly request your time for a moment." The tone of her voice implies that she's not going to take no for an answer. "You'll come to understand it a bit more when you see what's happened." [party.has kiyoko |"What has happened that involves my consort so, Komari?" Kiyoko asks. "Surely such impropriety on your part — " ] You have a bad feeling about this, but that much should be obvious at this point. Maybe if she explained it to you — "I am explaining it. You have to see it for yourself for the full weight of your actions to come to bear. If you don't mind, great [pc.title], you can accompany me to my home and I'll show you exactly what I mean." ] [party.has kiyoko |You throw your fox-wife a glance. Has she any idea what Komari's on about? "No, Beloved. And in all our time as girls, she only behaved with such impropriety when she was truly, really upset. I am not sure what either of us could have done to aggrieve her this deeply, but I am interested in finding out." ] Well, fine. [pc.isDK |This had better be good |You'll go and see what has this old lady so hopping mad ]. Curious gazes follow you as you trail along behind the den matron through the tree and up to her office in the branches, pushing past the screen door and into her living quarters in the back. There, sitting cross-legged on a futon, is Mai. [var1 |Unsurprisingly, it's been a while since you've last met given the circumstances of your last encounter with her, but while she's still nowhere near her sister's oversexed proportions she's thicker all around: it's mostly in the hips and thighs, and her bust fills her top ever more snugly than before. But all this eyeing her body is just putting off the inevitable, what she's hugging close to her bared breasts: a hefty two-tailed fox kit, gray-furred ears folded against her head while she nurses eagerly from her mother's breast. Oh. Oh. "Well then,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Komari continues, her face falling in exasperation, "it would appear that you've made a daughter, and I now have great-great-great- grandchildren. Good thing you had it in you to stay away from Miyuki here until she finally gave birth, or else she'd have torn you to pieces." For the first time since you entered the room, Mai looks up and notices you. Her ears flatten, her lips trembles, she bares her teeth, and for a moment you think she might just toss the child aside and leap for your throat. Thankfully, she doesn't do that, but it's not without considerable restraint on her part. |It's been a while since you last met, a good long while... and she's thicker all around, especially in the hips and thighs. But all this eyeing her body is just putting off the inevitable, what your gaze is most assiduously avoiding: the fact that Mai's belly is swollen and rounded, its firm curve lifting her skirts to announce to the world the fact that she's with child. While it might just be proportional on Miko, it's much less so for Mai given just how far she otherwise looks to be along, bloating up rapidly on her figure. Oh. Oh. "Well then,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Komari continues, her face falling in exasperation, "it would appear that you've made a daughter, and I now have great-great-great- grandchildren. Not that all the blame falls upon you for this turn of events — Miyuki here is just as, if not more culpable than you, especially given that she's supposed to be the more responsible of my dear great-great-grandaughters. So much for that." For the first time since you entered the room, Mai looks up and notices you. Her ears flatten, her lips trembles, she bares her teeth, and for a moment you think she might just leap for your throat, big tummy or no. She has to visibly struggle to not throttle you on the spot, and one only wonders how much restraint's left in that body of hers. ] One amber eye, bloodshot and now deep orange from what you imagine must be regular crying, focuses balefully on you[pc.ra kitsune |; in an instant, all propriety and consideration for your station is thrown to the wind ]. [var1 |She can't very well drop the baby to go for you, so she settles for hammering a fist against the wooden floor as she sniffles |Muscles tense and bunch up, and despite her rounded tummy she's quick to leap to her feet and against you, pounding your chest ineffectually with her fists while pressing her pregnant belly up against you ]. "You! You made me this —" Without so much as blinking, Komari raps her great-great-granddaughter hard on the side of the head with her walking stick. Mai yelps and settles down, although the seething mixture of rage, misery, lust and other volatile emotions inside of her doesn't recede in the least. "Don't act as if you had no agency in all of this, girl. When did I first urge you to wean yourself of that drug? More than a decade ago? Your sister and I know what happened — you flung yourself at [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence |[pc.name] ] and had as much of a hand in precipitating this situation as [pc.heShe] did." Mai trembles, looking absolutely miserable in her bedraggled fur, then turns on the waterworks; [var1 |if not for the fact that she's busy nursing, you're pretty sure the fox kit would have started wailing along with her mother |her normal neuroticism and overstimulation can't be helped in the least by the hormonal mess that her body must be ]. Komari sighs, puts her face in her hands, and mutters something in her native language that while you can't understand nevertheless manage to perfectly convey a resigned lamentation over the cosmic injustice of existence.
rows.translation: 当你逐渐接近那只狐妖的神社时，你感觉到有什么东西在你的后颈上爬来爬去。[pc.hasEmoteEars |紧接着，你的耳朵开始剧烈地抽动起来。 ] — 感觉就像有人用极其专注的目光盯着你，仿佛能把你看穿一样。而事实上，那个人恰恰就是麻里[var0 |米可与舞在值班中 |梅今晚值勤。 |在这个美好的日子里，米可正在值班。 ]他们的曾曾祖母站在神龛屋檐下，双脚牢牢地踩在通往捐款箱的石径上。她的双臂紧紧地插在袖子里，嘴唇紧闭成一条细细的直线；这位族长或许眼神空洞，但此刻你完全不需要她的目光就能判断出她的情绪。 哦不…… 你的脚步在半空中停住了，一时犹豫不决，不知道该前进还是后退，但你的身体仿佛被某种力量驱使般，自动做出了决定，继续向前移动。麻里简短地点了点头。 [pc.ra kitsune |并没有拿出你原本期待她会拿出的那把弓，这一点恰恰说明了她现在的状态有多么不正常。 “我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]船长。美琴预见了你将会到来，所以我擅自挡在了你的路上。” “出了什么事情吗？她的表情看起来很严肃。” “确实出了点事情，严重到让我不得不亲自下来，恳请您抽出一点时间陪我谈谈。”她的肌肉度表明，无论你们的社会地位有何差异，她都不会接受被拒绝的答复。“等你了解了发生的事情，就会明白我的意思了。 [party.has kiyoko |什么？拥有发生了一些与我的配偶有关的事情，对吧，麻里？”清子问道，“你这样的行为，实在太过分了…… ] 你对这件事有一种不好的预感，但到了这个时候，这种感觉应该已经很明显了吧。也许如果她能解释一下的话—— “我是这需要您亲身体验才能真正理解您所做行为的全部意义。请您务必这样做，尊敬的阁下。 |她瞪着眼睛，脸色明显很不好看。 “终于来了啊。美琴早就预料到你会来，所以我就打算来阻拦你。” 是不是出了什么问题？她的表情看起来很严肃。 肯定出了什么问题，一定是出了什么问题，否则我也不会专程下来，恳请您抽出一点时间陪我聊聊。”她的肌肉度明显表明，她不会接受被拒绝的答复。“等您看到发生了什么，就会明白我的意思了。" [party.has kiyoko |什么？拥有发生了一些与我的妻子有关的事情，对吧，麻里？”清子问道，“你这样的行为，实在太过分了…… ] 你对这件事有一种不好的预感，但到了这个时候，这种感觉应该已经很明显了。或许如果她能向你解释一下—— “我是这需要你自己亲眼去看看，才能真正理解自己行为的全部后果。如果你不介意的话，那就太好了。 [pc.title]你可以陪我回家，我会向你清楚地展示我的意思。 ] [party.has kiyoko |你瞥了瞥你的狐狸妻子一眼。她知道麻里在说什么吗？ “不知道，亲爱的。在我们还是女孩的时候，她只有在真正非常难过的时候才会做出这种不当的行为。我不确定我们当中有谁会做出什么事来让她如此伤心，但我很想知道原因。 ] 好吧，那就这样吧。 [pc.isDK |这东西最好真的不错才行。 |你去看看，是什么事让这位老太太如此愤怒吧。 ]当你跟在巢穴的女首领身后，穿过树林，来到她位于树枝间的办公室时，许多好奇的目光正注视着你。你推开门，走进了她位于后面的生活区。在那里，舞正盘腿坐在一张榻榻米上。 [var1 |毫不奇怪，考虑到你们上次见面的情形，这次再次见面已经隔了相当长的一段时间。虽然她的体形还远没有她姐姐那么性感诱人，但她的身体线条确实变得更加丰满了一些：尤其是臀部和大腿部位，而她的胸部也使得上衣显得比以前更加贴身了。但所有这些注视她身体的行为，其实只是在推迟那个不可避免的时刻——她紧紧抱在怀里的，正是那只毛色灰白、长着两条尾巴的小狐狸：它用灰色的耳朵贴在头上，正迫不及待地吮吸着母亲的乳汁。 哦。 哦。 那么，[pc.ra kitsune | 阁下， ]麻里继续说道，脸上露出无奈的表情：“看来你终于有了一个女儿，而我现在则有了一个曾孙女很棒孙子们……还好你有足够的自制力，没有在美雪分娩之前接近她，否则她早就把你撕成碎片了。” 自从你走进这个房间以来，舞第一次抬起头注意到了你。她的耳朵贴在脑袋两侧，嘴唇颤抖着，牙齿也露了出来，有那么一瞬间，你真以为她会把孩子扔到一边，然后扑向你的喉咙。幸运的是，她并没有那么做，但这显然需要她付出极大的克制力。 |你们已经很久没有见面了，真的很久……她的身体也变得丰满了许多，尤其是臀部和大腿。但所有这些对她身材的打量，其实只是在推迟那个不可避免的事实——也就是你的目光一直在刻意回避的那个事实：舞的肚子已经隆起了，那圆润的曲线将她的裙子撑得高高翘起，向全世界宣告她已经怀孕了。虽然在米科身上这种变化可能还算比较均匀，但对于舞来说却完全不同——她的身体其他部位明明还在继续发育，她的身材却迅速变得臃肿起来。 哦 哦。 那么，[pc.ra kitsune | 阁下， ]麻里继续说道，脸上露出无奈的表情：“看来你终于有了一个女儿，而我现在则有了一个曾孙女很棒- 孙辈们。不过，对于这一系列事件，不能把所有的责任都归咎于你——其实美雪的责任并不比你小，甚至可能更大。尤其是毕竟她应该是我们亲爱的曾曾孙女中最为懂事、最为负责任的一个啊……看来这种期望也是白费了。” 自从你走进房间以来，舞第一次抬起头注意到了你。她的耳朵贴在了脑袋两侧，嘴唇颤抖着，牙齿也露了出来，有那么一瞬间，你甚至以为她可能会不顾自己隆起的肚子，直接扑上来掐住你的喉咙。她显然在极力克制自己，才没有当场把你掐死，人们不禁会想，她体内究竟还剩下多少自制力啊…… ] 一只琥珀色的眼睛，因长期哭泣而充血，现在呈现出深橙色，那目光凶狠地盯着你。[pc.ra kitsune |转眼间，所有应有的礼貌与对您身份的尊重都被抛到九霄云外了 ]。 [var1 |她总不能把宝宝扔下就去找你吧，所以她只能一边抽泣，一边用拳头捶打木地板来发泄情绪 |她的肌肉紧绷起来，尽管肚子圆滚滚的，她还是迅速站了起来，冲向你，用拳头无力地捶打你的胸膛，同时将她那隆起的腹部紧紧压在你身上 ]。 "就是你！都是你逼我这么做的——” 麻里连眼睛都没眨一下，就用她的拐杖狠狠地敲了敲自己曾曾孙女的头部。舞发出一声尖叫，然后安静了下来，不过她内心那些愤怒、痛苦、欲望以及其他复杂的情绪丝毫没有消退。“别装作自己对这一切毫无责任，丫头。我是什么时候第一次劝你戒掉那种毒品的？十多年前吧？你姐姐和我都知道发生了什么——你当时简直是不顾一切地想要[pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer]尊贵的人士 |[pc.name] ]在促成这种局面方面，他们也起到了同样的作用。 [pc.heShe]做到了。” 舞颤抖着，身上那件破烂的皮毛让她看起来十分可怜，然后她突然哭了起来； [var1 |要不是她正在忙于哺乳，你完全可以肯定那只小狐狸也会跟着它的母亲一起嚎哭起来。 |她天生的神经质以及过度兴奋的情绪，再再加上她体内激素水平的混乱，更是让这些状况雪上加霜。 ]麻里叹了口气，双手抱住脸，用她的母语低声说了些什么。虽然你听不懂那些话，但它们却完美地表达出了一种对人生中种种不公平现象的无奈与悲叹。

Has she any idea what Komari's on about? "No, Beloved. And in all our time as girls, she only behaved with such impropriety when she was truly, really upset. I am not sure what either of us could have done to aggrieve her this deeply, but I am interested in finding out." ] Well, fine. [pc.isDK |This had better be good |You'll go and see what has this old lady so hopping mad ]. Curious gazes follow you as you trail along behind the den matron through the tree and up to her office in the branches, pushing past the screen door and into her living quarters in the back. There, sitting cross-legged on a futon, is Mai. [var1 |Unsurprisingly, it's been a while since you've last met given the circumstances of your last encounter with her, but while she's still nowhere near her sister's oversexed proportions she's thicker all around: it's mostly in the hips and thighs, and her bust fills her top ever more snugly than before. But all this eyeing her body is just putting off the inevitable, what she's hugging close to her bared breasts: a hefty two-tailed fox kit, gray-furred ears folded against her head while she nurses eagerly from her mother's breast. Oh. Oh. "Well then,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Komari continues, her face falling in exasperation, "it would appear that you've made a daughter, and I now have great-great-great- grandchildren. Good thing you had it in you to stay away from Miyuki here until she finally gave birth, or else she'd have torn you to pieces." For the first time since you entered the room, Mai looks up and notices you. Her ears flatten, her lips trembles, she bares her teeth, and for a moment you think she might just toss the child aside and leap for your throat. Thankfully, she doesn't do that, but it's not without considerable restraint on her part. |It's been a while since you last met, a good long while... and she's thicker all around, especially in the hips and thighs. But all this eyeing her body is just putting off the inevitable, what your gaze is most assiduously avoiding: the fact that Mai's belly is swollen and rounded, its firm curve lifting her skirts to announce to the world the fact that she's with child. While it might just be proportional on Miko, it's much less so for Mai given just how far she otherwise looks to be along, bloating up rapidly on her figure. Oh. Oh. "Well then,[pc.ra kitsune | your Eminence, ]" Komari continues, her face falling in exasperation, "it would appear that you've made a daughter, and I now have great-great-great- grandchildren. Not that all the blame falls upon you for this turn of events — Miyuki here is just as, if not more culpable than you, especially given that she's supposed to be the more responsible of my dear great-great-grandaughters. So much for that." For the first time since you entered the room, Mai looks up and notices you. Her ears flatten, her lips trembles, she bares her teeth, and for a moment you think she might just leap for your throat, big tummy or no. She has to visibly struggle to not throttle you on the spot, and one only wonders how much restraint's left in that body of hers. ] One amber eye, bloodshot and now deep orange from what you imagine must be regular crying, focuses balefully on you[pc.ra kitsune |; in an instant, all propriety and consideration for your station is thrown to the wind ]. [var1 |She can't very well drop the baby to go for you, so she settles for hammering a fist against the wooden floor as she sniffles |Muscles tense and bunch up, and despite her rounded tummy she's quick to leap to her feet and against you, pounding your chest ineffectually with her fists while pressing her pregnant belly up against you ]. "You! You made me this —" Without so much as blinking, Komari raps her great-great-granddaughter hard on the side of the head with her walking stick. Mai yelps and settles down, although the seething mixture of rage, misery, lust and other volatile emotions inside of her doesn't recede in the least. "Don't act as if you had no agency in all of this, girl. When did I first urge you to wean yourself of that drug? More than a decade ago? Your sister and I know what happened — you flung yourself at [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence |[pc.name] ] and had as much of a hand in precipitating this situation as [pc.heShe] did." Mai trembles, looking absolutely miserable in her bedraggled fur, then turns on the waterworks; [var1 |if not for the fact that she's busy nursing, you're pretty sure the fox kit would have started wailing along with her mother |her normal neuroticism and overstimulation can't be helped in the least by the hormonal mess that her body must be ]. Komari sighs, puts her face in her hands, and mutters something in her native language that while you can't understand nevertheless manage to perfectly convey a resigned lamentation over the cosmic injustice of existence. "

rows.original: "Well, [pc.ra kitsune |your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |[pc.name] ]," Komari continues when she's done bemoaning her fate, "you've [pc.mf |father |sir ]ed a kit on my great-great-granddaughter, and a big one she is, too. And now the question is: what happens next?" Look, before either grandmother or granddaughter has another breakdown, you need to ask: just what's going on? All right, you understand that since Mai wasn't on winterstem that night, she wouldn't have been in the frame of mind to choose if and when seed takes root in her womb. But there's a long way between then and now... "This stupid girl here wasn't just in heat, she wasn't in any frame of mind to prevent your seed from taking root in her. It just so happened to be your misfortune that you were passing by, but at the same time..." Komari sighs and pulls herself together. "Mikoto's explained some of the history to you, hasn't she?" Yes. That being said, how did Mai end up missing a dose? Komari shrugs. "The dried herb was improperly blended. How that happened... she was bound to make a mistake again sooner or later, and not be so lucky about the consequences as she was the previous times. That doesn't make me any less upset at you, but it was a long time coming. The moment we realize she's with child, my dear great-great-granddaughter can no longer drug herself, and [var0 |even afterwards there's to be no more smoking around the child for fear of breathing it in, or it getting into her milk |even after the kit's out of her there'll be no going back on it ]. No more winterstem for Miyuki here. Forever. You can imagine how tiring the days have been since, but that's what she gets for ignoring her ancestor's wisdom." Look... long story short, did she call you all the way up to her office just to berate the both of you? "No, I'm here to announce that my hand has finally being forced. While I initially thought Miyuki would be the victor in this little competition between the girls and that it was all but assured, her single weakness comes along and throws everything into disarray. "Mikoto, you may be a fool, notoriously fickle, impulsive, childish, and one step away from cutting loose and going feral most times. However, as fate would have it, you'll be my heir. Should the August Master at the Center of Heaven grant me permission to cease existing this generation, you'll be filling my position." You cast a glance over at the still sniffling Mai and [var0 |the kit at her breast |her round, pregnant belly ]. So then, what happens to Mai here? "That's between me and her sister as a family matter. In the last handful of decades, it's become popular to handle such mishaps by dumping them on the colonies — onto me — but it's not like there's anywhere for me to send her off from here, or that I would do such a thing even if I could." You fold your arms. It feels awful to call this entire situation a mishap, even if that's what it is. "[pc.ra kitsune |Well, if you aren't getting into the spirit of our people and culture, your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Soon you'll have mastered the art of euphemisms and insult without explicitly giving insult. |Weren't you people all about being direct and honest instead of being two-faced connivers who hide their feelings like us? ]" That's enough, she's going too far with this. You can understand that she's upset with both you and Mai, but the atmosphere of depressed melancholia is getting absolutely choking. Perhaps — It's finally Miko, who's been comforting her sister all this while, who takes action. Gently but firmly planting her hands on Komari's shoulders, the orange-furred shrine maiden pulls her great-great-grandmother away from the scene, allowing the den matron an exit while still being able to save some semblance of face. Komari makes a show of digging her heels in, but relents and allows herself to be led away; Miko returns after a little while, clears her throat, then gives you a small bow before settling back in next to her sister.
rows.translation: 嗯， [pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]运输 |[pc.name] ]等她抱怨完自己的命运后，麻里继续说道：‘你们已经[pc.mf |父亲 |先生 ]我给我的曾孙女买了一套装备，她长得也挺高大的。现在的问题是：接下来会发生什么呢？” “听着，在两位祖母或孙女中的任何一位再次情绪崩溃之前，你首先需要弄清楚：到底发生了什么？好吧，你应该明白，因为那天晚上舞并没有服用冬茎药剂，所以她根本没有考虑过自己的子宫里是否、以及何时会有种子生根发芽。但从那时到现在，已经过去了很长时间…… 这个愚蠢的女孩根本不是处于发情期，她根本没有任何阻止你的种子在她体内扎根的意愿。只是你恰好路过，这才成了你的不幸……不过同时……”麻里叹了口气，然后整理了一下自己的思绪继续说道。美琴已经向你解释过一些相关历史了，对吧？” “是的。不过，舞是怎么会错过那次服药的呢？” 麻里耸了耸肩：“那些干燥的草药被混合得不对。如何发生那样的事……她迟早会再次犯错，而且这次她所面临的后果肯定不会像之前那么幸运。这并不会减少我对你的不满，但这一切其实都是早有预料的。当我们发现她怀孕了，我亲爱的曾曾孙女就再也不能通过吸毒来逃避现实了[var0 |即使之后，在孩子周围也不允许再吸烟，因为担心孩子会吸入烟雾，或者这些烟雾会进入她的乳汁中。 |即使这套装备已经离她而去，她也再也无法回到从前了。 ]对美雪来说，这里再也没有寒冷的冬天了。永远。你可以想象，从那以后，她的日子该有多么疲惫吧……但这就是她忽视祖先智慧所必须承受的后果。 总之，她把你们叫到她的办公室，就是为了斥责你们两个人吗？ 不，我来这里是为了宣布一个消息：我终于被迫做出了决定。起初，我认为美雪会在这场女孩们之间的竞争中获胜，而且这一结果几乎是必然的，但她的那个致命弱点却让一切计划都泡汤了。 美琴，你或许是个傻瓜，以善变、冲动、幼稚著称，大多数时候都快要失控、变得野性难驯了。然而，命运就是如此安排，你将成为我的继承人。如果天之中心的天之中央尊主允许我这一代人就此终结，你将会接替我的位置。你瞥了一眼仍在抽泣的舞， [var0 |怀在怀中的物品 |她那圆鼓鼓的孕妇肚子 ]那么，舞在这里会发生什么呢？ “这是我和她姐姐之间的家庭私事。在过去的几十年里，人们习惯于把这类麻烦事推给殖民地——也就是把它们转移到殖民地去处理。我但是，我在这里并没有地方可以送她离开，而且就算有这样的地方，我也不会这么做。” 你双臂交叉抱在胸前。将整个这种情况称为一场意外，虽然事实确实如此，但这种说法还是让人感觉很糟糕。[pc.ra kitsune |嗯，如果你不能融入我们民族的文化氛围，那么你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]很快你就会掌握这种运用委婉语来表达侮辱却不会直接说出口的技巧了。 |你们这些人不是一直都主张直率诚实，而不是像我们这样虚伪狡诈，总是隐藏自己的真实感受吗？ ]够了，她这样做已经太过分了。你可以理解她对你和舞都感到不满，但这种压抑、忧郁的气氛真的让人喘不过气来。或许…… 终于，是一直以来一直在安慰妹妹的米可采取了行动。她轻轻但坚定地把手放在麻里的肩上，这位橙色毛发的神社少女将她的曾曾祖母拉出了现场，让这位族长得以体面地离开，同时也维护了她的面子。麻里起初表现得十分固执，不肯让步，但最终还是放弃了抵抗，任由别人将自己带走；过了一会儿，米可回来了，她清了清嗓子，然后向你微微鞠了一躬，接着便坐回到了她姐姐的身边。
