rows.original: [rand |"Azami may not be a mountain ascetic like her ancestors were, but she's doubtlessly inherited many of the same habits. Because they make do with so little, as well as have such a heavy emphasis on being able to be as self-sufficient as they can, there's very little she and her posse ever requisition from the storehouse. Not that they're in most of the time to make such requests, anyway. So when the woman herself comes down to my place, I always know I'm in for something good, nojya." What kinds of things would a wild fox like her want from Kohaku, anyway? "Mainly bits and pieces to help with her petitioning and making offerings at the shrine[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]. If she's in the den, she goes every day without fail, regardless of how much Miko and Mai tease her. If the stories are true, then she's a lot more pious than her ancestors were. Which, depending on how one looks at it, could be good or bad, nojya. But mostly good!" |"Azami is getting a bit older, but she hasn't found a husband yet," Kohaku says, the little fox's ears twitching. "It's causing no end of gossip and teasing, especially from the usual suspects." The usual suspects would be Miko and Mai, or at least include them, you suppose. "I cannot confirm or contradict this assertion, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|nojya]." So that's a yes. "I said nothing[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]!" Of course she didn't. "They say she's a really cold person, nojya. Not in the unfeeling way Mai is, but in the way that would remind someone of a schoolteacher. And who would want to marry their schoolteacher? Not me[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]! Also, they say that she's so cold her womb doesn't work at all... now that one gives me chills just talking about it. I'm sure it's just nonsense gossip and all, nojya. Nothing to it whatsoever." |"You wouldn't imagine it, but Azami makes all kinds of soybean-based stuff as a hobby in her free time, nojya. Tofu, natto, miso, that kind of stuff... fermentation isn't hard, or at least she makes it look easy, and she's out all the time so she just has to check in on them when she actually returns to the den. If she weren't a wildling, I'm sure she could have made a living as a tofu seller; that's one of the small mercies a lot of people still miss about the Old Country. She can't make more than just enough for her and hers, though." Is there some kind of problem there? "Soybeans don't grow well in this soil, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|nojya]. Any beans or derived products we have are imported from across the ocean. Hitoshi's been working on it for a while, but he clearly hasn't solved the problem to his satisfaction, or else we'd be seeing them in the fields. That would certainly make Azami happy — and few things ever do." |"There are all kinds of elven ruins out there in the woods dating from the Godswar, nojya. You can't go a dozen steps in any direction without tripping over some statue or remnant of a wall. Sometimes, Azami finds artifacts hanging around in some of them and brings them back to the matron for safe containment and study. A new find is always bound to bring in some good gossip — not as much as an actual metal find, but always good for some entertainment. The matron would like to acknowledge her or something, but Azami always ducks out of such things. It's kind of standoffish and rude to one's superiors to do that sort of thing, but the matron has a lot of history with the Ishida line, plus she's a very understanding and magnanimous person, nojya." |"Kurako always likes to badmouth Azami behind her back because of that stiff and dry personality she has. Right or wrong, justified or not, it's pretty nasty and shameful to be talking about your superior behind her back, isn't it? I'm pretty sure that Azami knows, but she doesn't seem to care one bit. The job gets done at the end of the day, after all." But isn't that a good thing, people being able to work together despite their differences? "Keros' tails, no[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]! You can't just let your subordinates go around being contentious and insubordinate under your nose and pretend to ignore it — shame aside, it sets a terrible precedent and encourages such behavior in lesser warranted situations, nojya! I —" All right, all right. You're here to gossip, not to discuss the intricacies of kitsune social etiquette. Perhaps later. ]
rows.translation: [rand |虽然秋美并不像她的祖先们那样是那种隐居山林的苦行僧，但毫无疑问，她继承了许多他们那样的习惯。因为他们的生活条件极其简陋，而且非常重视自给自足的能力，所以她和她的伙伴们几乎从不从仓库里领取任何东西。当然，大多数时候他们也没机会提出这样的请求。因此，当这位女士亲自来到我这里的时候，我总是知道会有好事发生，诺贾。 像她这样的野狐狸，究竟会想要琥珀给她些什么呢？ 主要是些零碎的东西，用来帮助她进行请愿活动，以及在神社里献祭。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]如果她真的每天都会去那个地方，那么无论米可与舞怎样取笑她，她都会坚持下去。如果这些故事都是真的，那么她确实比她的祖先们要虔诚得多。当然，从不同的角度来看，这可能既有好处也有坏处，但总体来说，还是好处居多吧！ |阿兹米年纪有点大了，但至今还没有找到丈夫。小狐妖的耳朵微微一动，科哈aku说道。这引发了无休止的闲言碎语和嘲笑，尤其是那些爱搬弄是非的人。 你大概会认为，通常会被认为是嫌疑人的，应该是米可与舞，或者至少会把她们包括在嫌疑人名单里。 我无法证实或反驳这一说法。 [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|诺雅]。" 那么，答案是肯定的。 我什么都没说。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]！" 她当然没有。 他们说她是个非常冷漠的人，诺雅。不是像舞那种毫无感情的样子，而是那种会让人联想到学校老师的类型。谁会想和自己学校的老师结婚呢？我可不想。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]而且，他们还说她太冷了，以至于她的子宫完全无法正常工作……光是听到这种说法就让我不寒而栗。我敢肯定，这些只不过是无稽之谈罢了，根本没有任何事实依据。 |你可能想象不到，但阿扎米在空闲时间会把各种以大豆为原料的食物当作爱好来制作，诺贾。豆腐、纳豆、味噌之类的……发酵其实并不难，至少她做得看起来非常轻松。而且她整天都在外面活动，所以只有当她真正回到家里时，才会去检查那些发酵食品的制作进度。如果她不是个野人，我相信她完全可以靠卖豆腐为生；这也是很多人至今仍然怀念旧国时的那些小确幸之一。不过，她挣的钱仅仅够自己和家人维持生计而已。" 这里是不是出了什么问题？ 这种土壤不适合种植大豆，大豆在这种环境下很难生长得很好。 [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|诺雅]我们手头的所有豆类及其衍生产品都是从海外进口的。Hitoshi已经研究这个问题有一段时间了，但显然他还没有找到令自己满意的解决方案，否则这些作物早就应该在我们自己的田地里种植了。那样的话，阿兹米肯定也会很高兴的——毕竟，很少有事情能让她真正开心吧。 |在森林里，到处都能找到那些起源于神战时代的精灵遗迹，诺雅。无论你往哪个方向走十几步，都会遇到一些雕像或墙的残骸。有时候，阿扎米会在这些遗迹中找到一些文物，然后把它们带回给女院长，由她妥善保管并进行研究。任何新的发现总会引起一些闲言碎语——虽然不会像真正发现金属矿那样引人注目，但至少也能带来一些娱乐话题。女管家本来想表彰她什么，但阿兹米总是逃避这类事情。对上级做出这种行为，未免太傲慢无礼了。不过，那位女主管与石田家族有着深厚的渊源，再加上她本人也非常通情达理、宽宏大量，诺贾。 |因为阿扎米性格刻板、冷漠，仓子总是喜欢在背后说她的坏话。无论对错，无论这种行为是否合理，在背后议论上司，这种行为确实很恶劣、也很可耻，不是吗？我敢肯定阿扎米是知道的，但她似乎根本不在乎。毕竟，只要工作能够完成，那就没什么关系了。 但这难道不是一件好事吗？人们尽管存在差异，却依然能够共同合作。 凯罗斯的尾巴，不行。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]你不能任由下属在你面前肆意争吵、违抗命令，却装作视而不见——说真的，这种行为会树立一个非常糟糕的榜样，还会在那些本不值得这样做的情况下，鼓励人们继续这种行为，真的不行啊！我—— 好吧好吧，你来这里是用来闲聊的，又不是来讨论狐族社交礼仪的复杂规则的。也许改天再谈吧。 ]
rows.raw: " [rand |"Azami may not be a mountain ascetic like her ancestors were, but she's doubtlessly inherited many of the same habits. Because they make do with so little, as well as have such a heavy emphasis on being able to be as self-sufficient as they can, there's very little she and her posse ever requisition from the storehouse. Not that they're in most of the time to make such requests, anyway. So when the woman herself comes down to my place, I always know I'm in for something good, nojya." What kinds of things would a wild fox like her want from Kohaku, anyway? "Mainly bits and pieces to help with her petitioning and making offerings at the shrine[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]. If she's in the den, she goes every day without fail, regardless of how much Miko and Mai tease her. If the stories are true, then she's a lot more pious than her ancestors were. Which, depending on how one looks at it, could be good or bad, nojya. But mostly good!" |"Azami is getting a bit older, but she hasn't found a husband yet," Kohaku says, the little fox's ears twitching. "It's causing no end of gossip and teasing, especially from the usual suspects." The usual suspects would be Miko and Mai, or at least include them, you suppose. "I cannot confirm or contradict this assertion, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|nojya]." So that's a yes. "I said nothing[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]!" Of course she didn't. "They say she's a really cold person, nojya. Not in the unfeeling way Mai is, but in the way that would remind someone of a schoolteacher. And who would want to marry their schoolteacher? Not me[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]! Also, they say that she's so cold her womb doesn't work at all... now that one gives me chills just talking about it. I'm sure it's just nonsense gossip and all, nojya. Nothing to it whatsoever." |"You wouldn't imagine it, but Azami makes all kinds of soybean-based stuff as a hobby in her free time, nojya. Tofu, natto, miso, that kind of stuff... fermentation isn't hard, or at least she makes it look easy, and she's out all the time so she just has to check in on them when she actually returns to the den. If she weren't a wildling, I'm sure she could have made a living as a tofu seller; that's one of the small mercies a lot of people still miss about the Old Country. She can't make more than just enough for her and hers, though." Is there some kind of problem there? "Soybeans don't grow well in this soil, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|nojya]. Any beans or derived products we have are imported from across the ocean. Hitoshi's been working on it for a while, but he clearly hasn't solved the problem to his satisfaction, or else we'd be seeing them in the fields. That would certainly make Azami happy — and few things ever do." |"There are all kinds of elven ruins out there in the woods dating from the Godswar, nojya. You can't go a dozen steps in any direction without tripping over some statue or remnant of a wall. Sometimes, Azami finds artifacts hanging around in some of them and brings them back to the matron for safe containment and study. A new find is always bound to bring in some good gossip — not as much as an actual metal find, but always good for some entertainment. The matron would like to acknowledge her or something, but Azami always ducks out of such things. It's kind of standoffish and rude to one's superiors to do that sort of thing, but the matron has a lot of history with the Ishida line, plus she's a very understanding and magnanimous person, nojya." |"Kurako always likes to badmouth Azami behind her back because of that stiff and dry personality she has. Right or wrong, justified or not, it's pretty nasty and shameful to be talking about your superior behind her back, isn't it? I'm pretty sure that Azami knows, but she doesn't seem to care one bit. The job gets done at the end of the day, after all." But isn't that a good thing, people being able to work together despite their differences? "Keros' tails, no[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]! You can't just let your subordinates go around being contentious and insubordinate under your nose and pretend to ignore it — shame aside, it sets a terrible precedent and encourages such behavior in lesser warranted situations, nojya! I —" All right, all right. You're here to gossip, not to discuss the intricacies of kitsune social etiquette. Perhaps later. ] "

rows.original: [rand |"Kazuo is a very nice man to let me test out his inventions in a controlled yet practical setting. I was a little hesitant to use his new puppet here to help with the heavy lifting, but so long as the goods aren't too fragile there's been nothing to worry about, nojya. I won't say there haven't been mishaps, but no two ones are the same and no one's been hurt so far, nojya. He says that automation is going to be the future, and that the Belharan wizards of old used golems to help out in their daily tasks. Of course, given what happened to them in the end, I'm not entirely convinced that's a good idea[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]. But... the puppet is very helpful, especially for someone as small as I am..." |"You know, the artificer supposedly lost his arm in a civil engineering accident," Kohaku says, leaning across her desk in a conspiratorial whisper. "Terrible thing with a collapsing building and a falling beam. Crushed his arm beyond repair and it had to be amputated. They said it was fitting that he was the only one hurt by the collapse, since it was a building he had designed." The key word here is %"supposedly." What does she think really happened? "We-ll... they say that he set the whole thing up so that he could have an excuse to test out his new invention on himself, nojya. That prosthetic arm he has is a fine work of shaping... practically like a real thing with fine enough control for his liking. But finding a genuine amputee on demand is quite troublesome and awkward, especially in polite society... "It's not surprising that not long after, the civil service posted him to the colonies, nojya. I think he's happier here than back in the Old Country[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]] — the matron is a much better superior than he used to have, in his own words." |"Most people find Kazuo kind of creepy and give the artificer a wide berth, but to be quite honest I don't mind him that much. Maybe it's because we're both quite short for who we are, and I don't have to crane my neck that much upwards as opposed to when I'm speaking with other men or even the taller women in the den, nojya. He's always very nice to me when he's here to pick up his things, mostly wood and metal, but it's always in this distracted way like his head is somewhere else and his body is just a puppet being piloted by him from far away, you know? I always make sure to give him something nourishing to eat before he leaves for his workshop again. It's important to watch out for everyone else living in the same den as you[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]." |"Kazuo is really big on tea, and I mean really big, nojya. Outside of the matron's family, he may be the only one who's got the entire tea ceremony memorised in perfect detail. But it's more than that — the only luxury he wants me to get for him from across the ocean are different blends and varieties of tea[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]. He says it's the only thing he really misses about the Old Country, that no one but Mai can fashion a proper brew over here in the colonies. "It's a little sad, nojya. I know he mightn't have been the best-regarded in polite society, but when the biggest thing you miss about your old home is not your family or neighbors but the tea, something was really wrong with either you or your life. In Kazuo's case, maybe both. I try to make us and our den a people and place worth caring about, you know? I hope he thinks better of the colonies than when he first arrived a handful of years ago, at any rate." |"The artificer is always interested in raw materials of all kinds; part of the reason he's so excited to be in the colonies is because of all the new things he can investigate and experiment with that aren't available on the other side of the ocean. He's officially here as a materials engineer to boot, so I suppose it gives those who are keeping track of him an excuse to say he's doing his assigned job, nojya. Even something as simple as the fact that the Belharans tended to fashion their automatons from stone and metal instead of wood or fired clay kept him awake all night the first time he learned of the idea and something of how things might be done. He'd never have the chance to exercise such creativity back in the Old Country, nojya." ]
rows.translation: [rand |一夫真是个非常好的人，他允许我在一个既受控制又实用的环境中测试他的发明。起初我还有些犹豫是否应该在这里使用他的新机械傀儡来帮忙搬运那些沉重的货物，但只要货物不是太脆弱，那就没什么好担心的，诺贾。我不敢说没有发生过意外，但每次的情况都不尽相同，而且到目前为止，还没有人受到伤害，诺雅。他说，自动化才是未来的发展方向，而古代的贝尔哈兰巫师们也曾利用魔像来协助他们完成日常任务。当然，考虑到他们最终遭遇的那些事情，我并不完全认为那是个好主意。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]但是……那个木偶是非常有帮助，尤其是对于像我这样身材矮小的人来说…… |你知道，据说那位工匠是在一场土木工程事故中失去了手臂的。小白凑近桌子，压低声音说道：“是这样的那栋建筑物倒塌，一根横梁掉落，真是太可怕了。他的手臂被压得严重受损，已经无法修复，最终不得不截肢。他们说，只有他在这次事故中受伤，实在是命运的安排——因为那栋建筑本来就是他设计的。 这里的关键词是“据说”。她到底在想什么呢？真的发生了什么事？ 我们……有人说是他故意策划了这一切，这样他就能有借口在自己身上测试他的新发明了，诺雅。他那条假肢制作得非常精良……几乎和真肢一样，而且控制起来也非常方便，完全符合他的要求。但是要随时找到一个真正的截肢者来进行测试，确实是一件相当麻烦且尴尬的事情，尤其是在讲究礼仪的社会中…… 难怪不久之后，公务员系统就把他派到了殖民地去，诺雅。我觉得他在这里比在旧国要开心得多。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]用他自己的话来说，这位女主管比他以前遇到的任何上司都要优秀得多。 |大多数人觉得和和雄在一起会让人感到有点毛骨悚然，因此都会尽量避免与他来往，但说实话，我并没有觉得他有什么不好的。也许是因为我们俩的身高都相对较矮，所以与我和其他男性交谈，甚至是与窝里那些个子更高的女性交谈时相比，我都不需要过分地仰起脖子。每次他来取他的东西时，对我总是非常友善——那些东西大多是木头和金属制成的。不过他的神情总显得心不在焉，就好像他的思绪在别的地方，而他的身体只是被远处的某个力量操控着的木偶罢了，你懂我的意思吧？在我让他再次去工作室之前，我总会确保他吃些有营养的食物。照顾好与自己同住一个地方的每一个人，这一点非常重要。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]。" |一夫真的很喜欢喝茶，我是说真的大野，真的。在女主人家族之外，他可能是唯一一个将整个茶道流程牢记在心的人。但不仅如此——他唯一希望我从大洋彼岸为他带来的礼物，就是各种不同种类和配方的茶叶。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]他说，这是他真正怀念旧国的唯一原因——在殖民地这里，除了舞之外，没有人能够酿造出真正地道的饮品。 有点遗憾吧，诺雅。我知道他在上流社会中可能并不受重视，但当你离开旧国后，最怀念的并不是家人或邻居，而是那里的茶……那么，要么是你本身出了问题，要么就是你的生活出了问题。在和雄的情况下，或许两者都是如此。我一直在努力让我们的小窝成为一个值得人们关心的地方，你知道吗？无论如何，我希望他现在对那些殖民地的看法，能比几年前他刚来到这里时有所改变。 |这位工匠对各种原材料总是充满兴趣；他之所以对前往殖民地感到如此兴奋，部分原因就在于那里有那么多他可以在那里进行研究与实验的新材料，而这些材料在海洋的另一边是根本无法获得的。他正式以材料工程师的身份来到这里，所以我想，对于那些一直在关注他的人来说，这正好是一个借口，可以声称他正在履行自己的职责，对吧？就连像贝拉尔人倾向于用石头和金属而不是木材或烧制的黏土来制造自动机这样的简单事实，也在他第一次了解到这个概念以及相关制造方法时，让他整晚都无法入睡。在旧国，他永远没有机会发挥这样的创造力，诺雅。 ]

rows.original: [var0 |[rand |"Oh, her?" Rubbing her hands together mischievously, Kohaku leans on the counter and grins up at you. "Want to hear a bit of juicy gossip, nojya?" Well, you did ask about Rindo. So long as it's nothing too bad. "I don't know about bad, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], ]but it certainly is scandalous. While I was on the other side of the gate securing imports for the den, I did some snooping around into her family; while it's true that her clan does have a distant connection to one of the twelve, the far more likely reason for her white fur and brands of divinity is that she's a by-blow of the local branch family situated where she used to live, nojya. The very one that she was going to marry into." No way. "I've no concrete proof, nojya. But the circumstantial evidence and the hearsay about the entirety of that province, even a few years old... I'm convinced myself. And it's a good thing there's no concrete proof of her being a noble bastard, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]otherwise I'd wager she'd have been 'cleaned up' far more thoroughly than that." |"Every time Rindo comes in to collect her allotment from the storehouse, I always try to give her some taiyaki of my own to take home, nojya. The poor thing may smile a lot, but she's always under such immense strain to keep her face cheery. The least I can do for her is a bit of comfort food. "Besides, she's so thin and slender — a bit of meat on her bones wouldn't hurt, nojya. If she had Miko's or even Mai's curves, maybe that could help offset her scars and eye a little. I know the poor thing's very conscious about her appearance, even if she puts up a strong front about it, so please be kind to her[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]!" |"It's not a big secret that Rindo and I have been working for the last couple years on something particularly special, nojya — we're trying to figure out something local to this part of the world that's truly unique and that we can leverage as an export. Metal is all well and good, but it isn't really unique, if you get my drift[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]. She's been sorting through the native plants for the last couple of years, find something that's truly unique and useful in some way. "I've been helping her as much as I can, bring back examples of what're sold in the native markets, but while there've been several interesting finds she hasn't found anything truly fur-raising yet. "Well, if you insisted, she wouldn't be able to, nojya. But that's another whole kettle of fish, to use a local saying. "That I can do, nojya. [pc.ra kitsune |That, added to the prestige of being the concubine of someone as important as you, your Eminence... well, no one's actually sure of exactly where you stand, but they all know that it's got to be way high up there, nojya. "It is what it is, nojya. rows.translation: [var0 |[rand |哦，她啊？”小花调皮地搓了搓手，靠在柜台上，冲你咧嘴一笑：“想听些有趣的八卦吗，诺贾？” 嗯，你确实问一下林多的情况吧。只要不是什么太严重的问题就行。 “我不太清楚糟糕， [pc.ra kitsune |我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]， ]但这确实是一件令人震惊的事情。当时我正在负责为兽穴采购进口物资，因此有机会调查了一下她的家族背景；虽然她的家族确实与十二大氏族中的某个氏族有着远亲关系，但更有可能的原因是，她那白色的毛皮以及那些象征神圣的印记，其实是她之前居住的地方——诺雅——那个地方的分支家族所留下的痕迹。就是她原本打算嫁入的那个家族。” “不可能。” “我没有确凿的证据，诺雅。但那些间接证据，以及关于那个地区发生的种种传闻，哪怕是几年前的事了，也足以说明问题。…我已经说服了自己。幸好没有确凿的证据证明她是个出身贵族的私生女。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]否则，我敢打赌，她会被处理得比现在更加彻底。 |每次林多来仓库领取她的那份食物时，我总会试着给她一些自己做的鲷鱼烧带回家，真的。那个可怜的孩子虽然总是面带微笑，但实际上她承受着巨大的压力，才不得不保持快乐的表情。对我来说，能为她做点什么让她感到安慰，就是我最起码能做的了。 Kohaku squeaks and contrives to look bashful, her cheeks reddening as she claps to her hands to them. "O-oh! I'm... well, maybe you're right[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. It can be a little embarrassing, nojya." ] ] "

rows.original: "My job here is to manage the den's storehouse! It's a position that implies the great trust that everyone has in me, and I don't intend to let anyone down, nojya!" It must be quite the endeavor, yes. You'd love to hear her talk about her job... Color rises to Kohaku's face, and she puts her index fingers together, ears folding forward. "It's kinda embarrassing, but if [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady] insists|you insist]... " Nah, you know that she just likes to talk, and doubly so if the topic's herself. Now's the time to cut free, as it were. Perhaps a little push in the direction of a topic will set this adorable blabbermouth off...
rows.translation: “我在这里的工作就是管理巢穴的仓库！这个职位体现了大家对我的极大信任，我绝对不会让任何人失望的，诺雅！” 这肯定是一项相当艰巨的任务，没错。你肯定很想听她讲述她的工作经历…… 琥珀的脸上顿时泛起了红晕，她把食指并拢在一起，耳朵也微微向前倾。“有点尴尬，不过[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]坚持要求|你坚持要这样]…… ” 不，你知道她就是喜欢聊天，尤其是当话题与她本人有关的时候。现在，可以说正是该抽身离开的时候了。或许稍微往某个话题上引一引，就能让这个可爱的小话痨打开话匣子……

rows.original: "That's right. The first amongst my duties is to ensure proper storage, nojya. That means making sure everything is neat and orderly, and ensuring that items are put away under conditions that lend themselves to preserving them. Usually, that means making sure that everything avoids exposure to heat, light and moisture, nojya. Whenever any perishables get old enough that they're in danger of starting to spoil, I have to earmark them for use before they actually do go bad. If something has been sitting here long enough that it's actually spoiled, then that means there's been a failure on my part, nojya." That makes sense. "The other part of my job is to audit the storehouse's inventory, make sure everything that's actually physically present matches up with what's on the books, and track down any discrepancies, nojya. People come in here to drop off their finished goods and pick up what they need; I oversee the bookkeeping involved in all of this, make sure what goes in and comes out matches with what remains." Hmm. She said %"drop off" and %"pick up." There's no money involved, unlike when you deal with her? "Eeeeh? No, not at all." Stepping over to her desk, Kohaku pulls a register from a nearby shelf. "This is a record of... oh look, it's Nakano's account, or at least, that of his household, of which there's only him. Over this week, he's requisitioned this much rice, and this many pickles... ink, grindstones, and he still drinks more far more sake than he ought to, nojya. Some of us still keep money for when we make trips back to the Old Country — I know Nakano and the matron do have sums, they make no secret of such — but by and large we've no use for the currency that the Marches use, nojya. There might be some intrinsic value in the gold and silver content of the coins, but otherwise they might as well be old leaves." She takes money, though. "That's because I do the trading, nojya. Not just with other dens and the Old Country, but also with the natives of the Marches. If a kitsune somehow comes across local currency, it inevitably ends up here." Shrugging, Kohaku shuts the register with a thump and places it back on the shelf. "We don't number very many in this den, and people know one another very well. It works quite differently from what the natives of this realm are used to, but it works — we're all effectively one big family here, sometimes literally so, nojya. Besides, if someone's asking for too much or giving too little... my records soon make that painfully obvious. Skiving's not a good idea unless you want the matron down on you like something very large and heavy, nojya." You see. "I don't think it could work with [pc.ra kitsune|the natives|you lot], nojya; your mindsets are simply too different. There's a lot of trust involved. Our nature does require foxes to stick together, that's probably helped." Right. Back to the point — what are Kohaku's other storehouse duties? "Well, I have to oversee the team and make sure their needs are met. Receive and sign off on goods from other dens. Make sure the puppet Kazuo made for us to do heavy lifting with is in good order, and bring it to him to be fixed if there's a problem I can't figure out alone. It's nice to have people whom you can depend on to help, isn't it, nojya?" Indeed. "That's about the long and short of it, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]; it'd be pretty tedious to go into all the details. Is there anything else you'd like to know?"
rows.translation: 没错。我的首要职责就是确保物品得到妥善保管，nojya。这意味着要让所有东西都摆放得整齐有序，并确保它们被存放在有利于保存的环境中。通常来说，这就意味着要防止这些物品受到热、轻型和湿气的影响，nojya。每当有易腐物品变质的风险时，我就必须提前将它们安排好用途，以免它们真的开始腐坏。确实变质了。如果有些东西在这里放了太久，以至于真的变质了，那么这意味着是我的疏忽导致了这个结果，诺雅。 有道理。 我工作的另一部分就是审核仓库的库存，确保实际存在的货物与账本上的记录一致，并找出任何差异，诺亚。人们会把完成的产品送到这里，然后来取他们需要的货物；而我负责监督所有这些与记账相关的工作，确保进出仓库的货物数量与剩余库存相符。 嗯，她提到了“交接”和“接取”这些词。这次并没有金钱交易，和你之前和她打交道的时候不一样吧？ 呃？不，完全不是这样。走到她的办公桌前，琥珀从附近的架子上拿下一个收银机。这是一份记录……哦，看，这是中野的账户，或者至少是他家的账户，因为这个账户里只有他一个人。这一周里，他领取了这么多大米，还有这么多腌菜……墨水、磨石，而且他喝的清酒也远远超出了应有的量，真是不行啊。我们当中有些人仍然会留一些钱，以备将来回到旧国时使用——我知道中野和那位女主管确实存着一些钱，她们从不隐瞒这一点——但总体来说，我们对那些边境地区使用的货币“nojya”并没有什么用处。这些硬币中的金银成分或许具有一定的内在价值，但除此之外，它们其实就跟旧树叶没什么两样。 不过，她还是收钱的。 那是因为这些交易都是我负责的，诺贾。不仅与其他帮派以及旧国进行交易，还包括与边境地区的原住民进行交易。如果狐妖们偶然得到了当地的货币，这些货币最终都会来到这里。耸了耸肩，小花“砰”的一声关上了收银机，然后把它放回了架子上。在这个聚居地里，我们的数量并不多，而且大家彼此都非常熟悉。这种相处方式与这个领域的原住民们的习惯截然不同，但确实有效——在这里，我们实际上就是一个大家庭，有时候甚至真的是一家人，诺雅。另外，如果有人要求过高或付出得太少……我的记录很快就会让这一切变得一清二楚。逃避责任可不是个好主意，除非你真的想让女家长像一块重型的大石头一样压在你身上，诺雅。 你瞧。 我认为它不太可能适用于[pc.ra kitsune|当地居民|你们这些人]诺雅，你们的思维方式实在太过不同了。信任在其中扮演了非常重要的角色。我们的天性确实要求狐妖们团结在一起，这种团结或许正是我们能够生存下去的原因吧。 好的，回到正题——琥珀还有哪些其他的职责呢？ 嗯，我必须负责监督这个团队，确保他们的需求得到满足。还要接收并确认其他分部的货物。另外，要确保那个专门为我们制作用来承担重活的木偶‘一夫’状况良好，如果出现我无法解决的问题，就要把它拿去修理。有可以依靠的人帮忙，确实是一件很棒的事情，不是吗，野谷？ 确实如此。 大致情况就是这样的。 [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]; 如果详细说明所有这些细节的话，会相当繁琐。还有其他你想了解的事情吗？

rows.original: [kohaku.anyKids |Now that Komari's granted her permission to go on caravan once more, you take it that Kohaku is doing just that? "For now, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |nojya ]." For now? "Mostly just to show others the ropes. Once that's done, I think I'll be settling down a bit and taking care of business at home... the situation's changing with so many new opportunities, and I need to oversee them, nojya. Having a daughter was what I needed to force me and change my habits ahead of time, so it's all worked out. "Maybe I'll go out again when our daughter's of age to be shown how to talk to people and make a trade[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Wouldn't that be nice?" But for now, she doesn't want to be separated. Kohaku's only reply is to bow her head and give you a weak smile, which is answer enough. Well, she could bring the baby along with her if she get separation anxiety, couldn't she? "Oh no, it'd be even worse, nojya. I'd be constantly worried about losing our daughter in one of those places, enough that I wouldn't be able to do my job. It hurts to leave her with Hotaru until evening, but at least I know that she'll be waiting for me when I get home in the evenings." No staying out overnight any more, huh? She shakes her head. "We never needed to[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Since we can be at most of our destinations in the blink of an eye thanks to the Ways, it's never been a serious issue. There was the option of staying out overnight if the situation called for it that isn't with us when I'm leading the caravan, but it's never actually come up, nojya. I think my heart would break if I had to do that." Good, good. It's nice to hear that things are working out decently, at least. "Nothing lasts forever, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |as they say ]," Kohaku replies with a small smile. "At least like this, I get to hand things over on my own terms instead of being forced one way or the other." And do people still want to poke and pet her? "More than before, but not as much as when I was just absolutely round, nojya." Kohaku reaches down and pinches a thigh[kohaku.wellFed |, letting some of the dense fullness press between thumb and forefinger ]. "[pc.ra kitsune |You know, your Eminence, t |T ]he den matron says that children leave a bit of themselves in their mothers for the rest of time... well, our daughter left [kohaku.wellFed |behind enough to make a whole other her, maybe two |a whole chunk of her behind ]. At least my disguise is holding up pretty well!" You can only imagine how much it must hurt her to be parted from her daughter in service to the den; it's a good thing that she's actively working towards being able to pass on the torch to someone more unattached. |[kohaku.pregStage 1 |"Not while I'm with child, nojya." Kohaku gives you a bright, if slightly sad smile. "The den matron has forbidden me to go out on caravan in my condition, so I mostly help with the prep work and accounting before and after the fact in addition to all the other things I did before. Take some of the mental burden off the people going so that they can save their energy for the actual trip[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. "There's still a lot to be done — after all, actually going out and finding goods and buyers is just the final step in a long chain of events! Every two weeks I conduct a full audit of what's in stock, and report my findings to the matron. We determine what exactly the den's requirements are, set a healthy buffer just in case something happens, and everything else left over is open to being traded, nojya. That's where the goods for bulk trade come from — day-to-day fluctuations in the storehouse are handled at my discretion. It shows the great trust the matron has in me, nojya! Then after everything comes back, I have to sort it all out and take inventory while everyone else gets a much-deserved rest!" Kohaku's beaming so brilliantly that you swear she's practically gleaming. Now here's someone who takes pride in her work... or a quiet desperation. With her being as pregnant as she is, it could really be both. That being said, given that her waystone pendant is how she gets from place to place quickly, she has to pass it on to whoever's leading the caravan in her stead, right? Those words instantly break Kohaku's cheerful demeanor and she shudders, [kohaku.pregStage 3 |clutching her ample tummy as if she were about to go into early labor |shrinking back defensively ]. It takes her but a couple seconds to recover and put her smile back on, but the illusion is firmly shattered. "Y-yes[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence. Begging your pardon for my directness, but may I ask why |. What's it to you ]?" You just shake your head, but note that the mere thought of her having to part with the waystone pendant, even fi temporarily, causes such a reaction in her. Being able to nip around via the Ways is extremely convenient and to lose that would be awful, to be sure, but for her to act as if she were physically struck... huh, one can only imagine what goes through Kohaku's mind every time she has to hand it over to the caravan leader. "Despite this change in affairs, there's been absolutely no disruption in the timing of caravans — I'm really proud of all my subordinates for keeping to the old schedule, nojya! The hauls might be a little less rich because someone else's doing the talking, but everyone's doing just fine[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]!" Mm-hm. And Komari's forbidden her from going herself because she has to waddle all over the place? "We-ll, not really, nojya." Oh? "Ever since I conceived, people want to poke and pet me — more than usual, nojya. Not just in the den, but when I go out with Miko and Mai to seek benefactors. They say it's because I've gotten cuter and more glamorous while carrying your daughter, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]and I don't disagree." Neither do you. Before you know it, you're already reaching [pc.heightRange 60 |down |out ] to pat Kohaku on the head, but the sudden force of her leaning her entire weight on you as she hands onto your forearm gives you pause. "See[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]? See? It wouldn't be that much of a problem if it were just that, but a tactile illusion is much, much harder to pull off than a visual one, nojya! If all those foreigners were to be constantly petting and stroking me, it'd only be a matter of time before I were to slip up and reveal a tail, or worse! Even if we were to abandon the goods, I can't run very fast like this!" Ah, you see. There is a downside to being extremely cute, after all. |"That's correct. Every two weeks I conduct a full audit of what's in stock, and report my findings to the matron. We determine what exactly the den's requirements are, set a healthy buffer just in case something happens, and everything else left over is open to being traded, nojya. That's where the goods for bulk trade come from — day-to-day fluctuations in the storehouse are handled at my discretion. It shows the great trust the matron has in me, nojya!" Kohaku's beaming so brilliantly that you swear she's practically gleaming. Now here's someone who takes pride in her work... who does she trade with, and what for? "Well, while we try our best to be self-sufficient, there're things we can't make ourselves for one reason or the other, nojya. Metal goods. Salt. Wheat flour... we don't have the land for that, not after rice. Then there're nice-to-have luxuries... "Sometimes we trade with other kitsune dens, other times we'll go through the torii gate and conduct business in the Old Country itself. What I like best, though, is to go to the cities of other peoples and do business there. The Winter City... Tychris... I've been to those places, and more. I like talking to all kinds of people, and outsiders like them have the most interesting conversations, nojya!" Hmm... "Then there're people like the leothrans and marefolk who don't really mind us as we are, nojya. I don't have to disguise myself when doing business with them — they know that we're not going to bite their necks and suck out their souls, nojya. Well... maybe just a little bit of their bodily energy, and benefactors are always well-repaid for their efforts as per divine law. They don't mind that, either." [party.has etheryn |Ryn rubs her temples. "I still can't believe it. Someone would have noticed fox-people hawking wares in the market. Someone would have put two and two together sooner or later. If you can get in and out of the Winter City without anyone noticing, and for months if not years on end to boot, something's seriously wrong — not that Alissa made the situation any better. The implications for our security are staggering." You can see how soul-sucking vampires freely mixing amongst the elves with no one being the wiser might cause some concern, yes. |It's a minor miracle someone hasn't already recognized her for what she is and run her out of town, or worse. Like it or not, soul-sucking vampires aren't really welcome in a lot of places regardless of how cute and fluffy they are; it's kind of a big deal why they aren't allowed in civilization, isn't it? ] "Oh, that's no problem. If [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |you ] would give me a moment, nojya?" Before you can reply, Kohaku's already turned around, the little kitsune rubbing at her face as if smearing something on her cheeks. When she turns back towards you, it's your face that's framed within those golden locks, beaming happily. "See? See?" And that's a perfect mimicry of your voice, too... [party.has einin |Einin whistles, but the little mouse-girl's eyes tell a very different story, wide with repressed fear instead of the awe she's trying to disguise it as. "W-well... even I wouldn't be able to tell the difference, [pc.name]. Life would have been so much easier for me if I could do that." ] "[pc.ra kitsune |I apologize for borrowing your face, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], but I thought it would be the most apt demonstration |I'm pretty good at this, nojya ]," Kohaku says in your voice. "Speech patterns take a little time, but they're not hard to copy given a half-day to listen to whoever's speaking. I prefer a catfolk's guise, since they're quite like us kitsune in many aspects, but even a rather short wyld elf will do in a pinch. I'm flexible, nojya!" With that said, Kohaku raises her hands to her face again, and in a blur of motion, she's her old self once more. The little golden-furred kitsune beams brightly at you as if nothing had ever happened, four tails wagging and swishing with eager excitement. Well, that explains a lot, really. There's just one more question on the topic... "Yes?" She goes out on trading trips, right? Yet whenever you visit, she's always here in the storehouse... Kohaku waves off the question. "Oh, those don't take more than a day or so, nojya. Matron Komari's torii gate makes the trip much shorter. We load up the wagon, get two bodyguards, then head off to wherever it is we're going. When it's time to return home, we just head to the nearest warpstone and pop on back. Teleportation is amazingly convenient; eliminating travel time gives me a serious edge over other merchants, and I can set off in the morning and expect to be back in the storehouse by evening. It's pretty great, nojya. Traveling somewhere as far away as Tychris doesn't take any longer than saying hello to the leothrans." Gods. Your own experience tells you warpstones are scattered all over the Marches and indeed, much of what used to be ancient Belhar. Kohaku does have an obscene advantage over other merchants who have to travel long distances to get to markets. Time, risk, mishaps... one supposes it balances out the danger that she'd be in if any city discovered there were disguised life-draining, soul-sucking vulpine monsters within its walls. "I like going out of the den to trade, nojya... one gets to see the world and its peoples in more aspects than just as benefactors. They all have little mundane concerns... the small talk people will make with merchants is something. Then there's the haggling... if only people could be less afraid of us kitsune. I'd love to be able to walk the streets freely like I do in the Old Country, I always feel so at home there, with people like me out and about, you know? "But that's enough of that. rows.raw: " [kohaku.anyKids |Now that Komari's granted her permission to go on caravan once more, you take it that Kohaku is doing just that? "For now, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |nojya ]." For now? "Mostly just to show others the ropes. Once that's done, I think I'll be settling down a bit and taking care of business at home... the situation's changing with so many new opportunities, and I need to oversee them, nojya. Having a daughter was what I needed to force me and change my habits ahead of time, so it's all worked out. "Maybe I'll go out again when our daughter's of age to be shown how to talk to people and make a trade[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Wouldn't that be nice?" But for now, she doesn't want to be separated. Kohaku's only reply is to bow her head and give you a weak smile, which is answer enough. Well, she could bring the baby along with her if she get separation anxiety, couldn't she? "Oh no, it'd be even worse, nojya. I'd be constantly worried about losing our daughter in one of those places, enough that I wouldn't be able to do my job. It hurts to leave her with Hotaru until evening, but at least I know that she'll be waiting for me when I get home in the evenings." No staying out overnight any more, huh? She shakes her head. "We never needed to[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. Since we can be at most of our destinations in the blink of an eye thanks to the Ways, it's never been a serious issue. There was the option of staying out overnight if the situation called for it that isn't with us when I'm leading the caravan, but it's never actually come up, nojya. I think my heart would break if I had to do that." Good, good. It's nice to hear that things are working out decently, at least. "Nothing lasts forever, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |as they say ]," Kohaku replies with a small smile. "At least like this, I get to hand things over on my own terms instead of being forced one way or the other." And do people still want to poke and pet her? "More than before, but not as much as when I was just absolutely round, nojya." Kohaku reaches down and pinches a thigh[kohaku.wellFed |, letting some of the dense fullness press between thumb and forefinger ]. "[pc.ra kitsune |You know, your Eminence, t |T ]he den matron says that children leave a bit of themselves in their mothers for the rest of time... well, our daughter left [kohaku.wellFed |behind enough to make a whole other her, maybe two |a whole chunk of her behind ]. At least my disguise is holding up pretty well!" You can only imagine how much it must hurt her to be parted from her daughter in service to the den; it's a good thing that she's actively working towards being able to pass on the torch to someone more unattached. |[kohaku.pregStage 1 |"Not while I'm with child, nojya." Kohaku gives you a bright, if slightly sad smile. "The den matron has forbidden me to go out on caravan in my condition, so I mostly help with the prep work and accounting before and after the fact in addition to all the other things I did before. Take some of the mental burden off the people going so that they can save their energy for the actual trip[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. "There's still a lot to be done — after all, actually going out and finding goods and buyers is just the final step in a long chain of events! Every two weeks I conduct a full audit of what's in stock, and report my findings to the matron. We determine what exactly the den's requirements are, set a healthy buffer just in case something happens, and everything else left over is open to being traded, nojya. That's where the goods for bulk trade come from — day-to-day fluctuations in the storehouse are handled at my discretion. It shows the great trust the matron has in me, nojya! Then after everything comes back, I have to sort it all out and take inventory while everyone else gets a much-deserved rest!" Kohaku's beaming so brilliantly that you swear she's practically gleaming. Now here's someone who takes pride in her work... or a quiet desperation. With her being as pregnant as she is, it could really be both. That being said, given that her waystone pendant is how she gets from place to place quickly, she has to pass it on to whoever's leading the caravan in her stead, right? Those words instantly break Kohaku's cheerful demeanor and she shudders, [kohaku.pregStage 3 |clutching her ample tummy as if she were about to go into early labor |shrinking back defensively ]. It takes her but a couple seconds to recover and put her smile back on, but the illusion is firmly shattered. "Y-yes[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence. Begging your pardon for my directness, but may I ask why |. What's it to you ]?" You just shake your head, but note that the mere thought of her having to part with the waystone pendant, even fi temporarily, causes such a reaction in her. Being able to nip around via the Ways is extremely convenient and to lose that would be awful, to be sure, but for her to act as if she were physically struck... huh, one can only imagine what goes through Kohaku's mind every time she has to hand it over to the caravan leader. "Despite this change in affairs, there's been absolutely no disruption in the timing of caravans — I'm really proud of all my subordinates for keeping to the old schedule, nojya! And Komari's forbidden her from going herself because she has to waddle all over the place? "We-ll, not really, nojya." Oh? They say it's because I've gotten cuter and more glamorous while carrying your daughter, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]and I don't disagree." Neither do you. "See[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]? See? It wouldn't be that much of a problem if it were just that, but a tactile illusion is much, much harder to pull off than a visual one, nojya! If all those foreigners were to be constantly petting and stroking me, it'd only be a matter of time before I were to slip up and reveal a tail, or worse! Even if we were to abandon the goods, I can't run very fast like this!" Ah, you see. There is a downside to being extremely cute, after all. |"That's correct. Kohaku's beaming so brilliantly that you swear she's practically gleaming. Now here's someone who takes pride in her work... who does she trade with, and what for? If you can get in and out of the Winter City without anyone noticing, and for months if not years on end to boot, something's seriously wrong — not that Alissa made the situation any better. The implications for our security are staggering." You can see how soul-sucking vampires freely mixing amongst the elves with no one being the wiser might cause some concern, yes. |It's a minor miracle someone hasn't already recognized her for what she is and run her out of town, or worse. Like it or not, soul-sucking vampires aren't really welcome in a lot of places regardless of how cute and fluffy they are; it's kind of a big deal why they aren't allowed in civilization, isn't it? ] "Oh, that's no problem. If [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ] |you ] would give me a moment, nojya?" Before you can reply, Kohaku's already turned around, the little kitsune rubbing at her face as if smearing something on her cheeks. When she turns back towards you, it's your face that's framed within those golden locks, beaming happily. "See? See?" And that's a perfect mimicry of your voice, too... [party.has einin |Einin whistles, but the little mouse-girl's eyes tell a very different story, wide with repressed fear instead of the awe she's trying to disguise it as. "W-well... even I wouldn't be able to tell the difference, [pc.name]. Life would have been so much easier for me if I could do that." ] "[pc.ra kitsune |I apologize for borrowing your face, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ], but I thought it would be the most apt demonstration |I'm pretty good at this, nojya ]," Kohaku says in your voice. "Speech patterns take a little time, but they're not hard to copy given a half-day to listen to whoever's speaking. I prefer a catfolk's guise, since they're quite like us kitsune in many aspects, but even a rather short wyld elf will do in a pinch. I'm flexible, nojya!" With that said, Kohaku raises her hands to her face again, and in a blur of motion, she's her old self once more. The little golden-furred kitsune beams brightly at you as if nothing had ever happened, four tails wagging and swishing with eager excitement. Well, that explains a lot, really. There's just one more question on the topic... "Yes?" She goes out on trading trips, right? Yet whenever you visit, she's always here in the storehouse... Kohaku waves off the question. "Oh, those don't take more than a day or so, nojya. Matron Komari's torii gate makes the trip much shorter. We load up the wagon, get two bodyguards, then head off to wherever it is we're going. When it's time to return home, we just head to the nearest warpstone and pop on back. Teleportation is amazingly convenient; eliminating travel time gives me a serious edge over other merchants, and I can set off in the morning and expect to be back in the storehouse by evening. It's pretty great, nojya. Traveling somewhere as far away as Tychris doesn't take any longer than saying hello to the leothrans." Gods. Your own experience tells you warpstones are scattered all over the Marches and indeed, much of what used to be ancient Belhar. Kohaku does have an obscene advantage over other merchants who have to travel long distances to get to markets. Time, risk, mishaps... one supposes it balances out the danger that she'd be in if any city discovered there were disguised life-draining, soul-sucking vulpine monsters within its walls. "I like going out of the den to trade, nojya... one gets to see the world and its peoples in more aspects than just as benefactors. They all have little mundane concerns... the small talk people will make with merchants is something. Then there's the haggling... if only people could be less afraid of us kitsune. I'd love to be able to walk the streets freely like I do in the Old Country, I always feel so at home there, with people like me out and about, you know? "But that's enough of that. Is there anything else you wished to ask of me, nojya?" ] ] "

rows.original: So, she goes out and conducts trading with other peoples?
rows.translation: 所以，她会出去和其他人进行交易吗？
rows.raw: "So, she goes out and conducts trading with other peoples?"

rows.original: At the question, Kohaku blushes and looks away. "It's kind of a long story..." And? "It'll take a while if I talk about it..." Is it something she can't say? "No...[pc.ra kitsune|forgive me my hesitation and disrespect, my [pc.mf|lord|lady].]" Then she can spit it out. For someone who loves to talk, Kohaku's being kind of reticent about the topic. Being the closest thing the kitsune have to an actual merchant must be the perfect job for someone like her, right? What's there to be awkward about? "Eeeeh... well, I'm not technically of this den, nojya. I wasn't born here." Kohaku takes a moment to steady herself, squaring the shoulders on her small frame. "My parents chose to leave the Old Country when I was very little, something to do with a particularly shameful event. No one's ever told me the details... since then, they've been traveling in this part of the world, trying to find a good, exploitable source of iron. My father was a metallurgist of some repute... since there's a standing edict from the Emperor on such, if he can find one, an imperial commendation would certainly repair our standing..." You get the feeling that there's more to this story than Kohaku is willing to let on, but it probably isn't the time to press her.[pc.ra kitsune| Sure, technically you seriously outrank her and could command her to spill everything, but then she might explode.] "When I was eight, my parents decided that constantly traveling wasn't good for a child like me, and so they sought to get me an apprenticeship. My father knew Matron Komari — I'm not sure how — and he arranged for everything to happen. Even more than ten years ago, the matron was looking to her retirement, and arranged to take me in. I got a proper education in knowing my writing and adding right next to Miko and Mai... "This position of storehouse keeper... it's actually really new, nojya. Caring for inventory used to be the matron's job, and official trade was conducted by whoever was willing to take the risks... she took the chance to formalise the position in me. Everyone's done their best to be kind to me, and yet I feel kinda lacking..." Hmm... "But that's all fine now, nojya!" Kohaku snaps back to her usual cheery self, melancholy vanishing from her expression in the blink of an eye, replaced by a big smile. "I now have a profession I love, surrounded by people who trust me with such a crucial role despite not even having blood relations with anyone in the den! I get to go out and talk to all kinds of people, and no one minds if I eat taiyaki on the job. The day I officially went on the job, Kazuo presented me with the giant puppet so my crew would have help with the heavy lifting... "Everyone's been really nice to me. It's all turned out for the best!" All right, you get the idea. She's truly blessed here. "I am. It's nice to have a direction in life and to know that the people you rely on are counting on you in turn, isn't it? That sense of connection with other people, no matter how brief — even if it's just a passing sale, that's something that makes me really happy, nojya."
rows.translation: 听到这个问题，小红脸一红，然后把目光移开了。这其实是个挺长的故事…… 然后呢？ 如果我详细解释的话，可能需要一些时间…… 这是她无法说出口的事情吗？ 不……[pc.ra kitsune|请原谅我的犹豫与无礼，我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]。]" 那么她就可以把话直说了。对于一个喜欢说话的人来说，小花在这个话题上显得相当沉默。作为狐族中最接近真正商人身份的人，这样的工作对于她来说应该再合适不过了吧？有什么好尴尬的呢？ 呃……其实，严格来说，我并不属于这个群体，诺雅。我并不是在这里出生的。琥珀花花了一会儿才稳住身体，将瘦小的肩膀挺得笔直。在我还很小的时候，我的父母就决定离开旧国，原因与一件极其羞耻的事情有关。从来没有人告诉过我具体的细节……从那以后，他们就一直在这个地区四处游历，试图寻找一种优质且可以开采的铁矿资源。我父亲原本是一位颇有声望的冶金专家……既然皇帝曾经颁布过相关法令，如果他能找到这样的铁矿，获得皇帝的表彰肯定能够恢复我们的声誉…… 你有一种感觉，这个故事背后还有更多不为人知的事情，但现在可能还不是追问她的时机。[pc.ra kitsune| 当然，从技术层面上来说，你的地位确实比她高得多。可以命令她把一切都说出来，否则她可能会发火。] 当我八岁的时候，我的父母认为，对于我这样的孩子来说，频繁搬家并不好，因此他们决定为我找一份学徒工作。我父亲认识麻里夫人——不过我也不太清楚如何 ——而他安排了一切，让这一切得以发生。早在十多年前，那位女院长就已经考虑到了退休的问题，于是便安排让我来到她身边生活。我因此接受了系统的教育，学会了如何写作，并且得以与米可、舞一起学习…… 这个仓库管理员的职位……其实真的是新设立的，诺雅。以前，管理库存本来是女管家的职责，而正式的贸易活动则由那些愿意承担风险的人来负责……她抓住机会，将这个职责正式地交给了我。大家都尽力对我好，但我还是觉得有点不够…… 嗯…… 但现在一切都好了，诺雅！琥珀立刻恢复了她一贯开朗的神情，眼中的忧郁转瞬即逝，取而代之的是灿烂的笑容。现在，我拥有一份自己热爱的工作，身边围绕着那些信任我、让我承担如此重要职责的人们，尽管我和团队中的任何人都没有血缘关系！我可以和各种各样的人打交道，而且在工作时吃天妇罗也不会有人介意。在我正式开始工作的那天，一夫送给了我那个巨大的木偶，这样我的团队在搬运重物时就能得到帮助了…… 大家都对我非常好，最终一切都发展得非常顺利！ 好吧，你明白我的意思了吧。她在这里确实得到了上天赐予的幸福。 是的。生活中有明确的方向，而且知道那些你依赖的人也在依赖你，这种感觉真的很棒，不是吗？无论这种联系持续多久，哪怕只是短暂的交易，这种与他人建立联系的感觉真的会让我感到非常开心，nojya。

rows.translation: 她究竟是怎么得到这份工作的呢？
rows.raw: "How'd she wind up doing this job, anyway?"

rows.original: [pc.ra kitsune |[rand |You hear Kohaku's breath catch in her throat. "C-certainly, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]. If I may be allowed to finish what little work remains and shut down the storehouse for the day, nojya?" Certainly. Kohaku is definitely more animated after all this, clearly innervated by the promise of more fun times. There's still a little time before the storehouse is officially slated to close for the day, but she finishes up everything and gives her subordinates half an hour early off. |"Excellent timing as always, your Eminence. We were about to close up for the day." You do have a knack for being in the right place at the right time. "Please, allow me to formally close up the storehouse and I will be with you forthwith, nojya." Of course, of course. |A slight twinge of color rises to the little kitsune's cheeks as you proposition her, both of her ears turning forward and down. My, what must she be thinking? "I am honored that you wish to be my benefactor, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]. Please, allow me to cease operations for the day and I will be with you shortly, nojya." Of course, no rush. Despite your words, Kohaku is definitely excited about the prospect, going through the checklists and dismissing her subordinates. It's not long before she shuts the heavy door with a heavy thud and turns back to you. ] |[rand |"Eeeeh? If that's what you want... well, it saves me the trouble of going outside of the den to seek benefactors, nojya. How fortuitous that you should turn up right now when I'm feeling a little peckish..." How fortuitous, indeed. It's almost closing time for her, isn't it? "Yes..." Kohaku gives you a sheepish grin and scratches her ears. "Let me finish up everything and dismiss my people, and we can begin." The little kitsune is good to her word. About half an hour later, the last of her subordinates is out the door, and she heaves it shut with a final-sounding thud. |"You're back again, [pc.name]? Do you really like me that much to come in while I'm still on the clock, nojya? You're supposed to wait for nightfall before turning for [silly|夜這い|yobai], you know." Turning up for what? "Oh. Uh, nothing, nojya. A tradition that's still practised in some parts of the Old Country, my father says. It's how he and my mother got together. Um, just let me get finished with all this paperwork and I'll be with you, okay?" Of course. Kohaku is good to her word — before your eyes, the little mountain of paperwork on her rapidly diminishes, her subordinates arriving at her desk and taking away the finished documents as she completes and stamps them. Within half an hour, she's done and ready to go, having dismissed her people for the day. |"Eeeeeh..." Kohaku's eyes shift from side to side, her ears mirroring their movements. At last, the little kitsune breaks into a small smile, her ears becoming still. "Well, if you want to be my benefactor, [pc.name], I'm not going to say no, nojya. With all the traveling I have to do it's nice to be able to enjoy oneself in the comfort of one's home, isn't it?" That's one way of putting it. "Now then, let me finish up my work and I'll be with you shortly, okay? Whatever my personal desires are, I do have responsibilities that need to be taken care of. I shan't keep you long waiting, nojya." Of course, of course. Maybe she's extra motivated today, but Kohaku finishes up the day's work with remarkable speed. Maybe there just wasn't very much to begin with, for she's back with you within half an hour, dusting off her hands. ] ] [party.hasCompanions |On your part, you dismiss [party.compNames] for a couple of hours, telling [party.manyCompanions|them|[companion1.himHer]] to take a small break and relax while you get things sorted out here. Surely there'll be no shortage of eager foxen willing to entertain [party.manyCompanions|them|[companion1.himHer]] while you're dealing with Kohaku... ] As before, Kohaku leads you up to the back of the storehouse where her tiny living quarters are located, a small foxhole for an equally small fox. You help her get the bedding out of the wall cupboard and spread it out, then turn back to Kohaku, who's busy trying to look nonchalant while twiddling her fingers all the while.[pc.ra kitsune| She collects herself with a small eep when she notices you watching her, tucking her four tails close to her body as she gives you a bow.] "[pc.ra kitsune|What might you desire of my body, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]?|Well then, nojya... what would you like to do?"]
rows.translation: [pc.ra kitsune |[rand |你能听到小白的呼吸在喉咙里急促地响着。当然，我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]如果允许我完成剩下的那点工作，然后关上仓库休息一下，可以吗，诺雅？ 当然。 经过这一切，小红显然变得活跃了许多，显然是因为期待着更多有趣的时光。虽然仓库正式关闭还有些时间，但她还是迅速完成了所有工作，然后让下属们提前半小时下班了。 |一如既往，您的时机把握得真是太好了，阁下。我们正准备结束当天的工作呢。 你确实很有本事，总能在恰好的时间出现在恰好的地方。 请允许我正式关闭仓库，之后我就会立刻与您会合，诺雅。 当然，当然。 |当你向这只小狐妖提出请求时，她的脸颊上浮现出一丝红晕，她的两只耳朵也都向前下方耷了下来。天啊，她现在在想些什么呢？能得到您的慷慨帮助，我感到无比荣幸。 [pc.mf|领主|女士]请允许我暂停今天的工作，稍后就会回到你们身边，诺雅。 当然，不必着急。 尽管你这么说，但小花对这件事确实感到非常兴奋，她开始仔细检查各项清单，同时吩咐她的下属们去处理其他事务。不久之后，她重重地关上了那扇重型的门，然后转身回到了你面前。 ] |[rand |呃？如果那是你想要的……那可就省去了我跑出去寻找施主们的麻烦了，真是太巧了，就在我有点饿的时候你出现了…… 真是太巧了。对她来说，现在差不多是下班时间了吧？ 是的……琥珀露出有些尴尬的笑容，然后挠了挠自己的耳朵。让我先把所有事情处理完毕，然后让我的手下们离开，这样我们就可以开始了。 那只小狐妖确实守信用。大约半个小时后，她的所有下属都离开了房间，她重重地关上了门，发出一声沉闷的声响。 |你又回来了， [pc.name]？ 你真的那么喜欢我，以至于在我还在上班的时候就来找我吗，nojya？你应该等到天黑之后再来的才对啊[silly|夜這い|妖怪]你知道的。 去参加什么活动呢？ 哦，呃，没什么，只是个老规矩。我父亲说，在老国的某些地方至今仍然有人沿袭这个传统。他和我母亲就是通过这种方式相识的。嗯，等我把这些文件处理完，就会去找你，好吗？ 当然。 小花确实说到做到了——就在你眼前，她桌子上那一堆文件迅速减少了下去，她的下属们陆续来到她的办公桌前，将处理完毕并盖好章的文件拿走。半个小时内，她就全部完成了工作，也准备结束当天的工作，让手下们各自回去休息了。 |呃……小红的眼睛左右转动，她的耳朵也随着这些动作而摆动。最终，这只小狐妖露出了一个微笑，她的耳朵也停止了移动。嗯，如果你想成为我的恩人[pc.name]，我不会拒绝的，诺雅。考虑到我需要经常旅行，能够在家里舒适地享受生活，确实是一件很愉快的事情，不是吗？ 也可以这么说。 那么，让我先完成手头的工作，稍后就会去找你，好吗？无论我个人的愿望是什么，我确实有一些责任必须去履行。我不会让你等待太久的，nojya。 当然，当然。 也许她今天格外有干劲，但小红以惊人的速度完成了当天的工作。也可能本来就没有太多事情需要处理，因为半个小时后她就回来了，手上还沾着灰尘。 ] ] [party.hasCompanions |而你方面，却对此不屑一顾。 [party.compNames]讲了几个小时的故事。 [party.manyCompanions|他们|[companion1.himHer]]你可以趁这个机会稍作休息，放松一下，同时把这里的事情处理好。肯定会有很多热心的狐妖愿意来陪你消遣的。 [party.manyCompanions|他们|[companion1.himHer]]当你正在处理小花的事情时…… ] 像之前一样，小红带你来到了仓库的后面，那里就是她那小小的居住空间——对于一只体型娇小的狐妖来说，这个地方简直就像一个迷你地洞。你帮她把壁橱里的被褥取出来并铺开，然后转身看向小红，她正努力装作若无其事的样子，但手指却一直在不停地扭动。[pc.ra kitsune| 当她注意到你在注视她时，她轻轻“哎呀”了一声，迅速将自己的四条尾巴收拢到身体旁边，然后向你鞠了一躬。] "[pc.ra kitsune|你对我身体究竟有什么渴望呢？我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]？|那么，诺雅……你想要做什么呢？]

The little golden-furred kitsune is practically awash with excitement as she kicks the trunk shut and presents the garment for your inspection, hands out and head down. "Please, my [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend], for your appraisal." You take the belt from Kohaku and run your fingers along its length. The sheer sensation of fluffiness brushing against your fingertips, small sparks of static leaping up in the chill, dry air. A shiver runs up your spine, and the thought of you having this thing at your waist all the time... it's clear a lot of work went into this garment, as it's practically a work of art. [pc.ra kitsune |Of course, there's the fact that it's kitsune fur isn't lost on you. It's not as if you're wearing a full body of it, after all. ] "Well, well? [pc.ra kitsune|Is my [pc.mf|lord|lady] enamored of the fineness of this piece|Can you feel the fluffiness], nojya? Imagine this belt keeping your waist warm as you travel on through the wilderness, nojya! Utter and maximum comfort and snuggliness in one simple loop! Easy to wash too, if it comes to that!" Did she say easy to wash? "Oh yes! Very easy! Stains? Come right off no problem, nojya! If you don't want it, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady], ]then I have some people in Tychris waiting to snap this up! How about it, nojya? It's a good deal! One-time deal only, no guarantees when or if another will come around again!"
rows.translation: 是的，是的！从平台上下来后，小红在附近的树干里翻找了一番，最终取出了一条由橙色和白色交织而成的精美毛皮腰带。这只金毛小狐兴奋得不得了，她踢上树干盖子，将这条腰带递给你仔细查看，然后低头等待你的反应。求你了，我的[pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]供您评估参考。 你从小白手中接过这条腰带，用手指轻轻触摸它的表面。柔软的纤维在指尖滑动，那种触感令人陶醉；在寒冷干燥的空气中，还偶尔会迸发出细微的静电火花。一阵寒意从脊背传来，想到这条腰带会一直缠在自己的腰间……显然，制作这条腰带花费了大量的心血，它简直就是一件艺术品。 [pc.ra kitsune |当然，你也注意到了那是由狐毛制成的衣物。毕竟，你并没有全身都穿着这种衣服。 ] 嗯，嗯？ [pc.ra kitsune|是我的吗？ [pc.mf|领主|女士]被这件作品的精妙之处所吸引|你能感受到那种柔软蓬松的感觉吗？]诺雅，想象一下：在荒野中旅行时，这条腰带能够让你的腰部保持温暖，诺雅！它既舒适又保暖，只需要一个简单的环扣结构就能实现这些功能！而且，如果需要清洗的话，也非常方便哦！ 她是说这种面料容易清洗吗？ 哦，没错！非常简单！污渍吗？根本不会留下痕迹，绝对不会！如果你不想要的话[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]，]那么，在提克里斯有一些人正在等着抢购这个机会呢！怎么样，nojya？这可是个不错的交易啊！只有一次机会，以后是否还会再有这样的机会就很难说了……

rows.original: "Aaaah, I think you will appreciate this[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]. Something made to be practical, as opposed to merely ceremonial, nojya." Reaching under her desk, Kohaku draws out an exquisite... well, it looks long enough to be a greatsword, still in its scabbard. The little golden kitsune is [pc.ra kitsune|all quiet and reverent as she formally presents it to you with both hands, her head and body alike bowed|all smiles as she presents it to you with both hands, perhaps a little too overeager to cinch a sale]. This is... "A swift sword from the Old Country, nojya! [pc.ra kitsune |I think it would go very well with you now that you're one of us, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]! If you could use it to cut down the enemies of our divine lord Keros, I'm sure you'd be even more heroic than you are already! |An excellent piece of art that will make you look even more heroic as you fell your foes! ]" Well, looking good is usually the last thing on your mind when you're pitched in the heat of battle, but you'll take a look anyway. Taking the sword from Kohaku, you draw it partway out of the scabbard, a silken metallic hiss accompanying the motion. You have to admit, it sounds really good. An iron sword, huh? Or at least, it looks like iron... or some alloy of such. [pc.bgMulti soldier scholar |While you've spent much of your soldiering years around various kinds of weapons, this just feels a little too fancy to be practical. Bronze has been the mainstay since forever... iron weapons are just not done. Well, you've seen some cleavers, but those are more clubs than anything since they lose their edges so quickly. |You've come across a couple of old texts referencing weapons of iron and iron alloys in your past, but holding one in your hands, it doesn't look or feel anything like it's all cracked up to be. Everyone's just so used to bronze. |You don't really know enough about these things to properly appraise the weapon, but doesn't everyone use bronze for these things? ] Then again, it's really balanced for an iron weapon, and you get the impression you could handle this well. The weight is still there, but you assume that's intentional, to provide power behind your strikes. [party.has arona |"Not my style," Arona says from behind you as she studies the blade over your shoulder. "Can't deny it's pretty damn well made, though; I know Rags would love to get her hands on something like this for study. Might have considered it myself if I were a fan of such things." ] "Well, how is it, nojya?" It's very nice, but wouldn't someone like Nakano be more interested in it? "Oh, he already has his own. Handed down to him by his ancestors; as hard as it is to imagine him loathing me even more than he does already, I think he'd do just that if I suggested he replace his family heirloom, nojya. This is a new piece that I brought back with me from my last trip over! Doesn't it look great? Not many people make swift swords back over the ocean, and even fewer that aren't just ceremonial. Hard to get the blade to heat evenly, I'm told. There're laws about who can make these, nojya. "So, how about it? Really rare piece there, nojya. Superb workmanship — I guarantee it'll hold an edge better than any bronze piece you find, even amongst the minotaurs. Once in a lifetime deal, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]."
rows.translation: 啊……我想你会喜欢这个的。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]有些东西是用来实际使用的，而不仅仅是用来做仪式用的，诺雅。 琥珀从桌子下面拿出一把精美的……嗯，它的长度足以被视为一把长剑，而且还插在剑鞘里。那只小金色的狐妖[pc.ra kitsune|她双手将它郑重地呈现在你面前，全身上下都洋溢着肃穆与敬意。|她双手将物品递给你时，脸上洋溢着笑容，或许是因为太急于完成这笔交易了吧。]这真是…… 来自古老国度的迅捷剑锋，诺雅！ [pc.ra kitsune |我想，现在你已经成为我们的一员了，这件东西一定会很适合你，我的。 [pc.mf|领主|女士]如果你能用它来消灭我们神圣领袖凯罗斯的敌人，我相信你会变得更加英勇无畏！ |这是一件精美的艺术品，当你击败敌人时，它会让你的形象显得更加英勇！ ]" 嗯，当你陷入激烈的战斗中时，外貌通常根本不是你会考虑的事情，但你还是会看一眼的。从科哈库手中接过那把剑，你将其从剑鞘中拔出一部分，伴随着一道丝丝金属般的嘶鸣声。不得不承认，这个声音确实很棒。 一把铁剑，哈？或者至少，它是看起来坚如铁……或者说是一种类似的合金。 [pc.bgMulti soldier scholar |虽然你在军旅生涯中的大部分时间都在使用各种武器，但这种武器看起来实在太花哨了，实在不太实用。青铜武器一直以来都是主流选择……铁制武器显然不够理想。嗯，你确实见过一些砍刀，但那些更像棍棒，因为它们的刀刃很快就会磨损掉。 |在过去，你曾经遇到过一些提到铁制武器和铁合金武器的古老文献，但当你真正握在手中时，你会发现它们的外观和手感根本不像那些文献中所描述的那样。毕竟，大家已经太习惯使用青铜武器了。 |你对这些事情的了解其实还不够深入，因此无法正确地评估这件武器的价值，但难道不是每个人在制作这些东西时都会使用青铜吗？ ]不过，对于一把铁制武器来说，它的平衡性确实相当不错。使用这种武器时，你会有一种能够熟练驾驭它的感觉。虽然它的重量依然存在，但你会认为这种设计是故意的，目的是为了让你的攻击更具力量。 [party.has arona |这不是我的风格。阿罗娜从你身后说道，同时她也在你肩膀上方仔细观察那把剑。不过，不得不承认，这个作品的制作质量确实相当高；我知道拉格斯肯定很想研究这样的东西。如果我也是这类东西的爱好者，可能也会考虑购买它。 ] 那么，诺雅，感觉怎么样？ 这确实很不错，但像中野这样的人，难道不会对它更感兴趣吗？ 哦，他已经有自己的那把了。那是他的祖先传给他的；虽然很难想象他会比我更讨厌我，但我想如果我建议他换掉那把家族传家宝‘诺雅’，他肯定会这么做的。这是我上次旅行时带回来的新剑！看起来很棒吧？在海外，很少有人会制作这种快剑，而那些制作的剑也大多只是用于仪式场合。据说要让剑刃均匀受热是一件非常困难的事情。而且，关于谁有权制作这种剑，也是有着明确规定的呢，‘诺雅’。 那么，怎么样？那可真是件非常稀有的物品啊，nojya。制作工艺也极其精湛——我敢保证，它的锋利程度绝对会超过你找到的任何青铜制品，甚至包括那些弥诺陶洛斯制造的物品。这真的是千载难逢的好机会啊。 [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]。"

rows.original: "Ehehehe. You're about to see a really good deal, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]." Kohaku does really look extra excited, her four tails practically thrashing about as she opens up a drawer in her desk and brings out what looks like a large jewellery box. Beaming with pride, the golden-furred kitsune smacks it on her desk with a resounding thump, then cracks open the box. "Look closely, nojya!" The inside of the box is lined with purple velvet, and lying atop that protective layer is a a shining teardrop-shaped jewel, an eerie blue flame dancing beneath the surface. It's large enough to comfortably fit in the palm of your hand, and indeed, there's a reinforced silken strap attached to it for fitting about your wrist — clearly a safety measure should you lose your hold on the object. [pc.ra kitsune |Even before Kohaku opened the box, you knew something special was within, something that tugged at the core of your being. There's a strange resonance between you and the gem that you just know wouldn't have existed were you not a kitsune... a feeling of unity, of togetherness, drawing out a latent power within you. Kohaku isn't lying; this is indeed a good deal. The little golden-furred kitsune is all smiles and bows, but she must be feeling this, too — the temptation to take this off the proverbial store shelf and use it herself must be overwhelming. Good thing it's surpassed by the rush she gets from introducing her special wares. |It's clear from the sight that this jewel is something special, brimming over with arcane powers. Any spellcaster would be able to make use of such a potent focus, it's true, but there's something more to this jewel... ...Something more that you can't unlock. Not for lack of skill or magical acumen, but simply by virtue of who — no, what — you are. But even without that, Kohaku is right in that this gem is an excellent bargain; just standing by it makes your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] prickle and a deep, ominous feeling well up in the pit of your stomach. ] [party.has einin |Einin peeks at the gem as you examine it. "Ooh, shiny. Would have been tempting in the past... but utterly impractical. You'd have problems trying to fence this off anywhere; it'd have too much heat on it." ] "Well?" Kohaku cocks her head jauntily at you and grins. Even though she's trying to not be too blatant about it, you can tell she's scrutinising your expression like a hawk watching a particularly fat rabbit. "marvelous, is it not[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" It's... something, all right. "Eeeeeh? Your calm and humility speaks well of you, my [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]. This is a rare fox jewel, painstakingly crafted by certain clans amongst the twelve Divine Houses, nojya! Normally, a commoner would never be able to get her hands on such a thing, especially a foreign-born commoner like me, but given the amount of high-quality iron I've shipped back to the Old Country... recognition by the court is a wonderful thing to have sometimes. "I implore you, [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend] — do consider this purchase deeply. The fox jewel will greatly enhance your already potent magical capabilities, nojya. You will not find something like this anywhere else on this continent! You ought to be armed as best as you can when venturing into danger, am I not right?" Hmm... [pc.ra kitsune |Seeing your hesitation, Kohaku leans in conspiratorially, dark mischief dancing on her face. "Then, of course, there is the matter of kitsunetsuki, nojya..." Kitsun — what, now? "Kitsunetsuki, the closest translation in the tongue you're used to being fox possession, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]. You can feel it, can you not, nojya? A fox jewel is a perfect aid in that art unique to our race... of course, someone as eminent and accomplished as the matron does not need a fox jewel to employ kitsunetsuki, but she has decades of experience, cultivation and spiritual energy over others. "This fox jewel, though... even a moment or two of intrusion into the psyche of an enemy would allow you to wreak all kinds of havoc on their minds and even bodies, nojya. A potent force to be reckoned with, for sure. I myself could never use such dangerous power to coerce others into making deals disadvantageous to them — such misuse of a sacred object would be inviting great and terrible retribution. However, the champion of our divine lord mazing the minds of our enemies before striking them down... it would make for the stuff of legends, nojya. ] "Well, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]? What do you say?"
rows.translation: 嘿嘿嘿，你马上就要看到一个非常划算的交易了[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]。"小白确实显得格外兴奋，她的四条尾巴不停地摆动着。当她打开书桌上的抽屉，拿出一个看起来像是一个大首饰盒的东西时，那只金毛狐妖脸上洋溢着自豪的笑容，将盒子重重地放在书桌上，然后开始打开它。仔细看，诺雅！ 盒子的内部铺着紫色天鹅绒，而在这一层保护材料之上，摆放着一颗闪闪发光的泪滴形宝石，其表面下跳动着诡异的蓝色火焰。这颗宝石大到足以轻松放在你的手掌中，事实上，它还配有一条加固过的丝质挂带，可以套在你的手腕上——显然，这是为了防止你不小心丢失它而设计的安全措施。 [pc.ra kitsune |甚至在琥珀打开那个盒子之前，你就知道其中蕴含着某种特别的东西，某种能够触动你内心深处的东西。你与这块宝石之间存在着一种奇妙的共鸣知道如果没有你，这种团结一致的感觉、这种共同奋斗的精神，就根本不会存在……这种感觉能激发你内心潜藏的力量。 小花并没有撒谎，这确实是一种不错真难办。这只金毛小狐虽然总是面带微笑、频频鞠躬，但她肯定也感受到了同样的诱惑——把这件“商品”从货架上拿下来自己使用，这种冲动肯定非常强烈。幸好，比起这种冲动，她为向别人展示自己的“特别商品”而感到的兴奋要强烈得多。 |从外观上就能看出，这颗宝石非同寻常，其中蕴含着强大的神秘力量。的确，任何施法者都能利用这样的能量源泉，但这颗宝石背后还有更多不为人知的秘密…… ……一些你目前还无法解锁的秘密。这并非因为你的技巧或魔法天赋不足，而是因为你的身份——不，应该说是你的本质。不过，即便没有这些因素，科哈库说得也对：这颗宝石确实是一笔非常划算的交易；仅仅只是将它放在身边，就能让你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]一阵刺痛感涌上心头，同时一种深沉而不祥的感觉也在胃部萦绕不去。 ] [party.has einin |当你仔细观察那颗宝石时，艾宁也偷偷地瞥了它一眼。哦，真闪亮……在过去的话肯定很吸引人……但根本不实用。在任何地方试图用围栏把它围起来都会遇到麻烦，因为它会散发出太多的热量。 ] 那么？小白歪着头，冲你笑了笑。虽然她努力不让自己表现得太过明显，但你能看出，她正像鹰注视着一只特别肥的兔子一样，仔细地观察着你的表情。太棒了，不是吗？[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]？" 这……算是某种东西吧，好吧。 呃……你的冷静与谦逊确实为你的品格增色不少，我的[pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]这是一颗稀有的狐妖宝石，是由十二个神族中的某些氏族精心制作而成的，真是难得啊！通常情况下，一个平民是永远不可能得到这样的东西的，尤其是像我这样出生在国外的平民。不过，由于我向旧国运送了大量高质量的铁矿……有时候，得到朝廷的认可确实是一件非常幸运的事情。 我恳求你， [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友] — 请务必慎重考虑这次购买。这只狐妖宝石将会极大地提升你原本就强大的魔法能力，诺雅。在这个大陆上，你再也找不到这样的东西了！在面对危险时，你必须要做好充分的准备，不是吗？ 嗯…… [pc.ra kitsune |看到你犹豫不决的样子，小红凑近了一些，脸上洋溢着调皮的笑意，仿佛在密谋着什么。那么，当然，还有另一个问题狐附身诺雅…… 狐……什么来着？ “狐附身用你熟悉的语言来说，最接近的翻译就是“被狐狸附身了”。 [pc.mf|领主|女士]你能感觉到吧，诺雅？狐妖宝石是我们种族独有的那种技艺中不可或缺的辅助品……当然，像那位女院长这样地位崇高、技艺高超的人，使用狐妖宝石来施展“狐怨”术并不是必需的，但她毕竟拥有比别人多得多的经验、修为以及灵力。 这种狐妖宝石啊……哪怕只是短暂地侵入敌人的心灵，也能在他们的心灵乃至身体上造成种种破坏，诺雅。这确实是一种需要谨慎对待的强大力量。就我个人而言，我绝不会利用这种危险的力量去强迫他人做出对自己不利的交易——如此滥用神圣之物，只会招来可怕的报应。然而，我们神圣领袖那位在击败敌人之前先扰乱他们心智的英雄……这样的故事简直堪称传奇，诺雅。 ] 嗯， [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]你觉得怎么样？
rows.raw: ' "Ehehehe. You're about to see a really good deal, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]." Kohaku does really look extra excited, her four tails practically thrashing about as she opens up a drawer in her desk and brings out what looks like a large jewellery box. Beaming with pride, the golden-furred kitsune smacks it on her desk with a resounding thump, then cracks open the box. "Look closely, nojya!" The inside of the box is lined with purple velvet, and lying atop that protective layer is a a shining teardrop-shaped jewel, an eerie blue flame dancing beneath the surface. It's large enough to comfortably fit in the palm of your hand, and indeed, there's a reinforced silken strap attached to it for fitting about your wrist — clearly a safety measure should you lose your hold on the object. [pc.ra kitsune |Even before Kohaku opened the box, you knew something special was within, something that tugged at the core of your being. There's a strange resonance between you and the gem that you just know wouldn't have existed were you not a kitsune... a feeling of unity, of togetherness, drawing out a latent power within you. Kohaku isn't lying; this is indeed a good deal. The little golden-furred kitsune is all smiles and bows, but she must be feeling this, too — the temptation to take this off the proverbial store shelf and use it herself must be overwhelming. Good thing it's surpassed by the rush she gets from introducing her special wares. |It's clear from the sight that this jewel is something special, brimming over with arcane powers. Any spellcaster would be able to make use of such a potent focus, it's true, but there's something more to this jewel... ...Something more that you can't unlock. Not for lack of skill or magical acumen, but simply by virtue of who — no, what — you are. But even without that, Kohaku is right in that this gem is an excellent bargain; just standing by it makes your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] prickle and a deep, ominous feeling well up in the pit of your stomach. ] [party.has einin |Einin peeks at the gem as you examine it. "Ooh, shiny. Would have been tempting in the past... but utterly impractical. You'd have problems trying to fence this off anywhere; it'd have too much heat on it." ] "Well?" Kohaku cocks her head jauntily at you and grins. Even though she's trying to not be too blatant about it, you can tell she's scrutinising your expression like a hawk watching a particularly fat rabbit. "marvelous, is it not[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" It's... something, all right. "Eeeeeh? Your calm and humility speaks well of you, my [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]. This is a rare fox jewel, painstakingly crafted by certain clans amongst the twelve Divine Houses, nojya! Normally, a commoner would never be able to get her hands on such a thing, especially a foreign-born commoner like me, but given the amount of high-quality iron I've shipped back to the Old Country... recognition by the court is a wonderful thing to have sometimes. "I implore you, [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend] — do consider this purchase deeply. The fox jewel will greatly enhance your already potent magical capabilities, nojya. You will not find something like this anywhere else on this continent! You ought to be armed as best as you can when venturing into danger, am I not right?" Hmm... [pc.ra kitsune |Seeing your hesitation, Kohaku leans in conspiratorially, dark mischief dancing on her face. "Then, of course, there is the matter of kitsunetsuki, nojya..." Kitsun — what, now? "Kitsunetsuki, the closest translation in the tongue you're used to being fox possession, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]. You can feel it, can you not, nojya? A fox jewel is a perfect aid in that art unique to our race... of course, someone as eminent and accomplished as the matron does not need a fox jewel to employ kitsunetsuki, but she has decades of experience, cultivation and spiritual energy over others. "This fox jewel, though... even a moment or two of intrusion into the psyche of an enemy would allow you to wreak all kinds of havoc on their minds and even bodies, nojya. A potent force to be reckoned with, for sure. I myself could never use such dangerous power to coerce others into making deals disadvantageous to them — such misuse of a sacred object would be inviting great and terrible retribution. However, the champion of our divine lord mazing the minds of our enemies before striking them down... it would make for the stuff of legends, nojya. ] "Well, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]? What do you say?" '

rows.original: "Our beloved matron has come around to tapping the sacred tree again," Kohaku says. "The sap is a potent restorative and used as a medicine in times of great need. I myself have thankfully not been in such danger that I would need a dose myself, but since you are placing yourself in much peril on a regular basis, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend], you may be interested in what little surplus there is from last time, nojya." Surplus? From last time? Is she looking to push expiring goods on you? "Eeeeh! Sorry, sorry, sorry! I didn't mean it that way, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]!" Wincing, Kohaku bows deeply, looking utterly sheepish and very, very regretful. Almost too regretful... but not so much as to be plainly transparent. "It's still... well, our eminent matron likes to keep things as fresh as possible, nojya. The medicine itself is no less effective than it was a year ago — since it's been properly stored, it takes longer than that to degrade — but she doesn't want to fall into the habit of leaving things on the shelf for years, nojya." All right. So to be sure, you're buying a measure of tree sap. "That is most certainly correct, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]. It will bind wounds, clear ailments and improve mental focus with remarkable rapidity. I have been permitted to only sell one portion — would you like it, nojya?"
rows.translation: “我们敬爱的主母又愿意来采那棵圣树的树液了，”琥珀说道。“这种树液是强效的滋补药，在危急时刻会被当作药物使用。幸运的是，我自己还从未落到需要服下一剂的险境；但既然你经常把自己置于危险之中，[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]，你或许会对上次剩下的那点存货感兴趣，诺雅。” 剩余库存？是上次剩下的吗？她是不是想把快要过期的商品卖给你啊？ “哎呀！对不起，对不起，对不起！我不是那个意思，[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]！”琥珀缩了缩脖子，深深鞠了一躬，看上去羞愧极了，也懊悔极了。简直太懊悔了……可又没夸张到一眼就能看穿的地步。“它还是……嗯，我们尊贵的主母喜欢尽量让东西保持新鲜，诺雅。这药本身的效力并不比一年前差——只要储存得当，要过更久才会变质——但她不想养成把东西在架子上放上好几年的习惯，诺雅。” 好吧。那么，确认一下，你要买的是一份树液。 “完全正确，[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]。它能极快地愈合伤口、祛除病痛，并大幅提升精神专注力。我只获准出售一份——你想要吗，诺雅？”
