rows.original: "We find strange objects in the woods at times, and some of the other dens send their finds here to be able to benefit from the knowledge and experience of the matron, nojya. Here in particular is something another den has delivered to us recently..." As she speaks, Kohaku reaches into a small box by the side of her desk and draws out a metal-reinforced canister. You note that runes are inscribed all along its length, circling around its cylindrical form[pc.bg arcanist scholar |; you even recognize some of them as being dampening and protective wards. Whatever she's got in there is pretty high-payload stuff ]. All right, then. What's it? "Our matron has identified the object as a ley-crystal grenade, my [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend], a relic of the Godswar. It is quite the terrible weapon, that once detonated, explodes with impressive force. We had thought to send it on to other dens for use in their mining forays... but it seems such a waste to let it be used for simple earth-moving." And so, opportunity opens ahead of you, does it? "Just so! With the world in peril again, there's no reason why we shouldn't bring all the ordnance from the last war out to bear... there's no more honorable end to a weapon than dying fulfilling the purpose it was made for, nojya. I'd be more than willing to let it go to join the cause... for a price, of course." Ah, it's always about the money, isn't it? "As the saying goes[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]: greenhorns talk battles, veterans talk strategy, masters talk logistics. A thousand apologies, but I can't just give it to you for free — that would be besmirching my honor and duties to this storehouse, nojya.[pc.ra kitsune| That, and as always, I have perfect faith in your eventual victory, my [pc.mf|lord|lady].] "So, how about it, nojya? Very good deal, isn't it?"
rows.translation: “我们有时会在树林里发现奇怪物品，其他狐窟也会把找到的东西送到这里，以便利用女族长的知识与经验，诺雅。尤其是这件东西，是另一个狐窟最近送来的……” 说话间，琥珀把手探进书桌旁的小盒子，取出一个以金属加固的罐子。你注意到，符文沿容器全长铭刻，环绕着它的圆柱形外壳[pc.bg arcanist scholar |；你甚至认出其中部分具有抑制与防护作用。不管里面装着什么，威力肯定相当惊人 ]。 好吧。那么，它是什么？ “我们的女族长已经认出这件物品是灵脉水晶手雷，我的[pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|领主|女主人]|朋友]，一件神战遗物。它是种相当可怕的武器，一经引爆，便会以惊人力量爆炸。我们原本想把它送往其他狐窟，供他们在采矿远征中使用……不过，让它仅仅用于搬运土石似乎太浪费了。” 这么说，机会就摆在你眼前，对吧？ “正是！如今世界再次陷入危机，我们没有理由不把上次战争的所有军械搬出来使用……对一件武器而言，没有比为完成受造使命而消亡更光荣的结局了，诺雅。我非常愿意让它加入这项事业……当然，得付钱。” 啊，总归是为了钱，对吧？ “俗话说[pc.ra kitsune|，我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]]：新兵谈战斗，老兵谈战略，大师谈后勤。万分抱歉，不过我不能白白把它送给你——那会玷污我的荣誉，也有违我对这座仓库的职责，诺雅。[pc.ra kitsune|而且一如既往，我完全相信你终会胜利，我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]。] “所以，意下如何，诺雅？这笔买卖很划算，对不对？”

rows.original: "Eeeh... being out in the world and doing all kinds of brave deeds is all well and good, but one must remember to have some rest and relaxation every now and then!" Kohaku says with a chuckle. The little golden-furred kitsune points to a stiff paper box atop her desk, and breaks into a disarming grin. "[pc.ra kitsune |And for the honorable champion of our divine lord, I have only the best! Anything else would be sacrilege, nojya! Luxuries of the kind the Imperial Court can only dream of, luxuries money, authority and influence cannot buy!" Psst, she's talking up her wares just a little too much. After all, if you can't buy whatever it is she's got with money, then there's no point in her making her pitch, is there? Little Kohaku doesn't even skip a beat. "Ah, but for you, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]... a small donation in return would be appreciated, of course. Just so that divine law is fulfilled, and imbalances are corrected, nojya. But first! I have yet to even unveil what it is I have in store for your eminence!" |And for our favorite outs — northerner, I have only the best, rest assured! Delights that would interest even the most decadent of old Belhar, nojya! Here with me is a luxury that will surely make you feel as if you're flying to the heavens! ]" Well, she's talking a good game, trying to build up suspense and interest here. Let's see what she actually has, though. "Of course, of course!" Without further ado, Kohaku reaches into the stiff paper box, undoes the cushioned packing, and brings out a small flask of colorless fluid. The sweet, enticing smell it gives off is plain to behold even through the glass, temptingly tantalising on the tip of your tongue, and you feel a certain something or the other tighten in the pit of your stomach. This is... Kohaku's grin turns from mischievous to downright devious, her large, triangular ears wiggling non-stop. "Razorcup nectar[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]." Razorcup nectar... the stuff of legends. [pc.bg barbarian hunter |You've been to places where these grow, but the thorns of the razorcup were always too much a deterrent for the miniscule amount of nectar that could be extracted from a single bush, let alone a single blossom. Even the couple of thimblefuls Kohaku's got in her hand must've taken an immense amount of time and patience to extract. |Everyone's heard about this stuff, it was the kind of thing the elite of old Belhar drank to show how obscenely wealthy they were. If you had the wherewithal to source, purchase and then serve razorcup nectar to your guests, you had to be someone to burn money like that. ] Must've been a pretty nice find for her. "Business in the Winter City has been going well, nojya. The boer'alvar are the only people remaining in the region who have the mindset for tasks like collecting razorcup nectar; I know I wouldn't have the patience for it, nojya. But even druids living in the forest need things that they can't produce themselves, and they're much more comfortable bartering with us than their estranged kin. "So, how about it[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" [pc.bg noblescion |Well, well... guess it wouldn't be too out of place for you to be having a sip, if it comes to that. After all, as a noble scion, you're the heritor of what lineages remained after the Godswar... although there admittedly is questionable wisdom in retracing the footsteps of your ancestors. |Hmm, it's tempting, but it also seems out of your place to have something this ostentatious. Razorcup nectar... the intricacies would probably be lost on you, like fine wine being served up in a seedy country tavern. And yet... ] Hmmmmm. Kohaku's smile just broadens and she rubs hands and wrists alike together. "It is quite a luxury, my [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend], one that should be savoured to the utmost. Even pastries made with famous tiger butter can't hold a candle to a single drop of such delectable nectar. I would be greatly honored if you would consider my offer deeply, nojya." Well, about that...
rows.translation: 呃……在外面闯荡、做各种勇敢的事情固然很好，但也要记得偶尔休息一下，放松一下才行啊！琥珀笑着说道。这只毛色金黄的小狐妖指了指她桌子上那个硬纸盒，然后露出一个让人感到安心的笑容。"[pc.ra kitsune |而对于我们神圣主君这位尊贵的冠军，我所能准备的只有最珍贵的礼物！其他的任何东西都简直是亵渎神明，不可饶恕！这些奢华之物，是连皇室都只能梦寐以求的，是金钱、权力和影响力都无法买到的珍宝！ 嘘，她只是在稍微夸夸自己的产品而已。太确实。毕竟，如果你用钱也买不到她拥有的东西，那么她再怎么推销也没意义，对吧？ 小红甚至没有丝毫犹豫。啊，但是为了你我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]当然，如果大家能稍献一份小小的捐赠，我们将不胜感激。这样，神圣的法则才能得到遵守，失衡的局面也能得到纠正，nojya。不过首先！我还没有来得及告诉大家，我究竟为各位准备了什么惊喜呢！ |而对于我们最喜欢的特色美食——来自北方的美食，我可只准备了最上等的佳肴，放心吧！这些美味甚至会让那些最崇尚奢华的古老贝尔哈人也会感到满意，真的！现在我带来的这些奢侈品，一定会让你有一种仿佛正在飞向天堂的愉悦感！ ]" 嗯，她说得倒挺有说服力的，试图营造出紧张感和兴趣氛围。不过，我们还是看看她到底有什么招数吧。 当然，当然！毫不迟疑，小红伸手进入那个硬纸盒，拆开里面的缓冲包装，取出一小瓶无色液体。那种甜美诱人的气味，即使透过玻璃瓶也能清晰地闻到；这种味道让人忍不住想要尝一尝，仿佛会让人舌尖上的味蕾产生难以抗拒的冲动，同时也会让人的胃部产生某种特殊的反应。 这……究竟是什么？ 小红的笑容从调皮变成了狡黠，她那大而三角形的耳朵不停地晃动着。剃刀杯花蜜[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]。" 剃刀杯花蜜……传说中的珍品。 [pc.bg barbarian hunter |你曾经去过那些这种植物生长的地方，但剃刀草的刺实在太过碍事了——从一株植物上，甚至是一朵花上，能采集到的花蜜量实在微乎其微。就连琥珀手中那一点点花蜜，想必也是她耗费了大量时间和耐心才采集到的。 |大家都听说过这种东西，过去在贝尔哈尔，只有那些极其富有的人才会饮用它，以此来炫耀自己的财富。如果你有能力采购、购买这种“剃刀杯花蜜”并招待客人，那肯定说明你是个不把钱当回事的人。 ] 对她来说，这肯定是一笔相当不错的收获。 在冬城，生意一直很顺利，诺雅。在这个地区，只有那些布尔阿尔瓦人才有耐心去采集剃刀杯花蜜这类东西；我是知道的。我可没有耐心去做这种事，诺雅。不过，即便是生活在森林里的德鲁伊，也需要一些他们自己无法生产的东西，而且与我们进行交易，他们比与那些疏远的族人交易要自在得多。 那么，你觉得怎么样？[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]？" [pc.bg noblescion |嗯，嗯……如果真到了那一步，你喝上一口应该也不会太不合时宜吧。毕竟，作为贵族的后裔，你是那些在神战之后仍然延续下来的家族的继承者……不过，追随你祖先的脚步，说实话，也确实有些不明智之处。 |嗯，这确实很诱人，但这种过于奢华的东西似乎也不太适合你。剃刀杯花蜜……其中的精妙之处你可能根本无法理解，就如同在一家破旧的乡村酒馆里享用高级葡萄酒一样。不过…… ] 嗯…… 小白的笑容更加灿烂了，她将双手和手腕相互摩擦着。这可真是种奢侈啊，我的[pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]这种美味绝对值得细细品味。即便是用著名的虎脂制作的糕点，也无法与这一滴如此美味的甘露相媲美。如果您能认真考虑我的提议，我将感到无上荣幸，诺雅。 嗯，关于那个……
rows.raw: " "Eeeh... being out in the world and doing all kinds of brave deeds is all well and good, but one must remember to have some rest and relaxation every now and then!" Kohaku says with a chuckle. The little golden-furred kitsune points to a stiff paper box atop her desk, and breaks into a disarming grin. "[pc.ra kitsune |And for the honorable champion of our divine lord, I have only the best! Anything else would be sacrilege, nojya! Luxuries of the kind the Imperial Court can only dream of, luxuries money, authority and influence cannot buy!" Psst, she's talking up her wares just a little too much. After all, if you can't buy whatever it is she's got with money, then there's no point in her making her pitch, is there? Little Kohaku doesn't even skip a beat. "Ah, but for you, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]... a small donation in return would be appreciated, of course. Just so that divine law is fulfilled, and imbalances are corrected, nojya. But first! I have yet to even unveil what it is I have in store for your eminence!" |And for our favorite outs — northerner, I have only the best, rest assured! Delights that would interest even the most decadent of old Belhar, nojya! Here with me is a luxury that will surely make you feel as if you're flying to the heavens! ]" Well, she's talking a good game, trying to build up suspense and interest here. Let's see what she actually has, though. "Of course, of course!" Without further ado, Kohaku reaches into the stiff paper box, undoes the cushioned packing, and brings out a small flask of colorless fluid. The sweet, enticing smell it gives off is plain to behold even through the glass, temptingly tantalising on the tip of your tongue, and you feel a certain something or the other tighten in the pit of your stomach. This is... Kohaku's grin turns from mischievous to downright devious, her large, triangular ears wiggling non-stop. "Razorcup nectar[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]." Razorcup nectar... the stuff of legends. [pc.bg barbarian hunter |You've been to places where these grow, but the thorns of the razorcup were always too much a deterrent for the miniscule amount of nectar that could be extracted from a single bush, let alone a single blossom. Even the couple of thimblefuls Kohaku's got in her hand must've taken an immense amount of time and patience to extract. |Everyone's heard about this stuff, it was the kind of thing the elite of old Belhar drank to show how obscenely wealthy they were. If you had the wherewithal to source, purchase and then serve razorcup nectar to your guests, you had to be someone to burn money like that. ] Must've been a pretty nice find for her. "Business in the Winter City has been going well, nojya. The boer'alvar are the only people remaining in the region who have the mindset for tasks like collecting razorcup nectar; I know I wouldn't have the patience for it, nojya. But even druids living in the forest need things that they can't produce themselves, and they're much more comfortable bartering with us than their estranged kin. "So, how about it[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" [pc.bg noblescion |Well, well... guess it wouldn't be too out of place for you to be having a sip, if it comes to that. After all, as a noble scion, you're the heritor of what lineages remained after the Godswar... although there admittedly is questionable wisdom in retracing the footsteps of your ancestors. |Hmm, it's tempting, but it also seems out of your place to have something this ostentatious. Razorcup nectar... the intricacies would probably be lost on you, like fine wine being served up in a seedy country tavern. And yet... ] Hmmmmm. Kohaku's smile just broadens and she rubs hands and wrists alike together. "It is quite a luxury, my [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend], one that should be savoured to the utmost. Even pastries made with famous tiger butter can't hold a candle to a single drop of such delectable nectar. I would be greatly honored if you would consider my offer deeply, nojya." Well, about that... "

rows.raw: "As exclusive as this rare offer might be, you think you'll pass."

rows.original: "Aaah, today's offer is something truly special. My apologies, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady], ]but I can't divulge just how I got my hands on this exceedingly rare and valuable merchandise. Suffice to say... this is something you will definitely want to have on you in your ventures[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]." Oh? What is it? Smiling that little smile of hers, Kohaku folds her ears forward and reaches into her furred cloth top. With great care, the golden-furred kitsune produces a lovely crystal vial filled with clear liquid, holding it between thumb and forefinger. She shakes it a little, and golden motes of light erupt into view within the liquid, dancing and swirling with the motion. "The tears of a goddess, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend]. Precious beyond compare. Born when she was tricked by a vampire lord into murdering her own father, and shed when she realized that fact. This substance is not of this world... and yet it is here to lend its strength to our cause, nojya." You can't help but feel that Kohaku is talking up her wares just a little too much. The tears of a foreign goddess from another world? That's a lot to swallow... still, if she wants to play this game, you'll play along. So, how exactly are these tears supposed to help? "All of the goddess' tears couldn't bring her father back from the dead — nor anyone for that matter, but for mortals like us they can drag someone back from the brink of beyond. This isn't something a mere merchant like me could get much use out of, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend], but I think it could be exceedingly valuable for you. While I have the utmost confidence in your abilities to secure victory, it would still be better to have such insurance and not need it, rather than need it and not have it, am I right?" Kohaku shakes the vial again, and the dancing motes of light speed from one side of the crystal vial to the other. "Don't worry, nojya. The container is incredibly hard to shatter. The treasure will be kept safe... until it is ready to be used. "So, how about it, nojya? Such a treasure could make all the difference in the world..." Hmm...
rows.translation: 啊，今天的优惠活动真是特别划算。实在抱歉[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]， ]但我不能透露自己究竟是如何得到这件极其稀有且价值连城的物品的。总之……在你的冒险旅程中，这件东西绝对是你必须拥有的。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]。" 哦？是什么东西？ 科哈克露出她那特有的微笑，将耳朵向前折叠，然后把手伸进她那件毛茸茸的布料上衣里。这只金毛狐小心翼翼地取出一只装满透明液体的水晶小瓶，用拇指和食指将其握住。她轻轻摇晃了一下瓶子，那些金色的光点立刻在液体中闪烁起来，随着瓶子的晃动而舞动、旋转。 女神的泪水， [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]无与伦比地珍贵。当她被一位吸血鬼领主欺骗，被迫杀害自己的父亲时，这种物质应运而生；而当她意识到这一事实时，这种物质又消失了。这种物质本不属于这个世界……然而，它却来到了这里，为我们的事业贡献它的力量，诺雅。 你不禁会觉得，琥珀只是在夸耀自己的产品罢了小的太夸张了。一个来自另一个世界的陌生女神的眼泪？这实在让人难以接受……不过，如果她想玩这个游戏，你也就只能配合她了。那么，这些眼泪究竟该如何发挥作用呢？ 女神的所有泪水都无法让她的父亲从死亡中复活——事实上，对任何人来说都是如此。但对我们这样的凡人来说，这些泪水却能够将某人从死亡的边缘拉回来。对于我这样一个普通的商人来说，这种力量实在没有什么用处[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]但我认为这对你来说可能会非常有价值。虽然我对你取得胜利的能力充满信心，但拥有这样的保障总归是好的——总比需要它却无法得到它要好，对吧？ 琥珀再次摇晃那个小瓶子，那些闪烁的光点便在水晶瓶的内部快速移动，从这一侧飞到另一侧。别担心，诺雅。这个容器非常坚固，根本不可能被打碎。那些财宝会安全地被保存起来……直到它们被需要的时候。 那么，诺雅，你怎么看？这样的宝藏绝对能改变一切…… 嗯……

rows.original: Know what? She's managed to pique your interest, and the price she's asking sounds fair, given what's on offer here. You'll take it. Kohaku closes her eyes and bows deeply. "Your business is very much appreciated[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]! Thank you very much!" While you count out your coins, Kohaku busies herself with wrapping up your newest acquisition, making sure it'll stow away neatly with your other possessions. Ever so polite and enthusiastic, the little golden-furred kitsune hands you your purchase when you're done, sweeping your coin into a little box. "Now then, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|friend], if you'd like to browse my more common wares or even simply stay and enjoy the company, you're more than welcome to, nojya. It is by Keros' blessing that the den is so abundant as to have such surplus to sell you — let us always keep that in our minds!
rows.translation: 你知道吗？她成功地引起了你的兴趣，而且考虑到这里提供的条件，她要求的价钱听起来也很合理。你一定会接受的。 小花闭上了眼睛，深深地鞠了一躬。非常感谢您的支持与帮助。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]非常感谢您！ 当你清点手中的硬币时，小红会忙着将你新买的东西包好，确保它能和其他物品一起整齐地被收好。这个金毛小狐总是那么有礼貌、那么热情周到，当你数完硬币后，它会把你的购买物品递给你，同时把你的硬币收进一个小盒子里。 那么， [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]如果你想浏览我那些比较常见的商品，或者只是想在这里闲逛、享受片刻的陪伴，也完全欢迎你，诺雅。正是凯罗斯的恩赐，才让我们有这么多多余的货物可以出售给你——让我们永远铭记这一点吧！

In the meantime, if you wish to browse my more common wares, you're more than welcome to do so, — it is by Keros' blessing that the den is so abundant as to have such surplus to sell you, nojya. Let us always keep that in our minds!"
rows.translation: 小白闭上了眼睛，鞠了一躬。如你所愿。 [pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]|朋友]也许以后我还能通过其他渠道再弄到一个……谁知道呢？不过，如果你想看看我平时出售的那些商品，随时都可以哦。多亏了凯罗斯的庇佑，我们才有这么多库存可以供应给你，诺雅。让我们永远铭记这一点吧！

rows.original: "You want one of the outfits Kura wears, nojya?" Kohaku [pc.mascFem|seems befuddled|smiles]. "You know they only make them for women, right[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" Be that as it may, you didn't ask Kura without at least thinking that might be the case. Can she get you one or not? "Yes,[pc.ra kitsune| my [pc.mf|lord|lady],]" she starts. However, the [silly|nojyaholic|storemanager] isn't quite satisfied with her answer. Skirting around it by brushing her own skirt, the girl idly looks between around the storeroom. It's not until she finds the nerves to look up that you notice her biting at the corner of her lip with a tiny fang. "So the best way I can put it? It... wouldn't be cheap. I mean like really expensive, nojya. [pc.ra kitsune|You are one of us, so, it's not as if I can't get it!|It's very difficult to get, even for one of our own.] It's just going to cost around two-thousand of your fancy coins?" "Wait, two-thousand electrum!?" The number definitely took you off-guard but judging on how Kohaku jumped, it's obvious that the girl at least somewhat expected your response. Most people would probably act that way. "Isn't it just a suit and some cloth? Why so much?" Kohaku presses her fingertips together and that fang of hers slips away in-place of her merchant's smile. Although she's putting up an act, the girl's attempt to try and quell any anger is at least appreciated. "Well, for starters... the material, no matter what, has to be special ordered. And I'll need to have someone make the suit, nojya. Rather than make each suit custom to every kunoichi, we have to preserve the stuff too. It may not be that pleasing[pc.ra kitsune| [pc.mf|lord|lady]] [pc.name] but I promise it'll fit! No need for me or anyone to put our hands on your almost-naked form, caressing and touching and— nojya!" The girl's eager expression and mumbling are adorable in their own way. In others, you just hope the short girl isn't in danger of getting lost in her imagination. However, her babbling at least gives you time to decide: do you order it or push it off?
rows.translation: “你想要一套仓穿的衣服，诺雅？”琥珀[pc.mascFem|似乎感到困惑|微笑起来]。“你知道他们只为女人制作这种衣服，对吧[pc.ra kitsune|，我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]]？” 话虽如此，你向仓询问之前，当然至少考虑过这种可能。她究竟能不能替你弄到一套？ “能，[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]，]”她开口说道。然而，这位[silly|诺雅成瘾者|仓库主管]对自己的回答并不太满意。她用手抚弄裙摆，绕着问题兜圈子，又漫不经心地环顾仓库。直到终于鼓起勇气抬头，你才注意到她正用一颗小獠牙咬着唇角。 “所以，最直白地说？它……不会便宜。我是说，真的非常昂贵，诺雅。[pc.ra kitsune|你是我们的一员，所以我并不是弄不到！|就算是我们自己人，也很难弄到。]只是大概会花掉两千枚你那些漂亮钱币？” “等等，两千枚琥珀金币！？”这个数字确实令你措手不及；不过看琥珀吓了一跳的模样，女孩显然多少预料到了你的反应。大多数人恐怕都会这样。“那不就是一套紧身衣和几块布吗？为什么这么贵？” 琥珀把指尖抵在一起，小獠牙也缩了回去，取而代之的是商人式微笑。虽然她在故作姿态，不过女孩试图平息你可能产生的怒气，至少值得赞赏。 “嗯，首先……无论怎样，材料都必须专门订购。而且我得请人制作紧身衣，诺雅。我们不会按每个女忍者的身体分别定制，而是必须把材料也保存好。这或许不会太令人满意[pc.ra kitsune|，[pc.mf|领主|女主人]][pc.name]，不过我保证一定合身！根本不需要我或其他人把手放到你几乎赤裸的身体上，不断爱抚、触摸，然后——诺雅！” 女孩急切的神情和低声嘟囔自有几分可爱。从另一个角度说，你只希望这个矮小姑娘不会沉迷于想象，最终在里面迷路。不过，她的喋喋不休至少给了你时间决定：要订购，还是推迟？
rows.raw: " "You want one of the outfits Kura wears, nojya?" Kohaku [pc.mascFem|seems befuddled|smiles]. "You know they only make them for women, right[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]?" Be that as it may, you didn't ask Kura without at least thinking that might be the case. Can she get you one or not? "Yes,[pc.ra kitsune| my [pc.mf|lord|lady],]" she starts. However, the [silly|nojyaholic|storemanager] isn't quite satisfied with her answer. Skirting around it by brushing her own skirt, the girl idly looks between around the storeroom. It's not until she finds the nerves to look up that you notice her biting at the corner of her lip with a tiny fang. "So the best way I can put it? It... wouldn't be cheap. I mean like really expensive, nojya. [pc.ra kitsune|You are one of us, so, it's not as if I can't get it!|It's very difficult to get, even for one of our own.] It's just going to cost around two-thousand of your fancy coins?" "Wait, two-thousand electrum!?" The number definitely took you off-guard but judging on how Kohaku jumped, it's obvious that the girl at least somewhat expected your response. Most people would probably act that way. "Isn't it just a suit and some cloth? Why so much?" Kohaku presses her fingertips together and that fang of hers slips away in-place of her merchant's smile. Although she's putting up an act, the girl's attempt to try and quell any anger is at least appreciated. "Well, for starters... the material, no matter what, has to be special ordered. And I'll need to have someone make the suit, nojya. Rather than make each suit custom to every kunoichi, we have to preserve the stuff too. It may not be that pleasing[pc.ra kitsune| [pc.mf|lord|lady]] [pc.name] but I promise it'll fit! No need for me or anyone to put our hands on your almost-naked form, caressing and touching and— nojya!" The girl's eager expression and mumbling are adorable in their own way. In others, you just hope the short girl isn't in danger of getting lost in her imagination. However, her babbling at least gives you time to decide: do you order it or push it off? "

The concept of the rules being bypassed doesn't seem to sit well with her. "W-what do you mean, nojya!? A favor? But-" "Kohaku, it'll be fine! Besides, wouldn't it bring you more business if I walked around in a sexy outfit like that? Everyone would be over here buying outfits like it for weeks. Isn't that worth the loss?" Kohaku looks you up and downn; like a kitsune caught in the fucklights, the storehouse manager shakily reaches out and grabs her ledger. It takes a few more bashful glances between the paper and you before Kohaku gulps down a breath and starts dragging her quill across and signing her ink in.|You put the large bundle of money on the top of her desk. "Oh! You have all the money, nojya?" Kohaku happily pulls the bag open, examining it for a few moments before tightening it back up. Either she counts fast or she's seen this much enough times that it's believably the right amount.] "Okay," she [pc.ra kitsune|whines between her resigned grumbles. "Just... urgh. Just don't tell anyone, nojya. If everyone started coming for handouts, my [pc.mf|lord|lady], we would be in a lot of trouble. Not a word! |chimes, tapping the quill and setting the ledger back down before taking the large sack of coins over the counter and dropping it at her feet. "]Come back in a few days to pick it up, alright?[pc.ra kitsune| You'll be able to pay me back another day since you're one of us now anyway, nojya.]"

rows.original:
You wait until Kohaku calms down a bit — which is honestly a tad longer than a few minutes — but once she's paying attention you share the news. "I'll need to think about it. Is it okay if I come by another time if I bring the money?"

        Kohaku puts on a disappointed frown but the foxgirl's tails sway merrily behind her, the small girl patting your shoulder. Although the merchant must be hopeful to make a sale, it's obvious she's not going to misunderstand your situation.
        
        "Okay! Anytime you get the money, feel free to come back and place the order whenever I'm around! I assure you we'd make only the best quality goods for you, nojya!"
rows.translation:
你等到琥珀稍微冷静下来——说实话，这比几分钟要稍久一点——但等她终于把注意力转过来，你才把这个消息告诉了她。“我需要好好考虑一下。如果我带钱再来一趟，可以吗？”

        琥珀摆出一副失望的皱眉表情，但这位狐娘的尾巴却在她身后欢快地摇摆着，这个小个子女孩还拍了拍你的肩膀。虽然这位商人肯定盼着能做成这笔买卖，但显然她不会误解你的处境。
        
        “好的！等你什么时候拿到钱，只要我在，随时都可以回来下单！我向你保证，我们只会为你制作最优质的商品，诺雅！”

rows.original:
"Yes! Your outfit! I almost forgot! So sorry[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]| [pc.name]]!"

    "It's fine," you [pc.mascFem|chuckle|giggle]. The kitsune girl pouts and considers telling you some lengthy story, yet shuffling through the goods at her desk leaves you aptly patient and quietly lacking the familiar ramblings of the den's spry merchant.
    
    However, that silence ends when she pumps her fist with a celebratory hiss, hoisting up a bundled package that easily fills her full grasp. Kohaku hustles her way back over and beams that fangy-smile of hers, shifting back side-to-side. As excited and cute as the display is, you eventually hold out your hands and get the package slapped down into your grasp. She silently waits for you to undo the bindings and open it up, pulling the wrapping off and revealing a magnificent bodysuit and tabard. Although similarly colored, Kohaku is quick to pry her way into your view and set her hands on the bodysuit.
    
    "So," she chimes. "What do you think, nojya? [pc.ra kitsune|I know your body kinda changes from time-to-time my [pc.mf|lord|lady], but this material?|You should be pleased with this material, you know?] It can stretch and accommodate whatever the wearer's body type is like. One size fits all! Erm... mostly. I don't know if it'd fit-well on someone [party.has brint|like Brint[pc.ra minotaur| and you]|[pc.isHeight 80|much bigger than you|the size of a minotaur]] but it'll fit, nojya!"
    
    "I appreciate it. This is really a nice thing you-"
    
    "Oh, oh — oops, sorry[pc.ra kitsune| my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]! — I forgot something! Lift the tabard!"
    
    Kohaku bounces up and down, looking between the bundle of clothing and your face without missing a beat. The girl seems content to see this through and when you pull the tabard off the bodysuit, you see why: a small bandolier of blades lies nestled within, each of them perfectly-sized for throwing. Now that you can see it, Kohaku makes sure you aptly see nothing but her close-up grin.
    
    "So!? It's a bonus! Kura said to give them to you! So you can be like the kunoichi, nojya!"
    
    These two really are something. You pat the short girl's head, lighting her up a bright cherry red whilst putting your new possessions away. Even by the time you're settling your new pack of blades away, Kohaku's lewd-inspired eyes are affixed to your hands before she straightens her short stature up.
    
    "Nojya... what will I do with you, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady]|[pc.name]]?"
rows.translation:
“对了！你的衣服！我差点忘了！万分抱歉[pc.ra kitsune|，我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]|，[pc.name]]！”

    “没关系，”你[pc.mascFem|轻声笑道|咯咯笑道]。狐族姑娘噘起嘴，似乎想给你讲个长篇故事；不过她只是在书桌上的货物中翻找，让你耐心等待，耳边也难得少了狐窟活泼商人那熟悉的唠叨。
    
    然而，她发出庆祝胜利般的嘶声、挥拳欢呼时，沉默就此结束；她举起一个包好的包裹，大小刚好塞满双手。琥珀急忙跑回你面前，露出带有獠牙的灿烂笑容，身体左右摆动。表演固然兴奋可爱，你最终还是伸出双手，让包裹啪地落入掌中。她默默等着你解开束带、打开包装；你扯下包裹，露出一件华丽的连体衣和战袍。两者颜色相近，不过琥珀立刻挤进你的视野，双手按住连体衣。
    
    “所以，”她欢快地说道。“你觉得怎么样，诺雅？[pc.ra kitsune|我知道你的身体偶尔会发生变化，我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]，不过这种材料？|你应该会对这种材料满意，知道吗？]它能够伸缩，适应穿戴者的任何体形。一种尺寸适合所有人！呃……大体如此。我不知道穿在[party.has brint|布林特那样的人身上[pc.ra minotaur|，还有你身上]|[pc.isHeight 80|比你高大得多的人身上|弥诺陶洛斯那么大的人身上]]是否贴身，不过肯定能穿，诺雅！”
    
    “谢谢。这真是件很棒的——”
    
    “哦，哦——哎呀，对不起[pc.ra kitsune|，我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]]！——我忘了一样东西！掀起战袍！”
    
    琥珀上下蹦跳，目光不停地在衣物和你的脸之间来回移动。女孩显然决心看完整个过程；当你从连体衣上掀开战袍，便明白了原因：里面藏着一条小型飞刀带，每柄刀的尺寸都恰好适合投掷。等你终于看到它，琥珀则确保近在眼前的灿烂笑容占满你的视野。
    
    “怎么样！？这是赠品！仓说要把它们送给你！这样你就能像女忍者一样了，诺雅！”
    
    这两个姑娘还真有一套。你拍拍矮个女孩的脑袋，令她满脸变得像樱桃一样通红，同时收好新物品。即便你已经把新得的飞刀收进行囊，琥珀那双因淫念而明亮的眼睛依旧牢牢盯着你的手；随后她才挺直矮小的身躯。
    
    “诺雅……我该拿你怎么办呢，[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女主人]|[pc.name]]？”

rows.original:
As you enter the storehouse, Kohaku comes bounding up to you, a big smile on her face as she [pc.ra kitsune
        |stops at the appropriate distance from you and gives you a deep bow from the waist. "Oh! Your Eminence! Your Eminence! I was hoping that you'd drop in today, nojya! His divine lordship must have heard my wishes, because barely an hour later you come by!
        |closes the distance at an astonishing speed and cosies up to you with her tails. "Oh! Oh! It's you, nojya! I was really, really hoping you'd drop in today — the gods must have been reading my mind, because you show up barely an hour later!
    ]"
    
    You catch the excitable little fox in your hands and smile, giving her a good petting between the ears. Somewhere in the back of your mind you know that Kohaku is being extremely and inordinately cute, which implies that she probably wants something out of you... but then again, you shouldn't refuse the deal without trying to negotiate or even seeing the price, eh?
    
    All right, what's the matter?
    
    "Ah! I got this specially ordered from the Old Country as a thank-you gift for Kinu, since she saved my life and all — that, and the lives of three of my people! Youhei's death weighs upon us all, but if not for her bravery, none of us would be here today, nojya."
    
    Ah...yes. Kinu mentioned that she was going to attend someone's funerary rites when you talked to her about everything that happened. But back to the point, though — if Kohaku has a thank-you gift for your daughter, where do you come into the picture?
    
    "We-ll[pc.ra kitsune
        |, your Eminence
    ]..." 
    
    Did something happen?
    
    "She didn't want it, nojya."
    
    Now that's surprising. Given the intricate web of obligations and respect that forms kitsune culture, turning down a gift like this has to be some breach of etiquette or the other[kinu.isInari
        | — while Kinu might be blunt enough to flatly turn down a gift if she didn't want it, she'd have a good reason for doing so, and you can't fathom one at the moment. Well, not one that would warrant such a refusal, at any rate
        |. It's certainly not like Kinu, ever so aware of the people around her and the need to be polite, to directly state such a refusal. For that to happen, she must've had a very good reason, you're sure
    ].[pc.ra kitsune
        | You haven't been one of the foxen for very long, and you already know that much.
    ]
    
    "We-ll..." Kohaku does a little pout. "She said [kinu.isInari
        |she didn't believe in good fortune, nojya. That luck and fortune, while being very real, weren't things that one should rely upon and use as an excuse to grow lax. She didn't like the idea of relying on things outside of her control... 
        |she didn't feel like she deserved it in the least, nojya. That it was her job to keep us safe, by force of arms if necessary, and the fact that we had two casualties proved that she hadn't done a very good job. You shouldn't reward incompetence, that's what she said.
    ]"
    
    That certainly sounds like something Kinu would say. [kinu.isInari
        |Your fox-daughter's always been about being independent and working under her own power — you just wish that even if she doesn't want to trust in something as capricious as fortune, she'd at least allow other people to help her.
        
        "She let me help her a lot back there, nojya."
        
        That... well, Kohaku is correct, but even so.
        |She can be very hard on herself when it comes to her and her perceived role in relation to others — but some things were really out of her hands in that encounter and she shouldn't be beating herself up over it constantly. Where's "nothing can be done about it" when you need it?
        
        "That's not exactly the intent of that saying, nojya..."
        
        You just want your fox-daughter to not hold herself responsible for things that happen beyond her power. Problem is, her limits are supposed to be vast... 
    ]
    
    "Uh, um, well!" Kohaku's trademark cheery smile pops back onto her beaming face. "She said that I should pass it on to you[pc.ra kitsune
        |, your Eminence

rows.original: So, what happens now? She's informed you of what you've made together, but what are her plans? "Give our child better memories growing up than I did, for one," Kohaku replies, patting [kohaku.anyKids |the kit on her head |her round tummy with satisfaction ]. "It'd be nice to be able to remember what your parents' faces look like without having to think hard on the matter, nojya." Well, now that you know what's up with her, there'll be more of a reason to visit her more regularly in the future. Kohaku [pc.ra kitsune |looks at you askance, and when she speaks her heart clearly isn't in her words. "If your Eminence would, I am thankful for your presence." |squints at you. "Promise?" ] Unless she's saying that she and her kit aren't compelling reasons? Kohaku [pc.ra kitsune |struggles not to pout in the presence of authority, and fails. A social butterfly like her has to know that it's not really making her look genuinely angry or threatening in the least, right? |pouts, ears folding back against her head. "Uuuu..." ] Now, on a more serious note — this is what she gets for acting on a whim and wanting things while also not wanting them. It's like the story of the lupine who went cart-chasing — he had absolutely no idea what to do when he finally caught the vehicle, much like Kohaku now. And you know that this is absolutely true, because if anything were genuinely pinnable on you she'd be up on you front and center for [pc.mf |fathering |siring ] a fluffball on another one of her important functionaries. The way Kohaku's cheeks color as she taps her fingers together and curls her tails about her fattened hips and thighs defensively makes it clear that you've hit the nail on the head. "I-I still haven't figured out how she knew I kicked you in the back of the knees, nojya." Could be any number of reasons — you remember yelling pretty loudly when she did just that, and the walls can't be very thick. Or she asked Miko or Mai to do a divination when the matter made itself apparent. Or... well, who knows what a being like her is capable of. And out of curiosity, just what did she say? Kohaku flinches[pc.ra kitsune |, knowing full well that there isn't a way to dodge the direct question. "Well, your Eminence |. She got smacked that hard, huh? Little wonder that the poor thing was looking for some reassurance from you that it wasn't all her doing. "Eeeeh... well ], there are some words she used that don't translate perfectly, but to make a long story short if I didn't want to be with child I should either have prevented your seed from taking root, or had you pull out when there was an opportunity to instead of... you know. Were you really limping for three days after the fact, nojya?" [pc.isDK |It damn well felt like it |You're not sure how it'd look to others, but it certainly gave a new meaning to not being able to walk straight ]. "I... I'm sorry, nojya." Aah, it's too late for that[pc.isDK | | and besides, you're sorry yourself for making her worry ]. So, that was all Komari said? Kohaku's blush deepens, and she continues grinding a hole in the floor with her feet. "Well, since I clearly had every intent of doing this, I was obviously ready to bear the consequences of my actions, nojya. Which amount to this. Miko keeps on teasing me about divine punishment for unscrupulous merchants, but I don't think that this is any kind of retribution." She hugs [kohaku.anyKids |her kit a little tighter |her round tummy close to her ]. You sigh and grab Kohaku by her ample ass and thick thighs, pulling her close. She squeals and grabs at your legs with her tails, but melts into your embrace when she realizes what you're doing. She does want the kit, right? "[pc.ra kitsune |It's my honor to bear you a child, your Eminence |I do, which is why I went to all that trouble even if it was in the heat of the moment ], but... when I think back on it perhaps the circumstances could have been better, nojya. But it's what it is, and it can't be helped at this juncture. We can't keep on waiting for the perfect moment to close the sale or nothing would ever get done." Well then it looks like Kohaku's calmed down a little from being all huffy at first. With her petulance dissipated, the little golden fox gives you a [pc.ra kitsune |bow |nod ], then pads back up the steps to her perch overlooking the storehouse. When all this began you had the suspicion that something like this was bound to happen, but seeing it become reality throws on another sobering layer atop it all. You'll be visiting Kohaku and taking good care of her from here on out, right? Right? [party.has kiyoko |It takes a little while for you to sort out your thoughts, start your train of thought back on the right path, but eventually the warm yet insistent sensation of your fox-wife's presence by your side draws your attention. She's been quiet all this while, hasn't she? A nod. "It was clear that little Kobayashi needed some kind of release for what was brewing inside of her before she exploded, Beloved; thank you for handling that so adroitly. No doubt her innate good nature helped, but being with child is an experience that can test even the best dispositions. You were best positioned to handle the matter, so I did not intervene as the addition of a third party would likely have changed the dynamic of the situation and made matters worse." Well, it's now over. If she doesn't mind, what are her thoughts on this whole matter? Any big social implications for Kohaku? Kiyoko contemplates the matter a moment, the usual activity of the storehouse starting back up around the both of you as she thinks. "I have probably mentioned it before, but no matter how well-dressed it is, the fact still remains that the colonies have, in the centuries of my absence from this world, become the dumping ground for the eccentric, unwanted, and shameful; in this place, there is not that much further to fall. Kiyoko being uninformed as to social graces? The gods forbid! Your fox-wife chuckles at that. "Dear [pc.mf |husband |beloved ], while a single settlement may appear monolithic in its nature, I would not base the behavior of all lupines on the mannerisms of the inhabitants of Hawkethorne, would I? [pc.ra kitsune |Being who you are, you do have a duty to be kind to her, as with all subjects in your care, do you not? |Given who you are and the circumstances laying blame upon her mischief, you certainly do not have a social obligation to be kind to her... but matters of a personal nature stem from a different source, mm? ]" Well then, her opinion on the subject is much appreciated. rows.translation: 那么，现在会发生什么呢？她已经告诉了你你们一起创造出了什么，但她自己的计划是什么呢？ “首先，”小花回答道，一边轻拍着说，“她希望我们的孩子在成长过程中能够拥有比我更美好的回忆。 [kohaku.anyKids |她头上的那顶帽子 |她满意地摸了摸自己圆滚滚的肚子。 ]要是能毫不费力地记住父母的面容该多好啊，诺雅。” 嗯，现在如果你了解她的情况，那么将来就有更多理由经常去探望她了。 小花[pc.ra kitsune |她斜眼看着你，说话时，心里的想法显然并没有表现在话语中。“如果阁下愿意的话，能见到您我感到非常荣幸。 |眯着眼睛看着你：“保证吗？ ] 除非她是想说，她和她的技能组合并没有什么吸引力？ [pc.ra kitsune |在权威面前，她总是努力不让自己露出不高兴的表情，但总是失败。她就是这样一个喜欢社交、喜欢与人交往的人。拥有要知道，这样做其实根本无法让她看起来真正生气或具有威胁性，对吧？ |她撅着嘴，耳朵紧紧贴在脑袋后面，发出“呜呜……”的声音。 ] 现在，说正经的——这就是她那些一时冲动、既想要某些东西又又不想得到的后果。这就像那个追逐马车的狼的故事：当它终于追上那辆马车时，却完全不知道该怎么做，现在的小花也是如此。而且你可以肯定，这绝对是事实，因为如果真有什么可以责怪她的地方，她早就狠狠地责备你了吧。 [pc.mf |父亲的角色与责任 |使怀孕 ]她又把那个重要的官员当成了出气筒。 当小红双手轻敲在一起，将尾巴紧紧缠在自己圆润的臀部和大腿上以示防御时，她的脸颊所呈现出的那种红晕，清楚地说明你确实说到了点子上。我……我还是不明白她是怎么知道我踢了你膝盖后侧的，诺雅。” 原因可能有很多——你记得当时你喊得可大声了，而且那些墙壁应该也没那么厚吧。或者，当事情变得明朗时，她会让米可或舞来进行占卜。又或者……嗯，谁知道像她这样的存在究竟能做出什么来呢。 出于好奇，她到底说了些什么呢？ 琥珀不禁一颤。[pc.ra kitsune |心里很清楚，根本无法回避这个直接的问题。“那么，阁下…… |她被揍得那么惨，是吧？难怪那个可怜的家伙会向你寻求安慰不是她所做的这一切。“呃……好吧 ]她用了一些词，这些词翻译起来并不是十分贴切，但长话短说，如果我不想怀孕的话，要么就应该阻止你的种子生根，要么就应该在有机会的时候让你离开，而不是……你懂我的意思吧？事后你竟然还跛了三天足部，真是的，nojya。 [pc.isDK |感觉确实就是这么回事。 |你不确定别人会怎么看待这一点，但事实上，这种无法直线行走的状态确实赋予了它全新的意义。 ]我……我很抱歉，诺雅。” 啊，现在说这些已经太晚了。[pc.isDK | | 而且，你自己也为让她担心而感到内疚。 ]所以，麻里就只说了这些吗？” 琥珀的脸颊变得更加红润，她继续用脚在地板上踩出一个个小洞来。“嗯，既然我确实是打算这么做的，那么我也当然愿意承担自己的行为所带来的后果，nojya。而现在的结果就是……米可总是拿那些不道德的商人会受到神罚来取笑我，但我觉得这次的事情根本算不上什么惩罚。”她抱住了自己。 rows.translation: 去问问琥珀关于你女儿的事情吧。

rows.original: Ask Kohaku if she'd like to spend a little time together with your daughter, just the three of you.
rows.translation: 问问琥珀，她是否愿意和你的女儿一起度过一些时光，就你们三个而已。
rows.raw: "Ask Kohaku if she'd like to spend a little time together with your daughter, just the three of you."

rows.original: Kohaku would like to, but you wouldn't be able to spend much time before she had to return to work, and that'd be worse than not doing it at all. Try asking her later towards the end of her shift.
rows.translation: 琥珀很愿意，但你在她回去工作之前，能陪她的时间其实并不多，那样的话，反而比根本不去做这件事还要糟糕。不妨试着在她轮班快结束的时候再问她吧。
rows.raw: "Kohaku would like to, but you wouldn't be able to spend much time before she had to return to work, and that'd be worse than not doing it at all. Try asking her later towards the end of her shift."

rows.original: Kohaku throws a glance at the scruffy little ball of golden fur in the crib, a brief smile playing across her lips as she ensures that your daughter is okay before turning back to you. "Of course — [pc.ra kitsune |it's my pleasure to be able to watch our daughter while you're out on his divine lordship's business, your Eminence |there's no better captive audience for talking about her who'll never get bored of it, ehehe ]. Would it be that we have more opportunities to talk together like this, but our duties keep us apart for too long, nojya. Nevertheless, she'll always be safe here." [rand |You've been meaning to ask, about the no-name thing... when is she going to see fit to give your daughter a name? It does feel impersonal to keep on referring to her as such... Kohaku's cheerful disposition vanishes, the little golden vixen looking pensive as she puts her fingers together. "Hard to say for sure, [pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, ]but... maybe three months? Half a year at most. I just want to be sure, nojya." You give her a pat on the head, taking care to smooth her ears against her hair. It doesn't disperse Kohaku's melancholy, but does at least soften the edge a bit. Yes, you know why there's this custom amongst some... but does she really have that little confidence in her daughter's vitality when the little furball is constantly trying to escape her crib? "I just want to be sure," she says softly, repeating a mantra. "It won't be that long, really. The blink of an eye, and the sun flies by[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]... before you know it, the day will come and she'll be old enough to be named, nojya." If she's afraid of getting too attached should the worst happen, it's already too late for that given the way she's been acting. "I know, but... it could be worse." Kohaku looks [pc.heightRange 60 |up ]at you, more than a little tearful. "Please, I beg your understanding on this matter[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. It must seem strange to you even given the explanation, but..." You'll hold her to her word, then. It may hurt her, but it also hurts you to not be able to call your daughter by a proper name. Give and take, okay? Kohaku nods silently. Is there a reason why she's so terrified that her daughter might suffer from the worst despite appearing healthy and fine in every way? Did something happen when she was younger? "No!" It's true, not everything needs to have that particular cause. But even so... well, it probably isn't the best time to press her about it now. |Well then! Does she have any new and interesting tales to tell? "I think I figured out why Miko called our daughter a dubious creature while she was still in my tummy, nojya." Oh? Kohaku nods so quickly that her face is a blur. "Yes, yes! You see, I've met a lot of people and even if we don't exchange many words, it's not hard to get a feel of the other party, nojya! But with our daughter, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]I can't really tell anything that she doesn't want me to know. She's really dubious, for lack of a better way to put it." You shake your head at that. Is she absolutely sure that she's not simply reading too much into the acts of a newborn? Kohaku[pc.ra kitsune |'s nodding intensifies to the point where it's conceivable her head might just pitch forward and fall off. "I'm absolutely sure of it, your Eminence! It's going to be a great asset for anyone looking to make deals in the future!" | plants her hands on her hips and tries to look pouty. "I'm absolutely sure of it! Have more confidence in your daughter's abilities, nojya!" ] You look at Kohaku, then at the little golden furball crawling about in her crib, then back at Kohaku again. Yeah, she's definitely reading too much into things. Unwilling to concede, Kohaku wiggles over to the crib, lifts the little golden furball right out, and holds her up before you like some kind of magical ward. "See? See? You can't tell anything about what she's thinking, can you?" No, you can't. "I knew I was right, nojya!" But that's really more because she's still too young to have deeper thoughts than the obvious ones expressed on the surface of things. [pc.ra kitsune |"With all due respect, your Eminence, I must disagree with that assessment, nojya." |"Uuuu... how would you know? It's not like you're a dreamwalker or anything to be able to get into peoples' heads, nojya!" ] |The truly funny thing is that despite Kohaku becoming [kohaku.wellFed |completely and absolutely round when she was pregnant, with an appetite to match, your daughter's kind of a small creature. With how obscenely huge Kohaku's tummy got and how far it protruded in front of her, you'd have expected larger. "Have you tried picking her up[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]? Tiny as she may be, she weighs every bit as much as it felt like she did when she was inside of me, nojya! |quite round and heavy while with child, your daughter's pretty cute and petite. There isn't a lot of fat left over on Kohaku's midriff, so one can only wonder where all the excess mass went. "Ehhh? I don't know, [pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. She feels every bit as heavy now compared to before, I still get just as tired having to carry her around all day!" ] Like mother, like daughter, then — both of them just really dense and concentrated as a result of their petite size. Did something happen when she was younger? "No!" It's true, not everything needs to have that particular cause. Kohaku eyes you[pc.ra kitsune | from behind her mask of yielding politeness ], clearly trying to decide if you're needling her. At last, the little golden vixen nods. rows.original: Well, then. Given that she's just about to finish her shift, she wouldn't mind a few extra hours before closing time to be with you and your daughter, would she? Kohaku brightens at the prospect, perking up from the tips of her ears to her little wiggly toes. "Eh... [pc.ra kitsune |if a request is made by the divine champion [pc.himHer]self, I have no choice but to comply, is that not the case? |the den matron said that she wouldn't fault me if I took a little extra time to care for my own. ] Since it's just an hour or two and I've already finished everything that needs doing... I need not have any regrets, nojya!" Kohaku waddles over to her desk, shuts the ledgers with a series of thuds, and returns the ink and everything else to the shelves. Pausing to rinse her hands in a nearby basin and encouraging you to do the same, the little golden vixen reaches down into and plucks out the tiny three-tailed ball of golden fur from her resting spot. No sooner has Kohaku's fingers closed about that the fox kit goes from dozing to fully activated, ears perking up and tails swishing to and fro as a broad smile works its way onto her little baby face. Guess someone got her mother's special brand of charisma — you can see why Kohaku thinks she's a shoo-in for her position down the line. "Oof, don't let her small size fool you, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]," Kohaku says as she bounces the kit in her grasp a few times. "She's heavy, nojya. I've gotten used to carrying loads bigger than I am when I go out, and even so she'd tire me out if she spent all day in my arms." Kohaku isn't exaggerating — your daughter weighs down in your hands like a rock as her mother passes her to you. She seems to understand that and paws at your [pc.armor] for a more solid hold on you, wrapping her tails about your arms as well for extra support. Clingy, this one. "[pc.ra kitsune |That would appear to be the case, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship |Heh, don't I know it ]. Once she gets picked up, she doesn't want to be put down, nojya. When she doesn't want attention, she's fine with being left alone, but when she does want attention, she wants it now; another reason to always be close by. Hotaru keeps on teasing me that I'm going to have it terrible when the time comes for her to understand that not every whim of hers is made to be tended to immediately. Well, what does Hotaru know? She doesn't have any of her own!" A bit scruffy, too. "[pc.ra kitsune |High praise, your Eminence |Ehe ]. I brush her to keep the tangles out, but I think there's a little charm in looking a bit wild. We're mountain folk made small so as to be able to run between the trees and roots, as the folktales go, nojya. I'm sure she'll smooth out as the years go by, but this really is the most natural state of our bloodline." Mm-hm. Kohaku definitely starts looking scruffy when she gets flustered or put-upon, and it does make her cuter in a lot of peoples' eyes. [rand |[pc.isMilky |By and large, you become aware of a small hand groping at your chest, squirming up against you in her swaddling and nudging her tiny, dense body against you. You give Kohaku a questioning look, and the little golden vixen simply crooks a smile back [pc.heightRange 60 |up ]at you. "Be careful. Kohaku's teasing tone leaves one wondering if she's just messing with you, but you find a seat by the crib and pull aside your [pc.armor] to expose a breast. Given the reputation for kitsune hunger, you expected to feel tired immediately, but that doesn't happen; looks like your daughter's simply hungry in one sense as the suction begins in earnest and you feel your milk begin to let down. This goes on for a little while, the rhythmic pulling at your [pc.chest] strangely comforting and pleasant in a soothing manner... ...And then she's done. Odd, it didn't feel that long, was she that voracious? You do feel a bit sore and tired from it all, but it's not that bad. Still, your arms are glad when you hand her back over to Kohaku, who wipes off and burps the little fox kit before passing her back to snuggle up against you. |As you continue to hold the little fox kit, though, she suddenly starts getting heavier, more than even her weight would warrant. Realizing what's happening, Kohaku hurries forward and peels the little golden furball off you; your daughter resists for a second or two, but her mother quickly forces the separation before she accidentally drains you further. The little golden furball whimpers, but her mother silences her with a single harsh word in her native tongue: the meaning is clear, even if the language isn't. "[pc.ra kitsune |A thousand apologies, your Eminence |I'm so sorry, [pc.name] ]. She doesn't know not to do that to others, she's so young..." It's... it's fine, you're happy to help make sure your daughter's sated. If she needs it to be healthy, then you're more than willing to give up a little bodily essence for her. "It's not a matter of whether you can afford it or not, nojya." Kohaku shifts her gaze. "One can't just take from other people like that without giving anything back. Once you get into justifying that, no matter how good a reason you think you have... she just doesn't know, not having that instinctive aversion. Once again, I must apologize for not better educating our daughter." There, there. You can take this later — for now, you really don't want to spoil the little time that you have together with such unpleasantness. "I'll feed her so she won't think of doing that again, nojya. Please, bide a moment." Kohaku shifts her weight and pulls her top aside to expose a breast; [kohaku.wellFed |it's time for all the nutrition that her body's accumulated during her pregnancy to be put to good use. Those tits aren't huge, but given their original petite size they've absolutely blown up as her hormonal body spent months packing away the concentrated essence of all the food you'd shoveled into her while she was with child. No, it's not merely about size — it's about being heavy, turgid and ripe with milky cargo, being in a motherly way. |compared to their original size, those milk puppies have certainly matured considerably over the last months ]. A gentle hum of contentment rises from her throat as her daughter stops fussing over having her meal interrupted and settles for the replacement. There, there. She doesn't need to be unduly upset about what just happened — it's far better to focus on the good, isn't it? There'll be time for discipline later, you're sure, but here and now you just want to enjoy the moment. Just as Kohaku's fussing over your daughter, so do you slide on over and wrap an arm about her waist, pulling the little golden vixen close before fussing over her as well. Kohaku sighs contentedly as you press her against you, snuggling in even as her tails grip at your legs. The three of you remain like that for a little longer, biding your time while your daughter feeds; eventually, the scruffy golden furball is done and snuggles back into her mother's arms, resisting all attempts to either burp or wipe her off. "A dubious creature, Miko said," Kohaku sighs as she finally cajoles your daughter into complying. "Well, I can believe it. She can get really fussy at times, so I can only hope that I raise her right." You have no doubt that she'll do a great job. ] |"Do you [pc.ra kitsune |wish to hold her, your Eminence |want to hold her for a bit, nojya ]?" But of course. Carefully, Kohaku passes the ruffled little furball that's your daughter over, only letting go when she's absolutely sure your grip is secure. Still, she watches you like a hawk, [pc.ra kitsune |her unease strong enough to overcome the deeply-ingrained instinct for decorum |practically neurotic about the matter ] — now, that's saying something. "Careful, nojya. Even if she doesn't have any teeth yet, she might still try to bite." Bite? This adorable little creature in your arms with a light dusting of baby fur all over? Her, bite? "Slobber would be more correct, nojya." You look down at the scruffy ball of golden fur in your arms. She looks back at you with big red eyes, and puts on a small baby smile even as her tails start swishing and beating against your forearms. Absolutely adorable — like mother, like daughter, especially the way her entire body perks up when interested, from her tiny toes to the tips of her large, concave ears. And speaking of ears, there's no better place to start. Perhaps it's by some long-held kitsune instinct, but your daughter babbles happily and tries to bow her head as you reach for her scalp with two fingers and scratch away gently. Giggling, she reaches out of her swaddling and tries to grasp at you as you move down to her brow, then back again to the bases of her ears, rubbing gently in a back and forth motion that spot where they join with her head. Looks like she isn't going to be slobbering over or biting anything, not like this. Kohaku [pc.ra kitsune |bows her head and tries to appear impassive, but doesn't last for more than a minute before breaking out into a warm smile |rolls her eyes and folds her arms, but can't help smiling as well ]. Kohaku's kit is still too young to have much control over her body, but tries to respond anyway; acting more like a fox kit than a human baby, she half-closes her eyes and babbles away happily as you lavish affection upon her. The little golden furball tries to crane her head towards your fingers, get a better feel for your touch; even if she doesn't succeed, the attempts are absolutely adorable. The more you scratch at your daughter's ears and fine layer of downy baby fur, the more they twitch and wiggle. She has cotton-ball ear fluff like her mother — or rather, will have once it's grown in, and promises to be every part the cute creature, too. Kitsune tails are far stronger than their other limbs when so young — the gentle squeeze of your daughter's tails about your forearms isn't quite a whole-body hug, but it's the best an infant can do. "[pc.ra kitsune |Are you done already, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship?" Kohaku asks as she sidles up to you and nudges your leg with an [kohaku.wellFed |absolutely thick |ample ] thigh. "You are away so long on his divine lordship's business and other matters... there's still some time before we've to retire, nojya |Are you sure you're done already, [pc.name]?" Kohaku purrs as she sidles up to you, very deliberately bumping her [kohaku.wellFed |enormous |ample ] rear against your thigh while her tails curl gently about your leg. "We can never be sure when you're going to be back next, nojya... a little longer can't hurt ]." Now, now. There's no need to malign you — no, you'd absolutely no intention of leaving so soon. If she doesn't mind helping you hold your daughter for a bit? "It'd be my pleasure, nojya." You pass your daughter back to Kohaku, then [pc.heightRange 60 |stoop down |reach over ] to tickle the little golden furball's tummy while she's secure in her mother's arms. It's just two fingers and through the fabric of her swaddling, but she absolutely delights in it, kicking away and making squeaky fox kit noises while you run your fingers back and forth over the ticklish spot. The little golden furball doesn't have the strength to meet you, but her mother helps with that, lovingly nudging her child up against your fingertips so that you can better shower her with loving affection. You have to carefully restrain yourself from accidentally pushing down too hard on your daughter — for all of her energy, she's still a baby in her mother's arms. Still, the wide red eyes and big baby smile really drive the kit's foxy nature home even as her ears flick and tails beat against her mother. Then, all at once, your daughter's energy sputters and runs out, the little golden furball going from full to empty in the blink of an eye. Twitching and snuffling, she rolls about in her mother's arms and completely and utterly deactivates: all the energy in her tiny body dissipates to the wind as she melts into a lump against Kohaku. "That's our daughter for you," Kohaku purrs, uncoiling her tails from your legs. "No middle ground between giving it her all and a completely smothered flame, nojya." She knows how to be endearing, doesn't she? "Almost as if by instinct[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]." ] Sighing happily, Kohaku gives your daughter a kiss on the forehead before setting her back in her crib, then steps up [pc.heightRange 60 |on tiptoe ]to give you one as well[pc.heightRange 66 | — or at least, as high as she can reach ]. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your spending time with us today is greatly appreciated, your Eminence. I haven't felt like this in some time now... but everything feels like it will be much better |Thanks for being with us today, [pc.name]. I know you have other things that need your attention, as do I, but even this small moment is enough to make me feel like things are going to be all right ]." And the dubious little creature didn't even bite! Or at least, try to. Kohaku tsks. "I worry when she'll start teething... I'm told that will hurt quite a bit, nojya. For now, though, I'm feeling rather spent and still have to close up the storehouse now that everyone else's left. Perhaps I'll see you tomorrow[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]?" Perhaps, perhaps. Until later, then.

Kohaku isn't exaggerating — your daughter weighs down in your hands like a rock as her mother passes her to you. "I was going to take our daughter down to the shrine and pray for her future good health after the storehouse's closed this evening[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. "Not every day, but it's good to stretch the legs, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence. |you know? ] Having everyone fuss over us is great... and it'll be even better with you around, nojya!" Why, yes. Your inclusion to any social situation is sure to spice things up, if you might say so yourself. Kohaku giggles at that and gives you a dip of her head, then prepares a seat and some small refreshments for you before returning to her work. You while away the next hour or so by playing with your little golden furball of a daughter, occupying her so that her mother can focus her attention on balancing the den's books. She's faster than promised — despite saying it might take an hour, Kohaku's done within half that time, thanks in no small part to the sudden burst of enthusiasm. Meanwhile, your little scruffy furball of a daughter has tried to bite you several times, her lack of teeth notwithstanding the gleeful effort with which she applies herself to the task. But eventually, it's over. Kohaku stands, dusts off her hands, and moves to dismiss her underlings, who've already readied themselves to leave. Once it's just the three of you, Kohaku [pc.ra kitsune |turns to you with a bow and receives your daughter from your hands. "You've my thanks for your forbearance, your Eminence. The trip through the fields to the fox shrine, the setting sun coming in rays through the tree's roots — it's rather peaceable. Kohaku must've chosen this hour to beat the rush of evening petitioners, given that the road's pretty open. Even with this short walk up to the sacred gardens, you can see why Kohaku's always at least a little worried about losing your daughter, given that she's tried to wriggle out of her mother's arms no less than thrice by the time the shrine draws into view. Your inclusion to any social situation is sure to spice things up, if you might say so yourself. Kohaku giggles at that and gives you a dip of her head, then prepares a seat and some small refreshments for you before returning to her work. You while away the next hour or so by playing with your little golden furball of a daughter, occupying her so that her mother can focus her attention on balancing the den's books. She's faster than promised — despite saying it might take an hour, Kohaku's done within half that time, thanks in no small part to the sudden burst of enthusiasm. Meanwhile, your little scruffy furball of a daughter has tried to bite you several times, her lack of teeth notwithstanding the gleeful effort with which she applies herself to the task. But eventually, it's over. Kohaku stands, dusts off her hands, and moves to dismiss her underlings, who've already readied themselves to leave. Kohaku must've chosen this hour to beat the rush of evening petitioners, given that the road's pretty open. Even with this short walk up to the sacred gardens, you can see why Kohaku's always at least a little worried about losing your daughter, given that she's tried to wriggle out of her mother's arms no less than thrice by the time the shrine draws into view. Tempting as it may be to try and feed Kohaku that to see if she'll keep on going regardless, you set down the fork with a sigh and show Kohaku the empty plate, letting her take in the obvious. The little golden vixen gazes up at you with puppy-dog eyes, as if affecting to appear endearing will produce yet another steak you've been saving for yourself, but when that fails to materialize she sinks back onto her desk with a whimper of relief. Even so, it's not completely over — Kohaku continues to squirm a little, fighting the impulse to grab the empty plate, to shamelessly lick up every last bit of flavor to be had from the sumptuous meal. Her naughty body has rewarded her with perverse delight for giving in to its needs and shamelessly stockpiling the fuel it needs to stoke the fires of her baby's growth, and her rosy cheeks and flushed neck mirror the heat within her hormonal core. Oh, oh, the poor dear. The blend of orgasmic pleasure, exhilaration and meat-induced ecstasy on her face is too much to bear. Grabbing one of the napkins that came with the steaks along in the wax-wrapped bundle, you wipe away the worst of the thick white gravy from her lips and chin, wondering at how heavily it manages to cling to just about everything it touches while having so much body to it. Poor little Kohaku makes a show of feebly batting at you while you clean her up, but is honestly more interested in patting [kohaku.wellFed |[kohaku.pregStage 3 |her ludicrously taut, pregnant tummy |her prominent baby bump ] |[kohaku.pregStage 3 |her heftily ripened tummy |the growing roundness of her midriff ] ], letting all the meat she's consumed settle heavily inside of her. It won't be long before all that goes to other parts of her body... ] Now, now, that won't do. Completely and utterly satiated, Kohaku's in no position to resist you and can only helplessly accept headpats right between the ears with several whimpers. If anything, she joins in on the perversity, pressing in on the sides of her tummy with the heels of her palms and rubbing away in small circles; the sheer sensation of her [kohaku.pregStage 2 3 4 |hefty |heavily ripe |monstrously life-filled |rounded ] belly being so full of child and food, her body readying itself to convert the latter into the former and more. "

rows.original: Another whimper from Kohaku draws your attention. Without the prospect of more good eating to be had, her body sees no point in staying sensate and is merrily sliding into stupefied unconsciousness, taking the rest of her with it. Certainly a one-track desire, if nothing else... ears folded down and a slight sheen of sweat on her skin, Kohaku cradles and gently rubs at her tummy as one set of hormones leaves and another arrives on the job. [kohaku.wellFed |The effects of ample nourishment are clear on Kohaku's figure, and this is going to be no exception |Such an appetite — all that food's got to go somewhere, and one can imagine the results ]. All the nutrition consumed in a single sitting, all the richness that's been packed into her — the hormonal slurry in her veins that comes with being pregnant is going to direct it all to where it's needed. Of course, the lion's share is going to go to her womb: [kohaku.pregStage 1 2 3 4 |still relatively small, the life within nevertheless quickens rapidly with the surge of nourishment, growing bigger and bigger until her child can no longer be hidden by even loose clothing |the swelling roundness is definitely going to be a bit bigger, a bit more prominent as the life within shudders with a growth spurt in response to the sudden abundance of nourishment |already cramped and heavy, it's only going to become moreso in the next few hours, her waistline expanding just a little as more and more mass is shamelessly piled on the energetic life growing within |that gloriously overstuffed midriff, low and heavy as it protrudes from her petite frame. It's only going to get more and more cramped as the child within greedily partakes of the nutrition Kohaku's stuffed into her face, becoming weightier and weightier as the moment of birth edges closer ]. After that, there's the matter of derriere, already bottom-heavy to begin with: nourishment flowing into hips, thighs, and rear alike, the first widening while the second and third thicken with dense meat, determined to close any thigh gap that might form. And finally, what little leftovers there are up to her top, ripening her bosom and trying desperately not to make her shape too unbalanced. Good, good. Too bad the poor little thing will be out of it for several hours at least to process it all. You give Kohaku a final pat on the head and make sure everything's clean and tidy in your wake, then turn to leave. While it's still technically business hours in the storehouse, you don't think anyone will fault her for her condition...
rows.translation: 琥珀又发出一声微弱的呜咽声，吸引了你的注意。既然再也没有美味的食物可以吃了，她的身体便觉得没有必要保持清醒，于是愉快地陷入了昏迷状态，整个人也随之失去了意识。可以说，这种欲望确实非常单一……耳朵耷拉下来，皮肤上还带着一丝细汗，琥珀轻轻抱着自己的肚子，轻轻揉搓着——因为有一组激素正在退去，而另一组激素则开始发挥作用了。 [kohaku.wellFed |充足的营养对琥珀的体形产生了明显的影响，这一次也不例外。 |这样的胃口啊——这么多食物总得有个去处，而人们也能想象到最终会是什么结果。 ]她在一次进食中摄入的所有营养，所有这些被塞进她体内的丰腴养分——孕期在她血管里流动的激素浆液，都会把它们输送到最需要的地方。当然，其中的绝大部分都会进入她的子宫：[kohaku.pregStage 1 2 3 4 |虽然还相对很小，但其中的生命随着营养的涌入迅速活跃起来，越长越大，直到即便穿着宽松的衣服也再也藏不住她的孩子 |随着生命体内部因突然获得大量营养而开始快速生长，这种肿胀与圆润感肯定会变得更加明显、更加突出 |它本来就已经显得拥挤而沉重了，而在接下来的几个小时里，这种情况只会变得更加严重。随着越来越多的物质无耻地堆积在那个正在茁壮成长的生命体上，她的腰围也会随之略微增加 |那塞得满满、壮观无比的腰腹，低垂而沉重地从她娇小的身形上凸显出来。随着腹中的孩子贪婪地汲取琥珀塞进嘴里的营养，它只会变得越来越局促，也随着分娩时刻的临近而愈发沉重 ]。 之后，就轮到臀部了——它本来就偏重：营养同时流向臀部、大腿和后臀，前者随之变宽，后两者则因紧实的肉而变粗，仿佛铁了心要填平任何可能出现的腿缝。最后，剩下的一点点则供给了她的上身，让她的胸部更加丰满，同时拼命不让她的身形变得太不协调。 好，好。可惜这个可怜的小家伙至少需要几个小时才能把这些都消化处理完。你最后拍了拍琥珀的头，确认自己离开后一切都干净整洁，然后转身离开。虽然严格来说仓库现在还是营业时间，但你觉得没人会因为她现在的状况而责怪她……
