rows.original: And just when think you're done, an ominous silhouette shows itself at the stairs leading up to Kohaku's perch overlooking the storehouse. The aura of evil-minded mischief is palpable about Hotaru as she makes herself known, the seamstress holding a large covered porcelain tray in her hands. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship, Kohaku |Kohaku, [pc.name] ]," she purrs, bowing as deeply as possible while still keeping the tray balanced in her hands — an impressive task considering how laden it must be under that cover. "I've come to deliver the quartermaster's requested snack." Your gaze wanders from Kohaku to the remnants of the enormous amount of food she's just crammed into her face-mouth, to the considerable offering that Hotaru has in her hands, then back to Kohaku again. Hotaru takes advantage of the lull to slink forward with small, socially-approved steps and set the tray down on Kohaku's desk amidst all the bookkeeping. A sweet, saccharine smile on her face, the seamstress leans in close and stage-whispers into one of Kohaku's tall, large ears; her warm breath tickles the dense, cotton-ball ear fluff and sends Kohaku to whimpering. "I see you've just eaten. Was [pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer] Eminence kind enough to bring you food as well?" Kohaku whimpers again. Eyes half-closed, Hotaru turns to you and bows once more, deep enough this time that she has to use her tails to keep her balance. "Thank you for taking care of my friend, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship; it truly means a lot to me. I have my own obligations to attend to, and I can't be around all the time to ensure that my friend eats properly." |[pc.name] nice enough to bring you something delicious?" Kohaku whimpers again, then louder as Hotaru pinches her on the cheeks. "Positively stunning today — you're simply so adorable, I don't know how you do it." Turning to you, Hotaru gives you a respectful dip of her head. "Thanks for looking after Kohaku for me, [pc.name]. I've got my own things to do, and can't be around all the time to ensure that this little rascal doesn't lose herself too much in her work. It would be terrible for the child inside of her if she doesn't eat properly while in her condition, so having someone else bring along a delicious treat from time to time is appreciated." ] What a coincidence, though, that she'd happen to show up after you've brought Kohaku enough food to satiate three people. "The gods have their own plans within plans, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |I'm told ]," Hotaru replies, raising a hand to her lips. "If you don't mind, though, I think it's time for our dear Kobayashi's daily snack; I hope she hasn't ruined her appetite any. Have you, my dear?" With a theatrical flourish befitting the storyteller she is, Hotaru sweeps the cover off the tray — laden upon it are traditional kitsune dishes with barely any empty space. Piles upon piles of artfully crafted and cut dishes accompanied by a big bowl of steaming rice cooked half and half with red beans... there's even a little meat in the form of grilled fish. But the sheer volume of it all is what's impressive — it's almost as much as the ridiculous amount that you've just fed Kohaku. A feast, if one artfully put together from base elements. Her smile widening, Hotaru sweeps over behind where Kohaku's seated, firmly planting clever hands and nimble fingers on the little golden fox's shoulders and gently kneading away. "What you need after all those sweets is something to balance that out, something truly filling and wholesome to make sure you don't get an upset stomach later on. You wouldn't pass up on that, would you? I've even added some sour and a little spice to stimulate the appetite, help you find a little extra space for your daily snack. "Rice and vegetables, good food." [var0] The aura of mischief oozes and drips all over the place as Hotaru reaches over Kohaku's shoulder and down to pat her [kohaku.wellFed |[kohaku.pregStage 2 3 4 |bulging tummy, running from top to bottom and up again in broad, easy strokes. Taut and more than amply full for how far along little Kohaku is, the rounded dome of Kohaku's overstuffed midriff offers Hotaru more than ample space to pet and squeeze. All the while, Hotaru whispers sweet nothings about how heavily and fully pregnant Kohaku is, and how she could be even more so in short order. |hefty pregnant tummy, trailing her fingers along the low curve of the round protrusion as it drops low from the little golden fox's waist. Kohaku squirms and moans in place as Hotaru gently caresses the full, warm weight under the stretched skin, driving home just how large and healthy mother and child have grown under regular care and feeding. |obscenely pregnant tummy, grown ripe and heavy with all the eager nutrition that gone into Kohaku while she's with child. The petite nature of the little golden vixen only makes her pregnancy look bigger when compared to the rest of her, and Hotaru plays that for all it's worth. Just the slightest touch upon the taut, sensitive skin is enough to leave Kohaku squirming in place, and Hotaru trails her fingers over the rosy red baby bump her friend's sporting, devious glee written all over her face as she watches the taut skin ripple and shiver with life. |rounded tummy, dwelling on the curve of Kohaku's eagerly protruding bump to press home the point on %"rounded." Even at this early stage, the effect of being happily well-fed is making its mark on the little golden fox's child-bearing, and it's only going to grow with time. ] |[kohaku.pregStage 2 3 4 |bulging tummy, running from top to bottom and up again in broad, easy strokes. While she's at is, the naughty seamstress squeezes and whispers away in her native language — or at least it sounds that way, gentle touches paired with sensual nothings. |heavily pregnant tummy, trailing her fingers along the curve of her weighty womb before supporting its weight from underneath. Not a single word passes between the two kitsune women, but Kohaku squirms and moans as Hotaru bounces the weight of her midriff in her palm, toying with how ripe and full her womb is, and how much more it'll be when she's done converting all that deliciousness into even more baby to stuff her even further. |blatantly bulging tummy, grinning madly as she takes in how the life-filled roundness quivers under her loving fingertips. Just the slightest touch upon the taut, sensitive skin is enough to leave Kohaku squirming in place, and Hotaru spends plenty of time toying with the cute outie of a belly button, cooing and fussing over her friend as if she were the one with child herself. |gentle baby bump, reaching under Kohaku's belly button and pressing in while rubbing away in slow circles. Kohaku's such a tiny creature that it's impossible for Hotaru to miss her mark; everything's just so much more concentrated when it comes to her. ] ] The direct appeal to Kohaku's unborn kit is what does it. Hotaru's mischievous touch slices clean through the little golden fox's psyche and strikes straight at the tumultuous, torrid mess of raw life in her tummy that dominates her decision-making. Whimpers rise from the back of Kohaku's throat as she succumbs to need, ears folding down and to the sides she trembles in place. "It looks like our friend needs our help," Hotaru purrs, turning to you and bowing again. "I fear that without a proper meal inside of her, dear Kohaku might just implode from hunger. [pc.ra kitsune |Would you like to oversee the proceedings, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship? |Wouldn't you like to help me help her? ]" Well, you've already served up a whole bunch of food to Kohaku. What's some more on top of everything else, eh? "[pc.ra kitsune |Most excellent, your Eminence. Many hands make for light work, indeed |How pleasant of you to agree, hmm? Welcome to being my accomplice in crime, then ]." Hotaru's ears wiggle as she hides her lips with a hand in the approved fashion and chuckles. "Let's proceed with [silly |fattening the beast |sating our friend ], then." The tense moment is finally broken as each of you take a side and start unloading the laden dishes from the tray and before Kohaku. Wielding the provided chopsticks, the little golden fox starts off with the most flavorful dishes — [rand |cold dry noodles in chilly soy sauce and grated cucumber, sour-spicy pickled cabbage, and steamed meat buns |deep-fried cabbage cakes, still warm and golden brown, paired with a pair of spicy seasoned duck drumsticks |a medley of lightly steamed vegetables drizzled with some kind of citrus juice, followed by skewers of dumplings laid out in thick, dark sauce |sweet tea and crispy rice-flour bread ] amongst others. It really feels like they've been doing this all their life — Hotaru with her sweet, saccharine smile, perfectly polite in every way, Kohaku giving in to the simple yet extremely filling meal with predictable results. You're pretty sure this is not how meals are supposed to be properly eaten around these parts, but the straight line of you taking food off the tray, having Kohaku absolutely demolish it, and Hotaru removing the empty dishes from her presence and back onto the tray is grim in its efficiency. There are no leftovers. "She trusts you so deeply, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence. |doesn't she? ]" Hotaru continues to purr, slinking around to give the edge of her friend's ear a kiss and nibble. "You planted the child in her womb, after all... it's fitting that you be the one to deliver the food unto her. Me? I'm merely here to assist the process." As satisfying as this may be, you hope that all this food isn't coming out of her allotment. It may be entertaining, but you wouldn't want Hotaru to go hungry or work extra hard in order to make Kohaku feel fat and happy. "Oh, don't worry[pc.ra kitsune |my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]. It's all been accounted for." Hotaru leans over Kohaku's shoulder to widen her smile at you, then continues nibbling on the tips of Kohaku's ears while the little golden fox packs it away. The last item on the menu is the hefty bowl of steaming rice and beans — no added flavor, nothing to go with it, just a whole lot of bulk. "Have you ever considered it[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]? Here we have rice and beans, the locals partake of wheat, barley, rye and all kinds of other grains. There's a little flavor to be had, but by and large it's all quite bland. "Yet we eat it everyday, and it forms the bases of our meals. A nice, bland base on which everything rests, notable in its bulk." Hotaru laughs, and removes the bowl and chopsticks from Kohaku after the little golden fox's sucked up the last stray grains of rice. In a single fluid motion, the seamstress places the bowl back on the tray and gently slaps her friend's [kohaku.wellFed |[kohaku.pregStage 1 2 3 4 |noticeably protruding |large, rounded |overfull and weighty |obscenely full ] |[kohaku.pregStage 1 2 3 4 |lightly rounded |protruding |amply stuffed |low, heavy ] ] tummy.[kohaku.pregStage 3 |[kohaku.wellFed | Repeated feedings have streamlined the food to baby conversion process amongst other things, but here in this moment both jostle for space within her petite body, her roundness blatantly bigger than it was before she started | With her midriff palpably bigger than it was before she started, the poor little creature needs to rest a bit and turn everything she's eaten into more baby, amongst other things ]. ] Well, if this isn't a sight to see. You should thank Hotaru for coming in with a snack — you'd brought most of the meal, but Kohaku needed something light to cap it off. "[pc.ra kitsune |Oh, it's my pleasure. If anything, I should be thanking you for your kind assistance, your Eminence — having a pair of hands as magnificent as yours certainly made the [silly |feeding and fattening |snack ] a lot smoother than it otherwise would have been. Hurry, Kohaku — thank [pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship for making sure that you've enough to eat. Would it be that subjects across the ocean were as well-cared for as we are, to have such personages like [pc.hisHer] Eminence show concern for the lives of us little people." |Oh, it's my pleasure. If anything, I should be thanking you — I don't think I would've been able to reduce our friend here to this state without you providing something in the way of rich local food." Well, the same goes for her and her cooking, then. Hotaru titters. "You have a saying that the whole is greater than the sum of the parts, do you not? We've just demonstrated as such. Kohaku, thank [pc.name] for taking such good care of you, hmm? Not everyone has the mind to come back and make sure that the mother of [pc.hisHer] kits has lots of good food..." ] Kohaku does make a genuine effort, but all that emerges from her lips is a whimpering moan. She can't be blamed, given that Hotaru's nibbled from tip to base and back again, hot breath washing into the sensitive insides of Kohaku's ears and tickling the cotton-ball fluff. Oh well, that sounds grateful enough. With the spectacle and story-telling over, Hotaru unwinds herself from Kohaku and gives you a final bow before clearing away both her tray and the remnants of your trail rations. "Please, allow me[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. It's the least I can do for the both of you. Don't let me disturb your time together." With that, she's gone.
rows.translation: 就在这时思考你完成了任务，这时，在通往小白的观景平台的楼梯处，出现了一个阴森的轮廓。当灯笼现身时，那种充满恶意与捣蛋意味的气息简直触手可及——这位裁缝手中拿着一个盖着盖子的大瓷盘。[pc.ra kitsune |你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]船，琥珀 |小白[pc.name] ]是，”她轻声说道，一边尽可能深深地鞠躬，一边努力保持手中的托盘平衡——考虑到托盘下面肯定装满了东西，这一动作实在令人印象深刻。“我是来送军需官要求的零食的。你的目光在琥珀和她刚刚塞进嘴里的那些大量食物残渣之间游移，然后又转向萤手中那些丰富的食物，最后又回到了琥珀身上。萤趁着周围暂时安静的时机，迈着那些被社会认可的小步子悄悄靠近，将托盘放在了琥珀的书桌旁，那里堆满了各种账本。她脸上挂着甜腻的笑容，凑近琥珀的一只高大的耳朵，用轻柔的声音低语着什么；她温暖的气息轻拂着琥珀那密密的、像棉花球一样的耳毛，让琥珀忍不住发出呜咽声。 我看你刚吃完饭，是吧[pc.ra kitsune |[pc.hisHer]恩人还特意为我们带来了食物，真是太慷慨了。” 科哈库又呜咽起来。 萤半闭着眼睛，再次转向你，这次鞠躬的幅度很大，以至于她不得不用尾巴来保持平衡。“感谢您照顾我的朋友，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]送她回家，这对我来说真的意义重大。我也有自己的责任要履行，不可能一直陪在她身边，确保她能按时吃饭。 |[pc.name]这么好心，还特意为我准备了一些美味的东西呢？” 小花又呜咽起来，当萤火虫捏了捏她的脸颊后，她的呜咽声变得更加大了。 “今天你真是漂亮极了——你实在太可爱了，真不知道你是怎么做到的。”萤火虫转向你，恭敬地点了点头：“谢谢你帮我照顾小花。 [pc.name]我也有自己的事情要忙，不可能一直都在身边监督这个调皮的小家伙，确保她不会过于沉迷于自己的工作。以她目前的身体状况，如果不能按时吃饭，对她的身体肯定非常不利。因此，如果有人能偶尔带一些美味的零食给她，我会非常感激的。 ] 真是太巧了，就在你给小白准备了足够让三个人吃饱的食物之后，她恰好出现了。 “看来上天自有它的安排。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |我听说。 带着一个符合她这个故事讲述者身份的戏剧性动作，萤掀开了托盘上的盖子——托盘上摆满了传统的狐妖主题美食，几乎没有一点空隙。一层又一层精心制作、切割得恰到好处的菜肴，再加上一大碗红豆与白米一起煮成的热气腾腾的米饭……甚至还有些烤鱼作为肉类食材。但真正令人印象深刻的是这些食物的数量——几乎和你们刚刚喂给小白的那些食物一样多。如果能够巧妙地利用基本元素来筹备一场盛宴，那么这场盛宴必定会非常精彩。 In a single fluid motion, the seamstress places the bowl back on the tray and gently slaps her friend's [kohaku.wellFed |[kohaku.pregStage 1 2 3 4 |noticeably protruding |large, rounded |overfull and weighty |obscenely full ] |[kohaku.pregStage 1 2 3 4 |lightly rounded |protruding |amply stuffed |low, heavy ] ] tummy.[kohaku.pregStage 3 |[kohaku.wellFed | Repeated feedings have streamlined the food to baby conversion process amongst other things, but here in this moment both jostle for space within her petite body, her roundness blatantly bigger than it was before she started | With her midriff palpably bigger than it was before she started, the poor little creature needs to rest a bit and turn everything she's eaten into more baby, amongst other things ]. ] Well, if this isn't a sight to see. You should thank Hotaru for coming in with a snack — you'd brought most of the meal, but Kohaku needed something light to cap it off. "[pc.ra kitsune |Oh, it's my pleasure. If anything, I should be thanking you for your kind assistance, your Eminence — having a pair of hands as magnificent as yours certainly made the [silly |feeding and fattening |snack ] a lot smoother than it otherwise would have been. Hurry, Kohaku — thank [pc.mf |his lord |her lady ]ship for making sure that you've enough to eat. Would it be that subjects across the ocean were as well-cared for as we are, to have such personages like [pc.hisHer] Eminence show concern for the lives of us little people." |Oh, it's my pleasure. If anything, I should be thanking you — I don't think I would've been able to reduce our friend here to this state without you providing something in the way of rich local food." Well, the same goes for her and her cooking, then. Hotaru titters. "You have a saying that the whole is greater than the sum of the parts, do you not? We've just demonstrated as such. Kohaku, thank [pc.name] for taking such good care of you, hmm? Not everyone has the mind to come back and make sure that the mother of [pc.hisHer] kits has lots of good food..." ] Kohaku does make a genuine effort, but all that emerges from her lips is a whimpering moan. She can't be blamed, given that Hotaru's nibbled from tip to base and back again, hot breath washing into the sensitive insides of Kohaku's ears and tickling the cotton-ball fluff. Oh well, that sounds grateful enough. With the spectacle and story-telling over, Hotaru unwinds herself from Kohaku and gives you a final bow before clearing away both her tray and the remnants of your trail rations. "Please, allow me[pc.ra kitsune |, your Eminence ]. It's the least I can do for the both of you. Don't let me disturb your time together." With that, she's gone. "

rows.original:
Hmm, it's a fine evening by the fox shrine, but Mai isn't on duty as she should be. Odd, that — perhaps [mai.anyKids|she had to hurry back to mind her kit|there was an emergency elsewhere which required her attention]? No, that's not right: if that were the case then there'd be someone else on duty at the shrine; even if both sisters were indisposed then Komari herself would be personally minding the place. Maybe she's just elsewhere on the grounds...
    
    [pc.ra kitsune
        |Well, this may technically be sacred ground, but as a god's champion you don't see anyone more qualified than you to wander about as you please
        |It may feel a little odd to look around the shrine grounds, especially in the gloom of night, but given that Mai's usually so gregarious and eager to come out and meet the few people who come at this time of day it's worth a look
    ]. You circle about the shrine to the far end of the gardens, coming up to the large stone table where Mai usually performs her massages; she's there all right, bent over an assortment of items laid out on its surface. What's surprising is that she isn't alone: Kohaku's seated an one end in the moonlight, helping out with whatever it is Mai's doing while your daughter snoozes in a sling hung about her front.
    
    Oh, there they are. You were wondering where Mai had gone.
    
    Mai doesn't miss a beat at your arrival, [pc.ra kitsune
        |momentarily setting aside her work to acknowledge your presence with a bow. "Welcome an' watch yer step at night, yer Eminence. Th' lanterns are lit out front, but here it's jus' us an' th' moon
        |glancing over her shoulder to give you a wide, open-mouthed smile. "Why, if'n it ain't ya, [pc.name] Lil' ol' me would appreciate it if'n ya tread lightly an' don't break th' atmosphere — 's all serene-like, what with it bein' jus' us an' th' moon
    ]."
    
    It is quite the serene night, and you'll be sure to exercise care. That being said, you hope you're not interrupting something?
    
    Mai casts a quick glance at Kohaku sitting by the table, who responds to the query with a nod. "[pc.ra kitsune
        |Oh, it ain't much, yer Eminence. Lil' Kohaku done asked me a couple days ago if'n I could be helpin' her with a ceremony o' sorts f'r her kit — she coulda done it herself, but havin' a servant o' th' gods partcipatin' done make it even more official, ya see. An' since ya jus' done showed up at th' right time, there ain't no explanation f'r it but his divine lordship sending ya our way to officiate it an' all!
        |Nah, 's actually a good thing yer here. Lil' Kohaku done asked me a couple days ago if'n I could be helpin' her with a ceremony o' sorts f'r her kit — she coulda done it herself, but havin' a servant o' th' gods partcipatin' done make it even more official, which means either Miko or me. The kit's yer get, too, so I don't think no one's got a problem with ya bein' here if'n that's yer desire.
    ]"
    
    You take in the assortment of items that's been laid out in a half-circle on the stone table — everything from a writing brush, to a flute, a carpenter's plane, even a small jade pendant and more. All of them are pretty ordinary, everyday things that one might find about the den or even Hawkethorne itself, albeit with a different cultural flavor. So, what's the thread that ties all of these together?
    
    "[pc.ra kitsune
        |Ya see, yer Eminence
        |Well, [pc.name], how should lil' ol' me go 'bout explainin' it
    ]... this here thing is supposed to give Kohaku as a mother some idea of what's goin' on in that head of her dubious lil' creature, help her raise her daughter right. But more importantly, if she done believe that her kit done has a future as this or that, then she'll be believin' that her kit done has a future to begin with, ya get me?"
    
    You're beginning to understand where this is going, yes.
    
    "Hey, it ain't jus' 'bout heavy, serious stuff. This is kinda fun, too. Gettin' all th' things that lil' Kohaku done needed were plenty amusin', even if'n Granny asked a whole bunch o' questions 'bout what we needed it f'r. Surprised myself she didn't want to come see it happen none."
    
    Mhm. To continue your previous guess, then, the kit — barely an infant — is supposed to pick out what she likes out of this dozen or so things.
    
    Kohaku takes a deep breath; she's even more nervous about this than her daughter is. While she looks antsy, the little golden fluffball is snuggled up close against her, awake but if barely. It is evening, after all.
    
    "That's the long and short of it[pc.ra kitsune
        |, your Eminence
    ]. We've already performed the ritual cleansings and arranged the items, so it remains to us to invoke the gods; from there, it's all up to what our daughter chooses."
    
    Your gaze sweeps between mother and child, and you can't help but smile. Does she believe in her daughter's choice?
    
    "One might argue that it's a form of divination, and perhaps even be right, but it's nothing of the sort that Miko does," Kohaku replies, patting her little kit on the back. "It's... at this age, our daughter is still largely untouched by the world, nojya. Her nature is still raw and has yet to receive much influence from everything around her...
    
    "That doesn't mean anything in the way of youthful innocence or goodness, of course. But it's at this time at which such efforts are most revelatory, nojya! Or at least that's how the custom goes. Maybe I just want to do it for fun, like Mai said?"
    
    So long as both mother and child don't stay up too late. She still has to open up the storehouse tomorrow.
    
    "I already rested before coming[pc.ra kitsune
        |, your Eminence
    ]. Whatever happens, I don't think I'll be able to sleep for the night, nojya."
    
    So, only one question remains: do you want to stay to watch this little ritual, ceremony, whatever it's called? Strictly speaking, you don't have to — you came here seeking Mai for something else and she's too occupied to help you at the moment, so it's perfectly understandable if you just want to leave. On the other hand, it doesn't look like either of the foxen ladies are going to protest if you want to stay and watch this little scene play out. 
    
    What would you like to get up to?
rows.translation:
嗯，狐妖神社旁的这个傍晚景色确实很美，不过舞却没有像往常一样来值班。奇怪啊——也许[mai.anyKids|她不得不赶紧回去收拾自己的装备。|其他地方发生了紧急情况，需要她立即处理。]不，那样不对：如果真是那样的话，神社里应该会有其他人值班；即使两位姐妹都不在，至少麻里本人应该会亲自照看那个地方。也许她只是正在神社的其他地方……
    
    [pc.ra kitsune
        |嗯，从技术上讲，这里或许属于神圣之地，但作为神的使者，你肯定认为没有谁比你更适合在这里随心所欲地游荡了。
        |在神社的周围走走，尤其是在夜色中，可能会让人觉得有些奇怪。不过，考虑到梅平时那么喜欢与人交往，总是乐于出来迎接那些在这个时间段来访的人，这样的体验还是值得尝试的。
    ]你绕着花园尽头的那座神龛走了一圈，来到了那张舞通常用来做按摩的大型石桌前。她果然在那里，正弯腰摆弄着放在桌面上的各种物品。令人惊讶的是，她并不是独自一人：琥珀也坐在石桌的一旁，在月光下帮忙舞做那些事情，而你的女儿则被挂在她胸前的吊带里小睡着。
    
    哦，他们就在那儿。你之前还在疑惑舞去哪儿了。

舞可一点也不会错过你到来的时机。 [pc.ra kitsune
        |她暂时放下手头的工作，鞠躬以示对你的尊重。“欢迎光临，夜深时分请小心行走，尊贵的阁下。前方的灯笼已经点亮了，但这里只有我们和月亮。
        |她回头看了你一眼，然后露出了一个张大嘴巴的微笑：“哎呀，原来是你啊[pc.name]小家伙，如果你能轻点行事，不要破坏这种宁静的氛围，那就太好了——现在这里只有我们和月亮，一切都是如此宁静。
    ]夜色十分宁静，你一定要小心行事。话虽如此，但希望你不会因此打扰到什么吧？

舞快速瞥了一眼坐在桌旁的琥珀，后者点了点头，表示没有问题。[pc.ra kitsune
        |哦，其实也没什么大事，尊贵的阁下。几天前，小红霞问我是否可以帮她举办一场与她的装备相关的仪式——她本来也可以自己动手，但如果有位神明的仆从参与其中，的话，整个仪式就会显得更加正式了，您明白我的意思吧。而既然您正好在这个时候出现了，那这就只能说明是她的神圣主君安排您来主持这场仪式的啦！
        |其实，你在这里反而是件好事。几天前，小琥珀问我是否可以帮助她举行一场与她的套装相关的仪式——她本来也可以自己动手，但如果有位神明的仆从参与其中，仪式就会显得更加正式些，而能够担任这个角色的人，要么是巫女，要么就是我。这套套装也是你的，所以如果这是你的意愿的话，我觉得没人会反对你在这里的。
    ]你将那些被摆放在石桌上半圆形排列中的各种物品一一收拢起来——有毛笔、笛子、木工刨子，甚至还有一个小玉坠等等。所有这些物品都相当普通，都是人们在日常生活中可能会遇到的东西，只不过它们带有不同的文化色彩罢了。那么，究竟是什么将它们全部联系在了一起呢？[pc.ra kitsune
        |您看，阁下
        |嗯， [pc.name]，我这个小不点该怎么去解释这件事呢？
    ]……这个东西其实是为了让小红作为母亲能够理解自己那个古怪的小家伙脑子里在想些什么，帮助她正确地抚养女儿。但更重要的是，如果她真的相信自己的女儿未来会有某种发展，那么她就会从一开始就相信自己的女儿确实有未来，明白我的意思吗？你开始明白事情的发展方向了，对吧。”

“嘿，这并不只是关于一些重型、严肃的事情。这也挺有趣的。看着小红舞做那些需要做的事情，其实挺有趣的，即使奶奶问了我们很多关于这些事情用途的问题。真没想到，她竟然不想来看这一幕发生。”

“嗯，继续你之前的猜测吧——这个还几乎是个婴儿的家伙，竟然要从这十几样东西中挑选出自己喜欢的。”

小白深深地吸了一口气；比起她的女儿，她自己对这件事更加紧张。虽然她看起来有些坐立不安，但那个小小的金色绒球却紧紧地依偎在她身边，虽然醒着，但几乎处于半睡半醒的状态。毕竟，现在已经是晚上了。

“事情就是这么简单。[pc.ra kitsune
        |，阁下
    ]我们已经完成了所有的仪式净化工作，也准备好了所有所需的物品，现在就剩下我们来召唤神明了；之后的一切，就完全取决于我们女儿的选择了。”

你的目光在母亲和孩子之间来回扫视，不禁露出了微笑。她是否相信自己女儿的选择呢？

“有人可能会认为这是一种占卜行为，甚至这种观点可能是正确的，但米可所做的根本不是这种事情，”琥珀一边回答，一边轻拍着她的小狗的背部。在这个年纪，我们的女儿还基本上没有受到外界的影响，诺雅。她的天性依然纯真，还没有受到周围环境的太多影响……

当然，这并不意味着她就一定天真无邪或品性优良。但恰恰是在这个时候，这样的努力才会展现出最大的意义，诺雅！至少传统上是这么说的。也许我只是想图个乐子而已，就像舞说的那样……

只要母子俩不要熬夜太晚就行。她明天还是得去打开仓库。

“来之前我已经休息过了。[pc.ra kitsune
        |，阁下
    ]无论发生什么，我想我这一晚上都睡不着觉了，nojya。”

那么，现在只剩下一个问题了：你是否想留下来观看这个小小的仪式、典礼，或者不管它应该被称为什么呢？严格来说，你并没有这个义务——你来到这里本来是为了找舞办别的事情，而她现在也忙得无暇帮助你，所以如果你想离开，也是完全可以理解的。另一方面，看起来这两位狐妖女士应该都不会反对你留下来观看这一小段剧情的发展吧。

你打算做什么呢？

rows.original: Actually, you think you'll stay here and watch this play out — you may have come here with business for Mai, but this surprise is a pleasant one and besides, it's for your daughter, isn't it? With Kohaku around to keep you company there's no reason to be rushing off in a hurry. [pc.ra kitsune |"Thank you for being here for me, your Eminence," Kohaku says, ears perking up despite the late hour as she beams at you. "I don't think it was a coincidence that the gods sent you here when you did, nojya." You don't know about divine intervention, but you do enjoy seeing her happy. Whatever business you had with Mai, it can wait; this is more important. Kohaku wiggles happily at that, and clears out a seat for you beside her with a flick of her tails. You accept it, and turn to Mai — you don't need to be ritually cleansed or anything beforehand, do you? "F'r somethin' like this, coupled with someone as close to th' divine as ya? Ain't no need. If'n ya wanna, lil' ol' me can do a pinch o' salt, but yer presence alone's better than any salt." |"Thanks for sticking around, nojya!" Kohaku says, ears perking up despite the late hour as she beams at you. "Not sure what kind of business you have here at this hour, but I'm glad you came, [pc.name]." Hey, she's up at a pretty late hour, too, and has even less of a reason to be up to boot. At least you don't have regular duties and the like to attend to. Cheeks coloring, Kohaku sticks her tongue out at you. "I'm doing this for our child, nojya. A few hours of sleep isn't worth that much in the scheme of things, hee hee." While you've been speaking with Kohaku, Mai's come up and sprinkled a pinch of salt about your feet. A ritual cleansing, you take it — wouldn't want outside influences influencing the kid's decisions, that kind of thing. ] At last, though, the big moment arrives. With all the objects laid out in a semicircle, Mai gestures for Kohaku to proceed. The little golden vixen reaches out and sets your drowsy daughter in the middle of the lot, taking great care to ensure that her little fuzzy body is exactly equally distant from each option. For a moment, you think that your daughter's just going to curl up in her tails and go back to sleep — the poor thing's struggling to keep awake with her eyes half-lidded. As you watch, the little golden furball yawns, looks around at her surroundings lit only by the wan, silvery moonlight, then squishes up against herself and pauses for an unbearably long time. Well, unbearable for her mother, at least — the way Kohaku's got her fingers together and has her sharpened teeth on edge tells you all you need to know. There's the unspoken thought, though, that's no doubt on the forefront of Kohaku's mind: what if the infant doesn't grab anything? Does that mean an uncertain future, or even worse, no future? Or maybe it's just that said future isn't in the items that've been laid out... but knowing how Kohaku is about matters that pertain to your daughter, you know she's going to assume the worst. Thankfully, that tension breaks as the otherwise nonchalant infant yawns again and raises her gaze to take in the spread before her. Kohaku's on edge as the little creature crawls forward and grabs hold of [pc.highestStat strength agility toughness presence willpower cunning |[var0 |a knife, small enough to fit in one's clothing. Now how did you miss that? Your heart skips a beat when you realize what she's actually reaching for, then calm yourself when the moonlight reveals the edge to be dulled and the point blunted. Right, right...neither Kohaku nor Mai would be careless enough to let a baby get hold of something genuinely dangerous. Still, that was quite the scare — is this how Kohaku feels when those troublesome thoughts plague her? Nevertheless, your little golden furball is absolutely enamored of the small, dull knife, giggling and making to wave it about until Mai steps in and gently removes it from the kit's grasp. "[pc.ra kitsune |Yer Eminence |[pc.name] ], Kohaku, I done think she's made her point pre-tty clear. Kid really done like sharp things." Heh. Does this mean you'll have to go looking for a practice weapon for her in the years to come? You'll have years to do so, but it doesn't hurt to think ahead. "Wouldn't say that ain't th' case, but wouldn't be sayin' yes, either. Give it a year or two." "I wouldn't say so. I need to know plenty about different professions in order to do my job, and having varied interests will certainly help, nojya! All kinds of things go both in and out of the storehouse, after all; you have to understand the nature of your goods in order to properly appraise them! Is that not the case[pc.ra kitsune |, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship ]?" You just smile and shake your head. Well, so long as she's got her daughter's aspirations placed first, you don't think you've any argument. The three of you put all the objects used in the divination away, then Mai hefts the box and gives you a bow. "[pc.ra kitsune |If'n ya don't mind, yer Eminence, I'll be takin' my leave f'r a bit |Guess I'll be going, then ]. Put these back where I found them, an' leave ya two to yer devices an' all. Don't ya stay up too late, Kobayashi — yer kit may be able to lie 'bout all day, but ya ain't got that pleasure." With that, she withdraws, leaving Kohaku and you along with your daughter. Is she all right? "I'm feeling better than before we began, nojya." That's good. If it gives her a little more confidence in the future, you don't really mind if it's just a load of bunk. Sighing, you brush away a few loose strands of hair from Kohaku's cheeks and watch her big red eyes. Ever since becoming a mother, something's shifted deep inside of her, a gain and a loss all at once. Does she believe in this little baby ceremony that she's done? "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ]... I wouldn't be doing it if I didn't believe in it at least a little, would I? All of my faint memories from when I was really little can't be wrong, nojya." She squeezes your hand gently. "I just want to be with her as much as I can, for as long as she'll have me. Isn't there that saying in Jassira? 'Your son's your son until he takes a wife, but your daughter's your daughter all your life.' She'll be growing up better than I did, I'll be making sure of that. I just don't want... never mind, nojya." There's no need to be coy — at this point, she doesn't need to feel like she has to keep anything from you. "I... I'm just not sure how to put it into words, nojya. But I think you do get a little of what I've been trying to say." Yes, you think you have. That being said, Mai's right — it's getting rather late, and she ought to turn in for what's left of the night. There's no need to stand on ceremony; she should be going. "Good night, [pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. Perhaps I'll see you tomorrow at the storehouse." Clutching your now-snoozing daughter close to her, Kohaku patters off, fur gleaming in the moonlight and tails swishing behind her. The future, huh...
rows.translation: 其实，你以为自己会留在这里看着这一切发展吧？你可能是为了舞的事情来到这里的，但这个惊喜确实很愉快，而且，这也是为了你的女儿，对吧？有红叶在身边陪伴你，也没有理由急着离开啊。 [pc.ra kitsune |感谢您在我身边支持我，尊贵的阁下，”小红即便已深夜仍竖起耳朵，面带灿烂的笑容对您说道，“我觉得诸神在您恰好出现在这里的时刻将您引荐给我，绝非巧合，诺贾。 你可能不了解什么是神的干预，但你确实很乐意看到她开心。无论你和梅之间有什么事情，都可以等等；现在这件事才更重要。 听到这话，小花开心地摇着尾巴，然后用尾巴轻轻一甩，为你在她旁边腾出了一个座位。你接受了它，然后转向梅——其实之前并不需要进行什么仪式性的净化之类的，对吧？ “对于这样的事情，再加上像你这样接近神明的人，根本不需要这些仪式。如果你愿意的话，我这个小不点可以撒点盐，但你的到来本身就已经比任何盐都要有意义了。" |谢谢你还留下来，诺雅！”尽管已经很晚了，小花还是兴奋地对你说道，她的耳朵都竖了起来。“不知道这个时候你来这里有什么事，不过我很高兴你能来。 [pc.name]嘿，她也熬到这么晚才睡，而且她更没有理由熬夜吧。至少你没有日常任务之类的东西需要处理。” 红颊微红，小红舌吐了出来，对着你说。我这么做都是为了我们的孩子，诺雅。相比之下，几个小时的睡眠根本不算什么，嘿嘿。” 而你在和琥珀交谈的时候，舞却走过来，在你的脚上撒了一撮盐。这是一种仪式性的净化措施，你懂的——毕竟我们不希望外界因素影响孩子的决定，就是这种意思。 ] 终于，那个重要的时刻到来了。当所有的物品都被摆成半圆形的布局后，舞示意小红继续进行下一步。那只金色的小狐妖伸出手，将你那昏昏欲睡的女儿放在了物品的中心位置，同时还格外小心地确保她那柔软的小身体与每一个选项之间的距离都是完全相等的。 有那么一刻，你以为你的女儿只会蜷缩起来继续睡觉——那个可怜的小家伙半闭着眼睛，正在努力保持清醒呢。你看着她，那个金色的小毛球打了个哈欠，环顾四周，周围只有微弱而银色的月光在照耀，然后她把自己紧紧地抱在怀里，静止了好长时间，仿佛时间都仿佛停止了一般。至少，对她的母亲来说，这种情景简直无法忍受—— 琥珀将手指紧紧握在一起，那锋利的牙齿也暴露了出来，这一切都已经说明了一切。 不过，琥珀心中肯定也在思考着一个未说出口的问题：如果那个婴儿没有抓住……会怎么样呢？任何东西这是否意味着一个充满不确定性的未来，甚至更糟，根本没有未来？还是说，那个所谓的未来其实并不在于那些已经准备好的物品之中……但考虑到琥珀对与你女儿相关的事情总是如此敏感，你肯定知道她会往最坏的方向去想。 幸运的是，这种紧张气氛很快就被打破了——那个原本显得毫不在意的婴儿又打了个哈欠，然后将目光投向眼前的食物。当这个小家伙爬过来并抓起食物时，琥珀也终于放松了下来。 [pc.highestStat strength agility toughness presence willpower cunning |[var0 |一把小到足以被藏在衣服里的刀。现在你是怎么没注意到它的呢？当你意识到她实际上想要拿的是什么时，你的心会猛地一跳；而当月光照亮那把刀，让你看到它的刀刃已经变钝，刀尖也被磨掉了时，你又会慢慢平静下来。对，对……无论是小花还是梅，都不会犯那么大的错误，让一个婴儿接触到真正危险的东西。 琥珀艰难地咽了口唾沫，摇了摇头。“哦，不……绝对不行。我记得你的表弟在族长夫人把他送到海外去接受教育之前是什么样的人，也记得他五年后回来时的样子。如果我的亲生骨肉也变得像他那样毫无幽默感，我想我一定会活不下去的。 但是，你总不会拒绝她追求自己的梦想和兴趣吧？毕竟，一位母亲也不会阻碍自己的孩子去实现这些目标，对吧？” 空气中突然弥漫着紧张的气氛，你迅速站在这两位女性之间，防止她们之间发生争执。喂，这次仪式本来应该是为了你女儿好，而不是让你们互相攻击、口角不断的借口啊。 [pc.ra kitsune |如果有必要的话，你就得利用你的职权，让他们俩尽快冷静下来，否则…… |作为一个旁观者来说，他们确实进展得太快了。 rows.raw: " Actually, you think you'll stay here and watch this play out — you may have come here with business for Mai, but this surprise is a pleasant one and besides, it's for your daughter, isn't it? With Kohaku around to keep you company there's no reason to be rushing off in a hurry. [pc.ra kitsune |"Thank you for being here for me, your Eminence," Kohaku says, ears perking up despite the late hour as she beams at you. "I don't think it was a coincidence that the gods sent you here when you did, nojya." You don't know about divine intervention, but you do enjoy seeing her happy. Whatever business you had with Mai, it can wait; this is more important. Kohaku wiggles happily at that, and clears out a seat for you beside her with a flick of her tails. You accept it, and turn to Mai — you don't need to be ritually cleansed or anything beforehand, do you? "F'r somethin' like this, coupled with someone as close to th' divine as ya? Ain't no need. If'n ya wanna, lil' ol' me can do a pinch o' salt, but yer presence alone's better than any salt." |"Thanks for sticking around, nojya!" Kohaku says, ears perking up despite the late hour as she beams at you. "Not sure what kind of business you have here at this hour, but I'm glad you came, [pc.name]." Hey, she's up at a pretty late hour, too, and has even less of a reason to be up to boot. At least you don't have regular duties and the like to attend to. Cheeks coloring, Kohaku sticks her tongue out at you. "I'm doing this for our child, nojya. A few hours of sleep isn't worth that much in the scheme of things, hee hee." While you've been speaking with Kohaku, Mai's come up and sprinkled a pinch of salt about your feet. A ritual cleansing, you take it — wouldn't want outside influences influencing the kid's decisions, that kind of thing. ] At last, though, the big moment arrives. With all the objects laid out in a semicircle, Mai gestures for Kohaku to proceed. The little golden vixen reaches out and sets your drowsy daughter in the middle of the lot, taking great care to ensure that her little fuzzy body is exactly equally distant from each option. For a moment, you think that your daughter's just going to curl up in her tails and go back to sleep — the poor thing's struggling to keep awake with her eyes half-lidded. As you watch, the little golden furball yawns, looks around at her surroundings lit only by the wan, silvery moonlight, then squishes up against herself and pauses for an unbearably long time. Well, unbearable for her mother, at least — the way Kohaku's got her fingers together and has her sharpened teeth on edge tells you all you need to know. There's the unspoken thought, though, that's no doubt on the forefront of Kohaku's mind: what if the infant doesn't grab anything? Does that mean an uncertain future, or even worse, no future? Or maybe it's just that said future isn't in the items that've been laid out... but knowing how Kohaku is about matters that pertain to your daughter, you know she's going to assume the worst. Thankfully, that tension breaks as the otherwise nonchalant infant yawns again and raises her gaze to take in the spread before her. Kohaku's on edge as the little creature crawls forward and grabs hold of [pc.highestStat strength agility toughness presence willpower cunning |[var0 |a knife, small enough to fit in one's clothing. Now how did you miss that? Your heart skips a beat when you realize what she's actually reaching for, then calm yourself when the moonlight reveals the edge to be dulled and the point blunted. Right, right...neither Kohaku nor Mai would be careless enough to let a baby get hold of something genuinely dangerous. Still, that was quite the scare — is this how Kohaku feels when those troublesome thoughts plague her? Nevertheless, your little golden furball is absolutely enamored of the small, dull knife, giggling and making to wave it about until Mai steps in and gently removes it from the kit's grasp. "[pc.ra kitsune |Yer Eminence |[pc.name] ], Kohaku, I done think she's made her point pre-tty clear. Kid really done like sharp things." Heh. Does this mean you'll have to go looking for a practice weapon for her in the years to come? You'll have years to do so, but it doesn't hurt to think ahead. "Wouldn't say that ain't th' case, but wouldn't be sayin' yes, either. Give it a year or two." Kohaku appears a little unsure of all this, but nods. |a chisel, the fine sort that might be used to shape wood or perhaps even stone. You're a little worried when she grabs it by the handle with her little baby hand and starts waving it around, but you relax a little when you see that the edge's been dulled. Still, that was quite the scare — is this how Kohaku feels when those troublesome thoughts plague her? Nevertheless, your little golden furball is absolutely enamored of the cutting tool, moving to bite it by the handle the way a fox would carry something by the mouth until Mai steps in and stops her. "All right, that there's enough, ya lil' scamp. Yer made yerself clear — now put that there thing down 'fore ya get sick from bitin' it all over." Once she's retrieved the chisel — making your daughter all pouty in the process, to boot — Mai hands the little golden furball back to Kohaku and gives you a nod. This is very cute and all, but you weren't planning on being present at an entire ceremony this evening. You came to the shrine looking for Mai, and since she's otherwise occupied you'll be fine with getting on with the next item on your long list of things to do.
        
        [pc.ra kitsune
            |"My apologies, yer Eminence," Mai says, turning to you and bowing. "If'n ya want, I could see to yer business first before —"
            
            No, that won't be necessary. [pc.isDK
                |S
                |You're not going to pull rank here, and s

            |ya wish

[pc.isDK|You note to your satisfaction|You note that] that there're several bruises on her face that you left from your previous encounter with her — given the ferocity of the fight, really, that there're merely bruises says something about this shortstack of a foxy grandma. "Well? Are you going to stand there all day?" She speaks Belharan with a distinct accent, yet the words are correctly enunciated. The words of someone who at base is completely unsuited to a language, but nevertheless is fluent in conversation from sheer practice. Komari gestures for you to pull up a cushion, and you do so, lowering yourself to the ground in order to be more on her level.[party.som| | [party.compNames] takes a step back away from this small meeting, letting you speak privately. | [party.compNames] take a step back away from this small meeting, letting you speak privately. ] "At least I hope that we can manage a decent enough conversation without going at each others' throats this time. Did Oxana appreciate the return of her toys?" She was mollified enough, you suppose. "If I were you, I'd seriously reconsider working for Oxana," Komari continues. "She spends most of her energies feuding with Carmen — has been for the last couple of centuries, really — and thus has favored hiring mercenaries to do her other dirty work. Expendables, to better illustrate the mindset she sees them with; the strongest and most effective pawn is one that you're willing to sacrifice." She seems to have been straightforward in her dealings so far. "Just because you offer loans at ruinous rates and are straightforward about it doesn't mean it's not a rotten practice. But I'm not going to mince my words further — while I don't know what she's thinking and nor know of anything she might have up her sleeve, people who get tangled up in that witch's business too deeply tend to meet sticky ends. Very sticky ones. I know you probably don't have any reason to trust me on this given the circumstances of our last meeting, but I'd still advise you to be careful and draw your own conclusions for yourself. If you last that long, that is." And if you endeared yourself to the witch? "Oh, no. That's the last thing you want to do — to become so valuable in her eyes that she can't let go of you. If that happens... she won't want to let you out of her sight. Forever. But that's enough about Oxana... presumably you're not here on her business, are you?" If you were, you wouldn't be as peaceful as you are, given how poorly she speaks of the tanuki witch. Komari mulls that over for a second or two. "Well, if you really want to prove that what happened last time was just one big misunderstanding, there's something you can do about that." |You approach and look down at the diminutive kitsune sitting upon a cushion at her floor desk, her many tails curled comfortably about her person as she deals with the day-to-day business of managing an arcology of a hundred families — that was what she said, wasn't it? Or was it someone else? If not for the golden crown perched atop her brow, you might not have thought anything strange about her — well, that and the blank eyes that glow faintly. But after all this time, you've made it here. This is what passes for the local leader of the kitsune, and if anyone can help Kiyoko out of her predicament, it's her. If nothing else, the words you exchanged during your first meeting have given you cause to hope... "Ah. Are you going to stand there all day?" She speaks Belharan with a distinct accent, yet the words are correctly enunciated. The words of someone who at base is completely unsuited to a language, but nevertheless is fluent in conversation from sheer practice. Ah, but you didn't know the correct way to approach one of her station... She waves you off. "You wouldn't be expected to know. So long as you don't display any malice, you'll find that most people living here are quite forgiving when it comes to bumbling foreigners breaching all kinds of etiquette in what often amounts to the most amusing manners. That, and saying something is better than just standing there looking silly." You scrutinize Komari's face, but there's nothing there except genuine earnestness, and that's all there is despite how much you attempt to dig beyond that smiling facade — if it's a facade to begin with, that is. Komari gestures for you to pull up a cushion, and you do so, lowering yourself to the ground in order to be more on her level.[party.som| | [party.compNames] takes a step back away from this small meeting, letting you speak privately. | [party.compNames] take a step back away from this small meeting, letting you speak privately. ] Well, where should you begin? It's good that you're now meeting on better terms, considering the circumstances you first encountered her under. "Oxana is... who she is. She spends most of her energies feuding with Carmen, and thus despite her animosity towards me has little strength to spare after spending most of it on the vampiress. Hence, mercenaries, of whom there are no shortage of in these trying times. Shameful. Yet... well, in the case you were hired for, I can't say that it was unjustified given what Mikoto and Miyuki did. Was she mollified somewhat by the return of her personal possessions?" Evergreen seemed satisfied enough and even gave you a bonus, as you remember. "Then let's hope she leaves it at that and has her silly little cum-brain forget that this ever happened. It's all so tiring. But enough of that. You wanted to see me about the amulet, didn't you? We conversed briefly about it the last time, but didn't get very far..." As you remember it, her patron deity was preoccupied at the moment and couldn't reply. "Yes. But before we proceed with the matter of the amulet, there's something I need you to do first." ] And that would be? You're all ears. "Oh, it's nothing much; I wouldn't ask anything that's beyond reason. All I would like for you to do is to go around and introduce yourself to the people who live around here, make sure that you see them as... well, people who can be spoken to and reasoned with, as opposed to the alternative." And that alternative would be? "Monsters. Which is not completely undeserved, perhaps, given our proclivities and needs, but unhelpful if you would like to engage them in any kind of constructive endeavor. I'm not asking you to greet every single family that lives in the den — that would be a little too much — but you ought to be acquainted with the major personages whom you'll be dealing with, if nothing else. Now let's see... these are the people I'd like you to get formally acquainted with." [var0 |Actually... when you hear the names Komari mentions, you realize that you have already introduced yourself to them. Kohaku, Miko and Mai, Nakano... whether you were following some kind of plan starting from the ground up or just happened to do so by good fortune, you've dropped by the doors of all these people and said your hellos. "Yes? Is something the matter?" You briefly inform Komari that there's no need for her to send you on this task because you've already completed it prior to ever setting foot here. Her eyebrows raise at that, but as you recount how the introductions went she settles back and looks a little sheepish. "Well," she says at last, "you're certainly one to move quickly and get around, [pc.race]. Not that it's necessarily a bad thing... I suppose it's my failing here. I would've heard of it if I weren't so engrossed... but that's not an excuse, either. "Still, that makes things much easier. Give me a couple of minutes to finish this, and we can get down to business. Matters of divinity take precedence over all else, I'm afraid."
rows.translation: [flags.FLOOF_HAUS_KOMARI_RESOLUTION 1 2 |你走近，俯视着坐在地上的书桌前的娇小狐妖，她众多的尾巴舒适地环绕着她的身躯，正处理着管理百户人家的弧形建筑的日常事务——她说的是这个，对吧？还是另有其人？若不是她额头上那顶金冠，你或许不会觉得她有什么奇怪之处——当然，还有她那双空洞的眼眸微微泛着光芒。 [pc.isDK|你满意地记下|你注意到]那她的脸上有几处淤青，是你们上次见面时留下的——考虑到那场战斗的激烈程度，说真的，居然只是淤青，这说明了这位身材娇小却机灵的老奶奶的厉害之处。 嗯？你是不是要站到天黑？她用一种独特的口音说着Belharan语，但每个字都发音清晰。这是一位原本似乎完全不擅长语言的人，却通过反复练习而变得流利。小毬示意你拉来一个垫子，你照做，蹲下身子，让自己与她平齐。[party.som| | [party.compNames]向这场小会议后退一步，让你能私下交谈。 | [party.compNames]退后一步，离开这场小范围会议，以便你们能私下交谈。 ] 至少我希望这次我们能好好谈谈，不至于又吵起来。奥克萨娜是不是很高兴她的玩具终于回来了？ 她总算平复了情绪，你猜。 要是我你的话，真该重新考虑是否还要继续为奥克萨娜效力。科玛莉继续说道。 她到目前为止的交涉似乎都很直接。 你们明明以毁灭性的利率放贷，还直言不讳，但这并不意味着这还不是个烂透的行径。不过我也不再拐弯抹角——虽然我不知道她在想什么，也不清楚她袖子里还藏着什么招数，但那些太深地卷入那个女巫生意的人，往往会迎来粘糊糊的结局。黏糊糊的家伙们。我知道，鉴于我们上次见面的情况，你大概没什么理由相信我。不过我仍然建议你小心点，自己得出结论。如果你能撑到那时候的话。" 如果赢得了女巫的好感，又会如何？ 哦，不。你最不想做的事，就是变得如此珍贵，让她无法放手。如果真到了那一步……她会寸步不离地跟着你，永远。但说到奥克萨娜，就先到此为止吧……想必你可不是为了她的事才来的吧？ 你要是真的那样，就不会像现在这样平静了，毕竟她对那只狸猫女巫的评价差得可怜。 麻里思索片刻。嗯，如果你想证明上次发生的事只是个大误会，那你可以做点什么来解决。 |你走近，俯视着端坐在地板书桌前的垫子上的娇小狐仙，她那数条尾巴舒适地环绕着身躯，正处理着管理百人家庭的弧ology的日常事务——她说的没错，对吧？难道是另一个人？若不是她额头上那顶金冠，你或许不会觉得她有什么奇怪之处——当然，还有那双微微发光的空洞眼睛。历经这么多时间，你终于来到这里。这就是狐族的本地领袖，如果有人能帮清子脱困，那一定就是她自己。至少，你们初次见面时的对话给了你希望的可能…… 啊，你打算站那儿一整天？她用一种独特的口音说着贝哈兰语，但每个字都发音清晰。她本该是个语言的门外汉，却因反复练习而变得能言善辩。 啊，但你还不知道该如何接近她这样的地位的人…… 她挥手示意你退下。你不用知道。只要你不显露出恶意，你会发现这里的人们大多很宽容，对于那些常常以最有趣的方式打破各种礼仪的笨拙外国游客来说。毕竟，说点什么总比站在那里傻笑要好。 你仔细端详着麻里的脸，但除了真挚的认真之外，再无其他。无论你怎样努力想要看透她那张微笑的假象——如果那张笑脸原本就是个假象的话——也终究只是如此。麻里示意你搬来个坐垫，你照做，盘腿坐在地上，好让自己更接近她的高度。[party.som| | [party.compNames]向这场小会议后退一步，让你能私下说话。 | [party.compNames]退后一步，离开这场小聚，让你们能私下交谈。 ] 嗯，你该从哪里开始呢？当初相遇时的种种，如今能以更融洽的条件相见，确实不错。 奥克萨娜……就是她自己。她大部分精力都花在和卡门的争斗上，因此尽管她对我怀有敌意，但大部分精力都消耗在那个吸血鬼女仆身上，对我的敌意也就显得微不足道了。因此，佣兵……这些艰难时期里从不缺人。丢脸。不过……就你这次受雇的情况而言，考虑到米克oto和米由纪所做的一切，倒也算情有可原。她是否因为个人物品的归还而稍微平复了些许？ 常青女士似乎相当满意，还给了你一个额外奖励，你还记得吧。 希望她就此作罢，让那点蠢念头忘掉这一切。真是够累的。行了，别再提了。你不是想和我谈谈那个护符的事吗？上次我们简短地聊过，但没谈出什么结果…… 你还记得吗？她当时的守护神正忙得不可开交，无法回应。 是的。不过在处理护身符的事情之前，我需要你先做件事。 ] 那会是？洗耳恭听。 哦，没什么大不了的；我不会提出过分的要求。我只要你去四处走走，向这里的居民介绍一下自己，确保让他们看起来是能沟通、讲道理的人，而不是另一种情况。 那个替代方案是什么呢？ 怪物。或许，考虑到我们的习性和需求，这倒也不算完全委屈他们，但如果你想和他们展开任何建设性的合作，这就有点不太方便了。我可不是让你去逐一拜访洞穴里每个家庭——那未免太夸张了点。也虽然很多——但你至少应该熟悉即将打交道的主要人物。现在让我们看看……这些人就是我想让你正式结识的。 [var0 |其实……当你听到小毬提到的名字时，你会意识到你有已经向他们介绍过自己了。 琥珀、米可、舞、中野……无论你是有计划地从头开始，还是偶然的巧合，你已经逐一到访这些人的门前，打过招呼了。 嗯？怎么了？ 你简单地告诉小毬，不需要她再派你去执行这个任务，因为你在踏足这里之前就已经完成了。她挑起眉毛，但当你回忆起介绍的过程时，她靠回椅背，显得有点不好意思。 好吧。她终于说道。你确实是个行动迅速、灵活的人，[pc.race]说不一定就是坏事……我想这里是我的疏忽了。如果我没那么专注的话……但这也说不上是借口。 不过，这倒是让事情简单多了。让我再花几分钟完成这件事，之后我们就可以开始正事了。恐怕神事的安排，必须优先于其他一切。

rows.original: With Komari nose-deep in her paperwork, you decide to give the shortstack of a foxy granny her space. After all the social pleasantries you've been through, you can wait a little while for her to be done, can't you? |So, go around and say hello, make sure no one's feathers are ruffled from what happened last time? Make peace and ensure there aren't any hard feelings? That sounds like something you can do. "It's more than that, but such an effort would be appreciated. Now, if there's nothing else, I would ask you to excuse me. There are several matters which my patron deity has requested I look into and I cannot put those off for too long." With that, Komari turns back to the scrolls and papers on her desk, several of her tails shifting into a more comfortable position against her shortstack of a body. Looks like she's going to be busy for a little while just yet...

rows.original: Stepping into the den matron's chambers, the sound of familiar voices drifts down to you from the doorway. You recognize who's with Komari at once — the beautiful flute-like voice of your fox-wife is unmistakable. Looks like Kiyoko's come to pay her old retainer a visit, and the two are seated on cushions about the low table, geniality practically oozing off them as [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |the strong, bitter smell of Old country-style tea rises in the air |Kinu waits on them hand and foot, your daughter's tails and sleeves swishing in her wake as she serves them tea and candies ]. "...It's hard to believe so much has happened in but two and a half centuries, Komari," your fox-wife says. "Yet it has. True, our divine lordship had returned, and yes, I know all the legends and lore surrounding him, but even so... to hear that the shogunate has been abolished, and that was but the least of the upheavals..." "No more shogunate. No more bakfuku government. All powers returned to the Cherry Blossom Throne, and all treaties signed with the Belharans by the shogunate prior to the Celestial Restoration declared void. Not that by the end of the fighting, Belhar was in any shape to protest this." Komari closes her eyes and sets her teacup on the table's surface, firmly grasping it in both hands. "And on the other side, no one was going to argue with the Trickster himself. rows.translation: 走进女首领的房间，门口传来一些熟悉的声音。你立刻就听出了和小毬在一起的人是谁——你那位声音如笛子般动听的狐妖妻子，她的声音绝对不会被误认。看来清子是来探望她这位老仆人的，两人正坐在低矮的桌子旁，身上散发着浓浓的亲切氛围。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |空气中弥漫着那种浓郁、苦涩的乡村风格茶叶的味道 |小娟忙前忙后地为他们服务，你的女儿跟在后面，她的裙摆和袖子随着动作摆动着，一边为他们端茶递糖果 ]。 ……真是难以相信，在短短两个半世纪的时间里，发生了这么多事情，麻里。你那个狐妖老婆是这么说的。然而事实就是如此。诚然，我们的神圣君主已经归来，我也了解所有关于他的传说和故事，但即便如此……听到幕府已经被废除，而这一事件只不过是诸多变革中最微不足道的一个罢了…… 不再有幕府。不再有bakfuku政府。所有的权力都重新回到了樱花宝座手中，而在“天复”之前幕府与贝尔哈兰人签署的所有条约都被宣布无效。不过，等到战斗结束的时候，贝尔哈兰已经无力再对此提出抗议了。麻里闭上了眼睛，将茶杯稳稳地放在桌面上，双手紧紧地握住它。而另一方面，也没有人会敢于与诡计之神本人争论。‘天高皇帝远’——嗯，现在连天都降临到我们中间，亲自面对着他们所有人。 那场面肯定非常壮观。 我的主公，他历经十年游历各地，而最初的十年我是与他一同度过的。他坚信，既然孤立主义行不通，我们就永远不会再向那些由他的大敌们领导的外国势力屈服。神明惩罚首先从他在皇室中最直系的后裔们开始——就因为几个世纪前他们让局势恶化到这种地步：他们仅仅成了傀儡，还因此引发了一场内战。您真该亲眼看看那一幕，奥托摩夫人——他的神圣陛下当众斥责那位皇帝！我当时真以为他会羞愧而死呢！ 诡计之神并没有就此罢休——他话音刚落，就指责藤原家族为了巩固自己的权力，而纵容宫廷中的堕落风气；接着，他又逐一批评了其余十二个神族。没错……你们的家族也受到了严厉的指责，因为他们太轻信外国人了，几乎让他的这片挚爱之地沦为对手的势力范围。 清子的表情没有变化，但她还是用手捂住了嘴。哦，天哪。 当我们的神圣主公在各地巡游时，没有人是安全的。真的没有人。只要他看中某件事，无论多么微不足道，他都会毫不留情地加以整治。他常说：‘鱼烂从头起，树朽从根发。’他认为，当前的局面是上层和下层所有人都应负责任的，而他决心整顿这一切。因此，很多人突然变得异常虔诚起来，不过这其实也没什么意义。 啊。清子思考了片刻，然后转过身来。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |把她的茶杯放回托盘上。当忽视神明的指引所带来的后果显而易见时，人们便很容易产生对神的敬畏之情。然而，当一个人被世俗的财富、事务和享乐所束缚时，保持虔诚就变得困难多了。 |去管管你那个狐狸女儿吧。原谅我，女儿。两个老妇人谈论她们的过去，而这些故事发生在一个你从未见过的地方……肯定让你感到厌烦了吧。 一点也不，母亲。未来是建立在过去的基础之上的；文明是一代又一代人持续努力的结果。如果我都不清楚自己的根源在哪里，我又怎么可能知道该朝哪个方向前进呢？如果我连从哪里开始都不知道，那我建造的就会是一座根基不牢的建筑。 麻里笑了。她对于每一个问题都能给出答案，而且还是非常圆滑得体的答案。 我或许从未见过自己的故乡，也可能永远见不到，但你们的经历中仍然有很多值得我学习的地方——而这些经历，都是通过那些我热爱和尊重的人与我联系在一起的呢。 哦，现在你是在讨好像我这样的老妇人罢了。麻里突然开始轻声咳嗽起来。哈哈，我想我得让中野带你去至少去你位于海洋对面的家族领地玩上一天吧。就当是一次短途旅行吧——我知道你的心其实在这里，姑娘，所以我不会让你离开太久。 ] 清子看起来像是要再说些什么，但突然她的耳朵动了一下，她抬头回头，看到了站在门口的你。哦，欢迎回来，亲爱的。希望我们没有让你等太久……说真的，小毬，你就是坐在门口那个位置的人，你应该早就注意到了才对。 [pc.name]在我那么做之前。 我原本以为[pc.name]我并不希望你们的谈话被不必要的因素打断。 确实，你没有。如果她正在和她的老友一起愉快地回忆过去的美好时光，或许你应该改天再来吧—— 清子摇了摇头，不再考虑这个想法了。不，不。家里还有很多事情要处理——你得去处理那些事情。 [pc.name]在这里。非常感谢你们今天的热情款待，我一定会尽快再次回访的。 说完这句话，清子站了起来。[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0||当她从女儿身边经过时，向小娟点了点头。]以及所有的树叶。 [kiyoko.kiyokoTails]她离开时，尾巴华丽地摆动着。你的狐妖妻子果然懂得如何以与她的身份相称的方式离开，不是吗？麻里留下了还冒着热气的茶，邀请你过来填补清子最近留下的空位——那个垫子还带着你那位狐妖妻子的体温，坐上去感觉非常温暖舒适。 那么，就这样吧。女头目在为你服务时说道。今天游客的数量一直在稳定增加，是吧？所以[pc.ra kitsune|阁下， ]今天你有什么事情想找我谈吗，还是只是想随便聊聊而已？

rows.original: Stepping into the den matron's chambers, you're greeted with the sight of Kiyoko being tended to by her faithful retainer. Kneeling on a cushion by the low table, her body turned to the side, your fox-wife looks incredibly snug and pleased with herself as Komari fusses over the [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |round bump of the kit taking shape inside of her, pushing outwards heartily from the flowing fabric of her yukata |huge bump of the kit inside of her, almost ready to be born at this point. Her enormous pregnant belly rests atop her knees as she supports it with her hands ] — it's clear that Kiyoko is taking no small amount of pleasure from all the attention. "Both you and the kit are doing very well, Myobu-sama. There's nothing to be concerned about." "Just as well," your fox-wife replies with a smile. "[kiyoko.numKits 1 4 8 32 |I'm sure Kinu could use more company around the house. It's important for her to have many brothers and sisters so she's used to being around young kits |I'm sure Kinu won't mind having a few more brothers and sisters to mind. It'll be good practice for her down the line... although with the way she's turning out, even this may not be enough preparation |Kinu already has plenty of siblings, but a few more won't be that much more work for her than what's already there |Given my experience, it would be awkward if there were complications from such an experienced mother like me ]. And what about you? By the looks of it, your descendants are doing quite well for themselves." "You honor me with such praise, my liege." "Come now, Komari. Even though you aren't carrying divine blood, that's still quite the impressive record you have there." The den matron bows her head, looking sheepish. "Voluntary emigrants were... hard to find at first; many who had come on the initial expedition wanted nothing more to do with the land across the ocean. The next generation would need hands, and my husband and I thought to lead by example... we did quite well for ourselves over the next fifty years or so, until my body could no longer conceive children. I stopped aging soon after, and remained much as you see me now." Kiyoko smiles. "Well-adjusted kits are a noble pursuit; there is no greater joy nor duty than the raising and care of another person into a fulfilled life. I am, of course, hardly inclined to be impartial... but planting trees we will never sit in the shade of is our duty. Well then, if you have declared both mother and child healthy, then I shall take my leave and demand no more of your time. After all, I believe there is someone here who needs your attention more than I do." With that, Kiyoko rises, if a little unsteadily, and heads for the door. She's probably the only person in all of Savarra who can make a pregnant waddle look regal and dignified, giving you a dip of her head as she passes you by, your fox-wife taps you on the leg with one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails before making herself scarce. Well, guess it's your turn now...
rows.translation: 走进女首领的寝室，你看到的是清子正由她忠实的侍从照料着。清子跪在矮桌旁的垫子上，身体微微侧倾，你的这位狐狸妻子看起来非常惬意，似乎对侍从的照料感到十分满意。 [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |她体内，那件装备的轮廓逐渐成形，从她和服柔软的布料中有力地向外凸现出来。 |她腹中的胎儿已经发育得相当大了，几乎快要出生了。她那隆起的孕妇腹部搁在膝盖上，她用手支撑着它。 ]显然，清子从这一切关注中获得了极大的乐趣。 你和这套装备的表现都非常出色，宫本大人。没有任何需要担心的地方。 也好。你的狐狸妻子微笑着回应道。"[kiyoko.numKits 1 4 8 32 |我相信小娟在家里需要更多陪伴。对她来说，拥有很多兄弟姐妹是很重要的，这样她就能习惯和年幼的动物们一起生活了。 |我相信小娟肯定不介意多几个需要照顾的兄弟姐妹。这对她来说也是一种很好的锻炼……不过，以她现在的成长速度来看，也许这样的经历还不够。 |小娟已经有很多兄弟姐妹了，但再添几个也不会给她带来太多额外的麻烦。 |以我的经验来看，如果像我这样经验丰富的母亲在这种情况下出现什么问题，那肯定会很尴尬。 ]那你呢？看样子，你的后代们现在都过得相当不错啊。 您的赞美让我感到无比荣幸，我的君主。 过来吧，麻里。虽然你没有流淌着神之血脉，但你所取得的成就已经相当令人印象深刻了。 巢穴的女首领低下了头，显得有些羞愧。起初，自愿移民确实很难找到；许多最初随探险队来到这里的人，根本不想再与这片海洋对面的土地有任何瓜葛。不过，下一代人确实需要劳动力，于是我和我的丈夫决定以身作则……在接下来的五十年左右时间里，我们过得相当不错，直到我的身体再无法生育。不久之后，我的衰老过程也停止了，至今依然保持着你们现在看到的这个样子。 清子笑了。培养出适应良好的人才是崇高的目标；没有什么比帮助他人过上充实的生活更令人喜悦、更具有责任感了。当然，我几乎不可能保持客观……但种植那些我们永远无法享受其荫蔽的树木，确实是我们的责任。那么，既然你们已经确认母亲和孩子都健康无恙，我就不再占用你们的时间了。毕竟，我相信这里还有其他人比我更需要你们的关注。 说完，清子站了起来，虽然有些不稳，但还是朝着门口走去。在整个萨瓦拉，她可能是唯一一个能让孕妇特有的摇摆步态看起来既高贵又端庄的人——当她从你身边经过时，会轻轻低头致意，而你的狐妻用她的[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]条尾巴之一轻拍了拍你的腿，随后匆匆离开。 好吧，现在轮到你了……

After all, I believe there is someone here who needs your attention more than I do." With that, Kiyoko rises, if a little unsteadily, and heads for the door. She's probably the only person in all of Savarra who can make a pregnant waddle look regal and dignified, giving you a dip of her head as she passes you by, your fox-wife taps you on the leg with one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails before making herself scarce. Well, guess it's your turn now... "

You shake your head and [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |tug on Hitoshi's sleeve. "So, this is where you were." "..." "What are those two on about? "You've come at a good time, Kinu. These two started fighting some time ago and haven't stopped since." "Some time ago being...?" "Some time." Hitoshi tucks his arms into his sleeves in a show of helplessness. "I walked in on them like this, much as you have, and while my presence here has prevented things from escalating I don't think they're going to stop anytime soon. rows.translation: 不久前…… 从院子里传来了狐狸的叫声，而你注意到那里显然空无一人。大多数人都明智地选择了躲藏起来[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|小蚊子奶奶|巢穴的女首领]他们正在争吵，从声音来看，这场争吵似乎相当激烈。 不过，你能够取得今天的成就，正是因为你从不回避冲突—— [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |就在你还在寻找仁的时候，这件事似乎正好需要你的介入。 |不管你愿不愿意，这些来自琥珀的账号都必须被放到它们该在的位置上。 ]你挺直肩膀跨过门槛，映入眼帘的景象却截然相反—— 一边是[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|奶奶|女士]麻里紧握着她的手杖，指关节都变得煞白，愤怒地在空中挥舞着它。而另一边则是舞，她那惯常冷漠的神情早已消失，那只未遮住的眼睛里流露出的轻微皱眉与怒视，比米子用再多的喊叫和尖叫所能造成的威胁还要可怕。被夹在她们两人中间，稍微站在一旁的，是值得信赖的老人仁志，他双臂交叉，冷眼旁观着这场激烈的争吵不断升级。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |还没等你反应过来，你就已经走到他身边，挽住了他的胳膊肘。他甚至都没有低头看你，而是继续专注于与那些争论不休的亲戚们交谈。 |这个位置看起来是个观察争论的理想地点，于是你走到了他那一边——当然，同时保持着尊重和适当的距离。 ] 奶奶，我实在受够了这些无聊的事情，再也无法忍受下去了。你的行为简直像个疯子一样。至少你应该给我机会说几句吧。 那你现在打算做什么呢？ 舞咬住了嘴唇。我并不是那个意思，你明明知道的！ 你摇了摇头，说道： [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |拉了拉仁的袖子。原来你之前一直在这里啊。 "……" 那两个人在聊什么呢？我从没想过会有这么一天，梅会气得开始争吵，但现在事实就是如此。 |尽量悄悄地清清嗓子。仁？ "……" 能问一下这里发生了什么吗？争论得这么激烈…… ] 仁在沉默中又过了片刻，这时他的两位亲戚又开始争吵起来[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |他俯下身来，轻轻拨弄你的头发，然后将手指从你的头巾下伸进去，挠你的耳朵后侧——正是你喜欢的方式 |向你投去侧目一眼 ]。 你来得正是时候，小娟。这两个人从前就开始打架了，从那以后就一直没停过。 不久前，有……？ 过一段时间吧。仁志无可奈何地把手臂插进了袖子里。我就像你一样，偶然撞见了他们。虽然我的出现阻止了事态进一步恶化，但我觉得他们短期内不会停止这种行为。或许可以称之为习惯使然吧，但我认为这件事更适合你们这些女性来处理。也许比起我，你们更适合调解这个矛盾。 格兰尼！你怎么会思考这种事，就更别提说出口了！ 姑娘，你首先应该多表现出一些孝心才对！ 当他们继续对话时，仁将目光转向了你。他确实是个可靠的人……但这也意味着他的惯常策略就是让别人在自己身上消耗精力，而面对这两个人，这种策略短期内是行不通的。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |你咧嘴一笑，然后一拳打在他的肋骨上——他甚至都没有察觉到。好吧，那我就试试看是否可以用一些女性特有的方式来解决这个问题。 |你仔细考虑了一下，把手指放在嘴唇上，然后露出了微笑。我会看看能做些什么。 ] 那将不胜感激。 好吧，没什么好说的。你清了清嗓子，然后走到祖母和孙女中间。正如你所预料的，她们俩立刻转过身来盯着你。 姑娘，别掺和这件事，这是家里的事情！ 是啊，小妹，这根本不关你的事，所以你就闭嘴好了—— 你强压住想要咬紧牙关的冲动，依然坚持继续前进。看，到底是什么引发了这一切？ 哈，真是没想到…… "……" "……" 麻里对舞露出了不悦的表情。……好吧。如果我们继续这样兜圈子，事情只会越来越复杂。我们告诉小娟，让她来判断到底是谁的错。你觉得这样没问题吧，姑娘？ 呃，没关系。她又没结婚嘛。 [kinu.isInari|仁志|中野]不过，我想她应该算是个从外部来看待这个问题的人吧……“好吧，我们可以这么办。而且无论妹妹说什么，最终决定都还是要按照她的意见来，好吗？ 我能够接受这一点。 你看看他们两个——至少现在他们开始用理性来思考问题了。这或许算是一个小小的进步吧…… 那么，发生了什么事呢？ 那好吧，小妹，我之前一直很担心奶奶，所以就给她准备了一份礼物。嗯，她确实不会变老，也不会生病，但有时候寒冷和潮湿还是会影响到她的身体……所以我把礼物做好了，然后送给了她。奶奶一开始很高兴，直到她拆开包装，看到了礼物是什么，然后她立刻就生气了。 你当时在想什么？你不能送我这样的礼物！ 哎呀，这也太没礼貌了吧！我只不过是想让你的骨头别受到伤害，所以才给你做了件穿在衣服里面的保暖内衣啊！ 暖胃的食物是给老年人吃的，而我可绝对不算老年人！ 奶奶，您都两百五十岁了。依我看，这个年纪绝对算得上老了吧。 你再次看向麻里，半期待着她会反驳什么，但你的未来婆婆此刻显得既愤怒又痛苦，脸色也变得煞白。她可能没有直接说出来，但你应该能猜到，这些看似琐碎的抱怨背后，真正困扰她的其实是什么。而仁则依旧是一副若无其事的样子，你根本无法从他那里得到任何帮助。 所以，小妹妹。到底谁才是错的一方呢？ 请回答。 说实话，你可以你认为他们俩都把这件事夸大了，但你知道，如果说他们俩都有错，只会惹恼他们，然后他们还是会继续争论下去。这不是一个你能给出且他们会接受的答案……这意味着你在这里的选择其实很有限。 到底该怎么办呢……

rows.original: "See, Miyuki? I told you I was in the right!" Mai looks between you and her great-great-grandmother, lip trembling. "Fine! All y'all gangin' up on me — what's yer deal anyway, lil' sis? [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Now that yer mom done come out an' said don't approve none o' yer dallyin' with my cuz Hitoshi, Granny's yer only lifeline, ain't she? Ya'll scared that if'n ya tick her off yer hopes of marryin' my cuz are gonna dry up, is it? |Guess ya gotta see my Granny's face close up every day, an' if'n ya'll tick her off she'll never let you live it down, that the case? ]" Wow, Mai actually looks like she's going to cry, and does she know how to cut deep when pressed into a corner. If this is happening to Mai, then any ordinary soul would be throwing a tantrum right about now. Komari takes a step towards her great-great granddaughter, but Mai darts away, snatching her pleated skirts with the clear intention of hightailing it out of here. "Miyuki!" "Spend th' time an' make a present, jus' to have it done scorned an' thrown back in' my face... I'm gonna go have a lie down." With that, she's out the door. Rolling her eyes, Komari jerks her thumb after her wayward granddaughter and Hitoshi rolls into action, lumbering after his cousin. You move to follow, too, but the den matron grabs you by the side of your waist and holds you back. "It's all right. Hitoshi going after her will be sufficient; her natural inclinations will regain their hold on her soon enough and she'll be her old self. Hmm. You don't look particularly convinced, dear." You sigh. You've been your mother's majordomo all your life... being answerable only to her hasn't prepared you in the least for this sort of thing. Altercations are one thing, altercations where both parties outrank you on the social ladder is another completely. "It was a hard decision," you say at last. "I don't doubt that it was, but you followed the reasoning that you believed to be right to its conclusion, no matter how unsavoury it might have been. That's something you'll need to get right down all firm and proper before you get married, let alone get pregnant with your first kit, dear." Wait, why did the conversation take such a — "Now then, what did you want to see me about?" "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |I was looking for Hitoshi at first, but now that you've sent him away after Mai there really isn't much point to that any more, is there? I think I'll stay here and keep you company for a bit, Granny. Where's the belly warmer Mai made, anyway?" "Oh?" "I'll try it on if you do." That earns a small laugh from Komari. "A young woman like you wearing one of those under her clothes? Oh, I get it, I get it. I'll... I'll give it a try, then. But you go first." "Of course, Granny. Wouldn't dream of it any other way." |I was going to see you about several records from the storehouse, Granny, but as things stand I don't think anyone's in the mood for work any more. How about we sit down and I play something for you to take your mind off things? A little music would help." "Yes... that would be appreciated. After I put away Miyuki's gift, of course." Ah. So there's a non-zero chance that despite all her protests, she might actually end up using the thing anyway. Maybe she's feeling a little guilty even though you sided with her in the end? "I know that look on your face, girl. Don't you go around telling Miyuki that I might be wearing that belly warmer... in fact, forget about playing me something; I'm going to make you my accomplice. Let's see how you stand wearing something as old-fashioned as that." ]
rows.translation: 看吧，美雪？我就说我是对的吧！ 舞的目光在你们和她的高曾祖母之间来回移动，嘴唇微微颤抖着。好吧！你们所有人一起针对我……到底怎么回事啊，小姐妹？ [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |现在你妈妈都出面来说了，不赞成你和我表哥Hitoshi来往，对吧？奶奶才是你唯一的依靠，不是吗？你们是怕惹恼了她，自己结婚的希望就会破灭，对吧？ |你可以想象，每天都要近距离地看着我奶奶的脸，要是惹她生气了，她绝对不会轻易放过你的，对吧？ ]" 哇，舞看起来真的要哭出来了，而且当她被逼到绝境时，她还真会狠狠地反击啊。真是没想到这个如果这种事发生在舞身上，任何一个普通人现在都会大发雷霆的。麻里朝她的曾孙女迈出了一步，但舞却迅速躲开了，甚至拽住了自己的百褶裙，显然是想立刻逃离这里。 美雪！ 花时间精心准备一份礼物，结果却只换来被蔑视和被扔回我脸上的后果……我先去躺会儿吧。说着，她就出门去了。麻里翻了个白眼，用拇指朝她那个不听话的孙女挥了挥手，而仁也立刻行动起来，笨拙地跟在表妹后面。你也准备跟上去，但窝里的“女当家”一把抓住你的腰，把你拉住了。 没关系的。让Hitoshi去追求她就足够了；她的天性很快就会重新占据上风，她就会恢复到从前的样子。嗯……亲爱的，你看起来似乎并不太相信这一点啊。 你叹了口气。你一生都充当着母亲的得力助手……只对她负责，这样的经历根本无法让你应对这种事情。争吵是一回事，但当双方的地位在社会阶层中都高于你时，情况就完全不同了。 这是一个艰难的决定。你总算说出来了。 我并不怀疑事实确实如此，但你还是坚持按照自己认为正确的推理方式得出了结论，无论这个结论看起来有多么不合理。亲爱的，在结婚之前，你真的需要先彻底弄清楚这一点，更不用说在怀上第一个孩子之前了。 等等，为什么这段对话会发展成这样 那么，你找我到底有什么事？ "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |我本来是在找仁的，但既然你在送走了梅之后也把他打发走了，那这样做真的没什么意义了，对吧？我想我就留在这里陪陪你吧，奶奶。话说回来，梅做的那个暖腹器到底放在哪里了呢？ 哦？ 如果你这么做，我也会试试看。 这引来了麻里的一丝笑声。像你这样的年轻女孩，在衣服里面穿那种东西？哦，我明白了，我明白了。那我就…我就试试看吧。不过你先来吧。 当然了，奶奶。我怎么会想别的呢。 |奶奶，我本来想找您谈谈仓库里的一些事情，但看现在的情形，似乎大家都没什么心情工作了。我们坐下来，让我为您播放些音乐，让您放松一下吧？一点音乐肯定会有帮助的。 是的……那真的会让我很感激。当然，前提是我先把美雪送的礼物收好。 啊，所以尽管她一再抗议，还是有可能最终会使用那个东西的。也许，即使你最终站在了她的一边，她还是会感到有些内疚吧？ 我明白你脸上的那种表情，姑娘。别去告诉美雪，说我可能穿着那种保暖内衣……其实，别想给我演奏什么了；我要让你成为我的同伙。让我们看看你穿上那么过时的东西会是什么样子。 ]
rows.raw: " "See, Miyuki? I told you I was in the right!" Mai looks between you and her great-great-grandmother, lip trembling. "Fine! All y'all gangin' up on me — what's yer deal anyway, lil' sis? [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Now that yer mom done come out an' said don't approve none o' yer dallyin' with my cuz Hitoshi, Granny's yer only lifeline, ain't she? Ya'll scared that if'n ya tick her off yer hopes of marryin' my cuz are gonna dry up, is it? |Guess ya gotta see my Granny's face close up every day, an' if'n ya'll tick her off she'll never let you live it down, that the case? ]" Wow, Mai actually looks like she's going to cry, and does she know how to cut deep when pressed into a corner. If this is happening to Mai, then any ordinary soul would be throwing a tantrum right about now. Komari takes a step towards her great-great granddaughter, but Mai darts away, snatching her pleated skirts with the clear intention of hightailing it out of here. "Miyuki!" "Spend th' time an' make a present, jus' to have it done scorned an' thrown back in' my face... I'm gonna go have a lie down." With that, she's out the door. Rolling her eyes, Komari jerks her thumb after her wayward granddaughter and Hitoshi rolls into action, lumbering after his cousin. You move to follow, too, but the den matron grabs you by the side of your waist and holds you back. "It's all right. Hitoshi going after her will be sufficient; her natural inclinations will regain their hold on her soon enough and she'll be her old self. Hmm. You don't look particularly convinced, dear." You sigh. You've been your mother's majordomo all your life... being answerable only to her hasn't prepared you in the least for this sort of thing. Altercations are one thing, altercations where both parties outrank you on the social ladder is another completely. "It was a hard decision," you say at last. "I don't doubt that it was, but you followed the reasoning that you believed to be right to its conclusion, no matter how unsavoury it might have been. That's something you'll need to get right down all firm and proper before you get married, let alone get pregnant with your first kit, dear." Wait, why did the conversation take such a — "Now then, what did you want to see me about?" "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |I was looking for Hitoshi at first, but now that you've sent him away after Mai there really isn't much point to that any more, is there? I think I'll stay here and keep you company for a bit, Granny. Where's the belly warmer Mai made, anyway?" "Oh?" "I'll try it on if you do." That earns a small laugh from Komari. "A young woman like you wearing one of those under her clothes? Oh, I get it, I get it. I'll... I'll give it a try, then. But you go first." "Of course, Granny. Wouldn't dream of it any other way." |I was going to see you about several records from the storehouse, Granny, but as things stand I don't think anyone's in the mood for work any more. How about we sit down and I play something for you to take your mind off things? A little music would help." "Yes... that would be appreciated. After I put away Miyuki's gift, of course." Ah. So there's a non-zero chance that despite all her protests, she might actually end up using the thing anyway. Maybe she's feeling a little guilty even though you sided with her in the end? "I know that look on your face, girl. Don't you go around telling Miyuki that I might be wearing that belly warmer... in fact, forget about playing me something; I'm going to make you my accomplice. Let's see how you stand wearing something as old-fashioned as that." ] "

rows.original: Mai should have been more considerate of her great-great-grandmother, especially her situation. She may have trouble feeling very much of anything, but that isn't an excuse for her to assume that everyone is as insensate as she is. Komari doesn't need to be reminded of her penance or her past, and that hurts her a lot more than a bit of winter chill ever would. When giving a present, you have to keep in mind who it's for, and Mai didn't consider that.
rows.translation: 舞本应该更加体谅她的曾曾祖母，尤其是考虑到她的处境。她或许很难感受到任何情绪，但这并不能成为她认为所有人都和她一样麻木不仁的借口。麻里并不需要别人提醒她自己的过错或过去，而这些回忆带给她的伤害，远比冬天的寒冷要严重得多。送礼物时，必须考虑到收礼人的感受，而舞显然没有考虑到这一点。
rows.raw: "Mai should have been more considerate of her great-great-grandmother, especially her situation. She may have trouble feeling very much of anything, but that isn't an excuse for her to assume that everyone is as insensate as she is. Komari doesn't need to be reminded of her penance or her past, and that hurts her a lot more than a bit of winter chill ever would. When giving a present, you have to keep in mind who it's for, and Mai didn't consider that."

rows.original: Your future grandmother-in-law glowers, then breaks into a sigh. "Well, I suppose it was expected that you young people would've stuck with each other. I have no choice but to accept this now, do I?" [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"Haaa." Even though you sided with her, Mai looks none too pleased about everything. "I get yer reasonin', lil' sis, but that was kinda harsh even if yer right..." "Well, I was right, wasn't I?" you reply. "If I didn't cut to the heart of the matter, the both of you would still be at it. I'd rather you be angry at me for the right reason rather than you being angry at each other for all the wrong reasons, so this is fine with me." "Well, I ain't wonderin' none 'bout why you an' Hitoshi are jus' made f'r each other." |As much as you tried to be tactful about it, both your future in-laws are too smart to be fooled by a little fast-talking. Still, hopefully the blow wasn't as bad as it could otherwise have been. While you might've been right, your job here is to smooth over arguments, not to exacerbate them even if they're not mad at each other any more, but you. "If the den matron would be as magnanimous as to accept a gift and take it in the spirit in which it was given, even if she has personal misgivings..." ] "Oh shush, girl. I'm too old for [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|yet another straight argument|sweet-talking]. In fact, I'm far too old for very much anything — I think I'm going to have a lie-down, as befits someone as world-weary as I am. That's what's expected of the elderly, isn't it? Having to take naps in the middle of the day?" Mai and you share a glance. Of course you know [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|granny|the den matron] doesn't even need to sleep at all, so... the both of you watch her totter past the screens that shield her private quarters from view and disappear from sight. "I swear," Mai says, taking a long drag from her pipe and letting clean white smoke billow from her lips. "She's actin' no different from a kit, an' she's more'n two centuries old. Ya'd expect... ah, hay-ell, I don't know what I'd be expectin' o' anythin' here an' now. Lil' sis, help me put th' gift back on granny's table; she'll accept it once she's done cooled down some." It's certainly light enough that she could do it herself. Why ask you to help her? Mai gives you an odd look. "That's 'cause yer in this with me now; yer my accomplice. Who else ya think's goin' to help me set down a woman's undergarment? Hitoshi?" [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality|Your fiance|Hitoshi] clears his throat and looks out the window. "Yeah, so I may have won and ya might've sided with me, but... it still don't feel great to wind up granny like this, ya hear? So c'mon, gimme a hand here, okay?" [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"Actually, no; I've had enough of this mess. I came up here to get my fiance, ended up having to sort the both of you out, and I'm running late. As far as I'm concerned, your argument has been dealt with, and you're not going to pull me along into further mischief. I'm done here." Mai says something else, but you're determined to not hear her. Grabbing Hitoshi by the crook of his elbow, you tug and tug and tug until he finally deigns to notice you and scoops you up, heading for the door. The peace of the fields is so much more pleasant than arguing in-laws... |You rub your temples in a rare show of exasperation. "Fine. But only because I'm worried you'll do something that will break this hard-won peace." Together, the two of you pick Mai's gift off the table and wrap it back up in the patterned cloth, all pretty and snug. Hopefully, the den matron will understand what Mai's getting at and won't be mad any more despite her great-great-granddaughter's repeated attempts... well, you're doing your best to make the presentation appealing, so that has to be good, right? ]
rows.translation: 你未来的婆婆先是怒目而视，然后叹了口气。嗯，我想大家本来也是预料到你们这些年轻人会一直在一起吧。现在我也没办法不接受这个事实了，对吧？ [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |哈啊。尽管你站在她那一边，但梅对发生的一切似乎并不满意。我明白你的理由，小妹，但就算你是对的，那样说也有点太严厉了…… 嗯，我果然没说错吧？你回复吧。如果我不直截了当地说明问题，你们俩现在可能还在争吵。我宁愿你们因为合理的原因生我的气，也不愿你们因为一些毫无意义的原因互相争吵，所以这样对我来说也没关系。 嗯，我倒也不想知道，为什么你和Hitoshi会如此般配。 |尽管你试图委婉地表达自己的意思，但你的两位未来公婆都太聪明了，不会被你那些花言巧语所蒙骗。不过，希望这次冲突没有变得比原本更严重。虽然你可能是对的，但你的职责其实是缓和矛盾，而不是让矛盾进一步恶化——即使他们彼此之间已经不再生气了，但对你来说，依然需要尽到这个责任。 如果巢穴的女首领能够宽宏大量地接受这份礼物，并且本着礼物赠送的初衷来接受它，即使她个人对此有所疑虑…… ] 哦，嘘，姑娘。我年纪大了，不适合这些了。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|又是一个直白的论点|花言巧语]事实上，我已经太老了，几乎不适合做任何事情了——我想我应该躺下来休息一下，毕竟像我这样一个看透了世间一切的人，确实应该这样做。对于老年人来说，午间小睡不也是理所应当的吗？ 舞与你对视了一眼。你当然明白其中的意思。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|奶奶|巢穴的女首领]甚至都没有需要根本无法入睡，所以……你们俩就看着她摇摇晃晃地走过那些遮挡她私人空间的屏幕，然后从视线中消失吧。 我发誓，舞长长地吸了一口烟斗，让洁白的烟雾从她的嘴唇中袅袅升起。她的行为跟个机器人没什么两样，可她都已经两百多岁了。你可能会觉得……唉，说实话，我现在都不知道该对这里发生的一切抱有什么期待。小妹妹，帮我把礼物放回奶奶的桌子上吧；等她冷静下来一些，肯定会接受的。 这个任务确实轻巧到她完全可以独自完成，为什么要请你帮忙呢？ 舞用一种奇怪的眼神看着你。那是因为你现在和我在一起了；你已经是我的同伙了。你还能想到还有谁会帮我把一个女人的内衣脱下来呢？Hitoshi吗？ [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality|你的未婚夫/妻|仁志]他清了清嗓子，然后望向窗外。 是啊，也许我本来会赢，也许你会站在我这边，但是……以这种方式变成‘老奶奶’，还是让人感觉不太好，你懂吧？所以拜托了，帮帮我吧，好吗？ [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |其实不是的；我受够了这些麻烦事。我本来是上来接我的未婚夫的，结果却不得不来调解你们俩之间的矛盾，现在我已经迟到了。在我看来，你们的争执已经解决了，你们不会再把我牵扯进更多的麻烦中去了。我受够了。 梅说了些什么，但你坚决不肯听她的。你抓住仁的肘部，不停地拉扯，直到他终于愿意注意到你，然后把你抱起来，朝着门口走去。田野间的宁静，可比和姻亲争吵愉快多了…… |你罕见地表现出恼怒，揉了揉太阳穴。好吧。但只是因为我很担心你会做出一些破坏这份来之不易的和平的事情。 你们俩一起把梅送的礼物从桌上拿下来，用那块有图案的布重新包好，包得既漂亮又整齐。希望巢穴的女首领能够理解梅的用心，不会因为她的曾孙女屡次尝试而生气……嗯，你们已经尽力让这份礼物看起来更吸引人了，所以应该没什么问题吧？ ]
