rows.raw: ' Deciding that there's really no sense in beating around the bush, you rather bluntly ask Komari the question on your mind. Would she be up for a roll in the hay? [party.has kiyoko |Almost immediately, the atmosphere of pervasive silence is broken by the sound of Kiyoko coughing, choking on her tea. She recovers before you're able to react, her normally composed demeanor utterly shattered as she looks up at you in bewilderment. "I'm sorry, WHAT?!" Kiyoko snaps, her voice shrill with shock |Komari doesn't respond at first, those blank white eyes staring at you unreadably. Her face, however, paints an expression of utter bewilderment, and you're beginning to grow worried as you shift uncomfortably ]. You're about to play it off as a mere joke, when Komari finally speaks up, her gaze still fixed firmly on you. "[pc.ra kitsune |Your Eminence, if you don’t mind my asking: |[pc.name], ] have you been feeling alright lately? Are you seeing things that aren’t actually there, or hearing strange sounds? Is there a high-pitched ringing in your ears, or have there been sudden flashes in your vision? Have you suffered any blows to the head as of late? [silly |Are you well? Do you have brain damage |Has anyone stated that you’ve been acting strangely, or otherwise behaving uncharacteristically ]?" As you shake your head in response to each of Komari’s questions, her quizzical expression gradually transforms into one of increasing confusion, before she finally shakes her head. Pinching the bridge of her nose as she rubs her eyes in frustration, she turns her gaze to you once more, the old vixen utterly baffled. "Then [pc.ra kitsune |if it’s not too much to ask, please do explain your reasons for asking of me such a thing, your Eminence |by all means, please do explain what reasons you could have for asking of me such a thing, [pc.name] ]." [pc.dcb |Why should you have to explain yourself? The question was perfectly clear; does she, or does she not want to have sex with you? |Well, it’s just that you find her attractive, and well... you know she’s been a widow for quite some time. You couldn’t help but be curious if she’d be down for a little fling. |Uh... you wanna have sex with her? She may be a lil’ old, but she’s still got like, some nice big titties! ] Komari freezes up again in response to that, her face an unflinching mask. [party.has kiyoko |For her part, Kiyoko continues staring at you from the side, her flabbergasted expression a mix of equal parts vexation and befuddlement. Shooting a pleading glance towards Komari, your fox-wife finds no succor from her stone-faced retainer; rather than speaking up, she silently begins to rub her temples, visibly mortified. |The crushing silence from earlier begins to seep into the air between the both of you once again, and Komari’s unblinking stare feels like it’s piercing straight through you. Awkwardly clearing your throat, you begin to stand up and excuse yourself — you’ll have to take that answer as a no, then– ] It’s only then that Komari reacts to your declaration, sardonically laughing in a dry chuckle. [party.has kiyoko |Neither you nor Kiyoko are put at ease by this; the atmosphere is one of unease as |Her sarcastic mirthfulness does nothing to allay your unease as ] she laughs and laughs, outright cackling for a few moments. Komari may be a servant of the Trickster through and through, but to see her actually laugh is nothing short of disturbing; by the time she composes herself, you[party.has kiyoko | and Kiyoko are |’re ] left staring awkwardly as Komari’s lips curl into a dubious grin. Fixing her gaze directly at you, the den matron speaks up, a mirthful edge still lingering in her voice. "[pc.ra kitsune |Oh, Keros himself, your Eminence. Were you born one of us, I would think that |Goodness, how brazen of you, [pc.name]! Had I heard that from anyone else, I’d think it ] were a prank; it truly would have made for a superb joke. But coming from you... that’s too absurd to be in jest, isn’t it? You’re actually serious, aren’t you?" Komari inquires, not waiting for an answer. "You know what? Sure, I’ll accept your proposition; this should be fascinating." [party.has kiyoko |Pausing, Komari turns her attention to Kiyoko, still struggling to comprehend exactly what just unfolded before her. Turning to look up as Komari clears her throat, your fox-wife stares at you, then her retainer, utterly bewildered as Komari speaks. "Of course, so long as the Lady Ōtomo finds such a thing agreeable. Is that agreeable, Myōbu-sama?" It’s not often that you get to see Kiyoko truly at a loss for words — given her status as an expert diviner, very few things truly surprise her. That said, you’d be hard-pressed to believe she foresaw any of this, given the way she’s currently stammering in confusion. "I– I don– [silly |who the fu—" abruptly, Kiyoko turns to face you, snapping with a "I should kick your fuckin’ ass, who the fuck says that?" before returning her attention to Komari. "Wh– |wh– ] what? I... excuse me for a moment." With that, Kiyoko [silly |screams into one of the seating cushions for a few moments |takes a few deep breaths, steadying herself ] before continuing. "Beloved, I’ll be expecting you to explain your rationale behind this in immense detail to me later. But in the meantime, yes, Komari, I suppose that would be acceptable." After that, the two vixens exchange several [silly |loud yips and gekkers, |more words in a language you don’t understand ]; their voices are sharp whispers as they communicate some incomprehensible argument. Regardless, at the end of it |With that ], Komari rises from her seat, using her gnarled cane to steady herself. Hopefully that screen was enough to keep her out of earshot... before long, however, Kinu rounds the corner, softly bowing her head as she waits to hear from Komari. "Young Lady Ōtomo, your [pc.mf |father |mother ] and I have some private matters to discuss. Would you mind granting us the privacy to do so?" Kinu gives a gentle nod at that, before wordlessly slipping past you and out the door with all the grace of a springtime breeze. |"Since we have some privacy, this ought to be nice and simple." Komari chides, laughing to herself. ] "Now, then." Komari appends, as she raps her gnarled cane against the floor. Immediately, the screen door behind you slides shut, and as you turn back, Komari’s countenance is stern and imperious. "I’m going to lay down a few ground rules, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ], so listen well." '

rows.original: "First and foremost," Komari continues, her glowing eyes burning a hole right through you. "I have agreed to this purely for the sake of my own amusement. It’s been the better part of two centuries since I last saw any action, and that is by choice. With that in mind, allow me to be perfectly clear: I will be setting the tempo here, as it were. [pc.ra kitsune |The authority you hold over me outside of this room is considered forfeit within it; I’m sure you understand, your Eminence |Should you truly wish to lay with me, it will only be with me heading the ship — like I said, this is for my own amusement ]. I don’t say that out of selfishness, but simple logic; I’m an old woman, far older than I ought to be. There will be no manhandling, at least of my person." You see... "Secondly, if I may continue, I’d like to make clear just what you’re getting, here. I’m an old, wrinkly crone; I’m hardly one to question taste, but really now." [pc.dcb |Well, that much was obvious. It’s not as if she looks particularly spry. |...You’re aware. What’s it matter, though? |D’aww, that’s alright! Just because she’s a lil’ saggy doesn’t mean she doesn’t look pretty! ] "I wasn’t done yet!" Komari snaps. [party.has kiyoko |Behind you, Kiyoko snickers, before a glare from Komari quiets her down |Alright, alright. She can continue ]. "As I was attempting to say, don’t expect some lithe young maiden. I’ll be taking the lead, and you’ll be doing little more than reciprocating; I’m not about to break a hip from getting my knees lifted to my head." Alright, that’s... not a pleasant visual. Is there anything else? "Yes. Lastly — and this one should be held as the most important of all, — I want you to be aware that my tastes are... specific. You haven’t the slightest inkling of what it required to keep a particularly vigorous marriage interesting for the better part of six decades. You will not be treated well, and I will not be gentle with you." Duly noted. Is that everything? "Yes, though should you harbor objections towards any of that, I advise you to speak now. You won’t get a second opportunity to voice dissent. So, bearing that in mind: which will it be, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]?"
rows.translation: “首先，”麻里继续说道，她那对发光的眼睛简直要把你盯穿。“我答应这件事纯粹是为了自娱自乐。距我上次经历这种事已经近两百年了，而这完全是我自己的选择。既然如此，请允许我把话说清楚：这里将由我来掌控节奏，可以这么说。 [pc.ra kitsune |你在这间房间之外对我拥有的权威，一旦进了这间房便不再作数；我相信你明白这一点，阁下 |如果你真想与我同床，那也只能由我来掌舵——正如我所说，这只是为了我自己的乐趣 ]。我这么说并非出于自私，而只是出于最简单的逻辑；我是个老妇人，年纪远比本该有的要大得多。不会有任何粗暴的摆弄，至少不会对我本人。” 你看…… “其次，如果允许我继续说下去，我想先讲清楚，你在这里得到的到底是什么。我是个又老又皱的老太婆；我本没资格挑剔你的品味，但说真的，你这是图什么呢。” [pc.dcb |嗯，这一点显而易见。她看上去可一点也不算精神矍铄。 |……你很清楚这一点。不过，那又有什么关系呢？ |哎呀，那有什么关系嘛！就算她有点松垮，也不代表她不好看呀！ ] “我还没说完呢！”麻里厉声说道。 [party.has kiyoko |在你身后，清子窃笑起来，直到麻里瞪了她一眼才安静下来 |好吧，好吧。她可以继续 ]。 “正如我方才想说的，别指望会遇到什么轻盈的年轻少女。我会主导一切，而你要做的不过是配合回应；我可不想因为把膝盖抬到头顶而弄断髋骨。” 好吧，那画面……可真不怎么赏心悦目。还有别的吗？ “是的。最后一点——这一点应当被视为所有事项中最重要的——我想让你知道，我的品味……相当特殊。你根本无法想象，要让一段格外热烈的婚姻在近六十年里始终保持有趣，需要付出多少。你不会受到善待，而我绝不会对你温柔。” 明白了。就这些吗？ “是的，不过如果你对其中任何一点有所异议，我建议你现在就说出来。你不会再有第二次表达异议的机会。所以，记住这一点：你打算选哪一个，[pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]？”

rows.original: In spite of her warnings, you're still quite interested. Telling Komari that you agree to her terms, [party.has kiyoko |you can feel Kiyoko glaring daggers at you from behind |you can't help but feel a little nervous as your mind races with the prospect ]. [silly |Hope you realize what you're getting into, bucko. |Hopefully you aren't biting off more than you can chew... ] Nodding her head softly, Komari looks at you once more, [party.has kiyoko |then towards Kiyoko. Clearing her throat to catch her attention, Kiyoko meets Komari's stare as she speaks up. "Of course, you needn't see such a sight unfold, Myōbu-sama. Allow me to get the doo—" "That won't be necessary, Komari," Your fox-wife interrupts, an uncharacteristically stern edge to her voice. "I have every intention of watching precisely what unfolds. [pc.name] is my [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |husband |wife ] |consort ], and as such, I shall bear responsibility for... this." It would appear morbid curiosity has overpowered Kiyoko's apprehension, given how comfortable she now looks in her seat. The earlier breach of composure is all but erased, and she observes the two of you with a studious, emotionless expression. "And in any case, I might add; it's been far too long since I've seen you in action, Komari." That earns another brief cackle from the old vixen, shaking her head softly as she reminisces. Before too long, however, Komari composes herself, looking her liege in the eyes as she replies. "In that case, my lady, I must ask that you forgive me for any... breaches of etiquette that you may experience from me. I find it difficult to enjoy myself if I’m to walk on eggshells, as it were." Kiyoko gives a noncommittal shrug by way of response, a surprisingly casual gesture. "That much is to be expected, Komari. You don’t have to worry about such things; the past between you and I is just that." Komari nods gently at Kiyoko’s words, before clearing her throat and resuming her train of thought. |then mutters something under her breath. Fixing her gaze squarely at you, the old vixen remains stone-faced as she speaks. ] "Very well then, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]. There's no going back now, so I hope you're ready for what comes next." With that, Komari shrugs off her heavy robes in a single, fluid motion, and you're treated to the sight of her body beneath them.
rows.translation: 尽管她发出了警告，你仍然对此非常感兴趣。你告诉麻里你同意她的条件。 [party.has kiyoko |你能感觉到清子正从背后用凶狠的目光盯着你 |一想到这个可能性，你的脑海中就会不由自主地浮现出各种念头，从而感到一阵紧张 ]。 [silly |希望你清楚自己即将面对什么，伙计。 |希望你没有试图做超出自己能力范围的事情…… ] 麻里轻轻点了点头，再次注视着你。 [party.has kiyoko |然后她转向清子。清了清嗓子以吸引她的注意，就在这时，清子与麻里对视了一眼，然后开口说道： “当然，美浓部大人，您没有必要看到这样的场景。让我去处理吧——” “没有必要，麻里，”你的狐狸妻子打断了她，语气中带着一丝不同寻常的严厉，“我恰恰想亲眼看到这一切发生。 [pc.name]是我的 [kiyoko.married |[pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ] |配偶 ]因此，我将对此事负责……” 看来，病态的好奇心已经压倒了清子的顾虑，因为她现在坐在那里，看起来非常镇定自若。之前那种慌乱的神情早已消失无踪，她用一种专注而面无表情的目光注视着你们两个人。 无论如何，我还想补充一点：我已经很久没有看到你真正大显身手了，麻里。” 老狐妖又发出一阵轻笑，轻轻摇头，陷入了回忆。不过不久之后，麻里恢复了平静，直视着她的主君的眼睛回答道。 那样的话，夫人，我必须请您原谅我可能犯下的任何……失礼之举。如果我一直小心翼翼、如履薄冰，的话，我就很难真正享受这个过程了。” 清子只是漫不经心地耸了耸肩作为回应，这个动作出人意料地随意。这也是意料之中的事，麻里。你不必为这种事情担心；你和我之间的过去，就是这样的。” 麻里轻轻点了点头，回应了清子的話，然后清了清嗓子，继续她之前的思路。 |然后她低声嘟囔了些什么。那老狐妖紧紧地盯着你，说话时面无表情。 ] 那好吧， [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]现在已经没有回头路了，所以我希望你们能够做好迎接接下来发生的事情的准备。” 说完，麻里以一个流畅的动作甩开了她那厚重的长袍，于是你们得以看到她身下的身姿。

rows.original:
That all sounds a little more intense than you’re willing to put up with. The den matron nods her head as you tell her such, evidently unsurprised.
        
        "Very well, then. There’s no shame in that, and I do apologize for making such a fuss over nothing. However..." Komari’s eyes glint as she gives you a mischievous grin. "Should you, at any point, change your mind... you may consider my invitation open."
        
        With that, Komari returns to her seat, and gestures for you to do the same, before speaking.
        
        "To that end, allow me to change the subject. Was there any other business you had with me, [pc.ra kitsune
            |your Eminence
            |[pc.name]
        ]?"
rows.translation:
这一切听起来似乎比你所能承受的还要严峻一些。当你这样告诉她时，巢穴主母只是点了点头，显然并没有感到惊讶。

        “为此，容我换个话题。您还有其他事情需要与我讨论吗？ [pc.ra kitsune
            |阁下
            |[pc.name]
        ]？”
rows.raw:
'
        That all sounds a little more intense than you’re willing to put up with. The den matron nods her head as you tell her such, evidently unsurprised.
        
        "Very well, then. There’s no shame in that, and I do apologize for making such a fuss over nothing. However..." Komari’s eyes glint as she gives you a mischievous grin. "Should you, at any point, change your mind... you may consider my invitation open."
        
        With that, Komari returns to her seat, and gestures for you to do the same, before speaking.
        
        "To that end, allow me to change the subject. Was there any other business you had with me, [pc.ra kitsune
            |your Eminence
            |[pc.name]
        ]?"

rows.original: It's hard to believe, but there you have it. Sure, you saw her when Kiyoko was being freed from her captivity, but now that you've had a little time to process it all it's still hard to believe that the little girl that you remember so freshly in your mind has grown into a young woman... [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |And she really has grown. You can see plenty of Kiyoko's influence in the cut of your daughter's face, her chin and her eyes, but her overall figure could only have come from you. Kiyoko was thin as a rail when you first met her[kiyoko.numKits 8| until numerous repeated pregnancies filled out her body somewhat], but Kinu's figure is more typical of the local ladies of the Frost Marches. It's ripe and filling, to put it lightly, and although her long sleeves and skirts do their best to conceal the curves of young womanhood, they nevertheless push out against the fabric determinedly. When her eyes meet yours, you get the sense of impulsive, bubbling energy that brings you back to when Kinu was still a child — growing older still hasn't dampened that spark any, even if it's found other ways in which to express itself. Your daughter's clean — or at least, as clean as someone who works all day in the fields can be — but the faint smell of sap, earth and fresh water linger about her this very moment, as well as a certain something or the other you can't quite place[pc.ra fox lupine kitsune|, even with your heightened sense of smell]. |And what a fine young woman she is, taking eagerly and heartily after her mother in mannerisms, while her body takes after you more. Kiyoko was thin as a rail when you first met her[kiyoko.numKits 8| until numerous repeated pregnancies filled out her body somewhat], but Kinu's figure is more typical of the local ladies of the Frost Marches. It's ripe and filling, to put it lightly, and it's best not to go into too much detail there. But her long-sleeved clothes, the way her hair and fur gleams with careful brushing and the application of her mother's perfumed herbal oils, the perfect politeness combined with the aura of genteel yet iron refinement is all her mother's. While your daughter may not be a perfect copy of Kiyoko — far from it — they doubtless possess much of the same energy. ] Well, hello. Nice day, isn't it? [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |The two of you stare at each other for a handful of moments, then Kinu makes a silly face, sticking out her tongue at you and breaking the awkward tension in the air. Sheepishly, your daughter sets down the hoe she's carrying, lowers her gaze and rubs the back of her head under her headscarf. "Hi again, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." |Without missing a beat, Kinu clasps her hands in front of her and gives you a small bow, closing her eyes, pressing her tails close to her body and folding her ears forward. "It is a very pleasant day indeed, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." ] You know, you did meet her when her mother was being released from the Astral Plane, but there was so much happening back then that you didn't really get the opportunity to say hello. Now that things have cleared up somewhat, though, you're here to... to catch up on where you left off, that's the only way to put it. The last time you were truly together, she was just a tiny three-tailed child, and now she's not so tiny any more, with two more tails to boot. Kiyoko was thin as a rail when you first met her[kiyoko.numKits 8| until numerous repeated pregnancies filled out her body somewhat], but Kinu's figure is more typical of the local ladies of the Frost Marches. It's ripe and filling, to put it lightly, and it's best not to go into too much detail there. But her long-sleeved clothes, the way her hair and fur gleams with careful brushing and the application of her mother's perfumed herbal oils, the perfect politeness combined with the aura of genteel yet iron refinement is all her mother's. While your daughter may not be a perfect copy of Kiyoko — far from it — they doubtless possess much of the same energy. ] Well, hello. Nice day, isn't it? [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |The two of you stare at each other for a handful of moments, then Kinu makes a silly face, sticking out her tongue at you and breaking the awkward tension in the air. Sheepishly, your daughter sets down the hoe she's carrying, lowers her gaze and rubs the back of her head under her headscarf. "Hi again, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." |Without missing a beat, Kinu clasps her hands in front of her and gives you a small bow, closing her eyes, pressing her tails close to her body and folding her ears forward. "It is a very pleasant day indeed, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." ] You know, you did meet her when her mother was being released from the Astral Plane, but there was so much happening back then that you didn't really get the opportunity to say hello. Now that things have cleared up somewhat, though, you're here to... to catch up on where you left off, that's the only way to put it. The last time you were truly together, she was just a tiny three-tailed child, and now she's not so tiny any more, with two more tails to boot. So much must have happened in the intervening... how long has it been inside of the orb? [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"As far as Mother explains it, time flows strangely there when compared to out here. Day to day, things can change... all I know is that one day, you stopped coming, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], and all of the divinations both Mother and I made pointed to the fact that you wouldn't be visiting ever again. Not that I didn't understand it, but I sure well didn't accept it for a while. But as they say... it can't be helped. And it really couldn't." You're so sorry that you missed watching your little girl grow up. It must have been so long in captivity there... Kinu raises a hand to her face, planting her heel of her palm on her cheek and stroking the fringes of her silvery-white hair. Your daughter's trying very hard not to cry, and mostly succeeding. Mostly. At last, she's unable to contain herself and lets her hoe fall to the ground as she steps forward and hugs you about the waist. "I missed you so much, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Damn it, how could you have done this to her... "It's not your fault, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], you couldn't have known and even if you did it couldn't have been helped anyway. But still... just don't beat yourself up over it. I'm not going to lie and say it didn't hurt, but hurting's not always a bad thing. It's how you know you're still alive." Haha... ever the careful diplomat, your little girl. Slowly, Kinu pulls herself away from you with a small sigh and sniffles a little before stopping |Kinu turns her gaze away from you. "As far as Mother explains it, time flows strangely when compared to out here. Day to day, things can change... one day your visits ceased abruptly, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], and all of the divinations both Mother and I made pointed to the fact that you wouldn't be visiting for quite a while." You're sorry to have made her worry like that. "Please set your mind at ease. We knew you were in no danger, it was just that the passage of time simply had... changed. Matters were coming to a head, and Mother had hope that her long captivity was coming to an end at last. The pain of your absence was salved by seeing Mother invigorated like that for years on end." Still, it must have been so long, and you missed the chance to see your little girl grow up... Kinu gives you a small dip of the head. "Do not chastise yourself over matters you had no way of knowing or preventing, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. As they say, it cannot be helped. I am grateful for all the time we have spent together in the past... and I will be equally grateful for the time we will now spend to make up for that which you missed." Haha... ever the careful diplomat, your little girl ]. Well, she's a woman now. "It doesn't feel like it," Kinu replies with a small chuckle. "I still have to do all the things I had to as a kit, [kiyoko.numKits 4|and take care of all my siblings in the bargain, ]so nothing's really changed there. There's been some change of scenery and things are a little less comfortable and more intense, but there's no point complaining about it. I would rather work to change matters... my responsibilities as a woman are no different in essence than when I was a kit." She was a very precocious kit. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"Ahaha, that's true." Heaving a small sigh, Kinu dusts off her hands and bends over to pick up the hoe she dropped. "Look, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], I'm glad you decided to drop by and have a talk, but the fields aren't going to till themselves and I've got to bring in the seedlings from the nursery — oh no, wait, I don't want to sound like I'm pushing you away or anything, especially not after all that. It's just that I'm on the clock now, you see, and I know you're more important than this stuff, I just —" She doesn't need to worry, you get what she's trying to tell you and aren't taking any offense. All right, you'll state your business. "Thanks. Talking to people can be kind of hard at times; I tell people one thing and they go and read a completely different meaning into my words. It's kind of awkward, really..." |"I will not deny that. Those were good times." Looking very pleased with herself, Kinu gives you a small smile. "Now then, perhaps I could help you with something, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]? There is much that we could do." ] "

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |[var0 |[rand |It doesn't take you long to find Kinu — your daughter is out by the sluice gates, making sure that everything's in good working condition. She finishes her inspection just as you approach, her face breaking into a small smile as she gives you a wave. "Hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]! Great morning, isn't it?" It's indeed a great morning, which is why you decided to come over and pay her a visit. How're things? "Oh, just fine. The gate was having trouble lifting yesterday, so I came on over and replaced the winch and a few other bits; Kazuo explained it all to me, so I can do basic repairs on the mechanisms by myself without needing to call him over from Granny's. Best to get these sorted out quickly so they don't become a problem down the road, you know? Anyways, can I help you?" |It takes you a little while searching the fields to find Kinu, but you eventually find her out the back by the bit of wilderness by the crater wall. She's got a hand sickle with her, and is cutting the grasses for use in thatching. You watch her for a bit, then get your fox-daughter's attention by clearing your throat. "Oh, hey! Sheesh, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], you oughtn't have walked all the way out here. if I'd known you were coming I'd have wrapped up early and come to meet you; as it is, I'm just about done, anyway." Kinu picks up her bundle of freshly-cut grass and heads with you down the path to the storage shed, where she sets down her burden and dusts off her hands. "Now I'm free. You wanted me for something, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]?" |You easily spot your fox-daughter amongst the paddies, her clothes of white and blue standing out against green and gold as she wades calf-deep in the flooded fields. Upon seeing you, she splashes her way up to dry land, wiping her feet off on the grass before coming up to your side. "Oh hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Harvest looks like it's going to be pretty good this time around, don't you think?" You're not exactly qualified to judge, and even if you did the grain in question would be more likely to be wheat than rice. Nevertheless, you can tell the love that she puts into her work and you're sure the plants will respond well to that. "Eh, ahaha. Come on, you're getting me all bashful... anyways, was there something you needed me for, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]?" |You look around for a while, and eventually find Kinu not too far from the lumber shed. Your daughter's putting together several sets of frames that look like they could be used for vines or gourds, shaping and smoothing the wooden portions to they can be joined together like puzzle pieces. At length, she finishes the last one and looks up to see you watching her. "Ah! [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], how long have you been standing there?" Clearly embarrassed, Kinu looks down at the finished frames and hurries to put them away in one corner of the shed. "Make some noise when you come along, won't you?" Oh, it's not that you were quiet, it's that she gets so absorbed in whatever she's doing that you could've yelled into one of her ears and it'd just have come out the other side. "That's not entirely wrong but still... make some noise, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Your daughter makes a small pouty face only young women can. "Well, I'm done now, I guess. What's up?" |It's not hard to find Kinu — your daughter's on her hands and knees, spreading mulch from a bucket with a flat-headed trowel. As you approach, she finishes up the last bit, patting down the dark material atop lighter soil and making a satisfied noise. Dropping the trowel in her now-empty bucket, she stands up and notices you. "Aha... nice morning, isn't it, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]? You wanted something with me?" Now, how does she know that you wanted something with her? You could be out here in the fields for any number of reasons. "Come on, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Unless you're interested in germinating sweet potatoes or weeding the adzuki beans, you're not going to be out here. Plus, you're talking to me right now." Oh, all right. You did want something with her. "Aand I'm right again." Kinu looks smug at that, and you see her mother clearly shining through for a moment. "Okay, let me just get this set down, and I'll be free." ] [party.has kiyoko |You're about to say something when you notice the air suddenly turn chill. Oh, but of course. Mother and daughter are most pointedly not looking at each other throughout the entire time you've greeted the latter. Oh, it can't be helped. This isn't really something you can force them to work out; i has to be done of their own volition. ] |[rand |While Kinu isn't in the fields like she usually is, spotting your daughter isn't hard; she's the only white kitsune her age around these parts, after all. She's tending to one of the flowering bushes in the shrine gardens, pruning off dead wood and leaves with a small pair of hand clippers. It's delicate work compared to the broader swathes her agricultural work usually requires, but she's just at home like this as she is with a hoe or sickle. "Oh, uh hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]!" she says, looking up and seeing you. "Miko asked me to see if I couldn't solve a few problems with these bushes and all, so I'm working on them for a bit. I'm almost done here, so if you could just wait a bit..." "Eh, that won't be needed none, lil' sis." Gah! Where did Miko come from? Considering how, uh, expansive the shrine maiden is, it's hard to believe how sneaky she can be when she puts her mind to it; even Kinu gasps a little as Miko just emerges from thin air, a basket of greens in her arms. "I — uh —" "Yer folks are more important than these here bushes. Go ahead an' chat with yer [pc.mf|dad|mom], I'll finish up f'r ya, okay? They were my job to begin with anyway. Now, if'n you don't mind, I'll be taking these." With the basket wedged against her body, Miko reaches out and plucks the clippers from Kinu's hands. "Don't mind me none, now. I'll be sweepin' up these here clippings when yer done." "Well," Kinu says as the both of you watch Miko sashay off. "Guess that takes care of that, then. You needed me for something, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]?" |You eventually catch up with Kinu by one of the pools, feeding... something to the fish being raised inside. Whatever the stinking mess in the bucket is, she's certainly willing to touch it with her bare hands, although in the scope of things that probably doesn't say much. "Oh, hi!" Your daughter half-raises a hand as if to wave at you, then remembers how grimy her fingers are. Well, it hasn't dampened her cheery mood anyway. "Pretty good afternoon we're having now, eh, [pc.mf|dad|mom]?" It's fine. You were hoping to catch her at a more opportune time, but if she's on the clock at the moment... "Eh, nah. Everything I do here for Granny Komari is gratis, so I'm not that beholden to my work and all." She looks down at the bucket in her hands. "Let me just put this aside and wash up, and I'll be with you, okay?" Kinu is good to her word. Perhaps ten minutes later, your daughter's back with you having scrubbed her hands and all. The faint smell of fish still clings to her... but that's not something that can be helped, you suppose. |Kinu isn't in the fields right now, but you catch her in the shrine gardens, [kinu.kinuWeapon |going through her forms with her naginata. Komari is watching over your daughter as she practices with the foreign glaive, her flowing movements belying wiry muscle under her deceptively curvaceous exterior. |going through a simple bout of archery practice. Komari is watching over your daughter as she looses several arrows in turn at a practice target, the muscles in her arms flexing as she draws and looses the shortbow over and over again. ] [party.has kiyoko |"Well," Kiyoko remarks as the two of you study your daughter from afar, "at least that's some part of her education she hasn't thrown away for good." ] At length, your daughter comes to a stop and bows to the den matron, who points at you. Kinu's expression brightens, and she passes her weapon over to Komari before running up to you. "Oh, uh, hi [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Y-you were watching, huh?" Yes, you were. With how diligently she's applying herself, she'll make you proud someday. "Oh, uh, ahaha! Granny Komari is a great instructor, you know! She doesn't look it right now, but back in the Old Country all girls of high birth were trained in the use of the naginata and hankyu..." ...Which she was, and still is now. "...Yeah. It's nice to have you drop in, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], we were finishing up anyway and about to break for tea. Did you need me for something?" |You look around a bit, and eventually find Kinu with Mai on the edge of the fields where they give way to the shrine gardens. The two young women have laid out a cloth over the grass, and are playing a game of shogi while the leaves and wind rustle about them. Mai is impassive as always, white winterstem smoke curling up from her pipe. Kinu is... less so. Your daughter watches as her opponent removes piece after piece on the board in quick succession, finally culminating in Mai saying something in her native language that you nevertheless manage to understand perfectly: Checkmate. Kinu deflates a bit, her shoulders sagging as she rubs her temples and eases out of her seat. Kitsune politeness is what it is, but your fox-daughter has always been particularly bad at concealing her genuine emotions. Seeing Kinu defeated, Mai merely shrugs and blows out a perfect smoke ring. Glancing around, your daughter catches sight of you and latches onto the excuse to retreat from the ring in a graceful fashion. "Oh. Uh, hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Uh." She looks down at her feet. "You saw that, didn't you?" It's best that she gets some experience playing with people outside of her immediate family. "I guess, it kinda stings, though. Can't be helped, can it? Eh... let's talk about something else, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Dwelling on it just makes me feel rotten." |Looking around, you find Kinu sitting in a small shed by the fields. The telltale smell of salt and vinegar comes to you even at this distant, making your nose wrinkle — your fox-daughter is completely unperturbed by it all, though. As you watch, she washes, slices and cuts several impressive specimens of vegetables, clearly preparing them for the pickling brine. When she notices you, though, Kinu turns and calls out to someone inside of the shed in the kitsune tongue, then carefully sets down the knife and heads for you. Behind her, a broad-shouldered young man emerges from the shed and begins packing in her things, removing them into the shed and out of sight. "Sorry about that," your fox-daughter says as she draws close. "Can't just abandon my post without letting someone know, even if it's for you, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Nah, it's perfectly fine. You're not interrupting her, are you? "The turnips can wait to be pickled, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], they'll still be there when I return... but I don't know when you'll be back next. I've got my priorities on right, thanks. C'mon, what are we going to do today?" ] [party.has kiyoko |You're about to say something when you notice the air suddenly turn chill. Oh, but of course. Mother and daughter are most pointedly not looking at each other throughout the entire time you've greeted the latter. Oh, it can't be helped. This isn't really something you can force them to work out; i has to be done of their own volition. ] ] |[var0 |[rand |You spy your fox-daughter stoking the fire in the firepit, lighting fresh logs with an outstretched finger so she can make some tea for herself. Her foxfire quickly catches on the wood, bluish flames turning a more mundane yellow as they spread out into mellow warmth to ward of the ever-present chill of the Marches; with great care, she hangs a small clay pot over the flames and settles back with perfect poise. Even when she thinks no one's watching her, Kinu is always a paragon of excellence and refinement... what really matters is what you do when you think you can get away with it, right? Without warning, your fox-daughter's ears swivel in your direction, and she freezes as she sniffs the air. It's only then that Kinu slowly relaxes and turns to greet you, standing and giving you a bow. "Good morning, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. To what do I owe the honor of your visit?" |Your fox-daughter is seated out by the back porch, busy with folding a small pile of clothes — not just hers, by the looks of it, for there're pieces that clearly aren't part of her elegant, refined getup. You'd have imagined she'd have better things to do with her time, but maybe it's better to do things personally every now and then. It's easy to see the ordered mind Kinu has — she's sorted the clothes into multiple stacks by size and color, fingers moving with practiced ease as she hums to herself. As you approach, though, your fox-daughter stacks all of them into a large basket by the door, then turns to greet you with a small bow. "A fine day today, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Inspiring enough for one to rise early and do some laundry." And for you to come and see your beloved firstborn daughter. "It is kind for you to grace me with a visit, when there are so many more important matters for you to attend to. Can I help you in any way?" |Soft music floats over to you as you find Kinu on the back porch, sitting cross-legged on a cushion as her fingers pluck at a koto. It's certainly a very different style of music than what's practiced in the Marches, sweet, melodic and flowing with an emphasis on the high notes; your fox-daughter is clearly quite the accomplished musician in the manner of her mother. The final notes sound in the air as you cross her chambers to the back, and Kinu rises from her seat to grace you with a small bow. [var1] "I did not know you were intending to visit this morning, otherwise I would have played in earnest instead of merely practicing." That was but practice? You couldn't tell. "Oh. I was trying out a composition of my own, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. It needs some refinement before it is fit for public perusal... but perhaps I may ask why you have chosen to grace me with a visit this morning?" |Your daughter isn't hard to find — Kinu herself is deep in concentration at her low table with her eyes half-lidded, poring over a scroll as she dips her brush in ink and focuses on... whatever it is she's writing. You can scarcely understand just the tiniest bit of the kitsune native language when spoken; the little squiggles and pictograms that make up their written word is completely opaque to you. Such furious concentration could only have been learned from her mother, and indeed, you see much of Kiyoko in Kinu as she is right now, all the way down to her seated pose while writing. Like mother, like daughter, as they say. At length, Kinu finishes with the document she's preparing, looks up to put away ink and brush — and meets your eyes. There's a moment of surprise there, but your fox-daughter recovers flawlessly and takes a slow, deep breath. "Ah, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. I hope I did not keep you waiting." No, no, you're the one at fault here for creeping up on her like that and not announcing yourself. "Be that as it may, I still — oh, you've got that look in your eye again. Very well, I shall drop the matter. Now, I have some time to spend while the ink dries; how may I assist you today, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]?" |Kinu herself is out back around the rear, carefully tending to several beds of flowers and a small fishpond. The flowers you can understand, but one can only wonder which poor sop from Komari's she cajoled into digging the fishpond for her. In either case, it's still good to know that Kinu hasn't outgrown her love of nature — if in a different fashion than her once childish self exhibited. Your fox-daughter finishes with the watering can and clippers, then half-turns to set them aside and notices you watching her. With perfect grace, Kinu breaks into a small smile and gives you a bow. "Good morning, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. You have come at quite the auspicious time." Mm, this is quite the sight she's got in front of her. "Ah, I had help in its fashioning. The flowers are delicate; their shaping requires much in the way of gentle care and precision. I hope to have something worthy of rivaling Mikoto's creations in a year or two. "Still, that is something else. What can I do for you today, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]?" ] [party.has kiyoko |"It's good to see you're applying yourself even when we're not around," Kiyoko says before you can begin. "Do ensure that things continue to run smoothly while we're away." "I will, Mother." ] |[rand |Your fox-daughter is busy assisting the den matron with several records, fetching and carrying dutifully and reading over Komari's shoulder as she proceeds with her paperwork. Upon noticing you, Kinu pauses for a moment, to which Komari waves a hand, dismissing her. "Run along and be with your [pc.mf|father|mother], girl. The ledger will still be here later, but [pc.heShe] may not. If I've learned anything in all my years, it's that people are the most important and that you should cherish them while they're around." Wordlessly, Kinu bows to both you and Komari before crossing to your side. "Can I help you today, then?" |Kinu is here, your elegant, refined daughter fitting into her surroundings seamlessly as she fetches and carries books and scrolls for the matron. Upon noticing your presence, your kitsune daughter clasps her hands, closes her eyes, and bows. Sheesh... "Welcome, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Things are well at home, so I [kiyoko.numKits 4|delegated matters to Asagiri and ]thought to come here in order to aid the shrine mother and gain an education in exchange." Such a good girl she is. "Plus, it's an excuse to see Nakano..." Ah. "Shall I announce you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]?" No, it's her that you came here to see. Now then... |Your fox-daughter is out in the courtyard before the matron's chambers, [kinu.kinuWeapon |going through her forms with her naginata. Mai and Nakano both watch over your daughter as she practices with the foreign glaive, her flowing movements belying wiry muscle under her deceptively curvaceous exterior |going through a simple bout of archery practice. Mai and Nakano both watch over your daughter as she looses several arrows in turn at a practice target, the muscles in her arms flexing as she draws and looses the shortbow over and over again ]. The former is providing most of the instruction, while the latter merely watches from a distance; it's perhaps a little off watching Kinu receive instruction from someone who's about her age, but Mai certainly knows what she's about. [party.has kiyoko |"Ah," Kiyoko remarks as the two of you study your daughter from afar, "it's good that I taught her well; our daughter does well by the clan name." ] The spectacle has drawn a small crowd, bystanders gathering on the sidelines to watch the white-furred beauty of your fox-daughter at it. After several moments, though, Kinu relaxes her body, and spotting you passes her weapon off to Mai before detaching herself from the group and approaching. "You were watching, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]?" Indeed, you were. She wasn't half-bad, as far as you understand such things. "Hm... I am perhaps lacking in practical experience when it comes to weapons handling, but one should not be complaining about the prevalence of peace. What brings you here today?" |Your fox-daughter is snugly sequestered away in the matron's chambers, arranging several colorful blossoms in basins and vases with Miko. As you enter, Miko notices you and breaks into a big smile. "Well, lil' sis, looks like yer folks just done come in an' are lookin' f'r ya. Maybe we'll call it here today, eh? I gotta get back to th' shrine an' all 'fore granny done notices I'm gone an' kicks up a mighty ruckus. Don't mind me none, go an' be with yer folks. I'll put this here stuff away." Kinu looks a little uncertain at that, but Miko clearly isn't going to brook any discussion on the matter. Rising from her seat, your fox-daughter crosses to where you are and gives you a small bow. "Good afternoon, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. To what do I owe the honor of you seeking me out here?" |Your fox-daughter's in the matron's chambers, working on a fine painting. The careful movements of her fingers turn into careful movements of her brush, and she's barely daring to breathe as her art slowly takes form. It's very stylised in a manner foreign to the Marches — as would be expected — but the frown of sheer concentration is universal the world over. At length, though, Kinu comes to a stop, and as she moves to put away her palette and other materials notices you standing there. A bit of color rises to your fox-daughter's cheeks as she realizes you've been standing there for some time now. "I hope I did not keep you waiting overlong, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. I lost myself there for a while." She's just like her mother in that regard. Mind as sharp as a nail, and always managing to keep herself busy with one endeavor or the other. Is this a good place for painting, compared to home?" "It... is." Kinu is clearly choosing her answer carefully. "The people and atmosphere are both most conducive to artistic expression. It is... inspiring. "But surely you did not come to question me on my art. Is there anything you needed?" ] [party.has kiyoko |"It's good to see you're applying yourself even when we're not around," Kiyoko says before you can begin. "Do make yourself useful to Komari, yes?" "I will, Mother." ] ] ]
rows.translation: [kinu.isInari |[var0 |[rand |你很快就能找到小娟——你的女儿正在水闸旁，检查各项设备是否运行正常。就在你靠近的时候，她检查完毕，脸上露出了微笑，向你招了招手。 嘿， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]早上好，不是吗？ 确实是个美好的早晨，正因为如此，你才决定过来看望她。最近怎么样？ 哦，没什么问题。昨天那扇门在开启时出现了故障，所以我过来把绞车和其他一些零件换掉了；和雄已经把所有细节都解释给了我，现在我可以自己进行一些基本的维修工作，不需要再叫他和雄从奶奶家过来帮忙了。最好尽快把这些问题解决掉，以免以后再引发麻烦，你知道的吧？那么，你需要帮忙吗？ Clearly embarrassed, Kinu looks down at the finished frames and hurries to put them away in one corner of the shed. "Make some noise when you come along, won't you?" Oh, it's not that you were quiet, it's that she gets so absorbed in whatever she's doing that you could've yelled into one of her ears and it'd just have come out the other side. "That's not entirely wrong but still... make some noise, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Your daughter makes a small pouty face only young women can. "Well, I'm done now, I guess. rows.original: Examine your fox-daughter in closer detail.
rows.translation: 仔细检查你的狐狸女儿吧。

rows.original: Now that your daughter's a young woman, that doesn't mean you can stop communicating with her, you know.
rows.translation: 现在你的女儿已经长大成人了，但这并不意味着你可以停止与她交流，你明白的。
rows.raw: "Now that your daughter's a young woman, that doesn't mean you can stop communicating with her, you know."

rows.original: Give your daughter a good petting. She may be older, but she's still your little girl.
rows.translation: 好好抱抱你的女儿吧。她虽然已经长大了，但依然是你的小宝贝。
rows.raw: "Give your daughter a good petting. She may be older, but she's still your little girl."

rows.original: She may be older now, but some things don't change. You still want to spoil your daughter with a bit of sweet fruit.
rows.translation: 她现在可能年纪大了些，但有些事情始终没有改变。你还是会想用一些甜美的水果来宠溺你的女儿吧。
rows.raw: "She may be older now, but some things don't change. You still want to spoil your daughter with a bit of sweet fruit."

rows.original: "Now, come on. Once a day is perfectly fine — even if she's grown up, you don't want to spoil your daughter too rotten, do you?"
rows.translation: “好啦，别这样。每天一次完全没问题——就算她已经长大了，你也不会想把女儿宠得太烂吧，对不对？”
rows.raw: "\"Now, come on. Once a day is perfectly fine — even if she's grown up, you don't want to spoil your daughter too rotten, do you?\""

rows.original: "You don't have anything on you that would make for a suitable sweet gift for your fox-daughter. She's always loved fruit since she was little."
rows.translation: “你身上没有能给你狐狸女儿当作合适甜点礼物的东西。她从小就一直爱吃水果。”
rows.raw: "\"You don't have anything on you that would make for a suitable sweet gift for your fox-daughter. She's always loved fruit since she was little.\""

rows.original: Kinu may be all grown up now, but that doesn't mean that you can't spend time with her as her parent and be involved in her life.
rows.translation: 虽然小娟现在已经长大了，但这并不意味着作为她的父母，你就不能花时间陪伴她、参与她的生活。
rows.raw: "Kinu may be all grown up now, but that doesn't mean that you can't spend time with her as her parent and be involved in her life."

rows.original: Get Kinu to recount the events that transpired while you were out
rows.translation: 让小娟来讲述你在外出期间发生的事情吧
rows.raw: "Get Kinu to recount the events that transpired while you were out"

rows.original: and try to get her story straight this time around
rows.translation: 这次一定要把她的说法弄清楚
rows.raw: " and try to get her story straight this time around"

rows.original: You should probably wait for tomorrow for Kinu to gather her thoughts before trying to tell her story again.
rows.translation: 你或许应该等到明天，等小娟整理好思绪之后，再试着向她讲述那个故事。
rows.raw: "You should probably wait for tomorrow for Kinu to gather her thoughts before trying to tell her story again."

rows.original: [flags.KINU_Q2_STORY|Get Kinu to recount the events that transpired while she was traveling in The Ways Between[flags.KINU_Q2_FB| and try to get her story straight this time around].|]
rows.translation: [flags.KINU_Q2_STORY|让小娟讲述她在界间之路旅行期间发生的事情[flags.KINU_Q2_FB|，并试着让她这次把事情讲清楚。]|]
rows.raw: "[flags.KINU_Q2_STORY|Get Kinu to recount the events that transpired while she was traveling in The Ways Between[flags.KINU_Q2_FB| and try to get her story straight this time around].|]"

rows.original: All right, that'll be enough for now. Until next time you drop by the den, then.
rows.translation: 好的，目前就到这里吧。那么，下次你再来兽穴的时候再说吧。
rows.raw: "All right, that'll be enough for now. Until next time you drop by the den, then."

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |Time and age have changed what was once a tiny fox-child into an energetic young woman, perfectly balanced on the cusp of adulthood. Kinu was short as a child, and even though she's grown, that hasn't changed very much. At four feet and seven inches, your daughter still isn't going to be picking peaches off the bough without a ladder; kitsune aren't the tallest people to begin with, and even by their standards Kinu is below what might be considered average for a kitsune woman. The difference between then and now, though, is that your daughter now possesses the wherewithal to bring over a ladder by herself. What she lacks in height, though, your daughter has made up by growing out. Even though her kimono is loose and flowing, giving her room to move, the fullness of her body still pushes outwards against the flaxen fabric, refusing to be contained without putting up a fight. Her sleeves and skirts are long to keep out the cold, too; it's a very practical design. Kinu's favored colors are still white, blue and purple, and she wears them on her clothes in a simple leaf-print pattern reminiscent of her childhood clothing. A simple sash of deep purple about her waist ties her kimono together, the coarse cloth functional yet complementary to the rest of her getup. If anyone could make work clothing worn for manual labor look good, it's your daughter. The collar of her kimono has been fluffed up with luxuriant silvery-white fur to keep out the cold, the exact same color as her hair and fur; if nothing else, it gives her a very warm appearance. Kinu still does up some of her silvery-white hair in a blue-ribboned braid, but there's simply too much of it for but one of them to ever hope to control. The rest falls all over the place from under the headcloth she wears — from the sides of her face in bangs, over her brow and temples in a fringe, and all the way down her back to the bases of her five tails. Her large fox ears are usually turned downwards by her headcloth, although they still occasionally twitch from side to side of their own accord. Your daughter's face is slender and foxy, her features reminiscent of her mother's; her eyes are still ice-blue with white pupils and set above thin lips and a small nose. As with all kitsune, Kinu keeps her five silvery-white tails in excellent form. Even though she doesn't use her mother's scented oils any more, it's still clear that the dirt and debris of the fields is brushed out thoroughly at dawn and dusk. She may be a working girl, but that's no reason to let one's fur run ragged. By her right ankle, you spy the same bell anklet that she's worn since she was a kit — the strap's been retooled several times to accommodate her as she's grown, but the bell is still the exact same one she's been wearing ever since you first met her. Its twin hangs about her neck from a dark blue choker, a plain clapperless brass bell; together, these are the only adornments she wears in her daily life. As with her childhood, Kinu wears no shoes; she goes barefoot through the fields and everywhere else she goes. How she still manages to avoid having the soles of her feet harden or worse, step onto something untoward in her daily work — well, that's a true mystery of one's time. "Eh, are you done staring at me, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]?" Kinu says, wincing and sticking out her tongue at you. "This is really awkward..." You're sorry. Even after all this time... it's a little much to take in. |Time and age have changed what was once a tiny fox-child into an elegant and refined young woman, perfectly balanced on the cusp of adulthood. Kinu was short as a child, and even though she's grown, that hasn't changed very much. At four feet and seven inches, your daughter still isn't going to be picking peaches off the bough without a ladder; kitsune aren't the tallest people to begin with, and even by their standards Kinu is below what might be considered average for a kitsune woman. The difference between then and now, though, is that your daughter now wouldn't even dream of doing such a thing; she knows the whys and wherefores and conducts herself appropriately. What she lacks in height, though, your daughter has made up by growing out. The fullness of her figure is only accentuated by her fine, silken clothing; save for the long sleeves draped over her arms, the smooth fabric hugs her body and flaunts much of her femininity, aggressively declaring her womanhood to all. One might imagine Kinu would catch cold wearing this sort of thing in the Marches, but hey, Cait wears even less and is fine by all regards. You're not sure of the specifics of kitsune fashion, but even you can tell that it's meant to be classy[pc.bg courtesan noblescion minstrel|| despite your simple upbringing]; there's a timeless quality about Kinu's clothes that suggest the outfit of white, blue and purple will never fall out of fashion. Even the fine leaf-print pattern just oozes elegance in spades, managing to find beauty in simplicity. A sash of deep purple about her waist ties Kinu's kimono together, threaded with exquisite gold patterning as it hugs her body and completes the picture of dignified grandeur fit for a fox-princess. Your daughter clearly takes after her mother so much, not just in personality but in appearance, too, enough for the resemblance to be striking. Kinu's face is slender and foxy, another piece of her inheritance; her eyes are still ice-blue with white pupils and set above a small nose and thin lips. While your daughter mostly relies on her natural charms to get the job done, you notice she's judiciously applied a small amount of makeup in her mother's style — not as much, naturally, but still enough to greatly accentuate what's there. After all, it's not how much you use, it's about how it's used. She's allowed her hair to flow freely all the way to the bases of her five tails, each strand spilling out in a silvery-white stream as the perfumed scent of her mother's trademark herbal oil rises from it. Her tails are even more carefully groomed than her hair is, each one sleek and fine as opposed to her mother's fluffiness. By her right ankle, you spy the same bell anklet that she's worn since she was a kit — the strap's been retooled several times to accommodate her as she's grown, but the bell is still the exact same one she's been wearing ever since you first met her. Its twin hangs about her neck from a dark blue choker, a plain clapperless brass bell; together, these are the only explicit adornments she wears in her daily life. As with her childhood, Kinu wears no shoes; perhaps it's unseemingly for a young lady like her to go about barefoot, but this apparently is the one place she'll break with accepted etiquette with regards to dress. "It feels very nice to be appreciated, does it not?" Kinu says. "Flattery is a surprisingly useful tool, especially when one expects it the least. One must be careful, of course, lest it gets to one's head." Ah, gods, she noticed you staring. Maybe you should move this onward before it becomes even more awkward... ]
rows.translation: [kinu.isInari |岁月流逝，那个曾经还是个小狐狸的孩子，如今已经成长为一位充满活力的年轻女性，正处于成年的边缘，各方面都发展得十分均衡。小时候，小娟的身高就很矮，即使现在长大了，这一情况也没有太大改变。她只有四英尺七英寸高，因此还是需要借助梯子才能摘到树上的桃子；毕竟狐族本来就不是身高最高的种族，而按照他们自己的标准来看，小娟的身高也属于偏低的水平。不过，现在与过去的不同之处在于，你的女儿现在已经具备了独自搬来梯子的能力。虽然她的身高还有所不足，但通过不断成长，她已经弥补了这一缺憾。出局尽管她的和服宽松飘逸，为她的行动提供了足够的空间，但她丰满的身材依然会将布料向外撑开，仿佛在反抗这种束缚。她的袖子和裙子也都设计得很长，就是为了抵御寒冷——这种设计确实非常实用。小娟最喜欢的颜色依然是白色、蓝色和紫色，她在衣服上采用了简单的叶纹图案，这种设计让人联想到她童年时穿的服装。她腰间系着一条深紫色的腰带，将和服束得整整齐齐，这种粗糙质地的布料虽然实用，但却与她整体的装扮相得益彰。如果有人能让用于体力劳动的工作服看起来也如此漂亮，那一定是你的女儿。她和服的领口被装饰上了柔软的银白色毛皮，既能保暖，颜色也与她的头发和毛皮完全相同；单是这一点，就让她看起来格外温暖舒适。 姬娜仍然会将自己那银白色的头发编成一条用蓝色丝带装饰的辫子，但她的头发实在太多了，以至于只有一条辫子根本无法完全控制。剩下的头发从她戴的头巾下面散落在各处：一部分垂在脸的两侧成为刘海，另一部分则覆盖在她的眉毛和太阳穴上，还有一部分一直垂到她的背后，连接着她那五条尾巴的根部。她那一对大大的狐狸耳朵通常被头巾遮住，垂在脑后，不过偶尔还是会不由自主地左右晃动。你女儿的脸庞纤细而带着几分狐狸般的精致，她的五官与她母亲十分相似：那双冰蓝色的眼睛里镶嵌着白色的瞳孔，而她那薄薄的嘴唇和小小的鼻子，更是为她的面容增添了几分独特的气质。 和所有九尾狐一样，纪奴也将自己的五条银白色尾巴保养得非常好。虽然她不再使用母亲使用的那些芳香精油，但每天黎明和黄昏时，她都会仔细地将尾巴上的灰尘和污垢刷干净。她虽然是个职场女性，但这并不意味着她就可以不顾自己的形象。在她的右脚踝上，你依然可以看到那副她从小时候就开始佩戴的铃铛脚链——虽然带子已经经过多次调整，以适应她身体成长的变化，但那些铃铛却依然和你们第一次见到她时一样。她的双胞胎姐妹被挂在一条深蓝色的项圈上，那是一个没有任何装饰、普通的黄铜铃铛；在日常生活中，这些就是她唯一佩戴的装饰品。和她的童年时代一样，小娟也不穿鞋子，总是赤脚走在田野里，去任何她想去的地方。她究竟是如何在日常生活中避免脚底变得粗糙，或者更糟糕的是，避免踩到那些令人不快的东西的——这，真的是现代人的一大谜团。 呃，你盯着我看够了吧？ [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]？"小娟皱着眉头，吐着舌头对着你说。这真的有点尴尬…… 很抱歉，即使过了这么长时间……这一切还是让人难以接受。 |岁月流逝，那个曾经只是个小狐妖的孩子，如今已经成长为一位优雅而娴静的年轻女子，正处于成年的边缘，一切都显得那么恰到好处。小时候，小娟个子就很矮，即使现在长大了，这个特点也没有发生太大的变化。你的女儿身高四英尺七英寸，所以她还是需要借助梯子才能从树枝上摘桃子；狐妖本来就不是身高最高的人类种族，而按照他们自己的标准来看，小娟的身高也属于狐妖女性中的偏矮那一类。不过，现在和过去不同的是，你的女儿现在根本不会考虑去做这样的事情；她已经明白了其中的缘由，也会举止得体。 不过，虽然她的身高还不够理想，但她通过其他方面的努力来弥补这个缺陷。出局她那丰满的身材只有在穿着精致柔滑的衣物时才会更加凸显出来；除了那长袖衣物覆盖在手臂上之外，光滑的面料紧紧贴着她的身体，将她的女性魅力充分展现出来，向所有人强烈宣告着她的成熟与女性化程度。有人可能会想，在三月的季节里，小娟穿这样的衣服肯定会感冒的，但是，凯特穿的甚至更少，却一点问题都没有。虽然你可能不太了解狐族的穿衣习惯，但就连你也能看出，这样的服装设计本来就是为了展现优雅与气质。[pc.bg courtesan noblescion minstrel|| 尽管你的成长环境十分简单]小娟的服装具有一种永恒的魅力，这种白色、蓝色和紫色的搭配永远不会过时。就连那些精美的叶纹图案也散发着十足的优雅气息，它们在简洁中诠释了美。 一条深紫色的腰带将小娟的和服紧紧束在腰间，上面镶嵌着精美的金色花纹，这条腰带贴合她的身体曲线，使得她整个人看起来既高贵又典雅，完全符合一位狐妖公主的形象。你的女儿显然非常像她的母亲，不仅性格如此，外貌上也有着惊人的相似之处。小娟的脸型修长而精致，这也是她从母亲那里继承来的特征；她的眼睛依然是冰蓝色的，瞳孔为白色，长在一张小巧的鼻子和薄薄的嘴唇上方。虽然你的女儿主要依靠自己的自然魅力来达成目标，但你注意到她还是巧妙地化了一点点母亲风格的妆容——当然，化得并不浓，但足以充分凸显她的五官优势。毕竟，重要的不是使用量，而是使用方式。 她的头发被随意地披散下来，一直延伸到她五条尾巴的根部，每一缕头发都像银白色的流苏般垂坠下来，而从这些头发中散发出来的，是她母亲特制的草本香油的芬芳气息。她的尾巴甚至比她的头发还要精心打理——每一条尾巴都光滑细腻，与她母亲那些蓬松的尾巴截然不同。在她的右脚踝处，你可以看到那副她从小时候就开始佩戴的铃铛脚链——随着她的成长，脚链的带子已经经过多次调整，以适应她的变化，但那个铃铛却依然和你们第一次见到她时一样。她的双胞胎姐妹被悬挂在一条深蓝色的项圈上，那是一个没有任何装饰、普通的黄铜铃铛；在她的日常生活中，这些就是她唯一会佩戴的装饰品。和她的童年一样，小娟也不穿鞋子；对于像她这样的年轻女孩来说，赤脚行走或许有些不妥，但在这个地方，她显然打破了人们对于穿着礼仪的常规认知。 被人认可的感觉真是很好，不是吗？小娟说道。奉承其实是一种相当实用的工具，尤其是在人们最不期待它的时候。当然，也必须小心谨慎，以免让它冲昏自己的头脑。 啊，天哪，她注意到你在盯着她看了。或许你该尽快把这件事推进下去，否则情况会变得更加尴尬…… ]
