rows.original: Kinu has such a fine, foxy face like her mother. Give your daughter an affectionate facerub.
rows.translation: 小娟有着和她母亲一样精致、迷人的面容。亲亲你的女儿，给她一个充满爱意的拥抱吧。
rows.raw: "Kinu has such a fine, foxy face like her mother. Give your daughter an affectionate facerub."

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |A small, sheepish smile comes over your fox-daughter's face as she realizes what you're up to. "Aha, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]... really now? You're going to treat me like a kit?" No matter how old she gets, she's always going to be your daughter. "Ehhh..." Kinu thinks a moment, then scratches the back of her head and sticks her tongue out at you. Rolling her shoulders, your fox-daughter does a twirl and flourish; her quintet of tails flowing in her wake. The glossy, silvery-white hairs catch the sunlight and glisten faintly, lending Kinu's tails a vaguely ethereal sheen. Gods, for her to be like this even after working all day in the fields... nature must really love her. That, or she must spend an inordinately long time brushing her tails every morning. "All right, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I don't mind if you pet my tails some." With that said, Kinu swishes about so that her side's facing you; one of her fluffy white tails curls about her waist invitingly, clearly beckoning for you to step forward and sink your fingers into it. Looking at you from over her shoulder, your fox-daughter waits for you to take the initiative here, egging you on with a tilt of her chin. Well, nothing for it. Reaching out, you accept Kinu's invitation with full gusto — and of course, your fingers just end up with nothing, the fur of the lustrous, fluffy tail flowing through your fingers like water. Your fox-daughter just laughs a good belly laugh each time this happens, until you finally manage to pin down its warm core through all the thick fox-fur and take it firmly in your grasp. Kinu playfully tugs and pulls as your hold a bunch of times — you're certain that if she had tried to wriggle free in earnest, she'd have succeeded long ago. Yet she continues to tease you for a bit, letting you get a good feel for the carefully cultivated fluffiness of her tail. "Feels good, doesn't it, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]? C'mon, I'll let you have another one." As she speaks, another of her five tails winds its way to you, its tip snugly wrapping about your wrist and gently pulling your hand into all the divine white fox-fur you could ever hope to need. She's got a lot more control over her tails from when she was a kit, you notice... Such thoughts, though, are quick to disperse when you start stroking Kinu's tail in earnest, starting from a little ways past mid-length to the tip, always careful to not get too close to the base. Mid to tip in long, languid strokes, then divesting your fingers of warm fox-fur so you can sink them back in and start the process all over again. No matter how tightly you try to grip the fine fur between your fingers, it's simply an impossible task. After the first pass, your daughter's expression has softened considerably; after the fifth, she stretches backwards, arms akimbo, and sighs happily. She's all grown up now and less prone to acting on childish impulses, but when it comes down to it at the end of the day, she's still your daughter. "Enjoying yourself, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]?" A smile. "I guess these tails of mine are good for something, aren't they? Come on, I think you can handle more than that — use both your hands, okay?" At those words, Kinu sends the remainder of her tails at you — all five of them suffusing your arms up to the elbow in a wriggling mess of warm cores and soft fluff. Everywhere you gather and pull, there's just more and more kitsune fur to be had; Kinu's smile spreads into a lazy grin even as a little color rises into her cheeks and the bridge of her nose. At this point, you're just grabbing tail fluff as it comes within reach, gathering it together in both your hands and pulling with all your might, feeling it run across your wrists and palms before flowing away in little glimmering wisps of silvery white. Her ears pressed flat against her hair beneath her headcloth, Kinu lets out a contented sigh, followed by several very vulpine yips before shaking herself out. "All right, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], that's enough. Don't want to get carried away, eh?" Ha, and just when it was getting good... "Don't get me wrong, that was great, but we can't do this all day or else I'll get too sleepy and there won't be any work done at all." With several final taps of their brush-like tips, Kinu's tails slink away from you and return to their mistress. "Like I said, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], I'm not a kit any more... I can't have you petting my tails to the point where I just doze off on the ground. This is different, but it's still a good thing nonetheless." It is. "Well then, I guess I should be going. Take care of yourself, okay?[party.has Kiyoko| And... also take care of Mother as well.]" Before you can reply, Kinu's already turned all five of her tails and is beating a hasty retreat, perhaps a little too hasty. Still, there's a spring in her step that wasn't there when you began, so all's well ends well. |The moment she sees you reaching for her tails, the small, pleasant smile on Kinu's face melts into a frown; your fox-daughter steps back defensively, her body reacting on instinct. Realizing what she's doing, Kinu looks at you askance and clears her throat awkwardly. "Forgive me, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]... but what you are asking of me is impossible, and not just because I am no longer a child." ... "For a maiden of my lineage and social standing, for the kind of person whom I need to be, my tails are reserved for my future husband and children alone. No one else, not even you or Mother, would be able to partake of them without — ah, hopefully you understand... "My deepest and most sincere apologies, but nothing can be done about it." There's that Old Country phrase again, in its various translations into Belharan. It can't be helped. Nothing can be done about it. "I am no longer a kit, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], and some things, while memorable in my youth, have passed into time's fire and are no longer possible, no longer recreatable even though we may try. Please... do not make the attempt, even in jest. It cannot end well. "I... I am going to take my leave now." Without waiting for so much as a reply, Kinu turns tail and pads off; she doesn't look back. [party.has kiyoko | "Well, that's our daughter," Kiyoko says, coming up to you. "She's not wrong, you know." ] She's right. Some things have changed; the past has been consumed by time's fire, leaving only memories. And sometimes memories are best left as such... ]
rows.translation: [kinu.isInari |当你的女儿意识到你在做什么时，她脸上浮现出一丝害羞的微笑。啊哈， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]…真的吗？你打算把我当成一个工具来使用吗？ 无论她年纪多大，她永远都是你的女儿。 呃……小娟思考了一会儿，然后挠了挠后脑勺，吐了吐舌头朝你笑了笑。她耸了耸肩膀，旋转着身体，五条尾巴在身后飘动。那些光亮如银的白色毛发在阳光下微微闪烁，让小娟的尾巴显得格外优雅而神秘。天啊，她整天在田里劳作后还能保持这样的状态……大自然一定是特别偏爱她的。不然的话，她每天早上肯定要花很长时间来梳理自己的尾巴吧。好吧， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]你要是能轻轻摸摸我的尾巴，我也不会介意的。 说着，小娟轻轻摆动身体，让她的身体侧面对着你；她那条蓬松的白尾巴其中一条优雅地绕在她的腰间，仿佛在邀请你上前，用手指轻轻触碰它。你的狐妖女儿从她肩后看着你，用微微倾斜的下巴鼓励你，等待着你主动迈出这一步。 好吧，也没什么办法。当你伸出手去，满怀热情地接受了小娟的邀请时——当然，你的手指最终什么也抓不到，那条光亮柔软的尾巴就像流水一样从你的指缝间滑过。每次发生这种事，你的狐妖女儿都会开怀大笑，直到你终于能够穿过厚厚的狐妖毛皮，抓住它温暖的身体。小娟顽皮地拉扯着你的手，让你反复抓住她的尾巴——你敢肯定，如果她真的想挣脱的话，早就成功了。然而，她还是继续逗弄你，让你好好感受她那条经过精心培育、柔软蓬松的尾巴。 感觉不错吧， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]来吧，我再给你一个。 她说话的时候，她的五条尾巴中的一条又蜿蜒着朝你伸来，它的尾巴尖轻轻缠住你的手腕，然后将你的手拉进了那片充满神圣气息的白色狐毛之中——那正是你梦寐以求的。她真是太很多从她还是幼崽的时候起，你就已经能够更好地控制她的尾巴了，你注意到了吗…… 然而，当你真正开始轻轻抚摸小娟的尾巴时，这些想法很快就会烟消云散。你可以从尾巴的中段开始抚摸，逐渐向尾巴尖端移动，同时一定要注意不要过于靠近尾巴的根部。用长而缓慢的动作将手指插入那柔软的狐毛中，然后又抽出手指，让它们重新陷入那温暖的毛丛中，再开始这个过程。无论你如何努力地用手指抓住那细密的毛丝，这都是一项根本无法完成的任务。经过第一次尝试后，你女儿的表情已经变得柔和了许多；到了第五次尝试时，她甚至会向后仰躺，双臂交叉放在身后，开心地叹气。她现在已经长大了，不再那么容易受孩子气冲动的驱使，但归根结底，她依然是你的女儿。 玩得开心吗？ [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]？"一个微笑。我想我的这些尾巴还是有点用的吧？来吧，你应该能应付得来——用你的两只手吧，好吗？ 听到这些话，小娟将她剩下的五条尾巴全都朝你甩了过来——那些柔软的尾巴缠绕在你的手臂上，一直延伸到肘部，形成了一团温暖而柔软的绒毛。无论你往哪个方向拉扯，总能得到更多的狐毛；小娟的笑容变得更加灿烂，她的脸颊和鼻梁也微微泛起了红晕。此时，你只需抓住那些触手可及的尾毛，将它们全部聚集在双手中，然后用尽全力拉扯。你会感觉到这些尾毛从你的手腕和手掌上滑过，最终化作一缕缕银白色的细丝，飘散开来。她的耳朵紧贴着头巾下的头发，小娟发出一声满足的叹息，随后又发出几声类似狐妖般的叫声，才终于回过神来。 好吧， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]够了，别太激动了，嗯？ 哈，就在事情开始变得有趣的时候…… 别误会，那样确实很棒，但我们不能整天都这样，否则我会变得太困，根本无法工作了。随着它们那刷子般的尾尖最后几次轻触，小娟的尾巴从你身边滑开，重新回到了主人的身边。就像我之前说的， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]我不再是一个需要别人不断抚摸来让自己放松的家伙了……不能再让你一直摸我的尾巴，直到我在地上睡着为止。这次虽然情况不同，但总归还是一件好事。 确实如此。 那好吧，我想我该走了。你自己多加小心，好吗？[party.has Kiyoko| 还有……也要照顾好母亲。]" 你还没来得及回应，小娟就已经把她的五条尾巴都甩了起来，慌忙地逃跑了——或许有点太慌了。不过，她逃跑时的步伐里带着一种活力，这是刚开始时并没有的，所以最终还是好事吧。 |当她看到你伸手去抓她的尾巴时，小娟脸上那抹愉悦的微笑立刻消失了，取而代之的是一幅皱眉的表情；你的狐妖女儿出于本能地后退了一步，她的身体做出了防御性的反应。意识到自己的行为后，小娟有些尴尬地看了你一眼，然后清了清嗓子。 原谅我， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]但是你要求我做的事情是不可能的，不仅仅因为我已经不再是个孩子了。 …… 对于我这样的出身和社会地位的少女来说，对于我这个应该成为的人而言，我的尾巴只属于未来的丈夫和孩子们。其他人，甚至你和母亲，都没有资格享用它们——啊，希望你们能理解这一点…… 我致以最深切、最诚挚的歉意，但对此我们无能为力。 又出现了那个古老的乡村用语，它被翻译成了各种贝尔哈兰语版本。这也没办法，对此无能为力。 我不再是一个工具包了， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]有些事情，虽然在我的年轻时代令人难忘，但它们早已被时间的火焰吞噬，再也无法实现，即使我们再怎么尝试也无法重现那些往事。请……千万不要尝试去做，哪怕只是开玩笑。那样做的结果肯定不会好。 我……我现在要告辞了。 甚至没有等待任何回应，小娟就转身溜走了，连一眼都没有回头看。 [party.has kiyoko | 嗯，那就是我们的女儿。清子走上前对你说。你知道，她并没有错。 ] 她说得对。有些事情确实如此。拥有一切都已改变；过去被时间的火焰吞噬，只剩下回忆。 而有时候，回忆就让它保持原样吧…… ]

rows.translation: 尽情宠爱你女儿那漂亮的尾巴。

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |"You know, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]... I did promise you that when I got older and wasn't so small, I'd pet you on the head, too. I guess I haven't gotten that much taller, so that kinda quashes that hope, but that doesn't mean that I can't make good on my promise anyway. You give your word, you've got to keep it, like it or not... that's how these things work, yeah? "So... since you went to all the trouble of becoming one of us, why don't I show you how it's like? Receiving sure feels nice, but it's after you've experienced it for yourself that you know how best to make other people feel good, yeah?" She's already assumed your consent, stepping forward, and to be honest... it would be a nigh-impossible task to deny your darling fox-daughter. This goes doubly so when getting headpats and ear scritches are so much more satisfying and above all, intense[pc.ora lupine|, surpassing even your previous life as a lupine before all this started; touching yourself doesn't much if anything at all, but having someone else do it changes the entire nature of the act]. Foxen most certainly are sluts for headpats, no two ways about it. "C'mon, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]! Get to my level and let me repay you for once!" Kinu's practically itching to get started already, making grabby hands and waggling her fingers with mischievous intent. Well, if she insists so strongly — [pc.heightRange 60 72 |balancing yourself with your hands on your knees, you crouch down so that your fox-daughter doesn't have to raise her arm in order to get at your head and ears. It takes a moment or two for Kinu to find a height with which she's comfortable, but it's so going to be worth it. |considering how much you tower over your fox-daughter, you have to crouch down pretty low in order for your fox-daughter to be able to reach your head without needing to raise her arm. It looks silly, to be sure, but then this whole situation is silly to begin with. What's a little more in the spirit of the act? |you don't have to crouch down very much in order to get your head and ears at a height with which your fox-daughter is comfortable, but it's still best to make this as enjoyable as possible for the both of you. Wouldn't want her arm to get tired, eh? ] Once everything's in position, Kinu thrusts her hand forward and starts [pc.isBald |massaging your scalp with unabashed gusto, pushing her fingers hard against the [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] and ensuring beyond any reasonable doubt that you feel the full extent of her contact with you. Such messy determination... such furious ardor for something as simple as a headpatting |running her fingers through your [pc.hair] with unabashed gusto, gathering great clumps of it in her grasp and tousling away with messy determination. Any semblance of order your [pc.hair] might have had is rapidly lost to Kinu's furious headpatting, [pc.hairsSimpleNoun] going all over the place in the controlled, energetic chaos ]. What a daughter you've raised, and all of the vigor and energy she's grown to possess as a young woman is being channelled back into your [pc.hair] as she rolls fingers, knuckles and palms all alike atop your head. The sensation is... indescribable. As Kinu's thumb and forefinger pinch the base of one of your ears, an electric jolt of molten, comforting pleasure shoots through your skull and down your spine. Every single muscle in your body relaxes of its own accord, and you can feel your tails start to swish from side to side — not vigorously enough to be considered wagging, but a long, languid movement that resonates perfectly with the growing drowsiness that's filling your head and heart. Your breathing deepens, your fox ears start moving of their own accord, there's a sensation of complete and utter surrender and helplessness that [pc.isDK|you might have once experienced before, but is utterly foreign to you these days|overwhelming in the fullness of it all]. "Haha, look at you, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Like it? I've been doing this for [kiyoko.numKits 2|my siblings since we were all little|Hitoshi quite a lot], so you can imagine that I've got in a lot of practice. Maybe you're even more sensitive because you weren't born a kitsune... familiarity breeds contempt, as they say, but I don't think I could ever get bored of receiving such divine headpats. One of the small joys of being who we are, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]... I'm sure you don't regret petitioning old Keros to become one of us now, yeah?" She's toying with your ears now, her fingers playing with the tips, flicking the cartilaginous flesh back and forth and watching it spring back into shape. You feel it spring back into shape, too — small tremors and shivers that course down the sides of your skull and envelop your mind in a warm sense of comfortable belonging. Kinu smiles down at you, your fox-daughter's bright expression full of robust energy as she tends to the insides of your ears too, her other hand still working away carefully at your [pc.hair]; the two work in tandem to bring you the utmost bliss for both body and mind. You can feel yourself melting away, and sure enough, your knees and waist finally give and you find yourself with your chin on the ground, unable to stay upright a moment longer. Before you know it, Kinu's got her hands under your shoulders and is hauling you upright, heaving with all her might and manhandling you into a position that won't be so damaging for your propriety. "Haha, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I guess that felt a little too good for you, huh??" Kinu gives your [pc.hair] a final pat and tousle before straightening herself out. "Okay, then — I'd love to stay and do this some more, but the weeding isn't going to do itself, you know. I'll see you around in a bit, okay?" You mumble something that's neither here nor there, which just prompts another hearty laugh from your fox-daughter. She thwaps you on the back with one of her five tails, then is sauntering off back across the fields, her steps quick and easy. Moreso than I was at your age, ehe; when your poor mother was eighteen summers old she was still horsing around with Komari... can you believe that the den matron was young once? Eh?" "It is only because of your gifts that I have managed to make it this far, Mother. The divine law of equivalent exchange mandates that I pay you back in equal measure." "Oh, such humble language in front of your dear mother." Kiyoko bites down into the berry. "A gift here, a gift there, what does it matter? Who keeps track? They are freely given... remember, daughter, that you were a gift given to me by your [pc.mf|father|mother]. And while I suppose I did bear you in my womb and birth you... you have given me far more in return than anything I have ever bestowed upon you. The joy of raising a daughter like you, especially in the times when your [pc.mf|father|mother] could not come to visit us... it is one of the reasons why we are here today, enjoying the sun." |You pick another berry off the bunch and sample it; not bad. Well! By the sound of it, your fluffy daughter's been quite the busy little bee, hasn't she? "I prefer to keep myself occupied, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Idle hands do no one any good, and engaging with others keeps the ennui away. Mother did once say that the most important thing you can invest in is other people; I have taken such sound advice to heart." And has she done so. She's quite the popular character around these parts, you've noticed. "It behooves me to at least try and be cordial with the people whom which I am going to spend my years around." Oh, come on. This is far more than merely cordial. "I just like people, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." ] A calm breeze picks up across the plaza, bringing with it the muted sounds of voices and laughter. You reach for another berry, only to find nothing; the lacquered plate is empty. That was fast... remarkably fast. No, too fast. Just like your daughter growing up. [party.has kiyoko |"Well," your fox-wife says, drawing herself [kiyoko.pregStage 2|and her pregnant belly ]up and off the bench, "I suppose it's time for us to go. Take care of yourself and the den while we're gone, you hear?" "Yes, Mother." Kinu closes her eyes and folds her ears flat against her head. "Please keep yourselves safe out there." "We will." |Well, it's time for you to go. Leaving the empty plate with Kinu, you draw yourself off the bench and heave a small sigh. She's to take care of herself and the den while you're gone, all right? "Yes, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." And she's going to be good and listen to her Mother, yes? To take care of her [kiyoko.numKits 2|and her siblings ]while you're gone? "I will. Please, keep yourself safe out there. I hear things about events that are going on beyond the den's confines." ] ] That's... that's good, then. If you don't leave now, you'll never get to it. Squaring your shoulders, you head off across the plaza at a brisk pace, feeling Kinu's gaze on the back of your neck every step of the way. [party.has kiyoko |Even with Kiyoko's comforting presence at your side, it hurts, damn it, and to make things worse, you know she's hurting, too |It hurts, damn it. ]. But it can't be helped, can it? If nothing, so that your daughter has a future worth having. ] ] "

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |It's a bit of a struggle, but you pull out a wild melon from your other possessions and present it to your fox-daughter. It's what she likes, right? Natural sweetness, nuanced flavor, not too cloying for a very liberal definition of cloying? Ah, the delights of wild melons, big, round and dense without being too big. Kinu gives you a lazy smile as she eyes your proffered gift, planting her hands on her hips akimbo. "You know, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], now that I'm bigger I could eat all of that in one go if I wanted to." Ha ha. She used to be so small that she'd joke about the melons being bigger than her... A sigh laced with longing. "Yes, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I know. Well, there's still plenty to go around here, so I don't have to eat it all myself if I don't want to. I think [kiyoko.numKits 2|my siblings|Mother] could use a bit of honey and melon, don't you think? The apiaries are coming along very nicely." That's very thoughtful of her. "Of course, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Now let me have a good look at this." You tip the melon into Kinu's waiting arms, and she catches it without so much as a hitch. Your fox-daughter spends several moments poring over the fruit, rubbing her fingers all over the rind and bumping it with her nose to get a good handle on the fruit's aroma. Eventually, Kinu lets out a small sigh and finishes appraising your fruit, cradling the hefty melon in front of her waist with both hands. "[rand |Not bad for a wild cultivar," she says after several moments' thought. "Smells like it'll be a bit starchy, but that's not necessarily a problem; it just means that there'll be room for it to pick up the flavor of whatever it's served with. |Ah, so big, so heavy. Everything in this part of the world grows so robustly and dense; even the fruit itself is no exception. Ah, what is a petite creature like me to do... ehe. This one promises to be refreshing, no doubt about it. |I don't think I'll eat this one just yet, not before picking out the seeds and seeing if they'll sprout. It'll ruin the pulp and make it fit for nothing but maybe preserves or filling... which in retrospect isn't so bad, but still. I want to grow more of this and see what comes of it. ] Thanks, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." She's welcome. "Ah, there's enough here to last everyone a day[kiyoko.numKits 8||, maybe even two]. I... I'll get this back to the shed, and be right back with you." Kinu is good to her word. Still cradling the melon in front of her, she disappears in the direction of said shed and returns several minutes later, melon-less. "Put it in some water to chill a bit. Flowing water would've been best, but I'd have to walk all the way to the pool for that. Now... is there anything else you needed, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]? |Seeing you pull the melon out of your pack, Kinu gives you a small smile and raises a hand to her cheek. "Oh, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], what a melon you have there; certainly a most large and robust specimen. One can only wonder how you managed to carry that around with you without feeling its weight." If it's for your little fox-princess, you're willing to shoulder any burden. It's what she likes, right? Natural sweetness, nuanced flavor, not too cloying for a very liberal definition of cloying? Ah, the delights of wild melons, big, round and dense without being too big. "Ehe. Then I shall refrain from further delay and accept your kind gift posthaste." While she does her best to remain poised and graceful throughout the exchange, the sheer weight of the melon is enough to give your fox-daughter pause as you tip it into her arms. She closes her eyes, draws a deep breath, then pads over to a nearby low table and sets it atop its surface, perfectly balanced in the middle. How does she do that? You may never know. Kinu steps back to admire the wild melon against the backdrop of the room, perhaps taking note of its color and shape before turning back to you with a small bow and dip of her head. "[rand |Such color, such vibrance. Perhaps I shall get Nakano to paint it against an appropriate backdrop before I serve it to him as honeyed melon. Perhaps it is not the usual subject matter of his paintings, but I am sure I can convince him to indulge my whims |Such weight, even for a fruit this size — I am sure everyone will be more than glad to receive some, and I will ensure that they know what a good eye you have for wild melons, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Perhaps something this rich will be able to sate even Mikoto's endless appetite |Such memories of my childhood, all of them utterly precious beyond compare. Even the smell... it is enough to evoke the old, endless woodland ]. It is a marvelous gift, [pc.mf|Father|Mother] — thank you, from the bottom of my heart." You're glad that you could have helped. [var0 |She shouldn't leave it out for too long, though. "I will set it in the pool with the rest of the chilled food before I leave today; it should be properly cooled by the time I return in the evening. Chilled melon is always fine to have; [kiyoko.numKits 4 |I am sure my siblings will agree |I ought to bring some over to Matron Komari's tomorrow ]. |Can she get it home on her own, though? Kinu gives you a little ladylike chuckle. "I do enough lifting and carrying in the course of my duties, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]; I should be fine. And if not... I am sure Nakano will be gallant enough to aid a young princess with her burden." Behind her, Komari heaves a small sigh. "I really don't see why that boy is enamored with you, girl, but I suppose it takes his mind off the alternatives. He could be doing much worse than hauling melons with his time." ] Either way, you're glad to have helped brighten her day. "Come to speak of it, I am in a considerably better mood than I was in several moments ago, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Can I help you with anything else, then?" ]
rows.translation: [kinu.isInari |虽然有点费劲，但你还是从其他物品中找出了一个野生甜瓜，把它送给了你的狐狸女儿。这正是她喜欢的吧？天然的甜味，细腻的风味，而且按照最宽泛的标准来看，也不会过于腻口吧？啊，野生甜瓜的可口之处就在于——它们又大又圆，果肉紧实，却并不太真大啊。” 小娟看着你送来的礼物，懒洋洋地笑了笑，然后双手叉腰站在那里。你知道， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]现在我长大了，可以如果我想的话，完全可以一次性把那些都吃掉。 哈哈，她以前那么小，甚至会开玩笑说那些瓜比她还大…… 一声充满思念的叹息。是的， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]我知道。嗯，这里的食物还有很多，所以如果我不想的话，并不一定非得把它们都吃掉。我觉得这样挺好的。 [kiyoko.numKits 2|我的兄弟姐妹|母亲]是不是应该再加些蜂蜜和瓜果呢？这些养蜂场的发展势头相当不错啊。 她真是太体贴了。 当然， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]现在让我仔细看看这个吧。 你将那个甜瓜递到小娟伸出的手中，她毫不费力地接住了它。你的狐狸女儿仔细端详着这个水果，用手指抚摸它的果皮，还用鼻子闻了闻，以便更好地了解它的香气。最终，小娟轻轻叹了口气，完成了对这个水果的评估，然后双手将这个重型的甜瓜捧在身前。 "[rand |对于一个野生品种来说，已经相当不错了。她思考了片刻后说道。听起来可能会有一点面糊的味道，但这不一定是个问题；这只是意味着它能够吸收搭配它的食物的味道而已。 |啊，这么大，这么重。这个地区的所有东西都长得如此茂盛、如此结实；就连水果也不例外。啊，像我这样的小生物该怎么办呢……呵呵。这个水果肯定很清爽，这一点毫无疑问。 |我想我还是先不吃这个吧，得先把种子挑出来，看看它们能不能发芽。如果发芽了，果肉就会变质，到时候就只能用来制作果酱或者馅料了……不过仔细想想，这样也还不错。不过我还是想再种一些，看看会有什么结果。 ]谢谢。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]。" 她不客气。 啊，这里的量足够让每个人吃上一整天了。[kiyoko.numKits 8||也许甚至两个]我……我先把这个拿到棚子里去，马上就回来找你。 小娟确实守信用。她仍然抱着怀里的西瓜，然后朝着那间小屋的方向走去，几分钟后回来时，西瓜已经不在她手里了。 把它放在水里稍微冷却一下吧。如果有流动的水的话效果会更好，不过那样我就得走到游泳池那里去了。现在……你还需要什么吗？ [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]？ |看到你拿出了那个“宝贝”，小娟微微一笑，然后用手捂住了自己的脸颊。哦， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]哇，你带的这个瓜可真大啊；简直是个又大又结实的家伙。真不知道你是怎么把它带着到处走的，居然一点都感觉不到它的重量。 如果这是为了你那位小狐狸公主，你愿意承担任何负担。这才是她喜欢的，对吧？天然的甜味，细腻的风味，而且按照最宽泛的标准来看，也不会过于腻人吧？啊，这些野生瓜果的魅力——又大又圆，果肉紧实，却并不太很大。 呵呵，那我就不再拖延了，尽快接受你这份慷慨的礼物吧。 尽管她在整个对话过程中都尽力保持镇定与优雅，但当你将那个重型的甜瓜递到她手中时，它的重量还是让她有些措手不及。她闭上眼睛深吸一口气，然后走到旁边的一张低矮桌子上，将甜瓜放在桌面上，让它完美地保持平衡。她是怎么做到的？你可能永远也不会知道。小娟退后几步，欣赏着房间背景映衬下的那个野瓜，或许还在仔细观察它的颜色和形状，然后才转过身来，微微鞠躬、低下头对你说道。 "[rand |这样的色彩，如此绚烂夺目。或许我应该让中野在合适的背景上绘制这幅画，然后再把它呈献给他。虽然这可能不是他平时常画的题材，但我相信一定能说服他满足我的这个奇想。 |这样的分量，即便是对于这种大小的果实来说——我相信大家都会非常乐意收到这样的礼物，而且我一定会确保他们知道，你对野生甜瓜的辨识力真是太棒了。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]或许这样丰富的内容甚至能够满足美琴那无穷的胃口。 |这些关于我童年的回忆，每一样都无比珍贵，无与伦比。就连那些气味……也足以让人回想起那片古老而辽阔的森林。 ]这真是一份精美的礼物。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]真的非常感谢，这是我发自内心的感激。 你能提供帮助，这让你感到很高兴。 [var0 |不过，她不应该把东西放在外面太久。 今天离开之前，我会把它和其他冷藏食品一起放在泳池里；等晚上我回来时，它应该已经彻底冷却了。冷藏过的甜瓜总是很不错的[kiyoko.numKits 4 |我相信我的兄弟姐妹们也会同意的 |明天我应该带一些东西去给麻里院长 ]。 |不过，她能自己把它带回家吗？ 小娟发出了一阵略带淑女气质的轻笑。在我的工作中，我确实需要经常进行举重和搬运之类的工作。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]应该不会有问题的。如果真的出了什么状况……我相信中野一定会挺身而出，帮助这位年轻的公主解决困难。 在她身后，麻里轻轻叹了口气。我真的不明白那个男孩为什么会对你如此着迷，姑娘，但我想这至少让他暂时忘记了其他可能的选择。他本可以把时间花在更重要的事情上，而不是去搬运那些西瓜。 ] 无论如何，你能帮助她度过一个愉快的一天，这让你感到很欣慰。 说起来，我现在确实比刚才感觉好多了。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]那么，还有什么我可以帮您的吗？ ]

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |You take the juicy peach out of your possessions, and Kinu freezes on the spot. Her ice-blue eyes widen just a little bit as she quirks her eyebrows and gives you a small smile; perhaps she doesn't quite realize it herself, but her pointer fingers come together in steady tapping motion as her lips part just wide enough to show you the sharp vulpine points of her teeth, which had been very much human moments ago. "H-hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], it's a good try, but you can't buy my affection like this, you know. Not any more. I-I'm not a kid who can be bought off with food." No, you're not trying to buy her affections — come on, the both of you know each other better than that to imagine such a thing would be possible of a young woman with such strong beliefs in right and wrong. "Ah ha ha ha... come on, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]... you aren't aren't trying to bribe me, eh? To make peace with Mother, perhaps?" While you would like to see Kinu and Kiyoko at least not fight so much, you know full well it's not something you can bring about just by giving her peaches. Now, maybe she should accept the gift in the spirit in which it's being given. A sheepish laugh. "Sheesh, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. All right, I'll take it..." With that, Kinu reaches out and plucks the juicy peach from your hands with all the deftness of a kingfisher sniping its prey. Adjusting the huge, ripe fruit in her hand, she raises it to her eye with a three-fingered grip and studies it with all the seriousness of a jeweler assaying the purity of gold. "[rand |Such color, such luster. But the taste? Oh, we'll see all right. |Hmm... such impressive size, and the firmness, too. Everything in this land grows to such humongous proportions — the natives, the animals, and even the fruit... not that I am complaining, of course. |Just get a whiff of this aroma. How exquisite..." Kinu proves her point by raising the peach's firm skin to her nose and taking a deep sniff, her five tails swishing excitedly behind her. "A nuanced scent belies an equally nuanced flavor. ] If it's any good, I'll see if I can't save the pit and do something useful with it. Three years for peaches, as the saying goes; I'm still going to grow that perfect peach someday, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." You're sure she will. As you watch, Kinu wipes off the sweet fruit on her clothes and tucks it away into its folds. Your eyes meet for a moment, and then your fox-daughter plants her fists on her hips and cocks her head to the side, ears twitching. "C'mon, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], I know that expectant look when I see it. You're waiting for something, aren't you? Perhaps for me to give in and start scarfing down this peach like my life depended on it?" We-ll... it would be a sight to see again once more... Kinu laughs and sends a dismissive wave your way. "Seriously now, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Maybe that's what you were hoping to bribe me into doing, huh? But no — my hands are filthy, especially under my nails, and I'll want to wash the fruit before eating, maybe chill it for a little in water. Not that I'm not grateful and appreciative for a gift and token of mindfulness, but I'm not going to put on a show for you." Haha. Well, it was worth a try. "I won't say that I'm not in a much better mood now, though. Anyways... thanks for all the fruit. Is there anything else you needed, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]?" |You take the juicy peach out from amongst your other possessions, and Kinu's eyes immediately dart over to take in the wholeness of its plump shape and lustrous skin. Your fox-daughter's ears swivel towards the sides of her head even as she squeezes her chin with fore and middle fingers, licking her lips. Yeah, there's no doubt you've gotten her attention now; little vulpine fangs peer out from between her lips as she bites them and draws a deep breath. "Oh my," Kinu says, clearly trying to suppress her excitement. "What a fine specimen of fruit you have there, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." Indeed, that's what you have there. A token of mindfulness from you to her; you do remember that she loved these as a kit, after all. "Hummm... you say that like it is no longer the case, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. I still do." Your fox-daughter graces you with a small, dainty smile. "Well then, if you are willing to give such fine treats as a gift, then I am as willing to receive it in the full spirit in which it was given." With that said, Kinu bows her head and holds both hands out in front of her, palms cupped and five tails swishing behind her. It's a little awkward as to how formal this is for but such a small gift, but knowing your fox-daughter she's the kind to pay miniscule attention to the small stuff in preparation for the big stuff. Well then — you drop the peach into Kinu's cupped hands and watch as she straightens herself, examining the fine fruit. "[rand |Such color, such luster. But the taste? Oh, we shall see. When she catches sight of you still looking at her, your fox-daughter rolls her eyes and broadens her smile. "Is something the matter, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]? rows.original: [kinu.isInari |As you step into the fields, it's not you who calls out to Kinu, but rather, your daughter's turn to come and greet you. Coming in from the [rand|rows of fresh vegetables|paddies|apiaries] and hitching up her skirts to come at you at a brisk walk, your fox-daughter raises an arm above her head to give you a full-bodied wave. "Oh, hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]! I was expecting you this morning!" She was expecting you, huh? "Yeah. I did a simple divination and it wasn't hard to see that in my future like a big old rock, so I went ahead and made preparations. And guess what, you did turn up after all!" You smile. Preparations, huh. What kind of preparations did she have in mind? "Well, you went to all the trouble of giving me a gift the last time we met, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I can't very well keep on receiving without giving anything back, can I? That would be violating divine law, accruing bad karma or some of all that other stuff Mai keeps on talking about. Anyways! Most importantly, I'd feel bad if I just kept on taking things from you, so I've got to repay you somehow." It's not strictly necessary — Kinu folds her arms under her bosom and pouts. "I insist, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." [party.has kiyoko |"There's that stubbornness, all right," Kiyoko says with a small chuckle, laced with sadness and regret. "I wonder whose side of the family she got it from." ] Well, if she insists so strongly, you guess you don't have any way of wriggling out of this one. What's she got in mind for you? |Entering Kinu's room, you're immediately confronted with your fox-daughter's beaming visage as she gives you a small bow and several swishes of her lovely, sleek tails. She's clearly been waiting for you, her chambers even more immaculate and spotless than they usually are. Given how her surroundings are always in perfect order, that's no mean feat, but Kiyoko really did put the effort into raising her well in your unfortunate absence. "Good morning, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. It is a pleasure to be receiving you." Ah... there's no need to stand on ceremony. Please. Did she know you were coming? "I made a small divination the other day. For good or for ill, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], you are not a difficult person to keep track of. You make yourself known, subconsciously or otherwise. Either way, yes, I knew you were coming, and I have prepared a gift accordingly." A gift? Why, that's very kind of her. "It is but a reciprocal token of appreciation for the favor which you showed me the other day. Divine law demands that kindness be repaid in full, [pc.ra kitsune|as you should well know by now as one of us|yes]. I am not about to shirk my obligations..." It was just some fruit... "Coming from you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], it is not just some fruit. And there is the matter of the time spent in the gifting of that fruit, and the meaning behind it..." [party.has kiyoko |Your fox-wife smiles sweetly and elbows you in the side. "Just accept the gift gracefully, beloved. Good gift-giving is a part of who we are." Okay, okay... |Well, when she puts it that way, you don't really have any kind of choice, do you? Ahaha. ] "All right, then. Please give me a moment." ]
rows.translation: [kinu.isInari |当你走进那些田野时，呼唤“小娟”的并不是你，而是你的女儿该过来迎接你啦。她从[rand|一排排新鲜的蔬菜|稻田|养蜂场]间走来，撩起裙摆，快步朝你走来，而你的那位狐妖女儿则将手臂举过头顶，向你热情地挥手致意。 哦，嘿， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]我本来今天早上就等着你来的呢！ 她是在等你吧？ 没错。我做了一个简单的占卜，结果很容易就看出，在我的未来中，你会像一块巨大的石头一样存在，所以我就开始做准备了。你猜怎么着，你最终还是出现了！ 你笑了。准备工作啊……她究竟准备了些什么呢？ 嗯，上次我们见面时，你还特意费心送了我一份礼物[pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]我总不能一直接受而不做出任何回报吧？那样就违背了天理，会积累恶业，或者招来舞经常提到的那些负面后果。总之，最重要的是，如果我一直从你这里获取东西而不给予任何回报，我会感到内疚的，所以我必须想办法来回报你。 这其实并不是绝对必要的—— 小娟将双臂交叉在胸前，撅起了嘴。我坚持要求， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]。" [party.has kiyoko |就是这种固执劲儿，没错。清子带着一丝苦笑说道，那笑声中蕴含着悲伤与懊悔。我想知道她是从家族的哪一方继承了这个东西。 ] 好吧，如果她坚持得这么坚决，那你也没办法逃避这个决定了。她到底有什么打算呢？ |一走进小娟的房间，你立刻就会被你那狐妖女儿灿烂的笑容所吸引——她轻轻向你鞠了一躬，同时她那美丽而柔顺的尾巴也摆动了几下。显然，她一直在等待你的到来，她的房间也比平时更加整洁干净。考虑到她的周围环境总是保持着完美的秩序，这确实是一件不简单的事……不过，在你不幸缺席的这段时间里，清子确实付出了很多努力，把女儿抚养得非常好。 早上好， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]能够接待您，我们感到非常荣幸。 啊……没必要这么拘谨。请坐吧。她知道你要来吗？ 前几天我做了一个小占卜。无论结果是好是坏， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]你其实并不是一个难以被跟踪的人。无论是有意还是无意，你总会让自己被人注意到。无论如何，没错，我早就知道你会来，所以我也准备了一份礼物作为迎接你的礼物。 礼物？哎呀，她真是太好了。 这只不过是作为对您前几天所给予我的帮助的一种回报罢了。神圣的法则要求，善意必须得到充分的回报。 [pc.ra kitsune|作为我们中的一员，你现在应该已经很清楚这一点了。|是的]我绝不会逃避自己的责任…… 只不过是一些水果而已…… 从你口中说出来， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]并不是这样。只是一些水果。还有在赠送这些水果所花费的时间，以及其中所蕴含的意义…… [party.has kiyoko |你的狐狸妻子甜笑着，用肘子轻轻碰了碰你的侧身。亲爱的，只需优雅地接受这份礼物吧。懂得如何赠送礼物，正是我们性格中的一部分。 好吧，好吧…… |嗯，既然她这么说了，那你其实也没什么选择吧？哈哈。 ] 好吧，那请给我一点时间。 ]

rows.original: "Well, I've got it keeping warm over a charcoal fire, so if you don't mind following me..." Time to see what your fox-daughter is playing at, then. Trailing Kinu all the way back into the den, you stop by her chambers, where she ushers you inside. She pulls out cushions for [party.hasCompanions|everyone|you] at the low table, clearly intending for you to make yourself comfortable. "Give me a moment, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I'll just get everything from the kitchens." [party.has kiyoko |Somehow, this feels familiar... "Of course," your fox-wife replies dryly. "She learned from the best, after all." Now, what's that supposed to mean? A small smile. "When they are young, children watch their parents a lot more than they're given credit for, and learn so much." ] It doesn't take long for Kinu to return, a large tray of covered dishes in her hands. She sets that down on the table, then returns with another, and another, until there's a veritable spread in front of you, filling the entirety of the table's surface. Steam gently rises from under the covers into the cool morning air, bringing with it a slightly salty and appetising scent. [party.comp viv cait brint brienne atugia arona etheryn berwyn |Viv sits quietly but awkwardly at the table. "I'm... Hmm... I don't know that I've ever had a meal quite like this one," she finally says. "I'm an only child, and we didn't exactly have a wealth of visitors growing up. Or particularly large meals, for that matter. So I'm not sure I know all the rules of eating such a meal." |Cait looks around at the massed dishes jostling for space on the table. "You sure it's okay for me to join you guys? This looks like some quality family time for you all. Wouldn't want to be intruding..." |Brint looks up and down at the spread. Even if everything else around your bovine friend is uncomfortably small for him, at least the food looks like it'd make a decent meal for a minotaur. Even so, he frowns and clears his throat, trying to be discreet but not quite succeeding. "You think I should be here, [pc.name]? I'd feel kinda awkward too if someone just sat down at the table with me and my mom and all." |Brienne looks up and down at the spread. Even if everything else around your bovine friend is uncomfortably small for him, at least the food looks like it'd make a decent meal for a minotaur. Even so, she frowns and clears her throat, trying to be discreet but not quite succeeding. "You think I should be here, [pc.name]? I'd feel kinda awkward too if someone just sat down at the table with me and my mom and all." |"You... you don't mind if I stay here, do you?" Atugia asks, looking a little uncomfortable. "It's been a while since I got to sit down and eat with Carmen and Severine and all. Of course, they don't eat much to begin with, but there's something about sitting around a table with other people, you know?" |Arona shifts about on her cushion, clearly uncomfortable with the whole idea and trying to decide if she should at least try to respect appearances or just throw propriety to the winds in true orcish sense. "Look here. I get that this is your family and all, but I'm hungry as fuck right now. You don't mind if I stay, right?" |Ryn looks at the foreign spread laid out in front of her and sighs. "When my [pc.mf|father|mother] was still alive, Alissa loved having all kinds of feasts. Even when she became queen after my dad died as king dowager, she tried to hold them as much as she could. I... I was allowed to attend, after a fashion, but I never quite felt at home in the drunken gorging and winterstem smoke that would fill the hall. [pc.name]... you don't mind if I stay, do you?" |Berwyn looks around the spread on the table, taking off his hat and holding it in both hands. "This reminds me of before when I went off to be with Matiha... with [pc.mf|Dad|Mom] and Mom and everyone else. I... kinda feel out of place, sitting in on your family time like this." |"Hope there's enough, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. It's a bit shameful, but I realized I don't really know what you like, so I made a bit of everything with all kinds of flavors. There should be something in there that should be to your tastes... which means there isn't a lot of any one thing. Maybe I should have made more..." ] No, no. If nothing else, you'll need help finishing everything that's laid out here. It's a feast, no less. "I grew everything that went into these dishes," Kinu says quietly as she uncovers the dishes one by one. "Wrought them from the earth with my own hands... well, except the fish and the ginger; that last one doesn't grow too well in these soils and I've yet to figure out a way to remedy that. But the point still stands." [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko half-parts her lips, poised to say something, then turns away and swivels her ears towards you. "I won't argue with you. Not right now, not in front of your [pc.mf|father|mother]. This is supposed to be for [pc.himHer]." Kinu turns away too, and the air between mother and daughter chills perceptibly. "For now." "For now." ] Unsurprisingly, Kinu's cooking leans heavily towards soups and salads, and there's plenty of steamed, fluffy rice out of what looks like a big wooden bucket. You sit and wait patiently as your fox-daughter serves [party.combatNames], one of the few rare times she ever acts so quiet and genteel. Some of the vegetables you recognize, others you know from having seen them in her fields, and others are considerably more alien to you, but all in all, it's a strange mixture of foreign cuisine prepared with Marches ingredients. Mostly Marches ingredients, anyway. That, and the salads are mostly pickled — your daughter really has a penchant for the things... How do they say it again? Thank you for the food? Kinu laughs. "[pc.ra kitsune |Well, since you're one of us now, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], I guess you've gotta give thanks to the Trickster before eating, eh?" At least, in this setting with your daughter [party.has kiyoko|and fox-wife ]at your side, you feel like you do. |You don't have to do this, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. It's not like you're from the Old Country or anything, so you don't need to give thanks to the Trickster before eating." Strictly speaking, perhaps not, but in this setting with your daughter [party.has kiyoko|and fox-wife ]at your side, you feel like you do. ] "Well, if you want to be observant, I'm not going to stop you. You just press your hands together like this... and say it after me... there. And with that, [party.has kiyoko|Mother, ][pc.mf|Dad|Mom], let's eat." With that, [party.isJustPC|the two|all] of you quietly apply yourselves to the offering Kinu's made in return for your gift. It's not gourmet, far from it — it's the kind of meal a working girl like her would sit down to at the end of a day, intended to fill the belly and regain one's strength for the rest of the day. The sourness and salt only serve to stimulate the appetite and thirst, and soon enough Kinu's ladling out extra servings of mushroom egg broth for you all. [party.comp viv cait brint brienne atugia arona etheryn berwyn |Viviane eats silently, though she constant looks around as if expecting some critique or stray remarks. |"This makes me nostalgic," Cait says as she fiddles with her chopsticks. "Hey, [pc.name]... when this is all over and we've gotten Calla back, want to head back to Jassira with me for a little bit? I'll show you the sights, introduce you to the people back at the Temple. We'll have some hot coffee together, and laugh off the past." |"Not as good as my mother's cooking," Brint says between shoveling copious quantities of rice into his mouth, "but still pretty damn good. Hey, girl... get to the point where your kids are saying the same thing that I am right now, defending their mom's cooking in front of other folks, okay? Make your [pc.mf|dad|mom] proud." |"Not as good as my mother's cooking," Brienne says between shoveling copious quantities of rice into her mouth, "but still pretty damn good. Hey, girl... get to the point where your kids are saying the same thing that I am right now, defending their mom's cooking in front of other folks, okay? Make your [pc.mf|dad|mom] proud." |"Gods," Atugia says glumly, poking at her pickles between mouthfuls of rice. "Severine and I would take turns cookin' for Carmen. Never asked if she needed to eat in that sense any more, but... we did it anyway, and she ate it. I... I wonder how the two of them are doing without me around. Maybe we could go up and check before we head off? It isn't too far away." |"Lumia's tits, not having any drink blows." Arona's long since given up fiddling with the lacquered chopsticks and is eating with her hands where possible, in true orc fashion of ignoring everyone else's etiquette. "But I guess it's only expected, isn't it, girl? You're going to be someone to your people like Hretha's to my folk, right? My sister doesn't touch the drink that much, either. Maybe I should get a couple tankards of mead down her throat when I next pop by the camp. Wouldn't that be a treat!" |Ryn has been silent throughout the whole meal, eyes turned downward towards her food. She doesn't say anything, but gives Kinu a grateful nod when the latter moves to refill her soup bowl. There's a lot going up in Ryn's head, you'd imagine, and she'll probably talk about it when the time's right. No point trying to force it out of her now. |Berwyn's been fiddling with his chopsticks all the while, trying to figure out how he's supposed to get them to work. It's kind of cute watching him trying to get the hang of the foreign utensils, but at long last he stops and picks up the spoon instead. "You don't mind if I could have some more soup, do you? This stuff is pretty nice. Never quite tasted anything like it before. You fox-people are weird, but you make good food." "But of course." Kinu moves to refill his soup bowl. "There you go." |"There you go, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]," Kinu says, beaming. "Have a bit more — this is meant to stimulate the appetite, so I'm sure you'll have plenty of room for the rest." Far for it being you to deny anything your beloved fox-daughter has prepared... ] One by one, the dishes are emptied. [party.isJustPC |It's a bit of a challenge with just the two of you, even if Kinu can really pack it away and the sour and salt really help bring out the appetite. On her own, your daughter's finished two bowls of rice and is halfway through her third, not to mention the other dishes... guess she served up what she liked, eh? Like mother, like daughter... |Even with [party.compNames] helping, there's a lot of food to get through, and you wonder if Kinu saw in her divination that you'd be bringing company as well. Didn't stop her from making too much, but you guess she wanted to prove a point, didn't she? ] "I'm full," your fox-daughter declares after a bit. And so are you. Aah, that wasn't bad. Not bad in the least; Kinu has turned out to be quite the accomplished cook. Whoever her future husband is, the lucky boy sure isn't going to go hungry, not with a wife who's as good a source of food as your darling fox-princess is. [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko chuckles thinly. "A source of food. Even if it's a little blunt... like mother, like daughter, one supposes." ] The words have far more of an effect on Kinu than you'd expected — the blush begins on the bridge of her nose, quickly claims her cheeks, then sinks down her neck all the way into the collar of her kimono. Ah, the very distinctive blush of her mother's bloodline — with how intense it is, even the insides of Kinu's ears must be red and steaming hot by now. Shifting her eyes from side to side, your fox-daughter starts tapping her index fingers together, clearly not realizing what she's doing, much in the same way her mother unconsciously toys with her hair when she's flustered. "I... uh..." [party.has kiyoko |While Kinu is distracted, Kiyoko leans over to you and whispers into your ear. "You do know that a man has been here in our daughter's chambers, right?" Wait, what? "I can scent it, but there are other tell-tale signs. Well, she is so independent and resolute these days; added to the fact that she is left to her devices so often, I'm honestly not surprised. Hmph. Our girl probably seduced him to begin with, that's my guess." She... she seems to care less than you thought she would... "Our daughter just wants to get married and leave; just as children catch onto more than their parents imagine, the reverse also applies. Please, I know more than she gives me credit for as her mother. I was young once, and had many sisters as well." ... "She is my heir, you know. If she continues like this, there's little doubt that she's going to wind up pregnant sooner or later. Maybe that's her plan." ... ] You turn to Kinu and reach over to pat her on the head. Your fox-daughter squeaks, takes a deep breath, and forces herself to calm down, rubbing her brow with her knuckles. "Well, I... I guess that's it, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I hope you liked the meal — there's so much I have to thank you for.[party.has kiyoko| And Mother too, of course.] Don't worry about cleaning up — I'll handle those and the leftovers." So much in return for such a small gift... now you're feeling kind of awkward and sheepish. "It's okay, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I mean —" Kinu turns away from [party.has kiyoko|her mother|you] and does that finger twiddling thing again. "I'm glad that I was born, okay? Even if it hasn't been a perfect life so far, I'm really glad it still happened. So this isn't just thanks for a wild melon or a peach or something, this is thanks for everything you've done for me since I was a kit. I..." Okay, you get the point. Rising from your seat a little unsteadily, you cross over to your fox-daughter and give her a pat on the head, as the situation demands. Kinu looks like she's going to protest for a moment, then melts under your touch as you push your fingers more insistently under her headcloth and into her hair. "Thanks, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]," she says at last. "I needed that." You're going to be heading out again, so she's got to watch the den and keep things in order while you[party.has kiyoko| and her mother are|'re] out, okay? "Got it. Yeah, stay safe out there, okay?" Mm-hm. [party.has kiyoko |Taking your fox-wife's hand in your own, you step out of your daughter's chambers together, the clacking of dishes being gathered behind you. Now, is she still so mad at Kinu? "It doesn't change the root of our disagreements, you know." That's true, but is she still so mad at her daughter? "...I may be inclined to be a little more lenient for a while now." [kiyoko.pregStage 2 |Kiyoko pats her big pregnant belly. "Feeding both me and her little sibling was a conscientious act, and I will acknowledge that. I am content with our daughter's conduct for the time being." |Kiyoko tries a small smile. "If nothing else, she is mindful of her responsibilities to others — when she chooses to acknowledge them." ] You smile and pet your fox-wife between her ears. That's about as much as you can hope for, you suppose. |You will. And while you're out... hopefully she can get along better with her mother so you don't have to worry about the both of them while you're slaying demons and saving the world. Kinu rolls her eyes and makes an exasperated noise. "You just have to ask for the one thing which I can't honestly promise you, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Yes, you know full well that it's hard, which is exactly why you're asking her for it rather than expecting it of her as a matter of course. "Okay, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], I'll try. I'll make no promises, but I'll try." You smile and give your fox-daughter another pet between the ears for addition reinforcement. There, there. All right, you'll have to be off now, or you'll never get going... ]
rows.translation: 嗯，我把它放在炭火上保暖着，所以如果你不介意的话，可以跟我来…… 那么，是时候看看你那个狐妖女儿在搞什么名堂了。你跟着小娟一路回到了她的巢穴，然后来到了她的房间，她邀请你进去。她拿出了一些垫子[party.hasCompanions|每个人|你]在那张较低的桌子旁，显然是想让你感到舒适自在。 稍等片刻， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]我只需要把厨房里的所有东西都拿过来就行了。 [party.has kiyoko |不知为何，这种感觉似乎很熟悉…… 当然。你的狐狸妻子冷淡地回应道。毕竟，她是向最优秀的人学习的。 现在，这到底是什么意思呢？ 一个淡淡的微笑。在年幼的时候，孩子们实际上会比人们通常认为的那样更多地观察自己的父母，并从中学习到很多东西。 ]
