"I would be angrier about our daughter's flawed recollection if the circumstances weren't so extenuating. As things stand, I can forgive her a little. Still, she needs to be better not just as my heir, but as who she is to the people around her. I hope we won't be wasting more time when we come around to hear this story again." ] ]
rows.translation: ……然后我就[kinu.isInari |开始哭泣 |哭了 ]嗯，不对，等一下。那显然不可能发生，因为上次你在仓库那里查看情况时，小花还活得好好的啊。而且，在那个窝点里，也没有因为他们的‘八卦中心’、也是整个地方最有魅力的成员之一突然去世而引起什么大骚动。肯定是她哪里弄错了。 [kinu.isInari |哎呀，看来我在讲述过程中有点太投入了[kinu.Dad]小娟挠了挠头，露出有些尴尬的笑容，然后吐了吐舌头对你说：‘我想我可能不小心把一些细节夸大了一点……’” 就像琥珀为了那位Otomo小姐英勇地献出了自己的生命一样。 “对，就是那个。你知道的，当我情绪激动的时候，就会这样[kinu.Dad]就好像我平时会把所有的情绪和能量都积攒起来，等到需要的时候再一次性释放出来。偶尔能够宣泄一下确实感觉很好，但有时候也会因此而难以保持清醒的头脑。” “或者说，难以做出准确的回忆。” “听着[kinu.Dad]我并没有撒谎……” 你并没有说她在撒谎；你肯定知道，她刚才只是有点搞糊涂而已。你那个可爱的女儿说每一句话、做每一件事，都是为了让你能为她感到骄傲。告诉她吧——为什么她就不能冷静下来，好好整理一下自己的思绪呢？在田里干活的时候慢慢想清楚这些问题，等她把所有的想法都理顺了，你再去找她，好吗？ “哎呀，你其实完全知道我本来打算做什么的。你笑了。能够被他人如此轻易地看透，其实也是一件好事。尽管你在她成长的过程中错过了那么多岁月，但你依然会不由自主地觉得，自己仿佛与这个女儿相识已久；而她能够让人产生这样的感觉，也同样是一件好事。尽管小娟天生性格内向，但只要她愿意，其实也是可以变得容易接近的。她或许没有琥珀那种充满活力与魅力的性格，但确实没有人能够完全模仿那只小金狐特有的魅力。 好的， [kinu.Dad]你把意思都表达清楚了。虽然还有许多工作需要完成，但这些事情不会自动解决。明天像你说的那样来找我吧，好吗？” 说完，你的女儿从墙上跳下来，开始沿着小路朝田野的方向走去，她的尾巴在身后摇来摇去。不知道她是否真的像自己表现出来的那样，对这一切毫不在意……但如果她不刻意表现出坚强的样子，她也就不会是小娟了。好吧，明天你再问一次吧。 [party.has kiyoko |这就是我们的女儿，”清子双臂交叉着低声说道，“连这么重要的故事都记不住，想做什么就做什么，从不考虑后果。如果她不是总是这么任性、不负责任的话，我或许还能理解她。 ] |那个……嗯，你说得对。 [kinu.Dad]我肯定在讲述这个故事的过程中哪里出错了。没错，让小白来讲这个故事会更好。[silly |-san ]并没有在那个介于两个世界之间的地方消亡。在古老国度，人们将这种结局称为‘成为水之子’，对于那些英年早逝的人来说，这其实并不是最糟糕的命运。” 一想到小白可能并不在那个储藏室里，这个想法就根本无法在你的脑海中形成。她肯定在那里，一定在那里。但要是纪久刚才告诉你的那个故事真的发生了呢？到时候还会有人在那里吗？甚至，还会存在那个储藏室吗？是如果没有琥珀在，这个仓库还能继续存在吗？ 小娟闭上眼睛，低下头，默默地调整自己的情绪，然后终于松了一口气。“对于我在讲述事情时出现的这个错误，我真的很抱歉，这样的行为确实非常不妥当。也许是吧，但你可以看到，这些经历对她造成了很大的影响。 “与其说这是我自己的痛苦，不如说是因为别人代替我承受了那些痛苦。每个人都愿意为我牺牲自己的生命，但仅仅是想到要向别人提出这样的要求，我就感到内疚。正因为如此，当时机成熟时，她一定会成为一名出色的领导者。 “啊， [kinu.Dad]请不要说这种话……”她清了清嗓子，努力让自己镇定下来，表现得体一些。“不管怎样，我的疏忽并不是借口。在再次尝试之前，我应该先整理好自己的思路和回忆，这样才能把它们有条理、简洁明了地表达出来。那么，你明天就能见到她了。 “确实如此。虽然我遭遇了一些变故，但这并不会让我忘记自己的职责，我现在必须离开了。时间已经不多了——请原谅我的失礼。说完这些，你的女儿便从座位上站起来，找了个借口离开了房间。你只好继续喝着那杯已经凉下来的茶，同时不禁摇头，思考着金奈这个年轻女孩如今已经变成了一个多么让人难以理解的人啊。 [party.has kiyoko | 那么，你的狐狸妻子对此事是怎么看的呢？ “如果情况不是如此特殊，我会对我们女儿这种错误的记忆更加生气。不过目前来看，我还是可以稍微原谅她。不过，她不仅作为我的继承人，更应该以一个正常人的身份，对待周围的人。我希望下次再听到这个故事时，我们不会再浪费时间了。 ] ]
rows.raw: " "...And then I [kinu.isInari |started to cry |wept ]." Yeah no, hang on a moment. That clearly didn't happen, because last time you checked in at the storehouse Kohaku was very much alive and well. Neither has there been any huge outcry at the den over the untimely passing of its gossip central and one of the, if not the most charismatic member in the entire place. Surely she's made a mistake somewhere. [kinu.isInari |"Oops. I think I got a little too carried away in the telling, [kinu.Dad]." Kinu scratches her head and gives you a sheepish smile before sticking her tongue out at you. "Think I might've accidentally embellished a few details..." Like Kohaku valiantly giving her life for the young lady Otomo. "Yeah, that. You know how it is when I get emotional, [kinu.Dad] — it's like I save up all my stuff normally just so I can let it all out in one big burst when it's called for. It's nice to let loose every now and then, but it can get hard to think straight as well." That, or make accurate recollections. "Look, [kinu.Dad], I wasn't lying..." You didn't say she was; you've no doubt that she just got confused for a little bit back there. For everything that your fluffy daughter says and does, she just wants you to be proud of her. Tell her what — why doesn't she calm down a bit and get her head sorted out? Work it off in the fields, and by the time she's got all her thoughts in a row you'll come ask her again, okay? "Sheesh, you know exactly what I was going to do..." You laugh. It's not a bad thing to be predictable that way. Despite having missed out on so many years of her life growing up, you still can't help but feel like you've known your daughter forever; it's not a bad thing that she's able to make people feel that way. Despite Kinu's taciturn base nature, she sure can be approachable if she puts her mind to it. She'll never have Kohaku's brand of energy and charm, but no one can really mimic the little golden fox's brand of charisma. "Right, [kinu.Dad], you've made your point. There's still work to be done, and it's not doing itself. Catch me tomorrow like you said, okay?" With that, your daughter swings herself off the wall and starts pacing down the path back to the fields, her tails swaying behind her. Wonder if she's really as unperturbed by the whole experience as she's trying to present herself as being... but she wouldn't be Kinu if she didn't put on a strong front. All right, you'll ask again tomorrow. [party.has kiyoko |"That's our daughter for you," Kiyoko mutters, arms folded. "Misremembers such an important tale, and just swings off without so much as a second thought. I'd be more understanding if she weren't just so feckless all the time." ] |"That is... well, you are correct, [kinu.Dad]. I must have made a mistake somewhere in the telling of the tale. Yes, it is better that Kohaku[silly |-san ] did not perish in that place between worlds. Becoming what is called in the Old Country a child of the water is not the worst of fates that can befall those who suffer an untimely death." The mere thought of Kohaku not being there in the storehouse is something that simply fails to register in your mind. Of course she's there. She has to be. But what if the story Kinu just told you had really come to pass? Who would be there, would it even be the storehouse any longer without Kohaku there? Kinu closes her eyes and bows her head, quietly steeling herself before letting out the breath she's been holding. "I am sorry for this mistake in recounting my tale, it is most improper." It might be, but you can see that events have taken their toll on her. "It is not so much my own suffering, but that which others have experienced in my stead. Everyone is more than willing to throw their lives away for me, yet just thinking of asking this of anyone makes me feel guilty." And that's why she'll be a great leader when the time comes. "Ah, [kinu.Dad]. Please do not say such things..." clearing her throat, your fluffy daughter pulls herself together and comports herself. "Either way, my negligence is not an excuse. Before I try again, I should sort out my thoughts and recollections before endeavoring to present them in a coherent and concise fashion." You'll see her tomorrow, then. "Indeed. What has happened to me does not divest me of my duties, and I must depart now. The day is not getting any longer — if you will excuse me, please." With that, your daughter rises from her seat and excuses herself, departing from the room. You're left to finish the cooling tea, and shake your head at the enigma that Kinu has become as a young woman. [party.has kiyoko | Well, what does your fox-wife make of all this? "I would be angrier about our daughter's flawed recollection if the circumstances weren't so extenuating. As things stand, I can forgive her a little. Still, she needs to be better not just as my heir, but as who she is to the people around her. I hope we won't be wasting more time when we come around to hear this story again." ] ] "

rows.original: The last of the otherworldly assassins falls to [kinu.kinuWeapon |a well-timed thrust from your naginata |a well-placed arrow from your hankyu ], crumpling into a heap upon the misty ground of the Ways Between. What happens to people when they die in this place? You don't know, but you have no intention of finding out firsthand. Two of Kohaku's wagon guards have already fallen along with your assailants; you're not sure if they're dead or just out of the fight. Spinning around, you steel yourself for the next opponent to come at you, but those lanky monsters who are still standing are backing off slowly, realizing that they're in over their heads trying to attack you. Still, they have their weapons out, watching you for your next move. "A-are you all right, nojya?" You can barely catch your breath at this point, but are able to give Kohaku a nod as you bite back the pain from your cuts and scrapes. It's distracting, but not enough to be overwhelmingly so... yet. "We must retreat." "Youhei and — " "Load them onto the wagon, but we must retreat before they regroup! Dump the cargo, it'll make us lighter!" Kohaku looks deeply conflicted at that, but the natural kitsune reverence for authority wins out and she nods. While you keep guard and hold your assailants at bay, Kohaku and the two remaining bodyguards pull out the wagon bed, dumping the sacks and boxes of all the goods she'd gathered from [kinu.isInari |Willowpast |across the ocean ] and loading their downed fellows onto the vehicle. Seeing that you're trying to escape, several of your assailants make tentative forays against you and test your defenses, but you manage to hold out with a few [kinu.kinuWeapon |counters |warning arrows ], sending them back once more. "Hurry!" Before you can make your getaway, though, more shapes materialize into the Ways Between, joining the assassins already present, and [kinu.isInari |a burning rage and glee alike grip your heart. So what if they've got you surrounded? That just means you can get at more of them at once. |cold terror and determination alike grip your heart. More of them? How many are there? How did they get here so quickly without using a waystone? ] And then a figure steps to the fore, one that you immediately recognise. [kinu.isInari |"...You!" Fire flows in your veins, and it's all you can do to hold yourself back from lashing out |"...You." You thin your lips, and your fingers unconsciously tighten about your [kinu.weapon] ]. But rationality prevails: you need to keep him talking, to buy more time for an opportunity to arise so that Kohaku and her entourage can make a break for it. "I've been waiting for you, demoness." Time and space are relative in the Ways Between, but even you weren't expecting Raphael to be dangerously close in no more than a few steps, his minions parting around him like a school of fish to give him space. Even they don't want to be close to him. But of course, it all makes sense now. "[kinu.isInari |So, you're the one responsible for what's been happening to the gates and waystone idols. |It would be reasonable to conclude that you are responsible for what has been happening to travel in this place, then. ]" He steps back, eyebrows raised, feigning shock. "Oh dear, no. You truly wound me, demoness, to think that I would do such a thing. In fact, I had to specially request to be included here in this endeavour just to have the chance to be able to see you again." ...They knew you would be here! Ahead of time, too! How? "If there's anything your farce of a native culture knows, demoness, it's shame. The shame that comes with failure... night by night, whenever I felt the pain of my own conscience at not being able to drive you monsters out from where you don't belong, I thought of your face. Poetic, isn't it?" "Disgusting." "For you? I can be anything you want, even a villain. I'll admit that the 'rogue' part of the Russet Rogue does have its own appeal... but to me, you're just a hypocrite. It's exactly as I told you the last time — if you can't realize your own hypocrisy, that simply makes you a fool." "[kinu.isInari |What do I care about anything you think or say? You're trying to hurt the people I care about, which makes you an enemy. That's all I need to know! |But I understand you and your point of view well enough. That someone acts contrary to your desires does not necessarily mean they do not understand you, merely that they disagree. Or are you the sort who imagines that your cause is so right and just that once someone understands your intentions they will certainly fall in line behind you? ]" Raphael scoffs. "Look at all the blood you've shed without a second thought. This is all thanks to you — such a beautiful and terrible representation of my pain and sadness at what your kind has done to mine, but every people you come into contact with. I want you to know the same thing, demoness — being tormented night after night for your failures to shield those whom you love, and being forced to greet every morning without being able to sleep." Keep him talking, appeal to his vanity. Buy some more time for Kohaku to find an opening. "[kinu.isInari |That's the worst... you're the one who ambushed me first. You tried to burn me and everyone else in our homes in the middle of the night — how dare you make yourself out to be some kind of victim in all this! |Cease making yourself to be some kind of victim in all this — you and yours tried to board us in our homes and burn us alive in the middle of the night! I could not care less if you failed, or that you feel remiss over that failure! ]" Raphael just grins and shrugs — you get the feeling he's enjoying this way more than a madman like him as any right to be. "I am the aggressor? I know something of what your native country is like, and how your kind rules. You are here in a land where you don't belong, slowly but surely turning everything that is ours into everything that is yours; but no doubt as many travelers up in the woodlands of the Marches will say, that such chance encounters with beautiful fox-people who take their life energy is perfectly fine, because they are duly compensated. I am to accept vampiric monsters just because they give back, that this so-called 'equivalent exchange' is supposed to make it all right. "You will excuse me then, if I find this rationalisation as completely and utterly disgusting as you claim to find me, and the sentiment is shared by all those who have thrown their lot in with Lord Taoth — I will not accept the rule of vampiric demons who have stolen the old treasures and secrets of Belhar to parade around as their own, who are stealing our land, and no doubt in the end drop the pretense and steal our dignity as you have stolen that of all the other peoples of your homeland. "So understand this, demoness; I will murder every last one of you so that my children don't have to. But as for you and you only, I will gouge out your eyes, cut off your ears, and break every last one of your fingers — then, just perhaps, you might understand what the sting of failure feels like." ...This man is insane. But you already knew that, didn't you? Slowly, you [kinu.kinuWeapon |lower the blade of your naginata at him, and memories of mother's forms flit through your mind |nock an arrow against the bowstring and prepare to draw ]; blood rushes in your veins and you can feel your heart pound in your chest. Yes, there's the opening Kohaku needs. The time for talking is over, then. "Do it if you can." Kohaku looks around. "[kinu.isInari |Kinu |Young Lady ], I think I will — " "Run. You are no match for him." She looks conflicted at this. "But — " "By all the power invested in me and my station, I order you to run!" There's no time to see if she obeys — Raphael is already upon you, faster than what you remember him being the first time you met. You barely have enough time to [kinu.kinuWeapon |turn aside his thrust with your naginata |sidestep his thrust ] as he lunges, a fanatical gleam in his eye. "Pff. I won't be so trite as to say I enjoy a woman with spirit, but you have some guts, I'll give you that," he says, chuckling. "You're a vixen made to be savoured, it's true — you just keep on fighting even though you know the outcome never is in doubt, and in a way I can respect that. Our first time was such a beautiful thing; I was having too much fun before we were rudely interrupted, but here and now no one will come to save you, girl. It just so happens that your opponent is indeed none other than I... and faced with such unfair odds, this is the perfect opportunity to show you what losing is like against such opposition. "Now, let's dance!" There's nothing left but to meet this madman in battle; your only hope is to stall him long enough for Kohaku to escape.
rows.translation: 最后一名来自异世界的刺客也倒下了。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |当你使用长刀发起一次恰到好处的攻击时…… |你手中长弓射出的一支精准无误的箭矢 ]在那些迷雾笼罩的道路旁，它们纷纷瘫软在地，化作了一堆堆的残骸。当人们在这个地方死去，会发生什么呢？你并不知道，而且也无意去亲自探求答案。琥珀的两个马车护卫已经和你那些袭击者一起倒下了；你也不确定他们是死了，还是只是暂时脱离了战斗。你迅速转身，准备迎接下一个来袭的对手，但那些仍然站立着的瘦高怪物却正在慢慢后退，他们意识到自己根本无力攻击你。不过，他们依然举着武器，密切注视着你的下一步行动。 你……你没事吧，诺雅？” 此时你已经几乎喘不过气来了，但还是勉强点了点头，同时强忍着身上的伤口带来的疼痛。这些疼痛确实让人分心，但还不至于让人无法继续行动…… 然而。 “我们必须撤退。” “幽黑和——” “把他们带上马车，但我们必须在他们重新集结之前撤退！把货物扔掉，这样我们会轻一些！” 听到这里，琥珀狐显得非常矛盾，但作为一只狐妖，她天生就尊重权威，最终还是点了点头。在你负责警戒、牵制袭击者的同时，琥珀和剩下的两名保镖把马车车厢拉了出来，把琥珀之前收集来的所有货物——那些装在袋子里的物品和箱子——都倒了出来。 [kinu.isInari |柳林镇 |横跨大洋 ]他们将倒下的同伴搬上了车辆。看到你试图逃跑，几名袭击者开始试探性地向你发起攻击，测试你的防御能力，但你成功抵挡住了他们的进攻。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |计数器 |警告标志 ]把它们再次送了回去。 “快！” 然而，在你来得及逃跑之前，更多的身影出现在那些通道中，加入了已经在那里的刺客们[kinu.isInari |一种炽热的愤怒与兴奋同时涌上你的心头。就算他们把你包围了又怎样？这说明你可以一次性对付更多的人。 |冰冷的恐惧与坚定的决心同时攫住了你的心。还有更多吗？它们到底有多少？它们又是如何在不使用任何传送石的情况下如此迅速地到达这里的？ ] 然后，有一个人物走了出来，一个你立刻就能认出来的角色。 [kinu.isInari |……就是你！”火焰在你的血管中奔腾，你只能竭力克制自己，才不会冲上去攻击对方。 |……你。”你紧抿着嘴唇，手指不自觉地攥紧了[kinu.weapon] ]但理性终究占了上风：你必须让他继续说话，这样才能争取更多时间，等待机会出现，让琥珀和她的同伴们有机会逃脱。 “我一直在等待你，恶魔女。” 在“异界之道”中，时间和空间都是相对的，但就连你也没想到拉斐尔会如此迅速地逼近——他只需几步就能来到你面前，而他的手下们则像一群鱼一样散开，为他让出道路。就连他们也不想靠近他。 不过现在想来，这一切也都说得通了。[kinu.isInari |所以，那些发生在大门和路标神像身上的事情，都是你造成的。 |那么，我们有理由认为，目前这个地方发生的种种问题都应该由你来负责。 ]他后退了几步，挑起眉毛，假装十分震惊：“哦，天哪，不会吧。你真的伤害到我了，恶魔女妖……竟然认为我会做出这种事来。事实上，我特意申请参加这次行动，就是为了有机会能再次见到你。他们早就知道你会来到这里！甚至提前就知道了！这是怎么做到的呢？” “如果你的这种所谓的‘本土文化’真的懂得什么的话，恶魔女，那就是羞耻——那种因失败而带来的羞耻。每晚，每当我在内心深处为无法将这些怪物赶出它们不该存在的地方而感到痛苦时，我就会想起你的脸。多富有诗意啊，不是吗？” “恶心。” “对你来说可能是这样吧？我可以变成你想要的任何角色，甚至是一个反派。我得承认，Russet Rogue这个角色中的‘叛逆’特质确实有一定的吸引力……但对我来说，你只是一个伪君子罢了。这正是我上次跟你说过的——如果你无法认识到自己的虚伪，那么你也就只是个傻瓜而已。[kinu.isInari |你以为我在乎你的想法或话吗？你试图伤害我在乎的人，因此你成了我的敌人。我只需要知道这一点就够了！ |但我非常理解你以及你的观点。有人的行为与你的期望相悖，并不一定意味着他们不理解你，只是他们持有不同的意见而已。还是说，你属于那种认为自己的立场是如此正确、如此正义，以至于一旦别人理解了你的意图，就一定会支持你的人呢？ ]拉斐尔冷笑道：“看看你究竟付出了多少鲜血，而且丝毫没有犹豫过。这一切都是因为你——你如此完美地诠释了我所承受的痛苦与悲伤，诠释了你的族群对我的族群，以及你们所遇到的每一个族群，所造成的伤害。恶魔女，我想让你也明白同样的道理：因为无法保护你所爱的人而夜夜备受折磨，每天清晨都在无法入睡的状态中迎接新的一天。 让他继续说话，迎合他的虚荣心。这样就能为小白争取更多时间来寻找机会。 "[kinu.isInari |这也太过分了……其实是你先埋伏了我的。你在半夜试图烧毁我以及我们家的所有人——这到底是怎么回事？敢在你看来，整件事中你完全是受害者啊！ |别再把自己当成这一切的受害者了——你们明明试图闯进我们的家中，还在半夜将我们活活烧死！你们是否失败了，或者是否为这种失败而感到内疚，我根本毫不在意！ ]拉斐尔只是咧嘴一笑，耸了耸肩——你能感觉到，他比任何一个疯狂之人都更享受这种局面。“我是挑衅者吗？我对你们的祖国有些了解，也知道你们这类人是如何统治的。你此刻身处一片不属于你的土地，慢慢地，但确实地，我们将属于我们的一切变成了属于你的东西；不过，毫无疑问，在边境地区的森林里，许多旅行者都会认为，与那些吸取他们生命能量的美丽狐人偶遇，其实是一件再好不过的事情，因为他们得到了应有的回报。我就因为吸血鬼怪物会做出回报，就认为这种所谓的“等价交换”能够使一切变得合理吗？ “那么，请原谅我吧。如果我认为这种辩解和你所说的那样令人作呕，而且所有那些支持托斯大人的人也都持有同样的看法，那我不是我们必须接受那些吸血鬼恶魔的统治——他们窃取了贝尔哈尔的古老珍宝与秘密，却将这些据为己有；他们正在侵占我们的土地，而毫无疑问，最终他们也会抛弃这些伪装，像他们曾经窃取过你们故乡上其他所有民族的尊严一样，窃取我们的尊严。 所以你要明白，女恶魔；我会把你们所有人全部杀死，这样我的孩子们就不用经历这些了。但只有你，我一定会挖出你的眼睛，割掉你的耳朵，折断你所有的手指——只有这样，你或许才能真正体会到失败所带来的痛苦。" …这个男人简直疯了。但你早就知道了，对吧？慢慢地，你[kinu.kinuWeapon |你将长刀的刀刃朝他挥去，此时母亲的动作影像瞬间在你的脑海中闪过。 |将箭搭在弓弦上，做好拉弓的准备。 ]血液在你的血管中奔涌，你能感受到自己的心脏在胸腔里剧烈跳动。没错，这就是琥珀所需要的契机。那么，现在谈话的时间已经结束了。 “如果可以的话，就去做吧。” 琥珀环顾四周，说道：[kinu.isInari |小娟 |年轻的女士 ]我想我会的——” “快跑。你根本不是他的对手。” 她显得很矛盾：“但是——” “以我以及我的职位所赋予我的所有权力，我命令你立刻逃跑！” 已经没有时间去看看她是否服从了——拉斐尔已经追了上来，他的速度比你们第一次见面时快多了。你几乎来不及[kinu.kinuWeapon |用你的长刀挡开他的攻击 |避开他的攻击 ]当他猛地冲过来的时候，他的眼中闪烁着狂热的光芒。 “哼，我可不会说喜欢有骨气的女人这种老套的话，但你的确很有勇气，这一点我得承认，”他笑着说，“你确实是个值得细细品味的‘狐妖’——即使你知道结果早已注定，你依然坚持战斗，从某种程度上来说，我挺佩服你的。我们的第一次相遇真是太美好了；在被人粗鲁地打断之前，我正享受着这段时光呢。但是现在，没有人能来救你啦，姑娘。事实上，你的对手正是我……面对如此不公平的竞争环境，现在正是向你们展示在如此强大的对手面前失败是什么感觉的绝佳机会。 “那么，让我们开始战斗吧！” 现在，除了与这个疯子决一死战，别无选择；你们唯一的希望就是拖住他足够长的时间，让小白有机会逃脱。。
rows.raw: ' The last of the otherworldly assassins falls to [kinu.kinuWeapon |a well-timed thrust from your naginata |a well-placed arrow from your hankyu ], crumpling into a heap upon the misty ground of the Ways Between. What happens to people when they die in this place? You don't know, but you have no intention of finding out firsthand. Two of Kohaku's wagon guards have already fallen along with your assailants; you're not sure if they're dead or just out of the fight. Spinning around, you steel yourself for the next opponent to come at you, but those lanky monsters who are still standing are backing off slowly, realizing that they're in over their heads trying to attack you. Still, they have their weapons out, watching you for your next move. "A-are you all right, nojya?" You can barely catch your breath at this point, but are able to give Kohaku a nod as you bite back the pain from your cuts and scrapes. It's distracting, but not enough to be overwhelmingly so... yet. "We must retreat." "Youhei and — " "Load them onto the wagon, but we must retreat before they regroup! Dump the cargo, it'll make us lighter!" Kohaku looks deeply conflicted at that, but the natural kitsune reverence for authority wins out and she nods. While you keep guard and hold your assailants at bay, Kohaku and the two remaining bodyguards pull out the wagon bed, dumping the sacks and boxes of all the goods she'd gathered from [kinu.isInari |Willowpast |across the ocean ] and loading their downed fellows onto the vehicle. Seeing that you're trying to escape, several of your assailants make tentative forays against you and test your defenses, but you manage to hold out with a few [kinu.kinuWeapon |counters |warning arrows ], sending them back once more. "Hurry!" Before you can make your getaway, though, more shapes materialize into the Ways Between, joining the assassins already present, and [kinu.isInari |a burning rage and glee alike grip your heart. So what if they've got you surrounded? That just means you can get at more of them at once. |cold terror and determination alike grip your heart. More of them? How many are there? How did they get here so quickly without using a waystone? ] And then a figure steps to the fore, one that you immediately recognise. [kinu.isInari |"...You!" Fire flows in your veins, and it's all you can do to hold yourself back from lashing out |"...You." You thin your lips, and your fingers unconsciously tighten about your [kinu.weapon] ]. But rationality prevails: you need to keep him talking, to buy more time for an opportunity to arise so that Kohaku and her entourage can make a break for it. "I've been waiting for you, demoness." Time and space are relative in the Ways Between, but even you weren't expecting Raphael to be dangerously close in no more than a few steps, his minions parting around him like a school of fish to give him space. Even they don't want to be close to him. But of course, it all makes sense now. "[kinu.isInari |So, you're the one responsible for what's been happening to the gates and waystone idols. |It would be reasonable to conclude that you are responsible for what has been happening to travel in this place, then. ]" He steps back, eyebrows raised, feigning shock. "Oh dear, no. You truly wound me, demoness, to think that I would do such a thing. In fact, I had to specially request to be included here in this endeavour just to have the chance to be able to see you again." ...They knew you would be here! Ahead of time, too! How? "If there's anything your farce of a native culture knows, demoness, it's shame. The shame that comes with failure... night by night, whenever I felt the pain of my own conscience at not being able to drive you monsters out from where you don't belong, I thought of your face. Poetic, isn't it?" "Disgusting." "For you? I can be anything you want, even a villain. I'll admit that the 'rogue' part of the Russet Rogue does have its own appeal... but to me, you're just a hypocrite. It's exactly as I told you the last time — if you can't realize your own hypocrisy, that simply makes you a fool." "[kinu.isInari |What do I care about anything you think or say? You're trying to hurt the people I care about, which makes you an enemy. That's all I need to know! |But I understand you and your point of view well enough. That someone acts contrary to your desires does not necessarily mean they do not understand you, merely that they disagree. Or are you the sort who imagines that your cause is so right and just that once someone understands your intentions they will certainly fall in line behind you? ]" Raphael scoffs. "Look at all the blood you've shed without a second thought. This is all thanks to you — such a beautiful and terrible representation of my pain and sadness at what your kind has done to mine, but every people you come into contact with. I want you to know the same thing, demoness — being tormented night after night for your failures to shield those whom you love, and being forced to greet every morning without being able to sleep." Keep him talking, appeal to his vanity. Buy some more time for Kohaku to find an opening. "[kinu.isInari |That's the worst... you're the one who ambushed me first. You tried to burn me and everyone else in our homes in the middle of the night — how dare you make yourself out to be some kind of victim in all this! |Cease making yourself to be some kind of victim in all this — you and yours tried to board us in our homes and burn us alive in the middle of the night! I could not care less if you failed, or that you feel remiss over that failure! ]" Raphael just grins and shrugs — you get the feeling he's enjoying this way more than a madman like him as any right to be. "I am the aggressor? I know something of what your native country is like, and how your kind rules. You are here in a land where you don't belong, slowly but surely turning everything that is ours into everything that is yours; but no doubt as many travelers up in the woodlands of the Marches will say, that such chance encounters with beautiful fox-people who take their life energy is perfectly fine, because they are duly compensated. I am to accept vampiric monsters just because they give back, that this so-called 'equivalent exchange' is supposed to make it all right. "You will excuse me then, if I find this rationalisation as completely and utterly disgusting as you claim to find me, and the sentiment is shared by all those who have thrown their lot in with Lord Taoth — I will not accept the rule of vampiric demons who have stolen the old treasures and secrets of Belhar to parade around as their own, who are stealing our land, and no doubt in the end drop the pretense and steal our dignity as you have stolen that of all the other peoples of your homeland. "So understand this, demoness; I will murder every last one of you so that my children don't have to. But as for you and you only, I will gouge out your eyes, cut off your ears, and break every last one of your fingers — then, just perhaps, you might understand what the sting of failure feels like." ...This man is insane. But you already knew that, didn't you? Slowly, you [kinu.kinuWeapon |lower the blade of your naginata at him, and memories of mother's forms flit through your mind |nock an arrow against the bowstring and prepare to draw ]; blood rushes in your veins and you can feel your heart pound in your chest. Yes, there's the opening Kohaku needs. The time for talking is over, then. "Do it if you can." Kohaku looks around. "[kinu.isInari |Kinu |Young Lady ], I think I will — " "Run. You are no match for him." She looks conflicted at this. "But — " "By all the power invested in me and my station, I order you to run!" There's no time to see if she obeys — Raphael is already upon you, faster than what you remember him being the first time you met. You barely have enough time to [kinu.kinuWeapon |turn aside his thrust with your naginata |sidestep his thrust ] as he lunges, a fanatical gleam in his eye. "Pff. I won't be so trite as to say I enjoy a woman with spirit, but you have some guts, I'll give you that," he says, chuckling. "You're a vixen made to be savoured, it's true — you just keep on fighting even though you know the outcome never is in doubt, and in a way I can respect that. Our first time was such a beautiful thing; I was having too much fun before we were rudely interrupted, but here and now no one will come to save you, girl. It just so happens that your opponent is indeed none other than I... and faced with such unfair odds, this is the perfect opportunity to show you what losing is like against such opposition. "Now, let's dance!" There's nothing left but to meet this madman in battle; your only hope is to stall him long enough for Kohaku to escape. '

rows.original:
No... not like this[kinu.isInari
        |!
        |.
    ] Not against this monster! [kinu.isInari
        |But for all that your spirit rages, the hurts of your body betray you, dragging you down with them. The realization that Raphael had been toying with you, eager to watch you bleed out from the death of a thousand cuts only makes you all the more infuriated as he forces you on your knees
        |But it is what it is, and the realization that your strength has failed you only add to the hurts of your body, regret welling up in that one moment. Maybe... maybe if you hadn't been so confident in your abilities and talents when young, maybe if you hadn't coasted along as a child prodigy, you might have applied yourself in a more serious fashion, worked harder to hone your skills, changed the outcome of this day. But it is not to be, not to be as Raphael forces you on your knees
    ]. The fox's ever-present smirk is all the more prominent as he taps you with the point of his thin blade, clearly intending to humiliate you in front of his subordinates; first he gently nudges it into your ribcage, and you wonder if he intends to skewer you there and then. That changes as he brushes it in circles across your left breast, sending an involuntary shiver down your spine; from there, he drags it slowly down your body, from rib to rib, past your stomach, until he does no less than slide the tip through the fabric of your [kinu.armor] and all the way between your legs. His predatory smile doesn't change in the least, challenging you to do something about it.
    
    And you do. Unable to suffer the humiliation of the tip of his blade prodding perversely at the petals of your feminine flower, you summon up the last dregs of your strength and lunge together with your [kinu.weapon] — 
    
    — And that's when he withdraws the slender sword in one fluid motion and slits your throat.
    
    "What a waste," Raphael says, blowing you a kiss as your vision dims and life ebbs, warmth running down your collarbone. "I could have loved you."
    
    "[kinu.isInari
        |...And so that bastard killed me, but it wasn't for nothing since Kohaku managed to get away
        |...And so thus humiliated, I perished at the hands of this madman, but at least my life was not given in vain. Kohaku and her wagon managed to escape
    ]."
    
    You give Kinu a weak grin. Really, she doesn't need to terrify you like that with exaggerated stories of her own death. She let herself get a little carried away with the climax of the tale, didn't she?
    
    Kinu [kinu.isInari
        |blushes, looking appropriately embarrassed. "Uh, guess I couldn't really have died, [kinu.Dad]. Otherwise I wouldn't be here talking to you now, would I?
        |looks appropriately chastised, folding her ears forward. "That... that is the case, [kinu.Dad]. Otherwise I could not be speaking with you in the flesh, could I?
    ]"
    
    Really now, what an active imagination she has. To go into such loving detail about how a pervert molested her with a swordpoint... at least it was better than cutting off her ears, gouging out her eyes and breaking all her fingers like he promised to do. Not that it's a high bar to surpass.
    
    "[kinu.isInari
        |Yeah
        |That is
    ]..."
    
    If something did happen to your fluffiest daughter at the hands of that bastard... 
    
    Kinu gives you a thin smile. "[kinu.isInari
        |I'd still be dead, [kinu.Dad]. But watching you as a restless spirit, egging you on during your roaring rampage of revenge might just make it worth the pain.
        |I would still not be counted amongst the living, [kinu.Dad]. That being said, I am happy knowing that you would do your utmost to avenge me should I fall ignominiously.
    ]"
    
    She knows you would move the earth and seas for her.
    
    [kinu.isInari
        |"Personally, I'd rather you not, [kinu.Dad]; it's really sweet that you would, but I've got to start doing things for myself someday, you know. And speaking of doing things, there's still work to be done, and the fields aren't going to till themselves. Catch me tomorrow like you said, okay?"
        
        With that, your daughter swings herself off the wall and starts pacing down the path back to the fields, her tails swaying behind her. Wonder if she's really as unperturbed by the whole experience as she's trying to present herself as being... but she wouldn't be Kinu if she didn't put on a strong front. All right, you'll ask again tomorrow.
        [party.has kiyoko
            |
            
            "That's our daughter for you," Kiyoko mutters, arms folded. "Misremembers such an important tale, and just swings off without so much as a second thought. I'd be more understanding if she weren't just so feckless all the time."
        ]
        |"To be frank, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], I would prefer it if you did not. While the sentiment is sweet and heartwarming, I have to grow into my own in order to be better able to serve the Cherry Blossom Throne in what capacity I can. And speaking of serving, what has happened to me does not divest me of my duties; I must depart now if I am to complete today's paperwork in a timely fashion. The day is not getting any longer — if you will excuse me, please."
        
        That was a rather blunt and fumbled attempt at a save if you have anything to say about it, but you're not going to stop Kinu. Seeing no protest from you, your daughter rises from her seat and excuses herself, departing from the room. You're left to finish the cooling tea, and shake your head at the enigma that Kinu has become as a young woman.
        [party.has kiyoko
            |
            
            Well, what does your fox-wife make of all this?
            
            "I would be angrier about our daughter's flawed recollection if the circumstances weren't so extenuating. As things stand, I can forgive her a little. Still, she needs to be better not just as my heir, but as who she is to the people around her. I hope we won't be wasting more time when we come around to hear this story again."
        ]
    ]

        |然而，尽管你的精神在愤怒中挣扎，身体的伤痛却仍在背叛你，将你拖向深渊。当你意识到拉斐尔一直在戏弄你，乐于看着你因千刀万剐而逐渐失去生命时，这种愤怒只会更加剧烈——尤其是当他迫使你跪倒在地的时候。

而你确实这么做了。你无法忍受他的剑尖如此恶作剧地触碰你女性特质的象征——你的身体，于是你拼尽最后的力气，握着[kinu.weapon]一同向他扑去——

rows.original: You pull back, gasping, not daring to take your eyes off Raphael. The fox-man isn't even breathing hard, let alone winded like you are, and clearly has been toying with you all this while. That's good — Kohaku is long gone while he and his have been fixated on you. In the end, that's all that matters. He flicks the point of his blade playfully in your direction, cleaving the air before drawing it to a standstill — anyone else might be hard-pressed to follow its movements, but not you. "I've never met a woman with your skills, demon or not," he says with a chuckle that turns into what he probably thinks is a suave smirk, but you can only see as a lecherous leer. "M'lady, I must have you. It would only be right — no, it will be exquisite. Lose yourself in my capable hands, won't you?" "[kinu.isInari |Get bent, asshole. Weren't you telling me moments ago how you'd break my fingers one by one? Gods, do you really think that highly of yourself? |Mere moments ago you made threats of grievous harm against me and mine, and now you expect me to accept your solicitations of affection? Just what do you think you are? ]" "Tsk, people often underestimate how tiring proper lovemaking is. I restrict myself to a mere tryst a day, no more, often less; you ladies would be the death of me otherwise, and proclamations of attraction are far less impactful when you throw them about willy-nilly. You should be glad that I offered to spend my daily passions on the likes of you, but I can't account for demons not knowing a good deal when presented with one." His eyes gleam. "Since you've rejected my offer of a little pleasure before your death, I think it's about time we ended this." No. You barely dodge out of the way of another swing; the point of Raphael's blade grazes your skin, but fails to find purchase in your flesh. He makes an exasperated noise through his teeth, then shakes his head. "Playing hard to get, I see. I suppose it's about time I got serious, then." The fox-man's attention is fully fixated on you, has been for what feels to you like an eternity, and each moment you spend as its subject makes your skin crawl and fur stand on end. Having bought enough time for Kohaku and her wagon to make its retreat, it's time for you to make like a tree and leave as well; Raphael's minions may have you encircled, but that shouldn't be a problem. He grins maniacally as he sees you charging towards him, expecting a last-ditch assault, but looks clearly disappointed when you don't throw yourself at him and instead swerve aside at the last moment, [kinu.kinuWeapon |using the haft of your naginata to vault onto one of his subordinates and use that momentum to further leapfrog up and over the circle they've formed about you. It feels sacreligious to use your weapon in that way, but its purpose is to protect your life and it's doing just that |stunning the nearest of his minions with a hefty whack from the body of your bow and leapfrogging off the lanky creature. It feels sacreligious to use your weapon in that way, but you'll treat your bow better later on to make up for its ignominy in service ]. Realizing you're not paying any further attention to him and are intending to escape, Raphael barks several orders, and you hear his boots clatter in pursuit behind you; several pairs of hands claw at your clothes and limbs, ripping apart fabric and drawing blood in their attempts to catch you but ultimately failing. Not today, not today. Not if you have anything to say about it. [kinu.isInari |It's not in you to run, but civilisation is all about channelling your instincts in ways that are constructive to society, as Mother used to say when you were young. Like it or not, you're outmatched, were always outmatched, and there's no point in fighting a losing battle. Anger and resentment lend you strength on the spur of the moment, a loan that will be repaid dearly with interest when all this is over. |Nakano would not run, but you are not him; his life is considered to be expendable whereas yours is not. Your life is not your own to throw away — not when Mother, [kinu.Dad], Matron Komari, Nakano and everyone else need you in their lives. It would be so easy to accept death and be satisfied with saving Kohaku and her wagon, but you were born for more than that; more lives than your own depend on you drawing breath. ] That moment of clarity amidst physical exhaustion, that moment when the body moves by itself and leaves the mind free to its own devices — your eyes scour the emptiness of the Ways Between for the column of light that denotes the waystone that must be somewhere close. Perhaps two or three more minutes' travel, nojya. Those were her words... "A clever trick you pulled to get around me — I do appreciate a woman who can actually pull a surprise like that on someone who has seen it all like me. And yet it is a familiar dance, isn't it?" His voice is jovial and playful even as he pursues in earnest, closing the distance with each step. "She runs, though not quickly enough that she cannot be caught, daring me to pursue despite her insistent claims not to follow. Alas, I am obligated to play along with each and every lady's little game, all identical despite how much they claim they're not like the others. Yet I never get tired of it." It's there, it's there! Just a dozen more steps... [kinu.isInari |you'd be tempted to ditch your [kinu.weapon] if it meant you could run just that bit faster, but it wouldn't have made a difference, would it? |the names of all of your ancestors and all of the gods are poised on your lips with each ragged breath you draw, praying for them to lend you that last bit of strength to outrun this madman. ] "That expression... so much hope. But now..." You don't hear the remainder of his words, because the shock of Raphael grabbing one of your five tails and pulling hard makes you stumble and scream. Fire — and not the comfortable kind — shoots up into your body as your spine feels like it's being ripped from your flesh through its base, your knees weakening instantly as that part of your body, ordinarily so sensitive and erogenous, lights up with pain. You fall to what passes for the ground in this nebulous realm, bumping your shoulder as you drop into a roll — — And find yourself at the foot of a statue in the middle of a busy village square, tasting dust while your [kinu.weapon] clatters to the dirt path beside you. Several natives, previously about their business, draw their gazes to you, although they appear more curious than hostile. Of Kohaku and her wagon, there is no sign; she must have left the Ways Between from another waystone. That is, assuming they didn't catch up to her... ...You know this place; [kinu.isInari |you've even snuck into it from time to time despite Mother's stern orders not to. But that was always with a disguise made with Kohaku's help, and here and now the natives of Hawkethorne are able to see you for what you are, and the sudden means of your arrival |while you've never even thought of disobeying Mother's instructions to give the place a wide berth, the tales both she and [kinu.Dad] bring back of Hawkethorne are well worth listening to ]. At least Raphael hasn't followed you for some reason, but that's a small consolation given the situation you've landed yourself in. The base of your tail still burns from where Raphael tried to tear it from your body, you cough and splutter from the dust in your face. The cuts and scrapes on your skin still sting, but so long as you treat them properly to avoid infection, you should be fine. Most importantly, you're alive... at least, if they don't decide to string you up for what you are. "Are you okay, miss?" You look up to see a white-haired catboy looking down at you from the bench he's sitting on, one hand on his lute while the other's outstretched in your direction. There's something strange about him that you can't quite place, a sense of familiarity, and yet... no matter. At least it's not creepy or threatening like Raphael is... [kinu.isInari |Right. River, that's his name; you've seen him before during your previous visits to Hawkethorne, but never really stopped to talk. He's just... there. ] "You look like you took a bad tumble there; the town square is the oldest part of the village and the path can be uneven in places. It can be hard to watch your step when your mind's preoccupied with other matters, but you should really try. I've been telling Garth that we should get some people together and fill in the worst of the potholes, maybe even lay down some proper cobblestones, but he's been putting it off for months now. I'm sorry." "[kinu.isInari |W-whatever for? It's not your fault. |There is no need to apologise, the fault is all mine. ]" You look over your shoulder, half-expecting Raphael and his cohorts to materialize about the statue at any moment now, but he doesn't. It really appears that you've shaken him off your tail... for now, at any rate. [kinu.isInari |River shrugs noncommittally as he helps you up; you can still feel your heart pounding in your chest. " |The catboy waves a hand noncommittally. "I think this is the first time we've met, isn't it? I'm River. ]Either way, you should be moving along now. Local legend has it that it's bad luck to take a tumble at the old baron's feet." "I — " you see him point up at the statue, the blue gem set in its shield, and nod. "[kinu.isInari |All right. I need to leave — I'll be out of your fur no problems. |I understand. I need to depart posthaste, and will trouble you no further. ]" "Mm, at least let me see you to the gate. You might run into trouble otherwise — " he lowers his voice. " — Being what you are and all. Someone might know of your kind, even if you aren't very common around these parts. Did you come from across the ocean?" You swallow hard, and hold your tongue. River takes in your silence, and then shakes his head before turning to address the handful of curious onlookers. "It's all right, you lot, I'll sort out this poor girl. Don't you have your lives to attend to? Now, Kinu Otomo, if you don't mind following me, I'll bring you to the north gate and you can be on your way." It never occurred to you how exactly the little musician knew your name until you were well into the forest and halfway home.
rows.translation: 你后退了几步，喘着粗气，不敢将视线从拉斐尔身上移开。那个狐狸人甚至都没有显得气喘吁吁，更不像你这样狼狈不堪，显然，他一直在戏弄你。这样也好——当他和他的同伴们把注意力都集中在你身上时，小红早就逃走了。归根结底，这才是最重要的。他戏谑地将刀刃的尖端朝你的方向一挥，刀刃在空气中划过一道弧线，然后突然停住了——其他人可能很难跟上这一连串的动作，但你不是。 我从未遇到过像你这样有能力的女性，无论你是不是恶魔。”他笑着说，那笑容在他看来或许显得很潇洒，但在别人眼中，却只是一种色眯眯的注视。“小姐，我必须得到你。这样才对……不，这样简直太完美了。让我来照顾你吧，好吗？[kinu.isInari |滚开，混蛋。刚才你不是还扬言要一根一根地折断我的手指吗？天啊，你真这么自以为是吗？ |就在刚才，你还威胁要对我和我的家人造成严重的伤害，现在却指望我接受你的求爱？你到底以为自己是谁啊？ ]啧，人们总是低估真正亲密的亲密行为会有多累人。我每天只允许自己进行一次这样的亲密接触，不多也不少；否则你们这些女性真的会把我逼疯的。而且，如果你们随意地表达自己的吸引之情，那些话其实根本没有什么效果。你应该感到庆幸，因为我愿意把我的热情和精力都投入到像你这样的人身上……不过，我实在无法理解那些恶魔，为什么在遇到这么好的机会时还会拒绝它。”他的眼中闪烁着光芒，“既然你之前已经拒绝了我为你在临死前带来一丝快乐的提议，那么我想是时候结束这一切了。" 不。你刚刚才勉强躲过了他的下一次攻击；拉斐尔的刀刃只是擦过了你的皮肤，并没有真正刺中你。他恼怒地咬了咬牙，然后摇了摇头。 “原来是在故作高深啊。看来是时候认真点对待你了。 那个狐狸人的注意力完全集中在你身上，这种感觉仿佛已经持续了永恒般漫长。每一刻，当你成为它的目标时，都会让你不寒而栗，毛骨悚然。既然你已经为小红和她的马车争取到了足够的逃跑时间，现在你也该赶紧离开这里了。虽然拉斐尔的爪牙可能已经将你包围，但这应该不是什么问题。当他看到你朝他冲过来时，他露出了疯狂的笑容，以为你会发起最后的攻击，但当你并没有直接扑向他，而是在最后一刻突然转向一旁时，他显然显得非常失望。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |利用长刀的刀柄作为支撑，跳到其中一个对手身上，然后借助这个动力继续跳跃，越过他们围绕你形成的包围圈。用这种方式使用武器，感觉有点违背常理，但它的目的就是保护你的生命，而它确实做到了这一点。 |你用弓箭重重地击中最近的那个仆从，使其倒地不起，然后跳过这个瘦高的生物继续前进。用这种方式使用武器，感觉有点亵渎神明，但为了弥补它这次“蒙羞”的经历，以后你一定会更加珍惜你的弓箭的。 ]意识到你已经不再理会他，而是打算逃跑，拉斐尔大声下达了几道命令，你听到他的靴子声在身后紧追不舍；有几双手试图抓住你的衣服和四肢，撕扯着布料，甚至划破了你的皮肤，但最终还是没能抓住你。 今天不行，绝对不行。只要你还有一丝反抗的意志，今天就绝不会让他们得逞。 [kinu.isInari |你天生并不适合逃跑，但文明的意义就在于将你的本能引导到对社会有益的方向上——就像你小时候母亲常说的那样。无论你愿不愿意承认，你现在的处境都是处于劣势，从来都是如此。继续这场必败的战斗毫无意义。愤怒和怨恨确实能在短时间内给你带来力量，但当这一切结束之后，你将会为此付出沉重的代价。 |中野不会逃跑，但你和他不一样；他的生命被认为可以牺牲，而你的生命却不可。你的生命不是你可以随意抛弃的——尤其是当母亲还在身边的时候。 [kinu.Dad]麻里女首领、中野以及所有人都需要你活在他们身边。接受死亡，只为拯救小花和她的马车，这样的结局其实也很容易让人接受，但你的存在意义远不止于此——还有许多人的命运都寄托在你能否继续呼吸上。 ] 在身体极度疲惫的时刻，那种恍然开朗的感觉；当身体开始自主行动，让思绪得以自由驰骋的瞬间——你的目光在那些空荡荡的道路间搜寻着，寻找那道代表路标的光柱，它一定就在附近某个地方。 或许再行驶两三分钟就可以了，诺雅。那些确实是她说过的话…… “你用了个聪明的办法来绕过我——我确实欣赏这样一位女性：她能够对一个像我这样见多识广的人使出这样的招数。不过，这个招数其实很老套，对吧？他的声音听起来既愉快又充满趣味，尽管他正在认真地追赶着，每迈一步都在缩小与她的距离。她在奔跑，速度虽然不够快，但还是无法逃脱他的追捕；她一再声称自己并不想逃跑，却仍在鼓励我继续追赶她。唉，我不得不配合每一位女士的小把戏，这些把戏虽然她们总声称自己和别人不一样，但实际上都是一样的。不过，我对此却从来不感到厌倦。 就在那里，就在那里！再走十几步就能到了…… [kinu.isInari |你可能会想要放弃它。 [kinu.weapon]如果这意味着你能跑得快那么一点点，但实际上并不会有什么区别，对吧？ |你每一次艰难地呼吸时，你祖先的名字以及所有神明的名字都会出现在你的唇边，你祈求他们能赐予你最后一点力量，让你能够逃离这个疯子。 ] 那种表情……充满了希望。但是现在……” 你没有听清他接下来说了什么，因为拉斐尔突然抓住你的五条尾巴中的一条，用力一拉，你整个人都被拉走了。用力这会让你踉跄着尖叫起来。一股剧烈的疼痛——绝非那种舒适的疼痛——瞬间涌入你的身体：你的脊椎仿佛从基部被生生撕裂开来，膝盖也瞬间失去了力量。那原本如此敏感、如此容易引发性兴奋的身体部位，此刻正被剧痛所吞噬。你跌落在这个模糊不清的世界里，所谓的“地面”上，肩膀在摔倒时撞到了什么东西…… 然后，你发现自己站在一个繁忙村庄广场中央的雕像脚下，口中满是尘土[kinu.weapon]那些声音沿着你身旁的土路传来。几个原本在忙自己事情的当地人将目光投向了你，不过他们的神情更多是好奇而非敌意。至于琥珀和她的马车，却没有任何踪迹——她肯定是从另一块路标处离开了“道路之间”……当然，也有可能他们已经追上了她…… ……你熟悉这个地方； [kinu.isInari |尽管母亲严令禁止，你还是偶尔偷偷溜了进去。但每次都是借助科哈克的帮助伪装过的。而现在，鹰棘镇的当地人终于看清了你的真面目，也知道了你突然出现的真正原因。 |而你甚至从未想过要违抗母亲的命令，远离那个地方……无论是她还是其他人，都讲述过许多关于那里的故事。 [kinu.Dad]鹰棘镇带来的这些作品确实值得一听。 ]至少拉斐尔没有跟踪你，这倒也算是个小小的安慰……不过考虑到你目前所处的处境，这个安慰也显得微不足道了。 你的尾巴根部仍然因为拉斐尔试图将其从你身上扯下来的动作而感到剧痛，你不停地咳嗽，脸上也充满了灰尘。你皮肤上的伤口和擦伤仍然会感到刺痛，但只要你妥善处理它们以避免感染，应该就不会有什么大问题。 最重要的是，你还活着……至少，只要他们没有因为你的身份而决定处决你的话。 你没事吧，小姐？” 你抬头一看，只见一个白发猫人正坐在长椅上，低头看着你。他一只手拿着琉特琴，另一只手朝你的方向伸来。他身上有种让你觉得奇怪却又说不上来的感觉，一种熟悉感，但又似乎有些不同………算了，无所谓。至少它不像拉斐尔那样让人感到毛骨悚然或充满威胁…… [kinu.isInari |对，他的名字叫瑞弗。你在之前去鹰棘镇的时候见过他，但当时并没有真正停下来和他交谈。他只是……就在那里而已。 ] 你看起来像是在那里摔了一跤吧？镇广场是这个村庄最古老的部分，那条小路有些地方确实很不平坦。当你的注意力被其他事情占据时，确实很难注意脚步，但你真的应该试试看。我一直跟加斯说，我们应该召集一些人来把那些最严重的坑洼填平，甚至可以铺上一些正规的鹅卵石，但他已经拖延了好几个月了。真不好意思。[kinu.isInari |为什么非得这样呢？这不是你的错。 |没有必要道歉，错完全在我。 ]你不时回头张望，半期待着拉斐尔和他的同伙们随时会从那座雕像后面出现，但他们并没有出现。看来，你确实已经把他甩在了身后……至少目前是这样。 [kinu.isInari |瑞弗漫不经心地帮你站了起来，你仍能感觉到自己的心脏在胸口剧烈跳动。 |猫人男孩漫不经心地挥了挥手：“我想我们应该是第一次见面吧？我叫瑞弗。 ]无论如何，你现在应该继续前进了。据当地传说，在那位老男爵的脚下跌倒是不吉利的。 “我——”你看到他指向那座雕像，看到盾牌上镶嵌的蓝色宝石，然后点了点头。[kinu.isInari |好吧，我得走了——离开后就不会再打扰你们了。 |我明白了。我需要立刻动身，不会再打扰您了。 ]嗯，至少让我送你到门口吧。否则你可能会遇到麻烦……”他压低了声音，“毕竟你是这样的身份。虽然这种人在这附近并不常见，但总有人会认识你的。你是从大洋的对岸过来的吗？” 你艰难地咽了口唾沫，紧咬住舌头。瑞弗注意到了你的沉默，然后摇了摇头，转而对着那些好奇的旁观者说道：“没关系，你们放心，我会照顾好这个可怜的女孩的。你们难道没有自己的事情要处理吗？现在，小娟 Otomo，如果你不介意的话，我就带你去北门，然后你就可以上路了。 直到你们走进森林，走了一半的路，你才突然想到：这个小小的音乐家究竟是怎么知道你的名字的？
rows.raw: " You pull back, gasping, not daring to take your eyes off Raphael. The fox-man isn't even breathing hard, let alone winded like you are, and clearly has been toying with you all this while. That's good — Kohaku is long gone while he and his have been fixated on you. In the end, that's all that matters. He flicks the point of his blade playfully in your direction, cleaving the air before drawing it to a standstill — anyone else might be hard-pressed to follow its movements, but not you. "I've never met a woman with your skills, demon or not," he says with a chuckle that turns into what he probably thinks is a suave smirk, but you can only see as a lecherous leer. "M'lady, I must have you. It would only be right — no, it will be exquisite. Lose yourself in my capable hands, won't you?" "[kinu.isInari |Get bent, asshole. Weren't you telling me moments ago how you'd break my fingers one by one? Gods, do you really think that highly of yourself? |Mere moments ago you made threats of grievous harm against me and mine, and now you expect me to accept your solicitations of affection? Just what do you think you are? ]" "Tsk, people often underestimate how tiring proper lovemaking is. I restrict myself to a mere tryst a day, no more, often less; you ladies would be the death of me otherwise, and proclamations of attraction are far less impactful when you throw them about willy-nilly. You should be glad that I offered to spend my daily passions on the likes of you, but I can't account for demons not knowing a good deal when presented with one." His eyes gleam. "Since you've rejected my offer of a little pleasure before your death, I think it's about time we ended this." No. You barely dodge out of the way of another swing; the point of Raphael's blade grazes your skin, but fails to find purchase in your flesh. He makes an exasperated noise through his teeth, then shakes his head. "Playing hard to get, I see. I suppose it's about time I got serious, then." The fox-man's attention is fully fixated on you, has been for what feels to you like an eternity, and each moment you spend as its subject makes your skin crawl and fur stand on end. Having bought enough time for Kohaku and her wagon to make its retreat, it's time for you to make like a tree and leave as well; Raphael's minions may have you encircled, but that shouldn't be a problem. He grins maniacally as he sees you charging towards him, expecting a last-ditch assault, but looks clearly disappointed when you don't throw yourself at him and instead swerve aside at the last moment, [kinu.kinuWeapon |using the haft of your naginata to vault onto one of his subordinates and use that momentum to further leapfrog up and over the circle they've formed about you. It feels sacreligious to use your weapon in that way, but its purpose is to protect your life and it's doing just that |stunning the nearest of his minions with a hefty whack from the body of your bow and leapfrogging off the lanky creature. It feels sacreligious to use your weapon in that way, but you'll treat your bow better later on to make up for its ignominy in service ]. Realizing you're not paying any further attention to him and are intending to escape, Raphael barks several orders, and you hear his boots clatter in pursuit behind you; several pairs of hands claw at your clothes and limbs, ripping apart fabric and drawing blood in their attempts to catch you but ultimately failing. Not today, not today. Not if you have anything to say about it. [kinu.isInari |It's not in you to run, but civilisation is all about channelling your instincts in ways that are constructive to society, as Mother used to say when you were young. Like it or not, you're outmatched, were always outmatched, and there's no point in fighting a losing battle. Anger and resentment lend you strength on the spur of the moment, a loan that will be repaid dearly with interest when all this is over. |Nakano would not run, but you are not him; his life is considered to be expendable whereas yours is not. Your life is not your own to throw away — not when Mother, [kinu.Dad], Matron Komari, Nakano and everyone else need you in their lives. It would be so easy to accept death and be satisfied with saving Kohaku and her wagon, but you were born for more than that; more lives than your own depend on you drawing breath. ] That moment of clarity amidst physical exhaustion, that moment when the body moves by itself and leaves the mind free to its own devices — your eyes scour the emptiness of the Ways Between for the column of light that denotes the waystone that must be somewhere close. Perhaps two or three more minutes' travel, nojya. Those were her words... "A clever trick you pulled to get around me — I do appreciate a woman who can actually pull a surprise like that on someone who has seen it all like me. And yet it is a familiar dance, isn't it?" His voice is jovial and playful even as he pursues in earnest, closing the distance with each step. "She runs, though not quickly enough that she cannot be caught, daring me to pursue despite her insistent claims not to follow. Alas, I am obligated to play along with each and every lady's little game, all identical despite how much they claim they're not like the others. Yet I never get tired of it." It's there, it's there! Just a dozen more steps... [kinu.isInari |you'd be tempted to ditch your [kinu.weapon] if it meant you could run just that bit faster, but it wouldn't have made a difference, would it? |the names of all of your ancestors and all of the gods are poised on your lips with each ragged breath you draw, praying for them to lend you that last bit of strength to outrun this madman. ] "That expression... so much hope. But now..." You don't hear the remainder of his words, because the shock of Raphael grabbing one of your five tails and pulling hard makes you stumble and scream. Fire — and not the comfortable kind — shoots up into your body as your spine feels like it's being ripped from your flesh through its base, your knees weakening instantly as that part of your body, ordinarily so sensitive and erogenous, lights up with pain. You fall to what passes for the ground in this nebulous realm, bumping your shoulder as you drop into a roll — — And find yourself at the foot of a statue in the middle of a busy village square, tasting dust while your [kinu.weapon] clatters to the dirt path beside you. Several natives, previously about their business, draw their gazes to you, although they appear more curious than hostile. Of Kohaku and her wagon, there is no sign; she must have left the Ways Between from another waystone. That is, assuming they didn't catch up to her... ...You know this place; [kinu.isInari |you've even snuck into it from time to time despite Mother's stern orders not to. But that was always with a disguise made with Kohaku's help, and here and now the natives of Hawkethorne are able to see you for what you are, and the sudden means of your arrival |while you've never even thought of disobeying Mother's instructions to give the place a wide berth, the tales both she and [kinu.Dad] bring back of Hawkethorne are well worth listening to ]. At least Raphael hasn't followed you for some reason, but that's a small consolation given the situation you've landed yourself in. The base of your tail still burns from where Raphael tried to tear it from your body, you cough and splutter from the dust in your face. The cuts and scrapes on your skin still sting, but so long as you treat them properly to avoid infection, you should be fine. Most importantly, you're alive... at least, if they don't decide to string you up for what you are. "Are you okay, miss?" You look up to see a white-haired catboy looking down at you from the bench he's sitting on, one hand on his lute while the other's outstretched in your direction. There's something strange about him that you can't quite place, a sense of familiarity, and yet... no matter. At least it's not creepy or threatening like Raphael is... [kinu.isInari |Right. River, that's his name; you've seen him before during your previous visits to Hawkethorne, but never really stopped to talk. He's just... there. ] "You look like you took a bad tumble there; the town square is the oldest part of the village and the path can be uneven in places. It can be hard to watch your step when your mind's preoccupied with other matters, but you should really try. I've been telling Garth that we should get some people together and fill in the worst of the potholes, maybe even lay down some proper cobblestones, but he's been putting it off for months now. I'm sorry." "[kinu.isInari |W-whatever for? It's not your fault. |There is no need to apologise, the fault is all mine. ]" You look over your shoulder, half-expecting Raphael and his cohorts to materialize about the statue at any moment now, but he doesn't. It really appears that you've shaken him off your tail... for now, at any rate. [kinu.isInari |River shrugs noncommittally as he helps you up; you can still feel your heart pounding in your chest. " |The catboy waves a hand noncommittally. "I think this is the first time we've met, isn't it? I'm River. ]Either way, you should be moving along now. Local legend has it that it's bad luck to take a tumble at the old baron's feet." "I — " you see him point up at the statue, the blue gem set in its shield, and nod. "[kinu.isInari |All right. I need to leave — I'll be out of your fur no problems. |I understand. I need to depart posthaste, and will trouble you no further. ]" "Mm, at least let me see you to the gate. You might run into trouble otherwise — " he lowers his voice. " — Being what you are and all. Someone might know of your kind, even if you aren't very common around these parts. Did you come from across the ocean?" You swallow hard, and hold your tongue. River takes in your silence, and then shakes his head before turning to address the handful of curious onlookers. "It's all right, you lot, I'll sort out this poor girl. Don't you have your lives to attend to? Now, Kinu Otomo, if you don't mind following me, I'll bring you to the north gate and you can be on your way." It never occurred to you how exactly the little musician knew your name until you were well into the forest and halfway home. "

rows.original:
"[kinu.isInari
            |...And that's about the long and short of it, [kinu.Dad]. The creeps tried to attack us while in the Ways Between. I couldn't beat them, but they were so fixated on me that I bought time for Kohaku and her people to retreat, then high-tailed it myself. It wasn't until a day or two later that Hitoshi came over and asked about me, let me know that Kohaku had made it out as well."
            
            How was the little golden fox?
            
            "Shaken but not dead, [kinu.Dad]. Her people... four came with us to Willowpast. One didn't make it, the other's bedridden. Even though I didn't really know their names, I'm going to attend the funerary rites in a few days; I... I kinda feel responsible for what happened there. It's the least I can do."
            
            [party.has kiyoko
                |Your fox-wife clears her throat gently, her expression ever so calmly stern like the gentle swell of a tsunami beneath the ocean's surface. "There is one matter."
                
                "What is it, Mother? Are you going to chastise me again?"
                
                "I do not remember granting you permission to visit a large native settlement, and Kohaku would not have agreed to chaperone you on such an excursion without someone's approval. Who said you could go?"
                
                "...I'm lucky to be alive, Mother. Must you ask such questions now?"
                
                "If you understand that, then maybe you're beginning to grow just wise enough to realize something of why these rules I try to impress upon you are there. We'll speak of this later in private, and you will not sidestep my questions."
                
            ]
            Everything is just... even if Kiyoko jokes about your firstborn daughter emerging from the womb old, Kinu's life experience is no more than nineteen years, give or take some for how time worked in the Astral Plane. Looking at her right now, you realize how short a time you've actually known your daughter, even if it feels like she's been family forever. And if something were to happen to her... 
            
            Kinu bites her lip and turns her gaze from you, clearly used to wearing her heart on her sleeve. "It's all right, [kinu.Dad]. Really, it is. Second time around, and he still hasn't realized that he should just shut up and try to kill me already. So long as that bastard can't get over his own ego and his need to justify his actions, I'll always be able to hold that advantage over him."
            
            Relying on someone else's weaknesses — or in other words, something that's not in her control — doesn't quite inspire confidence in you.
            
            "Which is why I'm not going to stop improving myself either, [kinu.Dad]." Sighing, Kinu leans over from where she's sitting and gives you a sidelong hug. "Trust me, okay? That's all I ask."
            
            It's really hard to say you can. Not because of her, but — 
            
            "I know, [kinu.Dad]. I know."
            
            Was Kinu ever an innocent child? She's certainly no stranger to death — you've seen ducks and carp in the paddies, and she's in charge of turning those from living animals into cooked meals. Even her beloved crops are brought in at the end of the day... as a daughter of the harvest, Kinu is intimately familiar with how things are and the facts of life, but this is... is it ever the same?
            
            "Really, [kinu.Dad], I'm okay. Please. If you start worrying about me, I'll have to worry about you, too. You don't want that, right?"
            
            Ah, you shouldn't spoil your daughter that way.
            
            Kinu tries to hide a smile. "[kinu.Dad], I'm asking you to do the exact opposite of spoil me."
            
            That's... well, technically true, but she's still asking you to let her have her way, isn't she?
            
            A sigh. "This isn't going to be the last time something like this happens to me, [kinu.Dad]. Nor, being who I am, do I think that they are the only people who are going to try and hurt me and mine in any way over the course of the rest of my life. You've your own problems to take care of, so trust me to handle mine, okay?
            
            "...Gods, this is exhausting. I'm not good with words."
            |...And that is the whole tale, [kinu.Dad]. We were accosted by assassins while traveling in the Ways Between. My strength could not match theirs, but it was I that they wanted, and that was enough for me to buy time for Kohaku and hers to retreat. It would be a lie to say that I was not terrified every moment of that encounter, but the remembrance of my station and birthright helped me pull through where I surely otherwise would not have prevailed.
            
            "It was a day or two later before Nakano and a couple of his subordinates came over to check on me; he let me know that Kohaku had returned to the den."
            
            Safely?
            
            Kinu averts her gaze from you. "She is shaken and has suffered some minor injuries, but should otherwise be fine. Of the four who accompanied us, one is bedridden, while the other... is not with us any more. Even if I knew their names, I did not know them as well as I could have... I will be attending the funerary rites of the deceased in a few days from now. He died in my service, even if indirect; I am responsible for what happened. That is, I feel, some simple respect for my future subjects."
            
            [party.has kiyoko
                |Your fox-wife clears her throat, her expression softening. "Ah, my poor daughter. What have you been through... perhaps I would never have given you permission to visit our ancestral holdings had I known this would happen. I thought the worst of it would be that my sister's descendants would view you as a threat... this is something else altogether, if the Ways Between are no longer safe."
                
                Your daughter bows her head and folds her ears down and to the side, pressing them against her head. "I am sorry to make you worry, Mother."
                
                "You're alive and relatively unscathed. That, I think, will be enough for now. We'll speak later in private."
                
            ]
            Everything is just... even if Kiyoko jokes about your firstborn daughter emerging from the womb old, Kinu's life experience is no more than nineteen years, give or take some for how time worked in the Astral Plane. Looking at her right now, you realize how short a time you've actually known your daughter, even if it feels like she's been family forever. And if something were to happen to her... 
            
            
            
            
            Kinu bites her lip and forces a smile; if not for you knowing your fox-daughter better, you might've even thought it was genuine. "It is all right, [kinu.Dad]. Please. This is the second time an attempt has been made on my life in this fashion, and he still has not realized that he should talk less and act more. I believe on some level the man understands that his actions are heinous, which explains his need to justify his actions not to me or his underlings, but to himself. So long as he holds that seed of doubt in his heart, he is not as efficient as he could be. That is why rigorous mental discipline, as well as unwavering loyalty and conviction are required of our warrior caste."
            
            Relying on someone else's weaknesses — or in other words, something that's not in her control — doesn't quite inspire confidence in you.
            
            "I did not say I was ceasing to improve either, [kinu.Dad]." Sighing, Kinu leans over from where she's sitting and looks like she's about to give you a sidelong hug, then thinks better of it and dips her head respectfully instead. "I merely wish for you to trust me and my abilities; they have pulled me through twice already."
            
            It's really hard to say you can. Not because of her, but — 
            
            "I understand. That I am still alive is not solely because of my strength alone, but also that of the people around me. Please, let them help me too, not just you. There are already so many other burdens you must shoulder, [kinu.Dad]."
            
            Was Kinu ever an innocent child? She's certainly no stranger to death — if nothing else, because of who she is and her lineage, your daughter has received an education in the histories of her motherland. Kinu is intimately familiar with how things are and the facts of life, but this is... is it ever the same now that it's personal? Now that someone she personally knows is no longer around?
            
            "[kinu.Dad]... if I were born across the ocean, if I were to sit in the so-called safety of the capital and politick for my clan like my mother would have been expected to do, like I would have to do... I would be in no less danger. A life, especially one such as mine, cannot be safe by any meaning of the word; it may hurt to admit it, but that is the truth. If you worry about me, I will be obliged to worry about you. That is not something you desire, is it?"
            
            Ah, you shouldn't spoil your daughter that way.
            
            Kinu tries to hide a smile, but you can never be wholly sure of her true feelings as a young lady. "[kinu.Dad], my request was to do the opposite of spoiling me."
            
            That's... well, technically true, but she's still asking you to let her have her way, isn't she?
            
            A sigh, and Kinu gathers up one of her quintet of tails on her hands, toying with the fine fur. "With the way things are going both here in the colonies and across the ocean, I have my doubts that this will be the final attempt on me, [kinu.dad]. Nor, given my station and birth, are these going to be the only people who will wish me ill in the course of my life. You have your tasks to take care of, so please allow me to see to mine.
            
            "...Tasks, to refer to such matters as tasks. Ah, with enough time, even the perilous can appear mundane to one such as I."
        ]
        
        The first time around, there was a quiet desperation to Kinu's words, an intense desire hidden behind them to believe that they were real. This time around, there's but equally muted resignation, an acceptance of the reality that she's she's seen and lived, even if but for a little while. Perhaps it's the short time that you've actually spent with her as a kit, but she's really being forced to grow up a little too fast, you feel... would it have been any different had you spent the entirety of those ten years with your daughter, maybe more? Maybe, but you have the lingering suspicion that it wouldn't be that way.
        
        Well. One way or the other, you'll reaffirm your promise to gut that Raphael bastard while out there in the wild, and make sure to do so in the most horrible and excruciatingly painful way possible for daring to treat your daughter like that. If he can threaten to gouge out her eyes, cut off her ears and break all her fingers, let's see if he's as good at taking it as he is dishing it out.
        
        The corners of Kinu's mouth turn downwards. "[kinu.isInari
            |[kinu.Dad], please don't do that
            |[kinu.Dad], please refrain from such actions
        ]."
        
        Why?
        
        She closes her eyes and puts her hands together[kinu.isInari
            |, wringing them as she speaks. "It's... it's not good for you. I don't want you to turn into someone who I don't remember just because of me."
            
            ...
            
            "I've got to go, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu says all of a sudden. "There're things I've got to do today. Can't let the daikon rot in the fields, can I?" 
            | atop her bosom. "Such actions, regardless of how justified they may be — or you may imagine them to be — are corrosive to your spirit. Please, stay who you are, the person whom I remember from my childhood, if but for a little longer."
            
            ... 
            
            "I am done recounting this tale," Kinu says abruptly. "Perhaps I should leave; there are matters I must attend to."
        ]
        
        ...A transparent pretext to escape. This conversation feels colder than the last similar one you had with her. Looking at Kinu as she [kinu.isInari
            |hops off the wall and heads back to the fields, you feel a knot tighten in the pit of your stomach. She looks a little — no, more than a little — downtrodden, and it's not because of what happened to her, not directly
            |gives you a bow and retreats, you feel a sinking feeling take hold in the pit of your stomach. That impeccably polite yet cold distance that hides sadness within its depths — and it's not because of what happened to her, at least not directly
        ]. [party.has kiyoko
            |Kiyoko and you watch your daughter retreat, then give each other a look.
            
            ...
            
            "Her words weigh on your mind, do they not, beloved?"
            
            ...They do.
            
            She takes your hand and squeezes it. "It's all right. I trust you."
            
            That means far more to you than she will ever know.
            
            Kiyoko smiles, then goes so far as to stick her tongue out at you. "I do not know about that, beloved. I think I already have a fairly good idea. Well then, shall we depart, too? Perhaps I can cheer you up after such heavy words have been bandied about."
            |You're left to mull over your own thoughts on the matter in silence, turning those last moments with Kinu over and over in your mind. Yet no matter how you frame them, they leave a bitter taste of the edge of your tongue.
            
            Maybe it's time you left, too... 
        ]

"[kinu.isInari
            |大概就是这么回事了。 [kinu.Dad]那些怪物在我们处于“道路之间”的时候试图攻击我们。我无法击败它们，但它们全都把注意力集中在我身上，这为我给了时间让琥珀和她的同伴们撤退，然后我自己也赶紧逃走了。直到一两天后，仁才来找我，告诉我琥珀也成功逃脱了。

那个小金狐狸怎么样了？

“虽然受到了惊吓，但并没有受伤。 [kinu.Dad]她的族人……有四个人和我们一起来到了柳木镇。有一个人没能活下来，另一个人现在卧床不起。虽然我并不真正知道他们的名字，但几天后我还是会去参加葬礼仪式；我……总觉得自己对发生在那里的事情负有责任。这是我最起码能做的。
            
            [party.has kiyoko
                |你的狐狸妻子轻轻清了清嗓子，她的表情平静而严肃，就像海洋表面下那轻轻荡漾的海啸波。“有件事需要讨论。”

“是什么事，母亲？难道您又要责备我吗？我不记得自己允许过你去那个大型原住民聚居地，而且如果没有得到别人的同意，小红也不会同意陪你去参加这样的活动的。是谁允许你去的呢？……能够活下来，我已经很幸运了，母亲。现在您真的非得问这样的问题吗？”

“如果你能够理解这一点，那么也许你已经开始逐渐变得明智起来，开始明白我之所以要向你强调这些规则，是有着原因的。我们稍后私下再讨论这个问题，你不能回避我的问题。
                
            ]
            一切都显得如此……尽管清子会开玩笑说你的大女儿似乎是一出生就已经老了，但实际上，小娟的人生经历也才十九年左右而已，当然，考虑到在星界中时间的流逝方式，这个数字可能会有一些出入。此刻看着她，你会突然意识到，其实你认识这个女儿的时间其实并不长，尽管在她看来，你们似乎已经是一家人很久了。如果她出了什么事……

小娟咬了咬嘴唇，将目光从你身上移开，显然她已经习惯了把自己内心的感受毫无保留地表现出来。“没关系的，”她说道。 [kinu.Dad]真的，就是这样。都已经第二次了，他还是没有意识到应该闭嘴，干脆直接杀了我算了。只要那个混蛋无法放下自己的傲慢，无法停止为自己的一切行为找借口，我就总能保持这个优势。”

依赖别人的弱点——换句话说，依赖那些自己无法控制的因素——确实无法让人对自己产生信心。

“正因如此，我也不会停止提升自己。 [kinu.Dad]唉，”小娟从她坐的位置上凑过来，侧身给了你一个拥抱。“相信我，好吗？这就是我唯一的要求。”

其实很难说出“可以”这个词。并不是因为她，而是因为——

“我明白的。 [kinu.Dad]我知道。”

小娟曾经是个天真无邪的孩子吗？她对死亡早已习以为常——你见过稻田里的鸭子和鲤鱼，而她的工作就是将这些活生生的生物变成可食用的食物。就连她心爱的农作物，到了傍晚也会被收回来……作为“丰收的女儿”，小娟非常清楚现实世界的种种状况与生活的真相，但这一次……真的还是一样吗？

“真的吗？ [kinu.Dad]我没事的。求你啦，如果你开始为我担心，那我也会开始为你担心的。你肯定不希望这样吧？”

“啊，你不应该这样溺爱你的女儿。”

小娟努力忍住笑意说道。[kinu.Dad]我其实是在要求你做完全相反的事情——不要宠着我。”

嗯……从技术上讲，她说的确实没错，但归根结底，她还是在要求你让她为所欲为，对吧？

叹了口气：“这种事情发生在我身上，肯定不会是最后一次。 [kinu.Dad]。 而且，以我的性格，我也并不认为在余下的生活中，只有他们会试图以任何方式伤害我和我的家人。你们也有自己需要处理的问题，所以请相信我，我会处理好自己的事情，好吗？

            “……天啊，这真的让人精疲力竭。我不太擅长用语言表达自己的想法。
            |这就是整个故事了。 [kinu.Dad]我们在“幽途”中行进时，遭到了刺客的袭击。我的力量远不如他们，但他们想要抓捕的人正是我，这一点就足以让我为柯白和她们的撤退争取时间。如果说在那场遭遇中我没有感到恐惧，那肯定是谎言——但我对自己身份与与生俱来的责任的铭记，帮助我度过了那些难关，否则我肯定无法成功逃脱。
            
            过了一两天，中野和他的几个下属才来看我；他们告诉我，琥珀已经回到了巢穴里。”

“安全地回来了吗？”

小娟将目光从你身上移开。她受到了惊吓，还受了些轻伤，但应该不会有大碍。和我们一起出发的四个人中，有一个人现在卧床不起，而另一个人……已经不在我们身边了。即使我知道他们的名字，我对他们的了解也还不够深入。几天后，我将参加逝者的葬礼仪式。他虽然是在执行我的任务时去世的，尽管这种死亡方式有些间接；但对于发生的一切，我负有责任。因此，我认为，我至少应该对我的未来的子民表达一些基本的尊重。
            
            [party.has kiyoko
                |你的狐狸妻子清了清嗓子，表情变得柔和起来：“啊，我可怜的女儿……你一定经历了许多艰难的事情……如果早知道会这样，也许我永远不会允许你去我们的祖宅探望的。我原本以为最糟糕的情况也不过是妹妹的后代会将你视为威胁……但现在的情况完全不同了，如果“通道之间”不再安全的话……

你的女儿低下了头，把耳朵贴在脑袋的两侧。母亲，让我担心您，实在让我感到抱歉。”

“您还活着，而且几乎没有受伤。我想，目前这一点就已经足够了。我们稍后私下再谈吧。
                
            ]
            一切都显得如此……尽管清子会开玩笑说你的大女儿似乎是一出生就已经老了，但实际上，小娟的人生经历也才十九年左右而已，当然，考虑到在星界中时间的流逝方式，这个数字可能会略有不同。此刻看着她，你会突然意识到，其实自己认识这个女儿的时间其实如此短暂，尽管在她们的生活中，她似乎早已成为了家庭中不可或缺的一部分。如果她出了什么事情……

……

小娟咬了咬嘴唇，强挤出一丝笑容；要是你不太了解你的这位“狐狸女儿”，你甚至可能会以为那是真心的笑容。没关系， [kinu.Dad]求你了。这已经是第二次有人以这种方式企图谋害我的性命了，而他仍然没有意识到自己应该少说多做。我认为，在某种程度上，这个人确实明白自己的行为是多么恶劣，因此他才需要为自己辩解——不是向我或他的下属辩解，而是向自己辩解。只要他心中怀有那种疑虑，他的表现就不会达到最佳状态。正因为如此，我们的战士阶层才需要严格的自我约束，以及坚定不移的忠诚与信念。
            
            依赖他人的弱点——换句话说，依赖那些她无法控制的因素——确实无法让人对你产生信任。

“我也没有说过自己会停止进步。 [kinu.Dad]唉，”小娟从她坐的位置上倾身过来，看起来像是想要侧身拥抱你一下，但最终还是改变了主意，恭敬地低下了头。“我只是希望你能信任我以及我的能力；它们已经两次帮助我度过了难关。真的很难说自己能够做到。并不是因为她，而是因为——”

“我明白。我之所以还能活着，不仅仅是因为自己的力量，也因为身边有这些人支持我。请也让他们来帮助我吧，而不只是你一个人。你已经肩负了太多其他的责任和负担了。 [kinu.Dad]凯努曾经是个天真无邪的孩子吗？她对死亡早已习以为常——至少，由于她的身份和血统，你的女儿从小就接受了关于祖国历史的教育。凯努非常清楚现实世界的残酷与生活的真相，但这一次……当这一切与她个人息息相关时，当她认识的人不再存在于这个世界上时，情况还是一样的吗？[kinu.Dad]…如果我出生在海洋的对岸，如果我也像我母亲那样，坐在首都这个所谓的“安全之地”，为我的家族操持政治事务，如果我也必须这样做的话……我面临的危险也同样不会减少。这样的人生，尤其是像我这样的人的人生，根本不可能有什么安全可言；承认这一点可能会让人感到痛苦，但事实就是如此。如果你为我担心，那我也就不得不为你担心了。这应该不是你想要看到的吧？啊，你不应该那样宠溺你的女儿。

小娟试图掩饰自己的笑容，但作为一个年轻女孩，她的真实感受其实很难被完全看透。[kinu.Dad]我的要求其实是不要被宠坏。”

“嗯……从技术上讲确实是这样，但她不还是在要求你让她为所欲为吗？”

小娟叹了口气，把其中一条尾巴拿在手里，轻轻抚摸着那柔软的毛皮。“看看现在殖民地这边以及大洋对岸的局势，我实在怀疑这会不会真的是最后一次尝试了[kinu.dad]。 而且，考虑到我的身份和出身，这些人也绝不会是我这一生中唯一会对我怀有恶意的人。你们有自己的任务要完成，所以请允许我去做我自己的事吧。

            “……任务，就是把这类事情称为任务。啊，只要有足够的时间，即便是最危险的事情，对像我这样的人来说，也会变得平淡无奇。
        ]
        
        第一次听到这些话时，小娟的话语中蕴含着一种隐忍的绝望，背后隐藏着一种强烈的渴望——渴望相信这些话是真实的。而这一次，她的话语中只有一种同样压抑的无奈，一种对现实的无声接受，一种承认自己确实看到了那些事情，也确实经历过那些经历，哪怕那只是短暂的一瞬间而已。也许是因为你真正与她共度的时光实在太短了，所以她才被迫如此快地长大……你是不是觉得，如果那十年的时光你都能陪在女儿身边，甚至更久一些，情况会不会有所不同呢？也许吧，但你心里始终怀疑事情并不会真的如你所愿那样发展。

无论如何，你都一定会履行自己的承诺——在野外找到那个拉斐尔混蛋，然后以最残忍、最痛苦的方式彻底消灭他，就因为他敢那样对待你的女儿。如果他连挖出她的眼睛、割掉她的耳朵、折断她所有的手指都敢威胁的话，我们就看看他承受这些痛苦的能力，是否和他施加痛苦的能力一样强。

小娟的嘴角微微下垂，说道：[kinu.isInari
            |[kinu.Dad]请不要那样做。
            |[kinu.Dad]请避免此类行为。
        ]为什么？

她闭上眼睛，双手合十。[kinu.isInari
            |她边说边紧紧地攥着它们。“这……这对你没有好处。我不想因为我的缘故，让你变成一个我都不认识的人。”

……

“我得走了。 [kinu.Dad]今天我还有事情要办，”小娟突然说道，“总不能让那些萝卜在田里烂掉吧？ 
            | 请保持你原来的样子，那个我童年时期记忆中的你，哪怕只是再坚持一会儿也好。”

……

“我讲完了这个故事，”小娟突然说道，“或许我应该离开了，还有些事情需要我去处理。
        ]
        
        ……这不过是一个用来逃避责任的借口罢了。这次谈话，比你上次与她进行的类似谈话还要冷淡。看着小娟[kinu.isInari
            |她从墙上跳下来，朝着田野方向跑去，你感到胃里突然一阵紧缩。她看起来……不，不仅仅是看起来，而是明显显得很沮丧，而这种沮丧并非直接源于发生在她身上的事情
            |她向你鞠了一躬然后退了下去，你顿时感到一股寒意涌上心头。那种表面上看似彬彬有礼、实则充满冷漠的距离，其实隐藏着深深的悲伤——而这种悲伤，至少并非直接源于她所经历的事情
        ]。 [party.has kiyoko
            |清子和你看着你们的女儿走远，然后彼此对视了一眼。

……

“她的话让你心里很不好受，对吧，亲爱的？”

……

确实如此。
            
            她握住你的手，轻轻捏了捏。“没关系的，我相信你。”

这对你来说，意味着远远超过她所能想象的东西。

清子微笑着，甚至还朝你吐了吐舌头。这个我就不清楚了，亲爱的。不过我想我已经有了一个相当不错的想法。那么，我们该出发了吧？也许在说了这么多沉重的话之后，我能够让你的心情好一些。
            |你只能独自静静地思考这件事，一遍又一遍地在脑海中回放与小娟共度的那些最后时刻。然而，无论你如何梳理这些回忆，它们总会在你舌尖留下苦涩的味道。

或许，你也该离开了…… 
        ]
